b01c3662b93cb30efaf48dd1e2581326fc8a31f4.text: The daily limit for creating new projects was increased from one to three. This allows more projects to be made each day before the count resets at midnight Pacific time.

081bdb229790aa903da4ba4462827ba867139ff3.text: The border around the referral banner changed color to a softer, muted tone. This small visual update aligns the banner with the rest of the application's quieter design palette.

633c256122a18c49ab89171fbcf977a4370c4658.text: The assistant no longer guesses where you are when asking for content. It only shares that detail if you explicitly provide it.

d0de3f5b1cbd70534b9d6c36f0dfc9c77ae8f92b.text: Some AI options now show a 'TEST' badge to warn that they are new and may not work perfectly. The system also records when users click the cloud connection button to help improve the service.

9e48fc62b994946fb6f5412439bc458c0c222904.text: A new coding assistant is now available in the web picker. Another model's description changed, and it is now marked as a premium feature.

05e61796b1e972e04d7ab08ff3ec77fa2d6808ce.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant guessed message size instead of measuring it accurately for some users. This ensures the assistant stays within its memory limits without needing extra setup.

25bcff7a78ced153e5d55e161619e48ffdb74ddb.text: The site now records when someone copies the command used to set up the tool from the main page. This helps the team understand how many people are trying to get started.

d0b938bca49fdf28e96d4a4079bcf350946b2f6f.text: The assistant's core instructions were simplified and updated to better support different usage modes. This internal cleanup helps the tool follow rules more clearly but does not change how you interact with it.

4fe98d8c048b271a57a32a41c6e79a114f39cb93.text: A small internal update was made to the packaging of the software. This change does not add new features or fix any bugs for users.

0a6df5765585fe3da17d92272fbce28be74bc127.text: Ads now appear between parts of the assistant's answers, not just at fixed spots in the chat. This lets the ads change based on how long the response is.

304f8c16ed581066ab94ad28f4f3d6ab3642865f.text: When you turn off the review option, the assistant no longer checks your work for errors. It only runs basic tests, making the process faster and simpler.

0deed0f9ae60e3d338e71d7077fe4180e21277f4.text: The app now sends commands to the computer in plain text instead of scrambled code. This stops security tools from blocking the app and keeps the actions visible for review.

f0d966458519ffa59de0fbce27fad27f0ac7a047.text: The app now runs its background tasks on its main server instead of a separate helper service. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

4afa065433a1f7c99574755052324ab24fc7bd1c.text: The assistant now offers a new AI model for web users. This option does not appear in the desktop app or command line yet.

e40725574901bc9196b956db9113351627654769.text: The free version of the assistant now uses only the newer, faster model. The older option is gone.

fd36250a7af2416544869fa2694916edfd81b6d2.text: The app now checks its own code more reliably without needing extra setup steps first. This small internal fix helps developers catch errors sooner, but you will not notice a difference while using the product.

6ab789012e6e8f3f43e22246828cb88f0c7a0a80.text: The system now recognizes a paid version of a specific AI model. This allows users to select this upgraded option for tasks requiring higher quality or capability.

f7828c2c4b5a55de46b00f0484ed047e091d0964.text: The assistant now runs on a dedicated background service to handle tasks more reliably. This internal change improves performance and stability without altering how you interact with the product.

778ce13d412dcf87de7eec8b2732d27aa9c35c3a.text: The assistant now counts the size of your conversations more accurately, especially when images are involved. This prevents the system from thinking your messages are much larger than they actually are, which helps avoid unnecessary cuts to your chat history.

3966fa98790b1983323c0e71526c781353ab17ea.text: A new AI model is hidden from the list of options you can choose. If you already use this model, it keeps working without change.

48803a249a48035e7f3c3041d5f704b233720a4c.text: Fixed a bug where terminal commands on Windows could cause garbled text to appear on screen. Commands now run quietly in the background, preventing interference with the application's display.

5ab9f24e10c3cafc301fe1eb3838c0c54008806f.text: Fixed how the assistant reads tool instructions. It now counts words correctly and avoids errors when using complex tools.

10ec4e5ad003a6c5bd72ba98ad322469581d3d69.text: The tool now reads files outside the project folder. This allows it to access other locations on your computer.

dc8f236d73ec651b392b4dbb09a8826258f12666.text: The app now sends private, anonymous updates to Reddit when you first see a prompt or stay active for one, seven, or twenty-four days. This helps Reddit measure how well their ads bring users to the app, without sharing your personal details or usage history.

c59bde7fe2f90f0e25b0ce36a1d8856ec8ccfa5f.text: The assistant now shows helpful tips at the end of its answers instead of in the middle, so reading is smoother. The app also works more reliably on Windows computers.

07ab1c6445e0e36697f749f10d34eccea254b5e5.text: The system now records clearer, organized notes about its activity. This internal change helps support teams diagnose issues faster.

2a0165cd6654c96138ebf48279da6271d3edb8d9.text: The assistant now checks for missing data labels before sending requests. This prevents errors when the assistant uses certain tools.

afc82b86ff83681ec1cf4e282c9cf930f7806eac.text: The software's internal packaging was updated. You will not notice any changes while using it.

bd166f455bc3bee08e35e0cc212e4da6fbbe4f15.text: The app now automatically tries again when the internet connection briefly drops. This helps prevent errors from stopping your work.

fe1d484e63713352e7fa5bbc033a1171fbed39c7.text: The tool now lets you save chat history and activity logs to a custom folder. This helps keep your files organized without affecting other settings.

30819406bcc40a132d363f3ac2bceb285ad06031.text: The team made a small internal change to how the assistant checks if it is connected to your account. This helps the developers test the software more easily without affecting how you use it.

04d67d73b9052e63dead5ad1a6cf6bbe76c4cd2e.text: The Kimi AI model is no longer available for free use. If you previously selected it, you must now choose a different model to continue.

7f595c4c0634c855c18f0cfb325c173392e3bd61.text: The app now shows a clearer message while your free session starts up. It no longer displays old waiting-room text.

e8a95a27ac79ae26a56a5fa8d8e9904471ec4423.text: The assistant now skips a background check when counting words in free mode. This makes responses appear faster and reduces strain on the service. Paid plans still use the full check for accuracy.

cee618d4b5a9d00053d9955262595b276fd7ea1e.text: Messages are now held back when your session ends to prevent failed sends. They automatically resume once you are active again.

8151087175d6205542190ed092126bdd19ae4130.text: If the assistant loses its connection during a chat, your message is now saved and sent again automatically, so it won't disappear.

85ccc41bab5e0ee15d2cd97f2230055f4f2984b2.text: The app now limits free users to one open window at a time, no matter which model they pick.

4f5a72d6b85c9521b28248e359c11719cf6d55c4.text: Developers fixed an internal tool that handles activity logs. This prevents crashes and keeps records tidy, making the app more stable.

030a4c60e51b5da6ad04a6ac3e3470a7ce53b874.text: The company added a test to see how you react to different ads in the chat area. You might see a new ad format or the usual one, and the system will track which version you click on.

22aa19aade611c31aff555cc55f280c653910fe7.text: The software now finds the correct web address more reliably. This prevents the app from loading the wrong page when used in different places.

671c093077dc5cd74ab2b1892c7c134d84c8fbd8.text: The app now loads your past chats faster by checking a small summary file first, instead of reading every message from scratch. It also stops cutting off old messages, so your full conversation history is kept.

4ea700cd6ebb12e204b37095f477a2e8fd5955b5.text: The app now records when users click 'send now' in the desktop queue. This helps the company understand how often people use this feature. You will not see any changes to how the app works.

77cfee986c1b3e6fd7fffc5b37bb7c4028a30446.text: You can now stop tasks that take too long. When you cancel, the system shuts down the search, download, or command completely, so no work continues in the background.

b88380a4c48c5a1dfe12d788f62d794c5df7db57.text: The app now saves chats in a way that prevents data loss if it crashes or closes suddenly. It also shows unreadable chat histories instead of hiding them, and starts new chats with unique identifiers to avoid overwriting previous conversations.

effaebabd70b475f18cd90481cc6cbc88c5ff9e3.text: If the app crashes or closes while it is working, your request and any progress it made are now saved. You won't lose your work or have to start over.

a07d73d1f0bdd5f9c47d64423d3837d59bcb2309.text: The assistant now finds the correct web address every time it runs, instead of using one saved at build time. This stops it from trying to connect to a private, unreachable address when working on remote servers.

d304465cf1503c0d27dc79e6ffaf252657fe922c.text: The desktop app now records when you see or click sponsored ads in transcripts. This helps the company understand how ads perform on desktop.

e6af6ff08ba0ed02b362aae22b208e554fd5f74a.text: The assistant now remembers its own instructions better, avoiding rare crashes during complex tasks. This internal fix makes the software more stable for everyone.

122933fd79cf8b99c6346050f96fc8dc56649141.text: The login screen now pulls its web address from a central list instead of having it written in multiple places. This small internal fix ensures the app always connects to the correct service if that address ever changes.

55f61ffc60b73ecdfb31f8d649e85e4ff3086c0b.text: The daily bonus banner now shows for users on the limited tier, not just full access. This means you see a quiet line about your capped free sessions instead of the big unlock card.

fe8de7d67497f25e3d80567e07554ae28a82a6e0.text: The software's internal release number increased. This update does not add new features or change how the program works for users.

f8b3b17b3ed642b2fb5d7bea14d33db9aa340651.text: The app now starts a session directly instead of showing a waiting room first. This internal change does not affect how the product works for you.

f67bb803bda67f875fd14647d3f3458e56e732fb.text: The assistant's internal setup process was cleaned up to be safer and more reliable. This is a small technical change that will not affect how you use the product.

b5b0f9c223124e9746e9faa8d3d5e96978262dc9.text: The tool received a small internal update. This change does not affect how you use it.

e90202304629a44f84287728ac07d150354508a2.text: The top choice in the free model list changed to a different option. This only affects the default order you see; all other models remain available and work exactly as before.

b10e9ab1644601375492fa771f2acd2088b27429.text: The assistant now bundles its reasoning and actions together correctly for specific models. This fixes errors that caused the assistant to fail. You should see fewer glitches when using these models.

f65992d39adda73162606b55c07b364ca8afa181.text: The app now stops waiting for a connection after twenty seconds if it gets stuck. This prevents the loading screen from spinning forever, letting you try again sooner.

bfaad48713d14b4e948a6ad49a2c6f79d6cb250c.text: The system now records when a referral reward fails due to strict rules, helping it spot suspicious activity. This keeps rewards fair and prevents people from gaming the system.

03843a6a7999022e6a7cb133ae6a3d5e8bd851f5.text: The system now blocks referrals for accounts older than 30 days and limits how many referral records one user can create to stop spam.

f1a5a202b3505df7216651ab21560dd053faf148.text: The program now checks your computer's ability to handle advanced math more accurately. This helps it run faster without guessing about your hardware.

6937a4a1d869a5d878d178a2c3b57d4ae6f75562.text: The software now records when a chat title changes on your computer. This internal update helps the team understand how people use the product.

1576d8cceceddde2310b475e1dbe0f0f0add67d5.text: The rule requiring a GitHub account to be at least one year old to join referral programs was lowered to four months. More users can now qualify for referral perks regardless of which product they use.

0eb5e08fac20277f02c9f486b6176610e73431da.text: Free users outside the main supported regions can now create only one new project per day. This limit resets at midnight Pacific time.

79127c26ba4d555c14ad85e5f16539447f4a81b8.text: The desktop app now uses a single shared identity for its hosted assistant. This internal cleanup allows the full set of models to appear in the picker without separate setups.

92a719efa08071eb2c6f0eb67079416304201adb.text: The app now records every action from desktop users instead of just a small random sample. This helps the team understand how people use the desktop version more accurately.

3f6c218fcf769874ed0dbdd7ffac50e3294db19e.text: The app now recognizes when a premium spot is full and waits correctly instead of guessing. This stops it from acting strangely during busy times.

15c9fe6c7e7bff8436ca2e3f48cb699de7d56c55.text: The desktop app now limits how many premium AI models you can use at once to prevent overload. If you try to open a new chat with a premium model while one is already running, the app will let you switch tabs or close the old chat to make room.

90210bb6a19dd9ee6bdc4f322668619399caa166.text: The app now records what kind of account you have when it sends a message. This helps the company understand how different users experience the service. You do not need to do anything.

c7df706d4a2306da3d645b3d5091a718f0b057bc.text: The waiting room now shows which rewards you have earned from your daily streak. This prevents the system from offering bonuses that are currently unavailable.

a60a6abccdfcbbe6d3a72c17ed86dbc03810876a.text: Pressing the tab key now fills in the typed command instead of running it. The app also tracks daily use and grants extra sessions after seven consecutive days.

b4989d0c77187ca908ff2417b1dfd4e68be25818.text: The referral banner and waiting room now keep their borders and buttons from squashing or overlapping other text when the window is small.

454dcd2c72790576154d4ed6cc68d96bf47dad96.text: The assistant can now accept new instructions while working on a task, instead of stopping to restart. This allows you to guide the assistant mid-task without losing progress.

425e9cb485d05a34b93c2abdf22a8e980fc2effb.text: The system now records details about how quickly and successfully it creates titles for new chats. This helps the team spot problems and improve the feature's speed.

a64b9c03fd75cad359bf64f3c82b1bc7651a2bc4.text: The system now records key steps in the referral process. This helps the company understand how well referrals work.

9e61e4b90860c77829c87b675c5a7f002276ef9d.text: The assistant now shows clearer reasons when a tool fails to load, instead of just saying it stopped working. If one tool breaks, the others still work, so you can keep using the rest of the features.

2cb4fc339e109217ef4fba773241100ee66680f0.text: The system now requires all accounts to be at least one year old to qualify for referral rewards, replacing stricter rules for some tools and looser rules for others. Daily free session bonuses from limited referrals are also capped to prevent excessive rewards.

6e063e113c757309a151e1c78b52ebca7a12c0e6.text: The system now better recognizes regular internet service providers, schools, and businesses as safe. This prevents ordinary users from being mistakenly flagged as suspicious.

5824dc1d4e6d9948220ac83e68c0254f775f08c7.text: The system now checks for several different signs to confirm it is ready, instead of relying on just one. This helps prevent startup errors for users.

ca8ddb859a773965c2058c74e401c818650f92d9.text: The waiting room screen is gone. After picking a model, you start chatting right away.

3c9348e961a86ace862cbc3c379eb2c2cb4fc703.text: Automatic checks that test the service's live connection now run only when explicitly enabled. This change affects only the internal testing setup and does not alter how the product works for you.

b3c3decd0afb7d08f0ab70a80070a316c1547bab.text: The assistant now checks for new skills directly from your device's storage first, instead of relying on a temporary memory. This means any skill you install or update will be available for use immediately, without needing to restart the session.

8a96d48d79d02c951416f047ba4d2b269407b584.text: The app now counts how many minutes you spend actively using it. This helps understand usage patterns without affecting your experience.

bf6d1e5e2016e11d155092e0e93ad17493db7a12.text: The app updated its internal records to mark a new release. This change does not affect how you use the product.

82827cafd83ff35bc18530e2729ccf86ee4497f4.text: The software's internal packaging was updated to a newer version. This change does not affect how you use the product.

d1fb7fdf239e8a306f7d31a19fd4de4fa4ab58e0.text: The assistant now suggests three follow-up questions after answering you. This helps guide your next step without you needing to think of what to ask.

00b24d0ffa5d006b4e9d830de87f5df772cbcc8e.text: The assistant switched its free, fast model from DeepSeek to MiniMax. This internal update does not change how you use the product.

eebd6089f2b07ee217e4367ccdf074effed29364.text: You can now use your keyboard to move between the model list and the referral banner buttons. This makes it easier to copy your invite link or use a specific model without reaching for your mouse.

dd3e1e6aa9ef1bd11f446bb4cca0ceaf1ac3e89b.text: The invitation link button no longer gets cut off when the screen is narrow. The text showing how many people have joined now wraps neatly instead of being squeezed together.

ec42536f50943a38138d63621738bf4a4e5bfa8f.text: The referral banner now includes a button to easily copy your personal invitation link, which takes friends to a special welcome page. Full members see this banner, but it is hidden for free users.

1bac5606860ccd893adeb9188103fde0d2bb93f6.text: The assistant can now use a new model if you invite friends. This model is hidden from the main menu but shown in a special banner.

43301d5fd2bcb9bdf1e0f3fc26a14de115359d84.text: The app now records how new users find it, especially through Reddit ads. This internal tracking helps the team understand which links bring people to the product, without changing how the app looks or works for you.

6e8e17d890d006bf4ee5a2545d18ed9fac02f01e.text: The app now quietly records steps during the initial setup to help improve the experience. This is a small internal update with no visible changes to how you use the product.

3e442f817a080ee0f2ac2ecd86193db9e2c7349f.text: The tool now remembers your anonymous usage history across sessions. This means your activity counts as one continuous record instead of restarting every time you open the program.

750dc9aaa60a81d5716bfe47380a859dd7159720.text: The planning and review features no longer require a specific account connection. They automatically use the model you selected.

979954f98423e67c331525052c100358fa1f97a4.text: The app now records when sign-in starts, fails, times out, or is stopped. This helps the team see where people get stuck during login.

c0d984a61fa18c7fdb06b8132b63d3134abf5816.text: The app now remembers your referral offer, so the banner stays visible even when your session status changes. Streak indicators also cap at seven days to avoid confusing visuals.

0b97b6efd524e5044a6c7b31e20a7a748326feff.text: The software tool was updated to a newer build. You may see a small improvement when you use it.

feb051debac2365daf253d424385b6c6e57ec64a.text: The team updated a background tool that helps run the product. This change is internal and small. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

692bf102f5e653d85d43fc32883c4d8366c537ef.text: The help pages now point to one main guide so instructions are easier to find. The list of available AI models was updated to show which ones work in the full version.

ff16426abdc93feb759df1e90f94539e877a07ca.text: The program's internal label was updated to mark a new release. This change does not affect how you use the product.

95a1156a6015112ed1b82cb897df77395b0fd5b0.text: When choosing an AI model, the highlighted option now shows a 'Press Enter' hint. This helps you know exactly when to press the key to make your selection.

b9439256f51364c82f6d6a551a213ae995a8813c.text: When the model menu closes, a larger logo appears to fill the empty space.

538768ba9aaf73180427a125c12e05edf67fbbd6.text: The countdown timer for resetting usage limits now shows up right away, even if you have not used your premium features yet. This change ensures you always see when your limits will refresh, rather than waiting until you start using them.

edacbeb3609c311a58aac127c5264255149302df.text: The company updated its name in legal documents and test data. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

637bdf14fa0443c9539f6550eeb64ae129fb55c6.text: The tool now records when you send a message. This helps measure how many people use it daily.

2e94bb23cc19832c25dad3b04883f71a44fdd998.text: The count of remaining premium sessions now appears in the model selection menu. This makes it easier to check your usage limits without looking elsewhere on the screen.

a4f5d94ecbd0e09f41c432abf7115b65eb498f3e.text: The tool now sends usage details to the company's logs before you sign in. This helps the team understand how many people try the product but never complete the login.

cd4e11ce2c5b9b4f3a216ab5c0f02dcfeac333e3.text: Suggested prompts now appear at the top of the chat window. They only show up during active conversations, not during reviews or when a session ends.

747abe3c717770a91c955c6e004da6e4154eb159.text: The program's internal update number changed. This release includes no new features or fixes for users.

59f2ba13cee05f37282e74d3738adfe15633ef31.text: The program now tries three times to start if it hangs. This helps it work better on some computers.

25b6dde3bbfade9e2e2423e30c20766f5c73d2b9.text: The team released a new version of the command-line tool. This update only changes the version number to keep track of releases. Users will not notice any difference in how the tool works.

43d2681d423104d649f6809fe00414f57b212420.text: The tool's internal packaging was updated to a new release. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

de1f1f716ab020ce631b126794f4de1a48daa13f.text: Daily usage limits for all referral tiers increased. Standard and premium model caps rose across every level, allowing more requests per day.

a94090ee7b615e9cb447b239791b4a5fb1dde283.text: The basic version now uses a different artificial intelligence to answer questions. You do not need to change any settings.

a54b61094c5a8b141e2d1f4dd365e538ffb8529c.text: The program now shows only its top suggestion at startup, letting you begin immediately by pressing enter. You can still expand the list to see other options. The privacy warning for one model was removed because it no longer sends your data for training.

7f85312af394fa37a87011970442a28c6c728292.text: The assistant now uses more powerful thinking modes for tricky tasks and bugs. It ignores slower options to keep your experience fast.

d38aa87d8f52653a6efbd545aba736173cf07a89.text: The assistant now tracks which specific helper model handled each part of its thought process. This ensures reasoning is correctly attributed to the right helper, such as the Gemini thinker.

ccac201df6fc4a1ab037a5d13c930a49e65459fe.text: The help section now clarifies that users in restricted regions can still earn referral rewards, but only for standard free models. Premium models remain unavailable in these areas, so rewards do not apply to them.

f0c65d3132424eafe090f368fc5615f2ced05c62.text: The tool now sends its activity records to the service to help improve it. This happens automatically in the background and does not affect how you use the product.

e459f2a24426424306293d667cef2ef135ed1cbc.text: The assistant now uses a newer, more capable model for its most advanced features. This update aims to improve the quality of responses and task completion.

be22023ea98700318566f36138d9cd5c6fe9eddb.text: A behind-the-scenes test was adjusted to allow the assistant a few more steps and stricter reading rules. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

f0766573fad36c88ba482c7873e7054124140720.text: The assistant now remembers the correct source for information when using tools, instead of guessing. This small fix makes sure answers stay linked to the right place.

4999c63158f0f57c511141ac4277be73ca153b19.text: The software's internal release label changed slightly. This update only affects how the program is packaged for distribution. Users will see no change in how the tool works.

957b9d654a945dcb47e4d91b473f0212e1565ad3.text: The command-line tool no longer crashes when it tries to open a web page on some computer setups. You can now use it normally without unexpected errors.

874c8ec4aabb8c0db77ffe375d5edd248402a83a.text: The assistant can now use a new coding model. This gives you an additional option for writing and fixing code.

7f268e15a4c0210e7b041f3cbb2265db15d97167.text: The assistant now strictly follows the current setup for identifying itself, ignoring any leftover information from previous sessions. This internal cleanup ensures the assistant's behavior matches the active configuration without relying on old data.

8118a50f77cd572f2b9a82fb5e8525e23aec4d25.text: The model menu now shows time limits and special status notes directly below the choices. These details hide automatically if your window is too small to fit them.

9d9e3f15ad1e2fd45a3501a73a9ea9d5acc8ed79.text: The assistant can now suggest third-party services with correct setup links. It also tracks which product you use to make sure clicks are counted for the right one.

9c8af8c79c36649273421ef43e515b2fffe63be3.text: When your main folder is set to your entire home directory, the file picker now scans only nearby folders instead of turning off completely. This keeps the tool responsive while still letting you select files from top-level areas.

0a3669024953392e5c7b6171940113766df9c728.text: The assistant now spots when a connection to the network goes quiet for too long. Instead of showing a confusing error, it gives clear advice on how to fix your internet connection.

6142b8be692c47b91afbaaced3ad6e433ab47175.text: If security software blocks the program from starting, it now shows a clear message and closes safely instead of crashing with confusing errors.

ff6f49149b964e3c2f917756c7979cb61ecffe8d.text: The assistant now cleans up unfinished tasks when stopped, preventing hidden data from lingering. Memory usage is also capped to keep the app running smoothly over long sessions.

53e9e1ac09bee289c4fe62535ad8eaa07a6f2ff1.text: The sign-in link sometimes wrapped onto a second line, so copying it only grabbed part of the address. A new warning now tells you to press 'c' to copy the full link.

370bbb64e5b86de777b8ded4303ad082fcf80b06.text: The service now checks if a friend's account is at least four months old before counting their sign-up. This stops people from creating new accounts to get extra free features.

778c6c18965612446c6b4fb568cba5120399fd94.text: The assistant now skips its internal quality check when you only ask questions or make plans, rather than changing code. This makes responses faster and saves system resources.

a6455dbd1cff1467ef80a3c7ce9d364e19756b09.text: The assistant now uses a newer, more capable model for complex tasks and an updated version for general work. This change is internal and aims to improve the quality of its responses.

f5aebdb4bd86f3c4c97f01039705133a9fd2eb8f.text: The app now checks web links more carefully before opening them. This stops it from accidentally connecting to hidden internal systems, keeping your data safer.

5f95e26baf6768feb52cc5e67519b4cede3d4a63.text: The web version now limits free users to five sessions per hour and blocks access from anonymous networks. Two specific AI models remain available for unlimited use by these free web users.

38844c7040fd9dd3eedac0755f87c6bfe6b1f75a.text: The chat assistant can now open a separate web research helper. This helper searches the internet for fresh information and cites its sources.

6c85a772586aa5d0ba7760d5ee1cad1723317bf0.text: The chat assistant now uses a faster service to answer questions, which may slightly reduce its ability to handle complex tasks. This change only affects the main chat page and does not change how other tools or the command line work.

f63541370c2725c95b8e38a776ce4c91402c2f7f.text: The research assistant now checks several sources before answering. It refuses to give a final response until it has read enough pages to be sure.

c63b7942c4944f02b89d0326a45adaa3d0c3ff45.text: The chat feature now uses a new, simpler assistant model that focuses only on your latest message. This change is internal and does not add new visible features.

e72bcc94a0acd7187855a568de78d5e8cfc49f74.text: Some AI models stopped working if the assistant tried to reply first. Now, the system always sends your question to them first, fixing the error.

937787d54b56ca6ee152ff1bb454214701601916.text: The assistant can now use two new underlying engines. This lets it switch to a more capable version for complex tasks while using a faster one for simpler requests.

7754f72e80e57678d648b9170a9bc725d31066a6.text: When the service is busy, the waiting screen now explains that the delay is due to model availability rather than account restrictions. It also clearly labels whether you are using standard or premium sessions.

241cc5bcc2452ac764d35c7d3557bd9490b1a852.text: Pressing Enter now works correctly on some newer keyboards. Before, it might have acted like you held the Alt key, changing your text instead of sending it.

323d5e50a72afae4df7bd73a04c94ded077e8d8c.text: The update tool received a minor internal adjustment. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

5d29036496273c2e61ccc2fb490f9c49826cc980.text: When the service is too busy, the app now shows the specific reason instead of a vague error. This helps you understand if a provider is overloaded so you know when to try again.

ac888447c1bb269cec8476262a11cf270b02942c.text: The software received a minor internal update for packaging. Users will not notice any changes in features or performance.

44cbd349993e6f82827d8ca66c2b3dcf6634ce31.text: The assistant can now use a new model to review your code. This means you get feedback on your work without needing to pay for a premium plan.

209f11b0fb3bcd73c25e68d691e48144f7cc001d.text: The ad display system was reorganized internally. Users will see the same ads, but chat screens now show only the first ad instead of a list.

7715a97463b9c6609c1f9e3a5d32eaf9449fb6dd.text: New users now default to a smarter assistant that handles images and text. Daily usage limits stay the same.

409f05fafae7718d0ff9fa5979f74f309b7bc5c0.text: In certain online coding environments, the assistant now recognizes when automatic clipboard copying is blocked by the system. Instead of failing silently, it provides clear instructions for manually copying text using a specific key combination.

f219b409368e128adf95153f694aabf896189c0e.text: The app now uses a different AI model by default for new conversations. This change affects only the starting choice, not your existing chats.

3deed7d21a3488df1deed4440a635321ec6bb445.text: The app now shows how many sessions you have left to start, rather than how many you have already used. This makes it easier to see if you can begin a new session immediately.

38401ec1b8df4542b80b71d41256a043e08f29be.text: The free assistant now uses a newer model instead of the previous one. This change is internal and mostly affects the quality of responses.

293172345e45adda8b4ab9be0546a1b5614ad09c.text: The active session summary now shows used units instead of remaining units, matching other screens.

e39f9da8bc239a0b8c08ee3014e7ec7c2a287c41.text: Added a new premium AI option for the free assistant. You can now choose this model if you have a premium account.

f34d91198316b40f048582b71a9aa915bac94a52.text: This internal update lets the system test specific tool setups more easily. It does not change how the product works for users.

270a776296bc67ae0369762cf91bc6b047ec9f69.text: The system now marks certain models as 'premium' or 'multimodal'. This lets the app show badges for premium models and limit their daily use, while also allowing multimodal models to process images.

ec6049895f39b81037265dc2dc4ec8ee4577161a.text: A small internal check was updated to match how the system describes a specific setting. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

2c743c61f11ee2f2df023ddf95b3268ed4737b07.text: The new model now shows a warning that it collects data for training. It also appears second in the model list, right after the previous top option.

56b18a1960ad0c308f1b210f01aa7b0fac0b98f0.text: The command-line tool received a minor update.

bc2e521ae7126000175fdb40f34658c9a358d7ff.text: The app now skips an extra review step for free users, fixes a bug that stopped some tasks from loading, and allows pausing without crashing.

fe118aa3f6950ee3cc04197a155e65dc87a57339.text: The system now uses a more capable default assistant for general requests. This means responses may be smarter or more detailed without changing any settings.

a7e0fa38f02a212b5209e1dfcd97f866d9cba34e.text: The assistant's description was corrected to use proper grammar. You may notice a small wording change in the menu.

360988f0ed5f75d567ab892ee251a9fa0fcde802.text: The assistant now checks live service lists instead of guessing from memory, improving accuracy. The command-line tool also displays actions as clear, bold subcommands.

89ef2b771d74e90e173c03c80e5a0b7e1285932f.text: Menu buttons now show simple action words and look cleaner with outlines. The assistant can also use new models that understand both text and images.

9de3b7019af2014d6245280c7808e2a92afeeed1.text: A check for a specific product description was removed from internal tests. This change does not affect the product or how you use it.

4642c507f8c5fe9034ddd46a98554ba964cb16db.text: The assistant now tracks which search or service request belongs to your current session. This helps the system show more accurate results and manage access permissions correctly.

ce77a82c508d26c25c88f298f9d65f4ff224125f.text: The assistant now suggests follow-up questions in all modes. This makes it easier to keep the conversation going.

8ae0c9c1da31404dd515238cb4e196c13c2872fc.text: The assistant now detects when it gets stuck in a loop of repeating the same task updates. It automatically tries to fix this behavior, and if that fails, it stops the response to prevent endless repetition.

6200a7bfdbdb111a8b2b94680839ae774b78dc41.title: scripts/delete-user.ts Postgres deletion script
6200a7bfdbdb111a8b2b94680839ae774b78dc41.summary: New scripts/delete-user.ts enables targeted Postgres user deletion via email or ID. Defaults to dry-run; requires --execute and interactive TTY or --yes to commit. Scope limited to Postgres: Stripe, BigQuery, and Loops remain untouched. --delete-owned-orgs extends cascade to org rows; otherwise execution halts if user owns orgs.

9468967ece2e1fcecf85d2f09903b4ec5fd97702.title: Replace cleanup, meta, review skills with simplify
9468967ece2e1fcecf85d2f09903b4ec5fd97702.summary: Consolidated three agent skills (`cleanup`, `meta`, `review`) into a single `simplify` skill. The new skill instructs the agent to review the entire change with fresh eyes to find design and implementation simplification opportunities. Covers the `.agents/skills/` directory.

0491f53a1259429a483e3099e04d576cbb5e5072.title: Local agent discovery skips nodemodules, scripts, skills dirs
0491f53a1259429a483e3099e04d576cbb5e5072.summary: SDK `load-agents.ts` adds `shouldSkipAgentDirectory` to exclude `node_modules`, `scripts`, `skills`, and `skills-*` from local agent scanning. File filtering moves to `isLoadableAgentFileName`, which now rejects `.d.ts` and test/spec files via regex instead of simple suffix checks. This prevents non-agent files from being loaded during local agent discovery. Scope limited to `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts`.

87a6812a3ad19cd2f3132214ce5034886777c02d.title: Update gpt-5.2, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4 pricing
87a6812a3ad19cd2f3132214ce5034886777c02d.summary: Input, cached, and output token costs for gpt-5.2, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-5.3-codex, and gpt-5.4 in web/src/llm-api/openai.ts. gpt-5.4 output cost rises to 15, while gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.3-codex shift to 14. Scope limited to core pricing constants; no CLI or UI logic changes. Cached input rates scale proportionally with base input costs.

89a10d6afc6fa78b3a7f001542950aae6e48307d.title: Fix wrapper terminal reset for help output
89a10d6afc6fa78b3a7f001542950aae6e48307d.summary: CLI wrapper now conditionally applies terminal reset sequences to prevent `--help` output erasure. `resetTerminal` defaults to safe sequences (mouse/cursor/paste), only exiting alternate screen (`?1049l`) after interactive children or Windows crashes. Scope covers `cli/release-staging/index.js`, `cli/release/index.js`, and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js`. Added `shouldExitAlternateScreen` logic to detect signals or Windows native crash codes (`0xC000001D`, `0xC0000005`, `0xC0000409`).

61c1eefd5999cb4bd2d8367929e3016eb6e2d69f.title: Remove GLM 5.1 from Freebuff model registry and agent configs
61c1eefd5999cb4bd2d8367929e3016eb6e2d69f.summary: GLM 5.1 (`z-ai/glm-5.1`) removed from `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and `LEGACY_FREEBUFF_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, collapsing `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS` to active models only. `FREEBUFF_GLM_MODEL_ID` stripped from `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` sets for `base2-free` and `code-reviewer-minimax` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Web server config drops GLM from `INSTANT_ADMIT_CAPACITY` in `web/src/server/free-session/config.ts`. Docs updated in `docs/freebuff-waiting-room.md` to remove deployment-hours gating references specific to GLM.

ad5e77cb4eae7ef2f6a183e84e915704819fea2a.title: Restore Carbon ads fallback
ad5e77cb4eae7ef2f6a183e84e915704819fea2a.summary: CLI ad logic now defers fallback ordering to the server. `useGravityAd` removes `fallbackProvider`; `chat.tsx` and `waiting-room-screen.tsx` drop `zeroclick` fallback. `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` implements `providerFallbacks` map: gravity tries gravity, zeroclick, carbon; zeroclick tries zeroclick, carbon; carbon tries carbon only. Server persists impressions to `ad_impression` table with `onConflictDoNothing`.

0e3a2e3a4b1ecfbbd704e53d500087469d665ea9.title: Add chat completion concurrency logging
0e3a2e3a4b1ecfbbd704e53d500087469d665ea9.summary: New `request-metrics.ts` module tracks active chat completion requests with sampled logging. Concurrency counters increment on start and decrement on completion, cancellation, or error, emitting structured metrics for host, PID, and duration. Streaming responses wrap the reader to detect stream end or failure, ensuring accurate lifecycle tracking.

b5460a424824ba881c15a718cdba566112678666.title: Add Scamalytics free mode risk scoring
b5460a424824ba881c15a718cdba566112678666.summary: Integrates Scamalytics API for fraud scoring and proxy evidence to augment IPinfo privacy signals in free-mode gating. Requires `SCAMALYTICS_API_KEY` and adds DB columns `scamalytics_status`, `scamalytics_score`, `scamalytics_risk`, `scamalytics_ip_privacy_signals`, and `risk_score` to `free_mode_country_access_cache`. Full access now demands clean results from both Spur and Scamalytics; failures or suspicious signals trigger limited access or hard blocks for residential proxies/Tor. Updated session types in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` and docs in `docs/environment-variables.md` and `docs/freebuff-waiting-room.md`.

2f7f2db929542d200cc6a617dcc3cabd83aaf557.title: Add server-side Composio managed auth
2f7f2db929542d200cc6a617dcc3cabd83aaf557.summary: Introduces server-side Composio managed auth infrastructure, adding four meta-tools (composio_manage_connections, composio_multi_execute_tool, composio_search_tools, composio_get_tool_schemas) to the core tool constants and agent runtime handlers. Includes new DB migration (0056_simple_tyrannus.sql) for connection state, API routes for execution/auth, and rate limiting. The base2 agent definition gates these tools behind an ENABLE_COMPOSIO_TOOLS flag (currently false), preventing immediate user exposure while establishing the backend plumbing for external app integrations.

6200a7bfdbdb111a8b2b94680839ae774b78dc41.text: Staff now have a safer way to remove user accounts from the main database. This tool checks for errors before deleting and prevents removing accounts that still manage groups unless specifically instructed.

b5460a424824ba881c15a718cdba566112678666.text: The system now checks for more signs of fraud before granting full access. Users with suspicious activity or privacy-blocking tools may see limited access or blocks.

89a10d6afc6fa78b3a7f001542950aae6e48307d.text: The command-line tool now displays help text correctly instead of clearing it. This fixes a visual glitch when requesting assistance.

0491f53a1259429a483e3099e04d576cbb5e5072.text: The software now ignores helper folders and test files when looking for new tools to use. This prevents it from accidentally loading broken or unfinished items.

61c1eefd5999cb4bd2d8367929e3016eb6e2d69f.text: The system stopped offering one specific AI model. If you used that model, you will now see a different option.

0e3a2e3a4b1ecfbbd704e53d500087469d665ea9.text: The system now tracks how many chat requests are active at once. This helps the team spot performance issues, but you will not notice any difference.

87a6812a3ad19cd2f3132214ce5034886777c02d.text: The cost to use certain AI models changed slightly. Some became a bit more expensive, while others stayed the same or got cheaper. This affects the price of using the assistant, but not how it works.

6f4dbb428ef40c0f3aaa2d30d97d8f9b51c9d5fa.title: Web search tool renderer for CLI
6f4dbb428ef40c0f3aaa2d30d97d8f9b51c9d5fa.summary: Added `WebSearchComponent` to render `web_search` tool calls in the CLI. Registered in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts`. Displays search query via `SimpleToolCallItem`.

17e14b8a31610135a829565584f8fbc36860041e.title: Add readurl tool to base2 agent and CLI registry
17e14b8a31610135a829565584f8fbc36860041e.summary: The `read_url` tool is now available to the `base2` agent and registered in the CLI tool component registry. This change introduces a new capability for the agent to fetch and process content from URLs, accompanied by a dedicated UI component (`ReadURLComponent`) for displaying the tool's execution. The update spans `agents/base2/base2.ts`, `cli/src/components/tools/read-url.tsx`, and `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts`. The new tool is unconditionally enabled for the agent, unlike some other tools which are gated by flags like `isFree` or `noAskUser`.

806e27d82f418a16f9f87c3a3e9d8af62c99d0b4.title: Add CURRENTDATE placeholder to agent runtime templates
806e27d82f418a16f9f87c3a3e9d8af62c99d0b4.summary: Moved date formatting from base2.ts to agent-runtime strings.ts via new CURRENT_DATE placeholder. Resolves static date injection in system prompts by enabling runtime substitution. Updated secret-agent-definition.ts and templates/types.ts to register the new placeholder.

4c20af5ced7ab262a2098201888f8a73f5383b19.title: Improve CLI binary spawn error diagnostics
4c20af5ced7ab262a2098201888f8a73f5383b19.summary: Refactored `main()` and `checkForUpdates()` in `cli/release/index.js` and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js` to use a new `spawnInstalledBinary` helper. This replaces bare `spawn` calls with robust error handling that prints detailed system info (platform, node version, binary path/status) on failure. The update includes specific Windows guidance for antivirus blocks and CPU instruction mismatches, plus a `BINARY_MISSING` check that cleans up stale metadata files.

21bb34cdb3e14f4f8bfd2eea28c3e45691483af5.title: Improve Freebuff session limit messaging
21bb34cdb3e14f4f8bfd2eea28c3e45691483af5.summary: LimitedLandingPanel renders plain-text explanation instead of CTA when quota exhausted. WaitingRoomScreen passes dynamic reset countdown message. Covers CLI components.

28d560182de8500514e34ac4079426b3c965675e.title: Split public LLM provider code from internal package
28d560182de8500514e34ac4079426b3c965675e.summary: Moved OpenAI-compatible and OpenRouter provider shims from `@codebuff/internal` to new public `@codebuff/llm-providers` package. Prevents SDK from depending on private server utilities while maintaining provider functionality. Updates architecture docs, package dependencies, and test mocks to reflect new structure. `packages/llm-providers/` now hosts forked AI SDK providers; `packages/internal/` retains only server-side utilities and database schema.

1b5ba7995640155ea933ea7343e3ca8614fbf6b1.title: Numpad Enter and printable key handling in CLI
1b5ba7995640155ea933ea7343e3ca8614fbf6b1.summary: CLI now correctly intercepts numpad Enter keys and filters printable sequences using new `keypad-keys.ts` and `terminal-enter-detection.ts` utilities. Affected components (`chat-input-bar`, `multiline-input`, `ask-user`, etc.) replace manual key checks with `isPlainEnterKey` and `shouldInterceptChatInputKey`. CI cache keys bumped to `v2` for Bun compile runtime.

e438af55d55a845703265971145c837b820313dd.title: VPN proxy users limited mode freebuff
e438af55d55a845703265971145c837b820313dd.summary: VPN/proxy traffic enters limited mode. `shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess` no longer blocks on `anonymous_network` unless Cloudflare Tor detected. Docs updated. `SPUR_TOKEN` failure/suspicion triggers limited fallback. Hard blocks restricted to Tor.

bc108e4bf8cc7d6f36a31989dbb76dd20e9d0d4e.title: Add readurl tool for web research
bc108e4bf8cc7d6f36a31989dbb76dd20e9d0d4e.summary: New read_url tool added to agent toolset, enabling direct URL fetching and text extraction. Replaces curl usage in researcher-web agent, now using read_url alongside web_search. Covers SDK, agent runtime, common tools, and type definitions. Input schema validates http/https URLs with optional max_chars (default 20000, max 50000).

a11f5b9bcc8ef033701e8c20747ebf4f7e70deee.title: Replace Linkup web search with Serper
a11f5b9bcc8ef033701e8c20747ebf4f7e70deee.summary: Web search now uses Serper API instead of Linkup. Researcher agent gained `run_terminal_command` to fetch source pages directly. `LINKUP_API_KEY` replaced by `SERPER_API_KEY` in env schema and examples. Response format changed from `sourcedAnswer` to raw JSON SERP fields.

6f4dbb428ef40c0f3aaa2d30d97d8f9b51c9d5fa.text: The app now shows search results in a clear, easy-to-read format when it looks things up for you.

4c20af5ced7ab262a2098201888f8a73f5383b19.text: If the app cannot start, it now shows clear reasons and fixes. This helps you solve problems like blocked files or missing updates without guessing.

21bb34cdb3e14f4f8bfd2eea28c3e45691483af5.text: When you reach your usage limit, the app now shows a clear message explaining the wait time instead of a confusing button. You will know exactly when you can start using the service again.

806e27d82f418a16f9f87c3a3e9d8af62c99d0b4.text: The assistant can now insert the correct current date into its responses. This fixes an issue where the date was previously fixed and could be wrong.

1b5ba7995640155ea933ea7343e3ca8614fbf6b1.text: The assistant now recognizes when you press Enter on the number pad. This prevents accidental messages or broken text when typing.

a11f5b9bcc8ef033701e8c20747ebf4f7e70deee.text: The assistant now uses a different search provider to find information. It can also access source pages directly. You may need to update your setup key to match the new provider.

e438af55d55a845703265971145c837b820313dd.text: Users connecting through VPNs or proxies now get limited access instead of being completely blocked, unless they are using Tor.

17e14b8a31610135a829565584f8fbc36860041e.text: The assistant can now read web links. You can paste a URL, and it will fetch and use the content.

28d560182de8500514e34ac4079426b3c965675e.text: The code that connects the assistant to different AI services was separated from private internal tools. This keeps the assistant working exactly as before while making the software easier to maintain.

bc108e4bf8cc7d6f36a31989dbb76dd20e9d0d4e.text: The assistant now fetches web pages directly to read their text.

565af42cfc6575e75f78e03f4ba8ad2609c4f31b.title: Base2 prompt includes current date
565af42cfc6575e75f78e03f4ba8ad2609c4f31b.summary: Base2 system prompt injects current date via `formatCurrentDate(new Date())`. Uses `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `en-US` locale, long month, numeric year/day. Affects `agents/base2/base2.ts`.

692b6fa2f3086116b9bf800c806b6963bd46df3b.title: Onboard page handles missing CLI auth code
692b6fa2f3086116b9bf800c806b6963bd46df3b.summary: Added explicit 'missing' status handling for CLI auth code resolution in the onboarding flow. Web and Codebuff surfaces now render a static expired-link card instead of proceeding with an undefined token. Includes structured logging of auth code metadata on the Web surface to aid debugging.

092de618a0779bc979a7077e49bf77725042e455.title: Spur integration reduces VPN false positives
092de618a0779bc979a7077e49bf77725042e455.summary: Added Spur Context API checks to free-mode IP privacy logic to corroborate IPinfo signals and reduce false positives. Schema updated with `spur_ip_privacy_signals`, `spur_status`, `privacy_decision`, and `privacy_provider_decision` columns in `free_mode_country_access_cache`. New `SPUR_TOKEN` env var required; clean Spur results restore full access in allowlisted countries, while failures fall back to limited access. Covers `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`, `packages/internal/src/db/schema.ts`, and docs.

d555af2e5b1448463bf81cbb73702e6de7e7003a.title: Add chat completion trace fetcher
d555af2e5b1448463bf81cbb73702e6de7e7003a.summary: New script fetch-recent-chat-completion-traces.ts reconstructs chat completion traces from BigQuery. It queries recent sessions, applies message deltas, and writes JSON files with an index. Supports --prod, --limit, --lookback-hours, and --trace-session-id flags. Redacts secrets in previews and handles incomplete sessions.

4423d090bc0971f43a9c24e00c675b163ce61f38.title: Allow zero-credit API calls without balance check
4423d090bc0971f43a9c24e00c675b163ce61f38.summary: checkCreditsAndCharge in web/src/app/api/v1/_helpers.ts returns early when creditsToCharge <= 0. This bypasses balance validation for free endpoints like web-search. Scope limited to API v1 helpers and web-search handler. Prevents 402 errors on zero-cost calls.

84778f9c96c19f127e53384b91190eb9d0e40c3c.title: Hide empty subagent spawn errors
84778f9c96c19f127e53384b91190eb9d0e40c3c.summary: cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts refactors spawn agent result handling to hide empty subagent spawn errors. updateSpawnAgentBlock returns null for error results with zero child blocks, filtering them out of the content tree. Scope limited to CLI SDK event handlers. Error status changed to 'complete' when non-empty blocks remain.

6c000e2fb5fcd6455833bc4e8ef3b40662e05bcb.title: CLI ad click tracking
6c000e2fb5fcd6455833bc4e8ef3b40662e05bcb.summary: Added ad click tracking to CLI surfaces (chat, waiting room) via new `useGravityAd` hook method `recordClick`. This sends a POST to `/api/v1/ads/click` with `impUrl` and `surface`, triggering PostHog event `ads.clicked` and DB update. Scope covers `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/choice-ad-banner.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, and new web API route `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/click/_post.ts`. Clicks are recorded before opening the URL, with auth token required and silent failure handling.

a3dbf723659094910c2cf7d85ec5535dadc3bd98.title: Block VPN and proxy traffic
a3dbf723659094910c2cf7d85ec5535dadc3bd98.summary: Freebuff now hard-blocks requests from VPN, proxy, and Tor networks. The CLI waiting room displays specific signal labels (e.g., 'VPN or Tor') instead of generic 'anonymized networks' text. Web API completions endpoint enforces this block by checking `ipPrivacySignals` against `FREEBUFF_HARD_BLOCKED_PRIVACY_SIGNALS` in `common/src/util/freebuff-privacy.ts`. Existing sessions using blocked networks will terminate with a 403 `free_mode_unavailable` error.

14fa5cb720bc6ffa0a47767e93d43d21fb01fb9a.title: Add incremental chat completion traces
14fa5cb720bc6ffa0a47767e93d43d21fb01fb9a.summary: SDK `RunState` gains `traceSessionId` (UUID), threaded through `run.ts` and `extraCodebuffMetadata` as `trace_session_id`. New BigQuery `chat_completion_traces` table stores `ChatCompletionTraceRow` with delta hashing (`delta_message_hashes`, `common_prefix_length`, `cache_hit`, `full_snapshot`) and JSON-stringified payloads. `setupBigQuery` auto-creates the table with monthly partitioning on `created_at` and clustering on `user_id`, `trace_session_id`, `trace_lineage_id`. CLI `run-state-storage.ts` imports `randomUUID` for state persistence alignment.

a85cb595b5dece0859ec6bb1d05f898d79ad0fdf.title: Add DeepSeek session trace exporter
a85cb595b5dece0859ec6bb1d05f898d79ad0fdf.summary: New script `scripts/export-deepseek-session-traces.ts` reconstructs multi-turn DeepSeek V4 free-mode sessions from BigQuery. It groups provider call rows by `client_id`, selecting the highest-context request to extract full conversation history. Targets include `base2-free-deepseek` (Pro) and `base2-free-deepseek-flash` (Flash). Supports sampling modes (newest, random, even) and date range filtering for trace export.

84778f9c96c19f127e53384b91190eb9d0e40c3c.text: The app now hides error messages when helper tasks finish without producing any results. This makes the conversation cleaner by removing confusing blank error notices.

6c000e2fb5fcd6455833bc4e8ef3b40662e05bcb.text: The app now tracks when you click an ad in the chat or waiting room.

092de618a0779bc979a7077e49bf77725042e455.text: The system now uses a second check to verify internet privacy. This reduces errors where safe connections were wrongly blocked. Clean results restore full access, while failures keep limited access.

4423d090bc0971f43a9c24e00c675b163ce61f38.text: Free features now skip balance checks. This prevents errors when using tools that cost nothing.

d555af2e5b1448463bf81cbb73702e6de7e7003a.text: A small internal update lets the team view recent conversation histories more easily. This change does not affect how you use the product.

692b6fa2f3086116b9bf800c806b6963bd46df3b.text: The setup page now shows a clear message when the link expires, instead of getting stuck.

565af42cfc6575e75f78e03f4ba8ad2609c4f31b.text: The assistant now knows today's date. This helps it give more accurate answers about time.

14fa5cb720bc6ffa0a47767e93d43d21fb01fb9a.text: The assistant now records detailed logs of each chat message to track how conversations are processed. This helps the team understand performance and fix issues faster.

a85cb595b5dece0859ec6bb1d05f898d79ad0fdf.text: The company added an internal tool to gather conversation history from their servers. This helps staff review how the AI assistant responds to users.

a3dbf723659094910c2cf7d85ec5535dadc3bd98.text: Freebuff now blocks connections that hide your identity, such as those using VPNs or proxies. If you use these services, you will see a specific warning and lose access to the free mode.

ae7713bb730569e0e4cfc464cd0e84ae5a4570c1.title: Clarify limited mode reason text in CLI waiting room
ae7713bb730569e0e4cfc464cd0e84ae5a4570c1.summary: Updated getLimitedModeReason in cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx to display 'based on detected country: <code>' instead of 'outside available countries (<code>)' for country_not_allowed errors. The change improves clarity on why access is restricted based on geolocation. Formatting adjustments were also applied to PRIVACY_SIGNAL_LABELS and selectorMaxHeight calculations.

2af416b863e4aab3507c0cb19b141fd839d44871.title: Clarify global availability in FAQ
2af416b863e4aab3507c0cb19b141fd839d44871.summary: Updated the FAQ answer in freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx to state that Freebuff is available in all countries, operating in either 'full' or 'limited' mode. This change clarifies that while full access is restricted to a specific list of countries, the service remains accessible globally with limited functionality.

d7915d1a449c1be76381e933b1237998f23e20ec.title: Remove redundant text from /live page
d7915d1a449c1be76381e933b1237998f23e20ec.summary: Removed explanatory subtitles and raw country codes from the /live stats view. Simplified the hero text and list items to focus on metrics. Updates `freebuff/web/src/app/live/live-client.tsx`.

522068a877a8196bc879f2fcd71b4e4d2ccbea38.title: Remove redundant live stats copy
522068a877a8196bc879f2fcd71b4e4d2ccbea38.summary: Stripped `sublabel` and descriptive paragraph from `HomepageLiveStats` in `live-summary.tsx`. Removed static text to reduce visual noise. Scope: Web live stats UI only.

f3d9f45431c96e2327bd28425a86a7bd853be3b4.title: Revert Windows Bun baseline compile target
f3d9f45431c96e2327bd28425a86a7bd853be3b4.summary: Reverts Windows Bun compile target from `bun-windows-x64-baseline` to `bun-windows-x64` across CI workflows and build scripts. Removes baseline-specific runtime preparation steps in `cli-release-build.yml`, `freebuff-e2e.yml`, and `npm-app-release-build.yml`. Updates `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts` and `setup-bun-compile-runtime` action to use standard x64 target.

cd83f663cb98745c005bd8ef51efcdf67cdf5f15.title: readfiles accepts absolute paths and fixes result mapping
cd83f663cb98745c005bd8ef51efcdf67cdf5f15.summary: read_files tool schema now accepts absolute paths within project root, previously restricted to relative paths. get-file-reading-updates.ts switched from filtering requestedFiles to mapping Object.entries(loadedFiles), fixing normalized path mismatches. Affects common/src/tools/params/tool/read-files.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/get-file-reading-updates.ts. Path normalization consistency ensured for agent file operations.

f60634199133dea8a0d80c669a57cc7d750525c0.title: CLI API client respects httpproxy env vars
f60634199133dea8a0d80c669a57cc7d750525c0.summary: Added proxy support to `createCodebuffApiClient` in `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts`. The client now resolves proxy URLs from `HTTPS_PROXY`, `https_proxy`, `HTTP_PROXY`, or `http_proxy` env vars, or explicit config. Pass `proxy: null` to disable. Applies to all API calls via Bun's `fetch` proxy option.

1796dbd4a28fab935a1eac47ddb0fa9db83fea66.title: Fix Freebuff 429 error messaging in CLI
1796dbd4a28fab935a1eac47ddb0fa9db83fea66.summary: The CLI now intercepts HTTP 429 rate-limit errors for Freebuff, displaying a friendly 'temporarily busy' message instead of raw API details. This is implemented via `getFreebuffRateLimitErrorMessage` in `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`, which checks for `statusCode === 429` and preserves specific `free_mode_rate_limited` messages if present. The fix applies to both `handleRunCompletion` and `handleRunError` in `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts`, gated by `IS_FREEBUFF`. Documentation in `docs/error-schema.md` is updated to reflect this new error handling path.

b1e92cb142e6cb222c6b54d9db58b5c4ac5a0109.title: Refactor live stats polling and add homepage summary
b1e92cb142e6cb222c6b54d9db58b5c4ac5a0109.summary: Extracted `useLiveStats`, `countryName`, and `EMPTY_LIVE_STATS` from `live-client.tsx` to new `live-stats-client.ts`. Added `enabled` and `pauseWhenHidden` options to the hook to support visibility-aware polling. New `live-summary.tsx` implements `HomepageLiveStats` using `IntersectionObserver` to trigger updates only when the section is visible. `home-client.tsx` now imports `HomepageLiveStats` instead of `CompactLiveStats`.

f14fd0cc343ecd2079f46853acc8966fee8a6449.title: Add freebuff access tier analytics
f14fd0cc343ecd2079f46853acc8966fee8a6449.summary: Access tier analytics added to completions API. `FreebuffAccessTier` type imported, `trackEvent` enriched with `accessTier` property. Proxy resolution uses `getSystemProcessEnv` in CLI. Covers `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

f14fd0cc343ecd2079f46853acc8966fee8a6449.text: The system now tracks which access level you have when you use the assistant. This helps the service understand usage patterns, but does not change how you interact with it.

522068a877a8196bc879f2fcd71b4e4d2ccbea38.text: We removed extra text from the live stats section on the homepage to make it look cleaner. You will see less clutter and fewer repeated details when checking these numbers.

d7915d1a449c1be76381e933b1237998f23e20ec.text: The live statistics page now shows only the key numbers. Extra text and country codes were removed to make the view cleaner.

cd83f663cb98745c005bd8ef51efcdf67cdf5f15.text: The assistant can now find files using their full location addresses instead of just short names. This prevents errors when the assistant tries to read specific files in your project.

2af416b863e4aab3507c0cb19b141fd839d44871.text: The help page now clarifies that you can use the service from any country. While some features may be restricted based on your location, basic access remains available worldwide.

ae7713bb730569e0e4cfc464cd0e84ae5a4570c1.text: When you cannot use the software due to your location, the message now simply states which country was detected. This makes the reason for the restriction clearer.

f60634199133dea8a0d80c669a57cc7d750525c0.text: The program now follows your computer's web proxy settings when connecting to the internet. If you use a proxy, the tool will work correctly without extra steps.

1796dbd4a28fab935a1eac47ddb0fa9db83fea66.text: When the service is too busy, the app now shows a simple message instead of confusing technical errors.

b1e92cb142e6cb222c6b54d9db58b5c4ac5a0109.text: The live statistics section now updates only when you are looking at it, and a new summary view appears on the homepage. This change reduces unnecessary background activity.

f3d9f45431c96e2327bd28425a86a7bd853be3b4.text: The software stopped using a special compatibility mode for Windows. This change is internal and should not affect how the product works for you.

6a1803431b6de7e4b6e4519bedfec9e164604a5b.title: Add /model alias to end-session
6a1803431b6de7e4b6e4519bedfec9e164604a5b.summary: Added aliases: ['model'] to the end-session command in cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts and cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts. This allows users to trigger the session-end model picker using /model instead of /end-session. Updated slash command description to remove redundant waiting room reference.

30c51ac38ce89001a9a39a00416a2d56ad446fce.title: Windows CLI builds switch to bun-windows-x64-baseline target
30c51ac38ce89001a9a39a00416a2d56ad446fce.summary: Windows binary compilation now targets bun-windows-x64-baseline instead of bun-windows-x64. A new composite action downloads and caches the specific Bun runtime zip, setting BUN_COMPILE_EXECUTABLE_PATH for the build script. cli/scripts/build-binary.ts passes this path to bun build --compile-executable-path when present. Scope covers CI workflows (cli-release-build, freebuff-e2e, npm-app-release-build) and the CLI build script.

9d59c700eaa58184656fe03f362b7a04c4aee4c0.title: CLI model selector adapts to short terminals
9d59c700eaa58184656fe03f362b7a04c4aee4c0.summary: CLI waiting-room components implement progressive disclosure for low-height terminals. The `useLogo` hook downgrades the ASCII art to a single-line text variant when the vertical budget falls below 6 rows. The `FreebuffModelSelector` and `LimitedLandingPanel` now accept a `maxHeight` prop, enabling internal scrollboxes with precise layout math to prevent flexbox compression. This ensures the model picker remains accessible and visually stable on small screens.

982f726c537864c08fa1e238ac7eae796286d453.title: Reduce chat request retention
982f726c537864c08fa1e238ac7eae796286d453.summary: Chat request logging now uses createRequestAuditRecord to store request summaries instead of full bodies. This change addresses retention issues by omitting messages from BigQuery inserts and telemetry. Covers all LLM API handlers (CanopyWave, DeepSeek, Fireworks, Moonshot, OpenAI, OpenCodeZen) and the main chat completions endpoint. The new helper extracts model, stream, temperature, max_tokens, and message/tool counts while setting messages_omitted: true.

7d451c872df79982a576bc3a1ac2906762cf1445.title: Fix disconnected stream retention
7d451c872df79982a576bc3a1ac2906762cf1445.summary: Added `skipDisconnectedBilling` for DeepSeek V4 Flash to cancel streams on client disconnect, preventing unnecessary consumption. Implemented `DISCONNECTED_STREAM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS` (2m) in OpenRouter to cancel disconnected streams that exceed the drain window. Updated chat completions telemetry to omit message bodies for `limited` access tiers. Changes affect `web/src/llm-api/deepseek.ts`, `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts`, and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

7dc62c8e1a89fb06800c16072f4db5e169f1ddb4.title: Web FAQ clarifies limited mode
7dc62c8e1a89fb06800c16072f4db5e169f1ddb4.summary: Added 'What is limited mode?' entry to home-client.tsx. Explains DeepSeek V4 Flash only and 5 one-hour sessions per day for VPN or non-full-access countries. Updated 'What models do you use?' and 'Which countries...' to distinguish full vs limited access. Minor documentation change.

e43653226f8be2c6f80ddbf0c98bcfa96cde9856.title: Add compact live stats to homepage
e43653226f8be2c6f80ddbf0c98bcfa96cde9856.summary: Added `CompactLiveStats` component to `home-client.tsx`. Updated `/api/live` cache headers to `s-maxage=60` and `stale-while-revalidate=30`. Server `getFreebuffLiveStats` now caches results for 60s. Client polling interval increased from 15s to 60s.

8cca5ab9b098ec1421e51a7c41b5eb13be0d2cda.title: Add Simplified Chinese README
8cca5ab9b098ec1421e51a7c41b5eb13be0d2cda.summary: Adds README.zh-CN.md with full Chinese translation of Codebuff/Freebuff docs. Links from English README via bilingual header. Covers CLI install, agent creation, SDK usage, and model picker details.

5380b97cc366aad170b24591ca16269002164dbd.title: Add /model aliases for CLI mode commands
5380b97cc366aad170b24591ca16269002164dbd.summary: Added aliases `model:<mode>` for all `mode:<mode>` commands in the CLI command registry and slash command data. This allows users to use `/model:<mode>` syntax interchangeably with `/mode:<mode>`. Changes apply to `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`.

9d59c700eaa58184656fe03f362b7a04c4aee4c0.text: The model picker now adjusts its display to fit smaller screens without hiding options. This makes the tool easier to use on laptops with limited vertical space.

5380b97cc366aad170b24591ca16269002164dbd.text: You can now use '/model:' instead of '/mode:' to switch settings. Both commands do the same thing.

6a1803431b6de7e4b6e4519bedfec9e164604a5b.text: You can now type /model to end your session and pick a new model. This replaces the longer /end-session command.

7d451c872df79982a576bc3a1ac2906762cf1445.text: The system now automatically stops processing when you close a chat window, saving computing resources. Additionally, private message contents are hidden from internal tracking for certain users.

8cca5ab9b098ec1421e51a7c41b5eb13be0d2cda.text: The help guide is now available in Simplified Chinese. This makes setup and usage instructions easier to read for Chinese speakers.

7dc62c8e1a89fb06800c16072f4db5e169f1ddb4.text: The help page now explains that some regions have restricted access, allowing only one specific AI model and five one-hour sessions per day. It also clarifies the differences between full and limited access.

30c51ac38ce89001a9a39a00416a2d56ad446fce.text: The tool now uses a version designed for older computers. This helps the app run smoothly on more types of Windows machines.

982f726c537864c08fa1e238ac7eae796286d453.text: The system now saves only basic details about chat requests instead of full message text. This keeps private conversations out of internal records.

e43653226f8be2c6f80ddbf0c98bcfa96cde9856.text: The homepage now shows a smaller live stats panel that updates less often to save resources.

47d025ad7973d0b474df5b2f2e83d6459469d17c.title: Waiting-room screen: premium reset text uses comma
47d025ad7973d0b474df5b2f2e83d6459469d17c.summary: Premium reset countdown in `WaitingRoomScreen` switched from `  ·  ` separator to `, `. Affects model selection screen reset text. File: `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

7f4d431302996f59c6624a4f9eaf992dc7d413b9.title: LimitedLandingPanel button text color tweak
7f4d431302996f59c6624a4f9eaf992dc7d413b9.summary: Interactable button text in `LimitedLandingPanel` now uses `theme.foreground` instead of `theme.primary`. Visual tweak for better contrast/readability. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/limited-landing-panel.tsx`.

f29db9e9ef09c89801ac25e7eaebe384991403b5.title: Overhaul Freebuff live map
f29db9e9ef09c89801ac25e7eaebe384991403b5.summary: Live map now uses accurate Natural Earth geometry and Equal Earth projection instead of hand-drawn blobs. Country centroids moved to generated `world-map-data.ts` via REST Countries data. `live-client.tsx` applies proper projection math for rendering. Covers Web `/live` surface.

cfc3e1ae4f15d4849696cdb1437075ba154a3d0e.title: Remove padded count from limited landing session counter
cfc3e1ae4f15d4849696cdb1437075ba154a3d0e.summary: The waiting-room screen's session counter now uses `formatSessionUnits` instead of `formattedSharedPremiumUsed` to display the used count. This drops zero-padding from the number. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx`.

4fb13aebd6a2e8db8ea0f3af3c48be8c74fa0c6f.title: Drop invalid Freebuff login auth codes
4fb13aebd6a2e8db8ea0f3af3c48be8c74fa0c6f.summary: Invalid CLI auth codes are now rejected during login, preventing malformed or opaque tokens from being forwarded to the `/onboard` route. A new `cli-auth-code-shape.ts` module centralizes regex validation and parsing logic, replacing inline checks in `_helpers.ts`. The change affects Web UI login flows (`/login`, `sign-in-button`, `login-card`) and NextAuth redirect handling (`auth-options.ts`). `getCliAuthOnboardSearchParams` explicitly strips invalid `auth_code` parameters before redirecting, ensuring only valid codes persist in the URL.

c3027175a0242057dd0de85ffcc835c9ad75a5e7.title: CLI waiting room labels limited access reason
c3027175a0242057dd0de85ffcc835c9ad75a5e7.summary: Waiting room screen now displays specific limited access reasons like 'hosting network detected' or 'outside available countries' instead of generic text. Server responses (session-view, handlers) and common types now propagate countryCode, countryBlockReason, and ipPrivacySignals to the client. Covers CLI, Shared/Core, and Web surfaces.

62c807a76b20fde83dc17bad79d7e787a864c538.title: extractApiErrorDetails unwraps nested AI SDK retry errors
62c807a76b20fde83dc17bad79d7e787a864c538.summary: New `extractApiErrorDetails` in `common/src/util/error.ts` traverses `lastError`, `errors`, and `cause` chains to pull status codes and parsed response bodies from nested AI SDK `RetryError` wrappers. Replaces direct `parseApiErrorResponseBody` calls in `sdk/src/run.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, ensuring accurate error reporting when upstream failures are wrapped. Docs updated in `docs/error-schema.md` to reflect the new `session_superseded` 409 error code.

558d1fe9213d28182cede6c95c42da24b4384bb4.title: Fix model switch landing
558d1fe9213d28182cede6c95c42da24b4384bb4.summary: Fix freebuff model switch landing (#669) by preserving metadata during session transitions. `use-freebuff-session.ts` introduces `toLandingSession` to extract `accessTier`, `queueDepthByModel`, and `rateLimitsByModel` from the current state before resetting status to 'none'. `session-ended-banner.tsx` updates button labels to 'Back to start' for limited tiers and 'Change model' otherwise, using dynamic pending states. Scope: CLI session hooks and UI components. Detail: `apply({ status: 'none' })` replaced with `apply(landingSession)` to prevent metadata loss on rejoin or return-to-landing.

af4e0fe1473a8a441a36d071db2cfda4dd30c3b2.title: Simplify Freebuff limited-mode landing screen
af4e0fe1473a8a441a36d071db2cfda4dd30c3b2.summary: New `LimitedLandingPanel` component replaces the generic model selector for limited-tier users, acting as a confirm gate rather than a picker. The `FreebuffModelSelector` hides the 'LIMITED' header and comparative taglines for this tier, while `WaitingRoomScreen` and `SessionEndedBanner` update session labels to 'sessions' to avoid leaking internal tier names. This change affects CLI components only, specifically `cli/src/components/limited-landing-panel.tsx` and related UI files.

8c189c305a0e72090d8eec4585136627709ce00d.title: Add dev-only env to force Freebuff limited mode
8c189c305a0e72090d8eec4585136627709ce00d.summary: Adds FREEBUFF_DEV_FORCE_LIMITED to force 'limited' access tier on localhost. Updates packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts and web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts to bypass country checks and skip cache reads/writes when active. Scoped to dev environment via NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT check.

c3027175a0242057dd0de85ffcc835c9ad75a5e7.text: When you are blocked from joining a call, the screen now shows the specific reason, like being outside allowed countries or using a restricted network, instead of a vague message.

47d025ad7973d0b474df5b2f2e83d6459469d17c.text: The waiting room screen now uses a comma instead of a dot to separate text in the premium reset countdown. This is a small visual change that makes the message easier to read.

558d1fe9213d28182cede6c95c42da24b4384bb4.text: When you switch models or return to the start, your account limits and wait times stay accurate instead of resetting. This keeps the app from showing wrong information about your usage.

cfc3e1ae4f15d4849696cdb1437075ba154a3d0e.text: The number showing how many sessions you have used no longer has extra zeros in front of it. This is a small visual change that does not affect your actual session count.

7f4d431302996f59c6624a4f9eaf992dc7d413b9.text: The text color on a specific button in the setup screen changed to improve readability. This small visual tweak makes the button easier to see.

f29db9e9ef09c89801ac25e7eaebe384991403b5.text: The live map now uses real geographic data instead of simplified shapes. This means country locations and borders appear more accurate and correctly proportioned when you view the map.

62c807a76b20fde83dc17bad79d7e787a864c538.text: The system now looks deeper inside technical errors to find the real problem. This helps show clearer messages when things go wrong.

8c189c305a0e72090d8eec4585136627709ce00d.text: Developers can now test a restricted version of the service on their own computers. This change does not affect how the product works for regular users.

af4e0fe1473a8a441a36d071db2cfda4dd30c3b2.text: The free version's start screen now asks for confirmation instead of showing a list of options. Internal labels are simplified to avoid confusing terms.

4fb13aebd6a2e8db8ea0f3af3c48be8c74fa0c6f.text: The system now checks login codes for errors before processing them. This prevents broken or confusing links from appearing when you sign in.

cae558b46d0c0c795fbf2c4644b5bbbfff8b2807.title: Local token counting for DeepSeek Flash
cae558b46d0c0c795fbf2c4644b5bbbfff8b2807.summary: Agent runtime skips remote token count API for free DeepSeek Flash agents, using local estimation instead. New helper `shouldUseLocalTokenCountForFreebuffDeepseekFlash` gates this behavior in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`. Implementation in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` replaces the `callTokenCountAPI` block for this specific model.

71b82cd473a88c3b984e5369f048ed7d9d7647aa.title: Coerce stringified params in spawn agent tools
71b82cd473a88c3b984e5369f048ed7d9d7647aa.summary: Added `coerceToObject` helper in `common/src/tools/params/utils.ts` to parse stringified JSON objects into actual objects for the `params` field. Applied via `z.preprocess` to schemas in `spawn-agent-inline.ts` and `spawn-agents.ts`. This fixes validation errors when models emit `params` as a JSON string instead of an object. Malformed strings remain untouched to ensure schema validation still rejects them.

6383ae8acdef116d44f37f944b28d0f5df4b5397.title: Log invalid Freebuff login auth codes
6383ae8acdef116d44f37f944b28d0f5df4b5397.summary: Added `isCliAuthCodeCandidate` to validate auth codes, triggering `logger.warn` with detailed metadata (lengths, hash prefix, params, headers) on failure in `auth-options.ts` and `login/page.tsx`. Handles array `auth_code` params. Improves debugging for malformed CLI login redirects.

317a5c0532048c69209010f9de87f1f07a740b8e.title: Add User-Agent header to CLI ad requests
317a5c0532048c69209010f9de87f1f07a740b8e.summary: CLI ad fetches in `use-gravity-ad.ts` now send a custom `User-Agent` header derived from `getCliAdRequestUserAgent()`. The web API (`_post.ts`, `impression/_post.ts`) and Carbon provider (`carbon.ts`) propagate this `requestUserAgent` to upstream services, replacing the previous browser-only assumption. This ensures ad networks correctly identify CLI traffic for targeting and billing.

ebe848f548bd41e22004128e7960267c059e4693.title: Add Freebuff premium reset countdown
ebe848f548bd41e22004128e7960267c059e4693.summary: Added `freebuff-premium-reset.ts` utility to calculate and format the countdown to the next Freebuff premium session limit reset. The `WaitingRoomScreen` now imports this utility to display the remaining time until the quota resets, leveraging server-provided reset timestamps or falling back to timezone-based day bounds. `use-freebuff-session.ts` includes a new `refreshFreebuffLandingMetadata` function to update quota and queue depths on the landing screen when the midnight-Pacific reset occurs. Scope limited to CLI components and hooks.

2506de227fbcba2c132e11a237f66f8e99d4e426.title: Limited DeepSeek access tier added to CLI model selector
