Prevents content layout jump when the banner fills. Implemented by exporting CHOICE_AD_BANNER_HEIGHT from choice-ad-banner.tsx and applying it to a wrapper box in waiting-room-screen.tsx. The separator line is replaced by the reserved height placeholder when ads are absent.

2d282ce3f002e05f6fa23ee3e753dcf71e878f2b.title: Remove Claude Code system prompt prefix injection
2d282ce3f002e05f6fa23ee3e753dcf71e878f2b.summary: Removes `CLAUDE_CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_PREFIX` and associated request body transformation logic in `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`. Previously, this injected a specific system prompt block to satisfy Anthropic OAuth authorization checks for Claude 4+ models. Scope limited to SDK model provider and shared constants in `common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts`. Fetch calls now pass original init objects without parsing/modifying the `system` field.

61ebc7842f5ed64de0431a0a74a94c99ef4903e9.title: Enable reasoning replay in agent runtime message history
61ebc7842f5ed64de0431a0a74a94c99ef4903e9.summary: The `INCLUDE_REASONING_IN_MESSAGE_HISTORY` flag in `packages/agent-runtime/src/constants.ts` is set to `true`. This causes reasoning chunks emitted by the model to be appended to the assistant message history, allowing them to replay on subsequent turns. Consecutive reasoning chunks are consolidated into a single message. This change affects the agent runtime's context management and model input.

721d1d5c2d85cc0acd878e826b4fd832cd95810a.title: Remove live queue position hints from CLI model selector
721d1d5c2d85cc0acd878e826b4fd832cd95810a.summary: The CLI model selector now hides "N ahead" counts, relying on static status labels like "Closed" and "Limit used" instead. Traffic levels do not currently trigger queue formation, making the dynamic depth hints noisy and visually cluttering. The change updates `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` (Kimi tagline shift). The `queueDepthByModel` field in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` is retained in the API response for diagnostics but is no longer consumed by the UI.

d14ae806ccc679972f645f18c4626c742992bc96.title: Repair malformed tool call inputs
d14ae806ccc679972f645f18c4626c742992bc96.summary: Agent runtime repairs malformed tool call inputs via stringified JSON parsing and alias normalization. `normalizeReplacementAliases` maps `old_str`/`new_str` to `old`/`new` for `str_replace` and `propose_str_replace` schemas. `parseStringifiedToolInput` attempts up to three `JSON.parse` cycles before applying narrow field repairs for tools like `code_search` and `glob` using a strict allowlist. Scope covers `common/src/tools/params` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`.

32aa640716e4d7af9ee0b5feac31802250ef2782.title: Kimi k2.6 gated to deployment hours
32aa640716e4d7af9ee0b5feac31802250ef2782.summary: Kimi k2.6 added to FIREWORKS_HOURS_GATED_MODELS in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. Restricts access to freebuff deployment hours on serverless, matching legacy GLM 5.1 behavior. Ensures consistent availability windows for specific models.

a81339bb43003d5c6f7e97fa18865c42e93b7543.title: Simplify CLI model selector focus styling
a81339bb43003d5c6f7e97fa18865c42e93b7543.summary: Removed conditional green text coloring for focused rows in cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx. The focus indicator now relies solely on the green border and arrow, keeping the model name in standard foreground/muted colors. This change applies to the CLI waiting room UI only. No functional logic or state changes were made.

12a85348fc6f4c647e2df06bf06fea631467ed6f.title: Agent Runtime repairs malformed tool call inputs
12a85348fc6f4c647e2df06bf06fea631467ed6f.summary: Tool executor now repairs malformed stringified JSON inputs and surfaces parse errors to agent. Scope includes packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts and CI tmux install fallback in .github/workflows/freebuff-e2e.yml. New parseStringifiedToolInput returns { input, parseError }; stringInputError includes parser message.

13805acab332ef9046b6b7681285c5b221755c0b.title: Upgrade OpenTUI to 0.2.2
13805acab332ef9046b6b7681285c5b221755c0b.summary: OpenTUI dependencies in `cli/package.json` bumped from 0.1.87 to 0.2.2. `cli/src/index.tsx` updates renderer config, replacing boolean `useAlternateScreen` with string `screenMode: 'alternate-screen'`. `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` adds `getPasteText` helper using `stripAnsiSequences` and `decodePasteBytes` to sanitize paste events. `web-tree-sitter` updated to 0.25.10 in `packages/code-map` and `sdk`.

c4d0d72a10dc26f2e55ce5c2dd709accf0b500af.title: Default freebuff to DeepSeek V4 Pro, switch lite to Kimi
c4d0d72a10dc26f2e55ce5c2dd709accf0b500af.summary: Freebuff default model updated to DeepSeek V4 Pro; Lite mode defaults to Kimi. Logic in `agents/base2/base2.ts` and `agents/editor/editor.ts` refactored to handle new variants and conditional Gemini Thinker spawning. CLI components (`freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, `waiting-room-screen.tsx`) updated to reflect new defaults and warning display logic. `local-agent-registry.ts` uses new helper `canFreebuffModelSpawnGeminiThinker` to strip spawnable agents for non-reasoning models.

a81339bb43003d5c6f7e97fa18865c42e93b7543.text: The text color for selected options in the waiting room changed to standard colors. The green border and arrow still show which option is active.

13805acab332ef9046b6b7681285c5b221755c0b.text: The tool upgraded its visual display engine to a newer version, which improves how text and input fields render on your screen. This change is internal and does not add new features, but it may make the interface smoother and more reliable.

c4d0d72a10dc26f2e55ce5c2dd709accf0b500af.text: The app now uses different default AI brains for its standard and lite modes. Some advanced features may no longer appear if the new default brain cannot support them.

721d1d5c2d85cc0acd878e826b4fd832cd95810a.text: The model list no longer shows how many people are ahead of you in line. This removes confusing numbers, since queues do not currently form.

32aa640716e4d7af9ee0b5feac31802250ef2782.text: An internal update restricts one AI model to specific hours. You can only use it during those times.

d14ae806ccc679972f645f18c4626c742992bc96.text: The assistant now fixes small mistakes in its own instructions when using tools. This makes it more reliable and less likely to fail during tasks.

2d282ce3f002e05f6fa23ee3e753dcf71e878f2b.text: The assistant now sends requests without adding extra hidden instructions. This small internal change does not affect how you use the product.

8698c9a9a2ae2c01a1619cfeacbc4f38e2e5b815.text: The waiting room screen now keeps a fixed space for the ad before it loads. This stops the page content from jumping around when the ad appears.

12a85348fc6f4c647e2df06bf06fea631467ed6f.text: The assistant now fixes broken data sent to its tools and reports issues clearly. This makes the system more reliable for users.

fdf34b7667ba21a400fdba34045282e9a10e3725.title: Gravity API key button guidance
fdf34b7667ba21a400fdba34045282e9a10e3725.summary: Added instruction to use `render_ui` for a primary button labeled "Get your {service.name} API key" with `conversion_url` as the link during service integration. This ensures a prominent, actionable UI element when credentials are the next required step. Change applies to `common/src/tools/params/tool/gravity-index.ts`.

18cde84c6d5b59255165d0fca707419bd82be4ca.title: Rename base2-gemini agent definition
18cde84c6d5b59255165d0fca707419bd82be4ca.summary: Renamed `agents/base2/base2-gemini-no-editor-evals.ts` to `base2-gemini-evals.ts`. Updated internal `id` to `base2-gemini-evals` and `displayName` to `Buffy the Gemini Orchestrator`. Affects only the base2 agents directory.

d727cd453111a7a6c890e0addf6884f095b552a0.title: Freebuff grace period fixed, env var removed
d727cd453111a7a6c890e0addf6884f095b552a0.summary: Removed `FREEBUFF_SESSION_GRACE_MS` env var. Replaced with hardcoded `SESSION_GRACE_MS` constant in `web/src/server/free-session/config.ts`. Updated `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts` to drop schema entry. Adjusted docs and `public-api.ts` getter to reflect fixed value.

fdadc4602f1fdbda8a076cd0af48714c5c9c4ab3.title: Disable renderui tool in base2 agent
fdadc4602f1fdbda8a076cd0af48714c5c9c4ab3.summary: Removed `render_ui` from the `base2` agent's tool list. This disables the tool for now, as indicated by the analysis notes. The change affects `agents/base2/base2.ts`.

2fdffcfa789703e0505995fccb30c422c778ab1c.title: gravityindex tool renderer added
2fdffcfa789703e0505995fccb30c422c778ab1c.summary: Added GravityIndexComponent in cli/src/components/tools/gravity-index.tsx to render gravity_index tool calls. Registered in cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts. Displays context-aware one-line summaries for search, browse, list_categories, get_service, and report_integration actions.

ce0dc1e52d1066d1087b9fbc7bd57403bfff2e9c.title: Add CANOPYWAVEAPIKEY default in CI env setup
ce0dc1e52d1066d1087b9fbc7bd57403bfff2e9c.summary: Added `ensureEnvDefault('CANOPYWAVE_API_KEY', 'test')` to `packages/internal/src/env.ts`. This ensures the `CANOPYWAVE_API_KEY` environment variable is set to 'test' when running in CI environments, aligning with existing API key defaults for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Fireworks. Scope limited to internal package environment configuration.

40185a3e1bcea3e4c2bc3b4b4c2cd1d9db18f8b7.title: Simplify terminal button UI feedback
40185a3e1bcea3e4c2bc3b4b4c2cd1d9db18f8b7.summary: Removed persistent status text and state tracking from terminal button components in `cli/src/components/tools/render-ui.tsx`. Click handling now triggers a transient 150ms visual flash using `TextAttributes.DIM` instead of setting `opened` or `failed` states. This eliminates color-coding based on link opening success and removes the associated status message rendering logic.

9b25609a250d7a9bf8b783d0305e212f76f681e8.title: Restore Gemini thinker for Kimi freebuff
9b25609a250d7a9bf8b783d0305e212f76f681e8.summary: Re-enabled the `freebuff-gemini-thinker` agent for the Kimi free model. Updated `base2.ts` to conditionally spawn this agent when `isFree` and `model` matches `FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID`. Modified `local-agent-registry.ts` to dynamically inject the thinker into `base2-free`'s spawnable agents and strip/add specific prompt lines based on the selected model. Adjusted `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to remove Gemini Pro from the picker UI while retaining its internal availability for the thinker role.

51359eead23d0c4ffee32cb78a61638ab3fc63f2.title: Add DeepSeek V4 Pro provider and agent
51359eead23d0c4ffee32cb78a61638ab3fc63f2.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro added as free model option. New `base2-free-deepseek-v4` agent uses `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`. Requires `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Reasoning tokens gated by `INCLUDE_REASONING_IN_MESSAGE_HISTORY` (default false). Covers `common/constants`, `agents/base2`, `web/llm-api`, `packages/agent-runtime`.

e781c56c1fd0f019f31795d09fe47b9296ebf740.title: Add renderui tool for interactive CLI buttons
e781c56c1fd0f019f31795d09fe47b9296ebf740.summary: New `render_ui` tool allows agents to display interactive buttons in the Codebuff CLI. Clicking a button opens the provided `http` or `https` link via the system browser. Implemented in `cli/src/components/tools/render-ui.tsx` with theme-aware styling and state feedback. Registered in `common/src/tools/constants.ts` and `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts`; available in non-fast base2 agent configurations.

40185a3e1bcea3e4c2bc3b4b4c2cd1d9db18f8b7.text: The app no longer shows permanent messages or color changes when you click a link. Instead, the button briefly dims to confirm the click. This makes the screen cleaner and easier to read.

fdadc4602f1fdbda8a076cd0af48714c5c9c4ab3.text: The assistant can no longer create visual layouts or interfaces. This feature is temporarily disabled.

d727cd453111a7a6c890e0addf6884f095b552a0.text: The time allowed to finish a free session is now fixed and cannot be changed. This update is internal and does not change how the product works for you.

18cde84c6d5b59255165d0fca707419bd82be4ca.text: The assistant's internal name and display label changed to 'Buffy the Gemini Orchestrator'. This is a small internal update that does not change how the assistant works.

fdf34b7667ba21a400fdba34045282e9a10e3725.text: When the app needs an account key to work, it now shows a clear button to get one. This helps you set up services faster without hunting for links.

9b25609a250d7a9bf8b783d0305e212f76f681e8.text: The assistant now uses a different thinking model when you select the free Kimi option. This happens automatically in the background without changing your usual settings.

e781c56c1fd0f019f31795d09fe47b9296ebf740.text: The assistant can now show clickable buttons in the command line interface. Clicking a button opens a web link in your browser.

ce0dc1e52d1066d1087b9fbc7bd57403bfff2e9c.text: A small internal update sets a default test key for an automated service. This helps internal systems run smoothly during checks. It does not change how the product works for you.

51359eead23d0c4ffee32cb78a61638ab3fc63f2.text: A new free option is now available for the assistant. To use it, you must connect your account to the provider's service. The assistant will not show its internal thinking steps unless you change a setting.

2fdffcfa789703e0505995fccb30c422c778ab1c.text: The tool now shows simple, one-line summaries for different actions. This makes results easier to read.

fbd3b1e27f7f8ecab654c9e7ca58e5e2557aa928.title: Dev-only localhost bypass for free mode country check
fbd3b1e27f7f8ecab654c9e7ca58e5e2557aa928.summary: getFreeModeCountryAccess now accepts allowLocalhost flag, gated on NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT === 'dev'. When set, requests lacking cf-ipcountry from loopback IPs (127.x, ::1, ::ffff:127.0.0.1) or missing client IP resolve as US-allowed, skipping ipinfo/geoip. Covers web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts and web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts. Production unreachable because Cloudflare always sets cf-ipcountry.

14559962af1f8a3de237b44dbaa9c22904093da8.title: Allow underscore aliases for spawned agent IDs
14559962af1f8a3de237b44dbaa9c22904093da8.summary: Added normalizeAgentIdForLookup to treat underscores as hyphens in agent name segments. Agent registry and spawn handlers now resolve IDs using this normalization, enabling flexible matching for local templates, database caches, and spawn permissions. Publisher IDs and versions remain case-sensitive and unnormalized.

8ebb2284766ba0abd76aa21b0077a4b2bc319ac6.title: Revert Kimi K2.6 to GLM 5.1 in free and lite agents
8ebb2284766ba0abd76aa21b0077a4b2bc319ac6.summary: Reverts the recent switch to MoonshotAI Kimi K2.6, restoring Z.AI GLM 5.1 as the default model for free and lite agent modes. The change updates `FREEBUFF_MODELS` constants, CLI selector logic, and agent definitions (`base2`, `editor-lite`, `code-reviewer-lite`) to use `z-ai/glm-5.1`. `moonshotai/kimi-k2.6` is removed from `ModelName` types and free agent model sets. Existing sessions and saved preferences referencing Kimi are unaffected by this config-level revert, but new sessions will default to GLM 5.1.

744f49cda0f96748aec3e1b875f8c9a01ef009e4.title: Add Gemini 3.1 Pro to free model picker
744f49cda0f96748aec3e1b875f8c9a01ef009e4.summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro (`google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview`) added to `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and prioritized in CLI selector. `base2.ts` supports model overrides, enabling 'Buffy the Gemini Evals Orchestrator'. Free mode agent model allowlists dynamically generated from `FREEBUFF_MODELS`. Database `AgentRun` gains `ancestor_run_ids` for root agent validation in completions API.

41a0f4dcb878a8912518a1677857235b3343612e.title: Kimi K2.6 replaces GLM 5.1 as free default model
41a0f4dcb878a8912518a1677857235b3343612e.summary: Kimi K2.6 replaces GLM 5.1 as the free model for base2, editor-lite, and code-reviewer-lite agents. The CLI model selector and session hooks now reference FREEBUFF_KIMI_MODEL_ID, updating quota and fallback logic examples. Model type definitions in agent-definition.ts remove kimi-k2.5 and add kimi-k2.6. Common constants switch from FREEBUFF_MODELS to SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS for validation.

8cc765a6f0e563278323a30c4ab4f69bf8d90b0b.title: CLI model picker shows rate limits and simplifies navigation
8cc765a6f0e563278323a30c4ab4f69bf8d90b0b.summary: The CLI freebuff model selector now displays 'Used today' and 'Limit used' hints by fetching per-model quota snapshots via a new `rateLimitsByModel` field in the session state. Navigation logic was refactored to remove selectable-filtering from `nextFreebuffModelId`, allowing users to arrow through all models and rely on the picker's `isJoinable` check to prevent joining exhausted queues. This change spans `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`, and `web/src/server/free-session/public-api.ts`.

537da7262e41c2b3153deaff46ba434318c2f83f.title: Subagent tool names use underscores
537da7262e41c2b3153deaff46ba434318c2f83f.summary: Direct subagent tool names now use underscores (e.g., `code_searcher`) instead of hyphens, driven by new `getAgentToolName` helper in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/prompts.ts`. This aligns tool identifiers with provider-native expectations and resolves potential schema compatibility issues. The change impacts `common/src/tools/params/tool/spawn-agents.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`. `getAgentShortName` remains for internal ID mapping, while `toolSet` keys in `buildAgentToolSet` and execution lookups now consume the underscored variant.

40d0a34ee8bd80033063f06c33855d67d09fdb9a.title: Add gated Gravity Index tool
40d0a34ee8bd80033063f06c33855d67d09fdb9a.summary: Introduces `gravity_index` tool for searching, browsing, and reporting third-party service integrations. Supports actions: search, browse, list_categories, get_service, report_integration. Includes `conversion_url` in search results for user credential setup. Gated tool definition, context pruning, analytics, and API routes added.

08b69435f21d290eebafab30f3bc456f29616697.title: Simplify ad response shape
08b69435f21d290eebafab30f3bc456f29616697.summary: Ad response shape simplified to `ads: AdResponse[] | null` across CLI and Web. Removed `AdVariant` ('banner' | 'choice') and single-ad `ad` field in favor of unified array. `useGravityAd` hook now returns `ads` directly; `ChoiceAdBanner` always receives array. Server API returns `{ ads: [], provider }` for empty cases via `noAdsResponse` helper. Gravity provider drops A/B variant logic and `BANNER_PLACEMENT_ID`, always using `CHOICE_PLACEMENT_IDS`. Carbon provider returns `{ ads }` without variant wrapper. Files: `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`, `web/src/lib/ad-providers/gravity.ts`, `web/src/lib/ad-providers/carbon.ts`, `web/src/lib/ad-providers/types.ts`.

b8fada28b29c3dca484789f94f35ad43ebc85bbf.title: Kimi K2.6 replaces GLM 5.1 as default free model
b8fada28b29c3dca484789f94f35ad43ebc85bbf.summary: Moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 now serves as the default 'Smartest' model in free/lite modes, replacing z-ai/glm-5.1. Updates span agent definitions (base2, editor, reviewer), CLI selectors, and core constants to enforce new routing and availability logic. The model inherits GLM's deployment-hours availability constraint and 5-session/12h rate limit quota.

537da7262e41c2b3153deaff46ba434318c2f83f.text: Internal names for helper tasks changed format to match system expectations. This is a small, behind-the-scenes fix that improves compatibility and does not change how you use the product.

14559962af1f8a3de237b44dbaa9c22904093da8.text: The assistant now recognizes agent names that use underscores instead of dashes. This makes it easier to find and use specific helpers.

8ebb2284766ba0abd76aa21b0077a4b2bc319ac6.text: The assistant switched back to its previous default settings for free and lite modes. This means new chats will use the older model again, while your existing saved chats remain unchanged.

41a0f4dcb878a8912518a1677857235b3343612e.text: The free AI assistant now uses a newer model instead of the previous one. You do not need to do anything; the switch happens automatically.

fbd3b1e27f7f8ecab654c9e7ca58e5e2557aa928.text: Developers can now test the product on their own computers without needing an internet connection. Regular users will not notice any difference.

40d0a34ee8bd80033063f06c33855d67d09fdb9a.text: The assistant can now search for and list third-party services you can connect. It also shows links to help you set up your login details for these services.

744f49cda0f96748aec3e1b875f8c9a01ef009e4.text: The assistant can now use a new, more advanced model for free. This change gives you better answers and smarter help when you use the product.

8cc765a6f0e563278323a30c4ab4f69bf8d90b0b.text: The tool now shows how much of each option you have used. You can scroll through all choices, but you cannot pick one that is full.

08b69435f21d290eebafab30f3bc456f29616697.text: The system now uses one consistent format for displaying ads, removing old variations. This change is internal and will not affect how you use the product.

b8fada28b29c3dca484789f94f35ad43ebc85bbf.text: The free version now uses a different smart assistant model. It has the same limits as the old one, so you can still use it during set hours and for up to five sessions every twelve hours.

19bb1512b49bc195eb4ee2a72e73ecf14ca26ba4.title: Route Kimi K2.6 through CanopyWave
19bb1512b49bc195eb4ee2a72e73ecf14ca26ba4.summary: Kimi K2.6 requests now route to CanopyWave in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts. CANOPYWAVE_MODELS in web/src/llm-api/canopywave.ts consolidates routing and per-model pricing, replacing hardcoded constants. Pricing updated to $0.95/$0.16/$4.00 per million tokens.

25213224df77f64c13bf40df22bf7b2cc4360a93.title: Kimi tool call compat layer
25213224df77f64c13bf40df22bf7b2cc4360a93.summary: Added `kimi-tool-compat.ts` to inject `id` fields into tool declarations and `name` fields into tool-result messages for `moonshotai/*` models. This satisfies Kimi's strict OpenAI-compatible schema requirements which reject standard Chat Completions payloads lacking these fields. The compatibility layer is applied in `canopywave.ts` and `openrouter.ts` via `isKimiModel` checks before sending requests. Types updated in `types.ts` to include optional `tools` and `id` fields.

b6b99666858e977fb2a300dcf1f8d4c80e018654.title: Freebuff CLI shows specific VPN/Tor block reasons
b6b99666858e977fb2a300dcf1f8d4c80e018654.summary: Waiting-room screen now displays precise IP privacy signals (VPN, Tor, proxy) instead of generic unknown-location errors. `getCountryCodeFromFreeModeError` replaced by `getCountryBlockFromFreeModeError` in `error-handling.ts` to extract `countryBlockReason` and `ipPrivacySignals` from API responses. `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` defines new `FreebuffCountryBlockReason` and `FreebuffIpPrivacySignal` enums; `parseApiErrorResponseBody` in `common/src/util/error.ts` parses these fields. Scope: CLI waiting-room UI, error handling utils, common type definitions, session state.

a452cabacaf1a0241a39bf657c576840943fba9d.title: Block unverifiable free-mode countries
a452cabacaf1a0241a39bf657c576840943fba9d.summary: Free mode now requires a resolved allowlisted country; unknown, VPN, Tor, proxy, or anonymized traffic returns `country_blocked` with `countryCode: 'UNKNOWN'`. The chat-completions gate and session handler replace the old fail-open `getCountryCode` logic with `getFreeModeCountryAccess`, removing the `geoip-lite` dependency from the completions path. CLI `waiting-room-screen` renders a distinct message for unverified locations, and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` updates the `country_blocked` contract to document the `UNKNOWN` sentinel.

20dc66e496fe49e4981becbf1c5a5839f1584836.title: CanopyWave test scripts add model argument and kimi alias
20dc66e496fe49e4981becbf1c5a5839f1584836.summary: scripts/test-canopywave-long.ts now accepts a model argument, defaulting to minimax/minimax-m2.5 but supporting moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 via MODEL_CONFIGS and MODEL_ALIASES. MAX_TOKENS increased to 10000 to accommodate reasoning models. scripts/test-canopywave.ts hardcoded model switched to moonshotai/kimi-k2.6. Pricing constants moved into a typed ModelConfig object; unknown models exit with error.

8cfc4b0c1c15bb82cadba7a997f4383b4bd3ac16.title: Add waiting room ad surface to Gravity
8cfc4b0c1c15bb82cadba7a997f4383b4bd3ac16.summary: Introduces `waiting_room` ad surface to `useGravityAd` and `Gravity` provider. Maps this surface to specific `waiting-room-*` placement IDs, forcing `choice` variant. Updates `AdProvider` types and `postAds` validation to support the new surface.

eb47be392d867a2a8a0235cb993ff4d2af6d6c09.title: Block free mode VPN traffic via IPinfo
eb47be392d867a2a8a0235cb993ff4d2af6d6c09.summary: Free mode requests now check IP privacy signals (VPN, proxy, Tor, hosting) via IPinfo before allowing access. Requires new `IPINFO_TOKEN` env var; missing token fails validation. Updates `web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts` with async IP lookup and caching (30m TTL, 5k entries). Affects `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts`, `web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts`, and chat completions API.

894c58555c70298811bb100eb79190a867c79a13.title: Disable GLM dedicated Fireworks deployment
894c58555c70298811bb100eb79190a867c79a13.summary: GLM 5.1 (`z-ai/glm-5.1`) now routes through Fireworks serverless API during availability hours, bypassing the dedicated deployment `mjb4i7ea`. This change is driven by a new `FIREWORKS_HOURS_GATED_MODELS` set in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` that enforces hour-gating for `FREEBUFF_GLM_MODEL_ID` even on serverless, overriding the previous deployment-hour check. The update affects `web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts` (commented out deployment map) and `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` (fallback logic). Deployment-mapped models still never fall back to serverless API during cooldown or after 5xx errors.

362f5d536d5e38b3a744f5c96daba82a0d815412.title: GLM 5.1 session quota window shortened to 12 hours
362f5d536d5e38b3a744f5c96daba82a0d815412.summary: The `z-ai/glm-5.1` rate limit window in `web/src/server/free-session/public-api.ts` drops from 20 to 12 hours, keeping the cap at 5 sessions. `fetchRateLimitSnapshot` now returns `windowMs` directly to prevent duplicated math in the `retryAfterMs` calculation. CLI comments in `waiting-room-screen.tsx` and `use-freebuff-session.ts` updated to reflect the new window. Docs and schema comments in `packages/internal/src/db/schema.ts` and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` aligned.

f33c1ebf082f796f6c975627d3cb6b75bb9f980f.title: Harden Freebuff country gating
f33c1ebf082f796f6c975627d3cb6b75bb9f980f.summary: Added strict country and IP privacy checks to `POST /session`, failing closed on unresolved IPs or lookup errors. Introduced `ip_privacy_lookup_failed` block reason and expanded `free_session` table with columns for `country_code`, `cf_country`, `geoip_country`, `country_block_reason`, `ip_privacy_signals`, `client_ip_hash`, and `country_checked_at` via migration `0047_tough_silver_fox.sql`. Covers `packages/internal`, `web`, and `common` types; updates `docs/freebuff-waiting-room.md`.

a452cabacaf1a0241a39bf657c576840943fba9d.text: The service now blocks free access from locations that cannot be verified. If you use a VPN, Tor, or a proxy, you will see a message saying your location is unconfirmed and access is denied.

362f5d536d5e38b3a744f5c96daba82a0d815412.text: The waiting time between free sessions for a specific assistant model is now shorter, lasting 12 hours instead of 20. You can start a new session sooner after hitting the daily limit.

25213224df77f64c13bf40df22bf7b2cc4360a93.text: The system now fixes missing details in requests sent to a specific type of model. This prevents errors when the assistant tries to use external tools with that model.

894c58555c70298811bb100eb79190a867c79a13.text: The service now directs certain requests to a shared network instead of a private one during specific hours. Users will notice no difference in how the assistant responds.

b6b99666858e977fb2a300dcf1f8d4c80e018654.text: When you cannot access a service due to location restrictions, the app now tells you specifically if a VPN or proxy is causing the block, instead of showing a vague error.

f33c1ebf082f796f6c975627d3cb6b75bb9f980f.text: The system now checks your location to block access from certain countries. If the check fails, access is denied for safety.

eb47be392d867a2a8a0235cb993ff4d2af6d6c09.text: The service now checks if you are using a privacy tool like a VPN or proxy before letting you use the free version. If detected, access is blocked to ensure fair usage.

19bb1512b49bc195eb4ee2a72e73ecf14ca26ba4.text: The assistant now uses a different service for Kimi K2.6. This is an internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

8cfc4b0c1c15bb82cadba7a997f4383b4bd3ac16.text: The app now shows a specific type of ad in waiting rooms. This ensures the right ad format appears while you wait.

20dc66e496fe49e4981becbf1c5a5839f1584836.text: The testing tools can now switch between different AI brains to compare their performance. This change helps the team check how well the product works with new options.

25f8b89c42ac2c35f0d8d4681987dfe169e3280c.title: Raise MiniMax instant admit threshold
25f8b89c42ac2c35f0d8d4681987dfe169e3280c.summary: MiniMax instant admit capacity increased from 200 to 1000 in `web/src/server/free-session/config.ts`. Change supports higher concurrent usage without altering session grace logic. Scope limited to server config.

a2ded144546c3a4535002cb8ae78cda4dcce08ae.title: ChoiceAdBanner shows ad title when URL missing
a2ded144546c3a4535002cb8ae78cda4dcce08ae.summary: The CLI ad banner now displays the ad title instead of a blank space if the ad response lacks a URL. A new `getAdDisplayLabel` helper resolves this fallback, using `extractDomain` for URLs or the title for missing links. The component applies `TextAttributes.DIM` for title fallbacks and truncates text to fit column widths. This change affects `cli/src/components/choice-ad-banner.tsx`.

f13eed31aadf22362eae2419ff326f18199b31b6.title: Lite mode fallback to Fireworks standard API
f13eed31aadf22362eae2419ff326f18199b31b6.summary: Lite cost mode now routes to Fireworks standard API instead of erroring or using custom deployments. `createFireworksRequestWithFallback` checks `cost_mode === 'lite'` to bypass deployment hours, cooldowns, and 5xx errors. Scope limited to `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts`.

d77b15357e72be57e8dc063f158ad87368fb7a55.title: Show local freebuff model availability
d77b15357e72be57e8dc063f158ad87368fb7a55.summary: CLI model selector now displays dynamic deployment availability labels based on user's local timezone. Replaced static `FREEBUFF_DEPLOYMENT_HOURS_LABEL` with `getFreebuffDeploymentAvailabilityLabel()` in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx`. Added timezone-aware date calculation utilities in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to compute local availability windows. Covers CLI interface; server-facing fallback label remains for API errors.

e6dbaa57c4631c420cc9490b6751d5d568719e12.title: ChoiceAdBanner label styling tweak
e6dbaa57c4631c420cc9490b6751d5d568719e12.summary: Updated `ChoiceAdBanner` in `cli/src/components/choice-ad-banner.tsx` to use `TextAttributes.BOLD` instead of `DIM` for non-domain labels. Also corrected closing tag syntax.

f7c7870d8533395e47d9a3ea1216b0036f9c204c.title: Add fallback model ID
f7c7870d8533395e47d9a3ea1216b0036f9c204c.summary: Added `FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` constant and `FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_MODEL_ID` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` now points to GLM, while fallback logic in `useFreebuffSession` and `freebuff-model-store` uses the always-available MiniMax model. `setSelectedModel` in `freebuff-model-store.ts` is now in-memory only, moving persistence exclusively to `joinFreebuffQueue` in `use-freebuff-session.ts` to prevent server-driven auto-flips from overwriting user preferences.

fa3c0324cf252ceff341f9dbc08e52dba3e051d5.title: CLI ad system adds Carbon fallback for Gravity
fa3c0324cf252ceff341f9dbc08e52dba3e051d5.summary: The `useGravityAd` hook now accepts a `fallbackProvider` option and iterates through a list of providers if the primary fails or returns no fill. This change updates `chat.tsx` and `waiting-room-screen.tsx` to specify `gravity` as the primary provider and `carbon` as the fallback, replacing the previous behavior where the waiting room exclusively used Carbon. The mechanism ensures ad continuity in the CLI by attempting a secondary network when the first is unavailable.

f7bda6243190a9d7853e0dfc16c0c808ac7271de.title: Fix CLI model picker Enter and navigation logic
f7bda6243190a9d7853e0dfc16c0c808ac7271de.summary: Refactored `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to use new `freebuff-model-navigation.ts` utilities for handling Enter/Space commits and arrow navigation. This ensures the picker correctly resolves the target model ID, prioritizing the focused item if available, otherwise falling back to the selected item, while gracefully handling scenarios where no models are selectable. Updated `use-freebuff-session.ts` to prevent race conditions during restarts by tracking generation IDs and resetting the fetch method to GET for landing states. Adjusted `waiting-room-screen.tsx` to display errors even when a session exists but has a 'none' status.

dc84d374a148fa96a6056bf8bccca23e68eca5b9.title: Fireworks deployment hours daily
dc84d374a148fa96a6056bf8bccca23e68eca5b9.summary: Fireworks deployment availability logic updated to run daily instead of weekdays only. `isFreebuffDeploymentHours` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` removes weekend checks and adjusts `getNextFreebuffDeploymentStart` offset calculation. `FREEBUFF_DEPLOYMENT_HOURS_LABEL` updated to '9am ET-5pm PT every day'. Local time formatting in `getFreebuffDeploymentAvailabilityLabel` drops the 'local' suffix.

dffc7e4372e2972a6b191c42e9365ef32a176a71.title: GLM rate limit 5 sessions per 20 hours
dffc7e4372e2972a6b191c42e9365ef32a176a71.summary: Added per-model session quota for GLM 5.1 (5 admits per 20h window). New `rate_limited` status in CLI `WaitingRoomScreen` shows usage and retry time. DB migration `0046` creates `free_session_admit` table with index on user/model/time. API returns 429 on POST when quota exceeded; older CLIs back off due to status code.

f7bda6243190a9d7853e0dfc16c0c808ac7271de.text: The model selection menu now responds more reliably to keyboard navigation. The app also prevents occasional glitches when restarting a session and displays errors more consistently.

e6dbaa57c4631c420cc9490b6751d5d568719e12.text: A small visual update makes certain text in the command-line tool appear bold instead of dim.

fa3c0324cf252ceff341f9dbc08e52dba3e051d5.text: The app now tries a backup ad source if the main one fails. This keeps ads running smoothly while you wait.

f7c7870d8533395e47d9a3ea1216b0036f9c204c.text: The app now automatically switches to a reliable backup assistant if the preferred one is unavailable. Your choice of assistant is saved only when you join a session, so the system won't override your preference.

a2ded144546c3a4535002cb8ae78cda4dcce08ae.text: Ad banners now show the ad title if the link is missing. This prevents blank spaces.

d77b15357e72be57e8dc063f158ad87368fb7a55.text: The assistant now shows if specific models are available based on your local time. This helps you know which options you can use right now.

25f8b89c42ac2c35f0d8d4681987dfe169e3280c.text: The assistant can now handle more people at once without slowing down.

dc84d374a148fa96a6056bf8bccca23e68eca5b9.text: Fireworks are now available every day, not just weekdays. The time label shows '9am ET-5pm PT' without mentioning your local time.

f13eed31aadf22362eae2419ff326f18199b31b6.text: When the system tries to use a cheaper, faster version of the AI assistant, it now automatically switches to the standard version if the cheap one is busy or unavailable. This means you are less likely to see an error or a blank screen, and the assistant will keep working normally.

dffc7e4372e2972a6b191c42e9365ef32a176a71.text: Usage limits now restrict the AI assistant to five sessions every twenty hours. When you reach this limit, the app will tell you when you can try again.

de32834c77187d82c06aef4462df5c10149f4546.title: Terms of Service updated to reflect Manicode, Inc. (DBA Codebuff)
de32834c77187d82c06aef4462df5c10149f4546.summary: Replaced all instances of 'Codebuff, Inc' with 'Manicode, Inc. (DBA Codebuff)' or 'Manicode, Inc' in web/src/app/terms-of-service/page.tsx. Aligns legal terms with current corporate entity. Scope limited to web ToS page.

2ce07f2db82e2bbb24f2499cc3bdc767670f3d6c.title: CLI marks session countryblocked on freemodeunavailable
2ce07f2db82e2bbb24f2499cc3bdc767670f3d6c.summary: CLI flips Freebuff session to `country_blocked` when chat-completions returns `free_mode_unavailable` with a `countryCode`. New `markFreebuffSessionCountryBlocked` in `use-freebuff-session.ts` aborts the poll controller, applies the terminal state, and releases the waiting-room slot. `getCountryCodeFromFreeModeError` in `error-handling.ts` extracts the code; `web/.../completions/_post.ts` now includes `countryCode` in the 403 body. Covers `send-message.ts` error/completion handlers and the Web API gate.

49b8b2cfa951743de1affca7625fc4165d9a670c.title: Region signal added to abuse scoring
49b8b2cfa951743de1affca7625fc4165d9a670c.summary: Added heuristic region inference to `abuse-detection.ts` using CJK names, Chinese email providers, and `.edu.cn` domains. Score increases by 25-40 points only when combined with high message volume (`msgs24h >= 300/500`). Updated `abuse-review.ts` guidelines to treat this as corroborating evidence, not standalone ban grounds. Prevents false positives for diaspora users while targeting VPN-based farming clusters.

08c9f24906e3ca2a5798360242009f7f70f5714c.title: Terms of Service update: entity name and date
08c9f24906e3ca2a5798360242009f7f70f5714c.summary: Terms of Service page updated to reflect entity name change from Codebuff, Inc. to Manicode, Inc. and date bumped to 04/23/2026. Change affects `web/src/app/terms-of-service/page.tsx`. Legal text now correctly identifies Manicode, Inc. as the entity holding trademarks and copyright.

a33580f1172d15cc5251c499c83675894751aa40.title: Refine quiet gap calculation in abuse detection
a33580f1172d15cc5251c499c83675894751aa40.summary: Updated `identifyBotSuspects` in `web/src/server/free-session/abuse-detection.ts` to calculate quiet gaps using window boundaries derived from user creation time and current time. The SQL query now constructs a `bounds` CTE to clip the observation window to `GREATEST(created_at, cutoff)`, ensuring leading and trailing gaps are counted correctly for fresh or recently active accounts. This change improves the accuracy of the 'user slept' counter-signal by including post-activity quiet time in the maximum gap calculation.

a372554f76118600c0116e7f7d4422c4e8f7e84b.title: Parse stringified tool-call input before Zod validation
a372554f76118600c0116e7f7d4422c4e8f7e84b.summary: Agent Runtime now attempts JSON.parse on stringified tool-call inputs before Zod validation in tool-stream-parser.ts. Malformed JSON from AI SDK repair failures previously bypassed validation, causing opaque errors. tool-executor.ts adds explicit stringInputError handling for remaining string inputs, returning actionable messages. Scope limited to packages/agent-runtime; no CLI/Web/Desktop changes.

ff675681689666dabad9e8a9172bc40aaa557b99.title: CLI ads use ChoiceAdBanner for all variants
ff675681689666dabad9e8a9172bc40aaa557b99.summary: CLI chat and waiting-room screens now render all ads through ChoiceAdBanner, deleting the standalone AdBanner component. This unifies the ad UI and removes the manual disable button from the chat interface. The Carbon web provider was updated to fetch multiple ads concurrently to support the choice variant layout.

3e4179228dddec236914b4fd5e0c7538ecb2da92.title: Add Carbon ad provider for CLI waiting room
3e4179228dddec236914b4fd5e0c7538ecb2da92.summary: CLI waiting room now queries Carbon (BuySellAds) instead of Gravity by passing provider: 'carbon' to useGravityAd. Server-side ad_providers/carbon.ts normalizes responses into the existing AdResponse shape. DB migration 0045_mean_sleeper.sql adds provider text column (default 'gravity') and extra_pixels text[] to ad_impression table, with payout now nullable. In-chat ads continue using Gravity as default.

8e39fa2e032c9956dd80ae84cc8f4d1c3420dca5.title: Add deployment hours availability for GLM 5.1 and MiniMax M2.7 support
8e39fa2e032c9956dd80ae84cc8f4d1c3420dca5.summary: GLM 5.1 (`z-ai/glm-5.1`) availability is restricted to deployment hours (9am ET-5pm PT) via new `availability` policy in `FREEBUFF_MODELS`. MiniMax M2.7 (`minimax/minimax-m2.7`) added as always-available option and mapped in `createCodeEditor`. CLI model store resolves available models; session hook handles `model_unavailable` 409s by resetting to default. `moonshotai/kimi-k2.5` variants removed from `ModelName`.

8ce2c7174ebedbe8117bf44377c553ceee8be468.title: Abuse review agent prompt tuning
8ce2c7174ebedbe8117bf44377c553ceee8be468.summary: Refined `abuse-review.ts` prompts to tighten bot detection heuristics. Counter-signal thresholds lowered (`quiet-gap` ≥3h, `diverse-agents` ≥5) while fresh-GH weighting increased. TIER 1 criteria clarified to require near-continuous activity (≥18h) or multi-signal stacks, reducing false positives on power users.

08c9f24906e3ca2a5798360242009f7f70f5714c.text: The Terms of Service page now lists the company name as Manicode, Inc. and shows the date April 23, 2026. This is a small internal update to legal text and does not change how the product works.

de32834c77187d82c06aef4462df5c10149f4546.text: The legal agreement text now names the correct company. This is an internal update. It does not change how you use the product.

a33580f1172d15cc5251c499c83675894751aa40.text: The system now better identifies inactive users by checking the time since their last activity. This improves the accuracy of security measures that protect the service from automated abuse.

2ce07f2db82e2bbb24f2499cc3bdc767670f3d6c.text: If the assistant stops working because your country is not supported, the app now shows a clear message instead of freezing. It also frees up your place in the waiting line so you can try again later.

ff675681689666dabad9e8a9172bc40aaa557b99.text: All ads in the chat and waiting areas now share one design. This removes the manual off button from the chat.

8e39fa2e032c9956dd80ae84cc8f4d1c3420dca5.text: One AI assistant is now only available during specific business hours. A new assistant is always available, and two older options were removed. If a restricted assistant is used outside its hours, the tool automatically switches to a default assistant.

49b8b2cfa951743de1affca7625fc4165d9a670c.text: The system now checks where messages come from to spot fake accounts more easily. Real users won't get banned just for their location, but spammers will be caught faster.

8ce2c7174ebedbe8117bf44377c553ceee8be468.text: The team adjusted the rules that spot automated accounts. This change aims to stop mistaking real, heavy users for bots.

3e4179228dddec236914b4fd5e0c7538ecb2da92.text: The waiting screen now shows ads from a new company. This change does not affect the ads you see in chats.

a372554f76118600c0116e7f7d4422c4e8f7e84b.text: The assistant now checks its own instructions for mistakes before trying to do them. This stops confusing errors and shows clear messages when something goes wrong.

4c3be9e5f60b0c89fb7fa8cb42e5d335d949e375.title: Move project picker before auth and waiting-room gates
4c3be9e5f60b0c89fb7fa8cb42e5d335d949e375.summary: Project picker rendering now precedes login modal and waiting-room checks in cli/src/app.tsx. Prevents auth failures or queue states from replacing the picker mid-flash, ensuring users select a working directory first. Affects CLI startup flow only. Logic relies on showProjectPicker flag evaluated before authentication state.

938191c3f2cdcda8e5f2613ed2f250a2c8b8ee6e.title: Fix CLI model picker showing false No wait after session ends
938191c3f2cdcda8e5f2613ed2f250a2c8b8ee6e.summary: Freebuff CLI model picker now fetches queue depths immediately after a session ends to prevent flashing "No wait" on all rows. `use-freebuff-session.ts` initiates a fire-and-forget GET request in 'landing' mode, extracting only `queueDepthByModel` to avoid triggering silent auto-rejoins from stale server states. `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` returns null for ahead counts when depths are missing, keeping hints blank until data arrives. Scope: CLI hooks and components.

76c3d44991d7a4d6424bb1d484b73cb453902454.title: Disable followup clicks after Freebuff session ends
76c3d44991d7a4d6424bb1d484b73cb453902454.summary: SuggestFollowupsItem disables buttons when IS_FREEBUFF and session status is 'ended'. Uses useFreebuffSessionStore to track state. Prevents actions on dead sessions.

2d3a32bd4522b027f88c1460088a2331a540ab22.title: Adjust abuse scoring for established GitHub accounts
2d3a32bd4522b027f88c1460088a2331a540ab22.summary: Added negative score adjustments in `abuse-detection.ts` for GitHub accounts aged ≥1 year (-20) and ≥3 years (-40). This acts as a counter-signal to prevent false positives on legitimate power users with old accounts. `abuse-review.ts` prompt updated to instruct reviewers not to tier established accounts as HIGH without independent signals.

2e3f02b8ddbf01d0944290ed1180467912f8d048.title: CLI: /end-session returns to model picker
2e3f02b8ddbf01d0944290ed1180467912f8d048.summary: Replaced endAndRejoinFreebuffSession with returnToFreebuffLanding in cli/src/chat.tsx and cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts. This ensures ending a session drops the user to the landing view rather than re-queuing immediately. The hook flips status to 'none', unmounting <Chat> and mounting <WaitingRoomScreen> on the picker. Updated END_SESSION_MESSAGE in cli/src/utils/constants.ts to reflect the new behavior.

57f569e59749eb959251d5293e64f60294a2c64b.title: Hourly bot-sweep dry-run endpoint and admin scripts
57f569e59749eb959251d5293e64f60294a2c64b.summary: Added /api/admin/bot-sweep endpoint triggered by hourly GitHub Action (.github/workflows/bot-sweep.yml). Uses shared secret auth (BOT_SWEEP_SECRET) and optional GitHub PAT (BOT_SWEEP_GITHUB_TOKEN) to identify abuse suspects via new abuse-detection/abuse-review logic in web/src/server/free-session/. Introduces FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts to filter root orchestrator agents (base2-free) from subagents for accurate usage counting. Includes dry-run scripts (inspect-freebuff-active.ts, test-bot-sweep.ts) and unban utility (unban-freebuff-users.ts) for manual review.

fb2656966ba564e13d588d8ca0a06658d1e5e422.title: Session endpoints reject banned users
fb2656966ba564e13d588d8ca0a06658d1e5e422.summary: Added 'banned' terminal status to Freebuff session endpoints, returning HTTP 403 to prevent banned accounts from joining the queue. `resolveUser` now fetches the `banned` field; `requestSession` and `getSessionState` short-circuit if true. CLI `use-freebuff-session` treats 403 with `banned` body as terminal, stopping polling; `WaitingRoomScreen` displays an account unavailable message. Server `queueDepthsByModel` and `queuePositionFor` filter out banned users via SQL `NOT EXISTS` to stabilize queue counters.

b234a41d2a82101d48b6df162b29f0896fe3a70a.title: Add counter-signals to abuse detector
b234a41d2a82101d48b6df162b29f0896fe3a70a.summary: Abuse detector now computes agent diversity and max quiet gap hours to mitigate false positives. LAG() SQL queries track inter-message gaps and distinct agent counts in 24h windows. Review prompt instructs tiering down suspects with strong counter-signals like sleep gaps or diverse agent usage. Updates web/src/server/free-session/abuse-detection.ts and abuse-review.ts.

0706c98b582684fbc935fa4a36f3575f310b5e6c.title: CLI session end returns to model picker
0706c98b582684fbc935fa4a36f3575f310b5e6c.summary: Session-ended banner now calls returnToFreebuffLanding instead of refreshFreebuffSession, dropping users to the model picker rather than silently re-queueing. use-freebuff-session.ts introduces a RestartMode type and restart controller to handle 'rejoin' vs 'landing' transitions. A new releaseFreebuffSlot helper conditionally DELETEs active session rows before restarts to ensure clean state.

212bab08e71dc3d7dec495ba7d7e2600c0ec77e2.title: Instant-admit free sessions when below per-model capacity
212bab08e71dc3d7dec495ba7d7e2600c0ec77e2.summary: Adds instant-admit logic to `requestSession` in `web/src/server/free-session/public-api.ts`. New joiners skip the FIFO queue if the model's active session count is below a configured `INSTANT_ADMIT_CAPACITY` (e.g., 50 for `z-ai/glm-5.1`, 200 for `minimax/minimax-m2.7`). Backpressure engages only when this threshold is reached. Includes new store functions `activeCountForModel` and `promoteQueuedUser` to handle the state transition.

938191c3f2cdcda8e5f2613ed2f250a2c8b8ee6e.text: The app no longer briefly shows an incorrect 'No wait' message when a session ends. It now checks the actual queue status first, so you see accurate information before choosing a model.

76c3d44991d7a4d6424bb1d484b73cb453902454.text: When a session ends, suggestion buttons become unclickable. This stops you from trying to use features that no longer work.

2e3f02b8ddbf01d0944290ed1180467912f8d048.text: When you end a chat session, you now return to the model selection screen instead of automatically rejoining a queue.

fb2656966ba564e13d588d8ca0a06658d1e5e422.text: Banned accounts can no longer join the waiting queue. If you try to use the app with a restricted account, you will see a message saying the account is unavailable instead of waiting indefinitely.

2d3a32bd4522b027f88c1460088a2331a540ab22.text: The system now trusts older accounts more. This helps avoid mistakenly blocking experienced users as abusive.

4c3be9e5f60b0c89fb7fa8cb42e5d335d949e375.text: The program now asks you to choose a folder before checking if you are logged in. This ensures you can pick a location even if you have login issues or are waiting in a queue.

0706c98b582684fbc935fa4a36f3575f310b5e6c.text: When a session ends, you return to the model selection screen instead of automatically rejoining the queue.

57f569e59749eb959251d5293e64f60294a2c64b.text: The system now checks for rule-breaking accounts every hour. This helps keep the service fair for everyone.

212bab08e71dc3d7dec495ba7d7e2600c0ec77e2.text: New users join instantly when a model has open spots, skipping the wait line. Waiting only starts when the model is full.

b234a41d2a82101d48b6df162b29f0896fe3a70a.text: The system now checks for signs of normal behavior, like long breaks or different helpers, before flagging an account. This reduces mistaken warnings for regular users.

b3c8862230764bfcb68cdd4001824885c81ee8cb.title: Add minimax-m2.7 to Fireworks long test script
b3c8862230764bfcb68cdd4001824885c81ee8cb.summary: Added `minimax-m2.7` configuration to `scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts`. Includes model ID `minimax/minimax-m2.7`, standard model `accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m2p7`, deployment model `accounts/james-65d217/deployments/nrdudqxd`, and cost parameters. Internal testing tooling only.

b0d0e55a348de37244c1edb5c8c97017e573c350.title: Disable minimax/minimax-m2.7 deployment in fireworks-config
b0d0e55a348de37244c1edb5c8c97017e573c350.summary: minimax/minimax-m2.7 deployment mapping commented out in web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts. Prevents routing to accounts/james-65d217/deployments/nrdudqxd. Internal config change.

46bf7033c9cdd02a76ffed40eab17c2ee9a3c1d9.title: Per-model active session counts in admission logs
46bf7033c9cdd02a76ffed40eab17c2ee9a3c1d9.summary: Admission tick logs per-model active session counts via new `activeCountsByModel` store function replacing global `activeCount`. Adds SQL `GROUP BY` on `freeSession.model` for single-query bucketed reads. Updates `AdmissionTickResult` interface and `AdmissionDeps` to carry `Record<string, number>` instead of scalar. Affects `web/src/server/free-session/admission.ts` and `store.ts`; log aggregator now receives `activeCountByModel` metric alongside existing `queueDepthByModel`.

50f2ade2171191f6369ab907ee04f50cf76f3dfb.title: Model tagline moves inline in CLI selector
50f2ade2171191f6369ab907ee04f50cf76f3dfb.summary: Tagline rendering shifts to an inline span next to the model name in cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx, removing it from the trailing hint slot. The hintWidth calculation drops the max(tagline.length) term, fixing the slot to 'No wait' or '999 ahead' widths. Affects the CLI freebuff model picker surface.

f953ae68f3b5abf9b56cc7d69b56ecd0e9266e25.title: Add minimax/minimax-m2.7 deployment
f953ae68f3b5abf9b56cc7d69b56ecd0e9266e25.summary: Added `minimax/minimax-m2.7` to `FIREWORKS_DEPLOYMENT_MAP` in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts`, pointing to `accounts/james-65d217/deployments/nrdudqxd`. This enables the new model version for the web LLM API. Scope limited to `web/src/llm-api/fireworks-config.ts`.

72afab04704468996fb3c2eef1150ff28633b78e.title: Model selector stacks buttons vertically on narrow terminals
72afab04704468996fb3c2eef1150ff28633b78e.summary: Added `useTerminalDimensions` to `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to compute layout dynamically. If calculated button width exceeds `terminalWidth - 4`, `flexDirection` switches from 'row' to 'column'. Keyboard navigation updated to accept Up/Down arrows for focus movement, previously ignored to prevent conflicts.

f872c7ae18bc99433babb66eaa22ec7f2a0cf695.title: CLI uses hardware fingerprint for login
f872c7ae18bc99433babb66eaa22ec7f2a0cf695.summary: CLI login flow now uses a stable hardware-based fingerprint via `node-machine-id` instead of random IDs. `getFingerprintId()` caches the result process-wide and falls back to legacy random generation if hardware hashing fails. Covers `cli/src/utils/fingerprint.ts`, `login-modal.tsx`, `init-app.ts`, and `login-store.ts`. Login polling gates on `fingerprintId` to ensure consistent auth state.

1d89739afa72e15aba869e50191b1be62a0cb290.title: Add two-step keyboard navigation to model selector
1d89739afa72e15aba869e50191b1be62a0cb290.summary: The CLI model selector now uses two-step keyboard navigation: Tab/arrow keys move a focus highlight, while Enter/Space commits the model switch. This prevents accidental queue position loss when navigating past the currently selected model. Mouse clicks remain one-step. Implemented in `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` by separating `focusedId` from `selectedModel` state.

6f2d8fa236055ec7e5f93209d3d93f8808c2eb1f.title: CLI freebuff startup now GET-probes before joining queue
6f2d8fa236055ec7e5f93209d3d93f8808c2eb1f.summary: Startup flow changed from auto-POST to GET-probe. Session status `none` now renders a pre-chat landing screen with a model picker instead of a shimmer 'Joining...' state. Server GET responses include `queueDepthByModel` so the CLI shows live 'N ahead' counts before the user commits to a queue. `switchFreebuffModel` renamed to `joinFreebuffQueue` in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`; `PollController.setHasPosted` removed.

58e7f306da16d24c097bda7826d08d1444777da7.title: evictBanned frees banned users' freesession slots each admission tick
58e7f306da16d24c097bda7826d08d1444777da7.summary: Adds evictBanned to web/src/server/free-session/store.ts, deleting free_session rows where the linked user is banned. Runs in parallel with sweepExpired in runAdmissionTick (web/src/server/free-session/admission.ts) so slots freed this tick admit queued users immediately. Bans via admin UI, direct SQL, or Stripe webhook previously left users holding slots until expires_at. AdmissionTickResult now carries evictedBanned count, logged under freebuff_waiting_room metric.

72afab04704468996fb3c2eef1150ff28633b78e.text: The model selection buttons now stack vertically when the screen is too narrow to fit them side by side. You can use the up and down arrow keys to choose a model in this view.

b3c8862230764bfcb68cdd4001824885c81ee8cb.text: A new option was added to internal testing tools. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

46bf7033c9cdd02a76ffed40eab17c2ee9a3c1d9.text: The system now tracks how many people use each service type at once. This helps staff spot which ones are getting crowded.

1d89739afa72e15aba869e50191b1be62a0cb290.text: The model selector now uses two-step keyboard navigation. You move the highlight first, then press Enter to switch models. This prevents losing your place if you accidentally scroll past the current selection.

f872c7ae18bc99433babb66eaa22ec7f2a0cf695.text: The login system now uses a unique, stable identifier tied to your device instead of a random one. This keeps your login state consistent and prevents unexpected logouts when the app restarts.

58e7f306da16d24c097bda7826d08d1444777da7.text: Banned users now lose their place in line immediately. This frees up spots for other people faster.

b0d0e55a348de37244c1edb5c8c97017e573c350.text: The system no longer sends requests to a specific AI model. This internal update stops that model from being used.

f953ae68f3b5abf9b56cc7d69b56ecd0e9266e25.text: The assistant can now use a new version of its underlying model. This is a small internal update that adds a new option for the team to choose from.

50f2ade2171191f6369ab907ee04f50cf76f3dfb.text: A short description for each model option now appears right next to the model name. This makes the list easier to scan.

6f2d8fa236055ec7e5f93209d3d93f8808c2eb1f.text: The app now checks server status before connecting to a queue, showing a model selection screen with real-time wait times instead of a generic loading message.

b76f9be64e0489961fd31dbb625d9181a9355b1d.title: Improved Freebuff model selector
b76f9be64e0489961fd31dbb625d9181a9355b1d.summary: Refactored the CLI model selector layout using a row-based box structure for better visual separation. Moved the selector component above the status details in the waiting room screen. This change enhances readability and interaction flow within the CLI interface.

ff385b6c6953eb8d617d7f53e1ce76e4dad57f85.title: Add bot investigation and ban scripts
ff385b6c6953eb8d617d7f53e1ce76e4dad57f85.summary: New scripts `scripts/ban-freebuff-bots.ts`, `scripts/investigate-user.ts`, and `scripts/unban-user.ts` enable case-insensitive email lookups, DB schema joins, and bulk `banned` flag updates via Drizzle. `ban-freebuff-bots.ts` defaults to a dry run, requiring `--commit` to toggle `banned=true` and delete `free_session` rows for parsed candidate lists. `investigate-user.ts` aggregates message counts, costs, and repo usage by agent. `unban-user.ts` reverses bans for provided email arguments. `.gitignore` excludes `docs/bot-detection.md`.

8b4f89224820c1cd509317e70450de8042486e3d.title: Switch db:migrate to drizzle-kit migrate
8b4f89224820c1cd509317e70450de8042486e3d.summary: packages/internal package.json script db:migrate now calls drizzle-kit migrate instead of push. Added bootstrap-migrations-journal.sql to seed drizzle.__drizzle_migrations with created_at 1776719872222 (matching 0044_violet_stingray) so migrate skips prior push-managed migrations. Run SQL once per existing environment; fresh databases skip it.

1242b4e38947578ec285e80ed8d498ad170ecd86.title: Set default token counter model to Claude Opus 4.6
1242b4e38947578ec285e80ed8d498ad170ecd86.summary: Token counting defaults to claude-opus-4-6 for non-Claude models after updating DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_MODEL in web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts. Adds anthropic/claude-opus-4.6 to OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP in common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts. Scope covers Web API token count endpoint and shared OAuth model mapping constants. Follow-up: Ensure tokenizer compatibility for Opus 4.6 context windows.

faa7d7a6e9ebd7897d4497103455f3161c7fc3fe.title: CLI status bar gains End session button and unified action rendering
faa7d7a6e9ebd7897d4497103455f3161c7fc3fe.summary: StatusBar renders a dedicated End session button when idle with an active freebuff session, and StopButton is replaced by a shared StatusActionButton for hover-bold styling. A new END_SESSION_MESSAGE constant centralizes the waiting-room notice previously hardcoded in command-registry.ts. The end-session handler appends the system message and calls endAndRejoinFreebuffSession from chat.tsx, removing the redundant IS_FREEBUFF guard from the button render path. Scope limited to CLI chat UI components and constants.

a51a9349ec1bcbe51bad6bdacccd11215310bff7.title: Remove shimmer animation from waiting room wait time
a51a9349ec1bcbe51bad6bdacccd11215310bff7.summary: ShimmerText component removed from wait time display in cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx. Static text now renders position 1 as 'any moment now' or formatted estimatedWaitMs. Affects CLI waiting room screen only.

c3a379ac7a9ae375387a052e2cb5a2ed48b5cea6.title: Block freebuff waiting room for disallowed countries
c3a379ac7a9ae375387a052e2cb5a2ed48b5cea6.summary: Added early country gate to freebuff session API. Rejects non-allowlist regions before queue admission via new `country_blocked` status. Covers CLI, Web, and shared types in `free-mode-country.ts` and `_handlers.ts`. Returns HTTP 403 to force older CLI backoff while new CLI parses body directly.

47084a9dee1e018602723f65e34025c41255896d.title: Docs align model references to Opus 4.7
47084a9dee1e018602723f65e34025c41255896d.summary: Documentation updates replace Claude Opus 4.6 references with Claude Opus 4.7 across FAQ, advanced docs, and tips. Subagent model lists in `what-models.mdx` and `how-does-it-work.mdx` are corrected to match actual agent configurations (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite for research, GPT-5.4 for reasoning). The `page.tsx` FAQ also notes deprecation of Claude Pro/Max subscription connections.

a3087a33f8fffc6f3dbdc169bb6f0c191af8d792.title: CLI wait list UX: Tab/arrow key cycling, fixed-width hints, muted wait
a3087a33f8fffc6f3dbdc169bb6f0c191af8d792.summary: Model selector keyboard shortcuts change from number keys (1-9) to Tab/Shift+Tab and Left/Right arrow cycling. Up/Down keys are intentionally ignored to avoid conflicts with other vertical UI. Trailing hints ('N ahead', 'No wait', tagline) are padded to a fixed width computed via useMemo to prevent button resizing as queue depth changes. Waiting room screen 'Wait' label and value now render in muted foreground instead of primary, reducing visual noise.

79ce156d76a8b978bdd7425f4b66bff19b6827c6.title: Add model selector and /end-session command
79ce156d76a8b978bdd7425f4b66bff19b6827c6.summary: New `FreebuffModelSelector` component and `/end-session` command enable switching between model queues in the CLI waiting room. Selection persists to local settings and sends `x-freebuff-model` header on session POST; server 409 `model_locked` triggers UI confirmation prompt. Covers `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`, and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Migration `0044_violet_stingray.sql` adds queue depth tracking columns.

ff385b6c6953eb8d617d7f53e1ce76e4dad57f85.text: Staff added internal tools to find and block abusive accounts, plus a way to reverse bans if needed. This work happens behind the scenes and does not change how the product works for regular users.

b76f9be64e0489961fd31dbb625d9181a9355b1d.text: The tool now shows model choices in a clearer, separated layout, with the selection area moved to a more logical spot. This makes the interface easier to read and use.

79ce156d76a8b978bdd7425f4b66bff19b6827c6.text: You can now choose which version of the assistant to use in the waiting room. Your choice saves automatically for next time. If the server blocks a change, you will see a confirmation prompt.

a3087a33f8fffc6f3dbdc169bb6f0c191af8d792.text: You can now choose a model by pressing Tab or arrow keys instead of numbers. The screen stays stable while waiting, and the wait time text appears less bright to reduce distraction.

a51a9349ec1bcbe51bad6bdacccd11215310bff7.text: The waiting screen now shows your position and estimated wait time as plain text, removing the animated shimmer effect. This change makes the information easier to read and reduces visual distraction.

1242b4e38947578ec285e80ed8d498ad170ecd86.text: The assistant now uses a newer, smarter model to count text length, even when you are talking to other AI services. This improves accuracy for everyone.

47084a9dee1e018602723f65e34025c41255896d.text: The help guides were updated to name the current assistant model. Some old subscription sign-in methods are no longer supported.

8b4f89224820c1cd509317e70450de8042486e3d.text: The system now records past database updates so it does not repeat them. This internal maintenance change prevents errors when saving data.

c3a379ac7a9ae375387a052e2cb5a2ed48b5cea6.text: The app now checks your location before letting you join the waiting line. If you are in a place where the service is not allowed, you will see a message and be unable to connect.

faa7d7a6e9ebd7897d4497103455f3161c7fc3fe.text: The chat interface now shows a clear 'End session' button when you are idle in a waiting room. Clicking it ends the session and returns you to the chat, with a standard message confirming the action.

8c694456f59d1ebdf7c410ea979a0a59596156c3.title: SDK tests drop referralcode mock
8c694456f59d1ebdf7c410ea979a0a59596156c3.summary: SDK test mocks for user objects remove the `referral_code` field. This aligns test fixtures with the current schema after the field was dropped from the `user` table. Covers `run-cancellation`, `run-error-preserves-history`, `run-file-filter`, `run-handle-event`, and `run-mcp-tool-filter` test suites.

2118e41fd1ff01f99c589aaa4be5eb359cbcdf06.title: Tighten Fireworks prefill p90 degraded threshold to 500ms
2118e41fd1ff01f99c589aaa4be5eb359cbcdf06.summary: Lowered `PREFILL_QUEUE_P90_DEGRADED_MS` from 1000 to 500 in `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts`. The tighter threshold triggers 'degraded' status earlier, leveraging p90 as a leading indicator to halt session admission before median latency rises. Scope limited to server-side health checks for Fireworks backend.

dd373b9102d0ec75fe327a1e3b7dcd2b0f654270.title: Apply 15s timeout to subscription limit tests
dd373b9102d0ec75fe327a1e3b7dcd2b0f654270.summary: Added SUBSCRIPTION_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS (15s) to five subscription limit test cases in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts. Tests covering weekly limit, 5-hour session limit, and fallback behavior now pass the timeout constant to Jest's it() function. Scope: web test suite only. No production code changes.

234adfdc33d52adb8e03da558d111ef5755d7630.title: Freebuff waiting room estimate lowered to 24 seconds per spot
234adfdc33d52adb8e03da558d111ef5755d7630.summary: Wait-time estimate in the free-session queue dropped from 60 seconds to 24 seconds per spot ahead via constant `WAIT_MS_PER_SPOT_AHEAD` in `web/src/server/free-session/session-view.ts`. Adjustment reflects observed throughput in the waiting room. Scope limited to server-side `toSessionStateResponse` and `estimateWaitMs`. Position 1 still maps to 0ms (next tick picks you up).

f7461e3885e81bf95a5058142b2754174f13eb43.title: Remove referrals feature from CLI
f7461e3885e81bf95a5058142b2754174f13eb43.summary: Removed /refer-friends command, referral code parsing utilities, and associated UI banners from CLI. This deletion strips out the entire referral redemption flow, including normalizeReferralCode and handleReferralCode logic. Scope covers cli/src/commands (registry, router, utils), cli/src/components (input bar, banners), and web/src/components (onboard, referral persist). Creator attribution remains intact; no migration path provided for existing saved referral states.

87c6e90052b803282e0edd7017a42409e9b36784.title: Fix grace-period hang and stuck streaming UI in CLI
87c6e90052b803282e0edd7017a42409e9b36784.summary: CLI now renders ask_user prompts during the freebuff grace window by gating the session-ended banner on !askUserState. handleFreebuffGateError calls updater.markComplete() on session_expired or waiting_room_required to stop the streaming cursor and clear the flush interval. Fixes #518.

f2386263397b6d6e6d4473c00622d45d3d027ee2.title: Agent runtime preserves message history on mid-run errors
f2386263397b6d6e6d4473c00622d45d3d027ee2.summary: Agent runtime now mutates `initialAgentState` in place during `loopAgentSteps` instead of creating new objects, ensuring `messageHistory` propagates to SDK callers even if an error throws before return. SDK `run.ts` detects this progress via array identity comparison (`sessionState.mainAgentState.messageHistory !== initialMessageHistory`) to conditionally append the user prompt in `getCancelledSessionState`, preventing duplicate messages when the runtime already processed the input. Changes cover `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` and `sdk/src/run.ts`. The fix relies on shared object references and array identity checks rather than length comparisons to handle context pruning scenarios.

9996bc60d46e06a5738df6d568f147ca937513ab.title: Update accountsuspended example message in error schema docs
9996bc60d46e06a5738df6d568f147ca937513ab.summary: The example message for the 403 account_suspended error in docs/error-schema.md was updated to remove the specific billing reason. This aligns the documentation with the new generic suspension message used by the API. The change also required updating the corresponding test in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts to match the new string.

6736dfa66d6bf15eb812a131068343af0029f59d.title: Keep session alive during /history
6736dfa66d6bf15eb812a131068343af0029f59d.summary: ChatHistoryScreen renders inside AuthedSurface instead of replacing it in App.tsx. This prevents session unmounting, which previously deleted the session row and forced a waiting room return. Affects CLI surfaces via cli/src/app.tsx. Session persistence logic relies on AuthedSurface remaining mounted.

20e84ced412bc793ededb64af3c50bca6765fe5b.title: Waiting room bypass for team@codebuff.com
20e84ced412bc793ededb64af3c50bca6765fe5b.summary: Added `isWaitingRoomBypassedForEmail` to allow `team@codebuff.com` to skip the free session waiting room. Updated `checkSession`, `requestSession`, `getSessionState`, and `endUserSession` in `web/src/server/free-session/public-api.ts` to accept `userEmail` and return `disabled` status if bypassed. Modified `web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` to fetch and pass `email` from user info. This prevents CI e2e test flakiness when the global waiting room is active.

6736dfa66d6bf15eb812a131068343af0029f59d.text: Opening the chat history no longer causes you to be logged out or sent back to the waiting room.

dd373b9102d0ec75fe327a1e3b7dcd2b0f654270.text: Internal checks for subscription limits now wait 15 seconds before timing out. This change affects only testing tools and does not impact how the product works for users.

9996bc60d46e06a5738df6d568f147ca937513ab.text: The message shown when an account is suspended became more generic. This small update ensures the instructions for reading these errors match the actual text displayed.

f7461e3885e81bf95a5058142b2754174f13eb43.text: The app no longer lets you invite friends to get rewards. Existing invitations stop working.

8c694456f59d1ebdf7c410ea979a0a59596156c3.text: A small internal cleanup removed an old data label from test files to match the current system rules. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

f2386263397b6d6e6d4473c00622d45d3d027ee2.text: When the assistant stops working mid-task, it now keeps a record of what was already said. This prevents the same message from appearing twice if you resume the chat.

2118e41fd1ff01f99c589aaa4be5eb359cbcdf06.text: The system now spots slow response times sooner. This change helps prevent you from getting stuck with a sluggish experience.

20e84ced412bc793ededb64af3c50bca6765fe5b.text: A special internal account now skips the wait for free sessions. This helps automated tests run smoothly and does not change how regular users experience the product.

234adfdc33d52adb8e03da558d111ef5755d7630.text: The estimated wait time for free sessions is now shorter, showing 24 seconds per person ahead of you instead of 60. This matches how quickly spots actually open up.

87c6e90052b803282e0edd7017a42409e9b36784.text: The app no longer freezes or shows a stuck loading cursor when a time limit or waiting room appears. You will now see a clear message asking what to do next, instead of the screen hanging.

9278d13d86080c3293753ec84c110db59e73deab.title: Raise provider headers timeout to 30m
9278d13d86080c3293753ec84c110db59e73deab.summary: Increased `headersTimeout` from 10m to 30m for all major LLM providers (Canopywave, Fireworks, OpenAI, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow). Deep-thinking models often exceed the previous 10-minute limit before streaming starts, causing premature connection drops. Updates applied across `web/src/llm-api/` files.

1b47ff6b79bfe5516520bd9bc28dee1c2a2c21c2.title: Update fireworks health test fixtures for tightened threshold
1b47ff6b79bfe5516520bd9bc28dee1c2a2c21c2.summary: Fireworks health classifier test fixtures reduced `prefillQueueBuckets` from 300 to 150. This aligns test data with a tightened queue threshold, ensuring `healthy` status assertions remain valid. Changes are scoped to `web/src/server/free-session/__tests__/fireworks-health.test.ts`.

c0061ed43bee434c65385d84134b8f5dd2b1dd6c.title: Prefill queue health threshold tightened to 125ms
c0061ed43bee434c65385d84134b8f5dd2b1dd6c.summary: PREFILL_QUEUE_DEGRADED_MS in `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts` lowered from 200 to 125. This makes prefill queue health checks more strict, degrading status earlier to match the 2s+ user-perceived latency threshold. Scope limited to the Fireworks health monitoring subsystem.

bf7bf87c62b0dba407d2ee2b03899d2c7ec13677.title: Switch fireworks health check from p50 to p90 prefill queue latency
bf7bf87c62b0dba407d2ee2b03899d2c7ec13677.summary: Fireworks health classification now evaluates p90 prefill-queue latency instead of p50. Threshold constant renamed `PREFILL_QUEUE_DEGRADED_MS` (125) to `PREFILL_QUEUE_P90_DEGRADED_MS` (1000). Change affects `web/src/server/free-session/fireworks-health.ts` and corresponding tests. P90 provides earlier warning signal for load, halting admission before median latency rises.

2dee392b72ade5fa5f5da75c8c821c8bc8c2b96c.title: Chat completions suspended message update and formatting
2dee392b72ade5fa5f5da75c8c821c8bc8c2b96c.summary: The account suspension error message in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` was simplified to remove explicit billing references. Extensive whitespace and indentation adjustments were applied to the ternary stream and non-stream routing logic. No functional behavior changes were introduced beyond the copy update.

504f80c1ed8afbd7081ff99a1932d9757ff74cdf.title: Remove web referral banner
504f80c1ed8afbd7081ff99a1932d9757ff74cdf.summary: Referral banner removed from web/src/app/layout.tsx. Banner component import and render deleted. Scope limited to web layout. No migration or API change.

3888bda6dbbd4b0dd55364e5781ae9d17b2661b5.title: Log waiting room time-series metrics each admission tick
3888bda6dbbd4b0dd55364e5781ae9d17b2661b5.summary: Admission tick logs now emit every cycle instead of only on state changes, adding `activeCount` to the metric payload. `store.ts` implements `activeCount()` via SQL count on `status='active'`, exposed through `AdmissionDeps` and `AdmissionTickResult`. This enables continuous time-series charting of queue depth and active sessions in the log aggregator, filterable by `metric=freebuff_waiting_room`.

eeffc4f2b7cd78031922b0fd8b22c77f57557e4f.title: Skip flaky subscriber block grant tests
eeffc4f2b7cd78031922b0fd8b22c77f57557e4f.summary: Two test cases in completions.test.ts marked with it.skip: 'continues when ensureSubscriberBlockGrant throws an error' and 'allows subscriber with 0 a-la-carte credits but active block grant'. Tests skipped to avoid CI flakiness. No production code changed.

ec7051080c95a60952a7b243e4c7a89a793c63aa.title: Add .claude/settings.json with auto permission mode
ec7051080c95a60952a7b243e4c7a89a793c63aa.summary: Introduced .claude/settings.json setting permissions.defaultMode to 'auto'. This configuration file governs Claude Code agent behavior within the repository. Affects only the .claude directory; no changes to Freebuff core logic, CLI, or web surfaces.

e0ba3a65c9a4f579af2ffd0f2ed6342ef0513646.title: Switch waiting room wait estimate to fixed one-minute-per-spot
e0ba3a65c9a4f579af2ffd0f2ed6342ef0513646.summary: The `estimateWaitMs` function in `session-view.ts` now uses a hardcoded constant `WAIT_MS_PER_SPOT_AHEAD` (60,000 ms) instead of calculating wait time based on `admissionTickMs`. This decouples the UI estimate from the actual server admission cadence, providing a simpler, human-friendly approximation that ignores health-gated pauses or variable tick rates. The `admissionTickMs` parameter has been removed from `SessionDeps` in `public-api.ts` and the corresponding interface in `session-view.ts`. Documentation in `docs/freebuff-waiting-room.md` is updated to reflect this rule-of-thumb calculation.

1b47ff6b79bfe5516520bd9bc28dee1c2a2c21c2.text: Small internal update to a test helper. This helps check that the service stays healthy when the queue gets shorter. No change to how you use the product.

ec7051080c95a60952a7b243e4c7a89a793c63aa.text: The assistant now automatically follows its own rules without asking for permission first. This internal update does not change how the product works for you.

9278d13d86080c3293753ec84c110db59e73deab.text: The system now waits longer for the assistant to begin answering. This prevents connections from dropping when the assistant is thinking deeply.

2dee392b72ade5fa5f5da75c8c821c8bc8c2b96c.text: The warning shown when an account is suspended no longer mentions billing. This small wording update changes nothing else about how the product works.

bf7bf87c62b0dba407d2ee2b03899d2c7ec13677.text: The system now watches for traffic jams in the queue more carefully, triggering a slowdown warning sooner. This helps prevent long waits for users by stopping new requests before the average delay gets too high.

504f80c1ed8afbd7081ff99a1932d9757ff74cdf.text: The referral banner has been removed from the website. Users will no longer see this message when visiting the site.
