20f5e0d7e3b94611e7bfb3b4e3343b4541161aa8.text: Internal test code was cleaned up to better check the software works as expected. This small change helps catch problems earlier, but you will not notice any difference.

bd070267edc055a452ed73b65ee315c50122284b.text: Internal checks were updated to ensure the code search feature correctly limits long results and handles delays. This change improves reliability without altering how the feature works for you.

3478b8b2654ced86779ac295dbea38fc881ad1e1.text: The team cleaned up the layout of some internal test tools to follow a consistent style. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

f74b73e042d7d0464901476ba7db59a419999d61.text: Internal code cleanup improved tool reliability. Users will notice no change in how the product works.

be4bb8c359e55c7451c27df1647e5df6011f63e4.text: The system now records detailed notes about its internal safety checks. This helps the team quickly spot and fix rare connection glitches. Users will see no direct change.

dc00f93621c2f362b6ce42898478d547ad915abe.text: Developers improved how they test the assistant's internal tools. This small change makes the software more stable and reliable for you.

67079658628c7649a17b0b669c3736c3c2df7730.text: A small internal update fixed a conflict in the software's underlying parts. This helps the system run more smoothly for everyone.

5b6c1419a54c8f2dde53fc9c3cb2f670fa827e86.text: Small fix. Attachment-only messages now display with correct spacing.

58a002be82a21979669f2369ca35ac3c81a508ce.title: Clarify general agent context limitations
58a002be82a21979669f2369ca35ac3c81a508ce.summary: Updated `spawnerPrompt` in `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts` for both GPT-5 and Opus variants. Explicitly states agent cannot see previously read files or discussion history, requiring context via `prompt` or `filePaths`. Internal prompt refinement only.

977816fea610bf712feeec52af289d8cfd261ff4.title: Fix CLI test failures via logger mock and path normalization
977816fea610bf712feeec52af289d8cfd261ff4.summary: CLI integration tests now mock `../../utils/logger` to prevent analytics initialization errors during execution. Path assertions in `local-agents.test.ts` use `realpathSync` to normalize macOS symlink discrepancies between `/var` and `/private/var`. Changes affect `cli/src/__tests__/integration/local-agents.test.ts` and `cli/src/utils/__tests__/image-dimensions.test.ts`. No user-facing behavior changes.

8cb6a827a8a3e377340841d9d1dd8eaa08552106.title: Replace analytics with logger.info in token-count API
8cb6a827a8a3e377340841d9d1dd8eaa08552106.summary: Token-count endpoint swaps `trackEvent` calls for `logger.info`. Success logs capture `messageCount`, `hasSystem`, `model`, and `tokenCount`. Error path `trackEvent` removed. Scope limited to `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts`.

a9f900271908d9a3951b71c2cec947fb4e1a8ec3.title: Fix CLI image sending to use pre-processed data instead of disk
a9f900271908d9a3951b71c2cec947fb4e1a8ec3.summary: The `processImagesForMessage` function in `cli/src/utils/image-processor.ts` now uses `pendingImages.processedImage` data directly instead of re-reading files from disk. This prevents failures when image paths are relative to a different working directory than the current `cwd`. The logic prioritizes pre-processed base64 data, falling back to disk processing only if `processedImage` is missing but status is 'ready'. Inline image paths detected in message content are processed separately, skipping any already handled by `pendingImages`.

62bfc2b932a5835c0fd87589df0c7ed95270d79d.title: Context pruner preserves last user images in summary
62bfc2b932a5835c0fd87589df0c7ed95270d79d.summary: Context pruner now extracts and retains `ImagePart`/`FilePart` objects from the most recent user message containing media before generating the `<conversation_summary>`. This prevents loss of visual context during aggressive pruning, ensuring the agent can reference images attached in the latest prompt even after older messages are condensed. The change is isolated to `agents/context-pruner.ts`, modifying the summary construction logic to append preserved media parts to the `UserMessage` content array.

e3b13bb549cad63cde06c932bab6b9f60450a0ca.title: Swap ad and referral grant priorities
e3b13bb549cad63cde06c932bab6b9f60450a0ca.summary: Reorders `GRANT_PRIORITIES` so `referral` (30) consumes before `ad` (40). Ensures one-time referral bonuses deplete ahead of renewable ad credits. Updates `common/src/constants/grant-priorities.ts` and `packages/billing/src/billing.knowledge.md`.

c1bf0a413a4381866be9c7a7b66c7f22f912a044.title: Hide copy button on empty user message in CLI
c1bf0a413a4381866be9c7a7b66c7f22f912a044.summary: Copy button suppressed when user message text is empty. `UserContentWithCopyButton` now checks `normalizedContent.length > 0` alongside `showCopyButton` in `cli/src/components/blocks/user-content-copy.tsx`. Scope limited to CLI user message blocks. Prevents rendering a non-functional copy affordance for whitespace-only or blank messages.

917fbccd9a4ced3c77b20ca144e2f252556275c9.title: Handle missing database in sitemap and static params fetch
917fbccd9a4ced3c77b20ca144e2f252556275c9.summary: Wrap fetchAgentsForSitemap and fetchAgentsForStaticParams in try/catch blocks in web/src/server/agents-data.ts. Return empty arrays and log warnings when database queries fail, preventing build crashes in CI environments without a database. Scope limited to server-side data fetching utilities. Static params fallback to runtime rendering when database is unavailable.

c707102f3545a81a8d29c3babaad2c42d6ac4240.title: CLI image attachment race condition and path fixes
c707102f3545a81a8d29c3babaad2c42d6ac4240.summary: ImageCard and ImageThumbnail skip processing/error states and use processedImage base64 to prevent race conditions. extractThumbnailColors accepts Buffer or string. validateAndAddImage uses resolvedPath for error reporting. Fixes inline image rendering in cli/src/components/image-card.tsx, cli/src/components/image-thumbnail.tsx, cli/src/utils/image-thumbnail.ts, and cli/src/utils/pending-attachments.ts.

8565c2d0deb416b5b1d8ac874a160b0d2c52c67b.title: Add build wrapper script for better error logging on Render
8565c2d0deb416b5b1d8ac874a160b0d2c52c67b.summary: Replaced the inline Next.js build command in package.json with a dedicated Bun script, web/scripts/build.ts. This wrapper captures full build output to build.log, filters noisy Contentlayer warnings from console display, and logs timing/memory stats. On failure, the full log is displayed to aid debugging on Render; on success, it triggers prebuild-agents-cache validation.

58a002be82a21979669f2369ca35ac3c81a508ce.text: The assistant now knows it cannot remember files or conversations from earlier steps. It must be given all needed information again to do its job correctly.

c1bf0a413a4381866be9c7a7b66c7f22f912a044.text: The copy button is now hidden for empty messages. This prevents a broken button from appearing when there is no text to copy.

62bfc2b932a5835c0fd87589df0c7ed95270d79d.text: The assistant now keeps the most recent images you upload, even when it shortens older chat history. This ensures it can still see and reference those pictures in your latest request.

977816fea610bf712feeec52af289d8cfd261ff4.text: A small internal fix cleaned up background test noise and standardized file paths on Mac.

8565c2d0deb416b5b1d8ac874a160b0d2c52c67b.text: This internal change helps the team spot and fix problems faster. It does not affect how the product works for users.

a9f900271908d9a3951b71c2cec947fb4e1a8ec3.text: The assistant now uses already-prepared image data instead of searching for the original file. This prevents errors when sending images if the file location has changed.

917fbccd9a4ced3c77b20ca144e2f252556275c9.text: The website now handles database errors more gracefully by showing an empty list instead of crashing. This prevents build failures in certain environments.

e3b13bb549cad63cde06c932bab6b9f60450a0ca.text: One-time referral bonuses now spend before renewable ad credits.

8cb6a827a8a3e377340841d9d1dd8eaa08552106.text: The system now records token counting requests in its internal activity log instead of sending them to a separate tracking service. This change is internal and does not affect how the feature works for users.

c707102f3545a81a8d29c3babaad2c42d6ac4240.text: Fixed a bug that caused images to sometimes fail to display or show errors in the command-line interface. Images now load reliably.

1dfb2cb4e583c9c41350c2306e1bbf9a10b8ce6b.title: openai-compatible generate missing tool call id
1dfb2cb4e583c9c41350c2306e1bbf9a10b8ce6b.summary: openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts generates missing tool call IDs via generateId() instead of throwing InvalidResponseDataError. Handles providers like GLM omitting IDs in streaming deltas. Internal package fix, no user-facing surface change.

fb0fd39bb4b0c3c78308e015328465970c37c42b.title: Remove readsubtree from file-lister agent
fb0fd39bb4b0c3c78308e015328465970c37c42b.summary: File-lister agent in agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts no longer uses the read_subtree tool. The toolNames array is cleared, preventing the agent from traversing the filesystem subtree. This change restricts the file-lister's capabilities to its core listing function.

a6526e0ba5aa3455b1ca4045b2d268af6cdf3d22.title: CLI handles native reasoning blocks in agent streams
a6526e0ba5aa3455b1ca4045b2d268af6cdf3d22.summary: CLI now parses native reasoning chunks for agent blocks instead of relying solely on think tag parsing. `block-operations.ts` adds `appendNativeReasoningToBlocks` and `closeNativeReasoningBlock` to manage `textType: 'reasoning'` states, while `stream-chunk-processor.ts` propagates `textType` to agent destinations. `sdk-event-handlers.ts` ensures reasoning blocks close before tool calls execute.

581659ac47ae5409e0f598807b3842d7487eb651.title: Refine askuser guidance in base2 agent
581659ac47ae5409e0f598807b3842d7487eb651.summary: Updated prompt instructions for the `ask_user` tool in `agents/base2/base2.ts`. The guidance now explicitly restricts usage to non-obvious choices, removing ambiguity about when to skip the step. This change applies to the base2 agent configuration.

e8d70e5016ac1950e34efe657bfe86360a5a2cef.title: Preserve partial responses on request cancel
e8d70e5016ac1950e34efe657bfe86360a5a2cef.summary: SDK `run.ts` preserves partial streamed content and appends interruption messages to `sessionState` when `signal.aborted` is true. CLI `send-message.ts` skips `handleRunCompletion` if `wasAbortedByUser` is set, preventing UI interference. Covers SDK core and CLI hooks.

7824e45e34da353dcdcc70c4cf54144f4d2d782f.title: CLI loads agents from ~/.agents global directory
7824e45e34da353dcdcc70c4cf54144f4d2d782f.summary: initializeAgentRegistry now scans ~/.agents in addition to project and parent directories via getDefaultAgentDirs(). Precedence order is cwd, parent, then home, allowing project agents to override global ones. buildAgentFilePathMap accepts an array of directories instead of a single path. This change affects cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts.

3e4406e582fdbde3d55264470fbdb1566ab8deca.title: Skip Gravity ads in compact non-free CLI layouts
3e4406e582fdbde3d55264470fbdb1566ab8deca.summary: use-gravity-ad.ts suppresses ad fetching, impression recording, and rendering when terminalHeight <= 17, gated by agentMode !== 'FREE'. Uses shouldHideAdsRef to guard async fetchAd and recordImpressionOnce calls. FREE mode retains mandatory ads on compact screens. Scope limited to CLI Gravity ad hook via use-terminal-layout and useChatStore selectors.

87f7793bb5a8970d47a8e54e171387551ae1c64a.title: GPT-5 general agent omits file-picker
87f7793bb5a8970d47a8e54e171387551ae1c64a.summary: GPT-5 general agent excludes `file-picker` from `spawnableAgents` and drops related guidance from `instructionsPrompt`. Prevents repeated full-file reads by GPT-5. Scoped to `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts` via conditional `buildArray` logic.

88c20d8c1cd5cfd16164b551ea88daea3360cec2.title: FREE mode replaces LITE, forces ads, zero-cost billing
88c20d8c1cd5cfd16164b551ea88daea3360cec2.summary: CLI and agent runtime introduce FREE mode, replacing LITE. `base2-free.ts` spawns `commander-lite` and `editor-glm` via `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast`. `--lite` flag deprecated in favor of `--free`. `getAdsEnabled` hardcodes `true` for FREE mode; `use-gravity-ad` sends mode to API to block credit grants. `AGENT_MODE_TO_COST_MODE` maps FREE to 'free' cost mode, passing `costMode` to `createRunConfig` for zero-credit allowlisted combos. Thinking block completion logic simplified in `thinking-block.tsx` and `message-updater.ts` to auto-collapse native reasoning on message end.

c1d136969c18ef32ecf0f4344f4f50bd7dae232c.title: Add skill support to CLI and agent runtime
c1d136969c18ef32ecf0f4344f4f50bd7dae232c.summary: Introduces a skill system allowing agents to load on-demand instructions via the new `skill` tool. CLI startup initializes a skill registry from `.agents/skills`, exposing each skill as a dynamic slash command (`/skill:<name>`) and a tool call. The `base2` agent now includes the `skill` tool, enabling it to fetch and apply skill context during execution. Covers core constants, CLI UI components, and SDK loading logic.

88c20d8c1cd5cfd16164b551ea88daea3360cec2.text: The basic free version now shows ads and does not use up your paid credits. The old 'lite' option is gone, replaced by this ad-supported mode.

3e4406e582fdbde3d55264470fbdb1566ab8deca.text: The app now hides ads in the command-line interface when the window is small. This only applies to paid accounts, so the free version still shows ads.

fb0fd39bb4b0c3c78308e015328465970c37c42b.text: The file lister can no longer browse through folders. It now only shows the files you ask for directly.

a6526e0ba5aa3455b1ca4045b2d268af6cdf3d22.text: The assistant now processes its internal thought steps more reliably. This helps keep its reasoning separate from its actions, so it can think clearly before doing work.

1dfb2cb4e583c9c41350c2306e1bbf9a10b8ce6b.text: The assistant now automatically assigns a label to tool requests when the underlying system forgets to do so, preventing errors. This internal fix improves stability without changing how the product works for users.

e8d70e5016ac1950e34efe657bfe86360a5a2cef.text: If you stop a response while it is still typing, the text written so far is kept. The chat history now shows this partial answer instead of losing it.

7824e45e34da353dcdcc70c4cf54144f4d2d782f.text: The assistant now checks a central folder on your computer for custom instructions, in addition to the current project folder. This means you can set up agents once and use them across all your projects, but project-specific settings still take priority.

581659ac47ae5409e0f598807b3842d7487eb651.text: The assistant now only asks for your input when a choice is unclear, skipping unnecessary questions. This makes interactions faster and less disruptive.

87f7793bb5a8970d47a8e54e171387551ae1c64a.text: The general assistant can no longer automatically use the file-picker tool. This stops it from repeatedly reading entire files.

9ac31fc961a4bc7e606903940a41575986e05e3e.title: context-pruner captures strreplace and writefile diffs
9ac31fc961a4bc7e606903940a41575986e05e3e.summary: Context pruner now includes diff results from `str_replace` and `write_file` tool messages in its summary. This ensures the agent retains visibility of file changes made during execution. The logic truncates diffs exceeding 2000 characters to manage context window size. Implemented in `agents/context-pruner.ts`.

f8e5c97566f5e2a7b6308e872a6680af67a7a983.title: CLI routes terminal detection through getCliEnv
f8e5c97566f5e2a7b6308e872a6680af67a7a983.summary: Clipboard OSC52 sequences and terminal title builders now read TERM, TMUX, and STY via getCliEnv instead of direct process.env access. This fixes process.env enforcement errors by centralizing terminal detection variables in CliEnv type and utils/env.ts. Scope limited to CLI core: types/env.ts, utils/clipboard.ts, utils/env.ts, utils/terminal-title.ts. tmux/screen DCS passthrough logic remains unchanged, only the variable source shifts.

69aaa1afdea79b06bc74e93f2f8359dda18c92f0.title: General agent adds context-pruner and loops steps
69aaa1afdea79b06bc74e93f2f8359dda18c92f0.summary: General agent now runs `context-pruner` before each step via `spawn_agent_inline` and loops until `stepsComplete`. Prompts clarify lack of conversation history, requiring explicit context in `prompt` or `filePaths`. `instructionsPrompt` tightened to focus on parallel spawning. Scope limited to `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts`.

bb10b2d58731901f13f442a1d7875288169459b0.title: GLM 4.7 editor added for Lite mode
bb10b2d58731901f13f442a1d7875288169459b0.summary: New `editor-glm` agent definition added to `agents/editor/editor-glm.ts`, replacing `editor-gpt-5` in Lite mode. `createCodeEditor` in `agents/editor/editor.ts` updated to accept `'glm'` model option, mapping to `z-ai/glm-4.7`. `agents/base2/base2.ts` updated to spawn `editor-glm` instead of `editor-gpt-5` for Lite mode prompts. GLM and GPT-5 models skip `<think>` tag prompting in editor instructions.

a5c382cba60723c7dfb4344f08b88647597f9b3c.title: Reduce chat history load limit to 500 and skip empty chats
a5c382cba60723c7dfb4344f08b88647597f9b3c.summary: Chat history loading caps at 500 chats (down from 1000) and filters out entries with zero messages. Adjusted `BACKGROUND_CHATS` constant in `chat-history-screen.tsx` and added `messageCount > 0` check in `getAllChats` within `chat-history.ts`. This prevents UI clutter and unnecessary processing of empty chat logs.

5938b0ea4263eb3aba69afa997e50c666e945103.title: CLI updates terminal title per user input
5938b0ea4263eb3aba69afa997e50c666e945103.summary: The CLI now sets the terminal window title to the user's current input, prefixed with 'Codebuff: '. This uses OSC escape sequences written directly to `/dev/tty` to bypass OpenTUI's stdout capture. Titles are truncated to 60 characters and sanitized. The title resets to default on exit via `renderer-cleanup.ts`. tmux and screen passthrough are handled automatically.

456cd9e491d89f4f4162d9ded9bd4c7b372ad80f.title: Researcher agents switch to grok-4.1-fast
456cd9e491d89f4f4162d9ded9bd4c7b372ad80f.summary: researcher-docs and researcher-web agent definitions bump model from x-ai/grok-4-fast to x-ai/grok-4.1-fast. Scope limited to agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts and agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts. Only the model string changes; prompts, schemas, and IDs remain identical.

db4d9fd47ecbcf0c9e8c20f1195d3a717950af92.title: Add OSC52 clipboard support to CLI
db4d9fd47ecbcf0c9e8c20f1195d3a717950af92.summary: Added OSC52 escape sequence support to `cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts` for cross-platform clipboard copying, particularly over SSH or headless environments. The implementation attempts OSC52 first, falling back to platform-specific tools (`pbcopy`, `xclip`, `xsel`, `clip`) if it fails. Includes handling for tmux and GNU screen passthrough wrapping, with a 32KB payload limit.

d85c249c33b9f7060bef187ce95c6ca27c67f3e4.title: Add researcher-web and researcher-docs to free agents
d85c249c33b9f7060bef187ce95c6ca27c67f3e4.summary: Added 'researcher-web' and 'researcher-docs' to the FREE_TIER_AGENTS set in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts. This grants these agents free tier access, expanding available research capabilities. The change affects the core agent constants used by CLI and Web surfaces.

9ac31fc961a4bc7e606903940a41575986e05e3e.text: The assistant now keeps track of file changes it makes during tasks. This helps it remember what it did, even if the list of changes is very long.

a5c382cba60723c7dfb4344f08b88647597f9b3c.text: The chat list now shows fewer recent conversations and hides empty ones, reducing clutter and speeding up loading.

5938b0ea4263eb3aba69afa997e50c666e945103.text: The terminal window title now displays your current input. This helps you identify which session is active.

3a1a7407db87eb9399a8c6c9d0ec1e07e80be1ac.text: The app now clearly states that connecting your Claude subscription is not officially supported by Anthropic. This warning appears on pricing pages and help articles to keep you informed before you link your account.

69aaa1afdea79b06bc74e93f2f8359dda18c92f0.text: The assistant now clears old details before each task to stay focused and repeats steps until finished. It no longer remembers past chats automatically, so you must include all needed information in your request.

f8e5c97566f5e2a7b6308e872a6680af67a7a983.text: The app now checks your computer's settings in a safer way to decide how to handle copy-paste and window titles. This fixes errors that happened when those settings were missing or unusual. No new features were added.

bb10b2d58731901f13f442a1d7875288169459b0.text: The editor now uses a different AI model in Lite mode. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

d85c249c33b9f7060bef187ce95c6ca27c67f3e4.text: Two new research tools are now included in the free plan. This lets users access these web and document search features without paying extra.

456cd9e491d89f4f4162d9ded9bd4c7b372ad80f.text: The research assistant now uses a newer, faster brain. This small update may help it find answers quicker, but works the same way otherwise.

c2565033906c4cecd55c4a6686592043c9278430.title: Reorder agent slash commands in CLI picker
c2565033906c4cecd55c4a6686592043c9278430.summary: Moved `agent:gpt-5` and `agent:opus` entries earlier in the `SLASH_COMMANDS` array within `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. This change places agent spawning commands above utility commands like `feedback` and `publish` in the CLI autocomplete picker. The reorder improves discoverability for frequently used agent commands without altering their functionality or insertion text.

0ec370051bbc449cc1a5c9e6f27409a39074755e.title: GPT-5 Agent reasoning config and prompt tweaks
0ec370051bbc449cc1a5c9e6f27409a39074755e.summary: GPT-5 Agent reasoningOptions simplified: drop `enabled` and `exclude`, keep `effort: 'high'`. instructionsPrompt rephrased to mandate `file-picker` spawning when relevant. Scope: `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`, `.vscode/settings.json`. TS formatter switched to built-in language features.

4397bbce21cfa5d71613b14afd999451151da269.title: Docs and web search endpoints charge zero credits
4397bbce21cfa5d71613b14afd999451151da269.summary: Hardcoded `creditsToCharge = 0` in `docs-search` and `web-search` API handlers. Removed `PROFIT_MARGIN` import and base cost calculations. Scope limited to `web/src/app/api/v1/`. Note comment says 'Temporarily free'.

3a4698ee18389356fe27a47f5ecb111b39407018.title: Add env var substitution for MCP config
3a4698ee18389356fe27a47f5ecb111b39407018.summary: Adds substituteEnvInValue and substituteEnvInRecord helpers in common/src/mcp/client.ts to expand $VAR_NAME references within MCP configuration values. These helpers process stdio transport envs, and http/sse transport headers, interpolating strings like 'Bearer $TOKEN'. If a referenced environment variable is undefined, the original literal string is preserved.

1aee04f6146e1a59321904e111fb04c6e80d5830.title: Add /agent:opus slash command, rename gpt-5-agent to agent:gpt-5
1aee04f6146e1a59321904e111fb04c6e80d5830.summary: cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts adds agent:opus (Opus agent) and renames gpt-5-agent to agent:gpt-5. IDs and labels switch to colon format. Descriptions change from Mention to Spawn. Affects CLI slash command picker only.

210383f7118a24e3a1116589360867c2ff64113e.title: Fallback commander to commander-lite in spawnagents
210383f7118a24e3a1116589360867c2ff64113e.summary: Adds transformSpawnAgentsInput to rewrite agent_type from 'commander' to 'commander-lite' when the former is unavailable in spawnableAgents. Applied in tool-executor.ts before UI streaming and handler execution to ensure consistent agent resolution. Scope limited to packages/agent-runtime. Transformation checks availability via getMatchingSpawn, falling back only if commander-lite exists; otherwise validation handles the error.

707cfbdfd246191b5c2d7fc504c17cdd3ff1d922.title: gpt-5-agent instructs parallel agent spawning
707cfbdfd246191b5c2d7fc504c17cdd3ff1d922.summary: Added `instructionsPrompt` to `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`. Directs model to use `spawn_agents` for parallel execution, prioritizing `file-picker` and batch reads. Scope limited to `gpt-5-agent` definition.

abaf6a1f5f527cefccbffbe1290a64ae4d56158c.title: Opus agent added to general agent factory
abaf6a1f5f527cefccbffbe1290a64ae4d56158c.summary: New `opus-agent` definition added alongside `gpt-5-agent` in `agents/general-agent/`. Both now share a factory `createGeneralAgent` in `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts`, replacing the standalone `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`. `base2.ts` spawns both `opus-agent` and `gpt-5-agent` when `isDefault || isMax`.

a31f085d483da7af1cd15b0786989c67e7d75b4f.title: Fix /gpt-5-agent slash command to insert @GPT-5 Agent
a31f085d483da7af1cd15b0786989c67e7d75b4f.summary: The /gpt-5-agent slash command now inserts '@GPT-5 Agent ' into the input field, replacing the previous '@gpt-5-agent ' string. This corrects the agent mention format to match the expected UI display. The change is scoped to cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts and cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts, with refactoring in cli/src/chat.tsx to share insertText logic. The command remains a UI shortcut and does not execute a backend action.

dd9233db8bf1da33155ac59fdb56f2787a42b1df.title: Gravity ads cache and cycle when fetches stop
dd9233db8bf1da33155ac59fdb56f2787a42b1df.summary: cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts caches fetched ads and cycles them when new fetches stop, replacing the hard rotation pause after 3 ads without activity. The hook tracks idle state via isUserActive with a 30s threshold, pausing new fetches while continuing to serve cached ads. Controller state is consolidated into a single ref, replacing multiple refs and useCallback chains.

4397bbce21cfa5d71613b14afd999451151da269.text: Searching documentation and the web now costs zero credits. This internal change temporarily makes those features free to use.

210383f7118a24e3a1116589360867c2ff64113e.text: If the main assistant cannot run, it now automatically switches to a simpler backup assistant. This keeps things working instead of failing, but the backup may be less capable.

abaf6a1f5f527cefccbffbe1290a64ae4d56158c.text: The assistant can now use a new model alongside the existing one. This gives the system more options for handling your requests.

c2565033906c4cecd55c4a6686592043c9278430.text: Agent commands moved up in the menu. You see them before other options now.

1aee04f6146e1a59321904e111fb04c6e80d5830.text: The assistant gained a new option to use a different model. The names of these options changed format. This only affects the list of commands you see when typing in the tool.

3a4698ee18389356fe27a47f5ecb111b39407018.text: The assistant can now automatically use secret keys stored on your computer when connecting to other services. If a key is missing, the setup remains unchanged.

dd9233db8bf1da33155ac59fdb56f2787a42b1df.text: Ads now stay on screen longer when you stop using the tool. This removes the annoying gap between ads.

707cfbdfd246191b5c2d7fc504c17cdd3ff1d922.text: The assistant now splits large tasks into smaller pieces and works on them at the same time. This helps it finish reading many files or answering complex questions faster.

a31f085d483da7af1cd15b0786989c67e7d75b4f.text: The command now inserts the correct name for the assistant, matching how it appears on screen. This is a small fix to make the text look right.

0ec370051bbc449cc1a5c9e6f27409a39074755e.text: The assistant now has clearer rules for when to open a file picker. This small update helps it choose the right tool for your request.

2f5d2bb93997374602839e7dbfff2de2b8719926.title: Tweak /new description
2f5d2bb93997374602839e7dbfff2de2b8719926.summary: Updated the description for the `/new` slash command in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. The text now reads 'Clear the conversation history and start a new chat' instead of 'Start a fresh conversation session'.

e70fc1ca89bf5cd55b9d363c6e664f22f2d77c8b.title: Remove CLI options section from README
e70fc1ca89bf5cd55b9d363c6e664f22f2d77c8b.summary: Removed the 'CLI Options' section from README.md, deleting documentation for flags like `--lite`, `--max`, `--ask`, and `--print`. Renamed 'File Explorer Agent' to 'File Picker Agent' in the agent workflow description. This cleanup reduces redundancy and aligns the documentation with current CLI behavior.

3dc91a3b5150512e5dd6a50f2dd0b7ece1ffe63e.title: Advisory lock health check verifies ownership via pglocks
3dc91a3b5150512e5dd6a50f2dd0b7ece1ffe63e.summary: Advisory lock health check now queries pg_locks to verify specific lock ownership instead of just checking connection liveness. Interval reduced from 30s to 10s to detect lost locks faster. Covers packages/internal/src/db/advisory-lock.ts. Triggers lost callback if lock is no longer held despite active connection.

0b7270dbdf852a3793ab1360616c298a9c72dbe1.title: Set TSX default formatter to vscode.typescript-language-features
0b7270dbdf852a3793ab1360616c298a9c72dbe1.summary: Changed `.vscode/settings.json` to set `editor.defaultFormatter` for `typescriptreact` from `esbenp.prettier-vscode` to `vscode.typescript-language-features`. This aligns TSX formatting with the built-in TypeScript language service. Scope limited to repo-wide VS Code settings. No action required.

eb114327c233844252811cb7f72e018741ef385f.title: Fix login modal clipboard errors and enable text selection
eb114327c233844252811cb7f72e018741ef385f.summary: Login modal replaces TerminalLink with selectable text and removes direct browser open to fix clipboard errors. `useClipboard` tracks selection state for visual feedback, while `copyTextToClipboard` discards stderr via `stdio` options to prevent TUI corruption on headless servers. Keyboard handlers now fire-and-forget async copy operations. Changes affect CLI components and hooks, specifically `login-modal.tsx`, `use-clipboard.ts`, and `clipboard.ts`.

62aab4646bf93c3a7250f17ab807832f6ec950dd.title: /gpt-5-agent inserts @gpt-5-agent mention
62aab4646bf93c3a7250f17ab807832f6ec950dd.summary: Added /gpt-5-agent slash command to cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts with insertText '@gpt-5-agent '. cli/src/chat.tsx now checks selected.insertText before executing, splicing text into inputValue and updating cursorPosition. SlashCommand interface gains optional insertText field. Insertion bypasses onSubmitPrompt, leaving the mention for further input.

ad6b2bc5fef693393229939e7dc73b212d15902e.title: CLI login modal adds explicit copy button and SSH URL display
ad6b2bc5fef693393229939e7dc73b212d15902e.summary: Replaced auto-clipboard copy on browser launch with an explicit `Copy link (c)` button and persistent URL display in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx`. The modal now shows the login URL immediately after pressing Enter, catering to SSH users where `open()` fails to launch a browser. Clipboard failures are silently handled since the URL is always visible for manual copying. Scope limited to CLI core login flow.

54212111ae03462e4a07daa3346cdd26ae6da731.title: Hide landing page knowledge and competition sections
54212111ae03462e4a07daa3346cdd26ae6da731.summary: Comment out FeatureSection and CompetitionSection in web/src/app/home-client.tsx. Removes 'Better and Better Over Time' knowledge feature and competition comparison from landing page. Scope limited to web app home-client.tsx. Sections hidden via JSX comments, not deleted.

1ad96664363a1ba4ea7428cb82a6234ecf01ba04.title: Rename gpt-5-thinker to gpt-5-agent with file edit tools
1ad96664363a1ba4ea7428cb82a6234ecf01ba04.summary: Renamed agent `thinker-gpt-5` to `gpt-5-agent` in `agents/base2/base2.ts` and `agents/gpt-5-agent.ts`. Added `read_subtree`, `str_replace`, and `write_file` to `toolNames` and enabled high-effort reasoning. Updated spawner prompt to reflect general-purpose deep-thinking role.

9982f5a561976355256ecea412861e4c9d7db730.title: Update hero tagline and subheading in web UI
9982f5a561976355256ecea412861e4c9d7db730.summary: Hero tagline changed from 'Supercharge Your AI Coding' to 'Better agents. Better code.' in `web/src/components/ui/hero.tsx`. Subheading updated to claim '100+ seconds faster than Claude Code with higher-quality output'.

1ad96664363a1ba4ea7428cb82a6234ecf01ba04.text: The thinking assistant was renamed to better match its job. It gained new tools to read and edit files while thinking more deeply.

2f5d2bb93997374602839e7dbfff2de2b8719926.text: The text explaining the 'new chat' button changed. It now clearly states that using it will erase previous messages and start fresh.

e70fc1ca89bf5cd55b9d363c6e664f22f2d77c8b.text: The product guide removed outdated instructions about settings that no longer exist and renamed a feature to match how it actually works. This change only updates the text users read, so the software itself behaves exactly the same.

54212111ae03462e4a07daa3346cdd26ae6da731.text: The landing page no longer shows sections about knowledge features and competition comparisons. This is a small internal change that only affects what new visitors see.

eb114327c233844252811cb7f72e018741ef385f.text: The login screen now lets you select and copy text without errors. This makes logging in smoother, especially when using the command line.

62aab4646bf93c3a7250f17ab807832f6ec950dd.text: Typing a specific command now automatically adds a mention to the text box, letting you continue writing without submitting the message immediately.

0b7270dbdf852a3793ab1360616c298a9c72dbe1.text: The system now uses its built-in tool to organize code, replacing a separate helper. This internal change affects how developers write code, but you will not notice any difference in the product.

9982f5a561976355256ecea412861e4c9d7db730.text: The website's main text was updated to say it is faster and produces better results than a competitor.

3dc91a3b5150512e5dd6a50f2dd0b7ece1ffe63e.text: The system now checks more often if it still holds a key safety lock. This helps it notice and fix problems faster.

ad6b2bc5fef693393229939e7dc73b212d15902e.text: When signing in from a remote computer, the login link now stays on the screen with a copy button. This helps you sign in even if your web browser does not open automatically.

17b2faee10d38e7fa62cff639e53f4301b87efdc.title: Move agents to agents-graveyard
17b2faee10d38e7fa62cff639e53f4301b87efdc.summary: Move agents to agents-graveyard. Rename `agents/` to `agents-graveyard/` in repo. Internal refactor.

02c7a7881109b432b27948add88d805127f1447b.title: File-picker agents exempt from credit billing
02c7a7881109b432b27948add88d805127f1447b.summary: Lightweight utility agents (file-picker, file-picker-max, file-lister) now bypass credit consumption when costs are under 5 credits. New `isFreeAgent` helper in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` parses agent IDs to identify free-tier agents, preventing unexpected charges for BYOK users. `web/src/llm-api/helpers.ts` updates `consumeCreditsForMessage` to return the actual billed amount, while `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` overwrites response costs with a fake value derived from billed credits to ensure SDK consistency.

fcf9b5e0e6941dee5525d40ba7b0eb2bbd95d96b.title: Fix base2 agent spawn typo
fcf9b5e0e6941dee5525d40ba7b0eb2bbd95d96b.summary: Corrected agent name in base2.ts prompt instructions. `reviewer-editor-gpt-5` changed to `code-reviewer-multi-prompt` for max mode. Ensures correct agent spawning logic.

46b2addbb1aaf17bbcd1414c252fc42cd4c8bf53.title: Fix imports in agents-graveyard and eval-task-generator
46b2addbb1aaf17bbcd1414c252fc42cd4c8bf53.summary: Corrected relative import paths for agents in `agents-graveyard` to point to `../../agents/` instead of `../`. Updated `eval-task-generator.ts` to import `file-explorer` and `find-all-referencer` from `agents-graveyard` instead of `agents`. Scope covers `agents-graveyard` files and `evals/buffbench`. Resolves broken module resolution after file moves.

02cb2e5dec72fa2cd02ca6759644f7429f3a6dc4.title: Rename CLI task-complete component to task-completed
02cb2e5dec72fa2cd02ca6759644f7429f3a6dc4.summary: Renamed `cli/src/components/tools/task-complete.tsx` to `task-completed.tsx` to match the `task_completed` tool name. Updated `registry.ts` import path. Removed outdated docstring comment.

11c14d9693c7f917299bcfe143218701ec49f651.title: Add thinker-gpt-5 agent
11c14d9693c7f917299bcfe143218701ec49f651.summary: Added `thinker-gpt-5` agent definition in `agents/thinker/thinker-gpt-5.ts` using model `openai/gpt-5.2`. Base2 agent (`agents/base2/base2.ts`) now includes `thinker-gpt-5` in spawnable lists for default and max modes. Prompts updated to mark `thinker-gpt-5` as a last resort for complex problems.

ed0e89912bdc9cf6a9f142aaeca9309a8754f745.title: Remove spawnagents match log in CLI SDK event handlers
ed0e89912bdc9cf6a9f142aaeca9309a8754f745.summary: Deleted state.logger.info call in handleSubagentStart within cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts. Log emitted tempId, realAgentId, agentType, hasParentAgentId on spawnAgentMatch. Scope limited to CLI SDK event handling. No functional change to block resolution.

036646e54d2c99d09c563b83e871401975df327e.title: CLI help banner structured layout
036646e54d2c99d09c563b83e871401975df327e.summary: Refactored cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx from a single text string to a component tree. Introduced SectionHeader and Shortcut components using useTheme for consistent styling. Organized content into Shortcuts, Features, and Credits sections with flexbox layouts. Added /usage command visibility in credits section.

830dba304fb3ad006f48dc4fbdb92f4a43ee1ff5.title: Ctrl+T toggles collapse/expand all in CLI chat
830dba304fb3ad006f48dc4fbdb92f4a43ee1ff5.summary: New Ctrl+T keyboard shortcut collapses or expands all collapsible blocks (thinking, agent, tool, agent-list) across all AI responses in the CLI chat view. `handleToggleAll` in `use-chat-messages.ts` calls `setAllBlocksCollapsedState` from new `cli/src/utils/collapse-helpers.ts`, which recursively walks message trees and flips `isCollapsed` on every collapsible block. If any block is expanded, Ctrl+T collapses all; otherwise it expands all. Wired through `keyboard-actions.ts` as a priority-11 action dispatched via `use-chat-keyboard.ts` `onToggleAll`, surfaced in `help-banner.tsx` shortcuts list.

26d1d5313ea418fe17cbba0019e09fda3a4d2238.title: Fix stale state in multiline-input during IME rapid keystrokes
26d1d5313ea418fe17cbba0019e09fda3a4d2238.summary: MultilineInput now reads from synchronous refs for value and cursor position during text insertion. This prevents stale closure errors when IME sends rapid multi-character events, ensuring each keystroke builds on the previous state. Affects `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. Refs are updated synchronously before `onChange` to bypass React batching delays.

830dba304fb3ad006f48dc4fbdb92f4a43ee1ff5.text: Pressing Ctrl+T now hides or shows all the detailed steps in the chat window at once. This helps you quickly switch between seeing just the final answers and reviewing how the assistant reached them.

02cb2e5dec72fa2cd02ca6759644f7429f3a6dc4.text: The assistant now uses a clearer name for the task that marks work as finished. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

26d1d5313ea418fe17cbba0019e09fda3a4d2238.text: Fixed a bug where typing quickly with a foreign keyboard could cause text to disappear or appear in the wrong order. Now, every keystroke is recorded correctly, so your text stays accurate.

fcf9b5e0e6941dee5525d40ba7b0eb2bbd95d96b.text: A small internal fix corrected the name of an assistant used for reviewing code. This ensures the right helper is chosen when using the advanced review mode.

17b2faee10d38e7fa62cff639e53f4301b87efdc.text: The team moved some old assistant features to a separate storage area. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

ed0e89912bdc9cf6a9f142aaeca9309a8754f745.text: The app stopped saving a hidden note about how it starts background helpers. This cleanup has no effect on how the product works for you.

02c7a7881109b432b27948add88d805127f1447b.text: Simple file tools now cost nothing if they are cheap to run. This prevents unexpected charges for users who bring their own access keys.

036646e54d2c99d09c563b83e871401975df327e.text: The help screen now displays information in organized sections. This makes shortcuts and features easier to find.

46b2addbb1aaf17bbcd1414c252fc42cd4c8bf53.text: The assistant can now find some older tools that were moved to a new location. This fixes an issue where the assistant could not use those tools to help with tasks.

11c14d9693c7f917299bcfe143218701ec49f651.text: The assistant can now use a new, more powerful model to solve difficult problems. It will only use this option when other methods fail, so answers for complex tasks may improve.

56c6c89e0bbe5b442de910c19144193edd842de6.title: Billing test mocks return AdvisoryLockTransactionResult shape
56c6c89e0bbe5b442de910c19144193edd842de6.summary: Test mocks in `packages/billing/src/__tests__/grant-credits.test.ts` and `org-billing.test.ts` updated to return `{ result, lockWaitMs }` instead of raw callback result. Aligns with `AdvisoryLockTransactionResult` return type. Internal test fixture change.

fd3d3db8705f1aaf3eea54cae6655f2211e78cc6.title: Skip advisory lock integration tests in CI without database
fd3d3db8705f1aaf3eea54cae6655f2211e78cc6.summary: advisory-lock.integration.test.ts now skips when CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS is true or when DATABASE_URL is missing and RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS is unset. CI injects DATABASE_URL as a secret but provides no running Postgres for packages/internal, causing spurious failures. Change scoped to packages/internal/src/db/__tests__/advisory-lock.integration.test.ts. Billing tests retain their own Postgres service; internal integration tests require explicit opt-in locally.

96b2d8a6dc65e7718bd3823302841548acb92a46.title: Remove noisy debug and info logs from CLI and agent runtime
96b2d8a6dc65e7718bd3823302841548acb92a46.summary: Deleted verbose logging calls in CLI health checks, gravity ad fetches, and agent spawn handlers. Removes `logger.debug`, `logger.info`, and `logAgentSpawn` invocations to reduce console noise. Affects `cli/src/hooks/use-connection-status.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-inline.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts`. No functional logic changes, only log statement removals.

960921026e18e0db354fb614b2d2f8f78fa63b4b.title: Remove BigQuery tracing from agent-runtime
960921026e18e0db354fb614b2d2f8f78fa63b4b.summary: Removed `insertTrace` calls from `run-agent-step.ts` and `search-system-prompt.ts`. This eliminates `agent-response` and `file-trees` trace inserts into BigQuery. Updated `packages/bigquery/src/client.ts` to use `getErrorObject` for error logging.

ce32bb56eed76e2b336218b6087febc609a9b07a.title: CLI thinking block preview logic
ce32bb56eed76e2b336218b6087febc609a9b07a.summary: Thinking block preview shows up to 5 lines while streaming, collapses to caret indicator upon completion. Native reasoning blocks hide when message completes via `isMessageComplete` prop. Updates `ThinkingBlock` and `Thinking` components in `cli/src/components/blocks/` and `cli/src/components/`. `PREVIEW_LINE_COUNT` constant increased from 3 to 5.

e309aede7e5bdeea828f731a16fe4c890a376bb9.title: CLI status bar uses battery indicator for Claude quota
e309aede7e5bdeea828f731a16fe4c890a376bb9.summary: Replaced percentage text with an 8-character battery-style progress bar in the CLI bottom status line. Implemented via new `BatteryIndicator` component in `bottom-status-line.tsx` and updated color logic in `progress-bar.tsx`. Healthy capacity (>25%) now renders in muted theme colors instead of primary/error to reduce visual noise.

9888fb656a1d19118f67a5a82130758e86e419c9.title: Add CI job for internal integration tests
9888fb656a1d19118f67a5a82130758e86e419c9.summary: New test-internal-integration job added to .github/workflows/ci.yml for packages/internal. PostgreSQL 16-alpine service container configured to support advisory lock tests. Database migrations run via bun run db:migrate before test execution.

913a419e099c75154e727ccf433ee5dd84c17633.title: Reduce verbose logging in CLI and Agent Runtime
913a419e099c75154e727ccf433ee5dd84c17633.summary: Removed redundant debug/info logs from CLI startup, chat state persistence, and agent tool execution. Specifically stripped full message history dumps in `run-agent-step.ts` and tool result logs in `tool-executor.ts`. This change reduces log noise and potential PII exposure in console outputs. No functional behavior changes for users.

7177b06ec8ea56cf4a6e9649698f36682efbcbf5.title: Advisory locks replace serializable transactions in credit ops
7177b06ec8ea56cf4a6e9649698f36682efbcbf5.summary: Billing credit consumption and grants now use `withAdvisoryLockTransaction` instead of `withSerializableTransaction`. This change eliminates serialization failures by making concurrent transactions wait on advisory locks keyed by user/org ID. Affected files include `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts`, `packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts`, `packages/billing/src/org-billing.ts`, and `packages/internal/src/db/transaction.ts`. New analytics events `ADVISORY_LOCK_CONTENTION` and `TRANSACTION_RETRY_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED` track lock waits and retry thresholds.

005e8cac511bb7123a56344e16a71a7f5279f33f.title: CLI logs emit PostHog events via SDK logger
005e8cac511bb7123a56344e16a71a7f5279f33f.summary: CLI logger now tracks events to PostHog in production. SDK `agent-runtime` accepts injected `logger`, defaulting to `noopLogger`. New `AnalyticsEvent.CLI_LOG` added to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Scope: `cli/src/utils/logger.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, `cli/src/utils/codebuff-client.ts`.

56c6c89e0bbe5b442de910c19144193edd842de6.text: Internal test tools were updated to match expected data formats. This change affects only development checks and has no impact on how you use the product.

96b2d8a6dc65e7718bd3823302841548acb92a46.text: The app now hides extra technical messages that used to appear on your screen. You will see a cleaner view with less clutter, but the app works exactly the same.

ce32bb56eed76e2b336218b6087febc609a9b07a.text: The assistant now shows more of its planning steps while it works, then hides them when it finishes.

fd3d3db8705f1aaf3eea54cae6655f2211e78cc6.text: Automated checks that previously failed without a live database now skip in that environment. This change only affects internal testing tools and does not alter how you use the product.

7177b06ec8ea56cf4a6e9649698f36682efbcbf5.text: Billing systems now handle multiple users updating balances at once more reliably. This reduces errors during credit purchases or grants.

e309aede7e5bdeea828f731a16fe4c890a376bb9.text: The status bar now uses a battery icon to show your usage limit instead of a number. Colors are softer when you have plenty of capacity left.

913a419e099c75154e727ccf433ee5dd84c17633.text: The system now hides unnecessary technical details from the logs. This keeps your private information safer and makes the output cleaner, without changing how the product works for you.

960921026e18e0db354fb614b2d2f8f78fa63b4b.text: The assistant stopped saving detailed internal activity logs to a large data warehouse. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

005e8cac511bb7123a56344e16a71a7f5279f33f.text: The tool now sends basic usage details to help the team understand how the product works. This happens automatically in the background and does not change how you use the software.

9888fb656a1d19118f67a5a82130758e86e419c9.text: The team added an automatic check to test how internal parts of the software work together. This small, behind-the-scenes update helps catch problems earlier, making the product more reliable for you.

c00389f164131f883ab0b8a44003e5b46b59c0f4.title: Fix CLI input history navigation after mode changes
c00389f164131f883ab0b8a44003e5b46b59c0f4.summary: Input history navigation now resets when switching input modes, preventing stale draft state. The `use-input-history` hook exposes `resetHistoryNavigation` and tracks navigation state via `isNavigatingRef` to isolate history movement from mode transitions. `chat-input-bar.tsx` updates key intercept logic to allow Up/Down history navigation even when suggestion menus are active, provided cursor position matches history boundaries. Feedback mode in `keyboard-actions.ts` now explicitly blocks global keys except Escape, Ctrl-C, and Ctrl-V, while allowing paste.

a5cac4bbbc705293539353a70fe0ca0bbb597930.title: Clarify codebuff-local-cli purpose as e2e visual testing
a5cac4bbbc705293539353a70fe0ca0bbb597930.summary: Updated `spawnerPromptExtras` in `.agents/codebuff-local-cli.ts` to explicitly define the agent's purpose as E2E visual testing of the CLI. The prompt now clarifies that the agent starts a local dev instance via `bun --cwd=cli run dev` in tmux to capture real terminal output, distinguishing this from unit tests or code review. This change restricts the agent's scope to visual verification of components, hooks, and rendering, preventing misuse for logic analysis or standard test execution.

34c0e7de63c4b283bb6988ae706f549d0d23bf92.title: CLI multiline Enter fix Linux
34c0e7de63c4b283bb6988ae706f549d0d23bf92.summary: MultilineInput now treats `\n` sequence as plain Enter on Linux. Previously only `\r` matched, causing `\n` to trigger Shift-Enter newline insertion. Fix covers CLI component `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`.

55e0209ebf3db68dbf9e46f10055dd4f9cb97bc4.title: askuser collapsed view flattens multiline custom answers
55e0209ebf3db68dbf9e46f10055dd4f9cb97bc4.summary: Collapsed ask_user views now flatten multiline custom answers into single lines. `accordion-question.tsx` replaces newlines and whitespace with spaces in `getAnswerDisplay`; `question-header.tsx` adds `truncate` and `wrapMode="none"` to the collapsed answer text. `custom-answer-input.tsx` raises `maxHeight` from 3 to 5.

3b2abb6b97eb8720d420223badeacc444a622467.title: Improve askuser custom input UX and filtering
3b2abb6b97eb8720d420223badeacc444a622467.summary: The CLI `ask_user` tool now filters redundant 'Custom'/'Other' options via `use-ask-user-bridge.ts` and `ask-user.ts` prompt instructions, relying on the built-in text field. `custom-answer-input.tsx` adds a themed border and scrollbar support to `multiline-input.tsx`, while `index.tsx` prevents accidental deselection of custom text when clicking away. `question-header.tsx` and `accordion-question.tsx` implement ellipsis truncation for long custom answers to fit terminal width.

ca8d393f0a9ec14d2d81239d109d3979ff577c91.title: Reduce web backend log verbosity
ca8d393f0a9ec14d2d81239d109d3979ff577c91.summary: Removes console.log calls from NextAuth redirect callbacks and downgrades auth flow logs from info to debug level. Strips redundant info-level logging from chat completions request handler. Limits balance calculator debug output to netBalance field only. Affects packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts, web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts, and web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts.

3860935c805c24b37e13bdcdc6aac874a3270dca.title: Web onboarding shows referrer name and bonus credits
3860935c805c24b37e13bdcdc6aac874a3270dca.summary: Referral landing page and onboarding flow now display referrer display name and `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS` amount. `onboard-client-wrapper.tsx` and `onboarding-flow.tsx` accept new `referrerName` prop, passed from `referrals/[code]/page.tsx` using `referrerDisplayName`. Copy updated to "[Name] invited you to Codebuff!" and mutual bonus credit messaging. `affiliates-client.tsx` migrated from deprecated `useFormState` to `useActionState`.

9e1ced5fec4155d20a0d5de3a1cd522dda723cef.title: Fix CLI paste handling in askuser custom input
9e1ced5fec4155d20a0d5de3a1cd522dda723cef.summary: Prop-driven focus/blur logic added to `MultilineInput` via `FocusableScrollBox` interface, exposing `blur` on `MultilineInputHandle`. Paste handler in `strings.ts` now prioritizes `eventText` over clipboard, fixing stale clipboard reads during drag-drop or native paste events. Scope: `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`, `cli/src/utils/strings.ts`. `readClipboardText` only called when `eventText` is empty.

c3dd4c8e0d50e2b788d2c1ae20912fba60328570.title: Revert Upstash Dependency Update
c3dd4c8e0d50e2b788d2c1ae20912fba60328570.summary: Reverts the update to @upstash/ratelimit and @upstash/redis in web/package.json. Removes the previously added dependency entries, restoring the prior state. This change affects only the web package's dependency manifest.

f2f8768f183a4493efa6da16fe64b374ec0b420f.title: Add streaming buffer caps to prevent OOM
f2f8768f183a4493efa6da16fe64b374ec0b420f.summary: Enforce 1MB buffer caps on response and reasoning text in `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` to prevent server OOM during stream consumption. Truncation appends `---[TRUNCATED]---` and logs warnings when limits are reached. Cancel handler now logs text lengths instead of full state objects to avoid OOM during logging.

ca8d393f0a9ec14d2d81239d109d3979ff577c91.text: This small internal update reduces the amount of technical data the system records in the background. It helps the service run more efficiently without changing how you use the product.

3b2abb6b97eb8720d420223badeacc444a622467.text: The assistant now shows cleaner choices when asking for your input, with a simple text box for custom answers that scrolls and truncates long responses to fit the screen.

9e1ced5fec4155d20a0d5de3a1cd522dda723cef.text: Fixes a bug where pasting text into the input box sometimes failed. Copying and pasting now works reliably.

a5cac4bbbc705293539353a70fe0ca0bbb597930.text: A small internal update clarified that a testing assistant only checks how the tool looks on screen, not how it works inside. This keeps the assistant focused on visual checks and prevents it from trying to do other tasks it is not meant for.

3860935c805c24b37e13bdcdc6aac874a3270dca.text: When you click a friend's link to start using the product, you now see their name and a message about bonus credits for both of you. This helps you know who invited you and what reward you get.

c3dd4c8e0d50e2b788d2c1ae20912fba60328570.text: The team removed a recent update to a tool that controls how often people can use the product. This change is small and internal. You will not see any difference in how the product works.

34c0e7de63c4b283bb6988ae706f549d0d23bf92.text: Pressing the Enter key on Linux now correctly submits your message instead of adding a new line.

c00389f164131f883ab0b8a44003e5b46b59c0f4.text: Pressing the up and down arrow keys now works correctly to browse previous messages, even when the text box is in a special mode or showing suggestions. This prevents the program from getting confused by old drafts and keeps your typing history separate from your current message.

f2f8768f183a4493efa6da16fe64b374ec0b420f.text: The assistant now stops writing if a response gets too long, adding a note that it was cut off. This keeps the service running smoothly for everyone.

55e0209ebf3db68dbf9e46f10055dd4f9cb97bc4.text: When the assistant hides previous questions to save space, long answers now fit on one line instead of looking messy. This is a small visual fix; your full answer is still saved and viewable when you open the question again.

d00903a709a387517c1ce06ba36ac6372c8f6c8c.title: Apply Prettier formatting across web package
d00903a709a387517c1ce06ba36ac6372c8f6c8c.summary: Standardized code style across web package files using Prettier. Changes include line wrapping, whitespace cleanup, and consistent formatting in scripts, API routes, and UI components. Scope covers web/scripts, web/src/app/api, and web/src/app components. No functional logic changes; purely cosmetic formatting adjustments.

546532d217d80b72cd904ab14b4ee2f9824a0ae2.title: token-count non-anthropic model handling
546532d217d80b72cd904ab14b4ee2f9824a0ae2.summary: web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts now routes non-Anthropic models to countTokensViaAnthropic using DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_MODEL ('claude-opus-4-5-20251101') instead of failing conversion. Applies NON_ANTHROPIC_TOKEN_BUFFER (0.3) to inflate counts via Math.ceil to account for tokenizer differences. Scope limited to Web API surface.

d752f67c2623da1313c5cf5f2f4bd33c4d8caaea.title: Fix masonry grid disappearing on terminal resize
d752f67c2623da1313c5cf5f2f4bd33c4d8caaea.summary: Unified DOM structure in `grid-layout.tsx` prevents content disappearance during column count transitions. Replaced conditional single/multi-column rendering with a consistent row/column layout using `MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH` to prevent zero-width collapse. Updated `use-grid-layout.ts` to enforce minimum column width and adjusted gap logic. Bumped `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/react` to 0.1.74.

1fd37c57f2de84bfb7df7910b06d9f252b6724cc.title: Help banner explains credits, moves /commands first, timeout doubled
1fd37c57f2de84bfb7df7910b06d9f252b6724cc.summary: Help banner text updated to explain credit pricing, ad earnings, and Claude Subscription connection. /commands shortcut moved to first position. HELP_TIMEOUT doubled from 30s to 60s. Change isolated to cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx.

306f8687ad62f943c366f87e6e2033c7332bef61.title: CLI displays terminal command timeouts
306f8687ad62f943c366f87e6e2033c7332bef61.summary: Terminal command displays now show non-default timeouts. New formatTimeout utility converts seconds to human-readable labels (e.g., "2m timeout"). Covers cli/src/components/terminal-command-display.tsx and cli/src/components/tools/run-terminal-command.tsx. Labels render dimmed next to commands, suppressed for the 30s default.

9df82f2c07d8d7cfbb84b6ddd213925f2dc0cd14.title: Add Upstash rate limiting and Redis dependencies
9df82f2c07d8d7cfbb84b6ddd213925f2dc0cd14.summary: Added @upstash/ratelimit and @upstash/redis to web/package.json. These libraries provide client-side or edge-compatible primitives for enforcing request quotas and caching state via Upstash. Scope limited to the web package dependencies.

8298fea956a823265b5aafd2f1e9df8eb5b519a9.title: Reorder /help to top of CLI slash commands
8298fea956a823265b5aafd2f1e9df8eb5b519a9.summary: The /help command definition moved to the first position in SLASH_COMMANDS array within cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts. This ensures /help appears at the top of the CLI autocomplete menu. The change affects only the ordering in the CLI data source.

6e43d3910d1556f38d39e37c8b83e2bbf4f96740.title: Exclude healthz test from Jest config
6e43d3910d1556f38d39e37c8b83e2bbf4f96740.summary: Added `<rootDir>/src/app/api/healthz/__tests__` to the `testPathIgnorePatterns` array in `web/jest.config.cjs`. This change prevents the healthz test from running during CI execution, resolving a reported failure. The scope is limited to the web package's testing configuration.

28b7135a68ba48fa7c1f4c9f39c5b46dcf657e4f.title: Fix MCP tool name separator to double underscore
28b7135a68ba48fa7c1f4c9f39c5b46dcf657e4f.summary: MCP tool names now use `__` instead of `/` as the server-tool separator. LLM APIs (OpenRouter/Anthropic) reject tool names containing slashes due to the `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$` pattern constraint. User-facing `toolNames` still accept `/` (e.g., `supabase/list_tables`), but `getMCPToolData` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/mcp.ts` and `tool-executor.ts` normalize to `__` internally. New constant `MCP_TOOL_SEPARATOR` extracted to `packages/agent-runtime/src/mcp-constants.ts`.

53151c9677656c761e9f0a3117d4f6b45f61c8ac.title: FAQ documents Claude Pro/Max subscription support
53151c9677656c761e9f0a3117d4f6b45f61c8ac.summary: Added FAQ entries explaining Claude Pro/Max subscription usage via `/connect:claude`. Updated `web/src/app/docs/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx` and `web/src/content/help/faq.mdx` to include this new question and answer. Clarifies that connecting a subscription saves credits while retaining orchestration features.

d752f67c2623da1313c5cf5f2f4bd33c4d8caaea.text: The grid layout no longer disappears when you resize the window.

9df82f2c07d8d7cfbb84b6ddd213925f2dc0cd14.text: The website now uses a service to limit how many requests users can make and to store temporary data faster. This helps keep the site running smoothly for everyone.

1fd37c57f2de84bfb7df7910b06d9f252b6724cc.text: The help screen now lists commands first and explains how credits and subscriptions work. The screen stays open longer before closing.

d00903a709a387517c1ce06ba36ac6372c8f6c8c.text: The software's internal code was cleaned up to follow a consistent style. This is a small, behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

8298fea956a823265b5aafd2f1e9df8eb5b519a9.text: The help command now appears first in the menu. This makes it easier to find when typing a command.

28b7135a68ba48fa7c1f4c9f39c5b46dcf657e4f.text: Fixed a naming rule for external tools so they work correctly with the AI's brain. Users keep typing tool names the same way; the system cleans them up behind the scenes.

53151c9677656c761e9f0a3117d4f6b45f61c8ac.text: The help pages now explain how to link a subscription to use the assistant without spending extra credits. This update is internal and does not change how the product works.

546532d217d80b72cd904ab14b4ee2f9824a0ae2.text: The system now estimates token counts for non-Anthropic models using a standard reference model, adding a small safety buffer to account for differences in how text is processed. This prevents errors when checking usage limits for these models, ensuring smoother operation for everyday users.

6e43d3910d1556f38d39e37c8b83e2bbf4f96740.text: A small internal fix stops a hidden system check from running during updates. This change does not affect how you use the product.

306f8687ad62f943c366f87e6e2033c7332bef61.text: When you run a command that takes longer than the standard wait time, the tool now shows a label indicating the extended limit. This helps you see that the process is allowed to run longer than usual without being stopped.

35b3d4776947057243f70de62a20d766b988f661.title: healthz switch to lightweight count query
35b3d4776947057243f70de62a20d766b988f661.summary: healthz route.ts replaces getCachedAgentsLite with getAgentCount in agents-data.ts. Fixes unstable_cache 2MB limit warning by querying direct SQL COUNT(*) on schema.agentConfig instead of caching full agent objects. Error response field changes from cache_warm to agent_count_error. Scope limited to web health check API.

17830c230a4f6b9ccef2a9ac860b30aa2ce692fc.title: Bump ai, lodash, diff, pin @ai-sdk/provider
17830c230a4f6b9ccef2a9ac860b30aa2ce692fc.summary: Dependabot patch bumps: ai ^5.0.0 to ^5.0.52, lodash 4.17.21 to 4.17.23, diff 8.0.2 to 8.0.3. f5fb361e464098fe551e0b350db6681f2cf83d09.title: Remove dead FEATUREPOINTS and keyPoints from landing pages
f5fb361e464098fe551e0b350db6681f2cf83d09.summary: Deleted unused `FEATURE_POINTS` constant and `keyPoints` prop from `web/src/components/ui/landing/constants.ts` and `web/src/components/ui/landing/feature/index.tsx`. This cleanup removes dead code from the marketing site's feature sections, specifically stripping out hardcoded bullet points for pricing and core features that were no longer rendered or needed. The `KeyPoint` interface was also removed from `web/src/components/ui/landing/types.ts`.

18ca79da38544e5a0ea7749d6429dffa69b8cf5f.title: Remove unused getCachedAgentsLite and buildAgentsDataLite
18ca79da38544e5a0ea7749d6429dffa69b8cf5f.summary: Removed `fetchAgentsWithMetricsLite` from `web/src/server/agents-data.ts` and `buildAgentsDataLite` from `web/src/server/agents-transform.ts`. These functions were dead code paths for lightweight agent data fetching and transformation. The change cleans up the server-side data layer without affecting active API endpoints or UI surfaces.

76fac870edb54a406f6e2169fe33410dae62b2d6.title: Bump lodash to 4.17.23 in evals and scripts
76fac870edb54a406f6e2169fe33410dae62b2d6.summary: Lodash dependency updated from 4.17.21 to 4.17.23 in `evals/package.json` and `scripts/package.json`. This addresses security alerts flagged by Dependabot. Scope limited to internal evaluation and scripting tooling packages. No API or behavior changes for end users.

6c8bdbb4d5b8554a0cc22cdb85358fb315d7e3c2.title: ci: explicit DATABASEURL override after secrets injection
6c8bdbb4d5b8554a0cc22cdb85358fb315d7e3c2.summary: CI workflow adds step setting `DATABASE_URL` to local test container after SDK build. Prevents injected secrets from overriding test DB config. Affects `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Uses `>> $GITHUB_ENV` for step-scoped env override.

accf15783fc7529ae9cf3942c82da8a8830bfb05.title: Healthz endpoint refactored for unit testability
accf15783fc7529ae9cf3942c82da8a8830bfb05.summary: Refactored `/api/healthz` GET handler into a testable `_get.ts` module. The new `getHealthz` function accepts a `HealthzDeps` interface, decoupling it from `getAgentCount`. Added `web/src/app/api/healthz/__tests__/healthz.test.ts` to verify response structure and error handling.

6ba0df14e0e9a4ee213a8fc10d0ffcdebf91f145.title: Add Claude Subscription Connect UI to Pricing
6ba0df14e0e9a4ee213a8fc10d0ffcdebf91f145.summary: Added a new feature section and illustration to the pricing page promoting the `/connect:claude` command. This visual update explains how users can link their existing Claude Pro or Max subscriptions to save credits. Changes are isolated to `web/src/app/pricing/pricing-client.tsx`.

44f596450369b5820acfd6c164b8a38a78df8016.title: Set DATABASEURL at job level in CI billing tests
44f596450369b5820acfd6c164b8a38a78df8016.summary: CI workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` now defines `DATABASE_URL` at the `test-billing-integration` job level. This change ensures the environment variable explicitly overrides any secrets injection that might occur during the workflow run. The scope is limited to the GitHub Actions CI configuration for billing integration tests. The hardcoded URL `postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/testdb` matches the local Postgres service container.

6d30e228aa7f057ffa08e63ef38b39130042fc79.title: Consolidate duplicate dependencies across packages
6d30e228aa7f057ffa08e63ef38b39130042fc79.summary: Refactored dependency declarations in `cli`, `evals`, `agent-runtime`, `bigquery`, `billing`, `code-map`, `internal`, `scripts`, `sdk`, and `web` to remove redundant entries and align versions. Removed duplicate `@types/node`, `@types/bun`, and `lodash` from package-specific manifests where they were already present or unnecessary, and updated `ts-pattern` to `^5.9.0`. This change reduces package size and simplifies dependency management without altering runtime behavior.

76fac870edb54a406f6e2169fe33410dae62b2d6.text: The team updated a helper tool to fix a security warning. This change only affects internal testing and does not change how the product works for you.

18ca79da38544e5a0ea7749d6429dffa69b8cf5f.text: The team removed unused background tools that fetched agent data. This change cleans up the system's internal workings. It does not affect how the product looks or functions for users.

6d30e228aa7f057ffa08e63ef38b39130042fc79.text: The tool's internal setup was cleaned up by removing duplicate parts. This makes the program smaller and easier to maintain without changing how it works for you.

f5fb361e464098fe551e0b350db6681f2cf83d09.text: The website team removed unused text from the landing page. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

35b3d4776947057243f70de62a20d766b988f661.text: The system now checks its health using a faster, simpler method. This internal fix improves stability without changing how the product looks or works for you.

accf15783fc7529ae9cf3942c82da8a8830bfb05.text: The health check system was improved internally. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

17830c230a4f6b9ccef2a9ac860b30aa2ce692fc.text: Small internal updates improve stability and security. You likely won't notice any changes.

44f596450369b5820acfd6c164b8a38a78df8016.text: A small internal update made sure the billing tests use the correct database location. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

6ba0df14e0e9a4ee213a8fc10d0ffcdebf91f145.text: The pricing page now shows how to connect an existing subscription to save credits.

6c8bdbb4d5b8554a0cc22cdb85358fb315d7e3c2.text: A small internal update fixes how the system checks test data, so future improvements work more reliably. No changes to the features you use.

1b6379f5e554c8faa0497836fbf8796984ee2c62.title: Inline consumeFromOrderedGrants in billing integration test
1b6379f5e554c8faa0497836fbf8796984ee2c62.summary: Inline consumeFromOrderedGrants in packages/billing/src/__tests__/balance-calculator.integration.test.ts to avoid importing db, which triggers side effects connecting to env.DATABASE_URL before test URL is set. Scope limited to billing package integration tests. Removed tx: db as any casts in favor of TestDbConn type.

5792b8402506f1c3b4c5502d704b79ce8b0d22af.title: Context pruner adds 1k token fudge factor
5792b8402506f1c3b4c5502d704b79ce8b0d22af.summary: agents/context-pruner.ts introduces a 1000-token fudge factor to the context length check. Pruning now triggers when `contextTokenCount + 1000` exceeds `maxContextLength`, causing earlier summarization. This ensures a safety buffer before hard limits.

07c8edf2d442720b901c628ef1879ba9e0d19a3a.title: Token count API tracks model and input tokens
07c8edf2d442720b901c628ef1879ba9e0d19a3a.summary: The agent runtime now passes the active model to the token count API. The web endpoint moved analytics tracking to post-success, logging the resolved Anthropic model ID and input token count. Model IDs are converted from OpenRouter format to Anthropic format before counting. Default fallback remains claude-opus-4-5-20251101.

614f8ba872fc3e99a949642fc3565cf27ec904a6.title: Add programmatic handleSteps to CLI agents
614f8ba872fc3e99a949642fc3565cf27ec904a6.summary: Implements `handleSteps` generator functions in `.agents` CLI definitions to enforce programmatic tmux session management. Replaces LLM-driven shell commands with structured logic that parses `run_terminal_command` results, validates exit codes, and extracts session names directly from stdout. Updates `claude-code-cli.ts`, `codebuff-local-cli.ts`, `codex-cli.ts`, and `gemini-cli.ts` to serialize constants within the generator, ensuring robust session initialization independent of model adherence to prompt instructions.

9f4906b6a90d9776bde69a25e7279fa9c60e10bf.title: Fix context-pruner threshold tests for fudge factor
9f4906b6a90d9776bde69a25e7279fa9c60e10bf.summary: Test updates align context-pruner threshold assertions with 1000 token fudge factor logic. Cases verify no prune at `max - fudge` and prune at `max`. Covers `agents/__tests__/context-pruner.test.ts`.

88d198baf9be9c8c93f3a6627003999f13dc81ed.title: fix(cli): resolve message queue race conditions and add recovery
88d198baf9be9c8c93f3a6627003999f13dc81ed.summary: CLI message queue refactored to prevent race conditions via synchronous state initialization and a 60-second watchdog timer. `use-message-queue.ts` separates user-pause state from system-busy state and adds `processNextMessage` logic. `use-send-message.ts` sets `isChainInProgressRef` synchronously before async work and introduces `resetEarlyReturnState` helper for error recovery. `send-message.ts` fixes history truncation assignment bug.

9926f45db5808786ce7e7e7f5a652a87dc9ebdc9.title: Refactor tmux session management with JSON output and robust parsing
9926f45db5808786ce7e7e7f5a652a87dc9ebdc9.summary: Agent definitions in `claude-code-cli.ts`, `codebuff-local-cli.ts`, `codex-cli.ts`, and `gemini-cli.ts` now parse JSON output from `tmux-cli.sh` to extract session names and error states. The complex, nested parsing logic was replaced with a streamlined check for `stdout`, `stderr`, and `exitCode` within the JSON object. System prompts in `cli-agent-prompts.ts` were updated to reflect that session management is now handled automatically, removing instructions for manual `tmux-cli.sh start` command construction. `codebuff-local-cli.ts` also added `skipPrepPhase: true`.

95a51d89d74b186344a0b8170ae55666a73cfe8a.title: New MCP Servers docs page
95a51d89d74b186344a0b8170ae55666a73cfe8a.summary: Added `web/src/content/agents/mcp-servers.mdx` documenting Model Context Protocol integration for Codebuff agents. Covers stdio and remote (HTTP/SSE) server configuration, `mcpServers` field structure, environment variable interpolation, and agent spawning via `@` syntax. Includes Notion, GitHub, and generic API examples.

31c6ff78607c4aea4456865d2a9dd28c5dd44608.title: CI split billing integration tests into dedicated postgres job
31c6ff78607c4aea4456865d2a9dd28c5dd44608.summary: CI workflow now runs `packages/billing` integration tests in a dedicated `test-billing-integration` job with a PostgreSQL 16 service container. The general `test-integration` job excludes `.agents` and `packages/billing` from its matrix, focusing on packages without database dependencies. `fail-fast: false` added to test strategies to allow independent package failures. Billing tests execute `db:migrate` via `packages/internal` before running `*.integration.test.ts` files.

9ff89c4b30b689fa83204343720511eda0b2ae6e.title: Fix retry detection and narrow grant reads
9ff89c4b30b689fa83204343720511eda0b2ae6e.summary: Billing `getOrderedActiveGrants` now uses a UNION query to always include the last active grant even if its balance is zero, ensuring debt is correctly attributed to the lowest-priority grant. Transaction retry logic in `packages/internal/src/db/transaction.ts` now traverses nested error causes to extract valid PostgreSQL error codes, preventing false negatives for wrapped errors. Changes affect `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` and `packages/internal/src/db/transaction.ts`.

31c6ff78607c4aea4456865d2a9dd28c5dd44608.text: Automated checks for billing features now run separately from other tests. This keeps the billing system more reliable.

5792b8402506f1c3b4c5502d704b79ce8b0d22af.text: The assistant now saves space earlier by adding a safety buffer. This helps prevent the conversation from stopping unexpectedly when it gets too long.

88d198baf9be9c8c93f3a6627003999f13dc81ed.text: Fixed a rare bug where messages could get stuck or sent out of order. The system now recovers automatically if a message fails.

07c8edf2d442720b901c628ef1879ba9e0d19a3a.text: The system now records which assistant version you use and how much text you send. This helps track usage accurately without changing how you interact with the product.

9f4906b6a90d9776bde69a25e7279fa9c60e10bf.text: The system now correctly handles memory limits, ensuring it keeps recent conversations without accidentally cutting off useful information too early.

1b6379f5e554c8faa0497836fbf8796984ee2c62.text: A small internal cleanup fixed a timing issue in the billing tests. This helps keep the system stable and does not change how you use the product.

614f8ba872fc3e99a949642fc3565cf27ec904a6.text: A small internal update improves how the assistant manages background tasks. It now follows strict rules to start and check these tasks, making the process more reliable.

9926f45db5808786ce7e7e7f5a652a87dc9ebdc9.text: The assistant now handles background tasks more reliably by checking for errors automatically. You will see fewer failures when running multiple tasks at once.

95a51d89d74b186344a0b8170ae55666a73cfe8a.text: A new help page explains how to connect outside services to the assistant. This is an internal documentation update; it does not change how the product works for users.

455bdaf609af6bb437c7077cc76ab1f11026df5c.title: Upgrade tar dependency to 7.0.0 in CLI release packages
455bdaf609af6bb437c7077cc76ab1f11026df5c.summary: Updated the `tar` dependency from `^6.2.0` to `^7.0.0` in `cli/release/package.json` and `cli/release-staging/package.json`. This upgrade resolves npm warnings associated with the previous version. The change affects the CLI release tooling surfaces.

442b0290c1ab6a071c3ee5220e19723f5e4be49f.title: Exclude commander agents from pruned context
442b0290c1ab6a071c3ee5220e19723f5e4be49f.summary: Added 'commander' and 'commander-lite' to the exclusion list in agents/context-pruner.ts. Prevents their output from being pruned during context management. Scope limited to the core agent context pruning logic. No migration or breaking changes required.

3a8e8925294f18fa14cbd415308f01c1ff1ca3a4.title: CLI agent modes simplified to work/review
3a8e8925294f18fa14cbd415308f01c1ff1ca3a4.summary: Internal `.agents` CLI agent modes renamed from `test` to `work`, with `review` kept. `create-cli-agent.ts` and `cli-agent-prompts.ts` updated to support `defaultMode`, `workModeInstructions`, and `reviewModeInstructions` overrides. `cli-agent-schemas.ts` renames `testResults` to `results` and `testName` to `name`. `cli-agent-types.ts` fixes `ExtraInputParams` type to properly exclude `mode` via key remapping.

99b49c66f7076a3a637649d81ace69a5ac87bed9.title: Remove binary smoke test from CLI update flow
99b49c66f7076a3a637649d81ace69a5ac87bed9.summary: Removed `runSmokeTest` from `cli/release/index.js` and `cli/release-staging/index.js`. This eliminates a Windows EPERM error caused by spawning the downloaded binary and reduces update latency. The update flow now moves the binary to its final location immediately after download.

2edc81fe91dd34d9a8d86d1f51a514e2a4f78029.title: Remove streamingAgents prop drilling in CLI blocks
2edc81fe91dd34d9a8d86d1f51a514e2a4f78029.summary: Removes `streamingAgents` prop from CLI block components (`AgentBlockGrid`, `BlocksRenderer`, `ToolBranch`, etc.) and adds `memo` to `MessageBlock` and `MessageAttachments`. `ToolBranch` now derives `isStreaming` directly from `useChatStore` state instead of receiving it via props. This eliminates unnecessary re-renders caused by prop drilling and ensures components only update when their specific streaming state changes.

6a8af63cf292d48cb9a2b25b0f6f4e271de4a6ed.title: Fix context pruner by moving constants and helpers into handleSteps
6a8af63cf292d48cb9a2b25b0f6f4e271de4a6ed.summary: Context pruner constants and helper functions moved inside handleSteps to prevent serialization errors. Agents previously failed to spawn because top-level module variables were inaccessible to the serialized generator function. Affects agents/context-pruner.ts.

fb890c67d66a6ebe351d627157959cdaba48966c.title: CLI: cancelled status for interrupted subagents
fb890c67d66a6ebe351d627157959cdaba48966c.summary: Added 'cancelled' status to AgentContentBlock. markRunningAgentsAsCancelled recursively updates 'running' blocks on interruption.
