UI displays '⊘ cancelled' in red. Files: types/chat.ts, utils/block-operations.ts, utils/agent-helpers.ts, hooks/helpers/send-message.ts.

be7a47c3aba6efd68c6a94469ef976b2bf075c1b.title: Extract chat UI and streaming hooks from CLI chat.tsx
be7a47c3aba6efd68c6a94469ef976b2bf075c1b.summary: Refactored cli/src/chat.tsx by extracting connection, timer, queue, and exit logic into cli/src/hooks/use-chat-streaming.ts, and scroll, terminal dimensions, and theme logic into cli/src/hooks/use-chat-ui.ts. This reduces chat.tsx complexity and isolates concerns. REFACTORING_PLAN.md marks commit 1.1b complete. No user-facing behavior changes.

2818f1b149f3c4ff78171c90c70f018d7af53ab5.title: Improve Discord advisory lock reliability for leader election
2818f1b149f3c4ff78171c90c70f018d7af53ab5.summary: Advisory lock implementation in `packages/internal/src/db/advisory-lock.ts` now returns a `LockHandle` object instead of a raw `postgres.Sql` connection. This handle exposes `onLost()` callbacks and a `release()` method, with an internal 30-second health check interval to detect connection drops. `web/scripts/discord/index.ts` consumes this new API, adding error handling for lock acquisition failures and a `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS` limit (5) before exiting. The `releaseAdvisoryLock` export was removed from `packages/internal/src/db/index.ts`.

3acbf5fec2f171a3ad4a1306ac327dff9a4083dc.title: setoutput tool collapsed by default in CLI
3acbf5fec2f171a3ad4a1306ac327dff9a4083dc.summary: CLI now renders set_output tool blocks collapsed by default. New shouldCollapseToolByDefault helper in cli/src/utils/constants.ts checks COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_TOOL_NAMES. ToolBranch component uses this helper to determine initial collapse state when toolBlock.isCollapsed is undefined. Reduces visual noise from verbose set_output JSON payloads.

fb890c67d66a6ebe351d627157959cdaba48966c.text: When you stop a task, the system now clearly shows it was cancelled. This helps you see that the work stopped, instead of looking like it is still running.

3acbf5fec2f171a3ad4a1306ac327dff9a4083dc.text: The assistant now hides detailed output data by default. This makes the screen less cluttered and easier to read.

99b49c66f7076a3a637649d81ace69a5ac87bed9.text: The update process no longer tests the downloaded tool before installing it. This removes a common error on Windows and makes updates finish faster.

3a8e8925294f18fa14cbd415308f01c1ff1ca3a4.text: The assistant's available modes were simplified to 'work' and 'review'. This makes the tool easier to understand and use.

6a8af63cf292d48cb9a2b25b0f6f4e271de4a6ed.text: The assistant now starts correctly when creating new tasks. Previously, some features could not load because internal tools were hidden from the startup process. This fix ensures the assistant can access the information it needs to begin working.

455bdaf609af6bb437c7077cc76ab1f11026df5c.text: The tool used to package the software was updated to fix minor background errors. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

442b0290c1ab6a071c3ee5220e19723f5e4be49f.text: The system now keeps the full conversation history for commander agents, instead of trimming it to save space. This helps those agents stay on track and remember earlier instructions.

be7a47c3aba6efd68c6a94469ef976b2bf075c1b.text: Programmers cleaned up the code behind the chat window to make it easier to manage. This change does not affect how the product works or looks.

2edc81fe91dd34d9a8d86d1f51a514e2a4f78029.text: The app now checks for new messages directly instead of passing them through multiple layers. This reduces unnecessary updates, making the interface feel smoother and more responsive.

2818f1b149f3c4ff78171c90c70f018d7af53ab5.text: The system now uses a more reliable method to ensure only one part of the service controls Discord updates at a time, preventing conflicts. If a connection drops, the system detects it quickly and stops to avoid errors, keeping the service stable.

1ce2372fe5ddb3fef01c99e60ccc255a83c1fefd.title: db:migrate:render script reverted to drizzle-kit push
1ce2372fe5ddb3fef01c99e60ccc255a83c1fefd.summary: The `db:migrate:render` script in `packages/internal/package.json` reverts from `npx drizzle-kit migrate` to `npx drizzle-kit push`. This undoes a previous fix intended to avoid SIGSEGV crashes during migrations. The change applies exclusively to the internal database migration tooling.

b939af8f6d1e89a2896d16ebe0cf8e0919943c6a.title: Update quick start docs for modes and init
b939af8f6d1e89a2896d16ebe0cf8e0919943c6a.summary: quick-start.mdx updates mode descriptions to `plan` and `max` with slash command `/mode`. `/init` guidance simplifies to `knowledge.md` and `.agents/types/` bullets. New projects note references AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md fallback.

1676c5b09e27231d61f40e68326ec291ac5c1eff.title: Removed db:migrate:render script from packages/internal
1676c5b09e27231d61f40e68326ec291ac5c1eff.summary: Removed `db:migrate:render` script from `packages/internal/package.json`. Reverts `fix(db): add db:migrate:render script using npx to avoid Bun SIGSEGV crash`. Scope limited to internal package scripts.

01fd3a1357e89fd2d52937003c4663ca77783c34.title: Add db:migrate:render script using npx
01fd3a1357e89fd2d52937003c4663ca77783c34.summary: Added `db:migrate:render` script to `packages/internal/package.json` executing `npx drizzle-kit push` instead of `bun`. This bypasses a known `Bun` SIGSEGV crash during migration rendering. Scope limited to internal package tooling.

2020bc7c3d154fd3f8be5e1edd39e517378921ac.title: db:migrate:render uses drizzle-kit migrate
2020bc7c3d154fd3f8be5e1edd39e517378921ac.summary: packages/internal/package.json switches db:migrate:render from drizzle-kit push to drizzle-kit migrate. Change avoids SIGSEGV crashes during render migrations. Scope limited to internal package scripts.

396d0dff0ce1ae452e308763c42339f199e87fc7.title: Add file-picker-max agent using grok-4.1-fast
396d0dff0ce1ae452e308763c42339f199e87fc7.summary: Introduce `file-picker-max` agent variant in `agents/file-explorer/file-picker-max.ts` using `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast` model. Refactor `agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts` to export `createFilePicker` factory supporting 'default' and 'max' modes. Update `agents/base2/base2.ts` to conditionally spawn `file-picker` or `file-picker-max` based on `isMax` flag.

913dc992870658f425f928f263d04565764168fb.title: SDK run-terminal-command prefers Git Bash over WSL bash
913dc992870658f425f928f263d04565764168fb.summary: Windows bash resolution in `sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts` now prioritizes `GIT_BASH_COMMON_PATHS` and non-WSL `PATH` entries before falling back to WSL. `WSL_BASH_PATH_PATTERNS` (`system32`, `windowsapps`) identify unreliable WSL paths, deferring them to last-resort fallbacks. WSL bash remains supported but is deprioritized to avoid failures when the VM is inactive or due to Windows/Linux quoting and UTF-16 encoding mismatches.

10f424728d116d125676d97dc1e9df848c01bc50.title: CLI chat state extraction and Postgres advisory locks
10f424728d116d125676d97dc1e9df848c01bc50.summary: Chat state and message logic extracted from cli/src/chat.tsx into new hooks (use-chat-state.ts, use-chat-messages.ts) and types (chat-state.ts). This reduces component complexity and isolates pagination/tree-building logic. Added packages/internal/src/db/advisory-lock.ts implementing PostgreSQL session-level advisory locks for singleton process leader election (e.g., Discord bot).

61e2ece6336e56b7c50719637287963a94591a9a.title: Update file lister to grok 4.1 fast
61e2ece6336e56b7c50719637287963a94591a9a.summary: File lister agent model updated from x-ai/grok-4-fast to x-ai/grok-4.1-fast. Definition export refactored to factory function createFileLister returning Omit<SecretAgentDefinition, 'id'>, with id merged in final object. Instructions prompt tightened: explicit newline separation, path accuracy emphasis, tool-call prohibition added.

ab53db5a63d86b5b55078476d10204f4fd18d3cb.title: Refactor context pruner constants and extract SDK client helpers
ab53db5a63d86b5b55078476d10204f4fd18d3cb.summary: Context pruner refactored. Magic numbers extracted to named constants (TARGET_SUMMARY_FACTOR, CACHE_EXPIRY_MS). Helper functions truncateLongText, estimateTokens, getTextContent added. SDK client, env, run files updated per Wave 1 review findings. REFACTORING_PLAN.md added tracking Phase 1 completion.

1ce2372fe5ddb3fef01c99e60ccc255a83c1fefd.text: The team reverted a change to the internal database setup tool. This is a small, behind-the-scenes fix that does not affect how the product works for you.

2020bc7c3d154fd3f8be5e1edd39e517378921ac.text: The system now uses a more reliable method to update its database structure, preventing unexpected crashes. This small internal fix improves stability without changing how you use the product.

1676c5b09e27231d61f40e68326ec291ac5c1eff.text: The team removed a background tool that helped set up the database. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

ab53db5a63d86b5b55078476d10204f4fd18d3cb.text: The system's internal memory management was cleaned up to be more reliable. This is a small background change that helps the assistant keep track of conversations better without affecting how you use it.

01fd3a1357e89fd2d52937003c4663ca77783c34.text: A small internal update fixes a rare crash during a database setup step. This change does not affect how you use the product.

10f424728d116d125676d97dc1e9df848c01bc50.text: The chat feature was cleaned up internally to make it more reliable. A new system prevents multiple copies of the assistant from running at the same time, avoiding duplicate replies.

61e2ece6336e56b7c50719637287963a94591a9a.text: The tool that lists files now uses a newer, faster brain. It follows instructions more strictly, so it gives you more accurate file paths and avoids making mistakes.

396d0dff0ce1ae452e308763c42339f199e87fc7.text: The assistant can now use a new model for finding files. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

b939af8f6d1e89a2896d16ebe0cf8e0919943c6a.text: The guide explains new assistant modes and simplifies setup steps.

913dc992870658f425f928f263d04565764168fb.text: The assistant now uses a more reliable tool for running commands on Windows. This helps prevent errors when the usual system is inactive or has compatibility issues.

626cb7cd501ede8e983b11cc8717392d0ffe0b61.title: Add newline shortcuts to CLI help banner
626cb7cd501ede8e983b11cc8717392d0ffe0b61.summary: Help banner text updated to include `Ctrl+J` and `Option+Enter` as newline shortcuts. @files and @agents references consolidated. Affects `cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx`.

952cafcea60b275942b7d3b676a7f206432289fd.title: Add message-block-store and block-margins utilities
952cafcea60b275942b7d3b676a7f206432289fd.summary: Introduces `message-block-store.ts` using Zustand and Immer to centralize `MessageBlockContext` and `MessageBlockCallbacks`, replacing prop drilling for theme, markdown palette, and message tree data. Adds `block-margins.ts` providing `extractTextBlockMargins` to suppress top margins when preceded by tool or agent blocks. These internal refactors improve state management and rendering consistency within the CLI chat interface.

93e36d191e5ae913ffab34acea06bae7e3bd18d9.title: code-reviewer.ts adds think tag directive
93e36d191e5ae913ffab34acea06bae7e3bd18d9.summary: Prompt injection in agents/reviewer/code-reviewer.ts instructs the code reviewer agent to use <think></think> tags before generating review output. This change enforces internal reasoning steps prior to providing feedback, aiming to improve the quality of suggestions by forcing the model to process the diff context first. Scope limited to the reviewer agent's system prompt configuration.

58d6c0e7ad61d7c3ba8d057744585e0890655cb3.title: Make MessageWithAgents markdownPalette optional
58d6c0e7ad61d7c3ba8d057744585e0890655cb3.summary: Type `markdownPalette` as `MarkdownPalette | undefined` in `message-with-agents.tsx`. `paletteForMessage` and `agentPalette` return `undefined` when source is null. Assertion operators (`!`) force non-null on `markdownOptions` and child props. Scope: CLI `message-with-agents` component.

4a88477aab83e69caeceb7e109b377707d815e1d.title: Refactor CLI ask-user components, rename Other to Custom
4a88477aab83e69caeceb7e109b377707d815e1d.summary: CLI ask-user UI refactored: extracted `custom-answer-input.tsx`, `options-list.tsx`, and `question-header.tsx` from `accordion-question.tsx`. Renamed `OTHER_OPTION_INDEX` to `CUSTOM_OPTION_INDEX` and updated props (`isOther` to `isCustom`, `otherText` to `customText`) across `constants.ts` and `index.tsx`. Scope limited to `cli/src/components/ask-user`.

41f44f4862192aed5e18abef99728a67b0c56529.title: SDK: Enforce bash on Windows
41f44f4862192aed5e18abef99728a67b0c56529.summary: SDK requires bash on Windows. Throws error if missing. Replaces cmd.exe. Affects `sdk/src/run-state.ts`, `sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts`, `WINDOWS.md`. Checks `CODEBUFF_GIT_BASH_PATH`, PATH, common Git Bash locations.

61fc6ea6bfc70e1118786b4ad40d39255b82c7c1.title: Fix CLI message queue race and add --wait-idle to tmux
61fc6ea6bfc70e1118786b4ad40d39255b82c7c1.summary: Refactored `useMessageQueue` to perform atomic state updates inside `setQueuedMessages`, preventing race conditions where the processed message mismatched the removed one. The `Chat` component switched to `useLayoutEffect` for context updates to ensure synchronous rendering during rapid streaming. The `tmux-send.sh` harness gained `--wait-idle SECS` and `--delay MS` flags to reliably detect stream completion and adjust post-enter timing in automated tests.

6fc8bbbcb2f87ec3ba3406e3e6e2218a73bd5fcd.title: Collapse code-reviewer children under code-reviewer-multi-prompt
6fc8bbbcb2f87ec3ba3406e3e6e2218a73bd5fcd.summary: Added PARENT_CHILD_COLLAPSE_RULES and shouldCollapseForParent in constants.ts to collapse code-reviewer agents spawned by code-reviewer-multi-prompt. message-block-helpers.ts implements findAgentTypeById for recursive parent lookup and updates createAgentBlock to accept parentAgentType for conditional collapsing. sdk-event-handlers.ts wires parentAgentType into handleSubagentStart and handleSpawnAgentsToolCall. Reduces CLI transcript noise from nested review agents.

a30c4db558d52fde3996feef83849945602af5e0.title: Refactor message-with-agents to use Zustand store
a30c4db558d52fde3996feef83849945602af5e0.summary: MessageWithAgents and AgentChildrenGrid now consume context (theme, callbacks) from useMessageBlockStore instead of prop drilling. ErrorBoundary renamed to ErrorBoundaryPlaceholder with deprecated alias, as it does not catch render errors. Message updater flushes pending changes on dispose to prevent data loss.

01c06622102352f6714739724f42933b4e0a4983.title: Refactor CLI blocks-renderer and agent-branch-wrapper with stable
01c06622102352f6714739724f42933b4e0a4983.summary: Refactored blocks-renderer.tsx and agent-branch-wrapper.tsx to store props in refs for stable handler access, eliminating 12+ and 17 useMemo dependencies respectively. Introduced extractTextBlockMargins and extractHtmlBlockMargins helpers in single-block.tsx to consolidate margin calculation logic. Added responsive grid layout guard in use-grid-layout.ts to force single column when terminal width falls below minWidthForTwoColumns. Updated implementor-helpers.ts to replace EDIT_TOOL_NAMES with ALL_EDIT_TOOL_NAMES constant covering both direct and proposed edit tools.

626cb7cd501ede8e983b11cc8717392d0ffe0b61.text: The help screen now lists keyboard shortcuts for adding line breaks. You can press Ctrl+J or Option+Enter to start a new line without sending the message.

a30c4db558d52fde3996feef83849945602af5e0.text: The app's message display was reorganized to work more reliably. This internal change prevents rare errors and ensures your messages are saved correctly.

952cafcea60b275942b7d3b676a7f206432289fd.text: This is an internal update that cleans up how the app stores and displays messages. You might see smoother, more consistent text spacing in chats, but nothing else changes for you.

61fc6ea6bfc70e1118786b4ad40d39255b82c7c1.text: Fixed a rare glitch where chat replies could appear out of order during fast streaming. Also added a small internal tool to help check that responses are fully sent before moving on.

58d6c0e7ad61d7c3ba8d057744585e0890655cb3.text: The assistant can now handle messages without color settings. This internal fix prevents errors when those settings are missing.

41f44f4862192aed5e18abef99728a67b0c56529.text: The software now requires a specific background tool on Windows to run commands. If you do not have this tool installed, you will see an error message and need to install it to continue.

01c06622102352f6714739724f42933b4e0a4983.text: The tool now handles text spacing more consistently and switches to a single-column view when the screen is too narrow, making the layout easier to read. It also updated how it recognizes certain editing actions, ensuring the assistant correctly applies changes.

6fc8bbbcb2f87ec3ba3406e3e6e2218a73bd5fcd.text: The tool now hides extra details from nested review steps. This makes the output easier to read.

93e36d191e5ae913ffab34acea06bae7e3bd18d9.text: The assistant now thinks through its reasoning steps before giving feedback. This change aims to make its suggestions more accurate and helpful.

4a88477aab83e69caeceb7e109b377707d815e1d.text: The program cleaned up its internal setup for how it asks you questions. This small change does not affect how you use the product.

20976b32502f0da1ab7c7d5a494f21e8b694e2f9.title: Rename .agents-graveyard to agents-graveyard
20976b32502f0da1ab7c7d5a494f21e8b694e2f9.summary: Directory rename. Dot-prefixed path removed. Internal repo structure updated. No code logic changes.

f029fe416ce90be9af4e32b173412e8b36a34d20.title: Update code reviewer multi-prompt examples
f029fe416ce90be9af4e32b173412e8b36a34d20.summary: Revised description and examples for `prompts` array in `agents/reviewer/multi-prompt/code-reviewer-multi-prompt.ts`. Updated guidance to include specific code parts (e.g., frontend) and angles like simplification. Provides two distinct example arrays replacing the single previous example.

f17e51b7c3f23463f0cfac4f5f0340de36d26c6d.title: Update agent-builder example imports
f17e51b7c3f23463f0cfac4f5f0340de36d26c6d.summary: agents/agent-builder.ts swaps planner and reviewer example imports to planner-pro-with-files-input.ts and code-reviewer.ts. Adds multi-prompt/code-reviewer-multi-prompt.ts to examplesAgentsContent. Internal refactor of agent definition examples.

40d41aa90dc2bf436ba838cbd8b0461c5e8fbda7.title: Update max agent prompts to use code-reviewer-multi-prompt
40d41aa90dc2bf436ba838cbd8b0461c5e8fbda7.summary: The max mode prompts in `agents/base2/base2.ts` now reference `code-reviewer-multi-prompt` instead of `reviewer-editor-gpt-5` for code review tasks. This aligns the agent's review step with the updated multi-prompt reviewer architecture. The change ensures the agent spawns the correct reviewer agent for max mode operations.

f45a870de64fdcf94b7c81fca177faa4cf8cf34d.title: Enforce read-only mode and trim history in multi-prompt reviewer
f45a870de64fdcf94b7c81fca177faa4cf8cf34d.summary: Code reviewer prompts now explicitly forbid tool calls to prevent accidental state modification. Multi-prompt agent strips trailing user messages from history via set_messages before spawning sub-agents. This reduces context noise and ensures sub-agents review only the intended diff scope. Files: agents/reviewer/code-reviewer.ts, agents/reviewer/multi-prompt/code-reviewer-multi-prompt.ts.

04cc786be8a45b952f8d235848ffcf4f9e3ad717.title: Base2 max mode runs typecheck before code review
04cc786be8a45b952f8d235848ffcf4f9e3ad717.summary: Base2 agent max mode now sequences typecheck before code-reviewer-multi-prompt. Previous logic ran them in parallel. Change affects agents/base2/base2.ts prompt construction.

153f21c0ce93b7a38c0965fbcdb4f805b4fc8e4d.title: Simplify CLI multi-prompt editor UI
153f21c0ce93b7a38c0965fbcdb4f805b4fc8e4d.summary: Removed dynamic 'proposals generated' header and per-file hunk counts from `ImplementorGroup` and `CompactFileRow` in `cli/src/components/blocks/implementor-row.tsx`. Added/removed diff bars switched from bright `theme.success`/`theme.error` backgrounds to muted hex colors `#3A5A3A`/`#5A3A3A` with `theme.foreground` text. Layout width calculations updated to exclude hunk text, granting more space for file paths.

0f4b98503ecce31555b4a32e0f293d39ab4bed3f.title: Remove best-of-n reviewer and base2 agents
0f4b98503ecce31555b4a32e0f293d39ab4bed3f.summary: Deleted `agents/reviewer/best-of-n` and `agents/base2` directories, removing `code-reviewer-best-of-n`, `code-reviewer-implementor`, `code-reviewer-selector`, and `base2-with-planner-pro` agent definitions. `decomposing-thinker` moved to `.agents-graveyard` with updated relative imports. This reduces the agent surface area and removes complex orchestration logic for code review and planning.

2a6aec3f1b54a9d183616be72337540f5cf3f24a.title: Remove agent status footer from AgentBlockGrid
2a6aec3f1b54a9d183616be72337540f5cf3f24a.summary: Removed `getAgentStatusSummary` and the status footer from `AgentBlockGrid` in `cli/src/components/blocks/agent-block-grid.tsx`. The footer displayed running, failed, and completed agent counts based on `streamingAgents` and block status. This simplifies the grid by removing the `streamingAgents` prop and theme dependencies for the footer.

f17e51b7c3f23463f0cfac4f5f0340de36d26c6d.text: Internal cleanup of assistant examples. No change to how you use the product.

20976b32502f0da1ab7c7d5a494f21e8b694e2f9.text: The system updated its internal file structure to make the way it stores old data clearer. Nothing changed about how the product works or what it can do.

04cc786be8a45b952f8d235848ffcf4f9e3ad717.text: The assistant now checks code types before reviewing the rest of the work. This ensures the review happens only after basic validation passes.

153f21c0ce93b7a38c0965fbcdb4f805b4fc8e4d.text: The app removed extra text and made colors softer. This gives more room for file names, making the screen easier to read.

40d41aa90dc2bf436ba838cbd8b0461c5e8fbda7.text: The assistant now uses a newer, multi-step process to review code. This internal update helps it check your work more thoroughly.

0f4b98503ecce31555b4a32e0f293d39ab4bed3f.text: The product removed several unused helpers that checked work and planned tasks. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the app.

2a6aec3f1b54a9d183616be72337540f5cf3f24a.text: The bottom row showing how many agents are running, failed, or finished was removed from the display. The screen is now cleaner, but you can no longer see those counts at a glance.

392655319d5814d42edd8cc06aef380791cadfe6.title: Max mode swaps reviewer-editor-gpt-5 for code-reviewer-multi-prompt
392655319d5814d42edd8cc06aef380791cadfe6.summary: Max mode agent configuration now uses `code-reviewer-multi-prompt` instead of `reviewer-editor-gpt-5` in `agents/base2/base2.ts`. The new `code-reviewer-multi-prompt` agent spawns multiple `code-reviewer` instances with distinct focus prompts (e.g., security, performance) and merges their outputs into a single structured review. This change affects only the internal agent orchestration for max-mode sessions.

3a2107e4d0372944191f09aa2bd398224ef0d7b0.title: Add UserErrorBanner component
3a2107e4d0372944191f09aa2bd398224ef0d7b0.summary: New `UserErrorBanner` component added to `cli/src/components/user-error-banner.tsx` for displaying runtime errors in the CLI UI. Uses theme-aware styling with `theme.error` border and text color, and supports optional `title` prop defaulting to 'Error'. Returns `null` for empty or whitespace-only error strings. Scope limited to CLI surface.

882572d22bf35146c53c73e870a4c19dcb6958de.title: Context pruner includes non-blacklisted spawnagents results
882572d22bf35146c53c73e870a4c19dcb6958de.summary: The context pruner now captures and summarizes tool results from `spawn_agents` calls, excluding a defined blacklist of utility agents like `file-picker` and `code-searcher`. This change ensures that outputs from substantive spawned agents are preserved in the summarized context, while noisy or redundant results from helper agents are filtered out. The mechanism involves iterating through `spawn_agents` results, filtering by `agentType` against `SPAWN_AGENTS_OUTPUT_BLACKLIST`, stripping `<think>` tags, and truncating long outputs to `ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_LIMIT`. This affects `agents/context-pruner.ts`.

20e9efa656734873d9199d96b1ba3b17a19582d0.title: Add GridLayout and ErrorBoundary CLI components
20e9efa656734873d9199d96b1ba3b17a19582d0.summary: New `GridLayout` and `ErrorBoundary` components added to `cli/src/components`. `GridLayout` renders responsive multi-column layouts using `useGridLayout`, while `ErrorBoundary` provides a structural wrapper for error fallbacks. Scope limited to CLI UI subsystem. `ErrorBoundary` uses a `memo` wrapper due to OpenTUI's lack of class component support, delegating true error catching to `withErrorFallback` or parent boundaries.

9495948aaae1dfa6fe453d655f21443e1515ecf2.title: Decompose CLI block rendering into dedicated components
9495948aaae1dfa6fe453d655f21443e1515ecf2.summary: Refactored CLI message rendering by splitting monolithic block logic into `cli/src/components/blocks/`. New files `agent-branch-wrapper.tsx`, `blocks-renderer.tsx`, `single-block.tsx`, `user-content-copy.tsx`, and `block-helpers.ts` handle specific rendering tasks. Existing components like `agent-block-grid.tsx` and `implementor-row.tsx` moved into the `blocks/` directory with updated import paths. This modularization improves maintainability of the CLI UI layer.

c6ed3479cbb3d26b18acd3af1544904e8faba7e0.title: Add AgentBlockGrid and ToolBlockGroup CLI components
c6ed3479cbb3d26b18acd3af1544904e8faba7e0.summary: New `AgentBlockGrid` renders multiple agent branches in a grid with a dynamic status footer (running, failed, completed counts). `ToolBlockGroup` wraps consecutive `ToolBranch` components, applying conditional vertical spacing based on adjacent timeline blocks. These components reside in `cli/src/components/` and handle layout logic previously scattered or absent in the CLI renderer.

b9c092fdbe928382fd8f37fe37866ddbe2a6f7ed.title: CLI: extract message-block internals and wire up parallel agent
b9c092fdbe928382fd8f37fe37866ddbe2a6f7ed.summary: Refactored CLI components by extracting message-block internals into dedicated files like `blocks-renderer.tsx` and `user-content-copy.tsx`. Implemented a `GridLayout` and `useGridLayout` hook to render parallel agent children side-by-side in `message-with-agents.tsx`. Added `userError` prop to `MessageBlock` for UI-only error banners. Scope covers `cli/src/components` and `cli/src/types/chat.ts`.

954d9565fd3c0c0a4c907dcd4210d4995637e0e8.title: Fix CLI @ menu with apostrophes, preserve input, keep leading
954d9565fd3c0c0a4c907dcd4210d4995637e0e8.summary: CLI @ menu ignores single quotes as delimiters, enabling mentions after apostrophes. AskUserBridge stops clearing input on submit/skip, preserving user text. Terminal output and top banner preserve leading whitespace via `trimEnd` instead of `trim`. Error handling simplifies to direct `setError` without `createErrorMessage` wrapper.

abbc9730a4783f84c1fa9c128fd4e1864f1381b9.title: Add useGridLayout hook for CLI responsive layout
abbc9730a4783f84c1fa9c128fd4e1864f1381b9.summary: New `useGridLayout` hook in `cli/src/hooks/use-grid-layout.ts` computes responsive grid dimensions based on available width. It uses thresholds (100, 150, 200 chars) to determine max columns, then delegates to `computeSmartColumns` from `layout-helpers` to finalize column count and width. The hook returns a memoized object containing `columns`, `columnWidth`, and `columnGroups` (items distributed round-robin). This provides a standardized mechanism for CLI components to adapt their layout to terminal width changes.

3f158d6374927f48c756d865153280f5ac0f8f4c.title: CLI implementor-helpers gains generic block grouping
3f158d6374927f48c756d865153280f5ac0f8f4c.summary: cli/src/utils/implementor-helpers.ts adds generic groupConsecutiveBlocks and derives groupConsecutiveImplementors, groupConsecutiveNonImplementorAgents, groupConsecutiveToolBlocks. PROPOSED_EDIT_TOOL_NAMES now derives from EDIT_TOOL_NAMES via map. Removes JSDoc on most exports. Scope: cli/src/utils only.

882572d22bf35146c53c73e870a4c19dcb6958de.text: The assistant now keeps useful results from complex background tasks in its memory, while ignoring noisy data from minor helper tools. This helps it remember important information better without getting cluttered.

3a2107e4d0372944191f09aa2bd398224ef0d7b0.text: The program now shows a clear, colored box when an error happens. You will see the problem message in the command window instead of just plain text.

20e9efa656734873d9199d96b1ba3b17a19582d0.text: The app now arranges content more flexibly to fit different screen sizes and shows helpful messages when errors occur, making it easier to read and use.

392655319d5814d42edd8cc06aef380791cadfe6.text: The review feature now uses a team of specialists who check different aspects of your work separately and combine their notes. This internal update aims to provide more thorough feedback without changing how you use the product.

3f158d6374927f48c756d865153280f5ac0f8f4c.text: The code that organizes the assistant's actions was cleaned up to be more flexible. This internal change does not affect how the product works for users.

abbc9730a4783f84c1fa9c128fd4e1864f1381b9.text: The app now automatically adjusts how content is arranged in the command window to fit your screen width. This means text and options will stay readable and properly spaced, whether your window is narrow or wide.

9495948aaae1dfa6fe453d655f21443e1515ecf2.text: The code behind the text you see on your screen was split into smaller, separate parts. This internal cleanup makes the tool easier to maintain without changing how it looks or works for you.

c6ed3479cbb3d26b18acd3af1544904e8faba7e0.text: The text interface now displays multiple tasks in a neat grid with a clear status summary. This makes it easier to see what is running, failed, or done at a glance.

0a378efeb66ac84c6014c50df46a5e923c81f781.title: Add block-processor utilities to CLI
0a378efeb66ac84c6014c50df46a5e923c81f781.summary: New `cli/src/utils/block-processor.ts` exports `processBlocks` and `BlockProcessorHandlers` to abstract content block iteration. Groups consecutive reasoning, tool, agent, and implementor blocks via `implementor-helpers` and `chat` types. Internal refactor for `BlocksRenderer` and `AgentBody` in the CLI surface.

85062102870de68eb7871eb8917d67e6e0ad6979.title: Fix Ctrl+J newline insertion in CLI multiline input
85062102870de68eb7871eb8917d67e6e0ad6979.summary: Ctrl+J now inserts a newline in CLI multiline input by detecting the terminal-translated linefeed character (0x0a) or ctrl+j key sequence. Previous logic missed linefeed detection, causing Ctrl+J to fail. Scope limited to cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx. Key check prioritizes linefeed name over raw ctrl+j to handle terminal translation.

6b2a98d9044c1ca85645d8541f306513a59294bd.title: Fix Claude OAuth error detection via APICallError status
6b2a98d9044c1ca85645d8541f306513a59294bd.summary: getErrorStatusCode now checks both statusCode and status properties to handle AI SDK APICallError conventions. isClaudeOAuthRateLimitError and isClaudeOAuthAuthError use this helper to correctly detect 429, 401, and 403 responses from Claude OAuth. Covers sdk/src/error-utils.ts and sdk/src/impl/llm.ts. Prevents missed rate-limit and auth handling when the AI SDK uses status instead of statusCode.

a93f8c52fb71e8355d3595afcfec0647d6fd2d52.title: Enhanced API error messages with endpoint context
a93f8c52fb71e8355d3595afcfec0647d6fd2d52.summary: API client now throws errors including method and URL for non-retryable failures. Timeout errors in agent-runtime now specify the endpoint and duration. Affects `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/codebuff-web-api.ts`. Error objects preserve original name and cause via enhanced error wrapping.

ed73d8422680785fdd74ad2bbf8c7bd0db804414.title: CLI: process queued messages one at a time
ed73d8422680785fdd74ad2bbf8c7bd0db804414.summary: The CLI message queue now enforces sequential processing via `isProcessingQueueRef` in `use-message-queue.ts`, replacing the previous timeout-based dispatch. This prevents race conditions where multiple messages could be sent concurrently if the queue drained faster than the agent could respond. The change spans `cli/src/hooks/use-message-queue.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, and `cli/src/utils/yield-to-event-loop.ts` (new file). `sendMessage` now returns a `Promise<void>`, and `finalizeQueueState` in `send-message.ts` handles lock release on completion, abort, or error.

23332b5a17edeafa295c8845d90ba6a179c10e4d.title: Remove Agent Store link from navbar
23332b5a17edeafa295c8845d90ba6a179c10e4d.summary: Removed 'Agent Store' navigation links and associated 'Bot' icon from `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. This change affects both desktop and mobile menu views. No functional impact on the `/store` page itself.

97ede16f9f23676151659ad8659acc31b006ca09.title: tmux scripts add buffer clear and unique session names
97ede16f9f23676151659ad8659acc31b006ca09.summary: scripts/tmux/tmux-send.sh clears input buffers via C-u and adds delays to prevent command concatenation. scripts/tmux/tmux-start.sh generates unique session names using PID and random suffix to avoid parallel collisions. Deduplication state is now explicitly reset during session initialization.

4b19be7354005515d072a83cf0b7f023109be47a.title: Update Claude Code comparison table
4b19be7354005515d072a83cf0b7f023109be47a.summary: Revised feature comparison matrix in claude-code-comparison.mdx. Removed rows for directory-specific context, diff-focused edits, polished UI, full SDK, and project templates. Added rows for SDK, speed, code review per prompt, and follow up suggestions.

253c4754e42312935287f7d0996ea9335394fa10.title: CLI agent factory extracted to modular files
253c4754e42312935287f7d0996ea9335394fa10.summary: CLI agent definitions in .agents/ now call createCliAgent() from .agents/lib/create-cli-agent.ts instead of duplicating inline config. Prompts, schemas, and types split into cli-agent-prompts.ts, cli-agent-schemas.ts, cli-agent-types.ts. Covers claude-code-cli.ts, codebuff-local-cli.ts, codex-cli.ts, gemini-cli.ts. Factory accepts cliName, shortName, startCommand, permissionNote, spawnerPromptExtras.

eabf40e54495c612d5a6308fc4f4f4be9ebf08fd.title: .agents CLI definitions add review mode
eabf40e54495c612d5a6308fc4f4f4be9ebf08fd.summary: Agent definitions in .agents/claude-code-cli.ts, .agents/codebuff-local-cli.ts, .agents/codex-cli.ts, and .agents/gemini-cli.ts add a review mode via params.mode enum. Files renamed from *-tester.ts to *-cli.ts to reflect dual test/review capabilities. Output schema adds reviewFindings array with file, severity, line, finding, and suggestion fields. Codex CLI additionally supports reviewType param for pr, uncommitted, commit, or custom review scopes.

a93f8c52fb71e8355d3595afcfec0647d6fd2d52.text: When a request fails, the error message now shows which part of the system caused the problem and how long it waited. This makes it easier to understand why something didn't work without needing technical knowledge.

0a378efeb66ac84c6014c50df46a5e923c81f781.text: Internal cleanup of how the assistant shows its work. No visible change to you.

253c4754e42312935287f7d0996ea9335394fa10.text: The team cleaned up the internal setup for the assistant's tools. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

ed73d8422680785fdd74ad2bbf8c7bd0db804414.text: The command-line tool now sends your messages one by one, waiting for a reply before moving to the next. This stops messages from getting mixed up or sent too fast, making the conversation smoother and more reliable.

eabf40e54495c612d5a6308fc4f4f4be9ebf08fd.text: The assistant can now check code changes and list problems with suggested fixes.

6b2a98d9044c1ca85645d8541f306513a59294bd.text: Fixed a bug where the system failed to recognize certain access errors from the assistant. This ensures users see proper messages when hitting usage limits or losing access.

85062102870de68eb7871eb8917d67e6e0ad6979.text: Pressing Ctrl+J now correctly adds a new line when typing multiple lines in the command window. Before this fix, that key did nothing.

23332b5a17edeafa295c8845d90ba6a179c10e4d.text: The 'Agent Store' link was removed from the main menu on both desktop and mobile. This is a small visual cleanup; the store page itself still works normally.

4b19be7354005515d072a83cf0b7f023109be47a.text: The list showing what this tool can do was updated to match its current features. This helps you understand exactly which tasks it handles best.

97ede16f9f23676151659ad8659acc31b006ca09.text: The tool now clears leftover text and names sessions uniquely to prevent errors when running multiple tasks at once. This is a small internal fix.

b3e504afd2899688e8a5049ca9332a2133d561cd.title: Add --paste and --retry to tmux-send.sh
b3e504afd2899688e8a5049ca9332a2133d561cd.summary: Added --paste flag using bracketed paste mode and --retry for session detection in scripts/tmux/tmux-send.sh. --paste triggers CLI paste handler correctly vs raw keystroke; --no-enter skips submit. Retry defaults to 3 attempts with 0.3s delay. Updated scripts/tmux/README.md with usage examples.

ee4243fffcd14b9091a06132807caae6962b0385.title: LONGTEXTTHRESHOLD raised to 1000 chars
ee4243fffcd14b9091a06132807caae6962b0385.summary: cli/src/utils/strings.ts updates LONG_TEXT_THRESHOLD from 200 to 1000 chars. Pasted text under 1000 chars now inserts inline instead of attaching. Affects CLI paste behavior.

1506118b849f954ef987c767cd716202fddaa047.title: Ad impression credit floor randomized
1506118b849f954ef987c767cd716202fddaa047.summary: Ad impression credit grants now use a randomized minimum floor instead of a static constant. The `MINIMUM_CREDITS_GRANTED` value is increased by a random integer between 0 and 2 using `Math.floor(3 * Math.random())`. This change affects the ad impression payout logic in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/_post.ts`, ensuring variable minimum credit grants per impression.

4a9f5399ab66052e1793f774e3c50fae738fd4cb.title: CLI unifies image and text attachments into PendingAttachment type
4a9f5399ab66052e1793f774e3c50fae738fd4cb.summary: Refactor consolidates separate image handling logic into a unified `PendingAttachment` type across CLI components and state. `chat.tsx`, `router.ts`, and `command-registry.ts` now manage `pendingAttachments` instead of `pendingImages`, with new `attachment-card.tsx` providing a shared UI shell for both media types. This internal restructuring simplifies attachment state management and prepares the CLI for broader attachment support without breaking existing image workflows.

83be8c8402aadb3865406aa15d9a7571a11dc597.title: Generic tmux TUI testing infra added for Claude Code and Codex
83be8c8402aadb3865406aa15d9a7571a11dc597.summary: Refactored tmux scripts in scripts/tmux/ to support generic TUI apps via new --command flag in tmux-cli.sh and tmux-start.sh. Added .agents/claude-code-tester.ts and .agents/codex-tester.ts definitions for testing external CLIs. Renamed .agents/cli-tester.ts to .agents/codebuff-tester.ts to clarify scope. Scripts now handle bracketed paste mode for any TUI, with Codebuff as default.

eaadfd2ebfb78e11b037af1e90aec9b09726f447.title: Add Claude 4 Sonnet aliases to OpenRouter mapping
eaadfd2ebfb78e11b037af1e90aec9b09726f447.summary: Added `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522` and `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet` keys to `OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP` in `common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts`. Both aliases resolve to the canonical `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` model ID. This ensures correct routing for OpenRouter requests using these specific model identifiers.

27a1225a727911ef4aff187402652ae400435967.title: Add gemini-tester agent for Gemini CLI testing
27a1225a727911ef4aff187402652ae400435967.summary: New `gemini-tester` agent added to `.agents/gemini-tester.ts` to test Google Gemini CLI functionality using tmux sessions. Agent spawns tmux, sends input, captures terminal output, and validates behavior with structured results. `scripts/tmux/README.md` updated to list `@gemini-tester` alongside existing TUI testing agents.

287c179493cd75c1e88a9aecd6d1f8ee30a3e40e.title: Add debug logging to CLI message queue and send hooks
287c179493cd75c1e88a9aecd6d1f8ee30a3e40e.summary: Instrumented `use-message-queue.ts` and `use-send-message.ts` with granular logging to diagnose input processing stalls. Queue processing logic now logs specific block reasons (e.g., `streamStatus`, `activeAgentStreams`) instead of silent returns. `use-send-message.ts` adds defensive state resets in `finally` blocks and logs validation failures and SDK run configs.

b9eb4a78d7ce4a1295a83fb65a3d201e7b6a8521.title: SDK loads knowledge files from user home directory
b9eb4a78d7ce4a1295a83fb65a3d201e7b6a8521.summary: SDK auto-discovers user knowledge files (~/.knowledge.md, ~/.AGENTS.md, ~/.CLAUDE.md) from the home directory, merging them with project context. New `userKnowledgeFiles` option in `run()` allows overriding or extending these defaults. Priority logic (knowledge.md > AGENTS.md > CLAUDE.md) is centralized in `common/src/constants/knowledge.ts` and applied across CLI init, Agent Runtime prompts, and Evals. Home directory files are read-only for the agent.

5a6348b74a6f86c73f6698bf81502dc5bbdfebf3.title: Add e2e database setup and Playwright infrastructure
5a6348b74a6f86c73f6698bf81502dc5bbdfebf3.summary: Introduced dedicated Postgres container (port 5433) and migration scripts via packages/internal/src/db/e2e-setup.ts for web E2E tests. Nightly CI now runs full `bun run e2e` suite instead of docs-only tests, with automatic cleanup. `web/package.json` scripts chain `e2e:setup` before Playwright execution; `playwright.config.ts` injects `E2E_DATABASE_URL` into webServer env. Remote DB safeguard requires `ALLOW_REMOTE_E2E_DATABASE=true` to bypass localhost check.

83be8c8402aadb3865406aa15d9a7571a11dc597.text: Internal testing tools now check more assistant apps. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ee4243fffcd14b9091a06132807caae6962b0385.text: The tool now pastes text directly into the chat if it is shorter than 1000 characters, instead of attaching it as a separate file.

eaadfd2ebfb78e11b037af1e90aec9b09726f447.text: Added support for new assistant model names. This lets the system correctly recognize and use these specific versions when you request them.

b9eb4a78d7ce4a1295a83fb65a3d201e7b6a8521.text: The assistant now automatically reads personal preference files stored in your home folder to better understand your needs. You can still override these defaults if you want to customize how the assistant behaves.

4a9f5399ab66052e1793f774e3c50fae738fd4cb.text: The program now handles pictures and other files in the same way internally. This cleanup makes it easier for the developers to add support for new file types in the future, but your current experience of attaching images stays the same.

b3e504afd2899688e8a5049ca9332a2133d561cd.text: The tool now handles pasted text more accurately and tries multiple times to connect to the session if the first attempt fails.

287c179493cd75c1e88a9aecd6d1f8ee30a3e40e.text: Internal tools were added to help diagnose why messages sometimes stop working. You will not see any changes in the app.

5a6348b74a6f86c73f6698bf81502dc5bbdfebf3.text: The system now automatically prepares a fresh, isolated test environment for every nightly check to ensure features work correctly before release. This internal improvement does not change how the product looks or feels for users.

1506118b849f954ef987c767cd716202fddaa047.text: The smallest amount of reward you get for viewing an ad now varies slightly instead of staying fixed. This is a minor internal update.

e1914a11273914c1231cce3e9c601e2a390fddbc.title: Remove gravity ad logging from CLI
e1914a11273914c1231cce3e9c601e2a390fddbc.summary: Deleted 6 `logger.info` calls from `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`. Removes '[gravity]' prefixed logs for AdBanner rendering, impression recording, rotation cycles, pause/resume states, and first-message detection. Reduces CLI console noise during ad lifecycle events.

1856ef41b700ca080571d7a991c8bafdf7b0959c.title: Fix ads minimum credits to 2
1856ef41b700ca080571d7a991c8bafdf7b0959c.summary: Corrects MINIMUM_CREDITS_GRANTED from 0.02 to 2 in web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/_post.ts. Ensures ad impression revenue share calculation grants a minimum of 2 credits per user.

52c9195bb6690eb8894cf681d1d85ed75f5017f2.title: Enforce minimum 0.02 credits for ad impressions
52c9195bb6690eb8894cf681d1d85ed75f5017f2.summary: Added `MINIMUM_CREDITS_GRANTED` constant (0.02) to `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/_post.ts`. Credit calculation now uses `Math.max` to ensure payouts below the threshold still grant 0.02 credits, preventing zero-value grants from low-payout impressions. Scope limited to the server-side impression handler.

3af03fe87e2089c2ba3096d0356ee8d8b5479002.title: Track followup click events in CLI chat
3af03fe87e2089c2ba3096d0356ee8d8b5479002.summary: Added AnalyticsEvent.FOLLOWUP_CLICKED and instrumentation in cli/src/chat.tsx to track user interactions with followup suggestions. The handler now logs prompt length, index, and agent mode via logger and sends the event to analytics before submitting the prompt. Includes promise handling for onSubmitPrompt to log success or failure. Scope covers CLI chat component and shared analytics constants.

aded8b49a9e169fa253ad8bae99b655f1d8ed886.title: Fix agent store metrics mapping
aded8b49a9e169fa253ad8bae99b655f1d8ed886.summary: Agent store metrics lookup switched from `publisherId/agentName` to `publisherId/agentId` keys. Deduplication logic in `agents-transform.ts` now uses stable IDs to ensure correct version selection and metric association. Updates affect `web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx` and `web/src/server/agents-transform.ts`.

2c7bcde4cb24d7266343a781e586fbe47a17bd9f.title: suggest-followups restricts click target to label text
2c7bcde4cb24d7266343a781e586fbe47a17bd9f.summary: Refactored `FollowupLine` in `cli/src/components/tools/suggest-followups.tsx` to wrap only the label text in a `Button` component, moving the description out of the interactive element. This prevents accidental triggering of followups when hovering over or clicking the description area. The change adds manual padding calculation to maintain visual alignment between the clickable label and the non-clickable description.

88a0c20e49d2b40a3d2eed9eae481241d55ab176.title: Remove obsolete plans and update doc links
88a0c20e49d2b40a3d2eed9eae481241d55ab176.summary: Deleted `plans/` directory containing obsolete migration and feature specs (e.g., `agent-runtime-migration.md`, `bash-mode-ephemeral-execution.md`). Updated MDX documentation links in `web/src/content/` to use new path-based routing (e.g., `/docs/agents/overview#h2-built-in-agents` instead of `/docs/agents#h2-built-in-agents`). Scope limited to repo cleanup and docs integrity tests.

ec5fa96b62322090df2731a59f8f6834200bab4b.title: CLI credentials save preserves other fields
ec5fa96b62322090df2731a59f8f6834200bab4b.summary: saveUserCredentials now merges new user data into existing credentials file instead of overwriting. clearUserCredentials deletes only the 'default' key, preserving other entries. Implemented in cli/src/utils/auth.ts via readCredentialsFile helper. JSON output now pretty-printed with 2-space indent.

44e0ce088a75fb8768a03c6447855d81243e7e7f.title: Add Vale docs linting and CI E2E checks
44e0ce088a75fb8768a03c6447855d81243e7e7f.summary: Added Vale linting infrastructure and CI checks to the web package. New `.vale.ini` config enforces heading case, wordiness, and TODO comment removal. CI workflow `nightly-e2e.yml` now installs Vale v3.13.0, runs content integrity tests, and executes Playwright E2E docs tests.

9032b27453a861dee6a007ef1d04cbde3a8aa9dc.title: Web static generation and ISR for performance
9032b27453a861dee6a007ef1d04cbde3a8aa9dc.summary: Added `force-static` and `revalidate = 600` to web routes. Static generation applies to affiliates, pricing, privacy, terms, and docs. ISR configures publishers and agent pages with 10-minute revalidation. Docs layout moved client logic to `docs-layout-client.tsx`.

88a0c20e49d2b40a3d2eed9eae481241d55ab176.text: The team removed old planning notes and fixed broken links in the help guides. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

2c7bcde4cb24d7266343a781e586fbe47a17bd9f.text: Only the short suggestion text is clickable now. Clicking the longer description no longer triggers an action, preventing accidental selections.

1856ef41b700ca080571d7a991c8bafdf7b0959c.text: A small internal fix corrected how ad revenue is shared with users. Each ad view now guarantees a minimum of 2 credits.

52c9195bb6690eb8894cf681d1d85ed75f5017f2.text: Low-value ad views now earn a small minimum reward. This ensures you always get some credit, even for tiny amounts.

e1914a11273914c1231cce3e9c601e2a390fddbc.text: The tool no longer writes extra notes about ads to the screen while it runs. You will see a cleaner, less cluttered view when using the command line.

ec5fa96b62322090df2731a59f8f6834200bab4b.text: When you save new login details, the system now adds them to your existing list instead of replacing everything. This means your other saved accounts stay safe and accessible.

44e0ce088a75fb8768a03c6447855d81243e7e7f.text: Automatic checks now catch writing errors and broken links in the help guides. This keeps the instructions accurate and clear for you.

aded8b49a9e169fa253ad8bae99b655f1d8ed886.text: The system now uses a unique ID for each assistant to match performance data. This fixes errors where stats appeared for the wrong assistant or version.

9032b27453a861dee6a007ef1d04cbde3a8aa9dc.text: Pages for partners, prices, policies, and guides now load faster by showing saved copies instead of building fresh every time. Publisher and agent pages update automatically every ten minutes to keep information current.

3af03fe87e2089c2ba3096d0356ee8d8b5479002.text: The chat tool now quietly records when you click suggested follow-up questions. This helps the team understand which suggestions are useful to you.

e4e8a22f55e03d98f8691490296f8d6bb1c2c645.title: Docs switch to static generation
e4e8a22f55e03d98f8691490296f8d6bb1c2c645.summary: Docs pages now use `generateStaticParams` for build-time rendering. `web/src/app/docs/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx` and `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` drop client-side `useParams` for async server props. `mdx-components.tsx` moves `'use client'` directive here.

bee92505bb5ee6828c82b034e39d11aa3e1e0b63.title: Researcher agents collapsed by default in CLI
bee92505bb5ee6828c82b034e39d11aa3e1e0b63.summary: Added researcher-web and researcher-docs to COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_AGENT_IDS in cli/src/utils/constants.ts. These agents now start collapsed in the CLI interface by default, matching the behavior of other utility agents like code-searcher. Scope limited to CLI constants.

624b646319fa2af93d2dd0b7365db47489fe3b99.title: Fix ad endpoint parsing
624b646319fa2af93d2dd0b7365db47489fe3b99.summary: Corrected Gravity API response handling in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`. The code now expects an object with an `ads` array instead of a single ad object, extracting `ads[0]` for processing. This fixes potential errors when parsing the JSON body.

1bb9f79664696fedfd4b3fd40e6e0cbdb4862270.title: Fix ad selection index in ads POST handler
1bb9f79664696fedfd4b3fd40e6e0cbdb4862270.summary: Corrected array access in web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts. Changed `ads.ads[0]` to `ads[0]` to properly select the first ad object. This fixes the ad serving logic for the API endpoint.

b15da6fa4c00648fae15b7f32d8ad34708cbbccd.title: Docs redirect config replaces page component
b15da6fa4c00648fae15b7f32d8ad34708cbbccd.summary: Next.js config redirects handle /docs and /docs/help navigation to /docs/help/quick-start. Removes web/src/app/docs/page.tsx in favor of next.config.mjs entries. Updates footer and navbar links to use standard internal routing.

6a3e149f939aa8751c92a4c6729dc461d023a865.title: Navbar decorative spans set pointer-events-none
6a3e149f939aa8751c92a4c6729dc461d023a865.summary: Added `pointer-events-none` to absolute-positioned decorative gradient spans in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. These spans overlaid `Docs`, `Pricing`, `GitHub`, `Agent Store`, and `Usage` links, blocking click events on the underlying anchors. The fix ensures hover effects render without intercepting user interaction.

e018647fa7bc63e59f22a1099a0267fc1d3d108b.title: CLI file stats bars switch to full-width center-aligned layout
e018647fa7bc63e59f22a1099a0267fc1d3d108b.summary: cli/src/components/implementor-row.tsx replaces proportional +/- bars with full-width green/red bars meeting at a center axis. Removed maxLines calculation and leftPadding logic; added/removed counts now render in white inside padded sections using padStart/padEnd. Scope limited to CLI implementor row rendering.

21b43d28231b3c8e97a7852037ea24b0574b6d4a.title: docs: fix /init command references
21b43d28231b3c8e97a7852037ea24b0574b6d4a.summary: README and web docs replace `codebuff init-agents` with `/init` inside the CLI. Reflects current command surface. Covers `README.md`, `web/src/content/agents/overview.mdx`, `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx`, and `web/src/content/walkthroughs/creating-your-first-agent.mdx`. Quick-start adds a table for `knowledge.md` and `.agents/types/` output.

5830a41371f415e37548922dcbfe53ad7c04e124.title: CLI supports slashless init, new, help, logout, exit commands
5830a41371f415e37548922dcbfe53ad7c04e124.summary: Router now parses slashless exact matches for init, new, help, logout, and exit via parseCommandInput in cli/src/commands/router-utils.ts. Input matching SLASHLESS_COMMAND_IDS from cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts triggers command execution without a leading slash, while multi-word slashless input remains a normal message. Scope is CLI only; slash commands and referral codes unchanged. ImplicitCommand flag added to SlashCommand interface and analytics payload distinguishes slashless invocations.

2379ebdd7dc0b899dfde10e53aad5d0ee1475536.title: CLI pasted text becomes attachment like image
2379ebdd7dc0b899dfde10e53aad5d0ee1475536.summary: Pasted text in the CLI is converted into a pending attachment card, mirroring image paste behavior. The `onPasteLongText` handler in `cli/src/chat.tsx` adds the text to the store, and new `TextAttachmentCard` and `PendingAttachmentsBanner` components display it. This change affects the input flow and message rendering in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` and related UI files.

b15da6fa4c00648fae15b7f32d8ad34708cbbccd.text: We moved the help page to a new address. Visiting the old link now sends you straight to the updated guide.

1bb9f79664696fedfd4b3fd40e6e0cbdb4862270.text: The system previously looked for ads in the wrong place, so the first ad was not selected correctly. This fix ensures the right ad appears when you use the product.

6a3e149f939aa8751c92a4c6729dc461d023a865.text: A small fix removed invisible layers blocking navigation links. Clicking Docs, Pricing, GitHub, Agent Store, and Usage now works.

2379ebdd7dc0b899dfde10e53aad5d0ee1475536.text: Pasting long text into the chat now turns it into a file-like attachment, similar to how images work. This keeps your chat window tidy while still letting you send the full text.

bee92505bb5ee6828c82b034e39d11aa3e1e0b63.text: Research tools now start hidden in the command line view. This keeps the screen cleaner, matching how other helper tools already behave.

624b646319fa2af93d2dd0b7365db47489fe3b99.text: Fixed a small internal error that could cause ads to fail to load correctly. No visible change for most users.

21b43d28231b3c8e97a7852037ea24b0574b6d4a.text: Instructions for setting up the assistant now show the correct command to type. This small internal fix prevents confusion when following the guide.

e018647fa7bc63e59f22a1099a0267fc1d3d108b.text: The file change indicators now use full-width bars that meet in the middle, with numbers displayed inside the colored sections. This makes the visual balance of added and removed lines easier to see at a glance.

5830a41371f415e37548922dcbfe53ad7c04e124.text: You can now type commands like 'new' or 'help' without adding a slash in front of them. This makes the interface slightly easier to use by allowing more natural typing.

e4e8a22f55e03d98f8691490296f8d6bb1c2c645.text: The help pages now build the full text before you visit, instead of assembling it while you wait. This internal update makes reading documentation faster and smoother.

7995908546f64334e1acb5bdb89b9a63810b4cb4.title: cli-ui-tester renamed to cli-tester
7995908546f64334e1acb5bdb89b9a63810b4cb4.summary: Agent definition `.agents/cli-ui-tester.ts` renamed to `.agents/cli-tester.ts`. Internal `id` and `displayName` updated to `cli-tester` and `CLI Tester`. References in `cli/tmux.knowledge.md`, `scripts/tmux/README.md`, and `scripts/tmux/tmux-viewer/README.md` updated to match new agent name.

f0eef6be25a0f614dadda4dd0e0485ef3f8c5311.title: Redirect /docs to quick-start
f0eef6be25a0f614dadda4dd0e0485ef3f8c5311.summary: DocsPage redirect target changed from /docs/help to /docs/help/quick-start. Eliminates intermediate /docs/help step. Affects web/src/app/docs/page.tsx only.

48828d98ddf7a968703fb8706cf5d60e46bea68c.title: ads API defaults sessionId to userId when missing
48828d98ddf7a968703fb8706cf5d60e46bea68c.summary: The `postAds` handler in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` now assigns `sessionId: sessionId ?? userId` to the request body, replacing the previous conditional spread that omitted `sessionId` entirely when absent. This ensures the downstream ads service always receives a valid session identifier, preventing potential mismatches or errors in ad placement tracking for unauthenticated or session-less requests.

9aa925a46842b21f4939378f22d0e8d5a4b8440c.title: tmux scripts add --binary flag for testing compiled CLI
9aa925a46842b21f4939378f22d0e8d5a4b8440c.summary: Added `--binary` flag to `tmux-cli.sh` and `tmux-start.sh` to test compiled CLI binaries instead of the dynamic development server. Supports optional path argument or `CODEBUFF_BINARY` environment variable, defaulting to `./cli/bin/codebuff`. Session metadata now records `cli_mode` and `cli_command` in `session-info.yaml`.

37bd86e3b484f17066b6d10223f694df268bc8da.title: Remove unstablecache from /api/agents route
37bd86e3b484f17066b6d10223f694df268bc8da.summary: Switched /api/agents GET handler from getCachedAgents to fetchAgentsWithMetrics. unstable_cache rejects payloads >2MB. Relies on route-level ISR revalidate: 600 for caching. Affects web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts.

da73910d42fa47d344cafa9840822922c7675768.title: CLI auth: default user schema optional
da73910d42fa47d344cafa9840822922c7675768.summary: Marked default user schema optional in credentialsSchema. Allows valid credentials object when logged out. Scope: cli/src/utils/auth.ts. Change: default: userSchema -> default: userSchema.optional().

8a8f1bf4b2dc63db9287af5c37347c3ab5de358a.title: Add JSON-LD structured data to Web pages
8a8f1bf4b2dc63db9287af5c37347c3ab5de358a.summary: Added JSON-LD structured data to agent detail, publisher, and store pages for SEO. Introduced optimized sitemap queries fetching minimal fields instead of full agent data blobs. Covers web/src/app/publishers, web/src/app/store, and web/src/app/sitemap.ts. Uses SoftwareApplication, Organization, and CollectionPage schema types.

6de489d104eb2a8c5df33254babcbdd8082b6853.title: Add JSON-LD schemas to web pages
6de489d104eb2a8c5df33254babcbdd8082b6853.summary: JSON-LD structured data added to homepage, pricing, and affiliates pages via `generateMetadata`. Client components extracted from `page.tsx` files into separate `*-client.tsx` files to support server-side metadata generation. Covers `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`, and `web/src/app/affiliates/page.tsx`.

0e8618beae7340f8c5738483e0c57729269e6573.title: Add /api/agents/metrics endpoint for client-side metrics loading
0e8618beae7340f8c5738483e0c57729269e6573.summary: New GET /api/agents/metrics route serves cached agent metrics separately from the store page's initial SSR payload. Store page now fetches only basic agent info via getCachedAgentsBasicInfo, while client-side queries load metrics from the new endpoint and merge them. Covers web/src/app/api/agents/metrics/route.ts, store/page.tsx, store-client.tsx, agents-data.ts, and agents-transform.ts. Metrics response keyed by publisherId/agentName; basic info dedupes to latest version per agent and sorts alphabetically, leaving metrics-based sorting to the client.

5e3264f498daeda08e1f714835bc683f1fd8ce85.title: Add SEO breadcrumbs, canonical URLs, and FAQ schema
5e3264f498daeda08e1f714835bc683f1fd8ce85.summary: Added BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, canonical URL metadata, and FAQ structured data to Web docs and publisher pages. Updated sitemap to include key documentation routes. Refactored SDK agent loader to rely on Bun's native TypeScript support, removing manual transpilation logic.

7995908546f64334e1acb5bdb89b9a63810b4cb4.text: The tool's name changed from 'CLI UI Tester' to 'CLI Tester'. This only affects how the tool is referred to internally and in documentation; it does not change what the tool does.

9aa925a46842b21f4939378f22d0e8d5a4b8440c.text: The team added a way to test the product using a different version of its core engine. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product today.

48828d98ddf7a968703fb8706cf5d60e46bea68c.text: The system now automatically assigns a unique tracking number to every ad request. This ensures accurate ad placement tracking, even for users without an active session.

0e8618beae7340f8c5738483e0c57729269e6573.text: The app now loads detailed performance data for AI agents separately from the main page. This makes the store page appear faster, while agent statistics update shortly after you open it.

f0eef6be25a0f614dadda4dd0e0485ef3f8c5311.text: A small internal update removes an extra step when you open the documentation. You now go directly to the quick-start guide instead of seeing a help page first.

37bd86e3b484f17066b6d10223f694df268bc8da.text: The system now uses a more reliable way to load agent information. This prevents errors when the list of agents is very large. Users may see slightly slower updates, but the data remains accurate.

da73910d42fa47d344cafa9840822922c7675768.text: The login system no longer requires a user profile to exist when you are signed out. This small fix prevents errors for users who are not logged in.

8a8f1bf4b2dc63db9287af5c37347c3ab5de358a.text: The website now gives search engines clearer details about agents, publishers, and stores. This helps those pages appear more accurately in search results.

6de489d104eb2a8c5df33254babcbdd8082b6853.text: The website now shares its page details in a standard format with search engines. This helps search results display the pages more clearly.

f043ef6f04e61d61a7fa203fb69d671a68154339.title: Add CI env defaults for ANTHROPICAPIKEY, GRAVITYAPIKEY
f043ef6f04e61d61a7fa203fb69d671a68154339.summary: ensureEnvDefault now injects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and GRAVITY_API_KEY stubs in packages/internal/src/env.ts under isCI. web/jest.config.cjs maps ^bun:test$ to src/test-stubs/bun-test.ts. Covers packages/internal and web test runner. Prevents missing env var failures in CI.

f4837612792b2fc89e06881c148132e06da070c5.title: Fix flaky timestamp comparison in messagesWithSystem test
f4837612792b2fc89e06881c148132e06da070c5.summary: Updated `messagesWithSystem` unit test to use spread operator for original message objects instead of constructing new ones. Avoids flaky assertions caused by `sentAt` timestamp mismatches. Internal test stability fix in `packages/agent-runtime`.

c8ba60fe617f1a2586164bbf60998ae1fbbe31c9.title: run-agent-step null-to-undefined coercion for agentTemplate
c8ba60fe617f1a2586164bbf60998ae1fbbe31c9.summary: Coerces null return from getAgentTemplate to undefined in loopAgentSteps within packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts. Fixes type compatibility for agentTemplate variable assignment. Scope limited to agent runtime step execution. Prevents null/undefined type mismatch during agent template resolution.

f8fd02ac2d4e33d0780e9f64b1ff3bd9a20c180f.title: Add session constants and fix bun-test stub type
f8fd02ac2d4e33d0780e9f64b1ff3bd9a20c180f.summary: Adds SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS and SESSION_TIME_WINDOW_MS to common/src/old-constants.ts. Fixes jest.Mock type in web/src/test-stubs/bun-test.ts. Internal type and constant cleanup.

534e9813c0cc9a2b34aa4fb73ebc2cf878a9fc28.title: CLI settings create config dir on first load
534e9813c0cc9a2b34aa4fb73ebc2cf878a9fc28.summary: Added `ensureConfigDirExists` helper in `cli/src/utils/settings.ts`. `loadSettings` now calls it before writing the default `settings.json`, preventing errors when the config directory is missing. `saveSettings` refactored to use the same helper instead of inline `mkdirSync` logic.

f51080f878829e318a2b462ba4c040734a35e510.title: Update Gravity endpoint and default ad payout
f51080f878829e318a2b462ba4c040734a35e510.summary: Switched Gravity API call to /api/v1/ad. Restructured request payload to match new schema (placements, testAd, user.id). Added DEFAULT_PAYOUT constant (0.04) fallback for missing ad payout data. Updated logging to include payout details. Affects web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts.

206730527e363e1bca216bacd55d5304cd3f5d3e.title: CLI ad requests use chat session ID instead of logger context
206730527e363e1bca216bacd55d5304cd3f5d3e.summary: The CLI `use-gravity-ad` hook now sources `sessionId` from `useChatStore.getState().chatSessionId` rather than `loggerContext.clientSessionId`. This aligns ad tracking with the active chat session, which is regenerated on `/new` via `crypto.randomUUID()` in `chat-store.ts`. The change also updates the Web API `postAds` endpoint to include `supports_links`, `supports_markdown`, and `numAds: 1` in the Gravity API request payload.

eed20257d2a0c7bd1e6c832bba3408e3259d147e.title: Add session createdat column for CLI logout time-window deletion
eed20257d2a0c7bd1e6c832bba3408e3259d147e.summary: Migration `0035_warm_orphan.sql` adds `created_at` timestamp column to `session` table with `DEFAULT now()`. Enables time-window deletion strategy for CLI logout flow. Updates `schema.ts`, `_db.ts`, `_post.ts` in logout API. Covers packages/internal and web auth surfaces.

428186cb3b0d7e93b1e3fa1dc6be1ae6c15eebbd.title: CLI logout deletes web sessions; auth refactor
428186cb3b0d7e93b1e3fa1dc6be1ae6c15eebbd.summary: CLI logout now deletes associated web sessions and unclaims fingerprints. New `_db.ts` and `_post.ts` modules in `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/logout/` handle session cleanup and fingerprint state. `auth-options.ts` uses `SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` constant. Onboarding logic moved to `web/src/app/onboard/_db.ts` with replay attack check.

5f43c1879089db13331ae9f7a0ed2600c17d4ee8.title: CLI auth fingerprint prefix updated to codebuff-cli
5f43c1879089db13331ae9f7a0ed2600c17d4ee8.summary: Internal refactor standardizes async/await usage across CLI, agent runtime, and common packages by extracting inline awaits into named variables. Additionally, the CLI login utility updates the fingerprint ID prefix from 'codecane-cli' to 'codebuff-cli' in cli/src/login/utils.ts. This ensures consistent identifier generation for authentication flows.

f8fd02ac2d4e33d0780e9f64b1ff3bd9a20c180f.text: Small internal updates. Improved session timing rules and fixed a testing tool. No visible changes for users.

5f43c1879089db13331ae9f7a0ed2600c17d4ee8.text: The tool updated how it identifies your login. This change makes the process more consistent behind the scenes.

eed20257d2a0c7bd1e6c832bba3408e3259d147e.text: The system now tracks when each login session starts. This helps remove old, unused sessions more cleanly.

f043ef6f04e61d61a7fa203fb69d671a68154339.text: Internal tests now run smoothly in automated checks. You won't see any changes or new features.

c8ba60fe617f1a2586164bbf60998ae1fbbe31c9.text: A small internal fix prevents a specific type of error when the assistant loads its settings. This makes the feature more stable for you.

206730527e363e1bca216bacd55d5304cd3f5d3e.text: The tool now tracks ad requests using the current conversation's unique identifier instead of a general system one. This helps keep ad data linked to the specific chat you are having.

534e9813c0cc9a2b34aa4fb73ebc2cf878a9fc28.text: The tool now automatically creates its settings folder when it starts up. This prevents errors if the folder is missing, so you can use the app without manually setting up files.

f4837612792b2fc89e06881c148132e06da070c5.text: This is a small, internal fix to make automated checks more reliable. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

f51080f878829e318a2b462ba4c040734a35e510.text: The system now uses a new method to connect with the ad service and has a set minimum payment value to ensure ads always have a cost assigned.

428186cb3b0d7e93b1e3fa1dc6be1ae6c15eebbd.text: When you log out on the command line, your web sessions are now deleted too. This internal change keeps you from being accidentally signed in elsewhere.

22f963340da5e4dc861ae0e85bb117fa7e1ec1e5.title: CLI test update: announceLoadedAgents assertion
22f963340da5e4dc861ae0e85bb117fa7e1ec1e5.summary: Updated integration test `announceLoadedAgents` to assert data availability via `getLoadedAgentsData` instead of spying on `console.log`. The change reflects that `announceLoadedAgents` now uses `logger.debug` internally, making direct console output assertions brittle. Scope limited to `cli/src/__tests__/integration/local-agents.test.ts`. The test now verifies the agent registry contains the expected ID and display name after initialization.

f988d78debb0a98dab289afa81a8239481e3597d.title: CLI renderer cleanup writes terminal reset escape sequences before
f988d78debb0a98dab289afa81a8239481e3597d.summary: renderer-cleanup.ts adds resetTerminalState() to write raw ANSI escape sequences to stdout before renderer.destroy(). This disables X10, button, and SGR mouse modes, focus reporting, and bracketed paste, while showing the cursor. The change ensures terminal state resets even if the renderer fails or on Windows where SIGTERM/SIGHUP are unavailable. Scope limited to cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts.

0ccf198a02188bd380c1a2e571fa25dde374a379.title: Add cta field to ad impressions and banner
0ccf198a02188bd380c1a2e571fa25dde374a379.summary: Ad banners now prioritize a dedicated `cta` field for button text, falling back to `title` then 'Learn more'. The `ad_impression` table receives a new non-null `cta` text column via migration `0034_orange_firebrand.sql`. This change updates the CLI `AdBanner` component, `use-gravity-ad` hook, internal DB schema, and web API ads handler.

5d179a62ea85ab8deb4706729b69b6a9eca7d3ad.title: CLI: announceLoadedAgents uses logger.debug instead of console.log
5d179a62ea85ab8deb4706729b69b6a9eca7d3ad.summary: cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts swaps console.log for logger.debug in announceLoadedAgents. cli/src/types/utils.ts drops unused SubsetOf and SetElement types. Agent identifiers are now passed as structured data to the logger.

a2b8c129128542a80a72b660be508873d199c53b.title: CLI publish command uses structured logger
a2b8c129128542a80a72b660be508873d199c53b.summary: Publish command in `cli/src/index.tsx` replaces direct `console.log` calls with `logger.info`, `logger.error`, and `logger.warn`. This routes output through the CLI's structured logging system, ensuring consistent formatting and log-level handling. Scope limited to `cli/src/index.tsx` publish result reporting.

11dbd952bcf4686fd720b4fb417cd0247b4f2b9c.title: CLI CopyButton logic extracted into testable utilities
11dbd952bcf4686fd720b4fb417cd0247b4f2b9c.summary: Refactored cli/src/components/copy-button.tsx to export COPIED_RESET_DELAY_MS, getCopyIconText, and copyButtonHandlers. The CopyIcon component now consumes these utilities instead of inline conditional logic, while CopyButton delegates state transitions to copyButtonHandlers. This change isolates pure logic for unit testing in cli/src/__tests__/unit/copy-button.test.ts, removing disconnected tests.

0ae1339c6e2feefdd99e09b9a2a1e6473f7b9dbb.title: Ads API includes render context and device targeting
0ae1339c6e2feefdd99e09b9a2a1e6473f7b9dbb.summary: Ads API requests now include `renderContext` with fixed placement and length constraints, plus optional `device` targeting data. CLI sends OS, timezone, and locale derived from Node.js process and Intl APIs. Server extracts client IP from `x-forwarded-for` or `x-real-ip` headers to populate device context. Changes affect `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`.

43ea122eac6e68bea05bff686c4d6099e2af8072.title: Ads default on for new users, slash commands exit beta
43ea122eac6e68bea05bff686c4d6099e2af8072.summary: Removed '(beta)' from `/ads:enable` and `/ads:disable` in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. `cli/src/utils/settings.ts` now writes `adsEnabled: true` to `DEFAULT_SETTINGS` on first run.

7f153b3f0c5abe6ea4067329c8b7c289695ba2c9.title: Add Clickable component and refactor CopyButton
7f153b3f0c5abe6ea4067329c8b7c289695ba2c9.summary: New `Clickable` component in `cli/src/components/clickable.tsx` wraps interactive regions to automatically disable text selection, preventing accidental highlighting during clicks. `CopyButton` refactored into `copy-button.tsx` using this new primitive, replacing the previous `copy-icon-button.tsx` implementation and its associated hook. The `makeTextUnselectable` utility is now exported from `clickable.tsx` and shared by `Button` to ensure consistent non-selectable text behavior across all interactive CLI elements.

db3787c4112c1903b4122a030882a3bf7de16745.title: Gravity ad payload moves message filtering to server
db3787c4112c1903b4122a030882a3bf7de16745.summary: CLI `use-gravity-ad.ts` now sends full `adMessages` to `/api/v1/ads`, removing client-side selection of last user/assistant messages. Server `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` handles filtering, stripping `<user_message>` tags via `extractLastUserMessageContent`, and selecting the last assistant message preceding the last user message. Scope covers CLI hook and web API route. Request body now includes `userId` and `user.email` from `userInfo`.

43ea122eac6e68bea05bff686c4d6099e2af8072.text: Ads are now on by default for new users. The ads controls are no longer in testing.

11dbd952bcf4686fd720b4fb417cd0247b4f2b9c.text: The copy button's internal logic was moved to a separate, testable location. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the button works for you.

5d179a62ea85ab8deb4706729b69b6a9eca7d3ad.text: The program now sends internal updates to a hidden log instead of showing them on your screen. This keeps the display cleaner.

db3787c4112c1903b4122a030882a3bf7de16745.text: The app now sends all conversation history to the server instead of selecting parts itself. This means the server decides what to show, making the process more consistent.

0ccf198a02188bd380c1a2e571fa25dde374a379.text: Ad banners now show a specific button label instead of a generic one. If the ad does not provide a button label, it falls back to the ad title or 'Learn more'.

22f963340da5e4dc861ae0e85bb117fa7e1ec1e5.text: The way the system checks its own internal records was updated to be more reliable. This change is small and internal, so you will not see any difference in how the product works.

7f153b3f0c5abe6ea4067329c8b7c289695ba2c9.text: Clicking buttons no longer accidentally highlights text. This makes the interface feel smoother and prevents unwanted selections.

0ae1339c6e2feefdd99e09b9a2a1e6473f7b9dbb.text: Ad requests now share basic device details like location and language settings. This helps the system show ads that fit your screen size and local context better.

f988d78debb0a98dab289afa81a8239481e3597d.text: The tool now cleans up its visual settings automatically when it closes, even if it crashes. This prevents your terminal from getting stuck in weird modes where the mouse or keyboard might behave strangely.

0a2247ae002a0eb868ab0a38bedb597749cce5d6.title: Replace as-any casts with typed error helpers
0a2247ae002a0eb868ab0a38bedb597749cce5d6.summary: Type safety improved by replacing `as any` casts with typed error helpers and `instanceof Error` checks. New `common/src/testing/errors.ts` provides `createNodeError` and `createPostgresError` for structured test mocks. CLI `publish.ts` and Web profile components (`api-keys`, `referrals`, `security`) updated to use explicit types instead of unchecked casts. This eliminates silent type errors in error handling paths across core and UI layers.

74616a3668e5a622d6e98737957d79fb61ad9486.title: CLI login modal shows fallback URL
74616a3668e5a622d6e98737957d79fb61ad9486.summary: The CLI login modal now displays the raw `loginUrl` as a fallback option. This change addresses devices where the automatic browser opening via `open()` fails. Implemented in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx`, the UI updates the primary prompt to 'Opening browser...' and adds a secondary section labeled 'Or copy this URL if browser didn't open:' containing the exact link.

2a8e031963a5972dcb1ef8fffb27cd71bdd14fcf.title: Add File Filtering API reference to SDK README
2a8e031963a5972dcb1ef8fffb27cd71bdd14fcf.summary: Added `fileFilter` API documentation to `sdk/README.md`. Explains `CodebuffClient` usage with `blocked`, `allow-example`, and `allow` statuses. Clarifies default gitignore behavior versus custom filter ownership.

c7029de47bfc6b8d69f281e78262b226e4bf3c6e.title: CLI API integration tests mock setTimeout for speed
c7029de47bfc6b8d69f281e78262b226e4bf3c6e.summary: API integration tests now mock globalThis.setTimeout directly instead of using mockModule on retry-config. This avoids async module mocking overhead and ensures retry delays execute instantly. Scoped to cli/src/__tests__/integration/api-integration.test.ts. Original setTimeout is stored and restored in afterEach to prevent leakage.

fef63081a41aae1ff84c058596dd97c80f9a1d71.title: Fix CLI integration tests for retry logic
fef63081a41aae1ff84c058596dd97c80f9a1d71.summary: Updated `api-integration.test.ts` to mock `@codebuff/common/testing/mock-modules` and zero out retry delays via `retry-config`. Tests now expect multiple fetch calls due to `fetchWithRetry` behavior on network errors, replacing previous single-call assertions. Cleanup added in `afterEach` via `clearMockedModules`.
