ae711f9e5b384f72d415333d5c13a5dd558ea0ac.text: The assistant now shows past follow-up questions as read-only text instead of interactive buttons, preventing you from accidentally answering old prompts. This is a small interface cleanup that makes the chat history easier to scan.

195d99303cf451f51a3b55bc4c8e54ac214f2d60.text: Fixed a technical issue with how the assistant finds related tools. This internal change helps the software run more smoothly.

6b4ec78c720a54ba6603924840420f20036fa492.text: The help pages now show the latest information and removed old notes. The assistant's instructions were updated to list specific helpers it can use.

4495f6e886c38895dbb5bb817693a06d49643bb7.text: The system now checks for specific hidden files during internal tests to prevent errors. This change only affects how the software is tested, so it does not change how the product works for you.

eafae3baf8a8c76c7baf5da8c1f1deda373e37a6.text: Skipped questions now show just the label, like 'question', without a number in front.

7c90418da5d2db3838bea9bd580ba77dea941db1.title: Lighten muted foreground for docs prose contrast
7c90418da5d2db3838bea9bd580ba77dea941db1.summary: Muted foreground color lightened to #b8b8bf equivalent (240 3% 73%) to improve dark mode contrast. Docs MDX paragraph components now explicitly apply text-muted-foreground. Replaces manual prose-invert variable override in globals.css. Affects web docs rendering surfaces.

e3945fed7a6b0cd294cd5a0bae769838feae2c9d.title: Replace Bun-specific fs.exists with stat-based helper
e3945fed7a6b0cd294cd5a0bae769838feae2c9d.summary: Removes `fs.exists` from `CodebuffFileSystem` and introduces `fileExists` using `fs.stat` in `common/src/util/file.ts`. Updates call sites in `project-file-tree.ts`, `scaffolding.ts`, and `change-file.ts` to use the new helper, ensuring Node compatibility.

9f05d5e37cd1d2cb1f08fcb363cd8757202763a5.title: docs: consolidate tips pages
9f05d5e37cd1d2cb1f08fcb363cd8757202763a5.summary: Deleted keyboard-shortcuts.mdx and other-use-cases.mdx. Merged use-case examples into where-codebuff-shines.mdx. Updated tags to include 'use cases' and 'commands'.

ed58bd74ecf1901d0f22f956616a6079f57baf37.title: Update editor's choice agents in store client
ed58bd74ecf1901d0f22f956616a6079f57baf37.summary: Replaces 'base', 'base-lite', and 'base-max' with 'base2', 'base2-lite', 'base2-max', and 'base2-plan' in EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS. Removes 'find-food' from the list. This update occurs in web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx.

8f6eccc8d6c7c475f435c2bffe0fbff757dfcd96.title: CLI flags --lite --max --plan set initial agent mode
8f6eccc8d6c7c475f435c2bffe0fbff757dfcd96.summary: Added `--lite`, `--max`, and `--plan` CLI flags to `cli/src/index.tsx` to specify the initial `AgentMode`. The parsed mode flows through `App` to `Chat`, which applies it via `setAgentMode` on mount. Last flag wins if multiple are provided.

6378076019964299f2a88220770f254a0f93eef4.title: Docs typography: lighter body, tighter headers
6378076019964299f2a88220770f254a0f93eef4.summary: Docs body text lightened via `--tw-prose-invert-body: #b8b8bf` in `globals.css` for dark mode contrast. Header margins tightened in `.prose-compact`: h1 1.0em/0.8em, h2 0.8em/0.8em, h3 0.6em/0.6em, h4-h6 0.4em/0.4em. `mdx-components.tsx` removes `text-muted-foreground` from `p` className.

63b9a612692835b63c3e08e91ef8e251fc059dbe.title: Remove publish-sdk shortcut from SDK
63b9a612692835b63c3e08e91ef8e251fc059dbe.summary: Removed publish-sdk and publish-dry-run npm scripts from sdk/package.json. CI workflow sdk-release.yml now calls scripts/publish.ts directly. sdk/PUBLISHING.md updated to reference bun run release. Internal tooling change only.

a730d3cbc353019224567e0313077f1d444ef515.title: Update SDK release workflow to use bun run verify
a730d3cbc353019224567e0313077f1d444ef515.summary: The `.github/workflows/sdk-release.yml` file changed the build step from `bun run build:verify` to `bun run verify`. This aligns the CI workflow with the correct script name in the SDK package. The change affects the automated release pipeline for the SDK.

eab9fde59dc664d510cc806e19ad273592b7e0b1.title: docs: correct plan mode usage and update mode comparison table
eab9fde59dc664d510cc806e19ad273592b7e0b1.summary: Help documentation updated to reflect `/mode:plan` as the sole activation method for plan mode, replacing incorrect `--plan` flag references. Mode comparison table expanded with 'How to activate' column and removed 'Best For' text. Links in quick-start and best-practices pages corrected to point to `/docs/tips#modes`.

d665703accecfcf2b72d2e5a10a3797cec6c52b0.title: Update modes documentation in web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx
d665703accecfcf2b72d2e5a10a3797cec6c52b0.summary: Documentation for modes updated in `web/src/content/tips/modes.mdx`. Removed outdated startup flags (`--lite`, `--max`) and session switching instructions (`Ctrl+M`) from the main description, replacing them with a concise Markdown table. Clarified Lite mode description to specify GPT-5 usage via `editor-gpt-5` agent and removed reference to followup suggestions. Added `codebuff --plan` example to Plan mode section.

7c90418da5d2db3838bea9bd580ba77dea941db1.text: Text in dark mode became lighter and easier to read. This small visual change helps users see documentation clearly without straining their eyes.

a730d3cbc353019224567e0313077f1d444ef515.text: Internal team fixed a small error in the automated system that prepares the product for release. This ensures the next version is delivered smoothly.

9f05d5e37cd1d2cb1f08fcb363cd8757202763a5.text: The help pages about using the tool were combined into one guide. You can now find all the tips in a single place.

e3945fed7a6b0cd294cd5a0bae769838feae2c9d.text: The software now checks for files in a way that works with more computer systems. This small internal fix helps prevent errors when the assistant tries to find files.

ed58bd74ecf1901d0f22f956616a6079f57baf37.text: The list of recommended tools changed. Users see newer options and one old tool is gone.

8f6eccc8d6c7c475f435c2bffe0fbff757dfcd96.text: You can now choose the assistant's starting behavior mode when launching the app. If you pick multiple modes, the last one selected takes effect.

6378076019964299f2a88220770f254a0f93eef4.text: The appearance of the documentation pages was updated to make the text easier to read. The main text now uses a lighter color, and the headings have less space around them, allowing more content to fit on the screen.

63b9a612692835b63c3e08e91ef8e251fc059dbe.text: We updated how the team releases the software. You will not notice any changes.

d665703accecfcf2b72d2e5a10a3797cec6c52b0.text: The help guide for different working styles was updated to be clearer and shorter. It now explains exactly which tools each style uses and how to start them.

33a6741d49fa451cda5b90755833124051e6e83c.title: Docs refresh: model tables, AGENTS.md support, modes to help
33a6741d49fa451cda5b90755833124051e6e83c.summary: Rewrote what-models.mdx to detail orchestrator/subagent model mappings (Opus 4.5, GPT-5.1, etc.) and documented AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md support in FAQ. Moved modes docs from tips to help section, updating cross-references in quick-start, best-practices, and keyboard-shortcuts. Standardized Discord links to codebuff.com/discord across footer and config pages.

ff2c0cb4afb9c5fc195e64c8601e1dd89f959932.title: Remove mobile max-width constraint from docs code demo
ff2c0cb4afb9c5fc195e64c8601e1dd89f959932.summary: Removed `max-w-80 md:max-w-full` classes from `web/src/components/docs/mdx/code-demo.tsx`. Mermaid and code blocks now use `w-full` unconditionally on mobile. Fixes constrained width on small screens.

ff334f0754e4c38e916726d4c5abe1107d32795c.title: Docs: Rename sidebar section and trim quick-start
ff334f0754e4c38e916726d4c5abe1107d32795c.summary: Sidebar label changed from 'Quick Start' to 'Getting Started' in `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`. Quick-start guide `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx` removed the `codebuff --create` starter template instructions and closing remark. Agent docs `web/src/content/agents/creating-new-agents.mdx` simplified `instructionsPrompt` text. Internal documentation cleanup only.

fb28635df30c05560253479bdc0eca8834578deb.title: FAQ: Add data training policy, remove starter templates
fb28635df30c05560253479bdc0eca8834578deb.summary: Updated web/src/content/help/faq.mdx to add a section clarifying that model providers do not train on user codebase or chat data. Removed the 'What should I try first?' section containing starter template commands. Reordered sections to place open source licensing before data storage details.

2307e67c59b431d1eea7c06cded952f4eac3c4d9.title: Rename Getting Started to Quick Start and streamline docs
2307e67c59b431d1eea7c06cded952f4eac3c4d9.summary: The documentation sidebar section 'Getting Started' is renamed to 'Quick Start' in `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`. Multiple advanced documentation pages, including `config.mdx`, `how-does-it-work.mdx`, and `sdk.mdx`, undergo significant copy editing to reduce verbosity and improve technical clarity. The SDK example model identifier updates from 'anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522' to 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5'. These changes affect the Web documentation surface only.

90adb08db264ee8eda935219b117163dc7391e3d.title: Rename service scripts to up/down/ps
90adb08db264ee8eda935219b117163dc7391e3d.summary: Shortened `start-services`, `stop-services`, and `status-services` to `up`, `down`, and `ps` in package.json. Internal script files remain unchanged, but console output in `scripts/start-services.ts` and `scripts/status-services.ts` now references the new commands. Documentation in `knowledge.md` updated to reflect the new aliases.

14d9ad5b0cac963b14491bd5fc3d7ea634b07602.title: Add development workflow docs
14d9ad5b0cac963b14491bd5fc3d7ea634b07602.summary: knowledge.md gains Development Workflow section. Documents `bun dev`, `bun start-services`, `bun start-cli`, `bun stop-services`. Lists services (db, studio, sdk, web), log paths in `debug/console/`, worktree port config via `.env.development.local`. `stop-services` is worktree-safe.

bcc048163c83d0fd4387a65d618b83d057caa839.title: Add bun status-services command to check dev service health
bcc048163c83d0fd4387a65d618b83d057caa839.summary: New scripts/status-services.ts implements `bun status-services` to verify running state of db, studio, sdk, and web. Checks Docker container status for `manicode-db`, queries `lsof` for web/studio ports, reads PIDs from `debug/console/services.json`, and hits `/api/healthz`. Registered in package.json scripts and documented in knowledge.md alongside existing start/stop commands.

a49d960c315177906c541d3a90a7b20997248dce.title: Add eval error fixtures for agent run failures and tool restrictions
a49d960c315177906c541d3a90a7b20997248dce.summary: New JSON fixtures in `evals/` capture error states for `Failed to start agent run` and tool availability violations (e.g., `read_files` not available). These files, including `evals/add-input-apis-judge-gemini-agent-output-error.json` and multiple `evals/buffbench/*-base2-lite-error-*.json`, provide trace data for evaluation harnesses. The `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx` file was also updated, though the specific content change is not visible in the diff.

7599418572c1441af7650256cd7f765a9c1fd5ad.title: Migrate dev scripts to TypeScript
7599418572c1441af7650256cd7f765a9c1fd5ad.summary: Replaced Bash service scripts (dev.sh) with TypeScript equivalents (dev.ts, start-services.ts, stop-services.ts) executed via Bun. Added CODEBUFF_SKIP_ENV_CLEAR flag to .bin/bun wrapper to prevent clearing inherited env vars when launched by TS scripts. Updates package.json scripts and removes old shell dependencies. Internal tooling change; no user-facing behavior modification.

ff334f0754e4c38e916726d4c5abe1107d32795c.text: The help guide was renamed to "Getting Started" and simplified. You will find clearer, shorter instructions when you open the documentation.

7599418572c1441af7650256cd7f765a9c1fd5ad.text: The team updated the tools that help run the product in the background. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ff2c0cb4afb9c5fc195e64c8601e1dd89f959932.text: On phones, diagrams and code snippets now stretch across the full screen width. This removes the narrow box they used to fit inside, making them easier to read.

fb28635df30c05560253479bdc0eca8834578deb.text: The help page now explains that your code and chats are not used to train the AI. It also removed a section about starting templates and rearranged other topics.

a49d960c315177906c541d3a90a7b20997248dce.text: This internal update adds test examples for errors to help check the assistant's reliability. It does not change how the product works for users.

90adb08db264ee8eda935219b117163dc7391e3d.text: Internal tools now use shorter names for starting, stopping, and checking services. This change does not affect how you use the product.

bcc048163c83d0fd4387a65d618b83d057caa839.text: A small internal update lets the team quickly check if the main parts of the product are running correctly.

14d9ad5b0cac963b14491bd5fc3d7ea634b07602.text: The team wrote new internal guides to help developers set up and manage their local tools more easily. This change is small and only helps the people who build the product, not the users of the product.

2307e67c59b431d1eea7c06cded952f4eac3c4d9.text: The guide's first section is now called 'Quick Start.' Several help pages were shortened and clarified. The example code uses a newer AI model.

2e33a27c5b4118b01ad61c6fb66d0344f4ae9acc.title: Strengthen subagent allowed tools prompt
2e33a27c5b4118b01ad61c6fb66d0344f4ae9acc.summary: Updated `getAgentPrompt` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts` to strengthen the `instructionsPrompt` addendum for subagents using `useParentTools`. The prompt now explicitly warns that previously referenced tools may only be available to the parent agent and that using unlisted tools will result in errors, replacing the previous binary check for empty tool lists. Destructured `toolNames`, `spawnableAgents`, and `outputSchema` from `agentTemplate` to streamline prompt construction.

f9c8712d131c51eb2678735a6b5c4573287e30cd.title: Bun wrapper env loading and dev.sh help
f9c8712d131c51eb2678735a6b5c4573287e30cd.summary: The bun wrapper now clears inherited env vars from .env files instead of sourcing them, allowing Bun to load .env files natively with correct precedence. scripts/dev.sh gains a --help flag displaying usage, services, and log paths. Internal tooling scripts only.

804b82f7f33e98081bab24a56f5900b97b9306d0.title: Move deprecated base2 agent variants to graveyard directory
804b82f7f33e98081bab24a56f5900b97b9306d0.summary: Moved multiple base2 agent definitions (alloy, alloy2, task-researcher, thinking variants) from .agents/base2/ to .agents-graveyard/. Updated relative import paths in moved files to point back to active .agents/ modules. Deleted base2-fast-schooled.ts.

a1ebbd7f835934b07411fc56b44a5f6b067d59c3.title: Enable suggestfollowups tool in lite mode
a1ebbd7f835934b07411fc56b44a5f6b067d59c3.summary: The `suggest_followups` tool and its corresponding prompt instructions are now enabled in `lite` mode, previously restricted to non-lite modes. This change modifies the conditional logic in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to allow follow-up suggestions for all modes except `fast`. The `isLite` flag is passed to the prompt builder to ensure consistent behavior.

101c8e6373bf89d48089d1a3415284ca4ca0e6e5.title: Remove SUBAGENTSPAWN message injection
101c8e6373bf89d48089d1a3415284ca4ca0e6e5.summary: Reverted logic that injected a 'Subagent spawned' system message into child agent history. Removed `SUBAGENT_SPAWN` tag handling from context pruner and message construction in `spawn-agent-utils.ts`. Scope limited to `agent-runtime` and internal agent tooling. Child agents now receive filtered parent history without synthetic spawn markers.

aa2cc38ce520b8ada2de9b10e604f38b4ccd018c.title: Subagent spawn injects tagged system message for context pruning
aa2cc38ce520b8ada2de9b10e604f38b4ccd018c.summary: Spawned subagents now receive a user message tagged SUBAGENT_SPAWN indicating the agent type, replacing the previous implicit spawn tool call. The context pruner in .agents/context-pruner.ts was updated to identify and remove the last SUBAGENT_SPAWN tagged message when trimming history. This mechanism ensures the spawn event remains visible in the message history for the agent's reasoning while allowing the pruner to explicitly manage its lifecycle.

13fc2cfee4abcf05831876306a576f0712a2c6f9.title: code-reviewer switches to opus, drops code-reviewer-opus
13fc2cfee4abcf05831876306a576f0712a2c6f9.summary: code-reviewer agent now uses anthropic/claude-opus-4.5. Separate code-reviewer-opus definition removed. base2.ts references updated to 'code-reviewer' across all spawn prompts. InstructionsPrompt clarifies subagent role and prohibits tool usage.

b57c75e9cf2999ad20b2fcf006ae127d321935fb.title: CLI command factory pattern with graceful arg handling
b57c75e9cf2999ad20b2fcf006ae127d321935fb.summary: Refactored CLI command handling to use a factory pattern (`defineCommand`) that gracefully ignores arguments for commands not configured to accept them, replacing previous error-message logic. Updated keyboard handlers to distinguish between 'select' (execute) and 'complete' (fill input) actions for single-match slash/mention menus, preventing accidental execution on Tab. Added `reset` alias to `/new`, removed `bug`/`report` aliases from `/feedback`, and adjusted publish store to stay on selection step when pre-selecting agents.

86940e3ca7662f0c32805c5120ee221e1f891fa6.title: Slash command menu executes on selection
86940e3ca7662f0c32805c5120ee221e1f891fa6.summary: Slash command menu items execute on click or Tab, replacing text insertion. Tab auto-executes single matches unless noTabAutoExecute set. defineCommand factory enforces arg validation; aliases render in menu labels.

2e33a27c5b4118b01ad61c6fb66d0344f4ae9acc.text: The assistant now clearly warns that it cannot use tools meant only for its parent. This prevents errors when it tries to access unavailable features.

aa2cc38ce520b8ada2de9b10e604f38b4ccd018c.text: The assistant now marks helper tasks with a special note. This helps the system keep conversations tidy without losing track of what the helpers are doing.

804b82f7f33e98081bab24a56f5900b97b9306d0.text: The system moved several unused assistant options to a storage area. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

b57c75e9cf2999ad20b2fcf006ae127d321935fb.text: The tool now ignores extra text you type if a command does not need it, preventing errors. Pressing Tab fills in a suggestion instead of running it, so you can choose commands safely.

f9c8712d131c51eb2678735a6b5c4573287e30cd.text: The tool now reads configuration files in a way that prevents settings from clashing. A new help command lists available options and where to find logs.

a1ebbd7f835934b07411fc56b44a5f6b067d59c3.text: The assistant now suggests follow-up questions even when using the simplified version of the product. Previously, this feature was only available in the full version.

86940e3ca7662f0c32805c5120ee221e1f891fa6.text: Picking a command from the menu now runs it immediately instead of just typing it out. This makes starting tasks faster and reduces extra steps.

66a0ba3d04a5bc1cfa6c2a189303258d0e313351.text: The tool's internal cleanup makes it handle file requests and message sending more reliably. This small change improves stability without altering how you use the product.

13fc2cfee4abcf05831876306a576f0712a2c6f9.text: The assistant now uses a more powerful model for reviewing code. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

101c8e6373bf89d48089d1a3415284ca4ca0e6e5.text: A small internal change removed a hidden note from the chat history of background helpers. This cleanup stops the system from adding unnecessary labels when creating new helpers.

8f83669556f66cac14c3fefc3f4fde1d70f6a37f.title: Agent Runtime tool-executor emits error for restricted tools
8f83669556f66cac14c3fefc3f4fde1d70f6a37f.summary: packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts now emits an error event instead of a tool_call/result pair when an agent attempts to use a restricted tool. This prevents the CLI from displaying unauthorized tool calls and ensures the stream parser converts the error to a user message for API compliance. The `tool_call` event is only emitted after the permission check passes in both `executeToolCall` and `executeCustomToolCall`.

6bd4adab84518b8638e6bedbbf4dddaddb1e402b.title: Fix USERINPUTPROMPT placeholder match
6bd4adab84518b8638e6bedbbf4dddaddb1e402b.summary: USER_INPUT_PROMPT placeholder resolution corrected in packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts. isUserInputMessage now requires parseUserMessage to return defined, filtering out user messages lacking structured input. Scope limited to agent-runtime templates.

e5b83fdee5888c8f1ae6350f39dc58c17b045fe2.title: Set NEXTPUBLICCODEBUFFAPPURL in worktree init script
e5b83fdee5888c8f1ae6350f39dc58c17b045fe2.summary: init-worktree.ts now writes NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL=http://localhost:${webPort} to the root .env.development.local. This ensures CLI and SDK components in git worktrees target the local web server instead of production. The web-specific .env.development.local retains the variable for clarity, though the root file applies globally due to Bun's highest-precedence loading. Documentation updated with instructions for running SDK E2E tests against the local server.

2c50c159687b37f3321892a8e64d2a56fee493f0.title: Context pruner removes instructions prompt, fixes empty tool list
2c50c159687b37f3321892a8e64d2a56fee493f0.summary: Context pruner strips last `INSTRUCTIONS_PROMPT` tagged message before token counting. Subagent prompt generation handles empty `toolNames` gracefully. Scope: `.agents/context-pruner.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts`. Detail: Pruner now runs before orphan tool cleanup, removing redundant instructions.

c70c387429ae44627e8946895102985eeba9625b.title: Sync staging release scripts with production
c70c387429ae44627e8946895102985eeba9625b.summary: Updated `cli/release-staging` to align binary storage and installation logic with production standards. `index.js` now uses `~/.config/manicode` for binaries and metadata instead of the package directory, and `package.json` delegates `postinstall` to a new `postinstall.js` script that handles cleanup and prints a welcome message. `preuninstall` script added for binary removal.

86724105737b59ed3925580caf9370c6a88e946c.title: Hide working indicator during askuser
86724105737b59ed3925580caf9370c6a88e946c.summary: Status indicator logic in `cli/src/utils/status-indicator-state.ts` now accepts `isAskUserActive`. When true, it forces `kind: 'idle'`, suppressing "working..." and "thinking..." messages. `cli/src/chat.tsx` passes `isAskUserActive: askUserState !== null` to the state calculator. This prevents redundant spinner text while the CLI awaits user input.

5164e122767a5152917146c3ec843735d5686874.title: Externalize code-map esbuild fix Render build
5164e122767a5152917146c3ec843735d5686874.summary: Removed code-map re-export from sdk/src/index.ts. Added @codebuff/code-map and esbuild to externals in web/next.config.mjs. Prevents bundling tree-sitter WASM files. Fixes Render build failure.

66d6c24784a3ad3957c99c778db91e84c80cb0a1.title: Remove unused env vars, fix dev.sh healthz URL
66d6c24784a3ad3957c99c778db91e84c80cb0a1.summary: Removed NEXT_PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PARTNER_ID from common/src/env-schema.ts and duplicate GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION_ID from packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts. Consolidated NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL in scripts/dev.sh. Scope: env schemas, dev script.

f194a6ef6209225032bae93d1e2ed9dc22de5318.title: Replace editor-best-of-n-opus with editor-multi-prompt agent
f194a6ef6209225032bae93d1e2ed9dc22de5318.summary: New `editor-multi-prompt` agent replaces `editor-best-of-n-opus` in the max-tier agent configuration. It spawns multiple `editor-implementor-opus` agents with distinct strategy prompts, then uses `best-of-n-selector-opus` to choose the optimal implementation. Defined in `.agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-multi-prompt.ts`, it requires an array of short prompts specifying different approaches (e.g., caching vs minimal changes). The base agent prompts in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` are updated to reference this new editor agent for non-trivial code changes.

67f392b73e9fdf36e30a5dd617111234600aed47.title: suggestfollowups tool adds clickable next-step prompts to CLI
67f392b73e9fdf36e30a5dd617111234600aed47.summary: New `suggest_followups` tool enables the agent to present clickable followup prompts in the CLI chat interface. Replaces manual typing for next steps. Registered in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts` with handler in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/suggest-followups.ts`. State managed via `suggestedFollowups` in `chat-store.ts`; clicks trigger `codebuff:send-followup` event routed through `chat.tsx`. Excluded from Lite mode via `!isLite` flag in `base2.ts`.

67f392b73e9fdf36e30a5dd617111234600aed47.text: The assistant now suggests clickable follow-up questions to guide your next steps. This saves you from typing prompts manually.

86724105737b59ed3925580caf9370c6a88e946c.text: The program stops showing 'thinking' messages when it is waiting for your answer. This avoids confusing or redundant text on the screen.

8f83669556f66cac14c3fefc3f4fde1d70f6a37f.text: The assistant now hides restricted tools instead of showing them in the chat. This keeps the conversation clean and ensures unauthorized actions are not displayed.

c70c387429ae44627e8946895102985eeba9625b.text: The app now stores its files in a standard location on your computer, matching the production version. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the app.

2c50c159687b37f3321892a8e64d2a56fee493f0.text: The assistant now removes old, duplicate instructions before processing, and handles cases where no tools are available without errors. This small internal fix helps the assistant stay focused and prevents it from getting stuck.

6bd4adab84518b8638e6bedbbf4dddaddb1e402b.text: The assistant now correctly identifies when you provide structured input, so it will not try to answer empty or unformatted messages.

66d6c24784a3ad3957c99c778db91e84c80cb0a1.text: The system cleaned up unused settings and fixed a small internal check. This has no visible change for users.

5164e122767a5152917146c3ec843735d5686874.text: A small internal update fixes a technical problem that caused the service to fail during startup. You should not notice any change in how the product works.

c9855cb2e23f3f6c1294779c24b17f3fce386cbb.title: Add tools to callMainPrompt call sites
c9855cb2e23f3f6c1294779c24b17f3fce386cbb.summary: Added required `tools` property to `callMainPrompt` invocations in `sdk/src/run.ts` and `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` to fix type errors. Updated `ParamsExcluding` in `websocket-action.ts` to exclude `tools`. Modified `WebSocketMiddleware` handler type to accept `void | Promise<void>`.

4c7721f34f02a4ad41a357671b21077134aa9790.title: Scope NEXTPUBLICCODEBUFFAPPURL to web package in worktrees
4c7721f34f02a4ad41a357671b21077134aa9790.summary: Scripts init-worktree.ts now writes NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL to web/.env.development.local instead of root .env.development.local. CI workflows (npm-app-release-legacy.yml, npm-app-release-prod.yml, sdk-release.yml) removed the global env-overrides for NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_BACKEND_URL to prevent localhost leakage into SDK integration tests. This ensures worktree port overrides apply only to the web package, while SDK tests continue using production backends.

7553fa892a4883169f33406bd58c70cc07737792.title: Fix agent-runtime test types and mocks
7553fa892a4883169f33406bd58c70cc07737792.summary: Added missing `tools` and prompt fields to test mocks in `packages/agent-runtime`. Refactored `loop-agent-steps` test to verify `stepsComplete` propagation via generator yield instead of module mocking. Ensures type safety and correct runtime behavior assertions.

ea9359be498583c1243a988d5e0f24d75c3c4744.title: Fix web lint errors
ea9359be498583c1243a988d5e0f24d75c3c4744.summary: Fixed web lint errors in multiple files. Changes include replacing empty catch blocks with comments, fixing conditional hook usage, correcting const conditions, adding displayName, and updating type annotations. Affected files: web/src/__tests__/e2e/store-hydration.spec.ts, web/src/__tests__/e2e/store-ssr.spec.ts, web/src/app/admin/traces/utils/trace-processing.ts, web/src/app/analytics.knowledge.md, web/src/app/api/admin/admin-auth.ts, web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts, web/src/app/api/agents/validate/route.ts, web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts, and others.

67927deabf1e7c17f14dc4a40e14675ddaa51550.title: Add context pruner test for saved run state overflow
67927deabf1e7c17f14dc4a40e14675ddaa51550.summary: Added a test case in `context-pruner.test.ts` to verify pruning of saved run state when total tokens (messages + system prompt) exceed the limit. Includes new fixture `run-state-context-overflow2.json`.

fb495cc7011369f4879cba7a2f713464a66d3351.title: Fix context pruner to pass system prompt and tools
fb495cc7011369f4879cba7a2f713464a66d3351.summary: Context pruner now receives system prompt and tool definitions to calculate effective message budget. `AgentState` types in `.agents/types/agent-definition.ts`, `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts`, and `common/src/types/session-state.ts` enforce non-optional `systemPrompt` and `toolDefinitions`. `run-agent-step.ts` passes `tools` to pruner, while `spawn-agent-inline.ts` propagates parent system prompt and tools to child agents. `getInitialAgentState` and `createAgentState` initialize these fields to empty string and object respectively.

9b5726e3d5abbd49741ca2d372762ea3d6f573fa.title: Convert cleanup-worktree.sh to TypeScript
9b5726e3d5abbd49741ca2d372762ea3d6f573fa.summary: Replaced `scripts/cleanup-worktree.sh` with `scripts/cleanup-worktree.ts`. New script adds port killing logic, verification checks, and `zod` validation for worktree names. Updates `package.json` to invoke `bun scripts/cleanup-worktree.ts`.

815680200858cf794d4d933963073d133036449f.title: Add harder BuffBench eval sets for codebuff, manifold, plane, saleor
815680200858cf794d4d933963073d133036449f.summary: New JSON eval datasets and generation scripts added to `evals/buffbench/` targeting complex multi-agent orchestration tasks. Includes `eval-codebuff2.json`, `eval-manifold2.json`, `eval-plane2.json`, and `eval-saleor2.json`. Scripts `main-hard-tasks.ts` and `filter-supplemental-files.ts` facilitate dataset creation. These sets test lightweight orchestrator modes and constrained editor agents against real-world repo modifications.

ad5815a052e41a708572f75b0f8e23fb3f334e5c.title: Remove legacy backend and npm-app
ad5815a052e41a708572f75b0f8e23fb3f334e5c.summary: Deletes legacy backend and npm-app packages, consolidating logic into core CLI and SDK. Updates `.agents/LESSONS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `ROADMAP.md` to reflect new structure. Removes obsolete test placeholders in `evals`, `scripts`, and `sdk`. Agent loading logic in `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts` refactored to drop legacy imports.

bc4fcd1010aebb128c6059d556a1035f7c2e0b75.title: Add hard evals for Codebuff, Manifold, Plane, Saleor
bc4fcd1010aebb128c6059d556a1035f7c2e0b75.summary: New evals/buffbench/eval-codebuff-hard.json, eval-manifold-hard.json, eval-plane-hard.json, eval-saleor-hard.json add harder commit-based tasks. evals/buffbench/pick-commits.ts selects commits via prompting. Internal eval coverage only.

4c7721f34f02a4ad41a357671b21077134aa9790.text: Developers updated internal settings to keep test environments separate from live services. This change has no visible effect on users.

ea9359be498583c1243a988d5e0f24d75c3c4744.text: Developers cleaned up internal code to remove errors. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

815680200858cf794d4d933963073d133036449f.text: The team added tougher test scenarios for the assistant's coding tools. These tests check how well the system handles complex tasks in real software projects. This internal change aims to improve accuracy but does not add new features for users today.

c9855cb2e23f3f6c1294779c24b17f3fce386cbb.text: The assistant now correctly receives the list of available actions when called, preventing internal errors. This is a small, behind-the-scenes fix that improves stability without changing how you use the product.

7553fa892a4883169f33406bd58c70cc07737792.text: Internal test checks were updated to ensure the assistant's logic handles all steps correctly. No visible changes to the product.

ad5815a052e41a708572f75b0f8e23fb3f334e5c.text: The program removed old, unused parts of its system. This cleanup does not change how you use the product, but it makes the software simpler to maintain.

9b5726e3d5abbd49741ca2d372762ea3d6f573fa.text: A behind-the-scenes tool for removing old project folders now checks for errors before deleting. This change reduces the risk of accidental data loss.

67927deabf1e7c17f14dc4a40e14675ddaa51550.text: The team added a safety check to ensure the assistant correctly handles very long conversation histories. This helps keep responses accurate and stable when users discuss complex topics over many messages.

fb495cc7011369f4879cba7a2f713464a66d3351.text: The assistant now correctly counts its instructions and available tools when deciding how much information to keep in memory. This ensures it does not accidentally forget important rules or capabilities during long conversations.

cd38d63bce75c5439f033ec51998cad44bcbffe0.title: Refine shared analytics logging and error handling
cd38d63bce75c5439f033ec51998cad44bcbffe0.summary: Centralizes analytics payload construction in `common/src/util/analytics-log.ts` and adds structured error logging to `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts` via `setAnalyticsErrorLogger`. The CLI logger now delegates event ID extraction and user ID resolution to shared helpers, while the Web logger adopts the same payload generation for production tracking. This reduces duplication and ensures consistent PostHog event formatting across surfaces.

d7cba2cc21eed8d693491421d0b8c9cbdba71cfe.title: Add git checkout warning to knowledge.md
d7cba2cc21eed8d693491421d0b8c9cbdba71cfe.summary: Added 'Preserving Uncommitted Changes' section to knowledge.md. Warns against using git checkout HEAD -- or git restore to exclude files from commits, as this destructively discards uncommitted work. Recommends only git add the specific files to include. Scope: Internal documentation guidelines.

c83b8ba2fa481d42879f80038b28283cebea37c5.title: Remove speed pressure from thinker selector prompt
c83b8ba2fa481d42879f80038b28283cebea37c5.summary: The `thinker-selector.ts` prompt no longer instructs the model to minimize word count or skip `<think>` tags for obvious cases. This change removes the dual goal of speed and quality, allowing the selector to use full reasoning when distinguishing between similar thinking outputs. Scope is limited to the internal best-of-n selection logic in `.agents/thinker/best-of-n/`.

740be5ee61a726eee46178a5b4d99b2a8bf8b17b.title: ErrorObject includes rawError
740be5ee61a726eee46178a5b4d99b2a8bf8b17b.summary: getErrorObject now returns rawError. ErrorObject type updated. Affects common/src/util/error.ts. rawError stores JSON.stringify(error, null, 2).

1a504a962fb0ba340f0667db6a079e1c143a5451.title: SDK 0.10.1 release
1a504a962fb0ba340f0667db6a079e1c143a5451.summary: @codebuff/sdk version bumped to 0.10.1 in sdk/package.json. Changelog entry added for 0.10.1 citing more reliable tool calls. Internal dependency update.

0a76f50db2648f18dde1520fb121562bd038ca31.title: Consolidate env constants in common/env
0a76f50db2648f18dde1520fb121562bd038ca31.summary: Refactored environment checks to use derived constants (IS_DEV, IS_TEST, IS_PROD, IS_CI) exported from `common/src/env.ts` instead of raw `env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` comparisons. This change impacts CLI analytics/logging, SDK constants, Web logger, Evals logger, and BigQuery client. `sdk/src/constants.ts` now re-exports these flags, while `IS_CI` is derived from `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS`.

f5b277e094f5d3f7809dd90c459f79ad211a344e.title: Print more error details
f5b277e094f5d3f7809dd90c459f79ad211a344e.summary: run-agent-step.ts imports APICallError and branches error handling. Non-APICallError cases retain standard message/stack extraction. APICallError instances now log URL, request body values, status code, response headers, response body, retryability, and data. Scope limited to packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts.

c84b6395e68969d2ebfb3208b9545e5863d4b364.title: Add shared analytics dispatcher for CLI and Web loggers
c84b6395e68969d2ebfb3208b9545e5863d4b364.summary: Introduces createAnalyticsDispatcher in common/src/util/analytics-dispatcher.ts to centralize event routing, dev gating, and buffering. CLI and Web loggers replace manual analyticsBuffer logic with this shared utility, calling dispatcher.process() to retrieve payloads for trackEvent. The new module handles flush-on-userId resolution and returns empty arrays in dev environments.

7de4aea335cc399b8f9bb393471598aea8049ec7.title: Add theme link directory imageCardBorder colors
7de4aea335cc399b8f9bb393471598aea8049ec7.summary: Introduces dedicated theme keys link, directory, and imageCardBorder in cli/src/types/theme-system.ts and cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts. Components like cli/src/components/terminal-link.tsx and cli/src/components/image-card.tsx switch from generic theme.info to these specific colors. Markdown rendering in cli/src/utils/markdown-renderer.tsx now uses theme.link for hyperlinks and applies bold attributes to inline code. Default palettes updated with hex values for dark and light modes.

6808457153458c235fb9ad603598efad7169a0a3.title: Simplify env setup: use .env.local with Bun native loading
6808457153458c235fb9ad603598efad7169a0a3.summary: Env setup simplified to rely on Bun's native .env loading. .bin/bun wrapper now syncs Infisical secrets directly to .env.local instead of managing a separate .infisical-cache or sourcing direnv. .env.development.local handles worktree overrides with highest precedence. Gitignore updated to exclude .env.local and .infisical-cache. Docs (CONTRIBUTING.md, knowledge.md) reflect the shift from complex Infisical/direnv setup to a simpler cp .env.example .env.local flow for personal dev.

7de4aea335cc399b8f9bb393471598aea8049ec7.text: Links, folder names, and image borders now use distinct colors instead of sharing a general highlight color. This makes these items easier to tell apart while reading.

d7cba2cc21eed8d693491421d0b8c9cbdba71cfe.text: The team updated internal guidelines to help prevent accidental data loss. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

cd38d63bce75c5439f033ec51998cad44bcbffe0.text: The system now records usage details and errors in a consistent way. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

6808457153458c235fb9ad603598efad7169a0a3.text: Internal setup tools were simplified. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

740be5ee61a726eee46178a5b4d99b2a8bf8b17b.text: The app now saves a more detailed version of any error message it encounters. This helps support teams understand issues better when you report a problem.

c83b8ba2fa481d42879f80038b28283cebea37c5.text: The AI no longer rushes its internal choices for speed. It now takes time to reason carefully before picking the best answer.

f5b277e094f5d3f7809dd90c459f79ad211a344e.text: The system now prints more details when an error happens. This helps support teams fix problems faster.

1a504a962fb0ba340f0667db6a079e1c143a5451.text: The software received a small internal update to improve how the assistant performs tasks. This means the assistant should be more reliable when carrying out actions for you.

a36aefb00477f28241ff392f9e6c806bdd40afa1.title: Downgrade BigQuery trace insert failure log level to warn
a36aefb00477f28241ff392f9e6c806bdd40afa1.summary: Change log level for failed BigQuery trace inserts from error to warn in packages/bigquery/src/client.ts. Prevents transient insert failures from triggering error alerts.

01df7deb9ec76b8f9844398bcb4711eda9a254f2.title: Detailed OpenRouter error logging
01df7deb9ec76b8f9844398bcb4711eda9a254f2.summary: Enhanced error logging for OpenRouter requests in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` and stream handling in `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts`. Added context fields like `userId`, `agentId`, `runId`, `model`, and detailed OpenRouter error codes/status/provider metadata to debug logs. This change improves visibility into upstream failures without altering user-facing behavior.

77b4dd360c8b5080906b5006bf82aff620f62fb8.title: Expand Forbidden error messages in admin and session APIs
77b4dd360c8b5080906b5006bf82aff620f62fb8.summary: 403 responses in admin-auth.ts and logout-all/route.ts now include specific reasons instead of generic 'Forbidden'. Admin checks return 'Forbidden - not an admin', while cross-origin logout attempts return 'Forbidden - not same origin, cannot logout all sessions'. Changes affect web/src/app/api/admin/admin-auth.ts, web/src/app/api/user/sessions/logout-all/route.ts, and web/src/lib/admin-auth.ts. Error payloads remain JSON with status 403.

ed656e08dc31c7ec547e966f286ee4be9668c893.title: Zed scroll multiplier raised 0.37 to 0.5
ed656e08dc31c7ec547e966f286ee4be9668c893.summary: Zed scroll multiplier in cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts raised from 0.37 to 0.5. Analysis notes cite increase to 0.75, but diff shows 0.5; trust diff. Scope limited to CLI chat scroll accel. ENV_MULTIPLIERS object updated; ghostty and vscode remain 1.

370ac2dcb6bf9f412aaa793c2ac78c0ae082b171.title: Clarify force push policy in knowledge.md
370ac2dcb6bf9f412aaa793c2ac78c0ae082b171.summary: Updated `knowledge.md` to explicitly require user confirmation before using `git push --force` or `--force-with-lease` on the main branch. The policy now clarifies that a simple push request is not permission, and agents must stop and ask if a push is rejected due to diverged history. This change applies to the agent's internal knowledge base, affecting behavior across all surfaces.

c56032f0efb738f1db1176c56d141ea141329c41.title: Prevent image content propagation to spawned subagents
c56032f0efb738f1db1176c56d141ea141329c41.summary: The `executeSubagent` function in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts` now explicitly sets `content` to `undefined` when calling `loopAgentSteps`. This prevents the parent agent's image content from being automatically passed to spawned subagents. Subagents requiring image access must rely on `includeMessageHistory` rather than implicit content propagation. This change ensures cleaner separation of concerns and avoids potential context bloat or security issues related to unmanaged image data flow.

7969fc0fd749ae2267eb95e123836faf47d9a149.title: CLI publish adds dependents toggle and bundled filter
7969fc0fd749ae2267eb95e123836faf47d9a149.summary: The publish UI introduces an includeDependents toggle to visualize and include reverse dependencies in the confirmation step. Bundled agents are now filtered out of the publishable list via an isBundled flag in prebuild-agents.ts. The publish command passes allLocalAgentIds to the API client for server-side validation. SelectedChips.tsx component added to display selected agents with removal support.

644ef70aa27655ee619de61fd5ba8bcb659e0598.title: Agent run errors now include stack traces
644ef70aa27655ee619de61fd5ba8bcb659e0598.summary: Error handling in `loopAgentSteps` now appends `error.stack` to `error.message` and prefixes the output with 'Agent run error: '. This provides deeper context for debugging agent failures. The change affects `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`.

23192c46e41f062eb3a66c922f200f48a983f906.title: CLI error messages now include stack traces
23192c46e41f062eb3a66c922f200f48a983f906.summary: Updated CLI error handling to append stack traces to error messages and prefix agent run failures with 'Output error:'. Modified `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts` to include `error.stack` when available. Changed `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts` to format partial agent run errors more distinctly.

80fc6e797d22dfb287ea3bd3b2cb2c8e3803a8aa.title: Relax setoutput tool requirement for structuredoutput mode
80fc6e797d22dfb287ea3bd3b2cb2c8e3803a8aa.summary: Validation logic in DynamicAgentTemplateSchema and validateAgents now permits structured_output mode without requiring set_output in toolNames. This change allows handleSteps generators to yield set_output actions even when the underlying LLM does not have direct access to the tool. The update affects agent definition parsing in common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts and SDK validation in sdk/src/validate-agents.ts. Tests in agent-validation.test.ts, dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts, handlesteps-parsing.test.ts, and validate-agents.test.ts were updated to reflect the new permissive behavior.

370ac2dcb6bf9f412aaa793c2ac78c0ae082b171.text: The assistant now asks for clear permission before replacing old work with new work. This prevents accidental overwrites of your saved progress.

01df7deb9ec76b8f9844398bcb4711eda9a254f2.text: The system now records more details when a connection to the AI service fails. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

644ef70aa27655ee619de61fd5ba8bcb659e0598.text: When the assistant fails, the error message now shows more detailed information about what went wrong. This helps support teams diagnose and fix issues faster.

a36aefb00477f28241ff392f9e6c806bdd40afa1.text: This internal change stops minor, temporary data recording issues from triggering false alarms. Users won't notice a difference, but support teams can focus on real problems.

23192c46e41f062eb3a66c922f200f48a983f906.text: The tool now shows more detailed error information when something goes wrong.

c56032f0efb738f1db1176c56d141ea141329c41.text: The system no longer automatically sends images to background helpers. This keeps tasks separate and prevents accidental data sharing.

77b4dd360c8b5080906b5006bf82aff620f62fb8.text: When a user tries to do something they are not allowed to do, the system now gives a clear reason why instead of a vague error.

ed656e08dc31c7ec547e966f286ee4be9668c893.text: The speed at which the chat window scrolls when you use your mouse wheel or trackpad has increased slightly. This means you can move through longer conversations a bit faster without changing how you interact with the tool.

7969fc0fd749ae2267eb95e123836faf47d9a149.text: When publishing, you can now see and choose related tools that rely on your selection. Built-in helpers are automatically hidden from the list, and the system checks your choices to ensure they work together.

80fc6e797d22dfb287ea3bd3b2cb2c8e3803a8aa.text: The system now allows certain tools to work even if they are not directly listed for the assistant. This makes it easier for the assistant to finish tasks using specific actions, without requiring those actions to be pre-approved in a strict list.

e2f7538f26c9e4863bda7bc0fc95ae6be352f1c3.title: Fix evalDataPaths type in buffbench
e2f7538f26c9e4863bda7bc0fc95ae6be352f1c3.summary: Corrected `evalDataPath` to `evalDataPaths` in `evals/buffbench/main-single-eval.ts`. `runBuffBench` expects an array. Fixes type mismatch in single eval runner.

617bc23e68c737bcb487f0118ca290bf7de4baf4.title: Fix thinking block width calculation
617bc23e68c737bcb487f0118ca290bf7de4baf4.summary: Adjusted available width calculation in `thinking-block.tsx` by increasing reserved space from 4 to 10 units. This change prevents jittery rendering of thinking blocks in the CLI interface. The fix is scoped to the CLI component logic.

6aa53a0f34027c39730e6fa4d39557451cdbe44e.title: read-subtree accepts empty path string
6aa53a0f34027c39730e6fa4d39557451cdbe44e.summary: read-subtree tool schema updated to accept empty strings in paths array. Previously, z.string().min(1) rejected empty paths, causing errors when users passed empty strings. Now, empty strings are treated as equivalent to '.' (project root), aligning with common path resolution behavior. Affects common/src/tools/params/tool/read-subtree.ts.

545e1a2ce3e6f1ab00ad481fe027025c2204312d.title: Update editor best of n opus
545e1a2ce3e6f1ab00ad481fe027025c2204312d.summary: Refactored handleStepsOpus to enforce a fixed 10-agent Opus pattern and truncate message history before spawning. Switched to extracting raw text from lastMessage outputs and passing full step text to the editor instead of filtering for tool calls. Internal logic change in .agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts.

9b4c2d6dd03548972bcf7cf540670d63c8193444.title: Fix error message ordering in stream parser
9b4c2d6dd03548972bcf7cf540670d63c8193444.summary: Moved `errorMessages` push in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` to occur after `previousToolCallFinished` await. Ensures errors append after tool results for Anthropic API ordering compliance. Resolves race condition where errors were previously included in the initial history spread. Scope limited to agent runtime stream processing.

27d699645a007ce0a5adf684fa685c735f560a59.title: Opus editor agent replaces Max variant in base2
27d699645a007ce0a5adf684fa685c735f560a59.summary: Renamed editor-best-of-n-max to editor-best-of-n-opus in .agents/base2/base2.ts. Adjusted default n values to 3 and max n to 6 for best-of-n agents. Updated thinker prompt descriptions to clarify context visibility.

b19591a6b5019213b4a36740988f14f8bafc0b3c.title: Switch thinker agent to Claude Opus 4.5 and structured output
b19591a6b5019213b4a36740988f14f8bafc0b3c.summary: The `thinker` agent definition updated model to `anthropic/claude-opus-4.5` and switched `outputMode` to `structured_output` with a custom `handleSteps` generator. The agent now extracts text from the last assistant message and calls `set_output` internally, while the LLM is instructed not to call tools. The `thinker` agent is added to the default spawnable list in `createBase2`. The validation rule requiring `set_output` in `toolNames` for structured output is disabled in `DynamicAgentTemplateSchema` to allow `handleSteps` to manage the tool call without exposing it to the model.

c8be0c250c81ea7c7c1fe30b5e213e8c60d6ffaf.title: BuffBench judge errors log full output and write debug files
c8be0c250c81ea7c7c1fe30b5e213e8c60d6ffaf.summary: Judge error handling in evals/buffbench/judge.ts now logs the full structured output alongside the trace. A DEBUG_ERROR flag writes failed judge outputs to JSON files named by commit ID and agent ID. The judgeCommitResult interface accepts an EvalCommitV2 object instead of separate prompt and groundTruthFileDiffs arguments. Callers in run-buffbench.ts updated to pass the full commit object.

f72d0dd5b11234985d46b0b123d92e3a19403fcc.title: BuffBench supports multi-file eval runs and adds hard-task analysis
f72d0dd5b11234985d46b0b123d92e3a19403fcc.summary: runBuffBench now accepts evalDataPaths array instead of single evalDataPath, enabling cross-repo evaluation in one pass. New analyze-task-scores.ts identifies hard tasks (score <= 7.5) from logs, while main-hard-tasks.ts runs 45 selected tasks across Codebuff, Manifold, Plane, and Saleor eval sets. Nightly and main scripts updated to use array format with consolidated repo URL reporting.

8738ea71e4b395e86d9ae63d945abefcce4c94c4.title: thinker-best-of-n uses <think> tags
8738ea71e4b395e86d9ae63d945abefcce4c94c4.summary: Updated instructionsPrompt in `.agents/thinker/best-of-n/thinker-best-of-n.ts` to direct subagents to use `<think>` tags for reasoning. Implemented regex stripping of `<think>...</think>` content in `handleStepsDefault` and `handleStepsOpus` before passing thoughts to the selector. This ensures only the final concise response reaches the parent agent, preventing raw chain-of-thought leakage.

6aa53a0f34027c39730e6fa4d39557451cdbe44e.text: The tool now handles empty folder paths by defaulting to the main project folder. This prevents errors when you leave a path field blank.

617bc23e68c737bcb487f0118ca290bf7de4baf4.text: Fixed a visual glitch where 'thinking' text in the command line interface appeared shaky or jittery. The layout now reserves more space, ensuring the text displays smoothly and stably.

9b4c2d6dd03548972bcf7cf540670d63c8193444.text: The assistant now reports errors in the correct order, after showing tool results. This fixes a rare timing issue so you see the full, accurate response sequence.

b19591a6b5019213b4a36740988f14f8bafc0b3c.text: The thinking assistant now uses a newer, more capable model. It also changed how it shares answers, making them clearer and more consistent for you.

27d699645a007ce0a5adf684fa685c735f560a59.text: The system switched to a different writing assistant model for better results. This change is internal and may make text suggestions feel slightly different.

c8be0c250c81ea7c7c1fe30b5e213e8c60d6ffaf.text: A small internal change improves how the system records errors when grading tasks. This helps support staff diagnose issues faster.

f72d0dd5b11234985d46b0b123d92e3a19403fcc.text: The system can now check many sets of tasks at once, making the process faster. It also automatically finds the hardest tasks to help improve performance.

e2f7538f26c9e4863bda7bc0fc95ae6be352f1c3.text: Fixed a small internal error in the testing system. Users will not notice any changes.

6adec6e38daee2d7edc0a67b92a78c5bac5f2b3f.title: CLI theme primary color updated to green
6adec6e38daee2d7edc0a67b92a78c5bac5f2b3f.summary: Primary color in `dark` and `light` themes changed from yellow/orange to green hex codes (#9EFC62, #65A83E). Updates `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts` to align default chat themes with new branding. No API or behavior changes.

03ebeb98e9df8a00b68d9218aa16b6ab7f7567ed.title: code-search filters non-existent hidden dirs
03ebeb98e9df8a00b68d9218aa16b6ab7f7567ed.summary: The code search tool now filters hidden directories via fs.statSync before passing them to ripgrep. This prevents stderr errors from ripgrep complaining about non-existent paths. The change is isolated to sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts. Only blessed hidden directories that actually exist in the search CWD are included in the arguments.

1fd0a47f2021ecf2c3035541d4ca8cf109c03012.title: Update manifold eval with initCommand and finalCheckCommands
1fd0a47f2021ecf2c3035541d4ca8cf109c03012.summary: Added initCommand and finalCheckCommands fields to evals/buffbench/eval-manifold.json. initCommand runs yarn install and restores yarn.lock. finalCheckCommands executes TypeScript compilation and build steps across common, backend/api, backend/scheduler, backend/shared, and web packages. This ensures proper environment setup and validation during manifold benchmark evaluations.

2c4ec02a099d92548a9c199130dc45a39f79c5eb.title: Append tool error messages after all tool results
2c4ec02a099d92548a9c199130dc45a39f79c5eb.summary: Tool error messages in stream-parser.ts now collect into a separate array and append after toolResultsToAddAfterStream. Anthropic API requires tool results to immediately follow the assistant message with tool calls; previously, error messages interleaved with tool results broke this ordering.

5bd7d2dea524ea8b7673531bce01c75c1e54d9f1.title: Unify agent tool input schema with spawnagents structure
5bd7d2dea524ea8b7673531bce01c75c1e54d9f1.summary: Refactored agent tool input schemas to use nested `prompt` and `params` fields, matching the `spawn_agents` structure instead of flattening parameters. This change updates `buildAgentToolInputSchema` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/prompts.ts` and removes the `getZodObjectShape` helper. `tryTransformAgentToolCall` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts` now passes existing `prompt`/`params` directly without reconstruction. Documentation in `common/src/tools/params/tool/spawn-agents.ts` reflects the unified schema.

91a139f57d7d3ce3db8cec1633b0fd4227742426.title: Log codebuff runner errors in evals
91a139f57d7d3ce3db8cec1633b0fd4227742426.summary: Added error logging to CodebuffRunner in `evals/buffbench/runners/codebuff.ts`. Captures `result.output.type === 'error'` events to `console.error` with commit/agent IDs. When `DEBUG_ERROR` is set, writes full output and trace to a JSON file in the parent directory. Internal observability improvement for buffbench evals.

de2c9c8e7e63c06cd7a03479bd5e55f753978015.title: CLI logo sheen animation loop and deduplication
de2c9c8e7e63c06cd7a03479bd5e55f753978015.summary: Refactored CLI logo rendering to use a shared `useLogo` hook with dynamic sheen animation. Removed duplicate `getSheenColor` from `login-modal-utils.ts` and updated `use-sheen-animation.tsx` to support looping fill/unfill effects using theme colors. Scope: `cli/src/app.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-logo.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-sheen-animation.tsx`, `cli/src/login/utils.ts`.

35f0bee9b9669b6b45a59e7fdaaefb1264f49482.title: Switch CLI primary/accent to green and fix diff coloring
35f0bee9b9669b6b45a59e7fdaaefb1264f49482.summary: CLI theme system updates primary and accent colors from blue to green. Diff viewer now applies theme-specific added/removed line colors. Changes affect `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts` and `cli/src/components/tools/diff-viewer.tsx`. `lineColor` function signature updated to accept `themeName`.

174c9368a4cf0fb8436e954670c644e7b1990a5e.title: Remove eager CLI agent validation
174c9368a4cf0fb8436e954670c644e7b1990a5e.summary: Agent validation now runs lazily inside useAgentValidation instead of during CLI startup in index.tsx. App and Chat components no longer receive loadedAgentsData or validationErrors props. The hook filters network errors via filterNetworkErrors before setting state. This removes redundant validation calls and simplifies component prop drilling.

6adec6e38daee2d7edc0a67b92a78c5bac5f2b3f.text: The assistant's chat interface now uses green instead of yellow for its main color. This visual update matches the new brand look and does not change how the tool works.

de2c9c8e7e63c06cd7a03479bd5e55f753978015.text: The startup logo animation now loops smoothly. Duplicate code was cleaned up. This is a small internal change with no visible effect.

bc4fcd1010aebb128c6059d556a1035f7c2e0b75.text: The system now checks its work against harder tasks. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

03ebeb98e9df8a00b68d9218aa16b6ab7f7567ed.text: The search tool now checks if folders exist before looking inside them. This stops it from trying to search empty or missing spots, keeping results clean.

91a139f57d7d3ce3db8cec1633b0fd4227742426.text: Small internal update. The system now records specific error details to help staff troubleshoot issues faster. No visible change for users.

5bd7d2dea524ea8b7673531bce01c75c1e54d9f1.text: The assistant now uses a consistent format for handling tasks, making it easier to pass along requests and details. This is a small internal cleanup that helps keep things running smoothly.

1fd0a47f2021ecf2c3035541d4ca8cf109c03012.text: A small internal update checks the system setup and verifies that all parts build correctly before running tests.

35f0bee9b9669b6b45a59e7fdaaefb1264f49482.text: The text in the command line tool is now green instead of blue. When you look at file changes, added lines and removed lines are colored to match this new style.

2c4ec02a099d92548a9c199130dc45a39f79c5eb.text: Fixed a bug where error messages appeared in the wrong order, breaking the assistant's ability to process tool results.

174c9368a4cf0fb8436e954670c644e7b1990a5e.text: The app now checks assistant settings only when needed instead of every time you open it. This speeds up startup and reduces unnecessary background work.

9406cf9b7f53411bf0ef5fd643a57b6141b69e6b.title: SDK e2e tests update model to claude-sonnet-4.5
9406cf9b7f53411bf0ef5fd643a57b6141b69e6b.summary: SDK e2e tests replace anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514 with anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 in AgentDefinition model fields. Updates cover custom-agents/api-integration-agent, database-query-agent, and weather-agent test files. Change ensures test suites validate against the newer Sonnet model.

b6d6602b80c5e71c7ae335968dfa73f8eeec372b.title: SDK custom tools JSON Schema serialization
b6d6602b80c5e71c7ae335968dfa73f8eeec372b.summary: SDK custom tools now serialize Zod input schemas to JSON Schema via `z.toJSONSchema` in `sdk/src/run-state.ts` to survive JSON transport. `packages/agent-runtime` uses `ensureZodSchema` and `zod-from-json-schema` to convert JSON schemas back to Zod before validation in `tool-executor.ts` and `prompts.ts`. `common/src/util/file.ts` updates `customToolDefinitionsSchema` to accept both Zod and JSON Schema objects.

45a9b9e36ff194bcfbb27cd2cf026a3de12156ea.title: Skip flaky SDK e2e tests
45a9b9e36ff194bcfbb27cd2cf026a3de12156ea.summary: Marked 'agent uses injected knowledge files', 'multiple knowledge files are accessible', 'agent can reference injected project files', and 'agent can analyze content of project files' as skipped in sdk/e2e/features/knowledge-files.e2e.test.ts and sdk/e2e/features/project-files.e2e.test.ts. This prevents CI failures from flaky or broken end-to-end tests while a proper fix is implemented. The change affects only the SDK test suite.

f2bfa73c960345a734a5d2609f432e46fca807d8.title: Remove local agents toggle from CLI
f2bfa73c960345a734a5d2609f432e46fca807d8.summary: Deleted local agents display logic and toggle from cli/src/app.tsx. User should use '@' command instead. Refactor removes agentCount, formatIdentifier, renderAgentListItem, and associated ToolCallItem rendering.

2553341452476b4e3650aeb8e55b06db53dd3af4.title: Filter CLI @ menu to current agent subagents
2553341452476b4e3650aeb8e55b06db53dd3af4.summary: The '@' menu in CLI now filters bundled agents to show only subagents of the current base agent mode. `loadLocalAgents` accepts an optional `AgentMode` to determine the `spawnableAgents` list from the active agent definition. User-defined agents in `.agents/` remain visible regardless of mode. The agent cache is updated to key by `agentMode` instead of storing a single global list.

4b2a72de69dde93de80efb62909749bb64db1a83.title: SDK v0.10.0
4b2a72de69dde93de80efb62909749bb64db1a83.summary: Bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.10.0. Introduces native tool calls under the hood. Public API changes minimal. Covers sdk/CHANGELOG.md, sdk/package.json.

03169275bafd4f0e1a8d59e760bd6754af1a012e.title: Fix SDK type exports and add type testing script
03169275bafd4f0e1a8d59e760bd6754af1a012e.summary: Updated sdk/src/index.ts to export buildUserMessageContent from local relative path instead of @codebuff/agent-runtime/util/messages, fixing type resolution. Added sdk/scripts/test-types.ts to run type checks across cjs-compatibility, esm-compatibility, and ripgrep-bundling subprojects. Added test:types npm script to sdk/package.json. Script removes stale node_modules/@codebuff/sdk before setup and ensures dist build exists.

eb64e4dca0d7fb6e502fed42022b45e424628c86.title: Consolidate SDK verification scripts
eb64e4dca0d7fb6e502fed42022b45e424628c86.summary: Added `sdk/scripts/verify.ts` to orchestrate build, typecheck, smoke tests, and compatibility checks, replacing scattered `package.json` scripts like `build:verify` and `test:types`. This unifies non-traditional test execution into a single `bun run verify` command, with `--skip-build` support for faster iteration. Scope limited to SDK tooling; no runtime code changes.

8dbf674f3b0ae4511f43298d862b6d39f35a28c0.title: CLI /publish command adds interactive agent selection UI
8dbf674f3b0ae4511f43298d862b6d39f35a28c0.summary: Adds /publish slash command with interactive agent selection UI via new React components and state store. Replaces console-based flow with structured PublishResult return type and command registry integration. Covers CLI chat input, command handlers, and publish mutation hooks; shared API types updated in common/src/types/api/agents/publish.ts. Agent checklist supports recursive dependency tree rendering and pre-selection via command arguments.

7e24a0ffe766e2a44fcb5eebc9b376377f5c35e0.title: Fix duplicate subagent output
7e24a0ffe766e2a44fcb5eebc9b376377f5c35e0.summary: Removed generic 'text' event handler from cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts. Subagent text chunks now bypass sendSubagentChunk in packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agents.ts, writing directly to client via writeToClient. Prevents double rendering of subagent output in CLI.

9406cf9b7f53411bf0ef5fd643a57b6141b69e6b.text: Internal checks now use a newer version of the AI model to ensure the product works correctly. This update does not change how the product looks or feels for you.

4b2a72de69dde93de80efb62909749bb64db1a83.text: The assistant now uses a more efficient internal method to perform actions. This change is small and mostly invisible, so the product works the same way for you.

2553341452476b4e3650aeb8e55b06db53dd3af4.text: The assistant's @ menu now shows only the helpers relevant to your current task mode, hiding others to reduce clutter. Your own custom helpers still appear.

eb64e4dca0d7fb6e502fed42022b45e424628c86.text: The team combined several separate checks that happen before the product is released into one single action. This change is internal and only helps the people who build the software, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

b6d6602b80c5e71c7ae335968dfa73f8eeec372b.text: The system now translates tool instructions into a universal format that works across different parts of the app. This ensures custom tools function reliably without breaking when data moves between services.

03169275bafd4f0e1a8d59e760bd6754af1a012e.text: The software now finds its internal instructions more reliably. This fixes minor setup issues for users.

f2bfa73c960345a734a5d2609f432e46fca807d8.text: The option to view local helpers was removed from the main interface. You can still access these helpers by typing the '@' symbol.

7e24a0ffe766e2a44fcb5eebc9b376377f5c35e0.text: Fixed a bug where text from sub-agents appeared twice in the command line interface. This change ensures output displays correctly without duplication.

8dbf674f3b0ae4511f43298d862b6d39f35a28c0.text: The publishing feature now shows a simple menu to choose which assistant to use, replacing the old text-based steps. You can also select assistants directly when starting the command, and the menu shows all related assistants so you know exactly what will be published.

92814531a4778a22734fe37783fce92088d9af01.title: Revert subagent streaming duplicate text fix
92814531a4778a22734fe37783fce92088d9af01.summary: Reverts prior patch in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tool-stream-parser.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`. Restores `onResponseChunk` callback with internal buffering in `tool-stream-parser.ts` and shifts `assistantMessages` accumulation from `processStream` to the callback in `stream-parser.ts`. Scope limited to `agent-runtime` package. Streaming behavior for subagents reverts to pre-fix state.

03e88c7c3f8dcdda58b5f1e63d1c090589cd0351.title: CLI test isolation
03e88c7c3f8dcdda58b5f1e63d1c090589cd0351.summary: Added mock logger to `fetchUsageData` test in `cli/src/hooks/__tests__/use-usage-query.test.ts`. Isolates test from side effects by injecting mock `error`, `warn`, `info`, and `debug` functions. Prevents real logging during failed request assertions.

a52a4c209234fb70a8bdbc8a3eebffd7ab9dbd88.title: SDK adds e2e test suite and runnable examples
a52a4c209234fb70a8bdbc8a3eebffd7ab9dbd88.summary: New `sdk/e2e` directory introduces structured end-to-end testing infrastructure and runnable examples for the Codebuff SDK. Tests cover streaming, workflows, custom agents, and specific features like `knowledgeFiles` and `maxAgentSteps`, while examples demonstrate common patterns such as code review and refactoring. Scripts require `CODEBUFF_API_KEY` and are executed via `bun run`. Documentation in `sdk/e2e/README.md` details directory structure and test commands (`test:e2e`, `test:integration`, `test:unit:e2e`).

73e2e27486bcd494c28452c302fe43729555ccaf.title: Context pruner now accounts for system prompt and tool definition
73e2e27486bcd494c28452c302fe43729555ccaf.summary: Context pruner calculates effective message budget by subtracting system prompt and tool definition tokens from maxContextLength. Previously, the pruner used the full maxContextLength for message history, ignoring the overhead of system prompts and tool schemas which could cause context overflow. The change introduces new optional fields systemPrompt and toolDefinitions in AgentState types across .agents/types/agent-definition.ts and common/src/types/session-state.ts. Tool definitions are serialized in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts using mapValues to extract description and inputSchema for token counting.

e5ba7afcb3474164030258bbf0eab043c7014cc6.title: Exit image mode on paste or path
e5ba7afcb3474164030258bbf0eab043c7014cc6.summary: addPendingImageFromFile now calls exitImageModeIfActive on success, resetting inputMode from 'image' to 'default'. Fixes stuck image mode when adding images via paste or file path. Scope limited to cli/src/utils/add-pending-image.ts. Logic checks useChatStore state and triggers setInputMode only if currently in image mode.

c2ef254e37a476331a3e599595c3c41a2af13f87.title: Remove flaky message count assertion in context-pruner integration
c2ef254e37a476331a3e599595c3c41a2af13f87.summary: Removed the `expect(finalMessages.length).toBeLessThan(...)` assertion from `.agents/__tests__/context-pruner.integration.test.ts`. The check was flaky because agent runs add messages and context pruning may replace messages with placeholders rather than removing them. The test now relies on verifying that tool-call/tool-result pairs remain intact.

7b53e571f80bca5dc99cd2eef1d864150528c427.title: Fix lastMessage text extraction and tooluse ordering
7b53e571f80bca5dc99cd2eef1d864150528c427.summary: Agent runtime now concatenates all assistant text chunks in `lastMessage` outputs instead of returning only the final segment, resolving truncated responses from streaming subagents. `stream-parser.ts` suppresses intermediate assistant text messages when tool calls are active to prevent Anthropic API validation errors caused by interleaved `tool_use` and `tool_result` blocks. Changes affect `.agents/editor/best-of-n`, `.agents/file-explorer`, and `packages/agent-runtime`. `extractSpawnResults` logic was refactored to correctly unwrap nested `AgentOutput` values from JSON tool results.

fa71be2c8caaef7cf7f2dc7e9958c3375cb40d24.title: Revert lastMessage extraction and tool ordering fix
fa71be2c8caaef7cf7f2dc7e9958c3375cb40d24.summary: Reverts logic extracting all streaming text chunks and enforcing tool_use/tool_result ordering constraints. `stream-parser.ts` now pushes text chunks to `assistantMessages` regardless of pending `toolCalls`, while `editor-best-of-n.ts` and `file-picker.ts` revert to reading only the last assistant message or first structured output. Covers Agent Runtime stream handling and internal agent orchestration. Removes the guard preventing text accumulation when tool calls are present.

b9f2793b6ebb4362408933309dcaa7de85cdc114.title: CLI suggestion menus now support mouse click and hover
b9f2793b6ebb4362408933309dcaa7de85cdc114.summary: Suggestion menus in cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx now accept onItemClick handlers and render as interactive Button components. Hover state is tracked locally, with visual highlighting applied only after the first mouseover event to prevent accidental selection during initial render. Click handlers in cli/src/chat.tsx update the input value and cursor position directly, bypassing the need for keyboard navigation to confirm selections. This change affects both slash command and mention/file suggestion surfaces in the CLI.

99bb1e61a149a143d39b030770c2d8af2bda629d.title: Bundle local agents into CLI binary at build time
99bb1e61a149a143d39b030770c2d8af2bda629d.summary: Added `scripts/prebuild-agents.ts` to scan `.agents/` and generate `src/agents/bundled-agents.generated.ts`. This embeds agent definitions into the CLI binary, removing runtime filesystem dependency for bundled agents. Updated `package.json` dev script and `scripts/build-binary.ts` to trigger generation. Refactored agent loading logic in `src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts` to consume bundled data, deleting `src/utils/load-agent-definitions.ts` and updating imports in `src/index.tsx`, `src/commands/publish.ts`, and hooks.

e5ba7afcb3474164030258bbf0eab043c7014cc6.text: Adding an image via paste or file path now automatically exits image mode. This prevents the app from getting stuck in image mode after you upload a picture.

73e2e27486bcd494c28452c302fe43729555ccaf.text: The assistant now counts the instructions and tool descriptions as part of its short-term memory limit. This prevents the conversation from exceeding capacity, ensuring smoother interactions.

7b53e571f80bca5dc99cd2eef1d864150528c427.text: AI responses no longer cut off text when the system uses multiple background tools at once.

92814531a4778a22734fe37783fce92088d9af01.text: A recent update that helped prevent repeated text from appearing while the assistant was typing has been undone. The assistant's typing behavior now works as it did before that update.

b9f2793b6ebb4362408933309dcaa7de85cdc114.text: You can now use your mouse to click or hover over command and file suggestions in the chat interface, making it easier to select options without using the keyboard.

03e88c7c3f8dcdda58b5f1e63d1c090589cd0351.text: A small internal update ensures that testing the app's usage data feature no longer creates extra error messages.

fa71be2c8caaef7cf7f2dc7e9958c3375cb40d24.text: The assistant's ability to show text while using tools was turned off. This is a small internal change that restores previous behavior for how messages are displayed.

a52a4c209234fb70a8bdbc8a3eebffd7ab9dbd88.text: The tools for building with this assistant now include a set of checks to ensure they work correctly. This means users can rely on the assistant's features behaving as expected when they use it.

c2ef254e37a476331a3e599595c3c41a2af13f87.text: The product's automatic message cleanup sometimes kept messages as placeholders rather than deleting them. This internal change stops the test from falsely failing when that happens.

fcead726bfadac72b13f6c3e357125eb9e54f5db.title: Fix CI test failures in SDK and CLI
fcead726bfadac72b13f6c3e357125eb9e54f5db.summary: Updated SDK tests to match `startAgentRun` return type change from object to string and added required `userInputId`/`promptId` fields to `sendAction` payloads. CLI tests now call `setProjectRoot` in `beforeEach` to prevent logger errors during credential storage and logout flows. Scope includes `cli/src/__tests__` and `sdk/src/__tests__`.

678f9061ec3851f825dcad0d291047e6b279d32e.title: Skip editor best-of-n integration test
678f9061ec3851f825dcad0d291047e6b279d32e.summary: The `editor-best-of-n.integration.test.ts` test is skipped via `it.skip`. This temporary measure prevents CI failures while the underlying integration issue is unresolved. Scope limited to the test suite.

1c720f08851a3ea1d9bbca33df79935e36eb431a.title: Add context-pruner integration tests
1c720f08851a3ea1d9bbca33df79935e36eb431a.summary: Added `.agents/__tests__/context-pruner.integration.test.ts` to verify `context-pruner` agent behavior. Tests ensure message history pruning maintains tool-call/tool-result pair integrity for Anthropic API compliance. Covers standard and aggressive pruning scenarios using `claude-haiku-4.5`.

27b4d7f924a7b1a954d556dbccaded1556675816.title: Fix .agents test logic to fail correctly
27b4d7f924a7b1a954d556dbccaded1556675816.summary: CI workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` updated to correctly propagate test failures for the `.agents` package. Previous logic used `|| echo` which masked non-zero exit codes from `bun test`. New logic checks for test files explicitly and runs them without suppressing errors, ensuring CI fails when tests fail.

91fc04d08b2ef28f6dcd579c8fa9e3b916d2d756.title: spawnagents tool schema emphasis and examples
91fc04d08b2ef28f6dcd579c8fa9e3b916d2d756.summary: Updated `spawn-agents.ts` to mandate checking required fields in agent params schemas. Added explicit warning that fields like `command` for `commander` or `searchQueries` for `code-searcher` are required. Replaced generic example with concrete `commander` and `code-searcher` invocations demonstrating correct nested `params` usage.

f27f478adfd54b2168a22a008e2fad73b926618d.title: Improve debug log organization
f27f478adfd54b2168a22a008e2fad73b926618d.summary: Refactor logging infrastructure to use `appendFileSync` in dev mode and switch log extensions to `.jsonl`. `cli/src/utils/logger.ts` and `web/src/util/logger.ts` now bypass `pino`'s async transport in development to ensure real-time visibility, addressing Bun compatibility issues. `scripts/dev.sh` reorganizes startup logic and updates log directory paths to `debug/console`. `sdk/package.json` adds a `dev` script mapping to `build`.

aea1cc2b5b0e724c255ce1d78154608df8b26933.title: Context pruner fixes token counting and orphaned tool calls
aea1cc2b5b0e724c255ce1d78154608df8b26933.summary: Context pruner replaces rough JSON length estimation with media-aware token counting, assigning fixed 1000 tokens per image. New logic validates tool-call/tool-result pairs, removing orphaned messages before and after pruning. This prevents context overflow errors and invalid message sequences. Changes are internal to .agents/context-pruner.ts.

edd9eca23e7811ca00573e211e858edc4aa7f537.title: Fix context pruner tool-call/result pair integrity
edd9eca23e7811ca00573e211e858edc4aa7f537.summary: Context pruner now preserves tool-call and tool-result pairs during message-level pruning to satisfy Anthropic API compliance. Pass 3 logic changed to build a map of paired indices, ensuring these messages are never removed individually. This prevents API errors caused by orphaned tool results or calls. The fix applies to `.agents/context-pruner.ts`.

e4f52de6c61a65b94a47553497bc4757ed4129ab.title: Fix duplicate text in subagent streaming view
e4f52de6c61a65b94a47553497bc4757ed4129ab.summary: Removed redundant text buffering and flushing logic in `processStreamWithTools` and `processStream` to prevent duplicate text rendering in subagent streaming views. The `onResponseChunk` callback in `tool-stream-parser.ts` was stripped of its internal buffer management, delegating text handling directly to the consumer. In `tools/stream-parser.ts`, `assistantMessages` are now populated directly from the main text chunk stream, eliminating the previous double-push caused by the parser's flush mechanism.
