This change affects the Agent Runtime SDK, specifically `packages/agent-runtime/src/tool-stream-parser.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`.

e4f52de6c61a65b94a47553497bc4757ed4129ab.text: Fixed a bug causing repeated text in subagent views. Users see cleaner, non-duplicated responses.

8738ea71e4b395e86d9ae63d945abefcce4c94c4.text: The system now hides its internal reasoning steps from you. You only see the final, clean answer, making the chat experience less cluttered.

f27f478adfd54b2168a22a008e2fad73b926618d.text: Internal logging was adjusted to appear instantly during development. This change does not affect how you use the product.

91fc04d08b2ef28f6dcd579c8fa9e3b916d2d756.text: The assistant now checks for all required information before starting a task. This prevents errors when you ask it to run a command or search for code.

27b4d7f924a7b1a954d556dbccaded1556675816.text: A small internal fix ensures the system correctly detects and stops when automated checks fail. This improves reliability by preventing broken updates from reaching you.

edd9eca23e7811ca00573e211e858edc4aa7f537.text: The assistant now keeps related steps together when cleaning up old conversations. This prevents errors and helps the assistant answer correctly.

aea1cc2b5b0e724c255ce1d78154608df8b26933.text: The assistant now counts images and text more accurately to avoid running out of memory. It also cleans up broken message links to prevent errors during conversations.

1c720f08851a3ea1d9bbca33df79935e36eb431a.text: The assistant now checks that it keeps conversations clear and accurate when trimming long chat histories. This prevents the assistant from getting confused by missing information during normal use.

678f9061ec3851f825dcad0d291047e6b279d32e.text: A temporary internal check was paused to stop system errors. This does not change how the product works for you.

cf7ff5e4a34be4119018d5d0810e03d026fecf6a.title: Remove deprecated width prop from MultilineInput
cf7ff5e4a34be4119018d5d0810e03d026fecf6a.summary: The deprecated `width` prop is removed from `MultilineInput` and its consumers (`ChatInputBar`, `FeedbackTextSection`, `OtherTextInput`). This cleanup eliminates unused prop threading and width calculation logic in the CLI components. Affected files include `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`, `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`, and related input components.

d3bcf7d35c21f7bad952a609f5530484215e0732.title: Upgrade opentui to 0.1.56
d3bcf7d35c21f7bad952a609f5530484215e0732.summary: Bumped @opentui/core and @opentui/react from ^0.1.55 to ^0.1.56. Scope limited to cli/package.json dependencies. Internal chore.

1ce04fbe5c2eb965bf9e7bb22486bbd0899b8448.title: Docs: simplify dev setup with bun run dev, rename start-bin to
1ce04fbe5c2eb965bf9e7bb22486bbd0899b8448.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md and INFISICAL_SETUP_GUIDE.md replace the multi-terminal `bun run start-server`/`start-web`/`start-bin` workflow with a single `bun run dev` command that orchestrates the backend, web server, SDK build, and CLI. The `start-bin` script is renamed to `start-cli` across all documentation examples, including agent publishing and directory-specific execution commands. This change affects only documentation files; no source code or package scripts were modified.

d649e3ba3c0fb84e173ba336e3163abc553fddd1.title: CLI mode commands generated from AGENTMODES
d649e3ba3c0fb84e173ba336e3163abc553fddd1.summary: Refactored `command-registry.ts` to generate `/mode:*` commands via `AGENT_MODES.map`. Replaced hardcoded DEFAULT, MAX, PLAN handlers with dynamic creation. Internal cleanup only; no user-facing behavior change.

6e517df5e97c2e6f5ce4d6ed3a2c42b3a1679c19.title: Fix multiline input navigation and history bugs
6e517df5e97c2e6f5ce4d6ed3a2c42b3a1679c19.summary: MultilineInput now calculates visual line boundaries from TextBufferView.lineInfo for Home/End keys, replacing stale logical line calculations. The getOrSetStickyColumn helper updates its dependency array to include cursorPosition, ensuring accurate sticky column tracking during vertical navigation. Line deletion via Ctrl+Shift+K (or similar) now sets lastEditDueToNav to false, preventing unintended history state pollution.

8899146839681cfb82159a5323df150f7c9ad0cc.title: dev.sh adds spinner UI and process cleanup
8899146839681cfb82159a5323df150f7c9ad0cc.summary: scripts/dev.sh gains braille spinner UI via wait_for_log and kill_proc cleanup. package.json adds start-cli script. Logs route to debug/proc. Internal tooling change.

87a98a5374861379cb7165b66d5a90b09527c296.title: CLI supports pasting image file paths
87a98a5374861379cb7165b66d5a90b09527c296.summary: CLI paste handler now detects image file paths in clipboard text or drag-drop events, prioritizing them over raw image data. Implemented via `getImageFilePathFromText` in `cli/src/utils/clipboard-image.ts` and wired through `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-keyboard.ts` and `cli/src/utils/strings.ts`. This ensures dragged files or copied paths attach correctly instead of relying on potentially stale clipboard image buffers.

7c8087db46d5abfaf5dfb9640efc89ae25f661fa.title: Add tmux bracketed paste workaround
7c8087db46d5abfaf5dfb9640efc89ae25f661fa.summary: Documented tmux bracketed paste workaround for CLI input automation. Standard `send-keys` drops characters due to OpenTUI keyboard handling; wrapping input in `\e[200~...\e[201~` ensures atomic processing. Added `cli/tmux.knowledge.md` with helper scripts and updated `cli/README.md`, `cli/knowledge.md`, and `web/src/content/advanced/troubleshooting.mdx`.

859aa304d1c29f80a794a917ba4d2656136acdda.title: CLI paste image file copied from Finder
859aa304d1c29f80a794a917ba4d2656136acdda.summary: CLI paste handler now detects image files copied from file managers (e.g., Finder) via new readClipboardImageFilePath utility. Supports macOS AppleScript furl extraction and Windows PowerShell GetFileDropList with -STA flag. Fixes stale clipboard image data issues by prioritizing file path extraction over raw image data in use-chat-keyboard.ts and strings.ts.

62f371ab9f8fea40c134bacc74ed3c184f655dc9.title: Add click-to-position cursor and selection-aware delete to CLI
62f371ab9f8fea40c134bacc74ed3c184f655dc9.summary: Multiline input now supports mouse clicks to position cursor and selection-aware deletion. Added renderPositionToOriginal helper to map tab-expanded render positions to original text coordinates. Deprecated the width prop in favor of dynamic viewport measurement. Covers cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx.

d3bcf7d35c21f7bad952a609f5530484215e0732.text: Small internal update to the text display engine. No visible changes to the interface or features.

7c8087db46d5abfaf5dfb9640efc89ae25f661fa.text: Fixed a glitch where typing long text into the command line tool could drop characters. Now, pasting text works reliably without missing letters.

62f371ab9f8fea40c134bacc74ed3c184f655dc9.text: Typing in text boxes now supports clicking to move the cursor and deleting selected text. The window adjusts its width automatically.

cf7ff5e4a34be4119018d5d0810e03d026fecf6a.text: The team removed an unused setting that controlled the size of text input boxes. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

87a98a5374861379cb7165b66d5a90b09527c296.text: You can now attach images by dragging them into the chat or copying their file path. This helps ensure the correct image is used, even if other images were recently copied.

8899146839681cfb82159a5323df150f7c9ad0cc.text: The tools used by the team to build the product now show a loading animation and close leftover programs automatically. This change affects only the internal work process and does not change how the product works for users.

859aa304d1c29f80a794a917ba4d2656136acdda.text: The assistant can now recognize images copied from your computer's file manager. This means you can paste a picture directly into the chat without needing to upload it as a separate file.

a9dd138609ae7b71e564eb51c95a17799314d731.title: CLI updater verifies binary in temp dir before final move
a9dd138609ae7b71e564eb51c95a17799314d731.summary: The CLI updater now downloads and extracts binaries to a temporary directory, runs a smoke test, and only moves the verified binary to the final location. This prevents corrupt or incompatible binaries from replacing the active executable, addressing previous failures where locked or bad files disrupted updates. The change is scoped to cli/release/index.js. A new `runSmokeTest` function executes the binary with `--version` to ensure it exits successfully and outputs a valid version string before proceeding.

7e8ed53562f22fd7f0f3330266f219fc81e43825.title: Increase tmux integration test timeout
7e8ed53562f22fd7f0f3330266f219fc81e43825.summary: Raised sleep duration from 400ms to 800ms and poll iterations from 5 to 10 in cli/src/__tests__/integration-tmux.test.ts. Addresses flakiness in tmux integration tests by allowing more time for CLI startup and help rendering. Scope limited to test configuration. No production code changes.

899b9c32be24c7ca6614bb65614a660f6a19944d.title: Consolidate agent mode definitions into single source of truth
899b9c32be24c7ca6614bb65614a660f6a19944d.summary: Refactored CLI to derive agent modes, labels, commands, and cycling logic from a new `AGENT_MODE_TO_ID` constant in `cli/src/utils/constants.ts`. This replaces hardcoded arrays and switch statements in `agent-mode-toggle.tsx`, `slash-commands.ts`, `use-send-message.ts`, `chat-store.ts`, and `settings.ts`. The change ensures all surfaces stay synchronized when modes are added or removed.

5cb3cc92bb55b8c47c601ed1e292282fc8672f07.title: agent-mode-toggle test updated for PLAN mode
5cb3cc92bb55b8c47c601ed1e292282fc8672f07.summary: Updated `agent-mode-toggle.test.ts` assertion to expect 5 segments (4 modes + 1 indicator) instead of 4. Reflects addition of PLAN mode to agent mode toggle. Internal test fix.

6012001897b09377dd576b936d5a3a7abf273528.title: Include provider metadata in OpenRouter error messages
6012001897b09377dd576b936d5a3a7abf273528.summary: Enhanced error messages now append provider metadata (raw response, provider name) to the base OpenRouter error string via `buildEnhancedErrorMessage`. This aids debugging upstream failures by exposing provider-specific details previously hidden in the `metadata` object. The change affects `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` and applies to all OpenRouter API error handling paths. Raw metadata is truncated to 1000 characters to prevent log bloat.

f43ff5c72d791bf0063de57f2e6a842616cdac13.title: Add LITE agent mode to CLI
f43ff5c72d791bf0063de57f2e6a842616cdac13.summary: Introduces LITE mode to the CLI agent system, mapping to the base2-lite agent. Updates constants, slash commands, mode toggle UI, and settings validation to include the new mode. The base2-lite prompt enforces spawning editor-gpt-5 without passing prompts or params.

0449bf89d90c35830958e53cb9819fb2d8b715ae.title: CLI: Replace built-in paste with custom clipboard reader
0449bf89d90c35830958e53cb9819fb2d8b715ae.summary: Refactored CLI paste handling to use custom `createPasteHandler` and `createTextPasteHandler` in `cli/src/utils/strings.ts` instead of relying on internal `PasteEvent` logic. Handlers now explicitly read text via `readClipboardText` and check for images via `hasClipboardImage`, with fallback support for bracketed paste. Scope covers chat input, feedback, and ask-user components, removing stale ref hacks from `multiline-input.tsx`.

9f1a79a6d7d0f1cecaba8752a6e24eb445937f47.title: CLI OSC theme detection runs before TUI startup
9f1a79a6d7d0f1cecaba8752a6e24eb445937f47.summary: CLI OSC theme detection now executes synchronously in `index.tsx` before OpenTUI initialization. This change prevents stdin conflicts, as OSC responses arrive via PTY and would previously race with OpenTUI's stdin listeners. The `--internal-osc-detect` subprocess flag and `osc-subprocess.ts` are removed. `use-theme.tsx` and `theme-system.ts` updated to consume the pre-computed theme via `getOscDetectedTheme()`.

343d329ba348c99f7c3fc62fcb01841c08d1f1d9.title: CLI slash menu shows current agent mode
343d329ba348c99f7c3fc62fcb01841c08d1f1d9.summary: The CLI suggestion engine now displays `(current)` next to the active agent mode in the slash command menu. This is achieved by passing `currentAgentMode` to `useSuggestionEngine` and appending the status to the description field for mode commands. The change affects `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts`. Mode matching is case-insensitive.

cc9334c64de77cce03e96f47dd083d245f3f2ba9.title: Remove OSC detection subprocess and input guard
cc9334c64de77cce03e96f47dd083d245f3f2ba9.summary: Deleted `terminal-input-guard.ts` and removed `--internal-osc-detect` flag checks from `common/src/env.ts` and `packages/internal/src/env.ts`. OSC theme detection now runs directly in `main()` before OpenTUI initialization, eliminating subprocess spawning and related stdin locking logic. Scope covers CLI utils and shared env modules. Stdin pause/resume handling simplified in `terminal-color-detection.ts`.

9f1a79a6d7d0f1cecaba8752a6e24eb445937f47.text: The app now checks your computer's color theme before it starts. This prevents display glitches and ensures the interface matches your system settings correctly.

899b9c32be24c7ca6614bb65614a660f6a19944d.text: The assistant's mode settings now update together automatically. This ensures all parts of the app stay in sync when modes change.

343d329ba348c99f7c3fc62fcb01841c08d1f1d9.text: The menu now marks the active assistant mode with '(current)'.

a9dd138609ae7b71e564eb51c95a17799314d731.text: The updater now tests new software in a separate, temporary space before replacing your current version. This prevents broken or incompatible files from disrupting your work.

7e8ed53562f22fd7f0f3330266f219fc81e43825.text: A small internal update improved the stability of automated checks for the command-line tool. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

0449bf89d90c35830958e53cb9819fb2d8b715ae.text: The program now checks the clipboard directly to paste text or images. This makes pasting into chat, feedback, and question boxes more reliable and consistent.

f43ff5c72d791bf0063de57f2e6a842616cdac13.text: The tool gained a new, lighter option for its assistant. This mode uses a simpler setup that limits how it interacts with other parts of the program.

6012001897b09377dd576b936d5a3a7abf273528.text: The system now shows more details when an error occurs. This helps the support team figure out what went wrong faster.

5cb3cc92bb55b8c47c601ed1e292282fc8672f07.text: The assistant can now use a new planning mode. An internal check was updated to recognize this addition.

274190d84e9cac806e7d983d88f830b16f479fdc.title: Add mode:default, mode:max, mode:plan slash commands
274190d84e9cac806e7d983d88f830b16f479fdc.summary: Added mode:default, mode:max, and mode:plan slash commands to CLI. Handlers call useChatStore.getState().setAgentMode() and inject system messages. Registered in cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts and cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts. No aliases defined.

64e9427805c82393e914edf25027eb33325884b5.title: CLI hides mode toggle at narrow terminal width
64e9427805c82393e914edf25027eb33325884b5.summary: Chat input bar suppresses AgentModeToggle when terminal width hits xs breakpoint. New isNarrowWidth flag from useTerminalLayout gates rendering in cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx and zeroes estimatedToggleWidth in cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts. Scope limited to CLI chat surface via cli/src/chat.tsx. Prevents layout overflow when height is sufficient but width is constrained.

2a022ccd9ae24f0630738c6b26c004b7a403c731.title: CLI downloader stores version in metadata file
2a022ccd9ae24f0630738c6b26c004b7a403c731.summary: CLI release script now reads version from `codebuff-metadata.json` instead of spawning binary with `--version`. `downloadBinary` writes the version to this metadata file upon successful extraction. `getCurrentVersion` becomes synchronous, checking file existence and parsing JSON. This reduces startup latency and avoids process spawn overhead during update checks.

d4a26e2750f2a18edc76d9bf3b9c902cd6a32a81.title: Add compact mode for low terminal height
d4a26e2750f2a18edc76d9bf3b9c902cd6a32a81.summary: Compact mode activates when terminal height is 'xs', removing borders and toggles from the chat input bar. This change reduces visual clutter and maximizes space for suggestions and multiline input in constrained environments. Updates span cli/src/chat.tsx, cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx, cli/src/components/thinking.tsx, and cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts. Key intercept logic for suggestion navigation is extracted into a shared handler within the input bar component.

bbd88d49a0d7a1c51b91fa62c03349132c28eacb.title: Fix CLI stdin state corruption during OSC theme detection
bbd88d49a0d7a1c51b91fa62c03349132c28eacb.summary: Refactored `sendOscQuery` in `terminal-color-detection.ts` to use event-based stdin reading instead of synchronous polling, ensuring raw mode and flow state are restored after detection. `use-theme.tsx` now initializes OSC detection after the theme watcher is set up to guarantee store updates on async completion. Added logic to skip theme recomputation if the name hasn't changed. This prevents stdin from remaining in a corrupted state (e.g., raw mode active) after startup.

08eeb71ed057de1b8303d34eaa373ab341b7b6ad.title: Fix send-message-helpers tests for streaming think tags
08eeb71ed057de1b8303d34eaa373ab341b7b6ad.summary: Removed obsolete tests for single-chunk think tag parsing. Added new tests verifying streaming behavior where closing tags do not create duplicate reasoning blocks. Changes are internal to the CLI test suite.

60d412d8ab2b9a11095fdfa0a32011380ceba4b4.title: Fix rule of hooks violation in CLI chat input bar
60d412d8ab2b9a11095fdfa0a32011380ceba4b4.summary: Moved `handleKeyIntercept` hook call to top of `ChatInputBar` component. Previously called after conditional `feedbackMode` return, violating React rules of hooks. Ensures consistent hook execution order. Affects `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`.

ceae0abf396aea5f2e5e76df7dfd68ad992f1308.title: CLI converts streamed <think> tags to reasoning blocks
ceae0abf396aea5f2e5e76df7dfd68ad992f1308.summary: New `think-tag-parser.ts` splits streamed text on `<think>`/`</think>` boundaries, emitting `textType: 'reasoning'` blocks with `thinkingOpen` state. `block-operations.ts` replaces naive append logic with `appendTextWithThinkParsingToBlocks`, shared by root stream and agent blocks. Partial tag suffixes are buffered via `getPartialTagLength` to prevent split-tag leakage across deltas. Scope: `cli/src/utils/`, `cli/src/types/chat.ts`.

8f4f6608f9fdb8c08ae534463c5d1d935eff66ea.title: Default base2 agents now spawn editor
8f4f6608f9fdb8c08ae534463c5d1d935eff66ea.summary: Removed useEditor flag from createBase2. Default mode now hardcodes editor agent spawning via isDefault check. Deleted separate base2-editor.ts definition. Editor prompt softened for non-gpt-5 models.

bbe9f8304767e8ec3175eab531bfe0b465109411.title: Tighten CLI terminal layout width breakpoints
bbe9f8304767e8ec3175eab531bfe0b465109411.summary: Width breakpoints in `cli/src/hooks/use-terminal-layout.ts` reduced: `WIDTH_XS_BREAKPOINT` 80→50, `WIDTH_MD_BREAKPOINT` 120→100, `WIDTH_LG_BREAKPOINT` 160→150. Adjusts responsive UI thresholds to trigger compact layouts earlier. Scope limited to CLI layout hook; height breakpoints unchanged. Note: doc comment still references `< 80 cols` for `xs`, mismatching new 50 threshold.

bbe9f8304767e8ec3175eab531bfe0b465109411.text: The app now switches to a smaller, more compact view when the window is narrower than before. This helps fit more information on screen without cutting off text.

274190d84e9cac806e7d983d88f830b16f479fdc.text: You can now type specific commands to switch the assistant's behavior between three preset modes. This lets you quickly adjust how the assistant responds without changing complex settings.

d4a26e2750f2a18edc76d9bf3b9c902cd6a32a81.text: When the window is short, the chat box now hides its borders and buttons to make more room for your text and suggestions.

2a022ccd9ae24f0630738c6b26c004b7a403c731.text: The tool now saves its version number in a simple text file instead of asking the program to start up every time it checks for updates. This makes the startup process faster and smoother.

64e9427805c82393e914edf25027eb33325884b5.text: The mode switch button now disappears when your terminal window is too narrow. This prevents the layout from breaking or looking messy in small windows.

60d412d8ab2b9a11095fdfa0a32011380ceba4b4.text: Fixed a small internal issue in the chat input bar to ensure it behaves consistently. This prevents occasional glitches when typing or using feedback mode.

8f4f6608f9fdb8c08ae534463c5d1d935eff66ea.text: The assistant now automatically opens its text editor when you start a new session. You no longer need to ask for it separately.

08eeb71ed057de1b8303d34eaa373ab341b7b6ad.text: The software now handles a specific type of internal message more cleanly during live updates, preventing duplicate text from appearing. This is a small, behind-the-scenes fix that improves stability without changing how you use the product.

bbd88d49a0d7a1c51b91fa62c03349132c28eacb.text: Fixed a startup glitch that could freeze keyboard input. The app now restores normal typing after checking system colors.

fdc0f6ff77a1d075c58d57cf15cb6d76b41d96a6.title: Remove message batching, use setMessages directly
fdc0f6ff77a1d075c58d57cf15cb6d76b41d96a6.summary: Removed pendingMessageUpdatesRef batching logic from useSendMessage, calling setMessages directly. Replaced queueMessageUpdate/applyMessageUpdate with direct state updates. Simplifies streaming updates by eliminating 48ms flush timeout and manual queue management.

7834671a5b93960ee216da4821e7e9484293d146.title: Codex runner uses CODEXAPIKEY and gpt-5.1-codex
7834671a5b93960ee216da4821e7e9484293d146.summary: The `CodexRunner` in `evals/buffbench/runners/codex.ts` now maps `CODEX_API_KEY` from `OPENAI_API_KEY` and switches the model from `gpt-5.1-codex-max:xhigh` to `gpt-5.1-codex`. This aligns the eval runner with our API key infrastructure and adjusts the model selection.

55d40fae1f7ec759ffa4c4b7a171c7534b2953e4.title: Refactor CLI send-message hook into modular helpers
55d40fae1f7ec759ffa4c4b7a171c7534b2953e4.summary: Split monolithic `use-send-message` hook into dedicated modules: `stream-state.ts` for mutable stream context, `helpers/send-message.ts` for message prep logic, and utilities for bash/image processing. Added `ts-pattern` dependency for type-safe match statements. Internal refactor only; no user-facing behavior changes.

a77640d86b6a0a36d02fd56722d9c56ebee86fa0.title: CLI send-message hook refactored with extracted helpers
a77640d86b6a0a36d02fd56722d9c56ebee86fa0.summary: useSendMessage simplified by extracting createEventHandlerState and createRunConfig helpers. Chat.tsx and useSendMessage.ts remove redundant state setters and options. sdk-event-handlers.ts renames EventHandlerContext to EventHandlerState. Fixes type errors in the CLI chat pipeline.

92a7fd201b02dc80c3408f37fbecd7a9d2d25462.title: Fix CLI ESLint unused var and duplicate import warnings
92a7fd201b02dc80c3408f37fbecd7a9d2d25462.summary: Removed unused variables and duplicate imports across CLI source and release scripts. Fixed `getCurrentVersion` in `cli/release/index.js` and `cli/release-staging/index.js` to ignore stderr and drop unused `reject`/`errorOutput`. Reordered imports in `cli/release/postinstall.js`, `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts`, and various React components to satisfy lint rules. Scope covers CLI core, release tooling, and build scripts.

d7c58203be448e764091f4a1ace649778f31728a.title: Evals bump claude-code to 2.0.56, pin model ID
d7c58203be448e764091f4a1ace649778f31728a.summary: evals/buffbench/runners/claude.ts passes claude-opus-4-5-20251101 to --model instead of alias opus. evals/package.json bumps @anthropic-ai/claude-code to ^2.0.56 and drops @anthropic-ai/sdk. BuffBench runner now pins dated model ID; SDK dep unused by runner.

0a44c0a2733540c97459a99ac77c0e684b0d6660.title: CLI: Add OSC detection timeouts and upgrade OpenTUI
0a44c0a2733540c97459a99ac77c0e684b0d6660.summary: CLI theme detection now enforces strict timeouts to prevent hangs. `terminal-color-detection.ts` introduces `withTimeout` helper and caps OSC queries at 500ms/2000ms. `osc-subprocess.ts` adds a 5s hard timeout and cleans up debug logging. `theme-system.ts` races detection against a 3s global timeout. OpenTUI dependencies upgraded from 0.1.46 to ^0.1.55.

b71bb469a43dea417bca0074e86030b73297a566.title: Simplify bash command execution API in CLI
b71bb469a43dea417bca0074e86030b73297a566.summary: Refactors bash command handling in `cli/src/commands/router.ts` to export a simplified `runBashCommand` function. The new API automatically determines ghost vs direct mode based on `streamingAgents` and `isChainInProgress` state, removing the need for explicit options objects. Updates `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` to use this new function for immediate command execution when arguments are provided to `/bash`.

001cf58e894f23a2755c163ddc8e0a6c3d7bb2ee.title: Remove unused AgentStep type and SDK imports from evals scaffolding
001cf58e894f23a2755c163ddc8e0a6c3d7bb2ee.summary: Removed `AgentStep`, `ToolResultBlockParam`, and `ToolUseBlock` types along with `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` imports from `evals/scaffolding.ts`. The `steps` array in `loopMainPrompt` now uses `any[]` instead of `AgentStep[]`. This cleanup eliminates dead code and unused dependencies in the evals subsystem.

afde2ad4554beaf169454cafe821a670be200bc4.title: Extract send-message helpers into dedicated module
afde2ad4554beaf169454cafe821a670be200bc4.summary: Refactored `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` by extracting complex logic into new `cli/src/utils/send-message-helpers.ts`. This isolates pure functions for block manipulation, message creation, and state updates, removing React dependencies from these utilities. Added comprehensive unit tests in `cli/src/utils/__tests__/send-message-helpers.test.ts` to cover the extracted logic. Scope limited to CLI internal structure; no user-facing behavior changes.

7834671a5b93960ee216da4821e7e9484293d146.text: A small internal update lets the system use the standard login key and a different AI model.

afde2ad4554beaf169454cafe821a670be200bc4.text: The team reorganized the internal code for sending messages to make it cleaner and easier to test. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

92a7fd201b02dc80c3408f37fbecd7a9d2d25462.text: The team cleaned up small, unused pieces of the tool's internal setup. This change doesn't affect how you use the product.

55d40fae1f7ec759ffa4c4b7a171c7534b2953e4.text: The internal code that handles sending messages was reorganized into smaller, clearer parts. This is an internal cleanup that makes the software easier to maintain, with no changes to how you use it.

001cf58e894f23a2755c163ddc8e0a6c3d7bb2ee.text: The team removed unused background tools from the testing system. This change cleans up the code but does not affect how the product works for users.

a77640d86b6a0a36d02fd56722d9c56ebee86fa0.text: The chat feature was cleaned up behind the scenes. You might see fewer glitches when sending messages.

0a44c0a2733540c97459a99ac77c0e684b0d6660.text: The app now stops waiting for a response if the check takes too long. This prevents the program from getting stuck during startup.

fdc0f6ff77a1d075c58d57cf15cb6d76b41d96a6.text: The app now updates messages instantly instead of waiting to group them together. This makes the assistant's responses appear smoother and faster.

b71bb469a43dea417bca0074e86030b73297a566.text: The tool now automatically chooses the best way to run your commands based on current activity. You no longer need to specify how it should work.

d7c58203be448e764091f4a1ace649778f31728a.text: The system now uses a specific, fixed version of the AI model for testing to ensure results are consistent and reliable. This is an internal update that does not change how the product works for you.

482e5facf248979f179b53e3cbc7e0dca5b41db5.title: Buffbench runners pass API keys from process env
482e5facf248979f179b53e3cbc7e0dca5b41db5.summary: agent-runner.ts injects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY from process.env into the runner env for claude and codex agents. ClaudeRunner.ts drops the CLAUDE_CODE_KEY fallback that previously set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Affects evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts and evals/buffbench/runners/claude.ts. Keys are added only when present in process.env, preserving existing env otherwise.

286c97c3f69fecbd7b12738df0694e09b37a80b8.title: Disable announcement banner in CLI chat-store
286c97c3f69fecbd7b12738df0694e09b37a80b8.summary: Set isAnnouncementVisible to false in initialState within cli/src/state/chat-store.ts. Hides the announcement banner by default for CLI sessions. Affects CLI state initialization only.

9ae00ce564cf62ba71ec333efd7dc6f3a24ca175.title: Revert agent runner key injection
9ae00ce564cf62ba71ec333efd7dc6f3a24ca175.summary: Reverts commit "Update agent runners to use the appropriate key" in evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts. Removed logic in runAgentOnCommit that explicitly copied ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY from process.env into the runner's env object. ClaudeRunner in evals/buffbench/runners/claude.ts now handles key resolution directly via CLAUDE_CODE_KEY fallback. Scope limited to internal buffbench evaluation runners.

b26ab6b7434ab25e2bead2ec54f676649603213f.title: Fix image banner flash on Ctrl+V text paste
b26ab6b7434ab25e2bead2ec54f676649603213f.summary: Chat keyboard dispatcher now checks clipboard content synchronously before routing paste actions. Ctrl+V triggers a generic paste action that prioritizes image detection; if no image exists, text is inserted immediately. This prevents the brief appearance of the image placeholder banner when pasting text. Changes affect cli/src/chat.tsx, cli/src/hooks/use-chat-keyboard.ts, and cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts.

06fd157fe7987fc9e038696580c3f5d0fa30aa4b.title: CLI bash command color change from red to green
06fd157fe7987fc9e038696580c3f5d0fa30aa4b.summary: Bash command display color changed from `theme.error` (red) to `theme.success` (green) in `cli/src/components/terminal-command-display.tsx`. Input mode config for `bash` updated from `color: 'error'` to `color: 'success'` in `cli/src/utils/input-modes.ts`. Command header refactored into shared `commandHeader` variable, reused across no-output and output cases.

a759cb9d36b85b618122e8a256b15d405f192a81.title: Remove git-evals, migrate to buffbench
a759cb9d36b85b618122e8a256b15d405f192a81.summary: Deleted the deprecated `evals/git-evals` directory, consolidating evaluation logic into `evals/buffbench`. Imports in `gen-evals.ts` and `gen-repo-eval.ts` updated to reference local `setup-test-repo` and `pick-commits` modules within the new directory. Removed CLI entry point from `setup-test-repo.ts` and associated email reporting scripts. This change reduces internal code duplication and aligns the eval infrastructure with the current buffbench architecture.

a87657c14662e0ef5c405e8f56d4f79f0f152729.title: Refine editor agent prompt and tool extraction
a87657c14662e0ef5c405e8f56d4f79f0f152729.summary: Updates `createCodeEditor` in `.agents/editor/editor.ts` to conditionally omit `<think>` instructions for `gpt-5` and explicitly forbid `set_output` usage. The `handleSteps` generator now extracts only `<codebuff_tool_call>` blocks from assistant text via regex, stripping commentary before yielding `STEP_TEXT`. This ensures cleaner tool execution and prevents output pollution from model reasoning traces.

db30e8c193515679b6ced7ca24cf99f050a99089.title: BuffBench supports external Claude and Codex CLI agents
db30e8c193515679b6ced7ca24cf99f050a99089.summary: BuffBench evals now accept `external:claude` and `external:codex` agent identifiers to benchmark against Anthropic and OpenAI CLI tools. Implementation adds `ClaudeRunner` and `CodexRunner` classes in `evals/buffbench/runners/` that spawn CLI processes with `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and parse `stream-json` output into internal `AgentStep` events. `run-buffbench.ts` updated with `parseAgentId` to route external types, while `agent-runner.ts` delegates execution to the new runner interface. Requires global installation of `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` or `@openai/codex` and respective API keys in environment.

387cbcfa0baaef8026e24eb202aeb6e82b14828e.title: Add image support to CLI
387cbcfa0baaef8026e24eb202aeb6e82b14828e.summary: CLI now supports image attachment via /image command and clipboard paste. New utils handle image validation, dimension calculation, and terminal rendering (jimp, terminal-image). Chat store tracks pendingImages; router and command registry integrate image mode. Includes UI components for image blocks, cards, thumbnails, and input/pending banners.

9ae00ce564cf62ba71ec333efd7dc6f3a24ca175.text: The system now finds its own password automatically, so nothing changes for you.

06fd157fe7987fc9e038696580c3f5d0fa30aa4b.text: When you run a command, it now appears in green instead of red. This visual update indicates the command was accepted, helping you distinguish it from error messages.

286c97c3f69fecbd7b12738df0694e09b37a80b8.text: The startup message in the command-line tool is now hidden by default. This makes the interface cleaner when you open the chat.

b26ab6b7434ab25e2bead2ec54f676649603213f.text: Pasting text no longer flashes a placeholder image banner. This is a minor fix that removes a visual glitch.

387cbcfa0baaef8026e24eb202aeb6e82b14828e.text: You can now add pictures to your messages by typing a command or pasting them from your clipboard. The app checks the images and shows them directly in the chat.

cc9334c64de77cce03e96f47dd083d245f3f2ba9.text: The app now checks your screen colors directly instead of using a separate helper program. This makes startup faster and smoother.

482e5facf248979f179b53e3cbc7e0dca5b41db5.text: This internal update standardizes how the system accesses secure credentials for its testing tools. It ensures that the necessary permissions are passed correctly from the server environment, without changing how users interact with the product.

a759cb9d36b85b618122e8a256b15d405f192a81.text: We cleaned up internal tools used to test the assistant's accuracy by removing an old system and merging its functions into a newer one. This change does not affect how you use the product, but it helps us maintain and improve the assistant more efficiently behind the scenes.

db30e8c193515679b6ced7ca24cf99f050a99089.text: The testing system can now check performance against external AI tools from Anthropic and OpenAI. This is an internal change, so it does not affect how you use the product.

a87657c14662e0ef5c405e8f56d4f79f0f152729.text: The system now hides internal reasoning notes from the final answer and only shows useful actions. This makes the results cleaner and easier to read.

c163bd75e46e612d8c18d9ab67e874836c8fa574.title: Log OpenRouter error details in chat completions
c163bd75e46e612d8c18d9ab67e874836c8fa574.summary: Added `openrouterError` to the error logging payload in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`. The handler now checks if the caught exception is an instance of `OpenRouterError` and serializes it via `toJSON()`. This provides specific upstream failure details for debugging chat completions requests.

483ca19b1acc0d765710d6250fdd79ee3f006677.title: Nightly buffbench eval switches to lite mode
483ca19b1acc0d765710d6250fdd79ee3f006677.summary: evals/buffbench/main-nightly.ts replaces base2-fast and base2-fast-no-validation with base2-lite in the agents array. taskConcurrency drops from 5 to 3. Scope limited to nightly eval config; no user-facing surfaces affected.

56ecce97fc37d6e98ea499132138fc28cf9d4170.title: base2-editor agent added with pre-edit think phase
56ecce97fc37d6e98ea499132138fc28cf9d4170.summary: New `base2-editor` orchestrator agent delegates implementation to the `editor` agent via `useEditor` flag in `createBase2`. The `editor` agent prompt now mandates `<think>` tags before and between tool calls to enforce reasoning before implementation. Internal agent definitions in `.agents/base2/` and `.agents/editor/` updated to support this delegation and thinking constraint.

ba05886551ad15b488ce6554959fbe7ecb67453e.title: Add minimal and none reasoning effort options to agent types
ba05886551ad15b488ce6554959fbe7ecb67453e.summary: Extended reasoning effort enums in `AgentDefinition`, `OpenRouterReasoningOptions`, and `DynamicAgentDefinitionSchema` to include 'minimal' and 'none'. Updates cover core type definitions and OpenRouter SDK provider options. Ensures type consistency across agent templates and dynamic schema validation.

416a550321ba403f602876bcbd4c07ea47900ed5.title: Best-of-n agents think before selecting or implementing
416a550321ba403f602876bcbd4c07ea47900ed5.summary: Prompt changes in `best-of-n-selector.ts` and `editor-implementor.ts` require Sonnet/Opus agents to use extensive `<think>` tags before choosing or writing code. `editor-best-of-n.ts` reduces default parallel implementors from 4 to 3 (default) and 5 to 4 (max), while `base2.ts` forbids passing prompts to spawned editor agents. Selector output now mandates a short reason alongside the `implementationId`.

7c4c0f7c4aa7fbd60a9abbc5a8a930896ed9dd4c.title: Disable gemini in best-of-n editor max mode
7c4c0f7c4aa7fbd60a9abbc5a8a930896ed9dd4c.summary: Gemini models removed from MAX_MODEL_PATTERN in .agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts. Upstream tool errors regarding missing thought signatures forced disabling. Internal agent logic only, no public API changes.

e08f638d4a872d0c9bda1459472ed5f0720223dc.title: CLI bash command context unified for LLM
e08f638d4a872d0c9bda1459472ed5f0720223dc.summary: Refactored CLI to unify bash command context handling for the LLM. Manual commands executed via `/` or ghost mode are now consistently tracked in `pendingBashMessages` with an `addedToHistory` flag, and formatted into a `<user_terminal_commands>` block via `formatBashContextForPrompt` before sending to the model. This replaces the previous split logic where some commands were excluded from LLM context or handled via a separate `pendingToolResults` store. Scope covers `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/commands/router.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`, and `cli/src/utils/bash-messages.ts`. The `PendingToolResult` type and related store actions were removed in favor of the unified `PendingBashMessage` flow.

8a3d8338e4d6d3cbb867738a67237e66820dbbf4.title: CLI: simplify bash command handling
8a3d8338e4d6d3cbb867738a67237e66820dbbf4.summary: Refactored CLI bash command execution to remove AI context injection. Terminal commands now update UI history only, not LLM context. New `bash-messages.ts` utility handles message construction. Scope limited to `cli/src/utils/bash-messages.ts`, `cli/src/commands/router.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`.

dfbdff0eec8fc81b0022b0b2f771d7fb7ab39b97.title: spawn-agent-utils.ts coerce null prompt to empty string
dfbdff0eec8fc81b0022b0b2f771d7fb7ab39b97.summary: validateAgentInput in spawn-agent-utils.ts coerces null or undefined prompt to empty string before safeParse. Prevents throw on missing prompt when schema requires it. Scope: packages/agent-runtime. Mechanism: nullish coalescing operator ?? ''.

091c6d50b52bdf05cee2bb5910bc5d426d9c30e4.title: Introduce base2-lite agent with grok-4.1-fast model
091c6d50b52bdf05cee2bb5910bc5d426d9c30e4.summary: New `base2-lite` orchestrator variant added to `.agents/base2/`, configured with `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast` model and `commander-lite` sub-agent. This lite mode disables `write_todos` and `code-reviewer-opus`, delegating implementation to `editor-gpt-5` instead of heavy opus editors. `editor.ts` refactored into `createCodeEditor` factory supporting `gpt-5` and `opus` models, while `editor-lite.ts` moved to `.agents-graveyard/`. Scope covers internal agent definitions in `.agents/` directory.

483ca19b1acc0d765710d6250fdd79ee3f006677.text: The system now uses a simpler, faster method for its overnight checks. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

8a3d8338e4d6d3cbb867738a67237e66820dbbf4.text: The app now handles terminal commands separately from chat conversations. This keeps your chat history cleaner and makes the assistant’s responses more focused.

c163bd75e46e612d8c18d9ab67e874836c8fa574.text: Developers improved internal tools to see more details when chat features fail. This helps the team fix problems faster.

7c4c0f7c4aa7fbd60a9abbc5a8a930896ed9dd4c.text: A specific AI model was removed from the editor's advanced mode because it caused errors. This change is internal and does not affect the product's public features.

091c6d50b52bdf05cee2bb5910bc5d426d9c30e4.text: A new assistant mode now uses a faster, lighter model to handle tasks. This change is internal and may make responses quicker without changing what the assistant can do.

e08f638d4a872d0c9bda1459472ed5f0720223dc.text: The assistant now sees all commands you run in the terminal, even those started by typing or suggestions. This helps it understand your recent actions and provide more accurate answers.

ba05886551ad15b488ce6554959fbe7ecb67453e.text: The assistant can now choose to think very little or not at all before answering. This gives you more control over how much effort it puts into each reply.

56ecce97fc37d6e98ea499132138fc28cf9d4170.text: A small internal update improves how the software plans tasks before acting. This helps the assistant make better decisions.

dfbdff0eec8fc81b0022b0b2f771d7fb7ab39b97.text: The system now handles missing instructions by treating them as empty, preventing a crash. This ensures the assistant starts correctly even if no prompt is provided.

416a550321ba403f602876bcbd4c07ea47900ed5.text: The system now spends more time thinking before choosing or writing code. It uses fewer parallel workers by default. This change is internal.

d0786316bad375c9ca02e150efda4a5bbfc099c0.title: Fix empty multi-select response via undefined stripping
d0786316bad375c9ca02e150efda4a5bbfc099c0.summary: Multi-select answers now omit `selectedOptions` when skipped, preventing `undefined` in JSON payloads. Added `removeUndefinedValues` in `cli/src/utils/codebuff-client.ts` to recursively strip undefined keys before serialization. Updates `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx` to return only `questionIndex` for empty arrays.

4e41963236dbe8b8b0884fdbb2b00102e70f304b.title: SDK run integration test use APIKEYENVVAR
4e41963236dbe8b8b0884fdbb2b00102e70f304b.summary: SDK run integration test replace hardcoded '12345' API key with process.env[API_KEY_ENV_VAR]. Fixes test failure when API key missing. Scope: sdk/src/__tests__/run.integration.test.ts. Imports API_KEY_ENV_VAR from @codebuff/common/old-constants.

c0a8dfbb7fd0023dc051aec262bdda338815fd73.title: Code search includes hidden config directories by default
c0a8dfbb7fd0023dc051aec262bdda338815fd73.summary: Code search now automatically scans hidden directories like .agents, .github, and .claude alongside standard project files. The tool passes these paths explicitly to the underlying ripgrep process, ensuring agent definitions and CI workflows are discoverable without manual flag configuration. Missing directories are ignored by ripgrep, preventing errors. This change affects the sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts implementation.

03827cfd2f388ea2117cd607fac04f8dc6aedc28.title: OpenRouter error logging includes response text
03827cfd2f388ea2117cd607fac04f8dc6aedc28.summary: OpenRouter error handling in `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` now logs the raw `response.text()` alongside `response.statusText` for both streaming and non-streaming requests. Previously, only the status text was available, obscuring upstream error details. This change improves debugging visibility for failed API calls within the web client.

a8f1af16b1fe7fe8d6c9fb3d6839232faea43564.title: Standardize message content to part arrays in types
a8f1af16b1fe7fe8d6c9fb3d6839232faea43564.summary: Message types in util-types.ts now require content as part arrays instead of strings. AuxiliaryData renamed to AuxiliaryMessageData and exported. Deprecates timeToLive, keepDuringTruncation, keepLastTags in favor of tags. Updates context-pruner.ts and task-researcher.ts to handle array content.

780933c2773c184d84d5bba9e3d500642f7c9bfc.title: CLI bash ghost UI with dashed box and batch flush
780933c2773c184d84d5bba9e3d500642f7c9bfc.summary: CLI bash execution adds ephemeral ghost messages rendered with a dashed border box in `cli/src/components/pending-bash-message.tsx` via `TerminalCommandDisplay`. Completed commands batch-flush to chat history instead of removing individually, fixing UI jitter during rapid execution. `executeBashCommand` in `cli/src/commands/router.ts` now accepts a `ghost` flag to toggle between direct history insertion and pending state management. `formatCwd` extracted to `cli/src/utils/path-helpers.ts` for shared use.

6343346dabbde8f9d96a1fe1e65ec062e9cc4acb.title: Unconditional editor subagent availability
6343346dabbde8f9d96a1fe1e65ec062e9cc4acb.summary: Best-of-n editor configuration removes `isDefault` and `isMax` guards for `best-of-n-selector-gemini`, `editor-implementor-gemini`, and `editor-implementor-gpt-5` in `spawnableAgents`. Agents now always register in the array regardless of tier flags. Change isolated to `.agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts`.

de8732e50334a2b2c36715e242966b1cfd39981e.title: Native tool calls replace text parsing in agent runtime
de8732e50334a2b2c36715e242966b1cfd39981e.summary: Agent runtime switches from custom text-based tool call parsing to native tool calls, updating `parse-tool-calls-from-text` logic and tool parameter definitions in `common/src/tools/params`. The `use-send-message` hook now requires `parentAgentId` to correctly attribute subagent tool calls, and `add-message` output schema changes from `emptyToolResultSchema` to `textToolResultSchema`. This affects CLI, shared core, and agent definitions like `editor-best-of-n` which now use `set_output` and improved spawn result extraction.

515b7693ac6b2f8378ca9df3d5d8bc4de82744e4.title: CLI bash tool results and exit status preservation
515b7693ac6b2f8378ca9df3d5d8bc4de82744e4.summary: CLI now handles bash tool results directly, preserving exit status and routing queued messages through the command router. New `PendingBashMessage` state and `addBashMessageToHistory` logic in `router.ts` enable immediate placeholder display and asynchronous output updates. `MessageBlock` renders bash metadata (cwd, timestamp) separately from standard user messages. `use-send-message.ts` injects `pendingToolResults` into `client.run` via `extraToolResults`, ensuring AI context continuity for user-executed commands.

10614922a610bd81b6f9491aa50eec0f47a193fa.title: Drop opus base2 variants, retune best-of-n model pattern
10614922a610bd81b6f9491aa50eec0f47a193fa.summary: Deleted base2-opus and base2-opus-chill-on-reading-files agent definitions; createBase2 mode union narrowed to fast|default|max, model hardcoded to anthropic/claude-opus-4.5, chillOnReadingFiles option removed, and subagent spawn lists simplified. MAX_MODEL_PATTERN in editor-best-of-n.ts swapped two editor-implementor-opus slots for editor-implementor-gemini; best-of-n-selector.ts adds reasoningOptions.max_tokens 4000 when isOpus. Scope: .agents/base2/base2.ts, .agents/editor/best-of-n/best-of-n-selector.ts, .agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts, evals/buffbench/main.ts. BuffBench agents list reduced from three opus variants to base2 and base2-max.

c0a8dfbb7fd0023dc051aec262bdda338815fd73.text: The search tool now automatically looks inside hidden folders for extra project files. You can find these files without changing any settings.

780933c2773c184d84d5bba9e3d500642f7c9bfc.text: The app now shows a temporary box for running commands to prevent screen flickering. Finished results appear together in the chat history instead of updating one by one.

d0786316bad375c9ca02e150efda4a5bbfc099c0.text: A small fix ensures that if you skip a question, the system correctly records that you did not answer, rather than saving an error.

a8f1af16b1fe7fe8d6c9fb3d6839232faea43564.text: The system now uses a stricter format for storing messages, which helps it handle complex information more reliably. This internal update improves how the assistant processes and keeps track of conversation details.

515b7693ac6b2f8378ca9df3d5d8bc4de82744e4.text: The assistant now shows the outcome of your commands immediately and keeps track of their success or failure. This helps the assistant understand your actions better and respond more accurately.

4e41963236dbe8b8b0884fdbb2b00102e70f304b.text: The assistant now checks for a saved login key instead of using a fixed test value. This helps the assistant work correctly when you use the product.

de8732e50334a2b2c36715e242966b1cfd39981e.text: The assistant now uses a more reliable method to understand and execute commands, reducing errors when handling complex tasks.

03827cfd2f388ea2117cd607fac04f8dc6aedc28.text: When the assistant fails to answer, the system now saves the full error message from the service it calls, not just a short code. This helps the team fix problems faster. You will not see any difference in how the assistant works.

6343346dabbde8f9d96a1fe1e65ec062e9cc4acb.text: The editor now always has access to its best selection of AI writing helpers. This small internal update ensures these helpers are available for everyone, regardless of account type.

10614922a610bd81b6f9491aa50eec0f47a193fa.text: The system now uses fewer, simpler settings for its writing assistant. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

f4ae69009504ff9958e25e76982fc8aad3843aba.title: read-files tool description cleanup
f4ae69009504ff9958e25e76982fc8aad3843aba.summary: Refined the `read-files` tool description in `common/src/tools/params/tool/read-files.ts`. Removed redundant grammar (`Read the multiple files`) and deleted the explicit warning against re-reading already accessed files. This streamlines the prompt for the core tool.

32dc0343d7e0bff59d25cf1a2b9245b5671c0429.title: CLI ask-user Other field uses MultilineInput
32dc0343d7e0bff59d25cf1a2b9245b5671c0429.summary: Refactors the 'Other' free-text field in the CLI ask-user form to use the shared MultilineInput component instead of custom manual character handling. This removes logic for space, backspace, and character input from use-keyboard-navigation.ts, delegating text editing and cursor management to MultilineInput. The change ensures consistent input behavior across the CLI and fixes issues where the 'Other' field did not handle multi-line or complex cursor movements correctly.

11a7a0ce795c06b73f27168627aa1b203363dd3e.title: use-send-message suppresses errors on user-initiated abort
11a7a0ce795c06b73f27168627aa1b203363dd3e.summary: Added `wasAbortedByUserRef` to `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` to track user-initiated cancellations. The `abortController.signal` listener now sets this ref to true. In the error handling block, if this flag is true, the function logs the cancellation and returns early, preventing the display of error messages for intentional aborts. This ensures that user-initiated stops do not trigger misleading error UIs.

ce45b623283bf28c506851791b987a1ef7d24f13.title: Prevent auto-topup disable on transient errors
ce45b623283bf28c506851791b987a1ef7d24f13.summary: Auto-topup no longer disables on transient Stripe or network failures in packages/billing/src/auto-topup.ts. validateAutoTopupStatus and checkAndTriggerAutoTopup now only call disableAutoTopup for AutoTopupValidationError and AutoTopupPaymentError. Other errors return a blocked status or throw without changing the user's setting, allowing retry on next trigger.

2ff04a605d1bc4152b2e674d27b7a1ae8b2cf4a7.title: CLI suppress low credit warnings for auto top-up users
2ff04a605d1bc4152b2e674d27b7a1ae8b2cf4a7.summary: CLI low-credit banner suppressed for auto top-up users with balance > 0. Backend `genUsageResponse` and `usage-service.ts` expose `autoTopupEnabled` from `user.auto_topup_enabled` column. `triggerMonthlyResetAndGrant` returns `MonthlyResetResult` instead of `Date`, avoiding redundant queries. Applies to CLI, Web API, and shared contracts in `common/src/actions.ts`.

9bfbea1d4e17832f2fed4e58702550e75b34fdcb.title: CLI auto-shows usage banner on low credits
9bfbea1d4e17832f2fed4e58702550e75b34fdcb.summary: New useUsageMonitor hook in Chat component continuously polls usage data and triggers input mode 'usage' when credit thresholds are crossed. This replaces the previous manual-only banner display, ensuring users see balance warnings without explicit commands. Covers CLI chat interface and usage query hooks; auto-hides after timeout.

6d6554d5d0102a8ecbb6466782719b7634eef9e8.title: Update CLI input placeholder text
6d6554d5d0102a8ecbb6466782719b7634eef9e8.summary: Replaced generic 'type a message...' placeholder with 'enter a coding task or / for commands' in default and usage input modes. This change clarifies expected user input and highlights slash command availability directly in the prompt interface. Modified `cli/src/utils/input-modes.ts`.

791e18173b458b7d12734163484349b0157ee4d4.title: Max mode editor drops gemini for gpt-5
791e18173b458b7d12734163484349b0157ee4d4.summary: Max mode editor implementor spawning replaces gemini agents with a fixed opus/gpt-5 pattern. Default mode retains gemini, while max mode now uses a 10-slot MAX_MODEL_PATTERN array in .agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts. Default max mode parallel agent count reduces from 6 to 5.

d05275532c93db7601d0c45d5740b32db33fd084.title: useChatKeyboard hook consolidates CLI key handling
d05275532c93db7601d0c45d5740b32db33fd084.summary: New cli/src/hooks/use-chat-keyboard.ts centralizes key dispatch via resolveChatKeyboardAction from cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts, replacing scattered useKeyboard calls. ChatInputBar onKeyIntercept gates nav keys only when suggestions active and lastEditDueToNav false. Scope: cli/src/chat.tsx, components, hooks. ChatKeyboardHandlers type enumerates slash/mention/history/feedback actions.

40b0eaac602f290e5127508fe56c6bdcae1b990e.title: Add Opus model support to Base2 agents and BuffBench evals
40b0eaac602f290e5127508fe56c6bdcae1b990e.summary: Introduced `base2-opus` and `base2-opus-chill-on-reading-files` agent definitions, extending `createBase2` to support an 'opus' mode that configures orchestrators with `editor-best-of-n-opus` and specific prompt behaviors like `chillOnReadingFiles`. Updated BuffBench evaluation scripts (`main.ts`, `main-single-eval.ts`) to run these new Opus agents against benchmark tasks. This change enables testing and deployment of Opus-based agent configurations within the Freebuff agent framework.

6d6554d5d0102a8ecbb6466782719b7634eef9e8.text: The text shown in the input box changed to say 'enter a coding task or / for commands' instead of just 'type a message'. This tells you what to type and shows you can use a slash to see commands.

32dc0343d7e0bff59d25cf1a2b9245b5671c0429.text: The typing box for custom answers now works like the rest of the app, fixing bugs where text or cursor movement broke. This makes typing and editing answers smoother and more reliable.

2ff04a605d1bc4152b2e674d27b7a1ae8b2cf4a7.text: If you have automatic top-up enabled and your account has money in it, the app no longer shows a low balance warning. This removes unnecessary alerts for users who are already set up to pay automatically.

d05275532c93db7601d0c45d5740b32db33fd084.text: The app now manages keyboard shortcuts in one central place instead of many scattered spots. This internal cleanup keeps the typing experience steady and predictable.

ce45b623283bf28c506851791b987a1ef7d24f13.text: Temporary internet or payment glitches no longer turn off automatic balance refills. The system now waits to try again later instead of stopping the feature.

40b0eaac602f290e5127508fe56c6bdcae1b990e.text: The internal testing system now includes a new, more capable version of the AI assistant. This allows the team to check how well this updated assistant performs on various tasks before making it available to users.

9bfbea1d4e17832f2fed4e58702550e75b34fdcb.text: The app now automatically displays a warning message when your credit balance gets low. You no longer need to manually check your remaining credits to see if you are running out.

791e18173b458b7d12734163484349b0157ee4d4.text: In high-performance mode, the editor now uses a fixed set of alternative AI models instead of the previous default. This means fewer simultaneous AI agents run, but the available models are standardized for this specific mode. Standard mode remains unchanged.

f4ae69009504ff9958e25e76982fc8aad3843aba.text: The instructions for the file-reading tool were simplified. This small cleanup helps the assistant understand the tool's purpose more clearly.

11a7a0ce795c06b73f27168627aa1b203363dd3e.text: The software now recognizes when you stop a process on purpose. It will no longer show a scary error message for these intentional stops.

2029e1e9119422e8e2072f925b451ef94c3d7dc6.title: Buffbench judges switch to GPT-5 and Gemini
2029e1e9119422e8e2072f925b451ef94c3d7dc6.summary: evals/buffbench/judge.ts replaces the three-agent judge pool with two: openai/gpt-5.1 and google/gemini-3-pro-preview. Anthropic claude-sonnet-4.5 removed from active judging. judgeAgents structure changed from array to Record<string, AgentDefinition>, runSingleJudge now accepts judgeAgentId string instead of numeric index. Parallel execution reduced from 3 to 2 judges.

751e74decde37bd796a8b8ce1cdbb993b3aa79aa.title: Billing monthly reset uses grantCreditOperation with tx
751e74decde37bd796a8b8ce1cdbb993b3aa79aa.summary: Monthly reset grant path in `packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts` now calls `grantCreditOperation` with the active `tx` instead of `processAndGrantCredit`. Ensures free and referral credit grants share the same transaction as the `next_quota_reset` update, preventing idle transaction errors. Scope limited to billing package internal grant logic. Referral bonus path receives identical `tx` propagation.

7feec3606d35b96b19d004c93867a4c2ab2ec349.title: Fix invalid API key error code from 404 to 401
7feec3606d35b96b19d004c93867a4c2ab2ec349.summary: The /api/v1/me endpoint now returns HTTP 401 instead of 404 when an invalid API key is provided. The CLI ReferralBanner component was updated to detect this 401 error and display a specific 'Session expired' message rather than a generic failure. This change affects the web API handler in _get.ts and the CLI UI in referral-banner.tsx.

170f4ac03f25ef3c2252ed382a85a261e2ec9b00.title: CLI usage banner logic extracted to utils
170f4ac03f25ef3c2252ed382a85a261e2ec9b00.summary: Refactor moves usage banner state logic from `cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx` to new `cli/src/utils/usage-banner-state.ts`. Functions `getBannerColorLevel`, `generateUsageBannerText`, and `shouldAutoShowBanner` now handle credit thresholds and display text. `usage-banner.tsx` imports these utils, reducing component complexity. Tests added for new utility functions.

8bca30fb396f7d22efecde0b4a23ff770b5b79d0.title: Reduce best-of-n editor max mode to 5
8bca30fb396f7d22efecde0b4a23ff770b5b79d0.summary: Internal constant `MAX_N` in `.agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts` decreased from 6 to 5. Limits candidate generation for the `best-of-n-selector-opus` agent. No user-facing behavior change.

341069192c57970279896134d88fa7b986589a11.title: CLI referral banner uses static URL, drops per-user API fetch
341069192c57970279896134d88fa7b986589a11.summary: ReferralBanner component replaced dynamic useUserDetailsQuery fetch with static `${WEBSITE_URL}/referrals` link. UserField type in codebuff-api.ts removed `referral_link` from union and mapped types. Input mode placeholder in input-modes.ts changed from code-entry prompt to generic text. Scope: cli/src/components/referral-banner.tsx, cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts, cli/src/utils/input-modes.ts.

05880abe323b6862e31bc5691a6b42f68cf89cda.title: CLI abstracts web API details via CodebuffApiClient
05880abe323b6862e31bc5691a6b42f68cf89cda.summary: New `CodebuffApiClient` abstracts web API interactions, replacing direct `fetch` calls in login, user details, publishing, and referral flows. Refactored hooks and commands now use `getApiClient()` and `setApiClientAuthToken()`, improving error handling and type safety. Covers `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts`, `cli/src/commands/publish.ts`, `cli/src/commands/referral.ts`, and related hooks.

ea119d20250121da03859f9303b2533c2ae3fbd0.title: Opus thinker best-of-n replaces GPT-5
ea119d20250121da03859f9303b2533c2ae3fbd0.summary: The max-mode thinker best-of-n workflow now uses `anthropic/claude-opus-4.5` via new `thinker-best-of-n-opus` and `thinker-selector-opus` agents, replacing the previous GPT-5 configuration. `createThinkerBestOfN` and `createThinkerSelector` factories conditionally spawn the Opus selector and apply distinct step handlers for Opus vs default models. Changes are isolated to `.agents/thinker/best-of-n/` and `.agents/base2/base2.ts`, updating agent IDs and spawn prompts for max-tier complexity solving.

5a0568271a9913e329b5138137911df628f72851.title: Fix tab auto-complete when slash menu disabled
5a0568271a9913e329b5138137911df628f72851.summary: CLI chat input now suppresses slash menu keyboard handling when `disableSlashSuggestions` is active. The `useSuggestionMenuHandlers` hook accepts a `disableSlashMenu` prop, derived from `getInputModeConfig(inputMode)`, which early-returns in `handleSlashMenuKey` to prevent tab interference. This ensures the file menu tab handler remains functional when slash suggestions are disabled. Changes are scoped to `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-menu-handlers.ts`.

605f55477bcb6983b0e450b8259e8159d096c257.title: Revert tool call to message conversion in stream parser
605f55477bcb6983b0e450b8259e8159d096c257.summary: Reverts logic converting `PrintModeToolCall` chunks into assistant messages within `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`. Removes `assistantMessages` accumulation and related `onResponseChunk` interceptors. `messageHistory` now directly appends joined `fullResponseChunks` instead of reconstructed message objects. Type signature in `tool-stream-parser.ts` retains `PrintModeToolCall` union but drops message conversion side effects.

170f4ac03f25ef3c2252ed382a85a261e2ec9b00.text: The code that decides when and how to show usage warnings was moved to a separate part of the program. This change is internal and does not affect how the tool works or looks for users.

05880abe323b6862e31bc5691a6b42f68cf89cda.text: The tool now uses a single, consistent method to connect with online services. This improves reliability and error handling for login, publishing, and referrals.

341069192c57970279896134d88fa7b986589a11.text: The tool now shows a fixed link for referrals instead of checking your account for a unique link each time. This means the referral option might look the same for everyone, rather than showing a personalized link.

7feec3606d35b96b19d004c93867a4c2ab2ec349.text: The system now correctly identifies when your login has expired. You will see a clear 'Session expired' message instead of a confusing error, helping you know when to sign in again.

5a0568271a9913e329b5138137911df628f72851.text: Pressing the Tab key now works correctly for file suggestions when slash commands are disabled.

2029e1e9119422e8e2072f925b451ef94c3d7dc6.text: The system now uses two different AI models to grade tasks instead of three. This internal change slightly alters how evaluations are scored, but it does not affect how you use the product.

ea119d20250121da03859f9303b2533c2ae3fbd0.text: The assistant now uses a different thinking engine for complex tasks. This internal switch aims to improve answer quality without changing how you use the product.

8bca30fb396f7d22efecde0b4a23ff770b5b79d0.text: The internal tool that picks the best answer from several options now checks one fewer option. This small adjustment has no impact on how the product works for you.

751e74decde37bd796a8b8ce1cdbb993b3aa79aa.text: Fixed a background error that could interrupt monthly credit resets. You should now reliably receive your free and referral credits each month without delays.

605f55477bcb6983b0e450b8259e8159d096c257.text: We changed how the assistant handles tool calls in its response stream. This is a small internal fix that improves how responses are assembled, but it doesn't change how you use the product.

0820c1fc4101d0496804bcd3692ecf794aa0c261.title: Add debug logging to prompt caching integration test
0820c1fc4101d0496804bcd3692ecf794aa0c261.summary: Adds console.dir logging to sdk/src/__tests__/run.integration.test.ts. Captures full run1 and run2 output objects during prompt caching assertions. Internal test observability improvement.

fe406c56163877c198ec15bfd72930b6a58670fb.title: Add getToolSet helper
fe406c56163877c198ec15bfd72930b6a58670fb.summary: Added `getToolSet` function in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts`. Builds a `ToolSet` by filtering `toolParams` against `toolNames` and merging `additionalToolDefinitions`. Uses `cloneDeep` for custom definitions.

51af033b8f28348f0b9361b2e833e93f19350342.title: Fix feedback mode hook order in chat-input-bar
51af033b8f28348f0b9361b2e833e93f19350342.summary: Moved `React.useState` for `askUserTitle` above `if (feedbackMode)` return block in `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`. Violated React rules-of-hooks by conditionally executing hooks after early return. Scope limited to CLI chat input component. Hook order now stable regardless of feedback mode state.

b4208070a0713d2fae8fee4854a97aabc4a86fc0.title: Remove getAgentStreamFromTemplate params from runAgentStep type
b4208070a0713d2fae8fee4854a97aabc4a86fc0.summary: Removes `ParamsExcluding` for `getAgentStreamFromTemplate` from `runAgentStep` signature in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Fixes typecheck error. Scope limited to agent-runtime. No runtime behavior change.

2d8c263702920179dd6182c56e08cfe133140f67.title: knowledge.md adds force push prohibition
2d8c263702920179dd6182c56e08cfe133140f67.summary: Added rule prohibiting git push --force on main branch. Prevents overwriting others' work and CI failures. Applies to knowledge.md documentation.

ca28cb5bb0d5909cb9edf1c87a346c08c79fcddb.title: Fix typecheck in run-programmatic-step
ca28cb5bb0d5909cb9edf1c87a346c08c79fcddb.summary: Replaced ParamsExcluding utility with Omit<ExecuteToolCallParams> and added toolCallId to exclusion list. Extracted crypto.randomUUID() into const toolCallId variable to pass to executeToolCall. Scope: packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts.

dde06ea5cade072e9ea7c619f931079978c7ae3e.title: getAgentStreamFromTemplate returns stream directly
dde06ea5cade072e9ea7c619f931079978c7ae3e.summary: getAgentStreamFromTemplate now returns the stream directly instead of a wrapper object containing a getStream function. Callers must pass messages into the main params object rather than to a nested getStream call. This change affects packages/agent-runtime/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts and run-agent-step.ts.

de6d712e7cce5198a15fde828e1ee7094c02a19a.title: Custom tool definitions use Zod schemas
de6d712e7cce5198a15fde828e1ee7094c02a19a.summary: Custom tool definitions now store `inputSchema` as a Zod object instead of `inputJsonSchema`. MCP tool registration converts JSON schemas to Zod via `convertJsonSchemaToZod` at ingestion. `CustomToolDefinitions` type is now NonNullable. Agent runtime tools and SDK `custom-tool.ts` updated to expect Zod schemas.

9bcd14928a9295924c79855964f0e6bf45828ee4.title: Refactor additionalToolDefinitions into standalone helper
9bcd14928a9295924c79855964f0e6bf45828ee4.summary: Extracted inline `additionalToolDefinitions` logic from `runAgentStep` into a standalone async function in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Updated type signatures in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts` to use `CustomToolDefinitions` and adjusted `ParamsExcluding` types in `loopAgentSteps`. Modified `evals/scaffolding.ts` to inject a default empty promise for the new dependency.

8ebd20c4b4f1601b4f4b8e63f40b4dcd7aabcb60.title: useTerminalLayout hook adds Tailwind-style breakpoints
8ebd20c4b4f1601b4f4b8e63f40b4dcd7aabcb60.summary: New `useTerminalLayout` hook replaces `useTerminalDimensions` in CLI components, providing Tailwind-style width/height breakpoints. Root cause: ad-hoc terminal width checks (`terminalWidth > 80`) fragmented responsive logic. Scope: `cli/src/hooks/use-terminal-layout.ts` plus `announcement-banner.tsx`, `banner-wrapper.tsx`, `build-mode-buttons.tsx`. Detail: width breakpoints defined as xs (<80), sm (80-120), md (120-160), lg (>160); height as xs (<20), sm (20-40), md (>40).

51af033b8f28348f0b9361b2e833e93f19350342.text: Fixed a small internal issue in the chat input area that could cause errors when switching modes. The chat input now stays stable regardless of mode changes.

fe406c56163877c198ec15bfd72930b6a58670fb.text: The assistant can now select and combine specific tools more easily. This small internal update helps it use the right features for different tasks.

0820c1fc4101d0496804bcd3692ecf794aa0c261.text: The team added extra notes to a private test to help them spot problems faster. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

dde06ea5cade072e9ea7c619f931079978c7ae3e.text: The assistant now starts sending its response immediately, instead of waiting for a separate signal to begin. This makes the chat feel slightly faster and smoother.

ca28cb5bb0d5909cb9edf1c87a346c08c79fcddb.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant reliably identifies and tracks each action it takes. This helps keep the system stable.

8ebd20c4b4f1601b4f4b8e63f40b4dcd7aabcb60.text: The program now checks screen size more carefully to adjust its layout. This helps the text and buttons fit better on different terminal windows.

2d8c263702920179dd6182c56e08cfe133140f67.text: A rule now stops staff from overwriting shared work, making the product more reliable.

9bcd14928a9295924c79855964f0e6bf45828ee4.text: The team cleaned up how the assistant finds extra tools. This is an internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

de6d712e7cce5198a15fde828e1ee7094c02a19a.text: The system now checks the instructions for custom actions more carefully before using them. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

b4208070a0713d2fae8fee4854a97aabc4a86fc0.text: Developers removed an unused option from the assistant's setup instructions. This fixes an internal error without changing how the product works.

b3dc2954c2d7a93071f51cb99875d23876e9f028.title: Emit toolcall chunk before parsing in stream-parser
b3dc2954c2d7a93071f51cb99875d23876e9f028.summary: The tool_call event now emits with a pre-generated toolCallId before parseRawToolCall executes in packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts. Previously, the event fired only after successful parsing, causing missing history entries when parsing failed. stream-parser.ts propagates the generated toolCallId to both standard and custom tool executors. This ensures consistent tool call tracking in message history regardless of parse outcomes.

e3d0b8ee2400ec16e242e5d590582eeb4ca8464b.title: CLI input mode refactoring test updates
e3d0b8ee2400ec16e242e5d590582eeb4ca8464b.summary: Test suites updated to match `inputMode` refactoring replacing `isUsageVisible` boolean. `setInputMode('usage')` now controls banner visibility in `useChatStore`. Scope limited to CLI integration and unit tests for usage refresh and fetch utilities. No production code changes.

bdc676b42c2af84835a0dd1fc4242ffd4589970d.title: CLI usage banner state moves to inputMode
bdc676b42c2af84835a0dd1fc4242ffd4589970d.summary: Replaced `isUsageVisible` boolean in `chat-store.ts` with `inputMode: 'usage'` in `input-modes.ts`. Consolidates banner visibility into the existing input mode system, removing redundant state. Affects `usage.ts` and `fetch-usage.ts` command handlers.

4382642d1725ee9041180281a7dc6e67d9369ea9.title: CLI Escape key exits non-default input modes
4382642d1725ee9041180281a7dc6e67d9369ea9.summary: Added Escape key handler to exit non-default input modes when input is empty. Prevents default and calls `setInputMode('default')` if `inputMode !== 'default'`. Applies to `use-keyboard-handlers.ts` and `chat.tsx` where `getInputModeConfig` now governs slash suggestion visibility via `disableSlashSuggestions` flag.

3e144e64550be90029e056b819564add6e1f6c9b.title: askuser tool adds interactive CLI question forms
3e144e64550be90029e056b819564add6e1f6c9b.summary: New `ask_user` tool enables agents to pause execution and present interactive multiple-choice forms in the CLI. Implementation includes `cli/src/components/ask-user/` components for navigation, validation, and progress indicators, plus `useAskUserBridge` hook integration in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Base2 agent prompt updated to prioritize clarifying questions via `ask_user` before generating specs. Covers CLI surface; type definitions added to `.agents/types/tools.ts`.

90505cc2fddb0cba143ef0524cd598d693a6e012.title: Extract BannerWrapper component for CLI banner UI
90505cc2fddb0cba143ef0524cd598d693a6e012.summary: New `cli/src/components/banner-wrapper.tsx` defines reusable `BannerWrapper` React component. Handles terminal width adaptation, theming, and close button interaction via `useTerminalDimensions` and `useTheme`. Part of refactor to centralize banner rendering logic previously duplicated in CLI surfaces.

3c1fed3e2b3910cadb9c2a4ff1ba298136b1661f.title: CLI static import replaces dynamic import in osc-subprocess
3c1fed3e2b3910cadb9c2a4ff1ba298136b1661f.summary: Dynamic `await import()` in `osc-subprocess.ts` replaced with static import. `cli/knowledge.md` adds guidelines banning dynamic imports (exceptions for WASM, client-only, tests) to fix tree-shaking and analysis issues. Scope: CLI init, docs.

509c78f170e4ab48fbb9d61a3968f1b727529cc7.title: Add referralcode to evals agent runtime test user
509c78f170e4ab48fbb9d61a3968f1b727529cc7.summary: Added `referral_code: 'ref-test-code'` to `GetUserInfoFromApiKeyOutput` mock in `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts`. Fixes type errors in `n-parameter.test.ts` and `run-programmatic-step.test.ts` where the mock object lacked the required `referral_code` property. Scope limited to evals test fixtures and agent-runtime package tests.

0fe10c620172c82e64f3659e927721c7acf792b4.title: Convert tool calls to assistant message history
0fe10c620172c82e64f3659e927721c7acf792b4.summary: Agent runtime converts stream tool calls into `assistantMessage` entries appended to `messageHistory`. `processStreamWithTools` now intercepts `onResponseChunk` to build this history, replacing raw text chunk accumulation. Covers `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tool-stream-parser.ts`. `PrintModeToolCall` type removed from `onResponseChunk` signature in `tool-stream-parser.ts`.

2a81534822132ef239dca11a91495cc6341dc9d0.title: CLI auto-show credit warnings and banner refactor
2a81534822132ef239dca11a91495cc6341dc9d0.summary: Refactored `UsageBanner` and `ReferralBanner` to use a shared `BannerWrapper` and moved visibility logic into `ChatInputBar` via `InputModeBanner`. `UsageBanner` now auto-shows credit warnings based on user state thresholds and timeouts, replacing manual toggle behavior. `ReferralBanner` fetches referral links unconditionally, removing mode-dependent gating.

90505cc2fddb0cba143ef0524cd598d693a6e012.text: The team cleaned up how the app draws its top notification bars. This makes the layout look more consistent and adapt better to different screen sizes.

b3dc2954c2d7a93071f51cb99875d23876e9f028.text: The assistant now records attempted actions even if they fail, preventing lost history entries. This change is small and internal.

bdc676b42c2af84835a0dd1fc4242ffd4589970d.text: The assistant now uses a single, simpler system to decide when to show usage information. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the code easier to maintain, with no visible change to how you use the product.

4382642d1725ee9041180281a7dc6e67d9369ea9.text: Pressing the Escape key now closes special typing modes if the text box is empty.

3e144e64550be90029e056b819564add6e1f6c9b.text: The assistant can now pause and ask you to pick from a list of choices to clarify your request. This helps it understand exactly what you need before it starts working.

e3d0b8ee2400ec16e242e5d590582eeb4ca8464b.text: The team updated internal tests to match a change in how the application controls the visibility of usage information. This ensures the feature works correctly behind the scenes and does not affect how you use the product.

3c1fed3e2b3910cadb9c2a4ff1ba298136b1661f.text: The command-line tool now loads its features all at once instead of one by one. This makes the program start faster and work more smoothly.

2a81534822132ef239dca11a91495cc6341dc9d0.text: The app now automatically shows credit warnings based on your usage, removing the need to toggle them manually. Internal display updates also ensure referral links appear consistently.

0fe10c620172c82e64f3659e927721c7acf792b4.text: The assistant now records tool actions in its chat history instead of just raw text. This helps it keep track of what it did during a conversation.

509c78f170e4ab48fbb9d61a3968f1b727529cc7.text: A small internal fix corrected a missing detail in test data. This change does not affect how you use the product.

9fdebef076cb48328a0f9c9a11f584f8055fcfda.title: CLI input modes consolidated into extensible system
9fdebef076cb48328a0f9c9a11f584f8055fcfda.summary: Replaced boolean isBashMode with enum inputMode ('default', 'bash', 'referral') in chat-store.ts, driven by new input-modes.ts config registry. chat.tsx and chat-input-bar.tsx now derive UI behavior (suggestions, width, toggle visibility) from getInputModeConfig(mode). Backspace at position 0 exits any special mode, not just bash. Referral mode added with '◎' icon and warning color.

303438b5b7e9dd991d021fd717a174b2ded3eb71.title: CLI multiline input adds sticky column cursor navigation
303438b5b7e9dd991d021fd717a174b2ded3eb71.summary: MultilineInput tracks desired column index in `stickyColumnRef` for vertical cursor navigation. `calculateNewCursorPosition` in `word-wrap-utils.ts` accepts `desiredIndex` to clamp cursor position against line boundaries. Non-vertical keys reset the sticky column. Affects CLI text input component and word-wrap utility.

c65563d3538b776cb8d320fde6f4b44bd83194c5.title: CLI elapsed time formatting improves precision
