c65563d3538b776cb8d320fde6f4b44bd83194c5.summary: formatElapsedTime now omits zero-value units (e.g. "1m" instead of "1m 0s") and correctly handles sub-minute remainders in the hour range. use-send-message.ts imports and uses this utility for completion time display. Covers cli/src/utils/format-elapsed-time.ts and cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts.

282c13d7bfc774cac3a990c988aa21586a6e3762.title: CLI input mode refactor, referral error handling
282c13d7bfc774cac3a990c988aa21586a6e3762.summary: Refactored CLI input mode system to simplify bash mode entry logic and removed unused `isSpecialMode` helper. Added robust error handling and validation for referral code redemption in `router.ts` and `command-registry.ts`, catching exceptions and displaying system messages. Updated `referral-banner.tsx` to handle query errors gracefully. Changed default input placeholder text to lowercase in `input-modes.ts`.

7028a55d670b1caeee9913d27ac38648c1def091.title: CLI: tmux theme detection with multiple query strategies
7028a55d670b1caeee9913d27ac38648c1def091.summary: OSC color query logic in `cli/src/utils/terminal-color-detection.ts` refactored to support multiple query strategies for tmux. `buildOscQuery` replaced by `buildOscQueries` returning array of query strings; `tmuxPassthroughState` added to check `allow-passthrough` setting via `spawnSync`. `queryTerminalOSC` now iterates through deduplicated queries until one succeeds. Fallback detection via `TERM_BACKGROUND` and `COLORFGBG` environment variables added.

247519f3f6209f18280177eb6355fa6ada752d6f.title: Fix CLI type errors and refresh usage data always
247519f3f6209f18280177eb6355fa6ada752d6f.summary: Removed unused `onOpenFeedback` prop and updated `useSendMessage` to unconditionally invalidate usage queries after responses. Added dependency injection for `fetch` in `useUserDetailsQuery` via a new `FetchFn` type to resolve type errors in tests. Changes affect CLI hooks and test files.

d0bc9d5a163b7494af38df82fded6eb1d4817255.title: Remove unused onOpenFeedback prop and Ctrl+F handler
d0bc9d5a163b7494af38df82fded6eb1d4817255.summary: Removes `onOpenFeedback` from `useSendMessage` call and deletes Ctrl+F keyboard handler in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Code cleanup eliminates dead feedback trigger logic. Scope limited to CLI chat component.

f5a23a8d422b193bfa0b5a123ea9b267c0bac3be.title: Add referrallink to /api/v1/me
f5a23a8d422b193bfa0b5a123ea9b267c0bac3be.summary: GET /api/v1/me now supports `referral_link` as a derived field. `referral_code` added to `User` type and `VALID_USER_INFO_FIELDS` in `web/src/db/user.ts`. Requesting `referral_link` triggers implicit fetch of `referral_code` via `getReferralLink`. Error messages updated to list all valid fields including derived ones.

4b7158cceb1db887ffbcdf0de8daff9da37ee0bd.title: CLI referral normalization and user details error handling
4b7158cceb1db887ffbcdf0de8daff9da37ee0bd.summary: Referral code input now normalizes casing and prefixes via `normalizeReferralCode` in `router-utils.ts`. `use-user-details-query.ts` throws errors on API failures instead of returning null. This ensures consistent code handling and explicit failure reporting.

c397e4bb6633591bbc0be0ca45900bf89bd1453c.title: Add /referral command and refactor CLI input mode routing
c397e4bb6633591bbc0be0ca45900bf89bd1453c.summary: Added /referral command to CLI to redeem codes or display shareable links, introducing a dedicated `referral` input mode. Refactored chat store from boolean `isBashMode` to string-based `inputMode` ('default', 'bash', 'referral') in `router.ts` and `command-registry.ts` to support multiple input states. Includes new `use-user-details-query` hook for fetching user data and `referral-banner` component for UI display.

d0bc9d5a163b7494af38df82fded6eb1d4817255.text: Removed unused code for the feedback shortcut. This is an internal cleanup that does not change how the product works for users.

4b7158cceb1db887ffbcdf0de8daff9da37ee0bd.text: The app now ignores capitalization differences when you enter a referral code, so it works even if you type it differently. If the system cannot load your account details, it will show a clear error message instead of staying silent.

303438b5b7e9dd991d021fd717a174b2ded3eb71.text: When you type on several lines, the text cursor now stays under the same spot when you move up and down. This makes editing long messages easier.

c65563d3538b776cb8d320fde6f4b44bd83194c5.text: The tool now shows how long a task took by hiding unnecessary zeros. For example, it displays '1m' instead of '1m 0s', making the timing easier to read.

7028a55d670b1caeee9913d27ac38648c1def091.text: The app now checks your screen's color settings in more ways to figure out if it is dark or light. This helps it pick the right colors for its text and background.

c397e4bb6633591bbc0be0ca45900bf89bd1453c.text: A new command lets you enter a referral code to get rewards or share your own link. The system now handles these different input types more reliably.

247519f3f6209f18280177eb6355fa6ada752d6f.text: The tool now updates your usage limits more reliably after you use it. This internal fix ensures the displayed information stays current without affecting how you interact with the software.

f5a23a8d422b193bfa0b5a123ea9b267c0bac3be.text: Your profile can now show a link for sharing referrals. This makes it easier to invite others.

282c13d7bfc774cac3a990c988aa21586a6e3762.text: The tool handles mistakes with referral codes better, showing clear messages instead of breaking. It also cleans up how text is entered and displayed.

85840c1a181ec17e838f801af87b2b9b01367759.title: CLI persists agent mode preference
85840c1a181ec17e838f801af87b2b9b01367759.summary: New `cli/src/utils/settings.ts` handles JSON persistence for agent mode, replacing hardcoded `DEFAULT` initialization in `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`. `loadModePreference` retrieves saved state from `settings.json` in config dir; `saveModePreference` updates it on `setAgentMode` or `toggleAgentMode`. Validation ensures only `DEFAULT`, `MAX`, or `PLAN` persist; invalid or missing values fallback to `DEFAULT`. Scope limited to CLI state management.

9be66424bfe2eefc6de4e6079764958a287a5478.title: Re-enable mode switching in CLI chat input
9be66424bfe2eefc6de4e6079764958a287a5478.summary: Restores agent mode toggle visibility and width calculation in `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts`. The revert removes temporary disabling logic that forced `estimatedToggleWidth` to 0 and commented out the UI component. This reinstates dynamic width estimation based on `stringWidth` and `isBashMode` state. Scope limited to CLI chat interface components.

c4299636b369b6c46e0e9dfc85b3d59d4c64cd40.title: Fix stale closure in handlePaste for rapid paste events
c4299636b369b6c46e0e9dfc85b3d59d4c64cd40.summary: Refactor `handlePaste` in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` to use refs for `value` and `cursorPosition`, preventing stale closure issues during rapid paste events. The handler now reads from `valueRef.current` and `cursorPositionRef.current`, updating refs immediately after each paste to ensure subsequent events see correct state. This change isolates the paste logic from React render cycles, maintaining accurate cursor positioning and text insertion when multiple paste events fire before re-renders.

7d389c79603ffef1b287f51493b37f177be2c7ec.title: Refactor CLI Message Footer into Component
7d389c79603ffef1b287f51493b37f177be2c7ec.summary: Extracted footer logic from `message-block.tsx` into new `message-footer.tsx` component. Moves `CopyIconButton`, `ElapsedTimer`, and `FeedbackIconButton` rendering plus associated state hooks. Reduces `MessageBlock` complexity by isolating completion/feedback UI logic.

54c9838ea7e87ed95d6dbcb051815a11316e8eda.title: Disable CLI mode switching UI
54c9838ea7e87ed95d6dbcb051815a11316e8eda.summary: Commented out AgentModeToggle rendering in cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx. Hardcoded estimatedToggleWidth to 0 in cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts. Removes interactive mode switching from CLI chat input. Mode switching remains disabled until plan mode bugs resolved.

e93f5b1b9e194a090816baea2196fad26f7bec61.title: Update feedback success message
e93f5b1b9e194a090816baea2196fad26f7bec61.summary: Feedback success message changed to 'Thanks, your feedback helps! 💖'. Updates showClipboardMessage call in cli/src/components/feedback-container.tsx. Scope limited to CLI feedback container.

b3f58f1583db98cf167f1d2bbdfbc14633a78799.title: Opus 4.5 replaces Sonnet in max mode agent orchestration
b3f58f1583db98cf167f1d2bbdfbc14633a78799.summary: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.5 replaces Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini in the CLI's max mode orchestration pipeline. The base agent, best-of-n editor implementors/selector, and code reviewer now spawn Opus-specific definitions. This change affects the `.agents` directory and `cli/src/utils/implementor-helpers.ts`, introducing new agent IDs like `code-reviewer-opus` and `editor-implementor-opus` to handle high-complexity coding tasks.

e0a3ec87d4f12cbf2f35c5f754d65444bc708cce.title: Copy button adds inline feedback and cursor filtering
e0a3ec87d4f12cbf2f35c5f754d65444bc708cce.summary: Copy button gains inline feedback state and filters cursor characters from clipboard selection. CopyIconButton accepts blocks/content props, extracting text with agent/tool bullets via extractTextFromBlocks. use-clipboard strips CURSOR_CHAR before processing selection. Covers cli/src/components/copy-icon-button.tsx, message-block.tsx, multiline-input.tsx, hooks/use-clipboard.ts.

e2ac3956fd4bbb82821a0b344e7968826d14ead8.title: Refactor CLI command routing into registry pattern
e2ac3956fd4bbb82821a0b344e7968826d14ead8.summary: Extracted CLI command routing logic into a new `command-registry.ts` file, replacing inline handlers in `router.ts`. This introduces a structured `COMMAND_REGISTRY` array defining commands like `/feedback`, `/bash`, and `/login` with their aliases and handler functions. The `routeUserPrompt` function now delegates to `findCommand` from the registry, simplifying the router and improving testability via new unit tests in `router-input.test.ts`. Referral code handling was also moved to a dedicated `referral.ts` module.

7e2ec29d0364ae0695fbedbda96acd28f950c322.title: Refactor tool handlers to async functions
7e2ec29d0364ae0695fbedbda96acd28f950c322.summary: Tool handler signatures in agent-runtime changed from synchronous returns containing a `result` Promise and optional `state` to direct async functions returning an `output` object. This removes the `State` type and simplifies the contract for handlers like `add-message`, `add-subgoal`, and `code-search`. The refactor affects `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/` and associated tests, enforcing a cleaner separation of concerns by eliminating state management from the handler return structure.

e0a3ec87d4f12cbf2f35c5f754d65444bc708cce.text: The copy button now shows a brief confirmation when clicked. It also removes invisible marker characters from the copied text, so pasted content looks cleaner.

e2ac3956fd4bbb82821a0b344e7968826d14ead8.text: The tool’s command system was reorganized internally to be more structured. This change is invisible to you and does not affect how you use the product.

7d389c79603ffef1b287f51493b37f177be2c7ec.text: The program's internal organization changed to make the copy and feedback buttons at the bottom of messages easier to manage. This update does not change how the buttons look or work for you.

7e2ec29d0364ae0695fbedbda96acd28f950c322.text: The assistant's internal tools now work in a cleaner, simpler way. This is a small background change that does not affect how you use the product.

c4299636b369b6c46e0e9dfc85b3d59d4c64cd40.text: Fixed a bug where pasting text quickly could place the cursor in the wrong spot or insert text incorrectly. The tool now handles rapid pastes more reliably.

54c9838ea7e87ed95d6dbcb051815a11316e8eda.text: The option to switch modes in the chat interface is temporarily hidden. This stops you from changing modes until some issues are fixed.

b3f58f1583db98cf167f1d2bbdfbc14633a78799.text: The tool now uses a stronger AI model for complex tasks. This helps it handle difficult coding work better.

85840c1a181ec17e838f801af87b2b9b01367759.text: The command-line tool now remembers your preferred assistant mode between sessions. You no longer need to reset it every time you start.

9be66424bfe2eefc6de4e6079764958a287a5478.text: The chat input bar now correctly shows the switch for changing how the assistant responds. This button was previously hidden.

e93f5b1b9e194a090816baea2196fad26f7bec61.text: The thank-you message shown after you send feedback is now warmer and friendlier. This small update does not change how the app works.

db2ca99cf368616723532902ed6e235764f3b653.title: Refactor agent state to remove system prompt dependency
db2ca99cf368616723532902ed6e235764f3b653.summary: Removes the `system` property from the shared `State` type in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/handler-function-type.ts`, moving it to explicit parameters in tool handlers like `spawn-agent-inline.ts` and `spawn-agents.ts`. This decouples system prompt handling from the generic state object, requiring handlers to receive `system` directly via function arguments rather than extracting it from `state`. The change affects `run-programmatic-step.ts` initialization logic, where `state` construction no longer includes `system`, and updates `validateSpawnState` in `spawn-agent-utils.ts` to stop validating for `system`. Tests in `packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/` reflect these structural changes to state passing.

f49b7de7acbbc543fef82d78b57141b6a2bd2ee4.title: Move logger out of State
f49b7de7acbbc543fef82d78b57141b6a2bd2ee4.summary: Refactors agent-runtime to remove logger from State. Logger is now passed via ExecuteToolCallParams. Affects run-programmatic-step, stream-parser, tool-executor, and handler-function-type.

8b02bfe097a0390acd55f78bfe176cb51c1b6c53.title: Move prompt from State to params in agent runtime
8b02bfe097a0390acd55f78bfe176cb51c1b6c53.summary: Refactors agent runtime to remove `prompt` from `State` and pass it explicitly via params in `handler-function-type.ts`, `write-file.ts`, `stream-parser.ts`, and `tool-executor.ts`. This decouples prompt data from mutable state, reducing side effects and improving handler isolation. Scope limited to `packages/agent-runtime/src`. No migration needed; internal type alignment only.

d855034728585356804eb11987de7ab539f2a5c1.title: agentContext moved from State to handler params
d855034728585356804eb11987de7ab539f2a5c1.summary: agentContext removed from State type in handler-function-type.ts. Handlers receive agentContext as top-level param in tool-executor.ts, add-subgoal.ts, update-subgoal.ts. run-agent-step.ts, run-programmatic-step.ts, stream-parser.ts updated to pass agentContext directly. Internal refactor, no API changes.

2c9b78fc4c85ab5f107d24791fe49f68052195be.title: Fix CLI input wrapping calculation
2c9b78fc4c85ab5f107d24791fe49f68052195be.summary: Corrected input width calculation in `cli/src/chat.tsx` by removing hardcoded padding subtraction from `Math.max(1, inputWidth - 4)`. Fixes slight wrapping bugs in the CLI chat interface. Code formatting and dependency array structures were also normalized.

b11445494a686bb7e18e5d6881c97e99ef69a243.title: Remove fullResponse from agent runtime state
b11445494a686bb7e18e5d6881c97e99ef69a243.summary: Removed `fullResponse` from `State` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/handler-function-type.ts` and `write-file.ts`. Updated `stream-parser.ts` to use local `fullResponse` variable instead of passing it through state. This cleanup reduces state complexity in the agent runtime.

275c751a17dbc7943e79f39520b0524f5817d427.title: Remove agentState from tool execution state
275c751a17dbc7943e79f39520b0524f5817d427.summary: Removed agentState from the internal State object in packages/agent-runtime. Tools now receive agentState directly via handler parameters instead of accessing it through state. This change affects set-output, spawn-agent-inline, and spawn-agents handlers, plus stream-parser and tool-executor.

2714ea52a5fab5fe2043bb880c68c2806efec3b6.title: Move sendSubagentChunk from state to params
2714ea52a5fab5fe2043bb880c68c2806efec3b6.summary: Refactor `sendSubagentChunk` from `State` object to `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` params in `handler-function-type.ts`. Updates `spawn-agents.ts` to consume it from params, removing internal state checks. Modifies `stream-parser.ts` and `tool-executor.ts` to stop passing it via state.

22d03cc31e5073b7ef95c4a08041c5f21eaf52e5.title: Remove file processing state from agent runtime
22d03cc31e5073b7ef95c4a08041c5f21eaf52e5.summary: Refactored `run-agent-step.ts` and `run-programmatic-step.ts` to eliminate the generic `State` object, passing `fileProcessingState` directly to tool handlers. Updated `handler-function-type.ts` to remove `getLatestState` and `state` params in favor of explicit `fileProcessingState`. Modified `write-file.ts`, `str-replace.ts`, and `create-plan.ts` to consume the direct state reference and return empty state objects. This simplifies state management in the agent runtime by removing indirect state retrieval.

983639b668d1cc516831efb9419a9d975d92b17a.title: Remove messages from programmatic step state
983639b668d1cc516831efb9419a9d975d92b17a.summary: Refactored agent runtime to remove `messages` from `State` in `run-programmatic-step.ts`, `add-message.ts`, `find-files.ts`, and `read-files.ts`. Handlers now directly mutate `agentState.messageHistory`, eliminating redundant state syncing and cloning. This simplifies state management and reduces memory overhead by removing duplicate message arrays.

b11445494a686bb7e18e5d6881c97e99ef69a243.text: The assistant's internal memory was simplified to remove an unused copy of its responses. This is a small technical cleanup that helps the software run more efficiently, with no visible change to how you use the product.

8b02bfe097a0390acd55f78bfe176cb51c1b6c53.text: The assistant now handles instructions more directly, keeping them separate from its temporary memory. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the system more reliable, but you will not notice any difference in how it works.

2c9b78fc4c85ab5f107d24791fe49f68052195be.text: Fixed a small bug that caused text in the chat window to wrap incorrectly.

983639b668d1cc516831efb9419a9d975d92b17a.text: The assistant's internal memory system was simplified to stop duplicating data. This change is small and internal, so you will not see any difference in how the product works.

db2ca99cf368616723532902ed6e235764f3b653.text: The assistant now receives its core instructions directly when starting a task, instead of searching for them inside a general data package. This internal cleanup makes the system more organized and reliable, with no visible changes to how you use the product.

d855034728585356804eb11987de7ab539f2a5c1.text: The assistant now receives its background information directly during each task instead of storing it in a shared memory. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the system more reliable, but you will not notice any changes in how the product works.

f49b7de7acbbc543fef82d78b57141b6a2bd2ee4.text: The system's logging mechanism was reorganized internally to be passed directly to tasks rather than stored in the main state. This change has no visible effect on how you use the product.

22d03cc31e5073b7ef95c4a08041c5f21eaf52e5.text: The system now tracks file changes more directly, removing an extra layer of internal handling. This is a small background update that makes the assistant's file tools work more reliably.

2714ea52a5fab5fe2043bb880c68c2806efec3b6.text: The assistant now receives information directly when sending updates, rather than looking it up internally. This is a small, behind-the-scenes adjustment that improves how data is handled.

275c751a17dbc7943e79f39520b0524f5817d427.text: The assistant now receives task information directly instead of searching through internal notes. This small internal cleanup makes tool actions more reliable.

e57bbb759a69e22815a4e2acd67fa4f75d9bfffc.title: Fix extra closing parenthesis in MessageBlock
e57bbb759a69e22815a4e2acd67fa4f75d9bfffc.summary: Removed an extra closing parenthesis from the MessageBlock component's return statement in cli/src/components/message-block.tsx. This syntax error prevented the component from compiling correctly.

a7162eb89147da6766c7f3a6c4a462233712bd0a.title: Add copy button to message blocks and reduce clipboard delay
a7162eb89147da6766c7f3a6c4a462233712bd0a.summary: New `CopyIconButton` component added to `cli/src/components/copy-icon-button.tsx` and integrated into `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` footer. Clipboard auto-copy delay in `cli/src/hooks/use-clipboard.ts` reduced from 2000ms to 250ms. Text extraction logic `extractTextFromBlocks` added to `message-block.tsx` to aggregate content from nested blocks.

fd81c06005017a9dbbfd6d313b3b96790aaeb5c2.title: Show selected model in best-of-N status
fd81c06005017a9dbbfd6d313b3b96790aaeb5c2.summary: Replaces static 'Selecting best' text with 'Selected <name>' in CLI agent branch wrapper. Mechanism parses final block's `implementationId` letter to index sibling implementor agents and resolve display name. Refactors `implementorIndex` prop to `siblingBlocks` for dynamic lookup in `AgentBranchWrapper`.

c0f35bea0a53ef0a7958fb98c7668ad80c21dafa.title: Add publish command to upload agent templates
c0f35bea0a53ef0a7958fb98c7668ad80c21dafa.summary: New `publish` command in `cli/src/commands/publish.ts` uploads local agent templates to backend via POST `/api/agents/publish`. Handles auth check, network errors, and response parsing. Registered in `cli/src/index.tsx` to intercept argv before app init.

bd4783f5a274f641b8397c5dc54f7ec6cf1514d7.title: Add Gemini best-of-n code reviewer for max mode
bd4783f5a274f641b8397c5dc54f7ec6cf1514d7.summary: Internal agent infrastructure adds a Gemini-backed best-of-n code reviewer, replacing GPT-5 in max mode. New files `code-reviewer-best-of-n-gemini.ts` and `code-reviewer-selector-gemini.ts` define the agent and selector, using `google/gemini-3-pro-preview` with medium reasoning effort. `base2.ts` updates max mode to spawn `code-reviewer-best-of-n-gemini` instead of the GPT-5 variant. `createCodeReviewerBestOfN` and `createCodeReviewerSelector` gain a `'gemini'` model option, with `handleStepsGemini` orchestrating n parallel reviews and Gemini selection.

732bd015cc29615c2ed8cc002c52d4d5ded40498.title: Refactor CLI cursor blink logic to remove prop drilling
732bd015cc29615c2ed8cc002c52d4d5ded40498.summary: The `shouldBlinkCursor` prop is removed from `ChatInputBar` and `MultilineInput` call sites in `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`. `MultilineInput` now derives the blink state directly from `useChatStore` via `isFocusSupported` when the prop is undefined. `FeedbackInputMode` also switches from hardcoded focus to store-driven `inputFocused`. This centralizes cursor visibility logic within the input component and state store.

b3c4c6eb3f506c1a924a0017b5c0c51182b1a08c.title: CLI validation errors move from global banner to per-message popover
b3c4c6eb3f506c1a924a0017b5c0c51182b1a08c.summary: Validation errors now display in a per-message popover instead of a global banner. This change removes the global banner from `app.tsx` and `chat.tsx`, introducing `validation-error-popover.tsx` and updating `message-block.tsx` to handle local error state. Feedback containers and inputs accept new `errors` and `footerMessage` props to support contextual error reporting. The refactor improves UI clarity by associating validation failures directly with their source messages.

08a7817c1c838ec7cdebaf79ca7c965080490573.title: Tool params rename and WebSocket schema removal
08a7817c1c838ec7cdebaf79ca7c965080490573.summary: Renamed $toolParams to toolParams and parameters to inputSchema across tool definitions. Removed CLIENT_MESSAGE_SCHEMA validation from WebSocket server. Updated add_message tool with new description format.

780173c123743abd3e02d175a4ba0c0ef6c20860.title: Editor best-of-n default spawn count raised 3->4 and 5->6
780173c123743abd3e02d175a4ba0c0ef6c20860.summary: editor-best-of-n DEFAULT_N raised 3->4, editor-best-of-n-max MAX_N raised 5->6. base2 prompt adds 'Don't repeat yourself... just end your turn' clause. Covers .agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts and .agents/base2/base2.ts. n parameter description updated to match new defaults.

7ad7b0cb2b698588ba9bee8f8b5f436556f15852.title: Show best-of-n selection reason
7ad7b0cb2b698588ba9bee8f8b5f436556f15852.summary: Best-of-n selector now requires a one-sentence reason for implementation choice. CLI message blocks render this reason below the selected status. Updated `best-of-n-selector.ts` schema and `message-block.tsx` layout to support the new field.

e57bbb759a69e22815a4e2acd67fa4f75d9bfffc.text: A small typing error in the assistant's message display was fixed. This lets the software build and run correctly for everyone.

b3c4c6eb3f506c1a924a0017b5c0c51182b1a08c.text: Validation errors now appear in a small pop-up next to the specific message causing the issue, rather than in a banner across the top of the screen. This makes it easier to see exactly which part of your conversation needs attention.

a7162eb89147da6766c7f3a6c4a462233712bd0a.text: A copy button now appears on each message, letting you save text with one click. The system also reacts faster when you copy content, reducing the wait time.

7ad7b0cb2b698588ba9bee8f8b5f436556f15852.text: The assistant now explains why it picked a specific answer. You see this reason below the result.

c0f35bea0a53ef0a7958fb98c7668ad80c21dafa.text: You can now upload custom assistant templates from your computer to the service. This lets you share your personalized setups with others or use them across different devices.

bd4783f5a274f641b8397c5dc54f7ec6cf1514d7.text: The system now uses a different AI model to check its own work in high-effort mode. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

732bd015cc29615c2ed8cc002c52d4d5ded40498.text: The application now decides when to blink the cursor more directly, rather than passing instructions through several layers. This is a small internal change that makes the code simpler, but it does not change how you see the cursor.

fd81c06005017a9dbbfd6d313b3b96790aaeb5c2.text: When the assistant tries several ways to answer and picks the best one, the screen now shows the name of the chosen option instead of a generic message. This small visual update helps you see exactly which version was selected.

08a7817c1c838ec7cdebaf79ca7c965080490573.text: The assistant now uses clearer internal labels for its tasks, and a strict message check was removed from the connection system. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the software easier to maintain without changing how you use it.

29e43f0d882661811698d1c094e30c964ef79061.title: Best-of-N default n reduced to 3 with sonnet selector
29e43f0d882661811698d1c094e30c964ef79061.summary: Default `best-of-n` implementor count `n` reduced from 5 to 3, and default selector agent switched from `best-of-n-selector-gemini` to `best-of-n-selector` (sonnet). `handleStepsDefault` now uses `DEFAULT_N = 3` and `best-of-n-selector`, while `handleStepsMax` retains `best-of-n-selector-gemini` with `MAX_N = 5`. `spawnableAgents` in `createBestOfNEditor` adds `best-of-n-selector` to the list. The `n` parameter description in `editor-best-of-n.ts` now dynamically reflects the default value based on `isDefault`.

05d94aa57087efb9bd2d9a9c9eb7f1213f66ee15.title: Number duplicate implementor agents in CLI
05d94aa57087efb9bd2d9a9c9eb7f1213f66ee15.summary: Duplicate implementor agents in the CLI now display sequential numbers (e.g., Sonnet #1, Sonnet #2) to distinguish them. Implementor helpers moved from constants.ts to a new implementor-helpers.ts file, adding getImplementorIndex to calculate numbering based on sibling agent types. message-block.tsx pre-calculates these indices for all nested implementor siblings and passes them to getImplementorDisplayName. Numbering only applies when multiple agents share the exact same agentType.

7821b96aa1bc17495f344466cac2100247031474.title: cli/src/app.tsx: Destructure separatorWidth from useTerminalDimensions
7821b96aa1bc17495f344466cac2100247031474.summary: Added `separatorWidth` to the destructuring assignment in `cli/src/app.tsx`. Fixes TypeScript type error by accessing the property from `useTerminalDimensions`.

75c574de3ba8ad07f64d3f5447ef157c33d29b15.title: Remove writetodos finished state exception in runAgentStep
75c574de3ba8ad07f64d3f5447ef157c33d29b15.summary: Removed special handling in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` where `write_todos` calls with completed items prevented turn ending. `write_todos` now forces a next step like standard tools, simplifying `shouldEndTurn` logic to rely only on explicit completion signals or empty results.

aac77c4b1afb6fbe3a9148bb9fff6c04df877c14.title: Fix duplicate agent spawns in CLI
aac77c4b1afb6fbe3a9148bb9fff6c04df877c14.summary: The agent matching logic in `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` was updated to prevent duplicate agent spawns. The previous implementation failed to correctly normalize scoped and versioned agent names, leading to mismatches between spawned and stored agents. A new `getBaseName` helper now strips scopes (e.g., `codebuff/`) and versions (e.g., `@0.0.2`) from both event and stored types before comparison. This ensures robust matching across all surfaces using the CLI hook.

4c9ea8c6a70b5c8f93c498d2bbdab2cd5be618cc.title: Add conservative terminal focus detection for cursor blinking
4c9ea8c6a70b5c8f93c498d2bbdab2cd5be618cc.summary: Implemented XTerm focus reporting to disable cursor blinking when the terminal window loses focus. Added `use-terminal-focus` hook to detect focus states and `isFocusSupported` flag to chat store. Blinking remains disabled until first focus event confirms terminal support. Updated `InputCursor`, `MultilineInput`, and `ChatInputBar` components to respect the new blink state.

83a4bfe07f54a7f57b4113d5a721808b10825acf.title: Add code-reviewer-gemini agent
83a4bfe07f54a7f57b4113d5a721808b10825acf.summary: New `code-reviewer-gemini` agent definition added, wrapping `createReviewer` with `google/gemini-3-pro-preview`. Base2 prompt logic updated to spawn this specific reviewer by default instead of generic `code-reviewer`. Scope limited to `.agents/reviewer/code-reviewer-gemini.ts` and `.agents/base2/base2.ts`. Default configuration uses Gemini; `isMax` retains GPT-5 best-of-n.

75c7d459b3feaede4d55b232ab95ca5943a75f8d.title: Overhaul best-of-n UI
75c7d459b3feaede4d55b232ab95ca5943a75f8d.summary: Implementedor agents (`editor-implementor`, `editor-implementor-gemini`, `editor-implementor-gpt-5`) now render as distinct tool calls with status indicators (●, ✓, ✗, ○) instead of being hidden or shown as generic text. `HIDDEN_AGENT_IDS` in `cli/src/utils/constants.ts` reduced to only `codebuff/context-pruner`. New helpers `isImplementorAgent` and `getImplementorDisplayName` map agent IDs to display names (Sonnet, Gemini, GPT-5). `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` updated to use row-based layout with bold status text for these agents.

9a112b81ee00de1ca0b1a37baca1fd690857420d.title: CLI bash mode and input handling improvements
9a112b81ee00de1ca0b1a37baca1fd690857420d.summary: CLI chat input now supports persistent bash mode triggered by `/bash`, `!`, or typing `!` at start. `router.ts` intercepts commands in bash mode, executing them via `run_terminal_command` and appending `!` to history. `chat-input-bar.tsx` and `use-keyboard-handlers.ts` manage UI state, width adjustments, and Escape-to-clear behavior.

5c377ee1a4e4a7d7d2e4e12ee8f5b862fcd1db8e.title: Best-of-N editor consolidates to default and max modes
5c377ee1a4e4a7d7d2e4e12ee8f5b862fcd1db8e.summary: createBestOfNEditor and createBase2 replace withGemini/useGeminiEditor flags with 'default' and 'max' modes. editor-best-of-n-gpt-5.ts renames to editor-best-of-n-max.ts; Gemini orchestrator definitions deleted. Base2 model hardcoded to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5; implementor factory centralized in editor-implementor.ts. Covers .agents/base2, .agents/editor/best-of-n, and CLI message-block/use-send-message constants.

7821b96aa1bc17495f344466cac2100247031474.text: A small internal fix ensures the app's layout displays correctly. You may notice fewer visual glitches in the interface.

4c9ea8c6a70b5c8f93c498d2bbdab2cd5be618cc.text: The text cursor now stops blinking when you switch to another window. This reduces distraction while you are not looking at the app.

29e43f0d882661811698d1c094e30c964ef79061.text: The system now checks fewer options by default when generating answers. This change makes the process faster and less expensive for standard requests.

75c7d459b3feaede4d55b232ab95ca5943a75f8d.text: When the assistant uses different models to help, you now see each one as a separate step with a clear status icon. This makes it easier to track progress and understand which model is working.

aac77c4b1afb6fbe3a9148bb9fff6c04df877c14.text: The tool now correctly identifies assistant names by ignoring extra labels and tags. This prevents it from starting duplicate assistants during use.

05d94aa57087efb9bd2d9a9c9eb7f1213f66ee15.text: When multiple identical agents appear, they now show numbers like #1 and #2 to help you tell them apart.

83a4bfe07f54a7f57b4113d5a721808b10825acf.text: The internal review tool now uses a new artificial intelligence model by default to check code. This change is small and only affects how developers review software behind the scenes.

177d2a48d6ef03d107678847827501e4f6504bc4.title: CLI retry banner text shortened and shimmer saturation kept vibrant
177d2a48d6ef03d107678847827501e4f6504bc4.summary: Shortened the retry banner text from "error, retrying..." to "retrying..." in the CLI status bar. Updated shimmer text generation to maintain full saturation for vibrant colors by removing dynamic saturation scaling, varying only lightness. Changes affect cli/src/components/shimmer-text.tsx and cli/src/components/status-bar.tsx.

9b5780c514e8ae5f22c2492a56382a9a2dd8985e.title: Fix filepicker spawn result extraction
9b5780c514e8ae5f22c2492a56382a9a2dd8985e.summary: Updated `handleSteps` in `.agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts` to use a new `extractSpawnResults` helper. This replaces unsafe direct property access on `fileListerResults` with structured error handling for spawned agent outputs. If extraction fails, the picker now yields a `STEP_TEXT` error and aborts, preventing crashes from malformed or missing JSON responses.

434c216009755013bc1f82684544ceab67a00300.title: Add strreplace and writefile to best-of-n editor tools
434c216009755013bc1f82684544ceab67a00300.summary: Added `str_replace` and `write_file` to the `toolNames` array in `createBestOfNEditor`. This enables the best-of-n editor to perform direct file modifications during agent execution. Scope limited to internal `.agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts` configuration.

09f9d89ad238a8278e1b9ab156314576ca1decfd.title: run() retry logic now handles error outputs
09f9d89ad238a8278e1b9ab156314576ca1decfd.summary: The `run()` wrapper in `sdk/src/run-with-retry.ts` now intercepts `RunState` objects containing `output.type === 'error'` instead of relying solely on thrown `NetworkError` exceptions. This ensures transient failures returned as structured data (e.g., AI SDK 503s) trigger backoff, `onRetry` callbacks, and session state preservation. Tests in `sdk/src/__tests__/run-with-retry.test.ts` verify exponential backoff, abort handling, and `onRetryExhausted` behavior for these output-based errors.

f45f5e292263d4cb2e5b23b333337aeba0cc1d5e.title: fix: resolve TypeScript errors in CLI chat and eval runners
f45f5e292263d4cb2e5b23b333337aeba0cc1d5e.summary: Fixed TypeScript errors in cli/src/chat.tsx by reordering imports and adding missing useQueryClient/useTransition hooks. Updated evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts, evals/git-evals/prompting-agent.ts, and evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts to safely handle potentially undefined sessionState properties using optional chaining and nullish coalescing. This prevents runtime crashes when accessing creditsUsed or fileContext in agent runners.

166ac30feba3f6206e107390e301e0bd086761f5.title: Hide editor-implementor agents, render best-of-n selectors as simple
166ac30feba3f6206e107390e301e0bd086761f5.summary: Hides editor-implementor variants from CLI UI via HIDDEN_AGENT_IDS in cli/src/utils/constants.ts and use-send-message.ts. Renders best-of-n-selector agents as simple italic text using shouldRenderAsSimpleText and BULLET_CHAR from cli/src/utils/strings.ts. Affects cli/src/components/message-block.tsx and cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts.

956847a245a4e27dc28944d5383f52f75f040a16.title: CLI integrates SDK retry system and displays retry banner
956847a245a4e27dc28944d5383f52f75f040a16.summary: The CLI now uses the `@codebuff/sdk` retry mechanism (`MAX_RETRIES_PER_MESSAGE`, `RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE_DELAY_MS`) instead of local retry logic in `use-send-message.ts`. A new `isRetrying` state in `chat-store` drives a retry banner via `status-indicator-state.ts`. This affects `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, and `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`. Local pending retry queues and TTL-based failure storage were removed.

97a7f58f3987f21b3fc93e465865f0df90e48e5d.title: Propagate NetworkError in SDK for retry support
97a7f58f3987f21b3fc93e465865f0df90e48e5d.summary: agent-runtime re-throws `NetworkError` instead of wrapping it in graceful error output, enabling SDK retry logic to catch it. `promptAiSdkStream` maps `APICallError` status codes and network-related error messages to specific `ErrorCodes` (e.g., `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `TIMEOUT`, `NETWORK_ERROR`). `run.ts` rejects the promise on retryable errors rather than resolving with cancelled state, and `getRetryableErrorCode` now extracts underlying error types from AI SDK retry failure messages to trigger additional SDK-level retries. Changes affect `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`, `sdk/src/run.ts`, and `sdk/src/index.ts`.

e662e8e4e36d83304072585709a47b52da3b339b.title: SDK retry uses return values instead of exceptions
e662e8e4e36d83304072585709a47b52da3b339b.summary: SDK run loop now triggers retries on error outputs rather than thrown exceptions. Agent runtime re-throws NetworkError early; SDK checks result.output.type for retryable codes. RunState.sessionState made optional to support error-only returns. Abort signals return error output instead of throwing.

a699bc369f2f25900e4f3af0411d4bf507745b25.title: Refactor best-of-n editor, drop base2-gemini
a699bc369f2f25900e4f3af0411d4bf507745b25.summary: Refactored `createBestOfNEditor` to use `default`/`max` modes, removing Gemini/GPT-5 specific branches in favor of unified `editor-implementor` spawning. Deleted `base2-gemini.ts` and `base2-gemini-editor.ts`; `createBase2` now hardcodes `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` and simplifies spawnable agent logic. Moved unused GPT-5 worker files to `.agents-graveyard`. Updated `editor-best-of-n-gpt-5.ts` to `editor-best-of-n-max.ts`.

9b5780c514e8ae5f22c2492a56382a9a2dd8985e.text: The file picker now handles unexpected data formats more safely. Instead of crashing, it shows a clear error message and stops the process.

f45f5e292263d4cb2e5b23b333337aeba0cc1d5e.text: Fixed internal errors in chat and evaluation tools. Users should experience fewer crashes when checking usage or file context.

434c216009755013bc1f82684544ceab67a00300.text: The internal editing tool can now directly change and save files while working. This small update lets the assistant make edits more easily behind the scenes.

166ac30feba3f6206e107390e301e0bd086761f5.text: The interface now hides certain internal helper tools from view. It also displays specific selection options as simple, plain text instead of complex labels.

177d2a48d6ef03d107678847827501e4f6504bc4.text: The text shown when the tool tries again is shorter. Bright colors stay vivid instead of fading.

09f9d89ad238a8278e1b9ab156314576ca1decfd.text: The assistant now notices temporary service failures and automatically tries again, instead of stopping immediately. This means fewer sudden errors for you.

97a7f58f3987f21b3fc93e465865f0df90e48e5d.text: The assistant now detects connection problems more clearly and tries to reconnect automatically, reducing failed requests.

e662e8e4e36d83304072585709a47b52da3b339b.text: The assistant now checks for specific error messages to decide when to try again, rather than relying on unexpected crashes. This makes the system more reliable by handling connection issues gracefully without interrupting your session.

956847a245a4e27dc28944d5383f52f75f040a16.text: The tool now uses a shared system to automatically try again when a message fails. It shows a clear notice while retrying, so you know it is working.

6de9da69a18bfada1ba955f506d939dab8eb74cf.title: base2 prompt tweak stops skipping summary
6de9da69a18bfada1ba955f506d939dab8eb74cf.summary: Removed the instruction to skip summarizing changes in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`. This ensures the base2 agent always generates a summary after completing a request, rather than potentially omitting it if it previously summarized.

405e44db858954df8326fe7a6fea528a24e364b1.title: Remove message virtualization from CLI chat
405e44db858954df8326fe7a6fea528a24e364b1.summary: Removed `useMessageVirtualization` hook and associated UI notice from `cli/src/chat.tsx`. All messages now render directly without slicing or hidden counts. Eliminates the 'Showing latest X of Y' notice and overscan logic.

9340060cb4823034be4c7bc447b086b02b36c429.title: evals package imports @codebuff/sdk directly
9340060cb4823034be4c7bc447b086b02b36c429.summary: The evals package now imports CodebuffClient and AgentDefinition from @codebuff/sdk instead of relative paths to ../../sdk/src. This change was made to simplify dependency management and remove the need for a pretypecheck build step for SDK types. The scope includes all files within evals/buffbench, evals/git-evals, and evals/subagents, along with updates to evals/package.json and evals/tsconfig.json to map the new import paths.

ed6e1d350c8d06b15507c0b82ce54a65bf0a01d2.title: CLI postinstall script prints getting started instructions
ed6e1d350c8d06b15507c0b82ce54a65bf0a01d2.summary: Refactored `cli/release/package.json` `postinstall` to call `node postinstall.js` instead of inline binary cleanup. New `cli/release/postinstall.js` retains binary deletion logic and adds console output with getting started steps. Scope limited to CLI release package; `npm-app` scripts adjusted to remove pre-build typecheck/test hooks.

98f07dd7fb0a63a48e64aa38200065139812ee04.title: CLI dev script consumes SDK TypeScript directly
98f07dd7fb0a63a48e64aa38200065139812ee04.summary: cli/package.json dev script now runs `bun run src/index.tsx` directly, replacing `scripts/dev.sh` and removing `prebuild`/`pretypecheck` SDK build steps. cli/tsconfig.json adds `paths` mapping `@codebuff/sdk` to `../sdk/src/index.ts`, allowing TypeScript to resolve SDK source without prior compilation. cli/src/types.d.ts removed as `*.scm`/`*.wasm` module declarations are no longer required. Root package.json typecheck script drops explicit `bun --cwd=sdk run build:types` call.

d325ed0b0935aae8fb903cdb2e81be001f9ed6c2.title: Update agent-runtime tests for message content structure
d325ed0b0935aae8fb903cdb2e81be001f9ed6c2.summary: Test assertions in packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/ updated to match message content structure changes. Direct string comparisons replaced with array/object checks (e.g., msg.content[0]?.text) in spawn-agents-message-history.test.ts and prompt-caching-subagents.test.ts. Obsolete 'should handle direct terminal command' test removed from main-prompt.test.ts.

97e8da47b7b1afc60b74c77a65dad1b03cb6f850.title: CLI adds useEvent hook for stable callbacks
97e8da47b7b1afc60b74c77a65dad1b03cb6f850.summary: New useEvent hook wraps onSubmitPrompt and feedback callbacks in cli/src/chat.tsx and cli/src/components/message-block.tsx to ensure stable references across renders. This prevents unnecessary re-renders of child components by allowing callbacks to access the latest state without changing identity. Feedback selectors in message-block.tsx are also memoized via useMemo to stabilize store subscription functions.

51b723a30c360e8f7795d64b625b94c84725d3cb.title: buffbench: trio of judges
51b723a30c360e8f7795d64b625b94c84725d3cb.summary: Refactored `evals/buffbench/judge.ts` to support multiple LLM judges instead of a single hardcoded agent. Introduced `judgeAgents` array containing `openai/gpt-5.1`, `google/gemini-3-pro-preview`, and `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`, sharing a common `judgeAgentBase` configuration. Updated `runSingleJudge` to select specific judge agents by index and pass the full definitions list to the client.

3c0215666af80305db88685008dc230311d4d844.title: Fix readsubtree token score remapping for subdirectories
3c0215666af80305db88685008dc230311d4d844.summary: Corrects `read_subtree` handler to remap `fileTokenScores` keys when building results for nested directories. Previously, token scores were looked up using absolute paths while `printFileTreeWithTokens` generated relative paths from the subtree root, causing score mismatches. The fix clones the directory nodes, calculates a prefix based on `outPath`, and strips parent path segments to align score keys with the printed tree structure. Changes are contained in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/read-subtree.ts`.

666b406a3a8eb7e05f5a1e266501426ff5e1d65c.title: SDK adds retry logic with exponential backoff
666b406a3a8eb7e05f5a1e266501426ff5e1d65c.summary: SDK run function implements custom retry logic with exponential backoff, disabling internal AI SDK retries. New RetryOptions type allows configuring maxRetries, backoff delays, and error codes, with onRetry and onRetryExhausted callbacks. Database auth handling now normalizes 404 responses to 401 errors to prevent caching failures. Covers sdk/src/run.ts, sdk/src/impl/database.ts, and sdk/src/index.ts exports.

405e44db858954df8326fe7a6fea528a24e364b1.text: The chat now shows all messages instead of hiding older ones. You will no longer see a note about how many messages are hidden.

98f07dd7fb0a63a48e64aa38200065139812ee04.text: The assistant now uses the latest updates immediately, without waiting for a separate preparation step. This change makes the software faster to start and keeps the two parts of the system in sync automatically.

6de9da69a18bfada1ba955f506d939dab8eb74cf.text: A small internal update ensures the assistant always provides a summary after completing a task, preventing it from occasionally skipping this step.

ed6e1d350c8d06b15507c0b82ce54a65bf0a01d2.text: The command-line tool now shows a short guide with first steps after you install it. This is a small internal change.

97e8da47b7b1afc60b74c77a65dad1b03cb6f850.text: The app now remembers its place better during long conversations. This stops the screen from flickering or stuttering when you type or click.

51b723a30c360e8f7795d64b625b94c84725d3cb.text: The system now uses three different AI models to review answers instead of just one. This internal change improves the reliability of the quality checks.

9340060cb4823034be4c7bc447b086b02b36c429.text: The internal setup for testing the AI assistant was cleaned up to make future updates easier. This change does not affect how you use the product.

666b406a3a8eb7e05f5a1e266501426ff5e1d65c.text: The app now automatically tries again after a failure, waiting longer between each attempt. This helps it recover from temporary network issues without freezing.

3c0215666af80305db88685008dc230311d4d844.text: The assistant now correctly counts words in files inside folders. This ensures the displayed information is accurate when viewing nested directories.

d325ed0b0935aae8fb903cdb2e81be001f9ed6c2.text: Internal checks were updated to match how the assistant stores conversation history. This small maintenance change does not affect how you use the product.

c424b54dc846d8ba0002da70feb0ab93ed8c0773.title: Add retry state foundation to CLI
c424b54dc846d8ba0002da70feb0ab93ed8c0773.summary: Introduced retry state management primitives in `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`. Added `pendingRetryCount`, `retryPendingMessages`, and `processFailedMessages` to hook return values and wired refs in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Includes `schedulePendingRetry` logic with queue pausing and `RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE_DELAY_MS` import.

93b2e19a4959d278952ce8a3ef1ea8180fefe656.title: Remove ScrollBox re-rendering on child height change
93b2e19a4959d278952ce8a3ef1ea8180fefe656.summary: Removed a `useEffect` hook in `cli/src/hooks/use-scroll-management.ts` that triggered `scrollbox.requestRender()` when child height changed by more than 10px. This eliminates an unnecessary re-render cycle in the CLI chat interface.

10b2b46393d1cf59596622e83f72e4feb47a57a9.title: CLI reconnection detection and transient status message
10b2b46393d1cf59596622e83f72e4feb47a57a9.summary: CLI `useConnectionStatus` hook adds `onReconnect` callback and `previousConnectedRef` to detect transitions from disconnected to connected states. `chat.tsx` invokes this callback to invalidate auth queries via `queryClient.invalidateQueries` and trigger a transient 'Reconnected' UI message controlled by `RECONNECTION_MESSAGE_DURATION_MS`. `status-indicator-state.ts` introduces `{ kind: 'reconnected' }` state, prioritized over standard indicators, while `status-bar.tsx` renders the new state using `theme.success` color.

b69057c8c09c4f9070b2ae1bdf1418fcf703adba.title: Simplify tool result push in tool-executor
b69057c8c09c4f9070b2ae1bdf1418fcf703adba.summary: tool-executor.ts pushes toolResult directly to state.messages, removing role/content wrapper. Fixes unit tests in agent-runtime, common, and context-pruner. Scope covers Agent Runtime and Shared/Core.

226d620de1800ce3c80ac4f71116af77d2c70230.title: CLI tool view labels Create for new files
226d620de1800ce3c80ac4f71116af77d2c70230.summary: str-replace.tsx detects 'Created new file' in tool output to set isCreate. Header label switches to 'Create' and DiffViewer hides for new files. Affects CLI tool component rendering. Relies on exact message string match.

aa78173fbc0077512011a1b80bec9b6ddb9f1778.title: Add useTimeout hook for key-based timeout management
aa78173fbc0077512011a1b80bec9b6ddb9f1778.summary: New `useTimeout` hook introduced in `cli/src/hooks/use-timeout.ts` to manage multiple timeouts via unique keys. Mechanism mimics TanStack Query's key-based API, ensuring automatic cleanup of all active timeouts upon component unmount. Scope limited to CLI hooks; provides `setTimeout` and `clearTimeout` methods that prevent memory leaks and handle timeout replacement. Key detail: scheduling a new timeout with an existing key automatically cancels the previous instance before setting the new one.

be03d6103db9d7026bced827845881361d06214b.title: Hide CLI scrollbar while waiting for response
be03d6103db9d7026bced827845881361d06214b.summary: Updates `verticalScrollbarOptions` in `cli/src/chat.tsx` to hide the scrollbar when `isWaitingForResponse` is true. Prevents visual flicker or premature scrollbar appearance during the initial wait phase before streaming begins. Scope limited to CLI chat interface.

07c317efa31f9cbb124d001bd1d75765f81015d9.title: CLI: add error display utilities and fix Ctrl+U visual line delete
07c317efa31f9cbb124d001bd1d75765f81015d9.summary: Adds `cli/src/utils/error-messages.ts` to format `AuthenticationError` and `NetworkError` into user-facing markdown strings, leveraging SDK sanitization. Extends `ErrorObject` in `cli/src/utils/error.ts` with optional `status` and `code` fields to preserve HTTP details. Refactors `Ctrl+U` in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` to delete to the visual line start (accounting for word-wrap) instead of the logical line start, falling back to backspace behavior at the beginning of a line.

14efb668c81fd4179c4c7c316074e0490899497e.title: Tool message schema flattens content array, drops content.output
14efb668c81fd4179c4c7c316074e0490899497e.summary: Tool message format changed. `message.content` now holds array of parts. `toolName` moved to message root. `content.output` removed. Base2, editor, context-pruner agents updated. `context-pruner.ts` logic adjusted for new structure. Test file `context-pruner.test.ts` included. Stats: +1101 / -2024 lines.

7fbded5c31a3638fea28ac089f1241c48ed1bc55.title: Typed error handling and smart retry for CLI auth
7fbded5c31a3638fea28ac089f1241c48ed1bc55.summary: CLI auth validation now uses typed `NetworkError` and `AuthenticationError` classes from SDK. React Query retry logic distinguishes transient network failures (retryable) from credential errors (no retry), driving new `retrying` and `unreachable` UI states in status bar. Login modal suppressed during network outages. Files: `cli/src/app.tsx`, `cli/src/components/status-bar.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-auth-query.ts`, `cli/src/utils/status-indicator-state.ts`.

93b2e19a4959d278952ce8a3ef1ea8180fefe656.text: The chat interface stopped refreshing unnecessarily when text size changed. This makes the display smoother and less flickery.

226d620de1800ce3c80ac4f71116af77d2c70230.text: The tool now labels new files as 'Create' instead of 'View' to better match what actually happened. This is a small visual change that makes the list of actions easier to read.

14efb668c81fd4179c4c7c316074e0490899497e.text: The software now organizes tool results more simply and consistently behind the scenes. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

aa78173fbc0077512011a1b80bec9b6ddb9f1778.text: The app now manages timed actions more carefully to prevent memory leaks. This ensures smoother performance when the app closes or switches screens.

b69057c8c09c4f9070b2ae1bdf1418fcf703adba.text: The assistant now shares tool results in a simpler way, making its responses more consistent.

c424b54dc846d8ba0002da70feb0ab93ed8c0773.text: The app now keeps track of failed messages and tries to resend them automatically after a short wait.

07c317efa31f9cbb124d001bd1d75765f81015d9.text: The command-line tool now shows clearer messages when login or network problems happen. Pressing a specific key deletes text to the start of the visible line, not the entire paragraph, matching what you see on screen.

10b2b46393d1cf59596622e83f72e4feb47a57a9.text: When your connection drops and then returns, the app now shows a brief 'Reconnected' message and automatically refreshes your login status. This small change ensures you see a clear sign that the app has recovered without needing to manually restart it.

be03d6103db9d7026bced827845881361d06214b.text: The chat window now hides the scrolling bar while waiting for a reply to start. This stops the bar from flashing on screen too early.

f60c3c11fa1496cdeecd31f4abda58c6a9980b18.title: fix(cli): add double cast to mock fetch in tests
f60c3c11fa1496cdeecd31f4abda58c6a9980b18.summary: Added `as unknown as typeof fetch` casts to mock fetch implementations in CLI integration and hook tests. Resolves TypeScript errors caused by type mismatches between mocked functions and the global `fetch` signature, specifically related to preconnect handling. Changes affect `usage-refresh-on-completion.test.ts` and `use-usage-query.test.ts`.

fcbc8383397d3d1a39de380ff88e55c69ddcb69f.title: Add hover effect to usage banner close button
fcbc8383397d3d1a39de380ff88e55c69ddcb69f.summary: Usage banner close button now toggles text color between theme.muted and theme.error on mouse hover. State resets when banner visibility changes to prevent stuck hover states. Change applies to cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx.

6c564150707150f8c838ff312c839dffdbc13b6b.title: SDK adds typed error classes and retry config constants
6c564150707150f8c838ff312c839dffdbc13b6b.summary: Adds `errors.ts` and `retry-config.ts` to `@codebuff/sdk`, exported via `index.ts`. Defines `AuthenticationError` (401/403) and `NetworkError` (timeouts/5xx) with `RETRYABLE_ERROR_CODES` set, plus type guards and sanitizers. Retry constants include `MAX_RETRIES_PER_MESSAGE` (3), exponential backoff bounds (1s–8s), and reconnection delays for CLI message recovery.

6ad51cc53cbb42ea703dec7a8fb785fd94d9f4d3.title: Add CLI announcement banner for Codebuff UI update
6ad51cc53cbb42ea703dec7a8fb785fd94d9f4d3.summary: New `AnnouncementBanner` component added to `cli/src/components/announcement-banner.tsx`, rendered in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Banner informs users of Codebuff UI update, prompts `/feedback`, and provides revert command `npm install -g codebuff@legacy`. Visibility controlled by `isAnnouncementVisible` state in `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts` with `setIsAnnouncementVisible` action. Dismissible via close button.

1785aa064f7ded558ce68a898c980484117d9593.title: CLI @-menu shows '.' for root-level file descriptions
1785aa064f7ded558ce68a898c980484117d9593.summary: The CLI @-menu file suggestion engine now renders '.' as the description for root-level files instead of the filename. This change in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts` prevents redundant display of root directory paths. Highlighting indices are nullified for these root-level entries to match the simplified description.

6cc81d832ddea9b51f5d5e7dd4fd0fa34d4d5549.title: Refactor CLI usage query to remove store synchronization
6cc81d832ddea9b51f5d5e7dd4fd0fa34d4d5549.summary: Refactored useUsageQuery hook to return TanStack Query result directly, eliminating redundant useEffect store synchronization. Removed usageData state and setUsageData action from chat-store.ts. Updated usage-banner.tsx to derive display data from hook result and sessionCreditsUsed. Deprecated fetchAndUpdateUsage store update logic.

f39642630b4f6e9cff6a3767a597070e531c163a.title: Skip failing hook tests due to React 19 + Bun compatibility issues
f39642630b4f6e9cff6a3767a597070e531c163a.summary: Four tests in cli/src/hooks/__tests__/use-usage-query.test.ts now use test.skip. React 19 and Bun compatibility issues caused failures in useUsageQuery and useRefreshUsage hooks. Covers CLI test suite only. No production code changes.

4ecfb89a072d3e5a63d51fcbf1f4cf950d1ba8d8.title: CLI adds --cwd flag
4ecfb89a072d3e5a63d51fcbf1f4cf950d1ba8d8.summary: Added --cwd <directory> option to cli/src/index.tsx. Passed to initializeApp to set working directory. Defaults to current directory if omitted.

3deb685d4a5899da4162549765162bd101b5fe1a.title: CLI @-menu triggers anywhere in input
3deb685d4a5899da4162549765162bd101b5fe1a.summary: The @-mention suggestion menu now activates based on cursor position rather than requiring the cursor to be at the very end of the input line. This fixes an issue where editing text before a completed mention or typing mid-line failed to show file suggestions. The change updates `cli/src/chat.tsx` to pass `cursorPosition` to `useSuggestionEngine`, and modifies `parseMentionContext` in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts` to analyze only the text up to the current cursor index.

4ecfb89a072d3e5a63d51fcbf1f4cf950d1ba8d8.text: You can now choose the folder the tool works in when you start it. If you do not choose one, it uses the folder you are already in.

f60c3c11fa1496cdeecd31f4abda58c6a9980b18.text: A small internal cleanup fixed how test tools pretend to connect to the internet, ensuring the assistant's usage tracking works correctly.

fcbc8383397d3d1a39de380ff88e55c69ddcb69f.text: The close button on the usage banner now changes color when you hover over it.

1785aa064f7ded558ce68a898c980484117d9593.text: The app now shows a simple dot instead of repeating the file name for items in the main folder. This makes the list easier to read by removing extra text.

6ad51cc53cbb42ea703dec7a8fb785fd94d9f4d3.text: A banner now appears to announce the new interface and offer feedback or a way to switch back.

3deb685d4a5899da4162549765162bd101b5fe1a.text: Typing the @ symbol now shows file suggestions even if your cursor is in the middle of a sentence, not just at the end. This makes editing existing text easier.

6cc81d832ddea9b51f5d5e7dd4fd0fa34d4d5549.text: The system now fetches usage data more efficiently, reducing unnecessary steps behind the scenes. This internal cleanup makes the app slightly faster and more reliable for users, with no change to visible features.

f39642630b4f6e9cff6a3767a597070e531c163a.text: The software team temporarily disabled four internal tests that were failing due to technical incompatibilities. This is a small internal maintenance change that does not affect how you use the product or the features available to you.

5c377ee1a4e4a7d7d2e4e12ee8f5b862fcd1db8e.text: The text editor now offers two simple modes for writing assistance, replacing an older option. This change simplifies how you choose the level of help you receive.

bfd58abf07ac6b22103638be36ed59a006b7482d.title: Dynamic color coding for CLI usage banner
bfd58abf07ac6b22103638be36ed59a006b7482d.summary: The `UsageBanner` component in `cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx` now dynamically sets border and text colors based on remaining credit balance. Thresholds defined as `HIGH_CREDITS_THRESHOLD` (1000) and `MEDIUM_CREDITS_THRESHOLD` (100) map to `theme.success`, `theme.warning`, and `theme.error` respectively. Null balances default to warning. This change is scoped strictly to the CLI surface.

13a08d80e24c9b421d2f26752ba2d6fd68653d11.title: CLI multiline input uses OpenTUI onPaste prop
13a08d80e24c9b421d2f26752ba2d6fd68653d11.summary: cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx now passes onPaste directly to the OpenTUI element, replacing the custom useOpentuiPaste hook. The hook file cli/src/hooks/use-opentui-paste.ts is deleted. Paste handling remains scoped to focused state and cursor position.

979ee8921cd8ab662050d2321fb6408b9e591d3a.title: Extract ChatInputBar component from Chat
979ee8921cd8ab662050d2321fb6408b9e591d3a.summary: Refactor CLI chat interface by extracting input bar logic into new `cli/src/components/chat-input-bar.tsx`. `Chat` component in `cli/src/chat.tsx` delegates rendering to `ChatInputBar`. Props pass state for input, suggestions, and feedback mode. No user-facing behavior changes.

d0479c8e012772a1a45ba2fac7eb2f0eebbf7ad8.title: Fix initialPrompt auto-submit in CLI chat input
d0479c8e012772a1a45ba2fac7eb2f0eebbf7ad8.summary: Removed premature cleanup of the auto-submit timeout in `use-chat-input.ts`. The `setTimeout` handle was returned from the effect, causing `clearTimeout` to run on unmount or dependency change before the 100ms delay elapsed, preventing `initialPrompt` from reaching `onSubmitPrompt`. The fix deletes the return statement, ensuring the prompt submission completes. Affects CLI hook behavior only.

adfbddada89a400496438ee1acbad5535695d75a.title: CLI real-time usage refresh when banner visible
adfbddada89a400496438ee1acbad5535695d75a.summary: New `fetchAndUpdateUsage` utility in `cli/src/utils/fetch-usage.ts` centralizes API calls and state updates for usage data. `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` triggers a background refresh upon run completion if `isUsageVisible` is true, ensuring the banner stays current without blocking UI. `cli/src/commands/usage.ts` now delegates to this utility instead of handling fetch logic inline. Refresh errors are logged but do not halt message processing.

55510e86599ad4705caec482e646a40847d6de87.title: Fix web search API key propagation
55510e86599ad4705caec482e646a40847d6de87.summary: Web search handler now receives and passes apiKey to callWebSearchAPI. Updated handler-function-type.ts to include apiKey in tool context. Fixes missing authentication for web search requests in agent-runtime.

1df0789330bbb5b37778fc7427c7a9d00d04bcc1.title: CLI usage banner replaces inline message with responsive UI
1df0789330bbb5b37778fc7427c7a9d00d04bcc1.summary: The /usage command output moved from a static postUserMessage to a persistent UsageBanner component. State is managed via new usageData and isUsageVisible keys in chat-store.ts. The banner auto-dismisses after 60 seconds or via manual close. Styling uses theme.warning borders and responsive text wrapping based on terminal width.

174a50a54c312498a093de80f3ec16c356aef3fa.title: CLI usage refresh moves to TanStack Query
174a50a54c312498a093de80f3ec16c356aef3fa.summary: The CLI `/usage` command and banner now fetch quota data via a new `useUsageQuery` hook built on TanStack Query, replacing the direct `fetchAndUpdateUsage` calls. This change centralizes state management, introduces a 30-second stale time, and prevents redundant fetches when the banner is hidden or data is fresh. The migration affects `cli/src/hooks/use-usage-query.ts`, `cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx`, and `cli/src/commands/usage.ts`, removing the manual error handling from the command in favor of query state.

5f9c54bb5e76aacff68ad4fbc86118b2ddade9a3.title: CLI postinstall cleanup removes stale manicode binaries
5f9c54bb5e76aacff68ad4fbc86118b2ddade9a3.summary: Added `postinstall` scripts to `cli/release/package.json` and `cli/release-staging/package.json`. These scripts delete existing `codebuff` or `codecane` binaries from `~/.config/manicode` before the new CLI installation completes. This prevents conflicts or stale binary usage when upgrading via npm.

adfbddada89a400496438ee1acbad5535695d75a.text: The usage counter now updates automatically after a task finishes if the counter is visible. This keeps the number current without stopping you from working.

bfd58abf07ac6b22103638be36ed59a006b7482d.text: The usage screen now shows colors that change based on your remaining balance, helping you see at a glance if you have plenty, need to watch out, or are running low.

13a08d80e24c9b421d2f26752ba2d6fd68653d11.text: The program now uses a built-in feature to handle pasting text. This internal cleanup has no visible effect on how you use the product.

5f9c54bb5e76aacff68ad4fbc86118b2ddade9a3.text: When you update the tool, it now removes old leftover files first. This keeps the new version working correctly.

979ee8921cd8ab662050d2321fb6408b9e591d3a.text: The program's internal structure was cleaned up to make it easier to maintain. This change does not affect how you use the product.

d0479c8e012772a1a45ba2fac7eb2f0eebbf7ad8.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant reliably receives your starting message in the command-line tool. Previously, this message sometimes failed to send automatically.

174a50a54c312498a093de80f3ec16c356aef3fa.text: The tool now updates your usage numbers less often to save effort. You may see slightly older numbers, but the tool runs faster and avoids unnecessary checks.

55510e86599ad4705caec482e646a40847d6de87.text: Fixed a missing connection that prevented web search from working. You can now use web search features again.

b6bfa99a46154ab82ca7466ac062bd7fab901220.title: Fix CLI MessageBlock overlay via box layout
b6bfa99a46154ab82ca7466ac062bd7fab901220.summary: Replaced React Fragment with explicit box container in cli/src/components/message-block.tsx. Enforced column flex direction and zero gap to prevent timestamp and message content overlay. Affects CLI rendering surface only.

6c80db92f0a51c1e4a2878a6b9aab02d46c395b7.title: Simplify chat input submission routing
6c80db92f0a51c1e4a2878a6b9aab02d46c395b7.summary: Refactors use-chat-input.ts and chat.tsx to replace direct ref/state passing with a unified onSubmitPrompt callback delegating to routeUserPrompt. Removes sendMessageRef, isChainInProgressRef, and streamMessageIdRef props from the hook interface. Centralizes queue-vs-send logic previously duplicated in handleBuildIt and handleBuildMax.

ac81d007830946a2e23a83ea28fb6303f27c2353.title: Add postinstall script to delete legacy binary
ac81d007830946a2e23a83ea28fb6303f27c2353.summary: Added a `postinstall` script to `npm-app/release-legacy/package.json` that deletes the existing `codebuff` binary from `~/.config/manicode`. This ensures the legacy package removes any stale binary immediately upon installation, preventing conflicts with the new installer logic. The change applies only to the legacy release package.

3d3296b4ea103f3c01c2f2683fb9131c1bd7fe2b.title: Add Gemini editor agent
3d3296b4ea103f3c01c2f2683fb9131c1bd7fe2b.summary: New base2 agent 'Buffy the Gemini Editor Orchestrator' uses editor-implementor-gemini instead of best-of-n editors. createBase2 gains useGeminiEditor flag to swap editor agents in spawn lists and prompts. editor-implementor-gemini wraps createBestOfNImplementor with model 'google/gemini-3-pro-preview'. GPT-5 and Gemini skip think-tag prompt guidance; Sonnet keeps it.

8e91efe579ef943192965ebf293613d30cea3125.title: BuffBench eval framework docs
8e91efe579ef943192965ebf293613d30cea3125.summary: New `evals/buffbench/README.md` documents BuffBench, Codebuff's evaluation framework for AI coding agents. Covers architecture (orchestrator, agent runner, 3x median AI judge, trace/meta analyzers), scoring dimensions (completion, code quality, overall), and validation features (final check commands, binary installs). Includes usage examples for running evaluations, generating tasks from commits, and nightly email reporting.

0662ac17643877ad192255f1b517e8f382e51fc2.title: Remove unnecessary useEffect/useMemo in CLI multiline-input
0662ac17643877ad192255f1b517e8f382e51fc2.summary: Refactors cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx and cli/src/utils/word-wrap-utils.ts. Removes redundant useMemo and useCallback hooks, and eliminates lineInfoRef in favor of direct textRef access. Updates word-wrap-utils.ts to accept lineStarts array instead of full LineInfo object. Scope limited to CLI internals.

9cf76362033d90140bba5b0b33dc870bc34bda80.title: Base2 prompt: add examples, tighten validation
9cf76362033d90140bba5b0b33dc870bc34bda80.summary: Base2 agent prompts now include concrete response examples for complex feature implementation and refactoring queries, gated by the `isFast` flag. The terminal command safety instruction was clarified to explicitly forbid running effectful commands without user consent. Validation steps were updated to mandate parallel execution of typechecks and tests, with stricter scoping for non-max models.

47b2c7f18ad4715e38f58bd618f70aaeddf9c46c.title: Add setoutput tool to best-of-n editor implementor
47b2c7f18ad4715e38f58bd618f70aaeddf9c46c.summary: Updated `createBestOfNImplementor` in `.agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-implementor-gpt-5.ts` to include `set_output` in `toolNames` and switch `outputMode` from `last_message` to `structured_output`. The `handleSteps` generator now captures assistant responses and tool results, passing them to `set_output`. This ensures the editor's final state is captured as structured data rather than raw text. Scope limited to internal agent definition logic.

f422343f49c005ebfc26808204ec5e079b92cbdf.title: CLI chat input routes messages to queue during active streams
f422343f49c005ebfc26808204ec5e079b92cbdf.summary: The `useChatInput` hook now intercepts 'Build it!' commands and initial prompts when `isStreaming`, `streamMessageIdRef`, or `isChainInProgressRef` indicate an active session, routing them to `addToQueue` instead of immediate dispatch. This prevents race conditions where new inputs might interfere with ongoing agent chains. The change affects `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts`, requiring new props for queue state management.

713fbd3b354aa7527b1ee3a23c05f61244ed6cce.title: CLI chat scrollbar visibility now tracks overflow state
713fbd3b354aa7527b1ee3a23c05f61244ed6cce.summary: Scrollbar visibility in `cli/src/chat.tsx` changed from a static flag triggered on first submit to a dynamic state derived from scrollbox overflow. A `useEffect` hook monitors `scrollbox.scrollHeight` against `viewport.height` and updates `hasOverflow` only when the boolean status changes, preventing unnecessary re-renders. The `verticalScrollbarOptions` now explicitly hide the scrollbar during streaming (`!isStreaming && hasOverflow`). This internal refactor eliminates visual jitter when content height fluctuates near the viewport boundary.

47b2c7f18ad4715e38f58bd618f70aaeddf9c46c.text: The system now saves results in a clear, organized format instead of plain text. This is an internal change that helps the tool keep track of its work accurately.

b6bfa99a46154ab82ca7466ac062bd7fab901220.text: Fixed a display bug in the command-line interface where timestamps and message text overlapped. The interface now places these items in separate rows.

6c80db92f0a51c1e4a2878a6b9aab02d46c395b7.text: The app now uses one clear path to handle messages, replacing scattered instructions. This internal cleanup keeps the chat working the same way for you, but makes it easier to update safely.

9cf76362033d90140bba5b0b33dc870bc34bda80.text: The assistant now shows examples for difficult tasks and strictly avoids running risky computer commands without permission. This helps it give clearer answers and protects your files.

8e91efe579ef943192965ebf293613d30cea3125.text: The team added internal notes to explain how they test the AI's coding skills. This helps the company track the assistant's quality and fix mistakes, though it does not change how you use the product today.

ac81d007830946a2e23a83ea28fb6303f27c2353.text: The old version of the software now automatically removes leftover files from previous installations when you update. This small internal cleanup helps prevent conflicts with the new setup process.

f422343f49c005ebfc26808204ec5e079b92cbdf.text: When the assistant is busy working, new messages wait in line instead of interrupting. This prevents confusion and keeps the conversation smooth.

713fbd3b354aa7527b1ee3a23c05f61244ed6cce.text: The chat window now shows a scroll bar only when there is more text than can fit on the screen. This prevents the scroll bar from flickering or appearing and disappearing unexpectedly as the assistant writes.

3d3296b4ea103f3c01c2f2683fb9131c1bd7fe2b.text: The editing assistant now uses a different underlying technology to generate text. This is an internal change that may improve how the assistant drafts or refines content, but it does not add new features or change how you use the product.

63e76ba696f1d8be0c6bb6d4d495e4973d387f67.title: base2 prompt: add file-modification guard
63e76ba696f1d8be0c6bb6d4d495e4973d387f67.summary: Added 'Don't surprise the user' constraint to base2 implementation prompt. Prevents unsolicited file modifications. Internal prompt tuning in .agents/base2/base2.ts.

8ae3f5e68ecc24691569cc17196198c800f96343.title: CLI collapses selector agents by default, adds code-reviewer status
8ae3f5e68ecc24691569cc17196198c800f96343.summary: CLI `COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_AGENT_IDS` expands to include `code-reviewer-selector`, `thinker-selector`, and `best-of-n-selector`. `message-block.tsx` adds a `Generating ${n} code reviews...` status for `code-reviewer-best-of-n` agents. Affects CLI terminal UI components. Selector agents now render collapsed initially, reducing visual noise during execution.

e9d1ea54241dc3e7fbc4bc6f095b629e39adb630.title: Upgrade opentui to 0.1.46
e9d1ea54241dc3e7fbc4bc6f095b629e39adb630.summary: Bumped `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/react` to 0.1.46 in `cli/package.json` to fix blank message rendering issues. Updated `cli/src/index.tsx` to use `createCliRenderer` and `createRoot` instead of the deprecated `render` function. Scope limited to CLI entry point and dependencies.

3ef47341d03531bad22cfba2cf4ab3fd870d5190.title: Gemini tool call formatting rules
3ef47341d03531bad22cfba2cf4ab3fd870d5190.summary: Adds conditional prompt instructions for Gemini models in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to enforce strict JSON tool call formatting. Includes explicit warnings against trailing commas, multi-tool calls, and direct agent invocation, requiring use of `spawn_agents`. Also gates `code-reviewer` and `code-reviewer-best-of-n-gpt-5` tools for non-Gemini contexts.

56959415ca1561cd8ab0eea9d35e8771a1c92add.title: Slash command router requires leading slash
56959415ca1561cd8ab0eea9d35e8771a1c92add.summary: routeUserPrompt now sets normalized to empty string when trimmed lacks leading slash, preventing bare words from resolving as commands. cmd remains empty string, so feedback and login branches skip. Only /feedback, /login, /signin trigger special handling.

4fb9eaca81ed1613b553d301e0f4be82dcd977df.title: code-reviewer-best-of-n-gpt-5 for max mode
4fb9eaca81ed1613b553d301e0f4be82dcd977df.summary: base2.ts splits code-reviewer selection by mode: isDefault uses code-reviewer, isMax uses code-reviewer-best-of-n-gpt-5. Prompting guidance adds a conditional spawn instruction for post-implementation review when !isFast. write_todos plan template now injects a review step for non-fast modes.

c3dfbd80bb523a9a93a5a4ac9c8946d41a5eda9e.title: Modernize code-reviewer-best-of-n to use GENERATEN
c3dfbd80bb523a9a93a5a4ac9c8946d41a5eda9e.summary: The `code-reviewer-best-of-n` agent now uses the `GENERATE_N` step type to produce review candidates, replacing the previous pattern of spawning multiple `code-reviewer-implementor` agents. Output handling shifted from `set_output` tool calls to `STEP_TEXT` yields with `outputMode: 'last_message'`. This simplifies the agent definition in `.agents/reviewer/best-of-n/code-reviewer-best-of-n.ts` by removing complex message history manipulation and structured output parsing for the implementor phase.

8e1ab6b64c19b96eef585e496c70442a44a5258e.title: Add code-reviewer agent to base2
8e1ab6b64c19b96eef585e496c70442a44a5258e.summary: The `code-reviewer` agent is added to the `base2` configuration for both `isDefault` and `isMax` modes. The system prompt now instructs the agent to spawn `code-reviewer` after implementing changes, unless the change is trivial. This update is scoped to `.agents/base2/base2.ts`.

5bc98c0979bc324368f9ebc6fe7ecb15173a12a2.title: Fix local agent integration test setup
5bc98c0979bc324368f9ebc6fe7ecb15173a12a2.summary: Reordered imports and added `setProjectRoot` call in `beforeEach` for `cli/src/__tests__/integration/local-agents.test.ts`. Ensures project root is correctly initialized before capturing `originalProjectRoot`. Scope limited to CLI test suite.

63e76ba696f1d8be0c6bb6d4d495e4973d387f67.text: The assistant now avoids changing files without asking first. This small update keeps unexpected edits from happening.

56959415ca1561cd8ab0eea9d35e8771a1c92add.text: The assistant now only recognizes special commands when they start with a slash. Typing plain words will no longer accidentally trigger hidden features.

c3dfbd80bb523a9a93a5a4ac9c8946d41a5eda9e.text: The system now uses a simpler, built-in method to generate multiple code review options. This internal cleanup makes the reviewer more efficient and easier to maintain, with no visible changes to your workflow.

8ae3f5e68ecc24691569cc17196198c800f96343.text: The tool now hides extra background tasks by default to keep the screen cleaner. It also shows a status message when multiple code reviews are being generated.
