679d23dc5fcdad5543477f223b21280d6ca45ebb.text: The app now automatically switches to a dark theme when used with a specific terminal, because light text was too hard to read. This improves visibility without requiring any settings changes.

a0085a3c128147a52a879fc1ecf718a7282a6134.text: When you stop a response early, the system now records why it happened. This helps staff fix problems faster. You will not notice any difference.

400db03e92a8848649af577a846aaf7c148f3134.text: Extra blank space at the end of some messages is gone. The text looks cleaner and more compact.

8475a8bccf2f7d0b319d0d4405eb0433ac848c40.title: CLI type safety refactor: remove as any, strict event typing
8475a8bccf2f7d0b319d0d4405eb0433ac848c40.summary: Refactored CLI type definitions and event handling to eliminate `as any` casts and improve type safety. `ContentBlock` union types in `cli/src/types/chat.ts` were split into named exports (`TextContentBlock`, `ToolContentBlock`, etc.), and `ToolName` usage was adjusted in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts` to satisfy strict typing via `satisfies`. In `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, `handleEvent` now uses type guards (`'agentId' in event`, `'totalCost' in event`) instead of unsafe property access, and subagent event matching was simplified to `subagent_start`/`subagent_finish` only, removing legacy hyphenated variants. A new `SetElement` utility type was added to `cli/src/types/utils.ts` to support strict tool name filtering in `isHiddenToolName`.

52ed28ba9766edc71d2f027357185ccc3cd2b399.title: Tweak file-list prompt in file-lister
52ed28ba9766edc71d2f027357185ccc3cd2b399.summary: Updated the system prompt in `.agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts` to explicitly instruct the agent to include all subdirectories (e.g., `src`) in file paths. This change addresses observed failures where agents omitted intermediate directory components. The modification is internal, affecting only the file explorer agent's behavior.

aeed81aef003d1668fe467fc4ae47f5745292c01.title: Consolidate Ctrl-C message into StatusIndicator
aeed81aef003d1668fe467fc4ae47f5745292c01.summary: Moved the 'Press Ctrl-C again to exit' message from `chat.tsx` into `StatusIndicator` in `status-indicator.tsx`. Updated `useHasStatus` hook to accept an object parameter including `nextCtrlCWillExit`. This centralizes status line rendering logic and simplifies `chat.tsx` by removing manual conditional text nodes.

4e832e9df2f2ed8bfd9f0b1e071fe656f9de575f.title: Ctrl-C cancels agent response; run() returns sessionState on abort
4e832e9df2f2ed8bfd9f0b1e071fe656f9de575f.summary: Ctrl-C now aborts streaming agent responses in CLI, marking the last text block with '[response interrupted]' and resetting queue/streaming state. SDK run() no longer throws AbortError; it returns a RunState with sessionState preserved and output.type='error' on cancellation, enabling follow-up runs via previousRun. Changes touch cli/src/hooks/use-keyboard-handlers.ts, cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts, sdk/src/run.ts, plus README and examples.

3b28978c436e50c74fd077f81f9d174468906777.title: use-send-message.ts replaces 'in' operator with has()
3b28978c436e50c74fd077f81f9d174468906777.summary: Switches from 'in' operator to has() helper for agentId and value checks in use-send-message.ts. Avoids potential runtime errors or type narrowing issues with the 'in' operator. Scope limited to cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts.

72c6c8f8de5e5e816d91ded74abe1b3c77617555.title: Refine file-lister prompts to suppress commentary
72c6c8f8de5e5e816d91ded74abe1b3c77617555.summary: Updated `.agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts` system prompts to explicitly forbid introductory commentary, analysis, and English text, enforcing newline-separated file paths only. Renamed `<example_output>` tags to `<example_response>` and added reinforcement instructions to ensure strict output format compliance.

5a4ed18334dbf0456bbb5e6428e56667206f3751.title: Ctrl-C cancels CLI runs
5a4ed18334dbf0456bbb5e6428e56667206f3751.summary: SDK `run()` throws `AbortError` on cancellation instead of returning `ErrorOr` result. CLI `use-send-message` hook handles `AbortError` to update UI state and append `[response interrupted]`. Removes explicit abort listener logic in favor of centralized error handling. Covers `sdk/src/run.ts`, `sdk/src/client.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`.

bc5157ced863b21ffa37b02fcad1e48c8342f034.title: Improve terminal tool component
bc5157ced863b21ffa37b02fcad1e48c8342f034.summary: Terminal tool component in `cli/src/components/tools/run-terminal-command.tsx` now displays command in bold next to bullet point, with output indented below. Output truncation limits display to 5 lines with mouse-clickable 'Show X more lines' toggle. Uses `useState` for expand/collapse state, `useTheme` for color styling, and `TextAttributes.BOLD` for command emphasis. Collapsed preview retains `$ ${command}` format.

31b8421b918c662073ba0cfd8a090465c6944856.title: Fix writetodos end-turn logic for multiple calls
31b8421b918c662073ba0cfd8a090465c6944856.summary: The `hasOnlyFinishedTodos` check in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` now evaluates all tool calls instead of strictly requiring a single call. This prevents premature turn termination when multiple `write_todos` calls are present but only some are completed. Logic updated to ensure turn ends only if every call is `write_todos` and at least one call contains fully completed todos.

fdd062321c48cef702d2cbe04a635f597f994f4c.title: OSC 10/11 terminal color detection
fdd062321c48cef702d2cbe04a635f597f994f4c.summary: Added `terminal-color-detection.ts` to query terminal foreground/background colors via OSC escape sequences for theme detection. Updated `theme-system.ts` to prioritize OSC detection over platform defaults and added Zed terminal support. `login-modal.tsx` adjusted to use `theme.surface` instead of `theme.background`.

8475a8bccf2f7d0b319d0d4405eb0433ac848c40.text: The tool's internal checks were made stricter to catch errors earlier. You likely see no difference, but the app is less likely to crash unexpectedly.

bc5157ced863b21ffa37b02fcad1e48c8342f034.text: The assistant now makes commands easier to read by highlighting them and neatly arranging their results. Long outputs are hidden by default, but you can click to see the rest.

3b28978c436e50c74fd077f81f9d174468906777.text: The assistant's message handling was improved to prevent potential errors. This small internal change helps the app run more smoothly.

4e832e9df2f2ed8bfd9f0b1e071fe656f9de575f.text: Pressing Ctrl-C now stops the assistant's response immediately. The conversation history remains intact, allowing you to continue the chat without restarting.

aeed81aef003d1668fe467fc4ae47f5745292c01.text: The warning shown when you press Ctrl-C was moved to a central location. This makes the code cleaner and easier to maintain, with no visible changes for users.

52ed28ba9766edc71d2f027357185ccc3cd2b399.text: The tool now shows full file locations, including folders inside folders. This helps it find things more accurately.

72c6c8f8de5e5e816d91ded74abe1b3c77617555.text: The file lister now strictly outputs only file paths, without any extra text or commentary. This internal cleanup makes results cleaner and easier to read.

5a4ed18334dbf0456bbb5e6428e56667206f3751.text: Pressing Ctrl-C now cleanly stops the assistant's response. You will see a clear note that the reply was interrupted.

31b8421b918c662073ba0cfd8a090465c6944856.text: The assistant now finishes its task only after completing all planned steps, rather than stopping early when multiple tasks are active.

7a92255c84bb12116cedcce01d791551450178c5.title: Switch CLI multiline input cursor to left-aligned block
7a92255c84bb12116cedcce01d791551450178c5.summary: MultilineInput cursor character changed from ┃ to ▍ for left-aligned rendering. Highlight condition simplified by removing cursorPosition > 0 check, allowing cursor display at line start. Affects cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx.

98903bec6fbb617384e7dfc9e0c1eb9ac5255df0.title: Thread includeToolCall through CLI and agent-runtime
98903bec6fbb617384e7dfc9e0c1eb9ac5255df0.summary: includeToolCall flag moved from toolBlock.input to top-level toolBlock in cli/src/components/message-block.tsx and threaded through cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts. packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts now sets includeToolCall: false when excludeToolFromMessageHistory is true, propagating via cli/src/types/chat.ts and common/src/types/print-mode.ts. Covers CLI and Agent Runtime. Conditional spread ensures flag only appears when explicitly false.

784785824d15d26fae0f40c43b0a06bcab44e51e.title: Remove exitWarning state from CLI chat
784785824d15d26fae0f40c43b0a06bcab44e51e.summary: Refactored cli/src/chat.tsx to remove exitWarning state and exitArmedRef, replacing them with nextCtrlCWillExit for status line rendering. This simplifies the Ctrl+C exit warning logic by eliminating redundant state tracking and effects. Scope limited to CLI chat component internals. Status line now directly checks nextCtrlCWillExit boolean instead of string state.

ffe4ccbdfd72127b58e5aed20dc32d2fcb2be84e.title: CLI: Cursor position reset on history navigation
ffe4ccbdfd72127b58e5aed20dc32d2fcb2be84e.summary: Cursor position is now explicitly managed via chat store state instead of local component state. `useInputHistory` hook accepts `setCursorPosition` and updates it to the end of the string when navigating history entries with up/down arrows. Changes affect `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-input-history.ts`, and `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`. This ensures the cursor visually jumps to the end of recalled commands, preventing it from remaining at arbitrary positions from previous edits.

290eaa6a4eaba7f6caf35094ddebe04932a7a6a9.title: CLI chat requires double Ctrl+C to exit
290eaa6a4eaba7f6caf35094ddebe04932a7a6a9.summary: CLI chat now requires two consecutive Ctrl+C presses to exit. First press clears input or shows 'Press Ctrl+C again to exit' warning; second press exits. Warning auto-clears after 2 seconds. Changes in cli/src/chat.tsx handleCtrlC callback.

2bce10880445870d060d38cb8ecf697097480b68.title: Hide tool calls in internal agent outputs
2bce10880445870d060d38cb8ecf697097480b68.summary: Added includeToolCall: false to set_output calls in editor, file-explorer, and best-of-n agents. Prevents raw tool call traces from appearing in final agent responses. Refactored n calculation in best-of-n editor for consistency.

e986021ad3703043db335b6e60ab5d8c54d0d3fb.title: CLI multiline input wrap and toggle width fix
e986021ad3703043db335b6e60ab5d8c54d0d3fb.summary: New `cli/src/utils/text-layout.ts` adds `computeInputLayoutMetrics` and `measureLines` for precise text wrapping. `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` uses measured viewport width instead of heuristic padding to prevent early wraps. `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts` recalculates `agentToggleLabel` width based on actual rendered collapsed box dimensions.

7dc922dcf77abcdc873fd44378bab6bfb8345690.title: Improve build mode buttons layout and theme consistency
7dc922dcf77abcdc873fd44378bab6bfb8345690.summary: Refactored `BuildModeButtons` to use a horizontal `flexDirection: 'row'` layout with `justifyContent: 'space-between'`, replacing the previous vertical column structure. Implemented responsive behavior via `useTerminalDimensions` to hide the 'Ready to build?' label on narrow terminals (<55 chars). Switched hardcoded `#ffffff` colors to `theme.foreground` and applied `BORDER_CHARS` for consistent styling. Updated file `cli/src/components/build-mode-buttons.tsx`.

3c4d47aa33f92d6dbde97c28f2db636c0242cf4f.title: SDK run() returns success/failure union
3c4d47aa33f92d6dbde97c28f2db636c0242cf4f.summary: CodebuffClient.run() now returns a discriminated union of success/failure objects instead of resolving directly to RunState. Callers must check `.success` before accessing `.value` or `.error`. Documentation and examples updated to reflect this breaking API change.

d3730a17be04a5374b39d72e9a80ae519ee3a23a.title: SDK run() returns ErrorOr; CLI Esc/ctrl-c aborts cleanly
d3730a17be04a5374b39d72e9a80ae519ee3a23a.summary: sdk/src/run.ts and sdk/src/client.ts replace thrown AbortError with ErrorOr<RunState> return type. checkAborted returns Failure object instead of throwing. cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts adds abort listener to append '[response interrupted]' to last text block. cli/src/hooks/use-keyboard-handlers.ts fixes Esc handler fallthrough with early return. SDK exports ErrorOr type via sdk/src/index.ts.

784785824d15d26fae0f40c43b0a06bcab44e51e.text: The chat interface now uses a simpler method to handle exit warnings. This internal cleanup does not change how the product looks or feels to users.

7a92255c84bb12116cedcce01d791551450178c5.text: The typing cursor in the chat box is now a small block that sits at the start of the line. This fixes a visual glitch where the cursor would disappear when you started typing at the very beginning of a line.

290eaa6a4eaba7f6caf35094ddebe04932a7a6a9.text: Pressing Ctrl+C once now shows a warning or clears your text instead of closing the chat immediately. You must press it a second time to exit, which helps prevent accidental closures.

e986021ad3703043db335b6e60ab5d8c54d0d3fb.text: The text input area now fits more words on each line without breaking them early. This makes long messages easier to read and edit.

3c4d47aa33f92d6dbde97c28f2db636c0242cf4f.text: The assistant now clearly separates success from failure when it runs. This change helps the system report errors more accurately.

7dc922dcf77abcdc873fd44378bab6bfb8345690.text: Build mode buttons now sit side by side. The label hides on narrow screens. Colors match the theme.

98903bec6fbb617384e7dfc9e0c1eb9ac5255df0.text: A small internal update ensures that when a tool is excluded from chat history, a specific setting is correctly passed along to prevent it from being shown.

2bce10880445870d060d38cb8ecf697097480b68.text: The assistant now hides its internal search steps from you. You see only the final answer, not the raw list of actions it took to find it.

d3730a17be04a5374b39d72e9a80ae519ee3a23a.text: Pressing the escape key or control-c now stops the assistant immediately and cleanly. The chat shows a clear message that the response was interrupted.

ffe4ccbdfd72127b58e5aed20dc32d2fcb2be84e.text: When you press the up or down arrow to view previous commands, the text cursor now automatically moves to the end of the line. This prevents the cursor from staying in a random spot where you last edited, making it easier to continue typing.

21fe632860e31ca5497fe0ea131e1162e260ae9a.title: CLI: Refine inline code styling
21fe632860e31ca5497fe0ea131e1162e260ae9a.summary: Updated inline code styling in the CLI. Removed theme-specific inline code foreground overrides from message-block.tsx and use-message-renderer.tsx, relying on new defaults in markdown-renderer.tsx and theme-system.ts. Default inline code foreground changed to #86efac in markdown-renderer.tsx; dark/light theme inline code foreground set to #fa8329 and codeMonochrome disabled in theme-system.ts.

4aef18cc3fa49ed4c38db78add715137ce20f537.title: Strip debug logging from CLI auth and chat flows
4aef18cc3fa49ed4c38db78add715137ce20f537.summary: Removed verbose `logger.info` calls from `use-auth-query.ts`, `use-auth-state.ts`, `use-login-polling.ts`, `login-flow.ts`, `chat.tsx`, and `login-modal.tsx`. `registry.ts` switched from `logger.error` to `console.error` for component rendering failures. Scope limited to CLI internal state management and login polling logic.

9a55c28f22dfb904ba25abe6c007982f3e6dea5d.title: Fix codesearch flag parsing to preserve argument pairs
9a55c28f22dfb904ba25abe6c007982f3e6dea5d.summary: Removed flag deduplication in `codeSearch` within `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`. Previous logic used `new Set` to deduplicate flags, which broke space-separated argument pairs like `-g *.ts`. Flags are now split and filtered without deduplication to ensure correct parsing.

bcca78c3594ba2ca964e7ec992f928d9e97e7295.title: CLI: Suppress tool calls with includeToolCall false
bcca78c3594ba2ca964e7ec992f928d9e97e7295.summary: MessageBlock now checks for `includeToolCall: false` in tool input and returns null. Prevents rendering of specific tool calls in CLI. Affects `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`. Internal rendering logic change.

919d8e7a2332edd48fb0d3cbf90e69f3ba808bb5.title: Remove asdf event log
919d8e7a2332edd48fb0d3cbf90e69f3ba808bb5.summary: Removed debug logger.info call for 'asdf event' in handleStreamChunk within cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts. This cleans up internal logging noise in the CLI message sending flow. Scope limited to CLI hook implementation.

de236d698f9b83773b4fe50cfb93f0ed1600ff5e.title: CLI input wrapped in bordered box
de236d698f9b83773b4fe50cfb93f0ed1600ff5e.summary: Chat input now renders inside a single-line bordered box via `BORDER_CHARS`. `agent-branch-item.tsx` imports shared constants from new `ui-constants.ts`, removing local border definitions. Scope limited to CLI UI components. Border styling centralized for consistency.

a711a7583540b23033f83b5523764dd2c0ea41fb.title: CLI: cleanup message rendering, diff viewer, tool registry,
a711a7583540b23033f83b5523764dd2c0ea41fb.summary: Removed unused string-width import and formatPreview helper from message-block.tsx. Simplified diffText handling in diff-viewer.tsx by removing fallback split. Replaced console.error with structured logger.error in registry.ts for tool rendering errors. Updated str-replace.tsx to pass empty string instead of null when diff is missing, preventing early return.

8a0e27f107fb54c23a1ed815ee1cc1d3112b2a61.title: CLI input placeholder text updated
8a0e27f107fb54c23a1ed815ee1cc1d3112b2a61.summary: Placeholder text in `cli/src/chat.tsx` changed from "Share your thoughts and press Enter…" to "Type your coding task or '/' to see available commands". This clarifies the input behavior and command discovery. Scope limited to CLI chat interface.

37c9c1dac1d2f4124aeb8b199a2f86d355650aee.title: CLI: Disable exitOnCtrlC in startApp
37c9c1dac1d2f4124aeb8b199a2f86d355650aee.summary: The `startApp` function in `cli/src/index.tsx` now passes `exitOnCtrlC: false` to the `render` call from `@opentui/react`. This prevents the CLI from terminating immediately upon receiving a Ctrl+C signal, allowing the application to handle the interrupt gracefully. The change is scoped to the CLI entry point. This modification alters the default behavior of the interactive terminal UI.

761b299c12816ce2a9b58686ccac78b167e3b347.title: Add backslash Enter for multiline input
761b299c12816ce2a9b58686ccac78b167e3b347.summary: Backslash Enter now inserts newline in CLI multiline input. Checks char before cursor for backslash; strips it on Enter. Modifies cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx. Adds isBackslashEnter flag and string slicing logic.

8a0e27f107fb54c23a1ed815ee1cc1d3112b2a61.text: The text shown in the input box changed to explain how to use it. It now tells you to type a task or use a slash to see commands.

4aef18cc3fa49ed4c38db78add715137ce20f537.text: The app no longer shows extra technical messages while you log in or chat. This keeps the screen clean for you.

de236d698f9b83773b4fe50cfb93f0ed1600ff5e.text: The text box where you type messages now has a clear border around it. This is a small visual update that makes the input area easier to see.

9a55c28f22dfb904ba25abe6c007982f3e6dea5d.text: A small internal fix ensures that when you give the assistant specific instructions to search for files, it now reads them correctly. This means your search requests are processed as intended, without accidentally ignoring parts of your command.

761b299c12816ce2a9b58686ccac78b167e3b347.text: You can now type text across multiple lines in the command tool by pressing the backslash key and then the Enter key.

a711a7583540b23033f83b5523764dd2c0ea41fb.text: Internal cleanup improved how text and errors are shown in the command-line tool. Users will see clearer previews and fewer confusing error messages.

919d8e7a2332edd48fb0d3cbf90e69f3ba808bb5.text: The app stopped recording extra internal notes while sending messages. This change is small and only affects how the app works behind the scenes.

37c9c1dac1d2f4124aeb8b199a2f86d355650aee.text: The command-line tool now ignores the Ctrl+C key combination, allowing it to close properly instead of stopping abruptly. This makes the experience smoother when you want to exit the program.

bcca78c3594ba2ca964e7ec992f928d9e97e7295.text: The application now hides certain internal background actions from the main text view. This keeps the conversation cleaner and easier to read.

21fe632860e31ca5497fe0ea131e1162e260ae9a.text: The color of small text snippets in the command line interface changed to look cleaner and match the app's theme better.

df345ddbcb03cc1b7e10855913e205d76dc4291a.title: Remove Prompt/Response labels from CLI agent branch items
df345ddbcb03cc1b7e10855913e205d76dc4291a.summary: Removes explicit 'Prompt' and 'Response' text labels from the CLI agent branch view in `cli/src/components/agent-branch-item.tsx`. The prompt text now uses italic attributes directly, simplifying the visual hierarchy. Scope limited to CLI rendering components.

569aa21fe301a74f85f40a3ccb2076ccdbf45035.title: Add taskcompleted tool UI renderer
569aa21fe301a74f85f40a3ccb2076ccdbf45035.summary: New `TaskCompleteComponent` renders the `task_completed` tool result as a bold "Task Complete" bullet in the CLI. Handles `task_completed` tool blocks via `defineToolComponent`. Affects `cli/src/components/tools/task-complete.tsx`. Uses `@opentui/core` `TextAttributes.BOLD` for styling.

585c22ba39a874ac9a437274cc8875f2e1da5898.title: Stop collapsing agents by default in CLI
585c22ba39a874ac9a437274cc8875f2e1da5898.summary: Agents expand by default in CLI. `use-send-message.ts` removed `setCollapsedAgents` calls. `agent-branch-item.tsx` replaced `RaisedPill` with text, removed `branchChar`. Scope: CLI only.

fa06a9fe2aa8d9b4b1b09c3ad88fc78b4014c9f7.title: CLI streams reasoning separately from text
fa06a9fe2aa8d9b4b1b09c3ad88fc78b4014c9f7.summary: CLI `use-send-message.ts` now handles `reasoning_chunk` events distinct from text, rendering them in grey. `stream-parser.ts` removes the hacky `think_deeply` tool wrapping for reasoning, passing raw chunks. `sdk/run.ts` buffers reasoning and emits `reasoning_chunk` to `handleStreamChunk`. `ContentBlock` type adds `textType` to distinguish reasoning from standard text.

2f9ad386ab476a4e9b7bc43a37d47d5e8be99e5a.title: Remove branching UI from CLI
2f9ad386ab476a4e9b7bc43a37d47d5e8be99e5a.summary: Removed branching characters and indent logic from CLI components. Simplified message-block.tsx, tool-call-item.tsx, and related files. Internal refactor.

d0266ee4a01b4e765a74390bf49da765c45f4561.title: Build mode buttons use bordered hover styling
d0266ee4a01b4e765a74390bf49da765c45f4561.summary: Build mode buttons in `cli/src/components/build-mode-buttons.tsx` switched from solid `backgroundColor` fills to `borderStyle: 'single'` with `theme.secondary` borders, brightening to `#ffffff` on hover. Added `useState` to track `hoveredButton` and a prompt text "Ready to build? Choose your mode:" above the button row. Scope limited to CLI build mode UI.

38c345fddae2e93c0411fd400c8b9f1158694321.title: Refactor CLI chat hooks into separate modules
38c345fddae2e93c0411fd400c8b9f1158694321.summary: Split monolithic logic from `cli/src/chat.tsx` into dedicated hooks: `use-agent-initialization`, `use-auth-state`, `use-chat-input`, `use-terminal-dimensions`, and `use-validation-banner`. This reduces component complexity by isolating state management, terminal dimension calculations, and agent initialization side effects. The change is internal to the CLI package, affecting `cli/src/hooks/` and `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Each new hook encapsulates specific responsibilities, such as handling auth query mutations or calculating input width based on terminal dimensions.

3a4bb9426497e14f22ec68a982cf95cee262406b.title: CLI: Add edit tool diff viewer for strreplace and writefile
3a4bb9426497e14f22ec68a982cf95cee262406b.summary: New `DiffViewer` component renders unified diffs for `str_replace` and `write_file` tool outputs. `str-replace.tsx` parses `unifiedDiff` or `patch` keys from tool output, while `write-file.tsx` delegates rendering to `StrReplaceComponent` via registry update in `registry.ts`. Colors distinguish added (`#B6BD73`) and removed (`#BF6C69`) lines, with hunk headers filtered out. Covers CLI tool UI surfaces only.

014d91c6c14489fa1861747ac8679e353693fd72.title: readsubtree label corrected to List deeply
014d91c6c14489fa1861747ac8679e353693fd72.summary: The read_subtree tool UI now displays 'List deeply' instead of 'Read subtree' to match standard tool naming conventions. The rendering logic was simplified to a single-line bullet format, removing the previous multi-line path list and collapsible header behavior. This change applies to cli/src/components/tools/read-subtree.tsx. The component now prioritizes the input.path field for the display description, falling back to the first valid entry in the paths array or '.' if neither is present.

d96c8279b4cb496a7023016d4921ef1679aa3aa6.title: Add reasoning stream support to CLI print mode
d96c8279b4cb496a7023016d4921ef1679aa3aa6.summary: Added `printModeReasoningSchema` to `common/src/types/print-mode.ts` and integrated reasoning chunk handling in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The CLI now renders reasoning text in gray before the main response, stopping the spinner on first reasoning chunk. Stream state tracking moved to instance variables (`streamStarted`, `textStreamStarted`) to manage interleaved reasoning and text output correctly.

3a4bb9426497e14f22ec68a982cf95cee262406b.text: When the assistant changes a file, you now see a clear side-by-side view of what was added and what was removed. This makes it easier to check exactly what changed without reading through the whole file.

fa06a9fe2aa8d9b4b1b09c3ad88fc78b4014c9f7.text: The assistant now shows its step-by-step thinking in grey text, separate from its final answer. This makes it easier to see how it reached a conclusion.

df345ddbcb03cc1b7e10855913e205d76dc4291a.text: The chat view no longer shows the words 'Prompt' and 'Response'. The user's text now appears in italics to tell it apart from the assistant's reply.

2f9ad386ab476a4e9b7bc43a37d47d5e8be99e5a.text: The tool removed the branching lines and extra spacing from its text display. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the output look simpler.

569aa21fe301a74f85f40a3ccb2076ccdbf45035.text: When a task finishes, the computer now shows a clear bold message saying it is done.

014d91c6c14489fa1861747ac8679e353693fd72.text: The tool's label now says 'List deeply' instead of 'Read subtree' to match standard naming. The display was simplified to a single line, removing the collapsible list view.

585c22ba39a874ac9a437274cc8875f2e1da5898.text: The tool now shows all assistant steps by default instead of hiding them.

d0266ee4a01b4e765a74390bf49da765c45f4561.text: The buttons for choosing how to build now have a cleaner outline style that lights up when you hover over them. A new message asks you to pick a mode, making the choice clearer.

38c345fddae2e93c0411fd400c8b9f1158694321.text: The team reorganized the internal structure of the chat tool to make it easier to maintain. This is a behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how you use the product.

bddfb8a52d16bf2c1b157382e392a17f8e9af54d.title: Add readsubtree CLI tool component
bddfb8a52d16bf2c1b157382e392a17f8e9af54d.summary: New read_subtree component added to CLI tool registry. Displays input paths via SimpleToolCallItem. Registered in cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts.

291adef5277d360edd064523a5171b088904db0a.title: Add writetodos component
291adef5277d360edd064523a5171b088904db0a.summary: CLI gains `write_todos` tool UI in `cli/src/components/tools/write-todos.tsx`. Renders task lists with `✓` for completed and `☐` for pending items. Registered in `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts`.

847f968f43424f8b480acb2864cb1fe87a89d7b0.title: Hide agent display name unless agentId set
847f968f43424f8b480acb2864cb1fe87a89d7b0.summary: Agent display name hidden in CLI chat UI unless agentId specified. showAgentDisplayName flag gates rendering in cli/src/chat.tsx. Affects agent status line visibility.

ab11cea0583ddddae98eaa8372fb81275098170d.title: Fix multiline input text color attributes
ab11cea0583ddddae98eaa8372fb81275098170d.summary: The `textStyle` object in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` now unconditionally sets the `attributes` key, resolving a bug where text color attributes were inconsistently applied. Previously, `attributes` were only added conditionally based on placeholder state or explicit `textAttributes`, leaving them undefined in other cases. The fix ensures `TextAttributes.DIM` is used for placeholders, while falling back to `textAttributes ?? TextAttributes.NONE` otherwise. This change affects only the CLI's multiline input component.

b333641ff8b0d0fd63202d8ac7f10a6fe2ff72b8.title: Adjust Zed scroll multiplier in chat-scroll-accel
b333641ff8b0d0fd63202d8ac7f10a6fe2ff72b8.summary: Zed scroll multiplier changed from 1 to 0.37 in cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts. This internal tweak affects chat scroll acceleration within the Zed terminal environment.

57ae36c28b8174a97dde7812300b081ce25de107.title: agent-mode-toggle hover open delay set to 0
57ae36c28b8174a97dde7812300b081ce25de107.summary: OPEN_DELAY_MS in cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx reduced from 100 to 0. Removes hover latency for agent mode expansion. Affects CLI interface responsiveness.

ba8c00dcdcf6d6d2c97e557a16a33b2ccc1566b9.title: Lower CLI logo breakpoint to 20 columns
ba8c00dcdcf6d6d2c97e557a16a33b2ccc1566b9.summary: The CLI `useLogo` hook now displays the `LOGO_SMALL` variant at terminal widths of 20 columns or more, replacing the previous 40-column threshold. This adjustment ensures the compact logo renders on narrower terminals instead of falling back to the plain text `CODEBUFF` string. The change applies to the CLI rendering logic in `cli/src/hooks/use-logo.tsx`.

9d1236be79902dc836b6797e2feaad2589a5b5d7.title: CLI tool branch alignment and dense agent lists
9d1236be79902dc836b6797e2feaad2589a5b5d7.summary: Tool call items now use `string-width` to calculate exact padding for branch stubs, ensuring labels align with toggle indicators (`▸ `) across different character widths. Agent lists in `message-block.tsx` render in `dense` mode with grouped tool branches, reducing vertical spacing and removing forced blank lines in collapsed previews. Changes affect `agent-branch-item.tsx`, `read-files.tsx`, `tool-call-item.tsx`, and `use-message-renderer.tsx`.

622efe1d9de19eeababd42d2999e49fe8402869d.title: Fix SDK auto-generation of project files when none provided
622efe1d9de19eeababd42d2999e49fe8402869d.summary: SDK now correctly auto-generates project files in initialSessionState if none provided. Removed unconditional empty object defaults for projectFiles and knowledgeFiles, allowing discovery logic to run when undefined. Added logger to run.ts context. Covers sdk/src/run-state.ts and sdk/src/run.ts. New unit tests verify initial session state behavior.

d658e6d3bffce72c9bd7e0eeab34d79c5a47e1a4.title: CLI segmented control enables hover and click for current mode
d658e6d3bffce72c9bd7e0eeab34d79c5a47e1a4.summary: Segmented control and agent mode toggle now allow hover and click interactions on the currently selected segment. Removed `isClickable` and `canHover` checks that previously blocked these states for active or disabled segments. Affects `cli/src/components/segmented-control.tsx` and `cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx`. Visual highlighting (`frameColor`, `isBold`) now applies to the active mode when hovered.

9d1236be79902dc836b6797e2feaad2589a5b5d7.text: The assistant's task list now appears in a tighter, more compact view, showing grouped steps with less empty space between them.

ba8c00dcdcf6d6d2c97e557a16a33b2ccc1566b9.text: The assistant now shows its small logo on narrower screens, instead of just text.

bddfb8a52d16bf2c1b157382e392a17f8e9af54d.text: The tool now shows the file paths it reads when looking inside folders. This helps you see exactly which parts of your project it is checking.

ab11cea0583ddddae98eaa8372fb81275098170d.text: Text in the command-line input now appears with the correct color and brightness. Placeholder text stays dim, while typed text shows normally. This fixes a small visual glitch.

847f968f43424f8b480acb2864cb1fe87a89d7b0.text: The assistant's name no longer appears in the chat interface unless specifically enabled. This change only affects how the name is displayed.

291adef5277d360edd064523a5171b088904db0a.text: The assistant now displays task lists with checkmarks for finished items and empty boxes for pending ones. This helps you see what is done and what still needs attention.

d658e6d3bffce72c9bd7e0eeab34d79c5a47e1a4.text: The mode switcher now reacts when you hover over or click the currently selected option. This lets you confirm which mode is active more easily.

b333641ff8b0d0fd63202d8ac7f10a6fe2ff72b8.text: The speed at which the chat moves when scrolling has been reduced. This small adjustment makes scrolling feel slower and more controlled.

57ae36c28b8174a97dde7812300b081ce25de107.text: The menu that lets you switch assistant modes now opens instantly when you hover over it, removing the previous short delay.

622efe1d9de19eeababd42d2999e49fe8402869d.text: The tool now automatically finds and loads project files when none are provided. You no longer need to manually specify these files to start working.

d34e86a543f72eb11f0f9838621009f07726377e.title: Fix glob tool path matching when cwd set
d34e86a543f72eb11f0f9838621009f07726377e.summary: The `glob` tool now correctly filters files when a `cwd` is specified. Paths are made relative to `cwd` before micromatch, then converted back to project-relative paths. Fixes incorrect matching logic in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`.

42c340c2c0830bdd269bbe851491652dfe2b7f4f.title: Tweak agent toggle timing and layout
42c340c2c0830bdd269bbe851491652dfe2b7f4f.summary: Agent mode toggle in `cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx` now opens instantly and closes after 100ms. Layout logic updated to always append current mode to `ALL_MODES` list rather than filtering and reordering, simplifying active state detection and frame rendering.

a2aaf401d7a8857b5e12643832b10b438c5e867f.title: CLI agent mode toggle revamped with SegmentedControl and hover logic
a2aaf401d7a8857b5e12643832b10b438c5e867f.summary: Refactored `agent-mode-toggle.tsx` to use a new `segmented-control.tsx` component, replacing static theme configs with dynamic segment rendering. Implemented `useHoverToggle` hook with configurable delays (`OPEN_DELAY_MS`, `CLOSE_DELAY_MS`) and reopen suppression to prevent UI flicker. Scope limited to CLI components and associated unit tests. SegmentedControl now handles hover state and border rendering via `onMouseDown`/`onMouseOver` callbacks.

0a30509a990ed2c22278282e35da2d4736ec06f9.title: Add readfiles tool component
0a30509a990ed2c22278282e35da2d4736ec06f9.summary: New `ReadFilesComponent` added to CLI tool registry. Renders `read_files` tool calls with first file on name line, next two on newlines, rest inline. No expand/collapse support.

bcf1184e6c4e3f108f3cd7bf7eefc0d78529532b.title: Hover animations for CLI agent mode toggle
bcf1184e6c4e3f108f3cd7bf7eefc0d78529532b.summary: Added hover animations to the agent mode toggle component in the CLI. The toggle now highlights segments on mouseover, with edges rendering dynamically based on the hovered index. This improves the visual feedback for users interacting with the agent mode selector.

0b0ad014895f0204c5612bfe89f6a32f66a35a77.title: CLI bang prefix executes terminal commands
0b0ad014895f0204c5612bfe89f6a32f66a35a77.summary: CLI router detects leading `!` to trigger `runTerminalCommand` from SDK, bypassing model. Sync execution renders stdout in tool block. `env` type in SDK relaxed to allow undefined values. Files: `cli/src/commands/router.ts`, `sdk/src/index.ts`.

5a8be1a7a1fb4bd5d2509d6fb2a1515b68ff76f3.title: CLI scroll multiplier set to 1
5a8be1a7a1fb4bd5d2509d6fb2a1515b68ff76f3.summary: Scroll acceleration multiplier in `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts` changed from 0.5 to 1 for all environments (zed, ghostty, vscode, default). This adjusts the scroll sensitivity within the CLI chat interface. Scope is limited to the CLI utility file. The `ENV_MULTIPLIERS` constant now enforces a 1:1 scroll ratio.

854079d054d022a272f3ba55974b5acb6b68693f.title: Fix codesearch flag injection with --
854079d054d022a272f3ba55974b5acb6b68693f.summary: Added `--` separator to `rg` arguments in `handleCodeSearch` within `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. Prevents patterns starting with `-` from being misparsed as flags by ripgrep. Ensures correct search execution for such patterns.

b423bc61c6f96453c2b60fe4dbd58c8aa80a621d.title: Tweak CLI tool display for code search and list directory
b423bc61c6f96453c2b60fe4dbd58c8aa80a621d.summary: Shortens labels for `code_search` and `list_directory` components to 'Search' and 'List' respectively. `code_search` summary format changes to include `cwd` and removes noisy regex `flags`, while `tool-call-item` updates text wrapping to 'word' mode for better layout. Affects `cli/src/components/tools/code-search.tsx`, `cli/src/components/tools/list-directory.tsx`, and `cli/src/components/tools/tool-call-item.tsx`.

da616d314ee02942d2098ea3582752f64ec84768.title: Chat scroll uses constant acceleration
da616d314ee02942d2098ea3582752f64ec84768.summary: CLI chat scroll switched to ConstantScrollAccel. Replaces QuadraticScrollAccel in createChatScrollAcceleration. ENV_MULTIPLIERS unified to 0.5 for zed, ghostty, vscode, default. Handles negative scroll buffers via Math.ceil.

854079d054d022a272f3ba55974b5acb6b68693f.text: A small internal fix ensures the search tool handles text starting with a dash correctly. Users will see more reliable results when searching for such terms.

d34e86a543f72eb11f0f9838621009f07726377e.text: The assistant now correctly finds files in specific folders. This fixes errors when searching for documents in a particular location.

bcf1184e6c4e3f108f3cd7bf7eefc0d78529532b.text: The switch for choosing the assistant's mode now lights up when you move your mouse over it. This small visual change helps you see which option you are selecting.

42c340c2c0830bdd269bbe851491652dfe2b7f4f.text: The assistant mode switch now opens instantly and closes with a slight delay. This makes the interface feel snappier and more stable when you change settings.

5a8be1a7a1fb4bd5d2509d6fb2a1515b68ff76f3.text: Scrolling in the chat interface now moves at a standard speed. Previously, it moved slower than your mouse wheel or trackpad input.

0a30509a990ed2c22278282e35da2d4736ec06f9.text: The assistant now shows multiple files more clearly by listing the first three on separate lines and the rest inline. This small change makes file lists easier to scan.

a2aaf401d7a8857b5e12643832b10b438c5e867f.text: The tool that switches between assistant modes now behaves more smoothly. It stays stable when you move your mouse over it, so the display no longer flashes or jumps unexpectedly.

0b0ad014895f0204c5612bfe89f6a32f66a35a77.text: You can now type an exclamation mark before a command to run it directly in your terminal.

b423bc61c6f96453c2b60fe4dbd58c8aa80a621d.text: The tool names for searching code and listing folders are now shorter. Search results show less cluttered information.

da616d314ee02942d2098ea3582752f64ec84768.text: Scrolling in chat now moves at a steady speed instead of speeding up or slowing down unpredictably. This makes reading conversations smoother and more consistent across different applications.

c1de47f91a7067abee48fcce88f29609eaca0134.title: CLI agent mode toggle adds selection menu
c1de47f91a7067abee48fcce88f29609eaca0134.summary: AgentModeToggle component in cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx introduces an expanded state for selecting FAST, MAX, or PLAN modes directly. Previously a simple toggle, it now renders a bordered menu when active, allowing users to click specific modes. The chat.tsx file passes the new onSelectMode prop to handle direct mode switching. Emoji labels were removed in favor of text-only identifiers.

e38e3d37e471814f6b4b728099e8d54eb6020aeb.title: CLI: agent status line and hover delay
e38e3d37e471814f6b4b728099e8d54eb6020aeb.summary: Added right-aligned agent status line to chat UI. Implemented 250ms hover delay for mode toggle to prevent accidental triggers. Scope: cli/src/chat.tsx, cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx. Detail: Agent display name resolves from loadedAgentsData using current mode or explicit agentId.

1f8db2ba7a32e708a3317a2d3202d01f36fc41d0.title: CLI scroll: Increase rolling window
1f8db2ba7a32e708a3317a2d3202d01f36fc41d0.summary: Default `rollingWindowMs` in `QuadraticScrollAccel` increased from 50 to 100 in `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts`. `ghostty` scroll multiplier reduced from 0.2 to 0.15. Adjusts scroll acceleration behavior for smoother terminal interaction.

3b2e13ab66a1aab36a742c2528e285910733bd65.title: Cancel pending timeout on agent mode toggle press
3b2e13ab66a1aab36a742c2528e285910733bd65.summary: handlePress now clears openTimeoutRef before executing toggle logic. Prevents delayed UI state conflicts when clicking current mode. Scope limited to cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx.

37b97349f8e1d6ea82e87911f14ba25951062d79.title: CLI agent mode toggle gains hover interaction and column layout
37b97349f8e1d6ea82e87911f14ba25951062d79.summary: AgentModeToggle now expands on mouse hover with 1s close delay, replacing click-only toggle. Collapsed state arrow repositioned to left of label. Expanded layout shifts from horizontal segments with shared borders to vertical columns with per-segment borders. Affects cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx only.

a9395df8485ddc52cd980a9cc46a59dc00d4d62d.title: Remove Cursor support from CLI scroll acceleration
a9395df8485ddc52cd980a9cc46a59dc00d4d62d.summary: Drops 'cursor' from ENVIRONMENTS and INERTIAL_HINT_VARS in cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts, removing CURSOR, CURSOR_TERM, and CURSOR_TERMINAL detection. Adjusts ENV_MULTIPLIERS: ghostty 0.3 to 0.2, vscode 0.3 to 0.05, default 0.3 to 0.05. Scope limited to CLI scroll acceleration logic.

2bb32123f60ddb7e4005bec14aae94e29a6404b3.title: Fix web build and CI for agents server aggregator
2bb32123f60ddb7e4005bec14aae94e29a6404b3.summary: Web build and CI pipeline updated to fix agents server aggregator issues. New prebuild script `web/scripts/prebuild-agents-cache.ts` validates data pipeline post-build. CI workflow `web` package tests run via `bun run test --runInBand`, and interactive debug shell removed. Health check endpoint `web/src/app/api/healthz/route.ts` now warms agents cache. Jest config ignores e2e tests; Playwright config port aligned with dev server.

7f8f33102e5c03dd36904f7a965535ec8aa259f3.title: Refactor CLI scroll acceleration to support CODEBUFFSCROLLMULTIPLIER
7f8f33102e5c03dd36904f7a965535ec8aa259f3.summary: The `createChatScrollAcceleration` function in `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts` was refactored to replace boolean `enabled` states and string-based `slow`/`fast` overrides with a numeric `multiplier` derived from the `CODEBUFF_SCROLL_MULTIPLIER` environment variable. The `resolveScrollEnvironment` function now parses this variable as a float (defaulting to 1.0 if invalid) and combines it with environment-specific base multipliers for Zed, Ghostty, and VS Code. This change removes the previous `INERTIAL_HINT_VARS` logic in favor of `ENVIRONMENT_TYPE_VARS` and simplifies the `ScrollEnvironment` type to use a `type` field instead of `hint` and `override` properties.

410437bfc210dfe73d11e2901f0cb579e08d1cd8.title: Simplify CLI title screen and agent list rendering
410437bfc210dfe73d11e2901f0cb579e08d1cd8.summary: Removed dynamic greeting and default agent header from `cli/src/chat.tsx`, replacing verbose status text with concise command/directory info. `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` drops agent list truncation logic, rendering full lists via `ToolCallItem` instead of `AgentBranchItem` previews. Scope limited to CLI chat interface components.

73fc133bba3cef3489ed499c986ab24b3fe12965.title: Update chat scroll acceleration multipliers for Zed and Ghostty
73fc133bba3cef3489ed499c986ab24b3fe12965.summary: Chat scroll acceleration multipliers for Zed and Ghostty environments updated in `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts`. Zed multiplier changed from 0.015 to 0.07, Ghostty from 0.15 to 0.2. This adjustment modifies the scroll speed behavior within the CLI chat interface for these specific terminal environments.

73fc133bba3cef3489ed499c986ab24b3fe12965.text: Scrolling in the chat window now moves at a smoother, more predictable speed for users of specific terminal apps.

1f8db2ba7a32e708a3317a2d3202d01f36fc41d0.text: Scrolling in the terminal now moves more smoothly. Small tweaks to how fast scrolling accelerates make the experience feel less jerky.

e38e3d37e471814f6b4b728099e8d54eb6020aeb.text: The chat interface now shows the active assistant's name on the right side. Hovering over the mode switch now requires a brief pause before changing, preventing accidental clicks.

410437bfc210dfe73d11e2901f0cb579e08d1cd8.text: The app shows a cleaner start screen with less clutter. The full list of available options now appears instead of a short preview.

37b97349f8e1d6ea82e87911f14ba25951062d79.text: The agent mode switch now opens when you hover over it and closes after a short delay, instead of only working when clicked. The options inside are arranged in vertical columns with separate borders for easier reading.

c1de47f91a7067abee48fcce88f29609eaca0134.text: The mode selector now shows a list of options instead of a simple switch. You can directly choose between fast, max, or plan modes.

2bb32123f60ddb7e4005bec14aae94e29a6404b3.text: The website's automatic checks were fixed to keep the assistant's data fresh and accurate. This makes the service more reliable for you.

3b2e13ab66a1aab36a742c2528e285910733bd65.text: The app now stops waiting for a timer when you switch modes. This prevents the screen from showing the wrong mode after a click.

a9395df8485ddc52cd980a9cc46a59dc00d4d62d.text: The app no longer checks for a specific editor to adjust how fast lists scroll. This change is small and internal.

7f8f33102e5c03dd36904f7a965535ec8aa259f3.text: Scroll speed in the app now adjusts based on your settings instead of just turning on or off. This makes scrolling smoother and easier to control.

e954f5f99053c912d7107fd3087e1aa59802c66d.title: chat-scroll-accel clamp back
e954f5f99053c912d7107fd3087e1aa59802c66d.summary: Replaced inline Math.min with clamp utility in QuadraticScrollAccel. Enforces minimum 1 row bound for scroll acceleration calculation. Scope limited to cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts.

fd73f201245a782db35f3ab05c8ebe5609c25250.title: CLI inertial scroll removed for quadratic
fd73f201245a782db35f3ab05c8ebe5609c25250.summary: Replaced `InertialScrollAccel` with `createChatScrollAcceleration` in `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts`. Deleted ~170 lines of inertial physics code (momentum, impulse windows, decay). Kept quadratic acceleration with adjusted multipliers. Affects CLI scroll behavior only.

a4b59dacf055dcc4e1554c15fcd7317b2c77a158.title: CLI message block ancestor prefix simplification
a4b59dacf055dcc4e1554c15fcd7317b2c77a158.summary: The CLI message block renderer now skips the first level of ancestor branches when constructing prefixes. This change reduces visual clutter by replacing vertical bars with spaces for all ancestors except the deepest one. The modification is isolated to `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`.

43413249f51bf453864381565ef61394e0ddd014.title: Linear scroll acceleration on macOS
43413249f51bf453864381565ef61394e0ddd014.summary: Switches chat scrolling to linear acceleration on macOS via `LinearScrollAccel` in `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts`. Renames `CODEBUFF_SCROLL_MODE` to `CODEBUFF_SCROLL_MULTIPLIER`, adds `fast` override, and applies platform-specific class selection. Default multiplier now uses `ENV_MULTIPLIERS.default` constant.

63d75420cad298d212820c1778bf7d4f09fb3aef.title: QuadraticScrollAccel buffer for macOS
63d75420cad298d212820c1778bf7d4f09fb3aef.summary: QuadraticScrollAccel now uses fractional accumulator buffer instead of rounding per tick. createChatScrollAcceleration drops platform check, always returns QuadraticScrollAccel. Affects cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts. Reset clears buffer alongside tickHistory.

e0d97b8d015a33156113d8d766e1b36eccc6ed6c.title: CLI: remove scrollToAgent and agentRefsMap
e0d97b8d015a33156113d8d766e1b36eccc6ed6c.summary: Deleted `scrollToAgent` logic and `agentRefsMap` tracking from the CLI chat interface. This removes the automatic scroll-to-anchor behavior when toggling agent or tool branches, simplifying `useChatScrollbox` and `MessageBlock` props. Affected files include `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-message-renderer.tsx`, and `cli/src/hooks/use-scroll-management.ts`.

ce38853421e74583e915c5d7480275ae42e14a16.title: Add ghostty scroll multiplier and refactor env detection
ce38853421e74583e915c5d7480275ae42e14a16.summary: Refactored `resolveScrollEnvironment` in `cli/src/utils/chat-scroll-accel.ts` to use a centralized `ENVIRONMENTS` array and `ENV_MULTIPLIERS` map, adding explicit support for `ghostty` (0.3) and `vscode` (0.3). Default scroll multiplier changed from undefined/1 to 0.2 when no environment is detected, and `slow` override now applies a 0.5x factor to the detected environment's multiplier instead of a fixed 0.12. Replaced `clamp` with `Math.min`/`Math.round` for scroll row calculation.

361d2e45cb0845681a4c5b23818f9efce596776a.title: best-of-n planner prompts gain code style nits
361d2e45cb0845681a4c5b23818f9efce596776a.summary: Code style notes added to plan-selector and best-of-n-implementor prompts. Covers sparse try/catch, required args over optional, new components in new files. Internal agent guidance only.

22452ae741879dd71b30193efb8585f9f1419bdc.title: QuadraticScrollAccel replaces createChatScrollAcceleration in CLI chat
22452ae741879dd71b30193efb8585f9f1419bdc.summary: New `QuadraticScrollAccel` class implements `ScrollAcceleration` using a rolling time window and `Queue` utility to calculate tick averages, replacing the factory function in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. A shared `clamp` helper was extracted into new `cli/src/utils/math.ts`, while `cli/src/utils/arrays.ts` gained `repeated` and a ring-buffer `Queue` implementation. The change affects only CLI chat scrolling behavior; no Web/Desktop surfaces modified.

a4b59dacf055dcc4e1554c15fcd7317b2c77a158.text: The assistant now shows fewer lines in its messages. This makes the text easier to read.

d96c8279b4cb496a7023016d4921ef1679aa3aa6.text: The command-line tool now displays the assistant's thinking process in gray text before showing the final answer.

e0d97b8d015a33156113d8d766e1b36eccc6ed6c.text: The app no longer automatically jumps to the top of a conversation when you open or close a message section. This is an internal cleanup that simplifies how the chat window handles scrolling.

fd73f201245a782db35f3ab05c8ebe5609c25250.text: The scrolling behavior in the command-line interface was simplified by removing complex momentum physics. This change is internal and makes scrolling feel more predictable, with no visible impact on regular use.

e954f5f99053c912d7107fd3087e1aa59802c66d.text: A small internal fix ensures the chat interface never scrolls too fast, keeping the view steady and easy to follow.

ce38853421e74583e915c5d7480275ae42e14a16.text: Scrolling speed now adjusts automatically for more types of apps. If the app cannot tell what you are using, it defaults to a slower, smoother speed.

361d2e45cb0845681a4c5b23818f9efce596776a.text: The internal instructions guiding the assistant's planning and coding processes were updated to enforce cleaner, more consistent logic and structure. This is a minor, behind-the-scenes change that does not directly alter the features or interface you interact with.

63d75420cad298d212820c1778bf7d4f09fb3aef.text: Scrolling now feels smoother on Mac. The system tracks tiny movements instead of ignoring them, so the view moves more naturally.

22452ae741879dd71b30193efb8585f9f1419bdc.text: Scrolling in the text chat feels smoother and more natural. This is a small internal update that improves how fast the screen moves when you scroll.

43413249f51bf453864381565ef61394e0ddd014.text: Chat scrolling on Mac now moves at a steady speed when you use your scroll wheel. This makes browsing conversations feel smoother and more predictable.

8555bf43ac590b20a7657db241d57c280d7282c3.title: Update initialSessionState call format in test-query-files.js
8555bf43ac590b20a7657db241d57c280d7282c3.summary: Refactored `initialSessionState` invocation in `sdk/test/tree-sitter-queries/test-query-files.js` to use a single options object instead of positional arguments. The `cwd` is now passed explicitly within the options object alongside `projectFiles`, `knowledgeFiles`, and other configuration parameters. This change aligns the test with the current API signature for `initialSessionState`. No functional changes to the test logic or assertions were made.

2c43eb9edaf19ff68971df7f3b80673c8324fe93.title: Remove SDK environment section from CLI welcome message
2c43eb9edaf19ff68971df7f3b80673c8324fe93.summary: Deleted SDK environment variable display logic from `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Removed `getCodebuffClient` import and associated block generation for raw/computed env vars. Streamlines welcome message output by eliminating verbose diagnostic info.

1533a0da7dddf47d8e389e96789a9bd9985e61d0.title: SDK defaults to fs.promises for filesystem operations
1533a0da7dddf47d8e389e96789a9bd9985e61d0.summary: SDK `run` and `initialSessionState` now default `fsSource` and `fs` to `require('fs').promises` instead of the raw `fs` module. This aligns internal file discovery with the `CodebuffFileSystem` interface expectations, removing the need for dynamic `import('fs')` casts. The change affects `sdk/src/run.ts` and `sdk/src/run-state.ts`, ensuring consistent async file handling for project and knowledge file discovery.

c458a7c7926924785efd4b35f1b1fa236a3a50d8.title: Trim CLI welcome screen and limit agent preview to 3
c458a7c7926924785efd4b35f1b1fa236a3a50d8.summary: Removed client environment variable dump from CLI welcome screen in `cli/src/chat.tsx`, relying on explicit `marginTop`/`marginBottom` spacing after ASCII logo instead of manual newlines. `TRUNCATE_LIMIT` for agent previews reduced from 5 to 3 in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`. Scope covers CLI chat rendering and message block components. Environment variable display logic now depends solely on SDK client availability.

c2456e094f56f947238b987e1fd7f0ea17bfbecf.title: Remove duplicate prompt rendering in agent-branch-item
c2456e094f56f947238b987e1fd7f0ea17bfbecf.summary: Removed duplicate prompt rendering block from `agent-branch-item.tsx`. Prompt now renders only once within expanded content section. Eliminates redundant UI duplication in CLI subagent branch items.

181a942c1336c3e198f43edca9e10af0a0d2c9ac.title: CLI tools registry refactors message rendering
181a942c1336c3e198f43edca9e10af0a0d2c9ac.summary: Tool rendering moves to `cli/src/components/tools/` with a central registry. `message-block.tsx` now calls `renderToolComponent` from `tools/registry` instead of `getToolRenderConfig` from deleted `tool-renderer.tsx`. Individual tool components like `code-search.tsx` and `list-directory.tsx` define rendering logic via `defineToolComponent`. Scope: CLI components only; no model or API changes.

660ec145ac1fecde82d2efdffca1cc83d5ddc0a3.title: Hide branching characters in top-level CLI messages
660ec145ac1fecde82d2efdffca1cc83d5ddc0a3.summary: Branching characters (│, ├, └) are now suppressed for top-level messages in the CLI, appearing only within subagents (indentLevel > 0). This change modifies `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` to conditionally render prefixes based on `ancestorBranchStates.length`. Tool previews and headers align without branch padding when at the root level.

982826a24ba6ed6d3f5ad0b1bc764d9df640dc9e.title: Structured error logging in CLI SDK client
982826a24ba6ed6d3f5ad0b1bc764d9df640dc9e.summary: New `cli/src/utils/error.ts` provides `ErrorOr<T>` result types and `getErrorObject` to normalize exceptions into serializable objects. `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` uses `getErrorObject` to pass structured error data to `logger.error` when `SDK client.run()` fails. Scope limited to CLI utilities and message hook. Non-Error throws fallback to stringified message with default 'Error' name.

8123b654697ca99500ce7f3f86f90ddde3c5eaaf.title: CLI persists input history to message-history.json
8123b654697ca99500ce7f3f86f90ddde3c5eaaf.summary: CLI input history now persists to disk in `message-history.json` within the config directory. `use-input-history.ts` loads history on mount and saves on every new message via new `message-history.ts` utility. Scope limited to CLI; files `cli/src/utils/message-history.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-input-history.ts`. History capped at 1000 entries; invalid JSON resets to empty array.

d965302b24714790de558e0250541d964f2ccd44.title: SDK filesystem interface migrates to async promises
d965302b24714790de558e0250541d964f2ccd44.summary: CodebuffFileSystem type in common/src/types/filesystem.ts now exclusively accepts fs.promises methods (exists, mkdir, readdir, readFile, stat, writeFile), removing all synchronous fs.*Sync counterparts. Core utilities like getProjectFileTree, parseGitignore, and ensureDirectoryExists in common/src/util/file.ts and common/src/project-file-tree.ts were converted to async functions returning Promises to match the new interface. This change impacts the SDK core, CLI (npm-app/src/cli.ts), and Evals (evals/scaffolding.ts), requiring callers to await filesystem operations. Synchronous helpers like getCurrentChatDirSync were retained or introduced in npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts to preserve non-blocking UI threads where async propagation is impractical.

8123b654697ca99500ce7f3f86f90ddde3c5eaaf.text: The command-line tool now saves your typed history to a file on your computer. This means your previous commands remain available for quick access even after you close and reopen the program.

181a942c1336c3e198f43edca9e10af0a0d2c9ac.text: The internal system that displays tool results was reorganized for better structure. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for you.

982826a24ba6ed6d3f5ad0b1bc764d9df640dc9e.text: The app now records clearer details when a message fails to send. This helps support teams diagnose problems faster, though it does not change how you use the app.

8555bf43ac590b20a7657db241d57c280d7282c3.text: Internal cleanup of a test file to match the new API. No changes to product features or user experience.

2c43eb9edaf19ff68971df7f3b80673c8324fe93.text: The assistant's welcome message now hides a list of technical settings that were previously shown. This makes the start-up screen simpler and less cluttered for users.

c458a7c7926924785efd4b35f1b1fa236a3a50d8.text: The assistant's welcome screen now shows fewer technical details, and lists only the first three suggested agents instead of five. This makes the initial view cleaner and less cluttered.

d965302b24714790de558e0250541d964f2ccd44.text: The tool now handles file tasks in the background instead of stopping everything until they finish. This keeps the app feeling smoother and more responsive while it works.

660ec145ac1fecde82d2efdffca1cc83d5ddc0a3.text: The assistant now hides decorative lines that show conversation structure when speaking directly to you. These lines still appear when the assistant talks to its internal helpers, keeping the main chat window cleaner and easier to read.

c2456e094f56f947238b987e1fd7f0ea17bfbecf.text: The text of your request no longer appears twice in the conversation view. This makes the interface cleaner and easier to read.

1533a0da7dddf47d8e389e96789a9bd9985e61d0.text: The assistant now uses a smoother method to find files in your project. This is a small internal update that improves how it handles file searches.

5b6b84a99d1b5084203b67e29ae5f658ea5fa2b9.title: Remove re-exported types from theme-system
5b6b84a99d1b5084203b67e29ae5f658ea5fa2b9.summary: Removed backward-compatibility re-exports for ChatTheme and ThemeColor from cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts. Updated imports to rely directly on ../types/theme-system. Refactored file watcher callback in setupFileWatchers to multi-line format.

985a7edea88be2e4a57f41e92eac85ad99521de2.title: Chat themes use transparent background
985a7edea88be2e4a57f41e92eac85ad99521de2.summary: Default chat themes in `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts` set `background` to `transparent` instead of fixed hex colors (`#000000` dark, `#ffffff` light). This change allows the terminal's native background to show through, improving visual integration with user-configured terminal color schemes. The update applies to both light and dark theme definitions within `DEFAULT_CHAT_THEMES`.

aa0d702629ed970d991c64f26e5ba4f349f0daf4.title: Relaxed env defaults and DB stubs for local tests
aa0d702629ed970d991c64f26e5ba4f349f0daf4.summary: Client and server env schemas now apply fallback values for local test runs, avoiding strict validation failures. The database module exports a minimal stub that throws on usage when `isLocalTest` is true, preventing Postgres connections during unit tests. This behavior is gated by `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT === 'test'` and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS !== 'true'`, keeping CI strict. Files: `common/src/env.ts`, `packages/internal/src/env.ts`, `packages/internal/src/db/index.ts`.

07652b39164bd06034983f1e13aedb2c0fb8158d.title: Remove CLI debug log spam
07652b39164bd06034983f1e13aedb2c0fb8158d.summary: Removed verbose logger.info calls from use-auth-query.ts and use-send-message.ts. Eliminates spam during API key validation and streaming agent updates. Scope limited to CLI hooks. No functional changes to auth or message processing.

152ffd521401cd8b08227eeede5f7066e02d473c.title: Remove suggestion menu padding in CLI
152ffd521401cd8b08227eeede5f7066e02d473c.summary: SuggestionMenu component paddingLeft and paddingRight set to 0. Eliminates horizontal whitespace surrounding menu items. Affects cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx.

ad42fd4105812cf4e320fef6bb37b4403ef598c0.title: Fix slash menu exact match filter
ad42fd4105812cf4e320fef6bb37b4403ef598c0.summary: Corrected `filterSlashCommands` in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts` to return `matches` instead of `commands` when `shouldKeepSearching` is false. This ensures exact matches are properly surfaced in the CLI slash menu. `filterAgentMatches` was also adjusted to consistently return `matches`.

90a461c2e715db1aa14e174c1ce7893bd9bb47c1.title: New TUI design with raised pills, theme hooks, OpenTUI 0.1.33
90a461c2e715db1aa14e174c1ce7893bd9bb47c1.summary: CLI TUI redesigned: new `RaisedPill` component replaces inline box-styled toggles (agent mode, status pills, branch indicators). Theme system migrated from `useSystemThemeDetector` to `useTheme`/`useResolvedThemeName` hooks backed by a new `theme-store` and `theme-config` module. `branch-item.tsx` split into `agent-branch-item.tsx` and `tool-branch-item.tsx`/`tool-renderer.tsx`, with markdown output now wrapped in `<text>` before reaching `<box>` to prevent OpenTUI crashes on bare `<span>` nodes. OpenTUI pinned from `^0.1.28` to exact `0.1.33`. `setIsAuthenticated` widened to `boolean | null` to defer auth UI during resolution.

daaed4019d7b44c9ccef3c878fcb24203f2ff190.title: Revert local test env defaults and DB stubs
daaed4019d7b44c9ccef3c878fcb24203f2ff190.summary: Reverts relaxed environment defaults and database stubs previously added for local test runs. Removes `isLocalTest` logic and `withClientDefaults`/`withServerDefaults` from `common/src/env.ts` and `packages/internal/src/env.ts`, restoring strict schema validation. Removes the `dbInstance` stub logic in `packages/internal/src/db/index.ts`, reverting to direct `drizzle` initialization.

1746ec3f4fd7645e9dc9338344e58088a65be373.title: CLI suggestion menu maxVisible prop now required
1746ec3f4fd7645e9dc9338344e58088a65be373.summary: SuggestionMenu component now requires maxVisible prop, removing default value of 10. Change affects chat.tsx and suggestion-menu.tsx. No functional behavior change for agents and slash commands.

050f460a48cc6be8db4f5bf6c216bb87088f05cd.title: Increase CLI suggestion menu max visible items to 10
050f460a48cc6be8db4f5bf6c216bb87088f05cd.summary: The default maxVisible prop in cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx increased from 5 to 10. This expands the number of suggestions displayed simultaneously in the CLI picker. Affects CLI surfaces only.

07652b39164bd06034983f1e13aedb2c0fb8158d.text: The app stops printing extra text when checking your login and sending messages. This makes the screen cleaner. Nothing else changes.

90a461c2e715db1aa14e174c1ce7893bd9bb47c1.text: The interface now uses rounded buttons for options, making it easier to identify active modes. The app is more stable when displaying complex text, preventing occasional crashes during use.

aa0d702629ed970d991c64f26e5ba4f349f0daf4.text: The system now uses safe placeholder settings for local testing, preventing errors when the real database is unavailable. This change is internal and does not affect the product's features or performance for users.

152ffd521401cd8b08227eeede5f7066e02d473c.text: The suggestion menu now displays without extra empty space on its sides. This change is small and internal. It makes the menu look slightly more compact.

daaed4019d7b44c9ccef3c878fcb24203f2ff190.text: Developers removed temporary shortcuts used for internal testing. This change does not affect how you use the product.

1746ec3f4fd7645e9dc9338344e58088a65be373.text: The suggestion menu now needs a visible limit set by the builder. This change does not affect how the menu looks or works for you.

985a7edea88be2e4a57f41e92eac85ad99521de2.text: The chat screen now uses a see-through background instead of a solid color. This lets your terminal's own colors show through, making the app blend in with your setup.

5b6b84a99d1b5084203b67e29ae5f658ea5fa2b9.text: The program cleaned up internal instructions for how colors and styles are applied. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

050f460a48cc6be8db4f5bf6c216bb87088f05cd.text: The command-line tool now shows up to ten suggestions at once instead of five.

ad42fd4105812cf4e320fef6bb37b4403ef598c0.text: Fixed a bug where exact command matches were hidden in the menu. Commands now appear correctly when you type them fully.

b648bb7d911ad0715d29c0121fc18dabae8b87c1.title: Chat autocomplete selectCurrent return value cleanup
b648bb7d911ad0715d29c0121fc18dabae8b87c1.summary: selectCurrent now returns undefined instead of true when no item is selected or startIndex is invalid in cli/src/chat.tsx. Added inline comments clarifying wrap vs no-wrap behavior for up/down/tab navigation in slash and agent matchers.

04a3759345130a71386a0a27a969f1b07c296808.title: Tweak writetodos prompt
04a3759345130a71386a0a27a969f1b07c296808.summary: Updated description in `write_todos` tool parameters to explicitly instruct adding ALL applicable tasks to prevent forgetting items. This change targets the `common/src/tools/params/tool/write-todos.ts` file. The adjustment aims to improve task tracking completeness by emphasizing full task list inclusion.

0ff14424b901b040bcd950d94c865ce474f005b1.title: chat.tsx selectCurrent returns false
0ff14424b901b040bcd950d94c865ce474f005b1.summary: selectCurrent in cli/src/chat.tsx now returns false instead of undefined. Fixes TypeScript strict return type compliance for slash and mention autocomplete handlers. Affects CLI chat interface only. No behavioral change for users.

0972d5c1c05e859711d56441de8aa26fd46093dd.title: Refine base2 agent validation and todo instructions
0972d5c1c05e859711d56441de8aa26fd46093dd.summary: Updated base2 agent prompts in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to mandate writing all applicable tasks to `write_todos` and to prioritize scoped typechecking before full-project tests. The validation instruction now explicitly directs the agent to test only the edited area first, falling back to broader checks if necessary. This internal change affects the core agent logic, aiming to improve efficiency and accuracy in complex codebase interactions.

c6f9d529f6b3abdf86a7c189f803e52b35cab6f6.title: Remove high reasoning effort from GPT-5 in best-of-n implementor
c6f9d529f6b3abdf86a7c189f803e52b35cab6f6.summary: Removed `reasoningOptions` with `effort: 'high'` from GPT-5 configuration in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-implementor.ts`. Reverts to medium effort. Internal agent configuration only.

ed8123417d0efdc798db9c0b825982936b241ea0.title: Build Fast and Build Max buttons added to Plan mode
ed8123417d0efdc798db9c0b825982936b241ea0.summary: New `BuildModeButtons` component adds clickable 'Build Fast' and 'Build Max' actions to the CLI interface, visible after a successful PLAN mode response. The `chat-store` tracks this state via `hasReceivedPlanResponse`, which `use-send-message` updates on send and completion. Clicking these buttons sets the agent mode to FAST or MAX and automatically submits the prompt 'Build it!'.

328e5f2b849e1242af413cc72549754d1caba9ba.title: Revert inline store agent data fetch to API route
328e5f2b849e1242af413cc72549754d1caba9ba.summary: Reverts the `getAgentsData` implementation in `web/src/app/store/agents-data.ts` from a direct database query back to an HTTP fetch of `/api/agents`. The previous change inlined the agent aggregation logic directly into the store data layer, removing the dependency on the API route. This revert restores the separation of concerns, ensuring store pages fetch data via the API rather than direct DB access, and deletes the now-unused `web/src/server/agents-data.ts` file.

0a6469f29d60e48a1aa18c4a6fc74281273689a4.title: CLI suggestion menu adds subsequence matching and highlighting
0a6469f29d60e48a1aa18c4a6fc74281273689a4.summary: The CLI slash-command suggestion menu now supports fuzzy subsequence matching and visual highlighting of matched characters. New utility functions `getSubsequenceIndices` and `range` power the matching logic in `use-suggestion-engine.ts`, while `HighlightedSubsequenceText` renders the colored spans in `suggestion-menu.tsx`. Slash command labels for `logout` and `trace` were updated to include their aliases (e.g., `logout (signout)`).

bd99ce76aa5be86d9e992b23f05f20a0ec1be865.title: PLAN agent mode added to CLI cycle
bd99ce76aa5be86d9e992b23f05f20a0ec1be865.summary: PLAN mode added to agentModes constant and toggle cycle (FAST -> MAX -> PLAN -> FAST). AgentModeToggle renders PLAN with blue background and adjusted padding. useSendMessage maps PLAN to base2-plan fallback agent. Scope limited to CLI files: constants.ts, chat-store.ts, agent-mode-toggle.tsx, use-send-message.ts, chat.tsx.

d56e2c7ac34337e890d0fab14412986da94a4d03.title: Tab key now selects and wraps in slash and agent dropdowns
d56e2c7ac34337e890d0fab14412986da94a4d03.summary: Tab key behavior updated in slash command and agent mention dropdowns. Tab now wraps around the list instead of stopping at the ends, and selects the current item when only one match exists. Selection logic extracted into a shared `selectCurrent` helper.

c6f9d529f6b3abdf86a7c189f803e52b35cab6f6.text: The internal assistant now uses less computing effort for certain tasks. This change is small and affects only how the system works behind the scenes.

0972d5c1c05e859711d56441de8aa26fd46093dd.text: The assistant now checks small changes first before testing everything, making it faster and more accurate.

04a3759345130a71386a0a27a969f1b07c296808.text: The assistant now receives clearer instructions to include every relevant task when creating a to-do list. This helps prevent it from forgetting steps during complex requests.

0a6469f29d60e48a1aa18c4a6fc74281273689a4.text: Typing fewer letters now finds the command. Matched parts are highlighted. Logout and trace show their other names.

328e5f2b849e1242af413cc72549754d1caba9ba.text: The system now uses a central service to fetch store agent data, rather than accessing the database directly. This internal cleanup keeps the store information consistent and reliable.

0ff14424b901b040bcd950d94c865ce474f005b1.text: A small internal update improved how the chat tool handles suggestions. Users will see no change in how it works.

b648bb7d911ad0715d29c0121fc18dabae8b87c1.text: The chat tool now handles empty or invalid selections more cleanly. This is a small internal fix that does not change how you use the product.

bd99ce76aa5be86d9e992b23f05f20a0ec1be865.text: A new planning mode was added to the assistant's settings. You can now switch to this blue-highlighted option to use a different assistant behavior.

d56e2c7ac34337e890d0fab14412986da94a4d03.text: Pressing the Tab key now moves through suggestion lists in a loop, so you can cycle back to the top after reaching the bottom. If only one suggestion matches, the Tab key selects it for you.

ed8123417d0efdc798db9c0b825982936b241ea0.text: After the assistant creates a plan, two new buttons appear to start building it immediately. You can choose between a quick build or a thorough build, and clicking either one sends the command to begin work without typing anything.

26a225aedcdd25aa90b5a618a806255e3590e154.title: Add /clear and /new commands to CLI
26a225aedcdd25aa90b5a618a806255e3590e154.summary: CLI chat interface now supports `/clear` and `/new` slash commands to reset conversation state. `routeUserPrompt` intercepts these commands to empty messages, stop streaming, and disable queue processing. `useSendMessage` exposes a `clearMessages` function that resets `previousRunStateRef`, ensuring fresh agent context. Scope limited to `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/commands/router.ts`, and `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`.

61e026159f3a419979f25c86141176258af58b62.title: Rename slash-commands to commands, handleSlashCommands to
61e026159f3a419979f25c86141176258af58b62.summary: CLI internal refactor renames slash-commands directory to commands and handleSlashCommands function to routeUserPrompt. Files moved: cli/src/slash-commands/init.ts to cli/src/commands/init.ts, cli/src/slash-commands/handlers.ts to cli/src/commands/router.ts. Import updated in cli/src/chat.tsx. No user-facing behavior change.

98c597943c9ba218c4c03c4117330eddf99a591a.title: Remove mergeTextSegments heuristic from CLI stream handler
98c597943c9ba218c4c03c4117330eddf99a591a.summary: Deleted mergeTextSegments in cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts. Stream chunks now append directly to accumulators. Fixes rendering issues caused by overlap detection. Scope limited to CLI text streaming.

d9b729f958badf789386989b4495d686c788f56c.title: Fix /init history saving in CLI router
d9b729f958badf789386989b4495d686c788f56c.summary: Moved `saveToHistory` and `setInputValue` calls to occur after `handleInitializationFlowLocally` in `cli/src/commands/router.ts`. Previously, history was saved before the `/init` command handler ran, potentially capturing incomplete state or bypassing handler logic. This ensures the user message is processed by the initialization flow before being persisted to history.

22e79b1075811c2c7819a1d4a55763cc5bee77c5.title: Extract handleSlashCommands router and define AgentMode type
22e79b1075811c2c7819a1d4a55763cc5bee77c5.summary: Extracted slash command routing logic into `cli/src/utils/slash-commands.ts` with a new `handleSlashCommands` function, reducing inline complexity in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Introduced `AgentMode` type in `cli/src/utils/constants.ts` to replace hardcoded `'FAST' | 'MAX'` unions across `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, and `cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx`. Scope limited to CLI core utilities and state management; no external API or model changes. `handleSlashCommands` accepts explicit refs and setters for `agentMode`, `inputValue`, and `logoutMutation` to decouple UI state from command execution.

3e5f667a18687dab45fb0713e3f550d2d907a1cd.title: Add /init command to CLI slash-command handlers
3e5f667a18687dab45fb0713e3f550d2d907a1cd.summary: New /init command registered in cli/src/slash-commands/handlers.ts and implemented in cli/src/slash-commands/init.ts. Core types (ChatMessage, ContentBlock, ChatTheme) moved from chat.tsx and utils/theme-system.ts to cli/src/types/, requiring import path updates across chat.tsx and components like agent-mode-toggle.tsx, branch-item.tsx, login-modal.tsx, message-block.tsx, separator.tsx, status-indicator.tsx, suggestion-menu.tsx, use-message-renderer.tsx, and use-send-message.ts. useSendMessage now returns a typed SendMessageFn from cli/src/types/contracts/send-message.ts.

ea0e5672c9860afeed32876de87b953e2001b827.title: Fix typecheck for unit tests
ea0e5672c9860afeed32876de87b953e2001b827.summary: Adds missing `loggerWithContext` mock to agent-runs and chat-completions unit tests. Resolves typecheck errors caused by new `LoggerWithContextFn` requirement. Internal test infrastructure only.

85bc484bfaf0397fb201e699843a73f3a69f3bf1.title: Update file picker max and base2 to use readsubtree tool
85bc484bfaf0397fb201e699843a73f3a69f3bf1.summary: Base2 agent now includes `read_subtree` in its `toolNames`. `file-lister` and `file-picker-max` agents updated to utilize `read_subtree` for directory-scoped file discovery, removing reliance on static file tree prompts. `file-lister` explicitly yields `read_subtree` with `maxTokens: 200_000` and accepts optional `directories` params. `file-picker-max` passes `params` to `file-lister` and changes final yield from `STEP_ALL` to `STEP`.

78f004a6bcef7bc20cec2153b55127a5629fde98.title: Inline store agent data fetch
78f004a6bcef7bc20cec2153b55127a5629fde98.summary: Store page fetches agent data directly via `getCachedAgents` instead of self-fetching `/api/agents`. This eliminates network overhead and potential SSR fetch failures during static generation. Changes affect `web/src/app/store/agents-data.ts` and introduce `web/src/server/agents-data.ts` for shared logic. Build-time errors are suppressed in CI/production builds via `NEXT_PHASE` check.

c1df8c7639422ed1d9f4d46c2fef006e64fa87cd.title: Update slash command labels and aliases
c1df8c7639422ed1d9f4d46c2fef006e64fa87cd.summary: Slash command labels updated for clarity: `exit` becomes `exit (quit)`, `usage` becomes `usage (credits)`. The `reset` command is renamed to `new` with aliases `reset` and `clear`, and label `new (reset, clear)`. These changes affect the CLI slash menu display and command matching logic in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`.
