61e026159f3a419979f25c86141176258af58b62.text: The team renamed internal parts of the chat tool to make the code easier to read and maintain. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

d9b729f958badf789386989b4495d686c788f56c.text: The assistant now saves your command to history only after it finishes processing it. This prevents the history from recording incomplete actions.

26a225aedcdd25aa90b5a618a806255e3590e154.text: The chat tool now has a way to clear the conversation and start fresh.

78f004a6bcef7bc20cec2153b55127a5629fde98.text: The store now loads agent information more directly, making the page faster and more reliable. This small internal change helps the site run smoothly without affecting how you use it.

85bc484bfaf0397fb201e699843a73f3a69f3bf1.text: The assistant now checks file lists live instead of using outdated snapshots. This means it finds files more reliably and reflects recent changes.

3e5f667a18687dab45fb0713e3f550d2d907a1cd.text: A new command lets you reset the chat session directly from the tool. This change also cleans up internal code, which does not affect how you use the product.

22e79b1075811c2c7819a1d4a55763cc5bee77c5.text: The code behind the command menu was cleaned up to make it easier to maintain. This is a small internal update that does not change how you use the app.

ea0e5672c9860afeed32876de87b953e2001b827.text: This internal update fixes a test error. It does not change how the product works for you.

c1df8c7639422ed1d9f4d46c2fef006e64fa87cd.text: Menu labels now show plain words like 'quit' and 'credits' to clarify what each option does. The 'new' command replaces 'reset' but still works with old names.

a57412a744db974df14dcc728e5ae5029a134187.title: Add logger param to clearAgentGeneratorCache
a57412a744db974df14dcc728e5ae5029a134187.summary: clearAgentGeneratorCache in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts now requires a params object containing a logger. This aligns the test helper with the Logger dependency pattern used elsewhere in the agent runtime. Internal change only; no user-facing behavior impact.

66b00b05a298ea8200bb3947b3bdf3ccf84b7fc5.title: Move chat completions to app router
66b00b05a298ea8200bb3947b3bdf3ccf84b7fc5.summary: Relocates chat completions handler to `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` and renames `chatCompletionsPost` to `postChatCompletions`. `route.ts` imports the new module path. Scope: web app router structure.

7ee10af5c6292c69fe6c2cfc04e5b84cc88e6ec9.title: Move agent-runs POST handler into route segment
7ee10af5c6292c69fe6c2cfc04e5b84cc88e6ec9.summary: Relocated agent-runs POST handler from web/src/api/v1/agent-runs.ts to web/src/app/api/v1/agent-runs/_post.ts. Renamed exported function agentRunsPost to postAgentRuns. Updated route.ts import to use relative path for co-location.

2e6dfaa8a0f25649a775944b1373195da0eddac5.title: Remove SDK environment info display
2e6dfaa8a0f25649a775944b1373195da0eddac5.summary: Reverts temporary test code that displayed SDK environment variables in the CLI chat interface. The `getEnvironmentInfo` method is removed from `sdk/src/client.ts`, and the corresponding UI block and import are stripped from `cli/src/chat.tsx`. This cleanup restores the standard environment variable display without exposing internal SDK constants.

c863b32d9653e8b268cf70477a0e3a358754a8ea.title: Move /api/v1/me GET handler out of impl directory
c863b32d9653e8b268cf70477a0e3a358754a8ea.summary: Relocates the `meGet` function from `web/src/app/api/v1/me/impl/_get.ts` to `web/src/app/api/v1/me/_get.ts`. Renames the exported function to `getMe` and updates the import in `web/src/app/api/v1/me/route.ts`. This change simplifies the directory structure for the `/me` API route.

696e0cb5474c37670a8d2edf5ea5004bccc8091f.title: Handlesteps run outside QuickJS sandbox
696e0cb5474c37670a8d2edf5ea5004bccc8091f.summary: Programmatic handlesteps generators now execute via native `eval` instead of QuickJS. Removes `SandboxManager` dependency from `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`. String-based templates compile to native generators; `clearAgentGeneratorCache` drops sandbox disposal logic. Scope limited to agent runtime step execution.

4adf0209934e11b8234ccc8cb9cb4ac1397f18c3.title: Add loggerWithContext to web API routes
4adf0209934e11b8234ccc8cb9cb4ac1397f18c3.summary: Introduced `loggerWithContext` in `web/src/util/logger.ts` and updated type contracts in `common/src/types/contracts/logger.ts`. Modified agent-run and chat-completion API handlers in `web` to inject user context (id, email, discord_id) into logs via the new helper. This ensures structured logging captures relevant user metadata for debugging API interactions.

f124c425840c5d9ee9fddbc991e1f376de3c5b37.title: Remove environment variable display from CLI welcome message
f124c425840c5d9ee9fddbc991e1f376de3c5b37.summary: Removed logic displaying client environment variables in the CLI welcome message. This eliminates the list of `key=value` pairs derived from `clientEnvVars` and `env`. The change affects `cli/src/chat.tsx` by deleting the block generation and associated imports.

3d00284e7b19c3c1cb387e09a8cde04ea2d9fa15.title: Auto-init analytics client in trackEvent
3d00284e7b19c3c1cb387e09a8cde04ea2d9fa15.summary: trackEvent now calls initAnalytics if client is missing, retrying init before skipping. PostHog env vars NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST_URL made required in clientEnvSchema. Change affects common/src/analytics.ts and common/src/env-schema.ts. Ensures events track even if initAnalytics was not explicitly called first.

23fce4bc71e65f985c2514766b091e8e03c550b3.title: Move agentRunsStepsPost into app/api route handler
23fce4bc71e65f985c2514766b091e8e03c550b3.summary: Relocated `agentRunsStepsPost` from `web/src/api/.../steps.ts` to `web/src/app/api/.../steps/_post.ts` and renamed to `postAgentRunsSteps` to align with Next.js App Router file conventions. The `route.ts` handler now imports directly from the local `_post.ts` file instead of the global `@/api` path. This internal refactor standardizes API handler structure without altering external behavior.

2e6dfaa8a0f25649a775944b1373195da0eddac5.text: The app no longer shows extra technical details about its setup in the chat window. This keeps the screen clean and hides information meant only for developers.

4adf0209934e11b8234ccc8cb9cb4ac1397f18c3.text: The system now records extra details about who is using the service during specific interactions. This helps support teams find and fix issues faster.

a57412a744db974df14dcc728e5ae5029a134187.text: A small internal cleanup was made to how the system records its activity. This change does not affect how the product works or looks to users.

c863b32d9653e8b268cf70477a0e3a358754a8ea.text: This is a small internal change to how the app stores information. It does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

696e0cb5474c37670a8d2edf5ea5004bccc8091f.text: The assistant now runs steps using a different internal engine. This change does not affect how you use the product.

66b00b05a298ea8200bb3947b3bdf3ccf84b7fc5.text: The team moved a chat feature to a new location inside the app. This is an internal change. It does not affect how you use the product.

f124c425840c5d9ee9fddbc991e1f376de3c5b37.text: The text command line tool no longer shows a list of computer settings when it starts up. This cleans up the initial display for users.

7ee10af5c6292c69fe6c2cfc04e5b84cc88e6ec9.text: The team reorganized internal code to group related functions together. This is a small maintenance task that does not change how the product works for you.

3d00284e7b19c3c1cb387e09a8cde04ea2d9fa15.text: The app now automatically starts tracking usage if it wasn't already running. This ensures your activity is recorded correctly without extra steps.

76062241808bf656bbaf44fc48c6fa103d914704.title: Log request body on OpenRouter errors
76062241808bf656bbaf44fc48c6fa103d914704.summary: Added `body` to error logs and analytics events in `web/src/api/v1/chat/completions.ts`. This provides context for debugging 500 errors from OpenRouter requests.

d480caa1a16550765e58ff21ba3c3d1435e661dd.title: Fix CLI env var display in binary mode
d480caa1a16550765e58ff21ba3c3d1435e661dd.summary: Replaced hardcoded NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix scan with clientEnvVars array from @codebuff/common/env-schema. Binary builds embed vars via --define, accessible through env object from @codebuff/common/env. Dev mode reads process.env via Infisical. Long string values truncated to 50 chars.

df7b59628120cabc3ce07e2c2cc62edf5a9486e8.title: Export CodebuffFileSystem type from SDK
df7b59628120cabc3ce07e2c2cc62edf5a9486e8.summary: SDK now exports `CodebuffFileSystem` type from `@codebuff/common/types/filesystem`. `validate-agents` type exports collapsed to single line. Change limited to `sdk/src/index.ts`.

1addb355b9dbeac4859d0231e2e262f61789a12e.title: Remove file-researcher from base2 agent
1addb355b9dbeac4859d0231e2e262f61789a12e.summary: Removed `file-researcher` from `spawnableAgents` and deleted conditional prompt instructions in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`. Unified context-gathering guidance to rely on `file-picker-max`, `code-searcher`, and other agents without GPT-5 branching. Internal refactor of agent orchestration logic.

92c43c83a71391b1a7c012c86e6f6ad283e9402e.title: Add SDK environment info display to CLI diagnostics
92c43c83a71391b1a7c012c86e6f6ad283e9402e.summary: CLI `/env` command now displays raw SDK environment variables and computed constants alongside CLI variables. SDK `CodebuffClient` exposes new `getEnvironmentInfo()` method returning `rawEnv` (`NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_BACKEND_URL`) and `computed` (`WEBSITE_URL`, `BACKEND_URL`, `WEBSOCKET_URL`, `IS_DEV`, `IS_TEST`, `IS_PROD`). Change affects `cli/src/chat.tsx` and `sdk/src/client.ts`. Computed string values exceeding 50 chars truncated to 47 chars plus ellipsis.

c4525b44712ca41a7f4033b0e62143368d3e62a4.title: Add readsubtree tool
c4525b44712ca41a7f4033b0e62143368d3e62a4.summary: New read_subtree tool added to agent runtime and common constants. Reads directory subtrees or file variables, returning a truncated blob based on maxTokens. Registered in tool lists, definitions, handlers, and UI renderers across core, CLI, and agent packages. Defaults to 4000 token budget, truncating by dropping variables then deepest files.

a202fe8bc30d54e7fafad2a1967884bb93aeca52.title: Add n param to best-of-n orchestrator
a202fe8bc30d54e7fafad2a1967884bb93aeca52.summary: The `best-of-n-orchestrator` agents now accept an optional `n` input parameter to control the number of parallel implementor agents spawned. Previously hardcoded to 5, the orchestrator now uses `params.n` (defaulting to 5, clamped between 1 and 10) to dynamically generate the agent list for both GPT-5 and Sonnet variants. This change applies to `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-orchestrator.ts` and updates prompt guidelines in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to reflect the new capability for tuning proposal counts based on task complexity.

f60cea017f27be06cbfd4e12288c61d6eb024c68.title: CLI chat logs move to config dir
f60cea017f27be06cbfd4e12288c61d6eb024c68.summary: CLI chat directories and logs now use `getConfigDir()` instead of `process.cwd()` or `debug/chats`. `getProjectDataDir()` resolves paths under `<config>/projects/<basename>/chats/<id>`. `logger.ts` drops fallback to `debug/cli.log` for non-dev environments, enforcing `log.jsonl` in chat dir. Affects `cli/src/project-files.ts` and `cli/src/utils/logger.ts`.

35af4be2c9b2244cf105c95a6f98d6fa70e95db0.title: Rename best-of-n-orchestrator to best-of-n-editor
35af4be2c9b2244cf105c95a6f98d6fa70e95db0.summary: Renamed the agent definition, file, and function from best-of-n-orchestrator to best-of-n-editor. Updated references in base2.ts and base2-gpt-5-worker.ts to use the new id and gpt-5 variant. No functional change to the orchestration logic itself.

f1a628329680e646e1a2935eb032d53ebbea8ead.title: Refactor best-of-n orchestrator to factory pattern
f1a628329680e646e1a2935eb032d53ebbea8ead.summary: Replaces static best-of-n-orchestrator-fast and best-of-n-orchestrator-gpt-5 definitions with a createBestOfNOrchestrator factory function in best-of-n-orchestrator.ts. The factory accepts 'sonnet' or 'gpt-5' model identifiers, dynamically assigning models, display names, spawnable agents, and handleSteps generators. Updates base2.ts to reference the unified 'best-of-n-orchestrator' ID, removing the fast variant branch. This consolidation eliminates code duplication while preserving distinct GPT-5 and Sonnet orchestration behaviors.

35af4be2c9b2244cf105c95a6f98d6fa70e95db0.text: The team updated a behind-the-scenes tool to use a newer, more capable model. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

f60cea017f27be06cbfd4e12288c61d6eb024c68.text: Chat history and logs now save in the app's settings folder instead of the current working folder. This prevents files from scattering across different directories when using the tool.

d480caa1a16550765e58ff21ba3c3d1435e661dd.text: The tool now shows the correct list of settings when running in its fast mode. It also shortens very long text values to keep the display clean.

76062241808bf656bbaf44fc48c6fa103d914704.text: The system now records extra details when a request fails. This helps the team fix errors faster.

df7b59628120cabc3ce07e2c2cc62edf5a9486e8.text: The assistant can now better understand and use your computer's files. This is a small internal improvement that helps the product work more smoothly.

1addb355b9dbeac4859d0231e2e262f61789a12e.text: The assistant's internal search logic was simplified to use one consistent method for finding files. This background cleanup does not change how the product looks or works for you.

a202fe8bc30d54e7fafad2a1967884bb93aeca52.text: The assistant can now adjust the number of parallel attempts it makes to solve a problem. This allows it to scale its effort based on task complexity, rather than always using a fixed number.

92c43c83a71391b1a7c012c86e6f6ad283e9402e.text: The command-line tool now shows detailed environment settings in its diagnostics view. This helps users see exactly which service addresses and modes the application is using.

c4525b44712ca41a7f4033b0e62143368d3e62a4.text: The assistant can now read parts of a folder or file. If the content is too long, it cuts off the end to stay within limits. This helps the assistant access information more efficiently.

f1a628329680e646e1a2935eb032d53ebbea8ead.text: The team simplified how the system chooses between two different assistant models. This cleanup keeps the feature working exactly the same for you.

c8b4a8ba4c17a49aa733f77a0092614bff4ed550.title: Commander agent supports timeoutseconds
c8b4a8ba4c17a49aa733f77a0092614bff4ed550.summary: The Commander agent in `.agents/commander.ts` now accepts a `timeout_seconds` parameter. This value is passed through to the `run_terminal_command` tool, enabling control over execution duration (default 30, -1 for none).

66b8f3867533c5bc8a22bd30467770f3eda591b5.title: Convert base2 agent arrow functions to declarations
66b8f3867533c5bc8a22bd30467770f3eda591b5.summary: Refactors `createBase2` and prompt builders in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` from arrow function assignments to function declarations. This internal change standardizes code style for the base2 agent definition logic. No user-facing behavior or API changes occur.

597070f05ffed5ecc2d27887115ec732146fda98.title: Add high reasoning effort to base2 GPT-5 agent config
597070f05ffed5ecc2d27887115ec732146fda98.summary: The base2 agent configuration in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` now sets `reasoningModel: { effort: 'high' }` when `isGpt5` is true. This ensures the GPT-5 orchestrator runs with maximum reasoning capability for complex coding tasks. Scope limited to the internal base agent definition; no CLI or Web UI changes.

7d7fc6a97ae7101f97f63b9f28d29dd8dd4ed39d.title: Fix import paths in base2-gpt-5-worker agent
7d7fc6a97ae7101f97f63b9f28d29dd8dd4ed39d.summary: Corrected relative import paths for `createBase2` and `SecretAgentDefinition` in `base2-gpt-5-worker.ts`. The file was moved from `.agents-graveyard` to `.agents/base2/task-researcher`, requiring updated path references to resolve module dependencies correctly. This change affects only the internal agent definition file.

5ddb0fc5ffa9423bb1ffbc77f93ca30b0c0e92fb.title: Add base2-plan agent and planOnly option to createBase2
5ddb0fc5ffa9423bb1ffbc77f93ca30b0c0e92fb.summary: New `base2-plan` agent defined in `.agents/base2/base2-plan.ts` using `createBase2('fast', { planOnly: true })`. `createBase2` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` accepts `planOnly` flag, disabling `file-researcher` spawn and altering instructions when true. Best-of-N orchestrator prompts in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/` clarified to forbid input prompts.

9ada540db1aacc997d1ddadd035e472ff92c638f.title: base2-max promotes base2-gpt-5
9ada540db1aacc997d1ddadd035e472ff92c638f.summary: Removed base2-gpt-5 definition. createBase2 hardcodes isGpt5 for 'max' mode. base2-gpt-5-worker moved to .agents-graveyard. Tool lists updated: removed spawn_agent_inline, consolidated best-of-n-orchestrator logic.

11751cbab44ca3604533167eab638b81617d245d.title: Prevent bun.lock updates in eval init
11751cbab44ca3604533167eab638b81617d245d.summary: Eval init command now resets bun.lock via git checkout after install. Prevents lockfile drift from confusing the judge. Applies to evals/buffbench/eval-codebuff.json. No user-facing change.

f951b57d192cd4618891c28e7d2c0f07904eb66c.title: Best-of-N agents set reasoning effort high for GPT-5
f951b57d192cd4618891c28e7d2c0f07904eb66c.summary: Best-of-N implementor and selector agents now inject `reasoningOptions: { effort: 'high' }` when model is `gpt-5`. Conditional spread ensures options apply only to GPT-5, leaving Sonnet unchanged. Internal logic in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-implementor.ts` and `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-selector.ts`.

b8120de7bf3b353329dc10b9b0c73c55c1552f79.title: Add taskcompleted tool to base2-gpt-5 agent
b8120de7bf3b353329dc10b9b0c73c55c1552f79.summary: Added `task_completed` tool to `base2-gpt-5` agent configuration in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`. Replaces previous instruction requiring tool calls in every response with explicit completion signal. Scope limited to `base2` agent definition for GPT-5 models.

a1d40af6491908e8b1ff620c92aa66905458a0a7.title: codesearch SDK tool now emits context lines
a1d40af6491908e8b1ff620c92aa66905458a0a7.summary: The `code_search` SDK tool now processes both `match` and `context` event types from the underlying search engine, rather than ignoring `context` events. A new `fileMatchCounts` map tracks actual matches separately from total output lines, ensuring that context lines are included in the output without consuming the `maxResults` or `globalMaxResults` quotas. This change applies to the `codeSearch` function in `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`, affecting how search results are grouped and truncated for SDK consumers.

66b8f3867533c5bc8a22bd30467770f3eda591b5.text: The team cleaned up the code that tells the assistant how to behave. This change did not affect how the assistant works for you.

7d7fc6a97ae7101f97f63b9f28d29dd8dd4ed39d.text: We fixed a small internal issue with how one background tool finds its data. This change does not affect how you use the product.

c8b4a8ba4c17a49aa733f77a0092614bff4ed550.text: The assistant can now set a limit on how long a task runs. This lets you control whether it stops automatically or keeps going until finished.

11751cbab44ca3604533167eab638b81617d245d.text: This internal update prevents a small system error during automated tests. It does not change how you use the product.

f951b57d192cd4618891c28e7d2c0f07904eb66c.text: The system now uses a more careful thought process for one specific AI model when choosing the best answer. This small internal change aims to improve accuracy without affecting other models.

5ddb0fc5ffa9423bb1ffbc77f93ca30b0c0e92fb.text: The assistant gained a new mode that lets it think through a plan without trying to change any files. This helps it prepare a strategy first, making it more careful before taking action.

597070f05ffed5ecc2d27887115ec732146fda98.text: The assistant now uses more careful thinking when handling difficult coding tasks. This is an internal update that improves accuracy without changing how you use the product.

a1d40af6491908e8b1ff620c92aa66905458a0a7.text: Code search results now show surrounding lines to provide better context. This helps you understand matches without using up your search limits.

b8120de7bf3b353329dc10b9b0c73c55c1552f79.text: The assistant now knows when to stop working on a task. This internal change helps it finish jobs without unnecessary extra steps.

f89e20d18a57f969a42bea09e939d8ed96a976d3.title: Add taskcompleted tool for explicit agent turn termination
f89e20d18a57f969a42bea09e939d8ed96a976d3.summary: New `task_completed` tool added to agent runtime, requiring explicit invocation to end turns when enabled in agent templates. Logic in `run-agent-step.ts` enforces this constraint, falling back to `end_turn` or implicit completion only if the tool is absent from the template. Covers core constants, CLI/Web renderers, and type definitions across `common` and `packages/agent-runtime`. Includes updated `write_todos` guidance to prevent premature status marking.

9252a5e521abec47bbfec2727c0e667d6ae13cdf.title: Add 10s timeout to codesearch to prevent hangs
9252a5e521abec47bbfec2727c0e667d6ae13cdf.summary: Code search now enforces a 10-second timeout, killing the `rg` process with `SIGTERM` then `SIGKILL` if exceeded. This prevents indefinite hangs from overly broad patterns or complex searches. Implemented in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` and `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`, returning a truncated output with an error message on timeout.

c09c49c60611b6ef0dc4d784b2579466d3e7aab7.title: Best-of-N orchestrators document no-input-prompt
c09c49c60611b6ef0dc4d784b2579466d3e7aab7.summary: Spawner prompts for best-of-n-orchestrator.ts and best-of-n-orchestrator-gpt-5.ts now state 'Has no input prompt! It reads the context from the message history.' This clarifies that these agents derive context from history rather than accepting a direct user prompt. Internal agent definition change in .agents/base2/best-of-n/.

dd918b7f8d5946114c3a55be6e86a8f6c3c24e4a.title: Include meta-analysis in buffbench nightly email
dd918b7f8d5946114c3a55be6e86a8f6c3c24e4a.summary: Nightly buffbench evaluation emails now append a Meta-Analysis section containing overall comparison, per-agent insights, and key findings. `run-buffbench.ts` passes `metaAnalysis` in results, and `main-nightly.ts` destructures it to format the email body. Scope limited to `evals/buffbench` internal tooling.

2d59705ed088acd08024eb653455fb680823c9da.title: Log NEXTPUBLIC env vars and drop underscore markdown markers
2d59705ed088acd08024eb653455fb680823c9da.summary: CLI startup logs sorted NEXT_PUBLIC_* environment variables to console. Markdown renderer fallback parser now ignores `_` and `__` emphasis markers, processing only `*` and `**`. Scope: `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/utils/markdown-renderer.tsx`. Underscore-prefixed text previously parsed as emphasis now renders as literal.

080f9aa96b9ef948fc728b2ff672e2f06ef960ef.title: Add GPT-5 support to base2 agent orchestration
080f9aa96b9ef948fc728b2ff672e2f06ef960ef.summary: Introduced `isGpt5` flag in `createBase2` to switch model to `openai/gpt-5` and adjust spawnable agents. Added new `best-of-n-orchestrator-gpt-5` agent definition handling GPT-5 specific orchestration logic. Updated prompts and tool availability in `base2.ts` and `best-of-n-implementor.ts` to conditionally exclude `file-researcher` and `<think>` tags for GPT-5.

b39871fe018ec4dfa404036a53b964474c663579.title: Remove --no-ignore from codesearch docs
b39871fe018ec4dfa404036a53b964474c663579.summary: Removed the `--no-ignore` flag example from the `code_search` tool documentation. This change aligns the docs with current behavior, preventing users from attempting to search files ignored by `.gitignore` via this specific flag. The update applies to the core tool parameters, agent types, and initial agent templates.

4d44be1e03e6ba6e18fa9d2622f2851dddaeec3b.title: Remove CI debug shells and dynamic NEXTPUBLIC env collection in CLI
4d44be1e03e6ba6e18fa9d2622f2851dddaeec3b.summary: Removed hardcoded NEXT_PUBLIC_* environment variables in cli/scripts/build-binary.ts in favor of dynamic collection from process.env. Deleted four mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3 debug shell steps from .github/workflows/cli-release-build.yml. This prevents hardcoded fallbacks and removes SSH access in CI.

579475bb899ea2315699ec815101fa7833c681d6.title: Fix compareVersions regex guard in release index
579475bb899ea2315699ec815101fa7833c681d6.summary: Inverted regex check in `compareVersions` within `npm-app/release/index.js`. Previously, valid numeric versions triggered an early `-1` return, causing incorrect sorting. Now only non-numeric versions return `-1`, allowing proper comparison of valid semver strings. Scope limited to release tooling logic.

e1f201cd8af7a5715d954f825612b6eaa46eb3a2.title: code-search switches to ripgrep JSON streaming with early stop
e1f201cd8af7a5715d954f825612b6eaa46eb3a2.summary: codeSearch tool replaces stdout line parsing with ripgrep --json streaming. Root cause: regex-based filename/line extraction failed on paths containing colons, hyphens, or non-UTF8 bytes, and patterns starting with `-` were misparsed as flags. Scope: sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts, sdk/src/__tests__/code-search.test.ts. Detail: adds `--no-config` to ignore user `.ripgreprc`, uses `--` to terminate flags, and kills the child process early when `maxResults` or `maxOutputStringLength` is hit, returning a `[Global limit of N results reached.]` suffix instead of buffering full stdout.

f89e20d18a57f969a42bea09e939d8ed96a976d3.text: The assistant now uses a specific 'task completed' signal to end its turn, instead of guessing when to stop. This change makes the assistant's behavior more predictable and prevents it from prematurely marking tasks as done.

080f9aa96b9ef948fc728b2ff672e2f06ef960ef.text: The system now uses a newer artificial intelligence model for certain tasks. This internal update helps the assistant think differently but does not change how you use the product.

9252a5e521abec47bbfec2727c0e667d6ae13cdf.text: The search feature now stops if it takes too long. This prevents the app from freezing while you wait for results.

e1f201cd8af7a5715d954f825612b6eaa46eb3a2.text: The code search tool now reads results directly from the source, avoiding errors caused by complex file names or search terms. It also stops searching as soon as it finds enough results, making the process faster and more reliable.

2d59705ed088acd08024eb653455fb680823c9da.text: Text with underscores now displays as written instead of appearing italicized. The tool also shows certain setup details in the console during startup.

b39871fe018ec4dfa404036a53b964474c663579.text: The search feature no longer allows looking inside files that are normally hidden. This matches how the tool actually works now.

dd918b7f8d5946114c3a55be6e86a8f6c3c24e4a.text: Internal nightly reports now include a summary comparing different tools. This does not change how the product works for you.

4d44be1e03e6ba6e18fa9d2622f2851dddaeec3b.text: The team made the system more secure by removing secret access points and fixing how settings are handled. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice a difference in how the product works.

c09c49c60611b6ef0dc4d784b2579466d3e7aab7.text: The system's internal instructions were clarified to specify that certain helpers read past conversation history instead of new user prompts. This internal change does not affect how users interact with the product.

579475bb899ea2315699ec815101fa7833c681d6.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system sorts software updates. You will now see updates listed in the proper order.

de61ea8a1e87e0d3eac64149fc73f72b22a9800b.title: Add tmate debug shell to CLI release workflow
de61ea8a1e87e0d3eac64149fc73f72b22a9800b.summary: Added `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` step after binary build in `.github/workflows/cli-release-build.yml`. Runs with `if: always()` and `limit-access-to-actor: true` for 15 minutes. Affects both matrix and Windows x64 jobs.

c32392a7eea53f25246c21294fae9f562156e3f6.title: Update release config to CodebuffAI/codebuff and strict semver regex
c32392a7eea53f25246c21294fae9f562156e3f6.summary: Release script updated to point to `CodebuffAI/codebuff` repository instead of `codebuff-community`. Version parsing regex in `npm-app/release/index.js` changed to strictly match `v` followed by `\d+\.\d+\.\d+`, replacing the previous generic tag capture and manual prefix stripping. This ensures only valid semantic version tags are accepted during the release process.

1ec25c4581e958745551d753f39b311a4b9deeef.title: CLI build script copies NEXTPUBLIC env vars
1ec25c4581e958745551d753f39b311a4b9deeef.summary: Added `--env "NEXT_PUBLIC_*"` flag to `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts`. Ensures matching environment variables are embedded in the compiled binary during build. Affects CLI binary generation process.

f29bb5032807fceb689ad5eaba1de382382924d0.title: build-binary.ts passes process.env to SDK build
f29bb5032807fceb689ad5eaba1de382382924d0.summary: cli/scripts/build-binary.ts now passes `process.env` to the `bun run build:sdk` command invocation. This ensures environment variables are available during the SDK asset build step, potentially resolving environment-related issues. Scope limited to CLI build script.

f1d505d12316e65c039183eb40ef6a3bbaa3deb8.title: CLI build script defines NEXTPUBLIC flags
f1d505d12316e65c039183eb40ef6a3bbaa3deb8.summary: Added manual definition of NEXT_PUBLIC_* environment flags in cli/scripts/build-binary.ts. Ensures build-time constants like APP_URL and STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY are explicitly set with fallback defaults. Scope limited to CLI binary build process. Includes hardcoded fallbacks for production URLs and keys.

d16684e78b989f7a2b904db86871b0907098270b.title: Remove staging environment from cli-release-staging workflow
d16684e78b989f7a2b904db86871b0907098270b.summary: Removed `environment: staging` configuration from all jobs in `.github/workflows/cli-release-staging.yml`. This reverts a previous change that applied the staging environment to `prepare-and-commit-staging`, `build-staging-binaries`, `create-staging-release`, and subsequent jobs. The workflow now executes without explicit GitHub environment protection rules or secrets scoping for these steps.

fe1ba1aa3451b156e5188cb166c2d326f5d867c1.title: dev.sh shebang uses env bash
fe1ba1aa3451b156e5188cb166c2d326f5d867c1.summary: cli/scripts/dev.sh shebang changed from #!/bin/bash to #!/usr/bin/env bash. Resolves bash path portability across Unix variants. Affects CLI dev script only. No functional change to command behavior.

78abaad0bb6919008d042580aaef127456719bf8.title: Update npm and legacy index files
78abaad0bb6919008d042580aaef127456719bf8.summary: Updated `npm-app/release-legacy/index.js` and `npm-app/release/index.js` to refine version parsing and comparison logic. Legacy tag extraction now strictly enforces the `vX.X.X-legacy.N` format via regex, stripping the leading 'v' directly from the capture group. `compareVersions` functions were modified to handle non-legacy or plain numeric versions by returning early, preventing incorrect numeric parsing on invalid inputs.

8ca27515443e96295bf04038b91f5faa6038edb8.title: codebuff-legacy UI banner and repo update
8ca27515443e96295bf04038b91f5faa6038edb8.summary: Added a startup banner to `npm-app/release-legacy/index.js` instructing users to run `npm i -g codebuff@latest` for the new UI. `CONFIG.githubRepo` updated from `CodebuffAI/codebuff-community` to `CodebuffAI/codebuff`. Scope: `npm-app/release-legacy`.

23fce4bc71e65f985c2514766b091e8e03c550b3.text: The app moved a behind-the-scenes piece of its code to a more standard location. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the app works or looks for you.

c32392a7eea53f25246c21294fae9f562156e3f6.text: The tool now checks release names more carefully before publishing updates. This small internal change helps prevent errors.

8ca27515443e96295bf04038b91f5faa6038edb8.text: The old version now shows a message asking you to switch to the new tool. This is a small internal change.

78abaad0bb6919008d042580aaef127456719bf8.text: The system now checks version numbers more carefully to avoid errors. This small internal fix helps keep the software stable.

f29bb5032807fceb689ad5eaba1de382382924d0.text: The tool now shares its setup details with the build step. This small fix helps prevent errors when preparing the program.

f1d505d12316e65c039183eb40ef6a3bbaa3deb8.text: The command-line tool now uses fixed web addresses and payment keys when building. This keeps the tool working correctly even if setup settings are missing.

1ec25c4581e958745551d753f39b311a4b9deeef.text: The tool now automatically includes specific web settings when creating its program file. This means the final version you use will have those settings ready to go without extra steps.

fe1ba1aa3451b156e5188cb166c2d326f5d867c1.text: The tool now finds the right helper program automatically on more computer types. This prevents startup errors on some systems. Your daily work stays the same.

d16684e78b989f7a2b904db86871b0907098270b.text: A safety check that required special permission before releasing test versions was removed. This change only affects internal tools and does not change how the product works for you.

d5be8f5e25c347809b1f87dd9a698b17d3d242a9.title: Add averageScoreExcludingFailures to buffbench evals
d5be8f5e25c347809b1f87dd9a698b17d3d242a9.summary: Added averageScoreExcludingFailures metric to buffbench agent results, filtering out runs with overallScore <= 1.0. Type update in types.ts and calculation logic in run-buffbench.ts now track this alongside existing averageScore. Console output displays the filtered average with run count context (e.g., 5/10 runs).

d3cc5200b205490ee058633a5fbc7cb6529b34e7.title: ToolMessage type field renamed to role
d3cc5200b205490ee058633a5fbc7cb6529b34e7.summary: The `ToolMessage` interface in `util-types.ts` now uses `role: 'tool'` instead of `type: 'tool'`. This aligns the message structure with standard LLM API conventions where `role` is the discriminator. The change applies to both `.agents/types/util-types.ts` and `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/util-types.ts`. Code consuming `ToolMessage` must access the discriminator via `.role`.

0cf5f2fd0fc87192cc81fed43cbcdffb39709c4c.title: Refactor best-of-n-selector to factory pattern for GPT-5 support
0cf5f2fd0fc87192cc81fed43cbcdffb39709c4c.summary: The `best-of-n-selector` definition in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-selector.ts` is refactored from a static object into a `createBestOfNSelector` factory function accepting a model parameter. This allows `best-of-n-selector-gpt-5.ts` to dynamically generate its definition using `openai/gpt-5` instead of inheriting a hardcoded `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` base. The `base2-gpt-5-worker.ts` prompt is also tweaked to clarify context gathering via agent spawning.

fc4650a30665ab54c11a6ad9ce30efd590e879c8.title: Fix legacy release workflow copy-paste refs
fc4650a30665ab54c11a6ad9ce30efd590e879c8.summary: Renamed jobs, steps, and paths in `npm-app-release-legacy.yml` from `prod` to `legacy`, targeting `npm-app/release-legacy/` instead of `npm-app/release/`. Updated `release-legacy.js` default `versionType` to `prepatch`. This corrects copy-paste errors from the production release workflow, ensuring the legacy pipeline bumps and tags the correct package directory.

e7c10938d7d456785ce6e13a8f2c3eefd006030d.title: best-of-n-orchestrator added to max mode agent
e7c10938d7d456785ce6e13a8f2c3eefd006030d.summary: best-of-n-orchestrator registered in .agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-worker.ts definition. Prompt now prefers best-of-n-orchestrator for feature implementation; str_replace/write_file restricted to smaller fixes. Scope limited to max mode agent definition.

118c2379ba39f52f9819c3bdb88abf2c64ed5301.title: Merge best-of-n into fast mode
118c2379ba39f52f9819c3bdb88abf2c64ed5301.summary: Removed separate best-of-n agent definitions and flags in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`. Fast mode now always spawns `best-of-n-orchestrator-fast` by default. Deleted `base2-best-of-n.ts` and `base2-best-of-n-fast.ts`.

8952cbcc915f0cc3d0f70839b57f1aaa25344e60.title: Add legacy release pipeline for npm-app
8952cbcc915f0cc3d0f70839b57f1aaa25344e60.summary: Introduced CI workflow `.github/workflows/npm-app-release-legacy.yml` and local script `npm-app/scripts/release-legacy.js` to automate legacy binary releases. New package configuration in `npm-app/release-legacy/` defines `codebuff@legacy` with specific platform targets (linux-x64, darwin-arm64, etc.) and GitHub release fetching logic. Workflow triggers via `workflow_dispatch` with version bump options (prepatch, minor, major) and integrates with `npm-app-release-build.yml` for artifact generation.

5f912ba00c65c58d148ba3aba5b5e3b4028cb49c.title: Update .bin/bun shebang
5f912ba00c65c58d148ba3aba5b5e3b4028cb49c.summary: The `.bin/bun` script shebang changed from `#!/bin/bash` to `#!/usr/bin/env bash`. This ensures portability across systems where `bash` is not located in `/bin`. The update also removes trailing whitespace in the `doesnt_need_secrets` function.

029efd764896cc0c54a6c4a50ed23bffce510542.title: Add staging environment to cli-release-staging workflow
029efd764896cc0c54a6c4a50ed23bffce510542.summary: Added `environment: staging` to all jobs in `.github/workflows/cli-release-staging.yml`. This enforces GitHub Actions environment protection rules for the staging release pipeline. Scope limited to CI configuration.

155ad8212eb92a904c328576c5868bcf81d8bbbb.title: Remove zod from initial agents util-types
155ad8212eb92a904c328576c5868bcf81d8bbbb.summary: Zod schema definitions stripped from `util-types.ts` in `initial-agents-dir` templates. Runtime validation schemas replaced by pure TypeScript type aliases and interfaces. Covers `.agents/types/util-types.ts` and `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/util-types.ts`. `DataContent` now uses explicit union `string | Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer | Buffer` instead of `z.infer`.

118c2379ba39f52f9819c3bdb88abf2c64ed5301.text: The assistant now automatically uses its best response selection method in fast mode. This internal change removes a separate setting, making the process simpler and more consistent for users.

fc4650a30665ab54c11a6ad9ce30efd590e879c8.text: A small internal fix corrected a copy-paste error in the release process. This ensures the older version of the product updates correctly without affecting the current version.

d3cc5200b205490ee058633a5fbc7cb6529b34e7.text: A small internal update renamed a label on messages to match standard conventions used by other AI services. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

d5be8f5e25c347809b1f87dd9a698b17d3d242a9.text: A new score shows how well the AI assistant performs when ignoring runs that failed completely. This gives a clearer picture of the assistant's typical quality.

5f912ba00c65c58d148ba3aba5b5e3b4028cb49c.text: The internal tool now finds the right system program automatically. This makes it work on more computers without breaking.

029efd764896cc0c54a6c4a50ed23bffce510542.text: Added safety checks to the internal staging release process. No effect on the product.

0cf5f2fd0fc87192cc81fed43cbcdffb39709c4c.text: The internal system for choosing the best answer was updated to support a new model. This change is invisible to users and does not affect how the product works.

e7c10938d7d456785ce6e13a8f2c3eefd006030d.text: The assistant now tries multiple approaches to solve larger tasks, picking the best one. Smaller fixes stay the same.

c36c8d1d728233b01011508bc9cf7ebf78ec0132.title: Buffbench timeout covers repo setup and checks
c36c8d1d728233b01011508bc9cf7ebf78ec0132.summary: Moved `withTimeout` in `evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts` to wrap entire `withTestRepo` block. Previously only `client.run` was timed out, leaving repo initialization, git diffing, context extraction, and final checks unprotected. Now 30-minute limit applies to full agent run lifecycle including setup and verification steps.

21c3c436875d93e37ddf856697eed491f313d566.title: Update repository URL in release package.json
21c3c436875d93e37ddf856697eed491f313d566.summary: Updated `repository.url` in `npm-app/release/package.json` from `codebuff-community.git` to `codebuff.git`. Corrects the metadata to reflect the actual repository path. Scope limited to the release package manifest.

5c1ed88897c505c202f355183d8015782e9df60e.title: CI staging injects prod env override
5c1ed88897c505c202f355183d8015782e9df60e.summary: cli-release-staging.yml sets NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT=prod in codecane env-overrides. Staging CLI builds now target production backend. Scope limited to CI workflow configuration.

33d27b8fc4e7f8c5a73860288ad364de49e0d0f9.title: Judge scoring uses 3-way median
33d27b8fc4e7f8c5a73860288ad364de49e0d0f9.summary: Judge scoring switched to 3 parallel runs with averaged numeric scores and median analysis. The `runSingleJudge` helper extracts the previous single-run logic, allowing `judgeCommitResult` to aggregate results via `Promise.all`. Only `evals/buffbench/judge.ts` is modified.

738788624edf38ab3bdce8c5dc2203e320a56bd1.title: Best-of-n prompts add think tags, selector context
738788624edf38ab3bdce8c5dc2203e320a56bd1.summary: Best-of-n implementor and selector prompts updated. Implementor allows brief <think> tags between tool calls. Selector gets explicit user request context via ${PLACEHOLDER.USER_INPUT_PROMPT}, ranked evaluation criteria, and optional <think> before set_output. Internal agent definitions only.

888d9b98c8467caaf5a53bbf9da90537b710ab91.title: Refactor best-of-n agent definitions and IDs
888d9b98c8467caaf5a53bbf9da90537b710ab91.summary: Renamed agent IDs and files to drop the `base2-` prefix (e.g., `base2-best-of-n-orchestrator` becomes `best-of-n-orchestrator`). Deleted redundant `base2-best-of-n-editor`, `base2-selector`, and `base2-implementor-step-gpt-5` files, consolidating logic into `best-of-n-implementor.ts` and `best-of-n-selector.ts`. Updated `createBase2` in `base2.ts` to reference the new orchestrator IDs and spawnable agents. This internal cleanup removes legacy naming conventions and simplifies the agent definition structure.

dc08e8bc7f2bf2ec3eae159cbaf3124487b38783.title: Update buffbench log analyzer to exclude zero-score tasks
dc08e8bc7f2bf2ec3eae159cbaf3124487b38783.summary: Refactors scripts/analyze-buffbench-logs.ts to implement a two-pass analysis strategy. The first pass identifies tasks where any agent received a zero or null overall score, excluding these from the final metrics to prevent skewed averages. The bottom-25% filtering logic was updated to calculate a global cutoff across all agents rather than per-agent, ensuring consistent task exclusion. The script now returns both aggregated results and raw agent scores, printing the latter to the console for deeper inspection.

4298f2fa488fbe7807ee74a83b7b422248c41f78.title: CI env generation uses --scope client
4298f2fa488fbe7807ee74a83b7b422248c41f78.summary: Release workflows now pass `--scope client` to `scripts/generate-ci-env.ts` instead of relying on `--prefix NEXT_PUBLIC_` or default behavior. This change standardizes how client-side environment variables are selected across CLI, npm app, and SDK release builds. Affected files include `.github/workflows/cli-release-build.yml`, `.github/workflows/npm-app-release-build.yml`, and `.github/workflows/sdk-release.yml`.

80ddeb3b78ea643c7dd930a00fd5a84c50c18e57.title: CLI supports local agents, adds elapsed time tracking and improved
80ddeb3b78ea643c7dd930a00fd5a84c50c18e57.summary: Added support for local agents in the CLI, including new validation hooks and error formatting utilities. Introduced elapsed time tracking for streaming messages via `use-elapsed-time` and updated `MessageBlock` and `StatusIndicator` to display timing information. Enhanced markdown rendering in the terminal by adding `remark-breaks` and `remark-gfm` dependencies, and refactored logo rendering into a reusable `use-logo` hook.

2529ad939468c6fc9138040858a51345d47a14de.title: Add fast best-of-n agent variant
2529ad939468c6fc9138040858a51345d47a14de.summary: Introduce `bestOfNFast` option in `createBase2` to enable a new fast best-of-n workflow. Adds `base2-best-of-n-fast-orchestrator`, `base2-best-of-n-fast`, and `base2-selector-fast` agents. Orchestrator spawns five `base2-implementor-step` agents and uses `base2-selector-fast` to pick the best implementation. Selector uses `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` and outputs only the `implementationId`.

21c3c436875d93e37ddf856697eed491f313d566.text: Internal update. Fixed a label to point to the correct source. No change to how the product works.

c36c8d1d728233b01011508bc9cf7ebf78ec0132.text: The system now stops waiting if the full task, including setup, takes too long. This prevents the tool from getting stuck forever when a job is slow or broken.

738788624edf38ab3bdce8c5dc2203e320a56bd1.text: The system now checks its own work more carefully before giving you an answer. This change is internal and aims to improve the quality of the final result.

dc08e8bc7f2bf2ec3eae159cbaf3124487b38783.text: The tool now ignores tasks with no results when calculating averages. This helps prevent bad data from messing up the scores.

888d9b98c8467caaf5a53bbf9da90537b710ab91.text: The team cleaned up internal labels and removed duplicate instructions to simplify how the assistant picks and writes answers. This change only affects the background setup and does not change how you use the product.

4298f2fa488fbe7807ee74a83b7b422248c41f78.text: The release process now picks the right settings for customer-facing tools. This makes the product behave the same way every time it updates.

80ddeb3b78ea643c7dd930a00fd5a84c50c18e57.text: The tool now works with local helpers, shows how long messages take to arrive, and displays text more clearly.

5c1ed88897c505c202f355183d8015782e9df60e.text: A setup error made test versions connect to the live service. This internal mistake is fixed and does not affect normal users.

2529ad939468c6fc9138040858a51345d47a14de.text: The system can now quickly generate and compare several versions of an answer to pick the best one. This makes the assistant more accurate, though the change is internal and users won't see new buttons.

8134f2f8f7a358cb93c871c34e16d99ef6b98e5f.title: Update DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tooltip text in CLI model selector tests
8134f2f8f7a358cb93c871c34e16d99ef6b98e5f.summary: Test assertion in `cli/src/components/__tests__/freebuff-model-selector.test.tsx` updated to match new tooltip copy for `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID`. The string changed from 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash drops to 15 Freebucks...' to 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: 7 hours a day on Starter...'. No production code modified.

8134f2f8f7a358cb93c871c34e16d99ef6b98e5f.text: The text describing a specific AI model in the command-line tool was updated. Users now see clearer details about daily usage limits. No features changed.

9992d8ab098eacd4ff5a08893c8474114e2de199.title: SDK fetchAgentFromDatabase defaults to latest when version undefined
9992d8ab098eacd4ff5a08893c8474114e2de199.summary: fetchAgentFromDatabase in sdk/src/impl/database.ts now constructs the API path with 'latest' when the parsed version is undefined, replacing the previous literal undefined interpolation. This prevents malformed requests to /api/v1/agents/{publisherId}/{agentId}/undefined. Scope limited to the SDK database implementation layer.

ac5ea20c87f129a464330188a3f76cc24b1410b6.title: Add messageId for STEPTEXT
ac5ea20c87f129a464330188a3f76cc24b1410b6.summary: Replaces null with crypto.randomUUID() as the return value for the STEP_TEXT stream generator in prompt-agent-stream.ts. Provides a unique identifier for step text events.

bafdc9cb97656953098291f86b53c27fd1d3eaca.title: CLI init writes maxAgentSteps to config
bafdc9cb97656953098291f86b53c27fd1d3eaca.summary: handleInitializationFlowLocally in npm-app/src/cli-handlers/inititalization-flow.ts now includes maxAgentSteps: MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT in generated config files. Imports CodebuffConfig type and MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT from @codebuff/common/constants/agents. Scope limited to CLI initialization flow; common/src/util/__tests__/messages.test.ts updated for unit tests. Config template now strictly typed as CodebuffConfig.

c008f6b4f7e8a19d42f7412ea6d28ada39bbb990.title: Cache boundary shifts to last assistant message
c008f6b4f7e8a19d42f7412ea6d28ada39bbb990.summary: common/src/util/messages.ts replaces INSTRUCTIONS_PROMPT with LAST_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE in convertCbToModelMessages. Cache boundary logic now scans for role === 'assistant' instead of tag matching. Scope limited to Core shared utilities.

0ba06cdd22a0e7e26ace49a224490461111e6c13.title: best-of-n orchestrator strips userInstruction
0ba06cdd22a0e7e26ace49a224490461111e6c13.summary: base2-best-of-n-orchestrator.ts now pops the last message from agentState.messageHistory before spawning implementors. This removes unnecessary userInstruction prompts from the best-of-n flow. Internal change to .agents/base2/best-of-n/. Uses set_messages tool call with includeToolCall false.

7dbbc9519321875aa6f2c6588fc0db4f9976ff10.title: fetchAgentFromDatabase adds schema parse and agent validation
7dbbc9519321875aa6f2c6588fc0db4f9976ff10.summary: fetchAgentFromDatabase in sdk/src/impl/database.ts now parses backend response via zod agentsResponseSchema and calls validateSingleAgent from @codebuff/common/templates/agent-validation. Previously returned response.json() unchecked. Malformed payloads or validation failures return null after logging. Scope limited to SDK database impl.

d71a65c907b832d925e31556da4166a017e5d09e.title: Refactor best-of-n to include gpt-5 implementor and selector
d71a65c907b832d925e31556da4166a017e5d09e.summary: The best-of-n orchestrator now spawns both Claude Sonnet and GPT-5 implementor agents, replacing the previous single-model approach. The base2-implementor agent was refactored into a factory function createBase2ImplementorStep to support multiple models, with new dedicated files for each implementation step. The base2-selector agent was updated to use GPT-5 instead of Sonnet for implementation evaluation. This change expands model diversity in the implementation generation phase while leveraging GPT-5 for selection logic.

153b1f0218ae5d1a20211b9138e36463a7619ef3.title: strreplace surfaces mixed success and failure errors
153b1f0218ae5d1a20211b9138e36463a7619ef3.summary: The `handleStrReplace` function in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/str-replace.ts` now aggregates error messages when `str_replace` operations yield mixed success and failure results. Previously, only the final result was returned, potentially masking earlier errors. The fix concatenates `strReplaceResult.messages` with the client tool result message, ensuring all encountered errors are visible to the user.

314ec8b2f756cd6ca4003b1500289ab4c60e6c27.title: SDK release workflow unified
314ec8b2f756cd6ca4003b1500289ab4c60e6c27.summary: sdk-release.yml replaces split prod/build workflows. `sdk/scripts/release.js` updated dispatch URL. Reduces CI config duplication.

d1135284e8100a3af8d78cc12659d430d38e7ac5.title: Add STEPTEXT to handleSteps generator
d1135284e8100a3af8d78cc12659d430d38e7ac5.summary: handleSteps generators now yield StepText ({ type: 'STEP_TEXT', text: string }) to emit text without invoking the LLM. run-programmatic-step.ts captures the yielded text into a textOverride field, which run-agent-step.ts passes to prompt-agent-stream.ts. The stream function short-circuits when textOverride is non-null, yielding the text directly. Propagated across agent-definition.ts, agent-template.ts, and evals/scaffolding.ts.

7dbbc9519321875aa6f2c6588fc0db4f9976ff10.text: The app now checks that data from the server is complete and correct before using it. If the data is broken or missing, the app ignores it instead of trying to use it. This helps prevent errors but does not change how the app looks or works normally.

314ec8b2f756cd6ca4003b1500289ab4c60e6c27.text: The team simplified how they publish updates. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

d1135284e8100a3af8d78cc12659d430d38e7ac5.text: Internal update. The assistant can now show prepared text directly without asking the AI to generate it. This saves time for simple messages.

bafdc9cb97656953098291f86b53c27fd1d3eaca.text: The setup process now adds a limit on how many steps the assistant can take at once. This keeps the assistant focused and prevents it from running too long without stopping.

9992d8ab098eacd4ff5a08893c8474114e2de199.text: The system now automatically picks the newest version of an agent if you don't specify one. This prevents errors that occurred when the version was left blank.

ac5ea20c87f129a464330188a3f76cc24b1410b6.text: The assistant now assigns a unique tracking number to each step of its response. This small internal change helps the system keep responses organized, but you won't see any difference in how you use the product.

c008f6b4f7e8a19d42f7412ea6d28ada39bbb990.text: The system now saves memory more efficiently by tracking the last reply instead of a specific marker. This internal update speeds up responses without changing how the assistant behaves.

d71a65c907b832d925e31556da4166a017e5d09e.text: The system now asks two different AI models to solve problems and uses a third model to pick the best answer. This change is internal and aims to improve quality by comparing options from multiple sources.

0ba06cdd22a0e7e26ace49a224490461111e6c13.text: A small internal fix stops the system from repeating your instructions unnecessarily. This makes the process cleaner without changing how you use the product.

153b1f0218ae5d1a20211b9138e36463a7619ef3.text: When a text edit partially fails, you now see all errors at once instead of just the last one.

6865350a9b7493c0effa4d5ad11b47181d166189.title: Remove env import from next.config.mjs
6865350a9b7493c0effa4d5ad11b47181d166189.summary: Dropped unused `env` import from `@codebuff/internal/env` in `web/next.config.mjs`. Reduces unnecessary dependency in Next.js config. Scope: `web` config only.

8a978517c751751f46917fd6f4ae475a8eff23c6.title: Move processEnv to env-schema
8a978517c751751f46917fd6f4ae475a8eff23c6.summary: Relocated `clientProcessEnv` from `common/src/env.ts` to `common/src/env-schema.ts` and `serverProcessEnv` from `packages/internal/src/env.ts` to `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts`. This groups environment variable definitions with their Zod schemas, simplifying imports and ensuring Bun's static analysis correctly identifies individual `process.env` references. The change affects shared core and internal packages, maintaining existing validation logic while improving code organization.

691593459fb4286db062ea906c43f353493a125c.title: WEBSITEURL now requires NEXTPUBLICCODEBUFFAPPURL
691593459fb4286db062ea906c43f353493a125c.summary: WEBSITE_URL constant in sdk/src/constants.ts no longer falls back to hardcoded localhost or production URLs, relying exclusively on NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL. scripts/init-worktree.ts updated to inject NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL into .env.worktree, ensuring dev environments provide the required variable. Scope covers SDK constants and worktree initialization scripts. Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL results in undefined WEBSITE_URL.

11a280be3f2a39b4fc22ce2e965a5e692fbb2238.title: Fix cache control for single string messages
11a280be3f2a39b4fc22ce2e965a5e692fbb2238.summary: Refactored `convertCbToModelMessages` in `common/src/util/messages.ts` to correctly apply `cache_control` to single-string messages by iterating backward through content blocks and splitting text parts. The logic now skips short text segments (<2 chars) and ensures the final valid content block receives the ephemeral cache tag. Updated `scripts/fat-sdk-openrouter-example.ts` to demonstrate cache control on system messages with string content.

23e04fb98ad9c2a65bc653d5ae03793690e4f9f6.title: BuffBench evals add typecheck and test final checks
23e04fb98ad9c2a65bc653d5ae03793690e4f9f6.summary: Adds `finalCheckCommands` to `EvalDataV2` and `FinalCheckOutput` to types. `runAgentOnCommit` executes these commands post-agent, capturing stdout/stderr/exitCode. `judgeCommitResult` receives formatted outputs for better context. `eval-codebuff.json` configures `bun run typecheck` and `bun run test`.

53658287965a4d04997107b939920c1bfe8251fe.title: Add STEPPROMPT to cache tags, remove assistant heuristic
53658287965a4d04997107b939920c1bfe8251fe.summary: Updated `convertCbToModelMessages` in `common/src/util/messages.ts` to include `STEP_PROMPT` in the loop applying cache control to preceding messages. Removed the heuristic that tagged the message before the last assistant response, simplifying cache marking to rely on explicit tags. This change affects core message processing for all agents using this utility.

ff643ff7b53ac81b875008a7acd85da592a48bc7.title: Switch env import to @codebuff/common/env
ff643ff7b53ac81b875008a7acd85da592a48bc7.summary: Updated env imports from @codebuff/internal/env to @codebuff/common/env across multiple web application files. This change aligns client-side components with the common environment configuration package. The modification affects various pages, API routes, and utility files within the web directory. No functional changes expected, primarily a dependency and import path standardization.

dd1d8c7857ce3cade456574569c4e6d60790e9da.title: Fix index boundary check in convertCbToModelMessages
dd1d8c7857ce3cade456574569c4e6d60790e9da.summary: Fixed unit bug in `convertCbToModelMessages` where `index--` occurred before boundary checks. Moved `index--` inside the loop and assigned `prevMessage` and `contentBlock` after validating `index >= 0` in `common/src/util/messages.ts`. Prevents negative index access and ensures correct cache control marker placement.

6160c38b9fd4722a14b473fba5678ea66fb714c8.title: Update best of n editor to pass through tool results
6160c38b9fd4722a14b473fba5678ea66fb714c8.summary: The best-of-n editor agent now uses structured output mode and a custom `handleSteps` generator to explicitly capture and forward `str_replace` and `write_file` tool results via `set_output`. Previously, the editor relied on `last_message` output mode, which discarded detailed execution feedback. The orchestrator was updated to consume this structured response and tool results array from the spawned editor, ensuring downstream processes receive precise change confirmation data. Changes affect `.agents/base2/best-of-n/base2-best-of-n-editor.ts` and `.agents/base2/best-of-n/base2-best-of-n-orchestrator.ts`.

405fdb4e065353f9b9c431133989e40229c681f9.summary: Set maxAgentSteps to 40 in cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts and evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts. Extends agent execution budget. Adds mandatory read_files instruction to .agents/base2/base2.ts.

31a5c37a1dd9a7ef1e60647d4a871acaa328ffb0.title: drizzle-kit 0.28.1
31a5c37a1dd9a7ef1e60647d4a871acaa328ffb0.summary: Revert drizzle-kit 0.31.6 to 0.28.1. Affects common/package.json. Pins 0.28.1.

1c3a5ebec14f47ed14f2b4f689efe2d6cbeab4ac.title: Base2 best-of-n agent pipeline added
1c3a5ebec14f47ed14f2b4f689efe2d6cbeab4ac.summary: Added a new 'best-of-n' mode to the Base2 agent framework, defined in .agents/base2/best-of-n/. This mode spawns multiple 'base2-implementor' agents in parallel to generate code proposals, uses 'base2-selector' to pick the best one, and 'base2-best-of-n-editor' to apply changes. The main 'base2.ts' orchestrator now accepts a 'bestOfN' flag to route tasks through this pipeline instead of direct editing.

5c2a415ead53f971258bcd8476ebd8fa6c3d8ae1.title: Refine agent prompts and selector schema
5c2a415ead53f971258bcd8476ebd8fa6c3d8ae1.summary: Updated `base2-selector` output schema with descriptions and fixed `implementationId` type. Simplified `base2-implementor` instructions by removing error handling directive. Enhanced `file-researcher` prompt to clarify tool limitations and research-only scope.

4cf528be260bef14e688d7483e79306398b7385b.title: Upgrade drizzle-kit to 0.31.6
4cf528be260bef14e688d7483e79306398b7385b.summary: Bump drizzle-kit from 0.28.1 to 0.31.6 in common/package.json. Keeps drizzle-orm pinned at 0.36.4. Internal dependency update.

2fce2191f4800b36c2dd3c3d392801d9b30bcbd7.title: Move database and sync utilities to @codebuff/internal
2fce2191f4800b36c2dd3c3d392801d9b30bcbd7.summary: Database access (`db`, `schema`) and sync utilities (`logSyncFailure`) moved from `@codebuff/common` to new `@codebuff/internal` package. Backend files updated to import from internal paths. CI matrix adds `packages/internal` and `packages/billing` for test runs. Prettier formatting applied to agent definitions and CLI scripts.

673ae6eb753ef1ce2137c5cca9a434c2febe1a9e.title: Standardize env access via @codebuff/common/env
673ae6eb753ef1ce2137c5cca9a434c2febe1a9e.summary: Refactored environment variable access across CLI, backend, and common packages to use a centralized `env` object imported from `@codebuff/common/env` or `@codebuff/internal/env`. This replaces direct `process.env` reads in files like `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts`, `backend/src/index.ts`, and `common/src/analytics.ts`. The change ensures consistent typing, validation, and handling of client vs internal environment variables, reducing reliance on implicit global state.

fc982fd79f84dd0ac4833998c807ed0fff0ead8e.title: Revert env schema refactor in CLI and backend
fc982fd79f84dd0ac4833998c807ed0fff0ead8e.summary: Reverts the centralized `env` schema refactor, restoring direct `process.env` access in CLI and backend modules. Removes `@codebuff/common/env` and `@codebuff/internal/env` imports in favor of raw environment variables. Affects auth, analytics, logging, and login constants.

540c2e6597871bd07df91fb60fb94295ff2bd135.title: Fix Stripe import path in backend tests
540c2e6597871bd07df91fb60fb94295ff2bd135.summary: Updated Stripe import path in `backend/src/__tests__/auto-topup.test.ts` from `@codebuff/common/util/stripe` to `@codebuff/internal/util/stripe`. Corrects module resolution failure during test execution. Scope limited to backend test suite.

e6045ca354143caf0820bbbd035f2a6e1ec4eff3.title: Centralize env vars via @codebuff/common/env
e6045ca354143caf0820bbbd035f2a6e1ec4eff3.summary: Refactor environment variable access to use typed `env` object from `@codebuff/common/env` and `@codebuff/internal/env` instead of direct `process.env` reads. This change standardizes configuration handling across CLI, backend, and common packages, ensuring consistent validation and type safety. Key files updated include `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts`, `backend/src/util/logger.ts`, and new schema definitions in `common/src/env-schema.ts`.

e6045ca354143caf0820bbbd035f2a6e1ec4eff3.text: The team made the settings behind the scenes more consistent and safer. This small internal update helps prevent errors but does not change how you use the product.

31a5c37a1dd9a7ef1e60647d4a871acaa328ffb0.text: The tool that builds the app was switched back to an older version to fix a recent problem.

673ae6eb753ef1ce2137c5cca9a434c2febe1a9e.text: The program now checks its settings more carefully. This makes the app more stable and reliable.

fc982fd79f84dd0ac4833998c807ed0fff0ead8e.text: The app now reads its settings directly from the system environment, rather than through a central manager. This internal cleanup has no visible effect on how the product works.

5c2a415ead53f971258bcd8476ebd8fa6c3d8ae1.text: The AI assistant received clearer instructions to better understand its tasks and avoid mistakes.

1c3a5ebec14f47ed14f2b4f689efe2d6cbeab4ac.text: The internal system now tries multiple approaches for tasks and picks the best result.

405fdb4e065353f9b9c431133989e40229c681f9.text: The assistant can now take more steps to complete complex tasks. This change also ensures it reviews relevant files before acting.

4cf528be260bef14e688d7483e79306398b7385b.text: The system uses a new internal tool to help developers build features. This small update makes the product more stable, but you will not notice any changes.

2fce2191f4800b36c2dd3c3d392801d9b30bcbd7.text: Internal tools were reorganized behind the scenes. You won't notice any changes to the app's behavior.

540c2e6597871bd07df91fb60fb94295ff2bd135.text: A small internal fix corrected a broken link in the system's background checks. This does not change how the product works for you.

f78605fb0b4af7357f0caa33ed2e61997598d4bf.title: Prettier formatting applied across CLI and agent files
f78605fb0b4af7357f0caa33ed2e61997598d4bf.summary: Applied Prettier formatting to multiple files in the CLI and agent subsystems. Changes include line wrapping, array formatting, and adding trailing newlines to files like `thinker-lite.ts` and `auth-helpers.ts`. 5a4debae16072a00ae66540141bb062737eb1b62.title: base2 prompt tweaks
5a4debae16072a00ae66540141bb062737eb1b62.summary: base2 prompt tweaks. Covers .agents/base2/base2.ts. Refactor internal agent prompts.

769c3ffdebbae39e7e6d0ef61fd7e254c0a17477.title: Move stripe.ts from common to internal package
769c3ffdebbae39e7e6d0ef61fd7e254c0a17477.summary: Relocates `stripe.ts` from `@codebuff/common/util` to `@codebuff/internal/util`. Updates imports in `backend`, `packages/billing`, `scripts`, and `web` API routes to use the new path. Includes minor lint fixes (trailing commas) in `auth-options.ts` and billing routes.

75ecd3cceb3e27353e7638fc45a129076604b8f5.title: Revert database module path from internal to common
75ecd3cceb3e27353e7638fc45a129076604b8f5.summary: Reverts backend database imports from `@codebuff/internal/db` to `@codebuff/common/db`. Affects `backend/src/agent-run.ts`, `message-cost-tracker.ts`, `agent-db.ts`, and websocket auth/middleware files. Includes formatting cleanup in `.agents/` definitions and VSCode settings.

5e07e379bdeb1307e191b9c1c3d8bb10861c75c7.title: writetodos forces next step unless all completed
5e07e379bdeb1307e191b9c1c3d8bb10861c75c7.summary: write_todos removed from TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP in common/src/tools/constants.ts. run-agent-step.ts adds exception: if sole tool call is write_todos with all todos completed, hasOnlyFinishedTodos triggers shouldEndTurn. Affects agent runtime loop logic in packages/agent-runtime. Prevents agents from stalling when write_todos is the only action without explicit end_turn.

3b8d54596cb77ac70305951fb8c03549cd220b00.title: Move database module from @codebuff/common to @codebuff/internal
3b8d54596cb77ac70305951fb8c03549cd220b00.summary: Relocated `db` and `schema` exports from `@codebuff/common/db` to `@codebuff/internal/db` across backend, billing, and evals packages. Updated imports in `agent-run.ts`, `message-cost-tracker.ts`, `websocket-action.ts`, and billing modules like `balance-calculator.ts` and `org-billing.ts` to point to the new internal path. This separation isolates database access logic within the internal package, preventing `@codebuff/common` from carrying server-side database dependencies. Configuration in `.vscode/settings.json` was also updated to enforce Prettier formatting for TypeScript and React files.

4140cab495d5f5716cd7df085cbbe087e6fdd053.title: Fix tool restriction bypass in agent runtime
4140cab495d5f5716cd7df085cbbe087e6fdd053.summary: Corrected logic in `tool-executor.ts` to enforce restricted tool filtering regardless of ask mode or summary export status. Updated `stream-parser.ts` to explicitly set `fromHandleSteps: false` during stream processing, ensuring the security check applies correctly to direct tool calls. This prevents unauthorized execution of restricted tools in the agent runtime.

06170a5c256b6641cb7305534ade2d1d2a62288d.title: Move validateAgentsWithSpawnableAgents to @codebuff/internal
06170a5c256b6641cb7305534ade2d1d2a62288d.summary: validateAgentsWithSpawnableAgents moved from @codebuff/common/templates/agent-validation to @codebuff/internal/templates/agent-validation. common package no longer imports validateSpawnableAgents. fetch-agent and agent-template-validation also relocated to packages/internal. Web API routes /api/agents/publish and /api/agents/validate updated to import from @codebuff/internal.

b73182067dbc1e12e451cfe68a116d5fde00e879.title: CI env script reads typed schema instead of parsing source
b73182067dbc1e12e451cfe68a116d5fde00e879.summary: scripts/generate-ci-env.ts now imports serverEnvSchema and clientEnvSchema from @codebuff/internal/env-schema, replacing fragile regex parsing of packages/internal/src/env.ts. All CI workflows (ci, cli-release-build, evals, nightly-evals, npm-app-release-build, sdk-release-build) updated to execute the .ts script.

75052a57cb38efdbfaa4ef1a7008bc571c1693a3.title: Add base2-read-moar agent definition
75052a57cb38efdbfaa4ef1a7008bc571c1693a3.summary: New file .agents/base2/base2-read-moar.ts defines SecretAgentDefinition id base2-read-moar, displayName 'Buffy Needs Moar Files', built on createBase2('fast'). Generator handleSteps runs context-pruner each step, inspects last read_files and spawn_agents tool results, and when a file-researcher returns relevantFiles not already read, emits add_message assistant prompts then yields 'STEP' to let the model pick files (forced read_files commented out). Internal repo-only change under .agents/base2/; no user-facing surface touched.

5e07e379bdeb1307e191b9c1c3d8bb10861c75c7.text: The assistant now stops correctly when it finishes all tasks in a list, preventing it from getting stuck waiting for more instructions.

769c3ffdebbae39e7e6d0ef61fd7e254c0a17477.text: A small internal cleanup moved a payment tool to a new spot behind the scenes. Users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

06170a5c256b6641cb7305534ade2d1d2a62288d.text: The team moved the rules that check if a helper can run into a private storage area. This is a small internal cleanup. The product works exactly the same for you.

5a4debae16072a00ae66540141bb062737eb1b62.text: The assistant's internal instructions were updated. This is a small change that may slightly improve how it responds, but you won't notice any new features.

631553fec3b98cb5efdca6aed761f547e7e690ce.title: CLI login modal sheen animation optimization
631553fec3b98cb5efdca6aed761f547e7e690ce.summary: Refactors getSheenColor to accept a Set of shadow characters instead of hardcoding a small array. Updates LoginModal to pass SHEEN_SHADOW_CHARS (including box-drawing chars) to the color generator. Scope: cli/src/components/login-modal-utils.ts, cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx.

1d968f141d70cf736dfdcc23afb4a7ba000ea8bf.title: Update message caching for alloy2 agent
1d968f141d70cf736dfdcc23afb4a7ba000ea8bf.summary: Message caching logic in `common/src/util/messages.ts` updated to support the `alloy2` agent. Removed `STEP_PROMPT` from tagged cache targets; added explicit cache control to the message preceding the last assistant response. Scope limited to shared core message conversion utilities. Migration note: `alloy2` specific caching behavior may not apply to other agents.

9e9b23e7ac1a281ad1912d1c07960d4a4884a258.title: Extract login URL fetching into custom hook
9e9b23e7ac1a281ad1912d1c07960d4a4884a258.summary: Refactored `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx` to delegate login URL fetching and browser opening to new `cli/src/hooks/use-fetch-login-url.ts`. This isolates `@tanstack/react-query` mutation logic and `open` package calls from the UI component. Scope limited to CLI login flow internals. Hook returns `fetchLoginUrlMutation` for component consumption.

8259dea1273d6153a8ea68e203d5c0c103005e2a.title: Add /exit slash command to CLI
8259dea1273d6153a8ea68e203d5c0c103005e2a.summary: Added `/exit` and `/quit` slash commands to the CLI chat interface. The command triggers an abort of active streaming, clears the input buffer, and executes the standard `Ctrl+C` termination sequence. This change modifies `cli/src/chat.tsx` to handle the new command logic and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts` to register the commands with aliases `quit` and `q`.

0937bf461415f89e86cb273def271d1c377d0aa0.title: writetodos excluded from forcing next step
0937bf461415f89e86cb273def271d1c377d0aa0.summary: The `write_todos` tool is added to `TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP` in `common/src/tools/constants.ts`. This prevents the agent loop from automatically triggering a subsequent step immediately after `write_todos` execution. The change applies to the core tool definitions used across all surfaces.

07594b7fc745e85de00e5a770d386b1a33c4d789.title: Make todos standard for base2
07594b7fc745e85de00e5a770d386b1a33c4d789.summary: Refactored base2.ts to make write_todos standard behavior, removing usesTodos and hasDecomposingThinker options. Updated base2-gpt-5-worker.ts to use write_todos for step-by-step planning. Deleted base2-fast-todos.ts and base2-fast-with-decomposing-thinker.ts.

297b92585db2e31296ef6ab38c845dc8e730bf5f.title: Buffbench supports custom binary installs
297b92585db2e31296ef6ab38c845dc8e730bf5f.summary: Added binInstalls config to Buffbench evals, allowing installation of specific binaries into a temporary directory before task execution. The runner executes provided install scripts, prepends resulting paths to PATH, and merges this environment with existing eval configs. This change affects evals/buffbench/run-buffbench.ts, types.ts, and configuration files like eval-codebuff.json.

e69082cb5a257484951b8a4f9001d3933472d8da.title: Add base2-alloy2 planner agent
e69082cb5a257484951b8a4f9001d3933472d8da.summary: Adds base2-alloy2 agent definition orchestrating context pruning and parallel planning steps. It spawns base2-plan-step (Claude Sonnet 4.5) and base2-plan-step-gpt-5 (GPT-5) to generate hypothetical next steps, then filters their outputs from the message history via set_messages before yielding the actual step. Files: .agents/base2/alloy2/base2-alloy2.ts, base2-plan-step.ts, base2-plan-step-gpt-5.ts.

3a2c574687a93973dc409e2bc24e73548821dced.title: CLI login modal refactored into custom hooks and utilities
3a2c574687a93973dc409e2bc24e73548821dced.summary: Login modal logic extracted into custom hooks (use-login-keyboard-handlers, use-login-polling, use-sheen-animation) and shared utilities/constants. Reduces component complexity by isolating keyboard input, polling state, and animation effects. Affects cli/src/hooks and cli/src/login.

9e9b23e7ac1a281ad1912d1c07960d4a4884a258.text: The login screen now uses a separate helper to fetch the web address needed for signing in. This is an internal cleanup that keeps the code organized, so you will not notice any difference when using the product.

297b92585db2e31296ef6ab38c845dc8e730bf5f.text: The system now lets users install specific tools in a temporary space before running tasks. This means the assistant can use custom software that was not previously available.

6160c38b9fd4722a14b473fba5678ea66fb714c8.text: The internal system now passes detailed feedback about file changes to the next step. This improves accuracy by ensuring precise confirmation data is received, though users may not see visible changes.

0937bf461415f89e86cb273def271d1c377d0aa0.text: The assistant now stops after writing a task list, waiting for your next instruction instead of automatically moving forward.

1d968f141d70cf736dfdcc23afb4a7ba000ea8bf.text: The assistant now remembers earlier parts of the conversation more efficiently when using the latest model, which may make responses slightly faster or cheaper.

631553fec3b98cb5efdca6aed761f547e7e690ce.text: The login screen's shimmering animation now displays more accurately on box borders.

8259dea1273d6153a8ea68e203d5c0c103005e2a.text: You can now type '/exit' to close the chat window. This stops any ongoing response and ends the session.

07594b7fc745e85de00e5a770d386b1a33c4d789.text: The system now uses a single, standard method for breaking down tasks into steps, replacing older, separate ways of doing this. This makes the assistant's planning process more consistent and predictable for you.

34d29421c439314478b2ccd72c43a75efca697a5.title: Reorder SDK release workflow to publish before commit
34d29421c439314478b2ccd72c43a75efca697a5.summary: sdk-release-prod.yml moves build-and-publish-sdk ahead of push-to-git. Publishing now gates the commit, ensuring the version bump lands only after the artifact is live. Affects CI release automation only.

3c382a9d57a598839692d3a8f936159be0d5d158.title: Remove SDK release artifact download and prod tagging from CI
3c382a9d57a598839692d3a8f936159be0d5d158.summary: CI workflows `sdk-release-build.yml` and `sdk-release-prod.yml` drop the `actions/download-artifact` step and the `sdk-v*` git tag creation/upload steps. This cleanup removes obsolete artifact handling and release tagging logic for the SDK. Scope is limited to GitHub Actions configuration files.

826cd02a168a7cc23c07b97c1ec3dae0c0363952.title: Add env override support to SDK release workflows
826cd02a168a7cc23c07b97c1ec3dae0c0363952.summary: SDK release build workflow now accepts `env-overrides` input, applying JSON key-value pairs to `GITHUB_ENV` after default variables. Prod release workflow passes `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT=prod` and backend URL override to the build job. `git stash` moved to `prepare-and-commit-prod` job to prevent dirty workspace conflicts during version bump. Interactive debug shell step removed from build workflow.

1f9ec81e03c61a304a100f1c5710bfc9768ff2c6.title: Remove checkout-ref input from SDK release workflows
1f9ec81e03c61a304a100f1c5710bfc9768ff2c6.summary: Removed `checkout-ref` input and conditional ref checkout from `sdk-release-build.yml`. `sdk-release-prod.yml` no longer passes explicit SHA to build job. Forces checkout to default branch state during release builds. Prevents accidental publishing of stale or unmerged commits.

6c955c8fa7400a3e49f70e0b15e7e1bf8ee7a54d.title: Add env-overrides input to sdk-release-build workflow
6c955c8fa7400a3e49f70e0b15e7e1bf8ee7a54d.summary: Added optional `env-overrides` string input to `.github/workflows/sdk-release-build.yml`. Allows passing a JSON object of environment variables to override defaults during manual or triggered runs.

1493d5f7031faf27fb425ec720b805f40b7c744f.title: SDK release build workflow enables SSH debug shell on failure
1493d5f7031faf27fb425ec720b805f40b7c744f.summary: The `sdk-release-build.yml` workflow now uses `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` to open an interactive debug shell when a build step fails. This mechanism allows developers to SSH into the runner for immediate troubleshooting of release build issues. The change is scoped to the CI pipeline configuration. A 15-minute timeout guard limits the duration of the debug session.

4005dbdd6d12b10eec8c128e43eb3e7e66ad7d4f.title: Remove SDK setEnv override
