4005dbdd6d12b10eec8c128e43eb3e7e66ad7d4f.summary: SDK `setEnv` removed from `sdk/src/index.ts` and `sdk/src/set-env.ts` deleted. Prod CI workflow `sdk-release-prod.yml` now injects placeholder env vars via `env-overrides` instead of relying on runtime code overrides. Scope limited to SDK entry point and GitHub Actions release pipeline. `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` check eliminated; non-dev/test environments previously cleared secrets.

9b97d0dda7a4bf9c70c0496519cb356708a86fe7.title: Fix SDK release workflow ordering
9b97d0dda7a4bf9c70c0496519cb356708a86fe7.summary: Reorders `build-and-publish-sdk` to run after `prepare-and-commit-prod` in `.github/workflows/sdk-release-prod.yml`. Resolves race condition where SDK build triggered before version commit/push. Ensures `sdk/package.json` updates persist before artifact generation.

1293bd993c1f1bcb3cf734e674aa568c41fb3840.title: SIGINT exit logic, markdown renderer plain text
1293bd993c1f1bcb3cf734e674aa568c41fb3840.summary: cli/src/chat.tsx: SIGINT handler and handleCtrlC simplified to immediate flush and process.exit(0) with no 3-second arm window or nested setTimeout state updates. Removes the double-press exit warning and its timer cleanup path. cli/src/utils/markdown-renderer.tsx: renderInlineContent and markdownToInline JSX builders replaced by nodeToPlainText, which flattens the mdast tree to a string with inlineCode backticks and heading # prefixes. Drops React and JSX type imports from the renderer module.

7981212c645f49747a55c7c94e942b2df9b7295d.title: Revert env.ts refactoring
7981212c645f49747a55c7c94e942b2df9b7295d.summary: Reverts the split of environment schemas into separate files, restoring inline Zod definitions within `packages/internal/src/env.ts`. This undoes the refactoring from commit 3959bf7b5 which extracted `serverEnvSchema` and `clientEnvSchema` into `env-schema.ts`. The change consolidates all environment validation logic back into a single file for the `@freebuff/internal` package.

3c382a9d57a598839692d3a8f936159be0d5d158.text: The team removed old, unused steps from the automatic system that builds the software. This cleanup has no effect on the product's features or performance for you.

34d29421c439314478b2ccd72c43a75efca697a5.text: The system now makes sure new features are ready to use before saving the update. This prevents situations where an update is recorded but the feature isn't actually available yet.

9b97d0dda7a4bf9c70c0496519cb356708a86fe7.text: Fixed timing error in software update process. This ensures the new version number saves correctly before the update is built. Small internal change.

1f9ec81e03c61a304a100f1c5710bfc9768ff2c6.text: A small internal safety update ensures the software always builds from the latest approved version. This prevents the accidental release of older or unfinished code.

7981212c645f49747a55c7c94e942b2df9b7295d.text: Developers moved settings back into one place. You won't notice any difference.

1493d5f7031faf27fb425ec720b805f40b7c744f.text: A small internal update lets engineers quickly check and fix problems when a software release fails. This does not change how the product works for you, but it helps ensure updates are delivered smoothly.

1293bd993c1f1bcb3cf734e674aa568c41fb3840.text: Pressing the stop button now ends the session instantly. Text displays as plain words instead of formatted styles.

4005dbdd6d12b10eec8c128e43eb3e7e66ad7d4f.text: The system now handles its setup automatically during release, rather than relying on a specific code instruction to do it. This internal cleanup ensures the product builds correctly without changing how you use it.

6c955c8fa7400a3e49f70e0b15e7e1bf8ee7a54d.text: A small internal change lets staff adjust some settings when building the product. This does not change how you use the app.

3f22ec37b9abf8976a11b9654ae0e11d6219c47c.title: SDK version bumped to 0.5.3
3f22ec37b9abf8976a11b9654ae0e11d6219c47c.summary: Bump @codebuff/sdk version from 0.5.2 to 0.5.3 in sdk/package.json. Internal version increment for SDK release.

80b0d7f5cb9e5b1910d3d51a6986164001987eac.title: directory-lister switch to structured output
80b0d7f5cb9e5b1910d3d51a6986164001987eac.summary: directory-lister agent in .agents/file-explorer/directory-lister.ts changes outputMode from 'all_messages' to 'structured_output'. handleSteps now accumulates list_directory JSON results into a toolResults array, then yields set_output with the combined array. toolNames updated to include 'set_output'. Import JSONObject and JSONValue from types/util-types.

889a4af5e3b5d248f6935d25fd1ad97617905b6c.title: Fix release:sdk script path
889a4af5e3b5d248f6935d25fd1ad97617905b6c.summary: Corrected `release:sdk` script in `package.json`. Previous command `bun run --cwd=sdkrelease` failed due to missing space between directory and command. Now executes `bun run --cwd=sdk release`.

a0e1d569a6715a17f60ff5a4cf1bdb44d590167a.title: sdk-release-prod workflow bumps version via node semver
a0e1d569a6715a17f60ff5a4cf1bdb44d590167a.summary: Replaced `npm version` with inline Node.js `semver.inc` in `.github/workflows/sdk-release-prod.yml` to update `package.json`. `npm version` failed due to `workspace:` protocol dependencies in the SDK package. The workflow now reads `package.json`, calculates the new version using the `version_type` input, and writes the updated JSON back to disk.

fe92bdacbc7512e47efe755e4518e1efead5d847.title: Tweak base2 stepPrompt
fe92bdacbc7512e47efe755e4518e1efead5d847.summary: Updated `stepPrompt` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to forbid example documentation files and enforce immediate turn end after summarization. This refines agent behavior to prevent redundant output or unwanted file creation.

5eee0babc6639e744d3ce7b2318f1c5981c39ef4.title: Add id-token write permission to sdk-release-prod workflow
5eee0babc6639e744d3ce7b2318f1c5981c39ef4.summary: Added `id-token: write` permission to `.github/workflows/sdk-release-prod.yml` alongside existing `contents: write`. This grants the workflow access to mint OIDC tokens for cloud provider authentication. Internal CI configuration change only.

335496eda9f44762cff28f27e66aee18f07eaafd.title: Add base2-fast-todos agent with writetodos tool support
335496eda9f44762cff28f27e66aee18f07eaafd.summary: New `base2-fast-todos` agent variant introduced in `.agents/base2/base2-fast-todos.ts`, leveraging a new `usesTodos` option in `createBase2` to inject the `write_todos` tool. The `base2.ts` factory now conditionally adds `write_todos` to the tool list and modifies the system prompt to instruct the agent to use `write_todos` for step-by-step planning instead of bullet-point lists when `usesTodos` is true. Evals in `evals/buffbench/main.ts` updated to benchmark `base2-fast` against `base2-fast-todos` with increased concurrency (5 to 10).

0b23c08522e35e0f34aed334a23903b166241f32.title: SDK release workflow injects env vars
0b23c08522e35e0f34aed334a23903b166241f32.summary: Added a step to `.github/workflows/sdk-release-build.yml` to set environment variables for the SDK release script. Uses `bun scripts/generate-ci-env.js` to determine variable names, then extracts corresponding values from `SECRETS_CONTEXT` via `jq`. Explicitly sets `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS` and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN`. Version in `sdk/package.json` reverted from `0.5.3` to `0.5.1`.

976f74186e3bc976f98a30ea5fbedb9ba26775bd.title: Add skipValidation flag to env schema in packages/internal/src/env.ts
976f74186e3bc976f98a30ea5fbedb9ba26775bd.summary: Added skipValidation flag to envSchema in packages/internal/src/env.ts. Flag activates when NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT equals 'test'. Internal change only.

0469a3f7877565ce3bf6c63863137230a62b5bfc.title: Extract usage cost metadata for generateText in SDK
0469a3f7877565ce3bf6c63863137230a62b5bfc.summary: SDK metadata extractor now parses usage cost from parsedBody for generateText calls. Updates llm.ts to capture openrouterUsage cost and upstream_inference_cost. Modifies fat-sdk-openrouter-example.ts to demonstrate generateText usage instead of streamText.

3f22ec37b9abf8976a11b9654ae0e11d6219c47c.text: A small internal update was made to the assistant's core tools. This change does not affect how you use the product.

889a4af5e3b5d248f6935d25fd1ad97617905b6c.text: A small internal fix corrected a typo in a setup instruction. This ensures the software builds correctly.

976f74186e3bc976f98a30ea5fbedb9ba26775bd.text: This small internal update lets the system skip certain checks when running in a test environment. It does not change how the product works for you.

5eee0babc6639e744d3ce7b2318f1c5981c39ef4.text: Internal setup change. It lets the release system sign in to cloud services automatically. You see no difference.

80b0d7f5cb9e5b1910d3d51a6986164001987eac.text: The file explorer tool now organizes its results into a clean list instead of a messy stream of text. This makes it easier for the system to understand and use the information.

a0e1d569a6715a17f60ff5a4cf1bdb44d590167a.text: Fixed a glitch that stopped the automatic update tool from running. The product keeps updating as normal.

fe92bdacbc7512e47efe755e4518e1efead5d847.text: The assistant now follows stricter rules to avoid creating unnecessary files or repeating itself after summarizing information.

335496eda9f44762cff28f27e66aee18f07eaafd.text: The assistant now creates a visible checklist to track its steps while working. This helps users see progress and understand what the assistant is doing.

0469a3f7877565ce3bf6c63863137230a62b5bfc.text: The tool now records the cost of using the assistant for text generation. This helps you see how much money you spend when using this feature.

0b23c08522e35e0f34aed334a23903b166241f32.text: The tools that deliver the software now automatically fetch the necessary access keys, and the product version was reset to a previous number.

7d027b9978d195bb1b197639b2a9c4b1114f4d2b.title: Add release:sdk script to package.json
7d027b9978d195bb1b197639b2a9c4b1114f4d2b.summary: Added `release:sdk` script to `package.json` to streamline SDK releases. The command executes `bun run --cwd=sdkrelease`, targeting the SDK release directory. This change affects the root package configuration, providing a dedicated entry point for SDK deployment tasks.

ea626e3586967a305af45e0867cf189acb9fac6b.title: Bump @codebuff/sdk version to 0.5.1
ea626e3586967a305af45e0867cf189acb9fac6b.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk from 0.5.0 to 0.5.1 in sdk/package.json. Internal patch release.

25831ff0488c8a4eab14fe5fcc7183ef8edb6852.title: Remove setmessages tool from context-pruner agent
25831ff0488c8a4eab14fe5fcc7183ef8edb6852.summary: Removed `toolNames: ['set_messages']` from `.agents/context-pruner.ts`. Prevents agent from injecting user prompt messages during context pruning. Internal change affecting agent definition only.

dcd79cd82cba676be30221112be9339bb7d2411d.title: Add SDK auto-build fallback to CLI dev script
dcd79cd82cba676be30221112be9339bb7d2411d.summary: The `cli/package.json` `dev` script now invokes `cli/scripts/dev.sh` instead of running `bun run src/index.tsx` directly. This wrapper attempts to run the CLI first; if that fails, it silently builds the SDK (`bun run build:sdk`) and retries the execution. This change affects the CLI development workflow, ensuring the SDK is built if missing or outdated when running `bun run dev`.

d13e9fa623ae51bc2ad5fc949224d31273178c71.title: SDK build script uses generateDtsBundle API
d13e9fa623ae51bc2ad5fc949224d31273178c71.summary: sdk/scripts/build.ts replaces execSync bunx dts-bundle-generator with direct generateDtsBundle import. Uses programmatic API with preferredConfigPath pointing to tsconfig.json. Writes bundle to dist/index.d.ts via fs/promises. Internal build refactor.

2bc8607144b44f0342871f5137124d47ebd4d133.title: Add writetodos tool for agent task tracking
2bc8607144b44f0342871f5137124d47ebd4d133.summary: The agent runtime gains a new `write_todos` tool, allowing the AI to maintain and update an ordered, step-by-step plan with completion statuses. Defined in `packages/agent-runtime` and exposed via `common/src/tools`, the tool accepts a list of tasks and flags, returning a JSON state. The CLI (`npm-app`) renders these updates as a checkbox list, suppressing intermediate chunks for cleaner output. This change spans core tool definitions, handlers, and type mappings across multiple packages.

4b4381d637361188165ada3105540ee032520149.title: Consolidate terminal breakpoints into reusable hook
4b4381d637361188165ada3105540ee032520149.summary: New `useTerminalBreakpoints` hook centralizes responsive logic previously inline in `login-modal.tsx`. It derives width/height flags (`isNarrow`, `isVerySmall`, etc.) from `@opentui/react` renderer dimensions. `LoginModal` now consumes this hook, removing direct `useRenderer` calls and manual breakpoint calculations. Includes `isTall` alias for backward compatibility.

b01a1c0afbc112e10ba2514f475cb882bd19c679.title: Add SDK release automation and runtime env overrides
b01a1c0afbc112e10ba2514f475cb882bd19c679.summary: New `sdk/scripts/release.js` and GitHub Actions workflows automate SDK version bumping, tagging, and npm publishing. Runtime environment variable overrides moved from build-time `define` in `sdk/scripts/build.ts` to a new `sdk/src/set-env.ts` module, executed on import. This ensures sensitive keys are cleared in production while allowing dev/test passthrough.

c9c35ea9f51210f82b68841890625deb72a7ff7c.title: SDK build injects empty env defaults and updates LLM imports
c9c35ea9f51210f82b68841890625deb72a7ff7c.summary: sdk/scripts/build.ts defines empty string defaults for 19 process.env keys (OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL, etc.) via Bun build define option for ESM/CJS outputs. sdk/src/impl/llm.ts switches relative file paths to @codebuff/* package specifiers and replaces hardcoded user-agent string with dynamic VERSION import from @ai-sdk/openai-compatible.

8450f267d05089ebc24e215e2003a8986d3e03e1.title: CLI shows loaded agents as collapsible message
8450f267d05089ebc24e215e2003a8986d3e03e1.summary: CLI chat now displays loaded agents in a collapsible assistant message on startup. New `agent-list` ContentBlock type and `renderAgentListBranch` component handle rendering and truncation logic. `App` component receives `loadedAgentsData` prop to initialize this message. Covers `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`, and related CLI components.

ea626e3586967a305af45e0867cf189acb9fac6b.text: A small internal update improved the tool's stability. Users will not notice any changes.

4b4381d637361188165ada3105540ee032520149.text: The app now checks the screen size more efficiently to adjust its layout automatically. This is an internal cleanup that helps the display fit better on different devices without changing how you use it.

2bc8607144b44f0342871f5137124d47ebd4d133.text: The assistant now tracks its own tasks in a visible checklist. This helps you see what it is working on and what it has finished.

25831ff0488c8a4eab14fe5fcc7183ef8edb6852.text: A small internal update stopped an automated system from adding extra text to your chats. You will see no changes in how the product works.

7d027b9978d195bb1b197639b2a9c4b1114f4d2b.text: A small internal update added a shortcut for the team to send out new versions of the software. You will not see any changes or new features.

d13e9fa623ae51bc2ad5fc949224d31273178c71.text: The tool that creates the instructions for this software now works differently behind the scenes. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

8450f267d05089ebc24e215e2003a8986d3e03e1.text: The program now shows a simple, foldable list of available assistants when it starts up, making it easier to see who is online without cluttering the screen.

b01a1c0afbc112e10ba2514f475cb882bd19c679.text: The team automated the software update process to reduce manual errors. They also changed how security keys work so private information stays hidden from the public version of the app.

dcd79cd82cba676be30221112be9339bb7d2411d.text: The tool now automatically prepares missing background files before running.

c9c35ea9f51210f82b68841890625deb72a7ff7c.text: Internal changes improved how the software builds and connects to the assistant. You will not notice any difference.

c4b933cad17573856ae8fdc23210a0f639175e1e.title: Include NEXTPUBLIC env vars in SDK build
c4b933cad17573856ae8fdc23210a0f639175e1e.summary: SDK build script now passes `env: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_*'` to the bundler. Ensures public environment variables are embedded in compiled output. Affects `sdk/scripts/build.ts`.

06ffa6a4e9a40385a3982d0bbca49ce24c357e90.title: Fix env var loading in dev workflow
06ffa6a4e9a40385a3982d0bbca49ce24c357e90.summary: Env.ts switches to explicit NEXT_PUBLIC_* mapping for experimental__runtimeEnv to ensure Next.js inlines client vars. dev.sh prepends project .bin to PATH so bun loads env correctly. Scope: packages/internal, scripts.

b9c2810da0c0752b43a857ed04412ca1a522e9ed.title: CLI login typecheck
b9c2810da0c0752b43a857ed04412ca1a522e9ed.summary: Added explicit `ValidatedUserInfo` type and return annotation to `validateApiKey` in `use-auth-query.ts`. Updated `pollLoginStatus` in `login-flow.ts` to safely cast `data.user` via intermediate `rawUser` check. Fixes TypeScript errors in CLI login flow. Affects `cli/src/hooks/use-auth-query.ts` and `cli/src/login/login-flow.ts`.

f2c0e412fae5c1f8b8ec9a103ebcde75e5a55dda.title: codesearch enforces -n flag for line numbers
f2c0e412fae5c1f8b8ec9a103ebcde75e5a55dda.summary: The code_search tool now unconditionally passes the -n flag to ripgrep in both SDK and CLI handlers. This ensures line numbers are always present in the output, which is required for correct parsing of results. The change affects sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts and npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

e293428d204d5b9e776b088d90bf6bb6fb81d5ea.title: SDK adds env parameter to client, run(), and runterminalcommand
e293428d204d5b9e776b088d90bf6bb6fb81d5ea.summary: Added optional `env` parameter to `CodebuffClient` and `run()`, passed through to `runTerminalCommand`. Custom environment variables merge with `process.env`, taking precedence. Scoped to `sdk/src/client.ts`, `sdk/src/run.ts`, and `sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts`. `run()` call `env` overrides client-level `env`.

3959bf7b5f948219edcc6b32903f7ba5ff9bbcc3.title: CLI auth refactor to TanStack Query
3959bf7b5f948219edcc6b32903f7ba5ff9bbcc3.summary: CLI authentication logic refactored to use @tanstack/react-query, replacing manual state management in chat.tsx and index.tsx with useAuthQuery and useLoginMutation hooks. This change introduces dependency injection for testability and standardizes error handling via QueryClient. The update affects cli/src/hooks/use-auth-query.ts, cli/src/chat.tsx, and cli/src/index.tsx, requiring @tanstack/react-query as a new dependency.

70ee5556c63d09f514ed3114292704b9807cd49e.title: Add env field to eval config and remove forced color flags
70ee5556c63d09f514ed3114292704b9807cd49e.summary: Eval configs now support an optional `env` field, threaded through `runAgentOnCommit` and `withTestRepo` to inject variables into `sdk.run()` and init commands. This allows passing test API keys and DB URLs to the agent environment. Additionally, `runTerminalCommand` no longer forces `FORCE_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE` to 1, respecting inherited environment colors.

14e4c921d3391bcee7d823be91746dcc6e56b715.title: Remove debug log from useSendMessage
14e4c921d3391bcee7d823be91746dcc6e56b715.summary: Removed a debug log statement in `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`. This change cleans up the codebase by removing unnecessary logging from the `useSendMessage` hook.

b9c2810da0c0752b43a857ed04412ca1a522e9ed.text: A small internal update improves how the login system checks your account details. This change does not affect how you use the product.

c4b933cad17573856ae8fdc23210a0f639175e1e.text: The assistant now automatically includes certain public settings when it builds itself. This ensures those settings work correctly without extra steps.

e293428d204d5b9e776b088d90bf6bb6fb81d5ea.text: The assistant can now use custom environment settings for commands. These settings apply only to specific tasks and do not change your computer's global configuration.

f2c0e412fae5c1f8b8ec9a103ebcde75e5a55dda.text: The code search tool now always shows line numbers. This small internal change ensures results are read correctly.

70ee5556c63d09f514ed3114292704b9807cd49e.text: The testing system now lets admins pass secret keys and database links directly to the assistant. Color settings in command outputs now follow the user's preferences instead of forcing bright colors.

3959bf7b5f948219edcc6b32903f7ba5ff9bbcc3.text: The system now manages login status more reliably behind the scenes. This update is internal and does not change how you use the product.

e69082cb5a257484951b8a4f9001d3933472d8da.text: The assistant now checks its own reasoning twice using different methods before answering. This internal update helps it think more carefully.

06ffa6a4e9a40385a3982d0bbca49ce24c357e90.text: Fixed internal developer setup so changes to the app's configuration load correctly during testing. This ensures the product works as intended when updated, with no visible changes for users.

4ba6ef0d829d5a2b3421ca06df034940369865d0.title: Add bun install to codebuff eval config
4ba6ef0d829d5a2b3421ca06df034940369865d0.summary: Added `initCommand: "bun install"` to `evals/buffbench/eval-codebuff.json`. Ensures dependencies are installed before running Codebuff evaluations. This internal change affects only the BuffBench eval harness configuration.

b1d9f0d4f79a0a00b018b8230b41e2cd2b0c472d.title: Evals: rename judge/analyzer ids, catch initCommand failures
b1d9f0d4f79a0a00b018b8230b41e2cd2b0c472d.summary: Agent ids in evals/buffbench drop git-evals2 prefix: judge, trace-analyzer, eval-task-generator. withTestRepo in evals/subagents/test-repo-utils.ts now try/catches execSync(initCommand), logs error via getErrorObject instead of stdio:ignore. Internal eval harness only.

f7ffed3713f37613637553e1f4c47e741c23363d.title: Refine base2 agent completion prompts
f7ffed3713f37613637553e1f4c47e741c23363d.summary: Updated base2.ts prompts to allow short bullet points for task completion summaries and added explicit 'keep working' instruction for max mode. The step prompt now conditionally enforces completion before summarizing.

d3cb8415d4f5e51b401e1a08187b2f744433cc45.title: commander suppress follow-up suggestions
d3cb8415d4f5e51b401e1a08187b2f744433cc45.summary: Added explicit instruction to `.agents/commander.ts` to exclude follow-up recommendations, suggestions, and offers to help from command output descriptions. This enforces conciseness in the commander agent's response generation. Scope limited to the internal agent prompt definition.

6da99d24210508da809379301201753a8b070d5a.title: file-lister prompt specifies root-relative paths and example
6da99d24210508da809379301201753a8b070d5a.summary: File-lister prompt updated to require root-relative paths and include example output. Changes in `.agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts` clarify expected format for internal agent. No user-facing impact.

8af8d077a9611738094b23ce30c567a180a5cc0e.title: context-pruner removes instructionsPrompt pop logic
8af8d077a9611738094b23ce30c567a180a5cc0e.summary: The `context-pruner` agent no longer executes `currentMessages.pop()` to strip the injected instructions prompt before token counting. This cleanup is redundant as the `instructionsPrompt` is not added to the message array in this context. The change is scoped to `.agents/context-pruner.ts` and its corresponding test file. This prevents potential misalignment in message indexing if the prompt injection behavior changes.

1de465822c93327a6615da338c2c8effdf4a6457.title: codesearch adds per-file and global result limits
1de465822c93327a6615da338c2c8effdf4a6457.summary: code_search now groups ripgrep output by file and enforces maxResults (default 15) per file plus globalMaxResults (default 250) across all files. Truncated or skipped files are reported in a structured message appended to stdout. Output string cap raised from 10,000 to 20,000 via maxOutputStringLength. Internal SDK only; no CLI or Web surface change.

7c5a830fbc562d75ad6c797a9cab717830765ac1.title: Fix formatPrompt content inclusion
7c5a830fbc562d75ad6c797a9cab717830765ac1.summary: Removed `collectParentInstructions` and simplified `getAgentPrompt` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts`. `fullToolList` and `getShortToolInstructions` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts` now return empty strings when no tools are defined. This prevents empty or redundant prompt sections from being included.

f05b9bb6ecb95f038f210a3d3a848bb37eca1b37.title: Fix agent file names in evals
f05b9bb6ecb95f038f210a3d3a848bb37eca1b37.summary: Renamed agent config files in `.agents/base2/` to match implementation: `base2-fast-no-validation.ts` and `base2-fast-with-decomposing-thinker.ts`. Updated `evals/buffbench/main.ts` to reference these corrected filenames in the `agents` array. Ensures evals run against intended agent variants.

9984487d7cff85d054cb969e1e2b75349057bd9f.title: Fix codesearch formatting bug
9984487d7cff85d054cb969e1e2b75349057bd9f.summary: Ripgrep output parser now handles filenames containing hyphens or colons by using regex patterns for match and context lines instead of naive `indexOf(':')`. Separator lines (`--`) are explicitly skipped. Applied to `common/src/util/format-code-search.ts`, `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`, and `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`.

b1d9f0d4f79a0a00b018b8230b41e2cd2b0c472d.text: The system now uses shorter names for its internal testing tools. If a setup step fails, it records the problem instead of ignoring it. This is a small internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

7c5a830fbc562d75ad6c797a9cab717830765ac1.text: The assistant now cleans up its internal instructions when no specific tools are available. This prevents it from reading empty or confusing sections, making its responses slightly more focused.

d3cb8415d4f5e51b401e1a08187b2f744433cc45.text: The assistant stopped adding extra offers to help at the end of its replies. This keeps answers shorter and cleaner.

6da99d24210508da809379301201753a8b070d5a.text: The system learned a clearer way to list files for its own use. This change is internal and does not affect the product you use.

9984487d7cff85d054cb969e1e2b75349057bd9f.text: Fixed a bug that caused search results to display incorrectly when file names contained certain symbols. Searches now show clean, readable results regardless of file name formatting.

4ba6ef0d829d5a2b3421ca06df034940369865d0.text: A small internal update ensures the system prepares its background tools before running performance checks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

1de465822c93327a6615da338c2c8effdf4a6457.text: The search tool now limits results per file and overall to prevent overwhelming output, with truncation notices added. This internal change improves result clarity for users without altering the interface.

8af8d077a9611738094b23ce30c567a180a5cc0e.text: The system stopped removing a hidden instruction text before measuring message length, because that text is no longer added in this case. This internal cleanup prevents errors if the text is added again in the future. You will not notice any change.

f7ffed3713f37613637553e1f4c47e741c23363d.text: The assistant now gives shorter, clearer summaries of completed tasks and stays focused on finishing work when asked to keep going.

f05b9bb6ecb95f038f210a3d3a848bb37eca1b37.text: A small internal fix corrected the names of test settings so the assistant is checked against the right versions.

d0b3c7aa1179cedc7c5903268b27f7cc14aeb26e.title: README documents CLI options
d0b3c7aa1179cedc7c5903268b27f7cc14aeb26e.summary: Added CLI Options section to README.md. Documents flags for quality (--lite, --max), modes (--ask, --print), agent control (--agent, --spawn, --params), debugging (--trace, --cwd), and setup (--init, --create). Provides quick reference for command-line usage.

21bfc2ffc14919bdbda19440f72908cee57e83ae.title: Fix prompt cache warm-up for thinker agents
21bfc2ffc14919bdbda19440f72908cee57e83ae.summary: Updated warm-up prompt in `decomposing-thinker.ts` to explicitly target cache priming before parallel requests. `thinker-with-files-input.ts` now strips `toolCallId` from the final `ToolMessage` and sets `includeToolCall: false` to ensure cache hit compatibility. Internal change to `.agents/thinker` subsystem only.

11c85e4e1b8ab58f1b8e3cb8846b3987a1e23c41.title: base2 prompt forbids any type casts
11c85e4e1b8ab58f1b8e3cb8846b3987a1e23c41.summary: Added rule to base2 agent prompt in .agents/base2/base2.ts. Explicitly bans casting variables to any or equivalent in other languages. Enforces stricter typing during code generation.

77f310f5e4eb270a996b02dda01bac2a1e520bf5.title: README adds agent guide structure details
77f310f5e4eb270a996b02dda01bac2a1e520bf5.summary: README.md documents output structure of `codebuff init-agents` command. Lists generated files in `.agents/` directory including 293-line guide, template, and types. Clarifies what users get after running init.

d1b7fd02ada4db27165fe63d9c32102c42e47396.title: Refactor agent-definition types to export ToolName and GetToolParams
d1b7fd02ada4db27165fe63d9c32102c42e47396.summary: agent-definition.ts now imports and re-exports ToolName and GetToolParams directly from ./tools, replacing the previous namespace import pattern. This simplifies type resolution in ToolCall definitions. Updated ripgrep flag examples in tools.ts comments to reflect standard -t/--type-not syntax.

f8e0282308c20c24f8a88f01c9c1bdf1dadd6d52.title: Skip tools instructions in system prompt when no tools available
f8e0282308c20c24f8a88f01c9c1bdf1dadd6d52.summary: getToolsInstructions in packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts returns empty string when tools array and additionalToolDefinitions are both empty. Prevents injecting '# Tools' section into system prompt for tool-less agents. Scope limited to agent-runtime package.

e5e30eb18509a80c4bd279f1ef726f7a9962b5ca.title: formatCodeSearchOutput returns No results on empty stdout
e5e30eb18509a80c4bd279f1ef726f7a9962b5ca.summary: Added guard in `formatCodeSearchOutput` to return 'No results' when `stdout` is empty. Prevents downstream processing of empty strings and ensures consistent user-facing output. Change scoped to `common/src/util/format-code-search.ts`.

b78d7b42f852086c0796e93268bf276d7e1a882b.title: Add tags to message schema, deprecate timeToLive,
b78d7b42f852086c0796e93268bf276d7e1a882b.summary: The `auxiliaryDataSchema` in `codebuff-message.ts` now supports a `tags` array, deprecating `timeToLive`, `keepDuringTruncation`, and `keepLastTags` to reduce framework prescriptiveness. `messages.ts` updates aggregation logic to respect `tags` for cache control, replacing `timeToLive` checks with `findLastIndex` on specific tags like `USER_PROMPT`. `run-agent-step.ts` and `loopAgentSteps` apply these new tags to step, user, and instructions prompts alongside deprecated fields. `strings.ts` adds a check to return `undefined` if the generated prompt is empty.

5fe62cce84d1124047ce649ecb5bbfcec297d82d.title: Add Windows troubleshooting guide to WINDOWS.md
5fe62cce84d1124047ce649ecb5bbfcec297d82d.summary: WINDOWS.md gains Common Windows Issues & Troubleshooting section. Covers failed version checks, git command syntax errors, login browser launch failures, and update message confusion. Provides specific fixes for corporate proxies, Git Bash/WSL compatibility, and manual login URL handling. References issues #294, #274, and #299.

8f6d890f97c0a175dd83c06284794c714b302c9f.title: Decomposing thinker uses file context; base2 accepts options
8f6d890f97c0a175dd83c06284794c714b302c9f.summary: Decomposing-thinker now accepts filePaths and uses context restart, dropping inherited message history. createBase2 refactored to accept options object for hasNoValidation and hasDecomposingThinker flags instead of mode string variants. Researcher agents removed decomposing-thinker from spawnable lists and workflow steps. New base-fast-no-validation copy.ts defines fast mode with decomposing thinker via options.

d1b7fd02ada4db27165fe63d9c32102c42e47396.text: Behind the scenes, the software organizes its tools more simply. This small internal cleanup does not change how the assistant behaves or what it can do for you.

f8e0282308c20c24f8a88f01c9c1bdf1dadd6d52.text: The assistant now hides its internal tool instructions when it has no tools to use. This keeps its messages cleaner and prevents it from mentioning capabilities it does not have.

d0b3c7aa1179cedc7c5903268b27f7cc14aeb26e.text: A guide was added to the help manual. It lists commands for changing how the assistant answers, running tests, and setting up the system. This helps users find options without guessing.

21bfc2ffc14919bdbda19440f72908cee57e83ae.text: The system now prepares data better before answering, so it can respond faster when you ask for help with files. This is a small internal update that makes the assistant feel more responsive.

77f310f5e4eb270a996b02dda01bac2a1e520bf5.text: The help guide now clearly lists the files the setup tool creates. This change is small and internal.

e5e30eb18509a80c4bd279f1ef726f7a9962b5ca.text: When a search finds nothing, the app now clearly says 'No results' instead of showing a blank screen. This small fix makes the experience more predictable.

5fe62cce84d1124047ce649ecb5bbfcec297d82d.text: A new guide explains how to fix common problems with signing in, updating, and connecting to the network. This helps users solve issues without needing technical skills.

11c85e4e1b8ab58f1b8e3cb8846b3987a1e23c41.text: The assistant's internal rules were updated to require more precise handling of data types. This change aims to improve the reliability of the code it generates.

82eb68d7d8908d1b25b20ad01239fdb7f1056f1c.title: file-researcher standard in base2
82eb68d7d8908d1b25b20ad01239fdb7f1056f1c.summary: file-researcher added to spawnableAgents in .agents/base2/base2.ts. Prompt updated to mandate file-researcher for file discovery, replacing multiple file-picker-max spawns. Scope limited to base2 agent config. read_files usage restricted to single comprehensive pass after file-researcher returns.

961949cda2cda5761de94254f9626205ce2a507d.title: codesearch flags docs add -g and --no-ignore
961949cda2cda5761de94254f9626205ce2a507d.summary: code_search `flags` descriptions updated to show `-g` glob filtering and `--no-ignore` for .gitignore'd files. Replaces `-t`/`--type-not` examples across `code-searcher.ts`, `types/tools.ts`, and `code-search.ts`. Internal docstring/param-schema change only. No runtime behavior change.

b5676a455ce66a06314c0fcdb60608a69b6c8f3d.title: filterXml switches from callback to generator stream
b5676a455ce66a06314c0fcdb60608a69b6c8f3d.summary: sdk/src/tool-xml-filter.ts changes filterXml from an async function with an omit callback to a synchronous generator yielding {chunk} objects. sdk/src/run.ts updates onStreamChunk and onSubagentResponseChunk to consume the stream via while(true) loop and await handleStreamChunk per yielded chunk. Internal refactor for streaming tool XML filtering.

776aabb75bf7a85f3f1c12b8889fa00c8a438a8e.title: Refactor /me API handler and fix eval runner typecheck
776aabb75bf7a85f3f1c12b8889fa00c8a438a8e.summary: Extracted GET logic from `web/src/app/api/v1/me/route.ts` into `web/src/app/api/v1/me/impl/_get.ts` to resolve typecheck errors. `CodebuffRunner.handleStreamChunk` in `evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts` now guards against non-string chunks before `process.stdout.write`. Scope covers Web API structure and Evals runner. `meGet` retains default `['id']` fields and `VALID_USER_INFO_FIELDS` validation.

008f8dd95ec9f17faf758560b3341d8a0e339728.title: Fix completions body type and property access
008f8dd95ec9f17faf758560b3341d8a0e339728.summary: Changed `body` type from `unknown` to `{}` in `web/src/api/v1/chat/completions.ts`. Extracted `bodyStream` and `runId` variables to safely access `stream` and `codebuff_metadata.run_id` without casting to `any`. Updated analytics and streaming logic to use these pre-extracted values.

824924201362ed796c2f4fed6868ddcb0c89a78f.title: SDK version bump to 0.5.0
824924201362ed796c2f4fed6868ddcb0c89a78f.summary: The @codebuff/sdk package version is incremented from 0.4.5 to 0.5.0. This release aligns with the integration of the local agent runtime. The change is isolated to the sdk/package.json manifest.

fb5f796ecd4cd7eaf4d258b6827cad92a94a7eea.title: Step prompt wrapping now requires non-empty prompt
fb5f796ecd4cd7eaf4d258b6827cad92a94a7eea.summary: Step prompt wrapping now requires a non-empty prompt value before applying <system_reminder> tags. This prevents empty step prompts from being wrapped and sent to the agent. Scope limited to packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts. The condition adds a truthy check for prompt alongside existing type and agentType checks.

e0d6df3ed1ceb4316fe837bb9bd6693f25c5a544.title: Token-efficient code search output
e0d6df3ed1ceb4316fe837bb9bd6693f25c5a544.summary: code_search output now groups matches by file, cutting token cost. New formatCodeSearchOutput in common/src/util/format-code-search.ts rewrites ripgrep stdout. Applied in sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts and npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. codeSearcher agent switched to structured_output via set_output.

9e226827a42b370975fde54a1ecf394e5e93c85c.title: Add base2-fast-no-validation agent to nightly evals
9e226827a42b370975fde54a1ecf394e5e93c85c.summary: Introduced base2-fast-no-validation orchestrator variant by extending createBase2 mode union in .agents/base2/base2.ts. This mode inherits fast behavior but skips final validation steps and enforces concise summaries. Nightly evals in evals/buffbench/main-nightly.ts now run base2-fast-no-validation instead of base2-fast. New definition file .agents/base2/base-fast-no-validation.ts registers the agent with display name 'Buffy the Fast No Validation Orchestrator'.

ef910125a487c7bb1f4af9bf66edd54e011c1d06.title: Refactor SDK stream chunk handling and tool XML filtering
ef910125a487c7bb1f4af9bf66edd54e011c1d06.summary: The `handleStreamChunk` callback in `sdk/src/run.ts` now accepts a union of strings and structured `subagent_chunk` objects, moving subagent delta accumulation logic from `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` into the SDK boundary. `sdk/src/tool-xml-filter.ts` is rewritten to use an async `filterXml` function with `startToolTag`/`endToolTag` constants, replacing the previous stateful `ToolXmlFilterState` and buffer management. `sdk/src/tool-xml-buffer.ts` is deleted, and its exports are removed from `sdk/src/index.ts`. The CLI hook simplifies by delegating raw string vs object handling directly to the new SDK event shape.

9e226827a42b370975fde54a1ecf394e5e93c85c.text: The assistant now uses a faster version that skips checking its own work. This saves time but may lead to less accurate answers.

824924201362ed796c2f4fed6868ddcb0c89a78f.text: The software update connects the product to a new local processing engine. Users will not notice any changes.

82eb68d7d8908d1b25b20ad01239fdb7f1056f1c.text: The assistant now uses a dedicated search tool to find files, which makes it more efficient. This internal update helps it locate information faster without wasting time on multiple steps.

776aabb75bf7a85f3f1c12b8889fa00c8a438a8e.text: This small internal update fixes a background process that runs product tests. Users will not notice any changes to the product.

ef910125a487c7bb1f4af9bf66edd54e011c1d06.text: The app now handles data from different parts of the system more consistently behind the scenes. This internal cleanup helps prevent glitches when the assistant uses multiple tools at once.

e0d6df3ed1ceb4316fe837bb9bd6693f25c5a544.text: Search results are now grouped by file to reduce data usage. This makes the feature faster and cheaper to run.

008f8dd95ec9f17faf758560b3341d8a0e339728.text: Fixed internal checks to ensure chat responses work correctly. No visible change for users.

fb5f796ecd4cd7eaf4d258b6827cad92a94a7eea.text: The assistant now skips adding instructions when there is nothing to say. This keeps messages cleaner.

ada0e6ba4b39862ee567f88e189f922e68f5a081.title: Refine logging format for print mode events in useSendMessage
ada0e6ba4b39862ee567f88e189f922e68f5a081.summary: Updates logging in `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` to include `JSON.stringify(event.type)` in the SDK event info log. This change ensures consistent formatting for event types in raw logs. Scope limited to CLI hook implementation. No functional changes to message processing logic.

5f0d358e8fa59e730c645478890f4ef33fb8520f.title: Conditional tool and agent prompt generation
5f0d358e8fa59e730c645478890f4ef33fb8520f.summary: Agent prompt generation now conditionally appends tool instructions and spawnable agent descriptions only when present. Previously, empty sections were always added to the instructionsPrompt. This change affects `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts`. The fix prevents unnecessary whitespace and empty text blocks in the final prompt string.

9872a589671e7f8e7ac108bb1947ff5ad280e7f0.title: Base2 validation standardization
9872a589671e7f8e7ac108bb1947ff5ad280e7f0.summary: The `base2-fast-with-validation` agent definition is removed from `.agents/base2/`. The `createBase2` factory in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` now accepts only `fast` or `max` modes. Validation steps (typechecks, tests, lints) are integrated directly into the prompt logic for both `fast` and `max` modes, ensuring standard behavior without a separate variant.

5b304a8a02d5f374b0ff1b732d12bd71de8b1b7c.title: Normalize subagent chunk event types to underscores
5b304a8a02d5f374b0ff1b732d12bd71de8b1b7c.summary: SDK and CLI normalize subagent event type identifiers from kebab-case to snake_case, specifically changing `subagent-chunk` to `subagent_chunk`. This update removes legacy kebab-case checks in `sdk/src/run.ts` and updates the corresponding listener in `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` to align with the new standard. The change ensures consistent event naming conventions across the agent communication pipeline.

ce5838beffc746f29d2f2bf0de4c4f3a94e0d140.title: Move api/v1/me implementation to app route
ce5838beffc746f29d2f2bf0de4c4f3a94e0d140.summary: Refactored `api/v1/me` logic by moving implementation from `web/src/api/v1/me.ts` to `web/src/app/api/v1/me/route.ts`. The route handler now directly exports `_meGet` alongside the standard `GET` export, removing the indirection layer. This consolidation aligns the code with Next.js App Router conventions, ensuring the handler and its dependencies reside within the route file structure.

37316d850d1997c2d84a80ef8a56b2e0b1be07cb.title: Add base2-fast-with-validation agent variant
37316d850d1997c2d84a80ef8a56b2e0b1be07cb.summary: New `base2-fast-with-validation` agent variant added to `.agents/base2`. Extends `createBase2` with a `fast-with-validation` mode that appends a validation step (typechecks, tests, lints) to the fast prompt flow. `evals/buffbench/main.ts` updated to run this new agent variant with `taskConcurrency: 5`, replacing previous fast-thinking variants.

191a634ca10f60e1c8b3ef12e18b154657c715fa.title: Add cost tracking to SDK responses
191a634ca10f60e1c8b3ef12e18b154657c715fa.summary: SDK now extracts and returns usage cost details from OpenRouter responses. Replaced `createOpenAICompatible` with direct `OpenAICompatibleChatLanguageModel` instantiation in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` to enable custom `metadataExtractor`. The extractor captures `cost` and `upstream_inference_cost` from stream chunks, building a `codebuff.usage` metadata object. `scripts/fat-sdk-openrouter-example.ts` updated to demonstrate new model initialization and streaming usage.

c2167451749849219ea711fd55c2327e67980f75.title: New task-researcher2, planner-pro, gpt-5-worker agent iteration
c2167451749849219ea711fd55c2327e67980f75.summary: Added task-researcher2 (claude-sonnet-4.5, structured output with report+relevantFiles) and planner-pro-with-files-input (gpt-5-pro, no tools, deep-thinking implementation plans). base2-with-task-researcher now spawns task-researcher2 and planner-pro-with-files-input instead of task-researcher/code-reviewer/validator, gains spawn_agent_inline tool, and swaps generate-plan for planner-pro. base2-gpt-5-worker simplified: stepPrompt removed, final step changed from "inform parent to double-check" to "end your turn". Files: .agents/researcher/task-researcher2.ts, .agents/planners/planner-pro-with-files-input.ts, .agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-worker.ts, .agents/base2/task-researcher/base2-with-task-researcher.ts.

3a2c574687a93973dc409e2bc24e73548821dced.text: The code behind the login window was split into smaller, independent parts. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

ce5838beffc746f29d2f2bf0de4c4f3a94e0d140.text: The team moved a piece of internal plumbing to keep it organized. You will not see any changes.

ada0e6ba4b39862ee567f88e189f922e68f5a081.text: The program now records its activity in a clearer, consistent format. This internal change does not affect how the product works for you.

9872a589671e7f8e7ac108bb1947ff5ad280e7f0.text: Internal cleanup simplifies the assistant's checking process. No changes to how you use the product.

5f0d358e8fa59e730c645478890f4ef33fb8520f.text: The assistant no longer includes blank lines when there are no extra instructions to add. This small cleanup makes the final message tidier.

14e4c921d3391bcee7d823be91746dcc6e56b715.text: The app stopped recording extra background details when sending messages. This is a small internal cleanup, so the experience stays the same.

5b304a8a02d5f374b0ff1b732d12bd71de8b1b7c.text: The assistant now uses a consistent format for internal messages about its work. This small cleanup helps the software run more smoothly.

191a634ca10f60e1c8b3ef12e18b154657c715fa.text: The assistant now tracks and displays the cost of each response. You can see exactly how much each interaction uses.

37316d850d1997c2d84a80ef8a56b2e0b1be07cb.text: The AI assistant now checks its own work for errors before giving you an answer. This small internal update helps ensure the results are more reliable.

c2167451749849219ea711fd55c2327e67980f75.text: The internal assistant now uses a more careful planning step before acting. This change helps it handle complex tasks more accurately.

2e98d744e03a921690fa18ad148ec1e8832202da.title: Add clean script to web package.json
2e98d744e03a921690fa18ad148ec1e8832202da.summary: Added 'clean' script to web/package.json. Removes .next directory to standardize build artifact cleanup. Scope limited to web package.

c1f78c05e1acff6698b19a9a7e3df363894c35e4.title: CLI LoginModal dimensions increased
c1f78c05e1acff6698b19a9a7e3df363894c35e4.summary: LoginModal width and height increased from 80%/70% to 90%/80% of terminal dimensions in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx`. Position offsets reduced from 10%/15% to 5%/10% to maintain centering. Scope limited to CLI login UI surface. Constraint: `maxHeight` updated to match new 80% height calculation.

72ac5ceeece0f9f634230cac977a7c635aef9f3e.title: Add CLI validation scripts and SDK file hooks
72ac5ceeece0f9f634230cac977a7c635aef9f3e.summary: Added `test-sdk-file-hooks.sh` and `validate-cli-with-tmux.sh` to verify CLI integrity when SDK files change. Configured `codebuff.json` hooks to trigger `bun run typecheck` and `bun run build` in the CLI directory upon SDK modifications. The tmux script captures CLI startup output to detect runtime errors.

3dcb91e7fcf9a52146e59b4f81ff2207cbf1c5d8.title: CLI login screen becomes modal overlay
3dcb91e7fcf9a52146e59b4f81ff2207cbf1c5d8.summary: Login screen replaced by modal overlay in cli/src/chat.tsx. Unauthenticated state no longer blocks main UI; modal renders atop chat interface. Files: login-modal.tsx (renamed from login-screen.tsx), login-modal-utils.ts. Modal preserves clipboard copy and auth flow; chat components remain mounted underneath.

1b1aa2e8b54e5a542c1c890cf5b6464c31e2745b.title: Fix CLI duplicate handleLoginSuccess and logger spread
1b1aa2e8b54e5a542c1c890cf5b6464c31e2745b.summary: Removed duplicate handleLoginSuccess definition in cli/src/chat.tsx to resolve type errors. Updated cli/src/utils/logger.ts to guard against undefined data in logAsErrorIfNeeded spread. Scope limited to CLI chat and logger utilities.

41f86aafad9366829ce6e2a3030b85cbbd72c715.title: knowledge.md: Add git workflow best practices for interactive commands
41f86aafad9366829ce6e2a3030b85cbbd72c715.summary: Added a 'Git Workflow Best Practices' section to `knowledge.md` detailing the use of `tmux` for interactive git commands. Explains that agents cannot handle user-input prompts, causing hangs, and lists common commands requiring tmux or non-interactive alternatives. Includes a bash example demonstrating the correct tmux invocation pattern.

e007c9b18e9eec8c881c0c3b90616bd1b371eb7f.title: Add tmux CLI testing guide to knowledge.md
e007c9b18e9eec8c881c0c3b90616bd1b371eb7f.summary: Added 'Testing CLI Changes with tmux' section to cli/knowledge.md. Provides scriptable patterns for capturing TUI states during auth flows, loading indicators, and time-dependent updates. Includes basic session lifecycle commands and specific use cases for UI verification.

8a6461f32fe69fda14f4b16e2f91634c62654d7b.title: CLI startup decoupled from auth check
8a6461f32fe69fda14f4b16e2f91634c62654d7b.summary: CLI renders immediately via AppWithAsyncAuth wrapper, deferring getUserInfoFromApiKey to useEffect. Removes blocking startApp auth await. Handles 5000ms timeout and invalid credentials states without freezing UI. Scope limited to cli/src/index.tsx and cli/src/chat.tsx.

d03f76120f224e8b93fbeec45c052b76bf8635f5.title: CLI Ctrl+C exit flow
d03f76120f224e8b93fbeec45c052b76bf8635f5.summary: CLI chat.tsx implements SIGINT handler for Ctrl+C exit flow. First press arms exit with warning; second within 3s exits after flushing analytics. Debounces rapid SIGINTs (<50ms) and clears input focus on arm. Scope limited to cli/src/chat.tsx.

a9da3c1510b478d14fd8521ec25bf8837589d04c.title: Remove CLI PostHog console suppression helper
a9da3c1510b478d14fd8521ec25bf8837589d04c.summary: Deleted cli/src/utils/suppress-console.ts and removed suppressPostHogConsoleErrors from cli/src/utils/analytics.ts. PostHog initialization no longer wraps console.error or console.warn to filter errors containing 'posthog'. Scope limited to CLI analytics utilities.

d03f76120f224e8b93fbeec45c052b76bf8635f5.text: Pressing Ctrl+C once shows a warning instead of closing immediately. Pressing it again within three seconds closes the app safely.

2e98d744e03a921690fa18ad148ec1e8832202da.text: A small internal update added a tool to remove old temporary files during website builds. This change does not affect how you use the product.

8a6461f32fe69fda14f4b16e2f91634c62654d7b.text: The command-line tool now starts instantly instead of waiting for a security check. If the check takes too long or fails, the tool still works without freezing.

3dcb91e7fcf9a52146e59b4f81ff2207cbf1c5d8.text: The login screen now appears as a pop-up over the main chat window. This means you can still see the chat interface while signing in.

72ac5ceeece0f9f634230cac977a7c635aef9f3e.text: The system now automatically checks the command tool whenever related files change. This helps catch startup errors early, keeping the tool stable for you.

c1f78c05e1acff6698b19a9a7e3df363894c35e4.text: The login screen on the command-line tool now appears larger. This small visual change makes the screen easier to read and use.

1b1aa2e8b54e5a542c1c890cf5b6464c31e2745b.text: A small internal fix removed a duplicate command that caused errors, and improved how the tool records failures. This makes the chat assistant more stable and reliable for you.

a9da3c1510b478d14fd8521ec25bf8837589d04c.text: The tool now shows more messages about data collection errors. This change is small and only affects how warnings appear.

e007c9b18e9eec8c881c0c3b90616bd1b371eb7f.text: The team added a guide for testing visual changes. This helps ensure the app looks correct during login and loading.

9651f9341bde3c4401207497630d7a0d75829e11.title: logger debug dir nested under debug/
9651f9341bde3c4401207497630d7a0d75829e11.summary: getDebugDir appends 'debug' to resolved path. Isolates debug logs from other parent dir contents. Scope: web/src/util/logger.ts only. No config or env var changes required.

f5428cc923afcd03861e96c3f3aac8909ea82796.title: Fix addAgentStep to return stepId
f5428cc923afcd03861e96c3f3aac8909ea82796.summary: The `addAgentStep` function in `sdk/src/impl/database.ts` now extracts `stepId` from the response body instead of `runId`. This corrects the identifier returned after an agent step is added, ensuring downstream logic receives the step-specific ID rather than the run ID. The change affects only the SDK database implementation.

93318f787d1c27c8b407bed91e778c71b713f1e1.title: CLI Ctrl+C exit warning
93318f787d1c27c8b407bed91e778c71b713f1e1.summary: Added Ctrl+C handler to `chat.tsx` with exit warning. First press shows 'Press Ctrl+C again to exit', clears input, arms exit. Second press flushes analytics via `flushAnalytics()` then exits. `use-keyboard-handlers.ts` accepts `onCtrlC` callback, prevents default when armed. Terminal width now falls back to `renderer.width` or 80 when `measuredWidth` is 0.

78c5b81ee1491f580cdd693565c85db9e57807f2.title: Add error logging to consumeCreditsAndAddAgentStep
78c5b81ee1491f580cdd693565c85db9e57807f2.summary: Added `logger.error` call in `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` within `consumeCreditsAndAddAgentStep` catch block. Imports `getErrorObject` from `@codebuff/common/util/error` to serialize error before logging. Logs 'Error consuming credits and adding agent step' alongside serialized error object. Internal observability improvement for billing transaction failures.

7206ef5ddb9c5b1f8bdc4cc111f19f56afdb8cb4.title: Login errors print via getErrorObject
7206ef5ddb9c5b1f8bdc4cc111f19f56afdb8cb4.summary: Login and login-status error logs now pass errors through getErrorObject before console.error. Replaces raw error printing in npm-app/src/client.ts to standardize serialization. Scope limited to client.ts login flow. getErrorObject import added from @codebuff/common/util/error.

c3b8d4b4dfd7542eda0fa4be8083d839a55ce90a.title: Add pino logger to evals runner
c3b8d4b4dfd7542eda0fa4be8083d839a55ce90a.summary: New evals/logger.ts wraps pino to write debug logs to debug/evals.log. run-buffbench.ts injects this logger into CodebuffClient. Logging skips CI and test environments via CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS and NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT checks. Supports info, debug, warn, error, and fatal levels.

974f7d91e9343e77bebc2bc2b3283d3a91742cbf.title: Fix CLI login transition UI regressions
974f7d91e9343e77bebc2bc2b3283d3a91742cbf.summary: Login success now triggers `resetChatStore` and `setInputFocused` to clear stale chat state and restore input focus. `MultilineInput` was refactored to expose a `MultilineInputHandle` via `forwardRef` and `useImperativeHandle`, replacing the direct `InputRenderable` ref used in keyboard handlers. Terminal width calculation in `chat.tsx` was hardened with a `sanitizeDimension` helper to prevent NaN or negative values from breaking layout rendering.

ecab14492ccb9bb7cbf115378fe387ed027d62e0.title: CLI auth typecheck fixes
ecab14492ccb9bb7cbf115378fe387ed027d62e0.summary: Widens hasInvalidCredentials to boolean | null in login-screen.tsx to satisfy typechecker. Prunes unused imports (validateAuth, loggerContext, flushAnalytics) and reorders remaining imports in auth.ts. Scope limited to CLI login and auth utility files. No runtime behavior change; internal type and lint hygiene.

5407694c252acfed83864ee7318dddb4f8bef411.title: CLI chat input width adjusts for agent toggle
5407694c252acfed83864ee7318dddb4f8bef411.summary: Chat input and separator widths in `cli/src/chat.tsx` now subtract estimated agent toggle dimensions from terminal width using `string-width`. Replaces static `renderer.width` with dynamic `separatorWidth` calculated via `useTerminalDimensions`. Adds `string-width` dependency to `cli/package.json`. Ensures layout alignment when toggle label length varies.

f5428cc923afcd03861e96c3f3aac8909ea82796.text: The system now correctly identifies each step of a task instead of the overall session. This small fix helps the assistant track progress accurately.

78c5b81ee1491f580cdd693565c85db9e57807f2.text: The system now records more details when a billing error occurs. This helps the support team fix problems faster.

7206ef5ddb9c5b1f8bdc4cc111f19f56afdb8cb4.text: The system now cleans up error messages before saving them. This helps support staff understand login problems faster.

c3b8d4b4dfd7542eda0fa4be8083d839a55ce90a.text: The system now quietly records detailed activity logs for internal testing purposes, but only when running outside of automated test environments. This change is small and internal, so users will not notice any difference in how the product works or looks.

5407694c252acfed83864ee7318dddb4f8bef411.text: The text box for typing messages now automatically shrinks when the agent switch is visible. This prevents the layout from looking broken or squashed.

974f7d91e9343e77bebc2bc2b3283d3a91742cbf.text: After logging in, the screen now correctly clears old messages and keeps the text box active for typing. Layout errors in narrow windows were fixed, preventing display glitches.

93318f787d1c27c8b407bed91e778c71b713f1e1.text: Stopping the chat with Ctrl+C now asks for a second press to confirm, preventing accidental exits.

9651f9341bde3c4401207497630d7a0d75829e11.text: The system now keeps its technical notes separate from other data. This small internal change does not affect how you use the product.

ecab14492ccb9bb7cbf115378fe387ed027d62e0.text: Internal housekeeping was done on the login screen and authentication tools to fix minor technical checks and remove unused code. This does not change how the product works or looks for users.

39601f204424035c8ab09718d2709ef44ee326d6.title: CLI logger logAsErrorIfNeeded data param optional
39601f204424035c8ab09718d2709ef44ee326d6.summary: `logAsErrorIfNeeded` in `cli/src/utils/logger.ts` marks `data` param optional (`data?: any`). Fixes type error where callers omit `data` field. Scope limited to CLI logger utility. No runtime behavior change.

8e3a9854575e435d6ca28b991c3e19c83068237f.title: Fix binary existence check in release scripts
8e3a9854575e435d6ca28b991c3e19c83068237f.summary: Updated `ensureBinaryExists` in `npm-app/release/index.js` and `npm-app/release-staging/index.js` to treat the string `'error'` as a missing binary. The check now explicitly verifies that `getCurrentVersion()` returns neither `null` nor `'error'` before skipping the download step. This ensures the release process correctly triggers binary downloads when the version probe fails.

863ae4e4ab28922c0bd55b88bcfd83cbfb8366dd.title: Remove apiKey from SDK getUserInfoFromApiKey URL params
863ae4e4ab28922c0bd55b88bcfd83cbfb8366dd.summary: The `apiKey` parameter is removed from the `URLSearchParams` object in `getUserInfoFromApiKey` within `sdk/src/impl/database.ts`. This prevents the API key from being included as a query string parameter in requests to `/api/v1/me`. The change affects only the SDK implementation in `database.ts`. Authentication likely relies on headers or other mechanisms rather than query parameters.

ebabc911ff7d730b13a704d7000adc933733fe35.title: Web logger debugDir set to parent
ebabc911ff7d730b13a704d7000adc933733fe35.summary: Web logger `getDebugDir` now sets `debugDir = parent` inside loop. Fixes issue with web logger. Scope: `web/src/util/logger.ts`.

04f078043e472ed46a37f0ce52855650c50b6d12.title: CLI binary check uses getCurrentVersion instead of fs.existsSync
04f078043e472ed46a37f0ce52855650c50b6d12.summary: Refactored `ensureBinaryExists` in `cli/release-staging/index.js` to check `getCurrentVersion` instead of `fs.existsSync(CONFIG.binaryPath)`. This ensures the CLI validates the binary's actual version state rather than just file presence, preventing false positives if the binary exists but is invalid or outdated. Scope limited to CLI release staging logic.

91faba0ecaf18548df103d35f9a1062550c9dab2.title: Update dev.sh to use start-web command
91faba0ecaf18548df103d35f9a1062550c9dab2.summary: scripts/dev.sh switches from `bun start-server` to `bun start-web`. The readiness check updates to grep for `  - Local:        http://localhost:3000` instead of `🚀 Server is running on port` to correctly signal server startup. This aligns the dev script with the current web server startup command and log format.

f192bf22d1dc4e4a4bd1a74db091749aa533612b.title: Fix web debug log output dir
f192bf22d1dc4e4a4bd1a74db091749aa533612b.summary: Updated web/src/util/logger.ts to dynamically locate the git root for debug logs instead of using a hardcoded relative path. Added a getDebugDir function that traverses up directories to find .git, falling back to null if not found. This ensures debug logs write to the correct location in various local development environments, particularly when the project structure changes or the logger is invoked from different subdirectories.

da268f7a70311adfee7f221466856140eb1690ab.title: Refine base2 file-researcher agent prompts
da268f7a70311adfee7f221466856140eb1690ab.summary: Updated `.agents/base2/task-researcher/base2-with-file-researcher.ts` and `.agents/researcher/file-researcher.ts` to tighten agent instructions. `base2-with-file-researcher` now mandates reading all researcher-found files, adds a pause step for tool results, and replaces custom `handleSteps` with a `stepPrompt` for summarization. `file-researcher` simplified its workflow by removing redundant spawn rounds, focusing on immediate report compilation via `set_output`. Eval runner `evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts` adjusted event printing logic to an `else if` block.

b2d399109dde4b7df51e81c91aded6382dce51b0.title: Add printEvents flag to BuffBench agent runner
b2d399109dde4b7df51e81c91aded6382dce51b0.summary: Added `printEvents` boolean parameter to `runAgentOnCommit` and `runTask` in `evals/buffbench`. When enabled, it logs full JSON event objects to console during execution. The flag automatically activates in `runBuffBench` when `agents.length === 1` and `taskConcurrency === 1`.

67a129e78ff23f1108987b7ecab76b855ece1eb8.title: Release scripts use getCurrentVersion for binary check
67a129e78ff23f1108987b7ecab76b855ece1eb8.summary: ensureBinaryExists in npm-app/release/index.js and npm-app/release-staging/index.js now calls getCurrentVersion() to verify binary presence, replacing fs.existsSync(CONFIG.binaryPath). This ensures the script correctly identifies if the binary is already installed by checking the version state rather than just file existence. The change applies to both staging and production release scripts. If getCurrentVersion() returns null, the script proceeds to fetch the latest version and download the binary.

ebabc911ff7d730b13a704d7000adc933733fe35.text: A small internal update improves how the app records technical details. Users will not notice any changes to the product.

863ae4e4ab28922c0bd55b88bcfd83cbfb8366dd.text: The app now hides your access key when looking up your profile, instead of showing it in the web address. This small internal update makes your account data safer.

04f078043e472ed46a37f0ce52855650c50b6d12.text: The app now checks if the tool is working correctly, not just if it is present. This helps catch broken or outdated versions before you use them.

da268f7a70311adfee7f221466856140eb1690ab.text: The assistant now checks all found documents before pausing to gather tool results and compiling its report more efficiently. This small internal update helps it process information more smoothly.

b2d399109dde4b7df51e81c91aded6382dce51b0.text: When running a single task with one assistant, the system now automatically shows detailed activity logs. This helps you see exactly what the assistant is doing step by step.

91faba0ecaf18548df103d35f9a1062550c9dab2.text: A small internal update fixes how the system starts up. Users should see no visible change.

39601f204424035c8ab09718d2709ef44ee326d6.text: A small internal fix corrected a tool that logs errors. You will not see any change in how the product works.

8e3a9854575e435d6ca28b991c3e19c83068237f.text: The release process now correctly downloads required files when a check fails. This change is small and internal.

f192bf22d1dc4e4a4bd1a74db091749aa533612b.text: The system now finds the right folder for its internal records no matter where it starts working. This helps developers see what is happening behind the scenes.

67a129e78ff23f1108987b7ecab76b855ece1eb8.text: The update system now checks the installed version, not just file presence, to ensure the correct software is used. This prevents errors when updating.

cd9f82cf065a6aa4631c6691eb344c1027193acc.title: Fix backend test expectation for agent run ID
cd9f82cf065a6aa4631c6691eb344c1027193acc.summary: Updated `agent-run.test.ts` to expect `runId: 'generated-uuid'` instead of `undefined` in logger error assertions. This aligns the test with actual backend behavior where run IDs are generated even during error states. Scope limited to `backend/src/__tests__/agent-run.test.ts`.

9014b08cfc9f7509d3018a2ab95a755c65b25818.title: fix $$ in str replace
9014b08cfc9f7509d3018a2ab95a755c65b25818.summary: Updated processStrReplace in packages/agent-runtime/src/process-str-replace.ts to pass a function to String.prototype.replaceAll instead of a string. This prevents special replacement patterns like $$ from being interpreted in the replacement string. Scope limited to Agent Runtime string replacement logic.

dd134d4bdeb1bca35a1bd69ba0ff34eed3c4d06f.title: Remove runId parameter from startAgentRun
dd134d4bdeb1bca35a1bd69ba0ff34eed3c4d06f.summary: Removed optional `runId` parameter from `StartAgentRunFn` type and `startAgentRun` implementation. Function now generates `runId` internally via `crypto.randomUUID()` instead of accepting it as input. Affects `backend/src/agent-run.ts`, `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Callers no longer pass `runId` to `startAgentRun`.

22db9d67c293a5aaf0d40117a01d13d25133214a.title: web-server stdoutFile debug/web-bg.log
22db9d67c293a5aaf0d40117a01d13d25133214a.summary: web-server stdoutFile redirected to debug/web-bg.log in codebuff.json. Prevents background process logs from contaminating debug/web.log. Internal config change.

62a4a492c9c72648b7a8f03a76cde3eb858859e8.title: Remove runId parameter from startAgentRun
62a4a492c9c72648b7a8f03a76cde3eb858859e8.summary: Removed optional runId parameter from startAgentRun in backend/src/agent-run.ts. Function now always generates new UUID via crypto.randomUUID(). Prevents duplicate runIds when caller passes existing ID.

221cb2ec11a00626b71169de7fda5ebe803df7dd.title: Remove CLI mock mode and debug logger statements
221cb2ec11a00626b71169de7fda5ebe803df7dd.summary: Removed mock AI response logic and random completion messages from `use-send-message.ts`. Deleted verbose `logger.info` calls in `use-system-theme-detector.ts`. Added new `project-files.ts` module to manage chat directory paths under `debug/chats/`.

f0215f45c927c452ae8d65be68ebea3f046e987b.title: Export getUserInfoFromApiKey from SDK
f0215f45c927c452ae8d65be68ebea3f046e987b.summary: SDK now exports `getUserInfoFromApiKey`. `OpenRouterProviderOptions` type moved from internal package to `common/src/types/agent-template.ts`. `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts` imports updated to use absolute paths.

50d0b36eae531b78dbac9e1e1d976c2a244dbc11.title: Deprecate checkConnection
50d0b36eae531b78dbac9e1e1d976c2a244dbc11.summary: CodebuffClient.checkConnection in sdk/src/client.ts is deprecated. Implementation replaced with static true return, removing WebSocket dependency and timeout logic. Scope limited to SDK client. Method remains callable for backward compatibility.

febe84c89746ba2f420d8468cdbdeec4dcfba12a.title: Web logger writes debug to file on dev
febe84c89746ba2f420d8468cdbdeec4dcfba12a.summary: web/src/util/logger.ts now uses pino/file transport writing to debug/web.log when NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT is dev and CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS is not true. split-data.ts moved to common/src/util/split-data.ts so backend and web share it. Backend logger imports the relocated module from @codebuff/common/util/split-data.

df596975d3847f148250d348fada73ef08f30465.title: CLI adds browser-based login screen
df596975d3847f148250d348fada73ef08f30465.summary: CLI now requires browser-based authentication via new `LoginScreen` component. Users authenticate by visiting generated URL in browser; credentials saved locally via `auth.ts`. New slash commands `/login` and `/logout` manage session state. Covers CLI surface only; SDK exports updated auth utilities.

22db9d67c293a5aaf0d40117a01d13d25133214a.text: Internal logging was adjusted to keep background activity separate from main records. This small change does not affect how you use the product.

cd9f82cf065a6aa4631c6691eb344c1027193acc.text: A small internal update ensures the system correctly records a unique ID for every task, even if it fails. You won't notice any change in how the product works.

221cb2ec11a00626b71169de7fda5ebe803df7dd.text: The app stopped using fake test messages and removed hidden background notes. This makes the assistant's replies more reliable and the app run smoother.

62a4a492c9c72648b7a8f03a76cde3eb858859e8.text: The system now creates a unique tracking number for every new task automatically. This prevents duplicate IDs from causing errors.

febe84c89746ba2f420d8468cdbdeec4dcfba12a.text: The system now saves detailed activity notes to a file when running in test mode. This helps the team track what happens behind the scenes without changing how you use the product.

f0215f45c927c452ae8d65be68ebea3f046e987b.text: The tool now shares account details more easily. This helps the app show your information correctly.

50d0b36eae531b78dbac9e1e1d976c2a244dbc11.text: The app now skips a slow check that used to wait for a network connection. This change happens in the background and makes the app start faster without affecting how you use it.

dd134d4bdeb1bca35a1bd69ba0ff34eed3c4d06f.text: The system now creates its own unique tracking number for each task instead of accepting one from outside. This small internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

9014b08cfc9f7509d3018a2ab95a755c65b25818.text: A small fix ensures that text containing double dollar signs is copied exactly as written, without being changed by mistake.

df596975d3847f148250d348fada73ef08f30465.text: The tool now asks you to sign in through a web browser instead of typing your password directly into the command line. Your login details are saved on your computer, so you don't need to sign in again each time.

dfe2a8c526d9bd4d9c552f4f53292167d5b83d84.title: SDK getAgentRuntimeImpl accepts scoped deps
dfe2a8c526d9bd4d9c552f4f53292167d5b83d84.summary: getAgentRuntimeImpl signature now takes AgentRuntimeScopedDeps directly instead of returning an Omit type. Caller passes handleStepsLogChunk, requestToolCall, and other client functions into the factory. Return type resolves to full AgentRuntimeDeps & AgentRuntimeScopedDeps. Internal SDK refactor; no behavior change.

2ca6706ab6330e4ebaecf35747ed3d221958a605.title: Fix malformed-tool-call test mock
2ca6706ab6330e4ebaecf35747ed3d221958a605.summary: Added requestFiles mock to processStreamWithTools in malformed-tool-call.test.ts. Prevents test failures by providing file content during stream processing. Scope limited to agent-runtime test suite. Mock returns `${path} content` for each filePath.

94d7e9c2ea70bdb2d63fd6f92ec1edd9e148cce3.title: Add self-validation step to gpt-5-worker prompt
94d7e9c2ea70bdb2d63fd6f92ec1edd9e148cce3.summary: Updated the `base2-gpt-5-worker` agent prompt in `.agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-worker.ts` to include an explicit step for running validation commands (typechecks, tests, lints) before completion. This change ensures the worker agent actively verifies its own edits rather than relying solely on the parent agent for review. The scope is limited to the internal agent definition file.

b28837b59c4e660e1f3643c81e0d0336ccbddaf4.title: Reorganize base2 agent definitions into subdirectories
b28837b59c4e660e1f3643c81e0d0336ccbddaf4.summary: Moved base2 agent variants into specific subdirectories (alloy, task-researcher, orchestrator) and deleted unused files like base2-with-task-researcher-full.ts. Updated import paths in .agents/base2/base2-gpt-5.ts and related files to reflect the new structure. This internal refactor cleans up the agent definition hierarchy without changing runtime behavior.

35d1dfbbbc290eecaf7a83ff6eade453eaf04825.title: Move callMainPrompt to agent-runtime
35d1dfbbbc290eecaf7a83ff6eade453eaf04825.summary: Relocated callMainPrompt from backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts to packages/agent-runtime/src/main-prompt.ts. Updated imports in websocket-action.ts to pull callMainPrompt from @codebuff/agent-runtime/main-prompt. Refactored mainPrompt to function declaration in agent-runtime to accommodate the move.

e323769925c2d3bf9766a629afcec59219b54378.title: Add Buffy orchestrator and file researcher agents
e323769925c2d3bf9766a629afcec59219b54378.summary: New internal agents added under .agents/base2 and .agents/researcher. base2-with-file-researcher.ts defines 'Buffy the Orchestrator' using base2/fast, spawning file-researcher and context-pruner. file-researcher.ts implements a Sonnet 4.5 agent that generates structured reports and file lists via specialized sub-agents like file-picker-max and code-searcher.

a25fb6d74829e92aca5c6f1c6715d0495dd6ae8d.title: base2 drops normal mode and validator agents
a25fb6d74829e92aca5c6f1c6715d0495dd6ae8d.summary: base2 agents now use 'fast' mode exclusively, removing 'normal' and 'max' variants. Deleted files include base2-gpt-5-planner, base2-hybrid-max, and base2-max-simple. The base2-gpt-5-worker no longer spawns code-reviewer-gpt-5 or validator-gpt-5, simplifying orchestration to file-picker and code-searcher only. Eval harness in evals/buffbench/main.ts updated to reflect these agent definition changes.

02faa42bd585e2ed567dd8cdb7a1f761febfc97c.title: Add runId to agent runtime and SDK contracts
02faa42bd585e2ed567dd8cdb7a1f761febfc97c.summary: Propagate `runId` through `PromptAiSdkFn`, `PromptAiSdkStreamFn`, and `runAgentStep` in `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime`. This links LLM calls and tool executions to specific agent runs for better tracing. Updates affect CLI hooks, evals scaffolding, and SDK dependencies.

92fa5b6572b619e73ecb6997537100f031e0825b.title: Add base2 fast thinking agent variants for evals
92fa5b6572b619e73ecb6997537100f031e0825b.summary: Adds five experimental base2 fast-thinking agent definitions (base2-fast-thinking, base2-fast-thinking-tool, base2-fast-thinking-tags, base2-fast-thinker, base2-fast-thinker-gpt-5) plus a new thinker-gpt-5 agent to compare thinking mechanisms. These are temporary scaffolding for buffbench eval runs, not shipped user-facing agents. The eval harness in evals/buffbench/main.ts switches from base2-max variants to base2-fast-thinker and base2-fast-thinker-gpt-5, dropping taskConcurrency from 10 to 2. base2.ts gains a guardrail instructing the orchestrator to stay silent after declaring completion.

e323769925c2d3bf9766a629afcec59219b54378.text: The assistant now uses a team of specialized helpers to find and summarize information from files.

94d7e9c2ea70bdb2d63fd6f92ec1edd9e148cce3.text: The internal AI assistant now checks its own work for errors before finishing a task. This small update helps it catch mistakes earlier, so it relies less on other systems to fix them.

dfe2a8c526d9bd4d9c552f4f53292167d5b83d84.text: Internal cleanup only. No visible change.

35d1dfbbbc290eecaf7a83ff6eade453eaf04825.text: A small internal cleanup moved a core assistant feature to a better spot. No visible changes for you.

b28837b59c4e660e1f3643c81e0d0336ccbddaf4.text: The team reorganized the assistant's internal instructions into clearer folders. This cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

2ca6706ab6330e4ebaecf35747ed3d221958a605.text: A small internal test update ensures the assistant's file-reading feature works reliably during checks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

613b7683e2d1d5a4ffa457355563761d66454b7f.title: Align agent mode toggle with status indicator in CLI
613b7683e2d1d5a4ffa457355563761d66454b7f.summary: Refactored `cli/src/chat.tsx` to wrap `StatusIndicator` and `AgentModeToggle` in a flexbox row, ensuring horizontal alignment. Updated `cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx` to use `alignItems: 'center'` instead of `alignSelf: 'flex-end'`. This change affects only the CLI interface layout.

312368db22c6b26de3ad9023b9ff601564d80b30.title: dev.sh builds SDK before starting client
312368db22c6b26de3ad9023b9ff601564d80b30.summary: scripts/dev.sh now runs bun --cwd=sdk run build after server readiness. SDK build failure terminates server and exits. Ensures client starts with updated SDK.

d0535c94ae0e5e1e820ae1aff529067b1a7a92e9.title: Tweak base2 agent prompts
d0535c94ae0e5e1e820ae1aff529067b1a7a92e9.summary: Updated .agents/base2/base2.ts to refine Minimal Changes guidance, mandate code_search for refactoring, and require running unit tests. Added ${PLACEHOLDER.SYSTEM_INFO_PROMPT} to the prompt template. Internal prompt engineering only, no user-facing API or behavior changes.

28722d9f64c04e01d170aefb574e9b5ceab32421.title: Revert ripgrep path logic in npm-app/src/native/ripgrep.ts
28722d9f64c04e01d170aefb574e9b5ceab32421.summary: Reverts brandon's change to `npm-app/src/native/ripgrep.ts`, restoring `@vscode/ripgrep` import and self-extraction logic to fix `code_search`. Dev mode uses `vscodeRgPath`; compiled mode extracts embedded binary to `CONFIG_DIR` or falls back to `vscodeRgPath`. Affects only `npm-app/src/native/ripgrep.ts`.

d6c73a45f0f58cc069d025a1b9cc969314630631.title: Update tool-handlers.test.ts
d6c73a45f0f58cc069d025a1b9cc969314630631.summary: Test assertion in `tool-handlers.test.ts` now uses `toHaveProperty` instead of `toContainKey`. This aligns with standard Jest matchers for checking object properties.

70087f680e5ae0cfbc648ba2f02fe8a9b9a0e81d.title: Fix base2 agent ID and stepPrompt logic
70087f680e5ae0cfbc648ba2f02fe8a9b9a0e81d.summary: Corrected `id` to `base2-gpt-5-worker-simple` in `.agents/base2/base2-gpt-5-worker-simple.ts` to match filename. Updated `stepPrompt` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to conditionally inject `generate-plan` for normal mode or `base2-gpt-5-worker` for max mode, replacing previous boolean logic. Scope limited to internal agent configuration files. Change ensures proper agent spawning based on execution mode.

cc27f91eeec33217f8e98e84c0868ba74c7bb117.title: Add base2 agent variants and update buffbench eval config
