Analysis executes regardless of agent count, removing previous commitTraces.length > 1 guard.

8b710f3cd6cbf7024b4e0781198404c3a95f93a7.title: Add buffbench score analysis script and task-numbered logs
8b710f3cd6cbf7024b4e0781198404c3a95f93a7.summary: Added scripts/analyze-buffbench-logs.ts to aggregate and print score tables from buffbench ANALYSIS logs. Modified evals/buffbench/run-buffbench.ts to prepend task index to trace and analysis filenames for easier sorting. Updated evals/buffbench/main.ts to use base2-simple agent, increase commitConcurrency to 20, and force exit.

7388861f69050bddc593202405e8ce9511db8f46.title: base2 prompt tweaks
7388861f69050bddc593202405e8ce9511db8f46.summary: Updated `.agents/base2/base2.ts` prompt guidelines. Clarified reviewer spawning rules for trivial vs. most changes. Added explicit instruction to avoid creating unrequested summary markdown files.

dbd41483a1cb5275b405801867e403d3f8617a4b.title: buffbench: refactor runTask, delete onProgress
dbd41483a1cb5275b405801867e403d3f8617a4b.summary: Extracted runTask into a standalone async function in `evals/buffbench/run-buffbench.ts` to modularize agent execution and trace handling. Removed `onProgress` callback support from `evals/buffbench/main.ts` and deleted the `ProgressEvent` type from `evals/buffbench/types.ts`. This simplifies the evaluation runner interface by handling progress logging internally within the task loop rather than via external callbacks.

51ee39cebee852bb151c0db4fa85f547bcfd3dbd.title: Add 10-minute timeouts to buffbench judge and trace analyzer
51ee39cebee852bb151c0db4fa85f547bcfd3dbd.summary: Wraps `client.run` calls in `withTimeout` (10m limit) within `evals/buffbench/judge.ts` and `evals/buffbench/trace-analyzer.ts`. Prevents indefinite hangs during eval execution. Minor cleanup in `run-buffbench.ts` removes verbose prompt logging.

5256ed43f35086dd245541f379056b01f9478c9c.title: Add generate-plan agent to base2 orchestration
5256ed43f35086dd245541f379056b01f9478c9c.summary: New `generate-plan` agent added to `.agents/planners/` and integrated into `base2` orchestration, replacing `decomposing-thinker`, `independent-thinker`, `code-sketcher`, and `editor`. `base2.ts` now spawns `generate-plan` for planning, simplifying the agent layer structure. `generate-plan` uses `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` to generate 5 alternative plans, analyze them, and select the simplest optimal plan via `set_output`.

a99f06f816ff8cc9b9d1ebbf4b58bcaee3acb8c2.title: Add base2-simple orchestrator agent
a99f06f816ff8cc9b9d1ebbf4b58bcaee3acb8c2.summary: New `base2-simple` agent definition added to `.agents/base2/`. Configures a 'Buffy the Simple Orchestrator' with specific spawnable agents (file-picker, researcher-web, etc.) and detailed layer-based orchestration instructions. Internal repo change only; no user-facing CLI or Web surface updates.

7627eca0d19fc59601017560f61194990dbc4589.title: Refactor agent output and message utils
7627eca0d19fc59601017560f61194990dbc4589.summary: Moved `getAgentOutput` and `buildUserMessageContent` from `run-agent-step.ts` to dedicated utility files `util/agent-output.ts` and `util/messages.ts`. 2309aac671735329bfa6b89c0341ea02472b0a6f.text: The team moved old, unused assistant tools to a hidden folder to keep things tidy. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

a99f06f816ff8cc9b9d1ebbf4b58bcaee3acb8c2.text: The product's internal helpers learned new ways to organize tasks. You will not see any changes.

dbd41483a1cb5275b405801867e403d3f8617a4b.text: The system's internal task handling was cleaned up to be simpler. This is a small behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how you use the product.

4bc5155e0063793c6285961c97b6583514497964.summary: New `.agents/independent-thinker.ts` defines a stateless analysis agent using `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`. It ignores message history and parent system prompts to prevent context pollution, accepting `filePaths` for direct reading. Registered in `base2.ts` to handle key self-contained decisions, while `decomposing-thinker` retains planning and context-gap checks.

99906af10509737faeed2d75388679a15d2c7c25.title: Exclude commits with agent errors from BuffBench scores
99906af10509737faeed2d75388679a15d2c7c25.summary: run-buffbench.ts now tracks commit SHAs with agent errors via `commitShasWithErrors` and excludes all runs from those commits when calculating average score, cost, and duration. Previously, only individual failed runs were filtered, potentially skewing metrics if one agent errored on a commit while others succeeded. The change ensures consistent comparison across agents by removing entire problematic commits from the evaluation set. Console output now notes the number of excluded commits.

4a8388e720a5aab236ea104da1c5d3642d549967.title: Overhaul base2 agent with editing tools and commander subagent
4a8388e720a5aab236ea104da1c5d3642d549967.summary: Updated `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to grant `base2` direct file editing capabilities by adding `str_replace` and `write_file` to `toolNames`. The `read-only-commander` spawnable agent was replaced by the full `commander` agent. Prompt logic was refined to allow `base2` to handle trivial edits directly, reducing reliance on spawning editor subagents for minor changes.

69a0b7ae249180d897533ae2f416980656ccff2a.title: Refine agent prompts for conciseness and remove file-q-and-a
69a0b7ae249180d897533ae2f416980656ccff2a.summary: Updated system and instruction prompts in `base2`, `code-sketcher`, and `file-picker` to enforce stricter output conciseness, removing final summaries and redundant formatting. `base2` now explicitly suppresses final summaries. `code-sketcher` instructions tightened to prevent sketching obvious code or duplicating helpers. `file-picker` switched to `FILE_TREE_PROMPT_SMALL` and removed `stepPrompt`. `find-all-referencer` dropped `file-q-and-a` from spawnable agents.

3d4f0d2ab93aede0e51defcef464ee8187d4c6ef.title: BuffBench2 eval harness added
3d4f0d2ab93aede0e51defcef464ee8187d4c6ef.summary: New BuffBench2 evaluation suite introduced via `evals/buffbench/` directory. `agent-runner.ts` executes agents on commits using `CodebuffClient` with 10-minute timeouts, capturing diffs, context files, costs, and step traces. JSON eval datasets (`eval-codebuff.json`, etc.) define specific tasks with SHAs and prompts for repo-based testing. `judge.ts` and `main.ts` orchestrate scoring and execution, expanding internal benchmarking capabilities.

93097f1e61a2863e3183b06ae6d31216525f06af.text: The team improved how internal test results are organized. This change does not affect how you use the product.

dfdff4a5cdc010df91f37eab8ade3a149e2ebf69.text: The assistant now uses a faster background tool to find related information. This change is internal and will not affect how you use the product.

69a0b7ae249180d897533ae2f416980656ccff2a.text: The assistant now gives shorter, cleaner answers by removing extra summaries and repeating obvious information. It also stopped using a tool that answered questions about specific files.

4a8388e720a5aab236ea104da1c5d3642d549967.text: The assistant can now edit files directly and handle small changes itself. This means it works faster and needs less help from other parts of the system.

4bc5155e0063793c6285961c97b6583514497964.text: The assistant can now use a fresh perspective for key decisions, ignoring previous conversation details to avoid confusion.

3d4f0d2ab93aede0e51defcef464ee8187d4c6ef.text: A new internal testing system was added to check how well the assistant handles code tasks. This helps the team find and fix problems before you see them.

6b54ac8762e57a9126f82da296f32f915811881b.text: The system now waits longer before stopping a test task, allowing more time for complex evaluations to finish. This is a small internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

3156f34a98e5308f0114d9f0631e98869a47be08.text: The assistant now uses one worker for standard tasks instead of multiple workers. This change helps save resources and makes the results more consistent.

99906af10509737faeed2d75388679a15d2c7c25.text: The internal scoring tool now ignores entire test batches if any part of them fails, rather than just skipping the single failed attempt. This change prevents broken tests from distorting the overall performance numbers.

515e690859b785cedf397c92dec1b3ef8f96b469.title: Strip prompt param before AI SDK calls
515e690859b785cedf397c92dec1b3ef8f96b469.summary: Added `prompt: undefined` to `streamText`, `generateText`, and `generateObject` calls in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. This prevents the `prompt` field from spreading into the AI SDK request when `messages` are explicitly provided via `convertCbToModelMessages`. Scope limited to the Vercel AI SDK backend adapter. Ensures clean parameter passing for structured and streaming outputs.

f60fc2ea7ee741c955bd4289097839e2535594f9.title: Add file tree to file-picker and find-all-referencer system prompts
f60fc2ea7ee741c955bd4289097839e2535594f9.summary: Injects PLACEHOLDER.FILE_TREE_PROMPT into the systemPrompt for file-picker and find-all-referencer agents. Updates import paths in find-all-referencer to use relative imports for agent-definition types. Scope limited to .agents/file-explorer/ internal agent definitions. Ensures these exploration agents receive the repository file tree structure in their initial context.

36e8766564f6d51a15cc9158805e0a3833b763ba.title: Commander agent added
36e8766564f6d51a15cc9158805e0a3833b763ba.summary: New `.agents/commander.ts` defines a `commander` agent using `x-ai/grok-4-fast` to execute terminal commands via `run_terminal_command`. The agent yields the command execution step then passes output to the model for concise analysis based on specific extraction prompts. Scope is limited to the internal agent definitions directory.

2b0526c64d26b503d63b0d81c90dde22a7d0d5cd.title: Replace checkAuthToken with getUserInfoFromApiKey
2b0526c64d26b503d63b0d81c90dde22a7d0d5cd.summary: Internal auth refactor replaces legacy `checkAuthToken` with `getUserInfoFromApiKey` in `backend/src/util/check-auth.ts`, `backend/src/api/usage.ts`, `web/src/app/api/agents/publish/route.ts`, and `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts`. Removes session-token DB joins in `packages/internal/src/utils/auth.ts` in favor of API-key lookups. Updates `packages/internal/src/knowledge.md` to drop deprecated auth utilities documentation. `checkAuth` signature changes to require `getUserInfoFromApiKey` dependency injection instead of `fingerprintId`.

78bed8cfae272b337de52963663a166f825d2a99.title: Multi-agent comparison for git evals
78bed8cfae272b337de52963663a166f825d2a99.summary: Added `run-eval-set-multi-agent.ts` to support parallel execution of multiple agents on the same eval tasks. The `run-eval-set` CLI now accepts a comma-separated `--agents` flag (e.g., `--agents base,base-lite,base2`) to trigger comparison mode, generating side-by-side metrics and comparison tables. This change affects the evals subsystem, specifically `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` and new types in `evals/git-evals/types.ts`.

2a6146f7c62ae4e182807a21b0a9dd6f313391e5.title: Remove stray eval result file
2a6146f7c62ae4e182807a21b0a9dd6f313391e5.summary: Deleted `evals/git-evals/eval-result-codebuff-yyzy-SZKdI4.json` from the repository. This 65k-line artifact contained test specs and mock data for spawn-agent message history filtering, previously committed by mistake. Scope limited to the `evals` directory; no source code or configuration changes.

65f9aa9f03bbb005d5fb047b0f9bdf6bb11a1c46.title: Fix promptWithAgent logic in git-evals
65f9aa9f03bbb005d5fb047b0f9bdf6bb11a1c46.summary: Corrected inverted boolean logic for `promptWithAgent` in `runSingleEval` within `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`. The condition previously evaluated truthiness directly; it now negates the flag to determine if the spec serves as the sole prompt. This ensures the fallback decision object triggers only when prompting is disabled.

67c2289b9b2c7a81323c5588bdb982e51dbc6f74.summary: Reverts the switch to getUserInfoFromApiKey, restoring checkAuthToken in backend/src/util/check-auth.ts and packages/internal/src/utils/auth.ts. 44ff08f94837913788bdac3a7414ac375e27cc19.summary: Corrected inverted logic for `promptWithAgent` in `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`, ensuring proper `MAX_ATTEMPTS` and agent response handling. Added `fetchAgentFromDatabase` to `BACKEND_AGENT_RUNTIME_IMPL` in `backend/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, enabling direct DB access within the agent runtime. 3ebeb7baef55f82c346cf32508625f20ef2cd012.title: Editor agent preserves preexisting comments
3ebeb7baef55f82c346cf32508625f20ef2cd012.summary: The `editor` agent definition in `.agents/editor/editor.ts` updates the 'No code comments' rule. a28a7ed3c7d8a2c540f9e6ff28b28e98b721b1de.summary: Removed `promptAiSdkStream` from `AgentRuntimeDeps` interface and implementations. `backend/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts` and `common/src/types/contracts/agent-runtime.ts` no longer export or require the LLM stream function. `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts` now imports `promptAiSdkStream` directly from `./llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk`. 7749099ba5a987c262d8317c33e33939f501e333.title: Refactor reviewer factory into reviewer.ts

95b4d8e4868428e74c708595676fb1544ea43d4c.title: Add base2-max and inline-file-explorer-max agent definitions
95b4d8e4868428e74c708595676fb1544ea43d4c.summary: New .agents/base2/base2-max.ts and .agents/file-explorer/inline-file-explorer-max.ts define specialized agent variants. base2.ts refactored to export createBase2(mode) factory, conditionally including inline-file-explorer-max in spawnableAgents when mode is 'max'. toolNames updated to include 'spawn_agent_inline'. backend spawn-agent-inline.ts re-enables writeToClient streaming for inline agents, excluding context-pruner.

de251aa9733c0427d81579d1aa9ee04acce9304a.title: Migrate evals to shallow git clones and add parentSha
de251aa9733c0427d81579d1aa9ee04acce9304a.summary: Eval harness switched to shallow git clones. `parentSha` recorded per task. Files `evals/git-evals/*.json`, `gen-evals.ts`, `run-git-evals.ts`. Reduces clone size and enables precise commit tracking.

e916b204abcabef027daf603065aa045f2add423.title: Rename WithDefaults to OptionalFields
e916b204abcabef027daf603065aa045f2add423.summary: Type alias `WithDefaults` renamed to `OptionalFields` across codebase. 52c8877220a91be43ee357fbfa420cfb20765347.title: Add thinker-lite agent and refine base-lite prompts

158a49890e2f6532c71feb1445a498c21b770821.summary: Internal refactor converts `parseRawToolCall`, `parseRawCustomToolCall`, and `getUserIdFromAuthToken` to accept object parameters instead of positional arguments. 5ec7760aec07feedd81c1296a32f2760a13e21ee.title: pruneFileTokenScores accepts options object
5ec7760aec07feedd81c1296a32f2760a13e21ee.summary: Refactor pruneFileTokenScores in backend/src/system-prompt/truncate-file-tree.ts to accept a single options object instead of positional arguments. 89cd2ae0fdc87ae9405cec900b24dc2dfb6f7a6e.summary: Refactors requestFiles, requestFile, and requestOptionalFile in websocket-action.ts to accept a single object parameter instead of positional arguments. 5f2e6db28676912a32f1cbdb3b2147d72ab5f821.title: Refactor backend util functions to object parameters

Callers now pass structured objects, e.g., `webSocketListen({ server, path: '/ws' })` and `splitData({ data, maxChunkSize })`.

069bd89609abf0a0dd255c3a276e6d43c1be35be.summary: Refactors processStrReplace, tryMatchOldStr, and tryToDoStringReplacementWithExtraIndentation to accept a single options object instead of positional arguments. This simplifies parameter passing and reduces coupling in the string replacement logic. Updated backend/src/process-str-replace.ts, backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts, and backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/str-replace.ts. Tests in backend/src/__tests__/process-str-replace.test.ts adjusted to match new signatures.

b5e2063a7451f1efd8da4d3f4956837e76afecb4.title: Refactor messagesWithSystem and sandbox methods to object parameters
b5e2063a7451f1efd8da4d3f4956837e76afecb4.summary: Converted messagesWithSystem, SandboxManager methods, and getUserIdFromAuthToken to accept object parameters instead of positional arguments. This change improves readability and maintainability in backend/src/util/messages.ts, backend/src/util/quickjs-sandbox.ts, and backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. Call sites in run-agent-step.ts, run-programmatic-step.ts, and admin scripts were updated to match the new signatures.

12b006755ed2d0302f7a2eebb00d688365a72b6b.summary: Removed console.log and console.dir debug statements from promptAiSdkStream in backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts. Eliminates verbose message dump output during streaming requests.

5a38f199b9be3dcbc326ad8521a3c6593caba355.title: context-pruner adds keepLastTags message retention
5a38f199b9be3dcbc326ad8521a3c6593caba355.summary: `.agents/context-pruner.ts` now honors a `keepLastTags` field on messages during truncation. The pruner builds a map of tag-to-index pairs from the message list and includes those indices in the keep set alongside `keepDuringTruncation`. This prevents specific tagged messages from being dropped when context length limits are hit.

3d73b9cbc895bfda6a7d9324ba27c8feca06db19.title: Refactor agent validation to accept logger
3d73b9cbc895bfda6a7d9324ba27c8feca06db19.summary: Agent validation functions (`validateAgents`, `collectAgentIds`, `validateSpawnableAgents`) now require a `logger` instance via a unified params object. This replaces implicit global logger imports, enabling dependency injection and testability. Updates propagate to `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts` and web API routes (`publish`, `validate`). New `ParamsOf` utility type added in `packages/types/src/common.ts`.

6a4036520e06e3da559471abb5b2e294798a0b9f.title: Refactor processFileBlock to single-object parameter
6a4036520e06e3da559471abb5b2e294798a0b9f.summary: processFileBlock and handleLargeFile signatures changed from positional arguments to a single object parameter in backend/src/process-file-block.ts. write-file.ts updated to pass an object instead of 12 positional args. This improves maintainability and testability by aligning with standard TypeScript patterns and simplifying argument ordering.

47a0d40b9643b70970b4581223a0bbdfb12dd9ca.title: BigQuery client functions accept explicit logger parameter
47a0d40b9643b70970b4581223a0bbdfb12dd9ca.summary: setupBigQuery, insertTrace, insertRelabel, and insertMessage now require a logger instance via destructured object arguments instead of importing a global logger. Callers in backend/src, scripts/ft-file-selection, and packages/bigquery/src/client.ts updated to pass the active logger. packages/bigquery/package.json adds @codebuff/types as a dependency for the Logger type.

952171c71f33ea4a41b59e5376e77f6512c2b072.title: logSyncFailure signature change to object param with logger
952171c71f33ea4a41b59e5376e77f6512c2b072.summary: Refactored logSyncFailure in common/src/util/sync-failure.ts to accept a single object parameter including a logger instance instead of positional arguments. Callers in backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts, packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts, and web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts updated to pass logger. Removes direct logger import from sync-failure module, enforcing dependency injection for logging.

198f32883998ecad95f2cd1f2b48c1a946cb0a1c.title: Switch file-picker to grok 4 fast
198f32883998ecad95f2cd1f2b48c1a946cb0a1c.summary: The file-picker agent now uses `x-ai/grok-4-fast` instead of `google/gemini-2.5-flash`. Persona details are hardcoded in `.agents/factory/file-picker.ts` rather than pulled from `AGENT_PERSONAS`. Scope limited to internal agent definitions in `.agents`.

13355c40a4d053d8e7aa3b8743ae336090f1c146.title: Update thinker and reviewer to prompt-cached Sonnet
13355c40a4d053d8e7aa3b8743ae336090f1c146.summary: The `thinker` and `reviewer` agents now use `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`, replacing `openai/gpt-5` and `google/gemini-2.5-pro` respectively. The `thinker-sonnet` definition was deleted and its functionality merged into the main `thinker` agent, while `decomposing-thinker` now spawns `thinker` agents instead. The `reviewer-factory` hardcodes the display name and spawner prompt, removing the dependency on `AGENT_PERSONAS`. Additionally, the step prompt wrapper in `backend/src/templates/strings.ts` changed from `<system-reminder>` to `<system_reminder>`.

68a3f2c895aad299cde3281a6688f1be3b41fc40.title: Add keepLastTags to message schema
68a3f2c895aad299cde3281a6688f1be3b41fc40.summary: Added keepLastTags field to auxiliaryDataSchema in util-types.ts and codebuff-message.ts. Refactored messageSchema to remove redundant top-level fields now handled by auxiliary data. Updated run-agent-step.ts to use keepLastTags for instructions prompt retention.

13a76403d6b83c8600db071cda3dee64c51e60e3.summary: initAnalytics signature updated to accept { logger: Logger } instead of importing global logger. b7bd85e82100a51416ecde0268444baa4691117c.summary: Refactored `trackEvent` in `common/src/analytics.ts` to accept a single object argument including a `logger` instance. Updated all call sites in backend (`message-cost-tracker`, `run-agent-step`, `xml-stream-parser`, `websocket-action`) and packages (`billing`) to pass the logger explicitly. `initializeServer` in `web` now requires a logger parameter to propagate this dependency to `initAnalytics`.

153fcfae637fec18f12587de88627705769fe527.title: Remove unused analytics and API key crypto code
153fcfae637fec18f12587de88627705769fe527.summary: Deleted `logError` from `common/src/analytics.ts` and removed `common/src/api-keys/crypto.ts` entirely. Updated `common/knowledge.md` to drop references to the deprecated encryption utilities. 0d7b7f07109f706992af0ec4989624acd875abbb.summary: Created @codebuff/types package to centralize Logger and database types, moving them from @codebuff/agent-runtime. f8017a94cd31a89100b907afc062172182092d46.summary: Moved terminal command detection in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to occur after agent template resolution. 66e97bde849140e394973d4a3c84be96b356fdd1.title: Remove unused liveUserInputs.endUserInput spy
66e97bde849140e394973d4a3c84be96b356fdd1.summary: Removes `liveUserInputs.endUserInput` spy mocks from `read-docs-tool.test.ts` and `run-agent-step-tools.test.ts`. The `endUserInput` method is no longer invoked in these test scenarios. Scope limited to backend test files.

9764dc2abf2f1c22c7c57dc7d229f55a383f77f4.title: Add eval planner latency tracking
9764dc2abf2f1c22c7c57dc7d229f55a383f77f4.summary: Eval planner now tracks and reports latency metrics. Implementation wraps `withTestRepo` calls in `evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts` with `Date.now()` timestamps, propagating `plannerLatencyMs` through agent output, JSON results, and console stats (avg/min/max/median). SDK `handleToolCall` error path in `sdk/src/run.ts` fixed to mutate `result` variable instead of returning early, ensuring consistent output structure.

fb9fee641c9ea126a149f3a94e369c1f3e03ee12.title: Add decomposing thinker agent to base2 workflow
fb9fee641c9ea126a149f3a94e369c1f3e03ee12.summary: Introduced `decomposing-thinker` and `thinker-sonnet` agents to the base2 coding workflow. `base2.ts` now spawns a thinker for insights before the planner, expanding the toolset with `code_search`. 38e35954d3606b75dd0a2460108788b7ecabe66a.summary: SDK and npm-app stop enforcing PromptResponseSchema on incoming actions. 5895866dcf2c8c8464e3c2ec0571b87aeb021069.summary: Deleted asyncAgentManager mocks and related test cases in `backend/src/__tests__/loop-agent-steps.test.ts`. Removed specific test for async agent message handling during `runLoopAgentSteps`. Adjusted formatting for remaining test calls.

7ec84dff520dcaf25b9420a1ef1b38101a944510.summary: Moved thinker agent definitions from .agents/deep-thinking and .agents/factory into .agents/thinker. Updated deep-thinker.ts, deepest-thinker.ts, gemini-thinker.ts, gpt5-thinker.ts, and sonnet-thinker.ts paths. 7b7a1af5be96f149c61ee71628ff4a0c01d5d0fb.summary: Removed spawn_agents_async tool definition, handler, and associated AsyncAgentManager infrastructure. Deleted superagent factory and async registration logic from run-agent-step.ts. Updates affect backend tool lists, websocket handlers, and common constants to eliminate asynchronous agent spawning support.

a6058752987bb07978ccd18e942524d85bc701d7.text: The assistant now always handles user inputs in the background, removing a setting that used to control this. You might notice faster responses when you type while it is working.

5895866dcf2c8c8464e3c2ec0571b87aeb021069.text: Small internal cleanup. Product works same.

9764dc2abf2f1c22c7c57dc7d229f55a383f77f4.text: The system now measures how long it takes to plan tasks. This helps track performance without changing how you use the product.

fb9fee641c9ea126a149f3a94e369c1f3e03ee12.text: The system now checks its own reasoning before making a plan, using a new search tool to help it understand code better. It also stopped a read-only helper from creating other helpers, keeping its access limited.

f8017a94cd31a89100b907afc062172182092d46.text: The assistant now checks if it has permission to run terminal commands before trying to do so. This internal fix ensures the system behaves correctly when the feature is not available.

38e35954d3606b75dd0a2460108788b7ecabe66a.text: The system now accepts responses from the assistant without checking every detail for perfect structure. This prevents minor formatting errors from stopping your work.

7b7a1af5be96f149c61ee71628ff4a0c01d5d0fb.text: The app removed a feature that let it run background tasks. This change does not affect normal use.

7ec84dff520dcaf25b9420a1ef1b38101a944510.text: Internal cleanup of the AI thinking logic. No visible change to the product.

376a6019fc55ccaa85aac05f63eaa0f4032fca8f.text: The program's internal instructions were reorganized for clarity. This change does not affect how you use the product.

66e97bde849140e394973d4a3c84be96b356fdd1.text: Developers removed an unused internal test tool. This small change does not affect the product's features or performance.

b1322a27219753741094521f50351f80ffaf26d4.title: Full tool list for inherited system prompt agents
b1322a27219753741094521f50351f80ffaf26d4.summary: Refactored backend/src/tools/prompts.ts to export fullToolList function, generating complete tool descriptions. backend/src/templates/strings.ts now conditionally uses fullToolList instead of getShortToolInstructions when agentTemplate.inheritParentSystemPrompt is true. Ensures spawned agents with inherited prompts receive full tool context. Internal backend logic change affecting agent prompt construction.

b6c95d4a2eef95f808a7381fd427ec33b659199b.title: Add debug logs to batch-str-replace
b6c95d4a2eef95f808a7381fd427ec33b659199b.summary: Added debug logging to `executeBatchStrReplaces` and `applyBenchifyIfNeeded` in `backend/src/tools/batch-str-replace.ts`. Logs track deferred replacement counts, path grouping, operation completion, and intended change details to aid debugging. No functional changes or user-facing behavior modifications.

7a7299fde3edbc83b67c25d47b495b78ee484c2e.title: Add ROADMAP.md
7a7299fde3edbc83b67c25d47b495b78ee484c2e.summary: New ROADMAP.md file added to the repository root. Documents current internal engineering priorities: rebuilding npm-app with TUI/SDK, moving backend logic to SDK, and developing base2 agent. Includes a note on daily plan re-evaluation.

6a49a1ac1aa1fa5e56d7f549eb1b3e0553078042.title: Keep user prompt messages after response in agent loop
6a49a1ac1aa1fa5e56d7f549eb1b3e0553078042.summary: Default for clearUserPromptMessagesAfterResponse flipped from true to false in run-agent-step.ts and spawn-agent-utils.ts. Prevents premature expiration of user messages during agent execution. main-prompt.ts now explicitly passes false when constructing agent state. Affects backend agent loop and subagent execution paths.

7e284d81d1d067d34d46f3f87f6e0319a308bde8.title: Add debug log to applyBenchifyIfNeeded
7e284d81d1d067d34d46f3f87f6e0319a308bde8.summary: Added `logger.debug` call to `applyBenchifyIfNeeded` in `backend/src/tools/batch-str-replace.ts`. Logs `options` and `batchContext` before applying Benchify results. Internal change only.

de87bfd624714d75f05b3903d4119e0a47f2008c.title: Clarify spawnable agents list
de87bfd624714d75f05b3903d4119e0a47f2008c.summary: Updated agent spawn prompts to explicitly restrict spawnable agents to the listed types. `backend/src/templates/prompts.ts` now states that only the listed agents are available, ignoring prior references. `.agents/base2/base2.ts` workflow step updated to spawn specific researcher types in parallel.

0f16ef8d751786f93fd8efbdc252d3afde5a67d0.title: batch-str-replace reads local files
0f16ef8d751786f93fd8efbdc252d3afde5a67d0.summary: backend/src/tools/batch-str-replace.ts now uses requestFiles to fetch local file contents instead of relying on client-side fileContext. BatchContext maps for editedFiles and intendedChanges converted to Records. Removed unused file import and excessive debug logging.

4f0db7c081c48ff869f6d667e35586338b5834f1.title: Add debug logs to batch-str-replace Benchify flow
4f0db7c081c48ff869f6d667e35586338b5834f1.summary: Added three `logger.debug` calls in `backend/src/tools/batch-str-replace.ts` to trace the Benchify application pipeline. Logs capture `batchContext` state, `filteredChanges`, and `benchifyResult` at entry, pre-call, and post-response stages. Internal change; no user-facing behavior or API surface modified.

2fd2162227a4d7519fa36e6b74cd6aa08e2a6942.title: OpenRouter wrapper integration with schema updates for reasoning
2fd2162227a4d7519fa36e6b74cd6aa08e2a6942.summary: Added OpenRouter API wrapper implementation and updated database schema to support reasoning tokens and agent IDs. Migration `0030_closed_union_jack.sql` modifies the `message` table by making `client_id`, `client_request_id`, and `request` nullable, dropping defaults for `cache_creation_input_tokens`, and adding `agent_id`, `reasoning_text`, and `reasoning_tokens` columns. New files include `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts` for the API client, `scripts/fat-sdk-openrouter-example.ts` for usage examples, and updated types in `web/src/llm-api/type/openrouter.ts`. The changes span core database migrations, web API routes, and shared type definitions to enable OpenRouter model access with extended metadata tracking.

a57d231d62f6756512255fb072978e000f8a5f30.title: Benchify integration and batch strreplace
a57d231d62f6756512255fb072978e000f8a5f30.summary: Added `benchify` dependency and `BENCHIFY_API_KEY` to enable AI-assisted code transformations. Implemented `batch-str-replace.ts` to defer and batch `str_replace` tool calls using a two-phase execution strategy in `stream-parser.ts`, improving handling of multiple edits. Updated `process-str-replace.ts` to strictly track successful replacements and return errors if none occur. Adjusted `npm-app` diff line counting to exclude metadata lines.

0f16ef8d751786f93fd8efbdc252d3afde5a67d0.text: The tool now reads files directly from your computer instead of relying on copied text. This makes batch edits more reliable and accurate.

7e284d81d1d067d34d46f3f87f6e0319a308bde8.text: A small internal update adds a record of certain actions to help the team check for errors. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

7a7299fde3edbc83b67c25d47b495b78ee484c2e.text: The team added an internal plan to track their current work priorities. This change does not affect the product you use.

b6c95d4a2eef95f808a7381fd427ec33b659199b.text: The system now records extra internal details when it updates text in bulk. This helps the team spot and fix problems faster. Nothing looks different for you.

de87bfd624714d75f05b3903d4119e0a47f2008c.text: The assistant now strictly follows its current list of available helpers, ignoring any outdated references to other types. This ensures it only uses the correct, up-to-date helpers for tasks.

6a49a1ac1aa1fa5e56d7f549eb1b3e0553078042.text: The assistant now keeps your questions visible while it works, instead of clearing them too early. This small internal fix helps it stay focused on your original request.

4f0db7c081c48ff869f6d667e35586338b5834f1.text: Added internal tracking to help engineers check how text replacements work. No change to how the product looks or acts for you.

b1322a27219753741094521f50351f80ffaf26d4.text: Agents that copy their instructions from a parent now see every available tool, not just a short list. This internal change helps them act correctly without missing options.

ed68a7cba426c757adaa86ab6b70620c661264ad.title: Update recommended models to Sonnet 4.5 and GLM 4.6
ed68a7cba426c757adaa86ab6b70620c661264ad.summary: The ModelName union in common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts updates recommended model identifiers. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 changes to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5, and z-ai/glm-4.5 plus its nitro variant change to z-ai/glm-4.6. This aligns the core type definitions with the current recommended model list.

5de4bc274b4fe6e409aaaa0951c67ecdfa0c7011.title: evals write dev traces to file
5de4bc274b4fe6e409aaaa0951c67ecdfa0c7011.summary: run-git-evals.ts writes per-commit trace JSON when NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT is 'dev'. Guts eval_commit.fileStates and top-level gitDiff before serializing to trace-<sha>.json. Internal evals harness only.

0fc18275eb2baded595dd1e540728d2500a1bf1b.title: New orchestrator agent with lite sub-agents for complex coding tasks
0fc18275eb2baded595dd1e540728d2500a1bf1b.summary: Added orchestrator agent (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5) coordinating planning, editing, and reviewing for complex tasks. Orchestrator spawns read-only-commander, researcher-grok-4-fast, decomposing-planner-lite, editor-lite, reviewer-lite, and context-pruner agents. New editor-lite (x-ai/grok-code-fast-1) handles easy coding tasks with full tool access. Added decomposing-planner-lite and implementation-planner-lite variants using claude-sonnet-4.5 and grok-4-fast respectively. Updated read-only-commander-lite and reviewer-lite to use grok-4-fast instead of grok-code-fast-1 and grok-4-fast:free. Reorganized agent files into subdirectories (editor/, planners/, orchestrator/, reviewer/).

930d08f1f3ea4801accd9bde056702998ad984da.title: Drop :free suffix from x-ai/grok-4-fast model identifiers
930d08f1f3ea4801accd9bde056702998ad984da.summary: The `:free` suffix is removed from all `x-ai/grok-4-fast` model references across agent definitions and type unions. The `ModelName` union in `agent-definition.ts` now expects the base identifier, and the `agent-builder` prompt guidance is updated to match. This change spans researcher agents, planner spawn lists, and eval harnesses, ensuring consistent model resolution without the deprecated suffix.

d33dd0e4783e875a4b3b967470f02109499749e6.title: Orchestrator agent config and eval judge handling
d33dd0e4783e875a4b3b967470f02109499749e6.summary: Editor agent switched from openai/gpt-5-chat to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5. Orchestrator spawnableAgents list updated: researcher-grok-4-fast, decomposing-planner-lite, editor-lite replaced by researcher-file-explorer, researcher-web, researcher-docs, decomposing-planner, editor. Eval judge agent now returns zero-score result object with error message instead of throwing when output is not structured.

5a201c718c49543c44f501230c5840cfc1dd92f0.title: Move planner files to .agents/planners
5a201c718c49543c44f501230c5840cfc1dd92f0.summary: Relocated decomposing-planner.ts, implementation-planner.ts, implementation-planner-max.ts, and plan-selector.ts from their respective subdirectories in .agents/ to a unified .agents/planners/ directory. This change consolidates planner logic into a single folder structure. No code modifications were made; files were moved with 100% similarity.

ac238255765b702559dba1b8460fb61645df4e9f.title: Switch read-only-commander to Sonnet 4.5
ac238255765b702559dba1b8460fb61645df4e9f.summary: The read-only-commander agent definition in .agents/read-only-commander.ts now uses anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 instead of openai/gpt-5-chat. This change leverages prompt caching for cost efficiency and simplifies reasoning options. The agent's system prompt inheritance and instruction structure were also updated to align with the new model's capabilities.

ea10e06cb24feaed39a4c389d96a2360748a7b91.title: Subagent prompt caching via inheritParentSystemPrompt
ea10e06cb24feaed39a4c389d96a2360748a7b91.summary: Subagents now inherit parent system prompts via `inheritParentSystemPrompt` to enable prompt caching. Orchestrator tool set reduced to `spawn_agents` and `read_files`; `reviewer-lite` replaced by `reviewer-max`. Decomposing planner display name changed to 'Peter Plan' and file exploration moved to parent.

99daf6cd36cecea2d6ae560cce6af1933756a196.title: Base2 Orchestrator Refactor and GPT-5-High Cleanup
99daf6cd36cecea2d6ae560cce6af1933756a196.summary: Refactored `base2` to use a new orchestrator pattern with `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`, replacing the old factory setup. Removed legacy `gpt-5-high` agent definitions (`base2-gpt-5-high`, `editor-gpt-5-high`, `reviewer-gpt-5-high`, `thinker-gpt-5-high`) and associated planner factories. Updated system prompts and tool configurations in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to support the new spawnable agents list.

5de4bc274b4fe6e409aaaa0951c67ecdfa0c7011.text: A small internal update helps developers track how the system checks new features during testing. This change does not affect how you use the product.

0d7b7f07109f706992af0ec4989624acd875abbb.text: The internal organization of the software was improved to make it easier to maintain. This change is invisible to you and does not affect how the product works.

930d08f1f3ea4801accd9bde056702998ad984da.text: The assistant now uses a cleaner name for a specific AI model. This is a small internal fix to help the system find the right model more reliably.

ac238255765b702559dba1b8460fb61645df4e9f.text: The internal assistant switched to a different underlying model. This makes it cheaper to run and simpler to configure.

ea10e06cb24feaed39a4c389d96a2360748a7b91.text: The assistant now shares its core instructions with smaller helper tasks to work faster and cheaper. It uses a stricter review step and organizes planning tasks differently, with the main assistant handling file exploration.

d33dd0e4783e875a4b3b967470f02109499749e6.text: The assistant now uses different tools for research and editing. If a grading step fails, it reports a score of zero instead of stopping.

5a201c718c49543c44f501230c5840cfc1dd92f0.text: The internal files that help the assistant plan tasks were moved to a single folder for better organization. This change does not affect how the product works or looks to users.

0fc18275eb2baded595dd1e540728d2500a1bf1b.text: The assistant now splits complex coding tasks into smaller steps handled by specialized helpers. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

ed68a7cba426c757adaa86ab6b70620c661264ad.text: The software now uses newer, recommended versions of its underlying AI models. This small internal update helps the assistant stay current without changing how you use it.

db5136ef2226350a07e419e7e234ff768a9273f9.title: eval-planner checkout previous commit
db5136ef2226350a07e419e7e234ff768a9273f9.summary: eval-planner adds checkoutPrevious flag to withTestRepo, enabling git checkout of parent commit via getPreviousCommitSha. evalPlannerAgent now passes checkoutPrevious: true, shifting evaluation baseline to pre-change state. Judge agent model updated from x-ai/grok-4-fast:free to x-ai/grok-4-fast. Event logging includes agent IDs for implementationPlannerAgent and eval-judge.

6f13b204e5c8a819d33ca8d7c78f18fc19451908.title: eval-planner writes results to JSON file
6f13b204e5c8a819d33ca8d7c78f18fc19451908.summary: evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts now collects all evaluation results into an array and writes them to eval-planner-results.json after each run. This persists agent output and judging results for later analysis. The script also explicitly logs pros to the console.

c5e091f351e22120b69ed60b8044a2468ed47272.title: New Decomposing Planner agent definition
c5e091f351e22120b69ed60b8044a2468ed47272.summary: Added .agents/decomposing-planner/decomposing-planner.ts defining a SecretAgent that decomposes tasks into 3-5 subtasks, spawns parallel implementation-planner agents, and synthesizes a unified plan. Uses anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 with tools spawn_agents and read_files, and spawnable agents file-explorer and implementation-planner. Internal agent infrastructure addition.

ab9a465cd44a06f4e7484961f052349e6057b54a.title: Extract withTestRepo to test-repo-utils
ab9a465cd44a06f4e7484961f052349e6057b54a.summary: Refactored `evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts` by moving `withTestRepo` and `getPreviousCommitSha` into new file `evals/subagents/test-repo-utils.ts`. Planner now imports these utilities instead of defining them locally. Internal change with no user-facing behavior impact.

e8c2de98a92d4fa210e73dfc0b8729303b063a99.title: Unify error serialization with getErrorObject
e8c2de98a92d4fa210e73dfc0b8729303b063a99.summary: errorToObject removed from common/src/util/object.ts; all callers migrated to getErrorObject in common/src/util/error.ts. getErrorObject now handles Error instances and plain values, returning name, message, and stack. common/src/util/error.ts adds ErrorOr, Success, and Failure result types plus success/failure helpers. Scope covers backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts, backend/src/util/messages.ts, backend/src/util/simplify-tool-results.ts, npm-app/src/utils/changes.ts, and evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts.

7842c81173fdf79d6b9836a68fbcfe4af663106d.title: Retry generating output schema if errors
7842c81173fdf79d6b9836a68fbcfe4af663106d.summary: Added `hasRetriedOutputSchema` flag to retry loop when required output is missing. Injects system message forcing `set_output` usage and resets `shouldEndTurn` to continue execution. Scope limited to backend agent step logic in `run-agent-step.ts`. Prevents premature termination on schema violations.

32ed63965f1469ba18841a9fc75adb251af4d2da.title: eval-planner loads local agents dynamically
32ed63965f1469ba18841a9fc75adb251af4d2da.summary: eval-planner now accepts agentId and loads all agents from .agents via loadLocalAgents instead of hardcoding implementation-planner. Judge model switched from x-ai/grok-4-fast to openai/gpt-5. Affects evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts. Requires agentId param in evalPlannerAgent calls.

ab3b11b51d7d44e4f207aac409f6bdb3bdd29ece.title: Refactor extractToolsFromBufferAndProcess to non-generator
ab3b11b51d7d44e4f207aac409f6bdb3bdd29ece.summary: Changed extractToolsFromBufferAndProcess from generator to void function. Directly calls onResponseChunk and clears buffer on flush. Scope: backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts. Removes redundant yield and chunk object creation.

a3bda0c4999b2466ede3041e5c392755fa68a6c6.title: Remove direct Gemini models from core constants and backend
a3bda0c4999b2466ede3041e5c392755fa68a6c6.summary: The `geminiModels` object and associated types (`GeminiModel`) were removed from `common/src/old-constants.ts`, eliminating direct Gemini model IDs (`gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20`, etc.) from the core model registry. Backend routing in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` and cost tracking in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` no longer handle these models, and prompt logic in `.agents/prompts/` now relies exclusively on `openrouter_gemini2_5_*` aliases. This enforces a single provider path for Gemini models via OpenRouter, removing direct Google AI SDK integration and associated thinking config logic from `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`.

4b9d2092a94478a7965df35286889750e29c8be9.title: Flush last text chunk as print mode event
4b9d2092a94478a7965df35286889750e29c8be9.summary: xml-stream-parser.ts now yields buffer content as a text StreamChunk upon stream completion. This ensures the final text segment is emitted and processed via onResponseChunk when forceFlush is true. The extractToolsFromBufferAndProcess function was converted to a generator to support this yield. Internal backend streaming logic only.

ab9a465cd44a06f4e7484961f052349e6057b54a.text: We cleaned up some internal code to make it easier for our team to maintain. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

7842c81173fdf79d6b9836a68fbcfe4af663106d.text: If the assistant fails to produce the required format, it now tries again instead of stopping. This small internal fix reduces cases where you receive no response.

6f13b204e5c8a819d33ca8d7c78f18fc19451908.text: The system now saves evaluation results to a file after each run. This keeps a record for later analysis. The change is small and internal.

c5e091f351e22120b69ed60b8044a2468ed47272.text: The assistant can now break large requests into smaller parts, handle them simultaneously, and combine the results for faster answers.

ab3b11b51d7d44e4f207aac409f6bdb3bdd29ece.text: The tool that handles incoming data was simplified to process information faster and with less wasted effort. This internal cleanup does not change how the assistant behaves.

a3bda0c4999b2466ede3041e5c392755fa68a6c6.text: The assistant now uses a single service to access Gemini models. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

4b9d2092a94478a7965df35286889750e29c8be9.text: The assistant now sends the final part of a response to your screen. This prevents text from being cut off at the end of a message.

32ed63965f1469ba18841a9fc75adb251af4d2da.text: The internal planning tool can now choose from a wider list of helpers and uses a new reasoning model to make decisions. This change is small and happens behind the scenes, so you won't notice any difference in how you use the product.

db5136ef2226350a07e419e7e234ff768a9273f9.text: The system now checks the state before changes to test new features more accurately. It also uses a better model for judging results.

a3ccddb0e8df9883b0da28fe8011e82176a6a8ac.title: Fix discoverProjectFiles path resolution
a3ccddb0e8df9883b0da28fe8011e82176a6a8ac.summary: discoverProjectFiles now joins relative paths with cwd before reading files. Previous logic used raw relative paths from getAllFilePaths, causing fs.readFileSync failures. Error handling moved inside the map loop to catch individual file issues without aborting discovery. Affects sdk/src/run-state.ts.

0e761c7b56fcf302773fa2d3d0a77532eae28e5d.title: User input cancellation no longer throws error
0e761c7b56fcf302773fa2d3d0a77532eae28e5d.summary: Agent loop in backend/src/run-agent-step.ts now breaks instead of throwing Error('User input no longer live (likely cancelled)') when checkLiveUserInput fails. Log severity upgraded from debug to warn. Prevents unhandled exceptions during cancellation.

dac55b74b77472e7ee95d8c2ae196e439e70701e.title: Add CONTEXT7APIKEY to env schema and auth headers
dac55b74b77472e7ee95d8c2ae196e439e70701e.summary: Added optional `CONTEXT7_API_KEY` to `packages/internal/src/env.ts` schema and injected it into `Authorization` headers for `searchLibraries` and `fetchContext7LibraryDocumentation` in `backend/src/llm-apis/context7-api.ts`. This enables authenticated access to Context7 API endpoints. Also reduced default `max_tokens` for `read-docs` tool from 20,000 to 10,000 in `common/src/tools/params/tool/read-docs.ts`.

dd17ce18df728c8ed0da3133d66eef2e05715960.title: message-cost-tracker returns null on retry exhaustion
dd17ce18df728c8ed0da3133d66eef2e05715960.summary: Removed throw error in `insertMessageRecordWithRetries` and `updateUserCycleUsageWithRetries`. Now returns `null` or `{ consumed: 0, fromPurchased: 0 }` after max retries fail. Eliminates special-case handling for `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT === 'test'`. Internal change in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts`.

ffa7e35e050ed32800724b7dbc368e2867dac448.title: Deprecate agentId in AgentStateSchema
ffa7e35e050ed32800724b7dbc368e2867dac448.summary: Marked agentId as deprecated in common/src/types/session-state.ts, indicating replacement by runId. backend/src/run-agent-step.ts updated to log runId, totalSteps, directCreditsUsed, and agentType alongside agentId on execution failure.

6ac9d5438c9d4baf2a3a0d89d75d63157f375ca3.title: Run git add before diffing files in git evals
6ac9d5438c9d4baf2a3a0d89d75d63157f375ca3.summary: The `getCodebuffFileStates` function in `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` now executes `git add .` before running `git diff`. This ensures uncommitted changes are staged and captured in the diff output. The scope is limited to the internal git evaluation suite.

30f30a98df211e6fd95b22e0640c4b396ed876c1.title: Add cb bin alias to npm-app release package
30f30a98df211e6fd95b22e0640c4b396ed876c1.summary: Added 'cb' as a bin alias pointing to index.js in the npm-app/release/package.json. This provides a shorter command-line invocation alongside the existing 'codebuff' entry. The change applies only to the published npm package structure.

5739bfadbdf38fe5daaf3236439480bcc64280b5.title: Add eval-planner subagent and reorder tool descriptions prompt
5739bfadbdf38fe5daaf3236439480bcc64280b5.summary: New `evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts` subagent introduced to run implementation planner evaluations against cloned repositories. `backend/src/tools/prompts.ts` modified to place tool descriptions after the critical instruction block. `diff` dependency added to `evals/package.json` to support file state comparison.

2fd2162227a4d7519fa36e6b74cd6aa08e2a6942.text: The app added support for a new source of AI models. It also changed how it saves chat history to track extra details about the assistant's thinking process.

0e761c7b56fcf302773fa2d3d0a77532eae28e5d.text: Small internal fix. The assistant now stops quietly when you cancel a request, instead of showing a confusing error message.

a3ccddb0e8df9883b0da28fe8011e82176a6a8ac.text: The software now correctly finds files in the current folder. This prevents errors when reading project data.

5739bfadbdf38fe5daaf3236439480bcc64280b5.text: The system can now test how well it plans work on copied projects. It also reads its main rules before looking at its tools. This helps the assistant follow instructions more reliably.

6ac9d5438c9d4baf2a3a0d89d75d63157f375ca3.text: The system now saves changes before checking them. This helps it see all updates correctly. This is a small internal fix.

dac55b74b77472e7ee95d8c2ae196e439e70701e.text: The app now supports an optional account key for a specific document service, allowing it to fetch extra information when configured. It also limits the amount of text read at once to keep responses faster.

ffa7e35e050ed32800724b7dbc368e2867dac448.text: The system now uses a new identifier for tracking tasks. If a task fails, support gets more details to help fix it.

dd17ce18df728c8ed0da3133d66eef2e05715960.text: This is a small internal change. It makes the system handle rare connection failures more smoothly, so you are less likely to see errors or interruptions.

30f30a98df211e6fd95b22e0640c4b396ed876c1.text: Users can now type a shorter command to start the tool. This small update makes launching the application faster and easier.

a57d231d62f6756512255fb072978e000f8a5f30.text: The assistant now applies multiple text changes more reliably and reports errors if no changes succeed. This is an internal improvement that makes editing tasks more accurate for users.

79df8b66057ac77deaa01a062e431b74ae7ee756.title: Tighten tool availability constraints in agent prompt
79df8b66057ac77deaa01a062e431b74ae7ee756.summary: Updated backend/src/tools/prompts.ts to explicitly restrict agent tool usage. Added instructions forbidding use of unlisted tools, clarifying they may belong to other agents. This prevents hallucinated tool calls by enforcing strict whitelist adherence.

001d4cdb9630c24e34cb62e7fd040b180031ec83.title: Remove eval-plane task
001d4cdb9630c24e34cb62e7fd040b180031ec83.summary: Deleted eval task sha 63d025cbf45cf753f9685469ed30ab072fd24c9a from evals/git-evals/eval-plane.json. Task spec covered Plane issue serializer validation, HTML parsing, and project-level checks. Removed due to unclear prompt. Eval suite now excludes this case.

890c1dfdc8b30dc7fa7f3652c344ac002f476aae.title: Rename test environment check to NEXTPUBLICCBENVIRONMENT
890c1dfdc8b30dc7fa7f3652c344ac002f476aae.summary: The `message-cost-tracker.ts` file now checks `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT === 'test'` instead of `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test'`. This aligns the backend cost-tracking retry logic with the unified frontend environment variable standard. No functional changes outside of this variable name update.

e16aa1d2904748e6aaa75cefc4a0710a6bf52c35.title: SDK 0.3.13 simplifies tree-sitter WASM resolution
e16aa1d2904748e6aaa75cefc4a0710a6bf52c35.summary: SDK version bumped to 0.3.13. The `initTreeSitterForNode` function in `packages/code-map/src/init-node.ts` removes a redundant fallback path for `tree-sitter.wasm`. It now strictly checks the shared WASM directory before falling back to the script directory, eliminating an unnecessary local directory check.

cda2d6d02ceca0d582bbe06544983208bd291845.title: Refine implementation planner prompts and tools
cda2d6d02ceca0d582bbe06544983208bd291845.summary: Implementation planner agents now focus on simple, correct solutions over complex ones. The `end_turn` tool was removed from `implementation-planner.ts` as it is no longer needed for the new flow. `plan-selector.ts` updated to prioritize simplicity and reuse, with `includeMessageHistory` set to true. Base prompts in `base-prompts.ts` strengthened the instruction to spawn the max planner for non-trivial tasks.

5cb58f262d249d754229bc9df501273e0feb890a.title: CONTRIBUTING.md: GitHub OAuth setup, simplified credits
5cb58f262d249d754229bc9df501273e0feb890a.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md adds GitHub OAuth app setup (CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ID/SECRET via Infisical) as step 7. Credits instructions simplified: replace manual Stripe/DB row creation with login at localhost:3000/login then edit existing credit_ledger principal/balance. Renumbered steps 8-10. Internal docs only.

fd5db264d201a2b1b13a23481f72c1153639b0c2.title: code-map tree-sitter.wasm path resolution
fd5db264d201a2b1b13a23481f72c1153639b0c2.summary: initTreeSitterForNode now resolves web-tree-sitter package root via require.resolve to locate tree-sitter.wasm, replacing sharedWasms loop. Throws explicit error if wasm missing instead of returning preferred path. SDK version bumped to 0.3.12.

ce6d4e52b133a9674152010f26cf5ddfe5987c72.title: Remove dirname checks for tree-sitter.wasm
ce6d4e52b133a9674152010f26cf5ddfe5987c72.summary: Removed `hereDir` and `getDirnameDynamically` from `packages/code-map/src/init-node.ts`. `initTreeSitterForNode` now relies solely on `locateFile` fallback to `scriptDir` for `tree-sitter.wasm`. Eliminates runtime directory resolution checks for the shared WASM path.

66c0a2e718a5cf4546cc5d0acc2dba99fcd4fc7c.title: Test-mode exception for message and usage persistence
66c0a2e718a5cf4546cc5d0acc2dba99fcd4fc7c.summary: Added NODE_ENV === 'test' guards to insertMessageRecordWithRetries and updateUserCycleUsageWithRetries in backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts. These bypass throw-on-failure behavior for test environments, returning null or { consumed: 0, fromPurchased: 0 } instead. The return type of insertMessageRecordWithRetries widened to Promise<typeof schema.message.$inferSelect | null>. Scope limited to backend message-cost-tracker.ts; no user-facing surfaces affected.

66c0a2e718a5cf4546cc5d0acc2dba99fcd4fc7c.text: A small internal update stops the system from crashing when it cannot record message details during automated tests. This change does not affect how you use the product.

cda2d6d02ceca0d582bbe06544983208bd291845.text: The internal planning system now favors simple solutions over complex ones. This helps the assistant produce cleaner, more reliable results for your tasks.

5cb58f262d249d754229bc9df501273e0feb890a.text: Internal instructions changed for how the team sets up sign-in and fixes credit balances. Users do not need to do anything.

890c1dfdc8b30dc7fa7f3652c344ac002f476aae.text: Small internal cleanup. You see no change.

79df8b66057ac77deaa01a062e431b74ae7ee756.text: The assistant now strictly limits itself to only the tools it is officially allowed to use. This prevents it from trying to use features that belong to other parts of the system, reducing errors and making its behavior more predictable.

99daf6cd36cecea2d6ae560cce6af1933756a196.text: The internal system was updated to use a new, more efficient way to handle tasks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

001d4cdb9630c24e34cb62e7fd040b180031ec83.text: Removed an internal check that tested how the system reads project tasks. The test had unclear instructions, so it was deleted. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ce6d4e52b133a9674152010f26cf5ddfe5987c72.text: The software no longer checks multiple locations to find a specific helper file, relying instead on a single default path. This internal cleanup simplifies how the program loads but causes no visible change for users.

e16aa1d2904748e6aaa75cefc4a0710a6bf52c35.text: The app now finds a required helper file more directly. This small update improves reliability without changing features.

fd5db264d201a2b1b13a23481f72c1153639b0c2.text: The software now finds its internal tools more reliably, so it starts up faster and fails less often.

3a2329e41c3a12f918d4fdecb082110a14d7d62c.title: SDK version bump to 0.3.7
3a2329e41c3a12f918d4fdecb082110a14d7d62c.summary: sdk/package.json version field incremented from 0.3.6 to 0.3.7. Change aligns with removal of local file references in SDK configuration. Scope limited to @codebuff/sdk package metadata.

f93c77af7ea6d4597958b7089b020cf425a3ec46.title: Add cwd to SDK README example
f93c77af7ea6d4597958b7089b020cf425a3ec46.summary: The SDK README quickstart example now passes `cwd: process.cwd()` to the client configuration. This update aligns the documentation with the SDK's working directory handling requirements. The change is scoped to `sdk/README.md`.

3053c4b4b8153c603f22a2cd8f28162c206d4543.title: Enable retries for promptAiSdkStream
3053c4b4b8153c603f22a2cd8f28162c206d4543.summary: Removed `maxRetries` passthrough in `promptAiSdkStream` to rely on default retry behavior. Added optional `maxRetries` parameter to `promptAiSdk` and `promptAiSdkStructured` type definitions. Set `maxRetries: 3` in `getAgentStreamFromTemplate` for agent streams.

08aae84900d7db2d413a6b470a304213114f0a62.title: SDK 0.3.8 dynamic dirname eval
08aae84900d7db2d413a6b470a304213114f0a62.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk to 0.3.8. Updated packages/code-map/src/init-node.ts to fetch __dirname via new Function('return __dirname')() instead of direct reference. Prevents bundlers from inlining absolute paths during build. Internal build fix.

4924584e8eb737117b718a2865a4142213713ecf.title: SDK v0.3.10 adds dirname try-catch guards
4924584e8eb737117b718a2865a4142213713ecf.summary: SDK version bumped to 0.3.10. Dynamic `__dirname` resolution in `packages/code-map/src/utils.ts` and `sdk/src/native/ripgrep.ts` wrapped in try-catch blocks to return `undefined` instead of throwing in ESM contexts. This prevents runtime errors during bundled ripgrep path resolution and directory mapping when `__dirname` is inaccessible.

0e831324dc7e1ef23143a82c479c2cff9c062438.title: Fix JSON.stringify typo in SDK README examples
0e831324dc7e1ef23143a82c479c2cff9c062438.summary: Corrects `JSON.stringifiy` to `JSON.stringify` in `sdk/README.md` event handler examples. Fixes invalid JavaScript syntax in documentation snippets.

30127cb7bd124fa82ffeb3ac138c2889ae187d86.title: Docs sidebar switch to CSS sticky
30127cb7bd124fa82ffeb3ac138c2889ae187d86.summary: Replaced JS scroll-based `fixed` toggling with CSS `sticky` positioning in `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx`. Eliminates `isFixed` state and `scroll` listener to prevent layout bouncing. Scope limited to Web docs layout. Height calculation now uses `calc(100vh - 64px - 3rem)`.

28ff9ca3f5ed781b7291ed4865afa0aad0a5dbe6.title: Fix wasm and ripgrep bundled paths
28ff9ca3f5ed781b7291ed4865afa0aad0a5dbe6.summary: SDK v0.3.11 resolves `tree-sitter.wasm` and `ripgrep` binaries across multiple directory structures. `initTreeSitterForNode` now iterates over shared and local WASM paths before falling back to script directory or parent directory checks. `getBundledRgPath` adds a secondary CJS vendor path check for `ripgrep` binaries. This ensures correct binary loading in varied bundling environments.

3a420050d14eb712e6931badbaff4c72a511775e.title: Stripe buy-credits route hardcodes centsPerCredit to 1
3a420050d14eb712e6931badbaff4c72a511775e.summary: web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts drops getUserCostPerCredit import and call, replacing it with literal 1. Removes async lookup, simplifies conversion to convertCreditsToUsdCents(credits, 1). Internal billing surface only, no CLI/Web/Desktop picker impact.

bd9fe14e9a9f7e7eccac7c665a2b4c3ab339ab48.title: Fix ESM/CJS dirname resolution for ripgrep and code-map
bd9fe14e9a9f7e7eccac7c665a2b4c3ab339ab48.summary: SDK 0.3.9 fixes `__dirname` resolution in ESM builds by replacing direct `__dirname` checks with dynamic evaluation via `new Function`. `packages/code-map` extracts this logic into `getDirnameDynamically` in `utils.ts`, updating `init-node.ts` and `languages.ts` to use the helper for tree-sitter WASM path resolution. `sdk/src/native/ripgrep.ts` applies the same dynamic `__dirname` trick for locating bundled `rg` binaries, ensuring correct path construction in both CJS and ESM contexts.

08aae84900d7db2d413a6b470a304213114f0a62.text: The software now finds its own location more reliably during setup. This is a small internal fix that does not change how you use the product.

30127cb7bd124fa82ffeb3ac138c2889ae187d86.text: The help menu now stays in place while you scroll. This stops the page from jumping around.

28ff9ca3f5ed781b7291ed4865afa0aad0a5dbe6.text: The software now finds its built-in tools more reliably. This reduces startup errors in different setups.

4924584e8eb737117b718a2865a4142213713ecf.text: The software now handles missing location data more gracefully. This prevents unexpected errors when searching for files.

f93c77af7ea6d4597958b7089b020cf425a3ec46.text: The instructions for setting up the tool now include an extra step to ensure it looks in the right folder for files. This small update helps the tool find things correctly when you first start using it.

3a2329e41c3a12f918d4fdecb082110a14d7d62c.text: The software received a small internal update to fix how it finds its settings. This change does not affect how you use the product.

3a420050d14eb712e6931badbaff4c72a511775e.text: The system now uses a fixed price for buying credits instead of checking a separate price list. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

bd9fe14e9a9f7e7eccac7c665a2b4c3ab339ab48.text: Fixed a bug that prevented the tool from finding its search engine and code analysis files. The assistant now works correctly in all environments.

3053c4b4b8153c603f22a2cd8f28162c206d4543.text: Internal adjustments improve how the system handles temporary connection issues during AI responses. This small change helps ensure smoother interactions by automatically trying again if a request fails.

0e831324dc7e1ef23143a82c479c2cff9c062438.text: Fixed a spelling mistake in the help guide. The example text is now correct.

f732133e0a8af0cc8222051e31c50e2cc46385c9.title: Allow async handleEvent and handleStreamChunk in SDK
f732133e0a8af0cc8222051e31c50e2cc46385c9.summary: The `handleEvent` and `handleStreamChunk` callbacks in `CodebuffClientOptions` now accept async handlers returning `void | Promise<void>`. The `run` function awaits these handlers in `onError` and `onResponseChunk` to support non-blocking I/O or complex processing within the callbacks. This change is scoped to the `@codebuff/sdk` package (version 0.3.5), specifically `sdk/src/run.ts`.

758f3c6347a99e60af6fdd986b89c9474e74eab6.title: SDK 0.3.4 enforce runterminalcommand processtype
758f3c6347a99e60af6fdd986b89c9474e74eab6.summary: SDK version bumped to 0.3.4. `process_type` in `run_terminal_command` removed `.optional()` from Zod schema, enforcing explicit enum values. Affects `common/src/tools/params/tool/run-terminal-command.ts` and `sdk/package.json`. Defaults to `SYNC` if omitted.

dc3afb56b2d763f2560a48ae4069cce0ec96222a.title: Load agents from ~/.agents in addition to project root
dc3afb56b2d763f2560a48ae4069cce0ec96222a.summary: Agent loading now scans both project root and `~/.agents` for `.ts` files. `getUserAgentsDirectory` added to `agent-utils.ts` to resolve home path. `load-agents.ts` aggregates files from both directories before processing. Affects `npm-app` agent discovery logic.

61cd0799dff3a72ddb1946f6f1d2917aab0a0e9b.title: Backend throws error when agent input is cancelled
61cd0799dff3a72ddb1946f6f1d2917aab0a0e9b.summary: Agent execution loop in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` now throws an error when `checkLiveUserInput` returns false, replacing the previous silent `break`. This change ensures that cancelled or stale user inputs are explicitly handled via exception rather than exiting the loop without signal. The scope is limited to the backend agent runner logic. A debug log entry is added before throwing, capturing `userId`, `userInputId`, `clientSessionId`, `totalSteps`, `runId`, and `agentState` for observability.

ce889f5bc4ddb9e354f4509550d81c7be06e9461.title: SDK run() accepts AgentDefinition object
ce889f5bc4ddb9e354f4509550d81c7be06e9461.summary: sdk/src/run.ts RunOptions.agent type widened to string | AgentDefinition. run() clones agentDefinitions and appends passed object, extracting id for agentId. Bumps @codebuff/sdk to 0.3.6.

5092b1e7ab0ed5fcfbc3fe8b43d4c8e0d96d7717.title: Add output to main prompt debug log
5092b1e7ab0ed5fcfbc3fe8b43d4c8e0d96d7717.summary: The `mainPrompt` function in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` now includes the `output` variable in the debug log payload alongside `agentState`. This provides visibility into the generated prompt content during development. No user-facing behavior or API changes.

597e59d7550eaec92991f537c46bd419f15d850f.title: Eval prompter forbids git commit requests
597e59d7550eaec92991f537c46bd419f15d850f.summary: Updated `run-git-evals.ts` to instruct the Eval Prompter Agent to avoid asking Codebuff to `git commit` changes. This prevents unnecessary commit actions during evaluation runs. Scope limited to `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`.

7c03da6f383950435336769e74baceae6cb5b0c0.title: SDK cwd parameter made optional
7c03da6f383950435336769e74baceae6cb5b0c0.summary: The `cwd` parameter in `sdk/src/run.ts` and `sdk/src/run-state.ts` is now optional. File discovery and indexing skip execution if `cwd` is missing. Tool handlers (`read_files`, `write_file`, `run_terminal_command`, `code_search`) throw explicit errors via `requireCwd` if invoked without a defined `cwd`. State initialization falls back to `process.cwd()` for `projectRoot` when `cwd` is undefined.

2426408827c5ce5bb9e0a54d3586c4939ccf977b.title: git-diff evals capture all changes since evalCommitSha^
2426408827c5ce5bb9e0a54d3586c4939ccf977b.summary: Updated `getCodebuffFileStates` in `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` to use `git diff ${evalCommitSha}^` instead of staging and diffing. This captures uncommitted changes and any commits made during the eval. Scope limited to internal evals.

c06f476a31525cc3320c0b1a24108623d72dee22.title: Add retries for message cost tracking
c06f476a31525cc3320c0b1a24108623d72dee22.summary: New `insertMessageRecordWithRetries` wraps `insertMessageRecord` with up to 3 attempts and linear backoff (1s * attempt). Throws after max retries to ensure cost data integrity. Scope: `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts`, `packages/billing/src/auto-topup.ts`. `getUserCostPerCredit` removed; auto-topup hardcodes 1 cent/credit.

5092b1e7ab0ed5fcfbc3fe8b43d4c8e0d96d7717.text: The team added a new way for them to see the instructions the assistant receives during development. This internal change helps the team check how the assistant works, but it does not change what you see or how the product behaves for you.

61cd0799dff3a72ddb1946f6f1d2917aab0a0e9b.text: When you cancel an agent's task, the system now clearly marks it as stopped instead of quietly ending it. This ensures you see the correct status and helps support teams track the issue.

7c03da6f383950435336769e74baceae6cb5b0c0.text: The tool now works without a specific project folder, defaulting to your current location. Some file actions fail if no folder is set.

f732133e0a8af0cc8222051e31c50e2cc46385c9.text: The assistant can now perform background tasks, like saving data or checking information, while it streams its response to you. This keeps the conversation moving smoothly even when the assistant needs to take an action that takes a moment to complete.

dc3afb56b2d763f2560a48ae4069cce0ec96222a.text: The assistant now finds extra helper tools in a shared personal folder, not just inside specific projects. This means your custom helpers are available everywhere, not just where you created them.

758f3c6347a99e60af6fdd986b89c9474e74eab6.text: A small internal update ensures the system always knows how to handle tasks, defaulting to a standard method if not specified.

2426408827c5ce5bb9e0a54d3586c4939ccf977b.text: The system now records every change made during a test, including edits that were not saved. This internal update improves how the team reviews test results.

ce889f5bc4ddb9e354f4509550d81c7be06e9461.text: The system now accepts a full description of an assistant instead of just its name. This allows you to define new assistants directly in your requests without creating them first.

597e59d7550eaec92991f537c46bd419f15d850f.text: A small internal change stops the testing system from asking the assistant to save work during checks. Users will not see any difference.

cde6ebb38236816467caa6bfb738dfd2b04faad1.title: Fix undefined toolName handling in xml-stream-parser
cde6ebb38236816467caa6bfb738dfd2b04faad1.summary: The xml-stream-parser now explicitly guards against undefined toolName values before attempting processor lookup, preventing potential crashes or silent failures during stream processing. If a tool call lacks a valid string toolName, the system triggers an 'unknown_tool_call' analytics event and emits a specific parse_error via onError, halting further processing for that chunk. This change applies to the backend XML stream parsing logic in backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts.

af5450c627d85ee8bbc48281337d72497fa60ec8.title: Standardize Sonnet 4.5 model name
af5450c627d85ee8bbc48281337d72497fa60ec8.summary: Model string anthropic/claude-4.5-sonnet standardized to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 across agent definitions and shared constants. Aligns with canonical Anthropic naming. Updates .agents/base.ts, implementation-planner, researcher, reviewer, and common/src/old-constants.ts.

50ae105891eea0851a127e42adf52922422ddd00.title: docs/web-researcher agents switch to grok-4-fast
50ae105891eea0851a127e42adf52922422ddd00.summary: docs-researcher and web-researcher agents updated to use x-ai/grok-4-fast instead of google/gemini-2.5-flash. reviewer-max definition adds publisher import for consistency.

9e1b2ce106aba7269fe0c0305dd922069949570c.title: Update xml-stream-parser test expectations
9e1b2ce106aba7269fe0c0305dd922069949570c.summary: Adjusts expected error output in xml-stream-parser.test.ts to match updated parser behavior. Tests now expect name 'parse_error' and a detailed error string including the unknown tool name and raw JSON payload. Ensures test suite passes after recent parser logic changes.

d6ef243c976331f43cf81f01788f78446f6fe7bf.title: Update EDITORSCHOICEAGENTS list in store-client.tsx
d6ef243c976331f43cf81f01788f78446f6fe7bf.summary: The `EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS` constant in `web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx` was updated. 'planner', 'deep-thinker', and 'rampup-teacher-agent' were removed, replaced by 'base-max', 'find-food', and 'landing-page-generator'. This change affects the default agent selection logic for the web client store.

ce4d79865d668f802cbb6108ecb51ea24094eb2e.title: Fix missing response content in AI SDK message table
ce4d79865d668f802cbb6108ecb51ea24094eb2e.summary: Added `content += flushed` and `content += stopSequenceResult.text` in `promptAiSdkStream` (backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts). Accumulated yielded text-delta chunks into the `content` variable. Ensures full response text is captured for database persistence. Scope limited to Vercel AI SDK streaming handler.

68cc6bba863ad4c89cca0d107a0af13d673480ac.title: Debounce search query in Agent Store
68cc6bba863ad4c89cca0d107a0af13d673480ac.summary: Added local state and a 300ms timeout effect to `store-client.tsx` to decouple immediate input feedback from query state updates. Prevents excessive re-renders and network requests during typing. Scope limited to the web Agent Store client. Input value binds to `localSearchQuery`, syncing to `searchQuery` via debounced effect.

6dc7848401b4167696523c366bc851a214df64e7.title: Docs nav one section per page
6dc7848401b4167696523c366bc851a214df64e7.summary: Refactored web/src/app/docs/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx and web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx to enforce one section per page, replacing category-level rendering with dedicated slug routes. Updated web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx to link directly to subsection hrefs, removing hash-based scroll logic. Removed hashchange smooth-scroll effect from web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx. This eliminates fragile anchor navigation in favor of standard Next.js routing.

6f9bb4c9e1eda2bb404b5edfb50567f7a45fb835.title: Resolve escaped characters in image file paths
6f9bb4c9e1eda2bb404b5edfb50567f7a45fb835.summary: Added normalizeUserProvidedPath to decode Unicode, hex, and literal escapes in image paths before resolution. resolveFilePath now applies this normalization to handle tilde expansion, absolute checks, and relative resolution correctly. This affects npm-app/src/utils/image-handler.ts.

08d425fcb39702284b08a75e9832c3e99da18afd.title: Switch researcher and reviewer agents to Sonnet
08d425fcb39702284b08a75e9832c3e99da18afd.summary: Researcher and reviewer agents migrated from GPT-5 to `anthropic/claude-4.5-sonnet` to reduce latency and improve planning consistency. `base-max.ts` updates spawnable agent IDs to `researcher-web-sonnet` and `researcher-docs-sonnet`, while `reviewer-max.ts` switches the underlying model. `base-prompts.ts` enforces `implementation-planner-max` spawning for medium-to-hard tasks across all max-tier configurations.

af5450c627d85ee8bbc48281337d72497fa60ec8.text: The assistant now uses a standard name for its underlying model. This is a small internal cleanup. You will not notice any difference.

9e1b2ce106aba7269fe0c0305dd922069949570c.text: This internal update adjusts automated checks to match recent changes in how the system handles errors. It does not affect the product or your experience.

6dc7848401b4167696523c366bc851a214df64e7.text: The documentation site now loads each section on its own page instead of scrolling within one long page. This makes navigation more reliable and easier to use.

d6ef243c976331f43cf81f01788f78446f6fe7bf.text: The store’s recommended assistant list changed. Three old options were removed and three new ones added.

6f9bb4c9e1eda2bb404b5edfb50567f7a45fb835.text: The app now understands special characters in image file names. This fixes errors when loading images with unusual names.

ce4d79865d668f802cbb6108ecb51ea24094eb2e.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant's response text was not saved in the chat history. Now, full responses are stored correctly.

cde6ebb38236816467caa6bfb738dfd2b04faad1.text: The system now safely handles missing information in certain requests, preventing crashes or silent errors. If a request lacks a valid tool name, it stops processing that part and logs an error instead of failing unpredictably.

08d425fcb39702284b08a75e9832c3e99da18afd.text: The assistant now uses a different brain for research and reviews. This makes answers appear faster and helps it plan complex tasks more consistently.

68cc6bba863ad4c89cca0d107a0af13d673480ac.text: The search bar now waits briefly before updating results. This stops the page from reloading too often while you type.

50ae105891eea0851a127e42adf52922422ddd00.text: The research tools now use a different artificial intelligence engine. This small internal update does not change how you use the product.

a459d5072eef428cf02c25fa02de540920ddeb42.title: Fix agent usage command in first agent docs
a459d5072eef428cf02c25fa02de540920ddeb42.summary: Corrected `codebuff --agent` command syntax in `creating-your-first-agent.mdx`. Removed erroneous `@` prefix from publisher ID. Affects documentation only.

358b711b30bff9759b631df733db5e27eaf1e56c.title: Implementation planner agents switch to Claude 4.5 Sonnet
358b711b30bff9759b631df733db5e27eaf1e56c.summary: implementation-planner, implementation-planner-max, and plan-selector definitions updated from openai/gpt-5 to anthropic/claude-4.5-sonnet. reasoningOptions and thinker-gpt-5-high dependency removed from implementation-planner. Parallel spawn count for implementation-planner-max reduced from 10 to 5. GPT-5 specific tool-call enforcement prompt deleted.

875ca1fb96d29b5ea7af8fa7431dec52421d98ce.title: base-max agent uses claude-sonnet-4.5
875ca1fb96d29b5ea7af8fa7431dec52421d98ce.summary: The `base-max` agent definition in `.agents/base-max.ts` now points to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5` instead of `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4`. This updates the underlying model for the max-tier base agent. No other files or surfaces are affected.

43ea37285bc949353ca37b1490a8f0773dc6ac5d.title: Add Claude Sonnet 4.5 support and improve end-turn tool guidance
43ea37285bc949353ca37b1490a8f0773dc6ac5d.summary: Added `anthropic/claude-4.5-sonnet` to OpenRouter model constants and provider order. Updated base agent definition and short model names to reference the new version. Improved `end-turn` tool description with explicit incorrect/correct usage examples. Enhanced error reporting in git evals judging failures.

d54351ceea1e4234a790c10db86b290f28e3211c.title: Add cache control for OpenAI and Anthropic models
d54351ceea1e4234a790c10db86b290f28e3211c.summary: supportsCacheControl in common/src/old-constants.ts now returns true for any model ID starting with 'openai/' or 'anthropic/'. This enables cache control for all models under these namespaces, bypassing the previous explicit definition requirement. The change applies to the core shared constants, affecting all surfaces using this helper. Unknown models outside these prefixes continue to default to false.

5dbf30d40c060361a702724debed8c886992a656.title: Refine agent docs and tool type definitions
5dbf30d40c060361a702724debed8c886992a656.summary: Updated custom agent documentation and type definitions to reflect current tooling.
