Removed deprecated planning and output control tools from type unions, consolidating `FileTools` into `FileEditingTools` and `TerminalTools`. Adjusted MCP config schemas to include `headers` in stdio transport. Revised template comments and model defaults in `my-custom-agent.ts` to align with active model versions like `x-ai/grok-4-fast`.

3620c288dfece6087a7f7d091063a55c3c2e4b4d.title: Dynamic Agent Definition Docs
3620c288dfece6087a7f7d091063a55c3c2e4b4d.summary: Docs now load `AgentDefinition.ts` content dynamically via `/api/docs/agent-definition`. Replaced static schema display with `AgentDefinitionDisplay` component in `agent-reference.mdx`. New route reads `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts` directly. `Logger` type import moved to `util-types` in `agent-template.ts`.

973aecfde121f57ce98402c67bfbee039783f032.title: Add Notion query and researcher agents
973aecfde121f57ce98402c67bfbee039783f032.summary: New `notion-query-agent` and `notion-researcher` definitions added to `.agents/`. Both use `x-ai/grok-4-fast` and connect to `@notionhq/notion-mcp-server`. The researcher orchestrates parallel spawning of query agents via `spawn_agents` tool.

0a0d56fe5f6deb0abb25441da2196a374dd1246a.title: MCP remote servers support custom headers
0a0d56fe5f6deb0abb25441da2196a374dd1246a.summary: Added `headers` field to `mcpConfigRemoteSchema` and `mcpConfigStdioSchema` in `types/mcp.ts` and `util-types.ts`. `getMCPClient` in `common/src/mcp/client.ts` now passes these headers to `StreamableHTTPClientTransport` and `SSEClientTransport` via `requestInit`. Enables authenticated access to remote MCP endpoints.

0ecce5c9e4d62760508c0f1312725cbd51607f7e.title: Update SDK README examples
0ecce5c9e4d62760508c0f1312725cbd51607f7e.summary: Updated sdk/README.md to use versioned agent IDs (codebuff/base@0.0.16) and changed the custom agent model example to x-ai/grok-4-fast. Added explicit toolNames field in AgentDefinition example and clarified custom agent/tool definition comments. Event logging examples now use JSON.stringify.

3620c288dfece6087a7f7d091063a55c3c2e4b4d.text: The online guide for the assistant's settings now updates automatically when the core rules change. This ensures the information you see always matches the latest version of the product.

358b711b30bff9759b631df733db5e27eaf1e56c.text: The internal planning tool now uses a different AI model to create plans. This change may slightly affect how quickly or accurately the tool generates steps for complex tasks.

a459d5072eef428cf02c25fa02de540920ddeb42.text: The instructions for setting up the first assistant had a typo in the name format. The guide now shows the correct way to type it, so following the steps will work without extra errors.

5dbf30d40c060361a702724debed8c886992a656.text: The assistant's settings and instructions were cleaned up to match current tools. You will see fewer outdated options and updated default choices.

973aecfde121f57ce98402c67bfbee039783f032.text: The assistant can now search and gather information from Notion pages more efficiently by working in parallel. This internal update helps the system find relevant notes faster, but does not change how you interact with the product.

875ca1fb96d29b5ea7af8fa7431dec52421d98ce.text: The assistant now uses a newer, more capable underlying engine. This small internal update may improve its reasoning and responses.

0a0d56fe5f6deb0abb25441da2196a374dd1246a.text: The app can now send special security keys with requests to online services. This lets you connect to protected services that require login details to work.

43ea37285bc949353ca37b1490a8f0773dc6ac5d.text: The assistant now uses a newer, more capable AI model. Instructions for finishing tasks were clarified to reduce mistakes. Error messages during internal testing are more helpful.

d54351ceea1e4234a790c10db86b290f28e3211c.text: The system now automatically recognizes features for certain new models. This means users can use these models without extra setup.

bba2125bb19edf0499fd32a8d808c682a46be6ee.title: Update recommended models in agent-definition.ts
bba2125bb19edf0499fd32a8d808c682a46be6ee.summary: Updated the `ModelName` union type in `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts` to reflect current model availability. Added Gemini 2.5 flash/flash-lite preview variants, Grok 4 fast free tier, and several Qwen3 models including max, coder-plus, and coder-flash. Normalized Anthropic Claude 4 Sonnet identifier from dated suffix to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4`. This ensures the initial agents directory template and type definitions match the active model catalog.

6c65de6819f6b14dba70c8a75eefcc7b92506b93.title: Fix typo in release CLI helpOption call
6c65de6819f6b14dba70c8a75eefcc7b92506b93.summary: Corrects `.helpOoption(false)` to `.helpOption(false)` in `npm-app/release/index.js`. The typo caused the release CLI to ignore the disable-help flag, potentially exposing unwanted help text or throwing errors during execution.

2f8cd0b79ba8bd56c167b4bf05eeaea8428948a1.title: Disable commander help option in release binary
2f8cd0b79ba8bd56c167b4bf05eeaea8428948a1.summary: Added `.helpOption(false)` to the `Command` instance in `npm-app/release/index.js`. This disables the built-in `--help` flag handling by Commander, redirecting help requests to the underlying binary as noted in the analysis. The change applies to the `codebuff` CLI entry point.

ef0502ca017e9e4a07924435b04db75d375ee7cb.title: Fix SDK sessionState override in CodebuffClient options
ef0502ca017e9e4a07924435b04db75d375ee7cb.summary: CodebuffClient constructor no longer pre-fills default options (cwd, maxAgentSteps, etc.) into this.options, preventing overrides of sessionState in run(). Type for options changed from Required<CodebuffClientOptions> to CodebuffClientOptions with explicit apiKey/fingerprintId. run() now applies defaults (process.cwd(), MAX_AGENT_STEPS_DEFAULT) and guards optional callbacks (handleEvent, handleStreamChunk) and objects (overrideTools, customToolDefinitions) with nullish coalescing. Affects sdk/src/client.ts and sdk/src/run.ts.

c8c024256c6cb507648ff71a950cc7cfad6686c2.title: base-max overhaul with implementation-planner-max
c8c024256c6cb507648ff71a950cc7cfad6686c2.summary: base-max agent switches model to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 and gains spawnableAgents including implementation-planner-max. New implementation-planner-max agent spawns 3 parallel implementation-planner agents then delegates selection to plan-selector. base-prompts adds isMax flag forcing implementation-planner-max spawn for medium/hard tasks. Scope covers .agents/base-max.ts, new .agents/implementation-planner/* files, and .agents/prompts/base-prompts.ts.

d41672194939af5698daaafd6a5aba046b8bbe8d.title: code-map queryPathOrContent, CodebuffRunner runState
d41672194939af5698daaafd6a5aba046b8bbe8d.summary: Renamed LanguageConfig.queryText to queryPathOrContent in packages/code-map/src/languages.ts to handle Bun's path-based query loading. Added fs.readFileSync check for absolute paths before Query instantiation. Updated evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts to assign this.runState immediately from client.run, removing redundant null check.

e9d593a3928418785a1ca9eef2d1d7807d91ce0b.title: Implementation Planner Max parallel count raised to 10
e9d593a3928418785a1ca9eef2d1d7807d91ce0b.summary: Implementation Planner Max spawns 10 parallel agents instead of 3. Plan Selector criteria shift to Completeness, Simplicity, Quality, Efficiency, Maintainability, Risk. Reasoning effort raised to medium. Files: .agents/implementation-planner/implementation-planner-max.ts, plan-selector.ts.

b77fcb25c22bcd14e9d2e16f28e70d2a6086da52.title: Update agent builder prompt and examples
b77fcb25c22bcd14e9d2e16f28e70d2a6086da52.summary: Refactored `agent-builder.ts` to dynamically load high-quality example agents (researcher, implementation-planner) into the system prompt. Updated instructions to prioritize agent composition, reuse of published store agents, and simplified input/output schemas. Removed static environment setup boilerplate in favor of direct project context awareness.

0ec2e79975f296601020169fd6c259534ccaa6bf.title: SDK auto-discovers project files via gitignore
0ec2e79975f296601020169fd6c259534ccaa6bf.summary: CodebuffClient now automatically discovers project files when projectFiles is undefined, using .gitignore patterns to filter content. This change modifies sdk/src/run-state.ts to integrate getProjectFileTree and getAllFilePaths, ensuring knowledge files are derived correctly without manual configuration. The update adds the 'ignore' dependency and includes new test suites for tree-sitter queries and SDK functionality in sdk/package.json and sdk/test.

ef0502ca017e9e4a07924435b04db75d375ee7cb.text: The assistant now correctly respects your custom settings instead of using default values that could block them.

bba2125bb19edf0499fd32a8d808c682a46be6ee.text: The list of AI models available for new agents was updated to include newer options and fix naming inconsistencies. This ensures the default setup matches current model availability.

b77fcb25c22bcd14e9d2e16f28e70d2a6086da52.text: The assistant now learns from good examples and existing tools to build better helpers. This makes creating new features easier and less repetitive.

6c65de6819f6b14dba70c8a75eefcc7b92506b93.text: A small fix corrects a typo in a release tool. The tool now works as intended without showing extra help text or errors.

d41672194939af5698daaafd6a5aba046b8bbe8d.text: The assistant can now load instructions from a file path. This fixes a minor internal issue.

c8c024256c6cb507648ff71a950cc7cfad6686c2.text: The system now uses a more capable assistant to handle complex tasks. It also checks multiple plans at once to pick the best one.

e9d593a3928418785a1ca9eef2d1d7807d91ce0b.text: The planning tool now uses ten helpers instead of three to create plans. It checks more options to find the best answer.

0ec2e79975f296601020169fd6c259534ccaa6bf.text: The tool now automatically finds your project files by skipping items marked to be ignored. You no longer need to manually list which files it should use.

2f8cd0b79ba8bd56c167b4bf05eeaea8428948a1.text: The command line tool now passes help requests directly to the underlying program instead of showing its own help menu.

3c7a755b150f47bf64c947f062c70ce093a6f20e.title: Add MCP SDK dependency to common package
3c7a755b150f47bf64c947f062c70ce093a6f20e.summary: Added `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` (^1.18.2) to `common/package.json` dependencies. Prepares core module for Model Context Protocol integration.

3fbf6fbab9c3d5ff80e3644e90d58a269a4e1852.title: JSONObject type uses mapped key syntax
3fbf6fbab9c3d5ff80e3644e90d58a269a4e1852.summary: The `JSONObject` type definition in `common/src/types/json.ts` changed from `{ [key: string]: JSONValue }` to `{ [key in string]: JSONValue }`. This aligns the index signature with standard TypeScript mapped types, similar to `Record`. The change affects only the type definition; no runtime behavior or schema validation (`jsonObjectSchema`) is modified.

55dbd5b724660edb3ae2089c091d318bb8aade5f.title: Update agent template test fixtures for mcpServers
55dbd5b724660edb3ae2089c091d318bb8aade5f.summary: Added `mcpServers: {}` to `AgentTemplate` fixtures in `cost-aggregation.integration.test.ts` and `main-prompt.test.ts`. Applied `satisfies AgentTemplate` to enforce type correctness. Updated assertion in `malformed-tool-call.test.ts` to match new error string 'Tool unknown_tool not found'. Internal test maintenance.

6ec38f475fdf58a64ec30ab716f13fa972a49123.title: Rename generic arg in getCustomToolDefinition
6ec38f475fdf58a64ec30ab716f13fa972a49123.summary: Renamed generic type parameter `ToolName` to `TN` in `getCustomToolDefinition` to prevent type rollup errors. Updated internal references and error messages to use `TN` and imported `ToolName` directly. Scope limited to `sdk/src/custom-tool.ts`. Error message now includes specific Codebuff team guidance for name conflicts.

aab8e78da45bcce60dca96fc8844099e9b2a6c9a.title: Fix SDK type tests
aab8e78da45bcce60dca96fc8844099e9b2a6c9a.summary: Updated `test-types.ts` in `cjs-compatibility` and `esm-compatibility`. Adjusted imports, removed semicolons, and simplified generic usage for `getCustomToolDefinition`. Scope limited to SDK test files.

db7219b6aaa0393878700d422abdc9921fc4d956.title: Improve hero section responsiveness on smaller screens
db7219b6aaa0393878700d422abdc9921fc4d956.summary: Refactored hero layout and typography to fit better on mobile. Replaced fixed height with min-height using dvh in `Section`, removed nested `Section` wrapper in `Hero`, and adjusted heading styles for proper text shaping and wrapping. Updated `IDEDemo` font classes and spacing.

8ec81740a15d8d26e36294d859936ecbc8d0bdc9.title: Add mcpServers to spawn-agents-permissions test fixture
8ec81740a15d8d26e36294d859936ecbc8d0bdc9.summary: Added empty mcpServers object to test fixture in backend/src/__tests__/spawn-agents-permissions.test.ts. Fixes typecheck failure caused by missing required field. Internal test-only change.

f90d544edc648043e312106e70b37161ff11bb20.title: SDK version 0.3.2 to 0.3.3
f90d544edc648043e312106e70b37161ff11bb20.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk version to 0.3.3 in sdk/package.json. Routine version increment for the official SDK.

c2d4eb320cca5c35bca24e82ff9c634af2faea5d.title: Streaming logger for programmatic agent steps
c2d4eb320cca5c35bca24e82ff9c634af2faea5d.summary: Added `logger` interface to `AgentStepContext` and `handleSteps` generator, enabling real-time debug/info/warn/error logs from agent code. Backend `runProgrammatic-step.ts` injects streaming logger that sends `handlesteps-log-chunk` actions to frontend via WebSocket. QuickJS sandbox exposes `_loggerHandler` for string-based generators to call native logging. Affects `.agents/types`, `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`, `backend/src/util/quickjs-sandbox.ts`, `common/src/actions.ts`.

3827ca8068cbbf8e9617771fb87c2aad118cf0d9.title: Add MCP support to agent definitions and backend
3827ca8068cbbf8e9617771fb87c2aad118cf0d9.summary: Added Model Context Protocol (MCP) support to agent definitions and backend. New `MCPConfig` types allow defining stdio or remote (http/sse) servers in `AgentDefinition`. Backend `getMCPToolData` dynamically fetches tool schemas from configured servers and injects them into prompts via `additionalToolDefinitions`. Tools are namespaced as `serverName/toolName`. Scope: `common/src/types/mcp.ts`, `backend/src/mcp/util.ts`, `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`.

3fbf6fbab9c3d5ff80e3644e90d58a269a4e1852.text: A small, internal update to the app's blueprint. Nothing changes for you or how the app works.

8ec81740a15d8d26e36294d859936ecbc8d0bdc9.text: A small internal update fixed a problem in the testing setup. This change has no impact on how you use the product.

3c7a755b150f47bf64c947f062c70ce093a6f20e.text: The team added a small internal tool to help the product work with new AI systems. This change does not affect you yet.

55dbd5b724660edb3ae2089c091d318bb8aade5f.text: A small internal update added missing details to the assistant's setup files. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

db7219b6aaa0393878700d422abdc9921fc4d956.text: The top banner on the home page now adjusts its size and text layout to fit better on smaller phone screens. This internal visual update ensures content displays cleanly without cutting off or overlapping.

c2d4eb320cca5c35bca24e82ff9c634af2faea5d.text: The assistant now shares its internal thoughts and status updates as they happen. This lets you see what it is doing in real time.

aab8e78da45bcce60dca96fc8844099e9b2a6c9a.text: The software's internal tests were updated to match its current features.

6ec38f475fdf58a64ec30ab716f13fa972a49123.text: Fixed a naming conflict in the software's internal setup. This prevents occasional errors when adding custom tools.

f90d544edc648043e312106e70b37161ff11bb20.text: The software received a routine update. This change affects only internal systems and requires no action from you.

a57a6e9232d5fa9fdfc595eeba4679364aa8600e.title: Stop emitting SDK sourcemaps and declaration maps
a57a6e9232d5fa9fdfc595eeba4679364aa8600e.summary: Removed `sourcemap: 'external'` from ESM/CJS build targets in `sdk/scripts/build.ts` and disabled `declarationMap` in `sdk/tsconfig.json` and `sdk/tsconfig.build.json`. This stops generating `.map` files alongside the SDK `dist` output. Scope limited to SDK build configuration. Reduces published package size by excluding map files.

cf5fa9ce2a6ce5a84d81a85e252f75f3ad5fd80a.title: SDK 0.3.2 simplify README examples
cf5fa9ce2a6ce5a84d81a85e252f75f3ad5fd80a.summary: Bump @codebuff/sdk to 0.3.2. Simplify sdk/README.md by removing verbose console logs, clarifying handleEvent comments, and restructuring error/output handling in examples. Scope: sdk/README.md, sdk/package.json. Detail: cwd marked optional in second example.

b63f3373cf2e1bd926511d53c065af014c1f3b8d.title: sdk.run() returns RunState instead of null on errors
b63f3373cf2e1bd926511d53c065af014c1f3b8d.summary: sdk.run() and CodebuffClient.run() now return Promise<RunState> instead of Promise<RunState | null>. Error paths in run.ts resolve with a structured RunState containing sessionState and an error output object, replacing null returns. Scope covers sdk/src/client.ts and sdk/src/run.ts. handlePromptResponse propagates initialSessionState to error resolutions.

232bdd1042bdbe3d4a9984634cbfc81d889ce924.title: open package replaces spawn in npm-app client
232bdd1042bdbe3d4a9984634cbfc81d889ce924.summary: Added `open` package to `npm-app/package.json` and replaced platform-specific `spawn` calls with `await open(loginUrl)` in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Switches to a cross-platform URL opener for reliable browser launching across Windows, macOS, and Linux during login. Scope limited to `npm-app` client logic.

6738315292b23625abf3ef87f6b502b85f27213c.title: Remove Suspense wrapper from Agent Store page
6738315292b23625abf3ef87f6b502b85f27213c.summary: Refactor `web/src/app/store/page.tsx` to remove the `<Suspense>` boundary and associated loading skeleton. `StorePage` now directly fetches data and renders `AgentStoreClient`, eliminating the intermediate `AgentsDataProvider`. This change tests if removing suspense prevents double load issues.

4a3511f1d7e763642926e8362f0b66b329970393.title: Referral banner text update
4a3511f1d7e763642926e8362f0b66b329970393.summary: Updated referral code banner text in `web/src/components/onboard/onboarding-flow.tsx` to guide users through redemption steps.

93ae8bc2a945091b9121a29cb5a7f86f6281f325.title: Multi-column layout for custom agents in load-agents.ts
93ae8bc2a945091b9121a29cb5a7f86f6281f325.summary: The `displayLoadedAgents` function in `npm-app/src/agents/load-agents.ts` now formats loaded custom agents into a multi-column grid instead of a single comma-separated line. The layout dynamically calculates `terminalWidth` from `process.stdout.columns` (defaulting to 80) and derives `columnWidth` from the longest agent name plus padding. This change saves vertical space when many custom agents are loaded.

17d52d9f1ddef72f79f223695292607f7c05f89c.title: @codebuff/sdk 0.3.1 removes null return from run
17d52d9f1ddef72f79f223695292607f7c05f89c.summary: @codebuff/sdk 0.3.1 changes `CodebuffClient.run` to return an object with `output.type === 'error'` instead of `null` on failure. README examples updated to check `run1.output.type` and use `zod/v4` imports. Breaking change for error handling logic in existing integrations.

6d42091e2faa4f5c79eee73cc40ee4d28d9a6bb2.title: Release script uses CODEBUFFGITHUBTOKEN instead of GitHub App JWT
6d42091e2faa4f5c79eee73cc40ee4d28d9a6bb2.summary: Release mechanism now reads `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN` directly. Removed `npm-app/scripts/generate-github-token.ts` and its JWT/openssl logic from `npm-app/scripts/release.js`. `checkGitHubToken` validates the env var and maps it to `GITHUB_TOKEN` for curl compatibility. Documented in `knowledge.md`.

232bdd1042bdbe3d4a9984634cbfc81d889ce924.text: The login process now uses a standard tool to open your web browser. This makes signing in more reliable on all computers.

6738315292b23625abf3ef87f6b502b85f27213c.text: Developers adjusted how the agent store loads its content. This internal update tests if the page loads correctly without showing extra loading steps.

93ae8bc2a945091b9121a29cb5a7f86f6281f325.text: The list of custom agents now displays in columns instead of a single line. This makes the screen easier to read when many agents are loaded.

cf5fa9ce2a6ce5a84d81a85e252f75f3ad5fd80a.text: The instructions for using the assistant are now clearer and shorter. This update does not change how the product works.

17d52d9f1ddef72f79f223695292607f7c05f89c.text: When the assistant fails, it now shows a clear error message instead of nothing. Apps built with this tool must update their checks to see these errors.

6d42091e2faa4f5c79eee73cc40ee4d28d9a6bb2.text: The tool used to publish updates now checks for permission in a simpler way. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for users.

a57a6e9232d5fa9fdfc595eeba4679364aa8600e.text: The software now ships smaller files. This change only affects the size of the download.

4a3511f1d7e763642926e8362f0b66b329970393.text: The sign offering referral rewards now shows clearer steps for claiming them. This small update helps users understand how to redeem their codes.

b63f3373cf2e1bd926511d53c065af014c1f3b8d.text: The assistant now sends back a clear error message instead of nothing when something goes wrong. This means you will see what failed and why, rather than just a blank result.

937f3aef56c009ecdd48ae68593c83c2cd76b6b3.title: Navbar auth UI flicker fix
937f3aef56c009ecdd48ae68593c83c2cd76b6b3.summary: Defers auth UI rendering in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx` until session resolution completes. Replaces boolean `isSessionReady` check with direct `status !== 'loading'` logic and adds `Skeleton` component for loading state. Fixes hydration mismatch and visual flicker during initial load.

0a303c15bb5b3805ff12f94d1b858cfa5e00117c.title: Add Suspense boundaries to profile and new publisher pages
0a303c15bb5b3805ff12f94d1b858cfa5e00117c.summary: Wrapped `ProfilePage` and `CreatePublisherPage` in `Suspense` boundaries. This prevents hydration and build errors caused by `useSearchParams` usage in client components without a fallback. The change applies to `web/src/app/profile/page.tsx` and `web/src/app/publishers/new/page.tsx`. Skeleton loaders serve as fallbacks during the suspense state.

9a081a74e4684c0770c984e63b80dc103d47b11e.title: Allow base agents to spawn any agent
9a081a74e4684c0770c984e63b80dc103d47b11e.summary: Base agents (`base`, `base-lite`, `base-max`, `base-experimental`) bypass `spawnableAgents` validation in `validateAndGetAgentTemplate`. This allows them to spawn any agent type without explicit configuration. Change scoped to `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts`.

e19f097a032f8b691751589bec7f348684af5683.title: Navbar defers auth UI until session resolves
e19f097a032f8b691751589bec7f348684af5683.summary: web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx now uses useSession instead of getServerSession, gating auth-dependent UI behind isSessionReady. This prevents hydration errors in ISR by ensuring server-rendered markup matches the client state during session loading. Scope limited to the web navbar component.

57fe4878aeb00ff3c9a09fa7fc920efce81c0ad9.title: Expose run.ts types from SDK index
57fe4878aeb00ff3c9a09fa7fc920efce81c0ad9.summary: Added `export type * from './run'` to `sdk/src/index.ts`. This exposes types defined in `run.ts` to SDK consumers. The change is limited to the SDK's public type surface.

c3782ed681722b82b1f051de41f61503a1b88090.title: Fix agent validation by including version
c3782ed681722b82b1f051de41f61503a1b88090.summary: Fix bug in `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts` where fetched agents failed validation. The `validateSingleAgent` call now includes `version` in the raw agent data object. This ensures agents retrieved from the database pass schema validation.

4f5be7d3fa2bcdae47b3f4fe5d36ad6d39aca23c.title: Add base-lite-codex agent definition
4f5be7d3fa2bcdae47b3f4fe5d36ad6d39aca23c.summary: New agent definition `base-lite-codex` added in `.agents/base-lite-codex.ts`. Extends `base-lite` with `model: 'openai/gpt-5-codex'` and `reasoningOptions: { enabled: true, effort: 'medium' }`. Internal change scoped to `.agents` directory.

50195d8e16652bc4a47f7fe98d7734a4cb443ea7.title: Include weeklyruns in agent metrics API and UI
50195d8e16652bc4a47f7fe98d7734a4cb443ea7.summary: Added weekly_runs to SQL aggregation in web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts and propagated through web/src/app/store/agents-data.ts. Updated web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/agent-usage-metrics.tsx and web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx to display weekly runs alongside weekly spend. Fixed weekly metrics showing total: include weekly_runs in data.

88cc7bfb2f724ceaa5fe526249535c48b9c81920.title: lookupagentinfo tool added for agent ID resolution
88cc7bfb2f724ceaa5fe526249535c48b9c81920.summary: New `lookup_agent_info` tool enables agents to retrieve metadata for published agent IDs. Handler validates ID existence and returns schema details via `getAgentTemplate`. Registered in core tool constants and base agent factory. `ReadDocsParams` updated: `topic` now required, `max_tokens` default raised to 20000.

b4d321ea165cad7843a03d33175ae27b9a852895.title: Fix Store page SSG and Navbar auth rendering
b4d321ea165cad7843a03d33175ae27b9a852895.summary: Store page static generation corrected by isolating agent data fetching into `web/src/app/store/agents-data.ts` with explicit 600s ISR revalidation tags, removing conflicting `fetchCache` directives from `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`. Navbar refactored to a server component using `getServerSession` in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`, deleting `web/src/components/navbar/client-auth-nav.tsx` to eliminate client-side hydration mismatches and dynamic import overhead. Added `web/src/lib/revalidation.ts` for centralized tag-based cache invalidation.

e19f097a032f8b691751589bec7f348684af5683.text: The top menu now waits for login details to load before showing account options. This fixes a visual glitch where the menu briefly looked wrong after the page loaded. The change is internal and only affects the navigation bar.

57fe4878aeb00ff3c9a09fa7fc920efce81c0ad9.text: The software now shares more detailed instructions with other programs. This helps those programs understand how to use the new features correctly.

b4d321ea165cad7843a03d33175ae27b9a852895.text: The store page loads faster and more reliably. The login menu shows the correct options immediately without flickering.

4f5be7d3fa2bcdae47b3f4fe5d36ad6d39aca23c.text: The assistant can now use a new model that thinks more carefully before answering. This is a small internal change.

9a081a74e4684c0770c984e63b80dc103d47b11e.text: A basic assistant can now use any available tool without needing extra setup.

c3782ed681722b82b1f051de41f61503a1b88090.text: Fixed a small internal error that stopped some saved assistants from working. All assistants should now load and run correctly.

0a303c15bb5b3805ff12f94d1b858cfa5e00117c.text: Fixed a hidden technical issue that could cause errors when loading profile and publisher creation pages. Users may experience smoother page loading with visible placeholders while content appears.

88cc7bfb2f724ceaa5fe526249535c48b9c81920.text: The assistant can now look up details about other assistants. This helps it find the right helper for a task. It also shows more helpful text by default.

50195d8e16652bc4a47f7fe98d7734a4cb443ea7.text: The usage report now includes a count of weekly tasks alongside spending. This shows how many times the assistant was used each week.

937f3aef56c009ecdd48ae68593c83c2cd76b6b3.text: The login menu no longer flashes or changes size when the page loads. This small internal fix makes the interface look steadier.

c302ee664192f47477ef81dc8cbd3b97566466d4.title: Eval prompting agent and codebuff runner typecheck fix
c302ee664192f47477ef81dc8cbd3b97566466d4.summary: Eval git runners updated. `prompting-agent.ts` captures `event.message` into `lastErrorMessage`, returning a `halt` decision if `client.run` yields null. `codebuff.ts` removes the `onError` throw handler, tracks errors via `handleEvent`, and throws only if `run` is null. Scope limited to `evals/git-evals`.

cc127b8d4a3b7a2a184e64603b505d023d4c9fe8.title: Persist tool errors in message history
cc127b8d4a3b7a2a184e64603b505d023d4c9fe8.summary: Tool errors now persist in message history via `toolResultsToAddAfterStream`. `run-agent-step.ts` adds explicit `Message[]` typing to `expireMessages`. `stream-parser.ts` imports `cloneDeep` to safely append `ToolMessage` objects post-stream. Internal backend refactor.

f936c23a7f2949d88caa1ceec39618baa046c89c.title: Remove debug console.log from stream parser
f936c23a7f2949d88caa1ceec39618baa046c89c.summary: Removed extraneous `console.log` statement from `processStreamWithTools` in `backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`. This cleans up noisy debug output during stream processing. Scope limited to backend stream parser. No functional changes to tool call processing or response handling.

a6578ab91bc012766c77409f5ade42c6b9e19cbe.title: Removed debug log from async-agent-manager
a6578ab91bc012766c77409f5ade42c6b9e19cbe.summary: Commented out 'Cleaned up session agents' debug log in `backend/src/async-agent-manager.ts`. Reduces noise during session agent cleanup. Internal change to logging verbosity.

f02a7c97178c2c26cf1945adbcc1c610e2d5ecbf.title: Remove agent store loading skeleton
f02a7c97178c2c26cf1945adbcc1c610e2d5ecbf.summary: Deleted web/src/app/store/loading.tsx. Removed generateStaticParams from web/src/app/store/page.tsx. Initialized displayedCount to 24 in web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx. Eliminates skeleton flash for static store page.

2ba83d6f2b6309166d7ce9651e2f9cc7c5017f73.title: Add malformed tool call unit tests
2ba83d6f2b6309166d7ce9651e2f9cc7c5017f73.summary: Added `backend/src/__tests__/malformed-tool-call.test.ts` covering `processStreamWithTools` edge cases. Tests verify error handling for invalid JSON, unknown tools, and mixed valid/invalid streams. Ensures tool result errors correctly populate message history and `toolResults` array.

3e3516db79eb7d4d1c78068c6055a0422f907602.title: Navbar auth components switch to client-side dynamic imports
3e3516db79eb7d4d1c78068c6055a0422f907602.summary: Navbar.tsx replaces server-side getServerSession with client-only dynamic imports of ClientAuthNav, ClientUsageLink, and ClientMobileUsageLink. New client-auth-nav.tsx uses useSession hook to handle auth state, rendering null during loading to prevent SSR conflicts. This enables SSG compatibility for the agent store while introducing an on-load jump for authenticated users. Desktop layout reserves min-w-[50px] to mitigate initial layout shift.

348327c308dbf8213b90930567fa01e6a2e43504.title: Add --spawn CLI flag for agent ID
348327c308dbf8213b90930567fa01e6a2e43504.summary: Adds `--spawn <agent-id>` CLI flag to npm-app, mapping to initial input `@agent-id`. Updates `baseAgentUserInputPrompt` to recognize `@agent-id` syntax and use `lookup_agent_info` for metadata. Scope covers `npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts`, `npm-app/src/index.ts`, `npm-app/src/types.ts`, and `.agents/prompts/base-prompts.ts`. Flag prepends `@<id>` to `initialInput` before CLI instance initialization.

e8b77f4dd8a78030e4eb7d5e899c9bdba9b5e557.title: init-worktree copies Infisical config
e8b77f4dd8a78030e4eb7d5e899c9bdba9b5e557.summary: scripts/init-worktree.ts now copies .infisical.json from project root to new worktrees via copyFileSync. Prevents missing config when bootstrapping worktrees. If root file absent, warns to run infisical init.

79d51fed4589d252018daf3777dad93fefe52ac9.title: Merge agent-guide.md into README.md
79d51fed4589d252018daf3777dad93fefe52ac9.summary: Merged agent-guide.md content into common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/README.md. Deleted agent-guide.md. Consolidates documentation into single file.

3e3516db79eb7d4d1c78068c6055a0422f907602.text: The website now checks if you are logged in after the page loads instead of before. Logged-in users might see a brief empty space in the top menu that quickly fills in with your account details.

a6578ab91bc012766c77409f5ade42c6b9e19cbe.text: A small internal update removed a hidden system message that appeared during background cleanup. This change reduces clutter in the system's records without affecting how the product works for you.

f02a7c97178c2c26cf1945adbcc1c610e2d5ecbf.text: The store page no longer flashes a placeholder while loading. This small internal change makes the page appear complete immediately.

c302ee664192f47477ef81dc8cbd3b97566466d4.text: A small internal fix improved how the system detects and reports errors when running automated checks. This helps ensure that failures are caught correctly, making the evaluation process more reliable.

2ba83d6f2b6309166d7ce9651e2f9cc7c5017f73.text: The team added safety checks to handle broken requests. This helps the assistant recover gracefully instead of crashing when it receives confusing instructions.

f936c23a7f2949d88caa1ceec39618baa046c89c.text: We removed extra internal messages that appeared in the background while the assistant processed your requests. This change cleans up the system's behind-the-scenes activity but does not affect how the assistant responds to you.

348327c308dbf8213b90930567fa01e6a2e43504.text: A new setting lets users pick a helper by name when starting the tool. This means the assistant can begin a conversation focused on that specific helper without extra steps.

e8b77f4dd8a78030e4eb7d5e899c9bdba9b5e557.text: The setup tool now automatically copies a hidden settings file to new workspaces. This stops errors from missing files when starting a new project.

cc127b8d4a3b7a2a184e64603b505d023d4c9fe8.text: The system now saves records of errors when tools fail during a conversation. This internal update helps the assistant better understand past issues, but does not change how you interact with it.

4101de8d3133d6f28bd1e3cf4036e89fbf98ad9a.title: Enable SSG for store page
4101de8d3133d6f28bd1e3cf4036e89fbf98ad9a.summary: Enables Static Site Generation (SSG) for the store page by adding `force-static` and `force-cache` exports in `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`. Introduces a loading skeleton component `web/src/app/store/loading.tsx` to handle static rendering states. Optimizes the agents API cache headers in `web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts` by adjusting `max-age` to 300s, increasing `stale-while-revalidate` to 3600s, and explicitly setting `Content-Type`.

75db11d044131e8b21a6a2a79cb055195bb8c4b2.title: AgentStore: Reduce motion animation usage
75db11d044131e8b21a6a2a79cb055195bb8c4b2.summary: AgentStore page replaces Framer Motion with CSS transitions in virtualized lists to improve performance. Data normalization via `select` prevents reference changes and precomputes sort fields. `getAgentsForRow` refactored to compute rows on-demand instead of pre-building `allAgentsRows`.

24d738b56c7b9032b26da7d3c6f96ce6aa5d9477.title: Switch Agent Store to SSG with 10-minute revalidation
24d738b56c7b9032b26da7d3c6f96ce6aa5d9477.summary: Agent Store page and API route now use static generation with 10-minute ISR revalidation instead of 60-second dynamic rendering. Server-side session fetching removed from page.tsx; client handles auth via useSession. New RelativeTime component replaces formatRelativeTime to avoid hydration mismatches during SSG. Cache headers updated to max-age=600, s-maxage=600, stale-while-revalidate=600.

7144de66ec0b48661cefdf6f12d6cebd2fb927dd.title: SDK bumped to v0.2.4
7144de66ec0b48661cefdf6f12d6cebd2fb927dd.summary: Version in `sdk/package.json` increased from 0.2.3 to 0.2.4. This is a routine dependency bump for the `@codebuff/sdk` package. No functional changes or new APIs are introduced in this diff.

b23bc94258b930de94dd1cd24e13486fcb57942c.title: Improve agent store list virtualization and layout
b23bc94258b930de94dd1cd24e13486fcb57942c.summary: Refactored `web/src/app/store/page.tsx` to improve virtualization performance and mobile responsiveness. Implemented dynamic overscan calculation based on device type (mobile/touch vs desktop) and added measurement caching with debounced resize/orientation listeners. UI adjustments include enforcing consistent card minimum heights to reduce layout shifts, hiding the version badge, moving tags to a different location or removing them from the card body, and hiding the copy button on mobile viewports.

36d2e3111661b2dcc14e70621317665a184c7a91.title: Remove Framer Motion from agent store cards
36d2e3111661b2dcc14e70621317665a184c7a91.summary: Drops framer-motion and AnimatedElement imports from web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx. Replaces motion-based transitions with standard CSS transition-colors and duration-150 utilities on Card, Avatar, and icon elements. Simplifies the component tree by removing redundant wrapper divs and inline style objects. Covers the agent store card rendering logic.

9e00a78856a5a9a4bde9a03049007a6522123e59.title: Force static rendering for agent store
9e00a78856a5a9a4bde9a03049007a6522123e59.summary: Next.js agent store page and API route switched to force-static rendering with generateStaticParams for common sorts. Suspense wrapper and skeleton removed; store-client now gates publisher UI on sessionStatus !== 'loading' to prevent hydration mismatches. ITEMS_PER_PAGE increased from 12 to 24. Files: web/next.config.mjs, web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts, web/src/app/store/page.tsx, web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx.

ec1acfbea24e178c1f0d43dbbc566fbb238bcd95.title: SDK build bundles types into single index.d.ts
ec1acfbea24e178c1f0d43dbbc566fbb238bcd95.summary: SDK build script replaces tsc declaration generation with dts-bundle-generator to create a single dist/index.d.ts. fixDuplicateImports removes redundant zod default imports from the bundled types. Adds test:typecheck-strict script to verify strict type checking on the generated definitions. Scope limited to sdk/package.json and sdk/scripts/build.ts.

5260144d060b2c381010cf1ca060693304002c37.title: SDK v0.3.0 introduces new CodebuffClient interface
5260144d060b2c381010cf1ca060693304002c37.summary: SDK v0.3.0 replaces the `CodebuffClient` implementation with a new `run` function in `sdk/src/run.ts`. `client.ts` now delegates to this new interface, removing direct WebSocket handling and tool execution logic from the client class. `custom-tool.ts` updates `CustomToolDefinition` to enforce `ToolResultOutput[]` returns and blocks reserved tool names via type constraints. The README example demonstrates the new `previousRun` chaining pattern for session continuity.

0eed7b6589e7b36cd6e6cd9ae178c2fa5a515632.title: Agent Store page adopts server components with static generation
0eed7b6589e7b36cd6e6cd9ae178c2fa5a515632.summary: Refactored web/src/app/store/page.tsx into a server component that fetches initial data via getServerSession and unstable_cache, delegating UI to a new web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx. This static generation approach reduces client-side hydration overhead and improves initial load performance by pre-rendering agent lists. The change isolates interactive state (search, sort) in the client component while keeping data fetching server-side.

7144de66ec0b48661cefdf6f12d6cebd2fb927dd.text: The software received a routine internal update. No new features or changes affect how the product works for users.

b23bc94258b930de94dd1cd24e13486fcb57942c.text: The store page now loads faster and fits better on phones. Cards keep a steady size so the view stays calm while scrolling.

9e00a78856a5a9a4bde9a03049007a6522123e59.text: The agent store loads as a fixed page instead of updating live. This change prevents display glitches but keeps the user experience identical.

ec1acfbea24e178c1f0d43dbbc566fbb238bcd95.text: The tool now packages all its instructions into one single file for easier use. This internal change helps the software run more smoothly but does not add new features for you.

4101de8d3133d6f28bd1e3cf4036e89fbf98ad9a.text: The store page now loads faster and shows a placeholder while content appears. This is an internal update that improves the browsing experience.

36d2e3111661b2dcc14e70621317665a184c7a91.text: The visual effects on the store cards were simplified to use standard styling. This small internal change keeps the appearance the same but makes the code easier to maintain.

24d738b56c7b9032b26da7d3c6f96ce6aa5d9477.text: The Agent Store page now refreshes its content every ten minutes instead of every minute. This change makes the site faster and less likely to show errors.

75db11d044131e8b21a6a2a79cb055195bb8c4b2.text: The assistant's list of agents now loads and scrolls faster because the app uses a simpler way to create movement effects.

200ee742891daf817accd2e169856c6138347812.title: SDK 0.2.3 relaxes ws dependency to caret range
200ee742891daf817accd2e169856c6138347812.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk to 0.2.3. Changed ws dependency from exact 8.18.0 to ^8.18.0. Affects sdk/package.json. Allows automatic minor/patch updates for WebSocket transport.

6cc189012b7e1f789d1ab4205c64d60b5306b00a.title: Fix typecheck in prompting-agent.ts
6cc189012b7e1f789d1ab4205c64d60b5306b00a.summary: Changed `CodebuffClient` import to `import type` and set `next_prompt` fallback to empty string in `evals/git-evals/prompting-agent.ts`. Fixes typecheck errors.

2e933cf93a18c26f4475cc448db5fa89ae5f7c05.title: Fix stream parser to use tagged stream and add debug logs
2e933cf93a18c26f4475cc448db5fa89ae5f7c05.summary: stream-parser.ts now iterates `streamWithTags` instead of `stream` in `processStreamWithTools`. Added `console.log` dumping `toolCalls`, `toolResults`, `state`, and response chunks before return. Internal backend fix; no user-facing behavior change.

30f6fec087d67ef5eefb8a98394652cdf9ed4351.title: Remove typesVersions from SDK package.json
30f6fec087d67ef5eefb8a98394652cdf9ed4351.summary: Dropped `typesVersions` field from `sdk/package.json`. Relies on standard `exports` map for type resolution. Internal packaging cleanup.

4839d9d8c7ff22ecb76d21160ec650ea5e7833b1.title: Fix agent-run test expectation for messageid
4839d9d8c7ff22ecb76d21160ec650ea5e7833b1.summary: Updated `backend/src/__tests__/agent-run.test.ts` to expect `null` instead of `undefined` for the `message_id` field in the `Agent Run Database Functions` test suite. This aligns the test assertion with the actual database function behavior, which returns `null` for missing message IDs rather than leaving the property undefined.

02e75684b4c2ef0f4086c3c69f34e137baf5fef3.title: SDK bundles ripgrep binaries, drops @vscode/ripgrep
02e75684b4c2ef0f4086c3c69f34e137baf5fef3.summary: The SDK now vendors ripgrep 14.1.1 binaries for x64/arm64 on Windows/macOS/Linux, replacing the `@vscode/ripgrep` dependency. A new `scripts/fetch-ripgrep.ts` downloads and extracts these binaries into `sdk/vendor/ripgrep/`, which `scripts/build.ts` copies to `dist/vendor/ripgrep/` during build. The `sdk/src/native/ripgrep.ts` module resolves the binary path at runtime via `getBundledRgPath()`, supporting ESM/CJS contexts and an optional `CODEBUFF_RG_PATH` override. `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts` uses this new resolver, and `sdk/src/index.ts` exports `ToolHelpers` and the native ripgrep utilities.

ee5733dc8b0bc3939eb82202bc411ce352182bab.title: grok 4 fast replaces gemini 2.5 flash in git evals
ee5733dc8b0bc3939eb82202bc411ce352182bab.summary: Git evals prompter model switched from `models.openrouter_gemini2_5_flash` to `x-ai/grok-4-fast:free` in `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`. `AgentDecisionSchema` in `evals/git-evals/types.ts` updated to make `next_prompt` required string instead of optional. Fallback logic simplified to `next_prompt || 'continue'` for continue decisions. Internal evals only; no user-facing changes.

f4acf8077f22e390c9b79fe20a2af5a08ca995ed.title: SDK package.json cleanup and build script path fix
f4acf8077f22e390c9b79fe20a2af5a08ca995ed.summary: Removed redundant `access` and `typings` fields from `@codebuff/sdk` package.json. Added `typesVersions` mapping to support subpath type resolution. Moved `build.ts` to `scripts/` and updated the `build` script path. Removed `prepublishOnly` script, relying on `prepack` for build execution.

d3815aa253ea421df8ee8266f46d40413189591c.title: SDK 0.2.2 adds ws dependency
d3815aa253ea421df8ee8266f46d40413189591c.summary: SDK bumped to 0.2.2. Added ws 8.18.0 to runtime dependencies in sdk/package.json. Build script externalizes ws plus related Node modules (bufferutil, utf-8-validate, http, https, net, tls, url, events) in sdk/scripts/build.ts.

099efeb6465994fec9d67eaa1c8ee466f19b70e3.title: Return messageId from stream generators instead of Promise resolve
099efeb6465994fec9d67eaa1c8ee466f19b70e3.summary: The `promptAiSdkStream` generator now returns `messageId` directly upon completion, replacing the side-effectful `resolveMessageId` callback and `messageIdPromise` pattern. Callers in `run-agent-step.ts` and `processStreamWithTools` consume this return value via manual `stream.next()` loops to capture the ID without race conditions. Type signatures for `addAgentStep` and related state objects updated to accept `string | null` for `messageId`. This refactoring simplifies async coordination in `backend/src/agent-run.ts` and `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`.

02e75684b4c2ef0f4086c3c69f34e137baf5fef3.text: The software now includes its own search tool instead of relying on an external one. This makes the product more self-contained and reliable for users.

6cc189012b7e1f789d1ab4205c64d60b5306b00a.text: This internal fix corrects a background error check. It does not change how the product works for you.

30f6fec087d67ef5eefb8a98394652cdf9ed4351.text: The software now uses a standard method to find its instructions. This is a small cleanup inside the product that does not change how you use it.

4839d9d8c7ff22ecb76d21160ec650ea5e7833b1.text: A small internal update fixed how the system checks for missing data. Users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

ee5733dc8b0bc3939eb82202bc411ce352182bab.text: The system switched to a different AI engine for internal tests. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2e933cf93a18c26f4475cc448db5fa89ae5f7c05.text: The system now tracks tool usage more accurately internally. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

099efeb6465994fec9d67eaa1c8ee466f19b70e3.text: The assistant now waits for a message to finish before saving its reference number. This prevents the system from losing track of the conversation during complex tasks.

f4acf8077f22e390c9b79fe20a2af5a08ca995ed.text: The software's internal setup files were cleaned up to fix how it finds certain features and build tools. This change is small and happens behind the scenes, so users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

200ee742891daf817accd2e169856c6138347812.text: The software now accepts a wider range of updates for its communication tool, allowing it to automatically use newer, compatible versions.

d3815aa253ea421df8ee8266f46d40413189591c.text: The software now includes a new part that lets it connect to live internet services. This change adds a standard networking tool to the background, allowing the product to receive real-time updates without extra setup.

a69f1398a49bd7c3dba880a9d6b53e60dce4eedd.title: Fix custom tool types in SDK v0.2.1
a69f1398a49bd7c3dba880a9d6b53e60dce4eedd.summary: SDK v0.2.1 fixes type definitions for custom tools by relaxing generic constraints from `Record<string, unknown>` to `any` and correcting the Zod import to `import { z } from 'zod/v4'`. This change addresses type errors preventing valid tool definitions from compiling. The update affects `sdk/src/custom-tool.ts` and bumps the package version in `sdk/package.json`.

aa88ea714c5165826eddf572167f53bcdfa3602a.title: Fix agents page link in README
aa88ea714c5165826eddf572167f53bcdfa3602a.summary: Updated the 'published agents' link in README.md to point to /store instead of /agents. Fixes broken navigation for users seeking reusable agents.

cb19c32e8d6f251b8b7983c72748ff62ce652c2f.title: Tweak store virtualization params
cb19c32e8d6f251b8b7983c72748ff62ce652c2f.summary: Adjusted `estimateSize` from 280 to 270 and `overscan` from 4 to 6 in `useWindowVirtualizer` on the store page. Changes optimize row height estimation and pre-rendering for smoother scrolling in the All Agents section.

bb309a8ff1a036914857adcf5c94370cf8b5a9ee.title: Fix runIdToStepAll key in runProgrammaticStep
bb309a8ff1a036914857adcf5c94370cf8b5a9ee.summary: Corrects the `runIdToStepAll` set key from `agentId` to `runId` in `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`. This aligns the tracking mechanism with the actual execution context, ensuring `STEP_ALL` commands are correctly associated with the specific run rather than the broader agent state. Internal fix to backend logic; no user-facing API or UI changes.

d56bf0c09c00ed6c386b397de5a6ec801fc303ef.title: SDK dual ESM and CJS build support
d56bf0c09c00ed6c386b397de5a6ec801fc303ef.summary: SDK build now outputs both ESM (`dist/index.mjs`) and CJS (`dist/index.cjs`) bundles. `package.json` updated to `type: module` with conditional `exports` mapping `import` to ESM and `require` to CJS. New compatibility tests added for both module systems.

14a59f3b5ea40df605caf705c07df4d73c9a158a.title: Disable researcher-codebase-explorer subagent
14a59f3b5ea40df605caf705c07df4d73c9a158a.summary: The researcher-codebase-explorer subagent is disabled in the researcher-grok-4-fast definition. It was removed from the spawnableAgents list and references in the instructions prompt were updated to reflect its absence. Additionally, the researcher-codebase-explorer definition itself was updated to explicitly restrict terminal commands to read-only operations, likely a preparatory step or safety hardening even if currently disabled.

15c52b7c0e02a4e4352b5d648e406723e04b18a0.title: Fix resolveMessageId call on AI SDK error
15c52b7c0e02a4e4352b5d648e406723e04b18a0.summary: promptAiSdkStream now calls options.resolveMessageId(undefined) when the AI SDK throws an error, preventing hanging message ID promises. The resolveMessageId signature changed from optional to required in ai-sdk.ts, and the underlying Promise.withResolvers generic updated to string | undefined in prompt-agent-stream.ts. This ensures agent streams terminate cleanly even during upstream API failures. Backend only; no user-facing config changes.

16e270c1ee516c18480d506077f8731686374a02.title: Add shell shims for direct agent command invocation
16e270c1ee516c18480d506077f8731686374a02.summary: New `codebuff shims` subsystem enables direct command execution of agents without the `codebuff` prefix via generated shell scripts. Implementation spans `npm-app/src/shell-dispatcher.ts` for cross-platform shim generation (Unix/Windows) and `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/shims.ts` for CLI logic. Supported subcommands include install, uninstall, list, update, doctor, upgrade, and env. Shims are stored in `CONFIG_DIR/shims` and rely on fully qualified agent IDs (`publisher/agent-id@version`).

d8f79b328cee11300b8803578baf05e40b15223a.title: Add Grok 4 Fast research and lite agent definitions
d8f79b328cee11300b8803578baf05e40b15223a.summary: New agent definitions added to .agents directory using x-ai/grok-4-fast:free model. Includes researcher-grok-4-fast orchestrator spawning file-explorer, codebase-explorer, web, and docs sub-agents. base-lite-grok-4-fast and reviewer-lite added for lightweight task execution.

c126a30593d7f3279168703bbadd1c5ebe150d6f.title: Remove unused base2 lite agent definitions
c126a30593d7f3279168703bbadd1c5ebe150d6f.summary: Deleted `.agents/lite/base2-factory.ts`, `base2-lite.ts`, `editor-lite.ts`, and `reviewer-lite.ts`. These files defined unused 'Buffy Lite' agent variants and their sub-agents. No functional impact on active agent configurations.

cb19c32e8d6f251b8b7983c72748ff62ce652c2f.text: Internal tweak to store scrolling logic. Adjusts row size and pre-rendering settings for smoother scrolling.

d8f79b328cee11300b8803578baf05e40b15223a.text: The assistant can now use a new, faster model for research and simple tasks. This change is internal and may make some responses quicker.

bb309a8ff1a036914857adcf5c94370cf8b5a9ee.text: A small internal fix ensures step tracking correctly links to specific actions instead of the broader assistant profile. This improves reliability of background processes without changing how the product looks or feels to you.

a69f1398a49bd7c3dba880a9d6b53e60dce4eedd.text: Fixed an error that stopped users from adding custom tools.

14a59f3b5ea40df605caf705c07df4d73c9a158a.text: The assistant stopped using a specific search tool for looking through files. This is a small internal safety update that does not change how you use the product.

d56bf0c09c00ed6c386b397de5a6ec801fc303ef.text: The software now supports two different ways of connecting to other programs. This makes it easier for apps to use the service without breaking.

aa88ea714c5165826eddf572167f53bcdfa3602a.text: The link to the assistant's store was broken. Clicking it now takes users to the correct page to find helpful tools.

16e270c1ee516c18480d506077f8731686374a02.text: You can now run specific assistant commands directly, without typing the main application name first. This small internal update makes using the tool slightly faster and less repetitive.

15c52b7c0e02a4e4352b5d648e406723e04b18a0.text: Fixed a bug where AI responses could get stuck waiting for a message ID when the system hit an error. Now, the assistant stops cleanly instead of hanging, so users get a clear end to the interaction even if something goes wrong behind the scenes.

c126a30593d7f3279168703bbadd1c5ebe150d6f.text: The company removed unused background settings that never affected the product. Nothing changes for users.

c488469718d6bf1526551860c0807ba27313780d.title: CONTRIBUTING.md formatting tweak
c488469718d6bf1526551860c0807ba27313780d.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md restructures 'Running in other directories' section. Nested list items replace sequential a./b. steps. Code blocks indented under bullets. Pure documentation formatting.

47b7615d03ac29d103611335675885e9881daaa7.title: Remove unused ANTHROPICAPIKEY2 and OPENAIKEY
47b7615d03ac29d103611335675885e9881daaa7.summary: Removes unused ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2 and OPEN_AI_KEY from env schema and .env.example. Adds CLAUDE_CODE_KEY mapping to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in ClaudeRunner constructor for evals. Deletes unused backend/src/llm-apis/openai-api.ts type definition.

55161deda604127fbe680c50a68752b690bfc023.title: Remove unused GEMINI, DEEPSEEK, HELICONE env keys
55161deda604127fbe680c50a68752b690bfc023.summary: GEMINI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, HELICONE_API_KEY removed from .env.example and packages/internal/src/env.ts schema. Unused keys cleaned up. Covers backend env validation. Removes z.string().min(1) constraints and process.env mappings.

491f154e344ed2e787764e2808156cb39e36ab79.title: Update .env.example NEXTPUBLICCBENVIRONMENT to dev
491f154e344ed2e787764e2808156cb39e36ab79.summary: Changed default NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT from development to dev in .env.example. Aligns example configuration with expected environment variable values. Affects local setup and documentation accuracy.

c97840e55968fed1a1bd564b80b38c9cb390ef26.title: Refactor onboarding flow to support dynamic steps and referral codes
c97840e55968fed1a1bd564b80b38c9cb390ef26.summary: Onboarding logic shifts to dynamic step counts based on referral code presence, replacing static constants. Referral pages now render directly via OnboardClientWrapper instead of a dedicated client component. Scope covers web/src/app/onboard, web/src/app/referrals, and shared onboarding components. Progress state initializes to step 1 and persists packageManager selection.

9d9f09f6a8d0bdb0b2b7ce2c694bc428f7fbb958.title: Centralize PostHog analytics event strings into shared constants
9d9f09f6a8d0bdb0b2b7ce2c694bc428f7fbb958.summary: AnalyticsEvent enum in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts centralizes PostHog event names. Web components replace hardcoded strings with enum references. Scope covers authentication, cookie consent, onboarding, install dialogs, home page, demo terminal, and UI elements. Ensures consistent event naming and reduces drift across web surfaces.

2f91aae1c0d4abd07dc3334de68afc47388dfbab.title: Use runId for programmatic step sandbox
2f91aae1c0d4abd07dc3334de68afc47388dfbab.summary: Switched programmatic step caching and QuickJS sandbox keys from `agentId` to `runId` in `run-programmatic-step.ts` and `quickjs-sandbox.ts`. Added `runId` to `AgentState` type in `agent-definition.ts`. Prevents state leakage when agents reuse IDs across different runs.

cb59f9fd1886bbb81b61c577689a4b6ec18d2c5e.title: CONTRIBUTING.md onboarding and env.example URL fixes
cb59f9fd1886bbb81b61c577689a4b6ec18d2c5e.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md adds steps for granting local credits via `credit_ledger` and publishing agents for cross-directory CLI usage. `.env.example` updates `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST_URL` to `https://us.i.posthog.com` and strips the scheme from `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_BACKEND_URL`. Changes affect repo docs and environment templates only.

27921c25ca825f1c4a385e257f3cd63e0525de64.title: Web UI responsive fixes and login flow update
27921c25ca825f1c4a385e257f3cd63e0525de64.summary: Implemented responsive layout adjustments across web app pages including agent metrics, publisher profiles, and store views. Updated login card to support session-based navigation with referral and CLI auth code handling. Changes affect `web/src/app/publishers`, `web/src/app/store`, and `web/src/components/login` files.

79d51fed4589d252018daf3777dad93fefe52ac9.text: Help information was combined into one main guide. This internal change does not affect how the product works.

cb59f9fd1886bbb81b61c577689a4b6ec18d2c5e.text: Internal guides and setup templates were updated to clarify how to add credits and connect services. This change does not affect the product for regular users.

47b7615d03ac29d103611335675885e9881daaa7.text: The system cleaned up old, unused settings. This change does not affect how you use the product.

c488469718d6bf1526551860c0807ba27313780d.text: The instructions for running the software in different locations were updated to be clearer and easier to follow. This is a small change to the documentation only, so the software itself works exactly the same as before.

55161deda604127fbe680c50a68752b690bfc023.text: The software removed three unused settings for connecting to other AI services. This internal cleanup has no effect on how you use the product.

491f154e344ed2e787764e2808156cb39e36ab79.text: The internal setup guide now lists the correct environment name. This does not change how the product works for you.

9d9f09f6a8d0bdb0b2b7ce2c694bc428f7fbb958.text: The system now uses a single, shared list to label user actions for analytics. This ensures all parts of the application report data consistently, helping the team understand how people use the product.

c97840e55968fed1a1bd564b80b38c9cb390ef26.text: The sign-up process now changes its steps automatically depending on whether you use a referral code. This makes the experience smoother and keeps your preferences saved as you go.

27921c25ca825f1c4a385e257f3cd63e0525de64.text: Pages now adjust to fit your screen size. Logging in improved to handle different sign-in methods.

2f91aae1c0d4abd07dc3334de68afc47388dfbab.text: The app now uses a unique number for each session to keep data separate. This prevents information from one task accidentally mixing with another.

df7f77aa8708fc48f5c262c19777a74b1c60be54.title: Skip agent DB validation errors in development
df7f77aa8708fc48f5c262c19777a74b1c60be54.summary: validateSpawnableAgents now suppresses invalid agent ID errors when NODE_ENV is 'development'. This prevents noisy database warnings during local agent config development. Affects shared core validation logic in common/src/util/agent-template-validation.ts.

3b8cfa8ce3c2b96b51ae824a9c3d14f4582bbec2.title: Support sync handlers in custom-tool execute
3b8cfa8ce3c2b96b51ae824a9c3d14f4582bbec2.summary: The `execute` handler in `getCustomToolDefinition` now accepts synchronous return values alongside promises. The SDK internally wraps the user-provided function in an async closure to ensure consistent handling. This change is reflected in the `sdk/src/custom-tool.ts` file and version bump to `0.2.0`.

33412ddc2e939a5f3cc6bb63f92b0071ccf67e91.title: CustomToolDefinition Args/Input generics constrained to Record
33412ddc2e939a5f3cc6bb63f92b0071ccf67e91.summary: Type parameters Args and Input in CustomToolDefinition and getCustomToolDefinition now extend Record<string, unknown>. This replaces the previous unknown constraint, enforcing object-shaped arguments and inputs at the type level. Affects sdk/src/custom-tool.ts only.

6cb0d214c2573ba320cd6c7560ed76b5d193e9bf.title: Virtualize agent store list
6cb0d214c2573ba320cd6c7560ed76b5d193e9bf.summary: Agent store page now virtualizes the 'All Agents' grid using @tanstack/react-virtual. New useResponsiveColumns hook adjusts column count (1-3) based on viewport width, splitting agents into rows for the virtualizer. Virtualization activates only when rows exceed 6, reducing DOM load on large lists.

87944dbecf2845a66c751e488f50c8a29bff8ddf.title: Revert @agent prefill, pass --agent directly
87944dbecf2845a66c751e488f50c8a29bff8ddf.summary: Removed logic prefilling `@agent` into `initialInput`. `--agent` flag now passed directly to `codebuff` as `agent` parameter. Affects `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

716de248d94d2856229009d742d92c29f21f7a66.title: SDK custom tool handler renamed to execute
716de248d94d2856229009d742d92c29f21f7a66.summary: The `handler` property in `CustomToolDefinition` is renamed to `execute` to align with the ai-sdk standard. Type parameters `Args` and `Input` default to `unknown` instead of `any`. This change affects `sdk/src/custom-tool.ts` and `sdk/src/client.ts`, requiring updates to any custom tool definitions using the old property name.

936ef5a2c914a6cca745be0ce2a2f2de0d3eaa91.title: Refactor referral client and add back button fallback
936ef5a2c914a6cca745be0ce2a2f2de0d3eaa91.summary: Referral page logic moved from server component to new `referral-client.tsx`, replacing `referral-client-wrapper.tsx`. `BackButton` now accepts optional `fallbackUrl` prop, used in agent detail page to navigate to `/store`. This consolidates client-side referral code storage and improves navigation reliability.

87f11bddc0736d4d7a54d1d0a1c71b472d99223a.title: await SDK custom tool handler result
87f11bddc0736d4d7a54d1d0a1c71b472d99223a.summary: SDK client now awaits custom tool handler results in sdk/src/client.ts. Ensures async handler completion before returning. Scope limited to SDK client. Imported PublishedClientToolName as type-only.

5260144d060b2c381010cf1ca060693304002c37.text: The app's inner workings were reorganized to make it easier to keep track of past conversations. This is a behind-the-scenes cleanup, so you will not notice any immediate difference in how the product works.

3b8cfa8ce3c2b96b51ae824a9c3d14f4582bbec2.text: The software now handles immediate results from custom tools without waiting for background processing. This makes tool responses faster and simpler for everyday use.

df7f77aa8708fc48f5c262c19777a74b1c60be54.text: Internal checks now ignore some setup errors in test environments to reduce noise. This change affects only how the software behaves during development and does not change what you see or do in the product.

87944dbecf2845a66c751e488f50c8a29bff8ddf.text: The way the app chooses its helper was changed to work more directly. This internal fix makes the selection process simpler and more reliable.

716de248d94d2856229009d742d92c29f21f7a66.text: The assistant's custom tool settings were renamed to match a standard, and some hidden technical details were made stricter. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

0eed7b6589e7b36cd6e6cd9ae178c2fa5a515632.text: The store page now prepares content before it reaches the browser. This change reduces loading delays, so the list of agents appears faster.

936ef5a2c914a6cca745be0ce2a2f2de0d3eaa91.text: The app's referral feature was reorganized behind the scenes, and the back button now reliably takes you to the store if the previous page is unavailable.

87f11bddc0736d4d7a54d1d0a1c71b472d99223a.text: The system now waits for custom tools to finish before continuing. This ensures results are ready when needed. It is a small internal fix.

951be1fa1b9038cb1704e9290c5b40bf9e6d8071.title: SDK version bump to 0.1.32
951be1fa1b9038cb1704e9290c5b40bf9e6d8071.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.32 in sdk/package.json. Updated publish-dry-run script to use bun run scripts/publish.ts instead of node scripts/publish.js. Internal maintenance only.

69a28634eed528e1c4376de0b753e0d65eca5e81.title: Remove addsubgoal from TOOLSWHICHWONTFORCENEXTSTEP
69a28634eed528e1c4376de0b753e0d65eca5e81.summary: Removed `add_subgoal` from `TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP` in `common/src/tools/constants.ts`. This forces the agent to take a next step after adding a subgoal, preventing potential stalls. Internal change affecting agent loop behavior.

6eeaf68db34acc80d3f93704856e06f08da09cf3.title: Stop truncating agent messages on server
6eeaf68db34acc80d3f93704856e06f08da09cf3.summary: Removed `getMessagesSubset` call in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Agent steps now use full `agentState.messageHistory` instead of token-limited subsets. Prevents context loss from server-side truncation.

df2d7681d5c46e125f01f00bedf6f73d6f64316b.title: run-eval-set default agent base-lite
df2d7681d5c46e125f01f00bedf6f73d6f64316b.summary: evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts changed `agent` flag default from `base` to `base-lite`. Affects default agent selection for eval runs. No migration needed.

aeb93d09c7bc4d57a4995f657a91203bcfbd8c3a.title: Fix relative path handling in SDK terminal command execution
aeb93d09c7bc4d57a4995f657a91203bcfbd8c3a.summary: SDK client now resolves relative paths for `run_terminal_command` using `path.resolve` against the session's working directory. Previously, `cwd` was passed directly, causing failures with relative paths. Updated `@codebuff/sdk` to version 0.1.33.

b71e164eba828984235a1655cc03d2be0311680c.title: Skip clientToolCallSchema validation for custom tools
b71e164eba828984235a1655cc03d2be0311680c.summary: handleToolCall now skips clientToolCallSchema.parse for actions where toolName is not in toolNames. This prevents validation errors when handling custom tool calls. Change scoped to sdk/src/client.ts. Validation now runs only for built-in tools; custom tools bypass schema check.

dcb913abd286e9b2dc50711d66a38de16158926c.title: unstablecache added to agents API route
dcb913abd286e9b2dc50711d66a38de16158926c.summary: The `GET` handler in `web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts` now uses Next.js `unstable_cache` to memoize the expensive agent aggregation query for 60 seconds, replacing the previous `force-dynamic` rendering. This change reduces database load by serving cached results with stale-while-revalidate semantics and explicit CDN headers. The cache key is `['agents-data']` with tag `['agents']`, and the response includes `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300`.

a0110d19af5cfccb07011e1fa9ccb4fc50f5f0aa.title: SDK publish script migrated to bun run scripts/publish.ts
a0110d19af5cfccb07011e1fa9ccb4fc50f5f0aa.summary: SDK package.json scripts prepare-dist and publish-sdk now invoke bun run scripts/publish.ts instead of node scripts/publish.js. The publish script was renamed from .js to .ts, maintaining 100% similarity. This aligns the publish workflow with the rest of the SDK build tooling that uses bun. Note that the publish-dry-run script still references the old node scripts/publish.js path.

afa50cef2b2e3ad224709a400c644332f20f04fe.title: Refactor agent store UI and CLI agent flag handling
afa50cef2b2e3ad224709a400c644332f20f04fe.summary: CLI `--agent` flag now prefills input with `@agent` instead of direct invocation. Web agent detail page replaces separate `AgentUsageMetrics` card with inline `VersionUsageBadge` in version navigation. `RunAgentButton` and `SaveAgentButton` icons changed to `Play` and `Bookmark` respectively, with updated toast messages. `store/page.tsx` removes `isRecentlyUpdated` helper.

0b95a09804e81283740e2f7155acd09955f5de5a.title: Drop generic types on customToolDefinitions
0b95a09804e81283740e2f7155acd09955f5de5a.summary: Removes generic type parameters <A, B, C> from CodebuffClient.run and customToolDefinitions in sdk/src/client.ts. Simplifies SDK interface by using non-generic CustomToolDefinition. Internal refactor; no runtime behavior change.

6eeaf68db34acc80d3f93704856e06f08da09cf3.text: The assistant now sees the full conversation history instead of a shortened version. This prevents it from forgetting earlier details during long chats.

69a28634eed528e1c4376de0b753e0d65eca5e81.text: A small internal update stops the assistant from pausing after adding a subgoal. It now always moves to the next step, keeping conversations flowing smoothly.

afa50cef2b2e3ad224709a400c644332f20f04fe.text: Typing an assistant name now automatically adds a mention instead of running it immediately. The assistant's usage details moved into its version list, and button icons changed for clarity.

df2d7681d5c46e125f01f00bedf6f73d6f64316b.text: Internal testing tools now use a lighter version of the assistant by default. This change affects only how tests are run and does not impact what you see or use in the product.

0b95a09804e81283740e2f7155acd09955f5de5a.text: A small internal update simplifies how the assistant handles custom tools. Nothing changes for you; the product works exactly as before.

b71e164eba828984235a1655cc03d2be0311680c.text: The system now skips strict checks for custom tools. This prevents errors when using them.

a0110d19af5cfccb07011e1fa9ccb4fc50f5f0aa.text: The tool that shares new updates now uses a different, faster engine behind the scenes. This internal change makes the update process smoother for the team, but you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

aeb93d09c7bc4d57a4995f657a91203bcfbd8c3a.text: The assistant now correctly finds files when asked to run commands from a specific folder. This fixes errors that occurred when using shortcuts for file locations.

951be1fa1b9038cb1704e9290c5b40bf9e6d8071.text: The team updated the tools they use to share software updates. This change only affects how the team works behind the scenes. You will not see any difference in the product.

dcb913abd286e9b2dc50711d66a38de16158926c.text: The list of agents is now stored briefly to reduce server strain. Users see the same results for a short time before they update.

c2837def5728f8e4a82058424ca1f7a5ca0bf4cc.title: Remove addedSpawnableAgents from codebuff.json
c2837def5728f8e4a82058424ca1f7a5ca0bf4cc.summary: Removed `addedSpawnableAgents` key from `codebuff.json`. This deletes the explicit registration of `codebuff/git-commiter@0.0.1`. Scope limited to project template configuration.

760ee27aff29334d9388e88537ef646d1720c7b4.title: SDK build drops ESM output, ships CommonJS only
760ee27aff29334d9388e88537ef646d1720c7b4.summary: Removed ESM build steps and dual-format output from `sdk/build.ts`, consolidating artifacts into a single CommonJS `dist` directory. Updated `sdk/package.json` to set `type` to `commonjs`, point `main`/`types` to `./dist/`, and remove `import`/`module` export conditions. Deleted ESM-specific smoke tests in `sdk/smoke-test-dist.ts` and adjusted `tsconfig.build.json` output path.

927d66df680ac2e25db6584e11a45e7ad74b0580.title: New codebuff save-agent CLI command
927d66df680ac2e25db6584e11a45e7ad74b0580.summary: Added `codebuff save-agent` command to append agent IDs to `addedSpawnableAgents` in `codebuff.json`. Implements `handleSaveAgent` in `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/save-agent.ts` to parse args, update config via `loadRawCodebuffConfig`, and report new/existing agents. Registered command in `npm-app/src/index.ts` and updated `isCommand` check to prevent treating it as initial input. Helper `loadRawCodebuffConfig` added to `npm-app/src/json-config/parser.ts` to read raw JSONC config.

06439eff34a19ee2d658e6cd5153f7146cbb8d11.title: Editor's choice agent list updated
06439eff34a19ee2d658e6cd5153f7146cbb8d11.summary: Swapped 'reviewer' for 'planner' and 'codebase-commands-explorer' for 'rampup-teacher-agent' in EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS. Changes the default agent recommendations on the web store page. Scope limited to web/src/app/store/page.tsx. No migration logic required.

b682d913025ea387539f62a1a58c134d648a60d9.title: Add addedSpawnableAgents and removedSpawnableAgents to codebuff.json
b682d913025ea387539f62a1a58c134d648a60d9.summary: Added `addedSpawnableAgents` and `removedSpawnableAgents` fields to `codebuff.json` to manage base subagents. `CodebuffConfigSchema` updated to `looseObject` with new optional string arrays. `main-prompt.ts` logic merges added agents and filters removed agents when `--agent` is unspecified. Default config includes new fields as undefined.

7bc9570e4ad49fbf79acbfba3ba99e0cb16505ef.title: Save this agent button on agent detail page
7bc9570e4ad49fbf79acbfba3ba99e0cb16505ef.summary: New SaveAgentButton component added to the agent detail page. It copies the command `codebuff save-agent <agentId>` to the clipboard and shows a toast. The button sits alongside CopyIdButton and RunAgentButton in web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx.

e8da05d461a83d2f61e4f7aea5dd6136a1a08826.title: Update SDK README API key URL and clarify examples
e8da05d461a83d2f61e4f7aea5dd6136a1a08826.summary: Update `sdk/README.md` to reflect new Codebuff API key URL (`/api-keys`). Add comments explaining `handleEvent` behavior and `previousRun` usage in code examples. Clarify custom agent creation context.

ca55ac53b557cd590534ac0be7be6c1868dd6d1a.title: Fix broken tests by updating mock stream yields to typed objects
ca55ac53b557cd590534ac0be7be6c1868dd6d1a.summary: Updated mock implementations in backend integration and unit tests to yield typed text objects (`{ type: 'text', text: ... }`) instead of raw strings. This aligns test mocks with the current `promptAiSdkStream` interface expectations. Affected files include `cost-aggregation.integration.test.ts`, `loop-agent-steps.test.ts`, `main-prompt.test.ts`, `read-docs-tool.test.ts`, `run-agent-step-tools.test.ts`, `web-search-tool.test.ts`, and `xml-stream-parser.test.ts`. Assertion logic in `xml-stream-parser.test.ts` was also adjusted to extract text from the new object structure.

09627a59071c8cb535f1437ff20876369e7556ce.title: Fix 404 errors in documentation internal links
09627a59071c8cb535f1437ff20876369e7556ce.summary: Resolved 404 errors by correcting internal documentation links. Updated anchor references in `claude-code-comparison.mdx` and related files to ensure accurate navigation. Scope includes web content and evaluation fixtures. Specific fix involved removing trailing question marks from anchor IDs like `#what-models-do-you-use?`.

b170d52ff00b8a43e52b387e0adfb13b1fe5766b.title: Simplify backend buildUserMessageContent logic
b170d52ff00b8a43e52b387e0adfb13b1fe5766b.summary: Refactored `buildUserMessageContent` in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` to stop merging prompt/params with client-provided `content` parts. The function now returns `content` arrays as-is, assuming the client (npm-app) already combined them, and only constructs text strings when `content` is absent. This removes ~19 lines of redundant part-prepending logic.

c2837def5728f8e4a82058424ca1f7a5ca0bf4cc.text: A small internal update removed a specific helper tool from the product's setup list. This change does not affect how you use the product or what it can do.

927d66df680ac2e25db6584e11a45e7ad74b0580.text: A small internal update added a new command that lets the system save and remember assistant profiles. This change does not affect how you use the product.

e8da05d461a83d2f61e4f7aea5dd6136a1a08826.text: The instructions for getting your access code were updated to show the correct web address. The guide now also includes clearer notes explaining how the assistant handles different tasks.

7bc9570e4ad49fbf79acbfba3ba99e0cb16505ef.text: A new button on the agent page lets you copy a command to your clipboard with one click. This makes it easier to save your agent without typing the command yourself.

06439eff34a19ee2d658e6cd5153f7146cbb8d11.text: The list of recommended assistants on the store page changed. Users will now see different options suggested by default.

09627a59071c8cb535f1437ff20876369e7556ce.text: We fixed broken links in the help pages so you can find information more easily. This small update improves how you navigate the documentation.

b682d913025ea387539f62a1a58c134d648a60d9.text: You can now choose which helper tasks the assistant uses by default. You can add new helpers or hide existing ones in your settings.

ca55ac53b557cd590534ac0be7be6c1868dd6d1a.text: The internal tests for the assistant were updated to match how the system currently works. This change does not affect how the product functions for users.

b170d52ff00b8a43e52b387e0adfb13b1fe5766b.text: Internal cleanup simplified how the system builds your message text. No changes to what you see or do.

760ee27aff29334d9388e88537ef646d1720c7b4.text: The software now uses one standard format instead of two. This change is internal, so users will not notice a difference in how the product works.

6b1d63c5b788db9167f88c1b4e9e074a512bca3e.title: Require quotes for image paths with spaces
6b1d63c5b788db9167f88c1b4e9e074a512bca3e.summary: extractImagePaths now requires quotes for paths containing spaces to avoid false positives. Unquoted paths with spaces are no longer auto-detected. Updated tests in npm-app/src/__tests__/image-upload.test.ts reflect this stricter parsing behavior.

70ac9d82264ea73ca2e8df0881570637229dc774.title: Fix image path extraction in messages
70ac9d82264ea73ca2e8df0881570637229dc774.summary: Image path extraction now handles bare relative paths and prevents agent mention regex from corrupting file paths containing slashes. Regex updates add support for `assets/image.png` style paths and expand trailing punctuation stripping. Covers `client.ts` and `utils/image-handler.ts` in npm-app.

f7d4075fd903d0ee921844674552a0a9462477a2.title: Automatic image descriptions added to CLI uploads
f7d4075fd903d0ee921844674552a0a9462477a2.summary: CLI image upload now injects text parts listing filenames (e.g. `[Attached Image: image_1.png]`) alongside binary image data. This ensures the model receives context about attached files. The change affects `npm-app/src/cli.ts` message construction and `npm-app/src/utils/image-handler.ts` regex to ignore `@` prefixed paths.
