f870afd6fc98c6d4c282d57a9999e52146eb929c.title: Add manual stop sequence detection for AI SDK streams
f870afd6fc98c6d4c282d57a9999e52146eb929c.summary: Added `StopSequenceHandler` to manually detect and truncate streams based on stop sequences, replacing reliance on upstream API support. This ensures precise control over output termination in `promptAiSdkStream`. The change affects `common/src/util/stop-sequence.ts` and `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. The handler buffers text chunks to identify overlaps, yielding only text preceding the stop sequence.

71441bd51e14d4d3dd85dbf4335497b014e0d9a4.title: Refactor spinner lifecycle to stream handler
71441bd51e14d4d3dd85dbf4335497b014e0d9a4.summary: Moved `Spinner.get().start()` from `MarkdownStreamRenderer` to `client.ts` stream chunk handler, triggering on newline completion. Removed redundant `Spinner.get().stop()` calls in renderer flush/end methods and XML parser callback. Updated `printSubagentHeader` to restart 'Thinking' spinner for textless stopped states. Internal refactor affecting CLI display logic only.

978c4a991cb11b15be437b2d5cf4306f5bfbba4a.title: New ETL agent registry
978c4a991cb11b15be437b2d5cf4306f5bfbba4a.summary: Added four new agent definitions to `.agents/registry`: `etl-manager.ts`, `extract-agent.ts`, `transform-agent.ts`, and `load-agent.ts`. These implement a sequential ETL pipeline (extract → transform → load) using `spawn_agents` and `handleSteps`. The manager uses `openai/gpt-5` while the workers use `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522`. Each agent defines specific `toolNames`, `instructionsPrompt`, and `inputSchema` for their stage.

200e55c179b2b5d38b30cef143064762fff4275c.title: StreamChunk typed union replaces raw string stream in backend LLM
200e55c179b2b5d38b30cef143064762fff4275c.summary: New StreamChunk union type (text, reasoning, error) replaces raw string AsyncGenerator yields in promptAiSdkStream, processStreamWithTools, and processStreamWithTags. Reasoning deltas now flow as typed chunks instead of being serialized into think_deeply tool-call text at the source. Error chunks yield and return rather than throwing, preventing unhandled stream aborts. Internal refactor across backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts, backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts, and backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts; tool-tag serialization moved downstream to stream-parser.

02150d4eeee407e8db14b476e53d1cb0ac9a8e37.title: Remove version field from agent registry definitions
02150d4eeee407e8db14b476e53d1cb0ac9a8e37.summary: Dropped the `version: '1.0.0'` property from `AgentDefinition` objects in `.agents/registry/etl-manager.ts`, `extract-agent.ts`, `load-agent.ts`, and `transform-agent.ts`. Publisher attribution updated to `brandon` across these files. This simplifies the agent schema by removing redundant versioning for internal registry entries.

d95ae9e26ad6795da108db2ffb6c2a696f386158.title: Stop spinner before tool call chunks
d95ae9e26ad6795da108db2ffb6c2a696f386158.summary: Spinner now stops before processing tool call chunks in npm-app/src/client.ts. Prevents visual artifact when streaming begins. Internal client logic only.

b276ed02a2b173d435dbf891dbdacba22661dbd5.title: Add image support to CLI and backend
b276ed02a2b173d435dbf891dbdacba22661dbd5.summary: CLI auto-detects image paths in prompts, processes them via `jimp` (compression/resizing), and sends structured `TextPart`/`ImagePart` content. Backend `loopAgentSteps` and `mainPrompt` updated to accept and merge this multi-part content into the agent message history. `npm-app/src/utils/image-handler.ts` introduced for image validation and encoding; `common/src/actions.ts` schema extended for optional `content` array. Limits: 2MB per file, 150KB base64 output.

70ac9d82264ea73ca2e8df0881570637229dc774.text: Fixed how image links are found in messages. Images now appear correctly when linked by simple names. This helps the assistant show pictures properly.

978c4a991cb11b15be437b2d5cf4306f5bfbba4a.text: The system now uses a new team of specialized assistants to process data in steps.

6b1d63c5b788db9167f88c1b4e9e074a512bca3e.text: The system now needs quotation marks around image paths containing spaces to avoid errors. Unquoted paths with spaces will no longer work automatically.

f7d4075fd903d0ee921844674552a0a9462477a2.text: When you send images through the command line, the assistant now automatically sees the file names alongside the pictures. This helps it understand exactly which images you attached.

d95ae9e26ad6795da108db2ffb6c2a696f386158.text: A small internal fix stops a loading animation before new text appears. This prevents a brief visual glitch when the assistant starts answering.

200e55c179b2b5d38b30cef143064762fff4275c.text: The internal system now sends text, reasoning, and errors as separate, labeled pieces instead of mixing them together. This prevents crashes when things go wrong and keeps the assistant's responses clearer for you.

f870afd6fc98c6d4c282d57a9999e52146eb929c.text: The assistant now stops writing exactly when it should, even if the underlying service misses the signal. This prevents unwanted text from appearing at the end of responses.

b276ed02a2b173d435dbf891dbdacba22661dbd5.text: The assistant can now understand and process images sent through the command line. It automatically shrinks large pictures to fit within size limits before analyzing them.

02150d4eeee407e8db14b476e53d1cb0ac9a8e37.text: The internal system now removes a redundant label from its list of automated helpers. This simplifies the setup without changing how the product works for users.

5ec3534506916a4466e6d5937085d5b7ef7f3aa2.title: Remove keepDuringTruncation override in agent step loop
5ec3534506916a4466e6d5937085d5b7ef7f3aa2.summary: Removed explicit mapping of `keepDuringTruncation: false` for initial message history in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. The loop now spreads `agentState.messageHistory` directly into `initialMessages`. This relies on existing state properties rather than forcing the flag to false during history construction.

2f42d22f25517d68fc0ff26001798856bd1143c7.title: Store copy command includes full agent id
2f42d22f25517d68fc0ff26001798856bd1143c7.summary: The store copy button now emits the fully-qualified command `codebuff --agent <publisher>/<id>@<version>` instead of the bare `codebuff --agent <id>`. The shortened form could not resolve uniquely when multiple publishers ship agents with the same id. Scoped to `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`; clipboard text, toast description, and button title all carry the full form.

8155a97484de68f4a92bc384a29567f5a0c5356d.title: Add messageHistoryLength to start event
8155a97484de68f4a92bc384a29567f5a0c5356d.summary: Added messageHistoryLength field to the start event payload. Updated backend websocket action to include current history length. Extended common print-mode start schema to validate the new number type. Covers backend and shared type definitions.

5d4b23f4c8f3bc3ce0316fbd71079e19376bc001.title: Web agent detail view renders definition as TypeScript
5d4b23f4c8f3bc3ce0316fbd71079e19376bc001.summary: Web agent detail page replaces `JsonViewer` with new `TypeScriptViewer` component in `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx`. Agent definitions now render with syntax highlighting and field ordering via `prism-react-renderer` instead of raw JSON. New `web/src/components/agent/typescript-viewer.tsx` handles serialization, enforcing preferred key order for fields like `id`, `displayName`, `systemPrompt`, and `handleSteps`. Prompt strings and `handleSteps` functions receive special formatting to preserve readability.

8c471757d2bd4d71df718d490f75c77d711700f6.title: Move fullResponseChunks log key after messages
8c471757d2bd4d71df718d490f75c77d711700f6.summary: Relocated `fullResponseChunks` in the logging object within `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. This change ensures the chunks are logged after the message history and tool results. The modification is internal to the backend agent step execution logic. No user-facing behavior or API changes resulted from this reordering.

a843dae88c94285ab67804c71d9532639cbf1f1e.title: Add partial indexes to agentrun for completed status
a843dae88c94285ab67804c71d9532639cbf1f1e.summary: Migration 0029 adds four partial b-tree indexes to agent_run filtered on status = 'completed'. Covers publisher/agent name, recent creation order, version lookup, and user_id. Scope limited to common/src/db/migrations and schema.ts. Indexes use CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS to ensure idempotent application.

d7a030548ce8b3024c8b5795729b434eb1588f54.title: Add CODEOFCONDUCT.md
d7a030548ce8b3024c8b5795729b434eb1588f54.summary: Added CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md establishing community standards for Codebuff. Defines encouraged/restricted behaviors, reporting via support@codebuff.com, and scope. Adapted from Contributor Covenant 3.0. Repo root only.

60200e78e66fe7747ddc96ecab99dbf3d29e9cbd.title: Remove agent store grid animations
60200e78e66fe7747ddc96ecab99dbf3d29e9cbd.summary: Removes layout and entry animations from agent store grids in web/src/app/store/page.tsx. Replaced motion.div with standard div and stripped initial/animate props from card containers to reduce sluggishness. Hover effects remain intact.

eb99717911a7e0fc2ef460c70a6d43a57c6a0b37.title: Add Copy ID and Run Agent CTAs to agent detail and store pages
eb99717911a7e0fc2ef460c70a6d43a57c6a0b37.summary: Added `CopyIdButton` and `RunAgentButton` components to the agent version detail page, replacing the inline `EnhancedCopyButton` and raw code snippet. The `RunAgentButton` copies `codebuff --agent <id>` to the clipboard via `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and triggers a toast notification. A similar copy-command button was added to the agent store list cards in `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`. Changes are scoped to the Web frontend, specifically `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/` and the store page.

8d6c0e63332f891b799c10800e5c7a92f07a5a15.title: Refine Agent Store initial animation
8d6c0e63332f891b799c10800e5c7a92f07a5a15.summary: Adjusted entry animations on `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`. Header fade replaced with targeted slide on publisher button; Editors Choice section wrapped in single fade to prevent layout shift during load. Publisher button logic updated to check `!publishers` alongside `!session`.

a843dae88c94285ab67804c71d9532639cbf1f1e.text: The system now finds finished tasks faster. This small update improves performance without changing how you use the product.

60200e78e66fe7747ddc96ecab99dbf3d29e9cbd.text: The online store no longer slides or fades in when you open it, making the page load faster and feel smoother. The small visual effects when you hover over items still work.

eb99717911a7e0fc2ef460c70a6d43a57c6a0b37.text: Pages for each agent now include a button to copy its unique ID and another to copy a command for running it. This makes it easier for users to share or use agents without manually selecting text.

8155a97484de68f4a92bc384a29567f5a0c5356d.text: The system now records how many messages were in the chat history when a session begins. This helps track conversation context, but you will not notice any change in how you use the product.

8c471757d2bd4d71df718d490f75c77d711700f6.text: Internal computer records now show conversation details in a clearer order. This helps support staff understand how the assistant works. Regular users will see no changes.

8d6c0e63332f891b799c10800e5c7a92f07a5a15.text: The store page now loads with smoother animations and stays stable without jumping around. This small visual update makes the interface feel more polished.

5d4b23f4c8f3bc3ce0316fbd71079e19376bc001.text: Agent details now display in a clearer format with highlighted text and organized fields. This makes it easier to read and understand agent configurations.

2f42d22f25517d68fc0ff26001798856bd1143c7.text: A small internal update ensures that when you copy a command to install an assistant, it includes the publisher's name. This prevents errors if two different companies offer assistants with the same name.

5ec3534506916a4466e6d5937085d5b7ef7f3aa2.text: A small internal cleanup removes a rule that was forcing the assistant to ignore parts of its memory during long chats. This change relies on existing settings instead, aiming to keep conversations running smoothly without altering how you see the results.

d7a030548ce8b3024c8b5795729b434eb1588f54.text: The company added a new set of rules about how people should treat each other. This doesn't change how you use the product, but it helps keep the community safe and respectful.

19b18574929a9c3ac181bdcb5cece86ed488be46.title: Show spinner during file reading
19b18574929a9c3ac181bdcb5cece86ed488be46.summary: Added conditional spinner start in npm-app/src/client.ts during file reading operations. Triggered only when this.userInputId is present. Internal UI enhancement for client feedback.

148d1c73f460f72e3b864797d647b486d87a3358.title: Add SECURITY.md
148d1c73f460f72e3b864797d647b486d87a3358.summary: SECURITY.md added. Defines vulnerability reporting process for CodeBuff. Directs reports to support@codebuff.com instead of public GitHub issues.

30e74b20042a3e3af86fe1e357656c66e3110abf.title: Add FILETREEPROMPTSMALL placeholder
30e74b20042a3e3af86fe1e357656c66e3110abf.summary: Introduce `FILE_TREE_PROMPT_SMALL` placeholder in agent templates. Maps to `getProjectFileTreePrompt` with 2,500 token limit. Updates `secret-agent-definition.ts`, `strings.ts`, and `types.ts`.

6cbd91b1dfc04e0946944d193098e0fc3811b3ed.title: Evals runner: add final flushStep() on finish event
6cbd91b1dfc04e0946944d193098e0fc3811b3ed.summary: CodebuffRunner now calls flushStep() when receiving a 'finish' event if responseText, toolCalls, or toolResults contain data. This ensures the final step's accumulated data is flushed before the runner completes, preventing potential loss of trailing output in evals. Change scoped to evals/git-evals/runners/codebuff.ts.

92ef47a31b12f1e75c0831c192b8d50d03d164ca.title: SDK build creates colocated index.d.ts files
92ef47a31b12f1e75c0831c192b8d50d03d164ca.summary: sdk/build.ts now writes dist/esm/index.d.ts and dist/cjs/index.d.ts after bundling, re-exporting from sdk/src/index. package.json types and exports.types fields point to ./dist/esm/index.d.ts instead of the nested sdk/src path. This ensures TypeScript resolves declarations colocated with the bundle index.js for both ESM and CJS consumers.

453e865754de799ccde739180429a59055b326b3.title: base-lite switches to gpt-5 medium effort with strict tool-use
453e865754de799ccde739180429a59055b326b3.summary: base-lite agent definition updated to openai/gpt-5 with reasoningOptions effort 'medium' and exclude true. New base-quick.ts added using openai/gpt-5-chat lite. Prompting overhaul removes end_turn tool requirement, enforcing tool usage per response unless task complete. baseAgentSystemPrompt now accepts mode parameter ('lite'|'normal'|'max'|'experimental') to conditionally inject proactive execution guidance. File tree prompt token limit reduced from 20_000 to 10_000 in backend templates.

376bf7e2cc49a8d817b90674e817a8ca88f110e9.title: Update spinner message in client.ts
376bf7e2cc49a8d817b90674e817a8ca88f110e9.summary: Spinner message changed from 'Reading through files...' to 'Processing results...' in npm-app/src/client.ts. This reflects the actual state during file processing. Internal UI text update only.

b0091ce2c3d28284800c6d702f9fc9aa48a7730c.title: Switch package manager from yarn to bun
b0091ce2c3d28284800c6d702f9fc9aa48a7730c.summary: Updated the `packageManager` field in `package.json` from `yarn@1.22.22` to `bun@1.0.0`. This change aligns the project's package management with Bun, potentially improving installation speeds and compatibility with modern JavaScript tooling. The modification affects the root configuration file, ensuring that all contributors use the specified package manager.

04dd986dc53bcf7d7272e962694bd9e32b3b7eae.title: @codebuff/sdk 0.1.30 released
04dd986dc53bcf7d7272e962694bd9e32b3b7eae.summary: Bumped @codebuff/sdk to 0.1.30. Changelog notes 'Types updates'. Scope limited to sdk/package.json and sdk/CHANGELOG.md.

e05b79eafc7f4e5b5d8a7cbfcbd2879473103364.title: Fix local database credentials and backend port in docs
e05b79eafc7f4e5b5d8a7cbfcbd2879473103364.summary: Updated `DATABASE_URL` in `.env.example`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `INFISICAL_SETUP_GUIDE.md` to use `manicode_user_local` and `manicode_db_local` instead of `postgres`/`codebuff`. Corrected `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_BACKEND_URL` from port `3001` to `4242` to match the local server configuration. Added troubleshooting steps for database connection errors and clarified that the Agent Store is empty in dev mode until agents are published.

6cbd91b1dfc04e0946944d193098e0fc3811b3ed.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant saves all final responses, preventing missing text at the end.

19b18574929a9c3ac181bdcb5cece86ed488be46.text: The app now shows a loading icon while reading files.

376bf7e2cc49a8d817b90674e817a8ca88f110e9.text: The loading message now says 'Processing results...' to match what the app is actually doing. This is a small internal text update that does not change how the app works.

30e74b20042a3e3af86fe1e357656c66e3110abf.text: The assistant now uses a shorter summary of your project files when space is tight. This helps it stay focused and avoids getting overwhelmed by long lists of files.

04dd986dc53bcf7d7272e962694bd9e32b3b7eae.text: Small internal update. No visible changes.

b0091ce2c3d28284800c6d702f9fc9aa48a7730c.text: The team switched to a faster tool for managing the app's building blocks. This update is internal and will not change how the product works for users.

148d1c73f460f72e3b864797d647b486d87a3358.text: The team added a rule for reporting security problems. If someone finds a safety issue, they will now send it to a private email instead of posting it publicly.

92ef47a31b12f1e75c0831c192b8d50d03d164ca.text: The internal setup for this tool was cleaned up so it works smoothly for everyone. You do not need to do anything; it just means the product runs more reliably behind the scenes.

453e865754de799ccde739180429a59055b326b3.text: The assistant now uses a smarter model to better understand requests. It is also stricter about taking action instead of just talking, and it processes file lists more efficiently.

e05b79eafc7f4e5b5d8a7cbfcbd2879473103364.text: Internal setup instructions were corrected to help new team members launch the tool properly. This change does not affect how the product works for current users.

f2ba232efe0a72760cdeebd88dcb7d93ac639c47.title: Add star history chart to README
f2ba232efe0a72760cdeebd88dcb7d93ac639c47.summary: Added a 'Star History' section to README.md embedding the star-history.com SVG chart for the CodebuffAI/codebuff repository. This provides visual growth tracking for users.

f51b44d3c12b7736e6cdc78331d037a0f1ae32b4.title: Agent Builder tip added to walkthrough
f51b44d3c12b7736e6cdc78331d037a0f1ae32b4.summary: Added a tip in creating-your-first-agent.mdx recommending @Bob the Agent Builder for agent creation, while advising manual first attempts. Scope limited to web content walkthroughs. Tip references internal Codebuff agent invocation.

a0ff417fce5cc87cd4843bc6b684db30030033c9.title: Remove extraneous code block from walkthrough
a0ff417fce5cc87cd4843bc6b684db30030033c9.summary: Deleted stray closing markdown code fences from `web/src/content/walkthroughs/creating-your-first-agent.mdx`. Added trailing comma to `spawn_agents` in `tools` array to fix syntax. Scope limited to docs content. No runtime impact.

3ea428b88171417329ad66277f1fa7661c3ae6ba.title: Log fullResponseChunks in agent step
3ea428b88171417329ad66277f1fa7661c3ae6ba.summary: Adds `fullResponseChunks` to the logging object in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. This captures raw streaming chunks alongside the aggregated `fullResponse` for debugging agent execution steps.

b64c31d77633c6c4dfdca27101978ce88f907f05.title: BackButton component added for publisher pages
b64c31d77633c6c4dfdca27101978ce88f907f05.summary: New `BackButton` component in `web/src/components/ui/back-button.tsx` uses `router.back()` for consistent navigation. Replaces hardcoded `Link` back buttons on agent detail and publisher pages. Improves UX by respecting browser history instead of fixed paths.

549a261f62cac8282808c079f3e2fd5e9c269a86.title: Walkthroughs docs section added
549a261f62cac8282808c079f3e2fd5e9c269a86.summary: Added Walkthroughs section to doc-sidebar.tsx. New file creating-your-first-agent.mdx added under web/src/content/walkthroughs/. Sidebar maps docs by category to subsections. Covers Web docs surface only.

4eda42c86b810924982a351f06ac801ec3ef6171.title: Add video embed and spawnable agent docs
4eda42c86b810924982a351f06ac801ec3ef6171.summary: Added YouTube embed to `creating-your-first-agent.mdx`. Inserted 'Spawnable Agents' section explaining Store vs Local ID formats. Updated example versions (`file-explorer@0.0.4`, `deep-thinker@0.0.3`) and added store links.

62a47a4cb7e9dedbc891f8bdf0790a6fe2730408.title: Add simple-code-reviewer agent
62a47a4cb7e9dedbc891f8bdf0790a6fe2730408.summary: New `.agents/simple-code-reviewer.ts` defines a `simple-code-reviewer` agent using `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` to review local code changes via `git diff`, untracked files, and spawned `codebuff/file-explorer@0.0.2` agents. `.agents/git-committer.ts` removes `process_type: 'SYNC'` and `timeout_seconds: 30` from `git diff` and `git log` tool calls, relying on default terminal command behavior. Scope limited to `.agents/` directory; no user-facing CLI or Web changes.

5e883532deefef112874f946493469ec9c566c2b.title: Fix escaped backticks in agent walkthrough doc
5e883532deefef112874f946493469ec9c566c2b.summary: Removed unnecessary backslash escapes from backticks in web/src/content/walkthroughs/creating-your-first-agent.mdx. Corrects Markdown rendering of systemPrompt and instructionsPrompt code blocks. Scope limited to documentation source.

0203027d0bb0d5b765435e6ca59913e420c1a9d4.title: Move agent store search and sort above grid
0203027d0bb0d5b765435e6ca59913e420c1a9d4.summary: Relocates search and sort controls to top of agent grid in `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`. Fixes layout flow so filters appear before results. Adds `mt-12` to All Agents section for spacing.

549a261f62cac8282808c079f3e2fd5e9c269a86.text: The help section now includes step-by-step guides for building your first agent, making it easier for new users to get started.

f2ba232efe0a72760cdeebd88dcb7d93ac639c47.text: The project's main page now displays a chart showing how its popularity has grown over time.

3ea428b88171417329ad66277f1fa7661c3ae6ba.text: A small internal change helps the support team see the full text the AI sends back, piece by piece. This makes it easier to figure out why a response might have looked broken or incomplete.

f51b44d3c12b7736e6cdc78331d037a0f1ae32b4.text: A small note was added to the guide suggesting you try building an agent manually first, then use a helper tool if you need it.

5e883532deefef112874f946493469ec9c566c2b.text: Fixed small text errors in an internal guide. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

a0ff417fce5cc87cd4843bc6b684db30030033c9.text: A small internal cleanup fixed a formatting error in a guide. This had no effect on how the product works.

0203027d0bb0d5b765435e6ca59913e420c1a9d4.text: Search and sort buttons now appear above the agent list. This makes it easier to filter results before viewing them.

62a47a4cb7e9dedbc891f8bdf0790a6fe2730408.text: A new internal tool reviews code changes automatically. This small update helps the team check work faster without affecting how you use the product.

4eda42c86b810924982a351f06ac801ec3ef6171.text: The help guide now includes a video and new explanations about how different types of assistants work. This makes it easier for users to understand the available options without technical knowledge.

b64c31d77633c6c4dfdca27101978ce88f907f05.text: Back buttons on agent and publisher pages now use the browser's history. This means clicking 'back' returns users to the previous page they visited, rather than a fixed location.

1217a53754489ef6be6257b36a25fcd8d4edb110.title: Add allowInferenceSourceChange flag to run options
1217a53754489ef6be6257b36a25fcd8d4edb110.summary: Added `allowInferenceSourceChange` flag to `RunOptions` in `sdk/src/run.ts` to permit explicit history transfer between inference sources. Default behavior preserves strict source pinning; provider failures never authorize transfer, only user-selected connections can trigger it. Scope covers SDK core (`run.ts`, `client.ts`) and BYOK error messaging (`byok.ts`). The flag ensures returned state and checkpoints pin the new source for subsequent runs.

1217a53754489ef6be6257b36a25fcd8d4edb110.text: You can now choose to switch the assistant's underlying model during a conversation. This keeps your chat history, but the assistant will use the new model for future replies.

a899c94590d8b9d2d7072a93ae9aaa5ebab6fa0c.title: Fix str replace on Windows newlines
a899c94590d8b9d2d7072a93ae9aaa5ebab6fa0c.summary: Refactor processStrReplace to normalize line endings before matching and replacing. Moved normalizeLineEndings to module scope and applied to newStr. Deferred line ending restoration until after all replacements. Covers backend/src/process-str-replace.ts.

fa2a6d7fe15d1513b99b7d92999eb578d3d90de0.title: Client logs structured output, explorer spawns parallel
fa2a6d7fe15d1513b99b7d92999eb578d3d90de0.summary: npm-app/src/client.ts adds console.log for a.output?.type === 'structuredOutput'. .agents/codebase-commands-explorer.ts shifts file-explorer spawn to parallel step 1, renumbering steps. Internal debug visibility and agent orchestration.

2f49439aa1b9c0e7a7f0986a3e7cf6b4d6672242.title: Publisher avatar and id link to profile page
2f49439aa1b9c0e7a7f0986a3e7cf6b4d6672242.summary: Wrapped publisher avatar and id in Link components pointing to /publishers/[id] on AgentDetailPage and AgentStorePage. Adds hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity for visual feedback. Covers web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx and web/src/app/store/page.tsx. Enables direct navigation from agent details and store listings to publisher profiles.

a96ca03f570f26957f6e9da4a6a399485e3e96d4.title: Fix strreplace null check and patch generation
a96ca03f570f26957f6e9da4a6a399485e3e96d4.summary: Moved null check for initialContent to top of processStrReplace, returning error immediately instead of continuing loop. Patch generation now compares initialContent to currentContent for no-op detection, replacing allPatches.length check. Single patch created from initial to final content replaces per-replacement patches.

d573159865734d54fae97bcbadf0ee816a61c366.title: agents API cache revalidate 60s
d573159865734d54fae97bcbadf0ee816a61c366.summary: Agents API route cache invalidation changed from 0 to 60 seconds. Route.ts `revalidate` export updated. Scope: `web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts` only.

916ee1fedd8e7caee71faabe679cf983a460b5e4.title: AgentStore: Add publisher avatar
916ee1fedd8e7caee71faabe679cf983a460b5e4.summary: Publisher avatars added to AgentStore listings and detail pages. New `avatar.tsx` component wraps `@radix-ui/react-avatar` to display images or initial fallbacks. API route `web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts` now selects `avatar_url` from the publisher schema.

a08f9cff13abcca298c078ce541259645fa0317a.title: Update Editor's Choice agents on store page
a08f9cff13abcca298c078ce541259645fa0317a.summary: Replaces 'base2' with 'codebase-commands-explorer' in EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS. Adjusts the featured agent list in web/src/app/store/page.tsx. Affects the Web store page UI.

3c8986b38c45b4cb0a7a607c87feda29a41c3a70.title: Add codebase commands explorer and read-only commander lite agents
3c8986b38c45b4cb0a7a607c87feda29a41c3a70.summary: Introduced `codebase-commands-explorer` and `read-only-commander-lite` agent definitions. `codebase-commands-explorer` uses `openai/gpt-5` to discover build/test commands with structured output. `read-only-commander-lite` uses `x-ai/grok-code-fast-1` for speedy read-only terminal execution. `read-only-commander` moved from `.agents/base2/` to `.agents/` and updated prompt wording.

2afe981bc91f71749098c1a87aedfedd899a7819.title: set-output schema mismatch returns tool result instead of throwing
2afe981bc91f71749098c1a87aedfedd899a7819.summary: set-output handler returns validation error string instead of throwing when outputSchema.parse fails. Prevents agent crash on schema mismatch by providing feedback as tool result. Affects backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/set-output.ts.

84398517afd68ed360d5db31fd0afe65be2b4ea0.title: Fix strreplace file edit chaining
84398517afd68ed360d5db31fd0afe65be2b4ea0.summary: Refactored `handleStrReplace` in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/str-replace.ts` to resolve the latest file content directly from the last promise in `fileProcessingState.promisesByPath` instead of awaiting all pending promises. This prevents race conditions where `Promise.all` would block on unrelated or failed edits, causing the tool to read stale file states or fail to apply changes. The change ensures sequential edits within a session correctly chain off the most recent successful content update.

2afe981bc91f71749098c1a87aedfedd899a7819.text: If the assistant gives a result that doesn't fit the expected format, it now shows you an error message instead of crashing.

a08f9cff13abcca298c078ce541259645fa0317a.text: The featured assistant list on the store page changed. One assistant was replaced with another.

fa2a6d7fe15d1513b99b7d92999eb578d3d90de0.text: The assistant now checks files faster by looking at them at the same time. This small internal update helps the system work more smoothly, but you won't see any changes on your screen.

3c8986b38c45b4cb0a7a607c87feda29a41c3a70.text: The assistant now finds project setup steps and runs safe checks faster.

916ee1fedd8e7caee71faabe679cf983a460b5e4.text: Publisher images now appear on agent listings and detail pages. If an image is missing, the system shows the publisher's initials instead.

a899c94590d8b9d2d7072a93ae9aaa5ebab6fa0c.text: Text replacements now work correctly even if the document uses Windows-style line breaks. This prevents errors when editing content.

d573159865734d54fae97bcbadf0ee816a61c366.text: The list of available assistants now refreshes every minute instead of instantly. This small internal change means you might wait up to sixty seconds to see new assistants appear.

2f49439aa1b9c0e7a7f0986a3e7cf6b4d6672242.text: Clicking a publisher's picture or name now takes you directly to their profile page.

a96ca03f570f26957f6e9da4a6a399485e3e96d4.text: Fixed a crash when editing text with no starting content. Now, if no changes are made, the system recognizes it and avoids creating empty updates.

84398517afd68ed360d5db31fd0afe65be2b4ea0.text: Fixed a small internal issue where making several changes to a file at once could cause errors or missed updates. Now, each change correctly builds on the previous one, so your edits save reliably.

480de71d81c0c71e0abacf87a62501d6190962b3.title: Nightly evals concurrency back to 10
480de71d81c0c71e0abacf87a62501d6190962b3.summary: Reverted --concurrency to 10 in .github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml. Restores previous throughput after temporary reduction. No user-facing changes.

440d1327dfc9a3b86ca9cc99ca3543b50e427267.title: Disable caching on agents API route
440d1327dfc9a3b86ca9cc99ca3543b50e427267.summary: Added `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and `revalidate = 0` to `web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts`. Forces fresh metrics data on GET requests. Scope limited to Web API surface.

bcfa26df1b0bc6a768025b8f3f1d7396eace9709.title: Remove temp logging from release-staging
bcfa26df1b0bc6a768025b8f3f1d7396eace9709.summary: Removed temporary console.log statements from getLatestVersion in npm-app/release-staging/index.js. These debug logs previously printed HTTP status codes, raw response bodies, and parsed package data to stdout. This cleanup reduces noise in the staging release pipeline output.

7d689bcbef4dcf858d042d1eef17b4ae1637beb9.title: Add debug logging to release-staging getLatestVersion
7d689bcbef4dcf858d042d1eef17b4ae1637beb9.summary: Added console.log statements to getLatestVersion in npm-app/release-staging/index.js. Logs statusCode, raw body, and parsed packageData for debugging. Internal change affecting release staging script only.

bcedb34354a69d3183827e79c1a816bd58cf0e10.title: markdown-renderer loading indicator cleanup
bcedb34354a69d3183827e79c1a816bd58cf0e10.summary: Loading indicator cleanup in `npm-app/src/display/markdown-renderer.ts` reorders timer clearing before cursor reset to prevent race conditions. The indicator line clearing width increases from 10 to 20 spaces to fully wipe the `●●●` animation. This change avoids stuck indicator states and potential memory leaks during markdown rendering.

b20b07f85f95950d5980853f6e9d7521290145d4.title: Fix typecheck for unit tests
b20b07f85f95950d5980853f6e9d7521290145d4.summary: Removed obsolete loading indicator tests from npm-app/src/__tests__/markdown-renderer.test.ts to resolve typecheck failures. Applied formatting fixes including trailing whitespace removal and arrow function parentheses. Scope limited to test suite cleanup.

be57454b44726626352e06a2b6873b3783514cc5.title: Remove fileContext from getFileReadingUpdates
be57454b44726626352e06a2b6873b3783514cc5.summary: Refactor getFileReadingUpdates signature to drop ProjectFileContext parameter. Callers in run-agent-step, find-files, and read-files updated to pass messages and options directly. Internal cleanup removes unused knowledge file injection logic from backend.

5f63472e4658c30ae98bfbf4fa31ae5bf9b6981b.title: Refactor spinner state into dedicated utility
5f63472e4658c30ae98bfbf4fa31ae5bf9b6981b.summary: Removed inline loading indicator logic from `MarkdownStreamRenderer` in favor of the shared `Spinner` utility. The `Spinner` class now supports textless frames and returns state metadata on `stop` to allow accurate resumption in `subagent-headers`. This centralizes cursor management and animation logic across display surfaces.

3d6dbdecbf5f64d99a76f7b4048292718de656ac.title: Remove fileupdates tool and simplify file reading logic
3d6dbdecbf5f64d99a76f7b4048292718de656ac.summary: Deleted the `file_updates` tool schema and associated injection logic in `run-agent-step.ts`. Refactored `getFileReadingUpdates` to accept only requested paths, removing complex diffing against message history and token budget filtering. This simplifies the backend agent loop by eliminating automatic file change tracking in favor of explicit tool calls.

5775c775c4a4f53adff96886b0aea617f388fa26.title: codesearch adds maxResults param, default 30
5775c775c4a4f53adff96886b0aea617f388fa26.summary: code_search tool gains maxResults parameter (default 30) across common params, SDK, and npm-app handlers. Previously hardcoded to 3 results in npm-app, now configurable with truncation notice `[Results limited to X of Y total matches]` when exceeded. Updated ReadDocsParams: topic now required, default max_tokens raised 10000→20000, libraryTitle description softened. SetMessagesParams.messages type relaxed to any. SpawnAgentsParams doc clarifies parallel execution semantics.

b20b07f85f95950d5980853f6e9d7521290145d4.text: The team removed outdated checks for a loading symbol to fix a technical error. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

440d1327dfc9a3b86ca9cc99ca3543b50e427267.text: The system now checks for new information every time you open the agent list. This ensures you always see the latest updates.

5775c775c4a4f53adff96886b0aea617f388fa26.text: The code search tool now shows up to 30 results by default, instead of just 3, with a notice if more exist.

480de71d81c0c71e0abacf87a62501d6190962b3.text: The system processes background quality checks at a faster rate again. This is an internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

7d689bcbef4dcf858d042d1eef17b4ae1637beb9.text: The team added internal notes to help track how the system finds the newest software updates. This change is for engineers only and does not affect how you use the product.

5f63472e4658c30ae98bfbf4fa31ae5bf9b6981b.text: The loading animation now uses a single shared system, so it looks and behaves consistently across the app.

3d6dbdecbf5f64d99a76f7b4048292718de656ac.text: The assistant now reads files only when you specifically ask, instead of automatically checking for changes. This makes the system simpler and more predictable.

be57454b44726626352e06a2b6873b3783514cc5.text: The system now fetches file updates more efficiently by removing an unnecessary step. This internal cleanup helps the assistant work faster without changing how you use it.

bcfa26df1b0bc6a768025b8f3f1d7396eace9709.text: Developers removed extra notes that the system was writing to its internal log. This change makes the log cleaner for the team, but it will not change how the product works for you.

bcedb34354a69d3183827e79c1a816bd58cf0e10.text: A small internal fix ensures the loading animation clears properly. This prevents the indicator from getting stuck on the screen while text displays.

25d1a63defbf9158bff0ba26f57f4631bc520dec.title: Hide last used date in Agent Store
25d1a63defbf9158bff0ba26f57f4631bc520dec.summary: Agent Store page hides `last_used` timestamps via CSS `hidden` class. Changes "Weekly spent" label to "Weekly spend". Internal UI tweak in `web/src/app/store/page.tsx`.

0ed809f2206bb8a837e0305cabfae89d7fe85c7b.title: Fix startAgentRun storing agent template id
0ed809f2206bb8a837e0305cabfae89d7fe85c7b.summary: Corrected startAgentRun to store agentTemplate.id instead of agentType. Fixes bug where full agent id was incorrectly persisted on run start. Affects backend run-agent-step.ts.

1a2d26f2c94bded264acc966d296d79ece223844.title: Drop initial files from first-read path in get-file-reading-updates
1a2d26f2c94bded264acc966d296d79ece223844.summary: Removes `getInitialFiles` injection from `backend/src/get-file-reading-updates.ts` so first reads only surface explicitly requested or edited files. Prevents knowledge files from being included twice when `previousFileList` is empty. Scope limited to backend file-reading logic; no CLI or Web surface changes. `newFiles` now derives solely from `filteredRequestedFiles` and `requestedLoadedFiles`.

26f4657033a26a318fa34b8f0ebd9a8f1260d50a.title: Hide download button on agent detail page
26f4657033a26a318fa34b8f0ebd9a8f1260d50a.summary: Download button removed from agent detail page UI. Button rendered but lacked functionality. Scope limited to `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx`.

905c18bf93f3c1e6cdcf640ad68b176b708075a3.title: Remove 50-agent fetch limit on publisher page
905c18bf93f3c1e6cdcf640ad68b176b708075a3.summary: The publisher page now fetches all agents for a publisher instead of limiting the query to 50 results. The `.limit(50)` call was removed from the database query in `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/page.tsx`. This change allows the page to display the complete list of agents for grouping, regardless of quantity.

7255f468e7e731ff8f736088c7e9c4259abc4c75.title: Add My Publishers button to Agent Store header
7255f468e7e731ff8f736088c7e9c4259abc4c75.summary: Added conditional 'Create Publisher' and 'My Publishers' buttons to web/src/app/store/page.tsx header. Logic checks session via useSession and fetches user publishers from /api/publishers. Buttons render only for signed-in users, linking to /publishers/new or /publishers based on existing publisher count. Uses PublisherProfileResponse type from @codebuff/common.

8646f5d7a111384bf2786fb050d4b8b4d60fc884.title: Agent store: Weekly spent, weekly runs. Updated instead of New
8646f5d7a111384bf2786fb050d4b8b4d60fc884.summary: The agent store page renames the `New` badge to `Updated` and updates the underlying helper from `isNewAgent` to `isRecentlyUpdated`. Metric labels change from "Weekly" and "Runs" to "Weekly spent" and "Weekly runs" for clarity. A trailing comma is added to the `EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS` array.

9d2ff93d42c26d0295ca59e5bf5dd9d92c6415d6.title: Fix agent metrics aggregation in API route
9d2ff93d42c26d0295ca59e5bf5dd9d92c6415d6.summary: Refactored GET handler in web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts to group agents by publisher/name before applying usage metrics. Previous logic mapped metrics to every version, causing incorrect aggregation when multiple versions existed. Now selects latest version first, then attaches metrics, ensuring accurate weekly/total spend reporting.

c168a9fbde4c22ff48801f596a5786ddae074282.title: Agent store API returns aggregated and per-version stats
c168a9fbde4c22ff48801f596a5786ddae074282.summary: The agent store API now returns both aggregated all-time/weekly usage metrics and per-version usage metrics. This fixes agent page accuracy by ensuring version-specific stats are available alongside aggregate data. Changes span web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts, agent-usage-metrics.tsx, version page.tsx, and store page.tsx. The AgentUsageMetrics component now accepts a version prop and falls back to zero stats when version-specific data is missing.

792bc54e45f1da9fe265950d8ca81091eec409a4.title: Fix MaxListenersExceededWarning and markdown rendering
792bc54e45f1da9fe265950d8ca81091eec409a4.summary: Moved `xmlStreamParser.end()` outside conditional in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to ensure cleanup, preventing `MaxListenersExceededWarning`. Updated `npm-app/src/display/markdown-renderer.ts` to clear loading indicators with 10 spaces instead of 5, and refactored code block placeholder replacement to use captured indices and simplify newline handling. These changes improve stability and rendering accuracy in the npm app.

8646f5d7a111384bf2786fb050d4b8b4d60fc884.text: A small internal update changed the label on the agent store from 'New' to 'Updated' and clarified the names of two usage statistics.

905c18bf93f3c1e6cdcf640ad68b176b708075a3.text: The publisher page now shows every agent linked to a publisher, not just the first 50. This means you see the complete list for grouping, regardless of how many agents there are.

1a2d26f2c94bded264acc966d296d79ece223844.text: The assistant now avoids showing duplicate files when opening a project for the first time. This is a small internal fix that improves how files are listed.

26f4657033a26a318fa34b8f0ebd9a8f1260d50a.text: The download button on the agent detail page is gone. It did not work, so removing it prevents people from clicking a broken feature.

9d2ff93d42c26d0295ca59e5bf5dd9d92c6415d6.text: Spending reports now show accurate totals for weekly and overall costs.

0ed809f2206bb8a837e0305cabfae89d7fe85c7b.text: The system now correctly remembers which assistant you selected when starting a task. This fixes an internal error, ensuring your choice is saved accurately.

c168a9fbde4c22ff48801f596a5786ddae074282.text: The system now shows both total usage and usage for each version of the assistant. This gives a clearer picture of how much the assistant is used overall and by specific versions.

25d1a63defbf9158bff0ba26f57f4631bc520dec.text: The Agent Store page no longer shows when an agent was last used. The 'Weekly spent' label changed to 'Weekly spend'.

7255f468e7e731ff8f736088c7e9c4259abc4c75.text: A new button appears in the store header for signed-in users, letting them create a publisher or view their existing ones.

792bc54e45f1da9fe265950d8ca81091eec409a4.text: The app now cleans up connections properly to prevent performance warnings. Text formatting displays more accurately. These internal updates improve stability and appearance.

621caab47b023609cbb1cbc8f03cf86714d6bc50.title: Fix CodebuffToolOutput type checker
621caab47b023609cbb1cbc8f03cf86714d6bc50.summary: Refactored `CodebuffToolOutput` generic in `common/src/tools/list.ts` to resolve type checking errors for tool results. Changed from nested conditional types to a mapped type over `ToolName | ResultOnlyToolName` followed by index access. This ensures correct inference of `z.infer` schemas for both standard and result-only tools.

2d49059d7d6deb57b5b0789d0d412f4b5c10dda8.title: Add New badge to agent cards
2d49059d7d6deb57b5b0789d0d412f4b5c10dda8.summary: Added a 'New' badge to the agent store cards in `web/src/app/agents/page.tsx`. Implemented `isNewAgent` helper to check if an agent's `created_at` timestamp is within the last 24 hours. The new badge renders in green alongside the existing amber 'Editor's Choice' badge within a flex container.

394a20a27d65f54cb1b6eb79a08e44a149e84cd5.title: Agent Store nav live, search moved below grid
394a20a27d65f54cb1b6eb79a08e44a149e84cd5.summary: Uncommented Agent Store links in web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx, pointing /agents to /store. Moved search/filter block below agent grid in web/src/app/store/page.tsx. Updated EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS: removed thinker, added deep-code-reviewer.

fc42ff3e264645abf7cccec56e3d1fdcd7503091.title: Add version to agent API response
fc42ff3e264645abf7cccec56e3d1fdcd7503091.summary: Added version field to agent API response in web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts. Consolidated groupBy calls onto single lines. Scope limited to web API route.

3f04e5b07d0ed57e4f81ba3dbe4390e61c4bb3d8.title: Simplify tool message types
3f04e5b07d0ed57e4f81ba3dbe4390e61c4bb3d8.summary: CodebuffToolMessage drops mapped-type indirection for direct CodebuffToolResult intersection. User and assistant message schemas switch from z.union to z.discriminatedUnion on type field for faster, precise validation. fileUpdatesResultSchema marks referencedBy optional in common/src/tools/params/tool/file-updates.ts. Scope covers common/src/tools/list.ts and common/src/types/messages/codebuff-message.ts.

36a870f0b74b53e35d8e041aba31f694241b393d.title: Fix fileupdates tool result parsing and typing
36a870f0b74b53e35d8e041aba31f694241b393d.summary: Corrects parsing logic in `getPreviouslyReadFiles` to handle `file_updates` tool outputs by accessing the nested `files` array, resolving prior type errors. Introduces `additionalToolResultSchemas` and `fileUpdatesResultSchema` in `common/src/tools/params/tool/file-updates.ts` to define strict Zod types for result-only tools. Updates `CodebuffToolOutput`, `CodebuffToolResult`, and `CodebuffToolMessage` types in `common/src/tools/list.ts` to support the new schema structure. Ensures `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` and `backend/src/util/messages.ts` correctly interpret `file_updates` outputs without runtime crashes.

330b28f48bcfb5b6c632d7723775000850546f6e.title: Add Editor's Choice section to Agent Store page
330b28f48bcfb5b6c632d7723775000850546f6e.summary: web/src/app/agents/page.tsx gains a hard-coded EDITORS_CHOICE_AGENTS list (base, base-lite, base2, reviewer, thinker, deep-thinker) and a filteredEditorsChoice memo that surfaces those agents in a dedicated section above the main grid. The AgentCard component was extracted and extended with an isEditorsChoice prop that applies a ring-2 ring-amber-500/50 border and a Star badge. Search filtering applies to both the editors' choice subset and the full agent list independently.

72f530b67942e103a670ba032070bf1556f2eb64.title: agents API aggregates metrics across versions
72f530b67942e103a670ba032070bf1556f2eb64.summary: GET /api/agents route now filters usage queries by publisher_id and agent_name IS NOT NULL, excluding unpublished agents. Grouping drops agent_id and agent_version, aggregating metrics across all versions. Output removes version field, keeping only latest agent per publisher/name. Internal change to web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts.

1a1d4cdf5378c1fe6c4acc06753065b07d358393.title: Add Infisical setup guide and .env.example
1a1d4cdf5378c1fe6c4acc06753065b07d358393.summary: Added `INFISICAL_SETUP_GUIDE.md` and `.env.example` to standardize local secret management. Updated `CONTRIBUTING.md` with explicit `infisical secrets set --file .env.example` commands and clarified service startup order (backend -> web -> CLI). Includes specific `DATABASE_URL` override instructions to match local Docker credentials.

b0e00faf4f414930f30b12bbe226e4987dabeecb.title: Update @ menu tip and refine file search priority
b0e00faf4f414930f30b12bbe226e4987dabeecb.summary: The `@` menu tip now instructs users to use `@` for file searching, replacing the previous agent-specific example. File search priority logic in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` was inverted to prioritize matches with directory prefixes and penalize non-prefix matches. This change affects the CLI's interactive file selection experience.

36a870f0b74b53e35d8e041aba31f694241b393d.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant misread lists of changed files. This stops crashes and helps the assistant accurately see what files were updated.

330b28f48bcfb5b6c632d7723775000850546f6e.text: The Agent Store now highlights a special 'Editor's Choice' section at the top, featuring a curated list of recommended assistants marked with a star badge. This helps users quickly find trusted options without scrolling through the entire catalog.

621caab47b023609cbb1cbc8f03cf86714d6bc50.text: Fixed internal checks to ensure the assistant correctly understands results from different tools. This improves reliability without changing how you use the product.

fc42ff3e264645abf7cccec56e3d1fdcd7503091.text: The assistant now shares its version number when asked. This small internal update helps support teams identify which version is running.

b0e00faf4f414930f30b12bbe226e4987dabeecb.text: The tip for the search menu now gives clearer instructions on how to find files. The search results are also ordered to show the most relevant files first.

3f04e5b07d0ed57e4f81ba3dbe4390e61c4bb3d8.text: The system now checks data formats faster and more accurately, making it slightly more reliable when handling file updates.

2d49059d7d6deb57b5b0789d0d412f4b5c10dda8.text: Agent cards now show a green 'New' badge if created within the last 24 hours. This helps users quickly identify recently added agents.

394a20a27d65f54cb1b6eb79a08e44a149e84cd5.text: The Agent Store is now visible in the navigation menu, and its search bar sits below the grid of agents. The featured list also updated, swapping one agent for another.

55179df4a53f2a542640b2bf05f3a109fe5cc02a.title: Inline agent display names and prompts
55179df4a53f2a542640b2bf05f3a109fe5cc02a.summary: Replaced `AGENT_PERSONAS` lookups with hardcoded `displayName` and `spawnerPrompt` strings in `superagent.ts` and `thinking-base.ts`. This fixes type errors caused by missing or mismatched keys in the personas object. Scope limited to internal agent factory definitions. Superagent now explicitly states 'Superagent that can spawn multiple code editing agents to complete a task.'

1ab6c9fe589d8ff53eb1081fc765ef8369fc8a6d.title: Agent store card redesign: id, version, relative time
1ab6c9fe589d8ff53eb1081fc765ef8369fc8a6d.summary: Agent store cards now lead with `agent.id` and version badge instead of display name. Added `formatRelativeTime` in `web/src/lib/date-utils.ts` for 'just now'/'X ago' labels. Currency formatting compresses >=1000 to 'k' suffix. Scope: `web/src/app/agents/page.tsx`, `web/src/lib/date-utils.ts`.

10dc52b48ef20a6d1b1bb2336e1d72e07ca6e8fa.title: Add CONTRIBUTING.md
10dc52b48ef20a6d1b1bb2336e1d72e07ca6e8fa.summary: New CONTRIBUTING.md added. README updated to link it. Covers setup, monorepo structure, contribution workflow. Internal docs only.

bb06e768c5ec19d836ce6d5a783a773fcdb2edaa.title: Add Usage Metrics to Agent Detail Page
bb06e768c5ec19d836ce6d5a783a773fcdb2edaa.summary: New AgentUsageMetrics component added to the agent version detail page, fetching data via /api/agents and displaying usage_count, weekly_spent, avg_cost_per_invocation, unique_users, and last_used in a card grid. The agent store page (web/src/app/agents/page.tsx) now supports sorting by 'unique_users' in addition to existing options. Metrics render with skeleton loaders during fetch and hide if no matching agent data is found.

48d92c2aac5956d616b4ddc82270b7fe0539fe98.title: Disable bold color styling in markdown renderer
48d92c2aac5956d616b4ddc82270b7fe0539fe98.summary: Added `strong` handler to `MarkdownStreamRenderer` in `npm-app/src/display/markdown-renderer.ts` returning plain text. Prevents yellow coloring for bold markdown. Internal display logic update.

0838f4fb0a134e922b8691fe6f7da9f92b5b4f6d.title: Nightly evals concurrency 3, timeout 24h
0838f4fb0a134e922b8691fe6f7da9f92b5b4f6d.summary: Nightly evals workflow concurrency drops from 10 to 3, timeout raises from 540 to 1440 minutes. Change in .github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml. Lower parallelism likely addresses rate limits or resource contention; extended timeout accommodates slower sequential runs.

2383f28ac6ccdf104d0779c41385815a9b771162.title: Update Infisical setup docs and ignore config
2383f28ac6ccdf104d0779c41385815a9b771162.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md adds `infisical init` step and dummy secret guidance. `.infisical.json` removed from repo and added to `.gitignore`. Prevents committing workspace-specific config.

167a90885971be3d7ce1943f1d6d4c6fd4dfdd8e.title: BrowserRunner drops persistent user data directory
167a90885971be3d7ce1943f1d6d4c6fd4dfdd8e.summary: Removed userDataDir configuration from BrowserRunner puppeteer launch. Eliminates project-scoped profile persistence in browser-runner.ts. Internal cleanup of browser_logs handling. No user-facing behavior change.

2d7bd9933357dab3148c7fbdbae66d66ccfa6705.title: Nit Pick Nick reviewer purpose updated for minor changes
2d7bd9933357dab3148c7fbdbae66d66ccfa6705.summary: Updated `AGENT_PERSONAS.reviewer.purpose` in `common/src/constants/agents.ts` to advise against using the reviewer agent for minor changes due to latency. The text now explicitly states 'otherwise, no need to use this agent for minor changes since it takes a second.' This change affects the core agent definition shared across CLI and Web surfaces.

3388b22dcf16bb140ef45efb664609f8cd806e68.title: Remove local-development.md and update README/CONTRIBUTING
3388b22dcf16bb140ef45efb664609f8cd806e68.summary: Deleted local-development.md and updated README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. Content from the deleted file was consolidated into CONTRIBUTING.md. README.md received minor text and formatting adjustments.

0838f4fb0a134e922b8691fe6f7da9f92b5b4f6d.text: The team reduced the number of tests that run at once and gave them more time to finish. This small internal change helps the tests complete reliably without overwhelming the system.

10dc52b48ef20a6d1b1bb2336e1d72e07ca6e8fa.text: The team added a guide for new workers. This helps them learn how to do their jobs correctly. It does not change how the product works for you.

bb06e768c5ec19d836ce6d5a783a773fcdb2edaa.text: The agent detail page now shows usage stats like total uses, weekly spend, average cost, unique users, and last used date. The agent list can also be sorted by unique users.

2d7bd9933357dab3148c7fbdbae66d66ccfa6705.text: The system now avoids using a slow, detailed review tool for minor updates. This speeds up the assistant's response time for simple tasks.

48d92c2aac5956d616b4ddc82270b7fe0539fe98.text: Bold text in the assistant's replies no longer appears in yellow. This is a small internal change to how messages look.

2383f28ac6ccdf104d0779c41385815a9b771162.text: Internal setup instructions now guide new team members to configure their private workspace settings locally, preventing accidental sharing of personal configuration details.

3388b22dcf16bb140ef45efb664609f8cd806e68.text: The team cleaned up internal setup guides by merging duplicate instructions into one place. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

167a90885971be3d7ce1943f1d6d4c6fd4dfdd8e.text: A small internal change removes how the system remembers browser settings between uses. This does not change how the product works for you.

1ab6c9fe589d8ff53eb1081fc765ef8369fc8a6d.text: The assistant cards now show their unique ID and a time label like 'just now' instead of the name. Prices over one thousand are shortened with a 'k'.

8be5fbd73d12fb50c27b9425aefee45a7bcae44d.title: Fix typos across agent prompts, tool definitions, and docs
8be5fbd73d12fb50c27b9425aefee45a7bcae44d.summary: Corrected spelling and grammar errors in system prompts, tool definitions, agent type documentation, and README examples. Fixes include 'abiltity' to 'ability', 'typcically' to 'typically', 'knowldge' to 'knowledge', and 'psuedo' to 'pseudo'. Scope covers backend prompt logic, common agent templates, and npm-app release scripts. No functional logic changes; purely cosmetic text corrections.

33d08de5b081f7d6ea1ed68f492a23a697207c44.title: changes-reviewer renamed deep-code-reviewer
33d08de5b081f7d6ea1ed68f492a23a697207c44.summary: Renamed agent id to `deep-code-reviewer`. Switched model to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4`. Added `code_search` tool and `deep-thinker` spawnable agent. Removed `inputSchema`, `systemPrompt`, and manual `add_message` step. Updated `handleSteps` to remove `process_type` and `timeout_seconds` from `run_terminal_command` calls.

e2239c70237ed1e925c48d01e3f3209b5ea95463.title: Add weekly usage metrics to agent store
e2239c70237ed1e925c48d01e3f3209b5ea95463.summary: The agent store API now computes weekly and all-time usage metrics by querying `agentRun` with date filters and aggregation. The frontend `AgentStorePage` defaults to sorting by 'cost' (weekly spend) and displays a new 'Weekly Usage' card with unique user counts. This change replaces static or limited usage data with real-time SQL-derived metrics for better agent visibility.

c9fda9fcc946fa948ecee730213f9296d66dbe95.title: getPreviouslyReadFiles tracks findfiles and fileupdates
c9fda9fcc946fa948ecee730213f9296d66dbe95.summary: getPreviouslyReadFiles in backend/src/util/messages.ts now matches find_files and file_updates tool messages alongside read_files. This expands the previously-read files context to include search and modification operations. Change affects backend message processing logic. Type guard updated to accept multiple toolName values.

c32293cd44f11a690888b98370da25754305f351.title: Exclude codebuff config files from web scraping in project context
c32293cd44f11a690888b98370da25754305f351.summary: Added filter in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` to exclude `codebuffConfigFile` and `codebuffConfigFileBackup` from `addScrapedContentToFiles`. Prevents scraping content for these specific config paths, addressing the issue of not scraping web pages from `codebuff.json`. Scope limited to internal project file context generation.

96863c321b7a9372ac5092113ed85989138c9d54.title: Trim agent personas
96863c321b7a9372ac5092113ed85989138c9d54.summary: Removed redundant agent personas (base-lite, base-max, base-experimental, claude4-gemini-thinking, superagent, dry-run) from AGENT_PERSONAS. Updated display names for base and ask agents to be more generic. This cleanup reduces the surface area of unused or deprecated agent configurations in common/src/constants/agents.ts.

0efad5d39dd06945d05cf060285246ae2133bc7c.title: Add @ file path completions to CLI
0efad5d39dd06945d05cf060285246ae2133bc7c.summary: Added `calculateAtFilenameCompletions` to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to support `@` prefix file path autocomplete in the CLI. The logic extracts the search term after `@`, retrieves all file paths from `client.fileContext.fileTree`, and filters for matches. Results are prioritized (directories first) and merged with existing agent name completions in `inputCompleter`.

e42a4ab995a2e11ada6e24f7aa0fa6ba71f5a0a2.title: Genericize tool call prompt examples
e42a4ab995a2e11ada6e24f7aa0fa6ba71f5a0a2.summary: Replaced specific tool names like str_replace and {tool_name} with generic placeholders example_editing_tool and tool_name in backend/src/tools/prompts.ts. This prevents model hallucination of non-existent tools or rigid adherence to specific parameter schemas during tool call formatting. Scope limited to internal prompt engineering constants.

51a9cf6ec831309e6e5938a2f807978886029983.title: Fix CLI agent autocomplete spaces
51a9cf6ec831309e6e5938a2f807978886029983.summary: Updated `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to support agent names with spaces in autocomplete. The logic now checks if the line contains `@` and extracts the prefix from the last `@` occurrence instead of relying on the last word. This ensures correct matching and completion for multi-word agent identifiers.

c8b9d6f0c31158e22e143f44f8c538c7ed80464c.title: Improve CLI rendering: faster indicators, markdown parsing, null
c8b9d6f0c31158e22e143f44f8c538c7ed80464c.summary: Internal refactor of CLI display and stream parsing utilities. `MarkdownStreamRenderer` reduces `indicatorThresholdMs` to 50ms, enables `breaks` in markdown-it, and adds logic for indented code blocks and spacing normalization. `xml-stream-parser` and `tool-renderers` implement null safety checks for tag names, text data, and parameter values to prevent crashes.

96863c321b7a9372ac5092113ed85989138c9d54.text: Removed several unused assistant options. This cleanup does not change how you use the product.

e2239c70237ed1e925c48d01e3f3209b5ea95463.text: The store now shows real weekly usage and cost data instead of static numbers. This helps you see which agents are actually being used and how much they cost.

33d08de5b081f7d6ea1ed68f492a23a697207c44.text: The code reviewer got a new name and a better brain. It now searches code deeper and thinks harder before answering. You will see smarter, more thorough reviews.

c9fda9fcc946fa948ecee730213f9296d66dbe95.text: The assistant now remembers files it found or edited, not just those it read. This helps it keep track of your work more accurately.

e42a4ab995a2e11ada6e24f7aa0fa6ba71f5a0a2.text: The assistant now uses generic examples instead of specific tool names in its internal instructions. This helps it avoid mistakes when choosing how to perform tasks.

0efad5d39dd06945d05cf060285246ae2133bc7c.text: When you type the @ symbol, you can now search for and select file paths directly.

8be5fbd73d12fb50c27b9425aefee45a7bcae44d.text: Corrected spelling mistakes in the text instructions that guide the assistant. This small cleanup improves the clarity of internal prompts and documentation, with no changes to how the features work.

c32293cd44f11a690888b98370da25754305f351.text: The system now ignores internal setup files when gathering project information. This prevents errors when the assistant reads your work.

dd11ea1898423928a22abd37b8a15fcd793b0521.title: Update subagent streaming unit test assertions
dd11ea1898423928a22abd37b8a15fcd793b0521.summary: Adjusts expectations in subagent-streaming.test.ts to match current behavior. Replaces checks for mockSendSubagentChunk with mockWriteToClient, verifying 4 total writes including dividers and raw chunks.

42c21943893bbd62254ebc3682ca43daec04438f.title: Fix ask agent prompts
42c21943893bbd62254ebc3682ca43daec04438f.summary: Condensed instructions in `.agents/prompts/ask-prompts.ts` to clarify file version handling and tool call formatting. Removed verbose explanations about user file modifications and redundant parameter formatting rules. Updated mandatory empty line examples to use `<codebuff_tool_call>` instead of generic tags.

cd14fb30dda157962368080bdddfa8f88148e3d9.title: Guard undefined text in markdown renderer
cd14fb30dda157962368080bdddfa8f88148e3d9.summary: Added `|| ''` fallbacks to `heading`, `paragraph`, `listitem`, `orderedlistitem`, `code_block`, and `fence` style functions in `npm-app/src/display/markdown-renderer.ts`. Prevents literal 'undefined' strings when upstream markdown-it passes undefined text. Internal fix only.

c27f169ca051f678a11de3039c8c1689d3ed62ac.title: ANSI-aware wrap width, lazy XML renderer, targeted resize cleanup
c27f169ca051f678a11de3039c8c1689d3ed62ac.summary: MarkdownStreamRenderer strips ANSI escape codes before computing wrap width, capping to available terminal columns instead of fixed 120. XML parser now lazily instantiates and tracks renderers via activeRendererCount, guaranteeing cleanup on destroy or flush. Subagent and traces handlers selectively remove handleResize listeners instead of removeAllListeners, preserving external resize hooks. Covers npm-app/src/display/markdown-renderer.ts, npm-app/src/utils/xml-stream-parser.ts, npm-app/src/cli-handlers/subagent.ts, npm-app/src/cli-handlers/traces.ts.

dd049fdd7dadc0ca752c0355f5a73040171a110c.title: Deep copy agent state in programmatic step
dd049fdd7dadc0ca752c0355f5a73040171a110c.summary: Switched to `cloneDeep` for `agentState`, `agentContext`, and `messages` in `run-programmatic-step.ts`. Previous shallow spreads failed to isolate nested mutations, risking state corruption during execution. Updated all subsequent references to read from the deep-copied `state` object instead of the mutable `agentState` parameter.

705d777231f507599c088d705abf026809c24d12.title: Add publisher single-owner check constraint
705d777231f507599c088d705abf026809c24d12.summary: Added `publisher_single_owner` CHECK constraint to `publisher` table in migration `0028_magical_korath.sql`. Enforces mutual exclusivity between `user_id` and `org_id`, ensuring a publisher belongs to either a user or an org, but not both or neither. Scope covers database schema in `common/src/db/schema.ts` and generated migration files. Includes `unique_step_number_per_run` index on `agent_step` table.

bf89ed5263bd37f73130630bdc6a410636bd159a.title: Update subagent streaming unit tests
bf89ed5263bd37f73130630bdc6a410636bd159a.summary: Refactored `subagent-streaming.test.ts` to assert `subagent_start` and `subagent_finish` events via `mockWriteToClient` alongside chunk payloads. Updated expected call counts and argument shapes to match current streaming behavior. Internal test maintenance only; no production code changes.

37d4c0c6379ab72349d088dcacde4751484385da.title: Structured print-mode events for subagent headers
37d4c0c6379ab72349d088dcacde4751484385da.summary: Agent start/finish notifications now emit typed `subagent_start` and `subagent_finish` print-mode events instead of hardcoded dash-formatted strings. The CLI renders these headers client-side via new `printSubagentHeader` helper, pausing and resuming the spinner to prevent output corruption. Covers `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/spawn-agent-utils.ts`, `common/src/types/print-mode.ts`, and `npm-app/src/subagent-headers.ts`. `Spinner.stop` returns a boolean indicating prior active state to enable conditional resume.

42c21943893bbd62254ebc3682ca43daec04438f.text: The assistant now follows clearer instructions for handling file changes and formatting. This internal update helps it give more consistent answers without changing visible features.

72f530b67942e103a670ba032070bf1556f2eb64.text: The assistant list now shows one entry per agent, combining usage data from all its updates. This hides duplicate entries and keeps the list cleaner.

bf89ed5263bd37f73130630bdc6a410636bd159a.text: The team updated internal checks to match how the assistant currently works. No changes affect the features you use.

705d777231f507599c088d705abf026809c24d12.text: The system now prevents a publisher from being linked to both a person and an organization at the same time. This keeps ownership records clear and consistent.

37d4c0c6379ab72349d088dcacde4751484385da.text: The app now uses a clearer method to show when tasks start and finish. This prevents text from overlapping or looking broken while the app is working.

dd049fdd7dadc0ca752c0355f5a73040171a110c.text: The system now makes complete, independent copies of its working memory during each step. This prevents errors where one action accidentally overwrites data needed for another, keeping the assistant's responses accurate and consistent.

c27f169ca051f678a11de3039c8c1689d3ed62ac.text: Text displays in the app now fit the screen size correctly, even with special formatting codes. Background tools clean up after themselves more reliably, and screen adjustments no longer interfere with other features. This is an internal update that improves visual consistency and stability.

cd14fb30dda157962368080bdddfa8f88148e3d9.text: The system now prevents broken text from appearing on screen. This is a small internal fix to improve visual stability.

dd11ea1898423928a22abd37b8a15fcd793b0521.text: A small internal update adjusted how the system checks its own work. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

1a1d4cdf5378c1fe6c4acc06753065b07d358393.text: Internal setup rules got clearer. This small change does not affect how you use the product.

9ac5443e315c21de8ba4985c35904715089c1111.title: Add agentrun and agentstep tables for cost tracking
9ac5443e315c21de8ba4985c35904715089c1111.summary: New backend module `agent-run.ts` introduces `startAgentRun`, `finishAgentRun`, and `addAgentStep` to persist execution metadata. Database migration `0027_brown_giant_girl.sql` creates `agent_run` and `agent_step` tables to track status, credits, and step counts. `run-agent-step.ts` and `run-programmatic-step.ts` now invoke these functions to log direct and total credit usage per step.

ec9b8a5dd57caba9ced3a53ac0473ed585f3ad66.title: Docs heading copy button, mobile badge, code spacing
ec9b8a5dd57caba9ced3a53ac0473ed585f3ad66.summary: Docs heading copy button reworked: desktop keeps hover-reveal, mobile tap now shows a floating badge auto-hidden after 3s (was 1.5s). Heading container split into margin/text class buckets so code snippets inside headings wrap cleanly on mobile. globals.css adds lighter inline-code styling inside h1-h6 and a max-width:767px flex-wrap rule with white-space:nowrap on code. Scope: web/src/components/docs/mdx/mdx-components.tsx, web/src/styles/globals.css.

743f1d9eded33ab4cfc8c4490ad0666e9feda8fd.title: Remove conditional check in prompt placeholder injection
743f1d9eded33ab4cfc8c4490ad0666e9feda8fd.summary: The `formatPrompt` function in `backend/src/templates/strings.ts` now unconditionally replaces placeholders. The previous guard `if (toInject[varName])` was removed, and the replacement logic uses `toInject[varName] ?? ''`. This ensures all listed placeholders are processed, defaulting to empty strings if no value is provided.

eb5af8d7675aabbfb5941c8843db7b9f02bdf01b.title: README SDK import fix @codebuff/sdk
eb5af8d7675aabbfb5941c8843db7b9f02bdf01b.summary: Updated README.md to import CodebuffClient from @codebuff/sdk instead of codebuff. Added npm install @codebuff/sdk instruction. Clarifies SDK package is distinct from CLI package.

046deb32c5f71317c3b57fc656e0864c174b99cd.title: Stop loading shell config files into project context
046deb32c5f71317c3b57fc656e0864c174b99cd.summary: Removed `loadShellConfigFiles` helper and its invocation in `getProjectFileContext`. The `shellConfigFiles` property in the returned context object is now hardcoded to an empty object `{}` instead of reading files like `.bashrc`, `.zshrc`, and `.profile` from the user's home directory. This change is scoped to `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. Shell configuration data is no longer passed to the agent context builder.

ceb0a75a57367452510e51e058a5c74fe9c67b28.title: README eval task count corrected to 175+
ceb0a75a57367452510e51e058a5c74fe9c67b28.summary: README.md eval description updated from 200+ to 175+ coding tasks. Aligns public copy with actual benchmark dataset size. Scope limited to README.md. No functional or code changes.

c99899bb5db495c24994ba35b8bd79f9cf6b0688.title: Remove tool availability check in runProgrammaticStep
c99899bb5db495c24994ba35b8bd79f9cf6b0688.summary: The `toolNames` validation in `runProgrammaticStep` is commented out, allowing any tool to execute via `handleSteps` regardless of agent template restrictions. This change removes the runtime error thrown when a tool is missing from the template's `toolNames` array. The modification affects the backend execution logic in `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`.

c6fb1afec11328d13b53737412783f6da3c8867e.title: Markdown rendering in CLI
c6fb1afec11328d13b53737412783f6da3c8867e.summary: Added `MarkdownStreamRenderer` to `npm-app` using `markdown-it` and `markdown-it-terminal` to format assistant text. Updated `xml-stream-parser.ts` to route text outside tool tags through the renderer, handling smart buffering and syntax highlighting. Modified `client.ts` to adjust output spacing for new block rendering.

28af8887e283cc0f6ac818aa84b9e9d692e5a227.title: Docs: update codebuff CLI usage examples
28af8887e283cc0f6ac818aa84b9e9d692e5a227.summary: Web docs `large-projects.mdx`, `knowledge-files.mdx`, and `other-use-cases.mdx` updated to reflect current CLI usage. Examples show `codebuff --cwd <dir>` for directory targeting and remove explicit `<project-path>` arguments from standard invocations.

fbb18db7bde110275b486bb366b7f3dc260063f1.title: Add GitHub links to website navbar and footer
fbb18db7bde110275b486bb366b7f3dc260063f1.summary: Added GitHub links to the website navbar and footer components. The navbar includes a direct link with an icon and a dropdown menu item, while the footer adds the link to community and social sections. Covers `web/src/components/footer.tsx`, `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`, and `web/src/components/ui/footer.tsx`. Links point to `https://github.com/CodebuffAI/codebuff` with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

743f1d9eded33ab4cfc8c4490ad0666e9feda8fd.text: The assistant now fills every blank in a request, even if some are empty. This keeps messages consistent for users.

9ac5443e315c21de8ba4985c35904715089c1111.text: The system now tracks how many credits each assistant step uses. This helps show what you are spending.

046deb32c5f71317c3b57fc656e0864c174b99cd.text: The assistant stops reading your personal computer settings when working on projects. This internal change reduces privacy risks and keeps project work separate from your system configuration.

ceb0a75a57367452510e51e058a5c74fe9c67b28.text: The description of how many practice problems are available was fixed to show the real number. This small update only changes the text on the website and does not affect how the software works.

eb5af8d7675aabbfb5941c8843db7b9f02bdf01b.text: The instructions for using a specific tool were corrected. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

c99899bb5db495c24994ba35b8bd79f9cf6b0688.text: The assistant can now use tools that were previously blocked by internal restrictions. This removes a safety check that stopped certain actions from running.

ec9b8a5dd57caba9ced3a53ac0473ed585f3ad66.text: Small internal update. Mobile users now see a confirmation badge for three seconds after tapping a copy button on a heading. Text inside headings also wraps more cleanly on small screens.

ed79f0b30210b762433b14e31960833a8af70509.title: Add init-agents example to CLI help
ed79f0b30210b762433b14e31960833a8af70509.summary: Added `codebuff init-agents` usage example to the `--help` output in `npm-app/src/index.ts`. This clarifies how to generate example agent files in the `.agents` directory directly from the CLI. Change applies to the npm app surface only.

bd3d070e1ba70c5dc57c5960882a1472c4c545a4.title: Document init-agents command and custom tool definitions
bd3d070e1ba70c5dc57c5960882a1472c4c545a4.summary: README.md adds documentation for the `codebuff init-agents` command and expands details on custom agent creation. The update clarifies that agents can define tools, spawn subagents, and use prompts, alongside existing TypeScript generator support. A `customToolDefinitions` field is added to the SDK example code. The 'Why choose Codebuff' section reorders points and adds a note about reusing published agents via MCP-like composition.

a8168d89d8bcf02009eb65dc34fc99f45ddd8210.title: CLI /agent menu selects subagents via @-mention instead of switching
a8168d89d8bcf02009eb65dc34fc99f45ddd8210.summary: The `/agent` menu now inserts `@<agent-name>` into the input field instead of calling `resetAgent` to switch the active session. This change prevents unintended chat context switches when selecting a subagent, allowing users to @-mention agents directly. The update is limited to `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/agents.ts`, removing the `Spinner` dependency for agent selection.

08575fd718d278870b48f29ff93d46aefa483e73.title: Add 5% fudge factor to judge context limit
08575fd718d278870b48f29ff93d46aefa483e73.summary: MAX_TOKENS in evals/git-evals/judge-git-eval.ts now applies a 0.95 multiplier to the 1 million token cap. This introduces a 5% margin to prevent judge context overflow during eval runs. Scope limited to git evals judge logic.

163f1494a641f585c09c89c029aa6b930250a7a0.title: README SDK section restructured with custom agent example
163f1494a641f585c09c89c029aa6b930250a7a0.summary: README.md SDK section retitled to 'Run agents in production' with numbered code comments and a custom AgentDefinition example. Adds `agentDefinitions` param usage with `id`, `displayName`, `model`, `instructionsPrompt` fields. Cosmetic formatting fixes (blank lines around code fences) in CLI install section.

406dd98ffa42f4e0b3c3aeac34cb7840729aa091.title: gpt-5-chat for read-only-commander and planner file checks
406dd98ffa42f4e0b3c3aeac34cb7840729aa091.summary: read-only-commander model switched to openai/gpt-5-chat. Planner pre-checks file existence via read_files before reading, filtering non-existent paths. Base2 prompts updated to emphasize upfront instruction density. Changes confined to .agents/base2 internal factories.

573e46f9daef1ff68b684087db2e5aa80acb2386.title: Fix prompt caching for Sonnet models
573e46f9daef1ff68b684087db2e5aa80acb2386.summary: Added `shouldCacheModels` array in `common/src/old-constants.ts` to explicitly enable prompt caching for specific Anthropic models (Opus 4.1, Sonnet 4, etc.). Updated `getExplicitlyDefinedModels` in `common/src/util/model-utils.ts` to include these new entries in the allowed set. This ensures prompt caching works correctly for Sonnet models referenced by their short OpenRouter names.

1606d967be0aa15b2803ca89e38bf2ad0935233e.title: gpt-5-chat editor, cache glm-4.5, qwen3-coder
1606d967be0aa15b2803ca89e38bf2ad0935233e.summary: base2 editor agent switches model from anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 to openai/gpt-5-chat. z-ai/glm-4.5 and qwen/qwen3-coder added to shouldCacheModels in common/src/old-constants.ts. base2-factory instructionsPrompt gains Simple workflow section: planner, editor, reviewer loop. Scope: .agents/base2/ sub-agents, common constants. Editor ID remains 'editor'; displayName unchanged.

ed79f0b30210b762433b14e31960833a8af70509.text: A new example was added to the help text. It shows how to create starter files for automated helpers.

163f1494a641f585c09c89c029aa6b930250a7a0.text: The guide for building custom assistants was updated with a clearer example. This is an internal documentation change. It does not affect how the product works for you.

a8168d89d8bcf02009eb65dc34fc99f45ddd8210.text: Choosing a helper from the menu now adds its name to your message instead of starting a new conversation. This keeps your chat history intact.

08575fd718d278870b48f29ff93d46aefa483e73.text: The system now checks a slightly smaller amount of text when judging certain tasks. This prevents errors caused by exceeding memory limits.
