fe4420b9faf6ca73d3d00520acede7cde693c444.summary: Added `-p` flag to `npm-app/release/index.js` via `commander`. Suppresses terminal UI updates and switches error/info logs to JSON format when active. Scope limited to release script and its `package.json` dependencies.

086f05fb5d74098333fcde044dcf86cf49c9ff30.text: The tool now suggests known AI models as you type, while still allowing you to enter any model name. This makes picking a model easier and more accurate.

17342cca0ae01585529c47a6a5cdd7e4adc7eb45.text: A small internal update helps the team set up new work areas more reliably. This change does not affect how you use the product.

f029917387d400e18035491552fbf2449e34dcfb.text: The app's internal notes for checking tools were updated to match current rules. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the app works.

d39fb2a7a256b86714f97ecfc5a88bba683ff648.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system tracks the relationship between different parts of an automated task. This ensures better accuracy in the background logs used for troubleshooting.

9a47fef1efdc3b960a1938a606fccacabf2e1448.text: The app now uses the correct system command to open your browser on Linux. This fixes a bug where the login page would not appear automatically on some computers.

9758acce4176bfc120ebe727e1aa3b3cf929eeb7.text: The system now includes ready-made templates for custom assistants. This makes it easier for builders to create new tools without starting from scratch.

1f0bac25584d68b774ebefd686e230f6994935ec.text: The system now handles assistant instructions differently to improve how it uses tools. This change is internal and does not affect how you interact with the product.

a16c4ec41998c38d0a50345fccee257214794b2e.title: Add git commit message example to run-terminal-command
a16c4ec41998c38d0a50345fccee257214794b2e.summary: Added a `git commit` example to the `run-terminal-command` tool definition showing heredoc usage for multi-line messages with Co-Authored-By. Reordered imports in `prompts.ts` and normalized a curly apostrophe. Internal change affecting backend tool definitions and system prompts.

cf24c26cbd54d0e4138c558ff490c24fd25212f4.title: Add chunk logging to agent stream parser
cf24c26cbd54d0e4138c558ff490c24fd25212f4.summary: Agent step processing now logs individual stream chunks alongside the full response. `processStreamWithTools` in `backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` accumulates chunks in a `fullResponseChunks` array, returning it alongside the joined `fullResponse` string. This change propagates to `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`, where `fullResponseChunks` is passed to downstream logging and state updates. The `xml-stream-parser.ts` refactor simplifies `lastIndex` initialization in `extractToolCalls`.

7dcd6127d2ca696ada8c442ec76aaf4577035dcb.title: Strip /$bunfs binary path from CLI args
7dcd6127d2ca696ada8c442ec76aaf4577035dcb.summary: npm-app/src/index.ts filters leading /$bunfs path injected by Bun before constructing initialInput. Fixes command-line argument parsing when launching compiled binary. Scope: npm-app CLI entrypoint.

3e16287740f1557c405ec048a27f206e6e024e1e.title: Shorten tool parameter names in common constants
3e16287740f1557c405ec048a27f206e6e024e1e.summary: Renamed tool parameter identifiers from codebuff_tool_name and codebuff_easp to cb_tool_name and cb_easp in common/src/constants/tools.ts. This change reduces token usage for tool definitions. Scope is limited to shared core constants. No migration logic is included; consumers must use the new names.

0d509da06d767843f74d01b88828b6c01df5cdb5.title: Add nightly evals workflow and increase eval concurrency
0d509da06d767843f74d01b88828b6c01df5cdb5.summary: New `.github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml` runs `bun run-eval-set` daily at 9:00 AM UTC via cron, using Bun 1.2.12 and a 360-minute timeout. Existing `.github/workflows/evals.yml` concurrency raised from 1 to 10. Both workflows share the same eval execution command with email notifications enabled.

7dcd6127d2ca696ada8c442ec76aaf4577035dcb.text: The command line tool now works correctly when launched as a standalone program.

a16c4ec41998c38d0a50345fccee257214794b2e.text: The assistant learned a new way to write detailed notes when saving changes. This internal update improves how it records work, but you will not see a difference in the app.

d622228ad6f7ed2f513ea29a275fb0320e11ce4b.text: Internal rules for creating custom assistants were updated to match the main settings. This ensures custom assistants work correctly with new features. No visible changes for users.

a29a854c99017a698e7c8c673e870465919ec957.text: The system now includes a new creative brainstorming assistant that can help users think through ideas. Existing tools for managing code and knowledge were also updated to work with this new structure.

3e16287740f1557c405ec048a27f206e6e024e1e.text: Shortened internal labels to save space. No change to features or results.

cf24c26cbd54d0e4138c558ff490c24fd25212f4.text: The system now records smaller pieces of text as they arrive, alongside the full message. This internal update helps the team track how responses are built, with no visible change to your experience.

0d509da06d767843f74d01b88828b6c01df5cdb5.text: The system now checks its own quality every morning to catch problems early. It can also run many more of these checks at the same time, so the results are ready faster.

61db08a8e6fabb1ca7e0b43c2df3e6c5d362e0bd.text: The system now tracks different versions of assistant templates and their publishers. This creates a structured catalog for discovering and managing these tools.

5e852c3246d88793c6b7bb3813885aacd72fe417.title: Input validation in getPartialJsonDelta
5e852c3246d88793c6b7bb3813885aacd72fe417.summary: Added explicit error throwing in `getPartialJsonDelta` when `content` does not start with `previous`. Prevents invalid partial JSON delta calculations. Affects `common/src/util/partial-json-delta.ts`.

664de46c08e361b11c97a6cfedf7a32a01475c71.title: Refactor partial JSON delta parsing logic
664de46c08e361b11c97a6cfedf7a32a01475c71.summary: Refactored `getPartialJsonDelta` in `common/src/util/partial-json-delta.ts` to inline previous parse logic, removing the `parsePartialJsonObject` helper. Added `delta[lastKey] === undefined` check in `npm-app/src/utils/xml-stream-parser.ts` to prevent overwriting existing delta values. Scope limited to core utility and stream parser.

b268e180b5be256164c1f42f74b623a2be7e8701.title: Replace updatereport with setoutput tool
b268e180b5be256164c1f42f74b623a2be7e8701.summary: The `update_report` tool is removed and replaced by `set_output` for structured agent responses. Agent templates now use `outputMode: 'json'` instead of `'report'`, and the `git-committer` agent model switched to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4`. Dynamic agent templates support optional `outputSchema` fields converted to Zod, defaulting `outputMode` to `'json'` when present. Core files updated: `backend/src/tools/definitions/set-output.ts`, `backend/src/templates/dynamic-agent-service.ts`, `backend/src/templates/agents/base.ts`, `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`.

da847de456d3be35922ca04d316cd8358084d0bf.title: partial-json-delta skips brace completion for numeric ends
da847de456d3be35922ca04d316cd8358084d0bf.summary: parsePartialJsonObjectSingle now checks if content ends with a digit before attempting to append a closing brace. This prevents malformed JSON errors when parsing partial objects that terminate in numeric values. The change applies to common/src/util/partial-json-delta.ts. The fallback logic for closing quotes remains unaffected.

060cf727c4c9dcae216f8f887bf820cb28086186.title: Add AGENTSPROMPT placeholder to agent templates
060cf727c4c9dcae216f8f887bf820cb28086186.summary: Introduce AGENTS_PROMPT placeholder in backend/src/templates/types.ts and populate it via buildSpawnableAgentsDescription in new file backend/src/templates/prompts.ts. This replaces the previous approach of injecting agent descriptions directly into tool instructions, now handled by separate logic in backend/src/tools/prompts.ts. Scope includes core agent templates (planner, researcher, reviewer, etc.) and base/ask prompts, ensuring all agents can dynamically list spawnable subagents. The change decouples tool definitions from agent availability, allowing cleaner circular dependency resolution in backend/src/tools.ts.

7e53db23132ab7e71689b5d4471ccf720748744b.title: Update partial-json-delta tests for streaming
7e53db23132ab7e71689b5d4471ccf720748744b.summary: Rewrote `getPartialJsonDelta` tests in `common/src/util/__tests__/partial-json-delta.test.ts` to strictly validate streaming input contracts and `lastParam` tracking. Previous tests incorrectly passed parsed objects as `previous` state; new tests enforce string-prefix validation and verify delta extraction for multi-line strings and non-string types. Scope limited to `common` package unit tests.

f511ffec5e7000266f63637f6091a3007e582722.title: Stop sequence switch and tool call analytics
f511ffec5e7000266f63637f6091a3007e582722.summary: Backend replaces globalStopSequences array with single globalStopSequence constant in tools/constants.ts and prompt-agent-stream.ts. Renames endsAgentStepParam from codebuff_end_step to codebuff_easp across tools.ts and constants/tools.ts. Adds MALFORMED_TOOL_CALL_JSON and UNKNOWN_TOOL_CALL analytics events in xml-stream-parser.ts and analytics-events.ts. Tool executor now conditionally extends schema only when endsAgentStep is true.

5e852c3246d88793c6b7bb3813885aacd72fe417.text: The assistant now checks data more carefully before processing it. This prevents errors when receiving incomplete information.

da847de456d3be35922ca04d316cd8358084d0bf.text: The app now handles unfinished text messages ending in numbers more reliably. This small fix prevents errors when reading incomplete data.

c41bd0e3af2042bfd300dea21f9fc932ca6371d1.text: A small internal update ensures the website's automated checks properly stop if they find an error. This makes the site more reliable.

060cf727c4c9dcae216f8f887bf820cb28086186.text: The assistant now automatically knows which helpers it can call, instead of needing them listed in every task. This makes the system cleaner and more flexible, though users will not notice a change.

b268e180b5be256164c1f42f74b623a2be7e8701.text: The assistant now uses a new method to format its answers, allowing it to organize information more clearly for you.

5796127d324536093f8d647aeede391bb6f2da72.text: The assistant's setup rules were simplified to allow clearer, step-by-step instructions. This change is internal and does not alter how the product works for users.

664de46c08e361b11c97a6cfedf7a32a01475c71.text: Internal cleanup of how the app reads incomplete data. This helps prevent existing information from being accidentally erased when new data arrives. Most users won't notice this change.

eb753bc25cc19785667584465261ff304d1be965.text: Internal labels for assistant settings were renamed to be clearer. This change does not affect how you use the product.

7e53db23132ab7e71689b5d4471ccf720748744b.text: Internal tests were updated to check how data arrives in pieces. This helps keep the assistant's responses accurate. No visible changes to the product.

72283cb3ad34bc140e2ad843981065e080184a60.title: Fix usage-calculation test mock path
72283cb3ad34bc140e2ad843981065e080184a60.summary: Corrected mock path in `usage-calculation.test.ts` from `@codebuff/common/db/index` to `@codebuff/common/db`. Aligns test setup with actual module resolution. Internal test fix only.

63d17bdb944e23096a21bf27ad1de36e2e2e758c.title: Add mockModule wrapper for module mocking
63d17bdb944e23096a21bf27ad1de36e2e2e758c.summary: Added `mockModule` and `clearMockedModules` in `common/src/testing/mock-modules.ts`. `mockModule` wraps `bun:test` `mock.module` to cache originals and support nested mocks, replacing direct `mock.module` calls in `evals/scaffolding.ts`. `clearMockedModules` restores originals, used in `afterAll` hooks per `knowledge.md` guidance.

ad1083ef61768cc5b7204ddbf6496fce47284f3a.title: Add logging to git eval runner
ad1083ef61768cc5b7204ddbf6496fce47284f3a.summary: Added console logging to `run-git-evals.ts` and `run-eval-set.ts` to track eval data loading, concurrency limits, and promise settlement results. Rejected promises in `Promise.allSettled` now log errors with specific eval names/SHAs and reasons, and failed evals are recorded in results with status 'error'. This improves visibility into silent failures during git evaluation runs.

793bc101117052c056761dfbc0fd7cf4429171b1.title: Fix duplicate parameters in tool renderer
793bc101117052c056761dfbc0fd7cf4429171b1.summary: Refactored `parsePartialJsonObject` to accept raw previous content string instead of parsed object, enabling accurate delta calculation for streaming tool parameters. Added `parsePartialJsonObjectSingle` for internal use and updated `getPartialJsonDelta` to compare against previous raw content, preventing duplicate parameter emission when partial JSON chunks overlap. Updated `xml-stream-parser.ts` to pass `prevParamsContent` to `getPartialJsonDelta`. Covers `common/src/util/partial-json-delta.ts` and `npm-app/src/utils/xml-stream-parser.ts`.

eee79edfa37fb1bb1b6ca90cad62fd631448e4b5.title: Rename handleStep to handleSteps in agent templates
eee79edfa37fb1bb1b6ca90cad62fd631448e4b5.summary: Refactors the `handleStep` property to `handleSteps` across agent templates and execution logic. Updates type definitions in `backend/src/templates/types.ts`, implementation in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`, and sandbox injection in `backend/src/util/quickjs-sandbox.ts`. Ensures consistent naming for step generator handlers.

ad6627939eca72397fd71d101ead016fb6d72d94.title: Remove global agentRegistry from backend
ad6627939eca72397fd71d101ead016fb6d72d94.summary: Replaced the global AgentRegistry class with a stateless getAllAgentTemplates function returning a plain object. AsyncAgentManager and mainPrompt now fetch templates per request, passing the registry explicitly to loopAgentSteps and runAgentStep. Deleted unused agent-system-prompt.ts.

fd29880e6f8f8d07f16002d301aa6354878cec5c.title: Add /subagent command, --trace flag, and subagent streaming
fd29880e6f8f8d07f16002d301aa6354878cec5c.summary: Introduced /subagent slash command and --trace flag for CLI inspection and logging of subagent activity. Backend now streams subagent response chunks to the client via a new `subagent-response-chunk` WebSocket action, enabling real-time visibility into subagent execution. Trace logs are written to `.agents/traces/*.log` files when `--trace` is enabled. CI test commands updated to sort files before execution to ensure deterministic ordering.

ad6627939eca72397fd71d101ead016fb6d72d94.text: The assistant now looks up its instructions fresh for every request, instead of using a shared list. This internal cleanup helps prevent errors when the system restarts, but users will not notice any difference.

72283cb3ad34bc140e2ad843981065e080184a60.text: A small internal fix corrected how automated tests find data. This does not change how the product works for you.

72a02114a2e6eb2217d3fc8708f929d3add4be03.text: The assistant now accepts extra settings in its configuration without breaking. This fixes errors that happened when loading new agent templates.

7defa45899aaab83853bd9a61504b3badc2f8359.text: The system now allows agents to use more flexible, step-by-step instructions defined in code. This means you can create more complex agent behaviors without needing to write the code yourself.

63d17bdb944e23096a21bf27ad1de36e2e2e758c.text: Internal cleanup of test tools. No changes to how you use the product.

fe4420b9faf6ca73d3d00520acede7cde693c444.text: A new setting was added to an internal tool. This change does not affect the product.

eee79edfa37fb1bb1b6ca90cad62fd631448e4b5.text: The team renamed an internal part of the system to make the code clearer. This change does not affect how you use the product.

793bc101117052c056761dfbc0fd7cf4429171b1.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant could show the same tool setting twice. This makes the display cleaner and more accurate.

ad1083ef61768cc5b7204ddbf6496fce47284f3a.text: The system now records details when checking tasks fail, instead of stopping silently. This helps staff find and fix problems faster.

bf47687a2f5b7d5d3ebd9654c84dd6cfc2635ac8.title: stream-parser guards empty assistant message append
bf47687a2f5b7d5d3ebd9654c84dd6cfc2635ac8.summary: stream-parser.ts now conditionally appends the assistant message to state.messages only when fullResponse is nonempty. Uses buildArray to filter falsy entries, preventing empty message objects from entering history. Affects backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts.

cc5711b84ba75c7380bd25d3caa330dae051142f.title: Skip prompt injection on empty user cancellation
cc5711b84ba75c7380bd25d3caa330dae051142f.summary: Client cancellation logic in npm-app/src/client.ts now conditionally injects the user prompt and system cancellation message only if the prompt is non-empty. Previously, empty prompts resulted in extraneous empty message objects being added to the agent state. This change prevents unnecessary message entries when a user cancels without providing additional input.

827ff59b4b6669d0e8eb5371b47a8a9117715325.title: Refactor agent tool state to flatten mutableState and add
827ff59b4b6669d0e8eb5371b47a8a9117715325.summary: Flattened `mutableState` into direct state properties (`agentContext`, `messages`, `agentState`) and introduced `getLatestState()` in `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` across backend tool handlers. Replaced mutable state references with `getFileProcessingValues` in `create-plan.ts` and direct state access in `add-subgoal.ts`, `find-files.ts`, `read-files.ts`, `send-agent-message.ts`, and `spawn-agents-async.ts`. Scope limited to `backend/src/tools/handlers/` and `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. `postStreamProcessing` now receives `getLatestState()` output instead of mutable state objects.

fb4a3fa673956b8c5e83855c4107a4bd1b38d04e.title: Unified programmatic agent execution and file explorer
fb4a3fa673956b8c5e83855c4107a4bd1b38d04e.summary: Refactored `runProgrammaticStep` to handle generator state, tool execution, and turn-ending logic directly, replacing the deleted `run-tool.ts`. Introduced `file-explorer` agent template that spawns parallel `file_picker` agents for comprehensive codebase exploration. Updated `agent-list.ts` and `base.ts` to register the new agent and adjust spawnable lists. Replaced `json-schema-to-zod` with `zod-from-json-schema` in `package.json`.

12f543cffc41f69df54a321881500e52ab4253a1.title: Add addmessage and setmessages tools for agent context management
12f543cffc41f69df54a321881500e52ab4253a1.summary: Introduced `add_message` and `set_messages` tools to allow agents to programmatically manipulate conversation history. `add_message` appends a single user or assistant message, while `set_messages` replaces the entire history with a provided array. Both tools are registered in `codebuffToolDefs` and handled via new definitions in `backend/src/tools/definitions/` and handlers in `backend/src/tools/handlers/`. This change modifies `run-agent-step.ts` to rely on the updated message state from these tools rather than manually constructing the final history.

ca78bc86d1640981548e39bae60064a23c34e184.title: Remove console.log from brainstormer template
ca78bc86d1640981548e39bae60064a23c34e184.summary: Removed debug console.log and comment from .agents/templates/brainstormer.ts. Template now contains only agent config logic. Affects agent scaffolding.

8d04c33a5fe3b083a08af02baf11408a378043a3.title: Support string-based generator code in QuickJS sandbox
8d04c33a5fe3b083a08af02baf11408a378043a3.summary: Agent templates now accept `handleStep` as a string of generator code, executed in a QuickJS WASM sandbox alongside native function support. `backend/src/util/quickjs-sandbox.ts` implements `SandboxManager` and `QuickJSSandbox`, initializing a WASM runtime with memory limits (20MB default) and stack size caps. `backend/src/run-programmatic-step.ts` routes string-based handlers to the sandbox, preserving native generator logic for function-based templates. The change requires `quickjs-emscripten-core` and `@jitl/quickjs-wasmfile-release-sync` dependencies, with sandbox cleanup triggered via `clearAgentGeneratorCache`.

62ad75f8e85230ea5a1da560992088ccfefb3e5e.title: Fix spawn error in release script
62ad75f8e85230ea5a1da560992088ccfefb3e5e.summary: Updated `npm-app/release/index.js` to handle `spawn` failures gracefully. `getCurrentVersion` now returns 'error' string instead of null on missing binary. `main` function wraps binary execution in try/catch, deleting corrupted binaries and retrying download on failure. Update checks now skip if initial spawn errored.

bf47687a2f5b7d5d3ebd9654c84dd6cfc2635ac8.text: The system no longer saves empty chat messages. This keeps the conversation history clean.

ca78bc86d1640981548e39bae60064a23c34e184.text: Internal cleanup removed leftover debugging messages from the assistant's setup template. This change has no visible effect on how the product works.

fb4a3fa673956b8c5e83855c4107a4bd1b38d04e.text: The assistant's file search tool now works faster and can explore large projects more thoroughly.

b63965d158c74af7166ecdf38ae280c47558b59b.text: The assistant can now find and use new tools stored in any folder within its main directory, not just one specific spot. This makes it easier to add or organize these tools without changing how the assistant works.

827ff59b4b6669d0e8eb5371b47a8a9117715325.text: The assistant's internal memory was simplified to make it easier to track current tasks. This change is internal and helps the system run more reliably.

cc5711b84ba75c7380bd25d3caa330dae051142f.text: A small internal fix prevents the assistant from creating empty, confusing messages when you cancel a request without typing anything.

12f543cffc41f69df54a321881500e52ab4253a1.text: The assistant can now add a single message to or replace the entire conversation history. This helps the assistant manage what it remembers during chats.

33185154b2617f737880d811644a7519bb249063.title: New USERINPUTPROMPT placeholder
33185154b2617f737880d811644a7519bb249063.summary: Added USER_INPUT_PROMPT placeholder to templates. Uses parseUserMessage to extract raw text from <user_message> XML tags in history. Replaces ad-hoc JSON parsing in formatPrompt. Scope: backend templates and message utils.

08db44aed164aaed864bc8b391b83b7b07f23915.title: Docs: remove override guide, add parentInstructions
08db44aed164aaed864bc8b391b83b7b07f23915.summary: Agent docs drop the override section and key terms, replacing it with from-scratch template guidance. New parentInstructions field added to examples and a dedicated section in creating-new-agents.mdx. Overview.mdx introduces Agent Coordination via parent instructions. Covers web/src/content/agents/ files.

66c78557eea2c8558160e5ab4e935c5cc6b60382.title: Fix type assertions in constants.ts
66c78557eea2c8558160e5ab4e935c5cc6b60382.summary: Replaced unsafe casts with `satisfies` constraints for `modelsGeneric` and `nonCacheableModels` in `common/src/constants.ts`. Removed redundant `satisfies` in `supportsCacheControl` argument check. Pure type-level refactor, no runtime behavior change.

16d12e771a8c781b3fc6ad05bb19ead604b2ad9e.title: Agent templates use TypeScript
16d12e771a8c781b3fc6ad05bb19ead604b2ad9e.summary: Agent templates in .agents/templates/ migrated from JSON to TypeScript. Files like brainstormer.ts, git-committer.ts, and knowledge-keeper.ts now export typed DynamicAgentConfig objects. Loader logic in npm-app/src/agents/load-agents.ts and backend/src/templates/dynamic-agent-service.ts updated to parse TS exports. Zod schemas replace manual JSON definitions for prompt structures.

67de04e383d347076dc197675c3549846bb12642.title: Add parent instructions to custom agents
67de04e383d347076dc197675c3549846bb12642.summary: Added `parentInstructions` field to `AgentTemplate` and `.agents/templates/*.json`. `DynamicAgentService` validates these instructions against available agents. `collectParentInstructions` aggregates relevant directives from all templates to inject into the parent's `userInputPrompt` under 'Instructions for Spawning Agents'. Includes new `knowledge-keeper` template and refactors base prompts.

ec444cc309a3733d9fbbba6c0337cbbf34cf31d1.title: escapeString helper added to sanitize placeholder prompts
ec444cc309a3733d9fbbba6c0337cbbf34cf31d1.summary: Added `escapeString` utility in `common/src/util/string.ts` to sanitize user input and initial agent prompts before template injection. Updated `backend/src/templates/strings.ts` to apply this escape to `PLACEHOLDER.USER_INPUT_PROMPT` and `PLACEHOLDER.INITIAL_AGENT_PROMPT`. Mechanism uses `JSON.stringify` and strips surrounding quotes to prevent prompt injection or template parsing errors from raw user strings.

def525e231d81e806379a00bd1bcab9d0b355cc1.title: Fix supportsCacheControl model lookup
def525e231d81e806379a00bd1bcab9d0b355cc1.summary: supportsCacheControl in common/src/constants.ts now uses Object.values(models) includes check instead of Record lookup. Previous generic cast allowed undefined key hits to bypass cache control guard. Unknown models default to false as before.

0a9d706727c7518decfaf051516b4b4c3123e044.title: Unified programmatic agent step handling
0a9d706727c7518decfaf051516b4b4c3123e044.summary: Refactors agent execution by removing ProgrammaticAgentTemplate and introducing a handleStep generator field on AgentTemplate. runProgrammaticAgent becomes runProgrammaticStep, managing generator state in-memory via agentIdToGenerator. This unifies LLM and programmatic agent paths in run-agent-step.ts, eliminating special-case branching for implementation types. Note: run-programmatic-step.ts contains a hardcoded throw new Error('Not implemented yet!') preventing programmatic agent execution.

e062af6483335d394a1c2be8a91b4599ccc1c3e2.title: CI: drop setup job, switch to per-job dependency caching
e062af6483335d394a1c2be8a91b4599ccc1c3e2.summary: Removed shared `setup` job and `node_modules` artifact upload/download in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Replaced with `actions/cache@v3` and direct `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in `build-and-check` and test jobs. Key uses `${{ hashFiles('**/bun.lockb') }}` for cache invalidation. Eliminates cross-job artifact transfer overhead.

67de04e383d347076dc197675c3549846bb12642.text: The assistant now knows how to guide other helpers it creates. This means tasks get handled by the right specialist without you needing to give extra instructions.

ec444cc309a3733d9fbbba6c0337cbbf34cf31d1.text: The system now cleans user text before sending it to the AI. This prevents confusing errors or unintended instructions from raw input.

def525e231d81e806379a00bd1bcab9d0b355cc1.text: Fixed a bug where the system failed to recognize certain models, causing them to be treated incorrectly. This ensures the assistant behaves as expected for all supported models.

16d12e771a8c781b3fc6ad05bb19ead604b2ad9e.text: The assistant's setup files switched from a rigid format to a smarter one. This change is small and mostly internal, so users will see no difference in how the product works.

66c78557eea2c8558160e5ab4e935c5cc6b60382.text: Developers updated internal safety checks for data types. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

08db44aed164aaed864bc8b391b83b7b07f23915.text: The guide for customizing assistants changed. It now uses a shared starting point instead of separate overrides.

e062af6483335d394a1c2be8a91b4599ccc1c3e2.text: The internal system that builds and tests the software now stores and reuses common parts directly, instead of moving them between steps. This makes the process faster and more efficient. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

f511ffec5e7000266f63637f6091a3007e582722.text: The system now tracks specific errors more accurately and uses a single standard for stopping responses. This internal cleanup helps the assistant behave more consistently without changing how you use it.

9180f967b49b755f230017ac2132da3e6c7bbc2f.title: Fix contentlayer module declaration path
9180f967b49b755f230017ac2132da3e6c7bbc2f.summary: Corrects the TypeScript module declaration in `web/src/types/contentlayer.d.ts` from `contentlayer/generated` to `.contentlayer/generated`. This ensures typecheck passes when the generated directory is missing or during clean builds. The `allDocs` export type is relaxed to `any[]` to accommodate the dynamic nature of the generated content.

8ed339c1d7699ff209dc33c1e12dec59eec7b03f.title: CI artifact actions bumped v3 to v4
8ed339c1d7699ff209dc33c1e12dec59eec7b03f.summary: actions/upload-artifact and actions/download-artifact bumped v3 to v4 in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Six download steps plus one upload step updated. Internal CI only.

891b001d3d53cc6a2126eb394646eb83b7bf6e6b.title: Remove contentlayer from CI typecheck
891b001d3d53cc6a2126eb394646eb83b7bf6e6b.summary: Removed contentlayer generation step from CI workflow and excluded .contentlayer from web/tsconfig.json include paths. This prevents typecheck failures caused by missing or malformed generated contentlayer files. Affects .github/workflows/ci.yml and web/tsconfig.json.

8a25fb4611c05256e2193ff79c9413a02c311290.title: Fix CI typecheck stub for contentlayer
8a25fb4611c05256e2193ff79c9413a02c311290.summary: Updated `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to generate a valid TypeScript stub for `contentlayer` during CI. The previous stub `export {}` caused typecheck failures because it lacked the expected `allDocs` export. The new stub exports `allDocs` as an empty array typed as `any[]`, satisfying the type checker.

60f1404da95fc5c107dc9f0001a1120ca198d4dd.title: CI: Merge typecheck and web build into parallel job
60f1404da95fc5c107dc9f0001a1120ca198d4dd.summary: Consolidated separate CI jobs for typecheck and web build into a single build-and-check job. Both processes now run in parallel using bash background jobs and `wait`, replacing the sequential execution or separate runner overhead. This change reduces CI pipeline duration by eliminating redundant setup steps and optimizing resource usage within the same runner environment.

68652f26a1bd45f7c131446ef1502231b7d11d62.title: Remove dynamic agent template schema invalid model test
68652f26a1bd45f7c131446ef1502231b7d11d62.summary: Removed the test case verifying rejection of invalid model names in dynamic agent templates. This cleanup addresses a redundant or failing assertion in the schema validation suite. The change is confined to the common package's test directory.

439503d77504035e2ea8d25c66ad6f823ceeec76.title: Remove 1000-char truncation from timeline chart event details
439503d77504035e2ea8d25c66ad6f823ceeec76.summary: TimelineChart event detail rendering now displays full responseContent. Previous logic truncated strings over 1000 characters with a suffix marker. Change scoped to web/src/app/admin/traces/components/timeline-chart.tsx. Large payloads now render fully within the max-h-96 scrollable container.

0bad4769d0cd38a4ed0e0a8876adb49e78f21ce1.title: CI workflow split into parallel setup, build-web, typecheck, and build
0bad4769d0cd38a4ed0e0a8876adb49e78f21ce1.summary: The CI pipeline now executes build-web, typecheck, and build as independent parallel jobs gated by a shared setup job, replacing the previous sequential build. This structure reduces total execution time by allowing these tasks to run concurrently on separate runners. The test and test-integration jobs now depend on the completion of all three parallel build jobs rather than a single build step. Dependency caching is centralized in the setup job using bun.lockb hashes to optimize installation across the parallel branches.

aaa25aa7b24c5e242be4f228b30342df56d3a699.title: CI nodemodules artifact replace cache
aaa25aa7b24c5e242be4f228b30342df56d3a699.summary: GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` replaces `actions/cache` and `bun install` steps in build/test jobs with `actions/upload-artifact`/`actions/download-artifact` for `node_modules`. The `setup` job now uploads the installed dependencies as an artifact with 1-day retention, which downstream jobs download instead of re-installing or restoring cache. A stub `.contentlayer/generated/index.ts` is created in the web typecheck job to satisfy build requirements without running the full contentlayer generation.

439503d77504035e2ea8d25c66ad6f823ceeec76.text: Internal change: Timeline charts now show full event details instead of cutting off long text.

891b001d3d53cc6a2126eb394646eb83b7bf6e6b.text: A small internal update fixed a problem that could stop website content from loading correctly. You should not notice any change in how the product works.

68652f26a1bd45f7c131446ef1502231b7d11d62.text: The software no longer checks if a specific setting is invalid. This small change only affects how the system tests itself and does not change how you use the product.

9180f967b49b755f230017ac2132da3e6c7bbc2f.text: Fixed a small internal issue to make website updates more reliable. Users will see no changes.

8ed339c1d7699ff209dc33c1e12dec59eec7b03f.text: The system that saves and retrieves files during automated software checks was updated. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

8a25fb4611c05256e2193ff79c9413a02c311290.text: Fixed an internal tool that checks code quality. You will not notice any change.

aaa25aa7b24c5e242be4f228b30342df56d3a699.text: The system now saves and reuses installed parts instead of downloading them repeatedly during internal checks. This change is small and internal, so users will not notice any difference in the product.

0bad4769d0cd38a4ed0e0a8876adb49e78f21ce1.text: A small internal change speeds up how the software is checked and prepared for release. Users will not notice a difference, but updates may reach the team faster.

6f93b768db05fb9d083095d985b3f2c71c6330fe.title: Allow forward slashes in worktree names
6f93b768db05fb9d083095d985b3f2c71c6330fe.summary: Worktree name validation regex updated to accept forward slashes. Internal tooling change in scripts/init-worktree.ts. No user-facing CLI or API changes.

a13b3c9856e6d29b405dfadd13b653a238209633.title: spawnagentsasync conversation history message moved inside
a13b3c9856e6d29b405dfadd13b653a238209633.summary: Refactor in `backend/src/tools/handlers/spawn-agents-async.ts`. The `conversationHistoryMessage` construction is moved from the outer scope into the `triggerSpawnAgentsAsync` function. Import order for `ASYNC_AGENTS_ENABLED` adjusted.

6959c02278f1642cd72694ffdb80e2a0c6faad41.title: Refactor bun wrapper to eliminate cd usage
6959c02278f1642cd72694ffdb80e2a0c6faad41.summary: The `.bin/bun` script now resolves the project root using `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` to anchor cache file paths and `infisical export` execution. This replaces direct `cd` commands with subshell execution (`cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && infisical export`) to prevent side effects on the main shell's working directory. The change affects `.bin/bun` and updates `knowledge.md` to document the new subshell isolation mechanism.

dc3464289d810a13a28c83a8819cc271ba7d7fef.title: Remove subgoal completion truncation from messages util
dc3464289d810a13a28c83a8819cc271ba7d7fef.summary: Removed logic in `getCoreMessagesSubset` that sliced messages to start after the last 'COMPLETE' subgoal. Core messages now pass directly to `trimCoreMessagesToFitTokenLimit` without pre-truncation. Affects `backend/src/util/messages.ts`. Internal refactor; no user-facing behavior change expected.

2f5589814f6e96270288d13fa4d68150c8168ffc.title: Infisical caching in bun wrapper
2f5589814f6e96270288d13fa4d68150c8168ffc.summary: Added caching for Infisical secrets in .bin/bun using .infisical-cache with 15-minute TTL. Reduces startup from ~1.2s to ~0.16s. Cache invalidates on .infisical.json modification or expiry. Uses infisical export with 10s timeout for session validation. Added .infisical-cache to .gitignore.

a17bd25564db357988d60a0d237cd9f78965e725.title: Move conversation history message into triggerSpawnAgents
a17bd25564db357988d60a0d237cd9f78965e725.summary: In backend/src/tools/handlers/spawn-agents.ts, the conversationHistoryMessage definition moved inside the triggerSpawnAgents async function. This change ensures the message content is generated only when the spawn operation is triggered, avoiding unnecessary JSON serialization of mutableState.messages if the handler exits early. Internal refactor affecting only the backend agent spawning logic.

cdc96f36a56704cd70d63e8aa7b28c10aa23cbe8.title: Allow all OpenRouter models
cdc96f36a56704cd70d63e8aa7b28c10aa23cbe8.summary: Backend `modelToAiSDKModel` now defaults unknown models to OpenRouter instead of throwing. `supportsCacheControl` helper replaces hardcoded `openrouter_grok_4` check for prompt caching. Zod schemas for `model` and `agentType` relaxed from strict enums to strings. Error handling in `promptAiSdkStream` now captures `APICallError` response bodies.

6959c02278f1642cd72694ffdb80e2a0c6faad41.text: A small internal fix prevents the system from getting lost when it runs background tasks. This means features that use these tasks will keep working smoothly without unexpected errors.

a13b3c9856e6d29b405dfadd13b653a238209633.text: A small internal update changed how the system stores recent conversation history. Users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

8d04c33a5fe3b083a08af02baf11408a378043a3.text: The assistant now supports new custom logic written as plain text. This allows more flexible automation without needing to install extra software.

6f93b768db05fb9d083095d985b3f2c71c6330fe.text: The system now allows slashes in project folder names. This internal update lets teams organize work areas with clearer labels, but you will not see any changes in the app.

2f5589814f6e96270288d13fa4d68150c8168ffc.text: The app now remembers secret login details for a short time, so it starts up faster. This is a small internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

a17bd25564db357988d60a0d237cd9f78965e725.text: The system now prepares conversation history only when needed, skipping unnecessary work if an action is canceled early. This small internal update helps the software run more efficiently without changing how you use it.

dc3464289d810a13a28c83a8819cc271ba7d7fef.text: The system now shares more context when calculating message limits. This is an internal cleanup. You should not see any changes.

e9162fbe8f71f75ae9158b80a87370ec035f8289.text: The system now handles plural words more accurately, ensuring terms like 'roofs' are not mistakenly changed to 'rooves'. This update also standardizes the display of 'credit' and 'user' labels throughout the interface for a cleaner look.

95a48c9ea91d41af4131419ed361f2c4c750032c.title: npm-app typecheck covers tests
95a48c9ea91d41af4131419ed361f2c4c750032c.summary: Removed test exclusions from `npm-app/tsconfig.json`. `include: ["src/**/*.ts"]` now covers test files. Fixes typecheck for npm-app.

2cff88d16544598e296e6fcae972f6cba7e2b09c.title: Fix type errors in OpenRouter usage accounting tests
2cff88d16544598e296e6fcae972f6cba7e2b09c.summary: OpenRouter usage accounting tests switched from vitest to bun:test. Semicolons removed across test files to match Bun linter style. Fixes type errors in packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk.

e7cb3d09fc3c812260954b2f81a66e6d69aa5a3d.title: Remove test exclusions from backend and common tsconfig
e7cb3d09fc3c812260954b2f81a66e6d69aa5a3d.summary: Typecheck now covers test files in backend and common packages by removing explicit test exclusion patterns from tsconfig.json. This ensures dynamic-agent-template-schema and agent-template-path-validation tests are included in static analysis. Affects backend/tsconfig.json and common/tsconfig.json.

0c7e401f9f5a66c8471545377d7077c7a2078105.title: Include test files in typecheck
0c7e401f9f5a66c8471545377d7077c7a2078105.summary: Removed test file exclusion patterns from tsconfig.json in packages/bigquery, packages/billing, packages/code-map, packages/internal, and scripts. This ensures .test.ts and .spec.ts files are now included in type checking. Internal OpenRouter AI SDK tests were also updated to align with this change.

ee8e6301311b44ef7cb96b26520e91491d70627e.title: Silence Infisical logs in dev wrapper
ee8e6301311b44ef7cb96b26520e91491d70627e.summary: The `.bin/bun` script now executes `infisical run` with the `--silent` flag and sets `INFISICAL_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true`. This change suppresses verbose Infisical output and skips version checks to reduce CLI overhead and speed up startup times for local development. The update is documented in `knowledge.md` under the Infisical wrapper section.

0e41172996f3dd2745000897a3c458628fac06e2.title: Enable typecheck for backend tests
0e41172996f3dd2745000897a3c458628fac06e2.summary: Removed `**/*.test.ts` from `exclude` in `backend/tsconfig.json`. Backend test files now undergo typechecking. Ensures type safety in test suites.

5dd32714276f230b86c332ffa34a5a09c244e232.title: Evals tsconfig includes test files for typecheck
5dd32714276f230b86c332ffa34a5a09c244e232.summary: evals/tsconfig.json drops `**/*.test.ts` and `**/*.spec.ts` from `exclude`, so evals typecheck now covers `evals/swe-bench.test.ts`. Previously evals test files were skipped during typecheck, leaving type errors in them undetected. Scope limited to evals tsconfig; no runtime or CLI behavior change.

91ff102e9aadb77aa7816450ee5fcb75796a5f05.title: Fix build
91ff102e9aadb77aa7816450ee5fcb75796a5f05.summary: CLI agent listing reads `purpose` instead of `description` from `AGENT_PERSONAS` metadata in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Troubleshooting docs update example agent config `purpose` field placeholder text.

c8e6db866b61d942679a726e78ec4e9a92a35cd0.title: Reenable CI integration tests
c8e6db866b61d942679a726e78ec4e9a92a35cd0.summary: Uncommented test-integration job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Runs integration tests across npm-app, backend, and common packages. Increased timeout to 15 minutes and reduced retries to 3 attempts.

5dd32714276f230b86c332ffa34a5a09c244e232.text: Internal check now reviews test code for errors. Small change. No effect on how you use the product.

2cff88d16544598e296e6fcae972f6cba7e2b09c.text: Small internal cleanup of test checks. No user-facing changes.

e7cb3d09fc3c812260954b2f81a66e6d69aa5a3d.text: The system now checks its own test files for errors. This small internal change helps catch mistakes earlier.

91ff102e9aadb77aa7816450ee5fcb75796a5f05.text: The assistant now shows the correct description for each agent. This small internal fix only affects how the tool lists agents.

95a48c9ea91d41af4131419ed361f2c4c750032c.text: A small internal update now checks the code that tests the app for errors. This helps catch problems earlier, but you will not notice any change in how the app works.

c8e6db866b61d942679a726e78ec4e9a92a35cd0.text: Automated checks for the software are back on. This means problems are caught earlier, so the product stays stable.

0e41172996f3dd2745000897a3c458628fac06e2.text: The system now checks the code that verifies other parts of the software. This small internal change helps catch errors earlier.

ee8e6301311b44ef7cb96b26520e91491d70627e.text: A small internal update makes the app start faster by hiding extra setup messages.

0c7e401f9f5a66c8471545377d7077c7a2078105.text: The team made sure the system checks the quality of its own test files. This small internal change helps catch mistakes earlier.

0a9d706727c7518decfaf051516b4b4c3123e044.text: The system now uses a single method to process all types of assistant tasks, making the underlying code cleaner. This is an internal update that does not change how you use the product.

508f60b39f1be9bc9378731c213ef28bb877542b.title: superagent template prefers sendagentmessage over spawning
508f60b39f1be9bc9378731c213ef28bb877542b.summary: superagent.ts adds send_agent_message to toolNames and injects a prompt directive to prefer messaging existing agents over spawning new ones. This reduces redundant agent creation for similar tasks. Scope limited to backend/src/templates/agents/superagent.ts.

f0a62f722271bc4b4c88ecad14e52763a6d613e1.title: knowledge.md adds Bun testing best practices
f0a62f722271bc4b4c88ecad14e52763a6d613e1.summary: Added Bun Testing Best Practices section to knowledge.md. Mandates `spyOn()` over `mock.module()` for function mocking to ensure test isolation and easier restoration. `mock.module()` is restricted to entire module replacement scenarios.

44b7f2568a6baa967756a741becc676cd3fe029c.title: Enable async agents
44b7f2568a6baa967756a741becc676cd3fe029c.summary: ASYNC_AGENTS_ENABLED set to true in common/src/constants.ts. Allows tool calls to continue executing even when main user input is cancelled. Scope limited to shared core constants.

ad42541ac1c3f1411509997cf39d2b3b4b1b2dcb.title: Remove agent spawn reminder from base prompt
ad42541ac1c3f1411509997cf39d2b3b4b1b2dcb.summary: Removed the system instruction block prompting agent spawning (file picker, thinker, reviewer) from `backend/src/templates/base-prompts.ts`. This internal cleanup eliminates redundant guidance in the base prompt template. The change affects only the backend prompt generation logic.

e707c836ad521ed123cdde4bdef3ed4013f2e367.title: Nullable agentType restored in session state schema
e707c836ad521ed123cdde4bdef3ed4013f2e367.summary: AgentStateSchema now accepts null for agentType. AsyncAgentManager adds non-null assertions to suppress TypeScript errors. Initial session state defaults to null instead of fake 'base' string. Scope covers common types and backend async manager.

e920a2f1fe10f912bb442ac482bf8667e79a2f27.title: Agent name normalization doc and validation refactor
e920a2f1fe10f912bb442ac482bf8667e79a2f27.summary: Agent name normalization logic clarified to strip only default CodebuffAI/ prefix, preserving other org identities. Validation in agent-template-validation.ts refactored to normalize dynamic agent IDs and spawnable agents before comparison, removing redundant prefix-stripping steps. backend/knowledge.md updated with Agent System section detailing valid prefix-less references and key file locations.

85179603f1b471b7a414fa3df09b6ddac8f9598c.title: Switch tool calls to XML-JSON mix
85179603f1b471b7a414fa3df09b6ddac8f9598c.summary: Tool call parsing switched from pure XML to a hybrid XML-JSON format. `ai-sdk.ts` now emits JSON-encoded parameters wrapped in XML tags, and `prompt-agent-stream.ts` removes per-template `stopSequences` in favor of global constants. This affects all agent templates and the backend streaming logic.

e3e403b364549a6ef6a9301f44b8b531f0480fb5.title: Async agents: spawn, messaging, session-aware inputs
e3e403b364549a6ef6a9301f44b8b531f0480fb5.summary: New `AsyncAgentManager` tracks spawned agents, routes `send_agent_message` prompts, and injects pending messages into `runAgentStep` tool results when `ASYNC_AGENTS_ENABLED` is true. `live-user-inputs.ts` splits `endUserInput` from new `cancelUserInput`, adds `sessionConnections` map, and requires `sessionId` in `checkLiveUserInput` to gate on WebSocket status. `superagent` template registered in `agent-list.ts` using `openrouter_claude_sonnet_4`; `main-prompt.ts` now sets `mainAgentState.agentType`. `ai-sdk.ts` passes `clientSessionId` to all three live-input checks.

e6ded262964744c92e4326959417d7736f3701bf.title: Rename agent template description field to purpose
e6ded262964744c92e4326959417d7736f3701bf.summary: The `description` field in `AgentTemplate` and `ProgrammaticAgentTemplate` types is renamed to `purpose`. This change propagates through backend agent implementations, dynamic agent loading, and shared constants in `common/src/constants/agents.ts`. Existing JSON templates and code referencing the old field name will fail validation or type checks until updated.

44b7f2568a6baa967756a741becc676cd3fe029c.text: The assistant can now keep working on tasks even if you stop sending messages. This small update prevents background actions from halting when input is cancelled.

508f60b39f1be9bc9378731c213ef28bb877542b.text: The system now talks to existing helpers instead of making new ones. This stops it from creating extra copies for the same job.

e6ded262964744c92e4326959417d7736f3701bf.text: A label inside the assistant's setup instructions changed from 'description' to 'purpose'. If you use custom setup files, you must update the label name or the assistant will stop working.

e3e403b364549a6ef6a9301f44b8b531f0480fb5.text: The assistant can now work on tasks in the background and send you updates or questions while you are still using the app. You can answer these messages or cancel them without interrupting your current session.

85179603f1b471b7a414fa3df09b6ddac8f9598c.text: The assistant now receives instructions in a clearer format that is easier for it to follow, helping it understand what actions to take. This is a small internal update that does not change how you use the product.

e920a2f1fe10f912bb442ac482bf8667e79a2f27.text: The assistant now handles name tags more accurately, keeping your specific labels instead of removing them. This is a small internal fix to help the system recognize your custom settings correctly.

e707c836ad521ed123cdde4bdef3ed4013f2e367.text: The app now correctly identifies when no specific assistant type is set, instead of using a placeholder. This internal cleanup prevents minor confusion in how sessions are stored.

ad42541ac1c3f1411509997cf39d2b3b4b1b2dcb.text: The assistant's internal instructions were simplified to remove a repetitive reminder. This cleanup does not change how the tool works for you.

f0a62f722271bc4b4c88ecad14e52763a6d613e1.text: The team updated internal testing rules to check software more reliably. This change helps prevent errors in the product, but you will not notice any difference in how it works.

0995194bd0e08148b005dfd48dfcfaff02af2422.title: Remove .agents template files
0995194bd0e08148b005dfd48dfcfaff02af2422.summary: Deleted `.agents/templates/base.json` and `.agents/templates/reviewer.json`. Cleanup of confusing internal agent templates. No user-facing behavior change.

5c0008ddf0c253f0384c3d7b1494ff9ee681fe6e.title: Remove spawnableAgents field from agent registry
5c0008ddf0c253f0384c3d7b1494ff9ee681fe6e.summary: Removed `spawnableAgents` assignment in `AgentRegistry` within `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts`. The registry no longer injects the full list of agent types into base template objects. This simplifies the dynamic agent resolution logic by eliminating redundant state propagation.

4716e11693dab3c390eec1579cd6a2f3c9e048f9.title: Fix dynamic agent initialization and validation flow
4716e11693dab3c390eec1579cd6a2f3c9e048f9.summary: AgentRegistry.initialize now calls reset() on every invocation, clearing stale state and resetting the underlying DynamicAgentService. websocket-action.ts delegates dynamic agent loading and override validation to the registry, removing manual dynamicAgentService.loadAgents and validateAgentTemplateConfigs calls. Scope: backend templates, websocket init, shared validation util. Reset clears allAgentNames, isInitialized, and validationErrors before reloading templates.

169cfe8a9f32a7b2bde473a27ebe649ac2b83eec.title: Remove dynamic agent override support
169cfe8a9f32a7b2bde473a27ebe649ac2b83eec.summary: Dynamic agent loader now rejects `override: true` in JSON templates. `agent-overrides.ts` throws validation errors for flagged files, while `dynamic-agent-service.ts` surfaces these errors during template processing. Scope covers backend template loading logic. Migration requires setting `override: false` or removing the field entirely.

929d9ff13003b9dbefd44bae79afcf9d0fd8a51f.title: DynamicAgentService loads templates from fileContext paths
929d9ff13003b9dbefd44bae79afcf9d0fd8a51f.summary: DynamicAgentService now uses full file paths from `fileContext.agentTemplates` instead of hardcoding `.agents/templates/` prefix. `loadAgents`, `collectAgentIds`, and `loadSingleAgent` pass `filePath` directly, removing `path.basename` stripping and manual `.agents/templates/${fileName}` reconstruction. Scope limited to `backend/src/templates/dynamic-agent-service.ts`. Ensures user-provided agent templates load correctly regardless of local `.agents/templates` directory presence.

d30469f4ee37b3e2cb2dbbece02b52cd4da25f61.title: Restore user-defined agents to base template spawnableAgents
d30469f4ee37b3e2cb2dbbece02b52cd4da25f61.summary: Fixes regression where user-defined agents were missing from base agent templates' `spawnableAgents`. `AgentRegistry` now explicitly merges `dynamicAgentService` types (excluding overrides) into static base templates. Affects backend `agent-registry.ts`.

0d4efa922e06c107e1615fa818735ab714d80b75.title: Fix dynamic agent registry init timing
0d4efa922e06c107e1615fa818735ab714d80b75.summary: Spawn-agents now awaits dynamic agent registry initialization inside the trigger function, fixing race conditions where templates were unavailable. DynamicAgentService adds logging for successful loads and validation errors. CI staging workflow updated for PR #208. Release-staging script switches version check to npm registry.

5e1975004572293ca62e0cf83def9374a05bc5aa.title: CLI discovers local agents from .agents/templates
5e1975004572293ca62e0cf83def9374a05bc5aa.summary: CLI now scans .agents/templates/*.json to discover local agents. getLocalAgentNames reads filenames and name fields, merging results with built-in UNIQUE_AGENT_NAMES. @mention autocomplete and displayAgentMenu show local agents. Invalid JSON files are skipped.

ff8a3a3182fec78b4c070d595efa07a8e9d21174.title: Add admin trace dashboard with interactive timeline visualization
ff8a3a3182fec78b4c070d595efa07a8e9d21174.summary: New admin trace dashboard added to web package with interactive timeline visualization for debugging client sessions. Shared XML parsing utilities introduced in packages/internal/src/utils/xml-parser.ts for tool call/result extraction. Covers web/src/app/admin/traces/* components including timeline-chart, trace-viewer, client-session-viewer, and chat-message. Trace processing logic in web/src/app/admin/traces/utils/trace-processing.ts parses tool calls from content and extracts user/assistant messages.

0995194bd0e08148b005dfd48dfcfaff02af2422.text: The company removed some confusing internal setup files. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

169cfe8a9f32a7b2bde473a27ebe649ac2b83eec.text: The system no longer allows custom agent templates to override default settings. If you use such a template, you must remove the override option or set it to false, or the template will fail to load.

0d4efa922e06c107e1615fa818735ab714d80b75.text: The system now waits for the agent list to load completely before starting. This prevents temporary errors where the assistant could not find a new feature.

5c0008ddf0c253f0384c3d7b1494ff9ee681fe6e.text: The assistant no longer carries an extra list of helpers inside its main settings. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

5e1975004572293ca62e0cf83def9374a05bc5aa.text: The assistant now recognizes custom agents saved in a specific folder. This means you can add new helpers locally, and they will appear in the menu and suggestions alongside the standard ones.

4716e11693dab3c390eec1579cd6a2f3c9e048f9.text: The system now clears old settings before starting up, ensuring it uses fresh configurations. This prevents glitches from leftover data when the assistant loads.

62ad75f8e85230ea5a1da560992088ccfefb3e5e.text: The app now automatically fixes broken downloads instead of stopping. If a part of the software fails to load, it deletes the bad file and tries again.

929d9ff13003b9dbefd44bae79afcf9d0fd8a51f.text: The system now finds custom assistant templates using their exact saved locations, rather than assuming they are in one specific folder. This ensures your custom templates load correctly, even if they are stored in different places.

d30469f4ee37b3e2cb2dbbece02b52cd4da25f61.text: The system now correctly includes your custom agents in the list of available options. This fixes a bug where these agents were missing from the standard templates, ensuring you can use them as intended.

ff8a3a3182fec78b4c070d595efa07a8e9d21174.text: The support team added a new screen to see how the assistant thinks and talks, step by step. This helps them find and fix problems faster.

87cbb266baeb3d24eebce49268d6b5c8aae8e979.title: Remove GITHUBTOKEN log from release script
87cbb266baeb3d24eebce49268d6b5c8aae8e979.summary: Deleted console.log notification for GITHUB_TOKEN usage in `httpGet`. Prevents token presence from being printed to stdout during releases. Affects `npm-app/release/index.js`. No functional change to authentication headers.

1877ed40d79229fd20aa8003bfe0d11e94c1e61d.title: Add debug logging for tool calls and results in stream-parser
1877ed40d79229fd20aa8003bfe0d11e94c1e61d.summary: Stream parser logging for tool calls and results downgraded from info to debug level. Tool call detection and result processing now include toolCallId in the log message for better traceability. Affects backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts.

7edf8ee1bf22b0138a09bde499dc49c0ed5049da.title: Add / command to menu and fix help prompt
7edf8ee1bf22b0138a09bde499dc49c0ed5049da.summary: The CLI menu now displays "/" as a command to list available commands. The startup prompt was updated to suggest "/help" instead of "help". Leading whitespace was removed from the ASCII art banner in `npm-app/src/menu.ts`.

7f421fb293897e10ee8363f69dac6b658b18bbc0.title: Refactor tool handler inputs
7f421fb293897e10ee8363f69dac6b658b18bbc0.summary: Tool handler signatures in `backend/src/tools/handlers/` now accept `agentStepId`, `clientSessionId`, and `userInputId` as top-level parameters instead of reading them from `state`. `backend/src/tools/constants.ts` updated `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` type to reflect this change. `backend/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` removed these fields from the state object construction. `write-file.ts` switched `agentMessagesUntruncated` source to `mutableState.messages`.

8d7bb32e78128440de4ac3d4818e2ea45519aeb7.title: findfiles tool handler mutableState migration
8d7bb32e78128440de4ac3d4818e2ea45519aeb7.summary: handleFindFiles migrates from direct state.messages access to state.mutableState.messages. Root cause: state schema refactor isolating mutable fields. Affects backend/src/tools/handlers/find-files.ts. Optional chaining on mutableState prevents runtime crash if field absent.

87fcf2384eafe3573e1e9364834648f15e4ebd68.title: Refactor tool handlers to unified format and remove WIP tool
87fcf2384eafe3573e1e9364834648f15e4ebd68.summary: Removed `WIP_TOOLS` constant and `NonWIPTool` type from `backend/src/tools/constants.ts` to unify tool handler signatures. Handlers for `spawn_agents`, `think_deeply`, `update_report`, and `web_search` are now registered in `codebuffToolHandlers` alongside existing tools. State access in handlers like `add-subgoal.ts` migrated to `state.mutableState.agentContext`, and `run-tool.ts` initializes `agentContext` as an object. `parseRawToolCall` in `tools.ts` now preserves `rawToolCall.toolCallId` instead of generating new IDs on error.

7114c75f4aeac61ebbc1dee2fb1aca7b5cfce46e.title: dev.sh passes explicit --cwd flag to bun start-bin
7114c75f4aeac61ebbc1dee2fb1aca7b5cfce46e.summary: scripts/dev.sh now passes the `--cwd` flag to `bun start-bin` instead of relying on positional argument interpretation. This ensures the client starts in the correct directory context during local development. The change affects only the `scripts/dev.sh` file within the Tooling area.

2dce0a73862dce97ed26ca7a5ddeb47dff205c7d.title: CLI cwd flag replaces positional argument
2dce0a73862dce97ed26ca7a5ddeb47dff205c7d.summary: Project directory selection moved from positional argument to --cwd flag in npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts and index.ts. Breaking change for scripts passing path as first arg; now requires explicit flag. Scope: CLI interface, types.ts CliOptions, package.json start scripts.

41d2e750bafe7bf3dc5869a989eaad5032615397.title: Add print mode flag to CLI
41d2e750bafe7bf3dc5869a989eaad5032615397.summary: Introduced `--print` (`-p`) flag to `codebuff` CLI enabling non-interactive execution. Runs until first response completes then exits, requiring prompt or `--params`. Greeting and interactive setup skipped; unauthenticated print mode exits with error. Affects `npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts`, `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, `npm-app/src/index.ts`, `npm-app/src/types.ts`.

9c18f8cba27f161e20ea2b80e4960dd9b947f44c.title: Add --agent and --params CLI flags for explicit agent selection
9c18f8cba27f161e20ea2b80e4960dd9b947f44c.summary: Added `--agent <id>` and `--params <json>` flags to the CLI to bypass cost-mode mapping and invoke specific agents. Backend `main-prompt.ts` validates agent IDs against `agentRegistry` and prioritizes explicit selection over default templates. `npm-app` parses JSON params, passing them via `promptParams` in the client action schema. Updated `cli-definitions.ts`, `types.ts`, and help text to support the new options.

7114c75f4aeac61ebbc1dee2fb1aca7b5cfce46e.text: A small internal update improves how the app starts up on computers. It helps the app find its files correctly when running locally.

87cbb266baeb3d24eebce49268d6b5c8aae8e979.text: A small internal change stopped a security code from being printed to the log during software releases. This keeps the code private and does not change how the product works for you.

7f421fb293897e10ee8363f69dac6b658b18bbc0.text: The assistant now receives conversation details directly from the system rather than searching for them, making it easier to track who is talking and when. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

87fcf2384eafe3573e1e9364834648f15e4ebd68.text: The assistant's internal tools were cleaned up to work more consistently. This is a small behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how you use the product.

7edf8ee1bf22b0138a09bde499dc49c0ed5049da.text: The menu now shows a '/' command to list options, and the help prompt says '/help'. A visual banner was cleaned up.

9c18f8cba27f161e20ea2b80e4960dd9b947f44c.text: You can now pick a specific assistant mode and set its options when starting it. This lets you bypass the automatic choice and use exactly what you want.

2dce0a73862dce97ed26ca7a5ddeb47dff205c7d.text: The tool now needs a special label before the folder path. Scripts that just gave the path first will stop working.

1877ed40d79229fd20aa8003bfe0d11e94c1e61d.text: This is a small internal update that changes how the system records its activity. It does not affect how the product works or looks to you.

8d7bb32e78128440de4ac3d4818e2ea45519aeb7.text: The tool's internal data access was updated to match a new system structure. This change is small and internal, so users will not notice any difference.

41d2e750bafe7bf3dc5869a989eaad5032615397.text: The tool now supports a quick, automatic mode for simple tasks. This lets it finish a job and close immediately without waiting for extra instructions.

f6a1aa2d6ace11d33266da263d675a80b28a0751.title: Fix doc heading anchors and copy-link behavior
f6a1aa2d6ace11d33266da263d675a80b28a0751.summary: Refactored MDX heading components in `web/src/components/docs/mdx/mdx-components.tsx` to generate hierarchical IDs (e.g., `#h2-title` for h2+) and fixed anchor link generation for all subsections. Logic moved from `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` to a shared `Mdx` component, ensuring consistent copy-link buttons and scroll behavior across h1-h4. Internal docs rendering only.

e133a602b602a3d8024e4330429ce623df4eeb9d.title: Improve AI SDK error logging and OpenRouter cache control
e133a602b602a3d8024e4330429ce623df4eeb9d.summary: Enhanced error logging in `ai-sdk.ts` by serializing `Error` objects via new `errorToObject` utility in `object.ts`, preserving non-enumerable properties for clearer diagnostics. Added `cacheControl` support for OpenRouter in `messages.ts` to match Anthropic's ephemeral caching behavior. These changes improve observability and provider compatibility in the core backend and shared utilities.

3879fc1debf18baf2a8e1d959e2041b4296b2bef.title: Add requireSlash flag to CLI command processing
3879fc1debf18baf2a8e1d959e2041b4296b2bef.summary: Added `requireSlash` boolean to `CommandInfo` interface in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` and implemented early check in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` `processCommand`. Commands with `requireSlash: true` (e.g., `/reset`, `/compact`) now forward raw input to backend if slash is missing, preventing accidental local execution. Cost mode commands also respect this flag via `interactiveCommandDetails` lookup. Scope limited to CLI command routing logic; no user-facing behavior change for valid slash commands.

9d5cb14ac691fc930b3a0f38680493a348f98607.title: Dynamic agent template loading fix
9d5cb14ac691fc930b3a0f38680493a348f98607.summary: DynamicAgentService now loads agent templates from fileContext.agentTemplates instead of reading .agents/templates from disk. This fixes validation errors caused by missing files or path issues. Scope covers backend/src/templates/dynamic-agent-service.ts and common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts. The override field in DynamicAgentTemplateSchema is now optional with default false, preventing validation failures on templates omitting it.

87a7b4bd082d74f59360a69b053cfb38d664d942.title: Drop 5-word sentence constraint from thinker prompt
87a7b4bd082d74f59360a69b053cfb38d664d942.summary: Removed explicit 5-word sentence limit from thinker agent prompt in backend/src/templates/agents/thinker.ts. General conciseness directive retained. Affects internal reasoning agent template only.

b4a95d509ff96b964c2809e742867f056076edf7.title: Add Mermaid diagram support to docs
b4a95d509ff96b964c2809e742867f056076edf7.summary: Docs components now render Mermaid diagrams via new `mermaid-diagram.tsx` and updated `code-demo.tsx` logic. This enables visual flowcharts and sequence diagrams within agent customization documentation. Scope includes `web/src/components/docs/mdx/` and related content files. Mermaid library added to `web/package.json` dependencies.

b9dbb87a896aeabcc0b59aa2446f3fc4cc520fe9.title: Preserve code block indentation in docs
b9dbb87a896aeabcc0b59aa2446f3fc4cc520fe9.summary: CodeDemo now preserves original indentation by passing rawContent via remark-code-to-codedemo.ts. Previous .trim() calls in code-demo.tsx stripped leading whitespace from string, array, and object children. The remark plugin extracts node.value directly into an mdxJsxAttribute, bypassing children processing when available.

4dac0f67281001587cadf3aa951c7808bad70468.title: Fix agent template schema rendering in docs
4dac0f67281001587cadf3aa951c7808bad70468.summary: AgentTemplateSchemaDisplay and AgentOverrideSchemaDisplay now import their dedicated components instead of aliasing to generic SchemaDisplay. The redundant dynamic imports in the docs page were removed. This ensures agent templates render correctly in the MDX pipeline.

44d9fc7837de87a7a7b7fb7700a29da7ab52f2f3.title: Implement findfiles tool handler
44d9fc7837de87a7a7b7fb7700a29da7ab52f2f3.summary: Added `find_files` to `codebuffToolHandlers` in `backend/src/tools/constants.ts`, moving it out of `WIP_TOOLS`. New handler `backend/src/tools/handlers/find-files.ts` implements file retrieval via WebSocket state and search prompts. Updated `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` params to include `agentStepId`, `clientSessionId`, and `userInputId`. Requires valid `ws`, `messages`, `fingerprintId`, and `repoId` in state.

f6a1aa2d6ace11d33266da263d675a80b28a0751.text: The website's documentation pages were updated internally to fix how section links work. This ensures that clicking a link takes you to the right spot and that the 'copy link' button works for all sections.

b4a95d509ff96b964c2809e742867f056076edf7.text: Documentation pages can now show simple diagrams. This makes it easier to see how different parts of the system connect.

87a7b4bd082d74f59360a69b053cfb38d664d942.text: The assistant's internal reasoning can now use sentences of any length, though it still aims to stay brief. This is a small internal change that helps the assistant think more clearly.

3879fc1debf18baf2a8e1d959e2041b4296b2bef.text: The system now checks for a missing slash in certain commands before running them. This prevents accidental actions if you forget to type the slash.

b9dbb87a896aeabcc0b59aa2446f3fc4cc520fe9.text: Internal fix. Code examples in documentation now show correct indentation. No user-facing change.

4dac0f67281001587cadf3aa951c7808bad70468.text: A small internal fix corrected how assistant templates appear in the help guides. The display glitch is gone, so the documentation now shows the right details.

9d5cb14ac691fc930b3a0f38680493a348f98607.text: The system now loads assistant instructions from a central source instead of searching for files individually. This prevents errors when instructions are missing or paths are incorrect. You will experience fewer failures when the assistant tries to use custom templates.

cff210788c5a35ba898b8d583393e3e7f50b662a.title: trimCoreMessagesToFitTokenLimit default 190k
cff210788c5a35ba898b8d583393e3e7f50b662a.summary: Default `maxTotalTokens` in `trimCoreMessagesToFitTokenLimit` reduced from 200,000 to 190,000. This tightens the token budget for message trimming in `backend/src/util/messages.ts`. Affects core message handling logic.

0fd278629c2cc763462e29d5a1af9bb3e5d53588.title: Add CodebuffAI prefix validation to agent IDs
0fd278629c2cc763462e29d5a1af9bb3e5d53588.summary: Introduced AGENT_ID_PREFIX constant and refined AgentOverrideConfigSchema id validation in common/src/types/agent-overrides.ts. The update ensures agent IDs are normalized and checked against available AgentTemplateTypes, appending the CodebuffAI/ prefix for error reporting. This prevents invalid agent configurations by enforcing strict ID structure and providing clear error messages listing valid prefixed agents.

236b55735026f8576be5e9243729b501cd47ca67.title: Add Agent Reference docs page
236b55735026f8576be5e9243729b501cd47ca67.summary: Adds `web/src/content/agents/agent-reference.mdx` documenting agent override and template schemas. Registers `AgentOverrideSchemaDisplay` and `AgentTemplateSchemaDisplay` in `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` using dynamic imports from `web/src/components/docs/mdx/schema-display.tsx`. Updates `web/src/content/agents/agent-templates.mdx` with directory structure examples.

13a1a2ddd2f03b45a2fcbab38bebb96475902f41.title: Add path validation for agent template configurations
13a1a2ddd2f03b45a2fcbab38bebb96475902f41.summary: Introduced strict path validation for `path` fields in agent template prompt overrides and dynamic fields. Rejects absolute paths and those resolving outside `AGENT_TEMPLATES_DIR` via `path.posix` normalization. Covers `systemPrompt`, `userInputPrompt`, `agentStepPrompt`, and initial/step assistant message fields. Validation failures skip further checks for the specific file.

c5d753dbc1ccd8b870ef9ebb1091a9ea2ed3ff78.title: cleanup-worktree.sh skips missing worktrees
c5d753dbc1ccd8b870ef9ebb1091a9ea2ed3ff78.summary: cleanup-worktree.sh now checks git worktree list instead of directory existence before removal. Missing worktrees trigger a warning rather than a hard exit 1. Scope limited to scripts/cleanup-worktree.sh. Prevents CI or local cleanup failures when worktrees are already detached.

23de9f55734aef7a9120500e36d0c7d4d7f62746.title: Mark Programmatic Agents as coming soon in docs
23de9f55734aef7a9120500e36d0c7d4d7f62746.summary: Update `web/src/content/agents/creating-new-agents.mdx` to mark Programmatic Agents as 'coming soon'. Add dedicated section detailing JavaScript/TypeScript capabilities for orchestration and conditional flows. Status change reflects current development phase.

5161f204cd81fcbc5ba71d8d07f506f6691012b7.title: Infisical env overrides for worktrees
5161f204cd81fcbc5ba71d8d07f506f6691012b7.summary: The `.bin/bun` wrapper now sources `.env.worktree` before invoking Infisical, allowing worktrees to override environment variables like ports. `scripts/init-worktree.ts` generates this file during setup, while `scripts/cleanup-worktree.sh` removes it upon teardown. This enables simultaneous worktree execution without port conflicts by bypassing global Infisical defaults.

23741261a65e50b975cf7a876cf542bf57ec0c69.title: Add Agent Templates and Customization Docs
23741261a65e50b975cf7a876cf542bf57ec0c69.summary: Added three new MDX documentation files under web/src/content/agents/ covering agent templates, creating new agents, and overriding existing agents. Updated web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx to include an 'Agents' section linking to these new docs. The content details JSON configuration structures for LLM-based and programmatic agents, including override types (append, prepend, replace) and external file references.

b25257700ce48db3c78efbf0dac893ea5940609a.title: Add id and toolNames validation to agent template schemas
b25257700ce48db3c78efbf0dac893ea5940609a.summary: Agent template schemas now enforce strict validation for `id` and `toolNames` fields. `ToolNamesOverrideSchema` in `common/src/types/agent-overrides.ts` replaces generic array handling with specific refinement logic checking against valid tool constants. `DynamicAgentTemplateSchema` in `common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts` adds similar refinement to `toolNames`, ensuring only registered tools are accepted. Invalid entries trigger errors listing available tools.

83c0bac173fc5dac8df83a1a7809e8860dfd426a.title: Dynamic agent prompt schema now parses via json-schema-to-zod
83c0bac173fc5dac8df83a1a7809e8860dfd426a.summary: Dynamic agent prompt schemas now convert via json-schema-to-zod instead of manual type switching. The promptSchema type in common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts splits into optional prompt and params JSON schema objects, validated with z.record(z.any()).refine(). Backend dynamic-agent-service.ts wraps conversion in try/catch, pushing errors to validationErrors and skipping the agent. common/src/util/file.ts adds getStubProjectFileContext for test scaffolding.

0fd278629c2cc763462e29d5a1af9bb3e5d53588.text: The system now checks agent names to make sure they are set up correctly. If a name is wrong, it shows a clear error message listing the valid options instead of failing silently.

23de9f55734aef7a9120500e36d0c7d4d7f62746.text: The help guide now says this new way to build assistants is coming soon. This means it is not ready for you to use yet.

cff210788c5a35ba898b8d583393e3e7f50b662a.text: The assistant now uses a slightly smaller amount of text to remember conversations. This helps keep chats running smoothly by staying within a safe limit.

13a1a2ddd2f03b45a2fcbab38bebb96475902f41.text: The system now blocks attempts to load prompt files from outside the approved folder. This protects against errors where a configuration accidentally points to the wrong location.

b25257700ce48db3c78efbf0dac893ea5940609a.text: The system now checks that requested tools are valid before running an agent. This prevents errors from using unknown tools, keeping the assistant stable.

c5d753dbc1ccd8b870ef9ebb1091a9ea2ed3ff78.text: A small internal fix stops the cleanup tool from failing if a folder is already missing. This makes the process smoother by warning instead of crashing.

23741261a65e50b975cf7a876cf542bf57ec0c69.text: The help pages now include guides for setting up and changing assistant templates. Users can follow these instructions to adjust how the assistant behaves.

5161f204cd81fcbc5ba71d8d07f506f6691012b7.text: A small internal update lets developers work on different parts of the app at the same time without their computers fighting over the same connections. This does not change how you use the product, but it helps the team build new features faster.

236b55735026f8576be5e9243729b501cd47ca67.text: Added a new help page explaining how to customize the assistant's behavior and appearance. This is a small internal update that does not change how the product works for you.

df51fc0e1225fbef80597abe27c5eaa64314c31a.title: Reorder agent step log messages to Start/End prefix
df51fc0e1225fbef80597abe27c5eaa64314c31a.summary: Agent step log messages in `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` now prefix `Start` and `End` instead of suffixing them. Prompt truncation logic updated to conditionally append prompt details only when present, avoiding `undefined` strings. This change affects internal logging format for agent iterations.

1fc362b6a7a23cc3872263dc1a88a0757a7f9fc1.title: Add git-committer agent template
1fc362b6a7a23cc3872263dc1a88a0757a7f9fc1.summary: Introduces `CodebuffAI/git-committer` agent template to automate git commits with structured analysis and standard footers. Registers the agent in `base.json` spawnable list. Includes detailed prompt instructions for diff review, file staging, and message generation. Status marked as internal/experimental due to debugging needs.

698d5a7dcd7fef0a4c035b5f31b8de956b6d9618.title: Enforce sequential spawn for thinker agent in base prompts
698d5a7dcd7fef0a4c035b5f31b8de956b6d9618.summary: Updated `baseAgentUserInputPrompt` in `backend/src/templates/base-prompts.ts` to explicitly forbid spawning the `thinker` agent concurrently with `file_picker` agents. The instruction now mandates waiting for file picker results before invoking the thinker. This ensures the deep thinking process operates on established codebase context.

21fff52c5c358d9a345f1650a662f63868684bc1.title: Fix dynamic agent ID collection order
21fff52c5c358d9a345f1650a662f63868684bc1.summary: DynamicAgentService now performs a two-pass load: collectAgentIds gathers all JSON template IDs first, then validation checks spawnable agents against the complete set. This fixes false-positive validation errors when a template references a dynamic agent defined later in the directory. Validation logic in common/src/util/agent-template-validation.ts and common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts updated to use normalizeAgentName instead of manual prefix stripping.

a2c4d6e1367a1c5e9c15064daca7df9bee181db5.title: Fix dynamic agent validation in websocket-action
a2c4d6e1367a1c5e9c15064daca7df9bee181db5.summary: Updated `validateAgentTemplateConfigs` to accept `dynamicAgentIds`, ensuring override templates validate against dynamically loaded agents. `websocket-action.ts` now loads dynamic agents before validating overrides, passing the resulting IDs to the validator. This prevents false validation errors for spawnable agents defined dynamically.

978abcd00776ef588b41d9e2be44c5f376659813.title: Add git worktree init and cleanup scripts with port overrides
978abcd00776ef588b41d9e2be44c5f376659813.summary: Added `init-worktree.ts` and `cleanup-worktree.sh` scripts to manage git worktrees with isolated environments. New `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_PORT` env var in `packages/internal/src/env.ts` and dynamic port usage in `web/package.json` dev script enable port overrides.
