Root `package.json` exposes `init-worktree` and `cleanup-worktree` commands.

c374050938e47559d792aad3d2275f0ef4a1b456.title: Allow relative paths in dynamic agent templates
c374050938e47559d792aad3d2275f0ef4a1b456.summary: Dynamic agent templates now accept relative paths for prompt fields. `resolvePromptField` checks the template directory and project root. `validateSpawnableAgents` tolerates missing `CodebuffAI/` prefixes. Updated `dynamic-agent-service.ts` and `file-resolver.ts`.

c62f4dc9fafde11f44f2ec090cc5883724b8f1a1.title: Dedup spawnable agent validation logic
c62f4dc9fafde11f44f2ec090cc5883724b8f1a1.summary: Moved `validateSpawnableAgents` from `common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts` to `common/src/util/agent-template-validation.ts` and updated `backend/src/templates/dynamic-agent-service.ts` to use the centralized utility. The refactored function now accepts `dynamicAgentIds` directly and internally constructs the full `availableAgentTypes` list, returning a unified result object with `availableAgents` for error formatting. This eliminates duplicate validation logic and standardizes how spawnable agent errors are generated across the codebase.

65c432bc959509a143dd2f09a601266ef1731f8a.title: Promote readfiles from WIP to active backend tool
65c432bc959509a143dd2f09a601266ef1731f8a.summary: The `read_files` tool moves from the `WIP_TOOLS` blocklist to the active `codebuffToolHandlers` registry in `backend/src/tools/constants.ts`. A new handler `backend/src/tools/handlers/read-files.ts` implements the logic, delegating to `getFileReadingUpdates` and rendering results via `renderReadFilesResult`. The tool handler signature now requires a `fileContext: ProjectFileContext` parameter, enabling direct access to file system state and token callers.

cea53e5a106c68ce3a20245020fbfb58be1328d3.title: Activate readdocs tool backend handler
cea53e5a106c68ce3a20245020fbfb58be1328d3.summary: Implemented `handleReadDocs` in `backend/src/tools/handlers/read-docs.ts` and registered it in `codebuffToolHandlers` within `backend/src/tools/constants.ts`. Removed `read_docs` from `WIP_TOOLS` to enable the feature. The handler integrates with `fetchContext7LibraryDocumentation`, enforcing strict state validation for `userId`, `agentStepId`, and `repoId` before execution. Includes telemetry logging for duration and token estimates.

698d5a7dcd7fef0a4c035b5f31b8de956b6d9618.text: The assistant now waits for file search results before analyzing code. This ensures its answers are based on accurate context.

a2c4d6e1367a1c5e9c15064daca7df9bee181db5.text: The system now correctly recognizes agents that are added while the app is running. This prevents false error messages when using these dynamic agents.

df51fc0e1225fbef80597abe27c5eaa64314c31a.text: The assistant now labels the beginning and end of each task step more clearly in its internal notes. This small change helps the team understand how tasks are processed but does not change how you use the product.

c374050938e47559d792aad3d2275f0ef4a1b456.text: The assistant can now find custom instructions using simpler file shortcuts. This small update makes setup easier without changing how you use the product.

1fc362b6a7a23cc3872263dc1a88a0757a7f9fc1.text: The assistant can now automatically save changes with clear, organized notes. This is an internal test, so you might not notice it yet.

cea53e5a106c68ce3a20245020fbfb58be1328d3.text: The assistant can now look up and use official documentation for software libraries. This helps it answer questions about those libraries more accurately.

65c432bc959509a143dd2f09a601266ef1731f8a.text: The assistant can now read files directly to understand your project. This change is internal and improves how the tool accesses information.

978abcd00776ef588b41d9e2be44c5f376659813.text: Added internal tools for developers to run multiple separate copies of the application at once. This change is small and does not affect how you use the product.

c62f4dc9fafde11f44f2ec090cc5883724b8f1a1.text: The system now checks for duplicate agents in one place instead of several. This makes error messages more consistent when you try to use an agent that is already running.

21fff52c5c358d9a345f1650a662f63868684bc1.text: The system now checks all available assistant options at once before validating them. This prevents false error messages when a setup references an option listed later in the file.

18a7d79e130256e56788be6703e58d37fea3393f.title: Agent template tests use id field instead of type
18a7d79e130256e56788be6703e58d37fea3393f.summary: Test mocks and assertions for agent templates switched from `type` to `id` to match the loader's field schema. Covers `dynamic-agent-loader.test.ts` and `agent-overrides.test.ts` in the backend. Ensures validation checks `templates.<name>.id` during template loading.

d529db2f4104336c563aab75c217cf016b55da40.title: Add strreplace tool handler
d529db2f4104336c563aab75c217cf016b55da40.summary: New `str_replace` tool handler added to backend, enabling precise string replacement in files. Handler registered in `codebuffToolHandlers` and removed from `WIP_TOOLS`. Shared `postStreamProcessing` logic extracted from `write-file.ts` to support both `write_file` and `str_replace`.

6120f46401805d692b37253c0c25a1f5642429c3.title: Remove agent registry init logs
6120f46401805d692b37253c0c25a1f5642429c3.summary: Deleted verbose startup logs from `AgentRegistry` and `DynamicAgentService`. Removed `logger.info` calls for initialization status, template counts, and dynamic agent loading. Refactors backend template subsystem to reduce noise.

1199aa0919bd7f397b2fea70ce02cb3446efd4df.title: Reduce verbose logging in services
1199aa0919bd7f397b2fea70ce02cb3446efd4df.summary: Removed redundant info/debug logs from server init, BigQuery setup, analytics, and websocket listeners. Error handling and warn logs for missing analytics keys preserved. Scope: backend, common, npm-app, web. Config: prettier filePattern narrowed to ts/tsx/json/md.

389cd3d7c211f0dba961dfc35b7aa87c3459653b.title: Switch thinker and planner agents to Grok 4
389cd3d7c211f0dba961dfc35b7aa87c3459653b.summary: Thinker and planner agent templates now use `x-ai/grok-4-07-09` instead of `google/gemini-2.5-pro-preview`. `common/src/constants.ts` adds `x-ai` to `ALLOWED_MODEL_PREFIXES` and defines the new model ID. `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` implements tiered pricing logic for Grok 4, applying $3/$6 per million input tokens and $15/$30 per million output tokens based on a 128k input threshold. `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` re-enables message truncation for non-Grok 4 models by restoring the conditional check.

d2fe4f46e112bf9f79fd35ba031fe70166efb744.title: Add createplan tool handler
d2fe4f46e112bf9f79fd35ba031fe70166efb744.summary: New `create_plan` tool handler added to backend, replacing WIP placeholder in `constants.ts`. Implements `handleCreatePlan` in `create-plan.ts`, sharing `FileProcessingMutableState` type extracted from `write-file.ts`. Tracks `KNOWLEDGE_FILE_UPDATED` analytics when path ends with `knowledge.md`.

eea6396c234082bf661564b58677f02bb8119823.title: Merge agent title into name and skip invalid agent types
eea6396c234082bf661564b58677f02bb8119823.summary: AGENT_PERSONAS in common/src/constants/agents.ts now combines name and title into a single name field (e.g., 'Buffy the Enthusiastic Coding Assistant'). toolRenderers in npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts skips rendering for unknown agent types by returning null instead of falling back to the raw agentType or 'Agent'. This affects agent name display in tool call outputs.

c27f5e78ddbbafb0477a917402d9f52a95566101.title: Convert web config files to ES modules
c27f5e78ddbbafb0477a917402d9f52a95566101.summary: web/.eslintrc.js and web/.prettierrc.js switched from CommonJS module.exports to ES module export default. Aligns config syntax with modern ESM tooling standards. Scope limited to web package configuration files.

6120f46401805d692b37253c0c25a1f5642429c3.text: The system now records fewer background details when it starts up. This small internal change keeps logs cleaner without affecting how the product works.

c27f5e78ddbbafb0477a917402d9f52a95566101.text: The rules for how the website's background settings are written were updated to match modern standards. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the product works for users.

eea6396c234082bf661564b58677f02bb8119823.text: Assistant names now show their full role, like 'Buffy the Enthusiastic Coding Assistant'. Unknown assistant types are hidden from the list to keep it clean.

fd29880e6f8f8d07f16002d301aa6354878cec5c.text: The assistant can now show real-time progress when working on tasks in the background. This helps you see what it is doing without waiting for the final result.

1199aa0919bd7f397b2fea70ce02cb3446efd4df.text: The software now writes fewer unimportant notes to its internal diary. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

18a7d79e130256e56788be6703e58d37fea3393f.text: The system now checks a different label to identify assistant templates. This internal fix ensures the right templates load correctly.

d2fe4f46e112bf9f79fd35ba031fe70166efb744.text: The assistant can now create plans. This internal update improves how it handles your requests.

d529db2f4104336c563aab75c217cf016b55da40.text: The assistant can now make specific, small edits to text files instead of rewriting them entirely. This internal update improves how the system handles file changes.

389cd3d7c211f0dba961dfc35b7aa87c3459653b.text: The assistant now uses a newer AI model for thinking and planning. This update may improve response quality and affects how usage is counted for pricing.

44d9fc7837de87a7a7b7fb7700a29da7ab52f2f3.text: The assistant can now search for files. This internal update lets it find specific files to help answer your questions.

7706aeaf01f13d3f8e1ea5e920a0fb082009f9fc.title: Remove duplicate reasoning token handling
7706aeaf01f13d3f8e1ea5e920a0fb082009f9fc.summary: Removed redundant `delta.reasoning` enqueue logic in `OpenRouterChatLanguageModel`. This prevents duplicate reasoning tokens from being emitted when `reasoning_details` are also present. The change affects `packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk/openrouter-chat-language-model.ts`. Reasoning output now relies exclusively on `delta.reasoning_details` processing.

35408cd3842bbf4bad167c04540d583dfb557fe2.title: Rename AgentTemplateSchema type field to id
35408cd3842bbf4bad167c04540d583dfb557fe2.summary: AgentTemplateSchema field 'type' renamed to 'id'. Affects JSON templates, backend agent logic, and type definitions. Update .agents/templates/*.json files and any custom agent code referencing template.type to use template.id.

e66dc736378804bdc8127aa28ba797ffa231817c.title: Fix type imports in backend run-tool
e66dc736378804bdc8127aa28ba797ffa231817c.summary: Swapped `TextBlockParam` from `@anthropic-ai/sdk` for local `TextBlock` in `backend/src/run-tool.ts`. Removed unused `AGENT_NAMES` import. Ensures consistent typing for system prompts without external SDK dependency in this context.

c7a6f84e1289be28e0cabfaa9ebdf8794ef56daa.title: Add includeCacheControl flag to getCoreMessagesSubset
c7a6f84e1289be28e0cabfaa9ebdf8794ef56daa.summary: getCoreMessagesSubset accepts optional includeCacheControl boolean, defaulting true. When false, skips adding anthropic/openrouter cacheControl to messages. backend/src/run-agent-step.ts imports updated. backend/src/util/messages.ts implements logic.

aa1b41fd45dd6eb6706bda6ccd9a5a3f04f28a7a.title: writefile tool handler added
aa1b41fd45dd6eb6706bda6ccd9a5a3f04f28a7a.summary: New `handleWriteFile` implementation in `backend/src/tools/handlers/write-file.ts` registers `write_file` as active tool. Removed from `WIP_TOOLS` in `backend/src/tools/constants.ts`. Handler accepts `writeToClient` callback for streaming chunks. Internal backend only.

fb06f629bfcb85e0d6cd534bb051b5f883c3113d.title: Enable argument passing to dev script
fb06f629bfcb85e0d6cd534bb051b5f883c3113d.summary: The root package.json dev script now accepts and forwards arguments to the underlying bun start-bin command via -- ${1:-..} "${@:2}". Redundant npm scripts (start-max, start-lite, start-ask, start-superagent, start-experimental, start-client) removed from both root and npm-app package.json files. start-bin script in npm-app/package.json no longer hardcodes .. as an argument. Covers root package.json and npm-app/package.json.

d35987b91ed8bd157c650ffff4512394c650fca7.title: Move dev script to scripts/dev.sh with readiness check
d35987b91ed8bd157c650ffff4512394c650fca7.summary: The `dev` script in `package.json` now calls `bash scripts/dev.sh` instead of inline shell logic. `scripts/dev.sh` starts the server, waits for a "🚀 Server is running on port" signal via a temporary ready file, then launches the client. This ensures the server is fully initialized before the client starts, preventing race conditions during development startup.

b4d6d0fbaa14e33456d21cdd608258cfb5f47258.title: clean-ts now deletes nodemodules and runs bun install
b4d6d0fbaa14e33456d21cdd608258cfb5f47258.summary: The `clean-ts` script in `package.json` now removes all `node_modules` directories and executes `bun install` after clearing `.tsbuildinfo` and `.next` files. This change ensures a fully clean dependency state during the cleanup process. The modification is limited to the root `package.json` scripts.

d19b63ec1b9ea8af210ea98a33e2d26948755b09.title: Add clean-ts script to fix typechecker infinite loop
d19b63ec1b9ea8af210ea98a33e2d26948755b09.summary: Added `clean-ts` script to `package.json` to delete `*.tsbuildinfo` files and `.next` directories. This resolves typechecker infinite loops caused by stale build cache or circular project references. Documented in `knowledge.md` under TypeScript Build State Management.

d35987b91ed8bd157c650ffff4512394c650fca7.text: A small internal update makes the product's startup more reliable. It now waits for the main part to be fully ready before loading the rest, which helps prevent occasional glitches when starting up.

7706aeaf01f13d3f8e1ea5e920a0fb082009f9fc.text: Fixed a bug that caused the assistant to show the same reasoning step twice. No visible change for most users.

aa1b41fd45dd6eb6706bda6ccd9a5a3f04f28a7a.text: The system can now save files.

e66dc736378804bdc8127aa28ba797ffa231817c.text: The tool now uses a simpler, local way to handle text blocks, reducing reliance on an external library. This internal cleanup helps keep the system prompts consistent.

fb06f629bfcb85e0d6cd534bb051b5f883c3113d.text: Developers can now pass custom settings directly to the main startup command instead of using separate shortcuts. This simplifies the internal setup without changing how you use the product.

83c0bac173fc5dac8df83a1a7809e8860dfd426a.text: The system now uses a stricter, automatic check to understand how custom AI assistants work. This prevents broken or confusing setups from being used, making the assistants more reliable.

c7a6f84e1289be28e0cabfaa9ebdf8794ef56daa.text: The system can now turn off an internal data-saving feature when retrieving messages. This is a small internal change and does not affect how the product works for users.

35408cd3842bbf4bad167c04540d583dfb557fe2.text: The system now uses a different label to identify assistant templates. This internal update helps keep the software organized. You will not notice any changes in how the product works.

08939022d786bba4e62950f78f41af20c8970592.title: Add dev script for server/client startup
08939022d786bba4e62950f78f41af20c8970592.summary: New `dev` script in `package.json` combines `start-server` and `start-bin` with process group management via `set -m` and `trap`. Removes redundant shutdown log message from `backend/src/index.ts`. Internal developer workflow improvement.

8d3cb7b2c0e4fbd3e9ddb28cdbb162055ad6b434.title: Add function overloads to Client.getInstance() for type safety
8d3cb7b2c0e4fbd3e9ddb28cdbb162055ad6b434.summary: Client.getInstance() in npm-app/src/client.ts now has explicit function overloads: no-arg returns Client, false returns Client | null, true returns Client. Call sites in npm-app/src/cli.ts and npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts hoist the client reference to a local const to avoid redundant calls and leverage the non-null return type. Internal refactor only, no user-visible behavior change.

635180e80ec364723d5e85f585f6c41a6c4ef5f2.title: Git color flags inserted before args in npm-app
635180e80ec364723d5e85f585f6c41a6c4ef5f2.summary: applyColorHints in npm-app/src/terminal/run-command.ts now uses cmd.replace to inject --color=always immediately after the git subcommand (diff, log, show) rather than appending it to the end. This ensures the flag applies correctly when user-provided file paths or other arguments are present. Scope limited to npm-app terminal command handling. Minor formatting adjustment to aliasEnable variable assignment.

81f52d5248fd5d7e4690ec9ccfb906c1227b33b9.title: Add prettier-format hook to codebuff.json
81f52d5248fd5d7e4690ec9ccfb906c1227b33b9.summary: New prettier-format command added to codebuff.json file change hooks. Runs git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md)$' | xargs -r npx prettier --write. Scope: codebuff.json only.

7140c172231339f503372d9bbce45094a3ae0423.title: Dynamic agent system with custom spawning
7140c172231339f503372d9bbce45094a3ae0423.summary: New `agentRegistry` merges static and dynamic agent templates from `.agents/templates/` JSON configs. `run-agent-step.ts` and `run-tool.ts` now fetch templates via the registry, enabling `spawn_agents` to use custom types like `brainstormer`. Override logic in `agent-overrides.ts` strictly filters for `override: true` configs. Base agent types (`base`, `ask`, etc.) dynamically update their `spawnableAgents` lists to include newly loaded templates.

496fb51030a09714dde7fc021fcb2eb32a55652f.title: Flatten agent override config
496fb51030a09714dde7fc021fcb2eb32a55652f.summary: Agent override JSON schema flattened. `override` key now boolean literal `true` instead of nested object. `type`, `version`, and prompt fields moved to root. Affects `common/src/types/agent-overrides.ts`, `backend/src/templates/agent-overrides.ts`, and validation logic.

ecdf54f5bf58360fb1a7c76c743efdaad2d1aed0.title: Fix assistant message loop in agent step execution
ecdf54f5bf58360fb1a7c76c743efdaad2d1aed0.summary: Corrected logic in `loopAgentSteps` within `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` to prevent infinite looping of the initial assistant message. The fix introduces a toggle for `currentAssistantMessage` and adjusts the conditional check for `currentAssistantPrefix` to ensure proper state progression. This change ensures that the agent loop correctly alternates between injected step messages and empty states, resolving the hang.

a85766f499aec1bd3697d456c96579cc96144f0b.title: file-picker agent restricts tools to findfiles
a85766f499aec1bd3697d456c96579cc96144f0b.summary: file-picker.ts removes code_search and read_files from toolNames and stopSequences, leaving only find_files and end_turn. System prompt simplifies to persona definition, moving analysis instructions to userInputPrompt. agentStepPrompt updates to forbid repeated find_files calls. Scope limited to backend/src/templates/agents/file-picker.ts.

dcf1248b453754e2d0e17116fa2e14f09c82d9e8.title: Agent registry dynamic imports, init agentNames, CLI renderer update
dcf1248b453754e2d0e17116fa2e14f09c82d9e8.summary: AgentRegistry loads dynamic agents via top-level `import AGENT_NAMES` instead of `require` inside `initialize`. WebSocket `onInit` now calls `agentRegistry.initialize` and sends `agentNames` in the `init-response` payload. CLI `Client` stores `agentNames` on init; `tool-renderers.ts` resolves agent display names from `client.agentNames` first, falling back to static `AGENT_PERSONAS`, then `agentType`. `getInstance()` accepts `shouldThrow=false` to return `null` when uninitialized.

5b9b71c236ae63df0ea980f8afb1f58905adfd89.title: Add programmatic agent template support
5b9b71c236ae63df0ea980f8afb1f58905adfd89.summary: Added support for programmatic agent templates, allowing agents to be defined via code generators instead of LLM prompts. The `runAgentStep` function now detects `implementation === 'programmatic'` and delegates to `runProgrammaticAgent`, which executes a generator function and handles yielded tool calls. Programmatic templates bypass the standard override mechanism in `getAgentTemplateWithOverrides`. An `example_programmatic` agent was added to `agent-list.ts` to demonstrate the new interface.

08939022d786bba4e62950f78f41af20c8970592.text: A small internal update simplifies how the system starts. Customers will not see any changes.

635180e80ec364723d5e85f585f6c41a6c4ef5f2.text: Git command colors now work correctly when file paths are included. This small internal fix ensures consistent formatting.

8d3cb7b2c0e4fbd3e9ddb28cdbb162055ad6b434.text: The app now checks its own settings more carefully before starting. This internal cleanup helps prevent hidden errors, but you will not notice any difference in how it works.

81f52d5248fd5d7e4690ec9ccfb906c1227b33b9.text: A small internal update now automatically tidies up the formatting of text files. This helps keep the codebase consistent without requiring manual effort from the team.

7140c172231339f503372d9bbce45094a3ae0423.text: The assistant can now create new types of helpers using custom templates. This allows you to spawn specific roles, like a brainstorming partner, that weren't available before.

ecdf54f5bf58360fb1a7c76c743efdaad2d1aed0.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant got stuck repeating its first message. The tool now moves to the next step instead of hanging.

496fb51030a09714dde7fc021fcb2eb32a55652f.text: The settings for customizing the assistant were simplified. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

dcf1248b453754e2d0e17116fa2e14f09c82d9e8.text: The assistant now shows clearer names for its helpers. This internal update makes the interface display more accurate labels.

a85766f499aec1bd3697d456c96579cc96144f0b.text: The file search tool now only finds files, without reading their contents or searching for code inside them. This means it will be faster and simpler, but you can't use it to look for specific text within files.

a281199d73d0091ac7696975b6faf1d67b3c6ed3.title: Update reviewer template model ID to
a281199d73d0091ac7696975b6faf1d67b3c6ed3.summary: The model identifier in `.agents/templates/reviewer.json` was updated from `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` to `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522`. This change ensures the reviewer agent uses the specific dated model version. Scope is limited to the internal agent template configuration.

d16619e75699a919e04e25ff33668dda06aa3767.title: Refactor tool handler signature to use previousToolCallFinished
d16619e75699a919e04e25ff33668dda06aa3767.summary: CodebuffToolHandlerFunction now accepts `previousToolCallFinished` (Promise<void>) instead of `previousToolCallResult` (Promise<any>). Handlers return `{ result: Promise<string>; state: Record<string, any> }` synchronously, chaining result generation via `.then()` on the completion promise. This change decouples tool execution from result retrieval, affecting core tool handlers like `add-subgoal`, `browser-logs`, `code-search`, `end-turn`, `run-file-change-hooks`, `run-terminal-command`, and `update-subgoal`.

616a6df5509f7bf65462b273e0c2ecfe9771e6da.title: Pin OpenRouter model IDs to dated versions
616a6df5509f7bf65462b273e0c2ecfe9771e6da.summary: Updated `openrouterModels` in `common/src/constants.ts` to use explicit dated model IDs (e.g., `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522`) instead of generic aliases. This ensures deterministic model resolution and prevents unexpected behavior changes from upstream alias updates. Scope limited to shared core constants.

2ff11c230959e2b2bcc003a223a25934a80827ca.title: Refactor backend tool handler types
2ff11c230959e2b2bcc003a223a25934a80827ca.summary: Updated `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` in `backend/src/tools/constants.ts` to enforce `{ result: string; state: Record<string, any> }` returns. Replaced `extra` parameter with direct `requestClientToolCall` and `state` props across handlers like `add-subgoal.ts` and `browser-logs.ts`. Moved `find_files` to `WIP_TOOLS` and deleted its handler file.

86965a85fbc64343fcdfb7aea4b1cf161fabeb85.title: openrouter.ts: allowfallbacks false
86965a85fbc64343fcdfb7aea4b1cf161fabeb85.summary: Added `allow_fallbacks: false` to provider config in `openRouterLanguageModel`. Prevents OpenRouter fallbacks for ordered providers. Internal backend change.

b2995afb32b7e6eb3c3ddb85200c3278b0118fa1.title: Remove auto file-change hooks, shift to reviewer
b2995afb32b7e6eb3c3ddb85200c3278b0118fa1.summary: backend/src/run-agent-step.ts stops injecting run_file_change_hooks client tool call on file changes. backend/src/templates/agents/reviewer.ts instructs reviewer to explicitly invoke run_file_change_hooks for TS/JS or test changes. backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts updates assertions. Internal agent orchestration refactor.

97312a3108d8be1a0a5f58ce2148bc78eece9abb.title: Remove Amazon Bedrock from opus provider order
97312a3108d8be1a0a5f58ce2148bc78eece9abb.summary: Amazon Bedrock removed from provider order for `openrouter_claude_opus_4` in `backend/src/llm-apis/openrouter.ts`. OpenRouter now routes Opus 4 requests only through Google and Anthropic providers. Internal routing configuration change; no user-facing behavior shift expected.

b275c1a52b7e523d172dfe4fe96066f35bad3782.title: Migrate tool call format and types in backend
b275c1a52b7e523d172dfe4fe96066f35bad3782.summary: Backend tool call handling migrated to new format with generic typing. `CodebuffToolCall` now accepts tool name parameter for stricter type inference. `parseRawToolCall` returns typed results or errors. `ClientToolCall` moved to `tools/constants.ts`. Handlers updated across 8 files including `add-subgoal`, `browser-logs`, `code-search`, `end-turn`, `find-files`, `run-file-change-hooks`, `run-terminal-command`, `update-subgoal`. Internal refactor, no user-facing behavior change.

53dc30d932a3f65ce7a28198d6e2bc21ccf0909b.title: Agent template overrides via .agents/templates
53dc30d932a3f65ce7a28198d6e2bc21ccf0909b.summary: Added customizable agent templates in `.agents/templates/`. Users define JSON overrides to modify model, prompts, and tools for specific agents. Backend applies these at runtime via `processAgentOverrides`. Docs added in `backend/src/templates/README.md`.

b275c1a52b7e523d172dfe4fe96066f35bad3782.text: Internal updates improved how the system handles background tasks for better reliability. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

d16619e75699a919e04e25ff33668dda06aa3767.text: The assistant now waits for one task to finish before starting the next, keeping actions in order.

b2995afb32b7e6eb3c3ddb85200c3278b0118fa1.text: The system now checks for file updates manually instead of automatically. This internal change ensures that reviewers explicitly verify changes before they are processed.

00ffb9f582ba344870e4fa0cdb418270c9394153.text: The assistant now handles missing cost data without breaking. This small fix prevents errors when specific details are not available.

a281199d73d0091ac7696975b6faf1d67b3c6ed3.text: The internal reviewer tool now uses a specific, dated version of its underlying model. This small change ensures consistent behavior but has no visible effect on how you use the product.

616a6df5509f7bf65462b273e0c2ecfe9771e6da.text: The app now locks onto specific, stable versions of the AI models it uses. This prevents the AI's behavior from changing unexpectedly when the provider updates their default options.

2ff11c230959e2b2bcc003a223a25934a80827ca.text: Internal cleanup of assistant tools. Search feature temporarily disabled.

97312a3108d8be1a0a5f58ce2148bc78eece9abb.text: The system now uses fewer services to process requests. This is a small internal change, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

774035a626c9551e53042fd4d693a77e1cca6eae.title: Inject short tool and agent instructions per user step
774035a626c9551e53042fd4d693a77e1cca6eae.summary: getAgentPrompt now appends short tool and spawnable agent instructions to userInputPrompt. buildShortToolDescription and buildSpawnableAgentsDescription added in backend/src/tools.ts. Refactors promptType signature in backend/src/templates/strings.ts and backend/src/run-agent-step.ts.

2f68d11fae988a63fb9174e2eb9c962bb35024c1.title: Add opus provider order preference
2f68d11fae988a63fb9174e2eb9c962bb35024c1.summary: Provider routing order preference added for `openrouter_claude_opus_4` in `backend/src/llm-apis/openrouter.ts`. `providerOrder` constant maps model IDs to provider arrays, replacing hardcoded check for `openrouter_claude_sonnet_4`. `extraBody.provider.order` now dynamically resolves via `providerOrder` lookup.

3e8496cb93ccd1c19a4d7d9b518b13cc5dcc76c7.title: Remove duplicate code from merge
3e8496cb93ccd1c19a4d7d9b518b13cc5dcc76c7.summary: Removed duplicate definitions of `getInitialFiles`, `getFileReadingUpdates`, `getPrintedPaths`, and `uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining` from `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts`. The file now imports `getFileReadingUpdates` from `./get-file-reading-updates`. Cleaned up unused imports including `requestFiles`, `parseFileBlocks`, `toContentString`, `countTokens`, `difference`, `uniq`, `CoreMessage`, `TextBlock`, `HIDDEN_FILE_READ_STATUS`, `requestRelevantFilesForTraining`, `GetExpandedFileContextForTrainingBlobTrace`, `parseToolResults`, `parseReadFilesResult`, and `insertTrace`. Scope limited to backend agent step execution logic.

64625567ead79bd99b0320bf96702decfc454488.title: Delete check-new-files-necessary integration test
64625567ead79bd99b0320bf96702decfc454488.summary: Removed `backend/src/__tests__/check-new-files-necessary.integration.test.ts`. The 179-line suite covered `checkNewFilesNecessary` logic for file loading decisions. Deletion streamlines the repo by dropping redundant coverage for this internal helper.

eb66058492309a7b7172c327206e8e632c636fdf.title: Disable Amazon Bedrock for OpenRouter Claude Sonnet 4
eb66058492309a7b7172c327206e8e632c636fdf.summary: Amazon Bedrock removed from provider routing order for `openrouter_claude_sonnet_4` in `backend/src/llm-apis/openrouter.ts`. Routing order now strictly prioritizes `Google` then `Anthropic` to avoid Bedrock-specific failures or latency. Change scoped to OpenRouter language model factory.

400b8c3a90390f3fb0404cd254eb867059860c70.title: PROFITMARGIN raised 0.25 to 0.3
400b8c3a90390f3fb0404cd254eb867059860c70.summary: PROFIT_MARGIN constant in backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts raised from 0.25 to 0.3. Change compensates for upstream OpenRouter discount. Affects cost calculation for all tracked messages. Single-line constant update.

097d5b66abe48120ca14ff7580d5945f7d095775.title: Split run-agent-step into run-tool and get-file-reading-updates
097d5b66abe48120ca14ff7580d5945f7d095775.summary: Refactored `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` by extracting tool execution logic into `backend/src/run-tool.ts` and file reading update logic into `backend/src/get-file-reading-updates.ts`. This decomposition isolates responsibilities for agent step processing, tool calls, and file context updates. The change is internal, affecting backend structure without altering user-facing behavior or APIs.

ef15e7858ec99e23e936839f8bcb220101667bed.title: Remove Anthropic fallback, route Claude via OpenRouter
ef15e7858ec99e23e936839f8bcb220101667bed.summary: Deleted `anthropic-with-fallbacks.ts` and `@anthropic-ai/sdk` dependency, routing all Claude models through OpenRouter via `openrouterModels` constants. Updated `claude.ts` to define local `TextBlock` type, decoupling system prompts from Anthropic SDK types. Affected `backend/src/llm-apis/` (claude, gemini-with-fallbacks, openrouter), `backend/src/admin/` (grade-runs, relabelRuns), and `backend/src/find-files/` (request-files-prompt). Model references shifted from `claudeModels.sonnet` to `models.openrouter_claude_sonnet_4` in eval and relabeling scripts.

c05fd779259e5639b1c7ab03beb7da0b7c5df23e.title: Add provider order for sonnet 4
c05fd779259e5639b1c7ab03beb7da0b7c5df23e.summary: Extracted OpenRouter model initialization into `openRouterLanguageModel` helper. Added provider order ['Google', 'Anthropic', 'Amazon Bedrock'] for `openrouter_claude_sonnet_4`. This ensures consistent routing priority for Sonnet 4 requests. Internal refactor, no user-facing API changes.

9b31b16ab18e95ee465852912a8f8e612e0e0a64.title: Remove backend Jest config and setup
9b31b16ab18e95ee465852912a8f8e612e0e0a64.summary: Deleted backend/jest.config.js and backend/jest.setup.js. Removes ts-jest preset, node test environment, and dotenv setup for backend tests. Internal cleanup of unused test infrastructure.

097d5b66abe48120ca14ff7580d5945f7d095775.text: The team reorganized how the assistant processes information internally. This cleanup helps the system run more smoothly but does not change what you see or how you use the product.

400b8c3a90390f3fb0404cd254eb867059860c70.text: The internal cost calculation for the assistant was adjusted to account for a discount from a third-party provider. This is a small backend change that does not affect how you use the product.

3e8496cb93ccd1c19a4d7d9b518b13cc5dcc76c7.text: This is a small internal cleanup that removes redundant instructions from the system's background processes. Users will not notice any changes to how the product works or looks.

eb66058492309a7b7172c327206e8e632c636fdf.text: We changed how the assistant picks its service provider to avoid occasional errors or delays. This small internal update helps the assistant run more smoothly for you.

774035a626c9551e53042fd4d693a77e1cca6eae.text: The assistant now receives brief reminders about which tools and helpers it can use at each step. This is an internal update to improve how it follows instructions.

c05fd779259e5639b1c7ab03beb7da0b7c5df23e.text: The system now checks specific service providers in a fixed order when processing requests for a certain AI model. This internal change ensures consistent performance without affecting how users interact with the product.

64625567ead79bd99b0320bf96702decfc454488.text: The team removed an internal check that verified how files are loaded. This cleanup makes the software simpler to maintain. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

9b31b16ab18e95ee465852912a8f8e612e0e0a64.text: The company cleaned up unused internal testing tools. This change has no effect on how the product works or looks for users.

2f68d11fae988a63fb9174e2eb9c962bb35024c1.text: The system now chooses which service handles the most advanced model based on a flexible list, not just one fixed option. This small internal change improves how the assistant picks its underlying engine.

85f076b0a56c344769a76071988df65757d9e09c.title: Switch eval agent to base template
85f076b0a56c344769a76071988df65757d9e09c.summary: Agent type in `run-git-evals.ts` changed from `AgentTemplateTypes.claude4_base` to `AgentTemplateTypes.base`. This internal modification affects the specific agent template used during git evaluation runs.

83921bb4aa7711926563fdc50b85a910e6321c88.title: Relace endpoint switch to standard
83921bb4aa7711926563fdc50b85a910e6321c88.summary: Relace AI endpoint changed from codebuff-instantapply.endpoint.relace.run to instantapply.endpoint.relace.run. Switches to standard Relace API. Internal backend change in backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts.

5d13344a278455400336c430deb5863c334c223a.title: Add hidden sonnet4agentbuilder persona
5d13344a278455400336c430deb5863c334c223a.summary: Added hidden `sonnet4_agent_builder` persona to `AGENT_PERSONAS` in `common/src/constants/agents.ts`. This entry defines a `sonnet4` agent named 'Agna' with the title 'The Agent Builder'. It remains hidden from standard client-side references.

1ccc95cc29936ac8318f0a0355e71f8363d88fc0.title: Analytics init no longer throws, referral HTTP 429 to 409
1ccc95cc29936ac8318f0a0355e71f8363d88fc0.summary: Analytics client init and event tracking now warn and skip on missing PostHog env vars or init failure instead of throwing. Referral redemption conflict responses changed from 429 to 409. Server init continues without analytics on failure. Affects common/src/analytics.ts, web/src/app/api/referrals/helpers.ts, web/src/lib/server-init.ts.

400f9755ae3ab7aa9d5d11fc17dca2aa413b42b1.title: Agent Builder template added
400f9755ae3ab7aa9d5d11fc17dca2aa413b42b1.summary: New `sonnet4_agent_builder` agent template registered in `agent-list.ts` via `agent-builder.ts`. Uses Claude Sonnet, exposes `write_file`, `str_replace`, `code_search`, and `spawn_agents`. Type added to `AgentTemplateTypeList` in `session-state.ts`. System prompt enforces strict `AgentTemplate` field structure.

2c1155c49a69577aa2964aee4e854904ff3285fb.title: Refactor agent templates to generic naming
2c1155c49a69577aa2964aee4e854904ff3285fb.summary: Agent template identifiers in `backend/src/templates/agent-list.ts` and related files replace model-specific names (e.g., `gemini25pro_base`) with generic roles (e.g., `base`, `ask`, `thinker`). This decouples template definitions from underlying model versions, allowing easier model swaps without renaming logic. The change spans core backend files including `main-prompt.ts`, `run-agent-step.ts`, and individual agent definition files. A guard clause in `run-agent-step.ts` now throws a descriptive error if a template type is missing.

4ce94161073ce64fa52f963f037d048e2c0cb27b.title: promptSchema uses zod instead of boolean
4ce94161073ce64fa52f963f037d048e2c0cb27b.summary: Agent `promptSchema` definitions now use zod schemas instead of booleans. `run-agent-step.ts` validates prompts via `safeParse`. Covers agent templates and `types.ts`.

2c1155c49a69577aa2964aee4e854904ff3285fb.text: The system now uses simple job titles for its helpers instead of specific names tied to one brain. This makes it easier to upgrade or swap the underlying technology without breaking things.

1ccc95cc29936ac8318f0a0355e71f8363d88fc0.text: The site now loads even if analytics services fail, preventing crashes. If you try to redeem a referral offer at the same time as someone else, you will see a clearer conflict message instead of a generic error.

b4d6d0fbaa14e33456d21cdd608258cfb5f47258.text: A small internal update now clears old data and reloads fresh files before starting. This ensures the system begins from a clean state.

d19b63ec1b9ea8af210ea98a33e2d26948755b09.text: Added a small internal tool to clear old data that caused the system to get stuck checking work. This helps the software run more smoothly.

83921bb4aa7711926563fdc50b85a910e6321c88.text: The assistant now uses a newer, more reliable version of the technology behind its coding suggestions. This change happens behind the scenes, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

85f076b0a56c344769a76071988df65757d9e09c.text: The system now uses a simpler, standard assistant model for internal checks. This is a small, behind-the-scenes adjustment that does not change how you use the product.

5d13344a278455400336c430deb5863c334c223a.text: The system added a hidden assistant persona named Agna. Regular users will not see this new option in their standard interface.

400f9755ae3ab7aa9d5d11fc17dca2aa413b42b1.text: A new feature lets the assistant build custom helpers for you. You can now create specialized tools without writing code.

e319cc9f1ba1c764bbd3b4184a4daafc159b4a3b.title: Fix undefined error in checkLiveUserInput
e319cc9f1ba1c764bbd3b4184a4daafc159b4a3b.summary: Added guard for undefined user input in `checkLiveUserInput`. Prevents crash when accessing `live[userId]` before checking existence. Scope limited to `backend/src/live-user-inputs.ts`. Logic now returns false if `live[userId]` is undefined.

e0abb539ab48d1673b1f51ac5c9694a7f44ef916.title: Terminal shell selection prefers zsh over bash
e0abb539ab48d1673b1f51ac5c9694a7f44ef916.summary: selectShell in npm-app/src/terminal/run-command.ts now calls detectShell to prefer zsh on non-Windows systems, falling back to bash. buildEnv dynamically sets env.SHELL to /bin/${shell} instead of hardcoding /bin/bash. This aligns the advertised shell with the actual binary started by the terminal agent.

e9c80a6fe5c9d7f30a11523403a1131f3bb1d220.title: Backend support multiple live user inputs per user
e9c80a6fe5c9d7f30a11523403a1131f3bb1d220.summary: Internal backend refactor in `live-user-inputs.ts` changes the `live` map from `Record<string, string>` to `Record<string, string[]>`. `startUserInput` now pushes IDs to an array, `endUserInput` filters them, and `checkLiveUserInput` uses `.some()` to validate against any active input. `ai-sdk.ts` updates log metadata to use the new plural `getLiveUserInputIds` function. This enables concurrent Codebuff instances per user without input cancellation conflicts.

debe21652898b9c67b12812635c192421e055193.title: Fix @ menu trigger on paste
debe21652898b9c67b12812635c192421e055193.summary: CLI @ agent menu now delays display by 30ms and checks `isPasting` flag to prevent accidental triggers during fast input. Paste detection logic updated to use named constants `PASTE_THRESHOLD_MS` (10ms) and `PASTE_MIN_COUNT` (2). Change confined to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` key press handling and `detectPasting` method.

0ecd9ff224a67a92a743b5a786f877c7ba3b8171.title: Downgrade endUserInput mismatch log to DEBUG
0ecd9ff224a67a92a743b5a786f877c7ba3b8171.summary: In backend/src/live-user-inputs.ts, the logger call for mismatched endUserInput attempts changed from error to debug. This reduces noise for expected race conditions or stale IDs during user input termination. The payload structure remains identical.

c79fb12ffd52c1b21523dd1cb034348adc246fac.title: Fix terminal command canceling
c79fb12ffd52c1b21523dd1cb034348adc246fac.summary: CLI stop handler now cancels current input via Client.cancelCurrentInput. Spinner start calls moved to ensure proper cleanup before stopping. Tool-call response spinners updated to 'Processing results...' and 'Fixing...' states.

68d3ca003fa1c1a182ad2c44b8b1dbc5bd66c7c1.title: Bold agent name and title in tool renderers
68d3ca003fa1c1a182ad2c44b8b1dbc5bd66c7c1.summary: toolRenderers in npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts now wraps agentName and displayTitle with bold(). The agent prompt string also lost its leading indent. This is an internal UI formatting tweak for agent tool calls.

7d0a6181c33f2a931e5875bebca10720367bdacd.title: Add error details to browser runner startup failure
7d0a6181c33f2a931e5875bebca10720367bdacd.summary: Startup failure logs now append the raw error message to the standard Chrome installation guidance in `npm-app/src/browser-runner.ts`. This change aids debugging by exposing underlying launch exceptions previously hidden by the generic catch block. Scope limited to internal logging and minor syntax cleanup within the browser runner. Error handling remains non-breaking, preserving existing success/failure return structures.

7f44ae43e17e9fc90c2437036f79653b1a06f858.title: Shell support narrowed to bash, zsh, cmd.exe
7f44ae43e17e9fc90c2437036f79653b1a06f858.summary: run-command.ts restricts UnixShell to bash|zsh and WinShell to cmd.exe. Drops fish, ksh, sh, tcsh, nu, powershell.exe, pwsh.exe from type unions and buildInit. Removes PowerShell profile sourcing, fish conf.d loops, and shell-specific shebang/alias branches. Wrapper script generation now hardcodes bash/zsh shebangs and alias expansion flags.

7d0a6181c33f2a931e5875bebca10720367bdacd.text: Internal logging now shows specific error details when the browser fails to start. This helps support staff diagnose problems faster. No change to how the product works for users.

0ecd9ff224a67a92a743b5a786f877c7ba3b8171.text: The system now ignores harmless, temporary glitches during data updates instead of flagging them as errors. You might see fewer unnecessary warnings in the background logs.

68d3ca003fa1c1a182ad2c44b8b1dbc5bd66c7c1.text: Agent names and titles are now bold in the interface. This is a small internal visual change that makes these labels easier to read.

53dc30d932a3f65ce7a28198d6e2bc21ccf0909b.text: Users can now customize how specific AI agents behave by setting their own preferences for the underlying model, instructions, and available tools.

e0abb539ab48d1673b1f51ac5c9694a7f44ef916.text: The terminal now automatically chooses the more modern shell available on your computer, rather than always using the older default. This ensures the terminal behaves as advertised without requiring you to change any settings.

debe21652898b9c67b12812635c192421e055193.text: A small internal fix stops the assistant menu from popping up accidentally when you paste text quickly.

e9c80a6fe5c9d7f30a11523403a1131f3bb1d220.text: The system now handles multiple active requests from one person at the same time. This stops one action from accidentally canceling another.

e319cc9f1ba1c764bbd3b4184a4daafc159b4a3b.text: Fixed a rare bug where the app could stop responding if a user's data was missing. This change is internal and only affects stability.

c79fb12ffd52c1b21523dd1cb034348adc246fac.text: Stopping an action now works more reliably, ensuring the process halts completely without leaving any visual indicators active. You will also see clearer messages during processing steps.

5f0216df5b0f3c942990d614ed9a4fd25e4f9cec.title: Enable gemini25prothinker in base agent templates
5f0216df5b0f3c942990d614ed9a4fd25e4f9cec.summary: Adds AgentTemplateTypes.gemini25pro_thinker to the spawnableAgents array in backend/src/templates/agents/base.ts. Updates the base prompt in backend/src/templates/base-prompts.ts to instruct agents to spawn the thinker for complex requests, specifically after file picker agents. This change affects the default agent behavior across surfaces using these backend templates.

de0adfaa42b7001c354a9f12849e6c8787dc252d.title: Hide unused agents from @ menu
de0adfaa42b7001c354a9f12849e6c8787dc252d.summary: Added `hidden: true` flags to `The Planner` and `Sketch` agents in `common/src/constants/agents.ts`. `UNIQUE_AGENT_NAMES` now filters out personas with the `hidden` property before mapping to display names. This prevents internal or experimental agents from appearing in the CLI `@` autocomplete menu.

23b42d371db181d709c37c0a39731d191fc78bdb.title: Refactor thinker agent prompt for conciseness
23b42d371db181d709c37c0a39731d191fc78bdb.summary: Updated `userInputPrompt` in `backend/src/templates/agents/thinker.ts` to enforce extreme conciseness. Removed prescriptive guidelines and step-by-step planning instructions, replacing them with directives for short sentences (~5 words) and argument-based reasoning over confident solutions. Scope limited to backend agent templates.

8be2bbb661ec127dc2574ff6bc279fd40404169d.title: Remove @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock dependency
8be2bbb661ec127dc2574ff6bc279fd40404169d.summary: Dropped `@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock` from backend dependencies. Likely cleanup of unused or deprecated provider integration. Scope limited to backend package manifest.

77ed9c98ca9647885e2623ef13430e6ade412bf4.title: Bun v1.2.12, CI matrix refactor, evals concurrency
77ed9c98ca9647885e2623ef13430e6ade412bf4.summary: CI pipeline switched to Bun v1.2.12 and refactored into Build/Test jobs using matrix strategy for npm-app, backend, and common packages. Evals workflow timeout increased to 360 minutes and command updated to `bun run-eval-set --concurrency 1`. `.bin/bun` script logic changed to `doesnt_need_secrets` with explicit command allowlisting for install/init/run. `.envrc` now committed directly instead of copied from example.

a7addaf7d9ce6fe2416b953ebcd02e9bfd03fed5.title: Add OpenRouter fallback for Claude models
a7addaf7d9ce6fe2416b953ebcd02e9bfd03fed5.summary: New `promptAnthropicWithFallbacks` in `anthropic-with-fallbacks.ts` retries Claude requests via OpenRouter if the primary Anthropic API fails. `promptAiSdkStream` intercepts Anthropic calls with configured `fallbackProviders` to trigger this chain. `openrouter-api.ts` maps Claude model IDs to OpenRouter equivalents, using fewer retries (2 vs 3) for fallbacks. Agent templates in `base.ts` enable this by passing `fallbackProviders: ['openrouter']` for Claude models.

83b0aa5ff659f58a986bf335f79886a5af734025.title: Move CodebuffToolCall to tools/constants.ts
83b0aa5ff659f58a986bf335f79886a5af734025.summary: Relocated CodebuffToolCall type definition from backend/src/tools.ts to backend/src/tools/constants.ts. Updated imports in backend/src/run-agent-step.ts and backend/src/tools.ts to reflect new location. Renamed codebuffTools to codebuffToolDefs in backend/src/tools/constants.ts for clarity.

77d7fc13548eabc20be1ddfe496b8dcc1b3dba2c.title: Remove infisical wrapper from unit test hooks
77d7fc13548eabc20be1ddfe496b8dcc1b3dba2c.summary: Removed `infisical run --` prefix from `backend-unit-tests`, `npm-app-unit-tests`, and `common-unit-tests` commands in `codebuff.json`. Unit tests now execute `bun test` directly without the secrets manager wrapper. This change applies to all three file change hooks defined in the repo configuration.

1b1d47513ef9ed9fa7e565580077d8f9d29633f9.title: Refactor tool definitions to separate files
1b1d47513ef9ed9fa7e565580077d8f9d29633f9.summary: Tool definitions moved from monolithic `backend/src/tools.ts` to individual files in `backend/src/tools/definitions/`. New `backend/src/tools/constants.ts` aggregates definitions and exports `codebuffTools` map. Imports updated to use `@codebuff/common/constants/tools` for `ToolName` and `toolNames`, removing local `TOOL_LIST` dependency. Internal `AGENT_NAMES` lookup replaced with `agentTemplates` access.

6c5cd50eb5b2c5cde021aed5e114ed8ed2c6ec1b.title: Init flow auto-starts background processes
6c5cd50eb5b2c5cde021aed5e114ed8ed2c6ec1b.summary: CLI init command now triggers automatic background process startup and displays configuration tips after config file creation. `handleInitializationFlowLocally` checks for existing `codebuff.json`, creating it if missing, while `Client` sets `isInitializing` flag to manage post-init feedback. Scope includes `npm-app/src/cli-handlers/inititalization-flow.ts`, `npm-app/src/client.ts`, and `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`. `logAndHandleStartup` executes configured `startupProcesses` from the newly created or existing config file.

83b0aa5ff659f58a986bf335f79886a5af734025.text: This internal update moves a technical component to a more organized location within the software's structure. It does not change how the product works or what features are available to users.

a7addaf7d9ce6fe2416b953ebcd02e9bfd03fed5.text: If the main service for the assistant fails, it automatically tries a backup service. This means you are less likely to see an error or have to wait.

77d7fc13548eabc20be1ddfe496b8dcc1b3dba2c.text: The system stopped checking secret passwords before running background quality tests. This is a small internal cleanup. It does not change how the product works for you.

5f0216df5b0f3c942990d614ed9a4fd25e4f9cec.text: The assistant can now use a new thinking model for complex tasks. This helps it handle difficult requests better.

23b42d371db181d709c37c0a39731d191fc78bdb.text: The assistant now gives shorter, simpler answers. It explains its reasoning instead of just giving a final answer.

de0adfaa42b7001c354a9f12849e6c8787dc252d.text: Two hidden assistant options were removed from the menu. This keeps the list shorter and shows only the tools you can use.

8be2bbb661ec127dc2574ff6bc279fd40404169d.text: The system stopped using a specific, unused service for connecting to artificial intelligence tools. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

c1d532c6f8f9e4700de685a185841538982693ca.title: Fix rage-detector test sleep mock
c1d532c6f8f9e4700de685a185841538982693ca.summary: Added `sleep` mock for `@codebuff/common/util/promise` in `npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/rage-detector.test.ts`. Refactored `webSocketHangDetector` test to use `createTimeoutDetector` directly, bypassing complex `shouldFire` logic. Internal test stability fix for npm-app.

5f915cbfccf773c50dcaae7f07252cb05150d748.title: Fix WebSocket hang detection false positives
5f915cbfccf773c50dcaae7f07252cb05150d748.summary: The `webSocketHangDetector` in `npm-app/src/rage-detectors.ts` now includes a `shouldFire` callback that checks the actual WebSocket state (`WebSocket.OPEN`) before triggering a rage event. This prevents false positives when a connection recovers during the 60-second timeout window. The `createTimeoutDetector` utility in `npm-app/src/utils/rage-detector.ts` was updated to support this optional async guard, and the `Client` class exposes `webSocket` publicly to facilitate the state check.

dc1b2c1148180d86a198b46e02695549dffc8c15.title: Fix spinner state management in checkpoint flow
dc1b2c1148180d86a198b46e02695549dffc8c15.summary: Added explicit Spinner.get().stop() calls in checkpoint save and CLI prompt flow to prevent overlapping spinner states. Ensures 'Loading Files...' and 'Saving...' spinners terminate before 'Thinking...' starts. Covers npm-app/src/cli-handlers/checkpoint.ts and npm-app/src/cli.ts.

cbee75b9d33c371389dd28cf6fcd85ab4696ad08.title: Add TERMINALCOMMANDCOMPLETEDSINGLE analytics
cbee75b9d33c371389dd28cf6fcd85ab4696ad08.summary: Added `TERMINAL_COMMAND_COMPLETED_SINGLE` enum value to `AnalyticsEvent` and triggered `trackEvent` within `runSinglePtyCommand` in `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts`. This separates single PTY command completions from the existing `TERMINAL_COMMAND_COMPLETED` event, providing more granular telemetry for terminal usage. The change also reorders imports in `base.ts` for clarity.

e885170f4baafbd3be8a299f909fa65cb043f801.title: Add SHELLRECREATED analytics event
e885170f4baafbd3be8a299f909fa65cb043f801.summary: Added `SHELL_RECREATED` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum. `recreateShell` in `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts` now tracks this event with `persistentProcess` payload. Also alphabetized existing events in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`.

ce2997f5f619c41bfe765bdd5eff650c1221f4d8.title: npm-app-release-staging.yml adds NEXTPUBLICCBENVIRONMENT prod
ce2997f5f619c41bfe765bdd5eff650c1221f4d8.summary: npm-app-release-staging.yml adds env-overrides with NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT set to prod. Staging release workflow now builds with production environment flag. Scope limited to CI workflow file.

16923279ae32387da295cc3c5b23b8813379b09a.title: Replace inf wrapper with .bin/bun binstub and direnv for secrets
16923279ae32387da295cc3c5b23b8813379b09a.summary: Removed the manual `inf` wrapper script and `bun run inf` calls in favor of a local `.bin/bun` binstub that selectively injects Infisical secrets. The new wrapper detects commands like `test`, `dev`, `start`, or scripts matching secret-dependent patterns (e.g., `db:*`) and executes `infisical run` before the real Bun binary, while passing through others directly. Updated `backend`, `common`, `evals`, and `npm-app` package.json scripts to call `bun` directly, relying on `direnv` (via `.envrc.example`) to prepend `.bin` to the PATH. Documentation in `README.md` and `direnv-test-plan.md` details the new setup requiring `direnv` installation and `direnv allow`.

90aae81dbea5378d1a84ce40d5b0dda7798d5576.title: Remove direnv-test-plan.md
90aae81dbea5378d1a84ce40d5b0dda7798d5576.summary: Deleted direnv-test-plan.md. File contained internal notes on selective bun binstub wrapping for Infisical secret injection via direnv. Repo-only cleanup. No code or config changes.

5f915cbfccf773c50dcaae7f07252cb05150d748.text: Fixed a bug where the system wrongly flagged a recovered connection as hung. This reduces false alerts for internal monitoring.

e885170f4baafbd3be8a299f909fa65cb043f801.text: The software now records a note when a specific background task restarts. This helps the team understand how often this happens.

c1d532c6f8f9e4700de685a185841538982693ca.text: A small internal update improved a background check that watches for unresponsive connections. This change only affects how the system tests itself and does not alter any visible features or user experience.

4ce94161073ce64fa52f963f037d048e2c0cb27b.text: The assistant now checks request details more carefully before acting. This reduces errors when using the product.

dc1b2c1148180d86a198b46e02695549dffc8c15.text: A small internal fix stops the 'Loading' and 'Saving' messages from lingering when the 'Thinking' message appears, keeping the status updates clear.

ce2997f5f619c41bfe765bdd5eff650c1221f4d8.text: A small internal update changed how a test version of the app is built. This means the test version now behaves more like the live product, so testing results will be more accurate.

90aae81dbea5378d1a84ce40d5b0dda7798d5576.text: We removed an internal document about how to manage secret passwords. This cleanup does not change how the product works or looks for you.

cbee75b9d33c371389dd28cf6fcd85ab4696ad08.text: The app now records when a single terminal command finishes. This helps the team understand usage better, but you will not notice any change.

9cec44f1b6c37819695f699ae2dbea98bf695163.title: Bump version to 1.0.421
9cec44f1b6c37819695f699ae2dbea98bf695163.summary: Version bump to 1.0.421 in npm-app/release/package.json. Routine release increment. No functional changes.

8380bf79f11b441193ec517f25828a51c00ae9cd.title: Update npm-app-release-prod.yml workflow
8380bf79f11b441193ec517f25828a51c00ae9cd.summary: Workflow step renamed to 'Commit and push version bumpAdd commentMore actions' to reflect direct push behavior. Release commit logic replaced with `git stash`, `git pull --rebase origin main`, and `git stash pop` to sync before committing `npm-app/release/package.json`. Removes Codebuff co-author trailers and broad `git add -A` in favor of targeted file staging.

2e66dcc86ca5aa1bb15e1f4ffa7d945edccbfb2c.title: codebuff version bump 1.0.341 to 1.0.420
2e66dcc86ca5aa1bb15e1f4ffa7d945edccbfb2c.summary: Release package version incremented from 1.0.341 to 1.0.420 in npm-app/release/package.json. Internal dependency or release cycle adjustment. No functional code changes.

5bf96c300de80eb1ef3bd998e094caa2c4fcb332.title: Replace common with @codebuff/common in billing tests
5bf96c300de80eb1ef3bd998e094caa2c4fcb332.summary: Updated mock paths in billing package tests to use `@codebuff/common` instead of `common`. This aligns with the monorepo package naming convention. Affected files include `credit-delegation.test.ts`, `org-billing.test.ts`, and `billing.knowledge.md`. No functional changes to billing logic.

cae5c5a1fd07cc04556965404ef14914d154ee82.title: Consolidate rage detector tests
cae5c5a1fd07cc04556965404ef14914d154ee82.summary: Rage detector tests consolidated into `npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/rage-detector.test.ts`. Deleted `npm-app/src/__tests__/rage-detectors.test.ts`. Factory tests for `createRageDetectors` moved to `describe('createRageDetectors factory')` block. Uses `require` for module access within new scope.

0414ada5ace4f7643bca8f637b2f95d76e9b840e.title: rage-detector.test.ts import path fix and formatting
0414ada5ace4f7643bca8f637b2f95d76e9b840e.summary: Import path for `AnalyticsEvent` updated from `common/constants/analytics-events` to `@codebuff/common/constants/analytics-events` in `rage-detector.test.ts`. Indentation and trailing comma formatting normalized in `createTimeBetweenDetector` config objects. Scope limited to test file `npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/rage-detector.test.ts`.

a69bc4e3c8d448ca21eeabc6ae396dd86d326113.title: Fix npm-app-release-prod.yml version variable scope
a69bc4e3c8d448ca21eeabc6ae396dd86d326113.summary: Corrected commit message generation in `npm-app-release-prod.yml`. Changed `${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.new_version }}` to `${{ steps.bump_version.outputs.new_version }}` to ensure the version bump commit uses the correct local step output instead of an unavailable job-level output. Scope limited to CI workflow definition.

1232858ff022388ff4512d9afdc3ed9355f7638b.title: Fix ripgrep binary extraction path
1232858ff022388ff4512d9afdc3ed9355f7638b.summary: ripgrep self-extraction path changed from hardcoded ~/.config/manicode to CONFIG_DIR in npm-app/src/native/ripgrep.ts. pty.ts updated to use CONFIG_DIR and implement self-extraction for compiled mode. Fixes flakiness on platforms where hardcoded path mismatches actual config directory. Scope limited to native binary loading in npm-app.

03fe8206bde10c0562e10a522addbc4d7fc46f5d.title: Add env-overrides input to npm-app-release-build workflow
03fe8206bde10c0562e10a522addbc4d7fc46f5d.summary: New `env-overrides` string input added to `.github/workflows/npm-app-release-build.yml`, accepting a JSON object to override default environment variables during the build process. The workflow logic now applies these overrides via `jq` after setting base secrets, replacing the hardcoded `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` assignment. `npm-app-release-prod.yml` utilizes this new input to explicitly set `NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` for production builds. This change decouples environment configuration from the build script, allowing flexible target environments without code changes.

a69bc4e3c8d448ca21eeabc6ae396dd86d326113.text: The release process now grabs the correct version number from the right place. This small internal fix ensures the software updates reliably.

2e66dcc86ca5aa1bb15e1f4ffa7d945edccbfb2c.text: The team updated the background code for the assistant. This change does not affect how the product works or looks.

1232858ff022388ff4512d9afdc3ed9355f7638b.text: The app now finds its search tool in the right place on more devices. This fixes occasional errors when searching.

cae5c5a1fd07cc04556965404ef14914d154ee82.text: We organized the tests that check for user frustration. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

0414ada5ace4f7643bca8f637b2f95d76e9b840e.text: A small internal fix corrected how a background test finds its data and cleaned up its layout. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

5bf96c300de80eb1ef3bd998e094caa2c4fcb332.text: Developers updated internal test labels to match standard naming rules. This cleanup does not change how the billing features work for you.

8380bf79f11b441193ec517f25828a51c00ae9cd.text: The release system now updates its own files more carefully. This prevents errors when publishing new versions.

9cec44f1b6c37819695f699ae2dbea98bf695163.text: The team updated the internal release number. This change does not affect how the product works.

7f44ae43e17e9fc90c2437036f79653b1a06f858.text: The assistant now supports a smaller list of system command tools. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

03fe8206bde10c0562e10a522addbc4d7fc46f5d.text: Small internal update. The build system now accepts custom settings instead of using fixed ones. This lets the team prepare different versions of the app for testing or launch without changing the code.

6797adce93a659d4f297f1e825d39144ccfbb524.title: Add GOOGLEGENERATIVEAIAPIKEY to env schema
6797adce93a659d4f297f1e825d39144ccfbb524.summary: Added `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` to the Zod environment schema in `packages/internal/src/env.ts`. This enables validation and mapping for the new Google Generative AI API key alongside existing Gemini and OpenAI keys. Scope limited to internal package configuration.

82f003f63cd3aa047d21b52dfa4e217f63e00658.title: Fix models import path in run-git-evals.ts
82f003f63cd3aa047d21b52dfa4e217f63e00658.summary: Corrects the import path for `models` in `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` from `common/constants` to `@codebuff/common/constants`. This aligns the eval runner with the monorepo package structure. Affects only the git-evals module.

eeab42f0181892f83d261d1db9dbd374c07f1028.title: Add console output suppression utility
eeab42f0181892f83d261d1db9dbd374c07f1028.summary: New `suppressConsoleOutput` utility in `npm-app/src/utils/suppress-console.ts` wraps `console.error`, `console.warn`, and `console.log` to filter specific messages. `npm-app/src/native/pty.ts` uses this to hide `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` errors during `bun-pty` dynamic import, while `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` refactors PostHog error suppression to use the shared utility. The implementation supports multiple concurrent suppression filters per method and provides cleanup functions to restore original console behavior.

e57ce1f53d19292bce98742f4cf4e9ae126de40b.title: Lazy load bun-pty native module
e57ce1f53d19292bce98742f4cf4e9ae126de40b.summary: Refactored `bun-pty` loading in `npm-app/src/native/pty.ts` to be asynchronous and lazy via `loadBunPty()`. Prevents startup crashes when native libraries are missing or platform unsupported by deferring errors. Callers in `cli.ts`, `index.ts`, and `terminal/base.ts` updated to `await` shell creation and reset functions.

9aa62e6fc2e7bbd7c23dfb2683e7148104dc39bc.title: CI release workflows reorganized with npm-app prefix
9aa62e6fc2e7bbd7c23dfb2683e7148104dc39bc.summary: GitHub Actions release workflows renamed from `releases/` subdirectory to flat `npm-app-release-` prefix. `prod.yml` switched `version_type` input from freeform string to choice enum, replaced custom bash semver logic with `npm version`, and renamed jobs. `staging.yml` updated `uses` reference to new build workflow path. `npm-app/scripts/release.js` updated API dispatch URL and manual trigger instructions to match new workflow filenames.

da73133a25d61bd1bebac97cc84e4d9f56d139eb.title: Refactor CI release workflows for CodeCane
da73133a25d61bd1bebac97cc84e4d9f56d139eb.summary: Split monolithic `release-binaries.yml` into modular `build.yml`, `prod.yml`, and `staging.yml` workflows. Added automated staging releases triggered by `[codecane]` PR titles, publishing to `codecane@beta`. Updated `npm-app/release-staging` package and build scripts to support dual-binary distribution.

b8c97893092cb3f84e402605f5a251bdc9d69d57.title: Pricing credit estimate reduced to few hours
b8c97893092cb3f84e402605f5a251bdc9d69d57.summary: Updated the `DEFAULT_FREE_CREDITS_GRANT` description in `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` from 'a day of intense coding' to 'a few hours'. This aligns the marketing copy with actual usage patterns. Scope limited to the web pricing page.

bdaa4f573db1c8497738f98fc46fc9638f7fd5ba.title: Fix codecane staging deploy
bdaa4f573db1c8497738f98fc46fc9638f7fd5ba.summary: CI workflows now pass `npmAppVersion` to `build-binary.js`, injecting `NEXT_PUBLIC_NPM_APP_VERSION` into the binary build. `client.ts` imports this version from `./config` instead of `package.json`. `release-staging` bumps to `1.0.420`, adds a concurrency group to prevent parallel runs, and updates the version calculation logic to use `npm view codecane@latest` as a base. `index.js` adds a bright warning banner for the staging environment.

6c5cd50eb5b2c5cde021aed5e114ed8ed2c6ec1b.text: When you start the program for the first time, it now automatically sets up essential background tasks and shows you helpful tips to get you ready to work.

da73133a25d61bd1bebac97cc84e4d9f56d139eb.text: The team improved how the product is built and released. This makes updates smoother and allows new features to reach the beta version faster.

9aa62e6fc2e7bbd7c23dfb2683e7148104dc39bc.text: The internal tools that prepare new software updates were reorganized to be more consistent and reliable.

eeab42f0181892f83d261d1db9dbd374c07f1028.text: A small internal update hides specific technical error messages from the system logs. This keeps the logs cleaner without changing how the product works for you.

82f003f63cd3aa047d21b52dfa4e217f63e00658.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system finds its settings. This helps the assistant run checks correctly.

6797adce93a659d4f297f1e825d39144ccfbb524.text: The system can now use a new AI service. This is a small internal update, so you won't see any changes in how you use the product.

1b1d47513ef9ed9fa7e565580077d8f9d29633f9.text: The assistant's internal organization was cleaned up. You will not see any changes in how you use the product.

e57ce1f53d19292bce98742f4cf4e9ae126de40b.text: The app now loads a specific background component only when needed. This prevents startup crashes on some computers. You are less likely to see error messages when opening the app.

b8c97893092cb3f84e402605f5a251bdc9d69d57.text: The pricing page now says the free credits last a few hours instead of a full day. This matches how people actually use the product.

d083cff15fc40d13c7e6c3e4d7e2170c8698605a.title: Fix credit granting idempotency
d083cff15fc40d13c7e6c3e4d7e2170c8698605a.summary: Refactors duplicate handling in packages/billing/src/grant-credits.ts. Replaces strict error code and constraint checks with helper matching code 23505 or message containing already exists. Ensures concurrent requests skip grants safely without throwing.

17c6428faea219ee83e0ae6df5f827947fd6f4fe.title: Evals table UI tweaks and o3 Pro mapping
17c6428faea219ee83e0ae6df5f827947fd6f4fe.summary: Evals table UI updated: model logos enlarged from 16px to 256px (sz=256 in getLogoForModel) and rendered at w-6 h-6 with wider spacing (space-x-3). Benchmark progress bars resized to w-36 h-8. Added 'o3-pro-2025-06-10' to modelDisplayNames map in web/src/app/evals/evals-table.tsx.

3237af0f56fa929e72b7e167200b0b147065f699.title: Add CODEBUFF tool format instruction to backend/src/tools.ts
3237af0f56fa929e72b7e167200b0b147065f699.summary: Added a developer comment in `backend/src/tools.ts` instructing CODEBUFF to use system-provided tool formats instead of file-local definitions. This clarifies internal tooling conventions without altering runtime behavior. Scope limited to source code comments. No functional changes to tool execution or API surfaces.

6bd1bce94a1cbcc102aa1d630b4f29404fb89271.title: Generalize syncfailure table schema and logging
6bd1bce94a1cbcc102aa1d630b4f29404fb89271.summary: Renamed `message_id` column to `id` in `sync_failure` table and removed default provider constraint. Updated `logSyncFailure` utility to accept provider argument, decoupling failure tracking from specific message contexts. Affects backend `message-cost-tracker.ts`, common `sync-failure.ts`, and database schema migrations.

6d11303a006de71433f2ca2b745f4fc9a30e8dd9.title: README Infisical steps renumbered
6d11303a006de71433f2ca2b745f4fc9a30e8dd9.summary: Infisical CLI setup steps in README.md changed from letters to numbers. Indentation adjusted for nested list alignment. Repo docs only.

526019e6e147a73b3757f7f33682d1d5990d7b53.title: Terminal PTY spawn fallback to childprocess
526019e6e147a73b3757f7f33682d1d5990d7b53.summary: Wrapped `bunPty.spawn` in try/catch in `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts`. If PTY creation throws, logs error with platform/arch and falls back to `child_process` logic. Prevents crash on unsupported PTY environments.

11f4ea2be931e7b97512cdc1b4492488b43d6bb5.title: Fix CheckpointManager listener leaks
11f4ea2be931e7b97512cdc1b4492488b43d6bb5.summary: Refactored `sendToWorker` in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts` to use a shared `cleanup` function. This ensures `message` and `error` listeners are properly detached on success, error, or timeout, preventing accumulation. Also set `maxListeners` to 50 on the worker instance to suppress warnings during high-frequency operations.

92b3b3a5ff8e8910a101a21676719d3bdb186383.title: Evals UI upgrade: avgTurns metric, model logos, display names
92b3b3a5ff8e8910a101a21676719d3bdb186383.summary: Evals table now computes avgTurns alongside avgScore and avgDuration, weighted by case count. getLogoForModel added to constants.ts resolves provider domains (google, anthropic, openai, deepseek) to Google favicon URLs for model rows. modelDisplayNames map in evals-table.tsx converts raw model IDs to friendly names like 'Gemini 2.5 Pro' and 'Claude 4 Opus'. Scope: common/src/constants.ts, web/src/app/evals/evals-table.tsx.

60e272f574e6f7175ae85a97934f13da57f22559.title: README local setup instructions update
60e272f574e6f7175ae85a97934f13da57f22559.summary: README local development steps simplified. Infisical CLI setup now includes `infisical secrets` verification instead of automatic injection note. Dependency installation consolidated to single `bun install` step, removing explicit `bun run build` requirement. Numbering corrected from 5 steps to 4.

d083cff15fc40d13c7e6c3e4d7e2170c8698605a.text: A small internal update fixes how the system handles duplicate requests. If you try to add credits twice at the same time, the system now ignores the extra request instead of failing, so you won't see errors or get charged twice.

17c6428faea219ee83e0ae6df5f827947fd6f4fe.text: The icons for different AI models in the evaluation table are now larger and easier to read, and the progress bars are sized for better visibility. The system now recognizes and displays a new model option.

3237af0f56fa929e72b7e167200b0b147065f699.text: This is a small internal update that adds a note for developers to follow existing rules. It does not change how the product works or looks for users.

5b9b71c236ae63df0ea980f8afb1f58905adfd89.text: The assistant can now follow fixed, step-by-step instructions instead of just guessing what to do. This makes some tasks more predictable and reliable for users.

92b3b3a5ff8e8910a101a21676719d3bdb186383.text: The evaluation screen now shows average conversation length per model, weighted by test cases, and displays friendly names with provider logos for easier comparison.

6d11303a006de71433f2ca2b745f4fc9a30e8dd9.text: Setup instructions for a security tool were renumbered for clarity. This is an internal documentation update that does not change how the product works for users.

6bd1bce94a1cbcc102aa1d630b4f29404fb89271.text: The system now records failed updates more flexibly, not just for messages. This internal change helps the app handle errors better in the future.

11f4ea2be931e7b97512cdc1b4492488b43d6bb5.text: Fixed a background issue where communication channels could get cluttered over time. This prevents the app from slowing down or warning you about too many listeners during heavy use.

60e272f574e6f7175ae85a97934f13da57f22559.text: The instructions for setting up the software on a computer were simplified and corrected. This change only affects how the tools are prepared for use, so there is no impact on the features available to end users.

61ca242ce408f41d09797ebba92e865d5a6cd6ff.title: Switch git eval agent to Gemini 2.5 Flash
61ca242ce408f41d09797ebba92e865d5a6cd6ff.summary: Git eval agent model switched from claudeModels.sonnet to models.gemini2_5_flash in evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. COST_MODE changed from 'normal' to 'experimental'. Import source updated from @codebuff/common/constants to common/constants.

b2b3aaa23e889cff8ee71ca19b84cce0686ed8dc.title: Add bun run inf to db:studio script
b2b3aaa23e889cff8ee71ca19b84cce0686ed8dc.summary: Updated `db:studio` script in `common/package.json` to prepend `bun run inf` to the `drizzle-kit studio` command. This aligns the script with other database commands (`db:generate`, `db:migrate`) which already use `bun run inf` for environment/infrastructure handling. Scope limited to `common/package.json`.

0b6573799be418d6a3b484d3a804bd6d4ceaed55.title: Release script prints latest GitHub Actions run URL
0b6573799be418d6a3b484d3a804bd6d4ceaed55.summary: The release script now fetches the latest workflow run ID before and after triggering the release-binaries.yml workflow to print a direct link to the new run. This replaces the static monitor URL with a dynamic link to the specific action run, falling back to the general actions page if the ID cannot be determined. The change is isolated to npm-app/scripts/release.js.

00b0464d1e5bdd1c3878e80d5ef437d47607c833.title: Robust binary version check and cleanup in release script
00b0464d1e5bdd1c3878e80d5ef437d47607c833.summary: npm-app/release/index.js replaces synchronous execSync with asynchronous spawn for getCurrentVersion, adding timeout handling and error resolution. downloadBinary now deletes existing binary files before fetching new versions to prevent corruption. checkForUpdates triggers downloads when version checks return 'error' or when versions mismatch.

74f862240de8082d65de13657ebbce64f417518e.title: Add preuninstall script to delete binary
74f862240de8082d65de13657ebbce64f417518e.summary: Added preuninstall script to npm-app/release/package.json to remove the codebuff binary from ~/.config/manicode/ during package uninstallation. This ensures clean removal of platform-specific executables (codebuff or codebuff.exe) when users run npm uninstall. The change is internal to the packaging metadata and does not affect runtime behavior.

4f0bacb0c98336fac86fa041ce9c6959aeeb05bd.title: Refactor rage detection to use object-based key events with filtering
4f0bacb0c98336fac86fa041ce9c6959aeeb05bd.summary: CLI key handling now passes raw `{ str, key }` objects to `keyMashingDetector.recordEvent` instead of pre-filtering strings. `createCountDetector` accepts an optional `filter` callback to determine event inclusion, replacing hardcoded modifier/special-key checks in `rage-detectors.ts`. Object comparison in repeat detection uses `JSON.stringify` to correctly group identical key events. This internal refactor centralizes filtering logic within the detector configuration.

9729e46d239e367d119ee1a76c7702c767548232.title: Fix ripgrep binary resolution in compiled Freebuff
9729e46d239e367d119ee1a76c7702c767548232.summary: New npm-app/src/native/ripgrep.ts resolves rg path dynamically, using @vscode/ripgrep in dev and self-extracting the embedded binary to ~/.config/manicode/rg in compiled mode. npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts now awaits getRgPath() instead of static import, fixing ripgrep failures in Bun-compiled executables. npm-app/scripts/build-binary.js wraps string env defines in single quotes to prevent shell interpretation of spaces or special characters. Unix extraction runs chmod +x; failed extraction falls back to @vscode/ripgrep path.

86e1d94b91de38f7ecca0cf6a00227041586645b.title: Revert untested release workflow link printing
86e1d94b91de38f7ecca0cf6a00227041586645b.summary: Reverts the attempt to print the specific GitHub Actions run URL in `npm-app/scripts/release.js`. The logic fetching pre/post workflow run IDs to construct the link is removed due to being untested. The script now logs a generic monitor URL after triggering the workflow.

df45175bae82d4e037863f76c0b41eb887cce029.title: Remove verbose debug logs from auth and websocket middleware
df45175bae82d4e037863f76c0b41eb887cce029.summary: Commented out debug log statements in `backend/src/util/check-auth.ts` and `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts`. This reduces noise from successful authentication and organization repository coverage checks. Internal change only; no user-facing impact.

c027e956959f160bd402b2f4f53525684b3a71af.title: Release check uses Atom feed
