c027e956959f160bd402b2f4f53525684b3a71af.summary: getLatestVersion in npm-app/release/index.js now fetches GitHub releases.atom instead of api.github.com. XML regex extracts tag from <id> node. Eliminates 403 rate-limit fallback logic. Internal release tooling only.

b2b3aaa23e889cff8ee71ca19b84cce0686ed8dc.text: A small internal update makes the database tool work the same way as other similar tools. You will not notice any change.

df45175bae82d4e037863f76c0b41eb887cce029.text: The system stopped writing unnecessary notes to its internal records when checking user access. This is a small maintenance update. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

86e1d94b91de38f7ecca0cf6a00227041586645b.text: A small internal change removed a feature that showed a specific progress link during updates because it wasn't fully tested. The system now shows a general link instead.

4f0bacb0c98336fac86fa041ce9c6959aeeb05bd.text: The program now checks keyboard presses more accurately to detect rapid input. This internal update improves how the system identifies when you are typing quickly, without changing how you use the product.

74f862240de8082d65de13657ebbce64f417518e.text: When you remove the product, the system now deletes its leftover helper files from your computer. This keeps your device tidy without changing how the product works while you use it.

61ca242ce408f41d09797ebba92e865d5a6cd6ff.text: The internal system that tests the assistant's code skills switched to a different, experimental model. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

00b0464d1e5bdd1c3878e80d5ef437d47607c833.text: The update system now checks for new versions more reliably and removes old files before downloading updates. This helps prevent broken installations and ensures you receive the latest features without manual fixes.

9729e46d239e367d119ee1a76c7702c767548232.text: A search tool inside the app now finds its helper program correctly in the finished product. This fixes rare errors when searching files.

0b6573799be418d6a3b484d3a804bd6d4ceaed55.text: The release tool now shows a direct link to the specific progress page for a new update, instead of a general overview page.

c027e956959f160bd402b2f4f53525684b3a71af.text: The internal tool that checks for new software updates now uses a different source to find the latest version. This change fixes a problem where the tool sometimes failed to check for updates, but it does not change how the product works for users.

e2714f8c2430a5ac228a7608b32fbc042ca435bf.title: Increase request timeout to 20s and update error message
e2714f8c2430a5ac228a7608b32fbc042ca435bf.summary: The `requestTimeout` in `npm-app/release/index.js` increased from 10000 to 20000 ms. The timeout rejection in `httpGet` now includes 'Please check your internet connection and try again.' to clarify network issues.

3a774075882c5ef899ea5c7d2f22f042a5cfe521.title: Replace term.writeLine with console.log in release rate-limit fallback
3a774075882c5ef899ea5c7d2f22f042a5cfe521.summary: Swapped `term.writeLine` for `console.log` in the GitHub API rate-limit fallback path within `npm-app/release/index.js`. This ensures the warning message outputs correctly regardless of terminal library initialization state or TTY availability. Scope limited to the internal release tooling script.

6ad625158f885c1b71f08d85e09af0b251bd0ed3.title: Simplify timeout error in release script
6ad625158f885c1b71f08d85e09af0b251bd0ed3.summary: The `httpGet` function in `npm-app/release/index.js` now rejects with a concise 'Request timeout.' message instead of a verbose connection-check instruction. This detailed guidance moved to the `ensureBinaryExists` catch block, ensuring users receive specific troubleshooting advice only when binary download failures occur.

fa45f1d2216ed59290203a42196afe3f32f0c4a1.title: npm-app package refactor with compiled binary release workflow
fa45f1d2216ed59290203a42196afe3f32f0c4a1.summary: Monorepo restructured: `common` package renamed `@codebuff/common`, `backend` scoped to `@codebuff/backend` with ESM (`"type": "module"`), and `npm-app` extracted as standalone buildable package. New `release-binaries.yml` workflow compiles Bun binaries via `npm-app/scripts/build-binary.js`, with `patch-bun-pty.ts` and `patch-web-tree-sitter.ts` patching native deps for static compilation. CI split into separate web build, typecheck, and npm-app build steps; `.manicodeignore` replaced by `.codebuffignore`. Jest config drops `@/env` module mapper in favor of direct relative imports.

1c584685b8d0df69908061aea316c1a766ed8b2f.title: Global rage detector singleton and flexible time-between operators
1c584685b8d0df69908061aea316c1a766ed8b2f.summary: Introduced a global `rageDetectors` singleton in `npm-app/src/rage-detectors.ts`, replacing per-CLI-instance initialization to enable application-wide access. Enhanced `createTimeBetweenDetector` in `npm-app/src/utils/rage-detector.ts` to support configurable comparison operators (`lt`, `gt`, `eq`, `gte`, `lte`), defaulting to `lt` for backward compatibility. Added `startupTimeDetector` and `exitTimeDetector` with `gte` thresholds to track slow startup and exit sequences in `npm-app/src/index.ts`. Updated `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to reference the singleton for error, hang, and repeat input detection.

1c6183b12a7c1cfb8082014c4a7388e3b858f58d.title: Fix npm-app types
1c6183b12a7c1cfb8082014c4a7388e3b858f58d.summary: Removed `paths` alias `@/*` from `npm-app/tsconfig.json` and replaced import `@/utils/logger` with relative path `../utils/logger` in `npm-app/src/native/pty.ts`. This resolves type resolution issues for the npm-app package.

b4063deba5c1f9345768ae7d4775644bd3762d39.title: Remove release-binaries.yml CI workflow
b4063deba5c1f9345768ae7d4775644bd3762d39.summary: Deleted .github/workflows/release-binaries.yml, stopping automated binary builds and releases to codebuff-community. This removes the matrix build steps for Linux, macOS, and Windows artifacts. Affects CI pipelines only; no runtime code changes.

435945b5b0aaa397d68c6640aca3a6e71253a9c9.title: PTY fallback to child process on native load failure
435945b5b0aaa397d68c6640aca3a6e71253a9c9.summary: Wraps `require('bun-pty')` in try/catch within `npm-app/src/native/pty.ts`, exporting `bunPty` as `undefined` on failure and logging platform/arch/BUN_PTY_LIB. `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts` gates PTY usage on `bunPty` truthiness, falling back to `runBackgroundCommand` child process. `IPty` type updated to `ReturnType<NonNullable<typeof bunPty>['spawn']>` to reflect optional native binding.

202feaac7b6dd5ffe35f8729a3d9b1eaa7facccf.title: Add CLI rage detection system
202feaac7b6dd5ffe35f8729a3d9b1eaa7facccf.summary: Implements rage detection in `npm-app` CLI via new `rage-detectors.ts` and `utils/rage-detector.ts`. Tracks key mashing, repeat inputs, exits after errors, and hangs (spinner, commands, WebSocket) using count, time-between, and timeout strategies. Fires `cli.rage` analytics event defined in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. Integrates into `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and refactors `npm-app/src/utils/spinner.ts` to use the new detector.

1c6183b12a7c1cfb8082014c4a7388e3b858f58d.text: Fixed a small internal issue to help the app find its own parts correctly. No visible changes.

3a774075882c5ef899ea5c7d2f22f042a5cfe521.text: Fixed a bug in the internal release tooling. The tool now correctly displays a warning message when the external service limits requests.

1c584685b8d0df69908061aea316c1a766ed8b2f.text: The app now uses a single, shared system to track user frustration, replacing separate trackers for each tool. This allows the app to more consistently detect slow startups or exits and repeated errors, leading to better overall stability monitoring.

bdaa4f573db1c8497738f98fc46fc9638f7fd5ba.text: The staging environment now shows a clear warning banner to help distinguish it from the live product, and the internal version tracking was corrected to ensure accurate build identification.

6ad625158f885c1b71f08d85e09af0b251bd0ed3.text: The tool now shows a short 'Request timeout' message for general network issues, while detailed troubleshooting advice appears only when a specific download fails. This internal update reduces confusing error messages without changing how the product works.

b4063deba5c1f9345768ae7d4775644bd3762d39.text: The company removed an internal tool that automatically built and published software files. This change does not affect how you use the product.

fa45f1d2216ed59290203a42196afe3f32f0c4a1.text: The application is now packaged as a single, self-contained file, making it easier to download and run without needing extra setup steps.

435945b5b0aaa397d68c6640aca3a6e71253a9c9.text: The app now checks if a special background tool is available. If it is missing, the app uses a simpler method to run tasks. This keeps the app working on more computers.

fe06b462903daa6168304889fbcbb20b4048c5e5.title: Log active handles on close in dev
fe06b462903daa6168304889fbcbb20b4048c5e5.summary: Added logging of active handles during CLI shutdown when `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` is `dev`. Uses `process._getActiveHandles()` to capture state for debugging. Scoped to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

85ddb95a1fe7571d1f8d7ce2ec487d03d914ca29.title: Suppress PostHog console errors in analytics
85ddb95a1fe7571d1f8d7ce2ec487d03d914ca29.summary: Added `suppressPostHogConsoleErrors` to wrap `console.error` and `console.warn`, filtering messages containing 'posthog' with `PostHogError` name. Modified `flushAnalytics` and `logError` to silently catch PostHog exceptions without logging to console or logger. This prevents internal analytics connection failures from cluttering the user's terminal output. Changes applied in `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts`.

c2d6adcb343dd8f939311cc7da0b76bf29e6db30.title: Increase checkpoint file manager buffer limit
c2d6adcb343dd8f939311cc7da0b76bf29e6db30.summary: The checkpoint file manager in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` now sets `maxBuffer` to 50MB for the git submodule exposure command. Stderr is also changed to 'ignore' to prevent potential buffer overflow or noise from non-critical error streams during large submodule operations.

4e3e8200cd129ec8dfe12d711fdeba3f4fc006da.title: tools.test.ts research mode assertions
4e3e8200cd129ec8dfe12d711fdeba3f4fc006da.summary: Updated `getFilteredToolsInstructions` tests in `backend/src/__tests__/tools.test.ts`. Corrected `ask` mode test to pass `false` for `readOnlyMode`. Added test verifying `research` tool exclusion when `readOnlyMode` is `true`.

20dcc6293f261bd06981d359e60546744e996610.title: CLI spinner adds hang detection
20dcc6293f261bd06981d359e60546744e996610.summary: CLI `Spinner` tracks `cli.app_hung` event after 60s inactivity. Mechanism uses `setTimeout` in `npm-app/src/utils/spinner.ts` to trigger `trackEvent` with duration. Scope covers `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` enum and CLI spinner utility. Timeout cleared on `stop()` to prevent false positives.

a5b2752eb82cd7b4474b4983077adddd5ab00e0b.title: Rename PLACEHOLDER keys in backend agent templates
a5b2752eb82cd7b4474b4983077adddd5ab00e0b.summary: PLACEHOLDER.REMAINING_STEPS_PROMPT and PLACEHOLDER.PROJECT_ROOT_PROMPT renamed to PLACEHOLDER.REMAINING_STEPS and PLACEHOLDER.PROJECT_ROOT. PLACEHOLDER.TOOLS, FILE_TREE, SYSTEM_INFO, and GIT_CHANGES renamed to their _PROMPT suffixed counterparts. Updates applied across claude4base, experimental, lite, and max agent templates, plus strings.ts and types.ts.

8c04479d0caecd8aa5812727bd1cadf50105912e.title: Fix readOnlyMode parameter passing in system prompt
8c04479d0caecd8aa5812727bd1cadf50105912e.summary: readOnlyMode parameter added to getAgentSystemPrompt call in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. getAgentSystemPrompt signature updated in backend/src/system-prompt/agent-system-prompt.ts to accept and forward readOnlyMode to getFilteredToolsInstructions. getFilteredToolsInstructions in backend/src/tools.ts sets readOnlyMode default to false. Ensures read-only agent mode correctly filters tool instructions.

cf9187cabf960dc9d7457161194f2d56e84d58fa.title: Migrate tool format to CodebuffToolCall schema
cf9187cabf960dc9d7457161194f2d56e84d58fa.summary: Refactored internal tool call representation from `ToolCall` to `CodebuffToolCall` across backend and common types. Field names standardized to `toolName`, `toolCallId`, and `args` to align with AI SDK `ToolCallPart` structure. Updated `parseRawToolCall`, `loopMainPrompt`, and XML parsers to handle new schema; `ToolCallError` now includes `toolCallId`. Scope includes `backend/src/tools.ts`, `main-prompt.ts`, and `common/src/actions.ts`.

5123f79a82386fcd6ca8efae0a37a195e413dcec.title: Broaden PostHog error suppression in analytics console wrapper
5123f79a82386fcd6ca8efae0a37a195e413dcec.summary: The `wrapConsoleMethod` function in `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` now iterates through all arguments to detect error names, replacing the previous strict check on `args[0]`. This change ensures that PostHog errors are suppressed even when passed as non-first arguments or wrapped in different structures, preventing them from leaking to the user's console.

beaf6f94b3b2db8a62053df80b11b82a4ecfdea0.title: Rename agent templates to model-specific names
beaf6f94b3b2db8a62053df80b11b82a4ecfdea0.summary: Agent template identifiers renamed from generic labels (lite, max, experimental) to model-specific names (gemini25flash_base, gemini25pro_thinking, gemini25pro_base, claude4_base). Backend template files and common type definitions updated to reflect new naming convention. Scope covers backend/src/templates and common/src/types/agent-state.ts. New AgentTemplateNames constant exported for type-safe references.

c2d6adcb343dd8f939311cc7da0b76bf29e6db30.text: The app can now handle larger data files during internal updates. This reduces the chance of errors when syncing large projects.

20dcc6293f261bd06981d359e60546744e996610.text: If the tool stops working for a minute, it now quietly notes the pause. This helps the team find and fix stuck processes.

beaf6f94b3b2db8a62053df80b11b82a4ecfdea0.text: The assistant's built-in options were renamed to match their underlying models. This internal update does not change how the assistant works for you.

4e3e8200cd129ec8dfe12d711fdeba3f4fc006da.text: Internal checks were updated to ensure the assistant correctly disables certain tools when in a restricted read-only mode. This small change helps prevent the assistant from attempting actions it shouldn't take in that specific state.

a5b2752eb82cd7b4474b4983077adddd5ab00e0b.text: This small internal update cleaned up how the assistant handles its instructions. You will not notice any changes to the product's behavior.

5123f79a82386fcd6ca8efae0a37a195e413dcec.text: A small internal fix now hides more types of background errors from the console. This keeps error messages from appearing unexpectedly while you use the product.

85ddb95a1fe7571d1f8d7ce2ec487d03d914ca29.text: A small internal update stops the system from showing error messages when analytics data fails to send. You will see less clutter in your logs, but the product works the same way.

cf9187cabf960dc9d7457161194f2d56e84d58fa.text: The assistant now uses a standard format to understand commands. This internal cleanup helps it run tools more reliably.

8c04479d0caecd8aa5812727bd1cadf50105912e.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant's 'read-only' mode might not properly restrict its available actions. This ensures that when you set the assistant to read-only, it correctly limits itself to viewing information without attempting to change anything.

fe06b462903daa6168304889fbcbb20b4048c5e5.text: The software now records extra details when it stops running in test mode to help engineers fix problems faster. This change is small and internal, so users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

69458a874a9b7c3eff67230f67a642e3abec0526.title: Refactor template placeholders to enum
69458a874a9b7c3eff67230f67a642e3abec0526.summary: Backend template injection logic now uses a PLACEHOLDER enum instead of string arrays for prompt variable management. This replaces manual brace-wrapped string keys in `claude4base.ts` and `strings.ts` with typed enum values, simplifying the `formatPrompt` function and reducing potential typos. The change is internal to the `backend/src/templates` directory and affects how agent prompts are constructed before execution.

6039f909d5badf56d3f464c831966286a764b894.title: Add admin layout, billing status API, and evals access control
6039f909d5badf56d3f464c831966286a764b894.summary: Added web/src/app/admin/layout.tsx to enforce session admin checks and redirect unauthenticated users. Created web/src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/billing/status/route.ts for Stripe subscription and portal retrieval. Updated web/src/app/api/git-evals/route.ts to filter results by is_public for non-admins. Refactored admin email checks into packages/internal/src/utils/auth.ts.

f8f58ec037f484a0a5384574eae6fc0ad900d9ab.title: Align toolConfigs with aiToolSet interface
f8f58ec037f484a0a5384574eae6fc0ad900d9ab.summary: Renamed tool config properties `schema` to `parameters` and `additionalInfo` to `description` in `backend/src/tools.ts` to satisfy the `ToolSet` interface from the `ai` package. Updated `buildToolDescription` and downstream consumers to use the new property names. Ensures type safety and compatibility with the AI SDK's tool definition structure.

7b5459d51edc76f4a51e4d459a178a332ee668b9.title: Disallow research tool in readOnlyMode
7b5459d51edc76f4a51e4d459a178a332ee668b9.summary: Updated `getFilteredToolsInstructions` in `backend/src/tools.ts` to accept `readOnlyMode` and exclude `research` and `create_plan` tools when active. Modified `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to pass `readOnlyMode` to the instruction generator and switch `create_plan` gating from `isAskMode` to `readOnlyMode`. This ensures read-only agents cannot initiate research or create plans.

6ed878c5dd69e33bc73de7685041095eadec1ca9.title: PLACEHOLDER renamed to strongly typed const
6ed878c5dd69e33bc73de7685041095eadec1ca9.summary: PLACEHOLDER enum replaced with strongly typed const object in backend/src/templates/types.ts. Keys renamed (e.g. TOOLS to TOOLS_PROMPT) to match string values. formatPrompt in strings.ts updated to use PlaceholderValue type and placeholderValues array. Agent templates in claude4base.ts and experimental.ts updated to use new keys.

f115e675e6f741606cdced358761c2d60b9e0f94.title: Add lite and max agent templates
f115e675e6f741606cdced358761c2d60b9e0f94.summary: New `lite` and `max` agent templates added to `backend/src/templates/agents/`. `lite` uses `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20` for speed; `max` uses `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` for quality. Both share the updated 'Buffy' system prompt with subgoal tracking and file versioning logic. Registered in `agent-list.ts` and typed in `common/src/types/agent-state.ts`.

eb2ac674792a936a452b6c47421377c77305333f.title: Add getAgentPrompt helper
eb2ac674792a936a452b6c47421377c77305333f.summary: Added getAgentPrompt to backend/src/templates/strings.ts to stringify agent prompts. It wraps formatPrompt using agentTemplates from backend/src/templates/types.ts. Scope limited to backend templates. agentTemplates Record added to types.ts.

c001a7c6320bd9578c5c98c1cc80fbee819185ff.title: agentTemplates registry moved to agent-list.ts
c001a7c6320bd9578c5c98c1cc80fbee819185ff.summary: agentTemplates registry relocated from backend/src/templates/types.ts to new backend/src/templates/agent-list.ts. types.ts now exports only AgentTemplate type and injectableVariables; strings.ts imports agentTemplates from agent-list. Refactor decouples registry from type definitions. No user-facing behavior change.

970af3ad42e94e09d6e70f1783316a4ab33a5793.title: Add experimental agent template
970af3ad42e94e09d6e70f1783316a4ab33a5793.summary: New `experimental` agent template added to `agentTemplates` in `backend/src/templates/agent-list.ts`, backed by `backend/src/templates/agents/experimental.ts`. This template uses `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05` and is registered in `AgentTemplateNameSchema` in `common/src/types/agent-state.ts`. Existing `claude4base` template moved to `backend/src/templates/agents/claude4base.ts` to support subdirectory organization. No migration needed for existing templates; new template available immediately for selection.

75e6c77beb02137e71b96ea0df60d8ba7ed005e6.title: Remove manager agent mode and superagent tools
75e6c77beb02137e71b96ea0df60d8ba7ed005e6.summary: Deleted manager-prompt subsystem and kill_terminal/sleep tools. Removed onManagerPrompt handler from websocket-action.ts. Updated common actions and CLI definitions to reflect removal.

69458a874a9b7c3eff67230f67a642e3abec0526.text: The system now uses a stricter internal method to fill in prompt details, reducing the chance of mistakes. This is a small background update that makes the software more reliable, with no visible changes for users.

970af3ad42e94e09d6e70f1783316a4ab33a5793.text: A new experimental option was added to the assistant's settings. This lets users try a different underlying model for their chats. Existing options remain unchanged.

c001a7c6320bd9578c5c98c1cc80fbee819185ff.text: The team reorganized how the system stores its list of assistant settings. This internal cleanup makes the code easier to manage, so nothing changes for you.

6ed878c5dd69e33bc73de7685041095eadec1ca9.text: Developers cleaned up how the assistant labels its internal instructions. You won't notice any change.

f115e675e6f741606cdced358761c2d60b9e0f94.text: The assistant now offers two new modes: one optimized for speed and another for higher quality. Both modes use improved logic to track tasks and manage file versions more reliably.

f8f58ec037f484a0a5384574eae6fc0ad900d9ab.text: The system updated how it describes available features to match new standards. This small internal change ensures the assistant understands and uses its tools correctly, with no visible difference to users.

6039f909d5badf56d3f464c831966286a764b894.text: Admins can now manage billing and access settings through a secure dashboard. Regular users see only public evaluation results, while private ones remain hidden.

eb2ac674792a936a452b6c47421377c77305333f.text: The assistant can now use a new way to build its instructions. This internal change helps the system work better behind the scenes.

75e6c77beb02137e71b96ea0df60d8ba7ed005e6.text: The app removed special tools that let a manager agent control other agents, stop tasks, or pause work. This is an internal cleanup; users see no change in normal features.

7b5459d51edc76f4a51e4d459a178a332ee668b9.text: Read-only assistants can no longer start research or create plans.

68860ccd6a481f9ab06194546f95648dfd194bb3.title: Replace currentWorkingDirectory with projectRoot and cwd in evals
68860ccd6a481f9ab06194546f95648dfd194bb3.summary: The `currentWorkingDirectory` property in `getProjectFileContext` return object was replaced by `projectRoot` and `cwd` in `evals/scaffolding.ts`. Both new fields are assigned `projectPath`. This fixes a type error in the scaffolding.

03bbd82e9081359b0b0d3a27b7c923a15027756a.title: Add version and update troubleshooting docs
03bbd82e9081359b0b0d3a27b7c923a15027756a.summary: Added Version and Codebuff not updating sections to troubleshooting.mdx. Updated Install failed guidance to use chown/takeown instead of sudo. Replaced hardcoded version 1.0.153 with someversion in error examples.

ab5e6a57326209d71b9002a0e5b9745d811bf7f3.title: formatPrompt derives cwd from agentState
ab5e6a57326209d71b9002a0e5b9745d811bf7f3.summary: formatPrompt in backend/src/templates/strings.ts now reads CODEBUFF_USER_CWD from agentState.fileContext.cwd instead of a separate cwd argument. This reduces the function signature to three parameters and centralizes context access within agentState. Scope is limited to backend template string generation. The change ensures prompt variables rely on the canonical agent state rather than potentially stale caller-provided paths.

354a3463a809a8e900ff1546905f709928113ff9.title: Remove redundant systeminstructions block from claude4base template
354a3463a809a8e900ff1546905f709928113ff9.summary: The `claude4base` template in `backend/src/templates/claude4base.ts` now omits the trailing `<system_instructions>` block containing `{CODEBUFF_TOOLS_PROMPT}`. This reduces the prompt payload by removing duplicate tool definitions already handled elsewhere in the agent context. The change applies strictly to the base Claude 4 template file.

d51122bc6283ab2e8626aa3c4941114502bb2581.title: Move cwd into AgentState fileContext
d51122bc6283ab2e8626aa3c4941114502bb2581.summary: Refactored `ProjectFileContextSchema` to include `projectRoot` and `cwd` fields, replacing the top-level `currentWorkingDirectory` and the optional `cwd` in `CLIENT_ACTION_SCHEMA`. This change centralizes working directory state within `agentState.fileContext` for `main-prompt.ts`, `research.ts`, and `npm-app` clients. `fileContext.cwd` is now updated dynamically during background process tool results in `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

207152a623b63fa174750ef851d43bbca9fb0b9c.title: Wrap unit test hooks in infisical run
207152a623b63fa174750ef851d43bbca9fb0b9c.summary: Updated `backend-unit-tests`, `npm-app-unit-tests`, and `common-unit-tests` hooks in `codebuff.json` to execute `bun test` via `infisical run`. This ensures required environment variables are injected during local file-change test execution. The change applies only to the `fileChangeHooks` section, leaving command logic and filters otherwise identical.

9a2c50ecef123fa892f16647fc653ab27056ac77.title: Add model ID to AI SDK error logs
9a2c50ecef123fa892f16647fc653ab27056ac77.summary: AI SDK stream errors now include the model identifier in the logger payload. This improves debugging by associating upstream failures with specific models. The change is scoped to `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. Model data is pulled from `options.model`.

c3b5a8116e599533e82169570bdd41a80090e74a.title: Clarify terminal status cwd label
c3b5a8116e599533e82169570bdd41a80090e74a.summary: Terminal status output label changed from `cwd:` to `Starting cwd:` in `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts`. Disambiguates initial directory from subsequent state changes. Affects CLI terminal status display only. No functional logic change.

e64b7691fdaa078c65efdf09e0d54c56f4eae8b8.title: Add claude4base agent template and subagent state schema
e64b7691fdaa078c65efdf09e0d54c56f4eae8b8.summary: New `claude4base` template defines a base agent using `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` with structured system prompts and tool sets. `AgentStateSchema` in `common/src/types/agent-state.ts` now includes `agents` array for subagent tracking via `SubagentStateSchema`. `backend/src/templates/` introduces `types.ts` for tool name groups (`baseAgentToolNames`) and `strings.ts` for prompt variable injection. The `AgentTemplateNameSchema` enum currently only accepts `claude4base`.

8e43ddbb832c3f82ba86c2fd5ea3233861b0e657.title: Seat-based billing syncs Stripe quantity on member changes
8e43ddbb832c3f82ba86c2fd5ea3233861b0e657.summary: Seat-based billing added via updateStripeSubscriptionQuantity in packages/billing/src/org-billing.ts. Stripe subscription item quantity for STRIPE_TEAM_FEE_PRICE_ID syncs to actual org member count on invite acceptance, member removal, and bulk invitations. Proration behavior set to create_prorations. Covers web/src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/billing/setup/route.ts, web/src/app/api/invites/[token]/route.ts, and web/src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/members/[userId]/route.ts. Stripe failures logged but swallowed to prevent blocking core member management.

68860ccd6a481f9ab06194546f95648dfd194bb3.text: The system now uses more precise internal labels to track where your project files are located. This fixes a technical error in the background. You will not notice any changes in how the product works.

c3b5a8116e599533e82169570bdd41a80090e74a.text: The label in the terminal status output now reads 'Starting cwd:' instead of 'cwd:' to clarify that it refers to the initial directory. This is a small internal change that only affects how the information is displayed, with no impact on functionality.

8e43ddbb832c3f82ba86c2fd5ea3233861b0e657.text: Billing now automatically updates when team members join or leave. The cost adjusts based on the current number of seats, so you only pay for active users.

354a3463a809a8e900ff1546905f709928113ff9.text: A small internal cleanup removed duplicate instructions from the assistant's setup. This makes the system run more efficiently without changing how you use it.

e64b7691fdaa078c65efdf09e0d54c56f4eae8b8.text: The assistant now uses a new built-in setup that lets it track smaller helper tasks it runs for you.

03bbd82e9081359b0b0d3a27b7c923a15027756a.text: Help guides now explain how to check your current version and fix update problems. Instructions for installing software were simplified to make troubleshooting easier.

207152a623b63fa174750ef851d43bbca9fb0b9c.text: Internal testing now uses the correct settings automatically. You will not notice any change in the product.

9a2c50ecef123fa892f16647fc653ab27056ac77.text: Internal logging updates record which assistant model caused an error. This helps engineers fix problems faster without changing how the product works for you.

ab5e6a57326209d71b9002a0e5b9745d811bf7f3.text: The assistant now uses one central source to find your current work location when building prompts. This internal cleanup ensures it always uses the correct, up-to-date path.

d51122bc6283ab2e8626aa3c4941114502bb2581.text: The assistant now tracks your working location more accurately, helping it find files in the right place.

75183ae0d850204e81d037acb0d05a7a544a3fdf.title: Refactor agentStepsRemaining and config loading
75183ae0d850204e81d037acb0d05a7a544a3fdf.summary: loadCodebuffConfig now returns a guaranteed CodebuffConfig object instead of null, falling back to a new getDefaultConfig() when files are missing or invalid. This removes optional chaining in npm-app/src/client.ts when accessing maxAgentSteps. backend/src/research.ts drops redundant consecutiveAssistantMessages initialization from AgentState. Shared defaults moved to common/src/json-config/default.ts.

ebefaef283560321a2112374229ed3ac84f6aa75.title: Remove usage-based pricing note from Claude Code comparison
ebefaef283560321a2112374229ed3ac84f6aa75.summary: Removed bullet point about usage-based pricing from web/src/content/advanced/claude-code-comparison.mdx. Aligns documentation with current pricing model reality. Scope limited to this specific comparison page.

29fe45e5bc81dd36fae50d786fdb476225b51471.title: Strict typing for toolConfigsList in backend/src/tools.ts
29fe45e5bc81dd36fae50d786fdb476225b51471.summary: Refactors `toolConfigsList` generation in `backend/src/tools.ts` to enforce strict type inference. Uses a mapped type assertion to preserve exact `name` and `config` properties, replacing the previous loose `Object.entries` map. Scope limited to backend tool definitions. Ensures `ToolName` and `TOOL_LIST` exports remain type-safe without casting overhead.

5903e989582d7d2867a98b6d83e486af72c8e755.title: Fix main prompt test assertion
5903e989582d7d2867a98b6d83e486af72c8e755.summary: Corrects expected value for `agentStepsRemaining` in `main-prompt.test.ts`. Assertion now checks decrement (`- 1`) instead of increment (`+ 1`). Internal test fix only.

7573845dff6f240690ee1ca5520c437749553b8e.title: Remove deprecated consecutiveAgentMessages from AgentState
7573845dff6f240690ee1ca5520c437749553b8e.summary: Removed the `consecutiveAssistantMessages` field from `AgentState` in `common/src/types/agent-state.ts` and `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The agent step limit logic now relies exclusively on `agentStepsRemaining`, which is initialized to 12 in `getInitialAgentState` and decremented per step. This simplifies the state schema and prompt construction by eliminating redundant tracking fields.

0ef68b547c97738f22114ec4203474481896cdbe.title: Refactor tool configs to map in backend
0ef68b547c97738f22114ec4203474481896cdbe.summary: backend/src/tools.ts converts toolConfigs from array to keyed object. Exports derive TOOL_LIST and ToolName from keys. managerTools and getFilteredToolsInstructions updated to filter by name string. parseRawToolCall checks name in toolConfigs directly.

588e20211f58ae72afe95da52e254881bed967cf.title: evals: switch APIBASE to prod, lower concurrency
588e20211f58ae72afe95da52e254881bed967cf.summary: In evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts, API_BASE changed from localhost:3000 to https://www.codebuff.com/. Global concurrency limit reduced from 10 to 5. Affects eval set execution only.

edcfdeff27d8b493d92cf258fb91f25cb98a6ac5.title: Add GitHub Action to release binaries
edcfdeff27d8b493d92cf258fb91f25cb98a6ac5.summary: New `.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml` builds and publishes binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows on tag push or manual dispatch. The workflow uses `bun` to compile the app, packages artifacts into tarballs/zips, and creates a release in `CodebuffAI/codebuff-community`. Covers CI infrastructure; no user-facing code changes.

1a4ed158f86d613e27df141446b335949495d638.title: Buffbench page update and admin visibility controls
1a4ed158f86d613e27df141446b335949495d638.summary: Added PATCH /api/git-evals/visibility route for admins to toggle eval result public status. Refactored admin email constants into common/src/constants.ts. Updated web/src/app/evals/page.tsx with session-aware admin checks and new visibility UI controls. Requires admin session for visibility changes.

75183ae0d850204e81d037acb0d05a7a544a3fdf.text: The assistant now always uses safe default settings when it cannot read its saved preferences. This internal cleanup prevents it from stopping unexpectedly when starting a task.

7573845dff6f240690ee1ca5520c437749553b8e.text: The assistant stopped tracking one extra detail about its own progress. This cleanup makes its internal memory simpler, but you will not notice any difference in how it works.

69fffe8f6b530e155e645d0bfd9c931f24294498.text: The system no longer tells the assistant to treat its own earlier answers as less smart. This internal cleanup means the assistant stops trying to fix past mistakes based on that old rule.

ebefaef283560321a2112374229ed3ac84f6aa75.text: A note about usage-based pricing was removed from the comparison page. This update aligns the text with the current pricing model. The change is small and only affects that specific page.

29fe45e5bc81dd36fae50d786fdb476225b51471.text: The system now checks its own settings more carefully before running. This small internal update helps prevent mistakes but does not change how you use the product.

5903e989582d7d2867a98b6d83e486af72c8e755.text: An internal test for the assistant's step counter was fixed. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

1a4ed158f86d613e27df141446b335949495d638.text: Admins can now control whether test results are shown to everyone or kept private. This keeps sensitive information hidden from regular users.

edcfdeff27d8b493d92cf258fb91f25cb98a6ac5.text: The team improved how they package the software for different computers. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

588e20211f58ae72afe95da52e254881bed967cf.text: Internal tests now run against the live product instead of a local copy. Fewer tests run at once.

c07d48726435795bf1fa8d2c432fb6293514a308.title: Terminal startup scripts await before command execution
c07d48726435795bf1fa8d2c432fb6293514a308.summary: Terminal process initialization in `npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts` now awaits shell startup scripts via a `setupPromise` before executing user commands. Previous implementation wrote init commands asynchronously, risking race conditions where commands executed before environment variables or aliases from sourced configs were available. The change refactors `shellInitCommands` from a single string to an array of commands, each wrapped with prompt identifier setup, and enforces sequential execution using `runSinglePtyCommand`. This ensures the persistent PTY is fully initialized before `runCommandPty` proceeds.

df2b439018be96faa7142d9a7cd3b706cc079288.title: Spinner text updates in CLI
df2b439018be96faa7142d9a7cd3b706cc079288.summary: Spinner messages updated to include trailing ellipses (e.g., 'Thinking...' instead of 'Thinking'). Logic in `npm-app/src/utils/spinner.ts` modified to remove automatic ellipsis addition. Affects `checkpoint.ts`, `cli.ts`, `client.ts`, `tool-handlers.ts`, and `tool-renderers.ts`.

aac5b2350146850b8962175c788b529f22ce966a.title: Update xml-stream-parser test expectations
aac5b2350146850b8962175c788b529f22ce966a.summary: Adjusts test assertions in xml-stream-parser.test.ts to remove trailing newlines from expected closing tags. Aligns expectations with current stream processing behavior. Internal test fix only.

87eb5eb7a63480b24bbd7f947b43ea4810175046.title: Catch research errors, log, cap prompts
87eb5eb7a63480b24bbd7f947b43ea4810175046.summary: Wrapped research execution in try/catch block within main-prompt.ts. Errors return formatted string instead of throwing. Added logger.debug for successful runs. research.ts now caps prompts at maxPrompts=10 via slice.

8364c1755c3e8f79e43aa9e99c5cfc08144406b1.title: Compact ID generator uses 64-bit base64url
8364c1755c3e8f79e43aa9e99c5cfc08144406b1.summary: generateCompactId now produces 64-bit identifiers using 40 timestamp bits and 24 random bits, encoded as base64url (~11 chars). Replaces the previous 32-bit base36 scheme (~5-6 chars) to reduce collision risk and ensure URL safety. Updated in common/src/util/string.ts. Bitwise operations use BigInt to preserve full 64-bit precision.

df512fead49f7da75f8cf81837b34b7e39ea9cc4.title: Remove test directory from workspace
df512fead49f7da75f8cf81837b34b7e39ea9cc4.summary: Removes the `test` directory from the monorepo workspace configuration and deletes all associated mock data files. The `package.json` workspaces array drops the `test` entry, while `test/__mock-data__` containing action and app schemas is purged. This cleanup affects only the repository structure and internal test fixtures.

25737320854a10c0e05284c05d711f3c133d8611.title: generateCompactId drops BigInt
25737320854a10c0e05284c05d711f3c133d8611.summary: generateCompactId in common/src/util/string.ts replaces BigInt arithmetic with native Number operations for timestamp and random generation. The change avoids BigInt overhead by combining two 32-bit integers (timestamp, random) into a 64-bit hex string before converting to base64url. Internal refactor; ID format and collision resistance remain functionally equivalent.

4d433c8d0d500bf95a5c5753c6f08fac12b791be.title: Remove unproductive loop detection from main prompt
4d433c8d0d500bf95a5c5753c6f08fac12b791be.summary: Removed `checkForUnproductiveLoop` import and associated logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The code previously checked for consecutive assistant messages without `end_turn` calls and forced termination if a loop was detected. This mechanism is now disabled.

4d9e40f7c092b0135e56b8171b1b265500bd9fed.title: Fix extra checkpoints with submodules
4d9e40f7c092b0135e56b8171b1b265500bd9fed.summary: Refactored submodule handling in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` to prevent duplicate checkpoints. Extracted `exposeSubmodules` and `restoreSubmodules` helpers to temporarily rename `.git` directories and remove submodule entries from the index during status checks and staging. `hasUnsavedChanges` now relies exclusively on native git commands, removing the `isomorphic-git` fallback.

b6fd8c63140a17abf9b53e0f06b42c86fc0fee66.title: maxIterations caps loopMainPrompt and research agent loops
b6fd8c63140a17abf9b53e0f06b42c86fc0fee66.summary: Added maxIterations parameter to loopMainPrompt with DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS = 20, breaking the agent loop once iterations hit the cap. research.ts passes maxIterations = 10 into loopMainPrompt, replacing the previous agentStepsRemaining: 10 assignment. Backend only: loop-main-prompt.ts, research.ts. AgentStepsRemaining in AgentState still governs per-prompt step budget; maxIterations bounds the outer tool-call loop.

c07d48726435795bf1fa8d2c432fb6293514a308.text: The system now waits for startup settings to load before running commands. This prevents errors caused by missing environment details.

4d9e40f7c092b0135e56b8171b1b265500bd9fed.text: Fixed a small internal issue that caused the system to save duplicate backups when projects included nested folders. This change improves reliability and prevents clutter, but does not add new features for users.

df512fead49f7da75f8cf81837b34b7e39ea9cc4.text: The software's internal cleanup tools were updated to remove unused test data. This change affects only the behind-the-scenes setup and does not change how the product works for you.

df2b439018be96faa7142d9a7cd3b706cc079288.text: The loading messages now show three dots at the end, like 'Thinking...'. This is a small visual change to make the wait feel more active.

25737320854a10c0e05284c05d711f3c133d8611.text: The system now uses a faster, simpler method to create unique identifiers. This change is internal and does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

aac5b2350146850b8962175c788b529f22ce966a.text: A small internal update corrected how the system checks its own work when processing certain documents. This change does not affect how the product looks or functions for users.

87eb5eb7a63480b24bbd7f947b43ea4810175046.text: The assistant now handles research problems quietly, preventing crashes and limiting requests to ten, so the tool stays stable and responsive.

8364c1755c3e8f79e43aa9e99c5cfc08144406b1.text: The system now creates shorter, safer links for sharing items. This change reduces the chance of two people getting the same link and makes it easier to use on the web.

4d433c8d0d500bf95a5c5753c6f08fac12b791be.text: A safety feature that automatically stopped the assistant if it seemed stuck in a repetitive cycle has been removed. This change is internal and does not alter the assistant's core capabilities.

b6fd8c63140a17abf9b53e0f06b42c86fc0fee66.text: Added a limit to how many times the assistant can retry a task. This prevents endless loops and stops the system from using too many resources.

b8ceddac690afbc228b27371a86e248341a91e40.title: Add Loading spinner to checkpoint save
b8ceddac690afbc228b27371a86e248341a91e40.summary: Spinner label changed to 'Loading' during readyPromise wait in saveCheckpoint. Added 'Loading' spinner before awaiting readyPromise, moved 'Saving' spinner to start after waitForPreviousCheckpoint. Affects npm-app/src/cli-handlers/checkpoint.ts.

db5d4f0c2380c1f7611e751b59ca245bfbd7acd2.title: getGitChanges returns empty on missing git binary
db5d4f0c2380c1f7611e751b59ca245bfbd7acd2.summary: getGitChanges in npm-app/src/project-files.ts checks gitCommandIsAvailable() and returns empty strings for status, diff, diffCached, and lastCommitMessages when git is absent. Added explicit Promise return type to getGitChanges. Imported gitCommandIsAvailable from ./utils/git. Prevents execAsync failures on systems without git.

83880a24d1c3cac370970d5462d2df3b639421e2.title: Improve AI SDK error reporting in stream handler
83880a24d1c3cac370970d5462d2df3b639421e2.summary: Error handling in `promptAiSdkStream` now preserves the original error object by setting it as the `cause` when the error is an `Error` instance. Non-Error payloads are stringified with a consistent `Error from AI SDK:` prefix. This change applies to `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` and affects non-production environments only.

5b0bc2ee0c6750a08a79eade0d96ec883d7c1dc4.title: Tool renderers support callback return
5b0bc2ee0c6750a08a79eade0d96ec883d7c1dc4.summary: ToolCallRenderer interface updated to allow onToolStart, onParamStart, onParamChunk, onParamEnd, and onToolEnd to return void callbacks alongside string outputs. XML stream parser logic modified to execute returned functions when output is not a string. Affects npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts and npm-app/src/utils/xml-stream-parser.ts. Enables side-effect execution from renderer hooks without pushing to stream.

132bf926a3c2470e980eb5ce46eeab6dd706e400.title: Git evals clone guard and error logging
132bf926a3c2470e980eb5ce46eeab6dd706e400.summary: Added post-clone validation in setup-test-repo.ts to throw if .git directory missing. Updated run-git-evals.ts to log specific error context before rejection. Scope limited to evals/git-evals subsystem. Prevents silent failures during test repo setup.

a3673d4fd91b47f3b7608ca5ac280213e0619fd9.title: Improve git test repo setup auth and validation
a3673d4fd91b47f3b7608ca5ac280213e0619fd9.summary: The `setupTestRepo` function in `evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts` was rewritten to use `execFileSync` instead of `execSync` for safer command execution and added robust authentication handling for GitHub private repositories via `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN`. This change ensures test repos clone correctly in CI environments (GitHub Actions, Render) by converting SSH URLs to authenticated HTTPS and disabling interactive prompts. The function now includes explicit verification steps, checking for `.git` existence, `git status`, and commit history count, with detailed error logging and troubleshooting guidance for authentication failures.

a25a238939b4c0fe11835c0a3c59e8cf187002c6.title: Spinner text customization
a25a238939b4c0fe11835c0a3c59e8cf187002c6.summary: Spinner class accepts custom text via start() method. Default 'Thinking' replaced with context-specific labels like 'Restoring', 'Saving', 'Storing API Key', 'Using browser'. Updates applied across checkpoint handlers, CLI, client, and tool handlers. Removed unused log() method from Spinner.

2aa6b5383deb1e349339a045cf706e9c7fd3ff79.title: Terminal PTY logging captures full output
2aa6b5383deb1e349339a045cf706e9c7fd3ff79.summary: runSinglePtyCommand now returns fullOutput alongside filteredOutput in npm-app/src/terminal/base.ts. runCommandPty accumulates full output from cd, command, exit-code, and cwd probes into fullCombinedOutput. logger.error calls include fullExitCodeOutput or fullCombinedOutput when needle matches fail.

70fe182b1cb2be918bd0e2afa142c2294b1fdd27.title: Move build-tools into packages workspace
70fe182b1cb2be918bd0e2afa142c2294b1fdd27.summary: Relocated build-tools directory to packages/build-tools. Updated root package.json workspaces array to remove explicit build-tools entry, relying on packages/* glob. Adjusted project.json cwd fields and tsconfig.json extends path to reflect new location.

841b80ab4b870a94374df2dc2e14c6f9102347d1.title: Add Researching spinner, trim stream close tags
841b80ab4b870a94374df2dc2e14c6f9102347d1.summary: Replaced static 'Researching...' text with active Spinner component in tool-renderers.ts. Added trailing newlines to prompt lists. Removed trailing newline from auto-closed XML tags in xml-stream-parser.ts. Scope: npm-app UI, backend parser.

b8ceddac690afbc228b27371a86e248341a91e40.text: A small internal change improves how the app shows progress when saving your work. You now see a 'Loading' message while the app prepares, followed by a 'Saving' message once the actual save starts, so you know exactly what is happening.

5b0bc2ee0c6750a08a79eade0d96ec883d7c1dc4.text: The assistant can now perform actions directly while generating text, rather than just displaying it. This internal update allows certain tools to trigger background tasks automatically during responses.

83880a24d1c3cac370970d5462d2df3b639421e2.text: Internal error reporting improved. Non-Error payloads stringified with prefix. Affects non-production only.

841b80ab4b870a94374df2dc2e14c6f9102347d1.text: The app now shows a moving loading indicator while it searches for information. Small internal adjustments were made to how text is processed.

a25a238939b4c0fe11835c0a3c59e8cf187002c6.text: Loading messages now show specific actions like 'Saving' or 'Restoring' instead of a generic 'Thinking'. This small internal update helps you understand exactly what the app is doing.

132bf926a3c2470e980eb5ce46eeab6dd706e400.text: The system now checks if test files are ready before starting. If something is missing, it shows a clear error message instead of failing quietly.

2aa6b5383deb1e349339a045cf706e9c7fd3ff79.text: The system now records the complete output of terminal commands when errors occur. This allows support staff to diagnose issues more accurately without changing how the product behaves for you.

70fe182b1cb2be918bd0e2afa142c2294b1fdd27.text: The team moved a small internal tool to a new folder. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

a3673d4fd91b47f3b7608ca5ac280213e0619fd9.text: A small internal update fixes how the system connects to private data sources during testing. This ensures the assistant can reliably access necessary information without getting stuck on security checks.

db5d4f0c2380c1f7611e751b59ca245bfbd7acd2.text: The app now checks if a required background tool is missing and stops trying to use it. This prevents errors on computers that do not have the tool installed.

fa845457b7f7ee385a2742e9514707aea22d876b.title: Clean up evals console logs
fa845457b7f7ee385a2742e9514707aea22d876b.summary: Trims verbose status messages in `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` and `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`. Removes references to 'sequentially' and hardcoded concurrency limits ('max 20') from `console.log` calls to reduce noise. Scope limited to internal evaluation scripts.

1f3755c0c96867ce04ebd78d17c16f61052cc7d2.title: infisical-run executor loads TS directly
1f3755c0c96867ce04ebd78d17c16f61052cc7d2.summary: Switched `@codebuff/build-tools:infisical-run` implementation from `./dist/executors/infisical-run/executor.js` to `./executors/infisical-run/executor.ts`. Removed `dependsOn: ["@codebuff/build-tools:build"]` from the `evals` project target to eliminate build dependency for eval execution. This change affects `build-tools/executors.json` and `evals/project.json`. The executor now relies on runtime TypeScript compilation rather than pre-built artifacts.

ae93fb9037b77824d4f83612a95332ecd9808060.title: Eval data paths use absolute paths in run-eval-set.ts
ae93fb9037b77824d4f83612a95332ecd9808060.summary: Updated `evalDataPath` in `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` to use `path.join(__dirname, ...)` instead of relative strings. This ensures eval JSON files are resolved correctly regardless of the current working directory when running the script. Scope limited to internal eval runner configuration.

abc62735a6c1356953de5dc78deb7bb0a394fd7b.title: Fix duplicated chat directory in npm-app worker context
abc62735a6c1356953de5dc78deb7bb0a394fd7b.summary: Refactored `project-files.ts` to enforce a singleton `currentChatId` and pass this ID to the `project-context.ts` worker via `postMessage`. The worker now calls `setChatIdFromExternal` to align its state with the main thread before processing files. This prevents race conditions where the worker and main thread generated different timestamp-based IDs, causing writes to duplicate chat directories.

1807375bb53c78d2a9eb6c1134ebf0ee1058d28f.title: Pass modelConfig to git evals child process
1807375bb53c78d2a9eb6c1134ebf0ee1058d28f.summary: The `fork` call in `runGitEvals` now serializes `modelConfig` to JSON and passes it as the fifth argument to the child process. This fixes a broken merge by ensuring the eval runner has access to the correct model configuration. The change is isolated to `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` and does not affect public APIs or user-facing behavior.

7cbac9a2d89aa8b248701d95de168616cb50c26b.title: Evals: hardcode API endpoint
7cbac9a2d89aa8b248701d95de168616cb50c26b.summary: In evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts, API_BASE now hardcodes http://localhost:3000/. Previous fallback to NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL removed. Scope limited to internal eval runner.

9da3544686236b416ac81189fc7db12c5a165403.title: Fix evals git setup to reset repos missing .git directory
9da3544686236b416ac81189fc7db12c5a165403.summary: setupTestRepo in evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts now checks for .git existence instead of just repoDir. If directory exists but lacks .git, it recursively deletes the folder before cloning. Prevents clone failures when previous runs left partial or corrupted test repos.

bcd24d28ecd1f45921ad9f729c7cbf458b5590a1.title: Add explicit build-tools dependency to infisical-run targets
bcd24d28ecd1f45921ad9f729c7cbf458b5590a1.summary: Added `@codebuff/build-tools:build` to `dependsOn` for all `@codebuff/build-tools:infisical-run` targets across backend, common, evals, npm-app, packages/billing, and web project.json files. This ensures the build-tools executor is compiled before any task attempts to invoke it, preventing race conditions or missing executor errors during Nx task execution.

47e63753ac5af6cc5cd5ee6019db93c2341299cf.title: Reorder git checkpoint nested repo handling
47e63753ac5af6cc5cd5ee6019db93c2341299cf.summary: The `gitAddAllIgnoringNestedRepos` function in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` was refactored to change the execution order of git operations. `gitAddAll` now runs after identifying modified files and removing them from the index, rather than before. This ensures nested repo `.git` directories are backed up and restored correctly relative to the file staging process.

fdcdf800aad9c6dffb6e1c35e61ffa8eb87c2ee7.title: Remove explicit build-tools dependency from infisical-run targets
fdcdf800aad9c6dffb6e1c35e61ffa8eb87c2ee7.summary: Reverts the addition of `dependsOn: ["@codebuff/build-tools:build"]` to all `infisical-run` executor targets across backend, common, evals, npm-app, billing, and web projects. The explicit dependency was removed from `project.json` files, likely resolving build graph issues or redundancy introduced in a previous fix. This change affects the Nx build orchestration for these specific targets.

abc62735a6c1356953de5dc78deb7bb0a394fd7b.text: Fixed a bug where chat files were saved to duplicate folders. Your chat history now stores in one correct location.

bcd24d28ecd1f45921ad9f729c7cbf458b5590a1.text: A small internal fix prevents occasional startup errors when running the software.

ae93fb9037b77824d4f83612a95332ecd9808060.text: A small internal fix ensures the evaluation system finds its data files correctly, no matter where the script is run from. This change does not affect how the product behaves for users.

1807375bb53c78d2a9eb6c1134ebf0ee1058d28f.text: A small internal fix ensures the system checks model accuracy using the correct settings. This change has no visible effect on the product.

fa845457b7f7ee385a2742e9514707aea22d876b.text: Internal cleanup work reduced unnecessary text in the system's background logs. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

47e63753ac5af6cc5cd5ee6019db93c2341299cf.text: Internal fix reorders how the app saves files during checkpoints. Nested project folders now back up correctly. No user-visible changes.

7cbac9a2d89aa8b248701d95de168616cb50c26b.text: Internal testing tools now always check the local copy of the app, not the live version. This change affects only how developers test features and does not impact your experience.

9da3544686236b416ac81189fc7db12c5a165403.text: A small internal fix improves how test data is set up. It prevents errors from leftover files that could make the system unstable.

fdcdf800aad9c6dffb6e1c35e61ffa8eb87c2ee7.text: The system stopped checking a specific internal setup step before starting certain tasks. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

1f3755c0c96867ce04ebd78d17c16f61052cc7d2.text: The tool now reads its instructions directly, skipping a separate preparation step. This internal change makes the system run more simply.

7f4759152d3d6155ab17a1e6aef97fa839f11efb.title: Limit buffbench concurrency to 10
7f4759152d3d6155ab17a1e6aef97fa839f11efb.summary: Reduced global concurrency limit in `evals/git-evals/run-eval-set.ts` from 20 to 10. Call to `setGlobalConcurrencyLimit` updated. Import statements reformatted for readability.

97c512708414a56938ebbe864642895fdbd2246b.title: Fix escaped commit message parsing in evals.yml
97c512708414a56938ebbe864642895fdbd2246b.summary: Refactored commit message check in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` to use environment variable `COMMIT_MESSAGE` instead of direct interpolation `${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}`. Prevents YAML injection and parsing errors from special characters in commit messages. Scope limited to CI workflow evaluation trigger logic.

c4c187769c73e73062c9573a1486dbd5787d7679.title: Cap git evals concurrency to 20
c4c187769c73e73062c9573a1486dbd5787d7679.summary: Git evals now limit concurrent processes to 20 via a global `p-limit` instance shared across repositories. `run-eval-set.ts` initializes the limiter, and `run-git-evals.ts` enforces it, replacing previous unbounded parallel execution. Dependency `p-limit` added to `evals/package.json`. This prevents resource exhaustion during large-scale evaluation runs.

7d08f24b7939469a6bb9807a009b11e887bee60a.title: evals task dependsOn build-tools:build
7d08f24b7939469a6bb9807a009b11e887bee60a.summary: Added dependsOn constraint to evals task in evals/project.json. Ensures @codebuff/build-tools:build completes before infisical-run executes run-eval-set.ts. Scope limited to evals project configuration.

0275ec9804c5514f3ff2beb4f2eb9faed02d7ff8.title: Introduce @codebuff/build-tools infisical-run executor
0275ec9804c5514f3ff2beb4f2eb9faed02d7ff8.summary: Added `@codebuff/build-tools:infisical-run` Nx executor to standardize Infisical CLI usage across `backend`, `common`, and `evals` project targets. The executor checks for `infisical` availability via `command -v` and falls back to direct execution if missing, removing inline shell conditionals from `package.json` scripts. Updated `backend/project.json`, `common/project.json`, and `evals/project.json` to delegate `start`, `dev`, `db:*`, and `*git-evals` commands to this new executor.

cedfe34b881aed3644851cf55fdabfa29b6ba164.title: evals workflow always runs on GH Actions
cedfe34b881aed3644851cf55fdabfa29b6ba164.summary: Removed job-level if condition from .github/workflows/evals.yml, ensuring the workflow triggers on every push. Added a 'Check commit message' step to set should_run_evals output based on [buffbench] presence. Applied conditional execution to all subsequent steps (Setup Bun, Cache, Install, Env, Run evals) to skip heavy operations if flag is false. Adds final 'Workflow completed' step to guarantee job success even when evals are skipped.

5bc5336e85d1d696c5ad4cef471144dde8d91046.title: Eval test repo directory naming flattened
5bc5336e85d1d696c5ad4cef471144dde8d91046.summary: Changed `setupTestRepo` in `evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts` to use a flat directory name `${repoName}-${commitSha}` instead of nested `repoName/commitSha`. This simplifies path construction for test repositories. Scope limited to internal eval setup logic.

6c31588bc5e211b48a3a96148febfa2bfd5237c8.title: Wrap evals.yml conditionals in expression syntax
6c31588bc5e211b48a3a96148febfa2bfd5237c8.summary: Updated `if` conditions in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` to use `${{ ... }}` expression syntax. GitHub Actions now requires explicit expression delimiters for step conditionals to prevent parsing ambiguities. Affects CI evaluation pipeline steps including setup, caching, and execution.

3feed691233fe92ca9c52ed90ce0ee8ee9f2d0ba.title: Refactor eval model config and add metrics
3feed691233fe92ca9c52ed90ce0ee8ee9f2d0ba.summary: Eval harness now supports explicit `modelConfig` (agent/reasoning models) passed to `mainPrompt`, overriding default cost-mode selection. `getAgentStream` signature updated to return stream directly, shifting model resolution logic to `common/constants` via new `getModelFromShortName` helper. `GitEvalMetadata` schema extended with `avgCompletion`, `avgEfficiency`, `avgCodeQuality`, `avgDuration`, and `avgTurns` fields. Eval runner aggregates these metrics from trace data before database insertion.

61268ac205708796f1b4f18854e1300bc3aec722.title: Add result logging to run-single-eval-process
61268ac205708796f1b4f18854e1300bc3aec722.summary: Added console.log for final eval result in run-single-eval-process.ts. Import order for fs adjusted. Improves visibility into eval process outcomes.

c4c187769c73e73062c9573a1486dbd5787d7679.text: The system now limits the number of background tasks running at once to prevent it from slowing down or crashing during heavy use. This small internal change helps keep the product stable.

6c31588bc5e211b48a3a96148febfa2bfd5237c8.text: This small internal update fixed how automated checks start. It does not change what you see or use.

97c512708414a56938ebbe864642895fdbd2246b.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system reads certain messages to prevent errors. This change is invisible to you, but it helps keep the service running smoothly.

7f4759152d3d6155ab17a1e6aef97fa839f11efb.text: The system now processes fewer tasks at once to prevent overload. This internal change helps keep things running smoothly.

5bc5336e85d1d696c5ad4cef471144dde8d91046.text: The system now uses simpler names for internal test folders. This change only affects how the software checks itself behind the scenes.

0275ec9804c5514f3ff2beb4f2eb9faed02d7ff8.text: The system now handles setup checks automatically instead of using messy manual instructions. This internal cleanup makes the software easier to maintain but does not change how you use it.

7d08f24b7939469a6bb9807a009b11e887bee60a.text: The system now checks that all necessary setup steps finish before running tests. This prevents occasional failures when starting internal evaluations.

61268ac205708796f1b4f18854e1300bc3aec722.text: A small internal update makes the system record the outcome of certain evaluations. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

3feed691233fe92ca9c52ed90ce0ee8ee9f2d0ba.text: The system now tracks average performance metrics like completion and efficiency for better insights. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

d94df780116b6156f0a7b77744a009d7b905d6b8.title: Git evals print completion immediately
d94df780116b6156f0a7b77744a009d7b905d6b8.summary: run-git-evals.ts prints completion status inside the message handler rather than after Promise.allSettled. Removes the pre-allocated evalRuns array in favor of filtering fulfilled results post-execution. Affects evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. Logging now occurs per-commit during async execution, decoupling output order from final aggregation.

a150b4e20295d8f907ba8d42f155d5c673decfcd.title: Skip nested repo backup if .git missing
a150b4e20295d8f907ba8d42f155d5c673decfcd.summary: Checkpoint file manager skips nested repos without .git directory. `git rm --cached` wrapped in try-catch to log errors. Prevents crashes during backup of non-git subdirectories.

ac79e41ed0b901cae39368732e5b81fff7238729.title: Eval runner delays exit by 2s to prevent race conditions
ac79e41ed0b901cae39368732e5b81fff7238729.summary: The `run-single-eval-process.ts` script in the `evals/git-evals` directory now delays process termination by 2 seconds using `setTimeout` before calling `process.exit(0)`. This change mitigates race conditions where child processes might not have fully flushed output or completed cleanup tasks before the parent process terminates. The scope is limited to the internal evaluation harness.

45ccb2377f64a4ca6a029156117dd0f8eb46a462.title: start-web script now runs start-db first
45ccb2377f64a4ca6a029156117dd0f8eb46a462.summary: start-web script updated to bun start-db && bun --cwd web dev. Ensures database initialization before web dev server launch. Scope: package.json scripts.

df27c6b9e9aef7642b9eda8e0bf51b528f74ac9f.title: Print error from git evals
df27c6b9e9aef7642b9eda8e0bf51b528f74ac9f.summary: Adds `console.error` logging for error messages in `run-git-evals.ts`. Logs stack trace and full message object before rejecting. Removes manual stack assignment to error object.

c54707e4cb86937db504b0d826f53eea9f804b10.title: Remove partial json save in git evals
c54707e4cb86937db504b0d826f53eea9f804b10.summary: Removes partial JSON result saving logic from run-git-evals.ts. Eliminates intermediate file writes during evaluation runs. Updates run-eval-set.ts to restore email sending flag and remove hardcoded limits.

d376339de7eb134ec935207ad6aa19b2868f9d8a.title: Add repo name to git eval log
d376339de7eb134ec935207ad6aa19b2868f9d8a.summary: Git eval runner now prefixes `Starting` log line with `testRepoName` variable. Distinguishes evals across multiple repos in parallel runs. Affects `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts`.

28470c3a9e8357389394996924268aed29a67730.title: Fix arg list too long in git evals fork
28470c3a9e8357389394996924268aed29a67730.summary: Git evals fork now passes `evalCommit` via temp file path instead of JSON string argument. Prevents `E2BIG` when commit data exceeds OS arg length limits. Affects `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` and `run-single-eval-process.ts`. Temp file cleanup runs on child message receipt.

cf98ac954a3a21f6fb791b77cf3bde6fd0770b41.title: Parallelize git evals
cf98ac954a3a21f6fb791b77cf3bde6fd0770b41.summary: Refactored `run-eval-set.ts` to execute git evaluations in parallel using `Promise.allSettled` instead of sequential loops. Updated `run-git-evals.ts` to improve log naming by sanitizing commit messages and including repo names in log directories. CI timeout for evals reduced from 360 to 180 minutes in `.github/workflows/evals.yml` to accommodate parallel execution speedups.

3287b282081f25efe4bb87a438c8108859d0c07e.title: Parallel git evals via child process fork
3287b282081f25efe4bb87a438c8108859d0c07e.summary: Git evals now run in parallel by forking child processes via `run-single-eval-process.ts` instead of sequential execution. `setupTestRepo` isolates checkouts per commit SHA and skips re-cloning if the directory exists. `run-eval-set.ts` uncomments the 'manifold' eval and removes the 'codebuff' limit. Internal test infrastructure change; no user-facing impact.

d376339de7eb134ec935207ad6aa19b2868f9d8a.text: Internal logging change. Helps distinguish test runs.

c54707e4cb86937db504b0d826f53eea9f804b10.text: The system now waits to save all results at once instead of saving them piece by piece. This internal cleanup ensures evaluation data is complete and consistent.

df27c6b9e9aef7642b9eda8e0bf51b528f74ac9f.text: Internal change. The system now records clearer error details when a background check fails. This helps the support team diagnose problems faster.

ac79e41ed0b901cae39368732e5b81fff7238729.text: The internal tool now waits briefly before closing. This prevents lost data during background checks. No visible change for users.

3287b282081f25efe4bb87a438c8108859d0c07e.text: Internal testing tools now run checks at the same time instead of one after another. This speeds up team work, but changes nothing for you.

cf98ac954a3a21f6fb791b77cf3bde6fd0770b41.text: The system now checks updates in batches instead of one by one, making the process faster. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

28470c3a9e8357389394996924268aed29a67730.text: Fixed a rare crash when processing very large data sets.

45ccb2377f64a4ca6a029156117dd0f8eb46a462.text: The startup process now prepares the data storage before loading the application. This small internal change ensures the system starts reliably.

d94df780116b6156f0a7b77744a009d7b905d6b8.text: Internal change. Progress updates now appear as each check finishes, not all at once at the end.

a150b4e20295d8f907ba8d42f155d5c673decfcd.text: The app now skips saving folders that are not part of the project history. This prevents errors when backing up certain internal files.

11e80bd9328da522db4e8cc400514c22a75e3d4a.title: Sonnet restored as default agent model; Gemini moved to experimental
11e80bd9328da522db4e8cc400514c22a75e3d4a.summary: Agent mode defaults for normal and max cost settings revert to Sonnet, while Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview shifts to experimental. This adjustment in common/src/constants.ts prioritizes Sonnet for standard agent operations. The change affects core model resolution logic for agent tasks.

43ca5a4369d2c74e7dcb209b0cab1db2cecdfff6.title: Relax NEXTPUBLICBACKENDURL validation in env.ts
43ca5a4369d2c74e7dcb209b0cab1db2cecdfff6.summary: Changed NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL schema from z.string().url() to z.string().min(1) in env.ts. The strict URL check rejected valid non-standard backend endpoints. Scope limited to client environment validation. Next step: verify deployment configs.

e71a0c76c384f58a533c7df9415092a95a800006.title: Add git eval leaderboard
e71a0c76c384f58a533c7df9415092a95a800006.summary: Added `git_eval_results` table via migration `0020_young_sleeper.sql` to store git evaluation metrics. Includes new API route `web/src/app/api/git-evals/route.ts` and UI page `web/src/app/evals/page.tsx` for displaying results. Eval runner scripts `evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts` and `run-eval-set.ts` handle execution and data population.

5f1ed18014f89acdedf814cf55b5b51da417f550.title: Add 6 hour timeout to evals CI workflow
5f1ed18014f89acdedf814cf55b5b51da417f550.summary: Added `timeout-minutes: 360` to the `run-evals` job in `.github/workflows/evals.yml`. This enforces a 6-hour limit on evaluation runs triggered by commits containing `[buffbench]`. The change applies only to the CI workflow configuration.

d725527ba6f5b22819ba432096aec4fd9b2cddb9.title: Fix AI SDK error serialization
d725527ba6f5b22819ba432096aec4fd9b2cddb9.summary: ai-sdk.ts now stringifies object errors via JSON.stringify instead of casting to string. Prevents '[object Object]' in thrown exceptions. Internal fix in vercel-ai-sdk stream handler.

950cd5b9b5e7ee83e66fb9e5869eaaf0c185bb27.title: Remove unused @/env path mapping from tsconfig.base.json
950cd5b9b5e7ee83e66fb9e5869eaaf0c185bb27.summary: Removed the `@/env` path mapping from `tsconfig.base.json`. This cleanup eliminates an unused alias that pointed to a non-existent or unimported `./env.ts` file. The change affects the base TypeScript configuration used across the repo, ensuring path aliases reflect actual imports. No runtime behavior changes.

d38f9086cbe320727643780ba29111952f098661.title: web: start bypasses Nx
d38f9086cbe320727643780ba29111952f098661.summary: web/package.json start and discord:start scripts now invoke next start and bun run scripts/discord/index.ts directly. web/project.json start and discord:start executors removed. Eliminates Nx indirection for local web and discord service startup.

18f6326560ecc0e2ad9f6488a4a3ed7666fed0ec.title: Fix web build perf via env string coercion and dynamic route flags
18f6326560ecc0e2ad9f6488a4a3ed7666fed0ec.summary: Next.js config coerces all env values to strings via Object.fromEntries, replacing manual PORT handling. Admin org routes force dynamic rendering with export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'. Feed API Substack schema allows nullable cover_image. Changes confined to web/next.config.mjs and web/src/app/api routes.

08d9ecfdfbc411d9281fe3a7476b732bc412485b.title: Add Evals GitHub Actions workflow
08d9ecfdfbc411d9281fe3a7476b732bc412485b.summary: New `.github/workflows/evals.yml` triggers `bun run --cwd evals run-eval-set` on pushes containing `[buffbench]` in commit message. Uses `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` (1.2.12) and `actions/cache@v3` for `node_modules`. Injects secrets via `scripts/generate-ci-env.js` and `jq`, setting `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT=test`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_INFISICAL_UP=true`, and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN`.

668035297dccf48b348d35b23ec1fb68661d6851.title: Parallel research tool spawns read-only sub-agents before planning
668035297dccf48b348d35b23ec1fb68661d6851.summary: Adds a `research` tool that accepts a JSON array of prompts to run parallel information-gathering tasks. Each sub-agent uses `loopMainPrompt` in `lite` mode with `readOnlyMode: true`, suppressing analytics and restricting to read-only tools. `main-prompt.ts` now uses a `MainPromptOptions` object; ASK-mode instructions direct agents to use `research` instead of answering directly. `create_plan` instructions mandate running `research` first. `end_turn` removed from `TOOLS_WHICH_END_THE_RESPONSE` in favor of `research`.

d725527ba6f5b22819ba432096aec4fd9b2cddb9.text: This small internal fix ensures the assistant shows clear error messages instead of confusing text when a problem occurs.

08d9ecfdfbc411d9281fe3a7476b732bc412485b.text: Internal update: automated quality checks now run when specific changes are submitted. This helps catch errors before they reach you.

950cd5b9b5e7ee83e66fb9e5869eaaf0c185bb27.text: We cleaned up a small internal setting that was no longer needed. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

43ca5a4369d2c74e7dcb209b0cab1db2cecdfff6.text: The software now accepts a wider range of internal addresses for its backend service. This fixes a problem where valid but unusual connections were previously rejected.

e71a0c76c384f58a533c7df9415092a95a800006.text: The system now tracks performance for specific tasks. This allows users to see how well the software handles these activities.

d38f9086cbe320727643780ba29111952f098661.text: The team removed an extra step from the process that starts the website and chat bot. This internal cleanup makes the services launch slightly faster and more directly.

5f1ed18014f89acdedf814cf55b5b51da417f550.text: A small internal update limits evaluation runs to six hours. This prevents long processes from running indefinitely.

11e80bd9328da522db4e8cc400514c22a75e3d4a.text: The assistant now uses its standard model for most tasks, while a newer experimental model is hidden from general use. This change improves reliability for everyday requests.

18f6326560ecc0e2ad9f6488a4a3ed7666fed0ec.text: The website now loads faster and more reliably by simplifying how it handles internal settings. Users will experience a smoother, quicker browsing session.

2b543527d01642e2324fed04cadf4a46d17e674f.title: Add ESLint deps and clean task to appease npm-app build
2b543527d01642e2324fed04cadf4a46d17e674f.summary: Added eslint-config-prettier, eslint-plugin-import, and typescript-eslint to devDependencies to resolve npm-app build errors. Introduced a clean target in project.json to remove dist and dist-env directories. Scope limited to root package.json and project.json configuration.

754532c99e33cdd53f0bd03a821801d75d8f3635.title: Add instructions param to writefile tool
754532c99e33cdd53f0bd03a821801d75d8f3635.summary: Added `instructions` parameter to `write_file` tool schema and implementation. Propagates user intent to `processFileBlock` and `fastRewrite` for better edit accuracy. Updates CLI renderer to display instructions alongside file paths.

19ca4cb6372db69115d8ea599697dc06ab2a23c1.title: Fix npm-app deploy env injection and tsconfig
19ca4cb6372db69115d8ea599697dc06ab2a23c1.summary: Refactored `npm-app/clean-package.js` to dynamically parse client-side environment keys from `env.ts` instead of hardcoding `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefixes, ensuring correct variable injection into `dist/index.js`. Updated `prepublishOnly` script to run `nx clean` and wrap execution with `infisical run --env=prod`, moving secrets handling out of the root `deploy:npm-app` script. Added `common` to root `tsconfig.json` references and adjusted `common` and `backend` tsconfigs for incremental builds and path resolution.

e489a748c481fd8b8ceb5058f18569b352f6cb49.title: Fix npm-app build order for tsc-alias and add dependency
e489a748c481fd8b8ceb5058f18569b352f6cb49.summary: Reordered npm-app build commands to run `tsc-alias` after copying `common` and `code-map` dists. Added `tsc-alias` to root `package.json` dependencies. This ensures path aliases resolve correctly in the final bundle. Affects `npm-app/project.json` and `package.json`.

04a2166f8b5c70a58a0466038bcd58ea7978c4e7.title: Add NEXTPUBLICBACKENDURL to env schema
04a2166f8b5c70a58a0466038bcd58ea7978c4e7.summary: Added `NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` to the client-side environment validation in `env.ts`. This ensures the backend URL is explicitly required and validated for the npm-app. The `package.json` for `npm-app` also received a new `start-js` script to build and run the JavaScript output.

4408b769103ee2e3aa047eb0b7536a7ee198c638.title: start-js script updated to include clean-package step
4408b769103ee2e3aa047eb0b7536a7ee198c638.summary: The `start-js` script in `npm-app/package.json` now executes `bun run clean-package.js` after building. This step was missing, causing stale artifacts to persist during the transition to the JavaScript entrypoint. The change ensures a clean state before `node` launches `dist/index.js` via `tsconfig-paths`. Scope limited to `npm-app` build scripts.

c5dd22f472223c5d2350c99c64094b5c323a6345.title: Revert git-evals COSTMODE to normal
c5dd22f472223c5d2350c99c64094b5c323a6345.summary: Reverts COST_MODE constant from 'experimental' to 'normal' in evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. This change affects the internal evaluation harness for Git-based tasks. The modification ensures evaluations run under standard cost parameters rather than experimental settings.

da92ba9d348e354fa12c8b2bd24d530b80ab0356.title: Downgrade tsc-alias to 1.7.0
da92ba9d348e354fa12c8b2bd24d530b80ab0356.summary: tsc-alias pinned to 1.7.0 in package.json. Reverts ^1.8.16 range to resolve CI build error. Scoped to repo build config.

9007dc17e64b15a73ec007cf443d64ccba17b765.title: Fix evals import paths and add infisical wrapper
9007dc17e64b15a73ec007cf443d64ccba17b765.summary: Relative import paths replace absolute module aliases in `evals/git-evals/*` and `evals/scaffolding.ts`. Package scripts in `evals/package.json` now conditionally wrap execution with `infisical run` if the binary exists. `scaffolding.ts` adds a default export for helper functions.

f7d34f17c69f0bb8e2aa5e69238a0d3a689906c1.title: Log vercel ai sdk stream errors
f7d34f17c69f0bb8e2aa5e69238a0d3a689906c1.summary: Added error logging for 'error' chunks in vercel ai sdk stream responses. Uses `logger.error` to record the chunk. Throws the error in non-prod environments to surface issues during development. Covers `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`.

4408b769103ee2e3aa047eb0b7536a7ee198c638.text: The startup process now clears old files before loading new ones. This prevents errors caused by leftover data from previous versions.

754532c99e33cdd53f0bd03a821801d75d8f3635.text: The assistant now receives clearer instructions when saving or updating files. This helps it make more accurate changes based on what you want.

f7d34f17c69f0bb8e2aa5e69238a0d3a689906c1.text: The system now records errors that occur during AI responses to help developers fix issues faster. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for users.

19ca4cb6372db69115d8ea599697dc06ab2a23c1.text: The app now automatically finds and loads the right settings for different environments, fixing a bug where some features might not work correctly. This ensures the app behaves as expected without requiring any action from you.
