This aligns the test suite with the current `processStreamWithTags` implementation, which no longer emits that diagnostic for the 'test' tag. Scope limited to backend unit tests.

ff94f9b459190ac8962fe83774f0e0fdd67b4d1c.title: Add typecheck runs for backend npm-app common
ff94f9b459190ac8962fe83774f0e0fdd67b4d1c.summary: Added `backend-typecheck`, `npm-typecheck`, and `common-typecheck` to `codebuff.json`. Each invokes `bun run typecheck-only` in its respective directory, matching existing `*.ts` files. This extends automated type validation coverage across core packages.

9addae7a5cdff64a2d5cedd9cb11f4cd9f4c2fad.title: Add unit tests for json-config constants
9addae7a5cdff64a2d5cedd9cb11f4cd9f4c2fad.summary: Added comprehensive unit tests for `CodebuffConfigSchema`, `StartupProcessSchema`, and `FileChangeHook` in `common/src/json-config/__tests__/constants.test.ts`. Tests verify schema validation logic, default values (e.g., `enabled: true`, `maxAgentSteps: 12`), and rejection of invalid inputs like empty names or commands. Scope limited to shared core config definitions. Ensures robust parsing of `codebuff.json` and backup files.

143623d373dd5e0f6e42638cd3d21b98edc048f0.title: Remove verifying checks prompt from main-prompt
143623d373dd5e0f6e42638cd3d21b98edc048f0.summary: Delete mandatory 'verify changes' instruction block from `mainPrompt` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This removes the directive forcing agents to run tests/lint/browser logs before finishing responses in non-lite mode. The corresponding 'Verifying changes' section is also stripped from `knowledge.md`. Agents now rely on explicit user requests or `codebuff.json` triggers for verification.

bd5503188e6c85e04e2936af3eadbcd43fcf42ea.title: Add ftfilepicker010 finetuned model for experimental file picking
bd5503188e6c85e04e2936af3eadbcd43fcf42ea.summary: New Vertex AI finetuned models `ft_filepicker_010` and `ft_filepicker_010_epoch_2` added to `common/src/constants.ts`. The file picker backend in `backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts` now routes `experimental` cost mode to `ft_filepicker_010` and applies `castAssistantMessage` preprocessing to convert assistant history into user messages, aligning with the model's training format. `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` updated to accept specific `FinetunedVertexModel` IDs instead of a boolean flag. Offline scoring scripts in `scripts/ft-file-selection/` include the new models for comparison.

5014af4859bbde92fd438d261f1a1fd362e106f4.title: Superagent manager mode adds killterminal and sleep tools
5014af4859bbde92fd438d261f1a1fd362e106f4.summary: Added manager-prompt.ts and manager-system-prompt.ts to enable a supervisory agent mode that orchestrates coding tasks via terminal commands. New kill_terminal and sleep tools allow forceful process termination and execution pausing, restricted to agent mode. run_terminal_command schema relaxed to permit empty commands for timeout handling. Scope covers backend prompt logic, tool definitions, and websocket routing.

d4329f12325cc6be7e1acca7136dad5109f4728c.text: Building the app now clears out old files before creating new ones. This prevents leftover data from causing errors or confusing results.

a6f1cafd2ffe93167338a3b7512b8cb05fe4d835.text: The app now stays quiet when saving your first checkpoint, instead of showing a confusing error. This is a small internal fix that reduces unnecessary messages for new users.

143623d373dd5e0f6e42638cd3d21b98edc048f0.text: The assistant no longer automatically checks its work after answering. It will only do this if you ask.

8328215807fd545487b12ec415ded2afdceb3920.text: Deleted a test that checked for a specific log message. This is a small internal change. It does not affect how the product works.

1ff848fc63f3ee45f56592a856b410f600544afa.text: A small internal fix corrected a mismatch between the system's description of its file change settings and how it actually stores them. This change does not affect how you use the product.

9addae7a5cdff64a2d5cedd9cb11f4cd9f4c2fad.text: Added checks to ensure the app's settings load correctly. This helps prevent errors when starting the program or using custom configurations.

5014af4859bbde92fd438d261f1a1fd362e106f4.text: The assistant gained a supervisor mode that can manage coding tasks by stopping programs or pausing them. This allows the software to better control how long processes run and when to end them.

489ef82e6834cd8f830f72df2c3092415b6b990f.text: The setup tool now includes an empty section for custom file actions in new projects. This internal fix ensures the project structure matches the expected format.

ff94f9b459190ac8962fe83774f0e0fdd67b4d1c.text: The team added automatic safety checks to the software's inner workings. This internal improvement helps catch errors before they reach you.

6feaf6ed6e79c832e43abae1e26a1cfb6376a433.title: Set project root in checkpoint worker
6feaf6ed6e79c832e43abae1e26a1cfb6376a433.summary: Added `setProjectRoot` call in `checkpoint-worker.ts` before checkpoint operations. Ensures file state functions resolve paths correctly within the worker context.

44c427d4ae7ec6898a37ff4a106d4e26db7c4414.title: codebuff.json unit test hooks suppress pass/skip lines
44c427d4ae7ec6898a37ff4a106d4e26db7c4414.summary: The `backend-unit-tests`, `npm-app-unit-tests`, and `common-unit-tests` hooks in `codebuff.json` now pipe `bun test` output through `grep -Ev` filters. These filters strip ANSI escape codes and lines matching `pass` or `skip` patterns to reduce noise in hook output. `set -o pipefail` ensures the hook still fails if the underlying test command exits non-zero.

a3b028d976a689de8d51f855df29cf7aeda271ae.title: Strip ANSI colors from terminal command output
a3b028d976a689de8d51f855df29cf7aeda271ae.summary: ANSI escape sequences are stripped from stdout in formatResult via stripColors before truncation. Prevents agent confusion from raw control characters. Affects npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts. Truncation limit COMMAND_OUTPUT_LIMIT applies to clean text.

2972b73cabb2fec16e7fe93dceef6e1e8abed691.title: Swap typecheck hooks for unit tests in backend npm-app common
2972b73cabb2fec16e7fe93dceef6e1e8abed691.summary: Replaced typecheck commands with `bun test` execution for `backend`, `npm-app`, and added `common` in `codebuff.json`. Hooks now target `src/*.test.ts` files, explicitly excluding `*.integration.test.ts`. This ensures unit test coverage triggers on file changes across these subsystems instead of static analysis.

609a06c6ced4ea40f2a0218260008dde32837f45.title: tools.ts updatesubgoal edit snippet instructions
609a06c6ced4ea40f2a0218260008dde32837f45.summary: update_subgoal tool prompt in backend/src/tools.ts tightened for fast-apply model parsing. MUST capitalized, finetuned smaller model named, detailed apply instructions banned. Placeholder comment format simplified to // ... existing code ... to minimize content parameter characters.

1a11d023861aafcfb59e659582919ade23c7b3bc.title: Remove stream-end tool close warning
1a11d023861aafcfb59e659582919ade23c7b3bc.summary: Removed the `onError` callback in `backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts` that logged an INFO message when `processStreamWithTags` reached the end of the stream while a tool was still open. The parser still appends the missing closing tag and yields it, but no longer surfaces the warning to the user. This internal change reduces noise in the backend logs without altering the core parsing logic.

780ac80ca3a0dae5b1eb0bff6874c03aa8837e08.title: Clarify edit snippet prompt for fast-apply model
780ac80ca3a0dae5b1eb0bff6874c03aa8837e08.summary: Updated `tools.test.ts.snap` to enforce strict formatting for the 'fast-apply' model. The prompt now explicitly forbids detailed application instructions and standardizes placeholder comments to `// ... existing code ...`. This ensures the finetuned smaller model correctly parses edit snippets without ambiguity.

7075ddbb9d540293df8c3b8ca479b4543a2e5f57.title: Temp pty debug log gated to local
7075ddbb9d540293df8c3b8ca479b4543a2e5f57.summary: Added temporary debug logging to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` within `createPersistantProcess`. Logs all pty data to `debug/terminal.log` when `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT` equals `local`. Uses `fs.appendFileSync` with JSON-stringified data and timestamps.

bc19f676ad3ea7db58df4f59f929fcb624b4aeb6.title: Fix fileChangeHook bugs
bc19f676ad3ea7db58df4f59f929fcb624b4aeb6.summary: Updated `runFileChangeHooks` in `npm-app/src/json-config/hooks.ts` to return an object `{ toolResults, someHooksFailed }` instead of just an array. Hook execution logic now unconditionally pushes results to `toolResults` while setting `someHooksFailed` if `result.exitCode !== 0`. `npm-app/src/client.ts` consumes this change to correctly determine `isComplete` status based on hook failures rather than result presence. `fileChangeHooks` in `common/src/json-config/constants.ts` marked `.optional()`.

9426dab66658a087315d9ad066c87850a87b75c6.title: File change hooks run commands on modified files
9426dab66658a087315d9ad066c87850a87b75c6.summary: Added `fileChangeHooks` to `codebuff.json` schema in `common/src/json-config/constants.ts`. New `npm-app/src/json-config/hooks.ts` executes configured commands synchronously after file writes, filtering by `filePattern` via `micromatch`. Failed hooks append `ToolResult` entries to agent state, forcing further agent steps. `npm-app/src/client.ts` tracks changed file paths and triggers hook execution.

609a06c6ced4ea40f2a0218260008dde32837f45.text: The assistant uses clearer, shorter instructions to process edits faster and more reliably.

1a11d023861aafcfb59e659582919ade23c7b3bc.text: The system stopped logging a minor internal warning when it automatically fixed a small formatting error. Users will see no change in how the product works.

7075ddbb9d540293df8c3b8ca479b4543a2e5f57.text: The team added a hidden safety feature to the internal test version that records technical activity for review. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for regular users.

780ac80ca3a0dae5b1eb0bff6874c03aa8837e08.text: A small internal update clarifies how the assistant understands quick code edits. This helps the system apply changes more accurately without getting confused by instructions.

a3b028d976a689de8d51f855df29cf7aeda271ae.text: The system now removes hidden formatting codes from command results. This prevents confusing characters from appearing in the output, making the information easier to read.

6feaf6ed6e79c832e43abae1e26a1cfb6376a433.text: A small internal fix makes sure the system finds the right files when saving checkpoints. This improves stability for background tasks.

bc19f676ad3ea7db58df4f59f929fcb624b4aeb6.text: Fixed a bug in how the app tracks background tasks that run when files change. The app now correctly shows when these tasks fail, instead of hiding the error.

44c427d4ae7ec6898a37ff4a106d4e26db7c4414.text: The system now hides unnecessary test results from internal reports. This change only affects how developers see test outcomes.

2972b73cabb2fec16e7fe93dceef6e1e8abed691.text: Internal checks now run quick tests on code changes instead of just scanning for errors. This helps catch small problems earlier to keep the product stable.

c9f4956589e405226e8ac8348351d6b719c8ea3b.title: Command permission prompt shows raw command, not tool call
c9f4956589e405226e8ac8348351d6b719c8ea3b.summary: System prompt in backend/src/tools.ts now instructs agent to display commands for permission via triple-backtick blocks, explicitly forbidding tool call format. Example added showing `git branch -D foo`. Scope limited to that prompt string.

1b5e2cce43aab4ddff937d61cddb8944e50d1452.title: Parse error flag set in main-prompt.ts
1b5e2cce43aab4ddff937d61cddb8944e50d1452.summary: The `foundParsingError` flag is now set to `true` inside the error callback in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This ensures parsing errors encountered during tool execution are correctly tracked. The change is internal to the backend prompt logic.

b22b4f316ad87b710f53ef58bbd5d034da3ca006.title: Ask mode restricts writefile, strreplace, createplan,
b22b4f316ad87b710f53ef58bbd5d034da3ca006.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts enforces tool restrictions in ask mode. write_file, str_replace, create_plan, and run_terminal_command calls return error results instead of executing. Exception applies when prompt matches /export or export, allowing summary generation. Internal backend change affects all surfaces using ask mode.

e5d8d416efb390e971990a46d12fd5d2227fceac.title: Add prompting to Relace tool formatter
e5d8d416efb390e971990a46d12fd5d2227fceac.summary: Relace API tool formatter prompt updated with instructions for multi-line parameters and explicit parameter handling. Adds guidance for write_file multi-line params and clarifies that no parameters are required. Changes confined to backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts.

6563095b22da191d83d89515ac45f5598f31f03a.title: Saxy adds shouldParseEntities flag
6563095b22da191d83d89515ac45f5598f31f03a.summary: Saxy constructor accepts optional shouldParseEntities boolean, defaulting to true. When false, parser skips parseEntities calls and incomplete entity detection. Affects text buffer emission in common/src/util/saxy.ts. Refactor of internal XML entity handling.

69d5ba4f7ad91db2b67f24252a471e8cc19c6316.title: Fix Relace API tool formatter response handling
69d5ba4f7ad91db2b67f24252a471e8cc19c6316.summary: Updated `toolFormatter` in `backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts` to correctly parse Relace API responses. Changed `response_format` to use structured `json_schema` with `name` and `schema` keys instead of stringified JSON. Adjusted response parsing to extract `tool_calls` from `JSON.parse` of message content.

1ad01db32c48fa48d3e7d7ca647720787d886f57.title: Update tools test snapshots for shell permission prompt
1ad01db32c48fa48d3e7d7ca647720787d886f57.summary: Updated `tools.test.ts.snap` to reflect changes in the shell tool's permission request instructions. The snapshot now includes explicit guidance to avoid the tool call format for permission requests, using a `git branch -D foo` example. This change is internal, affecting only test fixtures.

85c97f507637ec01a548916fd2a3e47b86233919.title: Add maxAgentSteps to CodebuffConfigSchema
85c97f507637ec01a548916fd2a3e47b86233919.summary: Added maxAgentSteps to CodebuffConfigSchema, allowing users to configure the maximum number of turns the agent takes before ending. This change updates the JSON config snapshot to reflect the new optional parameter.

5946f6b14f13e7c089384ffff938b4456f72317b.title: Fix Relace API response format serialization
5946f6b14f13e7c089384ffff938b4456f72317b.summary: Relace API tool formatter now serializes `outputSchema` to a JSON string before passing it to `response_format`. Max tokens reduced from 32k to 8192. Added `messageId` to error logging context in `backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts`.

24d66d6db0c8d74fbdcf88bcea417bbf93114853.title: Tweak FT data collection script
24d66d6db0c8d74fbdcf88bcea417bbf93114853.summary: Moved BLOBBIFY_MESSAGE_HISTORY logic in scripts/ft-file-selection/collect-tuning-data.ts to run before message combining. Increased trace fetch limit from 100 to 3000 in main().

c9f4956589e405226e8ac8348351d6b719c8ea3b.text: When the assistant asks for permission to run a command, it now shows the plain command instead of confusing technical formatting.

b22b4f316ad87b710f53ef58bbd5d034da3ca006.text: In ask mode, the assistant now only answers questions and cannot change files or run commands. This keeps your work safe by preventing accidental edits while you ask for information.

5946f6b14f13e7c089384ffff938b4456f72317b.text: The system now handles data more accurately and limits response length to prevent errors. Error tracking is also improved for faster problem resolution.

85c97f507637ec01a548916fd2a3e47b86233919.text: You can now set a limit on how many times the assistant tries to solve a problem before stopping.

1ad01db32c48fa48d3e7d7ca647720787d886f57.text: The assistant's instructions for asking permission to run commands were updated to prevent errors. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

1b5e2cce43aab4ddff937d61cddb8944e50d1452.text: The system now correctly notes when it fails to understand a request. This small internal fix helps the assistant track errors better.

6563095b22da191d83d89515ac45f5598f31f03a.text: The system can now skip processing certain text symbols if that setting is turned off. This is a small internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

69d5ba4f7ad91db2b67f24252a471e8cc19c6316.text: Fixed how the system reads answers from a specific tool. The assistant now handles these responses correctly.

24d66d6db0c8d74fbdcf88bcea417bbf93114853.text: A small internal update improves how the system gathers data to help the assistant learn from past conversations. This change does not affect how you use the product.

88983de123c2aa22493f343f05ed6a664347e253.title: Fix expired message history to include tool results in main prompt
88983de123c2aa22493f343f05ed6a664347e253.summary: In `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `expireMessages` now receives `messagesWithToolResultsAndUser` instead of `messageHistory`. This ensures tool results are correctly expired from the agent state's message history.

7dc06c38a8daa17713d51230f8eeced8a262ab88.title: Remove responseformat from relace-api toolFormatter
7dc06c38a8daa17713d51230f8eeced8a262ab88.summary: The `response_format` parameter, previously set to `json_schema` with `outputSchema`, was removed from the `toolFormatter` function in `backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts`. This change simplifies the API call payload by omitting the explicit JSON schema enforcement. The update is internal to the backend's LLM API integration for Relace.

6ace47b07474690a0056b8b379dd0587c1687011.title: Increase codebuff.json maxAgentSteps to 20
6ace47b07474690a0056b8b379dd0587c1687011.summary: Update `maxAgentSteps` in `codebuff.json` from 5 to 20. This change allows the agent to execute more steps per task, potentially handling more complex operations. Scope limited to `codebuff.json` configuration.

a411ce217fa50108b872b7c95cf6881a9695566d.title: logError no longer throws on uninitialized client
a411ce217fa50108b872b7c95cf6881a9695566d.summary: logError now logs an info message and returns early if the analytics client is missing, replacing the previous Error throw. This prevents application crashes during error logging when analytics initialization fails or is skipped. The change is localized to npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts.

367086a1ab85ef4c3ca72bf0be83bb5c22f6a233.title: Restore responseformat in relace-api toolFormatter
367086a1ab85ef4c3ca72bf0be83bb5c22f6a233.summary: Re-added `response_format` parameter to `toolFormatter` in `backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts`. Ensures structured JSON output enforcement for relace API calls.

338b7c42f56bf4dba3c8c90aa5f9247cbfe9de8f.title: Structured error logging across CLI subsystems
338b7c42f56bf4dba3c8c90aa5f9247cbfe9de8f.summary: Added `logger.error` calls to previously silent or console-only catch blocks in `npm-app`. Replaced bare `console.error` and empty comments with structured logging containing `errorMessage`, `errorStack`, and contextual keys. Covers `chat-storage`, `checkpoints`, `cli-handlers`, `client`, and `create-template-project`.

f3c42362f96444b3153bf6bdf1ae785e73fc45c3.title: Add structured error logging across npm-app subsystems
f3c42362f96444b3153bf6bdf1ae785e73fc45c3.summary: Structured `logger.error` calls added to catch blocks and error handlers in `npm-app/src`. Covers `cli.ts` (unhandled rejections, prompt history), `client.ts` (auth, WebSocket actions), `browser-runner.ts` (screenshot, browser close), and `chat-storage.ts` (message persistence). Mechanism: standardizes error reporting by injecting `errorMessage`, `errorStack`, and context-specific fields into logs alongside existing `console.error` output. Scope: internal logging infrastructure for the CLI package; no user-facing behavior changes.

9d0d843a287db028f99589085911cace793ca4fb.title: Consecutive assistant steps warning
9d0d843a287db028f99589085911cace793ca4fb.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts injects a system message reporting remaining assistant responses before cutoff. Replaces silent truncation with explicit user-role notification referencing codebuffConfigFile. Internal prompt logic only.

55cafbbe6486fa6a3fc021757d015a105db06462.title: maxAgentSteps config limits agent turns
55cafbbe6486fa6a3fc021757d015a105db06462.summary: Added maxAgentSteps to CodebuffConfigSchema and codebuff.json. Agent state now tracks agentStepsRemaining, decrementing per turn to enforce the limit. Refactored loadCodebuffConfig to fetch project root internally, simplifying CLI and startup handlers.

9d0d843a287db028f99589085911cace793ca4fb.text: The assistant now tells you when it is about to stop responding because it has reached its limit. Instead of just cutting off the conversation silently, you get a clear warning so you know what is happening.

a411ce217fa50108b872b7c95cf6881a9695566d.text: If the system that tracks problems fails to start, the app now notes the issue quietly instead of crashing.

367086a1ab85ef4c3ca72bf0be83bb5c22f6a233.text: A small internal fix helps the system reliably format its answers. This means the assistant's responses will stay organized and easier to read.

88983de123c2aa22493f343f05ed6a664347e253.text: Fixed an internal error where old tool results weren't removed from the assistant's memory. This ensures the assistant uses the right context when answering.

6ace47b07474690a0056b8b379dd0587c1687011.text: The assistant can now take more steps to finish a task, allowing it to handle more complex requests.

f3c42362f96444b3153bf6bdf1ae785e73fc45c3.text: The system now records problems more clearly behind the scenes. This change is small and internal, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

7dc06c38a8daa17713d51230f8eeced8a262ab88.text: The assistant now formats its answers without forcing a strict structure. This small internal update does not change how you use the product.

338b7c42f56bf4dba3c8c90aa5f9247cbfe9de8f.text: The system now records more details when errors occur, making it easier for support to diagnose problems quickly.

55cafbbe6486fa6a3fc021757d015a105db06462.text: The assistant now has a built-in limit on how many steps it can take to complete a task. This prevents it from running indefinitely and helps manage resource usage.

f699f18b7773043c9535dffbbdb6f17e22e9e85d.title: Enable relace tool formatter in local environment only
f699f18b7773043c9535dffbbdb6f17e22e9e85d.summary: The tool formatter execution is now gated by `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT === 'local'`. This prevents the formatter from running in non-local environments when `foundParsingError` is true. The change applies to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

4a709cbdf0a65f791c4ef7951039217b7b2a6a11.title: Set gemini thinkingBudget to 0 in agent stream
4a709cbdf0a65f791c4ef7951039217b7b2a6a11.summary: Backend agent stream now sets providerOptions.gemini.thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget to 0 for Gemini models in prompt-agent-stream.ts. This change disables extended thinking for Gemini requests, likely to control token usage or latency. Scope limited to backend streaming logic; no user-facing UI or model picker changes. Note: thinkingBudget is only applied if providerOptions or gemini config are not already set, preserving existing overrides.

e19de57f2d7d6f57085046a66540bcc7320031bd.title: Relace tool formatter adds message id metadata
e19de57f2d7d6f57085046a66540bcc7320031bd.summary: The `toolFormatter` function in `backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts` now includes a `relace-metadata` object containing the `codebuff-id` (derived from `messageId`) in the request payload. This change ensures the Relace API receives the specific message ID for better correlation or processing. The modification is internal to the backend API client logic.

a02d1b0667af38977e7bc8beedfad27653ce109f.title: Use asSystemMessage for /compact
a02d1b0667af38977e7bc8beedfad27653ce109f.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts wraps the /compact summary content in asSystemMessage instead of passing raw string. Internal refactor. No user-visible change.

fe0a0113126efb40ae5e2e23a77f4a378a7105ee.title: Add toolFormatter fallback for parsing errors
fe0a0113126efb40ae5e2e23a77f4a378a7105ee.summary: Added `toolFormatter` invocation in `main-prompt.ts` when `foundParsingError` is true. This triggers a secondary formatting pass on the full response using `relace-api` utilities. Scope limited to backend prompt processing logic. Requires `CoreMessage` and `toolSchema` imports in `relace-api.ts`.

c00cc73df21c34d993e75a369726f3b9c7b7f9ba.title: PostHog exception autocapture gated to production
c00cc73df21c34d993e75a369726f3b9c7b7f9ba.summary: Updated `initAnalytics` in `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` to conditionally enable `enableExceptionAutocapture` based on `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT`. Prevents non-production error noise from reaching PostHog. Scope limited to analytics initialization logic.

e58d6325e565f9efa8fd15b33ba3b9d66b531919.title: Use codebuffConfigFile constant for config path
e58d6325e565f9efa8fd15b33ba3b9d66b531919.summary: Replaced hardcoded 'codebuff.json' strings with codebuffConfigFile constant in npm-app/src/dev-process-manager.ts and npm-app/src/menu.ts. Ensures config filename changes propagate automatically to CLI status checks and startup logs. Internal refactor only; no user-facing behavior change.

2a9def687faa80ab7b729e648395a401b42eaedb.title: ai-sdk prompt functions accept single options object
2a9def687faa80ab7b729e648395a401b42eaedb.summary: Refactored `promptAiSdk` and `promptAiSdkStructured` to accept a single object argument instead of separate `messages` and `options` parameters. This change consolidates configuration into one typed object, simplifying call sites across backend utilities like `grade-runs.ts`, `fast-rewrite.ts`, and `gemini-with-fallbacks.ts`. The update aligns internal LLM invocation patterns with the Vercel AI SDK's expected structure, reducing boilerplate in message construction.

71a5dd348de49a75dc8e6d8851dfd82cc295591d.title: Add offline scoring relabel pipeline for filepicker finetunes
71a5dd348de49a75dc8e6d8851dfd82cc295591d.summary: feat: add offline scoring. New script `relabel-for-offline-scoring.ts` batches validation traces through `ft_filepicker_005/007/008` and base `gemini-2.0-flash-001`, comparing outputs against `claude-opus-4-20250514-with-full-file-context-new` ground truth. `getTracesAndRelabelsForUser` in `packages/bigquery/src/client.ts` accepts a `cursor` argument for time-based pagination; `collect-tuning-data.ts` exports `isValidationSample` and refactors Gemini history blobbing to tag prior model turns as `<previous_assistant_message>`. `common/src/constants.ts` adds `finetunedVertexModelNames` mapping endpoint IDs to readable names. Covers core constants, BigQuery client, and `scripts/ft-file-selection` tooling.

a02d1b0667af38977e7bc8beedfad27653ce109f.text: The assistant now labels its own memory summaries as instructions instead of regular text. This internal cleanup improves how it processes its own notes without changing what you see.

f699f18b7773043c9535dffbbdb6f17e22e9e85d.text: A small internal update ensures a formatting tool runs only on local machines. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

e19de57f2d7d6f57085046a66540bcc7320031bd.text: The system now tags each message with a unique identifier. This helps track conversations better.

c00cc73df21c34d993e75a369726f3b9c7b7f9ba.text: The system now only sends error reports to the analytics service when the application is running in the live production environment. This reduces unnecessary noise from testing and development environments.

fe0a0113126efb40ae5e2e23a77f4a378a7105ee.text: The system now re-checks and cleans up answers when it hits a formatting error. This reduces garbled text without changing how you interact with the product.

e58d6325e565f9efa8fd15b33ba3b9d66b531919.text: The team cleaned up how the app finds its settings file. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

2a9def687faa80ab7b729e648395a401b42eaedb.text: A small internal update simplifies how the system sends instructions to the AI. This makes the code easier to maintain, but users will not see any changes in the product.

71a5dd348de49a75dc8e6d8851dfd82cc295591d.text: The team added a new offline process to check how well the assistant picks files. This helps improve the assistant's accuracy for you.

4a709cbdf0a65f791c4ef7951039217b7b2a6a11.text: The assistant now avoids deep reasoning steps for certain requests. This change may improve speed. You will not see any difference in the interface.

fe8b008bd79e7f9436e2e2accf13d3077bfe7aef.title: Disable full file context collection
fe8b008bd79e7f9436e2e2accf13d3077bfe7aef.summary: Added `COLLECT_FULL_FILE_CONTEXT` flag set to `false` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Updated `getFileReadingUpdates` to gate `uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining` behind this flag, stopping the collection of full file context for training data even when files are requested. This prevents sending expanded file contexts to the training pipeline.

9276e9a4ad680ef832bf93f5b6f19c7c06378273.title: Internal view updated for new ai sdk schema
9276e9a4ad680ef832bf93f5b6f19c7c06378273.summary: The `getTracesForUserHandler` in `backend/src/admin/relabelRuns.ts` now uses nullish coalescing to extract `queryBody`. This fallback handles cases where `content[0].text` is missing, accommodating the new AI SDK message schema structure.

3914be3730cd7b9669f62806128c6d85280525e8.title: Fix main-prompt test
3914be3730cd7b9669f62806128c6d85280525e8.summary: Updated backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts to use dynamic index lookups for message history assertions instead of hardcoded positions. Removed brittle checks for intermediate instruction messages and strict cache control assertions. Scope limited to test file; no production code changes. Minimum message history length expectation reduced from 4 to 3 to match actual flow.

5c065d17d6fab07f0bb40e7856be2a240476f402.title: Reorganize agent messages for prompt caching
5c065d17d6fab07f0bb40e7856be2a240476f402.summary: Reordered and restructured message array in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. User prompt and relevant context moved earlier to stabilize prefix for prompt caching. Removed dead code and debug logging for tool results.

2bdbdcb8e73ffa8b2b79349b22fbaf7d2d0e4f9c.title: /compact command replaces message history with summary
2bdbdcb8e73ffa8b2b79349b22fbaf7d2d0e4f9c.summary: Added `/compact` command to summarize and replace conversation history. Backend `main-prompt.ts` swaps `messageHistory` with a single user message containing the summary when detected. CLI `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `menu.ts` handle input forwarding and UI registration. `system-prompt/prompts.ts` defines the summarization instructions.

5dfd3878ccf2d93e3856305cb581eae53ba565c7.title: Add --ask CLI flag for question-only mode
5dfd3878ccf2d93e3856305cb581eae53ba565c7.summary: Introduces the `--ask` command-line option to Freebuff, enabling a 'questions & planning only' mode that prevents code changes. The flag maps to `costMode = 'ask'` in `npm-app/src/index.ts` and is registered in `npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts`. Convenience scripts `start-ask` are added to both root and `npm-app` `package.json` files.

f10c01859ad10f35fe05d145b89f2447079634b2.title: Add ftfilepicker008 and ftfilepickertopk002 to internal view
f10c01859ad10f35fe05d145b89f2447079634b2.summary: Added finetunedVertexModels.ft_filepicker_008 and finetunedVertexModels.ft_filepicker_topk_002 to common/src/constants.ts for internal admin file-picker use. Updated backend/src/admin/relabelRuns.ts to target these new models, removing legacy claude/gemini branching logic in favor of unified promptAiSdk calls. Web admin page (web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx) and tuning script (scripts/ft-file-selection/collect-tuning-data.ts) updated to reflect new model IDs and message history compression.

3e91db4f5c60edad5fe3b25ed48f9bf827ca226a.title: Add /export command for conversation summaries
3e91db4f5c60edad5fe3b25ed48f9bf827ca226a.summary: Added /export slash command to CLI and backend prompts, generating Markdown summaries of conversation decisions, file changes, and reasoning. Implemented in backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts, npm-app/src/cli.ts, and npm-app/src/menu.ts. Saves files prefixed with codebuff-export- in project root.

47e976b76377e5c7496529c281817ec650d5a23d.title: Adjust main-prompt instructions to prevent infinite loops
47e976b76377e5c7496529c281817ec650d5a23d.summary: Commented out the standalone system instruction block in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` after it failed to prevent infinite loops. Updated the `previous_assistant_message` correction prompt to trigger only when `prompt && hasAssistantMessage` is true, changing its `timeToLive` from `agentStep` to `userPrompt`. This restricts the instruction to per-user-prompt execution, preventing it from persisting indefinitely across agent steps.

84b7ece47249ee80fa993ed025f7a4e1961c7ad6.title: Reorder interactive command menu to non-alphabetical priority
84b7ece47249ee80fa993ed025f7a4e1961c7ad6.summary: Removed alphabetical sort from getSlashCommands in npm-app/src/menu.ts. Commands now display in explicit array order, prioritizing init before login and grouping compact, export, and ask near reset. Description for reset updated to 'conversation history'. Scope limited to CLI interactive menu.

5c065d17d6fab07f0bb40e7856be2a240476f402.text: The assistant now remembers shared context more efficiently. This may reduce response times and costs without changing visible features.

2bdbdcb8e73ffa8b2b79349b22fbaf7d2d0e4f9c.text: A new command lets you replace the full chat history with a brief summary. This keeps the conversation focused without losing the main points.

84b7ece47249ee80fa993ed025f7a4e1961c7ad6.text: The list of commands no longer sorts alphabetically. Important options now appear first and related tools sit together for easier finding.

3914be3730cd7b9669f62806128c6d85280525e8.text: A small internal fix made the software's self-checks smarter. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

fe8b008bd79e7f9436e2e2accf13d3077bfe7aef.text: The assistant no longer copies entire files into its learning process when you ask it to look at them. This small internal change reduces the amount of your data used for training.

3e91db4f5c60edad5fe3b25ed48f9bf827ca226a.text: A new command lets you save a summary of your conversation, including decisions and file changes, into a simple text file.

f10c01859ad10f35fe05d145b89f2447079634b2.text: The file picker tool now uses updated internal models. This improves how the assistant processes file data for administrators.

9276e9a4ad680ef832bf93f5b6f19c7c06378273.text: The internal system now handles missing data from the AI more reliably. This prevents errors when viewing user activity logs.

47e976b76377e5c7496529c281817ec650d5a23d.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant could get stuck repeating itself. It now only uses specific correction instructions when you send a new message, preventing endless loops.

5dfd3878ccf2d93e3856305cb581eae53ba565c7.text: A new setting lets the assistant answer questions and plan tasks without changing your files. This helps you review ideas safely before approving any edits.

c78cbbdbeaaa5768fa3485bc411ffdb1548cb0aa.title: Remove deprecated flags and simplify npm README
c78cbbdbeaaa5768fa3485bc411ffdb1548cb0aa.summary: Removed obsolete `--lite` and `--max` cost/quality tradeoff flags from `npm-app/README.md`. Simplified troubleshooting section by replacing detailed nvm installation instructions with a generic Node reinstallation recommendation. Added `/help` command to Tips section to improve discoverability of available commands.

21581fcb49ab41635d1dc59b1c9453eab0f1c149.title: Add ftfilepicker008 and ftfilepickertopk002 tuning configs
21581fcb49ab41635d1dc59b1c9453eab0f1c149.summary: Adds two new fine-tuning configurations to the file selection tooling: `ft_filepicker_008` (expanded data/epochs from 007) and `ft_filepicker_topk_002` (early-stop dash suffix experiment). `collect-tuning-data.ts` introduces an `ADD_DASHES_TO_TOP_FEW_DATA` flag that appends three lines of dashes to training targets and updates prompt instructions to enforce this stop pattern. The default trace sampling limit in the main script was reduced from 10,000 to 1,000 to support the smaller `topk_002` validation run.

f11c9008f98b1366c2ca0f785f4b5a8996666138.title: Prevent back navigation on admin file picker
f11c9008f98b1366c2ca0f785f4b5a8996666138.summary: Added touch and wheel event listeners plus overscrollBehaviorX CSS to web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx to block horizontal swipe gestures from triggering browser back navigation. This prevents accidental page exits while scrolling the wide results table. The change is scoped to the admin file picker page.

b47a049c6b8178d360f9696bef04a921b2013d25.title: calculate-monthly-usage.ts defaults to current month
b47a049c6b8178d360f9696bef04a921b2013d25.summary: calculate-monthly-usage.ts defaults to current month. Static '2025-04' fallback replaced with dynamic Date parsing. Internal tooling script only. Month extracted via toISOString().split('-') concatenation.

b93b155edeb5f0e7d7a8d244804722db0bf073df.title: Tweak agentContext TTL and reorder tool results in main-prompt
b93b155edeb5f0e7d7a8d244804722db0bf073df.summary: Reordered tool results to appear before agent step instructions in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Added `timeToLive: 'userPrompt'` to the agent context block. This adjusts message expiration logic and prompt structure.

1b50daa17311dc7c04d314fa4e1180db472f1065.title: Refactor backend tools.ts for modularity
1b50daa17311dc7c04d314fa4e1180db472f1065.summary: Refactored `backend/src/tools.ts` to separate tool definitions from implementation details, enhancing modularity. Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to use `Extract` utility type for stricter type checking on `ToolCall` parameters. This change improves code maintainability and type safety within the backend services.

ff240b4f7b1485aae3af7bbf22f29f5b2bfd7551.title: Promise.allSettled for admin relabels
ff240b4f7b1485aae3af7bbf22f29f5b2bfd7551.summary: Switched `Promise.all` to `Promise.allSettled` in `backend/src/admin/relabelRuns.ts`. Prevents unhandled rejections from aborting the batch relabeling process when individual runs fail. Internal admin tooling only.

1e2e3fe3c2fbd0d297f48434252822317c80c597.title: Add ftfilepickertopk001 model
1e2e3fe3c2fbd0d297f48434252822317c80c597.summary: New finetuned model ft_filepicker_topk_001 (ID 3676445825887633408) added to constants.ts. Registered in backend relabelRuns.ts and web file-picker page.tsx. Updated scripts/ft-file-selection/README.md with endpoint ID and training metadata.

a15a34f2e48067613114f82155512b98b0e6aaec.title: Fix filepicker scroll prevention
a15a34f2e48067613114f82155512b98b0e6aaec.summary: Adjusted swipe and wheel event listeners in `web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx` to allow single-finger and normal horizontal scrolling while blocking browser back-navigation gestures. Touch prevention now triggers only on two-finger gestures, and wheel prevention checks for scrollable containers (`overflow-auto` etc.) and high deltaX thresholds. Removed inline `overscrollBehaviorX: 'none'` styles from the container and table wrapper, relying instead on document-level CSS and the new event logic.

3e82d5794506e66ce963b4077067120904a863cc.title: Add top-2 file selection training script and context relabeling
3e82d5794506e66ce963b4077067120904a863cc.summary: Added `relabel-traces-with-context.ts` for full file context relabeling and updated `collect-tuning-data.ts` to generate top-2 file training examples via `convertToTopFewTrainingExample`. Exported `TraceBundle` from `@codebuff/bigquery` to support script imports. Updated README with new `ft_filepicker_topk_001` finetune details and script usage.

f11c9008f98b1366c2ca0f785f4b5a8996666138.text: Swiping sideways on the admin file picker page no longer takes you back to the previous screen. This stops accidental exits when scrolling through wide tables.

3e82d5794506e66ce963b4077067120904a863cc.text: The assistant now picks files using a smarter training method. This helps it choose the right file more often when you ask it to work on something.

ff240b4f7b1485aae3af7bbf22f29f5b2bfd7551.text: A small internal fix stops one failed task from canceling the whole group of admin relabeling actions. This keeps the process running even if a single item hits an error.

b47a049c6b8178d360f9696bef04a921b2013d25.text: A hidden tool now automatically checks the current month's usage instead of a fixed date.

b93b155edeb5f0e7d7a8d244804722db0bf073df.text: The assistant now receives tool results before its next instructions, and context expires based on user prompts.

1e2e3fe3c2fbd0d297f48434252822317c80c597.text: The file picker now uses a new, specially trained model to better understand and organize your files.

21581fcb49ab41635d1dc59b1c9453eab0f1c149.text: The system's file selection tool was updated with new settings to improve how it chooses files. These changes are internal and do not affect how you use the product.

c78cbbdbeaaa5768fa3485bc411ffdb1548cb0aa.text: The app guide removed outdated settings and shortened a long installation fix. It also added a help tip so users can find available commands more easily.

a15a34f2e48067613114f82155512b98b0e6aaec.text: Small internal fix for the file picker. Normal scrolling works better. The browser no longer goes back when you swipe.

10e774b85abd195925bb21c4a251e8e88bb17284.title: Close WebSocket on CLI exit
10e774b85abd195925bb21c4a251e8e88bb17284.summary: Added `Client.close()` to explicitly terminate the WebSocket connection during CLI shutdown. This prevents dangling connections and ensures clean process termination in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. The change applies to the npm-app CLI package.

deafd88df6958e257ac11126429d6a464222ef39.title: Simplify npm-app build script
deafd88df6958e257ac11126429d6a464222ef39.summary: The `build` script in `npm-app/package.json` now runs `nx build npm-app` directly, removing the preceding `nx clean` and `nx reset` steps. This change aims to fix or streamline the npm-app build process by relying on Nx's built-in caching and incremental build capabilities instead of forcing a full reset. The scope is limited to the `npm-app` package configuration.

28d9dfd2a1df083a2ef0716beba110a8c8d52593.title: Add return type annotations to getCoreMessagesSubset and sendUserInput
28d9dfd2a1df083a2ef0716beba110a8c8d52593.summary: Explicit return types added to `getCoreMessagesSubset` in `backend/src/util/messages.ts` and `sendUserInput` in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. `getCoreMessagesSubset` now returns `CodebuffMessage[]`, while `sendUserInput` returns a promise resolving to `responsePromise` and `stopResponse`. These changes clarify internal API contracts for type checking.

5214caf0b52faf568ca998880cf8c11c7b87201e.title: Persist TTL via CodebuffMessage type
5214caf0b52faf568ca998880cf8c11c7b87201e.summary: Renamed `CoreMessageWithTtl` to `CodebuffMessage` in `common/src/types/message.ts`. Updated imports and usages across `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/util/messages.ts`, `common/src/types/agent-state.ts`, `common/src/util/messages.ts`, `npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts`, and `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. This ensures TTL metadata persists correctly to the client by standardizing the message type definition.

130b01934f43422f0c68a465ba6f2817f0391770.title: Tweak self-judging prompt in main-prompt.ts
130b01934f43422f0c68a465ba6f2817f0391770.summary: Refines the self-judging prompt in backend/src/main-prompt.ts to describe the previous assistant as 'less intelligent' rather than generic. Adjusts final instruction wording from 'Continue' to 'Simply continue'. Internal prompt tuning only.

7eec7198bbfbc34afaff675141501d4884496511.title: main-prompt.ts add no-repeat instruction
7eec7198bbfbc34afaff675141501d4884496511.summary: Added instruction to main-prompt.ts to prevent repeating previous assistant messages. Addresses redundancy in conversation flow. Scope limited to backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Detail: appended 'The user has seen the previous assistant's messages, so do not repeat what was already said.' to system instruction.

c62ad83322fd7b856408a90a250e4edcc1cc321e.title: Add ftfilepicker007 to relabel runs and admin UI
c62ad83322fd7b856408a90a250e4edcc1cc321e.summary: Added `ft_filepicker_007` to `finetunedVertexModels` in `common/src/constants.ts` and included it in the active model list for `backend/src/admin/relabelRuns.ts`, replacing previous candidates. The new model is also exposed in the admin file picker UI via `web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx` name overrides. Relabeling script concurrency (`MAX_PARALLEL`) was reduced from 5 to 2 in `scripts/ft-file-selection/relabel-traces-with-context.ts` to mitigate load.

01c30feb446875e2a283e9a40192e4baabb05216.title: Add timeToLive field to message types
01c30feb446875e2a283e9a40192e4baabb05216.summary: Introduced `CoreMessageWithTtl` type in `common/src/types/message.ts`, replacing the previous `any` alias with a Zod schema that includes an optional `timeToLive` field accepting 'agentStep' or 'userPrompt'. Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to filter messages based on this TTL during history construction, ensuring transient system instructions are excluded from long-term context. Modified `backend/src/util/messages.ts` to propagate the TTL metadata through trimming functions and apply cache control markers to messages preceding TTL boundaries. This change refines context window management by explicitly marking ephemeral messages.

a9794796ca383c226fd2bae4301f45b44a0b89f6.title: Extract expireMessages helper for message TTL filtering
a9794796ca383c226fd2bae4301f45b44a0b89f6.summary: Refactored message history filtering into new `expireMessages` utility in `backend/src/util/messages.ts`. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` now delegates TTL logic to this helper, replacing inline filters. Preserves existing `userPrompt` and `agentStep` expiration behavior.

7eec7198bbfbc34afaff675141501d4884496511.text: The assistant now avoids repeating information it has already shared in the conversation. This keeps replies shorter and less redundant.

10e774b85abd195925bb21c4a251e8e88bb17284.text: The app now shuts down its internet connection cleanly when you close it. This prevents leftover connections and helps the program exit properly.

130b01934f43422f0c68a465ba6f2817f0391770.text: The assistant now describes its previous responses as less intelligent and uses clearer instructions to continue. This small internal tweak helps it improve its own answers without changing how you use the product.

9426dab66658a087315d9ad066c87850a87b75c6.text: The app can now run custom actions automatically after files change. If an action fails, the assistant is alerted and must continue working to fix it.

5214caf0b52faf568ca998880cf8c11c7b87201e.text: The assistant now remembers how long each message stays valid, keeping conversations accurate.

01c30feb446875e2a283e9a40192e4baabb05216.text: The system now recognizes which instructions are temporary and automatically removes them from the conversation history. This keeps the assistant focused on your current request without being confused by old, short-lived commands.

deafd88df6958e257ac11126429d6a464222ef39.text: The program now builds faster by skipping unnecessary cleanup steps. This internal update does not change how you use the product.

c62ad83322fd7b856408a90a250e4edcc1cc321e.text: The system now uses a new model to help organize and label data. To keep things running smoothly, it processes fewer tasks at the same time.

28d9dfd2a1df083a2ef0716beba110a8c8d52593.text: The system now clearly labels the data it sends and receives internally. This helps prevent errors and keeps the assistant running smoothly.

95feb5d7ad41bf58bcdd508dea45ce944a37c9af.title: Reset project file context cache on /reset
95feb5d7ad41bf58bcdd508dea45ce944a37c9af.summary: The CLI `/reset` command now clears the cached project file context before re-initialization. `initProjectFileContextWithWorker` in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` accepts a `resetCache` flag that sets `cachedProjectFileContext` to undefined. This ensures fresh file indexing after session resets in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

55420032c4e09974d175a09cde27a312706a224f.title: Remove truncation in eval results
55420032c4e09974d175a09cde27a312706a224f.summary: Removed `.slice(0, 5)` and `.substring(0, 200)` truncation from problem lists and recommendations in `evals/git-evals/email-eval-results.ts` and `evals/run-eval-set.ts`. Full problem descriptions and all recommendations are now included in email summaries and console output. Scope limited to internal eval reporting utilities.

014e363c52c4bf4150f9f9caf230b41aaa7dd62b.title: CI startup smoke test waits 10s and suppresses output
014e363c52c4bf4150f9f9caf230b41aaa7dd62b.summary: The CI startup check in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` now redirects `bun run start-js` output to `/dev/null` and increases the post-launch `sleep` from 0.5s to 10s. The original 0.5s window was too short for the process to initialize, risking false-positive crash detections. The termination step also switched from bare `kill` to `kill -TERM` to ensure graceful shutdown. Scope limited to the CI workflow; no user-facing surfaces affected.

4d128a44264f41894df3dcfe5ed6af6f084c0d03.title: ftfilepicker007 finetune documented
4d128a44264f41894df3dcfe5ed6af6f084c0d03.summary: Added `ft_filepicker_007` finetune details to `scripts/ft-file-selection/README.md`, including endpoint ID, base model `gemini-2.0-flash-001`, and teacher model `claude-opus-4-20250514`. Updated `relabel-traces-with-context.ts` to double the `LIMIT` constant from 1000 to 2000. Scope limited to internal tooling scripts and documentation. The new finetune uses 1 epoch and forced maximum adapter size.

3faf57ca33b068da56647fb4e19b908f3c0b28f1.title: Remove CI startup test and fix type imports
3faf57ca33b068da56647fb4e19b908f3c0b28f1.summary: Removed the `startup-test` job from `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to eliminate redundant process verification. In `common/src/types/message.ts`, `CoreMessageWithTtlSchema` definition is commented out and `CoreMessageWithTtl` type cast to `any` to bypass `ai` package import issues. Deleted stray array destructuring `[''][1].split('')` from `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

f1e4db44c82a3c0893a1e56b6332ac5cbc41a859.title: Log test user credits in message-cost-tracker
f1e4db44c82a3c0893a1e56b6332ac5cbc41a859.summary: Added logging for test user credit usage in `message-cost-tracker.ts`. The `saveMessage` function now checks if `userId` matches `TEST_USER_ID`. If true, it logs cost details and returns early, skipping client notification and database insertion. This change removes the `TEST_USER_ID` check from `relace-api.ts`, centralizing test user handling in the cost tracker.

342e583e980eea2ffdbc1c6de830ba44fcdfc939.title: UpdateFile handler reports full file content back to agent
342e583e980eea2ffdbc1c6de830ba44fcdfc939.summary: The handleUpdateFile tool in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts now appends the full lines.join('\n') to the success message for both created and modified files. This provides the agent with the complete post-change content, replacing the previous generic 'Wrote to file successfully' string. Scope is limited to the internal tool handler logic in the npm-app package. The change increases the payload size of the tool response by the entire file content length.

3f77b33e6a7c75596e1cc3d0512e80c541ff2678.title: Migrate message schema to CoreMessage from ai-sdk
3f77b33e6a7c75596e1cc3d0512e80c541ff2678.summary: Backend message handling switched from custom `Message` types to `CoreMessage` from `ai-sdk`. Removed `transformMessages` calls in `fast-rewrite.ts`, `check-new-files-necessary.ts`, `request-files-prompt.ts`, and `main-prompt.ts`, replacing them with direct `CoreMessage` arrays and helpers like `getCoreMessagesSubset` and `coreMessagesWithSystem`. This standardizes LLM prompt construction across the backend.

44fd6081ffb8bd9df6c0c32e6410044520303e8e.title: Add codesearch to TOOLSWHICHENDTHERESPONSE

3f77b33e6a7c75596e1cc3d0512e80c541ff2678.text: The system now uses a standard method for organizing conversations with the assistant. This internal cleanup helps the software run more smoothly and consistently.

4d128a44264f41894df3dcfe5ed6af6f084c0d03.text: The team improved how the system picks files by updating its underlying learning process and increasing the number of examples it checks. This small internal change helps the assistant make better choices when handling your files.

a14639a460caa65ad66586f4e55cc816ba01b1cb.title: Remove ai package from common
a14639a460caa65ad66586f4e55cc816ba01b1cb.summary: Removed `ai` dependency from `common/package.json`. Deleted `coreMessageSchema` import and commented out `CoreMessageWithTtlSchema` in `common/src/types/message.ts`. Type `CoreMessageWithTtl` now aliases to `any`.

c0930b244b3fd2aa5374be479d58f6664f0de971.title: CI start-js crash detection switched to background PID check
c0930b244b3fd2aa5374be479d58f6664f0de971.summary: Replaced timeout wrapper with background process launch and PID verification in ci.yml. Uses kill -0 to confirm process liveness after 0.5s sleep, killing and waiting on success. Scope limited to .github/workflows/ci.yml Test start-js script startup step. Avoids exit code 124 ambiguity by directly checking process state.

2ceccf9438d104d90be9cbe51ee823675b287cb0.title: Add missing ai dependency to common package
2ceccf9438d104d90be9cbe51ee823675b287cb0.summary: Added `ai` version `^4.3.6` to `dependencies` in `common/package.json`. Fixes missing dependency error during build or runtime. Scope limited to shared core package configuration.

48061fb16e514eb0ea98d1c5f012464eff178b94.title: Add CI startup test for npm-app start-js
48061fb16e514eb0ea98d1c5f012464eff178b94.summary: New GitHub Actions job `startup-test` added to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. It runs `bun run start-js` in `npm-app` with a 1-second timeout to verify the process starts without crashing. Exit code 124 (timeout) is treated as success; any other non-zero exit fails the build.

cc66c81328613121e61b5171b45c0d9f175572df.title: Enable CoreMessageWithTtlSchema in message types
cc66c81328613121e61b5171b45c0d9f175572df.summary: Uncommented CoreMessageWithTtlSchema and its type inference in common/src/types/message.ts. Replaced the any type with strict z.infer usage. Requires importing coreMessageSchema from the ai package.

7df30906209e3765762c20e0dc8ab72a194fd185.title: Move post-eval analysis files to git-evals directory
7df30906209e3765762c20e0dc8ab72a194fd185.summary: Renamed evals/post-eval-analysis.ts and evals/email-sender.ts to evals/git-evals/. Updated imports in evals/run-eval-set.ts to reflect new paths. Extracted PostEvalAnalysis interface to shared module.

be8d7c8d3ff26a55ca8b6b3dda22caf7bd554693.title: CLI mode switch makes slash optional
be8d7c8d3ff26a55ca8b6b3dda22caf7bd554693.summary: The CLI regex in npm-app/src/cli.ts now makes the leading slash optional for cost mode commands. This allows users to type bare mode names (e.g., lite) instead of requiring the slash prefix (/lite). The change applies to lite, normal, max, experimental, and ask modes.

dc2d86731ec6a8d30de2afe678eb5e54f6cf57dc.title: Fix Loops email API dataVariables payload
dc2d86731ec6a8d30de2afe678eb5e54f6cf57dc.summary: Corrects the request body structure in `sendLoopsEmail` by wrapping `emailData` in a `dataVariables` object. This aligns the payload with the Loops API schema for transactional emails, ensuring custom data is correctly parsed. The change applies to `backend/src/util/loops.ts`.

5d7f0c9ccd09064db68f2f7dfcc46a5c33ca5ea1.title: Dead code expression in npm-app/src/index.ts
5d7f0c9ccd09064db68f2f7dfcc46a5c33ca5ea1.summary: Adds a no-op expression `[''][1].split('')` to `npm-app/src/index.ts`. This appears to be leftover test or debug code, as it has no effect on the application logic. The change is isolated to the CLI entry point and does not affect other packages.

be8d7c8d3ff26a55ca8b6b3dda22caf7bd554693.text: You can now type mode names like 'lite' directly without adding a slash before them. This small change makes the command easier to enter.

2ceccf9438d104d90be9cbe51ee823675b287cb0.text: A small internal fix ensures the app's core features work correctly. You might notice fewer errors when using the assistant.

b2abad5b36ea9b7fbf26f3272d0afb631866f9a1.summary: Deleted .github/workflows/daily-git-evals.yml. This workflow previously ran Codebuff git evaluations daily at 8am UTC to generate trace files. Scope limited to CI infrastructure; no user-facing code changes.

db002767ec6ce88575552e82a32af197bb82fd32.title: Simplify getThinkingStream to accept CoreMessage
db002767ec6ce88575552e82a32af197bb82fd32.summary: Refactor `getThinkingStream` signature to accept `CoreMessage[]` directly instead of raw `Message[]` and `System` types. Removes internal `transformMessages` call and associated imports (`Message`, `System`, `transformMessages`) from `backend/src/thinking-stream.ts`. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` updated to call `transformMessages` before passing data to the stream handler. This shifts message transformation responsibility to the caller, simplifying the stream interface.

7c67da92e90a02e3ba79b831a02000b24e604e1b.title: Add post-eval analysis to git eval runner
7c67da92e90a02e3ba79b831a02000b24e604e1b.summary: New `evals/post-eval-analysis.ts` implements LLM-driven analysis of `FullEvalLog` data, generating structured summaries, prioritized problems, and recommendations. `evals/run-eval-set.ts` now invokes `analyzeEvalResults` after each successful eval run, attaching the analysis to the result object. Type definition in `evals/git-evals/types.ts` updated to ensure `eval_runs` contains `EvalRunJudged` instances with `judging_results` required for analysis input. Analysis failures are caught and logged as warnings, allowing the eval pipeline to proceed without blocking on analysis errors.

c68a23236e2d2f25c4091f3938b4fcc70a4e2150.title: Migrate promptFlashWithFallbacks to CoreMessage
c68a23236e2d2f25c4091f3938b4fcc70a4e2150.summary: Refactor `promptFlashWithFallbacks` in `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` to accept `CoreMessage[]` instead of `Message[]` and `System` arguments. Callers in `backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts`, `backend/src/tools.ts`, and file-finding utilities now wrap arguments with `transformMessages` before invoking the function. The fallback chain is simplified to route primary requests through `promptAiSdk` and remove direct Vertex/Gemini API handling.

973904e9252deba01c18eaafb46f417fb4b483c1.title: Add CoreMessageWithTtl type and transform logic
973904e9252deba01c18eaafb46f417fb4b483c1.summary: Added `CoreMessageWithTtl` type in `common/src/types/message.ts` extending `CoreMessage` with a `timeToLive` field. Updated `transformMessages` in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` to accept this new type and pass it through to `CoreMessage[]` if present. This supports TTL-based message handling in the AI SDK integration layer.

c07b0311eeb0e5956971f4e517f4dfddc9cadb64.title: Remove backend/src/llm-apis/deepseek-api.ts
c07b0311eeb0e5956971f4e517f4dfddc9cadb64.summary: Deleted `backend/src/llm-apis/deepseek-api.ts` (-264 lines). Removes the Deepseek API integration layer, including stream handling, timeout/retry logic, and image stripping. Scope: backend LLM APIs. Internal cleanup; no direct user-facing behavior change visible in this diff.

2d55accd2d926586bb9c73324740db2a1231bae9.title: evals pipeline sends results via Loops API
2d55accd2d926586bb9c73324740db2a1231bae9.summary: New `sendLoopsEmail` utility in `backend/src/util/loops.ts` posts transactional emails via Loops API. `evals/email-sender.ts` formats aggregated metrics and analysis into email content. `evals/run-eval-set.ts` triggers email dispatch after eval completion. `evals/post-eval-analysis.ts` exports `PostEvalAnalysis` type and schema for reuse.

2269b526f252ee2e429c69ae0208ae3a4c115bd2.title: Eval output filenames include repo name
2269b526f252ee2e429c69ae0208ae3a4c115bd2.summary: Git eval runner renames output files to include repo name. `run-git-evals.ts` now takes `outputDir` instead of `outputPath`, generating filenames like `eval-partial-${actualRepoName}-${traceId}.json` and `eval-result-${actualRepoName}-${traceId}.json`. Eval data file renamed from `git-evals.json` to `eval-codebuff.json`. CLI usage string updated to reflect directory argument.

f6094b46efc0702c2e9effdb80f3195d0c1908a8.title: Add manifold eval set and runner
f6094b46efc0702c2e9effdb80f3195d0c1908a8.summary: Added eval-manifold.json containing 941 lines of curated git commits from manifoldmarkets/manifold for regression testing. Introduced run-eval-set.ts to execute these specs against Freebuff, updating package.json with necessary dependencies. This expands internal evaluation coverage for complex prompt engineering and code generation tasks.

770ce41fcad5f7ed8dde633ec3ae95b6eb7d908e.title: Replace direct Claude API with Vercel AI SDK in backend
770ce41fcad5f7ed8dde633ec3ae95b6eb7d908e.summary: Internal refactoring replaces direct Anthropic SDK calls in `backend/src/llm-apis/claude.ts` with the unified `promptAiSdk` interface from `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. This change standardizes LLM interactions across admin tools and prompt generation scripts, removing custom retry logic and message transformation handling specific to the raw Claude API. The `ai-sdk.ts` module now supports `chargeUser` options and `TEST_USER_ID` for internal testing contexts, ensuring consistent billing and logging behavior for non-user-facing operations.

2d55accd2d926586bb9c73324740db2a1231bae9.text: The system now automatically sends an email report with performance results after it finishes checking how well the software works.

c68a23236e2d2f25c4091f3938b4fcc70a4e2150.text: The system's internal message handling was updated to use a standard format. This change is invisible to users and improves how the assistant processes requests.

2d2b94cb3a19628b0f83212ef0ddb1b6bcc7b4e3.summary: Refactors `getAgentStream` to accept `CoreMessage[]` directly instead of `Message[]` and `System`. Moves `transformMessages` call upstream to `main-prompt.ts` and `thinking-stream.ts`. Eliminates redundant type conversion inside `prompt-agent-stream.ts`. Aligns stream generation with Vercel AI SDK core types.

b15faabe12b4c900fab6a0cf0574290ccf60a83c.title: Revert PostHog analytics host to direct endpoint
b15faabe12b4c900fab6a0cf0574290ccf60a83c.summary: Reverts `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` to use `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST_URL` for the PostHog client host, bypassing the internal proxy path. 6913a7ebac0d7da3c464aa06bc09de0d9baa87a5.title: Remove dedicated OpenAI API client in favor of unified Vercel AI SDK
6913a7ebac0d7da3c464aa06bc09de0d9baa87a5.summary: Deleted `openai-api.ts` and replaced all `promptOpenAI` calls with `promptAiSdk` from `./vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk`. The refactor consolidates backend LLM routing through a single provider-agnostic module, eliminating the separate OpenAI client initialization and its Helicone proxy headers. Files affected: `fast-rewrite.ts`, `relace-api.ts`, `process-file-block.ts`, and the removed `openai-api.ts`.

64b83645b97f0a2ede87d1256898f3d9e7c389d0.title: Refactor: make system parameter optional in transformMessages
64b83645b97f0a2ede87d1256898f3d9e7c389d0.summary: Updated `transformMessages` in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` to make the `system` parameter optional (`system?: System`) instead of explicitly accepting `undefined`. 52ced87cc0559e20f25596bb2c1451d8326ae6a9.title: AI SDK transformMessages extracts toolCallId from CoreToolMessage
52ced87cc0559e20f25596bb2c1451d8326ae6a9.summary: The `transformMessages` function in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` now handles tool messages by checking for `tool_call_id` directly or extracting `toolCallId` from the first part of `CoreToolMessage` content arrays. This fixes failures where tool messages lacked the direct `tool_call_id` property, previously causing undefined references or errors during transformation. The change is scoped to the backend AI SDK adapter, ensuring robust tool call ID resolution for both OpenAI-style and CoreToolMessage formats.

4e73dfd334684dfd3f5388691669be1da1a8f891.title: CoreMessageWithTtlSchema zod intersection replaces type
4e73dfd334684dfd3f5388691669be1da1a8f891.summary: CoreMessageWithTtlSchema defined via z.intersection(coreMessageSchema, ...). Replaces manual type intersection in common/src/types/message.ts. CoreMessageWithTtl type now inferred from schema. Covers Shared/Core types.

427525b708f93cfa71fc8788d46092e8ee7747e4.summary: Deleted `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-api.ts` and `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-vertex-api.ts` to consolidate Gemini handling into the Vercel AI SDK. f227db9b854ccb84a908c2d46dae7b0c5eb0e012.summary: Deleted promptGeminiStream, streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks, and open-router.ts. Cleanup of dead code paths for Gemini and OpenRouter streaming. Scope limited to backend/src/llm-apis.

8c0c174acfbc096426407fb7968eed7e0c21fc2c.summary: Updates `evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts` to robustly handle GitHub authentication in CI environments (Render/GitHub Actions). c9cde42591f5468a327e8063ff6fb96d898e812c.title: codesearch tool description update

750eb9f3c2a2cc5a4842a185671db416b7663101.summary: setupTestRepo.ts auth logic refactored. Clone URL construction moved outside CI checks. Token auth now applies whenever GITHUB_TOKEN exists for GitHub repos. Reduces branching complexity in evals/git-evals.

9246661c66d3c8c44a359d68828b60b7d6bfbf95.summary: Added cursor-based pagination to getTracesAndAllDataForUser and the relabel-traces-with-context script.
