120d9ffac77b2a64c06a02eab9c8cfb05ed7c258.summary: Lite mode in agent operations now maps to `models.gemini2_5_flash` instead of `models.gemini2_5_flash_thinking`. This change disables thinking mode for the lite configuration. The update is contained in `common/src/constants.ts`.

6a9d9e9e002983b8cf2be0a282b2c4abc05c5592.title: Add experimental cost mode command
6a9d9e9e002983b8cf2be0a282b2c4abc05c5592.summary: Added `/experimental` slash command to CLI cost mode matching and interactive menu. Updates `npm-app/src/cli.ts` regex to include 'experimental' and `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to display the new option. Switching modes triggers a magenta confirmation message in the terminal.

15b3737d741546f6844e1038b334b00456fb01f6.title: Revert npm-app PostHog proxy config
15b3737d741546f6844e1038b334b00456fb01f6.summary: Reverts refactor routing npm-app PostHog client to proxy. `initAnalytics` now requires `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST_URL` instead of `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`. Error message and validation logic updated in `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts`. Blank line removed before `flushAnalytics`.

8c0c174acfbc096426407fb7968eed7e0c21fc2c.text: The system now checks login details more carefully before starting. This prevents errors when setting up test projects automatically.

6a9d9e9e002983b8cf2be0a282b2c4abc05c5592.text: A new experimental option now appears in the menu. Selecting it shows a confirmation message to let you know the mode changed.

945aaa0fa65003c5231712f30deba214885b2601.text: Small internal change. The app now ignores missing data tracking outside production, preventing crashes during testing. Normal users see no change.

750eb9f3c2a2cc5a4842a185671db416b7663101.text: A small internal cleanup simplifies how the system checks access to GitHub repositories. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

2f0921c2ddaeb0246b78c44900e8a41d1e3de045.text: The app now catches errors from its background data tracking system so they do not crash the main features. This keeps the product running smoothly even if that specific service has a problem.

b4ea0d85c61d75efd99001660aee39c96eaf5e72.text: The assistant can now write longer answers before stopping. This is a small internal update that expands the limit on response length.

15b3737d741546f6844e1038b334b00456fb01f6.text: The app now uses a different path to send data for analytics. This change does not affect how the app looks or works for you.

120d9ffac77b2a64c06a02eab9c8cfb05ed7c258.text: The assistant now uses a simpler, faster version of its brain when you choose the Lite mode. This means it will think less deeply about your requests, making responses quicker but potentially less detailed.

9246661c66d3c8c44a359d68828b60b7d6bfbf95.text: The system can now process many more traces at once without timing out.

c9cde42591f5468a327e8063ff6fb96d898e812c.text: The search tool now waits for results before finishing its turn. This ensures the assistant reads search findings before responding.

eafbb9af9a67a5ac02c1443a60eb594608ff2175.title: Add Render.com detection to evals git setup
eafbb9af9a67a5ac02c1443a60eb594608ff2175.summary: setupTestRepo now checks RENDER and IS_PULL_REQUEST env vars to detect Render.com CI alongside GitHub Actions. This allows the function to correctly handle private repo authentication when running on Render. The change is isolated to evals/git-evals/setup-test-repo.ts.

6f40fb3f1c8e1d3df70d17bda44e4014d946335b.title: Add evals to bun workspaces
6f40fb3f1c8e1d3df70d17bda44e4014d946335b.summary: Added evals to bun workspaces array in package.json. Internal repo structure update. Scope limited to root package.json. No user-facing change.

3c7fbc0482ba4fe0308cc0c20c348523a4a0baf6.title: run-git-evals.ts: drop concurrency for sequential eval runs
3c7fbc0482ba4fe0308cc0c20c348523a4a0baf6.summary: Removed async.mapLimit concurrency (CONCURRENT_EVALS=3) from runGitEvals in evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. Eval commits now execute via a standard for-loop sequentially. Partial result persistence logic remains intact, writing after each single eval completion.

aba1891449b97c273e3890de33ba9488ba62643b.title: Add system tool result prompt to backend
aba1891449b97c273e3890de33ba9488ba62643b.summary: Added explicit instruction to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` clarifying that tool results are provided by the user's system, not the assistant. This prevents the model from hallucinating or prematurely generating tool outputs. Change scoped to core backend prompting logic.

2315a113c6c7f2450a809b06a43868d2eaf82426.title: daily-git-evals: fetch-depth 0, clone codebuff repo
2315a113c6c7f2450a809b06a43868d2eaf82426.summary: Updated daily-git-evals workflow to use fetch-depth: 0 for full git history. Modified setup-codebuff-repo.ts to detect GitHub Actions environment and clone from remote repository with GITHUB_TOKEN authentication for private repos, falling back to local clone for development. Replaces previous cp -r .git approach.

a7c06a2712110372bea2d081c80dda845602e9ec.title: Add script for relabeling traces with Opus context
a7c06a2712110372bea2d081c80dda845602e9ec.summary: New `relabel-traces-with-context.ts` script enables relabeling traces using Claude 4 Opus with full file context. `relabelWithClaudeWithFullFileContext` exported and updated to accept optional `dataset` param, calling `setupBigQuery` when provided. `print-recent-relabels.ts` now explicitly calls `setupBigQuery(DATASET)` before fetching relabels. Script filters for traces lacking `${MODEL_TO_TEST}-with-full-file-context` relabels, processing up to 20 traces in parallel batches of 5.

1c073efa0d43c0130e7bca488376843075853dd1.title: evals setup copies repo instead of git clone
1c073efa0d43c0130e7bca488376843075853dd1.summary: evals/setup-codebuff-repo.ts replaces remote git clone with local cp -r of project root. Avoids GITHUB_TOKEN auth and remote URL parsing in GitHub Actions, where checkout already exists. Preserves .git history for resetRepoToCommit. Adds fs checks for .git and package.json plus git status and rev-list verification.

e597c115d38c5d07f159a513be38ea576686c2a9.title: Eval setup clones git dir then checkout HEAD
e597c115d38c5d07f159a513be38ea576686c2a9.summary: setup-codebuff-repo.ts now copies only .git to CODEBUFF_REPO_DIR and runs git checkout HEAD -- . to restore working files, replacing the full cp -r of the project root. This avoids copying untracked/ignored files and node_modules into the eval sandbox, reducing I/O and timeout risk (60s -> 30s per step). Scope limited to evals/setup-codebuff-repo.ts. Verification checks .git and package.json presence post-checkout.

1ebf8d9b68b11b6e094c42a279daf6cc6d916a0f.title: evals git harness accepts arbitrary repo URLs
1ebf8d9b68b11b6e094c42a279daf6cc6d916a0f.summary: Git evals clone from repoUrl instead of hardcoded codebuff. setup-test-repo.ts replaces setup-codebuff-repo.ts; extractRepoNameFromUrl infers dir from HTTPS/SSH URLs. GitRepoEvalData gains repoUrl field, testRepoName optional. GitHub Actions injects GITHUB_TOKEN into clone URL for private repos.

3e9d4b721994f767a1db3998df9158571c8e6218.title: Update collect-tuning-data script for BigQuery setup and prod flag
3e9d4b721994f767a1db3998df9158571c8e6218.summary: The `collect-tuning-data.ts` script now imports and awaits `setupBigQuery(DATASET)` before execution. The CLI usage flag changed from `--production` to `--prod`. Output directory path simplified from `scripts/ft-file-selection` to `ft-file-selection`.

aba1891449b97c273e3890de33ba9488ba62643b.text: The assistant was updated to better understand that it receives results from other tools rather than creating them itself. This small internal fix helps prevent the assistant from making up answers or guessing at information it hasn't actually received yet.

1ebf8d9b68b11b6e094c42a279daf6cc6d916a0f.text: The system now checks code from many different places, not just one fixed location. This internal update helps the team test new features more flexibly, but it does not change how the product works for you.

3c7fbc0482ba4fe0308cc0c20c348523a4a0baf6.text: The system now checks items one at a time instead of three at once. This change is internal and does not affect what you see.

2315a113c6c7f2450a809b06a43868d2eaf82426.text: The system now accesses the complete history of its source code. This internal update allows it to retrieve more accurate data for daily evaluations, ensuring the assistant has full context without needing manual setup.

a7c06a2712110372bea2d081c80dda845602e9ec.text: A small internal update lets the system review past conversations using a new model and more context.

eafbb9af9a67a5ac02c1443a60eb594608ff2175.text: The system now recognizes a new automated environment. This allows it to access private data correctly when running in that environment.

1c073efa0d43c0130e7bca488376843075853dd1.text: The system now uses the code already present on the computer instead of downloading a fresh copy from the internet. This makes the setup process more reliable and removes the need for special login credentials.

e597c115d38c5d07f159a513be38ea576686c2a9.text: A small internal fix makes the system faster and more reliable by only copying necessary files. You may notice quicker responses and fewer timeouts.

6f40fb3f1c8e1d3df70d17bda44e4014d946335b.text: A small internal update was made to the software's setup. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

0a077ef91968600ad55f6e41961144506dfbbe65.title: GitHub token auth for evals repo clone
0a077ef91968600ad55f6e41961144506dfbbe65.summary: The evals setup script now requires GITHUB_TOKEN and injects it into the clone URL. SSH remotes convert to HTTPS with embedded credentials. This prevents interactive auth prompts in CI.

b86305adba4a1d4035c51f8852f222ed05dfdb75.title: Bump daily-git-evals upload artifact to v4
b86305adba4a1d4035c51f8852f222ed05dfdb75.summary: Updated `actions/upload-artifact` from `v3` to `v4` in `.github/workflows/daily-git-evals.yml`. This aligns with the fix for upload versioning issues. The change affects the CI workflow for daily git evaluations.

b92928268176a1a4dde5f0cf6e448cfecf783cbf.title: CI migrate upload-artifact v3 to v4
b92928268176a1a4dde5f0cf6e448cfecf783cbf.summary: Playwright CI workflow updates `actions/upload-artifact@v3` to `v4` in `web/.github/workflows/playwright.yml`. v3 deprecated and stopped working Jan 30, 2025. v4 offers up to 98% faster upload/download speeds. `.github/knowledge.md` documents the v3-to-v4 migration and breaking changes.

dade11c3a2372adb78a7889bf30f31ea550340b9.title: Remove console.log from context7-api searchLibraries
dade11c3a2372adb78a7889bf30f31ea550340b9.summary: Removed debug console.log statement in backend/src/llm-apis/context7-api.ts. Eliminates noisy URL logging during searchLibraries execution. Internal cleanup affecting backend API integration only.

0adc47918fccab0706e1a2b9ddf4b7f6126a2e32.title: Add daily git evals workflow
0adc47918fccab0706e1a2b9ddf4b7f6126a2e32.summary: New `.github/workflows/daily-git-evals.yml` runs Codebuff git evaluations daily at 8am UTC. Uses Bun 1.2.12, uploads `eval-trace-*.json` artifacts with 30-day retention, and generates step summaries. Internal CI only; no user-facing changes.

122102bb87087439ec17c52fdcb6f3653592f174.title: Add codebuff repo setup step to daily git evals CI
122102bb87087439ec17c52fdcb6f3653592f174.summary: The daily-git-evals workflow now clones the codebuff repository into evals/test-repos/codebuff before running evaluations. This ensures the test environment has the required source code available for the evals to execute against. The change adds a new setup-codebuff-repo.ts script and updates the GitHub Actions workflow to invoke it using the provided GITHUB_TOKEN.

32af0d70169f9358b79d351038931fc0fc4c5438.title: Fix codebuff repo clone auth format
32af0d70169f9358b79d351038931fc0fc4c5438.summary: Updates setupCodebuffRepo to inject GitHub tokens using `:x-oauth-basic` format for HTTPS and SSH-to-HTTPS conversions. Adds `GIT_ASKPASS: 'echo'` to the clone environment to prevent interactive password prompts. This ensures the evals setup successfully clones the codebuff repository.

bc20e13eb270ea1f445fa226483a639111046d85.title: Judge evals context truncation
bc20e13eb270ea1f445fa226483a639111046d85.summary: Judge Git evals now smartly truncate context to fit within 1 million token limit. Mechanism iteratively removes pre/post-commit content, then truncates trace entries from end if needed. Scope: `evals/git-evals/judge-git-eval.ts`. Detail: `countTokens` from `backend/src/util/token-counter` validates prompt size against `MAX_TOKENS`.

358d0db78fa82fc0c46511254ba6315755ace647.title: Git evals run 3 concurrent via async mapLimit
358d0db78fa82fc0c46511254ba6315755ace647.summary: run-git-evals.ts switches sequential commit processing to concurrent execution using async.mapLimit with a cap of 3. Replaces custom mapAsync in common/src/util/promise.ts with the async library dependency. Partial results now save after each completion rather than strict iteration order. Covers evals package, adding async ^3.2.6 and @types/async ^3.2.24.

1122f6c13ddc2d8545a7b94ef77fb58cf6e3a81d.title: Fix Saxy entity detection for ampersands
1122f6c13ddc2d8545a7b94ef77fb58cf6e3a81d.summary: Saxy now checks the full post-ampersand string slice instead of only the next single character to determine if a potential entity is pending. This prevents premature flushing of incomplete entities like `&#` or short named entities when chunk boundaries fall immediately after `&`. The fix applies to the `common/src/util/saxy.ts` XML/HTML parser stream. Duplicate trailing entity checks were removed to consolidate logic.

b86305adba4a1d4035c51f8852f222ed05dfdb75.text: An internal tool used to save daily test results was updated to a newer, more reliable version. This change fixes a problem where the tool sometimes failed to record data correctly. It does not affect how the product works for users.

0adc47918fccab0706e1a2b9ddf4b7f6126a2e32.text: The team set up a daily automated check to review how well the coding assistant performs. This is an internal improvement, so there is no visible change for you.

0a077ef91968600ad55f6e41961144506dfbbe65.text: The system now connects to a code library automatically without asking for a login. This stops setup delays for internal tools.

b92928268176a1a4dde5f0cf6e448cfecf783cbf.text: This small internal update fixed a broken tool that saves test results. It makes the process faster and keeps the system running smoothly.

dade11c3a2372adb78a7889bf30f31ea550340b9.text: A small internal cleanup removed extra background messages from the system. This change does not affect how you use the product.

122102bb87087439ec17c52fdcb6f3653592f174.text: A small internal update ensures the system can correctly access the code it needs to test, helping it run evaluations more reliably.

1122f6c13ddc2d8545a7b94ef77fb58cf6e3a81d.text: The system now waits for a complete signal before processing text, instead of guessing after a single character. This prevents broken or incomplete symbols from appearing when data arrives in small pieces.

bc20e13eb270ea1f445fa226483a639111046d85.text: The system now automatically shortens long review reports to fit within its size limits, ensuring they are still processed correctly without errors.

32af0d70169f9358b79d351038931fc0fc4c5438.text: A small internal fix ensures the system can automatically connect to and download necessary files without asking for a password. This prevents setup errors, so you can start using the tool smoothly.

358d0db78fa82fc0c46511254ba6315755ace647.text: The system now checks three items at once instead of one by one, making it faster. Results appear as they finish, not in a fixed order.

2e04e27f018162dd626784f75da68b6948f2b7ba.title: Squash system messages in Vercel AI SDK transform
2e04e27f018162dd626784f75da68b6948f2b7ba.summary: Squashes multiple system message blocks into a single string in `transformMessages` within `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`. Previously, array-based system inputs were pushed as individual `CoreMessage` objects. Now, they are joined with `\n\n` into a single `system` role message.

467cc64c2eee2eca3e02235782aead3a1a873749.title: Fix Anthropic prompt caching provider options and track cache tokens
467cc64c2eee2eca3e02235782aead3a1a873749.summary: Moved `cacheControl` into `providerOptions.anthropic` for user, assistant, and tool messages in `transformMessages` to match Vercel AI SDK expectations. Extracted `cacheReadInputTokens` and `cacheCreationInputTokens` from `providerMetadata.anthropic` in `promptAiSdkStream` and persisted them via `saveMessage`. Updated `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`.

85727445a1bf904311456cdffcee0be52cc2d0a4.title: Cost mode slash commands added to CLI
85727445a1bf904311456cdffcee0be52cc2d0a4.summary: CLI now supports /lite, /normal, and /max commands to switch cost modes directly. processCommand returns string or null to handle optional message forwarding. Mode indicator appears in prompt when not normal. Backend logger context and client state track active cost mode.

645460ce970644bb12946c65fa8142b6267370ee.title: Persist partial eval results during git eval runs
645460ce970644bb12946c65fa8142b6267370ee.summary: Git eval runner now writes partial results to a trace-ID-suffixed file after each commit. Prevents data loss on crash or timeout by incrementally persisting state. Scope limited to evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts. Final output still written to a distinct trace-ID-suffixed file upon completion.

50a0cad6548f68c6d3f8f766dc745cd83f0e24b8.title: Improve error handling and timeouts in git evals runner
50a0cad6548f68c6d3f8f766dc745cd83f0e24b8.summary: Added process-level uncaughtException and unhandledRejection handlers to capture async errors during single eval runs. Wrapped agent decision prompts with 5-minute timeouts and loopMainPrompt execution with 30-minute timeouts using withTimeout utility. Improved error logging and ensured judging results are returned even if judging fails.

1621707d9f8c9334e7b546e4d0847aaa06fb93d0.title: Send message cost response before db storage
1621707d9f8c9334e7b546e4d0847aaa06fb93d0.summary: Reordered `sendCostResponseToClient` to execute before database storage operations in `saveMessage` within `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts`. Eliminates client-side latency caused by waiting for the database write to complete before receiving the cost calculation. Internal logic update affecting the message saving pipeline.

f5754d1fac5f26e3e5dc789bdf265e9557e5da4d.title: Fix unsafe non-null assertion in uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining
f5754d1fac5f26e3e5dc789bdf265e9557e5da4d.summary: Replaced unsafe non-null assertions (`!`) with explicit null/undefined checks in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This prevents potential runtime crashes when accessing `loadedFiles` entries that may not exist. The change affects the `uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining` function, ensuring safer iteration over file contents before token counting.

18feb799f943e6f1e43a94ba321e765fb6038531.title: Add @ prefix completion for tokens and file paths in CLI
18feb799f943e6f1e43a94ba321e765fb6038531.summary: CLI completion now handles '@' prefix to suggest file paths and token names from client.fileContext.fileTokenScores. Uses getAllFilePaths to flatten fileTree and matches against token names. Scope limited to npm-app/src/cli.ts. Common prefix logic auto-completes when multiple matches share a suffix.

cf6fa144e64f39c43b53f920e44410cf97bd2b47.title: CLI completion caps matches at 20
cf6fa144e64f39c43b53f920e44410cf97bd2b47.summary: npm-app/src/cli.ts limits @-mention completions to 20 results via MAX_COMPLETION_RESULTS. Multi-match branches now return raw names without '@' prefix, relying on input retention. Single/no-match paths also use the sliced list.

a566ec2b780dc09c4cded7008af0081931421420.title: Add git evals and improve change application robustness
a566ec2b780dc09c4cded7008af0081931421420.summary: New `evals/git-evals` suite introduced with generation, tracing, and judging scripts. `applyChanges` in `common/src/util/changes.ts` updated to catch path resolution errors, adding an `invalid` array to the return object alongside `created`, `modified`, and `ignored`. This prevents crashes on malformed paths during patch application.

645460ce970644bb12946c65fa8142b6267370ee.text: The system now saves results step-by-step during long checks. If a check stops early, partial results remain available instead of disappearing.

85727445a1bf904311456cdffcee0be52cc2d0a4.text: You can now quickly switch between different spending levels for the assistant using simple commands. Your current spending level will be shown to you, so you always know how much effort the assistant is using.

467cc64c2eee2eca3e02235782aead3a1a873749.text: The system now correctly identifies which parts of your conversation are saved for faster reuse, allowing it to track and report on these efficiency gains.

2e04e27f018162dd626784f75da68b6948f2b7ba.text: A small internal update groups the assistant's setup instructions into one clear block. This helps the system follow its rules more consistently.

1621707d9f8c9334e7b546e4d0847aaa06fb93d0.text: The system now sends cost estimates immediately instead of waiting for data storage to finish. This reduces the delay you see when sending messages.

18feb799f943e6f1e43a94ba321e765fb6038531.text: In the command-line tool, typing @ now suggests matching files and tokens. This helps you quickly find and select items without typing full names.

f5754d1fac5f26e3e5dc789bdf265e9557e5da4d.text: The system now checks if files are missing before trying to read them. This prevents the app from crashing when uploading documents for training.

cf6fa144e64f39c43b53f920e44410cf97bd2b47.text: When you type '@' to mention a name, the list now shows at most 20 suggestions to keep it simple. This small internal change helps the tool run faster and prevents the menu from getting too long.

a566ec2b780dc09c4cded7008af0081931421420.text: The assistant now checks file paths more carefully before making changes. This stops the tool from crashing when it tries to save files to invalid locations.

50a0cad6548f68c6d3f8f766dc745cd83f0e24b8.text: The system now stops waiting if a task takes too long and reports problems more clearly. This helps the product handle issues better without freezing.

a07bfc55a360a2c5f3dd9fcf5f0becbe626d4745.title: stopSequences forwarded to ai sdk
a07bfc55a360a2c5f3dd9fcf5f0becbe626d4745.summary: stopSequences option now passed to generateText and streamText in backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts. Previously dropped despite existing in options. Scope limited to Vercel AI SDK adapter. No user-facing change unless stopSequences already set upstream.

cc7ea4b18f5495fce53018a51ca9663ac8b1fa29.title: Refactor LLM streaming to unified AI SDK approach
cc7ea4b18f5495fce53018a51ca9663ac8b1fa29.summary: Refactored LLM streaming in `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts` to use `promptAiSdkStream` from `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`, replacing direct provider-specific calls (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter). Added `stopSequences` support to `promptAiSdkStream` and `promptAiSdk` signatures. Removed imports for `models`, `OpenAIModel`, `openrouterModels`, and provider-specific stream functions. Consolidated message transformation via `transformMessages`.

817c4fc03608956cc5e8aef17b320aa710c435b8.title: Track git repo metrics in analytics
817c4fc03608956cc5e8aef17b320aa710c435b8.summary: Added getRepoMetrics utility to extract git repository statistics (age, tracked files, commits, authors) using isomorphic-git. These metrics are attached to PostHog user profiles and logger context during client initialization. The repoName field was propagated through backend prompt actions and file request functions to support analytics tagging.

2b0ead0f2f861631ae69c42436af9a3bc38b6249.title: Add ai sdk mocks to main-prompt tests
2b0ead0f2f861631ae69c42436af9a3bc38b6249.summary: Adds `spyOn` mocks for `promptAiSdk` and `promptAiSdkStream` in `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts`. Imports `aisdk` from `../llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk` to support existing test suite. Scope limited to test file; no production code changes.

faae0b7c9d92d8ddff2b4019e8a25fee4a8c76ae.title: Fix mocks in main prompt test
faae0b7c9d92d8ddff2b4019e8a25fee4a8c76ae.summary: Added `promptAiSdkStream` mock to `mockAgentStream` helper. Updated `promptAiSdk` mock to return Promise instead of async generator. Scope: `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts`.

5467138a5fdab77c57ae9acfab23e2587eb6feb9.title: Add ephemeral cache control to AI SDK message transform
5467138a5fdab77c57ae9acfab23e2587eb6feb9.summary: Updated `transformMessages` in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` to propagate `cache_control` flags as `providerOptions.cacheControl` with type `ephemeral`. This ensures user, assistant, and tool messages respect upstream cache directives when sent via the Vercel AI SDK. Scope limited to the backend LLM API adapter.

90e7765fc0aaf504c18a697dfe060bb4bc3df1da.title: Add @charleslien to CODEOWNERS
90e7765fc0aaf504c18a697dfe060bb4bc3df1da.summary: Added @charleslien to .github/CODEOWNERS. Now shares ownership of all files with @brandonkachen and @jahooma. Internal change.

693635b17ac0bc709ac805ab46be6dbc2543146f.title: Fix mock leakage in usage-calculation tests
693635b17ac0bc709ac805ab46be6dbc2543146f.summary: Refactored test structure in backend/src/__tests__/usage-calculation.test.ts and auto-topup.test.ts to prevent mock leakage. Moved mock.reset() and mock.module() calls from individual it() blocks to a top-level beforeEach() hook. This ensures clean state isolation between tests and fixes flaky failures caused by stale mocks.

e84dad64cc9b873a87de5631d51e4770aaa176a8.title: Add automatic client-side exception capture
e84dad64cc9b873a87de5631d51e4770aaa176a8.summary: Added `logError` to `common/src/analytics.ts` and `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` to wrap PostHog's `captureException`. `npm-app/src/utils/logger.ts` now intercepts `error` and `fatal` pino logs, converting them into analytics exceptions via `logAsErrorIfNeeded`. `npm-app/src/client.ts` and `npm-app/src/update-codebuff.ts` replace manual `trackEvent` error reporting with structured `logger.error` calls. PostHog client initialization in `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` enables `enableExceptionAutocapture`.

d09143aeacc7ea61ec5ae41cb91c7992ab3f0bdd.title: Add /reset command to clear conversation context
d09143aeacc7ea61ec5ae41cb91c7992ab3f0bdd.summary: The /reset command clears conversation state, terminates background processes, and reinitializes the project context as if starting a new session. This requires refactoring `currentChatId` from a static export to a mutable variable managed by `getCurrentChatId` and `startNewChat` functions in `project-files.ts`. The `Client.resetContext` method orchestrates the clearing of messages, checkpoints, and tool results, while `cli.ts` handles the terminal clearing and process restart logic.

a07bfc55a360a2c5f3dd9fcf5f0becbe626d4745.text: The system now correctly follows instructions to stop generating text at specific points. This internal fix ensures better control over responses, though you may not notice a difference unless those specific settings were already active.

faae0b7c9d92d8ddff2b4019e8a25fee4a8c76ae.text: Internal test setup was fixed to correctly simulate the assistant's behavior. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2b0ead0f2f861631ae69c42436af9a3bc38b6249.text: Small internal update. Tests now fake the AI service calls. You won't notice any difference.

90e7765fc0aaf504c18a697dfe060bb4bc3df1da.text: A new team member now shares responsibility for checking changes to the software. This is an internal update that will not affect how you use the product.

5467138a5fdab77c57ae9acfab23e2587eb6feb9.text: The system now remembers parts of your chat history more efficiently. This small internal update helps the service run smoother without changing how you use it.

693635b17ac0bc709ac805ab46be6dbc2543146f.text: Fixed an internal issue where tests could accidentally use leftover data from previous checks, causing unreliable results. This change does not affect how you use the product.

817c4fc03608956cc5e8aef17b320aa710c435b8.text: The app now collects basic information about your project folder, such as its age and file count, to help the team understand how the software is used.

cc7ea4b18f5495fce53018a51ca9663ac8b1fa29.text: The team updated the assistant's background connections to different services. This makes the system easier to maintain and keeps responses consistent.

e84dad64cc9b873a87de5631d51e4770aaa176a8.text: The app now automatically sends reports when it encounters unexpected errors. This helps the team identify and fix problems faster.

d09143aeacc7ea61ec5ae41cb91c7992ab3f0bdd.text: A new command lets you clear the chat history and stop running tasks to start fresh.

f554e4f6875aa970c5e3eb2d9f841bafd2cb7934.title: transformMessages handles Message in ai-sdk
f554e4f6875aa970c5e3eb2d9f841bafd2cb7934.summary: Exported transformMessages in backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts now accepts (GeminiMessage | Message)[]. Added explicit handling for Message image sources, text parts, and assistant tool_use blocks while skipping user tool parts. This broadens input compatibility for the Vercel AI SDK adapter.

c30832c674a1eebe071d6d8de47afd23ba8c6a8a.title: Enforce endturn in standard mode and refine agent instructions
c30832c674a1eebe071d6d8de47afd23ba8c6a8a.summary: The standard mode main prompt now explicitly requires the `end_turn` tool at the end of responses, mirroring the existing Lite mode behavior. Agent instructions were refined to remove redundant formatting and clarify package management, refactoring, and testing guidelines. These changes affect `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`.

7808329c547b03e6efb0693309b2336480f2cbec.title: Fix missing space in codesearch ripgrep command
7808329c547b03e6efb0693309b2336480f2cbec.summary: The `handleCodeSearch` function in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` now inserts a space before the current directory argument in the ripgrep command. Previously, the pattern and path were concatenated without separation, causing search failures. This change ensures correct shell command construction for code search operations.

7fc0330976e1fc68818be66994fbb527a18a96ed.title: Add prebuild clean scripts to npm packages
7fc0330976e1fc68818be66994fbb527a18a96ed.summary: Added prebuild clean steps to package.json build scripts. common runs bun run clean before tsc. npm-app chains nx clean, nx reset, and nx build. Ensures dist artifacts regenerate cleanly on each build.

51e607e54327e47b7872c039f86094d5db0a0fe5.title: Fix usage calculation tests
51e607e54327e47b7872c039f86094d5db0a0fe5.summary: Corrected mock paths and return types in usage-calculation.test.ts. Updated logger mock to common/util/logger and made orderBy return a Promise. Added test for in-memory settlement between positive balance and debt.

dd1fc083a17a228fdc1e11b5f964d6a1ce1b7a42.title: Fix processStrReplace line ending normalization
dd1fc083a17a228fdc1e11b5f964d6a1ce1b7a42.summary: `processStrReplace` now normalizes newline characters within extracted diff hunks using `replaceAll`. This ensures consistent line endings when constructing patch strings from raw diff content. The change applies to `backend/src/process-str-replace.ts` and its corresponding unit test.

360c1ad77fa0fa29e26e6fbadd2d9148dde26360.title: Remove cache-invalidating filter in main-prompt
360c1ad77fa0fa29e26e6fbadd2d9148dde26360.summary: Removed `isSystemInstruction` filter from `messageHistory` processing in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This change ensures all messages are mapped via `castAssistantMessage` regardless of system instruction status, stabilizing the prompt structure for caching. Internal refactor affecting backend prompt assembly logic. No user-facing behavior change expected beyond improved cache consistency.

6441cc7e8b117833035bdcf4d5956dfc01d62f32.title: Trim verbosity from gemini thinking guidelines
6441cc7e8b117833035bdcf4d5956dfc01d62f32.summary: Removed two specific instruction lines from the guidelines in `backend/src/thinking-stream.ts`. The deleted rules previously mandated showing code excerpts with comments for changes and writing full planning documents during thinking. This reduction aligns with the capability of Claude 4, allowing the model to rely on its inherent reasoning strength rather than verbose structural constraints. The change affects the internal prompt construction for the thinking stream.

ad6d724e9c34fe830d06749854a0c21f308e8b9b.title: Add isSubdir helper for cross-platform path checks
ad6d724e9c34fe830d06749854a0c21f308e8b9b.summary: Introduced `isSubdir` in `project-files.ts` to standardize directory containment checks. The function resolves paths and adds a Windows-specific drive letter comparison to prevent false positives across different drives. `menu.ts` and `terminal.ts` now use this helper instead of inline `path.relative` logic.

74dfac8401e2a598f738eac46c67ee9e76a70fa9.title: Strengthen script and git command restrictions
74dfac8401e2a598f738eac46c67ee9e76a70fa9.summary: System prompts updated to strictly forbid running scripts, git commits, or pushes without explicit user permission. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md` now mandate asking for confirmation before executing potentially destructive commands. This change aims to prevent costly accidents and production breakages caused by unauthorized agent actions.

7fc0330976e1fc68818be66994fbb527a18a96ed.text: The system now clears old setup files before building new ones. This ensures the software is always created from a fresh start, preventing leftover files from causing problems.

c30832c674a1eebe071d6d8de47afd23ba8c6a8a.text: The assistant now consistently signals when it has finished its response, ensuring smoother interactions.

dd1fc083a17a228fdc1e11b5f964d6a1ce1b7a42.text: The system now handles text formatting more consistently. This internal fix prevents minor display glitches when updates are applied.

74dfac8401e2a598f738eac46c67ee9e76a70fa9.text: The assistant now asks for your permission before performing powerful actions like saving changes or running code. This safety rule prevents accidental mistakes that could break your work.

360c1ad77fa0fa29e26e6fbadd2d9148dde26360.text: A small internal update fixed a rule that was accidentally skipping certain messages. This makes the system more consistent behind the scenes, with no visible change to how the product works for you.

ad6d724e9c34fe830d06749854a0c21f308e8b9b.text: The app now checks file locations more accurately to ensure it only accesses files within the intended folder. This internal update prevents errors when working with files on different drives.

f554e4f6875aa970c5e3eb2d9f841bafd2cb7934.text: The system now understands more types of messages when sending them to the AI. This means the chat works more reliably behind the scenes, with no visible changes to how you use it.

51e607e54327e47b7872c039f86094d5db0a0fe5.text: The company fixed internal checks to ensure usage calculations work correctly. This small change helps keep your account balance and payments accurate.

7808329c547b03e6efb0693309b2336480f2cbec.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system builds search commands. This ensures that searching for text within the codebase works reliably.

bbae1e98e4b9762b4893b5ecf2e097aad1228f8d.title: Make readline public in CLI to fix client circular dependency
bbae1e98e4b9762b4893b5ecf2e097aad1228f8d.summary: Promoted `rl` from private to public in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to allow direct access from `npm-app/src/client.ts`. This eliminates the need to pass the `readline.Interface` via `ClientOptions` and removes the circular dependency risk by importing `CLI` directly in the client. The `Client` class now accesses `CLI.getInstance().rl` for login event listeners, simplifying the constructor signature.

e8b4277364f163d0b8fa172d74ebe71f48021b33.title: Remove FLUSHFAILED event from analytics flush error handler
e8b4277364f163d0b8fa172d74ebe71f48021b33.summary: The catch block in flushAnalytics now swallows errors silently, removing the trackEvent(AnalyticsEvent.FLUSH_FAILED) call. This prevents recursive event tracking when the flush itself fails. Scope limited to common/src/analytics.ts.

538bad74e285b51cec47d602d5d48fcf4211b429.title: Add XML entity escaping instructions to tool definitions
538bad74e285b51cec47d602d5d48fcf4211b429.summary: Updated `backend/src/tools.ts` to explicitly instruct agents on escaping XML entities. Added rule requiring `&lt;` for literal `<` strings to prevent accidental tool execution or parsing errors. Internal prompt refinement only.

30b6bffa7528557ff91b30ab2160a133eaec35bd.title: Enforce explicit deletion comments in edit snippets
30b6bffa7528557ff91b30ab2160a133eaec35bd.summary: Strengthened prompting for `write_file` to mandate explicit deletion comments (e.g., `// Delete Block 2`) within edit snippets. This ensures the downstream 'fast-apply' model correctly interprets removals, as it cannot infer deletions from context alone. Updated `backend/src/tools.ts` to include detailed examples and stricter formatting rules for `content` parameters. Also corrected `updateSubgoal` status enum from 'ABORTED' to 'FAILED' in schema definitions.

1daa8a155d91ec8bf8816832f898822decb2c924.title: codesearch pattern JSON stringify
1daa8a155d91ec8bf8816832f898822decb2c924.summary: Updated `handleCodeSearch` in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` to use `JSON.stringify` for the search pattern instead of stripping quotes. The command construction now embeds the JSON string directly, adjusting the trailing dot syntax. This ensures patterns containing quotes are preserved and correctly escaped for the underlying `rg` execution.

a788e33dff020e23d7d022419340d16b329d25bb.title: Add attribute to xml-stream-parser test case
a788e33dff020e23d7d022419340d16b329d25bb.summary: Updated the 'ignore new parameters' test case in `backend/src/__tests__/xml-stream-parser.test.ts` to include an attribute (`attr="123"`) within the nested `<param2>` tag. This ensures the stream parser correctly ignores parameters with attributes while preserving raw text content in the final result.

27ffd5a802b2f9f178863bbc9b15b54f9685056a.title: Fix XML entity parsing in saxy
27ffd5a802b2f9f178863bbc9b15b54f9685056a.summary: Updated parseEntities in common/src/util/saxy.ts to correctly handle malformed or invalid XML entities. The logic now treats ampersands followed by invalid characters (space, &, <, >) or empty strings as literal characters, preventing incorrect parsing. Numeric entities (decimal and hex) are parsed with explicit validation, falling back to literal passthrough on NaN. This fix applies to the shared core utility used by all Freebuff surfaces.

6e704acbf06f1a8757c62304f3b02e493be15bd2.title: Add claude-opus-4-20250514 to relabel pipeline and constants
6e704acbf06f1a8757c62304f3b02e493be15bd2.summary: claudeModels.opus4 (claude-opus-4-20250514) added to common/src/constants.ts and backend/src/llm-apis/claude.ts. relabelRuns.ts now iterates [sonnet, opus4] for full-file-context relabels, replacing hardcoded claude-3-5-sonnet-with-full-file-context string with dynamic `${model}-with-full-file-context`. relabelWithClaudeWithFullFileContext accepts model parameter; error logging enriched with stack/message fields. Scope: backend admin relabel handler, Claude API message transform, shared constants.

3bc799fc01407634259af6f3746b4250865d9c53.title: xml-stream-parser ignores new params while parsing existing
3bc799fc01407634259af6f3746b4250865d9c53.summary: xml-stream-parser.ts now ignores new parameters encountered while parsing an existing parameter, emitting the raw tag as text instead of ending the current parameter. This prevents premature parameter closure and data loss when malformed XML contains nested or unexpected tags. The change affects backend stream processing logic and updates the warning message to instruct users to escape XML. Tests in xml-stream-parser.test.ts reflect the new behavior where state remains unchanged and rawTag is passed to onText.

af80b63047e5f9927938b7054b51edfb2389d319.title: Claude Sonnet 4 maxtokens bump and strreplace multi-edit support
af80b63047e5f9927938b7054b51edfb2389d319.summary: Claude Sonnet 4 replaces 3.6, raising `max_tokens` from 8192 to 32000 in `claude.ts`. `process-str-replace.ts` refactored to accept `oldStrs`/`newStrs` arrays for batched edits, updating `tools.ts` instructions to prefer `write_file` and document `old_{i}`/`new_{i}` syntax. `xml-stream-parser.ts` adds regex param matching via `includesMatch`. Main prompt removes forced `end_turn` and `add_subgoal` requirements.

1daa8a155d91ec8bf8816832f898822decb2c924.text: A small internal fix ensures that search terms with quotation marks work correctly. This means users can now search for exact phrases without errors.

538bad74e285b51cec47d602d5d48fcf4211b429.text: The system learned to handle special characters more carefully. This small internal fix helps prevent mistakes when the assistant processes text.

27ffd5a802b2f9f178863bbc9b15b54f9685056a.text: Fixed how text with special symbols is read. This prevents errors when content has unusual formatting.

bbae1e98e4b9762b4893b5ecf2e097aad1228f8d.text: A small internal fix cleaned up how the login screen talks to the rest of the app. You won't notice any new features, but the software is now more stable and less likely to break.

30b6bffa7528557ff91b30ab2160a133eaec35bd.text: The assistant now marks removed text clearly so it applies edits correctly. This fixes a small internal error and prevents wrong updates when you delete parts of a file.

e8b4277364f163d0b8fa172d74ebe71f48021b33.text: The app now quietly ignores errors when sending usage data, instead of trying to report those errors and causing a loop. This is a small internal fix that makes the app more stable.

6e704acbf06f1a8757c62304f3b02e493be15bd2.text: The system now uses an additional AI model to review and correct its own answers. This helps it catch mistakes more often, making the final responses you see more accurate.

3bc799fc01407634259af6f3746b4250865d9c53.text: The system now keeps text inside a message together when it sees unexpected formatting marks, instead of accidentally cutting the message short. This prevents information from being lost or broken apart during processing.

a788e33dff020e23d7d022419340d16b329d25bb.text: A small internal update added a test to check how the system handles extra data tags. This ensures the tool correctly ignores those tags without breaking other features.

af80b63047e5f9927938b7054b51edfb2389d319.text: The assistant can now write longer responses. It can also make several changes to a document at once, saving you time.

f07ddb1b39622cbbcb46a4e8a73b66e2759434a3.title: Tweak startup wording in npm-app menu
f07ddb1b39622cbbcb46a4e8a73b66e2759434a3.summary: Updated `displayGreeting` in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to clarify Codebuff's role as an AI pair programmer and fix a typo in the navigation instructions. The message now explicitly states the current project root and advises running `codebuff` within the target directory. This change is internal to the CLI startup experience.

c5bd510c980c3d6d357df91ed909bca8568b4df9.title: Startup menu homedir check
c5bd510c980c3d6d357df91ed909bca8568b4df9.summary: Updated startup menu logic in npm-app/src/menu.ts to detect homedir via path.relative instead of strict equality. Improved onboarding text and ensured clean exit with process.exit(0). Internal change.

fe649402a09aacff407e90cf2819de61de8ca371.title: Add start-lite dev script
fe649402a09aacff407e90cf2819de61de8ca371.summary: Added `start-lite` npm scripts to root and `npm-app` package.json. Mirrors existing `start-max` pattern but passes `--lite` flag to CLI entrypoint. Internal dev tooling only; no user-facing behavior change.

79dc159133c2af0ac84ebd7e8ef619bb920791c5.title: Switch large file search/replace model to o4-mini
79dc159133c2af0ac84ebd7e8ef619bb920791c5.summary: Update model for large file search/replace operations in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` from `models.o3mini` to `models.o4mini`. This internal change leverages the newer model for improved performance in this specific backend process. No user-facing features or configurations are affected.

efb016beae9069917fa236ac21558a565b26c927.title: CLI slash menu tracks pasted content
efb016beae9069917fa236ac21558a565b26c927.summary: CLI slash menu detection now checks `this.pastedContent` alongside `this.rl.line` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. This prevents the menu from activating when a slash is pasted as part of a larger string, ensuring it only appears when `/` is the first character typed. Scope limited to internal CLI logic.

b37a5ce3861e2626194c55921680c7cdf43a5061.title: Update Gemini 2.5 Flash preview model to 05-20
b37a5ce3861e2626194c55921680c7cdf43a5061.summary: The `gemini2_5_flash` and `gemini2_5_flash_thinking` constants in `common/src/constants.ts` updated from `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17` to `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20`. This aligns Freebuff with the latest upstream preview release. The change affects the core model definitions used across CLI, Web, and Desktop surfaces.

a68ccdf37c1bdcccbab922fa291f74df62033acc.title: Enable relace for larger files
a68ccdf37c1bdcccbab922fa291f74df62033acc.summary: LARGE_FILE_TOKEN_LIMIT increased from 16_000 to 64_000 in backend/src/process-file-block.ts. Temporary relace dispatch logic for files under 64k tokens removed. Routing to handleLargeFile now triggers at higher threshold.

d15a58924a5dba81dd334f226a1b15ec6f8a2331.title: Admin relabel limit configurable and full context counter fix
d15a58924a5dba81dd334f226a1b15ec6f8a2331.summary: Added a UI setting in web/src/app/admin/file-picker/page.tsx to configure the relabel limit, replacing the hardcoded value of 10. Fixed a logic error in backend/src/admin/relabelRuns.ts where the relabeled counter incremented per trace instead of per successful relabel action within the full context loop. The fix introduces a didRelabel flag to ensure accurate counting when multiple relabel types are triggered for a single trace. Scope limited to internal admin tools for relabel runs.

9ba698a4bd4852081e2ad21f0037c552883c71a5.title: Increase timeout for context 7
9ba698a4bd4852081e2ad21f0037c552883c71a5.summary: Adjusted timeout and chunk limits in `get-documentation-for-query.ts`. Increased Gemini response timeout from 12s to 20s and capped unique chunks at 25. Updated error logging to explicitly extract message and stack from Error objects. Enforced max 3 libraries/topics in prompt instructions.

ac9a7f7354e3dd3e6e28eb67521b4d340722c6aa.title: Add file-picker grading infrastructure and relabel UI updates
ac9a7f7354e3dd3e6e28eb67521b4d340722c6aa.summary: Introduce grade-run subsystem for evaluating file-selection model outputs via LLM judge, with new backend grading logic and BigQuery trace schema support. Add admin relabel runs UI page and expand trace retrieval to bundle related training-context traces. Update client.ts to support optional user filtering and INNER/LEFT join types for trace queries.

f07ddb1b39622cbbcb46a4e8a73b66e2759434a3.text: The startup message now clearly states which folder it is working in and reminds users to run the tool from the correct location. This small internal update fixes a typo and makes the instructions easier to follow.

efb016beae9069917fa236ac21558a565b26c927.text: The command menu no longer pops up when you paste text that starts with a slash. It only appears when you type the slash yourself.

d15a58924a5dba81dd334f226a1b15ec6f8a2331.text: Admins can now set the limit for relabeling actions, and the system counts these actions correctly. This internal fix ensures accurate tracking for staff managing data.

fe649402a09aacff407e90cf2819de61de8ca371.text: The team added a new internal tool for developers to test the app in a simpler mode. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

79dc159133c2af0ac84ebd7e8ef619bb920791c5.text: The system now uses a newer tool to help find and replace text in large files. This small internal update makes the process run faster without changing how you use the product.

9ba698a4bd4852081e2ad21f0037c552883c71a5.text: The assistant now waits longer for answers and uses fewer reference documents per request. This change helps prevent timeouts when searching for information.

b37a5ce3861e2626194c55921680c7cdf43a5061.text: The assistant now uses a newer version of its underlying brain. You might see slightly better answers, but the tool works the same way.

a68ccdf37c1bdcccbab922fa291f74df62033acc.text: The system now handles larger files more efficiently. Users can upload bigger documents without hitting previous size limits.

ac9a7f7354e3dd3e6e28eb67521b4d340722c6aa.text: The system now automatically checks how well the assistant picks files by using a second AI to grade its choices. Staff gained a new page to review and correct these grades, and search tools can now find related training data more flexibly.

44471279fd03b59ed9f9d68bf571efa2640dd975.title: Fix xml-stream-parser test expectation
44471279fd03b59ed9f9d68bf571efa2640dd975.summary: Updated `xml-stream-parser.test.ts` to expect the new warning message 'WARN: Tool not found. Make sure to escape non-tool XML! e.g. <invalid>'. This aligns the test with the current error handling logic for stray XML tags.

398d348899bdc2d782b4d61504f1f8c62c043658.title: Add analytics for slash command usage
398d348899bdc2d782b4d61504f1f8c62c043658.summary: Added `SLASH_MENU_ACTIVATED`, `SLASH_COMMAND_USED`, and `INVALID_COMMAND` events to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now tracks these events via `trackEvent` when users activate the slash menu, execute valid commands, or enter unknown slash commands. Includes user ID and command string in payload for successful and invalid commands. Menu activation tracking is gated to ensure it only fires when '/' is the sole character in the input line.

7bc711d065c89f75f32eb37b7b633a00b247bc2d.title: Switch saxy stream import to node:stream
7bc711d065c89f75f32eb37b7b633a00b247bc2d.summary: common/src/util/saxy.ts replaces readable-stream with node:stream for the Transform import. Removes external polyfill dependency in favor of native Node APIs. Scope limited to shared core utility module. No migration or behavior change required.

31bc4b20f88ab7d7f3d8449bad2af285d3709e4f.title: Add prompting for background process management
31bc4b20f88ab7d7f3d8449bad2af285d3709e4f.summary: Updated system prompts in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts` to enforce proper background process handling. Instructions now mandate killing entire process groups (or trees on Windows) using SIGTERM signals and restarting processes with `process_type=BACKGROUND`. This change aims to prevent orphaned processes and ensure cleaner lifecycle management for background tasks.

294e036ab38dd55fab20a9eb7e802cdadd1ebcad.title: SIGINT double-press exit skips active input
294e036ab38dd55fab20a9eb7e802cdadd1ebcad.summary: CLI SIGINT handler now checks `this.rl.line` before triggering exit on double-press. Prevents accidental termination when user has recently typed. Logic in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

9c9cf198ab9cbe7bc6cb3b9e7d049eb5978a596b.title: readfiles prompt update
9c9cf198ab9cbe7bc6cb3b9e7d049eb5978a596b.summary: Prompt for `read_files` tool in `backend/src/tools.ts` updated. New instruction explicitly forbids re-reading files already in context, noting changes surface via file update results. Internal change to backend tool definitions.

3695d0edfe0ebfe54ab989d9ee380184e9c16dad.title: Improve slash command validation and menu display
3695d0edfe0ebfe54ab989d9ee380184e9c16dad.summary: CLI slash command processing refactored into helper methods for cleaner input validation and unknown command handling. Menu display function renamed to displaySlashCommandHelperMenu with improved formatting including command descriptions and shell tip. Login command marked as non-slash command in interactiveCommandDetails. Slash command list now sorted alphabetically.

863afde43257d6028fabd3cf3a4124933d8321ba.title: System prompt tweaks and XML parser error message update
863afde43257d6028fabd3cf3a4124933d8321ba.summary: Updated `main-prompt.ts` to instruct the agent to correct system errors alongside assistant mistakes. Refined `agent-instructions.md` wording for clarity on end-turn behavior. Modified `xml-stream-parser.ts` to change the warning message for stray XML tags from 'Ignoring stray XML tag' to 'Tool not found', including an HTML-escaped example in the error output.

3ba6c2937062ebfb4438460d59570ad62e93ac7d.title: Fix unit tests in main-prompt
3ba6c2937062ebfb4438460d59570ad62e93ac7d.summary: Corrects assertions in `main-prompt` integration and unit tests. Updates import order and fixes newline escaping in `getMessageText`. Aligns expected user prompt content with `asUserMessage` helper output.

d49578e20a008503231d0a4059153313745f1e79.title: Context7 API v1 migration and query-based search
d49578e20a008503231d0a4059153313745f1e79.summary: Backend Context7 integration migrated to `https://context7.com/api/v1/search` for dynamic library lookup, replacing static project listing. `get-documentation-for-query.ts` now performs a two-step flow: AI-driven library suggestion followed by parallel documentation fetching. `context7-api.ts` exports `searchLibraries` and updates `fetchContext7LibraryDocumentation` to accept queries instead of pre-resolved IDs. 398d348899bdc2d782b4d61504f1f8c62c043658.text: The product now records when you open the command menu or use a command, including if the command is unknown. This helps the team understand how people use these features, but it does not change how the product works for you.

3ba6c2937062ebfb4438460d59570ad62e93ac7d.text: Internal checks were updated to match how the assistant prepares messages. This small fix improves reliability behind the scenes and causes no visible changes for users.

7bc711d065c89f75f32eb37b7b633a00b247bc2d.text: The software now uses its own built-in tools for handling data streams instead of relying on an extra helper. This is a small internal cleanup that makes the system simpler and lighter, with no visible changes to how you use the product.

294e036ab38dd55fab20a9eb7e802cdadd1ebcad.text: Pressing the stop button twice no longer quits the program if you have just started typing. This prevents accidentally losing your work.

44471279fd03b59ed9f9d68bf571efa2640dd975.text: A small internal update ensures the system correctly identifies when a tool is missing and advises users to escape invalid XML characters. This improves the accuracy of error messages during use.

9c9cf198ab9cbe7bc6cb3b9e7d049eb5978a596b.text: The assistant was told to stop re-reading files it already has. This saves time and prevents repeated work.

c34293dc8e061fe1acf1dfff5df2c40f825967f4.title: Add UPDATECODEBUFFFAILED analytics event
c34293dc8e061fe1acf1dfff5df2c40f825967f4.summary: New `UPDATE_CODEBUFF_FAILED` enum value tracks update failures in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. `npm-app/src/update-codebuff.ts` now calls `trackEvent` with the error message and flushes analytics before logging the console error. Scope limited to core constants and the update utility.

ec646edcd1946220593edd58e168251a8ad8d8d2.title: Fix Ctrl/Cmd click hint in menu
ec646edcd1946220593edd58e168251a8ad8d8d2.summary: Updated the Discord join prompt in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to dynamically display 'Command' or 'Ctrl' based on `os.platform()`. Replaced the static '(Ctrl/Cmd+Click to open)' string with a conditional template literal and changed the text color from `yellow` to `gray`.

7d8a37e5712e70dc92247fe0583799185607f4ee.title: Simplify interactive command menu display
7d8a37e5712e70dc92247fe0583799185607f4ee.summary: Removes redundant 'type ' prefixes from commandText strings in npm-app/src/menu.ts. Updates section header to 'COMMANDS (type these below)' and consolidates footer prompts into a single line. Internal UI polish for CLI help menu.

ab3dcc9148c27cfd7df5d49e5f84bc3bc443d3ac.title: menu.ts init hint
ab3dcc9148c27cfd7df5d49e5f84bc3bc443d3ac.summary: Added 'run init to fix' hints for missing knowledge.md and codebuff.json. Updated conditional rendering in npm-app/src/menu.ts. Internal repo change.

f3f39477859b4ad8704ebc09f2dfedcbc3589537.title: Add /init command alias to backend prompts
f3f39477859b4ad8704ebc09f2dfedcbc3589537.summary: The `/init` string is added as a key in `additionalSystemPrompts` alongside `init`, both mapping to the same `initPrompt` constant. This ensures the initialization flow triggers correctly when users type `/init`. The change is internal to `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`.

c8ec2d2f3d1728c09acd2fce0168574dcf39f46b.title: Fix help command table spacing
c8ec2d2f3d1728c09acd2fce0168574dcf39f46b.summary: Adjusts header spacing in the CLI help command table by reducing the fixed width padding calculation. The change corrects alignment between the COMMANDS and DESCRIPTION headers in npm-app/src/menu.ts. This is a cosmetic fix for the menu rendering logic.

7dfb438d63d2e4a896793d9b89c7b9d27b3c9242.title: Quit in root directory
7dfb438d63d2e4a896793d9b89c7b9d27b3c9242.summary: Added root directory check to the project root validation in `npm-app/src/menu.ts`. The agent now quits if `getProjectRoot()` returns `/` or the user's home directory. This prevents execution in unsafe contexts.

7b56b6e50da704593571588f3307d29786f5c05f.title: Wrap user prompt in tags
7b56b6e50da704593571588f3307d29786f5c05f.summary: Added asUserMessage helper in backend/src/util/messages.ts to wrap strings in <user_message> tags. Applied to user role content in mainPrompt within backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Ensures clear distinction of user inputs from system instructions in the prompt structure.

9bebbe47146fc889fc5ce904e2f49bb20b2908fa.title: Restore classic randomized coloring in menu
9bebbe47146fc889fc5ce904e2f49bb20b2908fa.summary: Reverts random character coloring in `displayMenu` to pick 3 distinct colors from a pool of 7 (`red`, `green`, `yellow`, `blue`, `blueBright`, `magenta`, `cyan`) before rendering, rather than choosing from a fixed 5-color list per character. Updates `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to import `blue`, `red`, and `Formatter` from `picocolors`. The new `getRandomColors` helper ensures consistent palette selection per menu invocation.

381a44f5fa93bbaa73bb7a7b8a270dcf631fda06.title: Update help menu text in npm-app/src/menu.ts
381a44f5fa93bbaa73bb7a7b8a270dcf631fda06.summary: Prepends 'Thanks for using Codebuff!' to the community feedback line. Replaces the closing prompt with '↓ Enter your prompt or command below ↓'. Affects only the CLI help menu output.

c8ec2d2f3d1728c09acd2fce0168574dcf39f46b.text: The menu text now lines up correctly. This is a small visual fix.

7dfb438d63d2e4a896793d9b89c7b9d27b3c9242.text: The assistant now stops working if it tries to run in a restricted system folder. This keeps the app from causing problems in unsafe places.

c34293dc8e061fe1acf1dfff5df2c40f825967f4.text: The app now records when an update fails. This helps the team see how often updates break.

381a44f5fa93bbaa73bb7a7b8a270dcf631fda06.text: The help menu now shows a thank you message and a new instruction for entering commands. This is a small internal text update that does not change how the tool works.

ab3dcc9148c27cfd7df5d49e5f84bc3bc443d3ac.text: The assistant now gives clearer tips when its setup files are missing, telling you to run the fix command. This small internal update helps you resolve startup issues faster.

7b56b6e50da704593571588f3307d29786f5c05f.text: The system now clearly labels what you type. This helps the assistant tell your words apart from its own instructions. It is a small internal update.

ec646edcd1946220593edd58e168251a8ad8d8d2.text: The menu now shows the correct key to press for opening links, using 'Command' on Macs and 'Ctrl' on other computers. This small change makes the instructions clearer and easier to follow.

f3f39477859b4ad8704ebc09f2dfedcbc3589537.text: The assistant now recognizes the command '/init' to start its setup process, matching the existing method.

9bebbe47146fc889fc5ce904e2f49bb20b2908fa.text: The menu now picks a random set of colors each time it opens, instead of always using the same ones.

7d8a37e5712e70dc92247fe0583799185607f4ee.text: The help menu now shows commands more cleanly, without extra words. This is a small internal change to make the screen easier to read.

e3fcf0ce0086870be8327e51980a59b4537bf45b.title: Clarify working directory in prompts and tool docs
e3fcf0ce0086870be8327e51980a59b4537bf45b.summary: Updated main-prompt.ts and tools.ts to explicitly handle current working directory (cwd) distinctions. Non-GeminiPro models now receive a system instruction that tool calls run from project root unless specified, while GeminiPro retains specific toolsInstructions. The user/assistant cwd context message format was standardized across prompt sections to clearly separate 'Assistant cwd (project root)' from 'User cwd'. Tools documentation now includes a dedicated Working Directory section emphasizing the need to resolve user-relative paths against the project root.

e7c367498103d349dd730800557510f6fa6a72bd.title: main-prompt injects explicit assistant cwd
e7c367498103d349dd730800557510f6fa6a72bd.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts now injects agentState.fileContext.currentWorkingDirectory directly into the system message, replacing the vague 'assistant cwd is project root' text. This ensures the model receives the precise working directory path for accurate file operations. Scope limited to backend prompt generation.

433ca68facb6408edf0e664d8d88e0f33bb2e368.title: Fix carriage return logic in display.ts
433ca68facb6408edf0e664d8d88e0f33bb2e368.summary: Updated addCarriageReturn in npm-app/src/display.ts to handle newline conversion more robustly. Replaced manual double-replacement logic with a lookbehind regex (?<!\r)\n to ensure \r is only added when missing. Fixed previous state handling to prevent copying stray \n characters from the previous buffer.

80e1ce908ea59f72ff6783f02be713ad559ae9ac.title: CLI exits with message when started in home directory
80e1ce908ea59f72ff6783f02be713ad559ae9ac.summary: Codebuff CLI now displays a welcome message and calls `process.exit()` if `getProjectRoot()` equals `os.homedir()`. Previously, it printed startup instructions and returned, allowing the process to continue running without a valid project context. This change enforces that the agent must be run from within a specific project directory. The exit logic was moved from `displayGreeting` in `menu.ts` to the shutdown handler in `cli.ts` to ensure clean termination.

df9797be99058335dfd30ddd48064aba1def883c.title: Add slash command completion to CLI
df9797be99058335dfd30ddd48064aba1def883c.summary: CLI input handling now supports slash-prefixed commands via `getSlashCommands` and `displaySlashCommandGrid`. The `inputCompleter` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` intercepts lines starting with `/` to provide tab-completion for defined commands, falling back to file path completion otherwise. `npm-app/src/menu.ts` exports the `CommandInfo` interface and `interactiveCommandDetails` array to drive this behavior.

a5eb09dc80f7f241cc343e69e090224dbd8f5c54.title: Delete duplicate npm-app knowledge.md
a5eb09dc80f7f241cc343e69e090224dbd8f5c54.summary: Deleted `npm-app/knowledge.md` to remove 302 lines of duplicate documentation. The file content overlapped with existing knowledge sources, causing maintenance drift. This cleanup affects the `npm-app` package structure only.

6b6a807ecd8f66cb97f4ed8685ac621595969b61.title: Rename Diagnostics Check to Project Setup in CLI menu
6b6a807ecd8f66cb97f4ed8685ac621595969b61.summary: Header label in npm-app/src/menu.ts changed from 'DIAGNOSTICS CHECK' to 'PROJECT SETUP'. Internal UI text adjustment. No functional logic changes.

7c9715349c229bdd55c23d8cca8acf36eb4f4cb7.title: Add cli.userinputcomplete posthog event with latency
7c9715349c229bdd55c23d8cca8acf36eb4f4cb7.summary: New AnalyticsEvent.USER_INPUT_COMPLETE ('cli.user_input_complete') added to common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. npm-app/src/client.ts captures startTime before subscribeToResponse, tracks stepsCount and toolCallsCount across prompt-response chunks, and emits the event with userInputId, latencyMs, stepsCount, toolCallsCount on completion. Scope: shared core constants and CLI client. latencyMs measured as Date.now() delta from input capture to stream completion.

c976d02582ecb8bdf44ae5697dc6689cd1e62a5c.title: Fix terminal hang on Windows echo line processing
c976d02582ecb8bdf44ae5697dc6689cd1e62a5c.summary:
Replaced bulk `replaceAll` with looped `replace` in `runCommandPty` to prevent premature clearing of echo lines. Added `
` to `cd` command write in assistant mode to ensure proper execution. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. Fixes Windows terminal hangs caused by incorrect echo line counting and missing newline in directory change commands.

ce68a5d652d8868ced1456d9397be3b6c2022f47.title: CLI clears pastedContent on freshPrompt
ce68a5d652d8868ced1456d9397be3b6c2022f47.summary: Clears `this.pastedContent` in `freshPrompt` within `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Prevents stale clipboard data from persisting across prompt resets. Internal refactor.

433ca68facb6408edf0e664d8d88e0f33bb2e368.text: The text display now handles line breaks more reliably, preventing extra blank lines or broken formatting. This small internal fix ensures your content looks correct without needing any action from you.

ce68a5d652d8868ced1456d9397be3b6c2022f47.text: Small internal fix. The app now clears old pasted text when you start a new prompt, preventing leftover clipboard data from appearing.

df9797be99058335dfd30ddd48064aba1def883c.text: Typing a slash (/) in the command line now shows a list of available commands. This makes it easier to find and use specific features without memorizing their names.

e7c367498103d349dd730800557510f6fa6a72bd.text: The assistant now knows exactly where your files are stored. This helps it find and edit documents more accurately.

e3fcf0ce0086870be8327e51980a59b4537bf45b.text: The assistant now clearly understands where files are located. It automatically looks for files in the main project folder unless told otherwise.

a5eb09dc80f7f241cc343e69e090224dbd8f5c54.text: The team removed duplicate instructions from the internal system to keep information accurate and consistent. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for users.

c976d02582ecb8bdf44ae5697dc6689cd1e62a5c.text: Fixed a bug where the program would freeze on Windows when typing commands. The app now handles text and directory changes correctly, preventing hangs.

6b6a807ecd8f66cb97f4ed8685ac621595969b61.text: The menu label changed from 'Diagnostics Check' to 'Project Setup'. This is a small internal text update. It does not affect how the product works.

7c9715349c229bdd55c23d8cca8acf36eb4f4cb7.text: The app now records how long it takes to answer and how many steps it used. This data helps the team improve speed and reliability.

80e1ce908ea59f72ff6783f02be713ad559ae9ac.text: The assistant now stops with a message if you start it in your home folder. It must run from inside a project folder to work.

f525deb12fe7dfa8789ff1c3cd23c87127d36f65.title: xml-stream-parser tool unclosed log level
f525deb12fe7dfa8789ff1c3cd23c87127d36f65.summary: Downgraded log level from WARN to INFO for unclosed tool tags in `processStreamWithTags`. Updated message to note appended end-of-tool sequence and potential omitted stop sequences. Affects `backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts`. Internal logging change.

70222b07c3b77d9495c55301c383a2710ff988e1.title: Update xml-stream-parser test expectations
70222b07c3b77d9495c55301c383a2710ff988e1.summary: Test assertions in `backend/src/__tests__/xml-stream-parser.test.ts` updated to match new warning and info messages. Parameter end-of-stream warning now states 'End of parameter appended to response'. Tool end-of-stream message changed from WARN to INFO, noting 'The stop sequence may have been omitted'. Internal test fix only.

5889be9e74ca30f741e348af1fc0f5be33d08ed6.title: Fix start truncation slice offset
5889be9e74ca30f741e348af1fc0f5be33d08ed6.summary: Corrects off-by-one error in `truncateStringWithMessage` when `remove === 'START'`. Previously sliced from `maxLength - prefix.length`, now uses `str.length - maxLength + prefix.length` to properly account for prefix length. Internal fix in `common/src/util/string.ts`.

010ea8f4bd613db0d2ed1a6af993cfc80a15b6bc.title: Reorder CLI options in help menu
010ea8f4bd613db0d2ed1a6af993cfc80a15b6bc.summary: Moved --lite, --max, --experimental options to end of cliOptions array in npm-app/src/cli-definitions.ts. Updated npm-app/src/index.ts to skip hidden arguments entirely instead of passing hidden flag to commander. Changes help menu display order and internal argument registration logic.

7b74fe111b380968a6bed2b17bdf56707af6ff96.title: Fix truncateStringWithMessage formatting
7b74fe111b380968a6bed2b17bdf56707af6ff96.summary: Updated `truncateStringWithMessage` in `common/src/util/string.ts`. Default message changed from `TRUNCATED_DUE_TO_LENGTH` to `TRUNCATED DUE TO LENGTH`. Suffix/prefix formats adjusted for `END` and `START` modes to correctly position ellipses and slice string.

9ce53baf5b6f43953bd228c7bc15d9b1c066ec2b.title: Revert selective cachecontrol retention in messages.ts
9ce53baf5b6f43953bd228c7bc15d9b1c066ec2b.summary: Reverts logic that preserved `cache_control` on the last cached message, restoring behavior to strip `cache_control` from all messages in `getMessagesSubset`. This change simplifies `backend/src/util/messages.ts` by removing the loop identifying the last cached index. The scope is limited to the backend message utility, ensuring consistent cache header removal for subset generation.

228d3ec90e1dd272b4923a68b01c40ea330de42e.title: Add main prompt integration test
228d3ec90e1dd272b4923a68b01c40ea330de42e.summary: Added `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.integration.test.ts` to verify main prompt behavior. Updated `backend/knowledge.md` to document that backend integration tests must run from the `backend` directory to load `env.mjs` variables.

427373457cac725710f8217af5f978c0278d4e72.title: Simplify CLI help menu output
427373457cac725710f8217af5f978c0278d4e72.summary: Replaces the detailed command-line usage section in `menu.ts` with a concise product description string. Removes imports of `cliArguments` and `cliOptions` from `cli-definitions.ts` within the menu module. Updates `--lite` and `--max` flags in `cli-definitions.ts` to `hidden: false`.

2c86dc19181a88a3170e4c0aeb4ce109817ecb06.title: Refactor help menu layout and add example prompts
2c86dc19181a88a3170e4c0aeb4ce109817ecb06.summary: Simplified CLI help menu rendering in npm-app/src/menu.ts by removing conditional layout logic and replacing random color generation with fixed picocolors functions. Added new 'EXAMPLE PROMPTS' section and explicit 'codebuff --lite' / 'codebuff --max' mode commands to the command list. Included a warning note that Codebuff does not read .gitignore files.

e2fd961bd1c659ed789bcf6030462ce804e2e40a.title: CLI help simplification hides advanced options
e2fd961bd1c659ed789bcf6030462ce804e2e40a.summary: New `cli-definitions.ts` centralizes CLI arguments and options, marking `--lite`, `--max`, `--experimental`, and `--model` as `hidden`. `index.ts` consumes these definitions to suppress hidden flags in `--help` output, while `menu.ts` renders a dedicated COMMAND-LINE USAGE section using `menuDescription` and `menuDetails` for visible flags. This reduces noise in standard help text while preserving access to advanced features via explicit flags.

70222b07c3b77d9495c55301c383a2710ff988e1.text: The system now reports the end of a specific data stream as a minor note instead of a warning. This internal update keeps the user experience unchanged.

5889be9e74ca30f741e348af1fc0f5be33d08ed6.text: Fixed a small internal error that sometimes cut off the wrong amount of text from the beginning of a message. This ensures messages display correctly without missing characters.

e2fd961bd1c659ed789bcf6030462ce804e2e40a.text: The command help screen now hides advanced settings to make it easier to read. You can still use these settings by typing their names directly, but they no longer clutter the basic instructions.

f525deb12fe7dfa8789ff1c3cd23c87127d36f65.text: The system stopped logging a minor warning when a tool tag was not closed. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

228d3ec90e1dd272b4923a68b01c40ea330de42e.text: The team added a check to make sure the assistant follows its core instructions. This small internal update helps keep the product reliable for you.

427373457cac725710f8217af5f978c0278d4e72.text: The help menu now shows a short product description instead of a detailed command list. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

010ea8f4bd613db0d2ed1a6af993cfc80a15b6bc.text: The help menu lists options in a clearer order. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works.

7b74fe111b380968a6bed2b17bdf56707af6ff96.text: Fixed how long messages are cut off so the warning text and three dots appear in the right spot.

9ce53baf5b6f43953bd228c7bc15d9b1c066ec2b.text: The system now removes a specific data marker from all messages in a group, rather than keeping it on just the last one. This is an internal cleanup that makes the message handling process simpler and more consistent.

2c86dc19181a88a3170e4c0aeb4ce109817ecb06.text: The help screen now looks simpler and shows example prompts and mode options. It also warns that the tool ignores.gitignore files.

8224f3e35031420a86afcea90e18661d799c0e68.title: Enable self-review prompt and cast assistant messages
8224f3e35031420a86afcea90e18661d799c0e68.summary: Re-enabled self-review system instruction in backend/src/main-prompt.ts by removing the false condition. Added castAssistantMessage to map filtered history, ensuring correct message types for the review step. Scope limited to backend main prompt logic. Self-review now triggers whenever assistant messages exist in history.

e324baabef67b6c2c69f986f2de610fcd73e53ce.title: Catch analytics flush errors
e324baabef67b6c2c69f986f2de610fcd73e53ce.summary: Wraps `client.flush()` in try/catch within `flushAnalytics` to prevent unhandled promise rejections. Catches errors and logs them via `trackEvent` using new `AnalyticsEvent.FLUSH_FAILED` constant. Affects `common/src/analytics.ts` and `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`.

41da8383dae1315b5c26aab2ad4086ca0e044229.title: Set defaultEncoding utf8 in Saxy constructor
41da8383dae1315b5c26aab2ad4086ca0e044229.summary: Explicitly sets `defaultEncoding: 'utf8'` in the Saxy Transform constructor options. This ensures consistent string handling for incoming data chunks, preventing potential undefined default encoding issues. The change applies to the shared core utility `common/src/util/saxy.ts`.

11f760c6a76e7b6e3d6dd8b13ecb1f8ef7cf4d8c.title: Add index on message finishedat
11f760c6a76e7b6e3d6dd8b13ecb1f8ef7cf4d8c.summary: Added btree index `message_finished_at_idx` on `message.finished_at` in migration `0015_stormy_zuras.sql`. Optimizes query performance for filtering or sorting messages by completion time. Updates `common/src/db/schema.ts` to reflect the new index definition.

ffd1f70fa537dcaec685a9f7b492f3ec5f955bc7.title: Saxy StringDecoder hardcodes utf8 encoding
ffd1f70fa537dcaec685a9f7b492f3ec5f955bc7.summary: Saxy constructor now instantiates StringDecoder with hardcoded 'utf8' instead of reading defaultEncoding from _writableState. Removes conditional check and fallback logic that guarded against undefined state or defaultEncoding. Scope limited to common/src/util/saxy.ts. Eliminates reliance on internal stream state properties for encoding resolution.

f80621692ac4f8d57c0e56f9154f8580302d3fa4.title: CLI enforces singleton Client via createInstance
f80621692ac4f8d57c0e56f9154f8580302d3fa4.summary: npm-app/src/client.ts converts `Client` constructor to private, adding `createInstance` and `getInstance` static methods to enforce a singleton pattern. npm-app/src/cli.ts removes the `private client: Client` property, replacing direct instantiation with `Client.createInstance` and subsequent calls with `Client.getInstance`. This centralizes client state management and prevents duplicate WebSocket connections within the CLI process.

b68d5d6c55772e309c312be7dae564059b2af999.title: Reword edit snippet instructions using relace example
b68d5d6c55772e309c312be7dae564059b2af999.summary: Updated `write_file` tool instructions in `backend/src/tools.ts` to prioritize `str_replace` for most edits. The prompt now explicitly defines an "Edit Snippet" format, requiring placeholder comments for unchanged regions and strict indentation preservation. A new "Optimizations" section warns that tool runtime scales with text volume, reinforcing minimal output.

820d62950d6e8bf1614e3ae2fc6e8fd76ef78a8a.title: Removed invoice.created handler from Stripe webhook
820d62950d6e8bf1614e3ae2fc6e8fd76ef78a8a.summary: Removed `handleInvoiceCreated` function and its `invoice.created` case from `web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts`. All invoices are now charged at zero dollars, making the credit note creation logic for draft invoices obsolete. The change affects only the Stripe webhook processing in the web app.

8af577c6c9d73bcdc8f71a16cb91a4dcbe24c86d.title: Add composite index on finishedat and userid to message table
8af577c6c9d73bcdc8f71a16cb91a4dcbe24c86d.summary: Migration 0016_clear_hairball.sql drops single-column index message_finished_at_idx and creates composite index message_finished_at_user_id_idx on (finished_at, user_id). This optimizes queries filtering by both user and completion time. Update common/src/db/schema.ts and run migration to apply.

11f760c6a76e7b6e3d6dd8b13ecb1f8ef7cf4d8c.text: The system can now find finished messages faster. This makes searches and lists load quicker.

b68d5d6c55772e309c312be7dae564059b2af999.text: The assistant's editing rules were updated to favor precise, minimal changes. This helps it make smaller, safer updates to your text.

41da8383dae1315b5c26aab2ad4086ca0e044229.text: Small internal update. Text processing now defaults to UTF-8. This prevents rare errors when handling special characters.

8224f3e35031420a86afcea90e18661d799c0e68.text: The assistant can now check its own work when past conversations exist. This small internal update helps the system review its responses more carefully.

820d62950d6e8bf1614e3ae2fc6e8fd76ef78a8a.text: The system stopped handling a specific payment notification because all invoices now cost zero dollars. This internal cleanup has no effect on how you use the product.
