f80621692ac4f8d57c0e56f9154f8580302d3fa4.text: The app now uses a single shared connection for its internal tasks instead of creating multiple ones. This small, behind-the-scenes change helps keep the app running smoothly.

e324baabef67b6c2c69f986f2de610fcd73e53ce.text: The system now quietly records any failures when sending usage data instead of crashing. This keeps the app running smoothly for you.

ffd1f70fa537dcaec685a9f7b492f3ec5f955bc7.text: The software now uses a fixed method to read text data, removing an unnecessary check. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for users.

8af577c6c9d73bcdc8f71a16cb91a4dcbe24c86d.text: The system now finds your completed messages faster. This internal change means the app may load your history more quickly.

d49578e20a008503231d0a4059153313745f1e79.text: The assistant now finds relevant library documentation on demand instead of relying on a fixed list. This makes it easier to get answers for a wider range of topics.

3482e499819aa717e968af06c910ebc76ae57032.title: Clarify user cwd vs assistant cwd in system prompt
3482e499819aa717e968af06c910ebc76ae57032.summary: The system prompt injected when `cwd` is present now explicitly labels it as `**user** cwd` and notes that the assistant's working directory is the project root. This change aims to reduce ambiguity for the model regarding which directory context applies to user commands versus agent operations. The update is localized to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` within the `mainPrompt` function's context injection logic. The previous format only specified `cwd: <path>`, which could lead to confusion about the agent's actual execution environment relative to the user's shell context.

b68ef311d4d1f636c5975523293b15ff7a545c47.title: Deterministic file tree sampling via seedrandom
b68ef311d4d1f636c5975523293b15ff7a545c47.summary: Replaced non-deterministic `sampleSize` with `sampleSizeWithSeed` in `truncate-file-tree.ts` to ensure consistent token budget estimation. The new utility in `common/src/util/random.ts` uses `seedrandom` for a Fisher-Yates shuffle, seeded by the JSON string of the file list and sample count. This change affects backend system prompt generation and adds `@types/seedrandom` to `common/package.json`. Identical inputs now yield identical sampling results, preventing flaky truncation behavior.

99624c1b1904df84d981b3705a276a36ab04540d.title: Relax whitespace regex in parseReadFilesResult
99624c1b1904df84d981b3705a276a36ab04540d.summary: Updated the `filePattern` regex in `backend/src/util/parse-tool-call-xml.ts` to accept variable whitespace instead of strict newlines. This prevents parsing failures when `read_file` XML blocks contain extra spaces or tabs between tags. Affects internal tool result parsing for file reads.

3f376ed78983a5da746167091d1219a5f271f829.title: Add seedrandom dependency to common package
3f376ed78983a5da746167091d1219a5f271f829.summary: Added `seedrandom` ^3.0.5 to `common/package.json` dependencies. This enables deterministic random number generation within the shared core module. Scope limited to the `common` package. No immediate API or behavior changes exposed.

b7121965147db2a996aff635acb87136e6c5bf84.title: Refactor CLI menu with diagnostics and responsive layout
b7121965147db2a996aff635acb87136e6c5bf84.summary: Overhauls `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to replace static help text with a structured interface. Implements a `DIAGNOSTICS CHECK` section that detects Git repos, `.gitignore`, `knowledge.md`, and `codebuff.json`, providing specific remediation hints. Adds responsive command rendering based on `process.stdout.columns`, using a simplified list for terminals under 100 chars. Removes unused imports (`picocolors` default, `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS`) and updates color application logic to use direct key indexing.

4db812729e2535d45d6b9ff03624a6613cbb3190.title: Cast assistant messages to user role in backend
4db812729e2535d45d6b9ff03624a6613cbb3190.summary: Added `castAssistantMessage` in `backend/src/util/messages.ts` to wrap assistant content in `<previous_assistant_message>` tags and change role to `user`. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` updated to filter history and calculate `iterationNum` based on total message count, though the explicit rerouting prompt injection remains disabled (`false &&`). Cache control logic in `getMessagesSubset` now preserves the marker only on the last cached message. Internal change to message history handling and prompt construction.

19f0de4ec1cc8d784649ba5350b2b3e9fb88f3b1.title: runMainPrompt accepts sessionId, costMode normal
19f0de4ec1cc8d784649ba5350b2b3e9fb88f3b1.summary: runMainPrompt now takes sessionId argument. loopMainPrompt generates unique test-session-id per run. costMode changed from experimental to normal. Internal evals scaffolding tweak only.

cb416767e33be5297ed874d1707fb32f8266866f.title: Add explicit endturn tool prompting to agent instructions
cb416767e33be5297ed874d1707fb32f8266866f.summary: System prompts in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md` now explicitly require the `end_turn` tool. This ensures agents correctly signal completion or wait for user input, preventing premature stops. The change applies to both lite and standard modes.

747efae72b2958aa8ed5232f073f8ee2ba574cea.title: Fix message history filter return in main-prompt
747efae72b2958aa8ed5232f073f8ee2ba574cea.summary: Corrects a missing return statement in the messageHistory filter callback within backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Previously, the arrow function body lacked explicit return, causing the filter to always evaluate to undefined and effectively deleting all history entries. This restores intended behavior for filtering system instructions.

c020f22baec530cd6e2ab4cc269739ff3e976fa2.title: Update test fixtures for referencedby tag
c020f22baec530cd6e2ab4cc269739ff3e976fa2.summary: Test fixtures in simplify-tool-results.test.ts updated to include <referenced_by> tags. Aligns expectations with current read_file output schema. Internal test maintenance only.

3482e499819aa717e968af06c910ebc76ae57032.text: The assistant now clearly knows the difference between your computer's location and its own. This helps it run tasks in the correct place without confusion.

b7121965147db2a996aff635acb87136e6c5bf84.text: The tool now checks your setup and gives clear advice if files are missing. The menu also adjusts its layout to fit your screen size.

19f0de4ec1cc8d784649ba5350b2b3e9fb88f3b1.text: A small internal update tracks test sessions separately and adjusts how usage is recorded. This change does not affect how you use the product.

c020f22baec530cd6e2ab4cc269739ff3e976fa2.text: Internal tests were updated to match how the tool now shows file references. This change does not affect how you use the product.

3f376ed78983a5da746167091d1219a5f271f829.text: The software now includes a tool that generates random numbers in a predictable way for internal testing. This change is small and does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

4db812729e2535d45d6b9ff03624a6613cbb3190.text: The system now labels past assistant replies as user messages to help the AI track conversation turns. This internal adjustment improves how the AI remembers context, with no visible change to the user.

cb416767e33be5297ed874d1707fb32f8266866f.text: The assistant now clearly signals when it is done talking or waiting for your reply. This stops it from ending conversations too early.

b68ef311d4d1f636c5975523293b15ff7a545c47.text: The assistant now picks files from your project more consistently. This makes its responses steadier and prevents random changes in how much information it uses.

747efae72b2958aa8ed5232f073f8ee2ba574cea.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant correctly remembers recent conversation details. Previously, a glitch caused these details to be ignored, leading to incomplete context.

99624c1b1904df84d981b3705a276a36ab04540d.text: The assistant now handles small spacing differences in its internal notes about files. This prevents occasional errors when reading file contents.

b7347271d4fb7c1c1f35817ebcc9f256072d8f9e.title: CI: Drop CODEBUFFGITHUBACTIONS, Re-enable tmate debug shell
b7347271d4fb7c1c1f35817ebcc9f256072d8f9e.summary: CI pipeline stops injecting `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` into `.env.local` for build and test jobs. `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` debug shell restored on failure in `ci.yml`.

11791918a9d333661d7935e82010a49d156f8423.title: Comment out action-tmate in CI
11791918a9d333661d7935e82010a49d156f8423.summary: Disables the interactive debug shell step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` by commenting out `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3`. This prevents the workflow from opening a tmate session on failure, which was previously configured with a 15-minute timeout guard. The change is internal to the CI configuration and does not affect user-facing functionality.

a9c79fcb6da92a14d0618856be825eb170505b38.title: Bump Bun to 1.2.12 in CI
a9c79fcb6da92a14d0618856be825eb170505b38.summary: CI workflow `bun-version` updated from 1.1.26 to 1.2.12 in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Aligns CI environment with current Bun stable release. Affects all CI jobs using `oven-sh/setup-bun`.

a704af7d2a2c7a779b248f5af832fd1d18980c73.title: Fix balance calculation to always itemize principals
a704af7d2a2c7a779b248f5af832fd1d18980c73.summary: Balance calculation now itemizes grant principals for all active grants, regardless of balance status. Previously, principals were only added to the breakdown if the grant balance was positive, causing underreporting for zero or negative balance grants. This change affects packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts. The fix moves the principal addition outside the balance check, ensuring accurate accounting for all active grants.

15ead13bb5b33d807eb1cc0b6688048514b7e843.title: Update main prompt stop conditions
15ead13bb5b33d807eb1cc0b6688048514b7e843.summary: Replaced GPT-4.1-specific 'do not end turn' instruction with a universal directive to stop immediately upon completion. Removed the conditional logic for `isGPT4_1` in the primary instruction block, simplifying the prompt structure. Scope limited to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. New rule explicitly forbids further refinements after initial completion.

82fe2020dcb20becda30267c3c5339ed6e7df806.title: CI test command switched to cd + bun test
82fe2020dcb20becda30267c3c5339ed6e7df806.summary: The CI workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` now executes tests via `cd ${{ matrix.package }} && bun test` instead of `bun test $(find ${{ matrix.package }}/src -name *.test.ts)`. This change ensures `bun test` runs within the package directory context, likely to resolve module paths or configuration correctly that the previous `find` approach missed.

80d76b1b657c557ef687345f9d2a0b24fd3ec932.title: CI test discovery and debug shell changes
80d76b1b657c557ef687345f9d2a0b24fd3ec932.summary: CI test commands now use `find src -name *.test.ts` for explicit discovery. Interactive debug shell step via `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` commented out. Affects `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

d34e4c9f4cb01934f1dd09daf7ad12da86996238.title: Fix CI test path generation in GitHub Actions
d34e4c9f4cb01934f1dd09daf7ad12da86996238.summary: CI workflow now generates test paths dynamically in the run step using `find` instead of pre-calculating them in the matrix include section. This fixes the bun test filter execution in GitHub Actions. Scope limited to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

dbceefdb35381bbce7542c064a02547c5589fdad.title: CI test retry maxattempts set to 5
dbceefdb35381bbce7542c064a02547c5589fdad.summary: Reverted CI workflow retry configuration in .github/workflows/ci.yml, increasing max_attempts for the bun test step from 1 to 5. This change addresses flaky test execution by allowing up to five retry attempts within the 10-minute timeout window. Scope limited to GitHub Actions CI pipeline configuration.

853a380f27f813b0d781a9141b848d43db637091.title: Add endturn tool for explicit turn termination
853a380f27f813b0d781a9141b848d43db637091.summary: Introduced `end_turn` tool to allow agents to explicitly finish their turn, overriding pending tool results. Updated backend prompt, tool schemas, and client handlers to recognize this signal. Eval scaffolding and npm-app client now break loops or set completion flags when `end_turn` is called. Renderer suppresses visual output for this tool.

15ead13bb5b33d807eb1cc0b6688048514b7e843.text: A small internal update changed how the assistant decides when to stop answering. It now ends its reply immediately once it has finished the task, rather than trying to add extra details or refinements.

d34e4c9f4cb01934f1dd09daf7ad12da86996238.text: A small internal update fixed how the system finds tests during checks. This helps ensure the product works correctly, but you will not notice any change.

853a380f27f813b0d781a9141b848d43db637091.text: The assistant can now clearly signal when it has finished a task, stopping any further actions. This ensures the conversation ends promptly without leaving unfinished steps or unnecessary delays.

dbceefdb35381bbce7542c064a02547c5589fdad.text: The system now automatically tries failed internal checks up to five times. This reduces false alarms and keeps the product stable.

11791918a9d333661d7935e82010a49d156f8423.text: The team removed a hidden tool that let them look inside the system when it broke. This change only affects how the team fixes problems and does not change how you use the product.

80d76b1b657c557ef687345f9d2a0b24fd3ec932.text: A small internal change improved how our system finds its routine checks. This update does not affect how you use the product.

a9c79fcb6da92a14d0618856be825eb170505b38.text: The team updated the tools used to test the software before it is released. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

a704af7d2a2c7a779b248f5af832fd1d18980c73.text: A small internal fix ensures that all active funding sources are listed in your balance breakdown, even if they have no money left. This makes the account details more accurate for everyone.

b7347271d4fb7c1c1f35817ebcc9f256072d8f9e.text: A small internal update improved how engineers test the software. You will not notice any changes in how the product works.

ce97fdc5f4c9e6a8b12c31772767065f75957d66.title: CI debug shell now triggers on failure
ce97fdc5f4c9e6a8b12c31772767065f75957d66.summary: Interactive debug shell step in .github/workflows/ci.yml now runs conditionally via `if: failure()`. This restricts tmate session creation to failed jobs, preventing unnecessary shell spawns during successful test runs. Change affects CI pipeline behavior for all matrix packages.

1aa4258755220e2ea8b26d1e8532a1b877ff09cf.title: Initialize balance breakdown with all grant types
1aa4258755220e2ea8b26d1e8532a1b877ff09cf.summary: The `calculateUsageAndBalance` function now initializes `breakdown` and `principals` objects with all `GrantTypeValues` set to 0, rather than starting with empty objects. This change ensures that the `CreditBalance` interface strictly requires a `Record<GrantType, number>` instead of a `Partial<Record<GrantType, number>>`, eliminating the need for optional chaining or defaulting logic in consumers like `usage-display.tsx`. The `GrantTypeValues` constant in `common/src/types/grant.ts` was updated to use `as const` to support this strict typing.

bd7eb3703f43cb776b5ad882d93b4c772d4aa077.title: Update Saxy XML parser tests to match current event emission behavior
bd7eb3703f43cb776b5ad882d93b4c772d4aa077.summary: Test suite updated to align with current Saxy parser behavior where tag events now include `rawTag` data. Assertions reflect changes in whitespace handling and immediate text emission for entities. The parser now emits `tagclose` events for invalid closing tags instead of treating them as text. Covers `common/src/util/__tests__/saxy.test.ts`.

e652a54b667329c212f78e0f2b1897f92f4e0a23.title: CI test discovery uses find instead of glob
e652a54b667329c212f78e0f2b1897f92f4e0a23.summary: CI matrix `test_path` renamed `test_paths` and replaced static globs with `$(find <src> -name '*.test.ts')` for npm-app, backend, common. Fixes glob syntax mismatch where `**` in single quotes failed recursive matching in shell. Affects `.github/workflows/ci.yml` only.

c2c315d89b86a09d3bd789624ce6f64e65daec3d.title: CI debug shell gated to workflowdispatch with access limit
c2c315d89b86a09d3bd789624ce6f64e65daec3d.summary: Interactive debug shell step in `ci.yml` now requires `workflow_dispatch` and `inputs.debug_enabled` or `failure()`. Replaced `inputs.debug == 'true'` check with `github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.debug_enabled`. Added `limit-access-to-actor: true` to restrict tmate session access to the triggering user. Includes `timeout-minutes: 30` guard.

6d236f12588b7efa915cb11930de14511c097407.title: Reorder debug shell step in CI workflow
6d236f12588b7efa915cb11930de14511c097407.summary: Moved the `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` step from before the test execution to after the `nick-fields/retry@v3` test step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. The debug shell now triggers only after tests complete or fail, rather than interrupting the test run. This ensures the interactive debug session captures the state after test execution logic has finished.

a99219be402d35bf8f6f2ac32cc3fd5e74b711ec.title: Remove debug shell and ls commands from CI workflow
a99219be402d35bf8f6f2ac32cc3fd5e74b711ec.summary: Removed `ls` commands and an interactive debug shell from `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. The `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` step was deleted entirely. This cleans up the CI logs and removes the manual intervention step for the test job.

5b73c255ca0ca51296b778266e0897e4f4ff6678.title: CI: add tmate debug hook, reduce test retries
5b73c255ca0ca51296b778266e0897e4f4ff6678.summary: Added `mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3` step to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, triggered on `inputs.debug == 'true'` or `failure()`. Reduced `nick-fields/retry@v3` `max_attempts` from 5 to 1 for test execution. Scope: CI pipeline only.

18f061e4a9e0c1f599b7c3ec16865da3c4ebb8a8.title: Remove CI tree-sitter debugging logs
18f061e4a9e0c1f599b7c3ec16865da3c4ebb8a8.summary: Removed temporary architecture and platform logging commands from the Build and typecheck step in ci.yml. These diagnostics were used to inspect tree-sitter prebuilds and are no longer required. The change also includes minor import formatting updates in packages/code-map/parse.ts.

c730cd91e5ffff204b7d6d2202eeb6cdad167e37.title: CI: Reorder test run after debug shell, add tree-sitter prebuilds
c730cd91e5ffff204b7d6d2202eeb6cdad167e37.summary: Moved 'Run tests' step after 'Open interactive debug shell' in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Added diagnostic steps listing node_modules/tree-sitter/prebuilds/linux-x64 contents. This change likely aims to debug CI failures by allowing shell access before tests run, while checking tree-sitter binary availability.

1aa4258755220e2ea8b26d1e8532a1b877ff09cf.text: The system now automatically lists every type of credit balance, even if the amount is zero. This prevents missing entries from causing display errors or confusion.

ce97fdc5f4c9e6a8b12c31772767065f75957d66.text: The system now creates a special troubleshooting tool only when a test fails, rather than every time.

6d236f12588b7efa915cb11930de14511c097407.text: A small internal change moves a debugging tool to run after tests finish. This lets engineers inspect the system's state only when tests are done, without stopping the test process.

bd7eb3703f43cb776b5ad882d93b4c772d4aa077.text: The tool now recognizes more types of text errors correctly. This change was internal and should not affect how you use the product.

e652a54b667329c212f78e0f2b1897f92f4e0a23.text: The system now correctly finds all tests during checks. This internal fix prevents errors when verifying that the product works.

a99219be402d35bf8f6f2ac32cc3fd5e74b711ec.text: A small internal cleanup removed temporary testing tools from the system's background checks. This does not change how the product works for users.

c2c315d89b86a09d3bd789624ce6f64e65daec3d.text: A small internal change tightens access to a troubleshooting tool used by engineers. This ensures only the person who started a task can see its details, improving security without affecting how you use the product.

c730cd91e5ffff204b7d6d2202eeb6cdad167e37.text: The team adjusted internal checks to help them find and fix problems faster. This change does not affect how you use the product.

5b73c255ca0ca51296b778266e0897e4f4ff6678.text: A small internal change lets engineers see exactly why a test fails without guessing. This speeds up fixing bugs but does not change how the product works for you.

18f061e4a9e0c1f599b7c3ec16865da3c4ebb8a8.text: The team removed temporary internal messages that were only used for testing the code. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

fd6d7e4d334afd0b614f3eb26607cf27c971ffb4.title: Fix out of order chunks in Saxy XML parser
fd6d7e4d334afd0b614f3eb26607cf27c971ffb4.summary: Saxy replaces `_entityBuffer` with `_wait(Node.text, ...)` for incomplete entities. Ensures chunks parse in correct order. Scope: `common/src/util/saxy.ts`.

35793599e381348e48a05280e7807a8ca45351ff.title: Fix types in display.ts
35793599e381348e48a05280e7807a8ca45351ff.summary: Update `process.stdout.write` and `process.stderr.write` signatures in `npm-app/src/display.ts`. Change callback error type from `Error | undefined` to `Error | null | undefined` to match Node.js types. Fixes GitHub Actions type check failure.

88a060c0cadcade2b07bed7289af204abfdf7327.title: Clarify user vs assistant cwd in prompts and terminal output
88a060c0cadcade2b07bed7289af204abfdf7327.summary: System prompt and terminal output now explicitly distinguish between user cwd and assistant cwd. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` injects `**user** cwd` with a note that assistant cwd is project root. `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` appends the same clarification to the final cwd status message.

34bc250bdf3848131c7591f27f8e1e67de6e4962.title: Add debug logging to tool-renderers unit test
34bc250bdf3848131c7591f27f8e1e67de6e4962.summary: Added a try-catch block around the `require('../tool-renderers')` call in `npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/tool-renderers.test.ts`. The catch block logs the error object and the string 'asdf' to the console. This change is internal to the test suite and does not affect production code or user-facing behavior.

5fa94bb045a318747504d730f80800745869a6b1.title: CI workflow adds system info step
5fa94bb045a318747504d730f80800745869a6b1.summary: Added Print System Info step to .github/workflows/ci.yml logging process.arch and process.platform via bun. Aids GitHub Actions diagnosis. Internal CI only.

fb3956d9e5d5713212f6c4d8e1f1f19a1845d8d3.title: ci.yml fix stray quote tree-sitter prebuilds ls
fb3956d9e5d5713212f6c4d8e1f1f19a1845d8d3.summary: Removed stray single quote in `ls node_modules/tree-sitter/prebuilds/linux-x64` command within `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Syntax error broke CI job execution. Scope limited to CI configuration.

0808a5f1a76b110f3de330438108b405ce3ae412.title: Improve warnings for invalid XML in stream parser
0808a5f1a76b110f3de330438108b405ce3ae412.summary: backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts adds WARN prefix and actionable guidance to onError calls for malformed tool XML. Covers unclosed tools/params, stray tags, duplicate params, and end-of-stream auto-closure. Affects backend XML stream processing.

0a8e4878aaa1ea8ea7bb4f26bf998944d6901f55.title: CI Bun 1.2.12 and tree-sitter debug
0a8e4878aaa1ea8ea7bb4f26bf998944d6901f55.summary: CI workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` upgrades `oven-sh/setup-bun` version from 1.1.26 to 1.2.12. Added `ls` commands in the 'Print System Info' step to inspect `tree-sitter/prebuilds` directories. Scope limited to CI pipeline configuration.

53d49574e52d85570574f60b96a8c9b8b022a82e.title: Reduce logger chunk limit to 65535
53d49574e52d85570574f60b96a8c9b8b022a82e.summary: Changed `MAX_LENGTH` constant in `backend/src/util/logger.ts` from 70,000 to 65,535. This aligns the log chunk size with potential 65,535 byte limits observed in some environments, replacing the previous buffer assumption for 100k total size. Affects backend logging utility only.

b9efc1ab9dbc218f1b124e41cf507e22a3b9547a.title: Move tree-sitter debug commands to build step
b9efc1ab9dbc218f1b124e41cf507e22a3b9547a.summary: Removed dedicated Print System Info step. Moved architecture, platform, and prebuild directory checks into Build and typecheck. Ensures debug output appears after bun run build executes.

0a8e4878aaa1ea8ea7bb4f26bf998944d6901f55.text: A small internal update to the automated testing system helps check for hidden errors more effectively. This change has no direct impact on how you use the product.

88a060c0cadcade2b07bed7289af204abfdf7327.text: The app now clearly shows which folder it is working in, separate from your folder. This helps you understand where files are being saved or read.

34bc250bdf3848131c7591f27f8e1e67de6e4962.text: Developers added a temporary debug note to an internal testing tool to help them track errors. This change does not affect how the product works or what you see.

fd6d7e4d334afd0b614f3eb26607cf27c971ffb4.text: The system now reads information in the correct order, preventing mistakes when processing complex data.

fb3956d9e5d5713212f6c4d8e1f1f19a1845d8d3.text: A small internal fix corrected a typing error in the automated testing system that previously blocked checks from running. This change has no direct impact on the product features you use.

5fa94bb045a318747504d730f80800745869a6b1.text: The internal system that builds the product now records extra technical details during its setup. This helps the team spot and fix issues faster. No changes to how the product works for users.

53d49574e52d85570574f60b96a8c9b8b022a82e.text: The system now breaks large logs into smaller pieces to prevent errors on some servers. This internal update improves stability without changing how you use the product.

35793599e381348e48a05280e7807a8ca45351ff.text: This is a small internal fix. It helps keep the software running smoothly for everyone.

0808a5f1a76b110f3de330438108b405ce3ae412.text: The system now gives clearer warnings when it encounters broken instructions. This small internal fix helps staff spot and correct errors faster, with no change to how you use the product.

b9efc1ab9dbc218f1b124e41cf507e22a3b9547a.text: This is a small internal change. It moves a technical check to a different step in the setup process. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2c1b68ff9199828cc34d7764716bd59b52834cd1.title: Track agentstep event in main prompt
2c1b68ff9199828cc34d7764716bd59b52834cd1.summary: Added `AGENT_STEP` event tracking in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and defined the corresponding enum value `backend.agent_step` in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. The new event captures `agentStepId`, `clientSessionId`, `fingerprintId`, `userInputId`, and `userId` at the start of each agent loop step. This enables correlation of logs and analytics within a single agent execution cycle.

04c9f7d9ec3356a07b8caa218b3c085f4e8af14b.title: Add gpt4.1 completion enforcement to main prompt
04c9f7d9ec3356a07b8caa218b3c085f4e8af14b.summary: Added conditional instructions to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` forcing `gpt-4.1` to continue until 100% completion of user requests. This prevents early turn ending for multi-step tasks. Scope limited to backend prompt logic.

c78cd87e2e12887d0dea7d90d12115abf94c1c09.title: CLI prompt history deduplication logic updated
c78cd87e2e12887d0dea7d90d12115abf94c1c09.summary: Prompt history deduplication now moves non-unique prompts to end instead of filtering them out during load. `addHistory` removes all previous occurrences of a trimmed line before appending it. This ensures readline history reflects the most recent usage order without losing context. Affects `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

adda69659cde44f32ae0e52c5e1468d098862536.title: Fix undefined dereference in Saxy defaultEncoding
adda69659cde44f32ae0e52c5e1468d098862536.summary: Added a fallback guard for `state.defaultEncoding` in `common/src/util/saxy.ts` to prevent undefined dereferences during `StringDecoder` initialization. The code now checks if `state` or `state.defaultEncoding` is undefined and defaults to 'utf8' if so. This change ensures stable stream processing in the Saxy XML parser.

984f285ad3bdb5661cf12436fc43830a7fe510d3.title: Rename PROMPTSENT to USERINPUT
984f285ad3bdb5661cf12436fc43830a7fe510d3.summary: Analytics event `backend.prompt_sent` renamed to `backend.user_input` to distinguish user actions from `agent_step` logs. Logging and tracking now occur after `getUserIdFromAuthToken` validation. Updates affect `websocket-action.ts` and `analytics-events.ts`.

0f33e633e79bd9e75060f9722bcf681c1aef3ede.title: Reduce agentic behavior in lite mode
0f33e633e79bd9e75060f9722bcf681c1aef3ede.summary: Adds `isLiteMode` check to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to conditionally disable verification steps and strict completion mandates when `costMode` is 'lite'. Lite mode now omits instructions to run type checkers/linters, close tags, or complete all steps before ending turn. This reduces token usage and latency for low-cost interactions.

a9aa4fb1dc1d8fb527ac1021f2daef85a04286c8.title: Add file path to writefile error logs
a9aa4fb1dc1d8fb527ac1021f2daef85a04286c8.summary: Error logging in write_file blocks now includes the file path and specifies 'write_file' in the message. Updates `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to prepend `result.path` to `result.error` in server tool results. Improves debugging by identifying which file caused the processing failure.

bc3991444e4d37d090b2fc20447feeefd6cc1462.title: System instruction tags for tool results
bc3991444e4d37d090b2fc20447feeefd6cc1462.summary: Added system instruction tags to clarify tool results are not user messages. Updated main-prompt.ts, agent-instructions.md, tools.ts.

ffd805fa006107cb6992598ef83c6075afac485e.title: File processing returns error strings instead of null
ffd805fa006107cb6992598ef83c6075afac485e.summary: processFileBlock and processStrReplace now return discriminated union types containing an error string instead of null on failure. mainPrompt.ts updates the fileProcessingPromisesByPath type to accommodate these error objects and passes the error message through to the user. This replaces silent skips with actionable feedback for common issues like missing old strings or unchanged files.

6e9750b7e926445391766db5345bec8c3b0fdc1c.title: Remove endturn and awaittoolresults tools
6e9750b7e926445391766db5345bec8c3b0fdc1c.summary: Removed end_turn and await_tool_results tools from the agent loop. The system now automatically reprompts if tool results are pending, eliminating explicit turn-ending signals. Updated main-prompt.ts, tools.ts, websocket-action.ts, and common constants to reflect this change. Agent instructions and thinking stream prompts adjusted to remove references to these tools.

bc3991444e4d37d090b2fc20447feeefd6cc1462.text: The assistant now better understands that information from its tools is separate from your messages. This small internal update helps it follow instructions more accurately.

04c9f7d9ec3356a07b8caa218b3c085f4e8af14b.text: The assistant now finishes all requested steps before stopping. This small update helps it handle complex tasks without ending too early.

a9aa4fb1dc1d8fb527ac1021f2daef85a04286c8.text: A small internal fix ensures error logs include the specific file location. This helps support staff identify which file caused a failure during saving.

adda69659cde44f32ae0e52c5e1468d098862536.text: A small internal fix prevents the system from crashing when reading certain files. This makes the software more stable for everyday use.

0f33e633e79bd9e75060f9722bcf681c1aef3ede.text: A low-cost setting now skips extra safety checks. This makes responses faster and cheaper, but the assistant may not always finish every task completely.

984f285ad3bdb5661cf12436fc43830a7fe510d3.text: The system now uses a clearer name to separate your typed messages from the assistant's internal actions. This small update improves how the product tracks activity, but you will not notice any difference in how you use the app.

2c1b68ff9199828cc34d7764716bd59b52834cd1.text: The assistant now records details about each step it takes while working. This helps the team understand how tasks are completed and fix issues faster.

ffd805fa006107cb6992598ef83c6075afac485e.text: The assistant now tells you when a file edit fails, instead of staying silent.

6e9750b7e926445391766db5345bec8c3b0fdc1c.text: The assistant no longer needs to explicitly signal when it is finished with a task. It now automatically waits for and processes results, making the interaction smoother and less prone to errors.

c78cd87e2e12887d0dea7d90d12115abf94c1c09.text: When you press the up arrow to find old commands, the tool now shows the most recent use of each command at the end of the list, instead of hiding repeated commands. This keeps your history organized by when you last used it.

9e4c5dafa6e4c719aebb90782ec6746cb032ffbd.title: Update xml-stream-parser unit tests
9e4c5dafa6e4c719aebb90782ec6746cb032ffbd.summary: Added test cases to `backend/src/__tests__/xml-stream-parser.test.ts` verifying that stray closing tags are ignored. The new assertions expect specific error messages for `content` tags during stream processing. This change is internal to the test suite and does not affect runtime behavior or user-facing features.

26d197b40bdace61de389775a4630bb1e497e93c.title: Merge key files into training request logic
26d197b40bdace61de389775a4630bb1e497e93c.summary: requestRelevantFilesForTraining now generates prompts for both key and non-obvious files, executing parallel retrieval via getRelevantFilesForTraining. Results merge into candidateFiles, deduplicate, validate, and truncate to MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST. Scope: backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts. Adds debug logging for keyFiles, nonObviousFiles, and validatedFiles.

4c1c17e0d64b9ae61618d73f19e8400ca77964d9.title: Gate training data upload on requested files
4c1c17e0d64b9ae61618d73f19e8400ca77964d9.summary: Wrap uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining in a requestedFiles.length > 0 check in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Prevents recording expanded file context for training when no files are explicitly requested. Internal logging/training pipeline change; no user-facing surface impact.

b2dc44b04f4ea6253d8134354d0592cfe1df644d.title: Remove non-obvious Sonnet request in max mode
b2dc44b04f4ea6253d8134354d0592cfe1df644d.summary: Deleted `nonObviousPromise` block in `requestRelevantFiles` for `costMode === 'max'`. File selection now relies solely on `keyPromise` results. Updated `request-files-prompt.ts` to remove parallel `getRelevantFiles` call for 'Non-Obvious' prompts. Logic simplifies candidate file aggregation to direct `keyPromise` resolution.

35442b388778a0d30072903b5c83bc1f9b878603.title: Remove debug console logs from xml-stream-parser
35442b388778a0d30072903b5c83bc1f9b878603.summary: Deleted seven `console.log` statements from `backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts`. These logs were tagged with 'asdf' in `startTool`, `startParam`, `endParam`, `endTool`, `onTagopen`, `onText`, and `onTagclose` handlers. Change is internal; no user-facing behavior impact.

95ac3778eafb2c777796932b8ca4364e4d32e813.title: Fix terminal cd command in runCommandPty
95ac3778eafb2c777796932b8ca4364e4d32e813.summary: Merged `cd` command into `runCommandPty` execution string to ensure working directory applies before user command. Removed separate `ptyProcess.write` for initial `cd` and unified Windows/Unix command construction with `cd` prefix. Prevents race conditions where `cd` might not execute before subsequent commands. Affects `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`.

b676962260dc5be0e3fb88b2f877d92bd55795ac.title: Gate credit debug logs behind VERBOSE flag
b676962260dc5be0e3fb88b2f877d92bd55795ac.summary: message-cost-tracker.ts wraps five logger.debug calls in a new VERBOSE=false guard. Reduces log spam during normal operation while preserving debug output when explicitly enabled. Affects backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts. VERBOSE constant defaults to false; set to true to restore verbose credit consumption and Stripe sync logging.

b2b3604e8d5b0451c6a3fdf85e83fbafef81984f.title: Saxy parser emits rawTag text for stray XML
b2b3604e8d5b0451c6a3fdf85e83fbafef81984f.summary: Saxy parser now attaches `rawTag` to `TagOpenNode` and `TagCloseNode`. `xml-stream-parser` forwards this raw text to `onText` when encountering stray or unknown XML tags. This prevents silent loss of malformed agent output by treating invalid tags as plain text. Covers `backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts` and `common/src/util/saxy.ts`.

e67405a81a75832c42aa2204aa8ba826c429b2f8.title: Add chargeUser flag to prevent billing filepicker training data
e67405a81a75832c42aa2204aa8ba826c429b2f8.summary: Backend adds optional `chargeUser` boolean to `promptClaude`, `promptClaudeStream`, and `saveMessage` in `claude.ts` and `message-cost-tracker.ts`. `getRelevantFilesForTraining` in `request-files-prompt.ts` passes `chargeUser: false` to skip billing for internal filepicker training requests. `saveMessage` zeroes out `costInCents` when `chargeUser` is false, defaulting to true otherwise. Scope limited to backend Claude API and cost tracking modules.

e61897f728a707e32b576074bdad43518e591643.title: Add carriage returns to newline squashing logic
e61897f728a707e32b576074bdad43518e591643.summary:
Updated `npm-app/src/display.ts` to normalize newlines by inserting carriage returns (`
`) before applying squash logic. The `previous` buffer now tracks 4 chars instead of 2 to handle the multi-character sequence, and regex patterns in `process.stdout.write` and `process.stderr.write` were adjusted to match `
{3,}` instead of `
{3,}`. This ensures consistent line ending handling across the CLI output stream.

9e4c5dafa6e4c719aebb90782ec6746cb032ffbd.text: The team added extra checks to make sure the system ignores broken parts in data files. This internal update does not change how the product works for you.

b676962260dc5be0e3fb88b2f877d92bd55795ac.text: The system now hides detailed tracking notes about costs and payments from its background logs unless a specific setting is turned on. This keeps the logs clean and easier to read for regular use, while still allowing support teams to see those details if they need to investigate an issue.

e61897f728a707e32b576074bdad43518e591643.text: The software now handles line breaks more consistently. This ensures text displays correctly without extra blank lines.

4c1c17e0d64b9ae61618d73f19e8400ca77964d9.text: The system now stops saving extra file details for training if no files were asked for. This is a small internal fix that does not change how the product works for users.

95ac3778eafb2c777796932b8ca4364e4d32e813.text: A small internal fix ensures that when the system runs a command in a specific folder, it correctly moves to that folder first. This prevents occasional errors where commands might fail because they ran in the wrong location.

e67405a81a75832c42aa2204aa8ba826c429b2f8.text: Internal systems that help the assistant choose relevant files no longer charge users for these background checks. This ensures you are not billed for data used to improve how the assistant finds information.

35442b388778a0d30072903b5c83bc1f9b878603.text: The software no longer records extra internal messages while processing files. This change is small and internal. It does not affect how the product works for users.

26d197b40bdace61de389775a4630bb1e497e93c.text: The assistant now looks for both important and surprising files when learning new information. It checks these files together, removes duplicates, and keeps only the most relevant ones.

b2b3604e8d5b0451c6a3fdf85e83fbafef81984f.text: The system now displays broken or unrecognized commands as normal text instead of hiding them. This prevents messages from appearing incomplete when the assistant sends incorrect formatting.

b2dc44b04f4ea6253d8134354d0592cfe1df644d.text: The assistant now picks the files it needs using one method instead of two. This change is small and internal. You might see slightly different files get used.

0ffa2f40e062e71a778d4b75fa85ab93b07d9a14.title: Reduce max consecutive assistant messages
0ffa2f40e062e71a778d4b75fa85ab93b07d9a14.summary: Lowered `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES` from 20 to 12 in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This tightens the limit on consecutive assistant messages within a single turn. The change applies to the backend core logic.

879b743cd517244d755ac1ddbed251827ae8dbce.title: Log malformed prompt responses
879b743cd517244d755ac1ddbed251827ae8dbce.summary: Added `AnalyticsEvent.MALFORMED_PROMPT_RESPONSE` and logging in `npm-app/src/client.ts` when `PromptResponseSchema.safeParse` fails. Previously, invalid responses were silently ignored. Now, errors are logged to console and analytics logger.

df0edf50f63f0c546cfca4e0c8d3f3193d114c98.title: Resolve merge conflicts in saxy.ts
df0edf50f63f0c546cfca4e0c8d3f3193d114c98.summary: Removed Git merge conflict markers from common/src/util/saxy.ts. Retained HEAD logic checking `!chunk.trim()` for text node processing. Reverted condition matching `chunk === '\n'` from commit 3e3cffbd. Scope limited to shared core utility file.

2763eef3cc93f9f915924bb6c11157d78a56b663.title: Fix terminal command timeout parsing
2763eef3cc93f9f915924bb6c11157d78a56b663.summary: Changed `timeout_seconds` from number to string in `backend/src/tools.ts` and `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. Added explicit `parseInt` with error handling to prevent crashes on invalid inputs. Scope covers backend schema and npm-app handler.

ed2a4dd91662583f650d330ff65eaba4555c53db.title: Add getProjectRoot spy to tool-renderers test setup
ed2a4dd91662583f650d330ff65eaba4555c53db.summary: Added spyOn for projectFiles.getProjectRoot in the beforeEach hook of npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/tool-renderers.test.ts. This mocks the root path resolution to prevent test failures caused by unmocked filesystem dependencies during tool renderer execution. The change is isolated to the test suite and does not affect production logic or user-facing behavior.

27a519e7246d53445c3419316dc7f857bb6ff01d.title: Remove merge conflict markers from backend main-prompt.ts
27a519e7246d53445c3419316dc7f857bb6ff01d.summary: Cleaned up unresolved merge conflict markers in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The conflict was between the current `HEAD` (which pushed `onResponseChunk` and `end_turn` tool calls) and a reverted XML parsing PR. This change ensures the codebase compiles cleanly without syntax errors from the conflict markers.

1b79a6d5380dfdf14a4e6a99cc1a63b5f9ad8b91.title: XML stream parsing returns
1b79a6d5380dfdf14a4e6a99cc1a63b5f9ad8b91.summary: XML stream parsing is back, replacing regex-based `processStreamWithTags` with new `xml-stream-parser.ts` using `Saxy` for tool-call extraction. This fixes issues with nested tags and attribute parsing in `write_file` and other tools. Scope covers `backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts`, `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, and `common/src/util/saxy.ts`. `parseRawToolCall` now returns `ToolCallError` objects instead of throwing, enabling graceful handling of malformed tool calls.

b450741963e3975f3e7b1f0c311fe4ba544c0711.title: Add cwd parameter to runterminalcommand
b450741963e3975f3e7b1f0c311fe4ba544c0711.summary: Added optional cwd parameter to run_terminal_command tool schema and handler. This allows the agent to execute commands from specific directories rather than being restricted to the project root. Implementation updates backend tool definitions, common constants, and npm-app terminal utilities to support directory resolution and proper path display.

c60fa21bba1531e05cc683abfb8272cae2bc712f.title: Revert XML parsing PR
c60fa21bba1531e05cc683abfb8272cae2bc712f.summary: Reverts the XML parsing implementation, restoring the previous stream processing logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/process-stream.ts`. The change removes the new `processStreamWithTags` function and associated test files (`backend/src/__tests__/process-stream.test.ts`, `backend/src/__tests__/parse-attributes.test.ts`) introduced in the reverted PR. `backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts` is restored, while `common/src/util/saxy.ts` and related tests are reverted to their prior state. This rollback affects core agent stream handling and tool call parsing.

95e59b8a0f3924722637e1f68727c6442ab5f045.title: Assistant terminal commands locked to project root
95e59b8a0f3924722637e1f68727c6442ab5f045.summary: Assistant mode in runCommandPty now forces cwd to project root via cd ${projectRoot} and bypasses directory tracking. run_terminal_command description updated to 'Execute a CLI command from the project root' and removed persistent cwd note. Affects backend/src/tools.ts and npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts. Assistant commands resolve with 'Ran command from project root' status; user mode retains cd tracking.

27a519e7246d53445c3419316dc7f857bb6ff01d.text: Fixed a small internal error that stopped the system from working. The assistant now functions normally again.

95e59b8a0f3924722637e1f68727c6442ab5f045.text: The assistant now always runs commands from the main project folder, ignoring any other locations. This keeps its actions consistent and prevents it from accidentally working in the wrong place.

1b79a6d5380dfdf14a4e6a99cc1a63b5f9ad8b91.text: The assistant now reads instructions from files more accurately, fixing errors when files contain complex formatting. This means commands like saving files will work reliably without crashing.

879b743cd517244d755ac1ddbed251827ae8dbce.text: The system now records when it receives confusing answers, instead of ignoring them silently. This helps the team see and fix problems faster.

ed2a4dd91662583f650d330ff65eaba4555c53db.text: A small internal fix improved how tests check the assistant's tool rendering. Nothing changed for users.

0ffa2f40e062e71a778d4b75fa85ab93b07d9a14.text: The assistant now stops repeating itself sooner during a conversation. This small internal update prevents it from sending too many messages in a row.

b450741963e3975f3e7b1f0c311fe4ba544c0711.text: The assistant can now run commands from specific folders instead of just the main project folder. This gives the assistant more flexibility in navigating your files.

2763eef3cc93f9f915924bb6c11157d78a56b663.text: Fixed a small internal issue that could cause crashes when the assistant used terminal commands with certain time limits.

df0edf50f63f0c546cfca4e0c8d3f3193d114c98.text: A small internal fix cleaned up a glitch in the text processing engine. You likely won't notice any changes, but the app is now more stable behind the scenes.

c60fa21bba1531e05cc683abfb8272cae2bc712f.text: The team undid a recent update to how the assistant reads and processes information. This change restores the previous, stable method for handling text, ensuring the assistant continues to work as expected without new experimental features.

7198e0392cee09135528380c425b5ece18f377d4.title: Saxy parser drops whitespace-only text at root
7198e0392cee09135528380c425b5ece18f377d4.summary: Saxy XML parser now strips whitespace-only chunks when `_tagStack.length === 1`. Fixes newline artifacts in tool call parsing. Implemented in `common/src/util/saxy.ts`.

9536965727e3f62969b74bed4c605db2ab709bf7.title: Reformat error logging in get-documentation-for-query.ts
9536965727e3f62969b74bed4c605db2ab709bf7.summary: Code formatting change in backend/src/get-documentation-for-query.ts. The logger.error call for failed Gemini responses was expanded to multi-line format. No functional change.

1ec706f75036a05e22c86f1e92f74751ff1ec763.title: Re-land training file context capture
1ec706f75036a05e22c86f1e92f74751ff1ec763.summary: Reverts previous revert, restoring `requestRelevantFilesForTraining` in `backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts` and `uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This captures expanded file context via a stronger model for training data, uploading full file contents up to 50k tokens. Schema updates in `packages/bigquery/src/schema.ts` add `get-expanded-file-context-for-training` and `get-expanded-file-context-for-training-blobs` trace types.

9a4ad025abb84b7082bf8324947873c15ea25c51.title: Replace regex stream parser with Saxy XML parser
9a4ad025abb84b7082bf8324947873c15ea25c51.summary: The backend replaces the custom regex-based `processStreamWithTags` in `process-stream.ts` with a new `xml-stream-parser.ts` utilizing the `Saxy` library from `common/src/util/saxy.ts`. This change addresses parsing fragility by implementing a proper state machine for tool call extraction, handling nested tags and stray text more robustly than the previous regex approach. The `main-prompt.ts` file imports the new parser, and `tools.ts` updates `parseRawToolCall` to return structured error objects instead of throwing exceptions, allowing the stream processor to gracefully handle invalid tool calls without crashing the agent loop.

fcb0f94dbaf29323c5587a64ba230d0f2d6e2f31.title: tool-renderers.test.ts mock lifecycle
fcb0f94dbaf29323c5587a64ba230d0f2d6e2f31.summary: Mock setup for `isFileIgnored` moved into `beforeEach` with `mock.restore` in `afterEach`. Fixes state leakage between tests in `npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/tool-renderers.test.ts`. Internal test hygiene; no user-facing change.

463ef5a59773b55dbeab4231c5733c9fac3937ac.title: Revert lite mode model assignments
463ef5a59773b55dbeab4231c5733c9fac3937ac.summary: Reverts lite mode to use cheaper models for agent, file requests, and new file checks. Agent lite uses gemini2_5_flash_thinking instead of sonnet. File request lite remains haiku, but normal drops to haiku; check-new-files lite uses gpt4omini. Scope includes common/src/constants.ts, backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts, and backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts.

67cf38db9c420ea7e875f42d6765e9764f75fa88.title: Stripe credit purchase uses default payment method and Link
67cf38db9c420ea7e875f42d6765e9764f75fa88.summary: Credit purchase logic in `web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts` now retrieves the customer's `invoice_settings.default_payment_method` instead of scanning all payment methods. Link is added to `payment_method_types` in the fallback checkout session. Card validity checks (expiry) are retained for direct charges, with Link bypassing expiry checks.

7d6815e377d4c37e67b5b94f0a47d6c828a2a407.title: Fix endturn parameters and writefile block formatting
7d6815e377d4c37e67b5b94f0a47d6c828a2a407.summary: Corrected `end_turn` tool call parameters from empty array to empty object in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Refactored `createWriteFileBlock` in `common/src/util/file.ts` to use template literals and remove newlines around `<content>` tags. Scope covers backend prompt generation and common file utilities. Fixes test failures related to main prompt structure.

4d582780490739dbec7967cafae57135e1c07ae1.title: Revert file context training pipeline
4d582780490739dbec7967cafae57135e1c07ae1.summary: Removes requestRelevantFilesForTraining and uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining from backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts and backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Drops associated BigQuery trace types (get-expanded-file-context-for-training, get-expanded-file-context-for-training-blobs) and interfaces in packages/bigquery/src/schema.ts. Reverts #135.

3a5e593d512005acfb865c3727621b2b118f3c8b.title: Stripe buy-credits accepts all payment types
3a5e593d512005acfb865c3727621b2b118f3c8b.summary: The Stripe `buy-credits` API route previously filtered payment methods by `type: 'card'`. This restriction is removed, allowing the endpoint to accept all valid payment types. The change is isolated to `web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts`.

fcb0f94dbaf29323c5587a64ba230d0f2d6e2f31.text: Developers fixed an internal test to keep checks separate. No change to how you use the product.

9a4ad025abb84b7082bf8324947873c15ea25c51.text: The system now reads assistant instructions more reliably. This prevents occasional crashes when the assistant tries to use a tool.

7198e0392cee09135528380c425b5ece18f377d4.text: The assistant now ignores empty lines in the background. This fixes errors where extra spaces caused commands to fail.

463ef5a59773b55dbeab4231c5733c9fac3937ac.text: The app switched back to using faster, less expensive tools for background tasks. This change aims to keep the service running efficiently without altering how the assistant answers your questions.

7d6815e377d4c37e67b5b94f0a47d6c828a2a407.text: Fixed a formatting error in how the system handles file writing instructions. This ensures the assistant's responses are structured correctly, preventing minor glitches.

9536965727e3f62969b74bed4c605db2ab709bf7.text: A small internal change adjusted how error logs are formatted in the code. This does not affect how the product works or looks to users.

4d582780490739dbec7967cafae57135e1c07ae1.text: An internal tool that sent extra file details to the training system was removed. This cleanup step does not change how the product works for users.

67cf38db9c420ea7e875f42d6765e9764f75fa88.text: The system now uses your saved card for purchases instead of searching all your cards. This makes checkout faster and supports one-click payment options.

3a5e593d512005acfb865c3727621b2b118f3c8b.text: The credit purchase page now accepts more types of payment, not just cards. You can use other valid payment methods to buy credits.

1ec706f75036a05e22c86f1e92f74751ff1ec763.text: A small internal update restores a feature that helps the assistant learn from more detailed file information.

d352882a73d99ef69fab07fa409a337b04b0b0ab.title: Restrict Gemini thinking to max cost mode
d352882a73d99ef69fab07fa409a337b04b0b0ab.summary: Gemini thinking is now gated to `costMode === 'max'` instead of `!== 'lite'` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This prevents thinking tokens from being generated in standard modes, reducing latency and cost for non-max requests.

b1bac2c744a2e3cc53f64c5ca305ca90596dcb00.title: Update Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview constant to 05-06
b1bac2c744a2e3cc53f64c5ca305ca90596dcb00.summary: The `gemini2_5_pro_preview` constant in `common/src/constants.ts` now points to `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06` instead of `03-25`. This aligns the internal identifier with the latest upstream preview release. The change applies to all surfaces referencing `FREEBUFF_MODELS` or `geminiModels`.

5d20d722a70f1bc76d0715100dd3f7239280ded3.title: main-prompt.ts verification instruction requires knowledge file
5d20d722a70f1bc76d0715100dd3f7239280ded3.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts updated to conditionally require knowledge file commands for type/linter checks. Agent must only run <run_terminal_command> for verification if knowledge files specify a command, otherwise use <await_tool_results>. Internal prompt logic change.

69a66e1d04cd22cff6c75aeffc766df5b0720ce9.title: main-prompt.ts: enforce full paths for writefile and readfiles
69a66e1d04cd22cff6c75aeffc766df5b0720ce9.summary: main-prompt.ts strengthened the full-path instruction for write_file and read_files, adding 'Important:' prefix and explicit root-relative path requirement. Updated to warn about import path mismatches (e.g., backend/utils/foo.ts vs actual backend/src/utils/foo.ts). Scoped to Gemini Flash and Pro models only. Single backend/src/main-prompt.ts file changed.

7f35f640dfcc9996c7380345504d90df78ee49c4.title: Refine thinking-stream prompt to request code excerpts
7f35f640dfcc9996c7380345504d90df78ee49c4.summary: Updated `backend/src/thinking-stream.ts` prompt guidelines to request major code change excerpts instead of full line-by-line rewrites. Added explicit instruction to minimize response length and corrected tool call reference examples to first-person. This internal prompt tweak aims to reduce token usage and improve clarity in the thinking stream.

ce0ef767dfe4065c39e1455238060a1a518a612c.title: Reduce prompt pressure for awaittoolresults
ce0ef767dfe4065c39e1455238060a1a518a612c.summary: System prompts and tool descriptions updated to discourage simultaneous use of `await_tool_results` and `run_terminal_command`. The `agent-instructions.md` section explicitly mandating periodic `await_tool_results` was removed. This clarifies that verification via terminal commands is preferred, reserving `await_tool_results` for when no specific check command exists.

c7a934eca71ec50ec2d246da6cd0f143dbe8e216.title: Strengthen pre-turn-end validation prompts
c7a934eca71ec50ec2d246da6cd0f143dbe8e216.summary: Backend prompts now mandate completion of all subgoals before ending turn. The conditional logic restricting validation instructions to specific cost modes was removed, applying the requirement to check file changes, tests, and lint errors universally. Agent instructions were updated to emphasize not ending turn while work remains and to clarify the end_turn tool usage.

77b6e4345669c3e1d9d0cb8325d3603cfb28c7d5.title: Add training file context capture
77b6e4345669c3e1d9d0cb8325d3603cfb28c7d5.summary: New requestRelevantFilesForTraining function in backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts captures expanded file context for model training. Main prompt handler triggers asynchronous upload via uploadExpandedFileContextForTraining in backend/src/main-prompt.ts, logging errors without blocking. BigQuery schema updated in packages/bigquery/src/schema.ts with new trace types for file context and blobs.

dd23114f5046383bc4931fb2fe9f93c6da3285ff.title: Refine agent prompts and model mappings
dd23114f5046383bc4931fb2fe9f93c6da3285ff.summary: Updated main prompt instructions to enforce `end_turn` usage after verification via `run_terminal_command` or `await_tool_results`. Adjusted `thinkingBudget` to 0 in `prompt-agent-stream.ts` and refined tool descriptions in `tools.ts`. Modified model mappings in `common/src/constants.ts` for agent operations, switching `normal`/`max` modes to `models.sonnet` and `experimental` to `models.gemini2_5_pro_preview`. Added specific constraints for Gemini Flash/Pro models regarding file writing and end-of-response tags.

1fb6f18190af2630f4f863773b65c7dd6bd22ebb.title: Add awaittoolresults tool for agent feedback
1fb6f18190af2630f4f863773b65c7dd6bd22ebb.summary: Introduced `await_tool_results` to allow agents to pause and check tool outputs before continuing. Updated `main-prompt.ts` and `agent-instructions.md` to mandate this tool usage before `end_turn` to verify state. Registered tool in `backend/src/tools.ts` and `common/src/constants/tools.ts` with no parameters. Added handler and renderer in `npm-app` to process the pause silently.

d352882a73d99ef69fab07fa409a337b04b0b0ab.text: The assistant now only uses its most powerful reasoning mode when you select the highest cost setting. This change saves money and makes responses faster for standard settings.

7f35f640dfcc9996c7380345504d90df78ee49c4.text: The assistant now shares only key parts of code updates instead of rewriting entire files. This small change keeps responses shorter and clearer for users.

b1bac2c744a2e3cc53f64c5ca305ca90596dcb00.text: The app now uses a newer version of the underlying AI model. This update is small and happens automatically in the background.

c7a934eca71ec50ec2d246da6cd0f143dbe8e216.text: The assistant now double-checks its work before stopping, ensuring it finishes all tasks and verifies no errors remain.

69a66e1d04cd22cff6c75aeffc766df5b0720ce9.text: The assistant now checks file locations more strictly to avoid errors. This small internal update helps it save and find documents correctly without needing user action.

ce0ef767dfe4065c39e1455238060a1a518a612c.text: The assistant now relies more on direct checks to confirm actions instead of waiting for background updates. This makes it faster and more reliable for you.

dd23114f5046383bc4931fb2fe9f93c6da3285ff.text: The assistant now uses different brain models for different tasks and has clearer instructions for when to stop thinking and start acting. This helps it answer more accurately and finish tasks without getting stuck.

77b6e4345669c3e1d9d0cb8325d3603cfb28c7d5.text: The system now quietly saves extra details from your files to help improve future responses. This happens in the background and does not slow down your work.

1e229c2414d21296fbe1b3df534d7e99015948d9.title: tools.ts forbids XML entities in tool call format
1e229c2414d21296fbe1b3df534d7e99015948d9.summary: Added rule 4 to backend/src/tools.ts instructing agents to avoid XML entities (<, >, &) in tool call parameters, requiring raw characters instead. This prevents parsing errors caused by uninterpreted entities. Scope limited to backend tool definition instructions. Rule 4 is now included in the critical failure warning.

a8c76bd5c1e37469b4550db7ca1b60c97421ea0d.title: Rename pendingEntity to entityBuffer in Saxy
a8c76bd5c1e37469b4550db7ca1b60c97421ea0d.summary: Internal refactor of Saxy XML parser renames _pendingEntity to _entityBuffer for clarity. parseEntities gains explicit string return type. Removes conditional check for pending entity when emitting buffered text at chunk end. Affects common/src/util/saxy.ts.

2b180da3ec412191f7cbbcbb5896d65504f01437.title: experimental costMode sets thinkingBudget to 0
2b180da3ec412191f7cbbcbb5896d65504f01437.summary: In `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`, the `getAgentStream` logic now sets `thinkingBudget` to 0 when `costMode` is 'experimental', alongside 'normal' and 'max'. Previously, 'experimental' mode left `thinkingBudget` undefined. This change ensures consistent budget handling for experimental cost modes within the agent stream.

7c6d8ede48ab90462888cda96218d9af4879db81.title: Fix experimental mode prompt filtering and instruction assembly
7c6d8ede48ab90462888cda96218d9af4879db81.summary: Corrects `costMode` logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The previous filter incorrectly excluded system instructions only in experimental mode; the condition is inverted to `costMode !== 'experimental'`. The user message construction now explicitly branches on `prompt` and `costMode` to ensure `toolsInstructions` are included only when appropriate, preventing malformed or missing instruction blocks.

7638e472c2a1a71d4d836450777c85bed12c7202.title: Fix gitignore subdirectory pattern resolution in project-file-tree
7638e472c2a1a71d4d836450777c85bed12c7202.summary: Non-rooted gitignore patterns now prepend `relativeDirPath` before matching, ensuring correct resolution for nested `.gitignore` files. Previously, patterns lacking a leading slash were treated as project-root-relative, causing incorrect ignore behavior in subdirectories. This change applies to `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` within the Shared/Core package.

03fef962e1215a65f51c2fa7cfe47377d6d0ffbe.title: Reduce Buffy persona references in tools instructions
03fef962e1215a65f51c2fa7cfe47377d6d0ffbe.summary: Removed explicit instructions to 'Remember your Buffy persona!' and 'act as Buffy' from `backend/src/tools.ts`. Added directive to avoid referencing tool names or parameters in user-facing output. Scope limited to internal tool prompt configuration.

00ca17f4249d7e5010c6ad7e18b10ae52267309c.title: main-prompt: pass userInstructions only on full prompt
00ca17f4249d7e5010c6ad7e18b10ae52267309c.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts now gates userInstructions injection on prompt presence. When prompt is absent, content falls back to costMode toolsInstructions plus toolInstructions instead. Internal prompt assembly refactor. Scope: backend main-prompt only.

9bb6fe282e5948105a77e5edf3344643c9180f05.title: Gate toolsInstructions to experimental costMode
9bb6fe282e5948105a77e5edf3344643c9180f05.summary: mainPrompt gates toolsInstructions injection behind costMode === 'experimental'. Default cost modes now omit tool instructions from userInstructions array. Adds explicit proceed directive to prompt. Affects backend/src/main-prompt.ts.

8c048dd8dc038298a44d6021900f779be3e16736.title: Disable Gemini 2.5 Pro thinking in normal/max cost modes
8c048dd8dc038298a44d6021900f779be3e16736.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro streaming disables thinking by passing `thinkingBudget: 0` when `costMode` is 'normal' or 'max'. `streamGemini25ProWithFallbacks` accepts `thinkingBudget` in options and forwards it to `promptGeminiStream`. Scope limited to `backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` and `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`. `thinkingBudget` remains `undefined` for other cost modes, preserving default thinking behavior.

511918a26dbbd2a41687ea2164b57b94871f4b76.title: Unify fetch timeouts via withTimeout util
511918a26dbbd2a41687ea2164b57b94871f4b76.summary: Refactored timeout handling in `context7-api.ts` and `ai-sdk.ts` to use shared `withTimeout` utility instead of inline `Promise.race`. Added optional `timeout` parameter to `promptAiSdkStructured` in `ai-sdk.ts`. Improved default timeout message in `common/src/util/promise.ts` to include duration. Updated error logging in `get-documentation-for-query.ts` for clarity.

a8c76bd5c1e37469b4550db7ca1b60c97421ea0d.text: The software now handles text more efficiently during loading. This internal update improves performance but does not change how the product looks or works for you.

511918a26dbbd2a41687ea2164b57b94871f4b76.text: The assistant now uses one standard way to decide when to stop waiting for a response, replacing separate rules in different places. This makes timeout messages clearer, but it does not change how you use the product.

1e229c2414d21296fbe1b3df534d7e99015948d9.text: The assistant now uses plain symbols instead of special codes when sending information. This stops the system from getting confused by those codes. The change is small and internal.

7638e472c2a1a71d4d836450777c85bed12c7202.text: The app now correctly hides files in folders that are set to be ignored. This prevents files from appearing in the list when they should be hidden.

2b180da3ec412191f7cbbcbb5896d65504f01437.text: A small internal update ensures the experimental cost mode now follows the same thinking limits as other modes. This change makes the assistant's behavior more consistent but does not add new features for users.

03fef962e1215a65f51c2fa7cfe47377d6d0ffbe.text: The assistant's instructions were adjusted to stop mentioning specific internal tools by name. This change is small and internal, meaning the assistant's responses may look slightly cleaner to you.

9bb6fe282e5948105a77e5edf3344643c9180f05.text: The assistant now only shares detailed tool instructions when an experimental setting is active. For most users, this means cleaner responses with less internal technical clutter.

8c048dd8dc038298a44d6021900f779be3e16736.text: The assistant stops using extra reasoning steps in standard and high-cost modes. This change makes responses faster and cheaper for those settings.

00ca17f4249d7e5010c6ad7e18b10ae52267309c.text: The assistant now only applies your custom instructions when you provide a full prompt. If you send a short or empty message, it uses standard settings instead.

94fca2c5be2787bd76a6a5fa20769875c89818d0.title: Add @ai-sdk/openai to backend deps
94fca2c5be2787bd76a6a5fa20769875c89818d0.summary: Added @ai-sdk/openai ^1.3.21 to backend/package.json dependencies. Sorted existing workspace deps alphabetically. Internal dependency update only. No user-facing changes.

893d2dddf1083a28c926885e6361bf7c2ecdb897.title: Gemini thinking prompt requires code and plan drafts
893d2dddf1083a28c926885e6361bf7c2ecdb897.summary: Added guidelines to `backend/src/thinking-stream.ts` instructing Gemini to draft line-by-line code changes and full planning documents within its thinking stream. This enforces explicit reasoning traces before tool execution for code modifications and planning tasks. Scope limited to backend prompt configuration.

4253f0ee60da409114f99cc7fc7ee070dde19027.title: Refactor terminal check to Vercel AI SDK
4253f0ee60da409114f99cc7fc7ee070dde19027.summary: checkTerminalCommand now uses promptAiSdk instead of racing promptOpenAI and promptFlashWithFallbacks. The prompt structure shifted to system/user roles, expecting 'y'/'n' responses parsed via includes('y'). This simplifies the logic by removing the Promise.race timeout handling for multiple providers, relying solely on a single AI SDK call with a 30s timeout. Internal refactor affecting backend/src/check-terminal-command.ts.

f70d699d484f2c1cfb224d437b7ad445e1981570.title: Remove ESLint fixAll from editor code actions on save
f70d699d484f2c1cfb224d437b7ad445e1981570.summary: Removed source.fixAll.eslint from editor.codeActionsOnSave in .vscode/settings.json. Prevents ESLint from automatically fixing code on save, relying on manual linting or separate fix commands. Affects repository-wide VS Code editor configuration.

8e0ae7d1a89fabf5cffb612178166e178f78221e.title: ai-sdk adapter enables Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic model routing
8e0ae7d1a89fabf5cffb612178166e178f78221e.summary: modelToAiSDKModel now routes geminiModels, openaiModels, and claudeModels to their respective @ai-sdk provider languageModel() calls. Previously only FinetunedVertexModel was mapped, throwing Unknown model for other providers. Change lives in backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts. Uses Object.values() membership checks against common/constants model enums.

8c7a04be0da6d90dfdebefe4ec0639a886e65210.title: Improve Saxy text emission for split entities
8c7a04be0da6d90dfdebefe4ec0639a886e65210.summary: Saxy XML parser buffers text chunks and flushes at tag boundaries or stream end to handle split entities correctly. Added heuristic to only treat trailing ampersands as pending entities if followed by alphanumeric or hash characters. Updates `common/src/util/saxy.ts` to introduce `_textBuffer` and refine `parseEntities` position handling.

13ab3a4de64c48ecaecb37d5e6ae3ff7df130199.title: Switch doc query to ai-sdk structured output
13ab3a4de64c48ecaecb37d5e6ae3ff7df130199.summary: Documentation query moved from `promptFlashWithFallbacks` to `promptAiSdkStructured` using `generateObject` with Zod schema. Replaced manual JSON parsing and confidence float with boolean `relevant` flag. `ProjectAnalysis` interface updated to match schema. Covers `backend/src/get-documentation-for-query.ts` and `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`.

3a298a3063af38830e48d23205adc3099a50da4d.title: Refine terminal command and documentation agent prompts
3a298a3063af38830e48d23205adc3099a50da4d.summary: Prompt structure updated for terminal command and documentation agents. `check-terminal-command.ts` consolidates system and user messages into a single user role with explicit prompt delimiters. `get-documentation-for-query.ts` replaces boolean relevance flags with 0-1 confidence scores, updating `ProjectAnalysis` and `zodSchema` types. Logic now gates documentation retrieval on `confidence <= 0.7` instead of `!relevant`.

0963ba72ae47c80f897f4c8c270729c0d9dc18e7.title: npm-app lint config migrate to flat eslint
0963ba72ae47c80f897f4c8c270729c0d9dc18e7.summary: Migrated from `.eslintrc.json` to `eslint.config.js` using flat config format. Added `no-restricted-imports` rule to prevent direct `src/` imports in `npm-app/src`. Added `lint` target to `npm-app/project.json` and `eslint` pre-build step. Updated `package.json` to `type: module` and added `typescript-eslint`, `globals`, `eslint-config-prettier` devDeps. Fixed import order and `pino` named import in affected files.

d074f6512ecdbad28235f9261a2af022b72f81fb.title: Enable Gemini 2.5 Pro in experimental mode
d074f6512ecdbad28235f9261a2af022b72f81fb.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro preview replaces GPT-4.1 for the experimental cost mode in `common/src/constants.ts`. File-request operations also shift from Haiku to Sonnet in experimental mode. New `start-experimental` npm scripts added to root and `npm-app` package.json to launch CLI with `--experimental` flag.

13ab3a4de64c48ecaecb37d5e6ae3ff7df130199.text: The assistant now checks if its answer is actually relevant to your question before showing it. This helps prevent it from guessing or giving unrelated information.

893d2dddf1083a28c926885e6361bf7c2ecdb897.text: The assistant now writes out its full plan and code changes before acting on tasks. This makes its reasoning clearer and more reliable for you.

8c7a04be0da6d90dfdebefe4ec0639a886e65210.text: The app now handles special text symbols more reliably when they appear in split sections. This prevents occasional display errors for normal users.

8e0ae7d1a89fabf5cffb612178166e178f78221e.text: The assistant can now use more types of AI models.

94fca2c5be2787bd76a6a5fa20769875c89818d0.text: A small internal update helps the product connect to a new AI service. Nothing changes for you.

f70d699d484f2c1cfb224d437b7ad445e1981570.text: The editor stopped automatically correcting code errors when saving. Users must now fix issues manually or run a separate command.

0963ba72ae47c80f897f4c8c270729c0d9dc18e7.text: The internal tools that check code quality were updated to a modern format. This change improves how the team maintains the application and does not affect the features or performance you see.

3a298a3063af38830e48d23205adc3099a50da4d.text: The assistant now judges how helpful a document is by scoring its confidence instead of just deciding yes or no. This helps it pick better sources when answering questions.

d074f6512ecdbad28235f9261a2af022b72f81fb.text: The assistant now uses a different, more powerful brain for experimental mode. This replaces the previous brain for cost-focused tasks and handles file requests with a stronger model. New commands let users easily launch this experimental version.

47370537e59039a7686938e309adba029663853b.title: Update working directory prompts and simplify terminal cwd output
47370537e59039a7686938e309adba029663853b.summary: Moved working directory guidance from global `toolsInstructions` to `run_terminal_command` description in `backend/src/tools.ts`. Removed critical block stating relative filepaths always start from project root, adding explicit warning to check cwd before execution. `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` simplified `cwdMessage` logic to always report final cwd, removing conditional empty string when unchanged. Minor syntax cleanup removing trailing semicolons on variable declarations.

8944e4d9adb65742406b8730169d73d996194f1a.title: CLI class switched to singleton pattern
8944e4d9adb65742406b8730169d73d996194f1a.summary: CLI class in npm-app/src/cli.ts now uses a private constructor with static initialize and getInstance methods. npm-app/src/index.ts calls CLI.initialize then CLI.getInstance instead of new CLI. Prevents multiple CLI instances and throws on double-init or pre-init access.

de18ec1fd18f7a6f0ec69ada2d2ff7e091eeae40.title: Fix cwd message formatting in terminal.ts
de18ec1fd18f7a6f0ec69ada2d2ff7e091eeae40.summary: Corrects working directory message assembly in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. Replaces ternary string concatenation with `buildArray` and explicit join to handle `outsideProject` state and `cwd` updates correctly. Internal refactor of terminal output logic.

c833fbf296103e4c38becfdafda2bd1f4e2dc713.title: Terminal timeout handling supports null and snakecase rename
c833fbf296103e4c38becfdafda2bd1f4e2dc713.summary: runTerminalCommand in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts now accepts negative timeoutSeconds as null to disable timeouts. Internal PTY and child process runners conditionally create timers and guard clearTimeout calls. Scope limited to npm-app terminal utilities.

1e992adce74376778376328e6598ac4e9fc24551.title: Fix import path in spinner.ts
1e992adce74376778376328e6598ac4e9fc24551.summary: Relative import path used for getPrevious and setPrevious in npm-app/src/utils/spinner.ts. Absolute src prefix removed. Internal build fix.

fc55d0bf3ed1f877431508b320c5df505553dd61.title: fix spinner newline duplication
fc55d0bf3ed1f877431508b320c5df505553dd61.summary: Spinner state now syncs with display module via getPrevious/setPrevious to prevent extra newlines. Internal refactor in npm-app/src/utils/spinner.ts and npm-app/src/display.ts. No user-facing API changes.

cdd32b801a6e2f5cd1a82451c79da66397a464c2.title: code-map: skip default object properties
cdd32b801a6e2f5cd1a82451c79da66397a464c2.summary: code-map parse.ts adds filter for default object properties. Token names like toString, hasOwnProperty now skipped via in {} check. Prevents false positives in getFileTokenScores. Internal fix, no user-facing behavior change.

674a6f9c70795af989774417b48b98a279094a33.title: Align normal cost mode with max mode
674a6f9c70795af989774417b48b98a279094a33.summary: The 'normal' cost mode now mirrors 'max' mode behavior for agent operations, file requests, and deep thinking. Updates in `common/src/constants.ts` map 'normal' to `claudeModels.sonnet` for agent and file-requests, and `models.gpt4o` for check-new-files. Backend logic in `main-prompt.ts` and `gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` includes 'normal' in max-mode conditionals for `think_deeply` tool calls and Sonnet fallbacks. `request-files-prompt.ts` increases `countPerRequest` for 'normal' to 14 and enables non-obvious file prompts.

2c1460fdd43768d35ec6d4898ba2243fe7a8428b.title: Add referencedby metadata to readfiles tool results
2c1460fdd43768d35ec6d4898ba2243fe7a8428b.summary: read_files tool results now include a <referenced_by> field listing files that call tokens defined in the read file. Mechanism: getFileTokenScores builds a tokenCallers map during code-map parsing, passed to renderReadFilesResult in backend prompts. Scope: packages/code-map (parse.ts, languages.ts, tree-sitter queries), backend/src/util/parse-tool-call-xml.ts, npm-app context workers. Detail: MAX_CALLERS limits caller lists to 25 files per token to control context size.

8944e4d9adb65742406b8730169d73d996194f1a.text: The app now blocks duplicate startup processes to prevent errors. This small internal fix improves stability without changing how you use the product.

47370537e59039a7686938e309adba029663853b.text: The assistant now shows the current folder it is working in before running commands. This helps you see exactly where files will be created or changed.

1e992adce74376778376328e6598ac4e9fc24551.text: A small internal fix corrected a broken link in the loading spinner's code. Users see no change.

674a6f9c70795af989774417b48b98a279094a33.text: The standard setting now behaves like the maximum setting, so the assistant can use its strongest reasoning and look at more files at once. You get better answers and deeper analysis without changing your preferences.

cdd32b801a6e2f5cd1a82451c79da66397a464c2.text: A small internal fix stops the system from noticing common background words that do not matter. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2c1460fdd43768d35ec6d4898ba2243fe7a8428b.text: The assistant now shows which files use code from the file you are reading. This helps you see connections without guessing.

c833fbf296103e4c38becfdafda2bd1f4e2dc713.text: The system now lets you set commands to run indefinitely without timing out.
