de18ec1fd18f7a6f0ec69ada2d2ff7e091eeae40.text: A small internal fix corrected how the app displays its current location, ensuring the path shown is always accurate.

fc55d0bf3ed1f877431508b320c5df505553dd61.text: The loading indicator no longer adds extra blank lines. This small internal fix keeps the screen tidy.

1fb6f18190af2630f4f863773b65c7dd6bd22ebb.text: The assistant can now pause to check its own work before finishing a task. This helps it catch mistakes earlier and provide more accurate answers.

4000dfed01964035908b4341aa76e46879891d48.title: Fix newline squashing across chunk boundaries in display.ts
4000dfed01964035908b4341aa76e46879891d48.summary: Newline squashing logic in `npm-app/src/display.ts` now tracks trailing blank state across write chunks. Previously, `squashVisibleNewlines` processed each chunk independently, causing blank line collapse errors when chunks split mid-stream. The new `squashVisibleNewlinesFromBuffer` function combines previous buffer state with incoming chunks, ensuring consistent blank line limits (max 2) across boundaries. Scope limited to internal terminal display buffering; no API or model changes.

f324f147c3d61a106de183afb3d912cb8e8826c6.title: Fix cd persistence prompt
f324f147c3d61a106de183afb3d912cb8e8826c6.summary: Updated backend/src/tools.ts to state cwd is persistent. Removed incorrect instructions claiming cwd resets per command and requiring cd subdir && cmd chaining. Aligns tool guidance with actual shell session behavior.

dab97535beb980aae0543ec87f2188ebe2172859.title: Update thinking-stream prompt to avoid angle brackets in tool
dab97535beb980aae0543ec87f2188ebe2172859.summary: Updated thinking-stream.ts guidelines to instruct the model to refer to tool calls without angle brackets (e.g., "use the end_turn tool" instead of "<end_turn>"). This prevents the model from accidentally generating literal tags inside the thinking block, which could interfere with stream parsing. The change applies to the backend thinking stream prompt guidelines.

8d1a2a56e6e78f7cdc5bbe3fe97c07056c15c2ad.title: Revert display newline squashing logic
8d1a2a56e6e78f7cdc5bbe3fe97c07056c15c2ad.summary: Reverts the complex `terminal-kit` ScreenBuffer-based newline squashing in `npm-app/src/display.ts` back to a simple string replacement mechanism. The previous implementation caused rendering artifacts with ANSI escape codes and failed to correctly handle split chunks across stdout writes. This change removes the `@types/terminal-kit` dependency from `npm-app/package.json` and restores the lightweight `previous` buffer tracking.

4b66e341afcb345b917abe363245a38b957f9f7e.title: CI: add GITHUBTOKEN to allow tree-sitter library download
4b66e341afcb345b917abe363245a38b957f9f7e.summary: CI workflow updated to include GITHUB_TOKEN in environment variables. This token allows the tree-sitter library to be downloaded successfully during the build process. Changes affect .github/workflows/ci.yml.

de5954b7c69cde46098b4cfcbab1c156dff38fd6.title: Fix flaky new lines after tool call header
de5954b7c69cde46098b4cfcbab1c156dff38fd6.summary: Updated `defaultToolCallRenderer` in `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts` to track tool start state via a new `toolStart` variable. This logic strips leading newlines from parameter chunks immediately following a tool header, resolving flaky spacing issues in console output. Scope limited to internal rendering logic within the npm-app package. The fix relies on a simple state flag reset on `onToolStart` and consumed on `onParamChunk`.

e3295f45892d7484ea2ff0ad073deb8468153901.title: Reset consecutiveAssistantMessages counter after duration log
e3295f45892d7484ea2ff0ad073deb8468153901.summary: Added `agentState.consecutiveAssistantMessages = 0` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` immediately after duration calculation. This clears the counter tracking repeated assistant messages to prevent premature force-stop loops. Scope limited to backend state management. Counter reset occurs before terminal command logging.

b0f62ac0188835ffadd0560cd6184496fb6b40ef.title: Remove outdated knowledge.md sections
b0f62ac0188835ffadd0560cd6184496fb6b40ef.summary: Deleted obsolete documentation from knowledge.md, including legacy file change strategies, project templates, referral system details, and duplicated backward compatibility guidelines. Replaced specific Claude/Mani references with generic LLM integration notes. Updated main components list to reflect current architecture. Scope limited to internal repo documentation.

9c136ff8f533e1e6c864ac9c92f2518d4a096941.title: Fix triple newlines
9c136ff8f533e1e6c864ac9c92f2518d4a096941.summary: The `display.ts` module replaced its previous regex-based newline squashing with a terminal-kit `ScreenBuffer` approach. The new implementation strips ANSI escape codes to accurately identify blank lines, capping consecutive empty lines at two. This change ensures consistent output formatting regardless of color codes. Dependencies in `package.json` were updated to include `@types/terminal-kit`.

0cd0f9fe6d1cc8c33de368e6e457f03b0d27a735.title: Implement prompt history in CLI
0cd0f9fe6d1cc8c33de368e6e457f03b0d27a735.summary: Added prompt history functionality to the CLI. New methods _loadHistory and _appendToHistory manage a JSON file at CONFIG_DIR/prompt_history.json, deduplicating and reversing entries for readline integration. Scope limited to npm-app/src/cli.ts. History persists across sessions, filtering empty/duplicate lines.

9c136ff8f533e1e6c864ac9c92f2518d4a096941.text: The display now removes extra blank lines for cleaner text. This fixes spacing issues caused by hidden formatting codes. It is a small internal improvement.

8d1a2a56e6e78f7cdc5bbe3fe97c07056c15c2ad.text: Fixed a bug causing text display glitches. You now see clean, correct messages.

b0f62ac0188835ffadd0560cd6184496fb6b40ef.text: The team cleaned up old internal notes to match how the system works today. This change only affects the team's reference materials and does not change how the product works for you.

4000dfed01964035908b4341aa76e46879891d48.text: Fixed a display bug where blank lines between text chunks were not properly limited. This ensures the app consistently shows no more than two empty lines in a row, even when text arrives in small pieces.

f324f147c3d61a106de183afb3d912cb8e8826c6.text: The assistant now remembers the folder you are working in, so you do not need to repeat the path with every command.

4b66e341afcb345b917abe363245a38b957f9f7e.text: A small internal change fixes the system that builds our software. This helps keep the product running smoothly.

e3295f45892d7484ea2ff0ad073deb8468153901.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant stops counting repeated messages after logging how long a task took. This prevents the system from incorrectly stopping conversations too early.

0cd0f9fe6d1cc8c33de368e6e457f03b0d27a735.text: The command line tool now remembers past prompts. You can press the up arrow to reuse a previous command. This helps you avoid typing the same thing again.

de5954b7c69cde46098b4cfcbab1c156dff38fd6.text: Fixed a small display glitch where extra blank lines sometimes appeared after tool headers. This makes the output look cleaner and more consistent.

dab97535beb980aae0543ec87f2188ebe2172859.text: The assistant now avoids using special symbol brackets when describing its actions. This small internal fix prevents technical glitches that could confuse the system, making responses more reliable.

4c2b80e180defef9d56598e69ed306d1176b0458.title: Add start-max npm script
4c2b80e180defef9d56598e69ed306d1176b0458.summary: Adds `start-max` script to `npm-app/package.json` and root `package.json`. Passes `--max` flag to `ts-node` execution. Enables local dev runs with max settings.

ec880a1dd15d0aa6615586739a91de5af05e6207.title: Fix system message serialization in checkNewFilesNecessary
ec880a1dd15d0aa6615586739a91de5af05e6207.summary: checkNewFilesNecessary now correctly serializes system messages that are passed as arrays of objects instead of strings. Previously, array inputs were coerced into '[object Object]' within the prompt construction. The fix maps array elements to their text properties and joins them with newlines before interpolation. Affects backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts.

fc8f626a0c035c73a506dfbc7de9d5c6182d8275.title: fix scripts importing bigquery
fc8f626a0c035c73a506dfbc7de9d5c6182d8275.summary: Added `setupBigQuery` call in `scripts/ft-file-selection/print-recent-traces.ts` and declared `@codebuff/bigquery` dependency in `scripts/package.json`. Fixes runtime errors when scripts execute without BigQuery client initialization. Scope limited to internal tooling scripts.

d6e5880d45e9f27190d0ae0cdf9bb2bee34567b8.title: Fix extra newline in write file tool
d6e5880d45e9f27190d0ae0cdf9bb2bee34567b8.summary:
Updated `getToolCallString` to join parameters with newlines and wrap the resulting string in newlines. Modified `Saxy` parser to ignore stray `
` text nodes when inside a single root tag. Adjusted `Client` prompt output to prepend the newline to the styled label. Affects `common/src/constants/tools.ts`, `common/src/util/saxy.ts`, and `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

24721efbb728525787f1ed097df4adcf4d24bc4f.title: endturn description requires turn end before questions
24721efbb728525787f1ed097df4adcf4d24bc4f.summary: The `end_turn` tool description in `backend/src/tools.ts` now explicitly instructs the agent to end its turn before asking the user any questions. This change clarifies that failing to call `end_turn` prevents the user from responding. The mechanism ensures the conversation loop remains active for user input.

90d0399f625b6889db9b98bafcc916c02fdba650.title: DEBUG flag gates truncateFileTreeBasedOnTokenBudget logs
90d0399f625b6889db9b98bafcc916c02fdba650.summary: Added const DEBUG = false in backend/src/system-prompt/truncate-file-tree.ts to conditionally execute logger.debug calls within truncateFileTreeBasedOnTokenBudget. This silences verbose token budget and duration metrics for unimportant-files, tokens, and depth-based truncation levels by default. The change is isolated to the file tree truncation subsystem. Existing logger.warn calls remain unaffected.

d222ee962475d19480a2ad8891e38e55f732da54.title: Strikethrough on gitignored files in tool renderers
d222ee962475d19480a2ad8891e38e55f732da54.summary: tool-renderers.ts applies strikethrough and '(blocked)' to gitignored files in tool call displays. isFileIgnored from common/project-file-tree checks paths against project root. Affects file listing and path parameter rendering. No user action required.

687e4dbb50a8b1bf82f5dbe8fb29d44140c0b176.title: Web landing updates: install dialog, hero button, editor logos, README
687e4dbb50a8b1bf82f5dbe8fb29d44140c0b176.summary: Landing hero button text changed from "Try Free" to "Get Started" with visual refinements. Install dialog rewritten as step-by-step guide with editor launch buttons (VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ, PyCharm) and copy-to-clipboard commands. Competitor logos moved from web/public/competitors/ to web/public/logos/ with new IDE icons added. README simplified to single `bun install && bun run build` command.

06514e514e06b6ce5520ad56fe10b2a3db260f85.title: Refine prompt guidance and readfiles tool description
06514e514e06b6ce5520ad56fe10b2a3db260f85.summary: Updated system prompts in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to remove XML-style tags from tool invocation instructions and streamline plan handling logic. The `read_files` tool description in `backend/src/tools.ts` no longer mandates reading files before writing. These changes aim to reduce redundant file reads and clarify experimental thinking modes.

7ebc9b32008b647f95b706a8da52f2c6e4d57966.title: Allow zero-credit message costs and restructure prompt flow
7ebc9b32008b647f95b706a8da52f2c6e4d57966.summary: Changed minimum cost and credits calculation from 1 to 0 in `message-cost-tracker.ts`. Refactored `main-prompt.ts` to move documentation fetching and consecutive message checks out of the initial conditional block. This prevents premature returns and ensures consistent state handling across agent loops.

fc8f626a0c035c73a506dfbc7de9d5c6182d8275.text: A small fix for internal tools ensures they can now connect to data storage correctly. This change does not affect how the product looks or works for regular users.

06514e514e06b6ce5520ad56fe10b2a3db260f85.text: The assistant now avoids unnecessary checks before saving changes. This makes it faster and less repetitive when working on your tasks.

4c2b80e180defef9d56598e69ed306d1176b0458.text: A small internal change added a new way to start the software locally with maximum settings. This helps developers test the app in its fullest state, but it does not change how the product works for regular users.

24721efbb728525787f1ed097df4adcf4d24bc4f.text: The assistant now waits for you to finish reading before asking a question. This stops it from blocking your reply. Small internal fix.

90d0399f625b6889db9b98bafcc916c02fdba650.text: A small internal update hides extra technical details from the system logs unless debugging is turned on. This makes the logs easier to read for support staff, but you will not notice any change in how the product works.

687e4dbb50a8b1bf82f5dbe8fb29d44140c0b176.text: The main button now says 'Get Started' and guides you through setup with clear steps and one-click copy commands. You can choose your preferred editor directly from the dialog, making it easier to begin using the product.

ec880a1dd15d0aa6615586739a91de5af05e6207.text: A small internal fix helps the assistant correctly read instructions sent as lists of separate notes instead of one long block. This prevents confusing errors when the assistant processes certain files.

7ebc9b32008b647f95b706a8da52f2c6e4d57966.text: Messages can now cost zero credits. The assistant checks information more consistently to avoid errors.

d222ee962475d19480a2ad8891e38e55f732da54.text: The assistant now marks files it cannot edit with a line through the name and a 'blocked' label. This helps you quickly see which files are off-limits. No action is needed from you.

d6e5880d45e9f27190d0ae0cdf9bb2bee34567b8.text: Fixed a bug where saving files sometimes added an extra blank line. This keeps the text cleaner and easier to read.

15c17cc63623f76987ecc136b573e959afde121c.title: npm-app/src/client.ts: start spinner on prompt continuation
15c17cc63623f76987ecc136b573e959afde121c.summary: Added `Spinner.get().start()` call in `npm-app/src/client.ts` before sending prompt action via WebSocket. Ensures visual feedback during tool result processing and response wait.

ac1f748be3c8bca327512edca6b8791fb8638c72.title: Server exits immediately on local
ac1f748be3c8bca327512edca6b8791fb8638c72.summary: handleShutdown in backend/src/index.ts now calls process.exit(0) when NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT is 'local'. This skips graceful client exit waits, flushing analytics first. Change is internal to the backend server lifecycle.

49aa0811060929487e0178db5d616ee75633f3bb.title: Add usage hint to CLI menu
49aa0811060929487e0178db5d616ee75633f3bb.summary: Adds a console.log instruction to the npm-app menu indicating users can type 'usage' to check remaining credits. This surfaces the usage command in the startup hints within npm-app/src/menu.ts. The change is internal to the CLI presentation layer.

ffba3745c455d1c6e092dc93145924b795b379c8.title: Reduce MAXLENGTH in logger.ts
ffba3745c455d1c6e092dc93145924b795b379c8.summary: Lowered `MAX_LENGTH` constant in `backend/src/util/logger.ts` from 100,000 to 70,000 to add buffer for log size limits. Internal adjustment affecting backend logging.

a5ebaaba019755369adf2ce7acd08962010cade2.title: Fix XML entity parsing and stream handling in saxy
a5ebaaba019755369adf2ce7acd08962010cade2.summary: Corrects entity parsing logic in `common/src/util/saxy.ts` to properly handle named and numeric entities without leading ampersands in internal checks, and fixes index offsets for hexadecimal/decimal parsing. Implements `_pendingEntity` state to buffer incomplete entities across stream chunks, ensuring they are resolved in subsequent `_parseChunk` calls or emitted on stream end. Removes previous whitespace trimming logic for top-level tags in favor of immediate entity parsing on text nodes. Updates `npm-app` snapshot tests to reflect corrected output.

f80dfe5fdc45c2c5b443dff468de82ce09fac001.title: Fix tool render spacing
f80dfe5fdc45c2c5b443dff468de82ce09fac001.summary: getToolCallString in common/src/constants/tools.ts now concatenates parameters without newlines. Replaced join('\n') with join('') and removed surrounding newlines in the return string. Affects tool call rendering across surfaces using shared constants. Tested in npm-app/src/utils/__tests__/tool-renderers.test.ts.

4961c59eb6ae1438ee4310cae487d456f453145f.title: Wrap PostHog flush in try/catch
4961c59eb6ae1438ee4310cae487d456f453145f.summary: Wrap `client.flush()` in `try/catch` within `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` to prevent unhandled PostHog network errors. Errors are silently ignored in production, logged only when `DEBUG_DEV_EVENTS` is true.

60b3ddd094e4903304071d77d15a860b267ec06a.title: Fix startup cwd to preserve project root
60b3ddd094e4903304071d77d15a860b267ec06a.summary: Startup sequence now separates working directory from project root. `getStartingDirectory` returns object with `cwd` and `shouldSearch` flag to control git root lookup. `setProjectRoot` accepts optional `setCwd` parameter (default false) to prevent unintended directory changes. Affects `npm-app/src/index.ts`, `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`.

91d4333a25cace02ad7b83b188ff28b4c05f9d77.title: Remove local act scripts, fix CI caching
91d4333a25cace02ad7b83b188ff28b4c05f9d77.summary: Deleted .github/act scripts (bootstrap-act-config.sh, run-local.sh) and removed `act` npm script. CI workflow updated: renamed 'Restore dependencies' to 'Cache dependencies', added `packages/*/node_modules` to cache paths, added `restore-keys`, and moved env var setup before build. `.github/.gitignore` cleaned of act-specific entries.

21cf6b6df5af6f30dafd44249d6a9db7de4163e0.title: Add timeoutseconds to runterminalcommand
21cf6b6df5af6f30dafd44249d6a9db7de4163e0.summary: The run_terminal_command tool now accepts a timeout_seconds parameter, defaulting to 30. This replaces the hardcoded MAX_EXECUTION_TIME constant in the PTY and child process implementations, allowing callers to specify custom timeout durations. The change spans backend tool schemas, common constants, and npm-app handlers/utils.

f80dfe5fdc45c2c5b443dff468de82ce09fac001.text: The assistant now displays tool usage results with tighter spacing, removing extra blank lines. This small visual cleanup makes the conversation look neater.

a5ebaaba019755369adf2ce7acd08962010cade2.text: Fixed text formatting errors when reading documents. This ensures special characters appear correctly without extra symbols.

ffba3745c455d1c6e092dc93145924b795b379c8.text: The system now keeps shorter notes about its own activity. This helps prevent errors when saving those notes.

60b3ddd094e4903304071d77d15a860b267ec06a.text: The app now remembers where your project starts, even if you open it from a different folder. This prevents it from searching the wrong place for files.

49aa0811060929487e0178db5d616ee75633f3bb.text: The menu now shows a hint to type 'usage' to check remaining credits. This is a small internal update to the menu text.

15c17cc63623f76987ecc136b573e959afde121c.text: A small internal change added a loading spinner when the assistant continues working on a task. This gives you visual feedback that the app is busy processing your request.

ac1f748be3c8bca327512edca6b8791fb8638c72.text: The server now shuts down faster when running locally. This internal change skips waiting for certain background tasks to finish.

21cf6b6df5af6f30dafd44249d6a9db7de4163e0.text: The assistant can now set a custom time limit for running commands, replacing a fixed 30-second wait. This means it can handle tasks that need more or less time without always stopping at the same moment.

91d4333a25cace02ad7b83b188ff28b4c05f9d77.text: The team removed tools used for local testing and improved how the system stores files during updates. These internal changes help the software build more reliably without affecting how you use the product.

4961c59eb6ae1438ee4310cae487d456f453145f.text: A small internal update helps the app ignore rare connection issues when sending usage data. This means the app won't crash or show errors if that data fails to send.

54f4d6eee4331aafc0f7a5b5f02c850d16a40be7.title: Consolidate CI test jobs into matrix strategy
54f4d6eee4331aafc0f7a5b5f02c850d16a40be7.summary: Replaced duplicated test-npm-app, test-backend, and test-common jobs with a single test job using a GitHub Actions matrix strategy. Matrix configuration defines package names and corresponding test paths for npm-app, backend, and common. Job name dynamically resolves to test-${{ matrix.package }}.

c0621152f01d986b25f56824f86778c9d2b79c0a.title: Set shell bash in setup-job env step
c0621152f01d986b25f56824f86778c9d2b79c0a.summary: Added `shell: bash` to the Set Environment Variables step in `.github/actions/setup-job/action.yml`. Ensures consistent shell execution for writing `.env.local` and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS` flag. CI-only change.

1e5e715fbfb1d537c35ac58d4cdab501b5fd5220.title: Inline CI setup steps, remove setup-job composite action
1e5e715fbfb1d537c35ac58d4cdab501b5fd5220.summary: CI jobs (test, test-npm-app, test-backend, test-common) now define Bun setup, dependency caching, and env var creation inline, replacing the shared `.github/actions/setup-job` composite action. The composite action file is deleted. This likely fixes the `github action test 16` failure noted in the commit, possibly by ensuring env vars are set correctly per-job or resolving composite action path issues. Scope: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/actions/setup-job/action.yml`.

a736dbec1672746654befe1978c11a7326cafe97.title: Move env setup to setup-job action
a736dbec1672746654befe1978c11a7326cafe97.summary: Refactored GitHub Actions CI to centralize environment variable configuration within the reusable `.github/actions/setup-job/action.yml` composite action. Previously, `.env.local` creation and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS` flag setting were duplicated or scattered in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. This change ensures consistent environment setup across all jobs utilizing the action, reducing workflow file clutter.

fbfe090ca925a0dacab799349a472db560fe59b3.title: CI workflow injects env vars before backend tests
fbfe090ca925a0dacab799349a472db560fe59b3.summary: Added a 'Set Environment Variables' step to the CI workflow. It writes `secrets.ENV_LOCAL` to `.env.local` and appends `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`. This ensures backend tests have required environment configuration.

0a74a72d65db99021f323434d27f2d98fd9dcdbe.title: terminal env load expanded
0a74a72d65db99021f323434d27f2d98fd9dcdbe.summary: createPersistantProcess in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts now sources full shell init chains. zsh loads zshenv, zprofile, zshrc, zlogin; bash loads bash_profile, profile, bashrc; PowerShell iterates all $PROFILE scopes. Explicit PATH, HOME, USER, SHELL injection preserves terminal env in spawned pty. Scope limited to internal terminal utility.

f5c4a776def8898e1d09bdab34224f3cad7f64af.title: Remove retry wrapper from CI backend tests
f5c4a776def8898e1d09bdab34224f3cad7f64af.summary: Replaced `nick-fields/retry` action with direct `bun test` execution in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Eliminates retry logic and timeout constraints for backend test job. Old retry configuration commented out.

32a90df39432c0ac15c70c37cf22a74ebd085a07.title: CI backend tests use retry action
32a90df39432c0ac15c70c37cf22a74ebd085a07.summary: CI workflow re-enables `nick-fields/retry@v3` for backend tests. Replaces direct `bun test` execution with the retry action to handle transient failures. Applies to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

3af25d94ece663073806355bac686c5a39a09884.title: Fix evals scaffolding imports and tool call
3af25d94ece663073806355bac686c5a39a09884.summary: Sorted imports alphabetically in evals/scaffolding.ts. Added missing undefined argument to runMainPrompt callback. Updated handleToolCall invocation to match signature.

cffb9ee7952e9cc0c63a9e90d04f215a63b1223f.title: Fix CI test command path resolution
cffb9ee7952e9cc0c63a9e90d04f215a63b1223f.summary: Updated `ci.yml` to `cd backend && bun test ./src/**/*.test.ts`. Previous glob `./backend/src/**/*.test.ts` failed to resolve paths correctly in the CI environment. Affects `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

f5c4a776def8898e1d09bdab34224f3cad7f64af.text: The system stopped automatically trying again when a check failed. This internal change does not affect how the product works for you.

1e5e715fbfb1d537c35ac58d4cdab501b5fd5220.text: A small internal change fixed how the team tests new features. Users should see no difference, but the app may be more stable.

c0621152f01d986b25f56824f86778c9d2b79c0a.text: A small internal update fixed a hidden setup step. This change does not affect how you use the product.

32a90df39432c0ac15c70c37cf22a74ebd085a07.text: The system now automatically retries a check if it fails by accident. This keeps the product stable and reliable for you.

0a74a72d65db99021f323434d27f2d98fd9dcdbe.text: The built-in terminal now loads your personal system settings, so custom tools and paths work correctly when you open a new session.

fbfe090ca925a0dacab799349a472db560fe59b3.text: A small internal update helps the system check its own settings more reliably. This change should not affect how you use the product.

cffb9ee7952e9cc0c63a9e90d04f215a63b1223f.text: A small internal fix corrected how automated tests find files. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

a736dbec1672746654befe1978c11a7326cafe97.text: The team cleaned up the automated systems that test the software behind the scenes. This internal tidy-up does not change how the product looks or works for users.

54f4d6eee4331aafc0f7a5b5f02c850d16a40be7.text: The system now runs tests for different parts of the software using a simpler, shared setup. This internal cleanup helps keep the checks running smoothly without changing how the product works for you.

3af25d94ece663073806355bac686c5a39a09884.text: Fixed internal errors that prevented the system from using certain features correctly. This change is small and improves stability for users.

42df18ba747a8bf69aba435b48491419fb09caf0.title: Add NEXTPUBLICCBENVIRONMENT to ci.yml
42df18ba747a8bf69aba435b48491419fb09caf0.summary: Added `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT: 'local'` to the global `env` block in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. This ensures the Next.js build step and subsequent jobs run with the local environment flag explicitly set. Scope limited to CI configuration.

b5a6ece7615b0d1b6aaeddb4be7b840001c90ada.title: Max mode enforces endturn verification
b5a6ece7615b0d1b6aaeddb4be7b840001c90ada.summary: `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` adds conditional instructions for `costMode === 'max'` and `costMode === 'experimental'`. The prompt now mandates verification of file changes, tests, and lint/type errors before invoking `end_turn`. This change targets internal agent behavior to prevent premature turn endings. The verification step requires using available tools like `browser_logs` to confirm project stability.

bf47284e69a75ff225e82928b4f696aa72733def.title: Inline logger stub in main-prompt test
bf47284e69a75ff225e82928b4f696aa72733def.summary: main-prompt.test.ts replaces logger import with inline debug/error/info/warn stubs. Removes commented spyOn mock setup in beforeEach. Fixes GitHub Action test failures in backend suite.

21b1f3f3c8f37be29c6c1ec926724e8d991e9bed.title: Type fix in main-prompt.test.ts
21b1f3f3c8f37be29c6c1ec926724e8d991e9bed.summary: Added `tool: 'write_file' as const` to mock return in `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts`. Resolves type error in test setup. Internal change only.

c1ddb9e96e2cf110a689417c2c000033b5c651ab.title: Mock logger in backend tests
c1ddb9e96e2cf110a689417c2c000033b5c651ab.summary: Added `mock.module` calls for `../util/logger` in `main-prompt.test.ts`, `process-file-block.test.ts`, and `usage-calculation.test.ts`. This replaces manual logger stubs and ensures the logger is mocked before module imports, preventing side effects during test execution. Specifically addresses issues in `usage-calculation.test.ts` by re-mocking the logger after `mock.restore()` in `beforeEach`.

2f406034d08e329db06b09ad5c5d4de19000b3ed.title: Fix CI secrets env file creation
2f406034d08e329db06b09ad5c5d4de19000b3ed.summary: Move `.env.local` creation from standalone step to `Build and typecheck` step in `ci.yml`. Fixes test failures caused by missing environment variables during build. Secrets `ENV_LOCAL` and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS` now injected directly before `bun run build`.

a740c492bd42ed0f0c5c904d6fb31e2abd489c2e.title: Comment out logger mocks in main-prompt test
a740c492bd42ed0f0c5c904d6fb31e2abd489c2e.summary: Comments out spyOn calls for logger.debug, error, info, and warn in backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts beforeEach block. This likely resolves GitHub Actions test failures by preventing mock interference or cleanup issues. Scope limited to backend test suite. Analytics and BigQuery mocks remain active.

7af6b743dc0413f95603a1623f6d7d5d094494e4.title: strreplace tool supports file creation
7af6b743dc0413f95603a1623f6d7d5d094494e4.summary: str_replace now creates new files when oldStr is empty. process-str-replace.ts handles null initialContent by generating a full-content patch. tools.ts documents the empty-string behavior for agents.

d3bb6937fb786aa62d6009359c8dc9c9728babbc.title: Move .env.local setup from setup-job action to CI workflow
d3bb6937fb786aa62d6009359c8dc9c9728babbc.summary: The .env.local creation step was moved from the reusable .github/actions/setup-job/action.yml to .github/workflows/ci.yml. This ensures secrets are injected directly into the main workflow environment before the setup action runs. The change affects only CI infrastructure; no user-facing functionality or code logic is altered.

497d434f8bf4f962710d0b0404f4460fe6404d93.title: Add strreplace tool for precise file edits
497d434f8bf4f962710d0b0404f4460fe6404d93.summary: New str_replace tool enables targeted string replacement in files, serving as a backup to write_file for failed edits or large files. Backend processes str_replace tags via processStrReplace, handling indentation matching and generating patches. Client tool handlers and renderers updated to display 'Editing file at' status for str_replace calls. Covers backend prompt logic, tool schemas, and npm-app UI rendering.

497d434f8bf4f962710d0b0404f4460fe6404d93.text: The assistant can now make small, precise changes to files instead of rewriting them entirely. This helps it fix mistakes or update large documents more reliably.

21b1f3f3c8f37be29c6c1ec926724e8d991e9bed.text: A small internal fix corrected a type error in the test setup. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

7af6b743dc0413f95603a1623f6d7d5d094494e4.text: The text replacement tool now creates new files if the original file is empty. This is a small internal change that helps the assistant handle file creation better.

42df18ba747a8bf69aba435b48491419fb09caf0.text: A small internal update ensures the system uses the correct testing settings during checks. You will not notice any changes to the app.

d3bb6937fb786aa62d6009359c8dc9c9728babbc.text: The team adjusted how the system handles private information during internal software testing. This change does not affect how the product works or what users can do.

2f406034d08e329db06b09ad5c5d4de19000b3ed.text: A small internal fix ensures the system correctly loads secret settings during automated checks. This stops some background failures that could affect stability.

a740c492bd42ed0f0c5c904d6fb31e2abd489c2e.text: The test setup was adjusted to remove unnecessary logging checks. This internal change helps the system run tests correctly and does not affect how the product works for you.

b5a6ece7615b0d1b6aaeddb4be7b840001c90ada.text: The assistant now checks its work before finishing a task. This helps prevent it from stopping too early or leaving mistakes behind.

bf47284e69a75ff225e82928b4f696aa72733def.text: A small internal update fixed a background test failure. This change has no visible effect on the product's features or performance.

c1ddb9e96e2cf110a689417c2c000033b5c651ab.text: This is a small internal change to the testing setup. It helps ensure the system's logging behavior is checked correctly without affecting how you use the product.

df0ae778a478ea90641aa1c5f052b497d33f98d2.title: Fix CI credential retrieval and deduplicate setup
df0ae778a478ea90641aa1c5f052b497d33f98d2.summary: Updated .github/actions/setup-job/action.yml to read credentials from secrets.ENV_LOCAL instead of env.ENV_LOCAL, ensuring proper secret injection. Removed redundant credential setup steps from .github/workflows/ci.yml, as the setup-job action now handles this. This change affects the CI pipeline's internal configuration.

fbc8a096753bad54325f1cc4bc9006f076258f31.title: setup-job action writes .env.local
fbc8a096753bad54325f1cc4bc9006f076258f31.summary: The `setup-job` GitHub Action now writes `.env.local` with `ENV_LOCAL` and `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`. This ensures credentials and flags are available for CI tests. Scope: `.github/actions/setup-job/action.yml`. Detail: Appends flag to file after writing env vars.

9480b4e871f6de484ae769fdf0de4b96e09416fd.title: Remove redundant shell bash from setup-job
9480b4e871f6de484ae769fdf0de4b96e09416fd.summary: Removed `shell: bash` declaration from the 'Get Credentials' step in `.github/actions/setup-job/action.yml`. The `run` command relies on default shell behavior for writing environment variables to `.env.local`. This cleanup reduces CI configuration verbosity without altering execution logic. Scope limited to internal CI infrastructure.

8e53414e75adaf46bb04070793ae4974de2fb498.title: Silence npm-app build output in start script
8e53414e75adaf46bb04070793ae4974de2fb498.summary: The npm-app start script pipes nx build output to /dev/null. This reduces local dev verbosity. Affects npm-app/package.json scripts only.

ad02e74d4a437864ede0e2836d18c669cfd73084.title: Add explicit checkout to CI jobs
ad02e74d4a437864ede0e2836d18c669cfd73084.summary: Added `actions/checkout@v3` to build, npm-app tests, backend tests, and common tests jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Ensures repository is available before local action `./.github/actions/setup-job` runs. Aligns CI setup with local execution requirements.

d249ca98604f51f4d5cfe95895e53e75d0bb62f2.title: CI workflow injects ENVLOCAL and CODEBUFF flag
d249ca98604f51f4d5cfe95895e53e75d0bb62f2.summary: The `ci.yml` workflow now creates a `.env.local` file before installing dependencies. It writes the `ENV_LOCAL` secret and appends `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`. This ensures the test environment has the required credentials and flag during CI runs.

7b8675edfd9e045a743b0344f3f62693951ad05d.title: Fix SWE-Bench evals and analytics init
7b8675edfd9e045a743b0344f3f62693951ad05d.summary: Refactored `passesSweBenchTests` to use `spawn` for streaming output and resolving async results instead of `execSync` with grep. Moved analytics client initialization check to occur after non-production logging to prevent unnecessary throws. Added `setProjectRoot` and `setWorkingDirectory` to `setupTestEnvironment` in `test-setup.ts`. Scope covers `common/src/analytics.ts`, `evals/swe-bench-eval.ts`, and `evals/test-setup.ts`.

b2d17e9d5315f24fc2136003a3213616d6fb86b4.title: CI setup refactored to use composite action
b2d17e9d5315f24fc2136003a3213616d6fb86b4.summary: GitHub Actions setup moved to composite action .github/actions/setup-job/action.yml. Removed inline checkout, Bun setup, and caching steps from ci.yml build job. Environment variable CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS now set globally in workflow env instead of appending to .env.local during setup.

e1ccedddf7f8bbbd959245bec86e42ee1ef25f5c.title: Reorganize docs, promote Troubleshooting to Advanced section
e1ccedddf7f8bbbd959245bec86e42ee1ef25f5c.summary: Troubleshooting guide moves from `help` to `advanced` section with `order: 1`, becoming the first advanced doc. `what-models.mdx` and `large-projects.mdx` shift to orders 3 and 4 respectively. FAQ and getting-started pages now link to `/docs/advanced/troubleshooting`. Model list in `what-models.mdx` adds Gemini 2.5 Pro for deep thinking, removes previous Claude Sonnet-only coding description.

5bf55e6e6fba17ba173b5625dfa23b83cdf48a3c.title: SWE-bench eval patch rundocker.py git safe.directory
5bf55e6e6fba17ba173b5625dfa23b83cdf48a3c.summary: Added patchRunDockerScript in evals/test-setup.ts to inject git config --global --add safe.directory '*' into run_docker.py docker_command. Fixes SWE-bench eval failures from git ownership checks in Docker. Scope: Evals, swe-bench-eval.ts, test-setup.ts.

df0ae778a478ea90641aa1c5f052b497d33f98d2.text: A small internal update fixed how the automated testing system gets its security keys. This change does not affect how you use the product, but it helps ensure future updates are tested reliably.

ad02e74d4a437864ede0e2836d18c669cfd73084.text: The team added a step to their automated testing process to ensure it can access the project files before starting. This internal change fixes a small glitch that could have caused tests to fail.

d249ca98604f51f4d5cfe95895e53e75d0bb62f2.text: The internal testing system now automatically loads necessary settings before running checks. This small background update ensures the system tests the product correctly.

b2d17e9d5315f24fc2136003a3213616d6fb86b4.text: We cleaned up internal setup steps for our automation tools. This change has no effect on the product you use.

fbc8a096753bad54325f1cc4bc9006f076258f31.text: This internal update ensures the system automatically prepares necessary settings and access keys before running automated checks. It helps tests run smoothly without manual setup.

8e53414e75adaf46bb04070793ae4974de2fb498.text: The application now hides detailed technical status messages during startup. This change reduces clutter for the internal team.

5bf55e6e6fba17ba173b5625dfa23b83cdf48a3c.text: A small internal fix helps automated checks run correctly. This improves how the system tests its own features, but you will not see any change in the product.

e1ccedddf7f8bbbd959245bec86e42ee1ef25f5c.text: The help guide moved to a more advanced section, making it easier to find detailed problem-solving steps. The list of available AI models was updated to include a new option for deep thinking.

9480b4e871f6de484ae769fdf0de4b96e09416fd.text: The internal setup process was simplified by removing a duplicate instruction. This cleanup does not change how the product works for users.

7b8675edfd9e045a743b0344f3f62693951ad05d.text: The system now handles background tasks more reliably and avoids unnecessary errors during setup. This change is internal and improves stability without altering visible features.

c073c689582f8fe527a1ce5850b380b1668ef96b.title: Add nx reset to build script
c073c689582f8fe527a1ce5850b380b1668ef96b.summary: The root `build` script in `package.json` now executes `nx reset` before `nx run-many`. This change ensures Nx's daemon and cache are cleared prior to building `common`, `packages/*`, `backend`, `npm-app`, and `web`, preventing stale cache artifacts from interfering with build integrity.

c77920a8ef1c614a1477afded0dfd56d546d8d56.title: Filter system instructions during context reset
c77920a8ef1c614a1477afded0dfd56d546d8d56.summary: Added `isSystemInstruction` checks in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/util/messages.ts` to exclude system instructions from message history and token trimming logic. This ensures system directives are stripped when resetting context or managing token limits, preventing them from interfering with user message processing. The change applies to the backend core, specifically affecting how `messageHistory` is filtered and how `trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit` handles string content.

cd0044041909ca7fd4d4f1d638075c808f6fd596.title: Add Endless Auto-Updates troubleshooting
cd0044041909ca7fd4d4f1d638075c808f6fd596.summary: Added 'Endless Auto-Updates' section to troubleshooting docs. Addresses update loops caused by conflicting Node/npm installations between Homebrew and nvm. Includes diagnostic commands for checking paths and uninstalling Homebrew Node.

4952f808ccd1f6d5e854a8ad61b360d87789bfe3.title: Fix relative path resolution in getStartingDirectory
4952f808ccd1f6d5e854a8ad61b360d87789bfe3.summary: Updated `getStartingDirectory` to accept an optional path and resolve relative paths against the current working directory using a new `toAbsolutePath` helper. This ensures project directories specified via CLI arguments are correctly normalized to absolute paths before being set as the project root. Changes affect `npm-app/src/index.ts` and `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`.

b2e20ade92dc4f9ee8c1427544e14cc7621b06e4.title: Skip file reads for Codebuff meta queries
b2e20ade92dc4f9ee8c1427544e14cc7621b06e4.summary: checkNewFilesNecessary logic updated to return NO for queries about the Codebuff application itself (model, credits, checkpoints). System prompt augmented with Codebuff context via new systemIntro constant. Scope limited to backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts. Prevents unnecessary file scanning when users ask agent meta-questions.

2d5479433a2d69e406b95892c7fff42cf1189e0f.title: CLI auto-detects git root and passes cwd to agent
2d5479433a2d69e406b95892c7fff42cf1189e0f.summary: The CLI now automatically resolves the project root by scanning parent directories for `.git` if no path is explicitly provided, ensuring consistent context regardless of the current working directory. The resolved `cwd` is added to the `ClientAction` schema and injected into the system prompt via `asSystemMessage`, allowing the agent to accurately track its location. This change affects `npm-app/src/index.ts`, `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, and `common/src/actions.ts`, with `findGitRoot` implemented in `npm-app/src/utils/git.ts`.

5a61a5397e376f1a3e8a62cd0f9ab1012066eaf3.title: Add calculate-monthly-usage script
5a61a5397e376f1a3e8a62cd0f9ab1012066eaf3.summary: Added scripts/calculate-monthly-usage.ts to compute monthly credit usage. Queries schema.message for total credits, user count, and message count within a YYYY-MM range. Also retrieves top 10 users by credit consumption. Defaults to 2025-04 if no argument provided.

fe425a050b39b2148db349d6c9a44f8586156323.title: cd logic checks pwd after command
fe425a050b39b2148db349d6c9a44f8586156323.summary: Terminal command execution logic in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` was refactored to detect directory changes by checking the working directory (`pwd`) after the command completes, rather than intercepting `cd` commands beforehand. The `handleChangeDirectory` helper was removed, and the PTY command wrapper now injects `$(pwd)` into the completion signal to capture the final path. This ensures accurate state tracking for nested or aliased directory changes and simplifies the command parsing flow.

6122b0d3f0fcd0f62eaf454101c219d425c15784.title: CI setup-job action drops ENVLOCAL secret write
6122b0d3f0fcd0f62eaf454101c219d425c15784.summary: CI setup-job action drops ENV_LOCAL secret write, only appends CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true to .env.local. Removes redundant Get Credentials steps from build, test-frontend, test-backend jobs; test-frontend/test-backend now call ./.github/actions/setup-job directly. .github/knowledge.md documents act env flow: .env.act/.secrets.act supply vars, run-local.sh backs up/restores .env.local, CI writes only the flag. Composite action using value normalized to single quotes.

1f43c1b870135fc0ecb44ac13dcb0dcdf9c5dbaf.title: Add local CI runner via act and refactor workflow
1f43c1b870135fc0ecb44ac13dcb0dcdf9c5dbaf.summary: Introduced local CI execution support using `act` via new scripts `.github/act/bootstrap-act-config.sh` and `.github/act/run-local.sh`, exposed through the `bun act` command in `package.json`. The `ci.yml` workflow was refactored to merge `setup` and `build` jobs, removing the separate typecheck dependency chain and updating test globs. A new `.github/knowledge.md` file documents the pipeline structure and local runner configuration.

4952f808ccd1f6d5e854a8ad61b360d87789bfe3.text: The software now correctly finds project folders when you enter their location by hand, ensuring it always looks in the right place.

c073c689582f8fe527a1ce5850b380b1668ef96b.text: The system now clears its temporary memory before starting a build. This small internal change helps prevent old data from causing errors.

fe425a050b39b2148db349d6c9a44f8586156323.text: The system now checks where you are after each command runs, instead of guessing before it starts. This makes the tool more accurate when you move between folders, especially in complex cases.

1f43c1b870135fc0ecb44ac13dcb0dcdf9c5dbaf.text: Internal tools now let staff test changes on their own computers before sending them to the main system. This helps catch problems faster, but you will not see any difference in the product.

b2e20ade92dc4f9ee8c1427544e14cc7621b06e4.text: The assistant now answers questions about its own features faster by skipping unnecessary file searches.

cd0044041909ca7fd4d4f1d638075c808f6fd596.text: A guide was added to help people fix a problem where automatic updates keep restarting. This usually happens when two different ways of running the software clash with each other.

5a61a5397e376f1a3e8a62cd0f9ab1012066eaf3.text: Internal tool now tracks monthly credit use. It shows totals and top users. This helps manage resources. Users see no change.

2d5479433a2d69e406b95892c7fff42cf1189e0f.text: The tool now automatically finds your project's main folder, even if you run it from a deeper subfolder. This ensures the assistant always has the correct context for your work.

c77920a8ef1c614a1477afded0dfd56d546d8d56.text: The assistant now removes its internal setup notes when starting a new conversation. This prevents hidden instructions from mixing with your messages, ensuring replies stay focused on what you ask.

6122b0d3f0fcd0f62eaf454101c219d425c15784.text: A small internal update cleaned up how the system prepares for testing. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

524ae7ef970e488defdd7e6bad732a5dc25c608e.title: CI workflow env handling and Bun version pinned
524ae7ef970e488defdd7e6bad732a5dc25c608e.summary: CI workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` now writes `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` directly to `.env.local` in each job. This replaces the previous mechanism of passing the flag via inline command env vars and sharing `.env.local` across jobs using `actions/upload-artifact` and `actions/download-artifact`. The `oven-sh/setup-bun` action is updated to explicitly pin `bun-version: 1.1.26` across all jobs.

9340aa8ca68b73cba1adfd8185376f246244084c.title: CI pipeline split into parallel jobs with dependency caching
9340aa8ca68b73cba1adfd8185376f246244084c.summary: The single `build-and-test` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` was decomposed into a `setup` job and four parallel downstream jobs (`build`, `typecheck`, `test-npm-app`, `test-backend`, `test-common`). The `setup` job now handles checkout, Bun installation, and credential generation, then caches `node_modules` using `actions/cache@v3` keyed by `bun.lockb`. Subsequent jobs restore this cache to avoid redundant installs. Working directory configurations were removed from test steps, relying on global paths instead.

73efb470e4f93593e2f9bd8f400ebe86c8fa9a3b.title: CI artifact actions v3 to v4
73efb470e4f93593e2f9bd8f400ebe86c8fa9a3b.summary: Bump actions/upload-artifact and actions/download-artifact from v3 to v4 in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Addresses upstream deprecation and ensures continued compatibility with GitHub Actions runners. Scope limited to CI pipeline configuration. No runtime code changes.

c73ba9c9cecfba6ff7d2a41fcc55cae75a6c1336.title: Clarify cwd behavior in agent instructions
c73ba9c9cecfba6ff7d2a41fcc55cae75a6c1336.summary: Updated working directory instructions in `backend/src/tools.ts` to explicitly state that relative filepaths for tool calls (e.g., `write_file`, `read_file`) remain anchored to the project root regardless of user `cd` actions. This prevents ambiguity about whether shell-like directory changes affect file I/O tools.

c8793b49aaf6a5465f7e786c731bfd2a94562143.title: Add env file artifact sharing to CI jobs
c8793b49aaf6a5465f7e786c731bfd2a94562143.summary: CI jobs now download .env.local via actions/download-artifact@v3 instead of relying on workspace persistence. The setup job uploads the file using actions/upload-artifact@v3. This ensures build, typecheck, and parallel test jobs (npm-app, backend, common) access credentials correctly across separate runners.

07a1aa95a598677aba7e137356cab540c9d132c4.title: Notify LLM of cwd after each command
07a1aa95a598677aba7e137356cab540c9d132c4.summary: Terminal result formatting now appends 'Final cwd: <path>' to command output in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts. handleChangeDirectory returns the resulting directory string instead of a boolean, allowing the caller to resolve with the accurate post-execution path. Backend system prompt in backend/src/tools.ts updated to reflect that cwd resets to user's working directory, not project root.

9abb38de789ded530507b492056b3e4c8458bd21.title: CI test glob patterns corrected
9abb38de789ded530507b492056b3e4c8458bd21.summary: CI test commands updated to use explicit `**/*.test.ts` globs instead of `./*.ts` with `working-directory` context. This ensures `bun test` correctly targets test files in `npm-app`, `backend`, and `common` within the GitHub Actions runner. Scope limited to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

d15034b6da24db2a43c0ad58dc9a054170a033f2.title: CI test steps switch from inline cd to working-directory
d15034b6da24db2a43c0ad58dc9a054170a033f2.summary: CI test steps in .github/workflows/ci.yml replace inline `cd` commands with the `working-directory` parameter for npm-app, backend, and common packages. This ensures the retry action executes tests from the correct context without shell chaining issues. Scope limited to CI workflow configuration. The `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ACTIONS` environment variable remains set per command.

bd33bb2817591471616d0c0bb0c238f406e15a4e.title: Add newlines to update messages
bd33bb2817591471616d0c0bb0c238f406e15a4e.summary: Prepends newline characters to console output in `update-codebuff.ts`. Improves readability by separating update success and restart instructions from preceding logs. Affects CLI update flow only.

e42ccfe65840d616173d0151a2b9917a7e5cb817.title: CI build and typecheck merged into single job
e42ccfe65840d616173d0151a2b9917a7e5cb817.summary: Merged typecheck into build job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Test jobs now depend on build. Added .github/actions/setup-job/action.yml to abstract common setup steps. Typecheck command changed to bun run typecheck-only.

9abb38de789ded530507b492056b3e4c8458bd21.text: The system that checks the software for errors was fixed to find all the relevant test files correctly. This is a small internal change and does not affect how the product works for you.

e42ccfe65840d616173d0151a2b9917a7e5cb817.text: A small internal update combined two separate checking steps into one during software creation. This streamlines the process for developers but causes no visible changes for users.

9340aa8ca68b73cba1adfd8185376f246244084c.text: The system now runs several checks at the same time and remembers previous work to avoid repeating it. This speeds up the process of testing new features before they reach you.

c8793b49aaf6a5465f7e786c731bfd2a94562143.text: The system now shares private settings more reliably between different parts of the automated setup. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

07a1aa95a598677aba7e137356cab540c9d132c4.text: The assistant now tells you exactly where it is working after running a command. This ensures it knows which folder to use next, so it can find your files more reliably.

524ae7ef970e488defdd7e6bad732a5dc25c608e.text: This is a small internal change to how the automated testing system works. It does not affect how you use the product.

bd33bb2817591471616d0c0bb0c238f406e15a4e.text: Update messages now start on a new line, making the text easier to read.

d15034b6da24db2a43c0ad58dc9a054170a033f2.text: We fixed a small, internal issue in how our automated checks run. This change does not affect how you use the product.

73efb470e4f93593e2f9bd8f400ebe86c8fa9a3b.text: The team updated a background tool that checks new versions of the software to keep it working smoothly with the service provider. This change is small and internal. It does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

c73ba9c9cecfba6ff7d2a41fcc55cae75a6c1336.text: The assistant now knows that moving between folders does not change where it saves or reads files. This keeps results predictable and prevents errors.

5f86cc0b645d0b2dc351bbcfb8ee562ecb4ea6f6.title: Restore web build script
5f86cc0b645d0b2dc351bbcfb8ee562ecb4ea6f6.summary: Added `build` script to `web/package.json`. Runs `contentlayer` then `next build`. Fixes missing build step.

324585540c95b54eef3a326d5779fbeda0f4e10c.title: CI pipeline: move credentials step before build
324585540c95b54eef3a326d5779fbeda0f4e10c.summary: The CI workflow now retrieves secrets and writes .env.local before the build step, ensuring environment variables are available during compilation. Dependency installation uses --frozen-lockfile to enforce deterministic builds. The credentials step was moved from post-build to pre-build in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

f297bd6a2682c32ecff3d3aa42a50dc059cb4b62.title: CI test globs anchored to cwd
f297bd6a2682c32ecff3d3aa42a50dc059cb4b62.summary: Test commands in ci.yml now use `bun test ./**.ts` instead of `bun test **.ts`. The unanchored glob could match files outside the target package directory, causing spurious failures or missed tests. Scope: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Detail: applies to npm-app, backend, and common jobs.

0af01373a44540d96bb63ceab1b83c9773e2cc87.title: Fix npm app tests
0af01373a44540d96bb63ceab1b83c9773e2cc87.summary: CI workflow updated to execute `bun test **.ts` for npm-app, backend, and common packages to ensure proper file discovery. `tool-renderers.ts` modified to return double newline (`\n\n`) instead of single newline after file list rendering. Changes confined to CI configuration and internal rendering logic.

4efb075c97ce569b18a09b1c41b89b9e159a5967.title: Add Nx cache troubleshooting docs
4efb075c97ce569b18a09b1c41b89b9e159a5967.summary: Added Troubleshooting section to README.md and Build System Notes to knowledge.md. Documents resolution for Nx SQLite cache corruption errors ('database disk image is malformed') caused by process termination or disk errors. Instructs users to run `bunx nx reset` or `npx nx reset` to clear cache and stop daemon, noting subsequent builds will be slower.

c24115a5744c31d4969c262edd5a5dc8f43cf8c8.title: Simplify CI build step to root command
c24115a5744c31d4969c262edd5a5dc8f43cf8c8.summary: CI pipeline now runs `bun run build` at root instead of sequential `bun run --cwd common build` and `bun run --cwd packages/billing build`. This change addresses CI/CD pipeline failures by delegating build orchestration to the root script. Affects `.github/workflows/ci.yml` only.

9c812f0cccc43a90ac980d4fb8b1be4f5aa8e1e1.title: Add clean script to package.json
9c812f0cccc43a90ac980d4fb8b1be4f5aa8e1e1.summary: Added `clean` script to `package.json`. Runs `bun run --filter` across `common`, `./packages/**`, `backend`, `codebuff`, and `web` to execute their respective `clean` tasks. Affects repo-level tooling only.

ff0f818a5f7b36c0245dd26b4fcb21de9a2b09ed.title: Fix Windows command echo handling
ff0f818a5f7b36c0245dd26b4fcb21de9a2b09ed.summary: Simplified echo line counting in `runCommandPty` for Windows (`win32`) to a fixed value of 1. Added logic to detect command completion by checking if `promptIdentifier` appears in the processed buffer, ensuring proper termination regardless of echo state.

646d88b3d86089feb284cd8d487ee97d421fbd28.title: Remove Command completed boilerplate from terminal output
646d88b3d86089feb284cd8d487ee97d421fbd28.summary: Terminal output formatting strips 'Command completed.' strings and adds trailing spaces/newlines in `client.ts`, `dev-process-manager.ts`, and `startup-process-handler.ts`. `utils/terminal.ts` updates PTY prompt handling (`PS2` set) and changes `exitCode` type from `number | undefined` to `number | null`. Scope: npm-app CLI terminal subsystem.

ff5f5f89dccaaaea3cd2e126a02983444710922a.title: Integrate Nx build orchestration for npm-app and web
ff5f5f89dccaaaea3cd2e126a02983444710922a.summary: Nx replaces manual `bun run --filter` scripts for `build`, `clean`, and `typecheck-only` tasks across the monorepo. New `project.json` files for `npm-app` and `web` define explicit build targets, dependency graphs (`implicitDependencies`), and output caching. `npm-app` scripts now invoke `nx build`/`nx clean` and use `tsconfig-paths/register` for runtime path resolution. `web` moves `contentlayer` generation and `next build` into Nx targets with `dependsOn` constraints.

5f86cc0b645d0b2dc351bbcfb8ee562ecb4ea6f6.text: A small internal fix restored a missing step in the website's creation process. This ensures the site builds correctly for you to use.

4efb075c97ce569b18a09b1c41b89b9e159a5967.text: Added internal guides for fixing a specific data storage error. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

646d88b3d86089feb284cd8d487ee97d421fbd28.text: The terminal display now removes unnecessary completion messages and fixes formatting glitches. This internal cleanup makes command outputs look cleaner and more consistent.

9c812f0cccc43a90ac980d4fb8b1be4f5aa8e1e1.text: A small internal update added a cleanup tool for the team. This change does not affect how you use the product.

f297bd6a2682c32ecff3d3aa42a50dc059cb4b62.text: An internal check now looks only at the correct files, preventing false alarms and ensuring all tests run.

ff5f5f89dccaaaea3cd2e126a02983444710922a.text: Internal updates improve how the team builds the software. Users will not notice any changes.

c24115a5744c31d4969c262edd5a5dc8f43cf8c8.text: The team made a small internal change to how the software is put together, which helps prevent occasional errors when saving new updates. You will not see any difference in the product.

0af01373a44540d96bb63ceab1b83c9773e2cc87.text: A small internal update improves how the system checks its own health and adjusts the spacing in some text displays. Users will not notice any direct changes to the product's features or performance.

ff0f818a5f7b36c0245dd26b4fcb21de9a2b09ed.text: Fixed a small internal issue with how the software recognizes when a command has finished running on Windows. This ensures the system stops waiting and responds correctly, making command execution more reliable.

5d40a19f727f05e4662556e5ed26e12b0f0cb7e8.title: Add cd analytics tracking
5d40a19f727f05e4662556e5ed26e12b0f0cb7e8.summary: Added CHANGE_DIRECTORY analytics event tracking in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts. The event fires during `cd` execution in runCommandPty, capturing source path, destination, and whether the target is a subdirectory. This provides visibility into directory navigation patterns within the CLI.

8f0084437aec929871d33aad9ebf12f2c43f7a2a.title: bigquery and billing build use tsc --build
8f0084437aec929871d33aad9ebf12f2c43f7a2a.summary: packages/bigquery/package.json and packages/billing/package.json switch build script from tsc to tsc --build. tsconfig.base.json adds declaration and declarationMap true. Fixes bigquery package deployment.

12424332f7ce042f336c1443112487c5463cd0c2.title: Add hasGit property to analytics identify calls
12424332f7ce042f336c1443112487c5463cd0c2.summary: Extracted `gitCommandIsAvailable` from `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` to new shared utility `npm-app/src/utils/git.ts`. Updated `npm-app/src/client.ts` to include `hasGit` boolean in analytics `identify` calls. This enables tracking of native git availability across user sessions.

00b91827ce90f96005fec1b18ed3e9b830771e9c.title: Windows dev doc list format
00b91827ce90f96005fec1b18ed3e9b830771e9c.summary: Windows dev setup guide credentials section converted to bullet list. No functional change. Affects WINDOWS.md.

ad147ec5f9339ffaf17daf1f1acca40b87dd987d.title: Add Nx build system and bigquery path alias
ad147ec5f9339ffaf17daf1f1acca40b87dd987d.summary: Introduced Nx (^20.8.1) with nx.json configuring build/typecheck caching and dependency graphs. Added @codebuff/bigquery path alias and project reference to backend/tsconfig.json. Updated .gitignore to exclude .nx/cache and .nx/workspace-data. Scope limited to repo tooling and backend TypeScript configuration.

fb2d1dfca2916877ffe136e6f82f171d831b5726.title: Refine schema stringification formatting
fb2d1dfca2916877ffe136e6f82f171d831b5726.summary: Updated `stringifySchema` to generate JSON-like output with comments for descriptions and defaults, replacing the previous text-based format. Imports adjusted in `backend/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts` and `web/src/components/docs/mdx/schema-display.tsx` to use `common/src/json-config` paths and remove the unused schema name argument. `common/src/json-config/stringify-schema.ts` now handles indentation, optional types, and default values explicitly. Minor description text tweaks in `common/src/json-config/constants.ts`.

f3d9be4ab2418808f32e3b86cfdc3e142aff4fe2.title: cd command handles outside-root path and non-directory targets
f3d9be4ab2418808f32e3b86cfdc3e142aff4fe2.summary: handleChangeDirectory in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts now returns true for outside-root paths and validates directory existence via isDir before executing cd. Out-of-root errors print a 3-step manual restart guide. Non-directory targets return false without setting working directory.

df35f81c8ea876490887ad8cd0dee06cf11e06fd.title: Add terminal command analytics tracking
df35f81c8ea876490887ad8cd0dee06cf11e06fd.summary: Added AnalyticsEvent.TERMINAL_COMMAND_COMPLETED to common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. runTerminalCommand in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts now calls trackEvent with command, result, stdout, exitCode, mode, and processType on completion. resolveCommand signature updated to include exitCode across runBackgroundCommand and runCommandPty.

17c71f6cd1a840b7e8b7eb26f2282ef90885a5bc.title: Split bigquery into @codebuff/bigquery package
17c71f6cd1a840b7e8b7eb26f2282ef90885a5bc.summary: BigQuery client and schema moved from common/src/bigquery to packages/bigquery, exported as @codebuff/bigquery. Backend and scripts now import from the new package instead of deep paths into common. The new package depends on common and @google-cloud/bigquery.

82e9c61af8ea9be36de12bd77b0a472ba3d9ea7a.title: CLI decouples working directory from project root
82e9c61af8ea9be36de12bd77b0a472ba3d9ea7a.summary: CLI and backend logic now separate `workingDirectory` from `projectRoot`. `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` adds `setWorkingDirectory`/`getWorkingDirectory`, while `npm-app/src/cli.ts` updates prompt rendering and path resolution to use the active working directory. Tool handlers in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` drop the explicit `projectPath` argument, relying on `getProjectRoot()` internally, and `backend/src/tools.ts` clarifies that agent operations remain anchored to the project root regardless of user `cd` commands.

82e9c61af8ea9be36de12bd77b0a472ba3d9ea7a.text: The assistant now tracks your current folder separately from the main project folder. This lets you navigate to subfolders without breaking tools that rely on the project's root location.

ad147ec5f9339ffaf17daf1f1acca40b87dd987d.text: Developers updated their internal setup tools to make building the app faster and more organized. This change does not affect how you use the product.

12424332f7ce042f336c1443112487c5463cd0c2.text: The app now checks if the user has git installed. This helps the team understand how many users have this tool available.

f3d9be4ab2418808f32e3b86cfdc3e142aff4fe2.text: The tool now stops you from moving to a location outside your project folder or a non-folder file. If you try, it shows simple steps to restart correctly.

5d40a19f727f05e4662556e5ed26e12b0f0cb7e8.text: The app now records when you switch folders. This helps the team see how people use the tool.

8f0084437aec929871d33aad9ebf12f2c43f7a2a.text: The software now builds and deploys correctly, ensuring the system functions as intended.

17c71f6cd1a840b7e8b7eb26f2282ef90885a5bc.text: The code that handles data storage was moved into its own separate part to make it easier to manage. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

fb2d1dfca2916877ffe136e6f82f171d831b5726.text: Settings pages now show clearer, easier-to-read examples of how to configure the system. This internal update improves how information is displayed but does not change how the product works.

00b91827ce90f96005fec1b18ed3e9b830771e9c.text: The setup guide's credentials section now uses a simple list format. This is a small internal change to improve readability. It does not affect how the product works.

df35f81c8ea876490887ad8cd0dee06cf11e06fd.text: The app now records details when you run commands in its terminal. This helps the developers understand how you use the tool.

e50c0ec9be8ab8cef45679d5dc8821599b76d417.title: Add PostHog tracking for credit consumption
e50c0ec9be8ab8cef45679d5dc8821599b76d417.summary: Introduced `AnalyticsEvent.CREDIT_CONSUMED` to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. `updateUserCycleUsage` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` now fires `trackEvent` with `creditsUsed` and `fromPurchased` flags. Scope limited to backend billing and shared analytics constants. Internal telemetry addition.

71f7c64f238a415c47a0fc9e6e47edcd80da98e7.title: Add analytics for checkpoints, modes, models, platform
71f7c64f238a415c47a0fc9e6e47edcd80da98e7.summary: New analytics events track checkpoint commands (`cli.checkpoint_command_used`) and enrich app launch/login events with `platform`, `costMode`, `model`, and `version`. `npm-app/src/client.ts` imports `os` and `package.json` to attach these properties to `APP_LAUNCHED` and user identification logs. `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts` adds a `DEBUG_DEV_EVENTS` flag to console-log events in non-production. Scope: `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`, `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, `npm-app/src/client.ts`, `npm-app/src/utils/analytics.ts`.

fafd076e9abca255e998845610be0f65bc754f61.title: Fix clean script failure in common package
fafd076e9abca255e998845610be0f65bc754f61.summary: The clean script in common/package.json now suppresses errors when removing tsconfig.tsbuildinfo. This prevents the script from failing if the file is already absent. Scope limited to the common package build tooling.

a61690c3d804051199037acf5a247a855d6d50fd.title: Add TOOLUSE event, drop flushInterval
a61690c3d804051199037acf5a247a855d6d50fd.summary: Added AnalyticsEvent.TOOL_USE to track tool invocations with name and parameters in `main-prompt.ts`. Changed PostHog `flushInterval` from 1000 to 0 in `analytics.ts` to force immediate event flushing. Updated non-production log output to include full `properties` payload alongside the event name. Scope: `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `common/src/analytics.ts`, `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`.

65e29cfe78347b1529738181d73c69f3bd02ff6b.title: Document .codebuffignore negation rules in FAQ
65e29cfe78347b1529738181d73c69f3bd02ff6b.summary: Added section to web/src/content/help/faq.mdx detailing .codebuffignore negation syntax. Explains standard .gitignore negation rules for un-ignoring files. Includes examples for nested directory negation constraints. Clarifies precedence: .gitignore content processed first, then .codebuffignore.

cf280d60a28f24211787a914698c7c162cab40a3.title: Fix spacing in findfiles tool renderer
cf280d60a28f24211787a914698c7c162cab40a3.summary:
Updated `defaultToolCallRenderer` in `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts` to insert double newlines before and after tool call output. `onToolStart` now prefixes with '

' and `onToolEnd` returns '

' to separate tool logs from surrounding text.

409d2537e88bd96037413785d1352cc1e3cf63d4.title: Fix terminal command output parsing
409d2537e88bd96037413785d1352cc1e3cf63d4.summary: The `runCommandPty` function in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` was updated to correctly parse command output by buffering data and identifying the prompt identifier (`PS1`/`PS2`) more robustly. The previous logic for stripping the initial command echo and detecting the end of output was replaced with a stateful buffer that tracks the prompt suffix and remaining echo lines, preventing premature termination or output corruption. This change ensures accurate stdout capture and proper command completion detection in persistent PTY sessions.

e981392bdbddda96419fd5168ddf806ca16b28d5.title: Global stdout newline squashing replaces Client.displayChunk
e981392bdbddda96419fd5168ddf806ca16b28d5.summary:
New `npm-app/src/display.ts` module intercepts `process.stdout.write` and `process.stderr.write` to globally squash consecutive newlines (`
{3,}` to `

`). This mechanism replaces the previous `Client.displayChunk` method, requiring all direct output calls in `npm-app/src/client.ts` and `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to use standard `process.stdout.write` or `console` methods. The squash feature is enabled via `enableSquashNewlines()` in `npm-app/src/index.ts` and `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, and disabled via `disableSquashNewlines()` before user input prompts. This ensures consistent spacing across all CLI output surfaces, including tool results and error logs.

2d7d7a990ff33bd90041223f1a955d5b4c987e17.title: Add WINDOWS.md for Windows dev setup
2d7d7a990ff33bd90041223f1a955d5b4c987e17.summary: Added WINDOWS.md documenting Windows development environment setup. File contains shared machine access instructions via Shadow.tech, credentials, and installation steps using Chocolatey and NVM. Internal documentation only, no code changes.

75e00b83dadca24eafbd038d5231929ab455518a.title: Add subscription and sign-up analytics events
75e00b83dadca24eafbd038d5231929ab455518a.summary: New AnalyticsEvent enums track CREDIT_GRANT and SIGNUP. Analytics module moved from backend/src/util/analytics.ts to common/src/analytics.ts for shared access. PostHog client configured with flushAt: 1 and flushInterval: 1000 for immediate event delivery. Grant credits and auth options updated to emit these events.

fafd076e9abca255e998845610be0f65bc754f61.text: A small internal fix stops a setup step from failing if a temporary file is missing. This change does not affect how you use the product.

409d2537e88bd96037413785d1352cc1e3cf63d4.text: The system now reads command results more accurately. This prevents errors when the assistant runs background tasks.

75e00b83dadca24eafbd038d5231929ab455518a.text: The system now records when you sign up or receive free credits. This helps the team understand how people use the service.

71f7c64f238a415c47a0fc9e6e47edcd80da98e7.text: The app now records basic usage details like your device type and chosen settings to help the team understand how people use it. This background tracking does not change how the product works for you.

a61690c3d804051199037acf5a247a855d6d50fd.text: The system now records when tools are used. Data is sent immediately instead of waiting. This change is internal.

e50c0ec9be8ab8cef45679d5dc8821599b76d417.text: The app now quietly records when you use up your credits. This helps the company understand how people use the service.

cf280d60a28f24211787a914698c7c162cab40a3.text: The assistant now adds extra space around file search results. This makes the text easier to read.

2d7d7a990ff33bd90041223f1a955d5b4c987e17.text: The team updated their internal notes for setting up computers. This does not change how the product works or looks for users.

65e29cfe78347b1529738181d73c69f3bd02ff6b.text: The help guide now explains how to exclude or include specific files from the assistant's view. This helps you control exactly which parts of your project the tool sees.

dcddb72525a27954dfc3e28fc6e96a5196090eb7.title: prebuild clean common
dcddb72525a27954dfc3e28fc6e96a5196090eb7.summary: prebuild script adds clean step for common package. Prevents stale artifacts causing missing binary on npm-app deploys. Affects npm-app/package.json scripts. Mechanism: bun run clean before bun run build in ../common.

f39688c2cf06e27c95df5a2dd4961d44ffd21e24.title: Simplify terminal command echo skip logic
f39688c2cf06e27c95df5a2dd4961d44ffd21e24.summary: Replaced multi-line command echo skipping with a single-line check in `runCommandPty`. The previous logic attempted to skip all lines corresponding to the command input, which caused issues with flaky terminal outputs or multi-line commands. The new logic strictly skips only the first line of output, assuming it is the command echo. This change is isolated to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`.

e00056bad736316e030a36c0e5351f1c0d896d09.title: Remove debug log in terminal.ts
e00056bad736316e030a36c0e5351f1c0d896d09.summary: Removed `console.log({ data }, 'asdf')` from `runCommandPty` in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. This eliminates noisy debug output during PTY data handling. Scope limited to internal terminal utilities.

e23fe979916c4fc7f85866ff7be5abac68e26bd0.title: backend build script uses tsc --build
e23fe979916c4fc7f85866ff7be5abac68e26bd0.summary: backend/package.json build script switched from tsc to tsc --build. Enables incremental compilation and project references. No user-facing behavior change.

005a3621451b792942a26a091e28474f88cd5ba1.title: Remove workspace common dep in npm-app clean-package
005a3621451b792942a26a091e28474f88cd5ba1.summary: Added logic to `npm-app/clean-package.js` to strip `common` from `dependencies` and `optionalDependencies` if it uses a `workspace:` version, as it is now bundled. Other workspace deps default to `1.0.0` with a warning. This ensures clean package generation for the npm app.

8941387a11a8a9c35377a8c67f997a1f9fea9cdd.title: Reenable findfiles tool for codebase context discovery
8941387a11a8a9c35377a8c67f997a1f9fea9cdd.summary: The `find_files` tool is re-enabled in `backend/src/tools.ts` and wired into `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to allow the agent to locate files via natural language descriptions when exact paths are unknown. The implementation leverages `getFileReadingUpdates` to fetch relevant files and renders results using `read_files` formatting, with explicit guidance added to prefer `read_files` when paths are known. Changes span `common/src/constants/tools.ts` for schema definition and `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts` for CLI display support. A minor logic update in `main-prompt.ts` also restricts a specific newline injection behavior to `gpt4_1` only, removing `gemini2_5_flash` from that condition.

80dc207c45d2fb589f7bed4af95b91485331166c.title: Root typecheck orchestrates build and typecheck-only across workspace
80dc207c45d2fb589f7bed4af95b91485331166c.summary: Root package.json typecheck now runs build then typecheck-only across common, packages, backend, npm-app, and web. Workspace packages gained typecheck-only and build-and-typecheck scripts, plus explicit common and code-map workspace dependencies. web renamed from codebuff-web to web. This ensures tsc-alias and contentlayer steps execute in the correct order during typechecking.

2647d6cedd87720f23fb06728f0c4b5fc777d77d.title: Flash prompt tweaks for Gemini 2.5 Flash
2647d6cedd87720f23fb06728f0c4b5fc777d77d.summary: main-prompt.ts adds isFlash instructions for full plan execution and partial write_file usage. prompt-agent-stream.ts routes models.gemini2_5_flash to openrouter_gemini2_5_flash instead of thinking variant. thinking-stream.ts adds guideline for full file paths in thoughts. main-prompt.ts emits newline chunks for gpt4_1 and gemini2_5_flash.

098e5c2b9d037a2a9f83095b257cb4dcf88302f3.title: Type annotation for model variable in prompt-agent-stream
098e5c2b9d037a2a9f83095b257cb4dcf88302f3.summary: Explicit `string` type annotation added to the `model` variable in `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`. This resolves type inference issues within the agent stream logic. Scope limited to backend agent stream module.

1d36564a1a9f39c10446a360ad2fb79382241380.title: Fix multiline command echo skipping in terminal.ts
1d36564a1a9f39c10446a360ad2fb79382241380.summary: Refactors runCommandPty in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts to dynamically calculate linesToSkip based on command length instead of a static foundFirstNewLine flag. This ensures all lines of a multiline command are correctly skipped from the output stream before processing begins. Scope limited to internal terminal utility logic.

dcddb72525a27954dfc3e28fc6e96a5196090eb7.text: The system now removes old files before creating new ones. This prevents errors that could stop the product from loading correctly.

8941387a11a8a9c35377a8c67f997a1f9fea9cdd.text: The assistant can now search for files using plain descriptions when you do not know the exact location. This helps it find the right information faster. The change is small and mostly internal.

e23fe979916c4fc7f85866ff7be5abac68e26bd0.text: The team made a small internal change to how the product is prepared. This helps the preparation go faster. Nothing changes for you.

f39688c2cf06e27c95df5a2dd4961d44ffd21e24.text: A small internal update makes the terminal show your typed commands more reliably. You will see fewer confusing duplicate lines when you run commands.

e00056bad736316e030a36c0e5351f1c0d896d09.text: We removed a hidden debug message that sometimes appeared in the background. You will not see any difference in the product.

005a3621451b792942a26a091e28474f88cd5ba1.text: The product's setup was simplified to remove an unnecessary step for users. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

80dc207c45d2fb589f7bed4af95b91485331166c.text: The system now checks code more thoroughly before saving changes. This helps prevent errors from appearing in the product.

2647d6cedd87720f23fb06728f0c4b5fc777d77d.text: The assistant now uses a faster model that thinks more clearly and writes files more reliably. This small internal update makes the tool respond quicker and follow instructions better.

cce7b2ae97c1476e011ea0ae7e5e92386266836f.title: Disable healthcheck and BigQuery setup
cce7b2ae97c1476e011ea0ae7e5e92386266836f.summary: Healthcheck endpoint now returns 404. BigQuery setup function call commented out in initialization. Changes affect backend/src/index.ts. This disables health monitoring and data ingestion.

bcb487462ab02d9d1d225633e0b67204a844d30e.title: Add credential logging in BigQuery client setup
