2d86909ff04f6c3d79bf105e6115e6ee399e7b9a.text: The assistant now checks for new files more thoroughly at the start of a conversation. This small internal update helps it better understand context without missing important information.

7775aa33d0f6879497aff01816d1fbf3dc8713ff.text: A small internal update helps the assistant check more files when you send just one message. This may improve how well it understands your request.

de61584048a43d6ffd1a153de63b4adef04fb5a2.text: The system now lists the assistant's replies and its results in the correct order. This keeps the conversation flow accurate.

a17bd88894ce4de861b23db36b08f46c0788adbd.text: The app now automatically catches and records errors when sending commands. This helps developers fix issues faster, but you will not notice a change.

e097b3f55689b7a7712e2408242c355237eacf01.text: A small internal fix now keeps the assistant's edits matching your original text formatting exactly. This prevents minor display glitches in the editor.

404c7a37e1937c7e68170eb5ae9823377e24a22e.text: This small internal update fixes how text displays after the assistant reads a file. It ensures a new line appears, making the output easier to read.

8df0d11f7528869f7a9b936b5c25e4ea67104dae.text: A small internal update changes how the assistant decides when to skip asking for file context. It now only skips this step when no user prompt is provided, rather than based on past tool usage.

307ad70ab086e54912205100a22a3942805600a5.text: The assistant can now record notes when you first create a subgoal. This ensures initial details are captured immediately, matching how updates work.

c70a7bd007480d503affbbdc6648917752cd48de.text: The assistant now follows user commands more freely, though it still asks for confirmation before risky actions to prevent costly mistakes. This is a small internal update to how the assistant decides when to act.

4eee2dd5a47c061ac2cfa13ec1d705d133d793d3.text: File reading now shows only the final text, hiding the messy loading steps. You see a clean result instead of a stream of partial content.

f32b6ff3ed8db914de1187c2b4b44635c8f893a1.title: Remove debug log from CheckpointManager
f32b6ff3ed8db914de1187c2b4b44635c8f893a1.summary: Deleted a stray console.log('asdf', {targetId}) in npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts. This cleanup removes unnecessary debug noise from checkpoint restoration logic. Scope limited to the checkpoint-manager.ts file within npm-app.

9fb5b4a08247ddbd73c7dcca05d8aed36a7589ed.title: Feed endpoint switches to Substack JSON API
9fb5b4a08247ddbd73c7dcca05d8aed36a7589ed.summary: web/src/app/api/feed/route.ts now fetches https://news.codebuff.com/api/v1/posts instead of the RSS feed. Zod schemas validate the JSON response, replacing fragile XML regex parsing. This internal change affects only the Web feed route. The Article interface remains unchanged, mapping Substack fields to existing properties.

7d80bfcfaf40b60a3321533e365e2d23497f6526.title: Stop spinner before tool calls in client
7d80bfcfaf40b60a3321533e365e2d23497f6526.summary: Added `Spinner.get().stop()` before state assignment in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Prevents spinner from running during tool execution. Internal client behavior change.

cb26ddc3796a646656e02e5e13caa3cc7d45f049.title: Remove redundant spinner start in client.ts
cb26ddc3796a646656e02e5e13caa3cc7d45f049.summary: Removed Spinner.get().start() call in npm-app/src/client.ts during incomplete prompt continuation. Eliminates redundant UI spinner activation when sending tool results via WebSocket. Internal cleanup only.

9e9be1917697c97278d5b2362e12fe697e759c68.title: Hide prompt when rejecting empty input
9e9be1917697c97278d5b2362e12fe697e759c68.summary: CLI clears readline prompt before validating empty input in `handleUserInput`. Prevents prompt display when input is rejected. Affects `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

82cb8bbaede30bf2e00ef695a7f64c07aa0d69e8.title: Add blacklisted terminal commands
82cb8bbaede30bf2e00ef695a7f64c07aa0d69e8.summary: Added blacklist check for 'halt', 'reboot', 'yes' in checkTerminalCommand. Blocks these commands before LLM validation. Internal security guard.

b241d9279c541e2eb7a4eb0b867561c20f43fe04.title: Fix git fallback logic in checkpoints file manager
b241d9279c541e2eb7a4eb0b867561c20f43fe04.summary: Corrected git command execution in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` to prevent unnecessary fallback to isomorphic-git when native git succeeds. Adjusted `stdio` configuration for `git status` and ensured `gitCommit` returns valid commit hashes from both native and fallback paths. This internal fix improves checkpoint reliability by properly handling git command outputs and return values.

105df9c10b72a55a483d0a6f5a7252545cfd23eb.title: Expand createplan tool triggers for new features and refactoring
105df9c10b72a55a483d0a6f5a7252545cfd23eb.summary: The `create_plan` tool description now explicitly includes "new feature" and "refactoring" as triggers alongside the existing "plan" keyword. The system prompt separates complex request handling into distinct directives: `think_deeply` for complexity and `create_plan` for feature/refactoring starts. This change applies to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/tools.ts`. The previous combined condition for `think_deeply` was simplified to focus solely on complexity.

0d502c7e7288be983f9f95e1a7200f7d3e7a1c8f.title: Show usage credits on each message
0d502c7e7288be983f9f95e1a7200f7d3e7a1c8f.summary: New `message-cost-response` action pushes real-time credit usage to clients after each LLM message. `saveMessage` in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` locates the active WebSocket via `SWITCHBOARD` and sends the cost immediately. Auth logic moved from `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts` to shared `backend/src/util/check-auth.ts`, enabling a new `POST /api/usage` endpoint in `backend/src/api/usage.ts`. `genUsageResponse` signature changed to accept `clientSessionId` and `requestedByUser` flags.

459ea4195ed3508bd72e694c5372b5cb47996a4d.title: Add redo command and checkpoint parent tracking
459ea4195ed3508bd72e694c5372b5cb47996a4d.summary: Implements redo functionality and parent tracking in CheckpointManager. Adds `redo` CLI command, `parentId` field to Checkpoint interface, and `restoreUndoCheckpoint`/`restoreRedoCheckpoint` methods. Worker responses now include original message for validation.

0d502c7e7288be983f9f95e1a7200f7d3e7a1c8f.text: The system now displays the exact cost of each message right after you send it. This lets you track your spending in real-time.

cb26ddc3796a646656e02e5e13caa3cc7d45f049.text: The app no longer shows a loading icon twice when sending data. This small internal cleanup keeps the visual feedback clean and consistent.

7d80bfcfaf40b60a3321533e365e2d23497f6526.text: The loading indicator now stops before the assistant runs a tool. This prevents the spinner from staying on while the tool works.

9fb5b4a08247ddbd73c7dcca05d8aed36a7589ed.text: The system now gets news articles from a more reliable source. This internal change makes the feed more stable, so you might see fewer errors when loading the latest posts.

b241d9279c541e2eb7a4eb0b867561c20f43fe04.text: Fixed an internal glitch that caused the app to use a slower backup method even when the main one worked. This makes saving checkpoints faster and more reliable.

9e9be1917697c97278d5b2362e12fe697e759c68.text: The program now hides the text cursor when you submit a blank line. This change is small and internal. It makes the screen look cleaner when you accidentally hit enter without typing anything.

82cb8bbaede30bf2e00ef695a7f64c07aa0d69e8.text: A small internal update blocks specific dangerous commands from running. This prevents accidental system shutdowns or restarts.

105df9c10b72a55a483d0a6f5a7252545cfd23eb.text: The assistant now automatically creates a step-by-step plan when asked to build new features or improve existing code, rather than only when explicitly asked to 'plan'. This helps break down complex tasks into manageable steps without extra instructions.

459ea4195ed3508bd72e694c5372b5cb47996a4d.text: The software can now redo actions after undoing them. It also tracks previous steps to ensure undo and redo work correctly.

f32b6ff3ed8db914de1187c2b4b44635c8f893a1.text: A small internal cleanup removed unnecessary debug noise from the system's checkpoint restoration logic.

64dde186e5ca7b4e0ff2401f2af7cf14961199a8.title: Normalize line endings in processFileBlock
64dde186e5ca7b4e0ff2401f2af7cf14961199a8.summary: Added `patch.replaceAll('\n', lineEnding)` in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` to normalize line endings within the patch string. This ensures consistent line ending usage when processing file blocks. Scope limited to backend file processing logic.

a07fa2b893936873e96cf80160da83b1458f930c.title: Clear checkpoints on project root change
a07fa2b893936873e96cf80160da83b1458f930c.summary: Added checkpointManager.clearCheckpoints() call to setProjectRoot() in npm-app/src/project-files.ts. Prevents stale checkpoints from previous directories when switching project roots.

a94529d60072531f3172605b9d6ca329aa125a52.title: Suppress git command output in checkpoints
a94529d60072531f3172605b9d6ca329aa125a52.summary: Added `stdio: 'ignore'` to `execFileSync` calls in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts`. This prevents git status and progress messages from polluting the agent's output stream during checkpoint creation. The change affects `gitCommandIsAvailable`, `getLatestCommit`, `gitAddAll`, and `gitCommit`.

d300f180a0152ba44abedcf405fd895c0a4f5826.title: Sequential file processing per path
d300f180a0152ba44abedcf405fd895c0a4f5826.summary: Refactored `main-prompt.ts` to process file blocks sequentially per path, preventing race conditions from concurrent writes to the same file. Updated `process-file-block.ts` to accept an initial content promise and return full content alongside patches, normalizing line endings before patch generation. Internal backend change affecting `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`.

a0ac982ba134446924f9fd30fbdf91a826e8150a.title: CLI skip checkpoint restore prompt on restore
a0ac982ba134446924f9fd30fbdf91a826e8150a.summary: Extracted `restoreCheckpointRegex` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and use it to skip `rl.write` when `checkpoint.userInput` matches `/^checkpoint\s+(\d+)$/`. Restoring a checkpoint created from another restore no longer fills the prompt with a literal 'checkpoint xxx' string. Internal CLI behavior only.

a5e8e0b1b94ecc896a8ee912a80991bea27c76ac.title: Update CLI prompt on directory change
a5e8e0b1b94ecc896a8ee912a80991bea27c76ac.summary: Added `this.setPrompt()` call in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to refresh the prompt after directory changes. This ensures the displayed working directory updates correctly when navigating via `cd`.

5396f20c74fb3efde805856b2ae2f1b2bbcc8f8b.title: Tweak Gemini prompt and fallback logic in process-file-block
5396f20c74fb3efde805856b2ae2f1b2bbcc8f8b.summary: Updated prompt instructions in backend/src/process-file-block.ts to enforce coherent integration of edit snippets while preserving original formatting and excluding placeholders. Refined fallback logic in fastRewrite to trigger Gemini rewriting only when lazy edits appear in both the input snippet and the final response, avoiding unnecessary processing. This change impacts the backend file processing subsystem.

fd9fb1d8e2d9590db8bfe8da8bdd87101d9df2ab.title: CLI freshPrompt clears stale input before re-prompt
fd9fb1d8e2d9590db8bfe8da8bdd87101d9df2ab.summary: Added private freshPrompt() in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Stops Spinner, resets readline cursor, clears rl.line, then calls rl.prompt(). Replaces bare rl.prompt() calls across help, login, logout, diff, checkpoint, and SIGINT handlers. Prevents stale user input from appearing when control returns to the prompt.

ae551e15b0befaf867661627e85e5bb8e2c6650d.title: Add pino logger to npm-app
ae551e15b0befaf867661627e85e5bb8e2c6650d.summary: Added `npm-app/src/utils/logger.ts` introducing a pino-based logger. Uses `AsyncLocalStorage` for context propagation and a file transport writing to `debug.log` at debug level. Internal utility for the npm-app package.

e6bdcf4ae10c7ec740fa7126cbfdc44d592bd02b.title: CLI checkpoint saves restricted to specific commands
e6bdcf4ae10c7ec740fa7126cbfdc44d592bd02b.summary: Checkpoint saving moved from unconditional `beforeProcessCommand` to explicit calls in `saveCheckpoint` for `undo`, `checkpoint list`, `restore`, and `forwardUserInput`. `login` now clears checkpoints. Checkpoint confirmation log format changed from colored `Checkpoint #id saved!` to plain `[checkpoint #id saved]`.

a5e8e0b1b94ecc896a8ee912a80991bea27c76ac.text: The command line tool now updates its display when you change folders. This keeps the shown location accurate.

a94529d60072531f3172605b9d6ca329aa125a52.text: The assistant now hides background technical messages when saving your work. This keeps the conversation clean and easier to read.

d300f180a0152ba44abedcf405fd895c0a4f5826.text: The assistant now handles file updates one by one to prevent conflicts. This internal fix ensures your changes are saved correctly without overwriting each other.

64dde186e5ca7b4e0ff2401f2af7cf14961199a8.text: The system now standardizes how text lines are formatted during file processing. This internal fix ensures consistent handling of document structure.

fd9fb1d8e2d9590db8bfe8da8bdd87101d9df2ab.text: The command line now clears leftover text before asking for new input. This stops old or half-typed answers from appearing unexpectedly.

e6bdcf4ae10c7ec740fa7126cbfdc44d592bd02b.text: The app now saves its history only when you use undo or restore features, rather than after every action. Logging in clears this history, and saved history messages are now plain text instead of colored.

a0ac982ba134446924f9fd30fbdf91a826e8150a.text: A small internal fix stops the command tool from adding unwanted text when restoring a previous state.

ae551e15b0befaf867661627e85e5bb8e2c6650d.text: The team added an internal tool to track how the application works behind the scenes. This change does not affect how you use the product, but it helps support staff understand and fix issues more easily.

5396f20c74fb3efde805856b2ae2f1b2bbcc8f8b.text: The file processing system now better preserves original formatting and avoids unnecessary rewrites, resulting in cleaner and more consistent document updates.

a07fa2b893936873e96cf80160da83b1458f930c.text: Switching to a different project folder now clears old saved points from the previous folder. This helps prevent the app from using outdated information when you work in a new location.

2ea746abe49347978c1a31d8956bf2f73bcde972.title: Refine thinkdeeply prompt guidance
2ea746abe49347978c1a31d8956bf2f73bcde972.summary: Updated think_deeply tool prompt in backend/src/tools.ts. Replaced verbose example with concise placeholder and added instruction to keep initial thinking steps under 5 words. Removed redundant usage criteria. Internal prompt engineering only.

116e23c2a5a3aea16627c3d43d420daa05383f5c.title: Fix cancelled response usage capture
116e23c2a5a3aea16627c3d43d420daa05383f5c.summary: Added `responseStopped` flag in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to ensure usage data is captured for cancelled responses. Moved `promptId` check to reject non-matching actions early. On stop, `unsubscribeComplete` and `xmlStreamParser.end` are called to finalize state.

7348c640bb9308878bd4ffd9085529e98f307ac7.title: Replace CheckpointManager boolean with disabledReason
7348c640bb9308878bd4ffd9085529e98f307ac7.summary: Refactors `CheckpointManager` state management by replacing the `enabled` boolean with a `disabledReason` string to capture specific failure causes. Updates `checkpoint-manager.ts` and `cli.ts` to check `disabledReason !== null` instead of `!enabled`, propagating the reason into error messages for undo and restore commands. Scope covers core checkpoint logic and CLI user feedback. Migration behavior ensures 'Project too large' remains the sole reason string currently, allowing future distinct reasons without boolean checks.

40521de35528c488d39557a4ef9e774351831a81.title: Strip null chars in saveMessage() to prevent DB errors
40521de35528c488d39557a4ef9e774351831a81.summary: Added `stripNullChars` utility in `common/src/util/string.ts` to remove U+0000 characters. Applied to `request` and `response` fields in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` before DB insertion. Prevents PostgreSQL errors when storing LLM messages containing null bytes. Request objects are serialized to JSON, cleaned, then parsed back to ensure nested null chars are removed.

193d18c027e53bf15765ab673db01e66f2b52aab.title: Fix terminal hang for commands without output
193d18c027e53bf15765ab673db01e66f2b52aab.summary: Corrects a hang in `runCommandPty` within `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` when commands produce no output. The prompt identifier trimming logic now checks `(commandOutput + pendingOutput).trim() === ''` instead of just `commandOutput.trim() === ''`. This ensures the condition evaluates correctly against accumulated data, preventing the process from stalling.

09dcc50f0c0925f20cb6c989762653af1215cae7.title: Add weekly usage calculation script
09dcc50f0c0925f20cb6c989762653af1215cae7.summary: New `scripts/calculate-weekly-usage.ts` aggregates credit consumption for active subscribers over the last 7 days. Uses `drizzle-orm` to query `message` and `user` tables, filtering by `subscription_active = true` and `finished_at >= sevenDaysAgo`. Outputs total credits, per-user breakdown (sorted desc), and daily aggregates to console. Internal tooling only; no user-facing UI changes.

ec76265ba536b400093d8604cf490320bf93f134.title: Fix null checkpoint crash in CLI undo and client completion
ec76265ba536b400093d8604cf490320bf93f134.summary: Added null checks for `checkpointManager.getLatestCheckpoint()` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The CLI `handleUndo` method now verifies checkpoints are enabled and exist before processing, returning specific error messages for disabled or missing states. The `Client` completion log conditionally renders the checkpoint revert hint only when a valid checkpoint ID is present. This prevents runtime crashes when checkpointing is disabled due to project size or when no checkpoints are recorded.

09425b4ead90942452204181dd3d67679347c665.title: Replace pie emoji with clover in CLI greeting
09425b4ead90942452204181dd3d67679347c665.summary: Greeting string in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` changed from 🥧 to 🍀. Includes Prettier formatting adjustments for long `console.log` statements and imports. Internal cosmetic update.

9b7e25c267e23cc232b323f6004d1b2018dc9c95.title: Fix checkpoint saving on empty diffs
9b7e25c267e23cc232b323f6004d1b2018dc9c95.summary: Refactored `storeFileState` to use a new `gitCommit` helper that validates changes before committing. This prevents empty commits when no file modifications are detected, fixing a bug where checkpoints were saved unnecessarily. The change also updates `resolveRef` and `init` calls to use `gitdir` instead of `dir` for bare repositories. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts`.

d6357823470aa9c365a19bdee374d4410646356b.title: Prompt tuning for file reading and plan execution
d6357823470aa9c365a19bdee374d4410646356b.summary: Updated system prompts to enforce aggressive file reading before edits and mandate complete plan implementation. Replaced 'think_deeply' references with 'create_plan' in agent instructions. Modified `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md` to prioritize context acquisition and full task execution over minimal steps.

9b7e25c267e23cc232b323f6004d1b2018dc9c95.text: The system now saves backup points only when you actually change something, avoiding unnecessary clutter.

09425b4ead90942452204181dd3d67679347c665.text: The greeting message in the internal tool now shows a clover instead of a pie. This cosmetic change does not affect how the tool works.

40521de35528c488d39557a4ef9e774351831a81.text: The system now removes invisible error-causing characters from messages before saving them. This prevents occasional crashes when storing conversations.

09dcc50f0c0925f20cb6c989762653af1215cae7.text: A background tool now tracks how much you use the assistant each week. This helps the team understand usage patterns. You will not see any changes in the app.

2ea746abe49347978c1a31d8956bf2f73bcde972.text: The assistant's internal instructions were simplified. This small change does not affect how you use the product.

116e23c2a5a3aea16627c3d43d420daa05383f5c.text: A small internal update fixes how the system records usage when you stop a response early. This ensures accurate tracking even if you cancel an action.

7348c640bb9308878bd4ffd9085529e98f307ac7.text: An internal change made the save point feature report a reason when it cannot be used. If undo or restore is unavailable, the message now explains why, such as the project being too large.

ec76265ba536b400093d8604cf490320bf93f134.text: The app no longer crashes when you try to undo changes if the safety feature is turned off or no recent steps were saved. Instead, it shows a clear message explaining why the undo cannot happen.

193d18c027e53bf15765ab673db01e66f2b52aab.text: Fixed a bug where the app would freeze if a command produced no text. Now, empty commands finish normally without hanging.

b326939d5dfc96ed494f512ac658b599419558c8.title: Upgrade @anthropic-ai/sdk to 0.39.0
b326939d5dfc96ed494f512ac658b599419558c8.summary: Bumped @anthropic-ai/sdk from ^0.36.3 to ^0.39.0 in backend/package.json. Internal dependency update.

c1d96037d902848e46d7b1be21b283389e6fb72d.title: Drop checkout from storeFileState in file-manager
c1d96037d902848e46d7b1be21b283389e6fb72d.summary: Removed redundant `checkout` call from `storeFileState` in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` and refactored `restoreFileState` to eliminate `resetDone` flag. Internal logic now relies on `git reset --hard` or isomorphic-git `checkout` + `resetIndex` only during restore, not store. Renamed `stageFiles` to `gitAddAll` and added JSDoc comments.

b4f522ef10553fcd59f63f000089fb8d02c745cf.title: Standardize lazy edit placeholder comments
b4f522ef10553fcd59f63f000089fb8d02c745cf.summary: Prompts in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/tools.ts` now enforce language-specific comment syntax (e.g., `// ... existing code ...`) for lazy edits instead of bare ellipses. `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` updated to explicitly reject these markers during apply-model processing. `common/src/util/string.ts` adds detection for the standardized `... existing code ...` pattern in `hasLazyEdit`.

0a2adb636c9c14cb40d6f8b26ffc83d17fb8f978.title: Add colored diff output to SWE-bench eval
0a2adb636c9c14cb40d6f8b26ffc83d17fb8f978.summary: Added console logging of the generated git patch in `evals/swe-bench-eval.ts`. Uses `picocolors` to highlight additions in green, deletions in red, and hunk headers in cyan. This change is internal to the evaluation harness and does not affect the Freebuff CLI or Web UI.

506a760c80c202983ffb04369b60357e0794277d.title: Print prompt during evals
506a760c80c202983ffb04369b60357e0794277d.summary: Added console log in evals/scaffolding.ts loopMainPrompt to print the prompt before execution. Uses picocolors blue for visibility. Internal evals tooling change.

e2b522b7208e4b6c6c3edd96f207458b77ef1340.title: Remove workers copy from npm-app postbuild
e2b522b7208e4b6c6c3edd96f207458b77ef1340.summary: postbuild script in npm-app/package.json no longer copies src/workers to dist/src/workers. Change reverts prior addition of worker bundling step. Scope limited to npm-app build pipeline. tsc-alias remains final step.

cedba23a052dd10e0e19fd0f5b47196058dcf7f2.title: Saxy ignores unclosed tags
cedba23a052dd10e0e19fd0f5b47196058dcf7f2.summary: Saxy parser no longer throws Error on unclosed tags. Node.tagClose case now returns silently instead of invoking callback with error. Affects common/src/util/saxy.ts.

f91c7f4911e4ade7152333ea11effa84c8b073bd.title: Fix checkpoint manager import path
f91c7f4911e4ade7152333ea11effa84c8b073bd.summary: Corrected relative import path in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts`. Replaced `src/project-files` with `../project-files` to ensure proper module resolution. Minor whitespace formatting adjustments also included.

bab2c967f0275c15aab8f0dfb476946ded10622b.title: Clarify tool visibility in prompts
bab2c967f0275c15aab8f0dfb476946ded10622b.summary: Updated tool descriptions in `backend/src/tools.ts` to explicitly state that Buffy sees tool definitions while the user does not. Changed headers from `##` to `###` for consistency and replaced concrete file paths with placeholders in usage examples. Rewrote `toolsInstructions` to define the assistant-user interaction model and clarify parsing expectations.

21d3f66edd767c5f133c3588a7cad3d54a1db71c.title: Fix hang after terminal command in client.ts
21d3f66edd767c5f133c3588a7cad3d54a1db71c.summary: Refactored `stopResponse` in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to call `unsubscribeComplete()` immediately alongside `unsubscribeChunks()`. Removed conditional `promptId` check that previously delayed `unsubscribeComplete()`. Ensures subscription cleanup occurs reliably to prevent hanging after terminal command execution.

b326939d5dfc96ed494f512ac658b599419558c8.text: A small internal update improved how the system connects to its core services. Users will see no visible changes.

506a760c80c202983ffb04369b60357e0794277d.text: A small internal update helps the team see instructions before the system runs them. This change does not affect how you use the product.

bab2c967f0275c15aab8f0dfb476946ded10622b.text: The assistant now knows which tools it can use, but you do not see these internal instructions. This small update helps the system work more clearly behind the scenes.

21d3f66edd767c5f133c3588a7cad3d54a1db71c.text: A small internal fix stops the app from freezing after you run a command. The assistant now cleans up its connection reliably, so the interface stays responsive.

b4f522ef10553fcd59f63f000089fb8d02c745cf.text: The system now uses clearer markers to identify parts of text that need updating. This internal cleanup helps the assistant edit your content more accurately and reliably.

c1d96037d902848e46d7b1be21b283389e6fb72d.text: The system now avoids unnecessary background steps when saving your work. This internal cleanup makes the process slightly more efficient without changing how you use the product.

cedba23a052dd10e0e19fd0f5b47196058dcf7f2.text: The system now ignores incomplete text labels instead of stopping with an error. This prevents unnecessary failures when reading slightly malformed data.

f91c7f4911e4ade7152333ea11effa84c8b073bd.text: A small internal fix corrected how a background feature finds its files. This keeps the checkpoint manager working reliably for users.

e2b522b7208e4b6c6c3edd96f207458b77ef1340.text: The app now skips an unnecessary copying step during its internal setup. This change does not affect how the app looks or works for users.

0a2adb636c9c14cb40d6f8b26ffc83d17fb8f978.text: The system now shows changes in color when checking its own work. This is an internal update for the team, so it does not change how the product works for you.

e85fe3406786b7454267a242f53f135e123320cc.title: CheckpointManager gates list and detail methods on enabled flag
e85fe3406786b7454267a242f53f135e123320cc.summary: getLatestCheckpoint and getCheckpointsAsString in npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts now return null or a red 'Checkpoints not enabled: project too large.' string when this.enabled is false. getCheckpointDetails removed entirely. getBareRepoPath visibility narrowed to private.

a3a13cce00f8d4cbe5fcd7b096f420f3a4d0d716.title: Checkpoint git ops move to worker thread
a3a13cce00f8d4cbe5fcd7b096f420f3a4d0d716.summary: CheckpointManager delegates storeFileState and restoreFileState to new checkpoint-worker.ts via worker_threads. Prevents main-thread blocking during git commits and restores. Requires bun run build to generate dist/workers/checkpoint-worker.js before local execution.

dee1d9d695f79ccd242c5c4ff41c689d55617980.title: Update menu greeting
dee1d9d695f79ccd242c5c4ff41c689d55617980.summary: Modified welcome message string in npm-app/src/menu.ts displayGreeting. Appended 'today' and pie emoji to prompt. Internal UI text change only.

ce9cdad782114777416dec58fec2c630e10c63cb.title: Export fs for checkpoint tests
ce9cdad782114777416dec58fec2c630e10c63cb.summary: Added `export { fs }` in `npm-app/src/checkpoints/file-manager.ts` to support testing. This change aligns with fixing checkpoint tests. Scope limited to checkpoint file manager and related test files.

091eb2b4c595a9e1213cb7a3da2fa61c9c35d53a.title: Fix case for truncating messages
091eb2b4c595a9e1213cb7a3da2fa61c9c35d53a.summary: Refactored `getMessagesSubset` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to handle the case where no subgoal is marked complete. The logic was simplified by removing an early return and using a ternary operator within the `trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit` call. This ensures consistent message trimming behavior regardless of subgoal status.

b3f32169ae9264c8ccbe6bd9a83f3a08ce89851c.title: Fix empty response handling in main-prompt.ts
b3f32169ae9264c8ccbe6bd9a83f3a08ce89851c.summary: Replace fallback string 'I'll continue.' with '<end_turn></end_turn>' in assistant message content when fullResponse is empty. This forces the model to end the turn instead of hallucinating continuation text. Affects backend/src/main-prompt.ts message construction logic.

d8d5a78690544df7d7938e15051b2424dd7697ba.title: Improve error handling in main prompt execution
d8d5a78690544df7d7938e15051b2424dd7697ba.summary: Refactored `main-prompt.ts` to extract tool result rendering into a new `renderToolResults` utility in `parse-tool-call-xml.ts`. Updated `websocket-action.ts` to catch errors from `mainPrompt`, append `<end_turn>` to error responses, and explicitly reconstruct `messageHistory` with the failed prompt and tool results before sending the response. This ensures the client receives a consistent state and proper termination signal even when backend execution fails.

4d89fd90e801069dd11296321a667c3c061b1280.title: Add princeton lite swe-bench tests to evals
4d89fd90e801069dd11296321a667c3c061b1280.summary: New evals/swe-bench-ids.ts defines SWE_BENCH_IDS mapping repos to issue IDs. evals/test-repos.json adds astropy, django, flask, pytest, requests, scikit-learn, seaborn, sphinx, sympy, xarray. Internal test coverage expansion for SWE-bench lite dataset.

9d5722474c27c94d9313d9e1cc988eea6cb2e8b9.title: Fix credits calculation and referral link generation
9d5722474c27c94d9313d9e1cc988eea6cb2e8b9.summary: Removed referral link generation from backend usage responses and fixed frontend credits calculation by introducing a `pendingRequestId` guard to prevent race conditions during concurrent requests. Referral links in CLI now use static environment variables instead of dynamic backend payloads. Updated `npm-app` build script to copy worker files to `dist`.

3b70e6d56a4ea8c7675e02b1a9ff78f0f0583529.title: Fix SWE-bench evals
3b70e6d56a4ea8c7675e02b1a9ff78f0f0583529.summary: SWE-bench evals bug fixes. `evals/test-setup.ts` adds `master` branch fallback for git clone. `evals/swe-bench-ids.ts` and `evals/swe-bench.test.ts` updated. Internal evals surface.

b3f32169ae9264c8ccbe6bd9a83f3a08ce89851c.text: If the assistant had nothing to say, it used to make up a short phrase to fill the silence. Now, it simply stops talking instead.

a3a13cce00f8d4cbe5fcd7b096f420f3a4d0d716.text: The app now handles file saving and loading in the background, so the main screen stays smooth and responsive during these tasks.

e85fe3406786b7454267a242f53f135e123320cc.text: For projects too large to support this feature, the system now shows a clear message instead of hiding the problem. This change is internal and only affects how the app handles very large projects.

4d89fd90e801069dd11296321a667c3c061b1280.text: The system now checks its work against a wider set of real-world programming problems. This internal update helps ensure the assistant remains accurate when solving complex tasks.

3b70e6d56a4ea8c7675e02b1a9ff78f0f0583529.text: Fixed internal checks to better find problems. This helps the team spot issues sooner.

ce9cdad782114777416dec58fec2c630e10c63cb.text: Internal update. Shared file system tools with testing software for save points. No user changes.

d8d5a78690544df7d7938e15051b2424dd7697ba.text: The assistant now handles backend failures more reliably by sending a clear stop signal and preserving conversation history. This ensures the chat interface stays consistent and functional even when an error occurs.

9d5722474c27c94d9313d9e1cc988eea6cb2e8b9.text: We fixed a bug that sometimes showed the wrong number of credits after quick actions. Referral links are now created more reliably.

dee1d9d695f79ccd242c5c4ff41c689d55617980.text: The greeting message now includes the word 'today' and a pie emoji. This is a small internal change that only affects the text displayed on the screen.

b49ef8c09b8a8caf7ce6260663feb99bc9309b75.title: Workaround for clear command in terminal
b49ef8c09b8a8caf7ce6260663feb99bc9309b75.summary: Added special handling for the `clear` command in `runCommandPty` within `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. Since `node-pty` fails to clear the terminal, the code now intercepts `clear` and executes it via `execSync` with inherited stdio before spawning the PTY process.

2115c454a75d328426b5f55ab4c506158f1fb038.title: worker-script-project-context moved to workers/project-context
2115c454a75d328426b5f55ab4c506158f1fb038.summary: Renamed `npm-app/src/worker-script-project-context.ts` to `npm-app/src/workers/project-context.ts`. Updated `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` to resolve the worker path from `dist/workers/project-context.js` instead of `dist/worker-script-project-context.js`. Adjusted relative imports within the worker to reference parent directory modules (`../project-files`, `../checkpoints/file-manager`).

88ec7b61f05a05eecfeabac08947cb84dae352cb.title: Subgoal renderer newline logic
88ec7b61f05a05eecfeabac08947cb84dae352cb.summary: Refined `onParamEnd` in `npm-app/src/utils/tool-renderers.ts` to conditionally emit newlines. `create_subgoal` now adds newlines only for `objective` and `status`; `update_subgoal` only for `status`. This prevents excess blank lines during subgoal rendering.

e9639036290d93a64a5175e97fe64ba9a33128e9.title: Move checkpoint files to checkpoints/ directory
e9639036290d93a64a5175e97fe64ba9a33128e9.summary: Refactors checkpoint-related modules into a dedicated `checkpoints/` directory. Updates import paths in `cli.ts`, `client.ts`, and `worker-script-project-context.ts` to reflect the new structure. Also replaces `which git` check with `git --version` in `file-manager.ts`.

0579cdcab13ae9aa373130a9429d3fcf6e6cf9a4.title: Server-side terminal command detection replaces CLI heuristics
0579cdcab13ae9aa373130a9429d3fcf6e6cf9a4.summary: Terminal command recognition moved from client-side prefix checks and `SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS` lists to a backend `checkTerminalCommand` function using LLM classification. The CLI no longer intercepts `!` or `/run` inputs locally; instead, the backend detects commands and triggers `run_terminal_command` with `mode: 'user'`, allowing the client to skip assistant reprompting for user-executed commands.

94e958b02fbd94d469effe3f9e162e05b0923025.title: Checkpoint manager adds gitCommandIsAvailable helper
94e958b02fbd94d469effe3f9e162e05b0923025.summary: Checkpoint file manager switches to named `isomorphic-git` imports and adds `gitCommandIsAvailable`, which checks for a `git` binary via `execFileSync('which', ['git'])`. This supports using system git when available and falling back to isomorphic-git otherwise. `checkpoints.ts` updates `restoreFileState` arguments to `projectDir` and `bareRepoPath`, while `stageFilesIndividually` renames its local matrix to `currStatusMatrix` to avoid shadowing the imported `statusMatrix` function.

467de2de8ea96333e5618c8e084c3663ce844100.title: Clarify request prompt tweak
467de2de8ea96333e5618c8e084c3663ce844100.summary: System prompt instruction for ambiguous user commands updated in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Trigger condition changed from general ambiguity preventing progress to explicit multiple interpretation paths, requiring at least one clarifying question instead of conditional formatting. Scope limited to core backend prompt logic; no API or CLI surface changes. Follow-up constraint: numbered list formatting instruction removed, relying on model default formatting for multi-question scenarios.

2393f9729496218177d700f1e3d32bccee607071.title: Disable checkpoints for large projects
2393f9729496218177d700f1e3d32bccee607071.summary: Checkpoints now automatically disable when project file counts exceed DEFAULT_MAX_FILES (10,000) to prevent performance degradation. The Checkpoint interface adds an enabled boolean flag, and addCheckpoint returns the full Checkpoint object instead of just the ID. CLI prompt logic was refactored to remove checkpoint number display from the main prompt, showing a success message only when checkpoints are active.

611b9448bf98d8633cc052c38cb854d9b619a4d0.title: Refine ambiguity handling in main prompt
611b9448bf98d8633cc052c38cb854d9b619a4d0.summary: Updated ambiguity handling logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Changed condition from 'ANY ambiguity' to 'ambiguity ... preventing you from making progress'. Removed hardcoded limit of 3 questions, allowing variable number of questions formatted as numbered list if multiple.

96f5c6445925ccc27f73748b4a84071f761b5408.title: Optimize checkpoint creation with git status checks
96f5c6445925ccc27f73748b4a84071f761b5408.summary: Refactored checkpoint logic in `checkpoint-manager.ts` to prevent redundant saves. Added `hasUnsavedChanges` and `getLatestCommit` helpers in `file-manager.ts` to detect clean states via `git status --porcelain` or `isomorphic-git` fallback. CLI now skips checkpoint creation if no changes exist, reducing overhead for large projects.

88ec7b61f05a05eecfeabac08947cb84dae352cb.text: Fixed a display glitch that added extra blank lines when viewing task lists.

b49ef8c09b8a8caf7ce6260663feb99bc9309b75.text: Typing 'clear' in the terminal now wipes the screen as expected. A small internal fix ensures the command works correctly.

2115c454a75d328426b5f55ab4c506158f1fb038.text: Internal housekeeping moved background tasks to a new folder. No user-facing changes.

0579cdcab13ae9aa373130a9429d3fcf6e6cf9a4.text: The system now checks if your typed command is meant for the computer to run using a smarter background process instead of simple local rules. This means you can ask the assistant to execute tasks more reliably without needing to know specific shortcuts.

e9639036290d93a64a5175e97fe64ba9a33128e9.text: The software moved some files to a new folder. This change is internal and will not affect how you use the product.

94e958b02fbd94d469effe3f9e162e05b0923025.text: The system now automatically picks the best tool for saving and restoring files. This makes the feature more reliable, but users will not notice any visual changes.

2393f9729496218177d700f1e3d32bccee607071.text: The app now automatically turns off its automatic saving feature when a project contains a very large number of files. This prevents the program from slowing down, ensuring it stays fast even when working with big projects.

611b9448bf98d8633cc052c38cb854d9b619a4d0.text: The assistant now only asks clarifying questions when it truly cannot proceed, rather than for every minor uncertainty. It also adjusts the number of questions based on what is needed, instead of sticking to a fixed limit.

96f5c6445925ccc27f73748b4a84071f761b5408.text: The app now checks for changes before saving a backup. If nothing changed, it skips the save to work faster.

d7f34b1299c747691f12a7fb61bad2590eef3837.title: Fix checkpoint manager git init and status filter
d7f34b1299c747691f12a7fb61bad2590eef3837.summary: Refactored `initializeCheckpointFileManager` in `npm-app/src/checkpoint-file-manager.ts`. Removed early return on existing HEAD resolution and moved `git.init` into the catch block to ensure initialization only when the bare repo is missing. Corrected `stageFilesIndividually` status filter to use strict equality checks (`=== 0 || === 2`) instead of invalid `in` array syntax.

c968bf257b1ed8227b8d2786a74328603baa89ce.title: Add opt-out for clarification questions in main prompt
c968bf257b1ed8227b8d2786a74328603baa89ce.summary: Updated system prompt logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to respect user instructions to skip the clarification step. Previously, the agent always requested 3 questions if ambiguity existed. Now, if the user specifies no questions, the agent makes best assumptions and proceeds. This internal change affects the core agent behavior.

53f26c8f9b9b944cc021da415b66e021ea1ece55.title: Gemini fallback for lazy edits in fastRewrite
53f26c8f9b9b944cc021da415b66e021ea1ece55.summary: Added rewriteWithGemini fallback in backend/src/process-file-block.ts when promptRelaceAI returns lazy edits. fastRewrite now checks hasLazyEdit and calls promptGeminiWithFallbacks with geminiModels.gemini2flash if detected. Scope limited to backend file processing logic. Fallback preserves formatting and strips trailing markdown fences from the response.

0cbf99e28ed75d9c0eecb31c6319d33ff19870d3.title: Checkpoint worker thread (91)
0cbf99e28ed75d9c0eecb31c6319d33ff19870d3.summary: Checkpoint manager initialization moves to worker thread. `initializeCheckpointFileManager` now runs in `worker-script-project-context.ts` alongside file context loading, removing it from main thread startup in `index.ts`. `storeFileState` and `checkoutFileState` signatures updated to accept explicit `dir` and `gitdir` parameters, replacing module-level `projectDir` and `bareRepoPath` globals. `stageFilesIndividually` replaces `addFilesIndividually`, handling deleted files via `git.remove` and skipping unchanged files.

2032de0401b67206e72b694b335701d590255017.title: CheckpointManager scopes git staging to tracked file paths
2032de0401b67206e72b694b335701d590255017.summary: CheckpointManager now passes explicit `relativeFilepaths` to `storeFileState` and `restoreFileState`, derived from `getAllFilePaths` on the agent's file tree. Previously, `isomorphic-git` status checks scanned the entire project directory, risking performance degradation and unintended state changes in large repos. The refactor updates `checkpoint-file-manager.ts` signatures to accept object parameters and renames `restoreFileState` to `restoreCheckointFileState` in `checkpoints.ts`. Worker initialization in `worker-script-project-context.ts` now awaits file context generation before checkpoint setup to ensure accurate path lists.

e059a365a97c2c83494f003220a5bff01981b69b.title: Prompting tweak: ask clarification
e059a365a97c2c83494f003220a5bff01981b69b.summary: Backend system prompt updated to require 3 numbered clarification questions for ambiguous requests. Instructions in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md` now emphasize minimal edits and concise responses. Scope limited to internal agent guidance logic.

6957d13cde567601b629dfd248805c8e55c6a575.title: Refactor checkpoint file staging to filter before async map
6957d13cde567601b629dfd248805c8e55c6a575.summary: Checkpoint staging logic in `npm-app/src/checkpoint-file-manager.ts` moved status comparison into a synchronous `.filter()` step before the async `.map()`. This reduces the number of async functions spawned by `Promise.all`, processing only files with differing workdir/stage statuses. The change is internal to the core checkpoint manager, affecting no public APIs or user-facing surfaces.

c572c558d4584221037e713d11d7326e25eac068.title: Drop Node 16 support and remove node-fetch
c572c558d4584221037e713d11d7326e25eac068.summary: npm-app/package.json bumps engines to node >=18 and removes node-fetch dependency. npm-app/src/client.ts and npm-app/src/web-scraper.ts switch to native fetch, dropping axios imports in the scraper. Node 16 reaches end-of-life; native fetch requires Node 18+.

3e2d18332a103aace9036d8923d1a2ad3aaee44b.title: Claude Sonnet model version revert
3e2d18332a103aace9036d8923d1a2ad3aaee44b.summary: Reverts `claudeModels.sonnet` from `claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219` to `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` in `common/src/constants.ts`. Adjusts `max_tokens` for the Sonnet model in `backend/src/llm-apis/claude.ts` from 15,000 to 8,192 to align with the reverted model's context limits. Removes obsolete comments and minor code cleanups in `common/src/constants.ts`.

d7f34b1299c747691f12a7fb61bad2590eef3837.text: The system now correctly sets up backup storage only when needed, preventing errors during saves. File tracking was also fixed to accurately record which items are included in each backup.

c968bf257b1ed8227b8d2786a74328603baa89ce.text: The assistant now skips asking for more details if you say you don't want questions. It will guess the best next step and keep working.

6957d13cde567601b629dfd248805c8e55c6a575.text: The app now checks file status before saving, reducing unnecessary work. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

d6357823470aa9c365a19bdee374d4410646356b.text: The assistant now checks more information before starting a task and finishes all planned steps. This small internal update helps it work more thoroughly.

0cbf99e28ed75d9c0eecb31c6319d33ff19870d3.text: Background tasks now run separately to keep the app responsive during startup. File operations are more reliable when handling deletions or unchanged items.

3e2d18332a103aace9036d8923d1a2ad3aaee44b.text: The assistant switched back to an older version of its underlying model. This adjustment may slightly change how the assistant handles very long requests.

53f26c8f9b9b944cc021da415b66e021ea1ece55.text: When the first AI assistant gives a weak answer, the system now automatically tries a second one. This helps you get better results without needing to ask again.

e059a365a97c2c83494f003220a5bff01981b69b.text: The assistant now asks three specific questions when a request is unclear, helping it understand exactly what you need. This change ensures better answers without guessing, though you might see more follow-up prompts before getting a result.

c572c558d4584221037e713d11d7326e25eac068.text: The system now uses its own built-in way to connect to websites instead of a helper tool. This internal update keeps the service running smoothly but changes nothing for you.

2032de0401b67206e72b694b335701d590255017.text: The system now checks only your specific files when saving or restoring work, instead of scanning the whole project. This makes the tool faster and prevents it from accidentally changing unrelated items.

5030044b940e33aa84b5e510ba01846c09f16fb2.title: Adjust SEARCH/REPLACE block parsing regex
5030044b940e33aa84b5e510ba01846c09f16fb2.summary: Updated regexes in generate-diffs-prompt.ts to remove mandatory newline requirements before ======= and after REPLACE markers. This allows more flexible parsing of SEARCH/REPLACE blocks that lack trailing newlines. The change applies to both multi-file and single-file diff parsing functions.

c232fa69ae6915eceb5eb51f2068289a73b577e4.title: Remove node-fetch from top-level dependencies
c232fa69ae6915eceb5eb51f2068289a73b577e4.summary: Removed `node-fetch` from `dependencies` in `package.json`. This cleans up unused top-level deps. Scope limited to `package.json`.

8bfded24eee0b8ed1b429b1e4f24a035671f3f6f.title: Add ctags to gitignore
8bfded24eee0b8ed1b429b1e4f24a035671f3f6f.summary: Added `tags` to `.gitignore`. Prevents accidental commits of ctags index files. Repo hygiene.

b30e9adbe737fae97ff0543c45e8bca53405d4ee.title: Reduce planning thinking token budget
b30e9adbe737fae97ff0543c45e8bca53405d4ee.summary: Lowered thinking budget_tokens in backend/src/planning.ts from 10,000/4,000 to 4,096/1,024 for max/standard cost modes. Reduces planning cost and latency by constraining model reasoning depth. Scope limited to backend planning logic.

4e3aa180766ffa110e797589ec6fdc67120a3180.title: Add timeout and fallback for Claude planning
4e3aa180766ffa110e797589ec6fdc67120a3180.summary: Claude planning requests now wrap `promptClaude` with `withTimeout`, enforcing a 4-minute limit in max-cost mode or 100 seconds otherwise. If the timeout triggers, the system logs an error and retries the request without extended thinking enabled. The `withTimeout` utility is added to `common/src/util/promise.ts` to handle promise races and cleanup.

9576da521188efd8acda60f8f23249cd4ea07b08.title: Free tier credit limit lowered to 500
9576da521188efd8acda60f8f23249cd4ea07b08.summary: The `FREE` plan credit limit in `common/src/constants.ts` was reduced from 1,000 to 500 in `PLAN_CONFIGS`. This change directly impacts the monthly usage cap for free users. No other plan tiers or configuration fields were modified.

bda7d09c830d4d1ea86649fdafff1fc84d4ff379.title: Reduce Claude Sonnet maxtokens to 15k in backend
bda7d09c830d4d1ea86649fdafff1fc84d4ff379.summary: Claude Sonnet max_tokens default reduced from 40,000 to 15,000 in backend/src/claude.ts to allocate more context window space. Eval submodules codebuff-swe-bench and pylint added to evals/test-repos. Non-Sonnet models retain 8096 token limit.

f0e8228f1223b9bd2fe7743bd6403bb76ab3389a.title: Fix search/replace regex for large files
f0e8228f1223b9bd2fe7743bd6403bb76ab3389a.summary: Refined `blockRegex` in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` to allow optional newlines before `>>>>>>> REPLACE` markers, preventing parse failures on large files. Switched retry logic from `promptOpenAI` (o3mini) to `promptClaude` (sonnet) in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts`. Exported `handleLargeFile` in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` and added `response` to logging metadata. Added matplotlib and swe-bench-docker submodules to `evals/test-repos/` for regression testing.

f89235c667f73c57879eb7f11bb9ddc554ac7621.title: Restrict thinkdeeply to explicit planning requests
f89235c667f73c57879eb7f11bb9ddc554ac7621.summary: Updated system prompts in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/planning.ts`, and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to restrict `think_deeply` usage. The tool is now only invoked when the user explicitly asks for a plan, removing triggers for general complex changes or immediate implementation. `planning.ts` logic simplified to always generate a markdown plan file, removing the option to implement directly. This change affects backend prompt generation logic only.

8585e19830ddf9f824141cb980e20d73a1f52a12.title: CI now runs tests and LLM APIs move to llm-apis directory
8585e19830ddf9f824141cb980e20d73a1f52a12.summary: CI workflow `build-and-typecheck` renamed to `build-and-test`, replacing sequential package builds with `bun run typecheck` and adding `bun test` steps for npm-app, backend, and common. Backend LLM modules (`claude`, `gemini-with-fallbacks`) moved to `src/llm-apis/`; `common/actions` imports replaced by `common/types/message`. `knowledge.md` exclusion removed from file request prompts, allowing knowledge files in context. `SWELancer-Benchmark` submodule and `conversation-progress.ts` deleted.

9576da521188efd8acda60f8f23249cd4ea07b08.text: Free users now have a monthly limit of 500 credits instead of 1,000. This means you can use the service less each month before hitting the cap.

5030044b940e33aa84b5e510ba01846c09f16fb2.text: The assistant now understands editing instructions more easily, even if they are missing small spacing details. This means fewer errors when the assistant tries to change your files.

c232fa69ae6915eceb5eb51f2068289a73b577e4.text: The app stopped carrying an unused helper tool. This small cleanup makes the software lighter without changing how you use it.

4e3aa180766ffa110e797589ec6fdc67120a3180.text: The planning assistant now has a strict time limit. If it takes too long, the system automatically restarts the request using a faster method to prevent the app from freezing.

8bfded24eee0b8ed1b429b1e4f24a035671f3f6f.text: Small internal cleanup. The system now skips saving temporary search lists, keeping the workspace tidy. No visible change for users.

f0e8228f1223b9bd2fe7743bd6403bb76ab3389a.text: The system now handles large text files more reliably by fixing a formatting error. It also switched to a different model for better accuracy when generating changes.

b30e9adbe737fae97ff0543c45e8bca53405d4ee.text: The assistant now spends less time thinking before answering, making it faster and cheaper to use.

f89235c667f73c57879eb7f11bb9ddc554ac7621.text: The assistant now only creates a detailed plan when you explicitly ask for one. It no longer pauses to make a plan for complex tasks unless you request it.

bda7d09c830d4d1ea86649fdafff1fc84d4ff379.text: The assistant now limits its response length to leave more room for your conversation history. This internal change helps it remember earlier parts of your chat better.

9e69b7cbaab90ee30f6162a6874268c780c972f3.title: Fix max tokens for lite mode
9e69b7cbaab90ee30f6162a6874268c780c972f3.summary: Adjusts default max_tokens in promptClaudeStreamWithoutRetry. Sonnet uses 40k, others 8096. Affects backend/src/claude.ts.

882b2ece9292ce528ac86e9a07933c8851c75e38.title: terminal.ts add quoted not found case
882b2ece9292ce528ac86e9a07933c8851c75e38.summary: terminal.ts `isNotACommand` adds check for `' not found` alongside existing `command not found` and `: not found`. Linux shells quote failed commands, causing detection miss. Scope: `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. New substring check covers single-quoted command names.

6bdbe7cc634f42bdf373b6b989981a5ed92dbc19.title: Remove forced pause after 6 assistant tool calls
6bdbe7cc634f42bdf373b6b989981a5ed92dbc19.summary: Removed logic in backend/src/main-prompt.ts that forced a pause and returned a canned response after 6 assistant messages when allowUnboundedIteration was false. This eliminates the artificial iteration cap, allowing the agent to continue processing until completion or user interruption. Scope limited to the backend prompt orchestration. The numAssistantMessages calculation remains but is no longer used for pausing.

548294cc51ff8fded56487e1f26dea5dd964decf.title: Simplify npm-app login prompt
548294cc51ff8fded56487e1f26dea5dd964decf.summary: Login prompt in `npm-app/src/client.ts` replaced with single-line `Press ENTER` instruction. Fallback URL display moved to post-Enter confirmation step. Affects only `npm-app` CLI client.

10630e0f5e067bf2525c12ceac195107ca6bdce2.title: Add pglite-demo eval repo, newline after thinking prompt
10630e0f5e067bf2525c12ceac195107ca6bdce2.summary: Adds pglite-demo as a new git submodule in evals/test-repos. Updates backend/src/main-prompt.ts to append a trailing newline to the "Thinking deeply" status message. Internal tooling and output formatting change.

c5c151ef64d26c0ebff8641e2c5dd8fd692aa645.title: trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit iterates all messages
c5c151ef64d26c0ebff8641e2c5dd8fd692aa645.summary: trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit now iterates messages.length-1 down to 0, replacing prior logic that pre-sliced essentialMessages from lastUserMessageIndex. Removes hardcoded retention of the last user message and subsequent messages in favor of uniform reverse traversal. Scope limited to backend/src/util/messages.ts. Internal refactor; no user-facing behavior change.

71cd514a6bf55bfd952227c413b70af32d0b2b87.title: Update README local dev setup instructions
71cd514a6bf55bfd952227c413b70af32d0b2b87.summary: README.md local dev setup now documents separate `bun run start-server`, `start-web`, and `start-client` commands instead of the `start-dev.sh` script. Build steps use explicit `cd` sequences to ensure correct package directory resolution. The `start-web` step notes Docker dependency for account authorization.

11d9e80aab463dc74f7ece14f1c7e90f330c30df.title: Add Claude Code comparison docs and MarkdownTable component
11d9e80aab463dc74f7ece14f1c7e90f330c30df.summary: New `web/src/content/advanced/claude-code-comparison.mdx` provides a feature matrix comparing Codebuff to Claude Code. `web/src/components/docs/mdx/markdown-table.tsx` implements a client-side parser for rendering these tables with copy-to-clipboard support. `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` registers the new component in the MDX dynamic imports. `web/src/app/subscription/confirm/page.tsx` refactors error handling to display a specific toast for unpaid invoices linking to the Stripe customer portal.

5c737b023f7f8de544b08688650ebd2935b45afc.title: CLI adds bang prefix for terminal commands
5c737b023f7f8de544b08688650ebd2935b45afc.summary: CLI accepts `!` prefix to run terminal commands. `npm-app/src/cli.ts` strips `!` before `handleRunTerminalCommand` and prints stdout when `!` commands fail. `npm-app/src/menu.ts` help now documents `!command` instead of `/run <command>`.

a9f9898592d18ccc113e4156257eff05c4e01d28.title: Trim messages to fit 200k token limit
a9f9898592d18ccc113e4156257eff05c4e01d28.summary: Added trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit in backend/src/util/messages.ts to truncate conversation history when exceeding the 200k token cap. mainPrompt now calculates system prompt tokens and passes trimmed messages to promptClaudeStream, preserving the last user message and recent context while dropping older turns. Includes new evals/test-repos/manifold submodule.

882b2ece9292ce528ac86e9a07933c8851c75e38.text: The system now correctly recognizes when a command is not found, even if it is displayed with quotation marks. This ensures accurate error messages for users.

9e69b7cbaab90ee30f6162a6874268c780c972f3.text: The assistant now handles longer conversations without stopping unexpectedly. This fixes a limit that previously caused some responses to cut off early.

548294cc51ff8fded56487e1f26dea5dd964decf.text: The login screen for the command line tool now shows a simpler message. The website link appears only after pressing Enter.

10630e0f5e067bf2525c12ceac195107ca6bdce2.text: The team added a new testing tool and fixed a small formatting issue in the status message. You may see a cleaner line break after 'Thinking deeply'.

5c737b023f7f8de544b08688650ebd2935b45afc.text: The assistant can now run terminal commands if you type an exclamation mark before the command. This replaces the old slash command method. If a command fails, the error message appears directly in the chat.

71cd514a6bf55bfd952227c413b70af32d0b2b87.text: The instructions for setting up the software were simplified. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

11d9e80aab463dc74f7ece14f1c7e90f330c30df.text: A new help page now compares this product with another assistant, using a table that can be copied. If an invoice is unpaid, the subscription confirmation page now shows a clear message with a link to the payment account page.

a9f9898592d18ccc113e4156257eff05c4e01d28.text: The system now automatically shortens old chat history when a conversation gets too long. This prevents errors and lets you keep talking without hitting a size limit.

6bdbe7cc634f42bdf373b6b989981a5ed92dbc19.text: The assistant no longer stops after a fixed number of steps. It now continues working until it finishes the task or you stop it.

5fe5052faa014781fa8c3ec5e71b856e0807b9d7.title: Raise MAXITERATIONS to 15 and fix empty continuation
5fe5052faa014781fa8c3ec5e71b856e0807b9d7.summary: MAX_ITERATIONS in backend/src/main-prompt.ts increases from 5 to 15. The 'continuing to generate' logic now checks if fullResponseMinusLastLine.trim() is non-empty before setting continuedMessages, otherwise resets it to []. This prevents malformed continuation prompts when responses consist solely of whitespace or are empty.

4685a02af64bf05c8ec4ab4e55cafadbc77d6b7e.title: Fix request file error
4685a02af64bf05c8ec4ab4e55cafadbc77d6b7e.summary: Corrects `requestFile` to return `null` on missing keys. Tightens `requestFiles` logic to match `requestId` exclusively, removing unsafe path array comparison. Updates `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to strip debug `console.log`.

327451aba62289d4477402b928c639976a9de307.title: Usage limit warning skips paid subscriptions
327451aba62289d4477402b928c639976a9de307.summary: Added `!a.subscription_active` check to the usage limit warning condition in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Prevents 'exceeded monthly usage limit' console output for users with active paid subscriptions. Scope limited to CLI client warning logic.

764fc5c039fef63f34a8a17cd5b996d76001b4a2.title: Increase default maxtokens for Claude
764fc5c039fef63f34a8a17cd5b996d76001b4a2.summary: Default `max_tokens` for Anthropic streaming requests raised from 8192 to 20,000 in `backend/src/claude.ts`. Change applies to `promptClaudeStreamWithoutRetry` when no explicit token limit is provided. Scope limited to backend Claude integration. Internal configuration adjustment.

bdb7458a47eb23c5756827ab0b60724ef678ad7f.title: Usage limit warning in client
bdb7458a47eb23c5756827ab0b60724ef678ad7f.summary: Added check in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to log blue warning when `a.usage >= a.limit`. Displays upgrade link using `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`. Internal client logic only.

14a9f09003f8dffae273f44210b285f08e2204ab.title: Raise large file token limit to 16k
14a9f09003f8dffae273f44210b285f08e2204ab.summary: LARGE_FILE_TOKEN_LIMIT constant increased from 11,000 to 16,000 in backend/src/process-file-block.ts. This adjustment allows the handleLargeFile function to process bigger files before triggering overflow logic. Scope limited to backend file processing logic.

4ffb037d93470a988ea46da3a8c584ce267f9d2a.title: Add extended thinking support to Claude backend
4ffb037d93470a988ea46da3a8c584ce267f9d2a.summary: Added `Thinking` type and `thinking` option to `promptClaude` functions in `backend/src/claude.ts`, matching Anthropic's API. Updated `planComplexChange` in `backend/src/planning.ts` to use `promptClaude` with Sonnet and enabled thinking (4k/10k budget) instead of OpenAI o3-mini. Temperature forced to 1 when thinking enabled.

922bd5565bc52bf44f0ead6df57c776630daeb22.title: Fix CLI usage warning consistency
922bd5565bc52bf44f0ead6df57c776630daeb22.summary: Refactored `showUsageWarning` in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to ensure `returnControlToUser` is called immediately upon receiving a usage response, preventing potential UI hangs. Consolidated upgrade and referral messaging into a single block with updated `picocolors` styling. Removed duplicate limit-check logic from the message handler in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to prevent conflicting warnings. Added a Konami code easter egg handler in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

f0fbce126c1c63b0e2aaa83c3d763e4979267a01.title: Update model references to Claude 3.7 Sonnet in docs
f0fbce126c1c63b0e2aaa83c3d763e4979267a01.summary: Documentation updated to reflect current model usage. `how-does-it-work.mdx` and `what-models.mdx` replace Claude 3.5 Sonnet and o3-mini references with Claude 3.7 Sonnet, including thinking mode for complex tasks. `keyboard-shortcuts.mdx` removes specific model names from `--max` flag description. Scope limited to `web/src/content`.

2abae689244d1ca1268143bc4f1113c7e7ff9314.title: Fix long pause before planning in process-stream
2abae689244d1ca1268143bc4f1113c7e7ff9314.summary: Changed `continue` to `break` in `processStreamWithTags` loop within `backend/src/process-stream.ts`. This stops processing chunks immediately after `streamCompleted` flag is set, preventing unnecessary iteration over remaining stream data. Fixes a performance issue causing long pauses before planning steps begin.

4ffb037d93470a988ea46da3a8c584ce267f9d2a.text: The assistant now uses a different reasoning engine for complex tasks, allowing it to spend more time thinking before answering.

327451aba62289d4477402b928c639976a9de307.text: A small internal fix stops a false warning about hitting monthly limits from appearing for paying customers.

bdb7458a47eb23c5756827ab0b60724ef678ad7f.text: The app now shows a blue warning message when you reach your usage limit. This helps you know when it is time to upgrade.

5fe5052faa014781fa8c3ec5e71b856e0807b9d7.text: The assistant can now take more steps to finish complex requests. It also stops trying to continue if it has nothing left to say, preventing broken messages.

f0fbce126c1c63b0e2aaa83c3d763e4979267a01.text: The help pages now name the newest assistant model. This does not change how you use the product.

4685a02af64bf05c8ec4ab4e55cafadbc77d6b7e.text: The assistant now handles missing information more safely and ignores unrelated data. This internal fix prevents errors when processing requests.

14a9f09003f8dffae273f44210b285f08e2204ab.text: The system now handles larger files without cutting off the content. This is a small internal update.

764fc5c039fef63f34a8a17cd5b996d76001b4a2.text: The assistant can now generate longer replies by default.

94955aa10e7943431bcc0d69dc97f2a8e00b4939.title: Landing page CTA shows install command with copy button
94955aa10e7943431bcc0d69dc97f2a8e00b4939.summary: web/src/app/page.tsx replaces generic Start Coding button with InstallCommand component showing `npm install -g codebuff` and clipboard copy via `navigator.clipboard.writeText`. Copy state uses `useState` with 2s timeout, toggling `Check`/`Copy` icons from `lucide-react`. CTA section spacing tightened (`mb-32`→`mb-16`, `py-16`→`py-12`), subtitle text changed to "Start coding in less than a minute". PostHog event `home.cta_clicked` retained on step-by-step guide link with `location: 'cta_section'`.

27859dbc15c578992c5d5467da16768643511400.title: Restore TOOLRESULTMARKER in client.ts to skip file reads
27859dbc15c578992c5d5467da16768643511400.summary: TOOL_RESULT_MARKER reintroduced to prefix tool result payloads in npm-app/src/client.ts. Mechanism: marker signals client to skip reading files in subsequent requests. Scope: internal client logic only. Detail: applies to both JSON-stringified objects and plain string responses.

3fb4a9afc114cd3304f791c5c38413897a8ecacd.title: Update Relace API endpoint to codebuff-instantapply
3fb4a9afc114cd3304f791c5c38413897a8ecacd.summary: The Relace AI endpoint in `backend/src/relace-api.ts` changed from `instantapply.endpoint.relace.run` to `codebuff-instantapply.endpoint.relace.run`. This update reflects a shift in the upstream service routing for the code application feature. The change is isolated to the backend API client configuration.

b50498d1fbab70b90d64ac90b129defe4be4e7bf.title: Plan summary replaced by clarifying questions
b50498d1fbab70b90d64ac90b129defe4be4e7bf.summary: The post-plan continuation prompt in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now asks for 2-3 clarifying questions and the plan.md filename, replacing the previous brief summary instruction. This shifts the agent's behavior after plan creation from summarizing to seeking alignment on proposed changes. The CLI welcome message in npm-app/src/cli.ts was also slightly rephrased.

9008c4d39db3d0ebcf75bd8c6722ef50a5ea176c.title: Update default Claude Sonnet model to 3.7
9008c4d39db3d0ebcf75bd8c6722ef50a5ea176c.summary: The `sonnet` key in the `claudeModels` constant now points to `claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219`, replacing the previous `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` version. This change updates the default model resolution for the Sonnet tier across the application. The modification is isolated to `common/src/constants.ts`. The `AnthropicModel` type definition remains derived from these constants, ensuring type safety for the new model string.

02261d21f962896ced32422b26d0a11047499ab3.title: Add requestId to read-files protocol
02261d21f962896ced32422b26d0a11047499ab3.summary: The `read-files` and `read-files-response` actions now include an optional `requestId` string to correlate requests and responses. `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` generates a compact ID for outgoing requests and validates it against incoming responses, falling back to file path equality for legacy clients. This change affects the WebSocket protocol in `common/src/actions.ts` and the npm client implementation in `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

39fdaef5146797690e94d31d91d689d043586b7a.title: System prompt: forbid touch for file creation
39fdaef5146797690e94d31d91d689d043586b7a.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts editingFilesPrompt section header renamed to 'Editing or creating files' and new constraint added: do not create files via terminal command like `touch`. Mechanism: instructs agent to use edit_file block with full content and new path instead. Scope: backend system prompt only. Typo 'terminial' preserved in source.

d39b95b614a7379d6bc1132117d05359fe3a3190.title: Refactor expectedFingerprintHash scope in npm-app client
d39b95b614a7379d6bc1132117d05359fe3a3190.summary: Moved expectedFingerprintHash from implicit closure to explicit function scope in npm-app/src/client.ts. This variable coordinates login callbacks by storing the fingerprintHash from the 'login-code-response' event for later validation in 'auth-result'. The change ensures the hash is properly reset and checked against incoming auth results, preventing mismatched login attempts from succeeding.

9124f763c550afc4dcb723c93b33cc6cd4cb1140.title: CLI auth switches from WebSocket to HTTP endpoints
9124f763c550afc4dcb723c93b33cc6cd4cb1140.summary: CLI authentication (login, status, logout) moves from WebSocket actions to HTTP REST endpoints at `/api/auth/cli/*`. This change improves reliability by decoupling auth flows from the persistent WebSocket connection. Updates span `npm-app/src/client.ts` (fetch calls), `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/*` (new routes), and `common/src/actions.ts` (removed WS schemas). CORS headers for `/api/auth/cli/:path*` are added in `web/next.config.mjs`.

34743caca48b5ea49a0adc6d8d66baa034df4dc1.title: Upgrade coding agent
34743caca48b5ea49a0adc6d8d66baa034df4dc1.summary: Updated hero section text in web/src/app/page.tsx to "Upgrade your coding agent" and added "Run in your terminal or IDE!" to the subtext. Replaced gradient text styling with solid blue. Added SWELancer-Benchmark submodule at commit af5d5dab1.

39fdaef5146797690e94d31d91d689d043586b7a.text: The assistant now uses a safer method to create new files instead of a shortcut that could cause errors. This internal change helps prevent mistakes when generating documents.

3fb4a9afc114cd3304f791c5c38413897a8ecacd.text: The system now uses a new address to send your code edits to the AI service. You will not notice any change in how the product works.

b50498d1fbab70b90d64ac90b129defe4be4e7bf.text: After making a plan, the assistant now asks clarifying questions instead of summarizing. This helps ensure it understands exactly what you want before acting.

94955aa10e7943431bcc0d69dc97f2a8e00b4939.text: The main page now displays the command needed to start the tool, with a button to copy it to your clipboard. This makes it easier to begin using the product without manually typing or selecting text.

34743caca48b5ea49a0adc6d8d66baa034df4dc1.text: The main message on the website changed to say the assistant can now run directly in your coding tools. This small update helps new users understand where they can use the product.

27859dbc15c578992c5d5467da16768643511400.text: The app now marks certain results so it can avoid rereading files on later requests. This is a small behind-the-scenes change, so users may not notice a difference.

02261d21f962896ced32422b26d0a11047499ab3.text: The system now adds a unique label to each file request. This helps it match responses to the correct requests, making the process more reliable.

d39b95b614a7379d6bc1132117d05359fe3a3190.text: A small internal update improved how the app checks security codes during login. This change helps prevent incorrect login attempts from succeeding, making your account access more reliable.

9124f763c550afc4dcb723c93b33cc6cd4cb1140.text: The command-line login process now uses standard web connections instead of a constant live link. This makes logging in, checking status, and signing out more reliable.

9008c4d39db3d0ebcf75bd8c6722ef50a5ea176c.text: The assistant now uses a newer version of its underlying model when you select the Sonnet option. This update is internal and does not change how you interact with the product.

1e13e67b1811c1710a91de58aca0a7523583baa5.title: Update relace endpoint
1e13e67b1811c1710a91de58aca0a7523583baa5.summary: Relace API fetch URL changed from instantapplysmart.endpoint to instantapply.endpoint. Switches to faster relace endpoint. Affects backend/src/relace-api.ts.

77b6e0be4e1d2db45fd1b929799567eef24e3665.title: Process stream emits end tag on EOF
77b6e0be4e1d2db45fd1b929799567eef24e3665.summary: EOF handling in processStreamWithTags now synthesizes closing tag events instead of yielding raw buffer. Remaining content is stripped of STOP_MARKER, passed to onTagEnd, and state reset. Affects backend/src/process-stream.ts.

10860243e7e5e9a8ae76abeb4881fba8d0040bae.title: System prompt adds package install permission rule
10860243e7e5e9a8ae76abeb4881fba8d0040bae.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts adds rule 7 requiring permission before package installs, renumbering prior rule 7 to 8. Terminal command use cases now list Windows equivalents (mv/move, rm/del). New guidance instructs agent to ask permission for commands outside the three approved categories, displaying the command in triple-backtick tags.

ef4e8ece4482dde9ad6378626b73590f97347ed6.title: Require logout before login
ef4e8ece4482dde9ad6378626b73590f97347ed6.summary: Client.login() now blocks new logins if this.user exists, prompting explicit logout first. Removed automatic logout call during successful authentication in client.ts. Login URL opening is guarded by shouldRequestLogin flag. Affects CLI authentication flow.

7560af255e825a03c221890bd46c9d9c271e5142.title: Add promptGeminiWithFallbacks and fix Vertex system message handling
7560af255e825a03c221890bd46c9d9c271e5142.summary: New `backend/src/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts` standardizes Gemini API calls with automatic fallback to Vertex Gemini and then Claude/GPT-4o. `backend/src/gemini-vertex-api.ts` updated to reject inline system messages in favor of top-level `systemInstruction` via new `transformSystem` helper, fixing API errors. Call sites in `backend/src/find-files/` and `backend/src/planning.ts` refactored to use the new helper. Gemini 2 Flash timeout increased to 60s in `backend/src/gemini-api.ts`.

9d0f409a24799ca79d762b467c9c76164b1554a2.title: Fix file path attribute name and tighten command scope
9d0f409a24799ca79d762b467c9c76164b1554a2.summary: Corrected `filePath` to `path` in file editing instructions within `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Clarified command execution rules to explicitly treat anything outside the project directory as read-only. This aligns system prompt guidance with actual tool schema and reinforces security boundaries for shell commands.

12d5f25d0111002f64df3eb156d444611bf53964.title: thinkdeeply drops prompt arg, uses last user message
12d5f25d0111002f64df3eb156d444611bf53964.summary: The think_deeply tool no longer accepts a prompt argument in its XML tag. Backend logic in main-prompt.ts and planning.ts now extracts the last user message via getMessageText and passes it directly to getRelevantFilesForPlanning and planComplexChange. This removes redundant prompt generation and ensures file context and planning steps align with the actual user request. System prompt documentation updated to reflect the empty tool signature.

cec67e5dbc17bdd9cbc4366ad6bb8450794458ab.title: Fix Gemini request saving
cec67e5dbc17bdd9cbc4366ad6bb8450794458ab.summary: Removed `messageId` dependency from save condition in `backend/src/gemini-api.ts`. Replaced manual ID generation with `generateCompactId()`. Ensures messages save when `messages.length > 0` and `userId` is valid, regardless of existing `messageId`.

d100b687b82eff62836f87e7f3b2b3bf049539ee.title: Update large file token limit and add manifold submodule
d100b687b82eff62836f87e7f3b2b3bf049539ee.summary: Refined large file detection in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` by summing initial content and edit snippet tokens, raising `LARGE_FILE_TOKEN_LIMIT` from 10,000 to 11,000. Added `strange-loop/manifold` as a new git submodule. Changes affect backend file processing logic and repo structure.

9d0f409a24799ca79d762b467c9c76164b1554a2.text: The assistant now understands file paths more accurately and strictly limits its actions to the project folder. This small internal fix improves accuracy and keeps the assistant from changing files outside your current workspace.

10860243e7e5e9a8ae76abeb4881fba8d0040bae.text: The assistant now asks for permission before installing new software or running certain commands. This adds a safety check to prevent unexpected changes to your computer.

12d5f25d0111002f64df3eb156d444611bf53964.text: The assistant now uses your latest message directly for planning, instead of creating a separate summary. This internal update ensures its actions match your request more closely.

ef4e8ece4482dde9ad6378626b73590f97347ed6.text: The app now requires you to sign out before signing in with a different account. This prevents accidental account switching.

cec67e5dbc17bdd9cbc4366ad6bb8450794458ab.text: Fixed a bug where some chat messages weren't saving. Your conversations will now record correctly.

77b6e0be4e1d2db45fd1b929799567eef24e3665.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant properly finishes its response when it reaches the end of a message. You may see smoother text output with no leftover symbols.

7560af255e825a03c221890bd46c9d9c271e5142.text: The system now switches to other models if the main one fails, and fixes errors when sending instructions. This makes the assistant more reliable.

8585e19830ddf9f824141cb980e20d73a1f52a12.text: The assistant can now use more information from your documents when answering questions. Internal checks were updated to help prevent errors.

1e13e67b1811c1710a91de58aca0a7523583baa5.text: A small internal update switches to a faster service for the assistant. You may notice quicker responses.

92a6fce7754249f14b90d44ba1abc67826681b26.title: Gemini API timeout added to promptGemini
92a6fce7754249f14b90d44ba1abc67826681b26.summary: Added timeout handling to `promptGemini` in `backend/src/gemini-api.ts` using `Promise.race` against a new `timeoutPromise` helper. Timeout is 30s for `geminiModels.gemini2flash`, 200s otherwise. Imports `geminiModels` from `common/constants` for model check.

7533053de393b8c4404cfebc14e77098a6238f06.title: Expand webscraping tool call prompt
7533053de393b8c4404cfebc14e77098a6238f06.summary: Added instructions to `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` clarifying that web scraping returns simplified markdown content. Prompt now explicitly lists use cases: reading documentation pages and other helpful web content. Internal prompt engineering only; no API or model changes.

b182a9488e677e052869ec65e18e12195dbd2138.title: Skip bash exit-code wrapper on Windows PTY
