b182a9488e677e052869ec65e18e12195dbd2138.summary: Windows skips the bash-style `; ec=$?...` completion wrapper in `runCommandPty` (`npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`). Shell syntax caused failures on cmd/PowerShell; `os.platform() === 'win32'` now sends the raw command. Unix/macOS behavior unchanged.

66cde57607533bd581f6a3812f4366da5fbd608b.title: Fix claude response storage in backend stream
66cde57607533bd581f6a3812f4366da5fbd608b.summary: Corrects accumulation logic in `backend/src/claude.ts` by appending text deltas to the `content` variable instead of the removed `fullResponse`. This ensures the final response object is populated correctly during streaming. Internal backend fix; no user-facing changes.

2db8a6e8e13c959209fc60c8d2836510489d4a70.title: Refine browseraction system prompt and remove type action
2db8a6e8e13c959209fc60c8d2836510489d4a70.summary: Updated system prompt for `browser_action` tool in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Clarified purpose to focus on debugging and visual design. Removed `type` action from available actions list, leaving only navigate, scroll, and screenshot. Adjusted workflow guidance to emphasize localhost development server assumption.

70879af86afc2f3102abe28bf7e129f4da1abfa8.title: Route Gemini Vertex through Helicone gateway
70879af86afc2f3102abe28bf7e129f4da1abfa8.summary: Gemini Vertex backend routes requests through Helicone gateway. VertexAI instance configures apiEndpoint to gateway.helicone.ai and injects Helicone-Auth and Helicone-Target-URL headers. RequestOptions passed to getGenerativeModel apply customHeaders. Affects backend/src/gemini-vertex-api.ts.

f5f53a911b5b8799f8d31b0663d0520bed7e3bab.title: Allow lazy edits in markdown files
f5f53a911b5b8799f8d31b0663d0520bed7e3bab.summary: Lazy edit blocks are permitted for new `.md` files in `processFileBlock`. Previously, any new file containing a lazy edit triggered an abort, regardless of extension. Scope: `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`.

0f817e0f7f1c77d213eac09ecf310f3c85ca26f3.title: Update docs for model types
0f817e0f7f1c77d213eac09ecf310f3c85ca26f3.summary: Updated `web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx` to reflect current model usage. Replaced references to `Claude 3.5 Haiku` and `o1` with `Gemini Flash` and `o3-mini`. Updated `--max` and `--lite` mode descriptions to clarify file pulling behavior and cost ratios.

bc0ed49b14838d3547f300bfc915583ba3a54843.title: Restrict terminal usage in system prompt
bc0ed49b14838d3547f300bfc915583ba3a54843.summary: Updated `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to limit `run_terminal_command` tool usage. Added explicit instructions to prefer markdown code blocks for showing commands rather than executing them. Removed dependency installation from primary use cases and added rules against using `cat`/`echo` for file edits and enforcing correct package manager usage.

81808634a99bc94ba34d26708f5fdad100e0bc77.title: Relace AI fallback to Gemini Flash 2.0
81808634a99bc94ba34d26708f5fdad100e0bc77.summary: Adds fallback to Gemini Flash 2.0 when Relace AI fails. Refactors newline handling: Relace now appends '\n' before return, while fastRewrite stops appending it. This ensures consistent output formatting across primary and fallback paths.

66cde57607533bd581f6a3812f4366da5fbd608b.text: The assistant now saves its answers correctly while typing. This internal fix ensures the full message appears as expected.

7533053de393b8c4404cfebc14e77098a6238f06.text: The assistant now knows web scraping returns simplified text. This helps it read documentation and other web content better.

b182a9488e677e052869ec65e18e12195dbd2138.text: Fixed a bug where commands failed on Windows. Commands now run correctly on Windows computers.

70879af86afc2f3102abe28bf7e129f4da1abfa8.text: The system now sends Gemini requests through a new central hub for better tracking. This internal change has no visible impact on how you use the product.

2db8a6e8e13c959209fc60c8d2836510489d4a70.text: The assistant now uses a clearer set of rules for browsing web pages, focusing on visual checks and debugging. It can no longer type text into fields, so it will only navigate, scroll, and take screenshots.

bc0ed49b14838d3547f300bfc915583ba3a54843.text: The assistant now shows commands as text instead of running them automatically. This change prevents accidental file edits or unwanted software installations during use.

f5f53a911b5b8799f8d31b0663d0520bed7e3bab.text: The system now allows certain text edits for new Markdown files that it previously blocked. This small internal update helps the tool handle these files correctly.

92a6fce7754249f14b90d44ba1abc67826681b26.text: The AI assistant now sets a time limit for itself. If it takes too long to answer, it will stop waiting instead of hanging forever.

81808634a99bc94ba34d26708f5fdad100e0bc77.text: The assistant now uses a backup option if the main one fails, ensuring you still get an answer. Text formatting is also fixed so responses look consistent regardless of which option is used.

0f817e0f7f1c77d213eac09ecf310f3c85ca26f3.text: The instructions for the different speed options were updated to match the new tools used by the assistant. This helps you understand which option is faster or cheaper, but it does not change how the product works.

396be03305477f51b63cb82c3276205c888f1ffc.title: Rename plancomplexchange to thinkdeeply
396be03305477f51b63cb82c3276205c888f1ffc.summary: Tool renamed from `plan_complex_change` to `think_deeply`. Logic updated in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to track recent thinking via user messages. `backend/src/planning.ts` now offers choice between direct implementation or writing markdown plans.

82302959c27344c2e8e96498412977ae623fef83.title: System prompt: enforce cleanup of unused code
82302959c27344c2e8e96498412977ae623fef83.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts gains a cleanup directive. Agent must add imports, remove unused vars/functions/files, and delete replaced code. Scope: system prompt text only.

6669d9c32c1fbef0c97133ced12918192559d3a8.title: Adjust new file check prompt
6669d9c32c1fbef0c97133ced12918192559d3a8.summary: Modified prompt in `backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts` to bias towards reading more files when current context is sparse (e.g., only knowledge files). This aims to prevent under-reading when initial context is low.

8768274d32f7b4809798f29d59f2e62d713e9ca6.title: Claude fallback for relevant-files planning
8768274d32f7b4809798f29d59f2e62d713e9ca6.summary: backend/src/planning.ts wraps the gemini2flash relevant-files prompt in try/catch and routes failures to promptClaude. Triggered when Gemini throws, logged via logger.warn as a fallback path. Scope is the planning subsystem only. Cost mode selects the fallback model: lite uses claudeModels.haiku, otherwise claudeModels.sonnet, with the same system prompt passed through the system option.

8cbdc73347e85d668d33b7ff5b3499f292624563.title: Refactor LLM provider stream handlers
8cbdc73347e85d668d33b7ff5b3499f292624563.summary: Refactored `claude.ts`, `deepseek-api.ts`, and `gemini-api.ts` to destructure options and standardize error handling in stream generators. Removed redundant try/finally blocks in `claude.ts` and normalized variable usage across providers. Updated `billing.knowledge.md` with cache cost analysis and API error handling best practices, specifically regarding retries and stream cleanup.

bcf9cb8a8fdb47d3878144182788e4c59c5c5a19.title: Restore claude cost tracking calculations
bcf9cb8a8fdb47d3878144182788e4c59c5c5a19.summary: Restored claude cost tracking calculations in `backend/src/claude.ts`. Fixed billing.knowledge.md, removing verbose schema details and condensing to core components. Added quota management and subscription status sections to `backend/knowledge.md`. Removed `backend/src/browser-debugging.knowledge.md`.

2b89eaf3032fbe4402ffdaab010e77bb66af42e2.title: Backend token count cache reduced to 1000 entries
2b89eaf3032fbe4402ffdaab010e77bb66af42e2.summary: The backend token counter now limits `TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE` to 1000 entries, down from 5000. The change is in `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts`, where the `LRUCache<string, number>` capacity was reduced. It affects cached token-count results for strings.

c6c8f1edfa697fe0bbcf87b13e6b76f6a41f84d9.title: Fix tool call stream processing logic
c6c8f1edfa697fe0bbcf87b13e6b76f6a41f84d9.summary: Refactors `processStreamWithTags` in `backend/src/process-stream.ts` to handle stream completion correctly. Replaces `break` with `continue` inside the chunk loop to prevent premature exit before final buffer parsing. Ensures all chunks are processed even after `streamCompleted` flag is set.

ea6f908232f1e252fa8a46a3535651ee8eceb46f.title: Remove running scripts use case from system prompt
ea6f908232f1e252fa8a46a3535651ee8eceb46f.summary: Deleted the 'Running scripts' use case from the system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. This removes instructions for checking package.json scripts and warnings about permanent effects. Scope limited to internal prompt configuration.

6669d9c32c1fbef0c97133ced12918192559d3a8.text: The assistant now reads more files when it lacks context.

82302959c27344c2e8e96498412977ae623fef83.text: The assistant was told to remove unused code and files during its work. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

c6c8f1edfa697fe0bbcf87b13e6b76f6a41f84d9.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant stopped reading responses too early. Now it always reads the full answer before finishing.

2abae689244d1ca1268143bc4f1113c7e7ff9314.text: The system now stops waiting for extra data once it finishes receiving information. This fixes a long pause, so the next steps start sooner.

bcf9cb8a8fdb47d3878144182788e4c59c5c5a19.text: The system now correctly calculates costs for AI usage. Internal billing rules were simplified and subscription limits clarified.

2b89eaf3032fbe4402ffdaab010e77bb66af42e2.text: The system now stores fewer temporary results to save memory. This small internal change has no noticeable effect on how you use the product.

ea6f908232f1e252fa8a46a3535651ee8eceb46f.text: The assistant no longer checks for scripts that could change your files. This small internal update means it will not ask for your approval before running those scripts.

8cbdc73347e85d668d33b7ff5b3499f292624563.text: The team cleaned up how the assistant talks to its different AI providers. This internal tidy-up makes the system more reliable without changing how you use it.

396be03305477f51b63cb82c3276205c888f1ffc.text: The assistant's internal planning tool was renamed and updated to better track recent conversations. This is a small internal change that helps the system decide whether to act immediately or write a plan first.

8768274d32f7b4809798f29d59f2e62d713e9ca6.text: If the primary tool for finding relevant files fails, the system now automatically tries a backup tool. This internal change improves reliability without altering how you use the product.

6027349d0085a934a6355db88872264da52a4a48.title: Replace file loading sentinels with null checks
6027349d0085a934a6355db88872264da52a4a48.summary: Removed magic string sentinels `[INVALID_FILE_PATH]`, `[FILE_IGNORED]`, and `[ERROR_LOADING_FILE]` from `getFiles` in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`, replacing them with `null` assignments or early returns. Updated `loadFilesForPlanning` in `backend/src/planning.ts` to filter out null content and enforce a 400k character length limit instead of checking for invalid path strings. This change affects the file loading pipeline used for planning context generation.

bcac47d1913b1d6e361e0336c8b77d962f1609a9.title: Add mode param to file tree prompt
bcac47d1913b1d6e361e0336c8b77d962f1609a9.summary: getProjectFileTreePrompt accepts mode param. Search/agent contexts pass distinct strings. Agent mode adds ignore instruction. Reorders shouldAddFilePlaceholders args.

25f40133635d3022b5d581ea2a5420dbbdae0078.title: Docs: Simplify heading for external docs feature
25f40133635d3022b5d581ea2a5420dbbdae0078.summary: Simplified heading in `web/src/content/tips/best-practices.mdx` for external docs feature. Added guidance on including documentation via pasted links and `knowledge.md` files. Scope limited to web docs content.

55af42d53d0de581bbcb5456c5804379fecb5cd9.title: keyboard-shortcuts.mdx document two-space line break
55af42d53d0de581bbcb5456c5804379fecb5cd9.summary: Added tip to web/src/content/tips/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx documenting that two consecutive spaces insert a line break for multi-line prompts. Clarifies terminal command input behavior under Terminal commands section. Scope limited to web docs.

3b40ec8dc13a9f2a431de8c1646a3220ba18f8a7.title: Refactor package.json scripts and metadata
3b40ec8dc13a9f2a431de8c1646a3220ba18f8a7.summary: Scripts adjusted in backend, common, and packages. Backend adds build script. Common adds description and typecheck. Scripts package renames, removes mrr, adds private flag.

93b68969ecc063e461b8a9625a1a3c72ed1b7372.title: Docs UI refinements in layout sidebar and code demo
93b68969ecc063e461b8a9625a1a3c72ed1b7372.summary: Docs layout spacing, sidebar active states, and code demo copy button interactions updated. Mobile sheet height and backdrop styling adjusted for better visibility. Changes confined to web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx, web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx, and web/src/components/docs/mdx/code-demo.tsx. Copy button now uses native button element with aria-label and hover opacity transitions.

0694f950f64c8ec6d86790444db73d20804667c8.title: Fix Claude cost tracking calculations
0694f950f64c8ec6d86790444db73d20804667c8.summary: Restores accurate cost tracking by capturing cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens from Anthropic stream usage data. Previously, these fields were omitted from saveMessage calls, leading to incomplete billing records. The fix updates backend/src/claude.ts to extract and persist these specific token counts alongside standard input/output metrics.

4dc4b2495dc8de7815333dd1c0fe5250f726fbc6.title: browseraction auto-screenshots, viewport config, spinner UX
4dc4b2495dc8de7815333dd1c0fe5250f726fbc6.summary: browser_action now returns a screenshot after navigate actions, replacing empty responses. Viewport dimensions moved from hardcoded 1200x800 to BROWSER_DEFAULTS.viewportWidth/Height (1280x720) in common/src/browser-actions.ts. Spinner added to tool-handlers.ts during browser actions for visual feedback. System prompt updated to encourage proactive browser observation and require explicit type field in action parameters.

b3ac409ed586259c2d576691baeb1235055941df.title: Refine agent prompts to reduce unnecessary code edits
b3ac409ed586259c2d576691baeb1235055941df.summary: Updated `main-prompt.ts` to instruct the agent to briefly summarize actions rather than review and improve implementation. `system-prompt.ts` response format now explicitly branches into answering questions (1a), planning (1b), or other modes, preventing unsolicited code changes during brainstorming. Tool call syntax rules were tightened to prevent nesting within `<edit_file>` blocks. These changes aim to align agent output with user intent, avoiding accidental modifications when only explanation or review is requested.

892afc07c227187bb69953d291875bd56e3b3bb4.title: Add pre/post browser action screenshots with backend limits
892afc07c227187bb69953d291875bd56e3b3bb4.summary: Browser actions now capture optional JPEG screenshots before and after execution, gated by an active page session. The backend enforces a limit of two screenshots per request via `limitScreenshots` in `common/util/messages.ts`, applied specifically in `backend/src/claude.ts` for Sonnet models. Haiku, Deepseek, and Gemini transformers strip image content or convert formats to ensure compatibility with providers lacking native image support. Failure to capture screenshots logs a warning or error but does not halt execution.

bcac47d1913b1d6e361e0336c8b77d962f1609a9.text: The assistant now adjusts its file list based on the task. In some cases, it ignores certain instructions to give a more focused result.

25f40133635d3022b5d581ea2a5420dbbdae0078.text: The help guide for the document lookup feature was updated with clearer steps. Users can now add reference materials by pasting links or uploading text files.

0694f950f64c8ec6d86790444db73d20804667c8.text: A small internal fix ensures cost tracking correctly records all types of data usage. This means billing records are now complete and accurate.

b3ac409ed586259c2d576691baeb1235055941df.text: The assistant now follows instructions more closely, so it stops making unwanted changes when you only ask for an explanation or review.

55af42d53d0de581bbcb5456c5804379fecb5cd9.text: The guide now explains that pressing the spacebar twice creates a new line, making it easier to write long instructions.

93b68969ecc063e461b8a9625a1a3c72ed1b7372.text: A small internal update improves the look and feel of the documentation pages. Spacing, menu highlights, and mobile pop-up windows are clearer, and the button to copy code samples works more reliably.

3b40ec8dc13a9f2a431de8c1646a3220ba18f8a7.text: Internal setup tasks were cleaned up and organized. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

4dc4b2495dc8de7815333dd1c0fe5250f726fbc6.text: The browser now automatically takes a picture after visiting a new page, so you can see what it found. A loading spinner appears while it works, giving you visual feedback. The assistant is also better at watching the screen and following specific instructions.

6027349d0085a934a6355db88872264da52a4a48.text: The system now handles missing or unreadable files more cleanly, preventing errors from stopping the assistant. This internal change improves stability without altering how you interact with the product.

fb17d9888659f8054532d4a90a7b8bb5027043e9.title: Add YC match promo constants
fb17d9888659f8054532d4a90a7b8bb5027043e9.summary: Added constants for a new YC matching program in `common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts`. Defines `AD_PROMO_YC_PROGRAM`, `AD_PROMO_YC_MATCH_MILESTONES_CENTS`, `AD_PROMO_YC_MATCH_GRANT_CENTS`, and `AD_PROMO_YC_MATCH_CAP_CENTS` to support a $1,000 credit grant upon $1,000 collection. Scope limited to core shared constants.

402caa5317de72e99b6c5d46b981da66b3caecc8.title: Remove spinner restart on chunk
402caa5317de72e99b6c5d46b981da66b3caecc8.summary: Removes `Spinner.get().start()` call in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Prevents spinner restarting immediately after stopping during chunk processing.

8640d37bda0e87cd0f486964d44622cd61462d68.title: System prompt adds markdown command block guidance
8640d37bda0e87cd0f486964d44622cd61462d68.summary: Added instruction to system prompt allowing agents to display terminal commands via markdown code blocks without execution. This clarifies how to present commands to users when actual execution is unnecessary or restricted. Change applies only to backend/src/system-prompt.ts.

c6f640b3b82e52cf9e9483c3f4e8784277a271d1.title: Adjust home video aspect ratio
c6f640b3b82e52cf9e9483c3f4e8784277a271d1.summary: Updated video container aspect ratio from `13/9` to `13.5/9` in `web/src/app/page.tsx`. Minor visual tweak for better layout fit.

776b4284c2efaec40b4b0716b8199f67a50c3239.title: Planning file selection switched to gemini2flash
776b4284c2efaec40b4b0716b8199f67a50c3239.summary: getRelevantFilesForPlanning in backend/src/planning.ts switched from promptClaude to promptGemini using geminiModels.gemini2flash. system-prompt.ts raised getSearchSystemPrompt maxTokens from 200_000 to 500_000. Planning messages now route through messagesWithSystem helper. Backend planning subsystem only.

1713f2f42d4bcda6dc812844f4c096409206e6eb.title: Refine new file reading prompt logic
1713f2f42d4bcda6dc812844f4c096409206e6eb.summary: Updated the prompt in backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts to broaden the criteria for reading new files. The logic now triggers 'YES' if new files provide a better answer, rather than just if the request is different. This internal adjustment aims to improve context retrieval for complex queries.

e2f1b4bdc73fddeafd3c9863c5cbf451805df367.title: Homepage video layout fix
e2f1b4bdc73fddeafd3c9863c5cbf451805df367.summary: Homepage video layout stabilized. Outer `div` replaced with `section`, inner `div` switched to fixed `aspect-[13/9]`. Video element uses absolute positioning with `object-cover` to prevent layout shift.

4374a203a950e2a34bda96f526466b4a6296ed0c.title: Tweak terminal tool use prompt in main-prompt.ts
4374a203a950e2a34bda96f526466b4a6296ed0c.summary: Simplified terminal tool use instructions in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Removed conditional logic requiring further instruction fulfillment after writing `STOP_MARKER`. Directive now strictly mandates `STOP_MARKER` output upon terminal command success and request completion.

2bb9bff2a728b4e55598108634696ea8704ed805.title: Refine SEARCH/REPLACE prompt instructions for large files
2bb9bff2a728b4e55598108634696ea8704ed805.summary: Updated `generate-diffs-prompt.ts` and `process-file-block.ts` to enforce minimal SEARCH content and explicit whitespace/quote handling in AI prompts. The retry logic now logs detailed context (duration, snippets, file paths) when initial diff blocks fail to match. This aims to reduce matching errors in large files by guiding the model toward more precise, compact edit blocks.

fdd41f4a93a9b5cafd3f4df7e6bb16701a79563f.title: Planning reuses main processFileBlock
fdd41f4a93a9b5cafd3f4df7e6bb16701a79563f.summary: Refactors backend/src/planning.ts to remove local processFileBlock implementation and import shared version from backend/src/process-file-block.ts. Updates planComplexChange signature to accept WebSocket and pass it to shared processor. Aligns planning edit handling with main agent flow, eliminating duplicate lazy-edit logic.

8640d37bda0e87cd0f486964d44622cd61462d68.text: The assistant can now show terminal commands in a separate box without running them. This helps you copy instructions safely.

402caa5317de72e99b6c5d46b981da66b3caecc8.text: The loading indicator no longer flickers or restarts while processing data chunks. This makes the progress display smoother and less distracting.

e2f1b4bdc73fddeafd3c9863c5cbf451805df367.text: The video on the homepage now stays in place. It no longer jumps around when the page loads.

fdd41f4a93a9b5cafd3f4df7e6bb16701a79563f.text: The system now uses a single shared method for handling file updates, replacing a separate internal copy. This change ensures planning tasks behave exactly like standard assistant actions, improving consistency without altering visible features.

c6f640b3b82e52cf9e9483c3f4e8784277a271d1.text: The home video now uses a slightly wider shape to fit the page layout better.

776b4284c2efaec40b4b0716b8199f67a50c3239.text: The planning file selection switched to a new model and increased token limits. This internal change may improve how the assistant selects files for planning.

2bb9bff2a728b4e55598108634696ea8704ed805.text: The assistant now makes fewer mistakes when editing large documents by using clearer instructions for changes. It also records more details when a change fails, helping the team fix issues faster.

1713f2f42d4bcda6dc812844f4c096409206e6eb.text: The system now checks new files more broadly to see if they offer a better answer. This internal update helps the assistant find more relevant context for complex questions.

4374a203a950e2a34bda96f526466b4a6296ed0c.text: A small internal update clarified how the assistant finishes terminal tasks. When a terminal command succeeds and the task is complete, it now always sends a stop signal instead of waiting for extra instructions.

1540281574940d0588fe14e9a41c5eda43ab2ba3.title: Hard filter knowledge.md in request-files-prompt
1540281574940d0588fe14e9a41c5eda43ab2ba3.summary: getExampleFileList now filters out paths containing knowledge.md before random selection. Prompt instructions tightened to explicitly forbid including these files in LLM responses. Applies to both standard and key-file request modes in backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts. Prevents knowledge files from leaking into example file lists sent to the model.

ff2c47c2c6e1666504b78554c33399555befe2f9.title: Record cost for relace requests
ff2c47c2c6e1666504b78554c33399555befe2f9.summary: Added fixed cost tracking for `relace-fast-apply` model. `message-cost-tracker.ts` defines `RELACE_FAST_APPLY_COST` and short-circuits `calcCost` for this model. `relace-api.ts` now constructs a synthetic `fakeRequestContent` using `createMarkdownFileBlock` and passes it as the `request` payload to `saveMessage`, replacing the previous empty array. Scope: backend billing and relace API integration.

caf14641c6d23645bdc31ad7a74a7f61da41f253.title: Switch check-new-files to Gemini 2 Flash with GPT-4o fallback
caf14641c6d23645bdc31ad7a74a7f61da41f253.summary: checkNewFilesNecessary now calls promptGemini with models.gemini2flash as primary, falling back to promptOpenAI (gpt4o or gpt4omini by costMode) on error. Replaces direct OpenAI-only path in backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts. request-files-prompt.ts log messages corrected to match actual fallback chain: Gemini -> Vertex Gemini -> Claude Haiku.

0a63280ece8d0607d41cf98bbfec901e432d812e.title: Remove Spinner from tool handler in client.ts
0a63280ece8d0607d41cf98bbfec901e432d812e.summary: Removed Spinner.get().start() and Spinner.get().stop() calls within the tool handler execution block in npm-app/src/client.ts. This change eliminates the visual loading indicator during tool processing. Scope limited to npm-app/src/client.ts.

2d126431420f2215e48033847ab6b90fbb58e8a8.title: Add Gemini Vertex AI backend integration
2d126431420f2215e48033847ab6b90fbb58e8a8.summary: New `backend/src/gemini-vertex-api.ts` implements Vertex AI message transformation and `promptGemini` endpoint, mapping OpenAI-format messages to Vertex AI's `Content`/`Part` structure including image `inlineData`. Adds `@google-cloud/vertexai ^1.9.3` dependency and requires `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` env var. `backend/knowledge.md` updated with per-provider image format specs and Vertex AI message constraints (system message handling, camelCase generation config).

62928301ba1f53a4470c0ea84e9d250f58429662.title: Trim new-files prompt guidance
62928301ba1f53a4470c0ea84e9d250f58429662.summary: Removed lean-towards-YES bias from new-files check prompt in backend/src/find-files/check-new-files-necessary.ts. Collapsed multi-line logger.error call to single line. Internal change to AI agent file-reading decision logic.

f4c4c51543faf23224585686cb4a6436e451f764.title: Add Vertex Gemini fallback to file request prompt
f4c4c51543faf23224585686cb4a6436e451f764.summary: File request prompt now tries Vertex AI Gemini first, then regular Gemini, then Claude. Adds `promptVertexGemini` import in `backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts`. Changes error logging to reflect the new three-step fallback chain.

b74bdd12b707706762d3fc523efc4ae3ea45af57.title: Switch diff retry to o3-mini
b74bdd12b707706762d3fc523efc4ae3ea45af57.summary: Diff block retry logic now uses o3-mini via promptOpenAI, replacing the previous Sonnet and DeepSeek routing. This change simplifies backend model selection by removing conditional cost-mode branching in generate-diffs-prompt.ts. A new getMessageText utility in util/messages.ts extracts plain text from message content, enabling process-file-block.ts to pass lastUserPrompt to the retry handler. The refactor touches backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts, main-prompt.ts, process-file-block.ts, and util/messages.ts.

593fac4cd7025d938086a69315aff780815cf17d.title: Swap Gemini API order in request-files-prompt
593fac4cd7025d938086a69315aff780815cf17d.summary: Reorders API calls in backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts. Gemini API now tried first, falling back to Vertex Gemini on failure. This change aims to reduce latency.

491594474c6bdedb64040e1656e687b7586a5b03.title: Extract generateCompactId to common util
491594474c6bdedb64040e1656e687b7586a5b03.summary: Moved createRelaceMessageId logic to shared generateCompactId helper in common/src/util/string.ts. Backend now imports this generic function from common instead of defining it locally in relace-api.ts. Supports optional prefix parameter for flexible ID generation. Refactor improves code reuse without changing ID format or behavior.

62928301ba1f53a4470c0ea84e9d250f58429662.text: The assistant's internal instructions were adjusted to be less biased toward creating new files. This small change helps the assistant make better decisions about when to read existing files instead of making new ones.

caf14641c6d23645bdc31ad7a74a7f61da41f253.text: The system now uses a new primary tool to check for new files, with a backup tool if the first one fails. This internal change keeps the feature working reliably.

1540281574940d0588fe14e9a41c5eda43ab2ba3.text: A small internal update prevents certain private knowledge files from accidentally appearing in example lists sent to the assistant. This ensures the assistant does not share or reference these specific files in its responses.

593fac4cd7025d938086a69315aff780815cf17d.text: The system now tries a faster service first and only uses a backup if that fails. This small internal update helps the assistant respond more quickly.

b74bdd12b707706762d3fc523efc4ae3ea45af57.text: The system now uses a different, simpler model to try again if it fails to create changes. This makes the background process less complicated.

491594474c6bdedb64040e1656e687b7586a5b03.text: Developers cleaned up how the system creates short, unique labels for messages. This internal tidy-up does not change how the product looks or works for you.

ff2c47c2c6e1666504b78554c33399555befe2f9.text: The system now records a fixed cost when using the fast replacement feature. This change is internal and does not affect how the feature works for users.

f4c4c51543faf23224585686cb4a6436e451f764.text: The assistant now tries a new option first when searching files, then falls back to older options if needed. This small internal change helps keep file requests working even if one option has trouble.

0a63280ece8d0607d41cf98bbfec901e432d812e.text: The small loading animation that appeared while the assistant worked is gone. This is a minor visual cleanup that does not change how the tool functions.

2d126431420f2215e48033847ab6b90fbb58e8a8.text: The assistant can now use a new model from Google Cloud. You may see different answers depending on which model handles your request.

b79a553e5af77db115cbd740b9712c11e5519174.title: Centralize spinner and update status messages
b79a553e5af77db115cbd740b9712c11e5519174.summary: Introduce `Spinner` singleton in `npm-app/src/utils/spinner.ts` to manage CLI loading states. Replace ad-hoc intervals in `cli.ts` and `client.ts` with `Spinner.get().start/stop`. Update backend status strings in `main-prompt.ts` and sync Web demo copy in `InteractiveTerminalDemo.tsx`.

d95d6054d95c7fca3206b03275858f7394437aee.title: Replace kill-port with native lsof/kill in dev script
d95d6054d95c7fca3206b03275858f7394437aee.summary: The `dev` script in `backend/package.json` now uses `lsof -t -i:4242 | xargs kill -9` instead of the `kill-port` dependency to free port 4242. This removes the `kill-port` package from `devDependencies`. The change simplifies the dev startup sequence by relying on standard Unix utilities rather than a third-party tool.

8a44dd81d72202066687a33e09bf23b58c87e7ac.title: Add Claude fallback for Gemini file request failures
8a44dd81d72202066687a33e09bf23b58c87e7ac.summary: The `getRelevantFiles` function in `backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts` now wraps the `promptGemini` call in a try-catch block. If Gemini fails, the system logs the error and falls back to `promptClaude`, selecting `claudeModels.sonnet` or `claudeModels.haiku` based on the `costMode`. Additionally, the prompt instruction excluding test files was removed, allowing Gemini/Claude to potentially select test files if relevant.

02ea49d99afda03ad99d5a9206fbbf34dcecae3b.title: browseraction prompt adds XML examples
02ea49d99afda03ad99d5a9206fbbf34dcecae3b.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated with explicit XML tag examples for browser_action types (navigate, type, scroll, screenshot). Includes strict instruction to use XML tags exclusively, prohibiting JSON or other formats. Internal change affecting agent behavior via system prompt only.

4dd2635751db0e307420be6b741cadeff72ca549.title: Add placeholder detection to file rewriting
4dd2635751db0e307420be6b741cadeff72ca549.summary: Backend file processing now detects missing `... existing code ...` placeholders in single-function edits and triggers a `fastRewrite` with injected context. `processFileBlock` receives `messages` and `fullResponse` to run `shouldAddFilePlaceholders` logic. Updated `main-prompt.ts` and `process-file-block.ts`.

1948b7c48205a73c5fb27e6a2136f72b161877e0.title: Strengthen placeholder comment guidance in system prompt
1948b7c48205a73c5fb27e6a2136f72b161877e0.summary: System prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` now explicitly instructs the agent to abridge file content using placeholder comments to minimize written lines. Previous wording permitted but did not strongly encourage this behavior for unchanged code sections. This change aims to improve clarity and conciseness of edit blocks.

1f91f2ea178b06aa306692ce6a76f859b8e945c7.title: Use Gemini Flash for file selection
1f91f2ea178b06aa306692ce6a76f859b8e945c7.summary: Refactored file selection logic into `backend/src/find-files/`, replacing the monolithic `request-files-prompt.ts` with modular `check-new-files-necessary.ts` and `request-files-prompt.ts`. Switched the primary file-finding model to Gemini Flash via `promptGemini`, removing DeepSeek and complex warm-cache logic from `main-prompt.ts`. Scope covers backend file discovery and prompt orchestration. `countPerRequest` now scales by cost mode (8/12/14) instead of fixed values.

bd0104d370f19b44533cfa87868c40f5d8739ba8.title: createRelaceMessageId strips negative sign from base36 output
bd0104d370f19b44533cfa87868c40f5d8739ba8.summary: createRelaceMessageId now calls .replace('-', '') on the base36 string to remove potential negative signs. This prevents malformed IDs when timestamp << 8 | random overflows into negative territory. Scope limited to backend/src/relace-api.ts. Bitwise shift on 32-bit signed integer can produce negative values before toString(36) encoding.

97d0c0e85151118dd07d01ab7babac07ce16f72f.title: Prevent cookie banner visibility
97d0c0e85151118dd07d01ab7babac07ce16f72f.summary: CookieConsentCard.tsx now prevents the consent banner from appearing. The `setVisible(true)` logic based on localStorage is commented out. This effectively hides the UI element for all users.

d95d6054d95c7fca3206b03275858f7394437aee.text: A small internal update simplifies how the system frees up space for development tools. Users will not notice any changes.

b79a553e5af77db115cbd740b9712c11e5519174.text: The app now shows a consistent loading indicator and clearer status messages while working. This internal update ensures you always see accurate progress updates without confusing or broken animations.

1948b7c48205a73c5fb27e6a2136f72b161877e0.text: The assistant now uses a clearer method to show only the parts of files that need changing, making edits easier to read and understand.

02ea49d99afda03ad99d5a9206fbbf34dcecae3b.text: The assistant now uses a specific, strict format to understand commands for web browsing tasks. This change is internal and helps the assistant follow instructions more accurately, so you should see fewer mistakes when it tries to navigate, type, or take screenshots.

1f91f2ea178b06aa306692ce6a76f859b8e945c7.text: The system now uses a faster, cheaper method to find files. This change is internal and improves how the assistant searches without changing how you use the product.

bd0104d370f19b44533cfa87868c40f5d8739ba8.text: The system now cleans up message ID numbers to prevent them from looking broken if they become negative. This is a small internal fix that ensures messages are tracked correctly without changing how you use the product.

8a44dd81d72202066687a33e09bf23b58c87e7ac.text: If the main system cannot find requested files, a backup system now tries instead. This makes file searches more reliable.

4dd2635751db0e307420be6b741cadeff72ca549.text: The system now automatically adds missing code markers when updating single functions. This ensures edits happen correctly without manual intervention.

97d0c0e85151118dd07d01ab7babac07ce16f72f.text: The cookie consent banner will no longer appear on the website. Users will not see or interact with this notification.

296fb315222e37ee7371b9d72d30b2b91ae48237.title: Pass prompt to processFileBlock in planning.ts
296fb315222e37ee7371b9d72d30b2b91ae48237.summary: Added `prompt` parameter to `processFileBlock` in `backend/src/planning.ts`. Function signature and call sites updated to include `prompt`. Fixes type error by ensuring `prompt` is passed to downstream logic.

bc3e00b4d36f645ab6596594973dd37892f54fad.title: Remove SEARCH/REPLACE block references from system prompt
bc3e00b4d36f645ab6596594973dd37892f54fad.summary: Removed `createSearchReplaceBlock` import and updated knowledge file editing instructions in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to drop SEARCH/REPLACE block usage. The prompt now directs agents to reproduce entire files with `... existing content ...` placeholders for unchanged sections. This change is internal to the backend system prompt logic.

4cd218eb007183350c84760e9077cff2e34b296e.title: Simplify Relace ID generation
4cd218eb007183350c84760e9077cff2e34b296e.summary: Replaced createRelaceCodebuffId with createRelaceMessageId in backend/src/relace-api.ts. The new function generates compact base36 IDs from timestamp and random bits, removing SHA256 hashing of file contents. This simplifies ID creation and reduces computational overhead during fastRewrite operations.

128d19903a01ee58337e23e0a6f6fc5a0ff318d0.title: Silence system instruction mentions and clarify editfile application
128d19903a01ee58337e23e0a6f6fc5a0ff318d0.summary: Wraps generated system instructions in a directive to follow them without mentioning them in responses. Adds a system prompt note clarifying that edit_file blocks apply immediately and may contain mistakes requiring a new block to fix. Removes a redundant instruction about not adding commentary when updating knowledge files. Fixes a string concatenation bug in the toolCallMessage generation.

824a97c16f7ad7b181d6c2ce7e4e771eedc9162a.title: Add relace-metadata to instantapply payload
824a97c16f7ad7b181d6c2ce7e4e771eedc9162a.summary: Backend now attaches `relace-metadata` (including `codebuff-id` and `codebuff-user-prompt`) to requests sent to Relace's `instantapply` endpoint. `createRelaceCodebuffId` generates the ID by hashing the initial code and edit snippet. This change updates `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`, and `backend/src/relace-api.ts` to propagate user prompt context and a unique identifier for better tracking and debugging of AI code application.

310c04f72b9540cf7ba4712207207c7a875f0e07.title: Gracefully handle browser action schema failures
310c04f72b9540cf7ba4712207207c7a875f0e07.summary: Browser action validation failures now return structured error responses instead of throwing unhandled exceptions. Zod schema parsing errors in `tool-handlers.ts` are caught and formatted into `BrowserResponse` objects with `success: false`. Knowledge base instructions updated to enforce element-based XML format over attribute-based syntax, with explicit URL validation rules. Scope limited to npm-app browser tooling and backend knowledge docs.

7deebad01fa66f3133bcfb51bb0b8858de07d74a.title: Relace AI integration for fast file edits
7deebad01fa66f3133bcfb51bb0b8858de07d74a.summary: Relace AI integration added via `promptRelaceAI` in `backend/src/relace-api.ts` to apply edits using fast rewrites, replacing legacy diff application logic in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`. New `RELACE_API_KEY` env var required. System prompt updated in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to guide model toward new edit syntax. Includes `scripts/analyze-edit-blocks.ts` for historical edit block analysis.

864595917326240c53d73457c3fbcf724748c311.title: Switch browser tool to puppeteer-core, restrict to read-only
864595917326240c53d73457c3fbcf724748c311.summary: Replace puppeteer with puppeteer-core in npm-app to avoid bundled Chromium download. BrowserRunner now locates system Chrome via platform-specific executablePath and validates connection before each action. System prompt restricts browser_action to read-only operations (navigate, scroll, screenshot, type) and prohibits interactive clicks or form submissions. DetachedFrameError added to retryOnErrors in common/src/browser-actions.ts.

2ca353455a6a76e88fd67336af97e4b96b222a68.title: Add Gemini 2.0 Flash streaming and pricing, remove lite mode routing
2ca353455a6a76e88fd67336af97e4b96b222a68.summary: Added `promptGeminiStream` to `backend/src/gemini-api.ts` and registered `gemini2flash` pricing in `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts`. The `lite` cost mode routing for DeepSeek was commented out in `main-prompt.ts`, `request-files-prompt.ts`, and `system-prompt.ts`, forcing `normal`/`max` budgets (e.g., `FILE_TOKEN_BUDGET` fixed to 100k). The `gemini2flash` model ID updated from `exp` to `001` in `common/src/constants.ts`, with a note that `getModelForMode` is stale.

07bf5aa64eae87a42088c706854e16d468379bb2.title: browser navigate auto-captures screenshot
07bf5aa64eae87a42088c706854e16d468379bb2.summary: BrowserRunner navigate action now automatically triggers takeScreenshot, merging result into return payload. Removes manual start/navigate branching in switch statement. Adds 500ms stabilization delay after page attachment. Updates puppeteer install command with --yes flag. Web banner padding reduced from py-2 to py-0.5, text size increased from text-xs to text-sm.

bc3e00b4d36f645ab6596594973dd37892f54fad.text: The assistant's instructions for editing files changed from using special markers to rewriting whole files. This is an internal update; users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

296fb315222e37ee7371b9d72d30b2b91ae48237.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant receives your request correctly. You likely won't notice a difference, but the system is now more stable.

310c04f72b9540cf7ba4712207207c7a875f0e07.text: Small internal update. The assistant now gives clear error messages instead of crashing when browser actions fail. Knowledge base rules tightened to require specific formatting and URL checks.

7deebad01fa66f3133bcfb51bb0b8858de07d74a.text: File editing is now faster because the system uses a new method to rewrite content instead of comparing old and new versions.

07bf5aa64eae87a42088c706854e16d468379bb2.text: When the browser visits a new page, it now automatically takes a picture of what it sees. You no longer need to ask for a screenshot separately after navigation.

4cd218eb007183350c84760e9077cff2e34b296e.text: The system now creates unique tags for messages more simply and quickly. This makes the tool run faster without changing how you use it.

128d19903a01ee58337e23e0a6f6fc5a0ff318d0.text: The assistant now follows hidden rules silently, without mentioning them to you. It also updates files instantly, so you no longer see extra explanations about the changes.

864595917326240c53d73457c3fbcf724748c311.text: The assistant now uses your computer's existing web browser instead of downloading a separate one, making it faster and lighter. It can only look at pages and take pictures, so it cannot click buttons or fill out forms for you.

824a97c16f7ad7b181d6c2ce7e4e771eedc9162a.text: The system now adds a unique tracking tag and context to requests sent to the code application service. This helps the support team trace specific actions and debug issues more effectively.

5583b8a276f342d7fc3d9ac200e52ca7a5f897c9.title: Fix banner mobile layout
5583b8a276f342d7fc3d9ac200e52ca7a5f897c9.summary: Banner layout adjusted for mobile via `web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx`. Container padding moved from outer div to inner container; text wrapping changed to `md:whitespace-nowrap`. Gift icon set to `flex-shrink-0` to prevent compression.

697619cc9c67d01e53fb768d202f52f6466cfd7d.title: Re-enable filetree in agent system prompt
697619cc9c67d01e53fb768d202f52f6466cfd7d.summary: Uncomments `getProjectFileTreePrompt` and `countTokensJson` calls in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The agent now includes the project file tree in the system prompt again, constrained by `fileTreeTokenBudget` (5k for lite, 20k otherwise). This reverts a previous disablement, restoring file context visibility for the agent.

0c7cbe8e92e59caf330c937d089b0c73aa0008ad.title: Cap planning file tokens at 140k
0c7cbe8e92e59caf330c937d089b0c73aa0008ad.summary: Added `loadFilesForPlanning` in `backend/src/planning.ts` to filter fetched files before planning. Drops entries with `null` content, `[INVALID_FILE_PATH]`, or >40k tokens, then removes files exceeding 140k cumulative tokens. Refactored `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to use this helper instead of inline filtering. Reduced `TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE` size from 10k to 5k in `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts` to bound memory.

e7d7d25cc8e1bb270a8d46316b6c6ee967182cd2.title: Browser action prompt tweaks
e7d7d25cc8e1bb270a8d46316b6c6ee967182cd2.summary: System prompt for `browser_action` tool updated in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Instructions clarify that the agent must never start the user's development server, emphasizing explicit user action for server startup. The prompt structure removes redundant error handling sections and reinforces the `<tool_call name="browser_action">` XML prefix requirement.

e059aaa20a4005fd799df4277357452b7d61ff66.title: Update troubleshooting docs
e059aaa20a4005fd799df4277357452b7d61ff66.summary: Simplified connection troubleshooting steps in `troubleshooting.mdx`. Removed `codebuff auth status` check and updated login/logout commands to `logout` and `login`. Clarified support response times, noting subscribers are prioritized but replies occur within a week.

5eab73b6f997945b3b8a8bb060a5fc1e34958fa5.title: Handle null filepaths in getFiles
5eab73b6f997945b3b8a8bb060a5fc1e34958fa5.summary: Added null/empty check for file paths in getFiles. Prevents crashes when invalid paths are passed. Change applies to npm-app/src/project-files.ts.

e4895637047fb9f8dcb6b78e8caf8ed578f4100b.title: Browser runner stops restarting on execution failure
e4895637047fb9f8dcb6b78e8caf8ed578f4100b.summary: Removed automatic browser restart logic in `npm-app/src/browser-runner.ts` when execution fails. Previously, `BrowserRunner` attempted to recover by calling `shutdown` followed by `startBrowser` for non-stop actions. Now, the runner simply shuts down and rethrows the error.

2eeafb528346e4bd3a89b210b6a7652727dcacdb.title: Update continue prompt in main-prompt.ts
2eeafb528346e4bd3a89b210b6a7652727dcacdb.summary: The `continue` tool input in `main-prompt.ts` now explicitly instructs the agent to summarize and review implementation without re-calling `plan_complex_change`. This change prevents the agent from entering a loop with the planning tool. The update affects the backend core logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

08a4e3eb7255aec4c3d6a6e054708e7890cd758b.title: ensureUrlProtocol normalizes missing scheme in browser and scraper
08a4e3eb7255aec4c3d6a6e054708e7890cd758b.summary: Added ensureUrlProtocol in common/src/util/string.ts to inject http:// for localhost/127.0.0.1 and https:// for other domains. Applied to npm-app/src/browser-runner.ts page.goto and npm-app/src/web-scraper.ts scrapeWebPage to prevent navigation failures on scheme-less URLs. Scope limited to shared string utility and npm-app browser/scraping surfaces.

9e21191a3b09258068cc151f1a3ef1f8944a06aa.title: Moved troubleshooting docs to advanced
9e21191a3b09258068cc151f1a3ef1f8944a06aa.summary: Renamed `web/src/content/help/troubleshooting.mdx` to `web/src/content/advanced/troubleshooting.mdx`. This reorganization shifts troubleshooting guidance into the advanced content section. Scope limited to the Web docs directory structure.

08a4e3eb7255aec4c3d6a6e054708e7890cd758b.text: The software now automatically adds the correct web address prefix when you forget it. This prevents errors when browsing or extracting content from websites.

2eeafb528346e4bd3a89b210b6a7652727dcacdb.text: The assistant now pauses to review its work before continuing, preventing it from getting stuck repeating the same planning steps.

5eab73b6f997945b3b8a8bb060a5fc1e34958fa5.text: The system now ignores broken file paths instead of crashing. This makes the app more stable when loading files.

9e21191a3b09258068cc151f1a3ef1f8944a06aa.text: The help section moved to a new spot in the menu.

e4895637047fb9f8dcb6b78e8caf8ed578f4100b.text: A small internal change stopped the browser tool from automatically restarting after a failed action. It now closes and reports the failure instead. For someone using the product, this may make some browser-related failures show up as errors instead of being hidden by a restart attempt.

5583b8a276f342d7fc3d9ac200e52ca7a5f897c9.text: The top banner now fits better on phones, so text and icons no longer look squashed.

0c7cbe8e92e59caf330c937d089b0c73aa0008ad.text: The system now limits how much text it reads at once to save memory. This change is internal and helps the app run more smoothly without changing how you use it.

697619cc9c67d01e53fb768d202f52f6466cfd7d.text: The assistant can now see the full list of files in your project again. This helps it understand your work better and give more accurate answers.

e059aaa20a4005fd799df4277357452b7d61ff66.text: Help guides now show simpler ways to fix connection problems. The team also clarified that paid users get priority, but everyone receives a reply within a week.

e7d7d25cc8e1bb270a8d46316b6c6ee967182cd2.text: The assistant now waits for you to start your development server before taking action.

36b930f637bf4d39a76afa4168b6599bd3d3572f.title: Added troubleshooting help page
36b930f637bf4d39a76afa4168b6599bd3d3572f.summary: New `web/src/content/help/troubleshooting.mdx` documents chat history location (`~/.config/manicode/...`) and common errors like WebSocket timeouts or command not found. `web/src/content/help/faq.mdx` updated to clarify data storage policies. Scope limited to web help content.

3ca6b55ace5ede8cf3f1a41e5015703262facf2d.title: Add duration to system prompt logs
3ca6b55ace5ede8cf3f1a41e5015703262facf2d.summary: Added `duration` field to system prompt logs in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. `getSearchSystemPrompt` and `getAgentSystemPrompt` now record `Date.now() - startTime` in their log metadata. This change provides visibility into prompt construction time for both search and agent flows. Scope limited to backend logging internals.

c489f830d43b132f01281dd53e0ab72b8f6f3702.title: Estimate file tree pruning to avoid repeated token counts
c489f830d43b132f01281dd53e0ab72b8f6f3702.summary: Replaced iterative deep-file removal with sampled token estimation in `backend/src/truncate-file-tree.ts`. `getFilesWithDepths` collects files; `sampleSize` picks 30 files to compute `avgTokensPerFileName`; `estimatedFilesToRemove` calculates bulk removal count. This avoids expensive `countTokensJson` calls in the `while` loop, speeding up pruning. `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` passes `fileTreeTokenBudget` to support the new logic.

a1b4ad89172ca55f1348017a4d8d39dd3b5cda4a.title: LRU cache added for token counting
a1b4ad89172ca55f1348017a4d8d39dd3b5cda4a.summary: LRU cache added to token counting. New common/src/util/lru-cache.ts provides generic LRUCache class. backend/src/util/token-counter.ts caches results for strings >100 chars, max 10k entries. Reduces repeated gpt-tokenizer encode calls.

b5c52c7eb19a457c5f45b98c9c9c70a105955b8c.title: Silent middleware option added for init action
b5c52c7eb19a457c5f45b98c9c9c70a105955b8c.summary: WebSocketMiddleware.execute and run accept options.silent to suppress sendAction on halt. init action now uses silent: true. Fingerprint records created on login-code-request.

60bf2430b1376d6a41ce65b65068580e9b361510.title: Disable project filetree prompt in agent system prompt
60bf2430b1376d6a41ce65b65068580e9b361510.summary: Commented out `getProjectFileTreePrompt` call and its inclusion in `getAgentSystemPrompt` in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Removes filetree from agent context window. Internal refactor.

6f966d91be4cdc45dacb1bff6d82a8c25c022f28.title: Add debug logs and lower slow-truncation threshold in
6f966d91be4cdc45dacb1bff6d82a8c25c022f28.summary: Added granular `logger.debug` calls at each truncation stage (A, unimportant-files, tokens, depth-based) in `backend/src/truncate-file-tree.ts` to track token budget adherence and duration. Lowered the warning threshold for slow file name truncation and pruning from 300ms to 100ms. Minor formatting updates applied to arrow functions and line breaks.

db4428789d250fcc5306448278c76cd6c840d597.title: Add iteration and progress guards to truncate-file-tree loop
db4428789d250fcc5306448278c76cd6c840d597.summary: truncateFileTreeBasedOnTokenBudget in backend/src/truncate-file-tree.ts adds MAX_ITERATIONS=10 and a previousTokenCount check to prevent infinite loops during token-budget truncation. The loop now breaks early if currentTokenCount >= previousTokenCount, logging a warning via logger.warn. Scope is backend only; no user-facing surfaces change. Iteration count and token deltas are logged when the guard trips.

e509ba2aca5614762173531ddb6cdc06a8811d25.title: Replace MinHeap with sorted array in token pruning
e509ba2aca5614762173531ddb6cdc06a8811d25.summary: Refactor `pruneFileTokenScores` in `backend/src/truncate-file-tree.ts` to replace `MinHeap` with a sorted array and heuristic batching. This change optimizes performance by reducing expensive `printFileTreeWithTokens` loop iterations via estimated token removals. The function now returns an object containing `pruned`, `printedTree`, and `tokenCount` instead of just the pruned scores.

7951ebc176382f24ef2511c6ace5aa7d79107e79.title: Add count-edit-file script for 24h edit metrics
7951ebc176382f24ef2511c6ace5aa7d79107e79.summary: New internal tooling script scripts/count-edit-file.ts added. It queries the message table for entries finished in last 24 hours. Counts occurrences of '</edit_file>' in responses to derive edit volume metrics.

6f966d91be4cdc45dacb1bff6d82a8c25c022f28.text: The system now watches its own speed more closely and warns if it takes longer than a short moment to organize files. This helps the team spot and fix delays, so you get a smoother experience.

7951ebc176382f24ef2511c6ace5aa7d79107e79.text: The team added a small internal tool that counts how many edits the assistant made in the last day. This helps them track usage, but it does not change how you use the product.

60bf2430b1376d6a41ce65b65068580e9b361510.text: The assistant no longer sees a list of your project files when answering. This internal change simplifies its processing but may affect how it references specific files.

db4428789d250fcc5306448278c76cd6c840d597.text: The system now stops trying to shorten long files if it makes no progress. This small internal fix prevents the assistant from getting stuck.

a1b4ad89172ca55f1348017a4d8d39dd3b5cda4a.text: The assistant now remembers the length of long text it has already measured. This saves time when you ask about the same long text again.

3ca6b55ace5ede8cf3f1a41e5015703262facf2d.text: The system now records how long it takes to prepare instructions for the assistant. This small internal change helps the team spot delays, but you will not notice any difference in the app.

e509ba2aca5614762173531ddb6cdc06a8811d25.text: The system now uses a simpler method to manage memory, making it faster and more efficient. This small internal update helps the assistant respond more quickly without changing how you use it.

c489f830d43b132f01281dd53e0ab72b8f6f3702.text: The system now estimates how much text to remove instead of checking every item one by one. This makes the assistant respond faster.

b5c52c7eb19a457c5f45b98c9c9c70a105955b8c.text: A small internal change prevents a hidden background message from appearing when a login step stops early.

9ede9cd45c61f6a1eb816f77cb2cce008aec2574.title: Remove redundant src/util mkdir in npm-app postbuild
9ede9cd45c61f6a1eb816f77cb2cce008aec2574.summary: The `postbuild` script in `npm-app/package.json` no longer creates `dist/common/src/util`. This directory was likely unnecessary or created as a side effect of copying `../common/dist/*` into `dist/common`. The change affects the build process for the `npm-app` package.

4368a1be6570f488ca878e48b010b24e9145d0ef.title: Include message history in planning prompt
4368a1be6570f488ca878e48b010b24e9145d0ef.summary: planComplexChange in backend/src/planning.ts now accepts messageHistory and injects prior turns into the reasoning prompt. backend/src/main-prompt.ts passes the messages array to the planner. This ensures the planning agent has full conversational context when generating solutions.

49c035e7ff9f11a5874099b6391ff2156a17408c.title: Tiered file tree truncation with AI feedback
49c035e7ff9f11a5874099b6391ff2156a17408c.summary: File tree truncation logic in `truncate-file-tree.ts` now uses a four-level fallback strategy: full tree, removal of unimportant files, removal of token counts, and finally depth-based pruning. The `getProjectFileTreePrompt` function in `system-prompt.ts` injects specific notes into the context to inform the AI which truncation level was applied. This replaces the previous binary fallback that often discarded too much structure. Internal docs in `knowledge.md` updated to reflect the new hierarchy.

c1a6261cf3828b9ede5029cb129403035755c4af.title: codebuff bin name in npm-app package.json
c1a6261cf3828b9ede5029cb129403035755c4af.summary: bin key in npm-app/package.json now maps codebuff to dist/index.js. Previous codecane entry was a typo. No migration or behavior change for existing installs.

a754368804d5909f4b9b52fafbbe3c5c26228d83.title: Fixed file tree budget in agent prompt
a754368804d5909f4b9b52fafbbe3c5c26228d83.summary: Agent system prompt enforces fixed token budgets for files (100k/25k lite) and file tree (20k/5k lite), removing dynamic calculation and conditional exclusion. Search prompt increments adjusted from 30k to 20k. Scope: backend/src/main-prompt.ts, backend/src/system-prompt.ts.

516276fff8cc25ae3416775e22882d6188d62508.title: truncateFileTreeBasedOnTokenBudget extracted to truncate-file-tree.ts
516276fff8cc25ae3416775e22882d6188d62508.summary: Refactor moves `truncateFileTreeBasedOnTokenBudget` and helpers from `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to new `backend/src/truncate-file-tree.ts`. `system-prompt.ts` imports the function; `FileTreeNode`, `printFileTree`, `printFileTreeWithTokens` imports relocated. Fixes TOC numbering in `backend/knowledge.md` (Automatic URL Detection section 12->13). Internal cleanup; no user-visible behavior change.

bc997875003b3b3b68eb16f8b0cf7b71ca97f91d.title: Update knowledge file prompt instructions
bc997875003b3b3b68eb16f8b0cf7b71ca97f91d.summary: Modified `getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to explicitly forbid adding commentary or justification when updating knowledge files. The existing instruction now mandates silent updates, aligning with the directive to avoid unnecessary prose in internal documentation. This change applies to the backend main prompt logic.

444163bb826361a61851ee8a3ad30109d98c0ca4.title: Fix terminal timeout for silent commands
444163bb826361a61851ee8a3ad30109d98c0ca4.summary: Silent commands no longer hang the terminal. `runCommandPty` in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` now wraps commands with shell conditionals to detect completion. `npm-app/knowledge.md` documents the new ANSI color and exit code handling.

bb02aa5925d19c1d2dd7ddf2b8956ffa5a54e687.title: Add browser automation with Puppeteer and auto-screenshot handling
bb02aa5925d19c1d2dd7ddf2b8956ffa5a54e687.summary: Implemented `browser_action` tool using Puppeteer for web interaction and debugging. Added `screenshot-formatter.ts` and `parse-tool-call-xml.ts` to handle XML-based browser instructions and convert screenshots to image blocks. Updated `claude.ts`, `deepseek-api.ts`, `gemini-api.ts`, and `openai-api.ts` to strip unsupported image blocks from messages before API calls, preventing token errors.

4368a1be6570f488ca878e48b010b24e9145d0ef.text: The assistant now considers past messages when planning tasks. This helps it understand the full conversation and provide better answers.

444163bb826361a61851ee8a3ad30109d98c0ca4.text: A small internal fix stops the app from getting stuck when certain quiet tasks finish. You no longer need to wait for these tasks to time out.

49c035e7ff9f11a5874099b6391ff2156a17408c.text: The assistant now keeps more file structure visible when lists get too long, instead of cutting off large chunks at once. This means you see a clearer, more complete view of your project files.

bc997875003b3b3b68eb16f8b0cf7b71ca97f91d.text: The assistant was told to update internal notes without adding extra explanations. This small change keeps the background information clean and quiet, so you won't see unnecessary comments from it.

9ede9cd45c61f6a1eb816f77cb2cce008aec2574.text: The software build process stopped creating an unnecessary folder. This small internal cleanup does not affect how you use the product.

bb02aa5925d19c1d2dd7ddf2b8956ffa5a54e687.text: The assistant can now open web pages, interact with them, and take screenshots. It automatically removes unsupported image data before sending requests, preventing errors.

c1a6261cf3828b9ede5029cb129403035755c4af.text: A small internal fix corrects a typo in the launch command name. This change has no effect on how you use the product.

2ca353455a6a76e88fd67336af97e4b96b222a68.text: The assistant now uses a newer, faster model for streaming responses. A previous setting that limited memory usage was removed, so the assistant can handle larger amounts of text.

a754368804d5909f4b9b52fafbbe3c5c26228d83.text: The assistant now uses a fixed size limit for listing files. This makes its behavior more predictable and prevents it from changing how it handles large projects.

516276fff8cc25ae3416775e22882d6188d62508.text: The team reorganized the internal code to make it cleaner and easier to maintain. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

eb5d673adb9d351e45298296a763562714171376.title: Fix stream delay and tool call prompt
eb5d673adb9d351e45298296a763562714171376.summary: processStreamWithTags now breaks immediately after streamCompleted to prevent token waste. System prompt clarifies that tool calls are delegations requiring no extra text.

9cf3bfbcac4396e5329c43788753a9ad73f98f26.title: Bump @anthropic-ai/sdk to ^0.36.3 in backend
9cf3bfbcac4396e5329c43788753a9ad73f98f26.summary: Update @anthropic-ai/sdk dependency from ^0.33.1 to ^0.36.3 in backend/package.json. Reflects upstream SDK version increment for Anthropic API integration. Scope limited to backend package dependencies and bun.lockb. No user-facing behavior changes expected.

54bb40a1c63b9cdf52197e89290141ffd441de0b.title: Remove debug logging in getSearchSystemPrompt
54bb40a1c63b9cdf52197e89290141ffd441de0b.summary: Deleted stray `console.log` call in `getSearchSystemPrompt` within `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Prevents unnecessary stdout noise during search prompt generation. Scope limited to backend system prompt logic.

c5e75252efbb9d315d2d643f8129097d798bdcfe.title: Delete obsolete knowledge docs
c5e75252efbb9d315d2d643f8129097d798bdcfe.summary: Removed `modes.knowledge.md`, `musings.knowledge.md`, and `todo.knowledge.md` from repository root. Files contained outdated implementation plans and scratch notes for legacy Codebuff/Manicode features. Pure documentation cleanup; no runtime code or config changes.

051c20c7cb2a698c7ae81ab6bb539b8440308006.title: promptClaudeStream and promptDeepseekStream return ReadableStream
051c20c7cb2a698c7ae81ab6bb539b8440308006.summary: backend/src/claude.ts and backend/src/deepseek-api.ts now return ReadableStream<string> from promptClaudeStream and promptDeepseekStream. AsyncGenerator return type replaced with ReadableStream wrapper in main-prompt.ts. ReadableStream prevents premature cancellation of underlying base streams. Internal refactor, no user-facing behavior change.

0c5ab268c64244b8fb2f0566438ed23461136b32.title: Add build scripts to backend and scripts packages
0c5ab268c64244b8fb2f0566438ed23461136b32.summary: Added `build` script to `backend/package.json` running `tsc` and `tsc-alias`. Updated root `package.json` workspaces to include `scripts`. Renamed `scripts/package.json` name to `codebuff-scripts` and updated its `typecheck` script to depend on `common` and `backend` builds. This ensures typechecking in the scripts package validates against compiled backend types.

66ee89f3bf9e919512c71bfd9c77c523556375b6.title: Fix prompt overflow via Anthropic token fudge factor
66ee89f3bf9e919512c71bfd9c77c523556375b6.summary: Token counting now applies a 1.35x multiplier to Anthropic models to prevent prompt overflow, as Anthropic encodes tokens less efficiently than GPT-4o. System prompt budgeting reduced misc tokens from 20k to 10k and quantized file tree budgets to 30k increments to preserve caching. Empty directories are skipped in file tree generation, and 'go' added to skipped terminal commands. Changes in backend/src/util/token-counter.ts, backend/src/system-prompt.ts, common/src/constants.ts, common/src/util/file.ts.

6a47827d9d8c4751aefe4c42e306352b10b62412.title: System prompt symbol pruning uses min heap
6a47827d9d8c4751aefe4c42e306352b10b62412.summary: System prompt generation now prunes symbols by score using a new `MinHeap` utility in `common/src/util/min-heap.ts`. This replaces previous file-based sorting logic in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` with an O(n log k) approach for better performance. The change affects core prompt assembly logic, removing lodash `sortBy` dependency in favor of custom heap operations.

3be38cadbf028f05ba3e84a6299acc75f85a1636.title: Condense web knowledge documentation
3be38cadbf028f05ba3e84a6299acc75f85a1636.summary: Rewrote web/knowledge.md to remove verbose UI pattern descriptions, component architecture details, and security considerations. Reduced file size from 1159 to 172 lines by stripping redundant guidance on terminal components, plan types, and code snippets. Scope limited to documentation file. No code logic or API behavior changed.

d239ea8241ac4466117233c7a83692154e11fee9.title: plancomplexchange applies file edits
d239ea8241ac4466117233c7a83692154e11fee9.summary: plan_complex_change now parses file blocks and applies edits via processFileBlock instead of returning text only. main-prompt.ts collects fileProcessingPromises from planning.ts, and system-prompt.ts updates tool description.

3be38cadbf028f05ba3e84a6299acc75f85a1636.text: The team shortened their internal guide about how the website looks and works. Nothing changed for you; the website behaves exactly as it did before.

54bb40a1c63b9cdf52197e89290141ffd441de0b.text: A small internal cleanup removed extra notes the system was creating while preparing search results. It does not affect how the product works.

c5e75252efbb9d315d2d643f8129097d798bdcfe.text: The team removed old internal notes about past features. This is a small housekeeping task. Nothing changes about how the product works.

0c5ab268c64244b8fb2f0566438ed23461136b32.text: The team improved internal tools to catch errors earlier. This change does not affect how you use the product.

6a47827d9d8c4751aefe4c42e306352b10b62412.text: The assistant now picks the most useful information for its responses using a faster, smarter method. This makes the system more efficient behind the scenes.

9cf3bfbcac4396e5329c43788753a9ad73f98f26.text: A small internal update improved how the system connects to the AI service. Users will not notice any changes.

66ee89f3bf9e919512c71bfd9c77c523556375b6.text: The assistant now counts words differently for some models to prevent messages from getting too long and failing. This change also reduces the size of background information sent with each request, making responses slightly faster and more reliable.

d239ea8241ac4466117233c7a83692154e11fee9.text: The assistant can now directly apply changes to your files, rather than just suggesting them in text. This makes it easier to update documents without manually copying and pasting.

051c20c7cb2a698c7ae81ab6bb539b8440308006.text: The system now keeps connections to AI models open longer to prevent interruptions. This internal update improves reliability but does not change how the product looks or works for users.

eb5d673adb9d351e45298296a763562714171376.text: The assistant now stops generating text immediately after it finishes a task, preventing unnecessary delays. It also avoids adding extra filler text when it hands off work to other tools.

b0d70e9344fccd4622e0394b2cacbb63f28e63d8.title: Landing page UI polish
b0d70e9344fccd4622e0394b2cacbb63f28e63d8.summary: CookieConsentCard, navbar, and banner components updated. Changes include max-width constraints, spacing adjustments, and text size tweaks. Scope limited to web/src/components/CookieConsentCard.tsx, web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx, and web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx.

470ac84747b03409b6f2611bf9283f20bdf4bfa1.title: Remove forced agent mode bypass after planning
470ac84747b03409b6f2611bf9283f20bdf4bfa1.summary: Removed conditional bypass for `checkToAllowUnboundedIteration` when `assistantIsExecutingPlan` is true in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Agent mode is no longer forced after planning. Added `start-codebuff-test` script to `package.json`.

107cb74b7a12f53e82ef48b7ff94a83f2a15bae1.title: CLI completion message mentions undo command
107cb74b7a12f53e82ef48b7ff94a83f2a15bae1.summary: Completion message updated to mention `undo` alongside `diff`. Mechanism: `npm-app/src/cli.ts` string replacement. Scope: CLI only. Detail: whitespace cleanup in token matching logic.

7744bdfb31ecec854ee534f08a61c9efa3dddee8.title: Add reasoningEffort option to OpenAI backend
7744bdfb31ecec854ee534f08a61c9efa3dddee8.summary: OpenAI backend gains `reasoningEffort` parameter. Default `medium` replaces hardcoded `high`. `planning.ts` explicitly sets `high` for o3-mini.

84b162580ec88b3547c69a8d9a12db719b78c5a0.title: Add analyze-model-usage script
84b162580ec88b3547c69a8d9a12db719b78c5a0.summary: New `scripts/analyze-model-usage.ts` aggregates model usage stats. Queries last 10k messages via `schema.message`. Calculates count, avg tokens, cost, and credits per model. Internal tooling addition.

c8664912289388e1b560b64150fa34691f4f6f03.title: Make tab completion case-insensitive
c8664912289388e1b560b64150fa34691f4f6f03.summary: Tab completion in npm-app/src/cli.ts now matches tokens case-insensitively. The filter and common-prefix logic lowercases both the input and candidate tokens before comparing. Affects the CLI's token and path matching.

5e9ae33025fefa1f49a0080f8325e2eb22c67e73.title: Remove cheerio, add raw.githubusercontent.com direct fetch
5e9ae33025fefa1f49a0080f8325e2eb22c67e73.summary: Removed `cheerio` dependency from `npm-app/package.json` and `npm-app/src/web-scraper.ts`. `scrapeWebPage` now detects `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/` URLs and fetches them directly via `axios`, bypassing the `https://r.jina.ai/` proxy used for other pages. This change is scoped to the web scraper subsystem in the npm app.

1e76e4dac70f2d76f74309a5050cdfeee74db946.title: Add script to export user emails
1e76e4dac70f2d76f74309a5050cdfeee74db946.summary: Added scripts/export-user-emails.ts to extract user email, name, creation date, and subscription status from the database. The script queries schema.user via common/db, formats results into CSV with proper field escaping, and writes to a timestamped file.

50c6ad5fbee31d741b783327a0547e32812f951a.title: Refactor cli.ts initialization and event handling
50c6ad5fbee31d741b783327a0547e32812f951a.summary: Extracted inline readline setup, signal handlers, and completer logic from the CLI constructor into dedicated private methods like `initReadlineInterface`, `setupSignalHandlers`, and `completer`. Moved `FileChanges` import alongside `Message` and removed the standalone `rewriteLine` helper. Updated `rl` property to use definite assignment assertion (`!`) to satisfy TypeScript strict mode during initialization. This structural cleanup improves maintainability of the `npm-app/src/cli.ts` entry point.

ef186f3b409f355dbb77ea735512328b5800af7e.title: Replace o1 with o3-mini in planning and cost tracking
ef186f3b409f355dbb77ea735512328b5800af7e.summary: Switched the thinking model from o1 to o3-mini (o3-mini-2025-01-31) in planning.ts and constants.ts. Updated message-cost-tracker.ts with new input/output token rates for o3-mini and added cached_tokens handling in openai-api.ts to subtract cache reads from input tokens. Removed costMode 'max' gating for plan_complex_change in system-prompt.ts and main-prompt.ts, making planning tool usage universal.

b0d70e9344fccd4622e0394b2cacbb63f28e63d8.text: The website's layout was adjusted to improve spacing and text size. These small visual changes make the page easier to read.

1e76e4dac70f2d76f74309a5050cdfeee74db946.text: Added an internal tool to export user email lists. This helps staff manage accounts, but nothing changes for you.

7744bdfb31ecec854ee534f08a61c9efa3dddee8.text: The assistant now uses less thinking power by default, making it faster. It still uses full thinking power for complex planning tasks.

ef186f3b409f355dbb77ea735512328b5800af7e.text: The assistant switched to a faster thinking model that costs less. It now uses this model for all planning tasks, removing previous restrictions on complex changes.

84b162580ec88b3547c69a8d9a12db719b78c5a0.text: A small internal tool now tracks how much the service uses different AI models. This helps the team understand usage patterns and costs, but does not change how the product works for users.

107cb74b7a12f53e82ef48b7ff94a83f2a15bae1.text: The program now mentions an undo option when it finishes a task. This small change helps you know you can reverse the action.

5e9ae33025fefa1f49a0080f8325e2eb22c67e73.text: The system now reads certain website text files directly instead of going through a middleman. This makes loading those specific pages faster and more reliable.

c8664912289388e1b560b64150fa34691f4f6f03.text: The assistant now ignores capitalization when completing commands. You can type the first few letters in any case, and it will find the right match.

50c6ad5fbee31d741b783327a0547e32812f951a.text: Developers cleaned up the program's internal setup to make it easier to maintain. You will not notice any changes in how the product works.

cceae9af9f1c1ba4dedda9e5c9c4eb9f52db34af.title: Ignore .codebuff hidden folder in .gitignore
cceae9af9f1c1ba4dedda9e5c9c4eb9f52db34af.summary: Added `.codebuff*` to `.gitignore` to exclude hidden `.codebuff` folders from version control. This prevents local agent state files from being accidentally committed. Affects repository configuration only.

9a8d233f9d196c46a2a08800bd6189cb69e57e27.title: system-prompt: codesearch for refs, .md planning files
9a8d233f9d196c46a2a08800bd6189cb69e57e27.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts swaps grep for code_search when locating references to modified exported tokens. Adds directive for agent to create structured .md files during planning or design discussions. Internal prompt logic change. No user-facing surface or version impact.

a2ca0e6854a7f0277aebb2349edef399684dc49d.title: Enforce mandatory newlines in search/replace block parsing
a2ca0e6854a7f0277aebb2349edef399684dc49d.summary: The regex in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` now requires explicit newlines before `=======` and `>>>>>>> REPLACE` markers, removing optional newline matching. This ensures strict format compliance for AI-generated diffs and prevents parsing failures caused by malformed blocks.

977781bef1944811126532fcce0e1466917d193d.title: runTerminalCommand reset shell instead of throw
977781bef1944811126532fcce0e1466917d193d.summary: runTerminalCommand in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts calls resetShell() when commandIsRunning is true, replacing the throw new Error('Command is already running'). Prevents errors on concurrent commands. Scope limited to terminal utility.

e44611848fbe485b38121225957841582e0f3fff.title: Pricing page 3-blurb card styling
e44611848fbe485b38121225957841582e0f3fff.summary: Updated pricing page 3-blurb cards in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. Added dark mode support, increased padding, and added shadow hover effects. Internal styling refactor only.

c760ba147d16ef6b1f3eeb258be8c2c1b32dc445.title: Fix hydration error on referrals page
c760ba147d16ef6b1f3eeb258be8c2c1b32dc445.summary: Refactored JSX structure in `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` to resolve hydration mismatch. Removed redundant `CardContent` wrapper and nested `div` elements within the referral link section. Simplified `CardDescription` layout by stripping unnecessary flex container.

bec6f9e4270093a25d10f7897116369abbcc0c76.title: Tools system prompt restructure
bec6f9e4270093a25d10f7897116369abbcc0c76.summary: Reordered and consolidated tool usage guidelines in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Moved file editing restrictions to rule 6 and added note on silent command success. Updated phrasing for tool adherence.

7eee186cefc703e803978090a4db20e025ca825c.title: Fix --create path handling and add logs
7eee186cefc703e803978090a4db20e025ca825c.summary: The `--create` command now respects the provided path argument for project creation. `createTemplateProject` accepts a `projectDir` parameter, constructs the full `projectPath`, and creates parent directories recursively if missing. Added console logs for template downloading, git initialization, and final success status. This change affects `npm-app/src/create-template-project.ts` and `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

88cf03f9da7b2def88a04a55f0a38c5f8118912a.title: calculate-mrr script now counts pastdue subscriptions
88cf03f9da7b2def88a04a55f0a38c5f8118912a.summary: calculate-mrr.ts adds a second pagination loop for Stripe subscriptions with status 'past_due', accumulating totalPastDueMRR and totalPastDueInvoices separately from active subscriptions. Previously the script only queried active subscriptions, undercounting MRR when payments failed but the subscription remained in a past_due state. Scope limited to scripts/calculate-mrr.ts; calculate-average-spend.ts received formatting cleanup and a ts-pattern import but no behavioral change. Past due base prices are matched via item.price.recurring?.usage_type === 'licensed', identical to the active subscription logic.

d7aef9b715aaeade4eb8eefb2440d42902ba6835.title: Fix CLI paste handling and readline buffer
