d7aef9b715aaeade4eb8eefb2440d42902ba6835.summary: CLI paste handling and readline buffer fixed. Logic prevents double-space-to-newline conversion during active paste sessions. Internal readline buffer clearing syntax adjusted. Scope limited to npm-app/src/cli.ts.

88cf03f9da7b2def88a04a55f0a38c5f8118912a.text: The system now counts subscriptions that are past due, which were previously missed. This means the reported monthly revenue is more accurate.

cceae9af9f1c1ba4dedda9e5c9c4eb9f52db34af.text: Small internal update. The system now keeps private helper files out of the shared project history. This stops accidental clutter but changes nothing about how you use the product.

977781bef1944811126532fcce0e1466917d193d.text: The system now prevents errors when multiple commands run at once. This small internal update keeps the tool stable without changing how you use it.

c760ba147d16ef6b1f3eeb258be8c2c1b32dc445.text: Fixed a bug that caused the referral page to display incorrectly. This small internal update ensures the page looks and works as expected for everyone.

d7aef9b715aaeade4eb8eefb2440d42902ba6835.text: Fixed a small internal issue where pasting text could create unexpected line breaks.

9a8d233f9d196c46a2a08800bd6189cb69e57e27.text: The assistant now finds related files more accurately when you change something. It also creates organized notes during complex tasks.

e44611848fbe485b38121225957841582e0f3fff.text: The pricing page cards now look better in dark mode and have a subtle shadow when you hover over them. This is a small visual update that does not change how the pricing information works.

a2ca0e6854a7f0277aebb2349edef399684dc49d.text: The system now strictly checks that AI-generated text changes follow a specific format. This prevents errors when applying those changes.

7eee186cefc703e803978090a4db20e025ca825c.text: The tool now creates projects in the exact folder you specify, automatically making any missing parent folders along the way. It also shows clear progress messages during setup.

5e5220c6dffa13ae7d95ffd94a43619e9b01530a.title: Clear readline buffer on Ctrl-C
5e5220c6dffa13ae7d95ffd94a43619e9b01530a.summary: Ctrl-C handling in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now explicitly clears the internal `readline` line buffer (`this.rl.line = ''`) before processing stop/response logic. This prevents stale input text from persisting in the terminal UI after an interrupt. Scope limited to CLI interface layer. Relies on internal `readline` API property access.

d5bd30c076875dd76f7b58a21c0470f3d5bcdee9.title: misc token budget doubled to 20k in system-prompt.ts
d5bd30c076875dd76f7b58a21c0470f3d5bcdee9.summary: miscTokens constant increased from 10,000 to 20,000 in backend/src/system-prompt.ts. Reduces systemPromptTokenBudget for getSearchSystemPrompt. Temporary fix for misc token constraints.

27245ad41e46a001880f7d7b06fbdcf1fff1d472.title: Strengthen git push prohibition in system prompt
27245ad41e46a001880f7d7b06fbdcf1fff1d472.summary: Updated backend/src/system-prompt.ts to explicitly prohibit git push due to production breakage risk. Consolidated file modification and global installation warnings into a single rule requiring explicit permission. Adjusted guidance to instruct users to manually run long-running commands instead of attempting them.

480d5741a0687e926e8a97b5ccee533b6dad3d0d.title: CLI Ctrl+C now kills running terminal commands
480d5741a0687e926e8a97b5ccee533b6dad3d0d.summary: CLI SIGINT handler now calls resetShell() to terminate active terminal processes before stopping response generation. Terminal utilities refactored from createPty to createPersistentProcess, adding isCommandRunning state tracking and explicit timer cleanup in resetShell. Double-SIGINT exit window extended from 3 to 5 seconds in cli.ts. Covers npm-app/src/cli.ts, npm-app/src/index.ts, and npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts.

6bd57ae3a33672c64efd35999acf71854863c8ee.title: Fix system prompt caching for --max mode
6bd57ae3a33672c64efd35999acf71854863c8ee.summary: Updated warmCacheForRequestRelevantFiles in backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts to use getModelForMode(costMode, 'file-requests') instead of hardcoded claudeModels.haiku. Ensures cache warming matches the active cost mode, preventing cache misses when using --max. Also tightened getRelevantFiles signature to require explicit costMode.

85ecb13c084669f3761230d6bf70e9b1459bd66e.title: Add --version and -v flags to CLI
85ecb13c084669f3761230d6bf70e9b1459bd66e.summary: Added --version and -v flags to the CLI entrypoint in npm-app/src/index.ts. The flags read the version from package.json and print it to stdout before exiting. Help text updated to document the new flags.

db699f21fa45574829ffb3f33bbadd1e9b5d6606.title: Add /discord redirect route in web config
db699f21fa45574829ffb3f33bbadd1e9b5d6606.summary: Added a permanent: false redirect for /discord to https://discord.gg/mcWTGjgTj3 in web/next.config.mjs. This enables a short, branded link for the Freebuff Discord community. Scope limited to web Next.js config.

8439268878175b5567899e1fcac22e4ed520037a.title: Refactor runTerminalCommand to split PTY and child process
8439268878175b5567899e1fcac22e4ed520037a.summary: Refactored `runTerminalCommand` in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` by extracting PTY and child_process execution paths into separate `runCommandPty` and `runCommandChildProcess` functions. The main function now acts as a dispatcher based on `persistentProcess.type`. `MAX_EXECUTION_TIME` was moved to module scope to be shared by both implementations.

e1a0031a517a37010bc8638bd002d61499c559fb.title: --create auto-cds and runs codebuff
e1a0031a517a37010bc8638bd002d61499c559fb.summary: createTemplateProject now calls process.chdir(projectName) and execSync('codebuff') instead of printing manual cd/codebuff instructions. Eliminates manual steps after scaffolding. Affects npm-app/src/create-template-project.ts.

34f77ef4ed2a509623586b69f494640e8ddef825.title: Add calculate-dau script
34f77ef4ed2a509623586b69f494640e8ddef825.summary: New `scripts/calculate-dau.ts` computes daily active users over last 7 days. Uses `drizzle-orm` to query `message` table, grouping by `finished_at` date and counting distinct `user_id` or `fingerprint_id`. Internal tooling only.

34f77ef4ed2a509623586b69f494640e8ddef825.text: The team added an internal tool to count how many people use the app each day. This helps them track activity, but you will not see any changes in the product.

6bd57ae3a33672c64efd35999acf71854863c8ee.text: Fixed an internal error where the assistant sometimes used the wrong model in 'max' mode. This makes responses more consistent for users selecting that setting.

27245ad41e46a001880f7d7b06fbdcf1fff1d472.text: The assistant now blocks actions that could accidentally break the live system. It will ask for permission before making changes or installing tools.

8439268878175b5567899e1fcac22e4ed520037a.text: The code that runs commands in the terminal was reorganized to be cleaner and easier to manage. This internal change makes the system more stable but does not add new features or change how you use the product.

5e5220c6dffa13ae7d95ffd94a43619e9b01530a.text: Pressing the stop button now clears any leftover text from the input box. This keeps the screen tidy after interrupting a request.

480d5741a0687e926e8a97b5ccee533b6dad3d0d.text: Pressing Ctrl+C now fully stops long-running background tasks. This prevents processes from lingering after you cancel a request.

85ecb13c084669f3761230d6bf70e9b1459bd66e.text: The command-line tool now shows its version when asked. This helps users check which version they have installed.

e1a0031a517a37010bc8638bd002d61499c559fb.text: The setup tool now automatically starts the project builder after creating a new project. This removes the need to manually type extra commands to get started.

db699f21fa45574829ffb3f33bbadd1e9b5d6606.text: A new link now sends visitors to the community chat. This makes it easier for users to join the discussion without memorizing a long address.

d5bd30c076875dd76f7b58a21c0470f3d5bcdee9.text: The assistant can now use more background instructions when answering search questions. This change is internal and helps prevent answers from getting cut off.

d28b3d5117c3e80bd5007c13033a2edfc1081858.title: Error handling for gitignore checks
d28b3d5117c3e80bd5007c13033a2edfc1081858.summary: Added try/catch block around `ig.ignores` call in `getFiles` to handle exceptions during gitignore evaluation. Errors result in `[ERROR_LOADING_FILE]` status instead of crashing. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`.

7001a8a4f4662ef982f45b3232f66d973be151aa.title: Add warning to runterminalcommand system prompt
7001a8a4f4662ef982f45b3232f66d973be151aa.summary: Added a warning to the `run_terminal_command` tool description in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The warning instructs the model to use the tool sparingly, avoid running commands beyond what the user asked for, and be careful with commands that could have permanent effects. This change is internal and affects the backend system prompt.

469ff525a232701bf55e36a2cce6174500cfba54.title: Lite mode runs non-obvious file request
469ff525a232701bf55e36a2cce6174500cfba54.summary: requestRelevantFiles in backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts now always issues the non-obvious file request, removing the `costMode !== 'lite'` gate. Lite mode `countPerRequest` raised from 7 to 8 to match standard. Prompt text consolidated into explicit exclusion lists for test files and `knowledge.md`.

7736bf8c71d2c5a5423312f7ca7527e8c58a083f.title: Docs restructure: Intro/Advanced sections, FAQ expansion
7736bf8c71d2c5a5423312f7ca7527e8c58a083f.summary: Web docs sidebar splits into Intro, Advanced, and Project Showcase sections. Three files (how-does-it-work, large-projects, what-models) move from help/tips to new advanced/ category. FAQ gains usage and trust questions; getting-started drops --lite/--max flags for --create template command. keyboard-shortcuts renames to Special commands under tips.

05e0047e93e5b1604d9473f8fe69e71bb3babb2f.title: Add Other use cases tips doc
05e0047e93e5b1604d9473f8fe69e71bb3babb2f.summary: Added web/src/content/tips/other-use-cases.mdx with 108 lines of example commands for Code Review, Git Workflow, Codebase Questions, Script Generation, Documentation, Configuration, and SQL. Covers non-coding workflows via natural language prompts. Includes tips for better results and knowledge.md usage.

1a070f6016b016b407870b0869f2243ef024ad44.title: CLI double space converts to newline
1a070f6016b016b407870b0869f2243ef024ad44.summary: Added logic in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to detect double spaces and convert them to newlines. The `keypress` handler now checks if the previous two characters are spaces and inserts a newline if true. This change affects the CLI input handling mechanism.

c3285d6f774d056d14008c9b204f0f9fe321e922.title: Add --create flag for project templates
c3285d6f774d056d14008c9b204f0f9fe321e922.summary: Introduces `--create <template> [name]` CLI flag to initialize projects from community templates. New `create-template-project.ts` clones `CodebuffAI/codebuff-community`, copies `starter-templates` or `showcase` dirs, strips `.git`, and runs `npm install` if lockfile exists. `chat-storage.ts` guards against missing project root to prevent crash in non-project contexts. Updates `index.ts` help text and `knowledge.md` docs.

83a09ad6b4de35a8bbb483183d90a4b88ceb8b2c.title: Restore cursor on exit and hide during loading
83a09ad6b4de35a8bbb483183d90a4b88ceb8b2c.summary: Added cursor visibility management to CLI. Hides cursor via ANSI escape `\u001B[?25l` during "Thinking..." spinner and restores it via `\u001B[?25h` on exit, SIGTERM, or animation stop. Prevents terminal from remaining without cursor after interruption. Updates `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and documents behavior in `npm-app/knowledge.md`.

3be2d5e260318c6283a0f4ca94e73d15d7a14776.title: Enforce CLI login for anonymous users
3be2d5e260318c6283a0f4ca94e73d15d7a14776.summary: CLI startup now blocks anonymous sessions, forcing `client.login()` before prompt rendering if no user exists. Login code expiration extended from 5 minutes to 1 hour in `websocket-action.ts` to accommodate this flow. `displayGreeting` moved to `menu.ts`, consolidating cost mode and git warnings for authenticated users only. Logout logic in `client.ts` wrapped in try/catch to prevent crashes when credentials file is missing.

7647f19829affd7dd786eb8e665bad501c034bd2.title: Support read-only ~/.knowledge.md user files
7647f19829affd7dd786eb8e665bad501c034bd2.summary: Agent injects `~/.knowledge.md` files from user home into system prompt context. `ProjectFileContextSchema` adds optional `userKnowledgeFiles` field; `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` scans `os.homedir()` for `*knowledge.md` files via `findKnowledgeFilesInDir`. Backend `system-prompt.ts` marks these files read-only, forbidding `<edit_file>` blocks; `main-prompt.ts` and `getResponseFormatPrompt` update `hasKnowledgeFiles` checks to include user files. Scope: `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`, `common/src/util/file.ts`, `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`.

7001a8a4f4662ef982f45b3232f66d973be151aa.text: The assistant received new instructions to be more careful when running computer commands. It will now ask for permission before doing anything risky and will avoid taking actions you did not specifically request.

7736bf8c71d2c5a5423312f7ca7527e8c58a083f.text: Help pages now group guides into beginner, advanced, and showcase sections. Frequently asked questions cover more usage topics, and getting-started instructions simplified template creation.

83a09ad6b4de35a8bbb483183d90a4b88ceb8b2c.text: The blinking text cursor now hides while the app works and returns when it stops. If the app closes unexpectedly, the cursor will still appear.

1a070f6016b016b407870b0869f2243ef024ad44.text: The text box now turns two spaces in a row into a new line. This lets you separate your thoughts without pressing the Enter key.

469ff525a232701bf55e36a2cce6174500cfba54.text: The assistant now always looks at an extra document to find answers. This helps it understand your question better.

7647f19829affd7dd786eb8e665bad501c034bd2.text: The assistant now reads your personal knowledge notes. It can use them for context but cannot change them.

c3285d6f774d056d14008c9b204f0f9fe321e922.text: A new option lets you start a project by picking from ready-made examples. It sets up the basic files for you so you don't have to build them from scratch.

05e0047e93e5b1604d9473f8fe69e71bb3babb2f.text: The assistant can now give you better tips for everyday tasks like checking work, organizing files, or writing instructions. This helps you get clearer answers without needing technical skills.

d28b3d5117c3e80bd5007c13033a2edfc1081858.text: The app now handles certain errors better. If it has trouble checking which files to ignore, it shows a warning instead of crashing.

3be2d5e260318c6283a0f4ca94e73d15d7a14776.text: The app now requires you to sign in before using it. This ensures you see personalized features and prevents errors if your login details are missing.

fc4c81c5f3a695cf6ce2c4560759f6ff7768c41c.title: Update local development setup instructions
fc4c81c5f3a695cf6ce2c4560759f6ff7768c41c.summary: README.md now mandates sequential package builds (common, code-map, npm-app) before root dependency installation. npm-app/knowledge.md adds required stack.env and .env.local configuration templates for local execution.

1a7bc28151c8ef7ccb58e9741b68fd1f69cc8686.title: System prompt warns against unrequested npm install
1a7bc28151c8ef7ccb58e9741b68fd1f69cc8686.summary: Updated `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to explicitly caution against running `npm install` without user permission, directing the agent to check knowledge files for project-specific package manager instructions (e.g., pnpm, bun, yarn, pip). This change mitigates the risk of agents modifying `node_modules` or `package.json` unexpectedly. The scope is limited to the backend system prompt definition.

f627e2530a620022fb721b9d6f0be34357189220.title: Remove excess new lines from agent response
f627e2530a620022fb721b9d6f0be34357189220.summary:
Removed `onResponseChunk('

')` and `fullResponse += '

'` from `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This eliminates redundant whitespace injection in the agent's output stream. The change ensures cleaner formatting for responses generated via the prompt handling logic.

2a62e8508b74c8bb9fd33f63ee0d23fc234ca4e4.title: Remove NOCOLOR passthrough from terminal.ts
2a62e8508b74c8bb9fd33f63ee0d23fc234ca4e4.summary: Dropped NO_COLOR env var passthrough in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts. This stops the PTY from explicitly propagating NO_COLOR, relying on default inheritance instead. FORCE_COLOR remains hardcoded to 1.

5044119481cc47730f8f3f99f85675aff2043fc4.title: Skip terminal execution for single-quote inputs
5044119481cc47730f8f3f99f85675aff2043fc4.summary: CLI command execution logic now skips auto-running inputs containing single quotes. This prevents shell interpretation issues during terminal handling. The change updates `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to filter inputs with `'` alongside existing checks for 'error' and word count. `npm-app/knowledge.md` documents the new rule requiring explicit `/run` prefix for such inputs.

fe766691f1530ba4575701b060baf516fbba6c8e.title: Drop PSModulePath and CI env vars from terminal PTY
fe766691f1530ba4575701b060baf516fbba6c8e.summary: Removed PSModulePath and CI from environment config in createPty within npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts. PSModulePath was preserved for PowerShell modules, and CI was passed through for environment detection. This change simplifies the terminal environment setup by eliminating unnecessary variable propagation.

fea0adfa4b3a7a9380f3c4d8226242d47d4bb086.title: deepseek-reasoner added to lite agent
fea0adfa4b3a7a9380f3c4d8226242d47d4bb086.summary: deepseek-reasoner replaces deepseek-chat for --lite agent via main-prompt.ts. Uses DeepSeek beta endpoint for prefix prompts; omits temperature for reasoner. Cost tracking updated in message-cost-tracker.ts. Model constant added to common/src/constants.ts.

10e5042a46f8a5369982b00658fa1d39fdea0643.title: Deepseek timeout retries via withRetry
10e5042a46f8a5369982b00658fa1d39fdea0643.summary: Deepseek API calls wrapped in `withRetry` with 90s timeout. `Promise.race` rejects slow requests, retrying only on timeout errors, not API errors. Mechanism in `backend/src/deepseek-api.ts`, docs in `backend/knowledge.md`.

842a3c9fe971c84b9a74440c96a10f741ff14816.title: Docs MDX pipeline adds CodeDemo plugin and landing polish
842a3c9fe971c84b9a74440c96a10f741ff14816.summary: ContentLayer now registers `remarkCodeToCodeDemo` from `web/src/lib/remark-code-to-codedemo.ts` in `web/contentlayer.config.ts`, and `web/package.json` adds `@mdx-js/mdx`, `remark-mdx`, `remark-parse`, `remark-stringify`, `to-vfile`, `unified`, `unist-util-visit`, and `vfile-matter` dev dependencies. The web knowledge docs describe writing markdown code blocks instead of direct `CodeDemo` components for consistent styling and copy behavior, while the landing page and docs surfaces receive gradient, layout, and scroll-margin polish. Scope covers `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx`, `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx`, `web/src/content/help/frameworks.mdx`, `web/src/content/tips/large-projects.mdx`, `backend/knowledge.md`, and `common/src/db/schema.knowledge.md`. The plugin is wired with ContentLayer array syntax `remarkPlugins: [[remarkCodeToCodeDemo]]`, and docs headings use `scroll-mt-24` for anchor offset.

61893b46b9498b063a99cd33325ef541e74eec83.title: Add analyze-overages script for Stripe billing
61893b46b9498b063a99cd33325ef541e74eec83.summary: New `scripts/analyze-overages.ts` utility aggregates Stripe billing data to calculate customer overages. It iterates active subscriptions, checks tiered pricing on recent invoices, and computes overage amounts by comparing usage against base tier limits. The script outputs per-plan statistics, including total overage revenue, average overage per customer, and usage distribution buckets ($0-$50, $50-$100, $100+).

f627e2530a620022fb721b9d6f0be34357189220.text: The assistant now removes extra blank lines from its replies, making the text look neater.

1a7bc28151c8ef7ccb58e9741b68fd1f69cc8686.text: The assistant now checks for specific setup instructions before automatically installing software dependencies. This helps prevent unexpected changes to your project files.

fc4c81c5f3a695cf6ce2c4560759f6ff7768c41c.text: The internal setup guide was updated to require building parts in a specific order and adding configuration files. This change is small and internal, affecting only how the software is prepared for testing, not how you use it.

5044119481cc47730f8f3f99f85675aff2043fc4.text: The assistant no longer runs commands that contain single quotes automatically. You must type a specific command to run them. This prevents errors when the computer reads the text.

842a3c9fe971c84b9a74440c96a10f741ff14816.text: The website's help pages now display code examples with a consistent look and a built-in copy button. This change also fixes a scrolling issue so that clicking a link in the table of contents lands on the correct section without hiding the title.

fe766691f1530ba4575701b060baf516fbba6c8e.text: The app no longer sends extra setup instructions to the terminal window. This small internal cleanup simplifies how the terminal starts up.

61893b46b9498b063a99cd33325ef541e74eec83.text: The company added an internal tool to track how much extra customers pay when they use more than their plan allows. This helps the business understand spending patterns, but it does not change how the product works for you.

10e5042a46f8a5369982b00658fa1d39fdea0643.text: The system now retries if the assistant takes too long to answer, improving reliability for slow responses.

2a62e8508b74c8bb9fd33f63ee0d23fc234ca4e4.text: The software now lets your computer's color settings apply automatically to its text display. This internal cleanup ensures the program respects your system preferences without forcing specific colors.

fea0adfa4b3a7a9380f3c4d8226242d47d4bb086.text: The basic version of the assistant now uses a different thinking model. This change is internal, so the way you use the product stays the same.

0193b3a0d465ba1adf4ed441230b342e9ce781fb.title: Fix project root update in terminal cd command
0193b3a0d465ba1adf4ed441230b342e9ce781fb.summary: The `runTerminalCommand` function now updates the local `projectRoot` variable when a `cd` command is executed. Previously, `setProjectRoot` was called without updating the local reference, causing subsequent relative path resolutions within the same execution context to use stale root paths. This change ensures `projectRoot` reflects the new directory immediately after the `cd` command is processed. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`.

d9361f97059416156af3b2b2706f8c0ba49ae077.title: Fix toolcall tracking and update Haiku costs
d9361f97059416156af3b2b2706f8c0ba49ae077.summary: Updated @anthropic-ai/sdk to ^0.33.1 and adjusted Haiku token costs in `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts`. Refactored `backend/src/claude.ts` to remove redundant API key checks, switch to `logger.error`, and ensure `saveMessage` runs unconditionally on `message_delta` unless database logging is ignored. Fixed stream processing in `backend/src/process-stream.ts` to continue instead of break on completion. Simplified `start-server` script in root `package.json`.

e47cfaa4d0d93073fecdbe019fae9a8a87edc43c.title: Fix Stripe webhook quota update for downgrades
e47cfaa4d0d93073fecdbe019fae9a8a87edc43c.summary: Stripe webhook `handleSubscriptionChange` now sets `baseQuota` directly from `PLAN_CONFIGS[usageTier].limit` instead of querying `AuthenticatedQuotaManager.getStripeSubscriptionQuota`. This ensures downgrades apply the new plan's quota immediately. Cancellation detection logic updated to use `subscription.canceled_at` timestamp (checking if <= 5 minutes from now) rather than `cancellation_details.reason`, correctly handling scheduled cancellations.

0848e5169e83b1cc9d6b335d7f518e42a54d4fa6.title: Clarify git push permission in system prompt
0848e5169e83b1cc9d6b335d7f518e42a54d4fa6.summary: Updated system prompt to explicitly state that user requests to commit changes do not imply permission to push. This change modifies the guidelines for the `git commit` and `git rebase` commands in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The update ensures the agent requires explicit permission for push operations, preventing unintended remote repository updates.

bb7a30ef9cea709728f973a3a9042fa064f8a5ec.title: Correct typecheck command in knowledge.md
bb7a30ef9cea709728f973a3a9042fa064f8a5ec.summary: Updated verification instructions in knowledge.md to use `bun run --cwd backend typecheck` instead of `bun run --cwd backend tsc`. This ensures developers run the correct script defined in package.json for type checking. Scope limited to internal documentation.

d91ef3f135dd1cca6dcda7b8dc7f98f097c5edf0.title: system-prompt.ts cap file tree tokens
d91ef3f135dd1cca6dcda7b8dc7f98f097c5edf0.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts caps project file tree prompt tokens at 100,000 via Math.min in getProjectFileTreePrompt. miscTokens budgets increased to 10,000 (search) and 15,000 (agent) to account for system info and response format prompts. Agent context file tree inclusion now evaluated by token count (2,500 lite / 10,000 max) rather than string length. logger.debug calls expanded to report granular token breakdowns for files, tree, system info, and response format.

db5076fef7fe4d056544d1fe80ce722266a15f7f.title: Update system prompt for git push and script safety
db5076fef7fe4d056544d1fe80ce722266a15f7f.summary: Tightened command execution guidelines in backend/src/system-prompt.ts to explicitly prohibit `git push` without permission and restrict scripts with side effects. Replaced vague 'probably don't run scripts' with strict side-effect checks, and clarified the 30-second timeout by specifying `npm start` alongside `npm run dev` as examples of forbidden long-running processes.

7043e237da9c08540c354264c1ccaf0e1814272f.title: Rename --pro to --max in CLI and docs
7043e237da9c08540c354264c1ccaf0e1814272f.summary: The premium mode flag `--pro` is renamed to `--max`, with `--o1` added as an alias. Internal `costMode` remains 'pro'. Docs in `modes.knowledge.md`, `npm-app/README.md`, and `web/src/content/help/*` reflect the new name and model usage details. CLI help text in `npm-app/src/index.ts` lists `--max, --pro, --o1`.

c3fa982685f2b2cf8d9117c1074bf488fb1cf199.title: Rename pro mode to max and deprecate --pro flag
c3fa982685f2b2cf8d9117c1074bf488fb1cf199.summary: Cost mode 'pro' renamed to 'max' across core constants, CLI, and prompts. The --pro flag now triggers a deprecation warning and exits, forcing users to restart with --max. Plan display name changed from 'Pro Max' to 'Pro Plus'. Updates cover backend logic, npm-app CLI, and documentation.

b361e9fe6f8e32245a7c08f0284e2f75eb82bbfb.title: ripgrep prompt clarifies automatic quote handling
b361e9fe6f8e32245a7c08f0284e2f75eb82bbfb.summary: System prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` updated to inform agent that quotes are automatically added around code search patterns. Previous instruction required manual quoting for special characters; now directs user to escape characters like '-' or '.' instead. Affects internal LLM guidance for `code_search` tool.

bb7a30ef9cea709728f973a3a9042fa064f8a5ec.text: Internal instructions for checking software health were corrected. You will see no change in how the product works.

0193b3a0d465ba1adf4ed441230b342e9ce781fb.text: A small internal fix ensures the tool correctly tracks your current folder after navigation. This prevents errors when accessing files using relative paths.

b361e9fe6f8e32245a7c08f0284e2f75eb82bbfb.text: A small internal update helps the assistant search text more reliably. You no longer need to format your search words in a special way.

c3fa982685f2b2cf8d9117c1074bf488fb1cf199.text: The 'Pro' setting is now called 'Max'. If you previously used the 'Pro' option, you must restart the application using 'Max' to continue.

7043e237da9c08540c354264c1ccaf0e1814272f.text: The premium mode button label changed from 'Pro' to 'Max'.

d9361f97059416156af3b2b2706f8c0ba49ae077.text: Fixed how usage is tracked and updated pricing. Costs are now calculated correctly.

e47cfaa4d0d93073fecdbe019fae9a8a87edc43c.text: When you switch to a smaller plan, your usage limits now update immediately. If you cancel your subscription, the system correctly recognizes it as an active cancellation.

d91ef3f135dd1cca6dcda7b8dc7f98f097c5edf0.text: The assistant now limits how much file information it processes to prevent slowdowns. It also uses smarter checks to ensure responses stay quick and accurate.

b44f1d9a895a0797a3df472e2617707c2f0b7081.title: Fix terminal first command execution on Windows
b44f1d9a895a0797a3df472e2617707c2f0b7081.summary: Added logic in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` to trim the prompt identifier from the first line of terminal output when it appears. This fixes an issue where the first command wasn't executing correctly on Windows due to prompt interference. The change applies specifically to the `runTerminalCommand` function's data handling.

f008686b5ffc15440d464376d1b08b1a98f98f23.title: Terminal: Use special prompt ID to detect complete commands
f008686b5ffc15440d464376d1b08b1a98f98f23.summary: Terminal command detection switched from fragile regex patterns to a unique string identifier `@36261@`. This prevents false positives when command output mimics standard shell prompts. Unix shells now receive `--login` and have `PS1` explicitly set post-RC sourcing. Windows relies on the `PROMPT` environment variable. Changes apply to `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`.

f68b71753130d7822e19cfc2c1b30632ffcc8a34.title: Payment change page replaces generic success redirect
f68b71753130d7822e19cfc2c1b30632ffcc8a34.summary: New /payment-change page handles plan modifications. Replaces static /payment-success redirect with dynamic confirmation showing current plan limits. Updates web app routing and adds plan-change.png asset. Onboard page image source updated from .jpg to .png.

36927f7bdb7ac9fba3b030e4983e3211baddabb2.title: calculate-average-spend splits new vs existing
36927f7bdb7ac9fba3b030e4983e3211baddabb2.summary: calculate-average-spend.ts now separates new and existing customers by first invoice date, reporting per-group totals. Queries 2 months of paid Stripe invoices to establish history, but counts only last 30 days for spend. Adds top spenders list for customers over $49 and sorts distribution ranges by count descending.

c42c1d8fc932b4b33f75238ccdcf68b11539c902.title: GPT-4o and reduced context for file reading checks
c42c1d8fc932b4b33f75238ccdcf68b11539c902.summary: File-reading decision logic now uses gpt-4o for non-lite modes, replacing the previous gpt-4o-mini default. The prompt sent to this model was significantly trimmed, removing the system message and project file tree in favor of conversation history and the user request. This change targets speed and accuracy in determining whether new files need to be read. Scope is limited to backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts and common/src/constants.ts.

3e66e5307621f23e926f16efde9dcc61f0482756.title: Add typecheck script to scripts package
3e66e5307621f23e926f16efde9dcc61f0482756.summary: Added `typecheck` script to `scripts/package.json` and configured project references in `scripts/tsconfig.json` pointing to `../backend` and `../common`. This enables isolated type checking for the scripts package, ensuring dependencies are correctly resolved during CI or local development. Scope limited to internal tooling configuration.

baba7b8b0a573668dbc63cccdfce33348204b2f4.title: Add Stripe billing portal link to user dropdown
baba7b8b0a573668dbc63cccdfce33348204b2f4.summary: User dropdown now routes active subscribers to the Stripe customer portal with a prefilled email. Previously, active users saw a disabled 'You are on the pro tier!' button. The `FreePlanButton` also accepts `userEmail` to prefill the portal on downgrades. Changes affect `web/src/components/navbar/user-dropdown.tsx`, `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`, and `web/src/components/pricing/free-plan-button.tsx`.

35cfba10d6e1cfe94f7669dcc5b11a9713b64934.title: Scale down file tree tokens based on message count
35cfba10d6e1cfe94f7669dcc5b11a9713b64934.summary: The system prompt generators now accept a `messagesTokens` argument to calculate dynamic token budgets for the file tree. `getSearchSystemPrompt` and `getAgentSystemPrompt` subtract message tokens and a fixed 5k misc buffer from the context limit (64k/200k) to determine the remaining space for file content. This prevents context overflow by scaling down the included file tree when message history grows. The `FILE_TOKEN_BUDGET` constant in `main-prompt.ts` was also reduced from 30k/90k to 25k/80k.

506c48b036eaf6147d393735610cf963d92889fa.title: Add description to Stripe meter events for referral credits
506c48b036eaf6147d393735610cf963d92889fa.summary: Referral credit adjustments now include a description field in the Stripe billing.meterEvents.create payload, removing the previous invoices.update call. This change ensures credit visibility in invoice line items without modifying invoice descriptions during checkout sessions, per updated billing knowledge docs. Scope limited to web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts and backend/src/billing/billing.knowledge.md. Meter events with negative values remain the preferred method for usage-based credits over coupons or invoice metadata edits.

f455c371952754aa6399023a9e599d0e6b2dfd86.title: CLI tab complete matches common prefix
f455c371952754aa6399023a9e599d0e6b2dfd86.summary: Tab completion in npm-app/src/cli.ts now auto-completes to the longest common prefix when multiple tokens match the current word. This behavior is implemented by extracting suffixes from matching tokens and iteratively finding shared characters. The 'print' command was also added to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts.

f68b71753130d7822e19cfc2c1b30632ffcc8a34.text: When you change your plan, you now see a confirmation page showing your new limits instead of a generic success message.

506c48b036eaf6147d393735610cf963d92889fa.text: Referral credits now appear clearly in billing records without altering invoice descriptions. This ensures users see credit adjustments accurately when reviewing their bills.

b44f1d9a895a0797a3df472e2617707c2f0b7081.text: A small internal fix ensures the first command you enter in the terminal works correctly on Windows.

baba7b8b0a573668dbc63cccdfce33348204b2f4.text: Subscribers can now click a link in their profile menu to manage their account details and payment information directly. This replaces a previous button that only showed their current plan status.

f455c371952754aa6399023a9e599d0e6b2dfd86.text: Typing a partial command and pressing the completion key now fills in the shared letters automatically. This saves you from typing the rest of the command if the start is unique. A printing command was also added to the list of skipped steps.

3e66e5307621f23e926f16efde9dcc61f0482756.text: A small internal tool update improves how the system checks its own code for errors. This helps keep the product stable without changing anything you see.

c42c1d8fc932b4b33f75238ccdcf68b11539c902.text: The system now uses a smarter model to decide which files to read. This change aims to make responses faster and more accurate.

36927f7bdb7ac9fba3b030e4983e3211baddabb2.text: The report now separates new customers from existing ones to show spending for each group. This helps you see exactly how much money comes from first-time buyers versus returning ones.

caad2a8f527d86af19df2b4268cfeb8ca0b94d24.title: Fix typos in system prompt terminal command guidance
caad2a8f527d86af19df2b4268cfeb8ca0b94d24.summary: Corrected text errors in backend/src/system-prompt.ts. Fixed missing parentheses in test execution example and misspelled 'globally' in permission guidelines. Internal documentation update only.

b37633c1c9c60972bc76d853f4c9675e772f34a7.title: Tighten terminal command safety and timeout guidance in system prompt
b37633c1c9c60972bc76d853f4c9675e772f34a7.summary: The system prompt for the `run_terminal_command` tool was updated to enforce stricter safety guidelines and clarify execution constraints. A 30-second timeout limit was explicitly added, prohibiting long-running or server-starting commands. Instructions regarding script execution were hardened, requiring explicit user permission for actions with permanent effects or significant environmental changes like installing global packages or virtual environments. Redundant references to grep/find and test script examples were removed or simplified to focus on core safety mechanics.

5d25488cfc53270b3a014df054637b3fd4dbec5e.title: Revert git stage new changes in cli.ts
5d25488cfc53270b3a014df054637b3fd4dbec5e.summary: Reverted commit fixing git staging logic in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Staging condition reverted to use allChanges instead of changesAlreadyApplied. Internal CLI logic adjustment.

854143b9093caeabb5a147fc7eb953493663a586.title: Fix git stage condition in CLI
854143b9093caeabb5a147fc7eb953493663a586.summary: The CLI now checks `changesAlreadyApplied.length` instead of `allChanges.length` when determining whether to stage files. This corrects the logic to only trigger `stagePatches` when there are actual changes to stage, preventing unnecessary operations or errors when no changes are present. The fix is isolated to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

377d549540468ab0aa8fdabd38b2db573e87a628.title: Add onWebSocketReconnect callback to APIRealtimeClient
377d549540468ab0aa8fdabd38b2db573e87a628.summary: APIRealtimeClient now accepts an onReconnect callback invoked upon successful reconnection, replacing hardcoded console logging. CLI and Client classes updated to pass this callback, ensuring proper UI state reset (prompting, stopping animations) via returnControlToUser. Covers common/websocket-client.ts and npm-app client/cli implementations.

e5e8438d6a64ffec26f9af957516d14bbf060a23.title: CI typecheck scripts split into package-local and full-build variants
e5e8438d6a64ffec26f9af957516d14bbf060a23.summary: CI workflow calls `typecheck-this-package` instead of `build`/`typecheck` for backend, npm-app, and web. Each package now defines `typecheck-this-package` (tsc --noEmit + tsc-alias) and a wrapper `typecheck` that builds `common` (and `code-map` for npm-app) first. Scope: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `backend/package.json`, `npm-app/package.json`, `web/package.json`. Backend previously ran `build` (tsc --build + tsc-alias) in CI; now runs `typecheck-this-package` (tsc --noEmit + tsc-alias), aligning with other packages.

beb7c4ab2ec83b7d54ebed31d8c542f291857aaa.title: Add git stage flag to Client
beb7c4ab2ec83b7d54ebed31d8c542f291857aaa.summary: Client constructor accepts git parameter. stagePatches called before applyChanges when git equals stage. CLI passes this.git to Client. Ensures files are staged prior to modification.

013a51e080edf3d610661982eac933a5ea0ad8f3.title: Fix terminal.ts import path
013a51e080edf3d610661982eac933a5ea0ad8f3.summary: Corrected import path in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` from `src/project-files` to `../project-files`. Resolves module resolution errors during build. No user-facing behavior change.

92608f821299aba1dba330d57c1b0dfb3fcfaebe.title: Anon tier limit reduced to 250 credits
92608f821299aba1dba330d57c1b0dfb3fcfaebe.summary: The ANON plan configuration in common/src/constants.ts reduces the credit limit from 500 to 250. This change enforces stricter usage constraints for unauthenticated users. The modification applies globally via the shared core constants.

3609a538a5f3139cf9a405b48e71d1114fec3566.title: Upgrade @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch to 0.12.0-beta.5
3609a538a5f3139cf9a405b48e71d1114fec3566.summary: Bumped optional dependency @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch from 0.11.14 to 0.12.0-beta.5 in npm-app/package.json. Update targets pty prebuilt multiarch support. Scope limited to npm-app package and lockfile.

b37633c1c9c60972bc76d853f4c9675e772f34a7.text: The assistant now stops commands that take too long and asks for permission before making major changes to your computer. This keeps your system safer and prevents it from getting stuck.

377d549540468ab0aa8fdabd38b2db573e87a628.text: When the connection drops and returns, the app now automatically resets the screen instead of leaving a loading animation running.

caad2a8f527d86af19df2b4268cfeb8ca0b94d24.text: Small internal text corrections were made to the assistant's instructions. This fixes minor errors in how it explains certain actions to users.

e5e8438d6a64ffec26f9af957516d14bbf060a23.text: The team improved the automatic checks that scan the software for errors. These checks are now faster and cover more areas, helping to catch problems before they reach you.

92608f821299aba1dba330d57c1b0dfb3fcfaebe.text: Users without an account now get 250 free credits instead of 500. This limit applies everywhere in the product.

beb7c4ab2ec83b7d54ebed31d8c542f291857aaa.text: The app now automatically saves changes to a temporary holding area before applying them. This small internal update helps keep your work organized and prevents accidental loss.

854143b9093caeabb5a147fc7eb953493663a586.text: The assistant now checks if changes exist before saving them. This prevents unnecessary work and errors when nothing needs to be saved.

3609a538a5f3139cf9a405b48e71d1114fec3566.text: A small internal update improves how the app handles text terminals. This may make the experience smoother for some users.

013a51e080edf3d610661982eac933a5ea0ad8f3.text: Fixed a behind-the-scenes problem that stopped the program from working correctly when built. No visible changes for you.

5d25488cfc53270b3a014df054637b3fd4dbec5e.text: The tool now looks at every update, not just the ones it already applied, when saving your work.

6546a77b438f1d8a268a4f2f767a213d05f27e6a.title: Code search output preview limited to 3 lines
6546a77b438f1d8a268a4f2f767a213d05f27e6a.summary: handleCodeSearch in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts now prints up to 3 lines of raw grep results before the count. Header format changed to 'Searching [basename] for "pattern":'. Full output remains truncated to 10000 chars for the agent.

a7f8c0182cbbedd3a18e79f9809c8544ede315a7.title: Remove --login flag from persistent PTY spawn
a7f8c0182cbbedd3a18e79f9809c8544ede315a7.summary: The `pty.spawn` call in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` no longer passes `--login` to non-Windows shells. This change ensures persistent PTYs start without login shell overhead or potential profile conflicts. Scope is limited to the internal terminal utility used by the CLI.

91537f0d53f45b8dc993fedfff319536140140b5.title: Fix stream start event for empty chunks in client
91537f0d53f45b8dc993fedfff319536140140b5.summary: The client now checks `chunk.trim()` before triggering `onStreamStart()`. This prevents the stream start event from firing on empty or whitespace-only chunks, ensuring it only activates when actual content is received. The change affects `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

917bbde1858dc6cc6c07edbd59d9e256fdb8d1da.title: Terminal execution timeout raised to 30 seconds
917bbde1858dc6cc6c07edbd59d9e256fdb8d1da.summary: MAX_EXECUTION_TIME constant in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts increased from 10_000 to 30_000 milliseconds. Allows longer-running commands to complete without premature termination. Internal utility change affecting terminal command execution limits.

473544be8885257c683c7ec3ff33551956ac9a17.title: Add average spend calculation script
473544be8885257c683c7ec3ff33551956ac9a17.summary: New `scripts/calculate-average-spend.ts` computes average monthly spend per customer from Stripe invoices. It aggregates paid invoices from the last 30 days, normalizes cents to dollars, and outputs total spend, average per customer, and spend distribution buckets. Internal tooling only; no user-facing behavior changes.

dd07bc673668d98facdf9bee7a38d26be7721cf1.title: Add lockfiles to default ignored files
dd07bc673668d98facdf9bee7a38d26be7721cf1.summary: Added `package-lock.json` and `bun.lockb` to `DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES` in `common/src/constants.ts`. Prevents agent from processing large dependency manifests. Scope limited to core shared constants.

f1590167d684f272710b2b2e319ef7239b74c069.title: Suppress redundant output when prompt detected in tool handler
f1590167d684f272710b2b2e319ef7239b74c069.summary: Removes manual stdout writing and newline appending when a prompt is detected in `handleRunTerminalCommand` within `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. This prevents duplicate output display, as the stream is already handled elsewhere or disposed immediately after detection. Scope is limited to the terminal command tool handler. The `dataDisposable` and `clearTimeout` calls remain to properly clean up the listener.

d02430ff07e656278bf8926cafb01b6e4c831e18.title: Extract runTerminalCommand to utils/terminal
d02430ff07e656278bf8926cafb01b6e4c831e18.summary: Moved `runTerminalCommand`, `resetPtyShell`, and PTY logic from `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` to new file `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts`. Added `truncateStringWithMessage` helper in `common/src/util/string.ts` to handle output truncation with explicit markers. Updated imports in `npm-app/src/index.ts` and `tool-handlers.ts` to reflect the new module structure. This refactor isolates terminal execution concerns from general tool handlers.

f27dc96467a6e1a6504927fb60566d2a485f89f7.title: Terminal PTY spawn adds login flag, UTF-8 locale, resize handler
f27dc96467a6e1a6504927fb60566d2a485f89f7.summary: createPty in npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts spawns Unix shells with `--login` flag and sets `LANG`/`LC_ALL` to `en_US.UTF-8`. Windows PTY spawn remains flagless. Added `process.stdout.on('resize')` handler forwards `pty.resize` to persistent process. `SHELL` env var now strips `.exe` suffix via `shell.split('.')[0]`. Documented in npm-app/knowledge.md.

c9918c0786a1baf82d4c82542d90d27ac9da10df.title: Terminal shell config sourcing and Windows prompt simplification
c9918c0786a1baf82d4c82542d90d27ac9da10df.summary: Terminal initialization now sources shell RC files (~/.zshrc, config.fish, ~/.bashrc, PowerShell profile) to match real terminal behavior. Windows environment variables were adjusted to set PROMPT='$P$G' for reliable parsing, and prompt detection regexes were consolidated to remove redundant patterns. Changes affect npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts and npm-app/knowledge.md.

917bbde1858dc6cc6c07edbd59d9e256fdb8d1da.text: A setting that stopped long-running computer tasks after ten seconds now waits thirty seconds. This change lets more commands finish without being canceled too early.

6546a77b438f1d8a268a4f2f767a213d05f27e6a.text: Search results now show only the first few lines of matches to keep answers shorter. This is a small internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

473544be8885257c683c7ec3ff33551956ac9a17.text: The company added a private tool to calculate how much customers spend each month. This change only helps the internal team understand spending patterns. It does not affect how you use the product.

c9918c0786a1baf82d4c82542d90d27ac9da10df.text: The software now reads your terminal settings to match real terminal behavior. On Windows, it uses a simpler prompt style for reliable text parsing. This is a small internal fix to help the assistant understand your terminal output correctly.

91537f0d53f45b8dc993fedfff319536140140b5.text: The app no longer reacts to empty or blank messages, waiting instead for real content to appear.

f1590167d684f272710b2b2e319ef7239b74c069.text: The app stopped showing repeated text when asking for input. This keeps the screen cleaner by removing duplicate messages.

f27dc96467a6e1a6504927fb60566d2a485f89f7.text: The terminal now loads your full settings and supports resizing. This makes the experience smoother and more consistent.

a7f8c0182cbbedd3a18e79f9809c8544ede315a7.text: The internal terminal utility now starts without loading extra user settings. This change is small and mostly affects how the system prepares its background processes.

dd07bc673668d98facdf9bee7a38d26be7721cf1.text: The assistant now skips large dependency lists. This makes it faster and less likely to get stuck.

d02430ff07e656278bf8926cafb01b6e4c831e18.text: Developers reorganized the code that handles system commands to make it cleaner. This internal change won't affect how you use the app.

bca20eb7c06a149a3c55cfcd224198bfa36408d0.title: CI typecheck web after contentlayer build
bca20eb7c06a149a3c55cfcd224198bfa36408d0.summary: CI workflow now runs `bun run --cwd web typecheck` instead of `bun run --cwd web build`. The `typecheck` script in `web/package.json` was updated to execute `contentlayer build` before `tsc --noEmit`. This ensures type checking succeeds by generating necessary Contentlayer types first. Scope limited to CI pipeline and web package scripts.

aad41fd2f1e8d948f67a628587f24eb08403e95e.title: CI web step switches from typecheck to build
aad41fd2f1e8d948f67a628587f24eb08403e95e.summary: CI web step now runs `bun run --cwd web build` instead of `bun run --cwd web typecheck`. Build step replaces typecheck to validate web package compilation. Scope limited to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

fd04248ef741ac72d79bbb72f3dd6cb272530289.title: Fix code-map typeRoots path
fd04248ef741ac72d79bbb72f3dd6cb272530289.summary: Corrected `typeRoots` in `packages/code-map/tsconfig.json`. The previous relative path `../node_modules/@types` resolved incorrectly, likely missing root-level type definitions. Updated to `../../node_modules/@types` to ensure proper type resolution from the workspace root.

fb2faab94efb1ec18f203297d019e4c73636254a.title: CI adds code-map build step
fb2faab94efb1ec18f203297d019e4c73636254a.summary: CI workflow inserts `bun run --cwd packages/code-map build` after common build and before backend. Removes numbered step comments. Ensures `code-map` package compiles before dependent targets. Scope limited to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

bf037ad3bcd486ce96317be0407b5cdd62af91bd.title: CI typecheck npm-app package
bf037ad3bcd486ce96317be0407b5cdd62af91bd.summary: CI workflow replaces `npm-app` build step with `typecheck`. New `typecheck` script added to `npm-app/package.json` running `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc-alias`. Scope: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `npm-app/package.json`. Detail: Build artifacts no longer generated during this CI stage.

90dff3f523d2680cd232c19d685fa41b9682f8e5.title: Zero-size terminal hidden input
90dff3f523d2680cd232c19d685fa41b9682f8e5.summary: Zeroed dimensions and disabled pointer events on .terminal-hidden-input in web/src/components/ui/terminal/style.css. Fixes terminal mobile scroll issues by preventing the off-screen input from affecting layout or intercepting touches.

039bf9ca922ea15e5f3b37416477787374bf7c31.title: CI workflow added
039bf9ca922ea15e5f3b37416477787374bf7c31.summary: New `.github/workflows/ci.yml` triggers on push/PR to `main`. Runs build for `common`, `backend`, `npm-app` and typecheck for `web` using Bun. Enforces monorepo dependency order.

f58f0944e0bb45f70bdeb6e159c3dcd7344704a2.title: Improve landing page performance
f58f0944e0bb45f70bdeb6e159c3dcd7344704a2.summary: Refactored landing page rendering and styles in `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/src/components/ui/background-beams.tsx`, and `web/src/components/ui/terminal/style.css` to enhance performance. Simplified `ReviewCard` and feature section styling by removing redundant border utilities and applying standard Tailwind light/dark mode classes. Predefined background beam SVG paths in `background-beams.tsx` and optimized `.terminal-hidden-input` positioning to mitigate layout thrashing. Scope limited to `web` package frontend components.

c8eb5b645d899998c0deb7db264acc286f2014a1.title: Fix mobile scroll and add demo request logging
c8eb5b645d899998c0deb7db264acc286f2014a1.summary: Terminal component uses `scrollTo` with smooth behavior for mobile containers. Hidden input CSS switches from `fixed` offset to `absolute` zero-size to prevent page scroll interference. Demo API route logs user-agent, referer, and message history. Scope limited to `web/src/components/ui/terminal` and `web/src/app/api/demo/route.ts`.

520d15a41012ac00a4f389d2d1918ccf3562b01a.title: Fix Windows terminal line clearing in CLI
520d15a41012ac00a4f389d2d1918ccf3562b01a.summary: The `codebuff` npm package (v1.0.136) replaces direct `process.stdout.clearLine`/`cursorTo` calls with a new `rewriteLine` helper in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. This change prevents display corruption on Windows terminals by only performing line rewriting when an interactive TTY is detected, falling back to newline writes otherwise. Additionally, `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` now writes a newline instead of clearing the line upon prompt detection to avoid overwriting output. The `npm-app/knowledge.md` file documents these Windows-specific handling requirements.

520d15a41012ac00a4f389d2d1918ccf3562b01a.text: Fixed text display glitches in the command line on Windows. Output now stays readable and does not overwrite previous messages.

f58f0944e0bb45f70bdeb6e159c3dcd7344704a2.text: The landing page loads faster. This change is small and internal.

c8eb5b645d899998c0deb7db264acc286f2014a1.text: A small internal update fixed scrolling on mobile screens and saved details from demo requests, so phone users may see smoother scrolling and the team can review request details.

Constants `DEEPSEEK_TIMEOUT_MS` and `DEEPSEEK_MAX_RETRIES` define these values. This applies to the singleton `deepseekClient` used across backend requests.

8da363766af2704b229ce6108ea70cdf0f675bc1.title: MOARPRO display name set to Pro Max
8da363766af2704b229ce6108ea70cdf0f675bc1.summary: MOAR_PRO displayName in common/src/constants.ts changed from Moar Pro to Pro Max. Internal plan config update. Scope limited to shared core constants.

c9b8dfc97959583230cdce6950a22860304cb6d3.title: Add syntax error near unexpected token to isNotACommand
c9b8dfc97959583230cdce6950a22860304cb6d3.summary: Added check for 'syntax error near unexpected token' in isNotACommand function in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. This expands the pattern matching for shell outputs that indicate a command was not found or invalid. Ensures proper handling of this specific syntax error variant alongside existing checks like 'syntax error:' and ': not found'.

9b2430b0c456a1509bc516c2b38a6449c8feefb0.summary: UsageLimits in common/src/constants.ts converted from TS enum to as-const object plus derived type. capitalize in common/src/util/string.ts now lowercases remaining characters. Covers shared core constants and string utils. Breaks enum reverse-mapping assumptions if relied upon.

541a515f763b1e86d86d008093c8f3c36a7401e2.title: Move sleep util from helpers to promise
541a515f763b1e86d86d008093c8f3c36a7401e2.summary: Relocated `sleep` helper from `common/util/helpers` to `common/util/promise`. Updated imports in backend (`claude.ts`, `generate-patch.ts`) and web components (`referrals`, `InteractiveTerminalDemo`, `sign-in-button`). Deleted `common/src/util/helpers.ts`.

0b41bb2890916f8ac878d1011c069ff1c4d9d06c.title: Rename Oliver case study file to oliver-lukesch.mdx
0b41bb2890916f8ac878d1011c069ff1c4d9d06c.summary: Renamed `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx` to `oliver-lukesch.mdx` for consistent naming. Updated content to explicitly name the company `StartMatch` with a link. Internal content structure change.

d40adfe6b20aae6ed0e9e0dc2ed17a6724f3178e.summary: hasLazyEdit in common/src/util/string.ts now applies toLowerCase().trim() to input before running detection checks. This fixes case-sensitive misses where lazy edit markers like '// REST OF THE' or uppercase comment variants failed to trigger the checker. The regex patterns and string literals remain unchanged, operating on the normalized cleanedContent.

315986b546823cc85c2c621df8b159d923bb6177.title: tool-handlers: hoist pty console.error suppression, shorten German
315986b546823cc85c2c621df8b159d923bb6177.summary: console.error suppression for pty require moved out of try block into module scope with finally restore. isNotACommand German string check shortened from full phrase to 'konnte nicht gefunden werden'. Internal refactor only in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

9fa91417f7faa69ef8e8c15074ee69351306ff92.summary: Model constant `o1` updated from `o1-preview` to `o1` in `common/src/constants.ts`. `backend/src/openai-api.ts` implements specific non-streaming handling for o-series models with `reasoning_effort: 'high'` and Zod validation. `backend/src/planning.ts` switches from `promptOpenAIStream` to `promptOpenAI` for planning tasks. OpenAI SDK dependency bumped to `^4.78.1`.

8da363766af2704b229ce6108ea70cdf0f675bc1.text: The name shown for the advanced plan changed from Moar Pro to Pro Max. This only affects how the plan is labeled in the app.

9b2430b0c456a1509bc516c2b38a6449c8feefb0.text: Internal code adjustments were made to improve how text is processed and data is handled. These changes are small and do not affect how you use the product.

9fa91417f7faa69ef8e8c15074ee69351306ff92.text: This is a small internal update. The assistant now uses an updated model and plans more carefully before answering.

275ed4dc5f8440c970f6ea2e64b099b22a9164cb.title: Extract getSystemInfo into npm-app utils
275ed4dc5f8440c970f6ea2e64b099b22a9164cb.summary: Refactored `getSystemInfo` into `npm-app/src/utils/system-info.ts`. `project-files.ts` now imports this helper to populate `systemInfo` context. Added `npm-app` path mapping and project reference in `test/tsconfig.json`.

b1245b24ac1c146fa17c1da0bfbad818f8ee1e75.summary: Added NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST_URL to .env.example. These variables configure client-side PostHog analytics. The change also fixes the missing newline at the end of the file.

cc68afa80e8fe010cafd9db3ebeed53a062c934b.title: Upgrade tree-sitter to 0.22.4
cc68afa80e8fe010cafd9db3ebeed53a062c934b.summary: Bumped tree-sitter from 0.21.1 to 0.22.4 in packages/code-map/package.json. Updates core parsing dependency for code mapping functionality. Scope limited to code-map package dependencies.

3fa4bc3605360ab0fe373c0b5d8c383aa4cb0d84.title: Add scraped content to knowledge files
3fa4bc3605360ab0fe373c0b5d8c383aa4cb0d84.summary: New `addScrapedContentToFiles` function parses URLs from knowledge file content and appends scraped blocks. `getProjectFileContext` now uses this enriched content instead of raw files. Affects `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`.

ab8eb3dee6f2248a3e095e2fcd0e240267d2e358.title: PostHog event naming standardization and proxy rewrites
ab8eb3dee6f2248a3e095e2fcd0e240267d2e358.summary: Standardized PostHog event names to dot-notation categories (e.g., `home.cta_clicked`, `subscription.payment_completed`) and added Next.js rewrites to proxy PostHog ingest traffic. Updated `web/next.config.mjs` with `/ingest` routes and `skipTrailingSlashRedirect`. Refactored tracking calls in `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/src/app/payment-success/page.tsx`, `web/src/components/InteractiveTerminalDemo.tsx`, and `web/src/components/CookieConsentCard.tsx` to match new schema. Removed theme context from analytics events and added client-side consent tracking.

5fc2da2850390542054c9ab1b7df38227491cfcb.title: Suppress node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch console.error on load
5fc2da2850390542054c9ab1b7df38227491cfcb.summary: Temporarily stubs console.error around require('@homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch') in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. Prevents noisy stderr output when optional native bindings fail to load. Scoped to CLI tool handlers. Restores original console.error immediately after require.

78fe64f1ceb0a50579950e56468c172881395321.title: Fix InteractiveTerminalDemo state race and API origin validation
78fe64f1ceb0a50579950e56468c172881395321.summary: Refactored `handleInput` in `InteractiveTerminalDemo.tsx` to use functional `setTerminalLines` updates instead of mutating a local copy, preventing race conditions with mutation handlers. Updated `api/demo/route.ts` to parse and normalize origin URLs (stripping `www.`, comparing host/port) rather than strict string equality, while enforcing CORS headers on all error responses. Scope includes web components, demo API route, and knowledge base docs.

48702972af6b73864b19f9eee0c095e208b84c84.title: Enforce relative paths in readfiles
48702972af6b73864b19f9eee0c095e208b84c84.summary: System prompt clarifies that `read_files` paths must be relative to the project root, explicitly warning against absolute paths. `getFiles` in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` adds an `isAbsolute` check to reject absolute paths before resolving them against the project root. This prevents path traversal issues and ensures consistent relative path handling across the agent.

0b397f5d019402242c5449c891b088a0862ef381.title: Replace bun-types with @types/bun
0b397f5d019402242c5449c891b088a0862ef381.summary: Switched from `bun-types` to `@types/bun` across all packages. Updated `package.json` devDependencies and `tsconfig.json` types arrays in backend, scripts, test, and root. This aligns with Bun's official type definitions.

3d5418aff18ef33dfef1abdfcc778fb852e09b47.title: Fix web crash on subscription confirm page
3d5418aff18ef33dfef1abdfcc778fb852e09b47.summary: Moved `posthog` import and reordered `useUpgradeSubscription` hook initialization in `web/src/app/subscription/confirm/page.tsx`. Hook now initializes after `currentPlan` data is available, preventing undefined access. Scope limited to web subscription confirmation flow.

b1245b24ac1c146fa17c1da0bfbad818f8ee1e75.text: A small internal update added missing setup notes for analytics tools. No visible change for users.

3d5418aff18ef33dfef1abdfcc778fb852e09b47.text: A small internal fix prevents the subscription confirmation page from crashing. You can now complete your subscription without encountering an error.

cc68afa80e8fe010cafd9db3ebeed53a062c934b.text: The software that reads and maps code was updated to a newer version. This internal maintenance improves how the system understands code structure.

48702972af6b73864b19f9eee0c095e208b84c84.text: The assistant now strictly follows folder rules when finding files. This small internal fix prevents it from looking outside the project, keeping your work safe and organized.

0b397f5d019402242c5449c891b088a0862ef381.text: The software now uses official tools to check its own rules. This is a small internal update. You will not see any changes.

5fc2da2850390542054c9ab1b7df38227491cfcb.text: The app stopped showing a confusing error message when a specific feature failed to load. This keeps the interface clean without changing how the assistant works.

8c81f3aa4e37a2cb5dd1547c2b18e039ef512b19.title: Detect lazy edits in file blocks
8c81f3aa4e37a2cb5dd1547c2b18e039ef512b19.summary: Added hasLazyEdit helper to detect ellipsis-based placeholder comments in generated code. processFileBlock now checks for these patterns and triggers full file rewrite via applyRemainingChanges when detected. The rewrite prompt instructs the model to ignore lazy edit comments and preserve original content. This prevents incomplete file writes when models output placeholder comments instead of full code.

99d576e61c043c7a94ab28bed7e116e699311e0c.title: System prompt editfile block guidance update
99d576e61c043c7a94ab28bed7e116e699311e0c.summary: System prompt guidance in backend/src/system-prompt.ts now explicitly discourages placeholder comments like `// ... rest of the file ...` in overwrite edits and emphasizes SEARCH/REPLACE blocks as the preferred format for most changes. This clarifies the expected mechanism for file edits to prevent truncation and ensure precise diff application. The change affects the internal system prompt used by the backend agent.

b3d5eaab4e0c94e8a8296df4865f63d2b989e86b.title: Simplify git staging condition in CLI
b3d5eaab4e0c94e8a8296df4865f63d2b989e86b.summary: The condition for staging previous changes in npm-app/src/cli.ts was simplified. It now checks only `this.git === 'stage'` and `allChanges.length > 0`, removing redundant checks for `lastChanges` and `changes` lengths. This internal refactor streamlines the logic without altering user-visible behavior.

e71a809870d31cd002ccb4cca70a60e646aedcfb.title: Upgrade button shows for logged-out users on pricing page
e71a809870d31cd002ccb4cca70a60e646aedcfb.summary: PaidPlanFooter now renders an Upgrade button when session.data is null, routing to /login. PricingCards sets effectiveCurrentPlan to UsageLimits.ANON for logged-out users so FreePlanButton and PaidPlanFooter receive a valid plan state. Scope: web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx, web/src/components/pricing/paid-plan-footer.tsx.

38aeb1c921aa31c27514693c07df77e715c2827b.title: Rename util to utils in tool-handlers
38aeb1c921aa31c27514693c07df77e715c2827b.summary: Renamed npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts to npm-app/src/utils/detect-shell.ts. Updated import in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts to match new path. Avoids compiler bug.

2043ab4a67b6cd5f4ed1819b90a8c263516b14e4.title: Add cmd prompt regex to terminal command handler
2043ab4a67b6cd5f4ed1819b90a8c263516b14e4.summary:
Added simpleWindowsPromptRegex3 to handleRunTerminalCommand to match bare Windows command prompt paths like "C:\...>". The new regex /[A-Z]:\
S+>/ complements existing patterns for PowerShell and time-based prompts. Updates npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts and documents Windows path regex escaping in npm-app/knowledge.md.

c77783dc1a17c67ec0a9a146dd070e0dbcec5d46.title: Fix FreePlanButton logic for anonymous users
c77783dc1a17c67ec0a9a146dd070e0dbcec5d46.summary: Updated `FreePlanButton` to treat `UsageLimits.ANON` as a free tier alongside `UsageLimits.FREE`. This ensures logged-out users see the 'Get Started' button and are redirected to the npm package page, rather than seeing a 'Downgrade' option or being sent to the cancellation portal. The change applies to the web pricing component in `web/src/components/pricing/free-plan-button.tsx`.

d35d51e295dfede403c0df56a48b5039d045db31.title: Make node-pty optional with childprocess fallback
d35d51e295dfede403c0df56a48b5039d045db31.summary: Moved @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch to optionalDependencies in npm-app/package.json. Implemented try/catch require in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts to detect PTY availability. Added fallback logic in createPty to use child_process when node-pty fails to load. Updated npm-app/knowledge.md to document native dependency handling and fallback behavior.

aeb348fdcaeca28f3de97d59c3083b2144f69a25.title: Add Knowledge Files documentation
aeb348fdcaeca28f3de97d59c3083b2144f69a25.summary: New `knowledge-files.mdx` documents usage of `knowledge.md` files for storing project context, best practices, and post-change verification commands. 6573107d01347935aadf697c09bca758bdb5e9ce.title: Add interactive terminal demo and PostHog analytics
6573107d01347935aadf697c09bca758bdb5e9ce.summary: Landing page now features an interactive terminal demo backed by a new `/api/demo` route using DeepSeek. PostHog analytics integrated for web traffic, requiring user consent via `CookieConsentCard`. Scope covers `web` package, including new components, API routes, and provider setup.

c77783dc1a17c67ec0a9a146dd070e0dbcec5d46.text: The website now correctly shows the 'Get Started' button to people who are not logged in. Previously, these visitors might have seen a confusing 'Downgrade' option instead.

2043ab4a67b6cd5f4ed1819b90a8c263516b14e4.text: The assistant can now recognize more Windows command prompt styles when it runs commands. This helps it understand where a command is being entered in Windows. It is a small internal improvement with no visible change for users.

e71a809870d31cd002ccb4cca70a60e646aedcfb.text: Visitors who are not signed in now see an 'Upgrade' button on the pricing page. Clicking this button takes them to the login page first.

99d576e61c043c7a94ab28bed7e116e699311e0c.text: A small internal update teaches the assistant to use precise instructions for changing files. This helps prevent accidental data loss or incomplete edits when the tool updates content.

d3f2357b21c36b29846d3bc35ac92bc9c3cc49c2.title: Fix code search pipe handling and add result count
d3f2357b21c36b29846d3bc35ac92bc9c3cc49c2.summary: handleCodeSearch now strips double quotes from input.pattern before wrapping it in shell-safe double quotes for ripgrep. This fixes failures when the pattern contains pipe characters or existing quotes. The tool handler also prints the number of results found using stdout line count. Changes are limited to npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

017f18a6991ec32e11a7e393b70e282c9bd49f21.title: Windows PTY spawns cmd.exe outside PowerShell
017f18a6991ec32e11a7e393b70e282c9bd49f21.summary: npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts createPty now calls detectShell() to pick powershell.exe or cmd.exe on win32, replacing hardcoded powershell.exe. New npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts probes $PSVersionTable, COMSPEC, and parent process via wmic/ps to resolve the active shell. Scope limited to CLI tool handlers; Web/Desktop unaffected. Unix path still defaults to bash.

9330c43a06996ca4d64ff92f38d1b661facd6df4.title: Revert Windows cmd.exe shell detection
9330c43a06996ca4d64ff92f38d1b661facd6df4.summary: Reverts Windows shell detection logic in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. `createPty` now hardcodes `powershell.exe` for `win32` and `bash` otherwise, removing the `detectShell` import. Deletes `npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts` which previously used `execSync` and `wmic` to identify parent shells. Scope limited to CLI tool handlers; no user-facing config changes.

e73fbb33f6392a6c3bf10bf29201761c337cb3f4.title: Add German error detection to handleRunTerminalCommand
e73fbb33f6392a6c3bf10bf29201761c337cb3f4.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand now checks for additional German error strings indicating command not found in PowerShell. This improves error handling for non-English locales. Affects npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

7b75881543bc0af917b79daa032c27848ac84b62.title: AWS keys in .env.example and Claude retry logic refactor
7b75881543bc0af917b79daa032c27848ac84b62.summary: Added AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY to .env.example. Refactored promptClaudeStream in backend/src/claude.ts to use manual loop with exponential backoff for APIConnectionError instead of withRetry. Removed obsolete sections from backend/knowledge.md.

9432f8961c0bcaa8d7a21768f833e02d4c7fadac.title: Windows PTY spawns cmd.exe outside PowerShell
9432f8961c0bcaa8d7a21768f833e02d4c7fadac.summary: Reverts previous revert to restore `cmd.exe` fallback for Windows PTY creation when not running within PowerShell. `createPty` in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` now calls `detectShell()` from new `npm-app/src/util/detect-shell.ts` to determine the active shell. `detectShell` checks `$PSVersionTable` via `execSync` to identify PowerShell, falling back to `COMSPEC` or parent process inspection via `wmic` for `cmd.exe`. Unix systems continue to use `bash`.

16ff9a300de5251929aaf5a429704d4eca67f7bb.title: Stripe webhook handles expired canceled unpaid subscription states
16ff9a300de5251929aaf5a429704d4eca67f7bb.summary: Stripe webhook route.ts adds ts-pattern match for customer.subscription.updated. Handles incomplete_expired, unpaid, and immediate canceled states by downgrading to UsageLimits.FREE. Preserves current plan for cancel_at_period_end: true until subscription.deleted event. Other states (active, trialing, past_due) proceed with existing plan resolution logic.

3abfb85ab2fa33ecb2e02d339132beb0b4f78461.title: Persistent PTY shell replaces childprocess for terminal commands
3abfb85ab2fa33ecb2e02d339132beb0b4f78461.summary: Terminal command execution in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts switched from `child_process.spawn` to a persistent `node-pty` shell. This unifies stdout/stderr into a single stream, matching real terminal behavior and simplifying output parsing. The CLI and tool handlers now rely on `resetPtyShell` for initialization and timeout recovery, removing separate stderr handling. Jest testing infrastructure added via `npm-app/jest.config.js` and `package.json` devDependencies.

a698cd8441363e0d429b1e191b7295ce9880620c.title: Add MRR calculation script
a698cd8441363e0d429b1e191b7295ce9880620c.summary: Added scripts/calculate-mrr.ts to compute Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Annual Run Rate (ARR) via Stripe API. The script paginates active subscriptions, filters out those scheduled for cancellation (cancel_at_period_end), and sums only licensed base fees. Exposed as bun run --cwd scripts mrr in scripts/package.json. Documented in backend/src/billing/billing.knowledge.md.

0d8894ca77aef154b2d414afb75c21846988c335.title: Self-serve plan upgrades for Pro and Moar Pro
0d8894ca77aef154b2d414afb75c21846988c335.summary: Adds self-serve plan changes for `PRO` and `MOAR_PRO` through `web/src/app/api/stripe/subscription/change/route.ts`, new `common/src/types/plan.ts`, and subscription confirm UI components, supporting multiple subscription tiers with licensed base and metered overage items. `common/src/constants.ts` replaces `PAID`/`PRO_PLUS` limits with `PLAN_CONFIGS`, `OVERAGE_RATE_PRO`, `OVERAGE_RATE_MOAR_PRO`, and `BILLING_PERIOD_DAYS`; `common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts` now defaults to `PRO`. `backend/src/env.mjs` removes `STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_ID`, while `.env.example` adds per-tier Stripe price IDs, `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL`, and provider API key entries. Claude streaming retries move to shared `withRetry` in `common/src/util/promise.ts`, applying only to `APIConnectionError`.

e73fbb33f6392a6c3bf10bf29201761c337cb3f4.text: The assistant now recognizes error messages in German when a command fails. This helps it explain problems clearly for users who set their computer language to German.

16ff9a300de5251929aaf5a429704d4eca67f7bb.text: A background update improves how the system recognizes when a subscription ends or payment fails. This ensures users lose access to paid features immediately when required, preventing accidental free usage.

a698cd8441363e0d429b1e191b7295ce9880620c.text: The company added a tool to calculate monthly and annual revenue from subscription data. This is an internal change that does not affect how you use the product.

3abfb85ab2fa33ecb2e02d339132beb0b4f78461.text: The system now runs commands in a single, steady channel like a real terminal window. This makes the output easier to read and handle.

d3f2357b21c36b29846d3bc35ac92bc9c3cc49c2.text: The search feature now handles special characters correctly and displays the total number of results found.

017f18a6991ec32e11a7e393b70e282c9bd49f21.text: The assistant now automatically detects which system command tool you are using on Windows instead of forcing one type. This small internal change fixes a startup issue so the assistant works correctly regardless of your default settings.

9330c43a06996ca4d64ff92f38d1b661facd6df4.text: The system now uses a fixed program for running commands on Windows instead of checking which program is active. This internal change makes command execution more consistent without affecting how you use the product.

9432f8961c0bcaa8d7a21768f833e02d4c7fadac.text: The program now correctly chooses the right command tool on Windows. This internal fix helps it run commands reliably when not using the main system shell.

7b75881543bc0af917b79daa032c27848ac84b62.text: The assistant now handles connection errors more reliably and the setup instructions were updated. This change is internal and does not affect user experience.

0d8894ca77aef154b2d414afb75c21846988c335.text: You can now upgrade or change your plan directly inside the app. This gives you control over your subscription without needing to contact support.

6a3165ecbf753be2ffc95b333e6b0520b47bdd45.title: Reduce anonymous tier credits to 250
6a3165ecbf753be2ffc95b333e6b0520b47bdd45.summary: Anonymous tier credit limit reduced from 500 to 250 in common/src/constants.ts. Updates CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS for ANON. Affects quota enforcement logic.

673bb02bba2b4e4e1886a17a0facb9cfb19e797b.title: German command not found detection
673bb02bba2b4e4e1886a17a0facb9cfb19e797b.summary: Added German error string 'ist entweder falsch geschrieben oder konnte nicht gefunden werden' to command failure detection in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. Fixes false negatives when shell outputs localized errors. Scope limited to terminal command handler.

378b851f01a1bd8f4a8ac4e83f2e31d8d65d2508.title: gpt4o fallback rewrite in pro mode
378b851f01a1bd8f4a8ac4e83f2e31d8d65d2508.summary: processFileBlock now threads costMode to applyRemainingChanges. Fallback rewrite model switches from gpt4omini to gpt4o when costMode === 'pro'. Internal backend logic; no user-facing config or model picker change.

6f539a6136f42ed8db0e420e471ee07f380ca725.title: Add German command not found detection
6f539a6136f42ed8db0e420e471ee07f380ca725.summary: Added 'Der Befehl' string check to error detection logic in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. This enables proper identification of German-language 'command not found' errors during terminal command execution. Scope limited to internal error handling utilities.

0cb901cdd22d5e3ab65784b92843a5ef07a8f67a.title: DeepSeek model added for diff retries in lite cost mode
0cb901cdd22d5e3ab65784b92843a5ef07a8f67a.summary: The `retryDiffBlocksPrompt` function in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` now accepts a `costMode` parameter. When `costMode` is set to 'lite', the system uses `promptDeepseek` with the `models.deepseekChat` model instead of `promptClaude` with `models.sonnet`. The `processFileBlock` and `mainPrompt` functions were updated to propagate the `costMode` argument through the call chain. This change reduces costs for diff retry operations in lite mode by leveraging a cheaper model.

890b5912499975c4ea7f615e6a74dddd5241c641.title: Filter hallucinated new files in getFileVersionUpdates
890b5912499975c4ea7f615e6a74dddd5241c641.summary: getFileVersionUpdates now filters newFiles to existingNewFilePaths before calling getRelevantFileInfoMessage. Checks loadedFiles[path] and content !== null. Prevents hallucinated files from triggering file info messages.

ee30ecb6f13737dc8dbfae749174dffefd7f31f7.title: Add prev/next navigation to docs category pages
ee30ecb6f13737dc8dbfae749174dffefd7f31f7.summary: Added DocNavigation component to docs category pages, rendering prev/next links based on section order. Uses sections array from doc-sidebar to determine adjacent categories. Component placed after sortedDocs map in page.tsx.

4a1c1090ec8373b0f2e1242fab2d79bf473ee973.title: Remove generate-knowledge-files, pass costMode to planning
4a1c1090ec8373b0f2e1242fab2d79bf473ee973.summary: Deleted backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts. Updated backend/src/planning.ts and backend/src/main-prompt.ts to thread costMode into getSearchSystemPrompt. Fixes type errors from missing parameter.

8b70e9059a23d07ab8233568dabbb5de21f24ddd.title: Docs layout flexbox fix
