8b70e9059a23d07ab8233568dabbb5de21f24ddd.summary: Docs layout uses flexbox for main content and mobile sheet. Sidebar links handle external subsections correctly. Updates `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx` and `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`. External subsection links now use `target=_blank`.

ae3804a62d8269be646f6b94cd9436b94a56492b.title: Revert persistent shell and colors
ae3804a62d8269be646f6b94cd9436b94a56492b.summary: Reverts persistent PTY shell implementation, restoring child_process spawn for terminal commands. Removes node-pty dependency and associated terminal emulation logic. Updates handleRunTerminalCommand to return separate stdout and stderr streams instead of combined PTY output. Affects npm-app CLI, tool handlers, and backend prompt processing.

0cb901cdd22d5e3ab65784b92843a5ef07a8f67a.text: When the system retries a failed task in lite cost mode, it now uses a cheaper, less powerful assistant model instead of the standard one. This saves money for the provider without changing the outcome for you.

378b851f01a1bd8f4a8ac4e83f2e31d8d65d2508.text: In pro mode, the system now uses a smarter backup option when the main one fails. This internal update improves reliability without changing how you use the product.

ee30ecb6f13737dc8dbfae749174dffefd7f31f7.text: Documentation pages now show previous and next links. Readers can move between sections without using the menu.

8b70e9059a23d07ab8233568dabbb5de21f24ddd.text: A small internal fix improves how the documentation pages arrange their content. Links to outside resources now open in new windows, preventing accidental navigation away from the help guides.

6f539a6136f42ed8db0e420e471ee07f380ca725.text: The system now recognizes German 'command not found' errors. This helps the tool handle these messages correctly when running commands.

ae3804a62d8269be646f6b94cd9436b94a56492b.text: The system switched back to an older way of running terminal commands. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

890b5912499975c4ea7f615e6a74dddd5241c641.text: The assistant now ignores reports of files that do not actually exist. This prevents it from trying to read or describe non-existent files.

4a1c1090ec8373b0f2e1242fab2d79bf473ee973.text: The team removed an unused background task and improved how the assistant selects information sources based on cost settings. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

6a3165ecbf753be2ffc95b333e6b0520b47bdd45.text: People who use the service without creating an account now get half as many free credits. This means they can ask fewer questions before needing to sign up.

673bb02bba2b4e4e1886a17a0facb9cfb19e797b.text: The assistant now recognizes German error messages when a command fails. This helps it give correct feedback instead of missing the problem. This is a small internal fix.

ea07c1a5ac11e6650f7b1b2dd17d46d7f730652a.title: Navbar right alignment
ea07c1a5ac11e6650f7b1b2dd17d46d7f730652a.summary: Added `ml-auto` to the navbar `nav` element in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. This pushes the links to the right side of the container, preventing distraction from the logo.

7d63183f5701c34d55ed2671dbca5120c0b1259e.title: Version bump to 1.0.124
7d63183f5701c34d55ed2671dbca5120c0b1259e.summary: Version bump to 1.0.124. Routine release increment. Covers npm-app/package.json.

a42ced07e08c3226a8584e9f6972afd158b6409a.title: Reduce file token budgets in lite cost mode
a42ced07e08c3226a8584e9f6972afd158b6409a.summary: getSearchSystemPrompt, getAgentSystemPrompt, and getProjectFileTreePrompt now accept costMode to scale token limits. Lite mode lowers file version budgets from 90,000 to 30,000, file tree truncation from 80,000 to 30,000, and agent context inclusion threshold from 40,000 to 10,000. Updates backend/src/main-prompt.ts and backend/src/system-prompt.ts. The FILE_TOKEN_BUDGET constant was moved into getFileVersionUpdates to enable per-mode evaluation.

502c8a171f713aaf91af8ed3ead28e0668af5971.title: Homepage UI, docs updates, model docs
502c8a171f713aaf91af8ed3ead28e0668af5971.summary: Homepage layout and copy refreshed. Docs updated: `--lite` now cites Deepseek V3 (1/10 cost). Case studies and tips restructured. Pricing copy tweaked. Marquee speed adjusted.

25bf18c95dc060332e914ac83a8cba130aa81966.title: Hide referral banner for unauthenticated users
25bf18c95dc060332e914ac83a8cba130aa81966.summary: Referral banner in `web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx` now checks `session?.user` via `useSession` and returns `null` if absent. Prevents unauthenticated users from seeing a banner that requires login to claim credits. Scope limited to web UI component. Condition updated to `if (!isVisible || !session?.user) return null`.

b1b052c78616d75d58f67dd82eb8d6b25c253ff0.title: Add tab completion for file paths and token names in CLI
b1b052c78616d75d58f67dd82eb8d6b25c253ff0.summary: Tab completion added to CLI readline interface using `completer` callback. Matches file paths from `fileContext.fileTree` and token names from `fileTokenScores`. Client now exposes `fileContext` publicly, updated during `initFileVersions` and file change actions. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/client.ts`.

65cfd5a0fcd047942bd548117e6700b37a1f0581.title: DeepSeek Chat added as backend for Lite mode
65cfd5a0fcd047942bd548117e6700b37a1f0581.summary: DeepSeek Chat (`deepseek-chat`) now powers Lite mode requests via new `backend/src/deepseek-api.ts` streaming handler. This replaces Claude Haiku for `costMode === 'lite'` in `main-prompt.ts` and `request-files-prompt.ts`, using OpenAI-compatible API with Helicone proxying. Cost tracking in `message-cost-tracker.ts` adds DeepSeek token rates ($0.14/$0.28 per M input/output), while `common/src/constants.ts` exports `deepseekModels`.

6290ea41cfa2cd1c46381d5fe38cd3182e9405f2.title: Add webm fallback to intro video
6290ea41cfa2cd1c46381d5fe38cd3182e9405f2.summary: Home page intro video adds `/codebuff-intro1.webm` as `<source>` fallback alongside existing MP4. New `disableRemotePlayback` and `preload="auto"` attributes added to `<video>` element. Scope: `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/public/codebuff-intro1.webm`.

6a7f6623edd8adaa109fc0a08f77ad85b5d3f01d.title: New home page with concise title, video
6a7f6623edd8adaa109fc0a08f77ad85b5d3f01d.summary: Home page layout simplified to a concise headline and an inline autoplaying video, replacing the previous multi-section structure with a modal-triggered demo and terminal install snippet. The change is scoped to the web package, specifically `web/src/app/page.tsx` and `web/src/lib/constant.ts`. A new binary asset `web/public/codebuff-intro1.mp4` is added to support the inline video, while the site description in constants is updated to match the new headline.

0676fd902eaef8c6d6bcc3f00447aa92c784b079.title: Persistent PTY replaces childprocess for terminal commands
0676fd902eaef8c6d6bcc3f00447aa92c784b079.summary: Terminal command execution in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts switched from child_process.spawn to a persistent PTY using @cdktf/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch. This change unifies stdout and stderr into a single stream to better emulate real terminal behavior and preserve colors, requiring updates to handleRunTerminalCommand return types and CLI output handling in npm-app/src/cli.ts. A resetPtyShell function was added to restart the shell on timeouts or initialization, replacing the previous kill logic. Backend prompt handling in backend/src/main-prompt.ts was also updated to strip STOP_MARKER from printed chunks.

ea07c1a5ac11e6650f7b1b2dd17d46d7f730652a.text: A small internal change moves the navigation links to the right side of the screen. This layout adjustment helps keep the logo as the main focus.

7d63183f5701c34d55ed2671dbca5120c0b1259e.text: A small internal update occurred. Users will not notice any changes.

6290ea41cfa2cd1c46381d5fe38cd3182e9405f2.text: The homepage intro video now loads faster and works on more devices.

b1b052c78616d75d58f67dd82eb8d6b25c253ff0.text: The assistant now finishes file names and token names when you press Tab. This saves typing time.

0676fd902eaef8c6d6bcc3f00447aa92c784b079.text: The system now runs terminal commands in a way that better matches how real terminals work, combining outputs and keeping colors intact. This internal change makes command results look and behave more like what you would see on a standard computer screen.

502c8a171f713aaf91af8ed3ead28e0668af5971.text: The website looks cleaner and the help pages now explain a cheaper way to use the assistant. This is a small update that makes it easier to find information.

a42ced07e08c3226a8584e9f6972afd158b6409a.text: The system now limits how much information it reads in a low-cost mode, reducing processing overhead. This keeps the assistant efficient but may slightly shorten context for very large projects.

6a7f6623edd8adaa109fc0a08f77ad85b5d3f01d.text: The main page now shows a short title and a video playing automatically. This replaced the older layout that required clicking a button to see a demo or copy installation commands.

25bf18c95dc060332e914ac83a8cba130aa81966.text: The site no longer shows a referral banner to users who are not logged in. This prevents visitors from seeing an offer they cannot use without an account.

65cfd5a0fcd047942bd548117e6700b37a1f0581.text: The app now uses a different, cheaper AI model for its 'Lite' mode. This change aims to lower costs for the service without altering how you interact with the chat.

fb17d9888659f8054532d4a90a7b8bb5027043e9.text: The system now recognizes a new program for verified YC companies. This means these companies can earn $1,000 in credits after collecting $1,000.

18d5e003dee7ea5b7933c08cd58ab5f429b2c405.title: Add terminal command check instruction to main prompt
18d5e003dee7ea5b7933c08cd58ab5f429b2c405.summary: Added conditional instruction in `getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt` requiring agents to run specified terminal commands (e.g., type/test checks) after changes if defined in knowledge files. This ensures automated validation steps embedded in project knowledge are executed. Scope limited to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

b5f8015e91062d3fb747cbe6e0775c61dc981176.title: Relax assistant message pause limit 3 to 6
b5f8015e91062d3fb747cbe6e0775c61dc981176.summary: mainPrompt increases shouldPause threshold from 3 to 6 consecutive assistant messages in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt now accepts justUsedATool and numAssistantMessages, gating plan_complex_change suggestions on tool usage. conversation-progress.ts adds example phrase for unbounded iteration detection. Scope limited to backend conversation logic.

ca216648702c2cce0358fe9baca28e0122c38b21.title: Expand planning file selection prompt
ca216648702c2cce0358fe9baca28e0122c38b21.summary: Refined the user prompt in `getRelevantFilesForPlanning` within `backend/src/planning.ts`. The instruction now explicitly requests `knowledge.md`, example code, tests, and second-order files to improve context gathering. This change targets the internal planning subsystem to ensure more comprehensive file retrieval for complex requests.

4853758b7a91f6e226b73b7d571e3efa273581df.title: main-prompt.ts plancomplexchange threshold raised
4853758b7a91f6e226b73b7d571e3efa273581df.summary: System prompt instruction for pro cost mode changed from 'complex' to 'very complex' requests. Added explicit guidance to use plan_complex_change sparingly. This adjustment discourages unnecessary planning tool invocation while using o1-preview model.

3cdf87242f07ca2829e21b9d7ef6b6eafdea23cb.title: Swap tiktoken for gpt-tokenizer in backend
3cdf87242f07ca2829e21b9d7ef6b6eafdea23cb.summary: Replaces `tiktoken` with `gpt-tokenizer` 2.8.1 for token counting in `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts`. Imports `encode` from `gpt-tokenizer/esm/model/gpt-4o` instead of instantiating an `encoding_for_model` encoder, simplifying the count logic to a direct function call. Scope is limited to the backend dependency list and token utility. The fallback behavior remains `Math.ceil(text.length / 3)` on error.

d527e4775bb4d882fb072b1e7f2938a1cfb48029.title: Conditional minimal-edit instruction in agent mode
d527e4775bb4d882fb072b1e7f2938a1cfb48029.summary: System prompt logic in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now conditionally omits the 'minimal edits' and 'pause for instructions' directive when allowUnboundedIteration is true. This allows the agent to perform more extensive changes without stopping for user input during unbounded iterations. The change propagates the allowUnboundedIteration flag through getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt.

c03c11d7b0be9bb8a98ec3eb544c575fee88f3fa.title: Force unbounded iteration for plan execution
c03c11d7b0be9bb8a98ec3eb544c575fee88f3fa.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts now detects if the assistant is executing a plan by checking for 'plan_complex_change' in the response. If detected, allowUnboundedIterationPromise resolves true immediately, bypassing the checkToAllowUnboundedIteration call. The logic for handling generated plans was refactored to trigger a 'continue' tool call with a specific implementation prompt instead of manually setting state flags. System instruction tags in getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt were renamed from <important_instruction> to <system_instruction>.

f50573107e2ef2f3f222cb0c45ef8a0c05e2900f.title: o1 reverted to o1-preview
f50573107e2ef2f3f222cb0c45ef8a0c05e2900f.summary: o1 model constant reverted to o1-preview. OpenRouter lacks access to o1-2024-12-17. Planning module imports updated to openai-api. Common constants reflect change.

2be5ae7a6594f5cd817dba1ecf97199e599fe81a.title: Extract main prompt instructions into helper function
2be5ae7a6594f5cd817dba1ecf97199e599fe81a.summary: Refactors `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` by extracting inline user prompt instructions into `getExtraInstructionForUserPrompt`. Adds conditional logic to suggest knowledge file updates when knowledge files exist and it is not the first user message. Scope limited to backend prompt generation logic.

79d15dd36fb8d58a489777bc568e4330ec072627.title: Route o1 through OpenRouter
79d15dd36fb8d58a489777bc568e4330ec072627.summary: Switched `o1` model routing to OpenRouter backend, replacing direct API usage. Added `open-router.ts` to handle streaming completions via `openai/o1` prefix and `OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY` env var. Updated `planning.ts` imports and `constants.ts` to use `o1-2024-12-17`. Scope includes backend routing logic, environment validation, and shared model definitions.

18d5e003dee7ea5b7933c08cd58ab5f429b2c405.text: The assistant now automatically runs specific checks after making changes, if those checks were defined in the project's instructions. This helps ensure the work is done correctly without you needing to ask.

ca216648702c2cce0358fe9baca28e0122c38b21.text: The assistant now looks for more helpful background files before answering. This small internal update may improve the quality of complex responses.

b5f8015e91062d3fb747cbe6e0775c61dc981176.text: The assistant can now send more messages in a row before pausing to check in with you. This small internal update helps it handle complex tasks that require several steps without stopping as often.

3cdf87242f07ca2829e21b9d7ef6b6eafdea23cb.text: The system now uses a different tool to measure text length. This internal update improves how the assistant processes information, but you will not notice any changes.

2be5ae7a6594f5cd817dba1ecf97199e599fe81a.text: This small internal update helps the assistant remember to suggest saving new information if you have already started a conversation. You will see no immediate changes to how you use the product.

79d15dd36fb8d58a489777bc568e4330ec072627.text: The assistant now uses a different system to access its latest thinking model. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

f50573107e2ef2f3f222cb0c45ef8a0c05e2900f.text: The assistant uses an older version of its reasoning model because the newest version is not currently available. This means you will see slightly less advanced thinking in responses until the update can be applied.

c03c11d7b0be9bb8a98ec3eb544c575fee88f3fa.text: The assistant now handles complex tasks more smoothly by automatically continuing its work when needed, without waiting for extra confirmation steps.

d527e4775bb4d882fb072b1e7f2938a1cfb48029.text: When the assistant is set to keep working without stopping for your input, it now makes bigger changes instead of just small edits. This helps it finish complex tasks on its own.

beb0a7f320489f054fabc167238bb0bce726e643.title: Add Oliver case study content
beb0a7f320489f054fabc167238bb0bce726e643.summary: New MDX file `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx` added. Documents user 'Oliver' workflow with Codebuff for European grant platform. Internal repo content only.

43aa27fdfc1d3345b4131cb6d610d196672b0cdc.title: Add paragraph break in Oliver case study
43aa27fdfc1d3345b4131cb6d610d196672b0cdc.summary: Split paragraph in `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx`. Separates Codebuff comparison from prior tool limitations. Improves readability. No logic changes.

a605eb68cacd92404eb936c1f6d3f193ed458efe.title: Fix stagePatches to skip deleted files
a605eb68cacd92404eb936c1f6d3f193ed458efe.summary: stagePatches in common/src/util/git.ts now filters file paths using fs.existsSync before executing git add. This prevents errors when attempting to stage files that have been deleted from the working directory. The function returns false if no existing files remain to stage. Unused imports for os and diff were removed.

c19645815c47cbab0acc37544e20a74b0ce4193e.title: Fix git stage logic in CLI
c19645815c47cbab0acc37544e20a74b0ce4193e.summary: Added `changes.length > 0` check to git staging logic in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Prevents staging previous changes when no new changes exist. Refactored `staged` variable to `didStage` for clarity.

1ffa07da0d957e4a9059e5de94d1b71b4a59f0da.title: Exclude cta.mdx from Contentlayer build
1ffa07da0d957e4a9059e5de94d1b71b4a59f0da.summary: Added `contentDirExclude` to `web/contentlayer.config.ts` to ignore `case-studies/_cta.mdx` during build. Prevents Contentlayer from processing the partial file as a standalone document. Scope limited to web docs configuration.

8ba905bca1fbdde31bd7335204efc5a38ac44093.title: Restructure Oliver case study with subheaders
8ba905bca1fbdde31bd7335204efc5a38ac44093.summary: Added Markdown subheaders to `web/src/content/case-studies/oliver.mdx` for better readability. Condensed narrative to focus on initial tool failures and Codebuff's specific advantages. Removed redundant paragraphs about workflow flexibility and `knowledge.md` details.

de59cd8a129423f999301e25c50e987f241d8baa.title: Add codesearch tool using ripgrep
de59cd8a129423f999301e25c50e987f241d8baa.summary: Added code_search tool to system prompt and handlers, enabling pattern search in project files via ripgrep. New handleCodeSearch function in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts spawns rg process, truncates output to 10000 chars stdout/1000 chars stderr. Backend main-prompt.ts extracts pattern attribute from code_search calls. Requires @vscode/ripgrep 1.15.9 dependency added to npm-app/package.json and root package.json trustedDependencies.

b3d2a104156df34952fbf27576e79dda625769ca.title: Add isValidFilePath filter to planning file selection
b3d2a104156df34952fbf27576e79dda625769ca.summary: Added isValidFilePath to common/src/util/file.ts and applied it in backend/src/planning.ts getRelevantFilesForPlanning. Replaced simple non-empty line filter with validation rejecting whitespace and illegal filesystem characters. Planning prompt updated to explicitly instruct model to ignore previous user instructions. Scope limited to shared util and backend planning logic.

aefb207e1738a672e5eeffb2086838226be2f7a3.title: Calculate quota from Stripe metered tiers
aefb207e1738a672e5eeffb2086838226be2f7a3.summary: QuotaManager adds getStripeSubscriptionQuota to derive limits and overage rates from active Stripe subscription metered price tiers, replacing hardcoded CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS values. Stripe webhook handleSubscriptionChange and Web usage page now consume this dynamic quota via AuthenticatedQuotaManager, removing redundant direct Stripe API calls from route handlers. Scope covers common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts, web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts, and web/src/app/usage/page.tsx. Unhandled webhook events return 405 Method Not Allowed; processing errors return 500 with message instead of silent 405.

8151ce2028b89f39a1159fe0f49102ceb2c92046.title: Add o1 model support and complex change planning tool
8151ce2028b89f39a1159fe0f49102ceb2c92046.summary: Added `o1` model to cost tracker (input $15/M, output $60/M) and implemented `planComplexChange` in `backend/src/planning.ts` to generate detailed solutions using `o1` via streaming. Refactored `promptOpenAI` into `promptOpenAIStream` async generator in `backend/src/openai-api.ts`, removing manual timeout logic in favor of native streaming and updated token accounting. `main-prompt.ts` now integrates planning tools, while `conversation-progress.ts` requires explicit `costMode` for system prompt generation.

43aa27fdfc1d3345b4131cb6d610d196672b0cdc.text: A small text change adds a blank line to break up a long paragraph in the Oliver case study, making it easier to read.

beb0a7f320489f054fabc167238bb0bce726e643.text: Added a new example of how a user named Oliver used the tool to build a grant platform. This is just for internal records and does not change how the product works for you.

a605eb68cacd92404eb936c1f6d3f193ed458efe.text: The app now skips missing files when saving changes. This stops errors from happening.

c19645815c47cbab0acc37544e20a74b0ce4193e.text: A small internal update stops the tool from accidentally saving old edits when there are no new changes to save.

b3d2a104156df34952fbf27576e79dda625769ca.text: The system now checks file names to ignore invalid or empty entries during planning. This prevents errors from messy lists. The change is internal.

8ba905bca1fbdde31bd7335204efc5a38ac44093.text: The Oliver case study page now uses clear section headings to make it easier to read. The text was shortened to focus on the main points, removing extra details.

8151ce2028b89f39a1159fe0f49102ceb2c92046.text: The assistant can now use a new, more capable model to plan complex tasks. This improves how it handles detailed requests.

1ffa07da0d957e4a9059e5de94d1b71b4a59f0da.text: This internal update fixes a small background issue to ensure the website builds correctly. It does not change how the product looks or works for you.

de59cd8a129423f999301e25c50e987f241d8baa.text: The assistant can now search through project files for specific text patterns. This change is internal and does not alter the user interface.

aefb207e1738a672e5eeffb2086838226be2f7a3.text: Usage limits now update automatically when you change your subscription plan, instead of relying on fixed settings. This ensures your available credits and overage costs always match the plan you are actually paying for.

dd3012203660f7eb2d79cabe28a9245c56f006a2.title: Pass newFiles directly to getRelevantFileInfoMessage
dd3012203660f7eb2d79cabe28a9245c56f006a2.summary: getFileVersionUpdates in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now passes newFiles directly to getRelevantFileInfoMessage, removing the intermediate readFilesPaths array. The previous code mapped addedFiles to paths, but newFiles is already the correct format. No external behavior change.

1e3e7fd9a68962ae2944ee3187f9cf43e3638146.title: Add node >=14 engine requirement to npm-app
1e3e7fd9a68962ae2944ee3187f9cf43e3638146.summary: Added engines.node >=14 to npm-app/package.json. Enforces minimum Node.js version for the CLI package. Scope limited to npm-app package metadata. npm will warn or fail on install if host Node version is below 14.

1681e199385ce89a1d33766a2354d82f471572e2.title: request-files-prompt.ts updates file reading heuristic
1681e199385ce89a1d33766a2354d82f471572e2.summary: backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts adds two negative constraints to the file-reading heuristic. Follow-up requests and non-specific greetings now suppress new file reads. Change applies to the promptOpenAI call for request-files-prompt.ts. No user-facing surfaces affected.

e6d16d0bfec019acef0ac4b8deeff1f3c44cf154.title: Windows command notes added to system prompt
e6d16d0bfec019acef0ac4b8deeff1f3c44cf154.summary: Windows-specific command notes injected into system prompt for `win32` platforms. Maps Unix commands to Windows equivalents (`mkdir`, `findstr`, `dir`, `move`, `del`, `copy`) and handles PowerShell distinction. Affects `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` only.

4b737984c62adeefece6a6e70d32d349ca94154e.title: Remove foundEndOfResponse flag from main-prompt stream handler
4b737984c62adeefece6a6e70d32d349ca94154e.summary:
Deleted `foundEndOfResponse` boolean and associated post-loop concatenation in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The stream handler previously tracked whether `
[END]` appeared in printed chunks, then appended it back to `fullResponse` after the loop. The flag and its conditional append were redundant since the token is already stripped from user-visible output and `fullResponse` accumulates raw chunks directly. No behavioral change to chunk rendering or tool-call detection.

70f42362b0771f5ca0130285f72a4b9270236ad6.title: Overage rate now plan-aware
70f42362b0771f5ca0130285f72a4b9270236ad6.summary: Overage billing uses plan-specific rates via new OVERAGE_RATE_PRO ($0.99) and OVERAGE_RATE_PRO_PLUS ($0.90) constants in common/src/constants.ts. Previously the usage page hardcoded $0.90 for all plans, undercharging Pro users. Scope: pricing page and usage page now import these constants; overage calculation drops Math.ceil in favor of exact per-credit rate.

92c08115233436487f5e0c757584e36e585e3b3e.title: Fetch overage rate from Stripe
92c08115233436487f5e0c757584e36e585e3b3e.summary: Overage rate calculation in the usage page now fetches real-time data from Stripe instead of guessing based on total quota. The `UsageData` schema adds an `overageRate` field, and `npm-app` CLI warnings remove hardcoded rates. This ensures users see accurate pricing derived from their active subscription's metered price tiers.

24d7ad7fc30c6dbf98d51d0c7835d78858be2d9e.title: Git stage command execution order
24d7ad7fc30c6dbf98d51d0c7835d78858be2d9e.summary: Moved `stagePatches` call to precede `applyChanges` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Ensures previous changes are staged before new file modifications are applied. Scope limited to CLI git staging logic. Prevents race condition where new changes might be inadvertently staged or previous changes missed.

a7294e394d936ec3782b9c4445ef9f63c66489df.title: Stripe webhook adds referral credit note to invoice
a7294e394d936ec3782b9c4445ef9f63c66489df.summary: web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts now calls stripeServer.invoices.update after adding the referral credit line item. Sets invoice description to 'Referral bonus: ${referralCredits} credits deducted'. Scope limited to Stripe webhook invoice creation handler.

4075972ed32841af532cdd8a572bd2b67e4cb005.title: Fix overage rate null handling in usage types and UI
4075972ed32841af532cdd8a572bd2b67e4cb005.summary: Updated `overageRate` in `usageDataSchema` to `z.number().nullable()` and adjusted local state in `UsagePage` to initialize as `null` instead of `OVERAGE_RATE_PRO`. The web usage page now conditionally renders overage fee details only when `overageRate` is present, preventing errors for users without a defined rate. This ensures correct type safety and UI behavior for accounts lacking an overage rate.

92c08115233436487f5e0c757584e36e585e3b3e.text: The system now checks your current subscription price directly to calculate extra usage fees. This ensures the amount you see matches your actual plan, rather than an estimate.

1681e199385ce89a1d33766a2354d82f471572e2.text: The assistant now skips opening files when you send follow-up questions or simple greetings. This small internal change stops unnecessary file reads, so it only helps the assistant work more efficiently.

4075972ed32841af532cdd8a572bd2b67e4cb005.text: The system now correctly handles accounts that do not have a set overage fee rate. Users without a defined rate no longer see errors or broken fee details on the usage page.

1e3e7fd9a68962ae2944ee3187f9cf43e3638146.text: The software now checks that your computer uses a recent enough system to run it. If your system is too old, the installation will warn you or stop.

70f42362b0771f5ca0130285f72a4b9270236ad6.text: Pro users were undercharged for extra usage. The system now applies the correct higher rate for Pro plans, while Pro Plus keeps its lower rate.

4b737984c62adeefece6a6e70d32d349ca94154e.text: A small internal change removed a redundant step that checked for the end of a response. This cleanup makes the system simpler but does not change how the product works or what you see.

dd3012203660f7eb2d79cabe28a9245c56f006a2.text: A small internal cleanup simplified how the system tracks new files. This change makes the code easier to maintain without altering how the product works for users.

a7294e394d936ec3782b9c4445ef9f63c66489df.text: When a referral bonus applies, the system now adds a line item to the invoice and updates the description to show the number of credits deducted. This makes the credit visible to the customer on their bill.

e6d16d0bfec019acef0ac4b8deeff1f3c44cf154.text: The assistant now recognizes Windows-specific commands and translates them into the correct format for your computer. This internal update ensures it provides accurate instructions when you ask for help with file management tasks on Windows.

24d7ad7fc30c6dbf98d51d0c7835d78858be2d9e.text: The tool now saves your previous edits before adding new ones. This prevents it from accidentally missing or mixing up changes.

4afd0074a494a5135098f5231c4ce1977847999c.title: Update benjamin-bryant case study
4afd0074a494a5135098f5231c4ce1977847999c.summary: Corrects phrasing in the benjamin-bryant.mdx case study, removing the 'if not' qualifier to state implementation time reduction to minutes directly. Change affects only the web content file.

56063ff50d80541ea0d50110670ac0f676b04c1f.title: CLI exits on Ctrl+Z via SIGTSTP handler
56063ff50d80541ea0d50110670ac0f676b04c1f.summary: Added `process.on('SIGTSTP', ...)` to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to trigger `handleExit()` when the user presses Ctrl+Z. This ensures the CLI terminates cleanly on suspend signals rather than backgrounding or freezing. Scope is limited to the CLI surface. The handler maps the POSIX stop signal directly to the existing exit logic.

99e74e93b4adf5f45b132df8c66fdbac2c8e2fd1.title: Fix case-study wording in benjamin-bryant.mdx
99e74e93b4adf5f45b132df8c66fdbac2c8e2fd1.summary: Corrects 'two minutes' to 'minutes' in Codebuff case study. Fixes logical contradiction in implementation time description. Affects web/src/content/case-studies/benjamin-bryant.mdx only.

03e91522f6de843ecbddeffd88285bfd390e003a.title: Reduce parallel file requests in non-lite modes
03e91522f6de843ecbddeffd88285bfd390e003a.summary: Disables example and test/config file request promises in generateFileRequests for non-lite cost modes. Increases countPerRequest for pro and lite modes to compensate for reduced parallelism. Addresses unreliable haiku latency by limiting concurrent calls. Scope: backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts.

37fa4c785cf3fcbd46be0456614c951464d2edc7.title: Apply referral credits before invoice finalization
37fa4c785cf3fcbd46be0456614c951464d2edc7.summary: Referral credits now apply to Stripe usage meters during `invoice.created` events, not just `invoice.paid`. New `handleInvoiceCreated` function in `web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` injects negative credit values into `stripeServer.billing.meterEvents` to reduce billable amounts before finalization. Logic extracted from `handleSubscriptionChange` into `getTotalReferralCreditsForCustomer` for reuse. `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts` cleaned up with minor syntax fixes and removed commented debug code. `package.json` adds `start-studio` script.

ac5d79136aa688830f28c0c60793bbe95f9f0263.title: Update Dennis Beatty testimonial in web testimonials.ts
ac5d79136aa688830f28c0c60793bbe95f9f0263.summary: Replaced Dennis Beatty's testimonial quote and link in `web/src/lib/testimonials.ts`. The new text references @CodebuffAI usage and links to a newer tweet ID. This is a content-only change to the web marketing copy.

53a1670cfe1d31ed6b3a3acb51d3f35dc3646c66.title: Case study copy fixes
53a1670cfe1d31ed6b3a3acb51d3f35dc3646c66.summary: Updated `benjamin-bryant.mdx` case study text. Changed 'Amplifies' to 'Increases' in title and heading. Replaced inconsistent name usage ('Benjamin' vs 'Ben') with 'Ben' in body paragraphs. Fixed grammar in 'enables him take' sentence.

37eecb174d98099780d0becc53758c30e768b2fa.title: Add Loops signup event tracking
37eecb174d98099780d0becc53758c30e768b2fa.summary: Added Loops API integration to send signup events on user creation. Includes new LOOPS_API_KEY environment variable and fetch call to https://app.loops.so/api/v1/events/send. Scope: web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts, web/src/env.mjs.

af2dd8415506131f5a49ae8ffade5e1329a0fb0f.title: Update Benjamin Bryant case study title and copy
af2dd8415506131f5a49ae8ffade5e1329a0fb0f.summary: Rewrote the Benjamin Bryant case study in `web/src/content/case-studies/benjamin-bryant.mdx`. Updated title to "How Codebuff Amplifies Developer Productivity" and simplified tags to just "productivity". Polished narrative copy for clarity and flow.

b2172514822c8405c13432c4393f6620ff737fe8.title: --git stage replaces --auto-git
b2172514822c8405c13432c4393f6620ff737fe8.summary: CLI git flag changed from boolean --auto-git to value-based --git stage. stagePatches in common/util/git.ts stages files from last message via git add, replacing prior auto-commit logic. New types.ts defines GitCommand and CliOptions. Backend retry error message updated to 'system's a bit overwhelmed'.

99e74e93b4adf5f45b132df8c66fdbac2c8e2fd1.text: A small wording fix corrected a contradiction in a success story, changing 'two minutes' to 'minutes' to accurately reflect the implementation time. This does not affect how the product works.

53a1670cfe1d31ed6b3a3acb51d3f35dc3646c66.text: Small internal text updates. Case study wording and names corrected. No product changes.

ac5d79136aa688830f28c0c60793bbe95f9f0263.text: The website now shows an updated quote from Dennis Beatty, including a link to his latest post. This is a small internal change to the marketing text and does not affect how you use the product.

37eecb174d98099780d0becc53758c30e768b2fa.text: The system now sends a signal to a marketing tool when a new user signs up. This helps the company manage welcome emails or user lists, but does not change how you use the product.

56063ff50d80541ea0d50110670ac0f676b04c1f.text: Pressing Ctrl+Z now closes the tool cleanly instead of leaving it frozen or running in the background. This is a small internal fix for stability.

37fa4c785cf3fcbd46be0456614c951464d2edc7.text: Referral discounts now lower the bill before the final total is calculated. This prevents you from being charged for amounts that should have been covered by your credits.

af2dd8415506131f5a49ae8ffade5e1329a0fb0f.text: The Benjamin Bryant case study now has a clearer title and easier-to-read text. This change only affects how the story is written and does not change how the product works.

03e91522f6de843ecbddeffd88285bfd390e003a.text: The system now asks for fewer files at once to improve reliability. This change reduces the risk of slow responses when processing requests.

4afd0074a494a5135098f5231c4ce1977847999c.text: The description of how long it takes to set up a feature was updated to be more accurate. This is a small change to the website's text and does not affect how the software works for you.

eff9c6be11845e708e20788406ffffd3273b0dd9.title: Fix docs layout spacing on desktop
eff9c6be11845e708e20788406ffffd3273b0dd9.summary: Removed `gap-12` from docs container and added explicit `w-64` spacer div. Compensates for sidebar width to maintain layout alignment on desktop. Affects `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx`.

c95d630de7b6227d3f518d884f37df8b8ff987dd.title: Move FAQ entries to docs MDX
c95d630de7b6227d3f518d884f37df8b8ff987dd.summary: FAQ content migrated to MDX docs. Files: web/src/content/help/how-does-it-work.mdx, web/src/content/help/what-models.mdx. Removed from web/src/lib/faq.tsx. Added web/src/components/docs/mdx/custom-link.tsx for internal/external link handling in docs pages.

46118f636c46b7c6d3b34b3d990ad255f2b5adff.title: Refactor testimonials into smaller cards
46118f636c46b7c6d3b34b3d990ad255f2b5adff.summary: Replaced generic Card components with a custom ReviewCard in web/src/app/page.tsx. Updated web/src/lib/testimonials.ts to adjust author casing and reorder entries. This change reduces visual weight and standardizes testimonial display.

4edac09cee1a84f5e58581036a43730c8e831469.title: Document --lite and --pro cost mode flags
4edac09cee1a84f5e58581036a43730c8e831469.summary: Adds documentation for the `--lite` and `--pro` CLI flags across README, help docs, and startup menus. Updates `npm-app/src/index.ts` to fix spacing in mode announcement strings. Covers `npm-app/README.md`, `web/src/content/help/getting-started.mdx`, and `web/src/content/help/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx`.

b1067ad47bd356da68c45eb832479355a0a76bf3.title: Rename Mode to CostMode
b1067ad47bd356da68c45eb832479355a0a76bf3.summary: Renamed `Mode` to `CostMode` across backend and CLI. Updated `getModelForMode` to handle new 'check-new-files' operation with GPT-4o. Refactored imports and type definitions in `common/constants.ts`, `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, and `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Ensures consistent naming for cost-based model selection logic.

ca0c95cf0318ef95b381c1d8b11ae04d7628e905.title: Cost mode selection added to agent operations
ca0c95cf0318ef95b381c1d8b11ae04d7628e905.summary: New `costMode` parameter ('lite', 'normal', 'pro') propagates from WebSocket `user-input` action through `mainPrompt` and `requestRelevantFiles` to `promptClaudeStream` and `promptClaude`. `getModelForMode` in `common/src/constants.ts` selects between `claudeModels.haiku` and `claudeModels.sonnet` for agent operations, and `claudeModels.sonnet` vs `claudeModels.opus` for file-requests/check-new-files based on mode. `requestRelevantFiles` adjusts `countPerRequest` (5/6/7) and skips `examplePromise`/`newFilesNecessaryPromise` in 'lite' mode. `CLIENT_ACTION_SCHEMA` in `common/src/actions.ts` adds optional `costMode` enum defaulting to 'normal'.

21d748c48c3edc8a2e677db6bd6df477033e8463.title: Fix mobile width overflow in web docs and landing pages
21d748c48c3edc8a2e677db6bd6df477033e8463.summary: CSS layout fixes applied to web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx, web/src/app/page.tsx, and web/src/components/docs/mdx/code-demo.tsx. Docs main content now centers with flex-1 flex justify-center; FAQ section adds px-4 padding; CodeDemo component constrains width to w-80 on mobile (md:w-full) and enables overflow-x-auto on pre tags. Navbar adds /docs link; Footer hides on /docs routes via usePathname. Content in getting-started.mdx adjusted for CodeDemo formatting.

1048f59905bbf7a35925abdeacbc9662d789d4e7.title: CLI startup mode indicator
1048f59905bbf7a35925abdeacbc9662d789d4e7.summary: The CLI startup sequence in `npm-app/src/index.ts` now displays the active `costMode` using colored text before the working directory prompt. `npm-app/src/cli.ts` no longer includes mode descriptions in the welcome message. The `start` script in `npm-app/package.json` was simplified to remove an explicit build step.

055e1a087350e0593bb66cfac9bab8ab20eb6219.title: Rename cost modes lite and pro
055e1a087350e0593bb66cfac9bab8ab20eb6219.summary: Cost mode identifiers renamed from 'cheap'/'expensive' to 'lite'/'pro' across core constants, CLI flags, and backend logic. Updates apply to `common/src/constants.ts`, `npm-app/src/index.ts`, and `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`. CLI now accepts `--lite` and `--pro` flags instead of `--cheap` and `--expensive`. Welcome messages in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` reflect the new mode names.

d591118f115c70fea467813f8f7b134c374153b8.title: Add docs news feed, lower sponsee names
d591118f115c70fea467813f8f7b134c374153b8.summary: Adds a docs News section backed by new `web/src/app/api/feed/route.ts`, which fetches `https://news.codebuff.com/feed` and regex-parses feed items into JSON articles. `web/src/lib/docs.ts` exposes `getNewsArticles()` for `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx`, while `web/src/app/[sponsee]/page.tsx` lowercases `params['sponsee']`, `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` logs failed unbounded-iteration checks and returns false, and `package.json` adds `codebuff` `^1.0.119`. Scope covers the Web docs sidebar/footer, sponsee page, backend prompt flow, package metadata, and removes `web/src/content/help/troubleshooting.mdx`. The feed route returns HTTP 500 when the upstream fetch fails.

21d748c48c3edc8a2e677db6bd6df477033e8463.text: Pages on phones now fit the screen better, so text and images stay inside the view instead of spilling off the edge. This makes reading guides and landing pages easier on small devices.

eff9c6be11845e708e20788406ffffd3273b0dd9.text: A small internal fix adjusted the spacing on the documentation pages. This ensures the text lines up correctly with the side menu on desktop computers.

ca0c95cf0318ef95b381c1d8b11ae04d7628e905.text: You can now choose between three service levels: light, standard, or professional. These settings control how much effort and detail the assistant uses when processing your requests.

c95d630de7b6227d3f518d884f37df8b8ff987dd.text: The help pages were moved to a new format to make them easier to update. You can still find the same answers to common questions in the help section.

055e1a087350e0593bb66cfac9bab8ab20eb6219.text: The names for the two service levels changed to 'lite' and 'pro'. If you used the old names to pick a level, you now need to use the new ones.

46118f636c46b7c6d3b34b3d990ad255f2b5adff.text: The website now shows customer reviews in smaller, simpler cards. This makes the page look cleaner and easier to read.

1048f59905bbf7a35925abdeacbc9662d789d4e7.text: The command-line tool now shows the active cost mode in colored text when it starts. This internal change gives users a clearer view of the current setting without cluttering the initial welcome message.

4edac09cee1a84f5e58581036a43730c8e831469.text: The app now explains how to switch between basic and advanced modes in its help guides. This change is internal and does not affect how the app works.

b1067ad47bd356da68c45eb832479355a0a76bf3.text: The team renamed an internal setting to make the system clearer. This change does not affect how you use the product.

d591118f115c70fea467813f8f7b134c374153b8.text: The documentation now includes a news section. Some sponsor names display in lowercase. A help page was removed.

bd517f15859805bdb577eb1a2068f5db5d46bb63.title: Propagate mode to request files prompt
bd517f15859805bdb577eb1a2068f5db5d46bb63.summary: Mode parameter added to `requestRelevantFiles` and `getFileVersionUpdates` in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. `countPerRequest` varies by mode: 6 for expensive, 7 for cheap, 5 for normal. `generateFileRequests` skips example prompt generation in cheap mode. `mode` default removed from `mainPrompt` signature, requiring explicit propagation via `websocket-action.ts`.

eeadaab84c6ba21b057e3e0d207b3dc32cccfd37.title: Lowercase sponsee param in web page
eeadaab84c6ba21b057e3e0d207b3dc32cccfd37.summary: Sponsee name extraction in web/src/app/[sponsee]/page.tsx now applies toLowerCase() to the route param. This ensures case-insensitive matching for sponsee profiles. Change scoped to the web app's dynamic route handler.

a2c879fce06b41a71b823495cbf5d0cb951150d5.title: Rewrite Benjamin Bryant case study
a2c879fce06b41a71b823495cbf5d0cb951150d5.summary: Condensed `web/src/content/case-studies/benjamin-bryant.mdx` to a concise narrative focusing on speed gains and Codebuff's pattern matching. Removed verbose sections on learning curves, iteration processes, and specific anecdotes about multi-repo workflows or Finbarr. Scope limited to the web content directory.

62a0134a4aa2d77f3231ecca7ae1aaf18114c15c.title: Add unhandledRejection handler to backend
62a0134a4aa2d77f3231ecca7ae1aaf18114c15c.summary: Added `unhandledRejection` handler to `backend/src/index.ts` to log errors without crashing the server. Updated `uncaughtException` handler to include structured logging and console output. Scope limited to backend process management.

6e7ad99c5c21dba05812a65e0dab9619dcaca601.title: catch checkToAllowUnboundedIteration errors defaulting to false
6e7ad99c5c21dba05812a65e0dab9619dcaca601.summary: checkToAllowUnboundedIteration now catches errors and returns false. Unhandled exceptions previously crashed mainPrompt. Scope limited to backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Error logging added via logger.error.

369b8b051db0507ebe41a6534a560ceccfaa8c66.title: Remove troubleshooting guide, add codebuff dependency
369b8b051db0507ebe41a6534a560ceccfaa8c66.summary: Deleted `web/src/content/help/troubleshooting.mdx` and added `codebuff` (^1.0.119) to `package.json` dependencies. Dev dependencies were alphabetized and reordered. Scope limited to repo metadata and web content directory.

cf23c145ce70cdcd245e025304dafa020b7d7e04.title: Replace --mode flag with --cheap and --expensive in CLI
cf23c145ce70cdcd245e025304dafa020b7d7e04.summary: The CLI mode selection now uses boolean flags `--cheap` and `--expensive` instead of the value-based `--mode <cheap|normal|expensive>` argument. This simplifies argument parsing in `npm-app/src/index.ts` by removing the need for an index lookup and value validation step, defaulting to 'normal' if neither flag is present. The change is scoped to the `npm-app` package entry point and updates the help text to describe the specific model quality and file fetch behavior for each flag.

3f43ab01953a8cbdde6b426d491904ef631e4fb1.title: Added Substack news feed to docs sidebar and footer
3f43ab01953a8cbdde6b426d491904ef631e4fb1.summary: Added `https://news.codebuff.com` to the docs sidebar and site footer. Implemented a serverless route `web/src/app/api/feed/route.ts` to fetch and parse the Substack RSS feed into JSON. The `DocSidebar` component now dynamically loads these articles via `getNewsArticles` in `web/src/lib/docs.ts`, rendering them under a new 'News' section with external links.

440d6914d76a8fac849413795f68ccbba9626f70.title: Add Gemini API integration
440d6914d76a8fac849413795f68ccbba9626f70.summary: New backend/src/gemini-api.ts implements promptGemini using OpenAI SDK against Google's generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai endpoint. GEMINI_API_KEY env var added to backend/src/env.mjs with AI prefix validation. common/src/constants.ts exposes geminiModels mapping gemini2flash to gemini-2.0-flash-exp, merged into unified models export. Responses tracked via saveMessage with Helicone headers for fingerprinting and cost attribution.

78eb505f1c5078acce40199d97be44e615b6d675.title: Add cost/quality mode selection
78eb505f1c5078acce40199d97be44e615b6d675.summary: Added --mode flag (cheap/normal/expensive) to CLI. Backend selects Claude models via getModelForMode based on mode and operation type. Cheap mode skips non-obvious/test/config file requests, using only key files. Affects npm-app, backend prompts, and common constants.

78eb505f1c5078acce40199d97be44e615b6d675.text: You can now choose a cost or quality setting. The system picks the right tools for the job, saving time or money based on your choice.

cf23c145ce70cdcd245e025304dafa020b7d7e04.text: The command-line tool now uses separate switches to choose between cheaper and more expensive options, replacing the old single setting. This simplifies how the tool interprets user instructions and updates the help text to explain what each switch does.

6e7ad99c5c21dba05812a65e0dab9619dcaca601.text: The assistant now handles certain internal errors safely instead of crashing. This makes the system more stable for users.

369b8b051db0507ebe41a6534a560ceccfaa8c66.text: A help page was removed, and a new background tool was added to support the website. You will not notice any change in how you use the product.

eeadaab84c6ba21b057e3e0d207b3dc32cccfd37.text: The website now ignores capitalization when searching for a specific profile. This means you can type a name in any format, and it will still find the correct page.

bd517f15859805bdb577eb1a2068f5db5d46bb63.text: The assistant now adjusts how many files it reviews based on the selected setting. This change is internal and may subtly affect response speed or detail.

62a0134a4aa2d77f3231ecca7ae1aaf18114c15c.text: The server now reports errors internally instead of stopping. You may see fewer interruptions.

3f43ab01953a8cbdde6b426d491904ef631e4fb1.text: The website now shows news articles in the sidebar and footer. You can click these links to read the latest updates.

a2c879fce06b41a71b823495cbf5d0cb951150d5.text: We shortened the text on the case study page to focus on the main benefits. This change only affects the website's written content and does not alter how the product works.

440d6914d76a8fac849413795f68ccbba9626f70.text: The app now uses a new AI model to answer questions. This lets the assistant try a different way of thinking to help you.

3b31538d9feac271f582483bb3cf72f3fb23a47a.title: System prompt adds explicit permission check for permanent scripts
3b31538d9feac271f582483bb3cf72f3fb23a47a.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated to require explicit user permission before running scripts with permanent effects or production impacts. The guidelines list was renumbered to accommodate the new constraint, and the 'Running scripts' use case now includes a warning about permanent effects. This change affects the agent's internal decision-making logic for terminal command execution.

7150842f1f9d5e1e61cef3168d394d501e2ff518.title: Remove unused backend build and test scripts from package.json
7150842f1f9d5e1e61cef3168d394d501e2ff518.summary: Removed prebuild, postbuild, clean, test, test:manifold, and test:watch scripts from backend/package.json. Only the build script remains. This cleans up unused or redundant commands in the backend package configuration.

3b2183eb92065c9623fafbeada3fb116f8c63646.title: Detect homebrew/bin as npm installer
3b2183eb92065c9623fafbeada3fb116f8c63646.summary: Update detectInstaller in npm-app/src/update-codebuff.ts to include /opt/homebrew/bin/codebuff in global npm path detection. Adds homebrew/bin string check to isGlobalNpmPath condition. Ensures Homebrew-installed binaries are correctly identified as npm installs.

4fb51045a01c64697eba586648de4b624000fefc.title: Remove async knowledge file generation from backend prompt
4fb51045a01c64697eba586648de4b624000fefc.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts deletes `genKnowledgeFilesPromise` and associated `generateKnowledgeFiles` calls. `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` updates `getResponseFormatPrompt` to accept `fileContext` and injects knowledge file instructions directly into the system prompt. Scope covers backend prompt logic. `main-prompt.ts` now emits 'No changes to existing files.' if `fileProcessingPromises` yield no changes.

39e050a949b84a3ea36138b1395939eadd927ad7.title: tiktoken 1.0.17, package-lock.json removed
39e050a949b84a3ea36138b1395939eadd927ad7.summary: tiktoken bumped 1.0.15 to 1.0.17 in backend/package.json. package-lock.json deleted in favor of bun.lockb. Scope backend deps, lockfile. Migration: bun install required, no npm lock.

a4b4d850b4d24a966aadbb0cbfa93eb0024dc79a.title: Consolidate drizzle-orm to 0.38.0 in common
a4b4d850b4d24a966aadbb0cbfa93eb0024dc79a.summary: Removed `drizzle-orm` and `drizzle-kit` from `backend` and `web` package manifests, consolidating dependencies into `common`. `common/package.json` updated to `drizzle-orm@0.38.0` and `drizzle-kit@0.28.1`, moving `drizzle-kit` from peerDependencies to dependencies. This centralizes ORM version management across the monorepo.

68cb82724cc5370312951fb27bbbb2c1c46f3182.title: Add system info to project context
68cb82724cc5370312951fb27bbbb2c1c46f3182.summary: System info (platform, shell, node version, arch, homedir, cpus) injected into ProjectFileContext via new systemInfo schema in common/src/util/file.ts and collected in npm-app/src/project-files.ts. Replaces getMiscFilesPrompt with getSystemInfoPrompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts, restructuring prompt to lead with OS/Shell details before shell config files and recently read paths. Covers backend, common, and npm-app packages; requires systemInfo object for all project context consumers.

d3a6c538d61969e08d092563304caf31a451461a.title: CLI exit requires double Ctrl-C
d3a6c538d61969e08d092563304caf31a451461a.summary: Pressing Ctrl-C now requires two presses within 3 seconds to exit. First press shows 'Press Ctrl-C again to exit' and re-prompts. Second press triggers handleExit().

c16ab111a0ff3d9731c3811d694badb5d4a9ee0c.title: Add latencyms tracking to message cost schema
c16ab111a0ff3d9731c3811d694badb5d4a9ee0c.summary: Added `latency_ms` column to the `message` table via migration `0010_overjoyed_red_skull.sql`. Updated `saveMessage` in `message-cost-tracker.ts` to accept and store `latencyMs`. Instrumented `promptClaudeStreamWithoutRetry` in `claude.ts` and `promptOpenAI`/`promptOpenAIWithContinuation` in `openai-api.ts` to capture request start time and calculate duration.

fbdf1f044cfb39225553aa6fb9ef6979dd190732.title: Add docs center, downgrade drizzle-orm, switch to Bun
fbdf1f044cfb39225553aa6fb9ef6979dd190732.summary: New docs center added via Contentlayer and MDX in `web/`. `drizzle-orm` downgraded 0.38.0 to 0.36.4 in `common/package.json`. Schema callbacks in `common/src/db/schema.ts` shifted from object to array returns for `primaryKey` and `index`. Docs surface covers `web/src/app/docs/`, `web/contentlayer.config.ts`, and `web/next.config.mjs`. `knowledge.md` mandates Bun for package management.

c16ab111a0ff3d9731c3811d694badb5d4a9ee0c.text: The system now records how long each message takes to process. This internal timing data helps track performance without changing how the product looks or works for you.

7150842f1f9d5e1e61cef3168d394d501e2ff518.text: The product team cleaned up unused internal setup instructions for the backend system. This change is small and internal, so it does not affect how you use the product.

68cb82724cc5370312951fb27bbbb2c1c46f3182.text: The assistant now checks your computer's basic setup, like the operating system and hardware type, before answering questions about your files. This helps it give more accurate advice for your specific machine.

d3a6c538d61969e08d092563304caf31a451461a.text: Stopping the tool now requires pressing the exit key twice within three seconds to prevent accidental quits.

a4b4d850b4d24a966aadbb0cbfa93eb0024dc79a.text: The team moved a shared tool into one central place. This keeps the system's parts consistent. You will not see any changes.

39e050a949b84a3ea36138b1395939eadd927ad7.text: The system updated its internal tools for managing software components. You do not need to take any action.

3b2183eb92065c9623fafbeada3fb116f8c63646.text: The system now correctly recognizes when the software is installed via a specific common method. This small internal fix helps ensure the product identifies its own version accurately.

3b31538d9feac271f582483bb3cf72f3fb23a47a.text: The assistant now asks for your permission before running any actions that permanently change data or affect live systems. This safety step ensures you are always in control of irreversible changes.

4fb51045a01c64697eba586648de4b624000fefc.text: The assistant now builds its knowledge base directly during the conversation instead of using a separate background process. This internal change makes the system simpler but does not alter the final answers.

fbdf1f044cfb39225553aa6fb9ef6979dd190732.text: A new help center is now available. Internal tools were updated for better stability.

cd15427d4df3eba8f62457c54eb83144ddd51320.title: Switch requestRelevantFiles from Claude to GPT-4o-mini
cd15427d4df3eba8f62457c54eb83144ddd51320.summary: backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts replaces promptClaude with promptOpenAI for new-file necessity checks. Model shifts from claudeModels.haiku to models.gpt4omini. Message array restructures to include system prompt as first element.

0b8ab09f123b442516dbe547673eb0496958edec.title: Remove git mv/rm preference in system prompt
0b8ab09f123b442516dbe547673eb0496958edec.summary: System prompt guidance for file operations now recommends standard `mv`/`rm` commands instead of `git mv`/`git rm`. This change in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` removes the requirement that file moves and deletions be tracked by Git for refactoring requests.

98bcb3a09187603ef2381eb9f5c9a37cbf246554.title: Refine knowledge file generation prompt logic
98bcb3a09187603ef2381eb9f5c9a37cbf246554.summary: Updated prompt instructions in `backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts` to prevent chain-of-thought leakage and enforce explicit no-op output. The model is now instructed to consider questions internally without writing them, and to output 'No knowledge file changes needed' if criteria are unmet, replacing the previous silent skip. This change aims to improve reliability in determining when to create or update knowledge files.

086c126431333da97c6243501da4e4abb0def26d.title: safeReplace escapes $ in file-block string replace
086c126431333da97c6243501da4e4abb0def26d.summary: Added safeReplace in common/src/util/string.ts to escape $ in replacement strings. Replaced String.prototype.replace in backend/src/process-file-block.ts with safeReplace. Prevents $1, $&, and other special patterns from being interpreted as capture group references during file block processing. Internal refactor in core and shared utilities.

de1deda5fcc4f75b0a204420af8d4e2b456ffad0.title: Refactor file requesting to consolidate prompts and remove index-based
de1deda5fcc4f75b0a204420af8d4e2b456ffad0.summary: Simplified `requestFilesPrompt` by removing the distinction between 'key' and 'non-obvious' file requests based on iteration indices. The `generateFileRequests` function now executes a single set of parallel requests (Key, Example, Non-Obvious, Test/Config) using a consistent `countPerRequest` of 5, eliminating the previous dynamic prompt generation that relied on `index * 2 - 1`. `checkNewFilesNecessary` now returns a `duration` metric, and `getRelevantFiles` hardcodes `claudeModels.haiku` instead of accepting a model parameter. This reduces complexity in the file selection heuristic while maintaining the same overall request structure.

a34ba22f1b0c1706fd7989330ac0ff52108e14d6.title: Disable prompt caching for single-file search prompts
a34ba22f1b0c1706fd7989330ac0ff52108e14d6.summary: Search system prompt skips `cache_control` when `fileVersions.length <= 1`. Mechanism: `shouldDoPromptCaching` flag gates ephemeral cache blocks in `getSearchSystemPrompt` and `getProjectFilesPromptContent`. Scope: backend `system-prompt.ts`. Detail: agent prompts retain forced caching via `shouldDoPromptCaching: true`.

4e699130e92374eb633fac2c40623e07079ff557.title: Fix subscriptionactive check on cancellation
4e699130e92374eb633fac2c40623e07079ff557.summary: In `web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts`, `subscription_active` now checks `!!newSubscriptionId` instead of `usageTier === 'PAID'`. This ensures the flag reflects actual subscription presence rather than tier status, preventing incorrect active states during cancellation or downgrade events. Scope limited to Stripe webhook handling.

e92b346971a2e04f5525674d2348b07b291b3513.title: Stricter criteria for updating a knowledge file
e92b346971a2e04f5525674d2348b07b291b3513.summary: The `generateKnowledgeFiles` function in `backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts` now enforces stricter criteria for updating knowledge files. The prompt logic was refined to require a very strong affirmative response to specific questions regarding missing context or undelivered outcomes before any file update is triggered. Examples of meaningful and meaningless changes were adjusted to better guide the LLM's decision-making process. This change aims to reduce noise in knowledge files by ensuring only highly relevant and non-derivable information is recorded.

f670fdb7932f87bef16edeb24cf73db2b5d6077d.title: Pro and Pro Plus prices halved to $49 and $249
f670fdb7932f87bef16edeb24cf73db2b5d6077d.summary: Pro and Pro Plus pricing halved to $49 and $249 respectively. Credit limits in `common/src/constants.ts` adjusted proportionally to 5,000 and 27,500 (dev/test values 5,000,000 and 27,500,000). Includes `scripts/migrate-stripe-customers.ts` to migrate existing $99/mo subscriptions, preserving usage data via Stripe meters. Updates `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` to reflect new costs and Team plan structure.

f670fdb7932f87bef16edeb24cf73db2b5d6077d.text: Monthly costs for the Pro and Pro Plus plans are now half as much. Existing customers were switched to the new prices without losing their current usage history.

98bcb3a09187603ef2381eb9f5c9a37cbf246554.text: The system now clearly states when no updates are needed instead of staying silent.

de1deda5fcc4f75b0a204420af8d4e2b456ffad0.text: The assistant now uses a simpler method to find files. It asks for the same number of files every time instead of changing the request based on the order. This makes the system easier to maintain without changing how you use it.

4e699130e92374eb633fac2c40623e07079ff557.text: Fixed how the system checks if a subscription is active when it is cancelled or downgraded. This ensures the status shown in the app matches the real subscription state.

086c126431333da97c6243501da4e4abb0def26d.text: Fixed a bug where special text symbols in files were misread as commands. This stops the system from breaking or showing wrong text when handling files with those symbols.

0b8ab09f123b442516dbe547673eb0496958edec.text: The assistant now uses standard file tools for moving and deleting files instead of requiring version control tracking. This is a small internal update that simplifies how the assistant handles file changes.

a34ba22f1b0c1706fd7989330ac0ff52108e14d6.text: The system now skips saving search results when only one file is involved. This small internal change reduces unnecessary memory use without affecting how you use the product.

e92b346971a2e04f5525674d2348b07b291b3513.text: The system now requires stronger evidence before saving new information to its knowledge base. This reduces clutter by ensuring only highly relevant details are recorded.

cd15427d4df3eba8f62457c54eb83144ddd51320.text: The assistant uses a different model to check if it needs new files. This internal change may make file checks slightly faster.

5ec8008e3f2dc755ccbe0c20a8f5726dd780eb62.title: Disable WebSocket context cache warm-up
5ec8008e3f2dc755ccbe0c20a8f5726dd780eb62.summary: The `promptClaude` call to `claudeModels.haiku` in `onInit` of `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` is commented out. This removes the dummy 'codebuff' request used to warm the context cache. The change is isolated to the backend WebSocket handler.

50abb8014679fde7dc7a28b430a3ee58407365aa.title: WebSocket middleware quota and halt logs downgrade to warn
50abb8014679fde7dc7a28b430a3ee58407365aa.summary: Three logger.error calls in backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts switched to logger.warn. Covers middleware execution halts and quota exceeded events for both user and fingerprint. Internal log severity adjustment in WebSocket middleware.

b6989659f72b2ed4413dee950d65349d9b285aa9.title: Add install to skipped terminal commands
b6989659f72b2ed4413dee950d65349d9b285aa9.summary: Added 'install' to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts. Prevents Freebuff from intercepting or processing the 'install' terminal command, ensuring it passes through to the underlying system or package manager without interference.

2e7608915470d28ef8d2536a86e8f989e144ee8e.title: Stripe request and response logging disabled
2e7608915470d28ef8d2536a86e8f989e144ee8e.summary: Stripe SDK request and response event listeners commented out in common/src/util/stripe.ts. Removes verbose console logging of API interactions. Internal cleanup; no functional impact on billing or checkout flows.

b5fb776d443920e4599793053740e78b2aedc92c.title: web-scraper switches to jina.ai proxy
b5fb776d443920e4599793053740e78b2aedc92c.summary: npm-app/src/web-scraper.ts now fetches `https://r.jina.ai/${url}` via axios instead of the target URL directly. Local cheerio parsing and `$('body').text()` extraction are commented out; proxy response body is stored raw in `scrapedPagesCache`. Affects the web scraping subsystem only.

907eb5a4c6a7e902f3684cfa3b5e09438ca0ba55.title: Claude API retry logic added
907eb5a4c6a7e902f3684cfa3b5e09438ca0ba55.summary: Backend now retries `promptClaudeStream` up to 3 times on `APIConnectionError` with exponential backoff. Other Anthropic errors propagate immediately with user-facing support email. WebSocket error display strips redundant `Error: ` prefix. Files: `backend/src/claude.ts`, `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`.

bd9eebfe97d8cca4befa261b1273103c61023748.title: Add readfiles tool to backend
bd9eebfe97d8cca4befa261b1273103c61023748.summary: Introduced `read_files` tool in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to read specific file paths directly, preferring it over `find_files` when paths are known. Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to parse `read_files` calls, extract paths, and fetch file versions via `getFileVersionUpdates`. Refactored `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` for formatting and added `assistantPrompt` to debug logs.

b948c09a26677459a8d19276fe7d9de812dda5dd.title: findfiles uses description instead of full response
b948c09a26677459a8d19276fe7d9de812dda5dd.summary: find_files tool now passes description to getFileVersionUpdates instead of fullResponse. The prompt builder extracts content into contentAttributes.description for find_files. Messages array includes the assistant response for context. Affects backend/src/main-prompt.ts.

f878fa88123182167052cb74de2219258f481500.title: Lower anon and free tier credit limits
f878fa88123182167052cb74de2219258f481500.summary: ANON and FREE usage limits reduced to 500 and 1,000 respectively in `CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS` within `common/src/constants.ts`. Adjusts resource allocation for non-paid tiers. Applies to shared core constants.

f72b036ddb7d80a82f8bda8c1ff95baeb8e2a7a4.title: Remove Promise wrapper from init-response handling in client
f72b036ddb7d80a82f8bda8c1ff95baeb8e2a7a4.summary: The `init` action flow in `npm-app/src/client.ts` no longer returns a Promise waiting for the `init-response`. The code now subscribes to `init-response` to update usage asynchronously while sending the `init` action without blocking. This change eliminates the 30-second timeout and promise resolution logic that previously guarded against hanging CLI sessions when `init-response` failed to return. The update affects the core client initialization sequence used by CLI and Web surfaces.

b948c09a26677459a8d19276fe7d9de812dda5dd.text: The assistant now uses a brief summary of search results instead of the full list of files. This helps it respond faster and more clearly when you ask about documents.

2e7608915470d28ef8d2536a86e8f989e144ee8e.text: The system stopped recording extra details about payment transactions in its internal logs. This change is small and does not affect how you make payments or use checkout features.

bd9eebfe97d8cca4befa261b1273103c61023748.text: The assistant now uses a faster method to find specific files when it already knows their location. This internal change helps the system work more efficiently.

b6989659f72b2ed4413dee950d65349d9b285aa9.text: The app now lets 'install' commands pass through to your computer without interfering. This means you can install things normally while using the software.

b5fb776d443920e4599793053740e78b2aedc92c.text: The system now uses a helper service to read web pages. This internal change may help it get information more reliably.

5ec8008e3f2dc755ccbe0c20a8f5726dd780eb62.text: The system stopped sending a test message to prepare the assistant's memory when it starts up. This internal cleanup saves a tiny bit of effort behind the scenes and does not change how the assistant works for you.

f878fa88123182167052cb74de2219258f481500.text: Free and guest users now have lower daily limits on how much they can use the service. This change helps manage system resources by reducing the amount of activity allowed for non-paying accounts.

f72b036ddb7d80a82f8bda8c1ff95baeb8e2a7a4.text: The app now checks for updates in the background instead of waiting for a response before starting. This removes a 30-second wait time if the system is slow to reply, letting you start using the tool faster.

50abb8014679fde7dc7a28b430a3ee58407365aa.text: This internal update lowers the priority level for certain connection logs, reducing unnecessary alerts for staff. Users will not notice any change in how the product works.

5514885ebd100eb0e72038ff28c838e8292d9afe.title: Wrap Banner in Suspense for useSearchParams
5514885ebd100eb0e72038ff28c838e8292d9afe.summary: Wrapped Banner component in Suspense boundary. useSearchParams hook requires client-side rendering context in Next.js App Router. Fixes potential build/runtime errors related to missing suspense boundary. Affects web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx.

ad3166ef0dcd02f0400e70725d4c15421e9b3888.title: Revert @auth/drizzle-adapter to ^1.5.0
ad3166ef0dcd02f0400e70725d4c15421e9b3888.summary: Reverted @auth/drizzle-adapter from ^1.7.4 to ^1.5.0 in common/package.json. Lockfile bun.lockb updated to reflect dependency rollback. Scope limited to common package dependencies.

2a74626af7b974735c402b81d47c6556bbe688dd.title: Add cachecontrol to System type in claude.ts
2a74626af7b974735c402b81d47c6556bbe688dd.summary: Updated `System` type definition in `backend/src/claude.ts` to include optional `cache_control` property for `TextBlockParam`. Removed unused `RATE_LIMIT_POLICY` import. This change aligns the type definition with Anthropic SDK capabilities for prompt caching, ensuring correct type inference for cache control directives.

71ff7075391839932d1a0d6a1f67b08f1735527e.title: Bump drizzle-orm to 0.36.4 and drizzle-kit to 0.28.1
71ff7075391839932d1a0d6a1f67b08f1735527e.summary: Update `drizzle-orm` to `0.36.4` across `backend`, `common`, and `web` packages, and bump `drizzle-kit` to `0.28.1` in `backend` and `web`. Aligns database library versions to latest stable patches and minor releases. Changes affect dependency manifests in `package.json` files.

25d4a8e48e68260979c0602f009c58de0537c73f.title: Add cleanMarkdownCodeBlock tests
25d4a8e48e68260979c0602f009c58de0537c73f.summary: Added unit tests for `cleanMarkdownCodeBlock` in `test/__src__/process-file-block.test.ts`. Verifies removal of markdown code block syntax with and without language tags, multiline handling, and passthrough for non-block content. Renamed existing suite to `parseAndGetDiffBlocksSingleFile`. Scope limited to test file; no production code changes.

3635d45bfa58833e890c17e39ea0356fe20abfb2.title: Remove unused imports in web/src/app/layout.tsx
3635d45bfa58833e890c17e39ea0356fe20abfb2.summary: Removed unused `useEffect` and `useSearchParams` imports from `web/src/app/layout.tsx`. This cleanup resolves linting warnings and reduces bundle size by eliminating dead code dependencies. The change is scoped to the web layout component.

5aab0b5ee5902370cefb69d340f6cb2b3dd1bbb7.title: Update drizzle packages
5aab0b5ee5902370cefb69d340f6cb2b3dd1bbb7.summary: Dependency bumps for @auth/drizzle-adapter (^1.5.0 to ^1.7.4), drizzle-orm (^0.36.0 to ^0.36.4), and drizzle-kit (0.27.1 to 0.28.1). Scope limited to common/package.json and bun.lockb. No functional changes to core logic.

ef308a3c78412bbd507e9887fd1667b574eaed7c.title: npm-app client refreshes usage after login
ef308a3c78412bbd507e9887fd1667b574eaed7c.summary: The npm-app client now calls getUsage() after a successful login instead of returnControlToUser(), so usage state is refreshed in the login path. The showUsageWarning(referralLink) call in the usage-update block is commented out, preventing the warning from firing during that refresh. The login path still resets lastWarnedPct to 0 before calling getUsage(). The change is limited to npm-app/src/client.ts.

775edca1c2cdbb94c609647669c4396352731a8f.title: Fix referral page to show sponsee name
775edca1c2cdbb94c609647669c4396352731a8f.summary: The referral redemption page now displays the sponsee's name instead of their GitHub handle when a valid referral code is provided. This change introduces a derived `sponsees` array in `web/src/lib/constant.ts` and updates `web/src/app/referrals/[code]/page.tsx` to lookup names via this array rather than direct config access. The fix ensures user-friendly naming across the web referral interface.

be867f7cc267dac46c3901eda5875596d8304fa3.title: Fix System type mismatch with as const in system-prompt.ts
be867f7cc267dac46c3901eda5875596d8304fa3.summary: Removed cache_control from System type in backend/src/claude.ts. Added as const to text block types in backend/src/system-prompt.ts to satisfy type checker. Internal type alignment fix.

775edca1c2cdbb94c609647669c4396352731a8f.text: The referral page now shows a person's real name instead of their online username. This makes it easier to recognize who you are helping.

ef308a3c78412bbd507e9887fd1667b574eaed7c.text: After logging in, the app now automatically refreshes your usage details. You will see accurate information immediately, without needing to reload the page.

be867f7cc267dac46c3901eda5875596d8304fa3.text: We fixed a small internal issue that stops the system from crashing when it handles certain text. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

71ff7075391839932d1a0d6a1f67b08f1735527e.text: The software’s internal database tools were updated to newer, stable versions. This is a routine maintenance step that improves reliability but does not change how the product works for you.

ad3166ef0dcd02f0400e70725d4c15421e9b3888.text: The team rolled back a small internal change to fix a problem. You won't see anything different, but the app should work better.

25d4a8e48e68260979c0602f009c58de0537c73f.text: The software team added tests to ensure the assistant correctly cleans up code snippets in responses. This small internal change does not affect how you use the product.

5514885ebd100eb0e72038ff28c838e8292d9afe.text: A small internal update fixed a technical issue that could cause the top banner to fail to load.

5aab0b5ee5902370cefb69d340f6cb2b3dd1bbb7.text: The software updated its internal tools for handling data and user accounts. These changes improve stability and security without adding new features or altering how the product works for you.

3635d45bfa58833e890c17e39ea0356fe20abfb2.text: Developers cleaned up hidden code inside the app. This change is small and internal. It does not affect how the product looks or works for you.

46234ad15d8366899aebf7099af3e77ae17f746a.title: Clarify knowledge.md auto-creation behavior in FAQ
46234ad15d8366899aebf7099af3e77ae17f746a.summary: Updated FAQ copy in `web/src/lib/faq.tsx` to state that Codebuff "typically" will not create `knowledge.md` files, replacing absolute negation. This aligns documentation with observed agent behavior where file creation is heuristic rather than guaranteed. Scope limited to web frontend copy.

5b94e8f906453756aa040429716834383a4d93d1.title: Reduce opengraph image size
5b94e8f906453756aa040429716834383a4d93d1.summary: The `web/public/opengraph-image.png` binary was updated with a smaller size. This adjustment optimizes the asset for preview rendering. The change is scoped to the web public directory. No other files were modified.

87cc3bdea5ceaab4fc2c5da6cce3032ac7da21e6.title: Remove MAXITERATIONS hard stop in agent mode
87cc3bdea5ceaab4fc2c5da6cce3032ac7da21e6.summary: Agent loop in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` no longer exits on `MAX_ITERATIONS` via `while` condition. Instead, hitting the limit triggers a synthetic `continue` tool call when `allowUnboundedIteration` is true and no real tool call exists. This prevents premature termination of long-running tasks while preserving the warning log. Internal loop logic only; no CLI or Web UI changes.

7d1b3f6252a10308fd6aae37a6e9a158297260fd.title: Add JJ Fliegelman testimonial to web
7d1b3f6252a10308fd6aae37a6e9a158297260fd.summary: New testimonial entry added to `web/src/lib/testimonials.ts` with quote from JJ Fliegelman, Founder. Proof image `web/public/testimonials/proof/jj-fliegelman.png` included. Affects web surface only.

7a5ea0107fbda2f103b168d84e3fe66226a75c4e.title: Add minimum member constraint to pricing page
7a5ea0107fbda2f103b168d84e3fe66226a75c4e.summary: Updated the enterprise pricing tier feature list to include a minimum member requirement. The text for 'Custom credit limits per member' now specifies '(min. 3 members)'. This change applies to `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`.

3f7dbde8192229ec2652690ed021d648bb446b51.title: Added Dex testimonial
3f7dbde8192229ec2652690ed021d648bb446b51.summary: Added testimonial for Dexter Horthy to web/src/lib/testimonials.ts. Includes proof image web/public/testimonials/proof/dex.png. Updated existing link for dnsbty to remove query params.

01e2d7e1acc1a0c22f92063232afdfa6708878fa.title: Enforce relative file paths in backend request handling
01e2d7e1acc1a0c22f92063232afdfa6708878fa.summary: Moved path validation logic from `main-prompt.ts` to `request-files-prompt.ts` to enforce stricter file path requirements. The `requestRelevantFiles` function now filters out absolute paths and `..` segments, and explicitly strips leading slashes from returned paths. This ensures all generated file requests are relative to the project root, preventing silent failures in file operations. Updated `backend/knowledge.md` to document these path constraints and the need for change verification.

2393cf1d3365ad1d84271aaf7f854be2e6af0e9f.title: Expanded DEFAULTIGNOREDFILES in constants.ts
2393cf1d3365ad1d84271aaf7f854be2e6af0e9f.summary: Added .env.*, .DS_Store, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache, and .next to DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES in common/src/constants.ts. Reordered existing env and ENV entries. Prevents Freebuff from indexing generated caches, OS metadata, and Next.js build outputs.

f65adba28db3fa54b0d303b79ce91026b28f437c.title: Add sponsee referral tracking and display
f65adba28db3fa54b0d303b79ce91026b28f437c.summary: Implemented sponsee referral tracking via new /{sponsee} routing page and updated Banner component. New page validates routing keys against sponseeConfig, stores search params, and redirects to home with utm_source=youtube. Banner displays personalized referral messages for YouTube-sourced users using display names from sponseeConfig. Referrals page now maps routing keys to referral codes and display names. Navbar hides Referrals link for unauthenticated users.
