b380c24195f43b3a6cc9e8819cae75f6ed8d4cb4.title: CLI shows last request credits
b380c24195f43b3a6cc9e8819cae75f6ed8d4cb4.summary: CLI displays credits used for the last request when `lastRequestCredits` exceeds `REQUEST_CREDIT_SHOW_THRESHOLD`. Client calculates per-request usage by tracking the delta between total session credits in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. Logic updates `common/src/constants.ts` and `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to gate the message visibility.

7a5ea0107fbda2f103b168d84e3fe66226a75c4e.text: The enterprise pricing page now shows that the custom credit limits feature requires at least three team members.

5b94e8f906453756aa040429716834383a4d93d1.text: The image shown when you share a link online got smaller. This helps it load faster without changing how the preview looks.

3f7dbde8192229ec2652690ed021d648bb446b51.text: The website now shows a testimonial from Dexter Horthy. A link was also cleaned up to remove extra text.

87cc3bdea5ceaab4fc2c5da6cce3032ac7da21e6.text: The assistant no longer stops working after a fixed number of steps. This lets it finish longer tasks without cutting off early.

7d1b3f6252a10308fd6aae37a6e9a158297260fd.text: A new customer testimonial was added to the website. This update is internal and does not change how you use the product.

01e2d7e1acc1a0c22f92063232afdfa6708878fa.text: The assistant now strictly follows file location rules to ensure it finds the correct documents. This prevents errors where the system might fail to retrieve needed information.

2393cf1d3365ad1d84271aaf7f854be2e6af0e9f.text: The system now ignores extra background files it does not need to read. This keeps the tool running faster and prevents it from showing you confusing, unnecessary details.

f65adba28db3fa54b0d303b79ce91026b28f437c.text: Links from specific YouTube channels now show a personalized welcome message and hide the referrals menu for logged-out users.

b380c24195f43b3a6cc9e8819cae75f6ed8d4cb4.text: The tool now shows how many credits a single request used, but only when the amount is large enough to notice.

a340fce4c6b6402295c0a3cbd45f16ed425c4402.title: Add test for multiple diff blocks in single file
a340fce4c6b6402295c0a3cbd45f16ed425c4402.summary: Added test case to `process-file-block.test.ts` verifying `processFileBlock` handles multiple SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in one file. Validates patch application via `applyPatch` ensures both blocks are processed correctly. Scope limited to test suite.

b175b35b1b9a671dc20bcd4817ca721bb2fba917.title: LinkedIn ID propagation in Stripe checkout URLs
b175b35b1b9a671dc20bcd4817ca721bb2fba917.summary: Stripe checkout success and cancel URLs now preserve LinkedIn `li_fat_id` and UTM parameters via `searchParams` in `web/src/app/api/stripe/checkout-session/route.ts`. `trackUpgrade` in `web/src/lib/trackConversions.ts` replaces `trackUpgradeClick`, conditionally firing `linkedInTrack` only on final conversion to prevent premature attribution loss. `web/src/app/payment-success/page.tsx` merges these params back into the URL using `router.replace`. Credit display values in `npm-app/src/client.ts` and `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` now use `toLocaleString()`.

c4bf385ecf319f2a9da8b77ebb8f9779d05df37f.title: System prompt restricts long-running scripts
c4bf385ecf319f2a9da8b77ebb8f9779d05df37f.summary: Added instruction to backend/src/system-prompt.ts forbidding execution of long-running scripts like npm run dev. Prevents terminal hangs from non-exiting processes. Affects all agent sessions via core system prompt.

5f66481bc140904bb2b7f8133fd371ecc1983cb2.title: Add empty state text for file blocks and file trees
5f66481bc140904bb2b7f8133fd371ecc1983cb2.summary: System prompt generation appends 'There are no files selected yet.' when fileBlockSets is empty. File tree printing returns '[No files in this directory.]' if nodes length is zero. Changes affect backend/src/system-prompt.ts and common/src/util/file.ts. Provides explicit context to the model when no files are included.

69167eee20eeaf7b0f8eaa1707d188d9cb4eb21f.title: system-prompt: make terminal build checks optional, move long-running
69167eee20eeaf7b0f8eaa1707d188d9cb4eb21f.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts reframes the post-edit verification section from mandatory to optional, instructing the agent to check knowledge files for a specified protocol before running terminal commands. The long-running command prohibition (e.g., npm run dev) moved from the run_terminal_command use-cases list to the tool guidelines, with added rationale that users must wait for completion. Scope limited to the backend system prompt; no CLI, Web, or Desktop surfaces affected. The two separate knowledge-file fallback paragraphs merged into one.

9137ca0c8cffe43534f1fce215958517349f4c46.title: Add indexes for message userid and fingerprintid
9137ca0c8cffe43534f1fce215958517349f4c46.summary: Added btree indexes on `message.user_id` and `message.fingerprint_id` to speed up usage calculations. Defined in `common/src/db/schema.ts` and applied via migration `0009_bitter_rumiko_fujikawa.sql`. Updated `schema.knowledge.md` with guidelines on index management and performance.

c485b69b4b1315b0b638e015cb7eb291a7e2624d.title: Add payment-success page tracking LinkedIn conversions
c485b69b4b1315b0b638e015cb7eb291a7e2624d.summary: New `payment-success` page fires `trackUpgradeClick` on mount to confirm LinkedIn conversions. `stripe.ts` removes pre-checkout tracking and utm param injection, relying on the success page instead. `linkedin.ts` renamed to `trackConversions.ts` with active `linkedInTrack` call and `li_fat_id` cleanup. Covers Web surface.

697f570e52aa3b07a5b8d6987a1913c23ce7c3c1.title: Fix Stripe checkout success URL
697f570e52aa3b07a5b8d6987a1913c23ce7c3c1.summary: Stripe checkout success_url redirects to /payment-success instead of /pricing. payment-success page shows CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS.PAID. Removed duplicate successUrl from redirectToCheckout call. Files: web/src/app/api/stripe/checkout-session/route.ts, web/src/app/payment-success/page.tsx, web/src/lib/stripe.ts.

ee0663dbef0086abfcdbabc749210904cf8dc92c.title: Refactor payment tracking and success flow
ee0663dbef0086abfcdbabc749210904cf8dc92c.summary: Payment tracking refactored in `web/src/lib/linkedin.ts` and `web/src/lib/stripe.ts`. `trackUpgradeClick` now returns `URLSearchParams` instead of a string query fragment. `stripe.ts` updates `redirectToCheckout` to use Stripe's `{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` placeholder in `successUrl` and removes manual UTM parameter appending to the checkout session API call.

9137ca0c8cffe43534f1fce215958517349f4c46.text: The system now finds message records faster. This makes usage calculations run quicker.

697f570e52aa3b07a5b8d6987a1913c23ce7c3c1.text: After paying, users now land on the pricing page instead of a separate success page. This internal fix ensures the correct screen displays after a checkout.

c4bf385ecf319f2a9da8b77ebb8f9779d05df37f.text: The assistant now stops trying to run tasks that never finish. This prevents the system from getting stuck while waiting for those tasks to complete.

a340fce4c6b6402295c0a3cbd45f16ed425c4402.text: The team added an internal test to check that the software can fix several parts of a single file at once. This helps prevent errors when the assistant updates your documents.

5f66481bc140904bb2b7f8133fd371ecc1983cb2.text: The assistant now clearly states when no files are selected or when a folder is empty. This helps it understand the situation without guessing.

b2172514822c8405c13432c4393f6620ff737fe8.text: The assistant now offers more precise control over saving changes, allowing you to specify exactly which stage to preserve. Error messages have also been updated to be friendlier when the system is busy.

c485b69b4b1315b0b638e015cb7eb291a7e2624d.text: The website now records a successful payment only after the customer sees the confirmation page. This makes the sales data more accurate.

b175b35b1b9a671dc20bcd4817ca721bb2fba917.text: When you pay for a service, the website keeps track of which ad or link brought you there so it can count how well that marketing worked. This helps the company understand if their ads are helping people find them.

ec0f0960ae0e556b39166323f9965f11c3b58d7e.title: Add LinkedIn tracking to pricing page
ec0f0960ae0e556b39166323f9965f11c3b58d7e.summary: Added `linkedInTrack` call in `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` using ID 353503946 when a `li_fat_id` exists in localStorage. Updated `web/src/app/page.tsx` to remove `li_fat_id` from URL params via `window.history.replaceState` after storing it. This ensures clean URLs and consistent tracking across the home and pricing pages.

0b9b8fd1a297f41f85a9a65c0ae3246190d34f57.title: Pricing page LinkedIn campaign ID tracking update
0b9b8fd1a297f41f85a9a65c0ae3246190d34f57.summary: Hardcoded LinkedIn campaign ID 353503946 replaced with constant LINKED_IN_CAMPAIGN_ID (719181716) in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. The new ID reflects updated campaign tracking for 'Codebuff YC'. Scope limited to pricing page conversion tracking.

6314fa1ed7c3df329d94e0685d9894e9bb73a2f0.title: System prompt warns against writing tool calls when explaining tools
6314fa1ed7c3df329d94e0685d9894e9bb73a2f0.summary: Added instruction to system prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts warning agents not to write out <tool_call name="..." /> unless actually intending to call the tool. Prevents accidental tool execution when explaining available tools. Internal prompt refinement only.

7ed1ff4eafe0b4d2989120f08f663f77da6616e7.title: LinkedIn UTM tracking and Stripe success URL
7ed1ff4eafe0b4d2989120f08f663f77da6616e7.summary: Replaced `ref` parameter with `utm_source` in LinkedIn tracking URL. Added explicit `successUrl` to Stripe checkout redirect. Affects `web/src/lib/linkedin.ts` and `web/src/lib/stripe.ts`.

f21fac01d4c9831c4e968b03e7282b08415c3253.title: Add UTM source tracking to Stripe payment success URL
f21fac01d4c9831c4e968b03e7282b08415c3253.summary: UTM source parameters are now appended to the Stripe checkout success URL in web/src/lib/stripe.ts. The implementation extracts utm_source from the query string (stripping the first 12 characters) and adds it to the successUrl object before redirection. This change enables attribution tracking for payment completions originating from specific marketing campaigns.

c24ba8efe2c06ba215111e206c351f49a5129293.title: Trim trailing whitespace in main-prompt assistant messages
c24ba8efe2c06ba215111e206c351f49a5129293.summary: Applied trim() to fullResponse before constructing assistant messages in main-prompt.ts. This ensures trailing end whitespace is stripped from continuedMessages and final message payloads. Scope limited to backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Prevents whitespace artifacts in model context.

43ed770f045a64d251db3d3c9319bb1d937c7f38.title: Add LinkedIn Insight Tag to web footer
43ed770f045a64d251db3d3c9319bb1d937c7f38.summary: Added `nextjs-linkedin-insight-tag` dependency and rendered `<LinkedInInsightTag />` in `web/src/components/footer.tsx`. Introduced optional `NEXT_PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PARTNER_ID` in `web/src/env.mjs` for tag configuration. Scope limited to web marketing analytics integration.

732906174af2edd05627bf13c4b9ea43b7a56b67.title: Comment out LinkedIn tracking calls in web/src/lib/linkedin.ts
732906174af2edd05627bf13c4b9ea43b7a56b67.summary: Disabled `linkedInTrack` calls in `web/src/lib/linkedin.ts` by commenting out `require('nextjs-linkedin-insight-tag')` and `linkedInTrack(LINKED_IN_CAMPAIGN_ID)`. Change scoped to Web surface only. `li_fat_id` retrieval and removal logic remain active.

87b543491dd17629e88ab979f6ced010e6b0e050.title: Add LinkedIn lifatid capture to landing page
87b543491dd17629e88ab979f6ced010e6b0e050.summary: Home page captures `li_fat_id` query param into localStorage via `useSearchParams` and `useEffect`. New `analytics.knowledge.md` documents the multi-step conversion tracking flow for upgrades and subscription checkouts using `nextjs-linkedin-insight-tag`. Scope limited to `web/src/app/page.tsx` and docs.

519f59e3da75e0220722ce9094577d3b11f6afd5.title: Add shared Stripe checkout and LinkedIn tracking helpers
519f59e3da75e0220722ce9094577d3b11f6afd5.summary: Shared `handleCreateCheckoutSession` in `web/src/lib/stripe.ts` and `trackUpgradeClick` in `web/src/lib/linkedin.ts` replace inline checkout and LinkedIn code in `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` and `web/src/components/navbar/user-dropdown.tsx`. The new helper reads `li_fat_id`, calls `linkedInTrack`, removes the stored value, and appends `?ref=linkedin&li_fat_id=...` to the checkout-session request before redirecting through Stripe. Scope is web pricing, navbar dropdown, and related knowledge docs; the dropdown checkout flow now uses the same tracking path as pricing.

519f59e3da75e0220722ce9094577d3b11f6afd5.text: This internal change ensures the system correctly records when users click upgrade buttons from LinkedIn ads. It does not alter the visible checkout process or add new features.

ec0f0960ae0e556b39166323f9965f11c3b58d7e.text: The website now quietly records visits from LinkedIn ads to help measure campaign success. This happens without changing the web address you see or affecting how you browse the pages.

0b9b8fd1a297f41f85a9a65c0ae3246190d34f57.text: The pricing page now sends visitor activity to the updated ad campaign used by the marketing team. This helps them measure how well the campaign works. It does not affect normal product use.

7ed1ff4eafe0b4d2989120f08f663f77da6616e7.text: A small internal update improved how the system tracks visitors from LinkedIn and ensures users land on the correct page after a successful payment.

c24ba8efe2c06ba215111e206c351f49a5129293.text: The system now removes extra spaces at the end of assistant responses. This keeps the conversation history clean and prevents small formatting errors.

87b543491dd17629e88ab979f6ced010e6b0e050.text: The website now records a small tag when you arrive from a LinkedIn ad, helping the team see which ads led to sign-ups. This is a minor internal tracking update and does not change how you use the product.

f21fac01d4c9831c4e968b03e7282b08415c3253.text: The system now tags completed payments with the specific marketing campaign that brought you there. This internal change helps track which ads or links lead to successful purchases. No visible change for users.

43ed770f045a64d251db3d3c9319bb1d937c7f38.text: Added a small tracking tool to the website footer for marketing analysis. Users will not notice any change.

6314fa1ed7c3df329d94e0685d9894e9bb73a2f0.text: The assistant now avoids accidentally running actions when describing its features. This internal update prevents confusion by keeping tool use separate from explanations.

732906174af2edd05627bf13c4b9ea43b7a56b67.text: The website stopped sending information about your visits to a marketing service. This change affects only how the site tracks activity behind the scenes and does not change what you see or how you use the product.

1aaf38e06dc8e559f842ebd7cd28034b6db24ce5.title: Added Dennis Beatty testimonial
1aaf38e06dc8e559f842ebd7cd28034b6db24ce5.summary: Added Dennis Beatty testimonial to `web/src/lib/testimonials.ts`. Entry references ManicodeAI terminal integration. Internal content update.

5e74c44b22a766a6d7fb72f43f2fab042ed90b2d.title: Simplify file reading message
5e74c44b22a766a6d7fb72f43f2fab042ed90b2d.summary: Simplified the file reading message by adding an `isFirstTime` parameter to `getRelevantFileInfoMessage` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The message now distinguishes between initial and subsequent file reads, formatting the file list as a bulleted list with a cap of 3 files before summarizing the remainder.

046534f3a22f24c03f03efbe5a65976900efcc49.title: Improve conversation progress handling
046534f3a22f24c03f03efbe5a65976900efcc49.summary: Refactors `checkConversationProgress` in `backend/src/conversation-progress.ts` to strip `STOP_MARKER` from responses and trim prompt templates. Updates `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to stream the progress determination response to the client and use it in the continue tool call input.

ad7784faa1da0e75ead84ada8b6809e0116c0a2e.title: ASCII art menu update
ad7784faa1da0e75ead84ada8b6809e0116c0a2e.summary: Replaced Manicode ASCII art with Codebuff ASCII art in `npm-app/src/menu.ts`. Updates visual branding in CLI menu. No functional logic changes.

dc707c40a6af0680e0464e97c6c7a59e9e0c33b6.title: Tighten unbounded iteration prompt in conversation-progress
dc707c40a6af0680e0464e97c6c7a59e9e0c33b6.summary: Adjusted unbounded iteration prompt to be more strict in backend/src/conversation-progress.ts. Added explicit 'yes'/'no' examples and rarity/commonness constraints to guide the classification.

cb97eb063b233b3e46290c91d4b05fbe64b6242a.title: Refine continuation logging and empty file handling
cb97eb063b233b3e46290c91d4b05fbe64b6242a.summary: Updated `main-prompt.ts` to log the last line of the response during continuation and return an empty string for `readFilesMessage` when `filePaths` is empty. This prevents unnecessary whitespace or prompt pollution when no files are relevant.

6a576126c7f8988ea1cab4927ec78bc55740d91c.title: Shared cleanMarkdownCodeBlock helper for AI file rewrites
6a576126c7f8988ea1cab4927ec78bc55740d91c.summary: Added `cleanMarkdownCodeBlock` to `common/src/util/file.ts` to handle markdown code block stripping. `processFileBlock` and `applyRemainingChanges` now use this helper instead of inline regexes. The rewrite prompt no longer explicitly forbids code blocks, relying on the new cleaning step.

fefd759f6be743da29d8bd9d89bc578c6c96cad4.title: Update npm-app README copy
fefd759f6be743da29d8bd9d89bc578c6c96cad4.summary: Revised `npm-app/README.md` to emphasize Codebuff's agentic capabilities, noting it runs commands, edits multiple files, and executes tests/linters. Updated installation troubleshooting to suggest `sudo` for permission errors and clarified OS-specific instructions. Adjusted feature list to highlight codebase understanding and autonomous task completion.

bf51ae2f197d6b22892722ae73c176e9f1740d91.title: Fix stale files bug in main-prompt
bf51ae2f197d6b22892722ae73c176e9f1740d91.summary: Refactored `getFileVersionUpdates` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to accept `skipRequestingFiles` option, bypassing `requestRelevantFiles` when `justUsedATool` is true. This prevents unnecessary file context updates and stale data after tool execution. Scope limited to backend prompt logic.

f85464740b55160de057dcd39b8c6aa512be4d07.title: Enable skipLibCheck in backend tsconfig
f85464740b55160de057dcd39b8c6aa512be4d07.summary: Added "skipLibCheck": true to backend/tsconfig.json compilerOptions. This disables type-checking of declaration files to prevent errors from third-party or internal library typings during compilation. Scope limited to backend TypeScript configuration. No runtime or API behavior changes.

6a576126c7f8988ea1cab4927ec78bc55740d91c.text: The assistant now automatically removes extra formatting symbols from the text it writes. This means you will see cleaner, more readable results without having to fix them yourself.

cb97eb063b233b3e46290c91d4b05fbe64b6242a.text: The assistant now ignores empty files when preparing its response. This prevents extra blank spaces from appearing in the output.

046534f3a22f24c03f03efbe5a65976900efcc49.text: Internal update. Assistant better tracks conversation flow. No visible user change.

5e74c44b22a766a6d7fb72f43f2fab042ed90b2d.text: The assistant now gives a clearer summary when reading multiple files. It shows a short list first, then describes the rest, so the response is easier to read.

f85464740b55160de057dcd39b8c6aa512be4d07.text: We made a small internal change to how the software checks its own instructions. This stops the system from complaining about minor mismatches in third-party guides, but nothing about how the product works or looks will change for you.

dc707c40a6af0680e0464e97c6c7a59e9e0c33b6.text: A small internal change made the assistant’s decision about when to keep going more careful. It now uses clearer yes-or-no examples and stricter limits to guide that decision. Most users will not notice anything.

1aaf38e06dc8e559f842ebd7cd28034b6db24ce5.text: Added a customer review to the website. This is a small internal update that does not change how the product works.

bf51ae2f197d6b22892722ae73c176e9f1740d91.text: The assistant now avoids using outdated file information after completing a task. This small internal fix helps it provide more accurate answers.

ad7784faa1da0e75ead84ada8b6809e0116c0a2e.text: The menu now shows a different picture at the top. This only changes how the menu looks and does not affect how the product works.

fefd759f6be743da29d8bd9d89bc578c6c96cad4.text: The instructions for setting up the assistant were updated to explain its new ability to edit files and run tests automatically. This helps users understand what the tool can do and provides clearer steps for fixing common setup errors.

26092ae9a09c3e9e0f587f3ab06c17da484a208a.title: Handle absolute paths in getFiles
26092ae9a09c3e9e0f587f3ab06c17da484a208a.summary: getFiles in npm-app/src/project-files.ts now converts absolute paths within the project root to relative paths before processing. This ensures correct gitignore matching and prevents path traversal errors when absolute paths are passed. The change affects file retrieval logic by normalizing input paths.

43dfad61c5c5f6b528c6ec9499014cea069ef82d.title: request-files-prompt clarifies relative path requirement
43dfad61c5c5f6b528c6ec9499014cea069ef82d.summary: Updated `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` to explicitly state that file paths must be relative to the project root, not absolute. This change appears in four prompt templates to prevent model hallucination of absolute paths. Scope is limited to internal prompt engineering logic.

41a7988a22d8f5ffe87e36db62da2dc7963c6819.title: System prompt clarifies full-file overwrite for editfile
41a7988a22d8f5ffe87e36db62da2dc7963c6819.summary: The system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` now explicitly instructs the agent to write the entire file content when overwriting, forbidding truncation with placeholder comments. This change targets the `edit_file` block mechanism to prevent incomplete file rewrites. The update is internal to the backend prompt logic.

6ac89cc4c5269bcdf2c51ed4b142e2f180fd0675.title: Add break to SKIPPEDTERMINALCOMMANDS
6ac89cc4c5269bcdf2c51ed4b142e2f180fd0675.summary: Added 'break' to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts. Prevents terminal handling for this command. Scope limited to shared core constants. Internal refactor.

42c28d63b9490ba5f63f5b1f616e7b8fd090d50d.title: Report usage to Stripe meter events
42c28d63b9490ba5f63f5b1f616e7b8fd090d50d.summary: Message costs reported to Stripe billing meter events asynchronously after DB save in `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts`. `stripe.billing.meterEvents.create` called with `event_name: 'credits'`, `stripe_customer_id`, and `value` from `creditsUsed`. Only for authenticated users with active subscriptions and non-zero credits. `common/src/util/string.ts` `pluralize` updated to include count in output string.

3250b8c1712f68ac2ae74ae1cec1a2cf9237178f.title: Clarify terminal verification protocol in system prompt
3250b8c1712f68ac2ae74ae1cec1a2cf9237178f.summary: System prompt section renamed from 'Verifying changes' to 'To complete a response, run commands to check for correctness'. Instruction now explicitly directs agent to check knowledge files for verification protocols before running terminal commands. Scope limited to backend/src/system-prompt.ts. Small change exception for confident single-line edits retained but moved inline.

40a018d94ff478a6678ecebaed3245b9b3d97178.title: Add createdat to fingerprint table
40a018d94ff478a6678ecebaed3245b9b3d97178.summary: Added `created_at` column to `fingerprint` table in `common/src/db/schema.ts` via migration `0008_puzzling_carnage.sql`. Column is `timestamp`, `NOT NULL`, defaults to `now()`. Updates Drizzle journal and snapshot metadata. No user-facing behavior change; internal DB schema only.

c9371008d553ea874e6929ca416ae24f7f6e6e4f.title: Add where to SKIPPEDTERMINALCOMMANDS
c9371008d553ea874e6929ca416ae24f7f6e6e4f.summary: Added 'where' to the SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS list in common/src/constants.ts. This prevents Freebuff from attempting to execute the 'where' command during agent runs, aligning it with other skipped utilities like 'which' and 'who'. Scope is limited to the core constants module.

91988bf6a74263671795cca88d37661d256f1847.title: System prompt: terminal checks now opt-in via knowledge files
91988bf6a74263671795cca88d37661d256f1847.summary: Updated backend/src/system-prompt.ts to change verification behavior. The prompt now instructs the agent to check knowledge files for verification protocols and to skip terminal commands if none are specified. This removes the previous default behavior of running tests/linters/type-checkers after every edit.

2c55be5648921d8bc2b0803a95969e3ab4941e70.title: Refine agent stop logic and continue tool payload
2c55be5648921d8bc2b0803a95969e3ab4941e70.summary: Updated `checkConversationProgress` in `backend/src/conversation-progress.ts` to require explicit confirmation of full user request satisfaction rather than minimal completion. The function now returns an object containing `shouldStop` and a `response` string detailing remaining tasks. In `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, stop marker handling was restructured to pass the progress check response to the `continue` tool call. `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` was modified to consume this `input.response` payload, replacing the static 'Please continue.' string.

2c55be5648921d8bc2b0803a95969e3ab4941e70.text: The assistant now checks if it fully answered your request before stopping. If tasks remain, it tells you what is left instead of giving a generic message.

40a018d94ff478a6678ecebaed3245b9b3d97178.text: The software now records when each item is created. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

26092ae9a09c3e9e0f587f3ab06c17da484a208a.text: A small internal update fixes how the tool finds files. This prevents errors when searching for files in certain ways.

91988bf6a74263671795cca88d37661d256f1847.text: The assistant now skips automatic code checks unless the project instructions ask for them. This change saves time and reduces unnecessary work.

43dfad61c5c5f6b528c6ec9499014cea069ef82d.text: The assistant now knows to look for files using simple folder paths instead of full computer addresses. This small internal update helps it find the right files more reliably.

3250b8c1712f68ac2ae74ae1cec1a2cf9237178f.text: The assistant now checks its instructions before running verification steps, making responses more reliable. This is a small internal update.

6ac89cc4c5269bcdf2c51ed4b142e2f180fd0675.text: A small internal fix ensures that one specific command is skipped during processing. This change does not affect how you use the product.

42c28d63b9490ba5f63f5b1f616e7b8fd090d50d.text: Usage tracking now sends message counts to the billing system automatically. This ensures your account is charged correctly for the messages you send.

c9371008d553ea874e6929ca416ae24f7f6e6e4f.text: The assistant no longer tries to run a specific search command. This small fix prevents minor errors during tasks.

fbf01f1f57948f9d4ab0fbf313b878b0d7b08ea4.title: Prevent empty blocks in file version and project prompts
fbf01f1f57948f9d4ab0fbf313b878b0d7b08ea4.summary: Added filters to remove empty strings from prompt construction in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Prevents empty blocks in `getFileVersionUpdates` and `getProjectFilesPromptContent` when file lists are empty. Ensures cleaner prompt output by excluding empty file version arrays and project file strings.

cca3ced75e6f2223a2a173f5d75bf74ea48c99cd.title: Add changesAlreadyApplied to websocket debug log
cca3ced75e6f2223a2a173f5d75bf74ea48c99cd.summary: The `response-complete` debug log in `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` now includes the `changesAlreadyApplied` object. This provides visibility into idempotency state during websocket action processing. Scope limited to backend websocket logging.

0f517782fec99400b1314809cdeed2c69482aba7.title: Add Python defaults to file ignore list
0f517782fec99400b1314809cdeed2c69482aba7.summary: Expanded `DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES` in `common/src/constants.ts` to include Python-specific artifacts (`__pycache__`, `*.egg-info/`, `*.pyc`) and virtual environment directories (`venv`, `virtualenv`, `env`, `.venv`, `.virtualenv`, `ENV`). `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` now iterates over this constant to populate the `ignore` instance, replacing hardcoded additions. This prevents Freebuff from indexing irrelevant Python build and cache files.

66006c3871aec152096f4f48fa655af7b3d66ab2.title: Add dedicated test and config file retrieval prompt
66006c3871aec152096f4f48fa655af7b3d66ab2.summary: Introduced `generateTestAndConfigFilesPrompt` in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` to fetch test and config files separately from main logic files. Updated system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to mandate explicit verification steps using concatenated commands (e.g., `npm run lint && npm run test`) after edits.

43e03e58db80c99614d63ea0dc1971258af72603.title: Remove STOPMARKER cleanup and empty file filter
43e03e58db80c99614d63ea0dc1971258af72603.summary: Removed `fullResponse.replace(STOP_MARKER, '')` from `main-prompt.ts` and `.filter((str) => str)` from `system-prompt.ts`. These changes eliminate post-processing that stripped stop markers and filtered empty strings, likely relying on upstream handling or simplifying logic. Scope limited to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The `STOP_MARKER` is no longer explicitly removed from the response string in the stop condition.

6b20e41107c04b8870bc35225d6371acaeb2289b.title: Re-enable conversation progress checks and unbounded iteration logic
6b20e41107c04b8870bc35225d6371acaeb2289b.summary: Reverts previous revert, restoring `conversation-progress.ts` to handle smart continuation. Implements `checkConversationProgress` using Claude Sonnet to detect loops or satisfied requests, and `checkToAllowUnboundedIteration` using GPT-4 Mini to identify user intent for 'do all' tasks. Updates `main-prompt.ts` to pause only when appropriate, replacing rigid message counts with dynamic progress evaluation. Refines `system-prompt.ts` to remove `checkFiles` option and enforce local package installation via project-specific managers.

e5f85d760ee77cd7cfeb10a2489c36ae3746ae96.title: Add STRIPEOVERAGEPRICEID to checkout session
e5f85d760ee77cd7cfeb10a2489c36ae3746ae96.summary: Stripe checkout session now includes a second line item for overage usage alongside the subscription price. Requires new `STRIPE_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID` environment variable in `web/src/env.mjs`. Subscription line item explicitly sets `quantity: 1`.

07a24a2fcadc2a4f836f299fb5bdb8b8efd755a9.title: Add conversation progress detection and refine system prompts
07a24a2fcadc2a4f836f299fb5bdb8b8efd755a9.summary: New `backend/src/conversation-progress.ts` introduces `checkConversationProgress` (Claude Sonnet) and `checkToAllowUnboundedIteration` (GPT-4o Mini) to detect loops and unbounded requests. `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` integrates these checks to pause or continue based on progress, replacing simple message-count limits with semantic evaluation. `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` removes the `checkFiles` option from `getAgentSystemPrompt` and adds explicit instructions to avoid global package installs and use project-specific package managers. `backend/knowledge.md` documents the new WebSocket flow and conversation management architecture.

6f27f4d86abf2ba45057e82294ed8f3b753a7746.title: Revert Continue-until-condition logic
6f27f4d86abf2ba45057e82294ed8f3b753a7746.summary: Reverts 'Continue until user condition' feature. Removes `conversation-progress.ts` and associated logic from `main-prompt.ts` and `system-prompt.ts`. Eliminates GPT-4 Mini/Claude Sonnet checks for loop detection and unbounded iteration permissions. Restores simpler pause mechanism based on message count in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

b5d976e118da6f39dce3ab47189176b981991272.title: Usage-based pricing migration
b5d976e118da6f39dce3ab47189176b981991272.summary: Added DB migration 0007_equal_warlock.sql enforcing cascade deletes on `message` foreign keys to `user` and `fingerprint`. Updated `schema.ts` to reflect `onDelete: 'cascade'`. Stripe checkout session removed hardcoded `quantity: 1` to support usage-based pricing. Pricing page layout adjusted for cancellation link.

0f517782fec99400b1314809cdeed2c69482aba7.text: The app now automatically skips temporary Python files and folders. This keeps the project view cleaner and faster.

cca3ced75e6f2223a2a173f5d75bf74ea48c99cd.text: The system now records extra details when handling background actions. This helps the support team diagnose issues faster. You won't notice any changes to the product itself.

fbf01f1f57948f9d4ab0fbf313b878b0d7b08ea4.text: The assistant now ignores blank entries when gathering file updates. This keeps its internal instructions tidy. You will not see any change in the final answers.

66006c3871aec152096f4f48fa655af7b3d66ab2.text: The system now checks testing and setup files separately from main code to avoid confusion. It also confirms changes work by running all necessary checks together.

43e03e58db80c99614d63ea0dc1971258af72603.text: Small internal cleanup. The assistant now handles message endings automatically, removing extra steps that previously tidied up text.

07a24a2fcadc2a4f836f299fb5bdb8b8efd755a9.text: The assistant now checks if it is making real progress or stuck in a loop before continuing. This helps it avoid repeating itself or getting stuck on tasks that cannot be finished.

6f27f4d86abf2ba45057e82294ed8f3b753a7746.text: The assistant no longer tries to run tasks repeatedly until a specific condition is met. It now pauses more simply after a set number of messages.

6b20e41107c04b8870bc35225d6371acaeb2289b.text: The assistant now checks if a task is finished or stuck in a loop before stopping. This helps it complete longer requests without giving up too early.

e5f85d760ee77cd7cfeb10a2489c36ae3746ae96.text: The checkout page now shows a separate price line for extra usage alongside the main subscription cost. This is a small internal change to make billing details clearer for users.

b5d976e118da6f39dce3ab47189176b981991272.text: The billing system now supports pricing based on actual usage rather than a fixed amount.

3806bde8ed7f61bc6a883e71389ee1b0f4d56e06.title: Twitch polling interval 15s and command prefix
3806bde8ed7f61bc6a883e71389ee1b0f4d56e06.summary: Polling interval reduced from 60s to 15s in `npm-app/twitch-plays-codebuff.sh`. Filter logic now requires `>` prefix for commands and processes last 10 messages. Deduplication via `last_message` prevents re-sending.

37b631589d5a5ccb928d9f0409f998cb352f08a4.title: Fix Twitch message processing loop
37b631589d5a5ccb928d9f0409f998cb352f08a4.summary: Moved `break` statement in `npm-app/twitch-plays-codebuff.sh` outside the conditional check. Ensures loop termination after processing the first valid message, preventing unnecessary iteration. Updated `npm-app/knowledge.md` with rules for historical message processing.

35aa8ccddea9fc4b5f340b447a07c4ffd3b2eed3.title: Add Twitch chat integration script for Codebuff
35aa8ccddea9fc4b5f340b447a07c4ffd3b2eed3.summary: New `npm-app/twitch-plays-codebuff.sh` script polls Twitch chat via robotty.de API and injects messages into a tmux session running Codebuff. Updates `npm-app/knowledge.md` to document this testing infrastructure and the API integration details. Scope limited to repo tooling and internal documentation.

846073e11af5a585d774bca1a3c19e05b4738828.title: Added pre-buy credits copy to pricing page
846073e11af5a585d774bca1a3c19e05b4738828.summary: Added 'Pre-buy credits' string to the features array in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. This updates the UI text for the custom pricing tier. Scope is limited to the web pricing page component.

63de78d54dc6a38f5f9cdbe85e9a497b21a65a30.title: Refine terminal command detection and skip list
63de78d54dc6a38f5f9cdbe85e9a497b21a65a30.summary: Removes 'kill' and adds 'do' to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts. Increases max word count for CLI command recognition from 4 to 5 in npm-app/src/cli.ts. Expands command-not-found detection in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts to catch /bin/sh errors, fatal:, and error: prefixes.

09348fe3cd58008666ef4263b4a53dc1607245bf.title: Fix navigation error on referral redemption page
09348fe3cd58008666ef4263b4a53dc1607245bf.summary: Referral pages now handle fetch errors gracefully instead of crashing on back navigation. `web/src/app/referrals/[code]/page.tsx` and `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` update `useQuery` to throw on `!res.ok` and render `CardWithBeams` for errors. Query keys include `params.code` to prevent cache collisions. Removed unused `redirect` import from `web/src/app/layout.tsx`.

67dc1947f10464791cd5cfd8f5ff6f81f88cf1fe.title: Pricing page updates overage rules and credit estimates
67dc1947f10464791cd5cfd8f5ff6f81f88cf1fe.summary: Pricing page clarifies overage policies: Free tier adds 'No overage allowed', while Paid and Pro Plus tiers standardize on 'Overage allowed' with explicit rates ($0.99 and $0.90 per 100 credits). Intense work session credit estimate revised from 500-1000 to 500. Changes isolated to web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx.

dfe8b52458c5aabadb0a4f4b72070b5dba409e1d.title: Fix diff block parsing regex
dfe8b52458c5aabadb0a4f4b72070b5dba409e1d.summary: Updated `blockRegex` in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` to make newlines optional before separators (`\n?`). Fixes parsing failures for diff blocks lacking trailing newlines. Internal backend change.

32813dc7f27196da7dffc6595e489c1d44cb3a67.title: Handle leaked SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in processFileBlock
32813dc7f27196da7dffc6595e489c1d44cb3a67.summary: processFileBlock now detects leaked SEARCH/REPLACE markers in updatedContent and triggers applyRemainingChanges with normalizedNewContent instead of diffBlocksThatDidntMatch. applyRemainingChanges signature updated to accept changes string and filePath. Covers backend/src/process-file-block.ts.

640ba7053b1769172a2c81bc5a4e61c6d199914f.title: Skip knowledge file writes for placeholder content
640ba7053b1769172a2c81bc5a4e61c6d199914f.summary: Added guards in `process-file-block.ts` to return null if new content is `[UPDATED_BY_ANOTHER_ASSISTANT]` or starts with `@@`. `main-prompt.ts` now injects the placeholder marker instead of actual file blocks for knowledge updates. `generate-knowledge-files.ts` propagates change metadata to handle these skipped writes.

67dc1947f10464791cd5cfd8f5ff6f81f88cf1fe.text: The pricing page now clearly states that free users cannot exceed their limits, while paid users can pay extra for more credits. The estimated cost for a long work session was updated to a fixed amount of 500 credits.

32813dc7f27196da7dffc6595e489c1d44cb3a67.text: The software now automatically fixes formatting errors when updating files, ensuring changes are applied correctly even if the initial instructions were slightly malformed.

09348fe3cd58008666ef4263b4a53dc1607245bf.text: The referral page now shows a helpful error message instead of crashing when you navigate away. This small internal fix keeps the page working smoothly even if there is a temporary connection problem.

03eea8e272e4d0801cc8b073520d6450f844deab.summary: Binary asset update to web/public/opengraph-image.png. No logic changes or metadata modifications indicated.

21ee88b1ac1218481753ee1128c5c696262f3c5c.title: Preserve whitespace in parsed diff blocks
21ee88b1ac1218481753ee1128c5c696262f3c5c.summary: Removed `removeNewlinesFromStartAndEnd` helper from `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts`. `parseAndGetDiffBlocks` and `parseAndGetDiffBlocksSingleFile` now preserve leading/trailing newlines in `searchContent` and `replaceContent` to ensure exact matching. 4dc401072f493d4382d4dd4e2ef16a3704e43545.title: System prompt adds change verification protocol
4dc401072f493d4382d4dd4e2ef16a3704e43545.summary: Adds 'Verifying changes' section to system prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts. Internal prompt update only.

f495d4509a07cb41354593acedd1cef9216e4ade.title: Fix nvm detection in update-codebuff installer

497e275e19f1831cf5ef9c8761ec3de9e7d5cbeb.summary: knowledge.md heading Development workflow renamed Verifying changes. Instruction tightened to run `bun run --cwd backend tsc` after every change and fix resulting type errors. Scope limited to knowledge.md. No behavioral change to Freebuff runtime.

48495e6d349bce9ca157754a142057a0df415c5c.title: Fix type error in generate-patch-search-replace.ts
48495e6d349bce9ca157754a142057a0df415c5c.summary: Commented out `generateExpandedFileWithDiffBlocks` call in `backend/src/generate-patch-search-replace.ts`. Removed unused import. Fixes type error.

8908de22dfeacdba150a8d59632233bfc1f733a2.title: Update Open Graph image
8908de22dfeacdba150a8d59632233bfc1f733a2.summary: Binary update to `web/public/opengraph-image.png`. Improves visual quality of Open Graph preview. Scope limited to web static assets.

fb6fdb5a187b1f6a275891fb52ee500752293a59.title: Track changes already applied during tool execution
fb6fdb5a187b1f6a275891fb52ee500752293a59.summary: Renamed `previousChanges` to `changesAlreadyApplied` in WebSocket schemas and propagated it through backend handlers and CLI clients. This ensures the client accumulates all file modifications made before and during tool calls, displaying a complete diff at the end of the request. Updated `common/src/actions.ts`, `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, and `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to merge `changesAlreadyApplied` with new changes for accurate state tracking.

e33f588367b6276f2875377d232c39d6a19a00ee.title: Fix type error in WebSocket server
e33f588367b6276f2875377d232c39d6a19a00ee.summary: Relaxed `deadConnectionCleaner` type to `any` in `backend/src/websockets/server.ts` to resolve a compilation error. Reformatted `logger.error` call for linting compliance. No runtime behavior changes.

bb0b6f8596654c2b1e0a2d349f6427a6238d0764.title: Improve fallback file rewrite prompt in process-file-block
bb0b6f8596654c2b1e0a2d349f6427a6238d0764.summary: Refines the prompt used in `applyRemainingChanges` when exact string matching fails. Adds `fullResponse` context and uses `createSearchReplaceBlock` for clearer diff representation. Updates instructions to emphasize minimal changes and preserve comments. Scope limited to `backend/src/process-file-block.ts`.

497e275e19f1831cf5ef9c8761ec3de9e7d5cbeb.text: A small internal update tightened the rules for checking code changes. This helps the team catch mistakes early, but you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

48495e6d349bce9ca157754a142057a0df415c5c.text: A small internal fix removed a broken feature that caused errors. This change improves stability and requires no action from you.

4dc401072f493d4382d4dd4e2ef16a3704e43545.text: The assistant now checks its work by running safety tests after making changes. If specific tests are missing, it uses other basic checks to ensure the software still works correctly.

21ee88b1ac1218481753ee1128c5c696262f3c5c.text: The system now keeps empty lines at the start and end of text changes exactly as written. This helps it find and update specific parts of documents more reliably.

fb6fdb5a187b1f6a275891fb52ee500752293a59.text: The assistant now tracks all file changes made during a task. This ensures you see a complete summary of every edit when the work finishes.

e33f588367b6276f2875377d232c39d6a19a00ee.text: This is a small, internal fix that helps the system's connection cleanup work correctly. It does not change how the product looks or behaves for users.

385a99b3d9437720f257e7edf99fc5570dfe8fa1.summary: Adds `SUPABASE_AGENTIC_PILOT_VERSION` and `SupabaseDeliveryVersion` union to `common/src/ads/supabase-format-experiment.ts`. 385a99b3d9437720f257e7edf99fc5570dfe8fa1.text: The assistant can now test a new feature on a small group of users without mixing their results with the main experiment.

ace7e6a4f1fc2ca19e4bfaf9ebe711a3226b0918.title: Add Pro Plus pricing tier
ace7e6a4f1fc2ca19e4bfaf9ebe711a3226b0918.summary: Added PRO_PLUS to UsageLimits type and CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS constant (55k credits prod, 55M local). 6156588518166800a73786c8a3cb58f5b7099066.summary: Pricing cards enforce consistent heights via min-h-[180px] on CardHeader and flex justify-between on CardContent in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. Resolves visual misalignment from varying feature list lengths. Affects only the Web pricing page.

ae02bac00074bbaa7c79f2b30f2a96df08a4a0a7.title: Truncate terminal command output at 10k chars

7217444eefb125db1e27e9bb2c870058b4e9cd12.summary: Added external links to news.codebuff.com in Navbar and Footer components. Adjusted Footer padding and font size for compactness. ace7e6a4f1fc2ca19e4bfaf9ebe711a3226b0918.text: The pricing page now shows a new plan called Pro Plus for $500 a month.

7e274e30d3106b8379bfe073e95d045d0adf1a88.title: Add Stefan Gasser testimonial to web
7e274e30d3106b8379bfe073e95d045d0adf1a88.summary: Adds Stefan Gasser (Founder & CEO) testimonial to web/src/lib/testimonials.ts. Includes new avatar web/public/testimonials/stefan-gasser.jpg and LinkedIn link. Quote highlights rapid dark-to-light mode conversion.

f565d6738b61d650acc5adda4143780e03f0c314.summary: Updated prompt in `backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts` to require a strong 'yes' on generality, non-derivability, and future relevance before creating or updating knowledge files. e5ab17ce596a729cbf493a2b5bc31c3b0272a2d5.summary: Updated FAQ text in `web/src/lib/faq.tsx` to clarify `knowledge.md` file management. Specified that Codebuff will not create new `knowledge.md` files if missing, but will autonomously update existing ones. Scope limited to Web FAQ documentation.

69fd0e1a55ce069874dbffb155652662af586c35.summary: FAQ sections in web/src/app/page.tsx now enforce single-open state via useState. Swaps ChevronDown/ChevronUp icons instead of CSS rotation. web/knowledge.md documents this React state pattern for collapsible UI.

72eca15260568914ae982b8496e70b236f034245.title: Add diff block test case
72eca15260568914ae982b8496e70b236f034245.summary: Adds test coverage for empty and single-newline replace blocks in `parse-diff-blocks.test.ts`. Updates existing tests to use double quotes for string literals and marks whitespace handling test as async. Scope limited to internal test suite. New test asserts `replaceContent` is empty string and match succeeds.

55f715ecef90771744be1918df1edb18c31b36ed.title: Rename update-manicode module to update-codebuff
55f715ecef90771744be1918df1edb18c31b36ed.summary: Internal refactoring renames npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts to update-codebuff.ts and updates the corresponding import in npm-app/src/index.ts. bf3e3979338128284676dbc17e8a39c9c2dc758c.title: Add unbounded iteration detection to main-prompt
bf3e3979338128284676dbc17e8a39c9c2dc758c.summary: Unbounded iteration detection added to `mainPrompt` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Async check moved before response generation; logic documented in `backend/knowledge.md`.

d0367fdc6b85d6477c1a7d3b8dbd5acbffc1566d.title: Knowledge file prompt forbids content removal
d0367fdc6b85d6477c1a7d3b8dbd5acbffc1566d.summary: The knowledge file generation prompt in backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts now explicitly instructs the model not to remove previous content. 7fecc6d01a9c82b8b07cb0b1994513c9af0b8f17.title: Show session token usage on exit
7fecc6d01a9c82b8b07cb0b1994513c9af0b8f17.summary: Added session_credits_used to usage responses and quota checks. Tracks credits consumed during the current WebSocket session via clientSessionId. Updated common/src/actions.ts, common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts, and backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. Requires passing sessionId to genUsageResponse and checkQuota.

e5ab17ce596a729cbf493a2b5bc31c3b0272a2d5.text: The help guide now clarifies that the assistant updates existing knowledge notes but does not create new ones if they are missing. This is a small internal change to documentation.

7e274e30d3106b8379bfe073e95d045d0adf1a88.text: A new customer review from Stefan Gasser appears on the website. This is a small internal update that does not change how the product works.

69fd0e1a55ce069874dbffb155652662af586c35.text: The FAQ page now keeps only one question open at a time, closing the previous one when a new question is selected. This makes the list easier to read and prevents the page from becoming cluttered with multiple open answers.

55f715ecef90771744be1918df1edb18c31b36ed.text: Internal cleanup renamed old labels to match the current brand. You will see 'Codebuff' instead of 'Manicode' in some places. No features changed.

8be7449b6eb2832f7ff0ac7ff3d70d09cbd76ebc.title: Add FAQ section to home page

This change adds web/src/lib/faq.tsx and modifies web/src/app/page.tsx to import and render the faqs array within a new section.

70b081956b9b41a76b49af35e29d3fe0c2226166.title: Update file reading message and logic in main-prompt

c1575f66a59c713f50c78b558ab8f52d8043dfb9.text: Testimonials on the website can now show profile pictures next to the quotes. This is a small internal update that makes those quotes look more personal when a picture is available.

c1afad717e45147f90d5bc436067481baaee7a71.text: The website now shows customer quotes moving across the screen.

f76a0a674d943feae9d7ede7805bf532b60ce4e7.text: The service lowered the amount of free usage available to anonymous and basic users. This means those users can now access fewer features or actions before needing to pay.

f3fcbc871040f310e55a4afa21ce90c78594c3dc.text: The landing page now shows customer reviews in a continuous scrolling banner. Each review card includes a link to learn more.

748d8771e89c39953132547896e55c346d710a17.text: The assistant's name changed from Mani to Buffy. This only affects how the assistant introduces itself; nothing else about how it works has changed.

e26fcadca4ed9e5c89a5e1e2fe88c708d8ceaf57.text: Fixed errors that prevented the website from building correctly. This change ensures the site loads properly for users.

1367890292c8ed494196706ac6dd0e5b0872d06b.text: A small internal fix corrected the text on the referral code redemption page so it now says codebuff instead of manicode when copied. It only affects that displayed text.

f86d9a6e05a6e4eb5cd7fa04a20a6837795aaf50.text: The company changed the product's name. This is an internal update, so it does not change how the tool works.

b11b9f06bc3a36da563f30984dff8e957fa2c978.title: Tighten file-block rewrite prompt to force full file output
b11b9f06bc3a36da563f30984dff8e957fa2c978.summary: Rewrote the file-block processing prompt in backend/src/process-file-block.ts to explicitly require the full, complete file content, forbidding excerpts. This change aims to prevent lazy model responses that return partial code blocks during file rewrites. Scope is limited to the backend prompt construction logic. The prompt now adds 'Do not excerpt portions of the file, write out the entire updated file.' to the instruction set.

34cf7983623180c9e0045365263ebef11b7736c4.title: Add OpenAI predicted outputs to file processing
34cf7983623180c9e0045365263ebef11b7736c4.summary: Refactored `promptOpenAI` to accept an options object, enabling `predictedContent` for OpenAI's prediction feature. `processFileBlock` switched from Claude Haiku to GPT-4o-mini, passing `updatedContent` as predicted output to speed up generation. Updated prompts to avoid markdown code blocks and adjusted response parsing. Added documentation on thorough refactoring practices.

e2e028fae06563f943db0b587224c5383c307da1.title: Update referral form link to codebuff.retool.com
e2e028fae06563f943db0b587224c5383c307da1.summary: Referral form URL in `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` updated from `manicode.retool.com` to `codebuff.retool.com`. Same form ID and email parameter structure retained. Scope limited to web referrals page.

c4f1d8ec13d142b549a693c0adb3da11e4bbd525.title: System prompt clarifies latest file version usage
c4f1d8ec13d142b549a693c0adb3da11e4bbd525.summary: System prompt updated to explicitly instruct model to use only the last copy of file. New `createMarkdownFileBlock` helper in `common/src/util/file.ts` formats content with triple backticks and path. This change targets `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to reduce confusion from multiple file versions in context.

7f4a1ffd11ddda89e09f98e9d9c22019a308df3a.title: Rename Manicode to Codebuff in web landing and legal pages
7f4a1ffd11ddda89e09f98e9d9c22019a308df3a.summary: Rebrand strings updated from Manicode to Codebuff in `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `privacy-policy/page.tsx`, and `terms-of-service/page.tsx`. Domain references changed from `manicode.ai` to `codebuff.com` and email addresses from `support@manicode.ai` to `support@codebuff.com`. This aligns web surfaces with the new brand identity. Copy-to-clipboard command now reflects `npm install -g Codebuff`.

3c666803289ed5ed7cb9b58c0e8ac6500c783507.title: Updated favicon assets
3c666803289ed5ed7cb9b58c0e8ac6500c783507.summary: Replaced favicon.ico, favicon-16x16.ico, and apple-touch-icon.png with new logo assets. Updates affect web/public/favicon directory. No functional code changes.

7b26863a97693a9aa27f5d6bf59bca8a3279a310.title: Rebrand Manicode to Codebuff in docs and web UI
7b26863a97693a9aa27f5d6bf59bca8a3279a310.summary: Project name changed from Manicode to Codebuff across README, knowledge files, and web pages. npm install command updated to codebuff. Pricing page links and contact email updated to codebuff.com. Home page feature descriptions rewritten for clarity.

114f246f470db549078f90abcb5f13fb97b8236f.title: Rename Manicode to Codebuff in web app
114f246f470db549078f90abcb5f13fb97b8236f.summary: Web application branding and internal references updated from Manicode to Codebuff. Changes span documentation (README, knowledge.md), UI components (navbar, footer, home page), and configuration constants. CLI installation instructions and external links (npm, Product Hunt, YC) now point to codebuff. Error message text simplified in referral helpers.

ca14c85607d18e1ad0018681c673836aa5e0ce90.title: Windows path and script fixes
ca14c85607d18e1ad0018681c673836aa5e0ce90.summary: Updated `common/src/db/drizzle.config.ts` to use `__dirname` with backslash-to-forward-slash conversion for Windows compatibility. Modified `common/package.json` `db:start` script to use `(timeout 1 || sleep 1)` for cross-platform waiting. Added `trustedDependencies` for tree-sitter packages in root `package.json` and `@t3-oss/env-core` to `web/package.json`. Updated `schema.knowledge.md` with local development and Windows-specific path handling instructions.

19487b28dbc9089e4cbd33a68ce86777b8682dee.title: Add example file retrieval to request-files-prompt
19487b28dbc9089e4cbd33a68ce86777b8682dee.summary: Introduces `generateExampleFilesPrompt` in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` to fetch example files alongside key files. Uses Haiku model to identify relevant code examples based on user/assistant prompts and project context, excluding `knowledge.md`. Results merged into `keyResults` via `Promise.all`. Error handling logs failures and returns empty arrays.

114f246f470db549078f90abcb5f13fb97b8236f.text: The product changed its name to Codebuff. Users will now see the new name everywhere in the app.

34cf7983623180c9e0045365263ebef11b7736c4.text: The tool now uses a faster, smarter AI to process files and gives results more quickly. This internal update improves speed without changing how you use the product.

3c666803289ed5ed7cb9b58c0e8ac6500c783507.text: The small icon that appears in web browser tabs and bookmarks was updated to match the new logo. This change does not affect how the product works.

b11b9f06bc3a36da563f30984dff8e957fa2c978.text: The system now forces the assistant to write out the entire updated file instead of just parts of it. This small internal change ensures you receive complete, usable files without missing sections.

7f4a1ffd11ddda89e09f98e9d9c22019a308df3a.text: The company changed its name from Manicode to Codebuff. Users should visit the new website and email the new support address.

e2e028fae06563f943db0b587224c5383c307da1.text: The link to the referral form now points to a new address. The form itself works the same way as before.

ca14c85607d18e1ad0018681c673836aa5e0ce90.text: The software now works correctly on Windows computers. This fixes minor issues so the program runs smoothly for everyone.

7b26863a97693a9aa27f5d6bf59bca8a3279a310.text: The product name changed from Manicode to Codebuff. You will see the new name on the website and in the instructions for getting started.

c4f1d8ec13d142b549a693c0adb3da11e4bbd525.text: The assistant now automatically picks the most recent version of a file when you upload multiple copies. This prevents it from getting confused by older versions.

38709b23e80cdb95ef6ea6230e7db77d9cda8079.title: Switch file rewrite fallback to Claude Haiku
38709b23e80cdb95ef6ea6230e7db77d9cda8079.summary: File rewrite fallback in `processFileBlock` now uses `claudeModels.haiku` via `promptClaude` instead of `openaiModels.gpt4o` via `promptOpenAI`. This change is internal to the backend file processing logic, specifically affecting how failed diff applications are retried. Scope is limited to `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` and associated imports from `common/constants`. The prompt structure remains identical, only the underlying model provider and specific model identifier change.

21fdc209a42dc4541d73ee63d00ea515b19c8ca5.title: codebuff replaces manicode in npm package identity
21fdc209a42dc4541d73ee63d00ea515b19c8ca5.summary: The npm package name and bin entry in `npm-app/package.json` changed from `manicode` to `codebuff`. Version remains `1.0.99`. This aligns the CLI binary with the new branding. Existing installs of `manicode` will not auto-update to the `codebuff` package.

c3593160eb31595ec0645c71cfa7895aba96f1d5.title: Switch haiku constant to 3.5 and update request-files model
c3593160eb31595ec0645c71cfa7895aba96f1d5.summary: The `claudeModels.haiku` constant in `common/src/constants.ts` is updated from `claude-3-haiku-20240307` to `claude-3-5-haiku-20241022`. Consequently, `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` now invoke this new Haiku 3.5 model for file request generation and session initialization, replacing the previous Sonnet usage. Cost tracking in `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts` reflects the new model's pricing, with input tokens rising from 0.25 to 1.0 and output from 1.25 to 5.0 per million.

61978dc9e65d5549e0458e9aa2e5d2df4bf9951a.title: Fix filteredRequestedFiles undefined check in backend
61978dc9e65d5549e0458e9aa2e5d2df4bf9951a.summary: Added explicit undefined check for content in filteredRequestedFiles within getFileVersionUpdates. Prevents potential errors when loadedFiles returns undefined for a requested path. Affects backend/src/main-prompt.ts.

86db77ee28f24762aa0a73040d65eac10a4203b5.title: Refine file-request prompts
86db77ee28f24762aa0a73040d65eac10a4203b5.summary: Updated backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts to clarify Haiku's file-selection tasks. Replaced 'Ignore previous instructions' with explicit context and added strict output constraints. Prevents model confusion and ensures relevant file retrieval.

d0245347b3f5052039ffc6f8151c3f99212ec7bd.title: Filter absolute paths in file version updates
d0245347b3f5052039ffc6f8151c3f99212ec7bd.summary: Backend file version update logic now filters out absolute paths before processing. This prevents path traversal or normalization issues when handling requested, previous, and edited file paths in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. The `request-files-prompt.ts` instructions were also updated to explicitly require "full relative path" instead of just "full path". These changes harden path handling in the backend.

557b21047f102e2923b51d2d3210518493a75844.title: Filter null content in file version updates
557b21047f102e2923b51d2d3210518493a75844.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts now filters null content from readFilesPaths before calling getRelevantFileInfoMessage in getFileVersionUpdates. Prevents invalid paths with null content from triggering file info messages. Scope limited to backend prompt logic.

3247e65412974a410f3d2681145e8bb7b3f10f7d.title: Prefill email in referrals limit increase form
3247e65412974a410f3d2681145e8bb7b3f10f7d.summary: The 'Request limit increase' link in web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx now appends a query parameter to the Retool form URL. The parameter uses the current user's email from the session. This reduces manual input for authenticated users.

b59a8ab8c6bdd0625e2088c8ccc199a7b541dcd5.title: Referral page copy and link placement
b59a8ab8c6bdd0625e2088c8ccc199a7b541dcd5.summary: Referral page copy updated in `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx`. The "refer more" link moved from the header to the referral limit display. Text changes "friends" to "people" and "Send this link" to "Share this link".

6604b7989b06a7bd740d399288d947e70cd1a9fc.title: Per-user referral limits replace global MAXREFERRALS constant
6604b7989b06a7bd740d399288d947e70cd1a9fc.summary: Referral caps now enforce per-user limits via new `referral_limit` integer column in `user` table, replacing global `MAX_REFERRALS` constant. Migration `0006_first_quasimodo.sql` adds column with default 5 NOT NULL. `hasMaxedReferrals` checks user-specific limit from DB instead of constant. Web API returns `referralLimit` number instead of `limitReached` boolean.

557b21047f102e2923b51d2d3210518493a75844.text: The system now ignores empty file data when updating version information. This internal fix prevents errors without changing how you use the product.

3247e65412974a410f3d2681145e8bb7b3f10f7d.text: When you ask for a higher referral limit, your email address now fills in automatically. You no longer need to type it yourself.

61978dc9e65d5549e0458e9aa2e5d2df4bf9951a.text: The system now checks if a file is missing before trying to use it. This stops a crash when loading certain files.

21fdc209a42dc4541d73ee63d00ea515b19c8ca5.text: The tool now uses a new name to match its updated branding. Existing installations will not update automatically, so users must install the renamed version to receive future changes.

86db77ee28f24762aa0a73040d65eac10a4203b5.text: The system now gives clearer instructions when asked to find files. This helps it pick the right documents and avoid mistakes.

d0245347b3f5052039ffc6f8151c3f99212ec7bd.text: The system now checks file locations more carefully before processing them. This internal security fix helps prevent errors when the assistant accesses files.

b59a8ab8c6bdd0625e2088c8ccc199a7b541dcd5.text: A small internal update changed the wording on the referral page and moved the 'refer more' link to a clearer spot near the referral limit.

6604b7989b06a7bd740d399288d947e70cd1a9fc.text: The system now sets a separate referral limit for each user instead of applying one fixed cap to everyone. This means your personal referral allowance can vary based on your account rather than being the same for all users.

c3593160eb31595ec0645c71cfa7895aba96f1d5.text: The assistant switched to a newer version for handling file requests and starting sessions. This change increased the cost of using the feature.

38709b23e80cdb95ef6ea6230e7db77d9cda8079.text: The system now uses a different engine to fix files when the first attempt fails. This is an internal update that helps the assistant recover from errors without changing how you use the product.

c530833adc99de98bf2ff74b263145f33b35d9f8.title: drizzle-orm bumped 0.33 to 0.36
c530833adc99de98bf2ff74b263145f33b35d9f8.summary: drizzle-orm updated 0.33.0 to 0.36.0, drizzle-kit to 0.27.0. Propagated across backend, common, web package.json. Syncs ORM versions across monorepo.

640a2011fe541a7b002611f82a384a91997a259c.title: Filter malformed paths in getFileVersionUpdates
640a2011fe541a7b002611f82a384a91997a259c.summary: Added path validation filter to `getFileVersionUpdates` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Paths containing `..` or causing `path.normalize` exceptions are now excluded before `requestFiles` execution. This prevents server errors from malformed file path inputs.

627588ec121c731dab388632e09f78d8e9499574.title: Improve cross-platform command error detection
627588ec121c731dab388632e09f78d8e9499574.summary: Updated `handleRunTerminalCommand` in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` to detect Linux-specific 'not found' and capitalized 'Syntax error:' messages alongside existing Mac/Windows patterns. This ensures accurate error reporting across platforms.

d4c10cd1008c16f441222947fccdedcf7c2ac7f3.title: Referral redemption clears quotaexceeded flag
d4c10cd1008c16f441222947fccdedcf7c2ac7f3.summary: Successful referral code redemption now resets `quota_exceeded` to false alongside credit addition. This ensures users blocked by quota limits regain access immediately upon earning referral bonuses. Changes affect `web/src/app/api/referrals/helpers.ts` and `route.ts`. Commented-out SQL aggregations removed from referral query logic.

e2c83ec90996cfda4d35246b2dc750aaec4057e9.title: Add file access validation in project files
e2c83ec90996cfda4d35246b2dc750aaec4057e9.summary: getFiles in npm-app/src/project-files.ts now validates paths against projectRoot and .gitignore rules. Returns [FILE_OUTSIDE_PROJECT] or [FILE_IGNORED] markers instead of file content. parseGitignore exported from common/src/project-file-tree.ts to support shared logic.

4555b46bb32251dae58cc4b889ce7640dd4dfbaf.title: Lower CLI large-file change threshold to 8000
4555b46bb32251dae58cc4b889ce7640dd4dfbaf.summary: The CLI in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now uses `8_000` instead of `4 * 10_000` as the length threshold for including file change patches. This reduces the maximum size of user edits included in messages, replacing longer patches with `[LARGE_FILE_CHANGE_TOO_LONG_TO_REPRODUCE]`. The change affects the CLI's file change processing logic.

5abea6033162cfc7885d2d14e2dc94fbc97333e9.title: Fix editfile closing tag typo in createFileBlock
5abea6033162cfc7885d2d14e2dc94fbc97333e9.summary: Corrected a malformed closing tag in `createFileBlock` and `createFileBlockWithoutPath`. The output now emits `</edit_file>` instead of `</edit_file>`. This ensures the agent parser correctly identifies file edit boundaries. Scope limited to `common/src/util/file.ts`.

82b15d5ad5695e1a3a697c4b27d66978ef1d9319.title: Set nextquotareset on upgrade and add createdat column
82b15d5ad5695e1a3a697c4b27d66978ef1d9319.summary: Database schema updated with `created_at` timestamp column and `next_quota_reset` logic fixed to align with Stripe billing periods. Migration `0005_minor_the_professor` adds the `created_at` column to the `user` table. Webhook handlers and auth options now explicitly set `next_quota_reset` based on `current_period_end` or `next_payment_attempt` instead of defaulting or omitting it. Refactor in `handleSubscriptionChange` simplifies credit calculation and ensures quota reset is triggered on subscription changes.

acdc10a9b34eb900af1f7790a360e03f8b4166ae.title: Improve prompt caching via file versioning
acdc10a9b34eb900af1f7790a360e03f8b4166ae.summary: Refactors system prompt generation to use `fileVersions` instead of a flat file map, enabling stable prompt caching for Anthropic models. `getSearchSystemPrompt` now constructs ephemeral cache blocks around static project context while isolating dynamic file content, preventing cache invalidation from minor file changes. `requestRelevantFiles` updates to track unique file paths from versioned contexts, and `openai-api` increases timeout to 200s. Core backend files `system-prompt.ts`, `main-prompt.ts`, and `request-files-prompt.ts` carry these changes.

c530833adc99de98bf2ff74b263145f33b35d9f8.text: The software that connects the app to its data was updated to keep everything working smoothly. You might notice faster or more reliable performance, but nothing changes about how you use the app.

e2c83ec90996cfda4d35246b2dc750aaec4057e9.text: The software now checks file requests to ensure they stay inside the current project and respect ignored files. This prevents accidental access to unrelated system files or hidden data.

640a2011fe541a7b002611f82a384a91997a259c.text: The system now ignores broken file requests. This stops errors when searching for file updates.

627588ec121c731dab388632e09f78d8e9499574.text: The system now spots more error types on different computers. This keeps error reports accurate.

d4c10cd1008c16f441222947fccdedcf7c2ac7f3.text: When you use a referral code, any limit blocking your access is removed right away. This lets you start using the service again immediately after earning the bonus.

82b15d5ad5695e1a3a697c4b27d66978ef1d9319.text: The system now correctly tracks when your monthly limits reset to match your billing date. This ensures you get the right amount of usage each cycle.

5abea6033162cfc7885d2d14e2dc94fbc97333e9.text: Fixed a small internal error where the assistant failed to recognize the end of a file edit instruction. Now, file updates work reliably.

acdc10a9b34eb900af1f7790a360e03f8b4166ae.text: The assistant now remembers your project's general rules more reliably, even if you make small changes to individual files. This reduces delays and saves money by avoiding the need to re-read static context every time.

4555b46bb32251dae58cc4b889ce7640dd4dfbaf.text: The assistant now skips sending text for very large file edits. This prevents messages from becoming too long.

03e4a0e7c07570061e5f645e0d26ba6a7f2dec73.text: The website's feature descriptions were rewritten to be more specific about what the product can do, such as understanding entire codebases and working in the terminal. Icons were also updated to match these new descriptions.

d1951f6fbc907fc35c25de9ece5056f25a2af2aa.title: Pricing page credit estimate updated to 500-1000 for 1-hour session
d1951f6fbc907fc35c25de9ece5056f25a2af2aa.summary: Updated the credit usage estimate on the pricing page from 'multi-hour session uses 500 credits' to 'intense 1-hour session uses 500-1000 credits'. This reflects more accurate credit consumption data for high-intensity work. Change scoped to web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx.

c36de5f1a6d3fbce0773ba8602d26f0ea42a8635.title: Add error handling to knowledge file generation
c36de5f1a6d3fbce0773ba8602d26f0ea42a8635.summary: Added `.catch()` blocks to `generateKnowledgeFiles` in `backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts` and `mainPrompt` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. This prevents unhandled promise rejections during file processing and knowledge generation, logging errors via `logger.error` and returning null or empty arrays respectively. Scope limited to backend logic. Internal stability improvement.

b25566f45187d9a8415a76a3b19343f1c3ee8808.title: Clickjacking fix via X-Frame-Options header
b25566f45187d9a8415a76a3b19343f1c3ee8808.summary: Added `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` to `web/next.config.mjs` headers. Prevents clickjacking by restricting frame embedding to same origin. Scope limited to web config.

24c16b3a2476eacf23a71b3a290d0a4305387027.title: Fix installer console.log in update-manicode
24c16b3a2476eacf23a71b3a290d0a4305387027.summary: update-manicode.ts renamed installer var to installerInfo to match detectInstaller object return. Updated console.log to use installerInfo.installer. Passed installerInfo to runUpdateManicode. Changed goodbye message to 'Manicode out!'.

1326b4c6b1afaaba15273e5053137ec83049eaa8.title: npm update script now detects nvm installs
1326b4c6b1afaaba15273e5053137ec83049eaa8.summary: The `detectInstaller` function in `npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts` now recognizes paths containing `.nvm` as global npm installations. This fixes an issue where Freebuff installed via nvm was misidentified, preventing the update script from running correctly. The change is internal to the CLI update mechanism.

ab177ae5ce5dbea15830c399b3611434a037a5f7.title: Pro overage charge raised to $0.95 per 100 credits
ab177ae5ce5dbea15830c399b3611434a037a5f7.summary: Pro overage cost raised to $0.95 per 100 credits, up from $0.90. Change applied to pricing page features array in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. Only web pricing surface affected; no core constants or CLI picker changes. Follow-up constraint: verify billing engine matches displayed rate.

146e09dd961e67875aae7396c526a17de639f321.title: Disable Helicone rate limit policy in backend API clients
146e09dd961e67875aae7396c526a17de639f321.summary: Helicone rate limit policy disabled in Claude and OpenAI API clients by commenting out the `Helicone-RateLimit-Policy` header. This change affects `backend/src/claude.ts` and `backend/src/openai-api.ts`. The `RATE_LIMIT_POLICY` constant remains defined but is no longer sent in request headers.

03f9e4b86210df1e98b0c3fb33fa0245ffcaab15.title: Stripe webhook handles subscription updates and cancellations
03f9e4b86210df1e98b0c3fb33fa0245ffcaab15.summary: The Stripe webhook handler now processes `customer.subscription.updated` events and clears `stripe_price_id` when `cancellation_details.reason` is present. `stripe_price_id` is exposed in NextAuth sessions and types, enabling the pricing page to display conditional renewal or cancellation links. Checkout sessions now allow promotion codes.

6ab694669541596938b3e537b1e11c0c1baef90f.title: Add gpt4o fallback for unmatched search/replace blocks
6ab694669541596938b3e537b1e11c0c1baef90f.summary: The backend now invokes `applyRemainingChanges` using `gpt4o` when search/replace blocks fail to match after retry logic. `processFileBlock` captures blocks that don't match and passes them to the new fallback mechanism to ensure all intended changes are applied. This internal update in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` and `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` improves robustness for complex file edits.

535fbc2e860e08b374e529e1f128cb9c3480fc0e.title: Fix quota display and overage fees for subscribers
535fbc2e860e08b374e529e1f128cb9c3480fc0e.summary: QuotaManager now returns `subscription_active` flag alongside usage data. Backend propagates this state via `usage-response` websocket messages to client. CLI `showUsageWarning` logic updated to distinguish between blocked non-subscribers and warned subscribers. Paid quota limit reduced from 50M to 10M credits in `constants.ts`.

24c16b3a2476eacf23a71b3a290d0a4305387027.text: The system now correctly identifies which tool installed the software, ensuring smoother updates. This small internal fix improves reliability without changing how you use the product.

b25566f45187d9a8415a76a3b19343f1c3ee8808.text: We made a small internal safety update to stop malicious websites from hiding behind our app to trick you into clicking things you did not intend to click.

c36de5f1a6d3fbce0773ba8602d26f0ea42a8635.text: The system now safely handles errors during file creation and knowledge generation. If something goes wrong, it logs the issue and continues without crashing. This is an internal stability improvement.

d1951f6fbc907fc35c25de9ece5056f25a2af2aa.text: The pricing page now shows a more accurate credit estimate for high-intensity work. A one-hour session of this type may use 500 to 1000 credits.

1326b4c6b1afaaba15273e5053137ec83049eaa8.text: The update script now recognizes a common way to install the tool. This fixes a problem where updates failed for some users.

6ab694669541596938b3e537b1e11c0c1baef90f.text: If the assistant fails to find the exact spot to edit, it now tries a different method to apply your changes. This makes the tool more reliable for complex updates.

146e09dd961e67875aae7396c526a17de639f321.text: The system no longer applies a specific speed limit when sending requests to external services. This is a minor internal adjustment that does not change how the product works for users.

ab177ae5ce5dbea15830c399b3611434a037a5f7.text: If you use more credits than your Pro plan includes, the extra cost per 100 credits is now $0.95 instead of $0.90. This price increase appears on the pricing page, but the actual bill depends on the system that calculates charges, which needs to be checked for consistency.

03f9e4b86210df1e98b0c3fb33fa0245ffcaab15.text: The system now recognizes when a subscription is canceled or updated, allowing the website to show the correct renewal or cancellation options. You can also apply discount codes during checkout.

535fbc2e860e08b374e529e1f128cb9c3480fc0e.text: The system now clearly distinguishes between users who have exceeded their limit and those who are currently blocked. Subscribers will see a warning instead of a hard stop, while non-subscribers remain blocked. The monthly credit limit for paid plans was lowered to 10 million.

09990fbfc577df08a4bc0861dbf9d31f3016735f.title: Fix pricing card footer width alignment
09990fbfc577df08a4bc0861dbf9d31f3016735f.summary: Added `w-full` to `cardFooterChildren` container in `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`. Ensures consistent width for pricing card footers.

021ff879220086cff042045d1106497a67e403ee.title: CLI trims input, accepts diff aliases
021ff879220086cff042045d1106497a67e403ee.summary: handleUserInput in npm-app/src/cli.ts trims userInput before command matching. diff handler accepts 'doff', 'dif', 'iff' alongside 'diff' and 'd'. Scope: CLI command parsing only. Trim applies globally, affecting all subsequent string comparisons.

d7f2d6ac64b8ec4c6fb4bdfe621697e07aecf5f0.title: Remove URL scraping from knowledge file context
d7f2d6ac64b8ec4c6fb4bdfe621697e07aecf5f0.summary: getProjectFileContext now calls getExistingFiles instead of getExistingFilesWithScrapedContent. Removed getExistingFilesWithScrapedContent which appended scraped URL blocks to knowledge.md files. Only npm-app/src/project-files.ts affected. No migration needed; existing knowledge.md files remain unchanged.

d8c9d999966f2921fd78bb495bbc37b25ae61729.title: Add tests for diff block parsing edge cases
d8c9d999966f2921fd78bb495bbc37b25ae61729.summary: Added unit tests for `parseAndGetDiffBlocksSingleFile` covering multiline imports and Python-style indentation mismatches. Includes new `test.knowledge.md` documenting guidelines for testing whitespace and indentation preservation. Changes restricted to `test/__src__/` directory.

40be20c1a00bb2a2fc8134efacc594cebee87985.title: Update manicode local installs
40be20c1a00bb2a2fc8134efacc594cebee87985.summary: Update logic handles local installs. Detects installer and scope via environment variables and paths. Runs package manager commands matching scope. Covers npm-app update-manicode.ts.

a807e38ba995ea368f26450df77562a85120aaf4.title: Strip markdown code fences from new file creation
a807e38ba995ea368f26450df77562a85120aaf4.summary: backend/src/process-file-block.ts now strips leading ```lang and trailing ``` fences from newContent before writing new files. This prevents markdown artifacts from being saved as literal file content when the agent creates files via diff blocks.
