Scope limited to the backend file processing logic; no changes to CLI, Web, or Desktop surfaces.

8e47d113a1f9db946d06668bcf24a5d862996195.title: Whitespace-agnostic diff matching
8e47d113a1f9db946d06668bcf24a5d862996195.summary: Added fallback logic in `parseAndGetDiffBlocksSingleFile` to match diff blocks ignoring whitespace differences. This prevents failures when indentation or spacing changes cause exact string matches to fail. Implemented in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` with new test fixtures in `test/__mock-data__/whitespace/`.

50ca3f3ec7049f4cb081c369a7e8cdd36bd63e3f.title: Add Stripe customer portal cancel link to pricing page
50ca3f3ec7049f4cb081c369a7e8cdd36bd63e3f.summary: Pricing page pro tier card now renders a cancel link pointing to NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL when subscription_active is true. Replaces buttonText/buttonAction props with cardFooterChildren across free, pro, and enterprise tiers to support custom button layouts and conditional rendering. Adds NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL to web/src/env.mjs runtime validation as a required URL. Pro tier support text updated to mention Discord alongside email.

57836c9ef17bf5436ea134b20014e5d357a4ba4e.title: Clarify referral banner and page copy
57836c9ef17bf5436ea134b20014e5d357a4ba4e.summary: Referral copy simplified on web. Banner text now explicitly states the {CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS} credit reward for both parties, importing the constant from common/constants. Referrals page splits the call-to-action, moving 'Send this link to them:' to a separate paragraph. Changes limited to web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx and web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx.

91139688c0e564d65a3d2258e5fe764085eb0e0c.title: knowledge.md add tsc instruction
91139688c0e564d65a3d2258e5fe764085eb0e0c.summary: Added Development workflow section to knowledge.md requiring `bun run tsc` execution and error fixing on every code change. Strengthened existing TypeScript guidance to explicitly forbid writing return types. Internal documentation update affecting agent behavior only.

40be20c1a00bb2a2fc8134efacc594cebee87985.text: The update process now automatically finds the right settings for each installation. This means updates happen without manual steps.

09990fbfc577df08a4bc0861dbf9d31f3016735f.text: Fixed a small layout issue to make sure pricing card footers display at the correct width.

d7f2d6ac64b8ec4c6fb4bdfe621697e07aecf5f0.text: The assistant no longer automatically adds web page content to your project notes. This internal update ensures your saved files stay exactly as you wrote them.

a807e38ba995ea368f26450df77562a85120aaf4.text: The assistant now removes extra formatting symbols when creating new files, preventing them from appearing in the saved text. This internal fix ensures downloaded files look correct and clean.

d8c9d999966f2921fd78bb495bbc37b25ae61729.text: The team added extra checks to make sure the software handles text spacing correctly. This small internal update helps prevent display errors but requires no action from users.

57836c9ef17bf5436ea134b20014e5d357a4ba4e.text: The text explaining referral rewards is now clearer. It explicitly states that both the sender and the friend receive credits. This is a small internal change to improve readability.

50ca3f3ec7049f4cb081c369a7e8cdd36bd63e3f.text: Active subscribers now see a cancel link on the pricing page.

8e47d113a1f9db946d06668bcf24a5d862996195.text: The tool now ignores extra spaces and line breaks when comparing text changes. This means fewer errors occur if formatting differences prevent a match.

021ff879220086cff042045d1106497a67e403ee.text: The command tool now ignores extra spaces you type. It also accepts shortened names for the comparison feature.

91139688c0e564d65a3d2258e5fe764085eb0e0c.text: The team updated their internal instructions to require checking for errors before saving any changes. This small internal update helps prevent mistakes from reaching you.

8ca14540dc0c0a9f1a71a17f4bf08693e2b33308.title: Pricing page feature list corrections
8ca14540dc0c0a9f1a71a17f4bf08693e2b33308.summary: Moved 'Custom integrations' from the standard tier to the Custom tier in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. Removed 'Dedicated AI model' from the Custom tier features array. Internal copy adjustment to align displayed features with actual plan capabilities.

6e292a9504ec4e5d29ec15854e8d1b2f3cb3549f.title: Add privacy policy and terms of service pages
6e292a9504ec4e5d29ec15854e8d1b2f3cb3549f.summary: New web/src/app/privacy-policy/page.tsx and web/src/app/terms-of-service/page.tsx added with full legal text. Footer and navbar updated to link these pages. Home page gains copy-to-clipboard for npm install command and responsive text layout. @tailwindcss/typography added for prose styling of legal content.

1f271671867dfba845970b18e6471adce4dc42ba.title: Fix build errors in env schema and referrals page
1f271671867dfba845970b18e6471adce4dc42ba.summary: Updated `common/src/env.mjs` to simplify `runtimeEnv` and add `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL` to both server and client schemas. Fixed JSX apostrophe encoding in `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` to resolve build errors. Changes affect core environment configuration and web referral UI.

505bf6edac0718d665628739101396a887fb6858.title: Fix message saving for tool calls and warmup calls
505bf6edac0718d665628739101396a887fb6858.summary: Claude stream handler now detects end of turn via 'usage' presence in message_delta instead of checking stop_reason === 'end_turn'. This fixes bug where messages were not saved during tool calls and warmup calls. Backend files claude.ts, main-prompt.ts, request-files-prompt.ts updated. Removed debug console.log in main-prompt.ts onTagEnd handler and made userId parameter explicitly nullable in warmCacheForRequestRelevantFiles.

2f1b213d1a4583a370275a663b30caa7aba29c74.title: processFileBlock handles new files with replace blocks
2f1b213d1a4583a370275a663b30caa7aba29c74.summary: Added logic to `processFileBlock` in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` to handle new files containing replace blocks. When `requestFile` returns null, the function now parses the new content for diff blocks; if found, it constructs the file content from these blocks and returns it, instead of falling through to the default new file creation.

74fddbca36640c7007e6709ca39735bb52cf8e60.title: Use stored fingerprint for logged-in CLI users
74fddbca36640c7007e6709ca39735bb52cf8e60.summary: npm-app/src/client.ts now stores `fingerprintId` on `Client` and initializes it from `user?.fingerprintId ?? await calculateFingerprint()`, replacing the global `fingerprintId` export and `initFingerprint()` in npm-app/src/config.ts. The change fixes logged-in users reusing their stored fingerprint and centralizes credential loading, fingerprint generation, and login actions in `Client`, with authentication.knowledge.md documenting the single-source-of-truth pattern. npm-app/src/fingerprint.ts converts `FINGERPRINTING_INFO` from an async IIFE to `getFingerprintInfo()`, and npm-app/src/index.ts drops the startup `initFingerprint()` promise.

4dbefaa92d5935b8a805c0cb0cbafb904f541e91.title: Fix websocket response-complete delivery on error
4dbefaa92d5935b8a805c0cb0cbafb904f541e91.summary: Removed setTimeout delay for response-complete signal in websocket-action.ts. Error paths now send response-complete immediately via direct sendAction call. Fixes issue where delayed signal was not received by client. Scope: backend websocket handler only.

9cd16ae0354363557c893960f676c2a03430b7ca.title: Add 'faster' to homepage copy
9cd16ae0354363557c893960f676c2a03430b7ca.summary: Updated hero text in `web/src/app/page.tsx` to include 'faster' when describing codebase editing. This change applies to both mobile and desktop layouts. No functional or performance changes were made.

8d675ea7bdec92d5bc572b07f6fc7cc157393dd3.title: Claude Search/Replace File Editing Pipeline
8d675ea7bdec92d5bc572b07f6fc7cc157393dd3.summary: Added `generate-patch-search-replace.ts` to handle file edits using Claude's search/replace blocks instead of full file rewrites. Updated `generate-diffs-prompt.ts` and `system-prompt.ts` to support `EXISTING_CODE_MARKER` and `<search>`/`<replace>` directives for precise line-by-line modifications. Refactored `env.mjs` to use `path.join` for robust environment file resolution.

f257801349ff1a8f88a5e39c15887849d0d04de9.title: Referral Status API, Banner Component, Landing Page
f257801349ff1a8f88a5e39c15887849d0d04de9.summary: Referral check logic in common/src/util/server/referral.ts returns structured `ReferralStatus` with stable reason codes (`Referral Limit Reached`, `Referrer Not Found`, `Unknown Error`) and `msg` fields, replacing raw string reasons. The `/api/referrals/[code]` route now calls `hasMaxedReferrals` server-side and returns a `ReferralCodeResponse` including `status`, removing the client-side 401 guard to support anonymous lookups. A new `Banner` component is mounted inside providers in `web/src/app/layout.tsx` with `z-20` to ensure clickability above the `z-10` navbar. `web/src/app/page.tsx` removes `mounted` state hydration checks, replaces `Globe` with `BackgroundBeams`, and simplifies copy layout.

8ca14540dc0c0a9f1a71a17f4bf08693e2b33308.text: The pricing page now shows 'Custom integrations' only for the Custom tier, and removes 'Dedicated AI model' from its feature list. This small internal update ensures the displayed features match what the plans actually offer.

2f1b213d1a4583a370275a663b30caa7aba29c74.text: The assistant can now create new files using specific instructions, fixing a previous limitation.

4dbefaa92d5935b8a805c0cb0cbafb904f541e91.text: Fixed a timing issue in the internal system that caused some error responses to be delayed or missed. This change improves reliability for users experiencing errors, though it is a small backend fix.

6e292a9504ec4e5d29ec15854e8d1b2f3cb3549f.text: The website added pages for the privacy policy and terms of service. These pages are linked in the footer and top menu, so you can easily find them.

f257801349ff1a8f88a5e39c15887849d0d04de9.text: The system now gives clear, consistent messages when checking referral links, so users see specific reasons if a code is invalid or a limit is reached. A new banner appears at the top of the page, and the landing page layout was simplified for a cleaner look.

74fddbca36640c7007e6709ca39735bb52cf8e60.text: The tool now remembers your unique device identity once you log in. This stops it from creating a new identity every time you run it, making the process smoother and more consistent.

9cd16ae0354363557c893960f676c2a03430b7ca.text: The homepage text now says editing code is 'faster.' This is just a wording update.

1f271671867dfba845970b18e6471adce4dc42ba.text: The app's setup for showing support contact details was corrected. This ensures the support email displays properly on the referrals page.

505bf6edac0718d665628739101396a887fb6858.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant reliably saves conversation history, even when it uses tools or prepares data in the background.

8d675ea7bdec92d5bc572b07f6fc7cc157393dd3.text: The assistant now edits files by replacing only the specific lines that need changing, instead of rewriting the entire file. This makes updates faster and more precise.

1c50f5ee498e22fd579aebfe163af3bc497963b2.title: Add timeout to parallel patch generation
1c50f5ee498e22fd579aebfe163af3bc497963b2.summary: generateBestOfNPatch now dynamically times out parallel patch generation. Mechanism: Promise.race waits for first patch, sets timeout to 1.75x duration plus 2s, then Promise.all filters nulls. Scope: backend/src/generate-patch.ts only. Detail: comparePrompt and bestPatchNumber validation updated to handle variable patch counts.

15f637a7185d2fb1c783715a175dcc83380d9b94.title: Add look to skipped terminal commands
15f637a7185d2fb1c783715a175dcc83380d9b94.summary: Added 'look' to the SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS array in common/src/constants.ts. This ensures the 'look' command is excluded from standard processing or execution flows. Scope is limited to core constants.

0c078bfdc22034cdc837719fc5f0f12cf585613e.title: Clarify referral bonus and usage limit copy
0c078bfdc22034cdc837719fc5f0f12cf585613e.summary: Referral copy now specifies bidirectional credit rewards (`CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS` per month for both referrer and referee). `showUsageWarning` in `npm-app/src/client.ts` displays exact usage counts (`${usage}/${limit}` credits) and shifts upgrade/referral prompts from yellow to green. `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` and `npm-app/src/menu.ts` updated to match the 'both earn' phrasing.

45869d40206f66ec7512d4a77c2c3ed5dbd2e0f8.title: Referral POST auth switched to sessionToken lookup
45869d40206f66ec7512d4a77c2c3ed5dbd2e0f8.summary: web/src/app/api/referrals/route.ts POST handler replaces getServerSession with direct database query. Request body validated via zod for referralCode and authToken. Auth flow now resolves userId by matching sessionToken column against provided authToken. Eliminates NextAuth session dependency for this specific endpoint.

d61954b5d65b66d860e35250dbe04ce786749da1.title: Add please and apply to skipped terminal commands
d61954b5d65b66d860e35250dbe04ce786749da1.summary: Added 'please' and 'apply' to the SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS blacklist in common/src/constants.ts. This prevents Freebuff from attempting to execute these specific commands within the terminal interface. The change affects the shared core constants used by CLI and Web surfaces.

5703126c1bcbb0de93b2ea9912b926d32ffa919b.title: Increase websocket timeout
5703126c1bcbb0de93b2ea9912b926d32ffa919b.summary: WebSocket client timeout increased from 10000ms to 30000ms. Reconnect wait remains 5000ms. Change affects common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts.

8389f1d1d064aa676d5d455714e291d1b012a534.title: cd command only updates project root in user mode
8389f1d1d064aa676d5d455714e291d1b012a534.summary: In `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`, the `handleRunTerminalCommand` function now checks `mode === 'user'` before updating the project root via `cd`. This prevents assistant-initiated `cd` commands from persisting working directory changes, restricting root updates to explicit user actions.

270a8f9b7f645a0209233fb4c19ed0b6bf94d6af.title: CLI /run command error handling refactor
270a8f9b7f645a0209233fb4c19ed0b6bf94d6af.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand returns structured {result, stdout, stderr} instead of string. CLI /run prefix now writes stdout/stderr directly on command-not-found, preventing fallback to Claude. Covers npm-app/src/cli.ts and tool-handlers.ts. Tool handler wrapper adapts to new return shape.

7a1efe5fcb6853b8b262c9ecddbf496d3d22272c.title: Sonnet model updated to claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022
7a1efe5fcb6853b8b262c9ecddbf496d3d22272c.summary: The `sonnet` model constant now uses `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`, replacing `claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620`. The update follows the note to use the latest Sonnet model. It is limited to `common/src/constants.ts`, the shared/core model list; the `haiku` entry remains unchanged.

9bd24bac82d19576e43dadf2f76cbd5053e9c85e.title: System prompt: enforce latest package versions
9bd24bac82d19576e43dadf2f76cbd5053e9c85e.summary: Updated system prompt to explicitly instruct agent to use install commands (e.g. `npm install`) instead of guessing versions in `package.json`. Added warning to ensure latest versions are fetched across all package managers (Maven, etc.). Changes affect `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`.

45869d40206f66ec7512d4a77c2c3ed5dbd2e0f8.text: The referral system now checks login details directly against its own records instead of using a shared login service. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

7a1efe5fcb6853b8b262c9ecddbf496d3d22272c.text: The assistant now uses a newer version of its main thinking engine. This internal update improves how it processes requests, though users may not notice immediate changes.

0c078bfdc22034cdc837719fc5f0f12cf585613e.text: The app now clearly shows that both you and the person you refer earn monthly bonus credits. Your usage screen displays your exact remaining credits and uses a green highlight for upgrade or referral suggestions.

15f637a7185d2fb1c783715a175dcc83380d9b94.text: The system now ignores a specific command called 'look'. This prevents it from running that command during standard operations.

d61954b5d65b66d860e35250dbe04ce786749da1.text: The assistant now ignores the words 'please' and 'apply' when they appear as standalone commands in the terminal. This prevents it from trying to run them as actions.

270a8f9b7f645a0209233fb4c19ed0b6bf94d6af.text: The app now shows clear error messages when a command is missing, instead of guessing or failing silently.

5703126c1bcbb0de93b2ea9912b926d32ffa919b.text: The system now waits longer before giving up on a connection, making brief network hiccups less likely to interrupt your work.

8389f1d1d064aa676d5d455714e291d1b012a534.text: The assistant now ignores its own folder-switching commands. Only your explicit instructions change the active project folder. This internal fix prevents the assistant from accidentally working in the wrong directory.

1c50f5ee498e22fd579aebfe163af3bc497963b2.text: The system now stops waiting if multiple responses take too long to arrive. This ensures you get the best available answer faster without unnecessary delays.

84e14ee58ea24229f57dca4790018e5ab5c4df8c.title: Remove pb-12 from hero section, reflow startup tagline
84e14ee58ea24229f57dca4790018e5ab5c4df8c.summary: Removed pb-12 utility class from hero section container in web/src/app/page.tsx. Reflowed YC startup tagline JSX text across lines. Internal UI styling and formatting change.

9e0ba44869f5e9a4e617bf207697154bd68a3105.title: Context warmup wrapped in try/catch
9e0ba44869f5e9a4e617bf207697154bd68a3105.summary: The context cache warmup call to promptClaude in backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts is now wrapped in a try/catch block. Previously, a failure during this initialization step would throw and prevent the init-response from being sent to the client. Now, errors are logged via logger.error and execution continues to sendAction.

811d56ee00eb9a481adbe24e7cd2e514f4a81c47.title: generate-patch uses gpt-4o-2024-08-06 fine-tuned model
811d56ee00eb9a481adbe24e7cd2e514f4a81c47.summary: generate-patch model reference updated to `gpt-4o-2024-08-06` with `generate-patch-batch2` suffix and new fingerprint `AKYtDIhk`. Previous `gpt4o` constant replaced with explicit dated model string. Change scoped to `backend/src/generate-patch.ts`. Fine-tuned model variant switched to batch2.

afa2739e2016b111b317f344820982ecb4850eb5.title: Added Product Hunt launch badge to web homepage
afa2739e2016b111b317f344820982ecb4850eb5.summary: Added a Product Hunt featured badge to the web homepage in `web/src/app/page.tsx`. The badge dynamically adapts to the user's current theme using `useTheme` from `next-themes`. Links to the Manicode launch post with a theme-aware embed URL.

7d89b9143ecec8630eace9a02717e51cb64c8dfd.title: Update footer text and Discord link label
7d89b9143ecec8630eace9a02717e51cb64c8dfd.summary: Footer component in `web/src/components/footer.tsx` updated. Removed "coded with 🤖" text. Changed Discord link label from "(Keep in touch!)" to "Join our Discord!". Scope limited to web footer UI.

2a697a73f4f35675cc9ef569aa90414b862f6846.title: Rename ignoreHelicone flag and refactor fine-tuning dataset scripts
2a697a73f4f35675cc9ef569aa90414b862f6846.summary: Renamed `ignoreHelicone` to `ignoreDatabaseAndHelicone` in `backend/src/claude.ts` to accurately reflect that the flag bypasses both Helicone logging and database persistence. Moved fine-tuning dataset generation scripts to `scripts/patch-dataset-processing/` and exported `updatePatch` and `updateSketch` functions for modular reuse. Dataset entry interfaces now include `updatedPatch` and `updatedSketch` fields, and parallel processing count increased from 5 to 10.

de1b1be8b4adbf10c2464601af2a658d1558639b.title: Updated favicons and added YouTube demo video
de1b1be8b4adbf10c2464601af2a658d1558639b.summary: Replaced PNG favicon with ICO format and updated Apple touch icon in web/public/favicon/. Added embedded YouTube demo section to web/src/app/page.tsx. Navbar logo switched from lucide-react BrainCircuitIcon to local favicon image in web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx.

11f6aed905d7e5640b03567d78e83e5669a40b32.title: Add YC logo to landing page
11f6aed905d7e5640b03567d78e83e5669a40b32.summary: Replaced text-based YC mention with `y-combinator.svg` in `web/src/app/page.tsx`. Updated hero copy line breaks and standardized agent name to 'Manicode'. Internal repo change.

33f0e7ca14083cd03c663bd5d8c5fe3e919a2e7f.title: Update Freebuff landing page copy and CTA layout
33f0e7ca14083cd03c663bd5d8c5fe3e919a2e7f.summary: Replaced legacy Manicode branding with Freebuff-focused copy on `web/src/app/page.tsx`. Updated hero tagline to emphasize natural language codebase editing and terminal command execution. Restructured CTA placement by moving the npm install command to the hero section and replacing the bottom button with a 'Get Started Coding with AI' link.

ea33b2602d1ba8b3b3423a203455f67393d23ee6.title: Add web usage tracking page and move quota manager to common
ea33b2602d1ba8b3b3423a203455f67393d23ee6.summary: New /usage page and /api/usage endpoint expose credit consumption via shared usageDataSchema. AnonymousQuotaManager.checkQuota now returns concrete Date instead of SQL<Date>, with creditsUsed and endDate resolved in DB query. Quota manager moved from backend/src/billing to common/src/billing to enable web API access.

ea33b2602d1ba8b3b3423a203455f67393d23ee6.text: You can now see your credit usage on a new page. The system checks your remaining credits more reliably to ensure accurate limits.

afa2739e2016b111b317f344820982ecb4850eb5.text: A new badge now appears on the website homepage. Clicking it takes you to the product's launch page.

de1b1be8b4adbf10c2464601af2a658d1558639b.text: The website now shows a clearer icon in your browser tab and displays a demo video on the main page.

9e0ba44869f5e9a4e617bf207697154bd68a3105.text: A small internal fix stops a startup error from blocking the app. The service now loads even if a background step fails.

7d89b9143ecec8630eace9a02717e51cb64c8dfd.text: The website footer changed. It removed a small note and updated the text on the Discord link.

2a697a73f4f35675cc9ef569aa90414b862f6846.text: The system now skips saving data when a specific setting is active. Background tools were reorganized and work faster.

811d56ee00eb9a481adbe24e7cd2e514f4a81c47.text: The assistant switched to a newer, more capable brain. This update is internal and aims to make responses slightly more accurate.

33f0e7ca14083cd03c663bd5d8c5fe3e919a2e7f.text: The website now uses the new name and clearer text about helping you write code and run commands. A button to start using the tool was moved to the top of the page.

11f6aed905d7e5640b03567d78e83e5669a40b32.text: The landing page now shows a logo instead of text for the YC mention. This small visual update also fixes text spacing and corrects the assistant's name.

84e14ee58ea24229f57dca4790018e5ab5c4df8c.text: A small internal update adjusted the spacing on the homepage. This change slightly improves how the text appears but does not alter the product's features or performance.

bf245a37e473e354eca1d24fc06a78c14059dde6.text: Freebuff customers see clickable starter prompts on their first visit, but these disappear permanently after they submit any prompt.

6e392721fb79228f970577ee7d957562e282073f.text: The team updated the software's internal version number as part of a routine check. No features changed, so the tool works exactly as before.

2177c0adabe02f06a3bc88a7da3cb1a8526070f8.text: The assistant's internal label changed. No visible features or actions changed for you.

bbbcb51ed3f071e10a3c13da9479225c773bc536.text: A small internal update was made to the command-line tool. This change does not affect how the tool works or looks for you.

c75442472177f65a135093c5eb0a4f6506e49d80.text: The command-line tool received a routine version update. This internal change does not affect how you use the tool.

685722d57a156a8eabefcdeaf69271502509313c.text: The app updated its internal record number to match the latest release. No features or behaviors changed for users.

996258cf42269f4121e590f33229257b9814db65.text: The software update process was adjusted to ensure the correct version number is recorded. This is an internal maintenance task that does not change how the product works for you.

61bbbed7acda7e26413a443b17854e6dfdd359d9.text: The command-line tool now offers two new AI assistant types for writing and checking code. Older built-in assistant types were removed, so the list of available assistants is different.

b7218a9426cf1bb3ecdff1f907286190dbaeb6eb.text: Small internal update. No visible changes for you.

74269a520be5a36c6c0c3484383f880a9dc9e9a0.text: The command-line tool received a routine update. Nothing changed in how it works.

25ebdc54239630ac0679ccb4d869b548c5e738a6.title: Updated opengraph-image asset
25ebdc54239630ac0679ccb4d869b548c5e738a6.summary: Replaced `web/public/opengraph-image.png` with updated binary asset. Ensures correct Open Graph metadata rendering for social previews.

99fa7895e91da94dbd8c8171655f7252ef526b8f.title: Exclude tool results from User Input logs
99fa7895e91da94dbd8c8171655f7252ef526b8f.summary: websocket-action.ts now skips logging lastMessage.content when TOOL_RESULT_MARKER is present. Prevents raw tool execution output from flooding application logs. Applies to backend WebSocket user input handling.

6ee165addf06f13c322b693b531062c554bbe1e0.title: Update referral message in npm-app client
6ee165addf06f13c322b693b531062c554bbe1e0.summary: Referral message updated in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to explicitly state credit bonus. Replaces generic wording with `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS` constant and specific per-friend/month detail. Affects CLI output when `referralLink` is present.

022c717dea34c02b76b59227b08cdfe557339712.title: Remove packageManager field from package.json
022c717dea34c02b76b59227b08cdfe557339712.summary: Deleted the `packageManager` field specifying `bun@1.1.27` from `package.json`. This field caused confusion for `manicode`. Scope limited to root `package.json`.

4ceead5ccce3f7a14182ea1ba0cb03894d15d676.title: system-prompt: Clarify editfile vs code block usage
4ceead5ccce3f7a14182ea1ba0cb03894d15d676.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated editing_instructions to distinguish between applying edits and displaying code. <edit_file> blocks are now explicitly described as immediately applied, while code intended for display only must use markdown ``` tags. Comment guidance refined to prohibit edit-related comments (e.g. "// Add this line") rather than just excessive comments.

fff10829091d6eb31ec593b2e4e293f37b2e549f.title: Update menu. Plug referrals after login
fff10829091d6eb31ec593b2e4e293f37b2e549f.summary: CLI menu and post-login output now highlight referral rewards using `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS`. Login success message appends a referral link. Menu prompt examples updated to encourage feature building and integration via documentation URLs. Changes confined to `npm-app/src/client.ts` and `npm-app/src/menu.ts`.

fc03f28466cca75c0c96f57614f36fafa4e505ab.title: Adjust isSketchComplete prompt for LOCALCHANGEONLY
fc03f28466cca75c0c96f57614f36fafa4e505ab.summary: Modified the `isSketchComplete` prompt in `backend/src/generate-patch.ts` to soften the condition for returning `LOCAL_CHANGE_ONLY`. The strong prior language was removed, requiring the model to simply 'believe' the scenario rather than 'strongly believe' it, while maintaining `REPLACE_ENTIRE_FILE` as the default fallback.

95e461430a3db11de81d449e3326a017bec19889.title: Simplify login copy and fix GitHub button casing
95e461430a3db11de81d449e3326a017bec19889.summary: Login page copy simplified: title changed from 'Confirm cli login' to 'Login', description reduced to 'Continue to sign in to the Manicode CLI.' with phishing warning commented out. Sign-in button now renders 'GitHub' instead of 'Github' for provider casing. Scope: web/src/app/login/page.tsx, web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-button.tsx.

77a1ee5ba552df96ac94cf69ede92c2f391f0e4c.title: Drop anthropic key rotation
77a1ee5ba552df96ac94cf69ede92c2f391f0e4c.summary: backend/src/claude.ts stops randomizing between ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2. Directly assigns ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2. Reason: upstream rate limit increase. Scope: backend claude.ts only.

7d5989ef8550811be44d7bed834b6f5347e679b6.title: Move initial project context to worker thread
7d5989ef8550811be44d7bed834b6f5347e679b6.summary: Initial project context generation now runs in `worker_threads` via new `worker-script-project-context.ts`, decoupling it from main thread startup. `project-files.ts` adds `initProjectFileContextWithWorker` which spawns worker, passes `dir`, caches result, terminates worker. `index.ts` calls worker init instead of `getProjectFileContext([], {})` and removes `await readyPromise` before CLI construction, so user input no longer blocks on version check or fingerprint. `getProjectFileContext` signature changed to accept `projectRoot` as first arg, propagated to `client.ts` call sites.

25ebdc54239630ac0679ccb4d869b548c5e738a6.text: The image that appears when you share a link to the site was updated.

4ceead5ccce3f7a14182ea1ba0cb03894d15d676.text: The assistant now clearly separates actions that change your files from code snippets meant only for viewing. This prevents accidental edits when you just want to see an example.

fff10829091d6eb31ec593b2e4e293f37b2e549f.text: The menu and login screen now show referral rewards and include a link to share. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

fc03f28466cca75c0c96f57614f36fafa4e505ab.text: A small internal adjustment made the assistant more likely to apply only the specific changes you request, rather than rewriting an entire file. This helps keep your existing content intact when you ask for minor edits.

6ee165addf06f13c322b693b531062c554bbe1e0.text: Referral messages now clearly state the credit bonus amount for each friend per month. This change only affects the text shown in the command-line tool when a referral link is present.

7d5989ef8550811be44d7bed834b6f5347e679b6.text: The app now prepares its background settings in a separate process. This means the program starts faster and you can begin typing immediately without waiting for setup tasks to finish.

99fa7895e91da94dbd8c8171655f7252ef526b8f.text: The system now hides technical details from internal logs. You will not see this change, but it helps keep the service running smoothly.

95e461430a3db11de81d449e3326a017bec19889.text: The login screen now uses simpler wording and displays the 'GitHub' button with correct capitalization. This small update makes the page clearer and easier to read.

022c717dea34c02b76b59227b08cdfe557339712.text: Removed a confusing internal setting. No change to how you use the product.

77a1ee5ba552df96ac94cf69ede92c2f391f0e4c.text: The assistant now uses a single fixed connection instead of switching between two. This small internal change helps it handle more requests without hitting speed limits.

fb3e26bdf23087b7bb3f017afb39134eca8d6233.title: Pro overage cost raised to $0.90 per 100 credits
fb3e26bdf23087b7bb3f017afb39134eca8d6233.summary: Pro tier overage allowance updated from $0.50 to $0.90 per 100 credits in `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`. Documentation in `web/knowledge.md` expanded to explicitly define the new pricing structure. Support description refined to 'Priority support over email'.

67dea5d21a532a655a9a03ae58cc61d0a005f448.title: Cap web scraper output at 75k chars
67dea5d21a532a655a9a03ae58cc61d0a005f448.summary: Added MAX_SCRAPED_CONTENT_LENGTH constant (75,000 chars) to npm-app/src/web-scraper.ts. getScrapedContentBlocks now truncates scraped content exceeding this limit, appending '[...TRUNCATED: WEB PAGE CONTENT TOO LONG...]'. This prevents oversized web content from bloating prompt tokens. Scope limited to the web scraper module in the npm-app package.

bcdfbf51858dea9839d99351f65c8ca9d98a68e2.title: Pricing page adds Discord link to Community support
bcdfbf51858dea9839d99351f65c8ca9d98a68e2.summary: The Free tier's 'Community support' feature on the pricing page is now a clickable link to the Discord server (https://discord.gg/mcWTGjgTj3). This change affects web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx, replacing plain text with a Link component.

8cac781f8e04012d8ff94c72780091fb30107fb6.title: Referral page prompt copy updated
8cac781f8e04012d8ff94c72780091fb30107fb6.summary: `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` updated the non-limit referral prompt. The copy now reads `Refer a friend and earn ${CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS} credits per month! Share this link with them:` instead of the generic send-link message. Scope is limited to the Web referrals page. The change uses `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS` interpolation in user-facing copy.

41498026ec398fd7742e26025ab10d7abddcaa4c.title: Add CSS test case to generatePatch suite
41498026ec398fd7742e26025ab10d7abddcaa4c.summary: Added test fixture for CSS file patching. Includes `old.ts`, `new.ts`, and `expected.ts` mock data. Registered in `generate-patch.test.ts` via `runPatchTest` on `src/style.css`. Internal QA only.

8a2a55ce7b6b178352de769a3a641668b4f5508c.title: Logger writes debug.log in non-production
8a2a55ce7b6b178352de769a3a641668b4f5508c.summary: Backend logger now uses pino/file transport to write debug logs to `debug.log` in non-production environments, replacing previous pino-pretty console output. This change ensures persistent log storage for easier debugging and troubleshooting outside production. The update affects `backend/src/util/logger.ts` and adds logging guidelines to `npm-app/knowledge.md`.

41b405b65610a0b6602197b616c9e653ffdd6e6b.title: Quota error handling and pricing page improvements
41b405b65610a0b6602197b616c9e653ffdd6e6b.summary: WebSocket middleware now returns structured `ServerAction` objects instead of raw `Error` instances, enabling precise quota exceeded messages and referral link generation in `response-complete` payloads. The `genUsageResponse` helper centralizes usage calculation and referral logic, while `hasMaxedReferrals` provides detailed status reasons for UI feedback. Support email validation added to `env.mjs`; backend dev script switched from `nodemon` to Bun's native `--hot` reload.

e1ce9db7f53491e135c1ee0e7cf9f1984d814579.title: Refine local-only-change detection in generate-patch
e1ce9db7f53491e135c1ee0e7cf9f1984d814579.summary: Refactored isSketchCompletePrompt in backend/src/generate-patch.ts to better handle Claude's local-only-change detection. Added early returns for EXISTING_CODE_MARKER presence and prior file edits via parseFileBlocks. Updated the GPT-4o classification prompt to explicitly distinguish between REPLACE_ENTIRE_FILE and LOCAL_CHANGE_ONLY, replacing the previous INCOMPLETE_SKETCH logic.

ac1d046cb508d1f697e5a02fc531049e35221618.title: Fix file parsing for previously edited files
ac1d046cb508d1f697e5a02fc531049e35221618.summary: Replaced JSON.stringify(messageHistory) with explicit content extraction in backend/src/generate-patch.ts. The previous approach serialized the entire message object, causing parseFileBlocks to fail identifying files when content was non-string or multi-part. This ensures accurate detection of previously edited files for patch generation.

fa94e8e486ba0e884c2b5ca3eb68df3171e2eac4.title: Pricing page copy and layout fixes
fa94e8e486ba0e884c2b5ca3eb68df3171e2eac4.summary: Updated `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` to simplify overage copy, add credit context, and fix card layout. Changed Pro plan text to '$0.90 per 100 credits afterwards' and added a note that '500 credits is equivalent to a multi-hour work session'. Applied flexbox to pricing cards for consistent height and set `target="_blank"` on community support links.

ac1d046cb508d1f697e5a02fc531049e35221618.text: The system now correctly recognizes files you have edited in the past. This ensures that changes are applied to the right places when you ask for updates.

8cac781f8e04012d8ff94c72780091fb30107fb6.text: The text on the referral page now clearly states how many monthly credits you earn for referring a friend. This is a small wording update.

41b405b65610a0b6602197b616c9e653ffdd6e6b.text: The system now shows clearer messages when you reach your usage limit and helps you find referral links to get more access. Internal updates also improved how the service checks support emails and restarts when changes are made.

bcdfbf51858dea9839d99351f65c8ca9d98a68e2.text: The 'Community support' text on the Free plan now links directly to a Discord chat. Users can click it to join the community server.

fb3e26bdf23087b7bb3f017afb39134eca8d6233.text: Extra usage costs more: 90 cents per 100 credits, up from 50 cents. This applies only if you exceed your monthly limit.

fa94e8e486ba0e884c2b5ca3eb68df3171e2eac4.text: The pricing page now shows a simpler cost for extra credits and explains that 500 credits equal a multi-hour work session. The plan cards also look neater with matching heights, and support links open in new tabs.

8a2a55ce7b6b178352de769a3a641668b4f5508c.text: The system now saves technical details to a file instead of showing them on screen. This helps support staff find problems faster.

67dea5d21a532a655a9a03ae58cc61d0a005f448.text: The assistant now shortens very long web pages it reads. This helps it answer questions faster and more reliably.

41498026ec398fd7742e26025ab10d7abddcaa4c.text: The team added a small internal test to ensure the system can correctly update visual styles. This is a behind-the-scenes quality check that does not change how you use the product.

e1ce9db7f53491e135c1ee0e7cf9f1984d814579.text: The assistant now better recognizes when to update only a small part of a file versus replacing the whole thing.

ea7d2dd260f854f9ec70a090890f850f805c0bf2.title: Training dataset script filters files over 50,000 tokens
ea7d2dd260f854f9ec70a090890f850f805c0bf2.summary: scripts/patch-dataset-processing/create-training-dataset.ts now imports countTokens from backend/util/token-counter and applies a filter dropping entries where countTokens(str) >= 50_000. This prevents oversized conversations from entering the training/validation split. Scope limited to the dataset preparation script; no model, CLI, or Web surface changes. Filter runs post-stringify, pre-shuffle, using a 50_000 token threshold.

9b36eea10a2b242a13c6fc88ddef508a0624fcbc.title: Isolate credentials dir for localhost dev
9b36eea10a2b242a13c6fc88ddef508a0624fcbc.summary: Refactored credential handling to support isolated directories for local development. The `npm-app` package now imports `userFromJson` and `CREDENTIALS_PATH` from a new local `src/credentials.ts` file instead of `common/src/util/credentials.ts`. This new file constructs the path using `os.homedir()/.config/manicode-${ENVIRONMENT}` when `process.env.ENVIRONMENT` is set and not 'production', preventing dev credentials from clashing with production ones. The shared `common` utility was stripped of these specific path/parse exports.

f34dfb314852af30b6bd2a368395cbf6a2f4b405.title: Refactor ChatStorage class
f34dfb314852af30b6bd2a368395cbf6a2f4b405.summary: Refactored `ChatStorage` in `npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts`. Removed unused public methods (`getChat`, `deleteChat`, `listChats`, `setCurrentChat`) and private helpers (`getFilePath`, `generateChatId`), moving remaining private helpers to the end of the class. The `fs` import was dropped as file I/O is stubbed out.

f28de674005b83cd5a5b2979b50e14b53ca3ba8f.title: Add JSX comment pattern to replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments
f28de674005b83cd5a5b2979b50e14b53ca3ba8f.summary: Added regex case for JSX comments in `replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments` in `common/src/util/string.ts`. Matches `{/* ... */}` blocks containing rest/unchanged keywords. Updated `common/src/util/__tests__/string.test.ts` to cover the new pattern.

1e26d2d9c56e11c8fa6902adccc8cda0b772e68c.title: WebSocket timeout raised to 10s; nodemodules ignored
1e26d2d9c56e11c8fa6902adccc8cda0b772e68c.summary: WebSocket client timeout increased from 5000ms to 10000ms in `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`. Project file tree now ignores `node_modules` by default in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts`. `make` added to `SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS` in `common/src/constants.ts`. File size limit for project files reduced from 5MB to 1MB in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`.

5d7f6c6f547418d57c5d5c81f1a61442518d3ee2.title: Add patch dataset processing scripts and string util
5d7f6c6f547418d57c5d5c81f1a61442518d3ee2.summary: New `scripts/patch-dataset-processing/` directory contains TypeScript utilities for generating AI training datasets from code patches. Scripts handle concatenating raw datasets, processing directory structures, updating patch files to remove trailing context, normalizing sketch comments via `replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments2`, verifying patches, and creating shuffled JSONL training/validation splits. Core `common/src/util/string.ts` gains `replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments2` to standardize non-code comments across multiple languages.

e9b21c2d37f054932d7b8b7fb4233efacb221417.title: Skip websocket middleware in local
e9b21c2d37f054932d7b8b7fb4233efacb221417.summary: Added early return in backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts when env.ENVIRONMENT is 'local'. Skips match(action) and associated protection logic during local development. Internal change affecting only local websocket connections.

bd64b7f177bb7e92d08d2183619e53ee1d189001.title: CLI shows usage on quota exceeded
bd64b7f177bb7e92d08d2183619e53ee1d189001.summary: Quota exceeded errors now direct users to the `usage` command. Removed dedicated `quota-exceeded` action; unified error handling via `action-error`. Backend `protec` middleware returns generic error message prompting `usage`. CLI `client.ts` subscribes to `action-error` to display red text and restore prompt.

3c7f9217997a70f48266ae36f3fb79c6658f1987.title: Replace patch placeholder comments with EXISTINGCODEMARKER
3c7f9217997a70f48266ae36f3fb79c6658f1987.summary: Unified patch generation and sketch updates to use the explicit `EXISTING_CODE_MARKER` constant instead of language-specific comment placeholders. Refactored `replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments` to accept a mandatory replacement string, removing the legacy multi-pattern regex block. Updated `generatePatch` and `update-sketch.ts` to propagate this marker, ensuring consistent handling of unchanged code sections across backend and tooling.

9b36eea10a2b242a13c6fc88ddef508a0624fcbc.text: Internal tools for testing the app now use a separate storage spot for login details. This prevents test accounts from mixing with real production data. Regular users will not notice any changes.

3c7f9217997a70f48266ae36f3fb79c6658f1987.text: The system now uses a standard signal to mark code that stays the same. This makes updates more consistent and reliable.

9bd24bac82d19576e43dadf2f76cbd5053e9c85e.text: The assistant now picks the newest available software updates instead of guessing. This helps you get the latest features and fixes automatically.

f28de674005b83cd5a5b2979b50e14b53ca3ba8f.text: The system now recognizes specific notes written in a certain format, allowing it to process them correctly. This small internal update ensures better handling of these notes without changing how you use the product.

1e26d2d9c56e11c8fa6902adccc8cda0b772e68c.text: The app now waits longer for network connections to finish, reducing failed actions on slow internet. Internal cleanup and file size limits were also adjusted, but you likely won't notice these changes.

bd64b7f177bb7e92d08d2183619e53ee1d189001.text: When you hit a limit, the app now tells you to check your usage instead of showing a confusing error. This helps you quickly see how much you have used and what you can do next.

f34dfb314852af30b6bd2a368395cbf6a2f4b405.text: We cleaned up the code that saves your chats, removing parts that were no longer needed. This change does not affect how you use the product.

5d7f6c6f547418d57c5d5c81f1a61442518d3ee2.text: The team added tools to process code updates, helping the assistant learn from more examples.

e9b21c2d37f054932d7b8b7fb4233efacb221417.text: The software now skips certain security checks when running in a local test environment. This change is internal and does not affect the product you use.

ea7d2dd260f854f9ec70a090890f850f805c0bf2.text: The system now automatically removes very long conversation records when preparing data for the assistant. This helps keep the training process efficient and prevents issues from unusually large text entries.

e94190c145566fc78ccf053a062bf0750ac4ed0e.title: Fix referral error message typos and punctuation
e94190c145566fc78ccf053a062bf0750ac4ed0e.summary: Corrects typos and punctuation in referral redemption error strings within `web/src/app/api/referrals/helpers.ts`. Fixes missing space in 'already.o' to 'already. No' and adds trailing periods to duplicate/self-referral errors. Updates `web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx` to remove redundant period concatenation in UI display logic.

859ac32a5fd2380b563ec5787fc1f9a90d2838b2.title: Fix SQL query for max referral check
859ac32a5fd2380b563ec5787fc1f9a90d2838b2.summary: Corrects `hasMaxedReferrals` logic in `common/src/util/server/referral.ts`. Replaces complex join/groupBy query with direct count check and separate user lookup to ensure accurate limit detection and referral code retrieval.

18d586d784dc4c6623376cc3f76ed08df8848b2e.title: Web sign-in button shown for signed-out users
18d586d784dc4c6623376cc3f76ed08df8848b2e.summary: Added `SignInCardFooter` component and rendered it on `/login` and `/referrals` pages when the user is not authenticated. The `/referrals` navbar link is now always visible, previously hidden for signed-out users. `SignInButton` was moved from `navbar/` to `sign-in/` and its image rendering switched from `next/image` to native `img`.

952fa8c84387446b85044aef5815af31befb9783.title: Fix referral text formatting
952fa8c84387446b85044aef5815af31befb9783.summary: Corrects JSX text rendering in `web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx` by removing stray backticks from the referral success message. Updates copy in `web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx` to clarify login requirement for generating a referral code. Scope limited to Web UI text components. No logic or API changes.

1e3f61cf86eeb9adb06b66fc27c2afa0a4ae48f6.title: Deterministic API key selection via fingerprint hash
1e3f61cf86eeb9adb06b66fc27c2afa0a4ae48f6.summary: Replaced random 50/50 API key selection with deterministic hashing in `promptClaudeStream`. New `randBoolFromStr` utility in `common/src/util/string.ts` sums character codes of `fingerprintId` to select between `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2`. This ensures consistent routing per user session, likely to stabilize rate limit handling. Changes affect backend Claude integration and shared string utilities.

67b14536ed4e738d021b9da9b6719f42472f8172.title: Add double-dipping check to referral redemption
67b14536ed4e738d021b9da9b6719f42472f8172.summary: RedeemReferralCode now rejects cases where the referrer was already referred by the current user. The check queries schema.referral for a matching referrer_id and referred_id pair using and() from drizzle-orm. Returns 429 with a specific error if double dipping is detected.

f69e63694f1c3e7f92a77ed5167cafe70a2323b2.title: Support multiple Anthropic API keys
f69e63694f1c3e7f92a77ed5167cafe70a2323b2.summary: Added ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2 to env schema and updated promptClaudeStream to randomly select between ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2. This change is scoped to backend/src/claude.ts and backend/src/env.mjs. The selection logic uses Math.random() > 0.5 to distribute requests across available keys.

23d30e803574b62295d5a2fc559c005f163595ad.title: Add referral system, bonus credits, and env var refactor
23d30e803574b62295d5a2fc559c005f163595ad.summary: Implemented a full referral system allowing users to generate unique links and earn 500 bonus credits per successful referral, capped at 5 referrals. This required new database tables for tracking referral status, API routes for code validation, and UI pages for user management. Environment variables were refactored from `APP_URL` to `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` across backend and web configs, and local development credit limits were significantly increased to bypass quota checks during testing.

97a524e86e58a1203a38a17e13cf91bf8e10c892.title: Extract redeemReferralCode to helpers.ts and fix build errors
97a524e86e58a1203a38a17e13cf91bf8e10c892.summary: Moved redeemReferralCode logic from web/src/app/api/referrals/route.ts to new file web/src/app/api/referrals/helpers.ts. Updated imports in route.ts and web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx to point to the new helper location. Fixed React build errors by escaping apostrophes in JSX text across web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx, web/src/app/referrals/[code]/page.tsx, and web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx. Replaced raw img tag with next/image component in web/src/components/navbar/sign-in-button.tsx.

48b17912a5de555d39ba6fc8177fc74ece88ec05.title: Add ANTHROPICAPIKEY2 to .env.example
48b17912a5de555d39ba6fc8177fc74ece88ec05.summary: Added `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY2` placeholder to `.env.example`. Supports multiple Anthropic keys for load balancing or fallback. No code logic changes in this commit.

18d586d784dc4c6623376cc3f76ed08df8848b2e.text: People who are not logged in will now see a clear button to sign in on the main pages. The link to share referrals is also always visible, making it easier to find.

e94190c145566fc78ccf053a062bf0750ac4ed0e.text: Small internal fix to referral error messages. Typos and punctuation corrected for clearer display.

67b14536ed4e738d021b9da9b6719f42472f8172.text: The system now stops people from swapping referral credits back and forth to cheat the rules. If you try to redeem a code for someone who already gave you one, it will fail.

952fa8c84387446b85044aef5815af31befb9783.text: A small update fixed messy text on the referral page. It also clarified that users must log in to create a referral code.

48b17912a5de555d39ba6fc8177fc74ece88ec05.text: Small internal update. The system now supports multiple backup connections to the AI service. No change to how you use the product.

1e3f61cf86eeb9adb06b66fc27c2afa0a4ae48f6.text: The system now picks the same connection path for each user session instead of choosing randomly. This creates a more stable experience.

23d30e803574b62295d5a2fc559c005f163595ad.text: Users can now invite friends with a unique link to earn bonus credits, up to five times. This lets people get more credits without paying.

f69e63694f1c3e7f92a77ed5167cafe70a2323b2.text: The system can now switch between two separate accounts when sending requests. This helps spread out usage to reduce the chance of hitting a limit on either account.

97a524e86e58a1203a38a17e13cf91bf8e10c892.text: The app's referral code feature was reorganized to run more smoothly. Minor text and image glitches were fixed, so the sign-in and referral pages now display correctly.

ab0e6d1c2572ce6ab30f1531b31e145e2b60f4eb.title: Fix usage limit warning copy in client.ts
ab0e6d1c2572ce6ab30f1531b31e145e2b60f4eb.summary: Updated the monthly usage limit warning message in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to read "over ${pct}%" instead of "${pct}+%". This corrects the phrasing for clarity when users approach their quota. The change is internal to the CLI client's console output logic.

01dcb7699252d1ae09fd248d324a83c49b0e1a1d.title: Fix applyPatch hunk index fallback
01dcb7699252d1ae09fd248d324a83c49b0e1a1d.summary: patch.ts adds maybeStartIndex guard in applyPatch. Prevents negative or out-of-bounds startIndex from corrupting getMatchIndex. Falls back to undefined when startIndex < oldIndex. Internal core utility refactor.

c95395cbd1421a001dc8a2d639723a4451313926.title: Skip local credit checks, tighten env guard
c95395cbd1421a001dc8a2d639723a4451313926.summary: Credit enforcement bypasses on local env via `env.ENVIRONMENT === 'local'` in `calculateUsage`, returning `limit: Infinity`. `protec` middleware guard tightened from `!== 'production'` to `=== 'local'`, now enforcing checks on staging. `generate-commit-message` action formatting updated. User input logs prefixed with `USER INPUT:`. Changes isolated to `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts` and `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`.

9b75e22adeb88a77be9113ce1cd4e1fec32702d3.title: Fix installer detection on Windows
9b75e22adeb88a77be9113ce1cd4e1fec32702d3.summary: Installer detection in `npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts` now uses `where` on Windows instead of `which`. The change adds a platform check for `process.platform === 'win32'` and wraps the execution in a try/catch block to handle errors gracefully. This ensures correct path resolution for `manicode` across different operating systems.

f78d41250eb5835e52d8a1e49853a16bca7b03c1.title: Backend: implement best-of-3 patch generation
f78d41250eb5835e52d8a1e49853a16bca7b03c1.summary: Added `generateBestOfNPatch` to `backend/src/generate-patch.ts` to generate three patch variations in parallel and select the best one via an LLM comparison prompt. This replaces the direct `generatePatchPrompt` call in the main `generatePatch` flow. The comparison prompt evaluates patches on correctness, minimal changes, and readability, explicitly penalizing un-replaced placeholder comments. `applyPatch` from `common/util/patch` is now used to evaluate the generated patches against the original content before comparison.

21a7ba6d0c84d43b01f95994d8d40f9bf93d18bc.title: CLI change display and commit message output
21a7ba6d0c84d43b01f95994d8d40f9bf93d18bc.summary: Updated `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to prefix added lines with `+` for file changes and removed green coloring from auto-commit message output. This improves diff readability by explicitly marking additions and ensures commit messages render in standard terminal color.

24a7b3028414b7cc67dffcc4a68874caa7ea3aa1.title: Add 5MB file size limit to project file reading
24a7b3028414b7cc67dffcc4a68874caa7ea3aa1.summary: Enforces a 5MB limit on files read by `getFiles` in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. Files exceeding this threshold are skipped and replaced with a `[FILE_TOO_LARGE: ...]` placeholder string to prevent memory issues. This change applies to the core file reading logic used by the agent.

5a4af4e5028e95612781da33abcec1a537c55d09.title: Auto commit staged changes in CLI
5a4af4e5028e95612781da33abcec1a537c55d09.summary: Added autoCommitChanges method to CLI class. Checks for staged changes via git diff --staged --quiet. Commits with message 'Manicode: auto commit' if changes exist. Called before staging new changes in stageAllChanges.

09b8f1d5bef7c0a6f14c8762231d44747146125e.title: AI commit message generation for autoGit
09b8f1d5bef7c0a6f14c8762231d44747146125e.summary: Added `generate-commit-message` action to backend and CLI to replace static auto-commit messages with Claude Sonnet-generated summaries. New `common/util/git.ts` helpers handle staging and diff retrieval, while `npm-app/src/cli.ts` integrates async generation into the `autoGit` flow. Websockets in `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts` route staged diffs to `generateCommitMessage`, returning imperative-style commit texts to the client.

9e51d6d8c9c52eeb4ddf69ee0aef6fc9ab9a47c6.title: Refactor git utility functions and improve CLI output
9e51d6d8c9c52eeb4ddf69ee0aef6fc9ab9a47c6.summary: Refactored `common/src/util/git.ts` to separate staging from change detection, introducing `hasStagedChanges` and updating `stageAllChanges` to return a boolean based on the new helper. Silenced `console.error` in `getStagedChanges` and added a try-catch block to `commitChanges` to prevent crashes on empty commits. Updated `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to use `hasStagedChanges` for auto-commit logic and adjusted newline placement in CLI output messages.

01dcb7699252d1ae09fd248d324a83c49b0e1a1d.text: The assistant now handles certain file updates more reliably by checking its starting position before making changes. This prevents occasional errors when applying small edits.

9e51d6d8c9c52eeb4ddf69ee0aef6fc9ab9a47c6.text: The tool now checks for saved changes before trying to record them. This stops errors when there is nothing new to save and makes the text messages on the screen easier to read.

9b75e22adeb88a77be9113ce1cd4e1fec32702d3.text: The program now finds the assistant correctly on Windows. This fixes a small internal issue that could stop the assistant from starting.

ab0e6d1c2572ce6ab30f1531b31e145e2b60f4eb.text: The wording of a warning message about monthly usage limits was corrected for clarity. This is a small internal change, so the tool's features and behavior remain exactly the same.

24a7b3028414b7cc67dffcc4a68874caa7ea3aa1.text: The system now ignores files larger than 5MB when the assistant reads project data. Instead of loading the whole file, it replaces it with a note saying the file is too big. This stops the app from running out of memory.

21a7ba6d0c84d43b01f95994d8d40f9bf93d18bc.text: Added text in change previews now starts with a plus sign to make it easier to see what is new. Automatic commit messages no longer appear in green, so they match the rest of the text.

09b8f1d5bef7c0a6f14c8762231d44747146125e.text: The tool now writes its own commit summaries automatically instead of using fixed text. You get clearer, more descriptive records of what changed.

5a4af4e5028e95612781da33abcec1a537c55d09.text: The tool now automatically saves changes before adding new ones. This keeps your work safe without you needing to do anything.

c95395cbd1421a001dc8a2d639723a4451313926.text: The system now checks usage limits more strictly on the test site, while skipping these checks only on private computers. This update is internal and does not change how the product works for regular users.

f78d41250eb5835e52d8a1e49853a16bca7b03c1.text: The system now creates three different versions of a change at the same time. It then picks the best one by checking for accuracy, simplicity, and clarity. This helps ensure the final result is cleaner and more reliable for users.

0ca813ae18ce0f5c031b2086a1483c5e06902aff.title: Pricing page redirects unauthenticated users to login
0ca813ae18ce0f5c031b2086a1483c5e06902aff.summary: Pricing page now checks session status before creating Stripe checkout session. Unauthenticated users redirect to /login instead of proceeding. Change affects web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. Uses next/navigation router.push for redirect.

97ab43be2b6a93b084c2d3f97c7a519102056f5e.title: Disable OpenAI store flag
97ab43be2b6a93b084c2d3f97c7a519102056f5e.summary: Commented out `store: true` in `promptOpenAI` call within `backend/src/openai-api.ts`. Simplified error logging in `promptOpenAIWithContinuation` to pass raw error object instead of extracting message.

907f0c597b3bb9542a04638fa30f6078f82d6e57.title: Disable WebSocket protection in non-production environments
907f0c597b3bb9542a04638fa30f6078f82d6e57.summary: WebSocket protection middleware now skips rate-limiting checks when `env.ENVIRONMENT` is not set to production. This change prevents development friction by allowing unrestricted WebSocket action matching during local testing. The update applies to `backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts`, specifically within the `protec.use` handler chain.

4f70425b5129db047161a98a35db550581dec9ed.title: Simplify CLI diff header display
4f70425b5129db047161a98a35db550581dec9ed.summary: CLI diff output now prints a plain hyphen before file paths instead of green text. This removes color formatting from the `lastChanges` loop in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Scope limited to CLI diff rendering.

3ad8161f54f606085223f3683c182a726e40d7c2.title: Broaden npm detection in update-manicode
3ad8161f54f606085223f3683c182a726e40d7c2.summary: detectInstaller in npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts now returns 'npm' when pathIncludesNodeModules, path.includes('npm'), path.startsWith('/usr/'), or npm_config_user_agent includes 'npm'. Previous logic required pathIncludesNodeModules AND (npm or /usr/), missing global installs without node_modules in path. Scope limited to CLI update mechanism. User-agent check adds fallback for npm-managed binaries outside standard paths.

5dcf2c6bc9477fdacc7ce43bd9ec6e727d591db5.title: Update Pro pricing page credits and features
5dcf2c6bc9477fdacc7ce43bd9ec6e727d591db5.summary: Pro tier credits set to literal 10_000 instead of CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS.PAID. Added overage allowance feature text ($0.50 per 100 credits). Scope limited to web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. No logic changes, only display data.

3422538d1f19bd3fbc4d6c823b4ab3acb1920caf.title: Fix logger context leakage in mixin
3422538d1f19bd3fbc4d6c823b4ab3acb1920caf.summary: The `mixin` function in `backend/src/util/logger.ts` now returns a shallow copy of the async storage context (`{ ...loggerAsyncStorage.getStore() }`) instead of the direct reference. This prevents mutable context objects from leaking across log entries, ensuring isolation between different execution contexts. The change applies to the backend logging subsystem.

d5755643aec3760a38c22012acd48cea9924de97.title: Make second ellipsis optional in placeholder comment regexes
d5755643aec3760a38c22012acd48cea9924de97.summary: Updated regexes in common/src/util/string.ts to make the trailing ellipsis optional in non-standard placeholder comment detection. This ensures comments like `// ... existing code` without a second `...` are correctly normalized to `// ... existing code ...`. Affects C-style, Python, HTML, SQL, and MATLAB comment patterns.

f40d27414760f00ae5731c7b390ae6a14fbaf3c0.title: /usage command and credits in response-complete
f40d27414760f00ae5731c7b390ae6a14fbaf3c0.summary: Added `usage` and `credits` aliases to the CLI, triggering a new `usage` websocket action that returns a `usage-response` payload. The `response-complete` server action now embeds `usage` and `limit` fields, allowing the client to store them and display a warning via `showUsageWarning` without a separate websocket round-trip. The `sendUsageUpdate` helper was refactored into `calculateUsage`, and the server action type `usage` was renamed to `usage-response` to avoid collision with the new client action.

7d6c953a5942f1daf7b5beab1d6ce14467650914.title: CLI diff command added
7d6c953a5942f1daf7b5beab1d6ce14467650914.summary: CLI now supports `diff` and `d` commands to print last assistant file changes. Implementation tracks `lastChanges` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, rendering green/red diffs via `handleDiff`. `SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS` updated in `common/src/constants.ts` to include `diff`. System prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` enforces file verification before edits.

97ab43be2b6a93b084c2d3f97c7a519102056f5e.text: The assistant stopped saving conversation data to external servers. Users should see no change in how the tool works.

3ad8161f54f606085223f3683c182a726e40d7c2.text: The software now finds its updater more easily. This helps the product update itself correctly in more cases.

3422538d1f19bd3fbc4d6c823b4ab3acb1920caf.text: A small internal fix ensures log entries stay separate. This keeps records accurate and prevents information from mixing between different actions.

907f0c597b3bb9542a04638fa30f6078f82d6e57.text: The system now lets staff test features more easily by turning off speed limits for live data connections in testing areas. This change helps developers work faster but does not affect how the product behaves for normal users.

0ca813ae18ce0f5c031b2086a1483c5e06902aff.text: The pricing page now sends visitors to the login screen if they aren't signed in. This prevents errors when trying to start a payment without an account.

7d6c953a5942f1daf7b5beab1d6ce14467650914.text: Users can now view a summary of the last file changes made by the assistant. This helps verify edits without needing to open each file manually.

5dcf2c6bc9477fdacc7ce43bd9ec6e727d591db5.text: The Pro pricing page now shows the credit limit as a fixed number and adds text about paying extra if you use more credits. This change only updates the displayed information; it does not change how the product works.

f40d27414760f00ae5731c7b390ae6a14fbaf3c0.text: The app now shows your remaining credits and usage limits directly with every response, instead of asking you to check separately. This update keeps the interface simple and ensures you always see your current status without extra steps.

d5755643aec3760a38c22012acd48cea9924de97.text: Fixed a small issue where text was not cleaned up correctly if it missed a specific ending mark. Now, the tool handles more types of notes properly.

4f70425b5129db047161a98a35db550581dec9ed.text: File lists in the command line now use simple hyphens instead of colored text. This is a small internal visual change with no impact on functionality.

c959d4b4ca2ddbc22e9324b7234e65a1c3190de0.title: Replace logger with console in env config
c959d4b4ca2ddbc22e9324b7234e65a1c3190de0.summary: Removed `logger` import and replaced `logger.info` with `console.log` in `backend/src/env.mjs`. This avoids using the application logger during early environment configuration, preventing potential circular dependencies or premature initialization issues. Scope limited to backend environment setup.

d331ada8e2cebedc02a80dce4c97070bf60ba802.title: Backend uncaughtException handler added
d331ada8e2cebedc02a80dce4c97070bf60ba802.summary: Added process.on('uncaughtException') to backend/src/index.ts. Logs fatal errors via logger.fatal, closes server, and exits with code 1. Includes 1-second timeout fallback to process.abort() if graceful shutdown fails. Internal change affecting backend error handling.

004944622f0c376786eb2ff4caee6ad10696e404.title: Add keep to placeholder comment regex in common/src/util/string.ts
004944622f0c376786eb2ff4caee6ad10696e404.summary: The `replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments` function now matches `keep` in its regex patterns. Previously, comments using `keep` (e.g., `// ... keep ...`) were ignored. This change ensures they are normalized to `... existing code ...`. The update applies to all supported comment styles (C, Python, HTML, SQL, MATLAB) in `common/src/util/string.ts`.

1a2b21b7958fb4db49eb50322c5a909fff47b8b0.title: Logger: pino level label and ISO timestamp
1a2b21b7958fb4db49eb50322c5a909fff47b8b0.summary: Updated backend logger config in `backend/src/util/logger.ts` to format log levels as uppercase strings and use ISO 8601 timestamps. Added `formatters.level` to convert pino's numeric level to its label, and a custom `timestamp` function. Internal logging format change.

996ccc5a44c36603479e0c9e51952148f7e46493.title: AsyncLocalStorage binds pino context to websocket actions
996ccc5a44c36603479e0c9e51952148f7e46493.summary: logger.ts wraps pino with AsyncLocalStorage via a mixin, exposing withLoggerContext to inject request-scoped fields. websocket-action.ts calls withLoggerContext around onUserInput, attaching fingerprintId, authToken, and clientRequestId to all downstream logs. Scope is backend logging and websocket handlers only. Context merges with existing store values, enabling correlated logs across async boundaries without manual parameter threading.

a91bdaf622ea5f8f00cc8557ff18dd1d1a4057e9.title: Add --auto-git flag to stage changes before applying
a91bdaf622ea5f8f00cc8557ff18dd1d1a4057e9.summary: CLI adds `--auto-git` flag. `stageAllChanges` runs `git add .` via `execSync` before `applyChanges` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Argument parsing shifts to `process.argv.slice(2)` in `npm-app/src/index.ts` to extract flag, stripping it before passing `projectPath` and `initialInput`. `npm-app/package.json` `start` script enables flag by default.

fe7d4c67ed9a26f06c17b637c782a60eb0aae895.title: Normalize placeholder comments and skip test billing
fe7d4c67ed9a26f06c17b637c782a60eb0aae895.summary: Added `replaceNonStandardPlaceholderComments` to normalize AI-generated placeholder comments into standard formats across multiple languages before patch generation. Introduced `TEST_USER_ID` constant and updated `promptOpenAI` to skip `saveMessage` billing tracking when the user ID matches this test constant. Changes affect `backend/src/generate-patch.ts`, `backend/src/openai-api.ts`, and `common/src/util/string.ts`.

ebf36d4bceac3e6d79e707a93d7e4b351dba2156.title: Consolidate backend logging calls
ebf36d4bceac3e6d79e707a93d7e4b351dba2156.summary: Refactors logging in `backend/src` to use structured `logger.debug`/`logger.info` calls with consistent object payloads. Removes verbose inline logs, redundant `console.error` usage, and unused imports like `fs`/`path` in `main-prompt.ts`. Updates `system-prompt.ts` to log detailed token counts from `getTruncatedFilesBasedOnTokenBudget` and removes the unused `getRelevantFilesPrompt` export. Scope limited to internal backend observability; no user-facing behavior changes.

b87b4ec631f69c7930ae5bf220e458be5f880133.title: Consolidate requestRelevantFiles logs
b87b4ec631f69c7930ae5bf220e458be5f880133.summary: Refactored `requestRelevantFiles` and `generateFileRequests` to consolidate multiple scattered `logger.info` calls into single structured log entries. `checkNewFilesNecessary` now returns an object containing both the boolean result and the raw response string for better traceability. `getRelevantFiles` returns the full result object including `requestType` and `response` instead of just files and duration. Updated `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`.

1376cfaf7769ce0f595c8ff7d0ea4db561e39a28.title: Replace console and debugLog with pino structured logging
1376cfaf7769ce0f595c8ff7d0ea4db561e39a28.summary: Backend logging migrated to pino, replacing console.log, console.error, and custom debugLog calls across claude.ts, generate-knowledge-files.ts, generate-patch.ts, index.ts, main-prompt.ts, and openai-api.ts. Production uses JSON output, development uses pino-pretty transport, with levels controlled by LOG_LEVEL env var. Updates backend/knowledge.md documenting the new logging strategy and configuration.

ebf36d4bceac3e6d79e707a93d7e4b351dba2156.text: The system's internal record-keeping was cleaned up to make it easier for the team to track how the software works. This change does not affect how you use the product.

1a2b21b7958fb4db49eb50322c5a909fff47b8b0.text: The system now writes its internal notes with clearer dates and labels. This small change helps staff read logs more easily, but it does not affect how the product works for users.

b87b4ec631f69c7930ae5bf220e458be5f880133.text: Internal logging changes help track file requests. You will not see any difference.

fe7d4c67ed9a26f06c17b637c782a60eb0aae895.text: The assistant now fixes messy notes in the code it writes. Test actions no longer count toward usage limits.

d331ada8e2cebedc02a80dce4c97070bf60ba802.text: A safety rule was added to the system. If a serious error happens, the system now stops cleanly instead of crashing unexpectedly.

a91bdaf622ea5f8f00cc8557ff18dd1d1a4057e9.text: The tool now automatically saves your changes before running them. This means you do not need to manually prepare files before the tool applies updates.

1376cfaf7769ce0f595c8ff7d0ea4db561e39a28.text: The system now uses a better way to keep records of its activity. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

c959d4b4ca2ddbc22e9324b7234e65a1c3190de0.text: The system now uses a simpler built-in tool to record early setup details, avoiding potential startup conflicts. This internal adjustment does not change how the product works for you.

004944622f0c376786eb2ff4caee6ad10696e404.text: The tool now recognizes a specific note to keep existing code and formats it consistently. This means fewer errors when you use that note in your comments.

5620f2880a3629b8b59fee5d0f79cd4b2d8b4725.text: The update label changed. The app works the same.

440632f919e4158538026a2e133eacf7dce98bae.text: The program's internal record of its current version number was updated to reflect a new release. This is a routine administrative step. It does not change how the program works or what it can do.

1318f2239cff53552173d8c0ea7481c0818e9ba7.text: The program's internal version number was updated. This change does not add new features or affect how the program works for users.

d8820934a14e88dac6a2c3e4b985786d4156aca3.text: The tool's internal label number updated. No features or behaviors changed for you.

937e91d646c95b094900a9cd2ce55151d96f0037.text: The command-line tool was updated to a newer version as part of its regular release schedule. This change only affects the tool's internal packaging metadata and does not add any new features or visible changes for users.

a4a5d3588601a5033f963ce4c1e62debf6a2e3f4.text: The product's internal version number increased. This update does not change how the product works or what it can do for you.

147d55f17173896e1e3dd6660953bdf2d56000ba.text: The command-line tool's internal version number was updated. This change is for developers and does not affect how you use the software.

6920f0c320e4b111d0ce67baba12dd11581f64ec.text: The product's internal version number was updated. This change has no visible effect for regular users.

4222c1a8c8e2ba9824b53e428b595c4969fb8229.text: The app's internal label changed. Nothing new for you yet.

df78052cf2742f7de888239806a358a80f6f6738.text: A routine update was released for the command-line tool. Nothing changed in how the tool works.

511d68cee61c813e39b673c71b67da324ad9afed.title: Reduce buffer size in process-stream.ts
511d68cee61c813e39b673c71b67da324ad9afed.summary: Decreased `bufferSize` from 250 to 50 in `backend/src/process-stream.ts`. This change affects the streaming tag processing logic. The smaller buffer size is intended for demo purposes.

0cf519228ac6c030e31d3a0537f3830a0af0710d.title: Update CLI menu prompt examples
0cf519228ac6c030e31d3a0537f3830a0af0710d.summary: Replaced 'Refactor a large file into smaller files' with 'Refactor a component into multiple components' in the CLI menu examples. Adjusts suggested prompts to better align with component-based refactoring patterns. Change applies only to npm-app/src/menu.ts.

724fd998785430febc6f24a7b1decbd24a9d462d.title: Stop duplicating previous changes in websocket responses
724fd998785430febc6f24a7b1decbd24a9d462d.summary: Removed concatenation of `previousChanges` and `changes` in `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`. `previousChanges` were being applied twice during user input processing. Responses now send only the current `changes` array for both `toolCall` and `response-complete` actions.

b3c4509650d8eeb93e9d35843febb2cb46eed4c7.title: Increase stream buffer size in process-stream.ts
b3c4509650d8eeb93e9d35843febb2cb46eed4c7.summary: Bumped `bufferSize` constant from 50 to 150 in `backend/src/process-stream.ts`. This change expands the internal string accumulation limit for stream processing, likely to accommodate larger chunks or reduce frequent flushing. Affects tag processing and attribute parsing within the backend stream handler.

37e52b627435c37225417f54e78b3b03afd3c912.title: Disable middleware for websocket init action
37e52b627435c37225417f54e78b3b03afd3c912.summary: Removed `protec.run` wrapper from `subscribeToAction('init', ...)` in `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`. The `onInit` handler now executes without authentication middleware. This change prevents middleware interference during the initial websocket handshake.

982cb5a21e70e009d775d118c37cf1862f728b39.title: Fix db migration snapshot default expressions
982cb5a21e70e009d775d118c37cf1862f728b39.summary: Corrected timestamp column default expressions in `common/src/db/migrations/meta/0003_snapshot.json` by removing invalid `SELECT` prefixes from `now() + INTERVAL '1 month'`. Drizzle Kit snapshots expect raw SQL expressions, not query statements, causing metadata validation mismatches. Affects shared core database migration metadata only.

9ba7a7b550434c4407f6eefafb53347dba53cf37.title: URL scraping moves from client to CLI
9ba7a7b550434c4407f6eefafb53347dba53cf37.summary: URL scraping logic relocated from `npm-app/src/client.ts` to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Previously, `Client` mutated the last user message with scraped content before sending. Now, `CLI` parses URLs from `userInput` and prepends scraped blocks to the message content before storage. This ensures scraping occurs on raw user input rather than potentially edited or stored message states.

a9b4dafb599fa3a076a9ad4961c0d604172d04e4.title: Add optional initial prompt arg to manicode CLI
a9b4dafb599fa3a076a9ad4961c0d604172d04e4.summary: Manicode CLI now accepts a second argument, `[initial-prompt]`, which is immediately processed as the first user input upon startup. `printInitialPrompt` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` writes the provided string to stdout and triggers `handleUserInput`, bypassing the interactive prompt wait. The entry logic in `npm-app/src/index.ts` parses `process.argv.slice(3)` and updates the help text to reflect the new optional parameter.

de75f4e6a81dbb638c89ae575e8afec8f2f37d5a.title: Init action now fingerprint-protected
de75f4e6a81dbb638c89ae575e8afec8f2f37d5a.summary: WebSocket middleware inserts missing fingerprints via onConflictDoNothing before quota checks. Init action now runs through protec.run, enforcing fingerprint validation. New error action type added to SERVER_ACTION_SCHEMA to relay middleware halts to clients. Covers backend/src/websockets/middleware.ts, backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts, common/src/actions.ts.

f0ea9490c29d6691ba8bf669a849f2f7322788c8.title: Implement API limits for anon, free, and paid users
f0ea9490c29d6691ba8bf669a849f2f7322788c8.summary: New `QuotaManager` and `MessageCostTracker` enforce tiered usage limits (1k anon, 2.5k free, 50k paid) via `common/src/constants.ts`. `message-cost-tracker.ts` calculates credits using model-specific token rates plus 20% profit margin, replacing legacy `billing/message.ts`. Integration touches `authentication.knowledge.md` for session quota application and `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx` for UI updates.

a9b4dafb599fa3a076a9ad4961c0d604172d04e4.text: You can now type a question or command directly when starting the tool. It will process that text immediately, so you don't need to wait for the screen to load before typing.

511d68cee61c813e39b673c71b67da324ad9afed.text: The system now holds less temporary data while processing live text. This adjustment is meant for demonstrations and has little effect on everyday use.

f0ea9490c29d6691ba8bf669a849f2f7322788c8.text: The system now tracks how much you use it and stops requests when you hit your plan's limit. Free users get less than paid users, and anonymous users get the least.

9ba7a7b550434c4407f6eefafb53347dba53cf37.text: The assistant now reads links from the message you type, instead of the saved version. This ensures it sees your original text even if the message is edited later.

724fd998785430febc6f24a7b1decbd24a9d462d.text: A small internal fix stopped the system from repeating old updates when sending new ones. Users now see only the latest changes.
