b3c4509650d8eeb93e9d35843febb2cb46eed4c7.text: The system now handles larger chunks of text at once. This makes stream processing more efficient.

37e52b627435c37225417f54e78b3b03afd3c912.text: The system now skips a security check during the first step of connecting. This fixes a bug that stopped some users from starting a session.

de75f4e6a81dbb638c89ae575e8afec8f2f37d5a.text: The system now checks a digital fingerprint before allowing certain actions. This stops unauthorized use and protects your account limits.

0cf519228ac6c030e31d3a0537f3830a0af0710d.text: The assistant now suggests breaking down parts of your project into smaller pieces instead of just splitting large files. This change updates the example prompts you see in the menu.

982cb5a21e70e009d775d118c37cf1862f728b39.text: The system fixed a small internal error in how it saves dates. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

c1a6afbe729a1dc133b8979f2f995775ff79241a.title: Upgrade openai to 4.67.1 and enable store flag
c1a6afbe729a1dc133b8979f2f995775ff79241a.summary: Upgrades `openai` package from `^4.56.0` to `^4.67.1` in `backend/package.json`. Adds `store: true` to the `chat.completions.create` payload in `backend/src/openai-api.ts` to persist generated completions server-side. Changes affect backend API integration and dependency lockfiles.

c5c62f922dad7f963ecad0de4fab769c1f3bbd58.title: Fix deploy:npm-app script to use cd npm-app && npm publish
c5c62f922dad7f963ecad0de4fab769c1f3bbd58.summary: Updated `deploy:npm-app` script in `package.json`. Replaced `bun --cwd npm publish` with `cd npm-app && npm publish`. Ensures correct directory context and npm binary usage for publishing.

35884b7b561c34e2784872abdabdff17f4540cfe.title: Gate knowledge file generation on existing files
35884b7b561c34e2784872abdabdff17f4540cfe.summary: mainPrompt.ts adds a `hasKnowledgeFiles` check before spawning `generateKnowledgeFiles`. This prevents the system from attempting to create knowledge files in projects that don't already have them, aligning with the rule to only generate changes for existing files.

7fbf7670167134f3fea31af8fb19a5ed98acd5df.title: main-prompt distinguishes Creating from Editing
7fbf7670167134f3fea31af8fb19a5ed98acd5df.summary: main-prompt.ts now checks file existence via requestFile before formatting the status line, outputting Creating for new files and Editing for existing ones. This replaces the previous hardcoded Editing label. Scope: backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Mechanism relies on requestFile returning null for missing files to determine isNewFile.

311c427fce7296d68921d2f47107ec1855e122ff.title: Redo CLI help menu
311c427fce7296d68921d2f47107ec1855e122ff.summary: The CLI help menu in npm-app/src/menu.ts was redone to improve clarity and reduce noise. The initial prompt in npm-app/src/cli.ts had its emoji removed. The help text now separates 'ASK MANICODE TO...' examples from 'COMMANDS', and the 'Welcome' message was simplified.

c409707321172e20165a3a6116c0b53ad8c1beec.title: Add usage tracking and billing infrastructure
c409707321172e20165a3a6116c0b53ad8c1beec.summary: Implemented initial usage tracking via new `fingerprint` and `message` DB tables in `backend/src/billing/message.ts` and migrations `0002`/`0003`. The system now calculates costs per model (Sonnet, Haiku, GPT-4o) using defined token prices and a 20% profit margin, storing detailed request/response metadata and quota states. Authentication flows were updated to store `fingerprintId` and hashes in session rows, with CLI polling for credentials instead of direct backend pushes. This change introduces core billing logic to `common/src/db/schema` and updates `backend/src/claude.ts` to pass session context for accurate cost attribution.

be23e161a7b41337d25b2fac5314d461036fda05.title: Remove assistant change appendix from main-prompt
be23e161a7b41337d25b2fac5314d461036fda05.summary: Removes `<edits_made_by_assistant>` appendix and `createFileBlock` import in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Prevents bugs triggered by the appended edit context. Response now returns only the trimmed `fullResponse`.

a61a6eb25a2dd6f238acb75f5d729ef61eb4efc9.title: System prompt: remove git operations, add git commit/rebase guardrail
a61a6eb25a2dd6f238acb75f5d729ef61eb4efc9.summary: Removes 'Performing git operations' from the allowed `run_terminal_command` use cases in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Adds explicit constraint: 'Don't run git commit or git rebase or related commands unless you get explicit permission from the user.' Fixes duplicate numbering in guidelines list.

a889ebf02c82ddb0a0ad88839b56503c9d048196.title: Include shell config files in project context
a889ebf02c82ddb0a0ad88839b56503c9d048196.summary: Adds user shell configuration files to the AI context window. `common/src/util/file.ts` extends `ProjectFileContextSchema` with `shellConfigFiles`. `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` implements `loadShellConfigFiles` to read standard dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `.zshrc`, etc.) from the home directory, filtering missing files. `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` injects these contents into the prompt via a new `<user_shell_config_files>` block.

02bdf194609c3974a27ea19a265700bece9163e2.title: Add add and hey to skipped terminal commands
02bdf194609c3974a27ea19a265700bece9163e2.summary: Added 'add' and 'hey' to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts. Updated CLI logic in npm-app/src/cli.ts to bypass command parsing if input contains 'error '. This prevents specific short inputs from being incorrectly processed as terminal commands.

7fbf7670167134f3fea31af8fb19a5ed98acd5df.text: The assistant now correctly labels its action as either creating a new file or editing an existing one. This makes the status messages more accurate.

be23e161a7b41337d25b2fac5314d461036fda05.text: The assistant stopped adding a hidden list of its own changes to the end of its replies. This fixes a bug that sometimes confused the assistant. For you, the responses are now cleaner and more reliable.

35884b7b561c34e2784872abdabdff17f4540cfe.text: The assistant now checks for existing files before trying to create new ones. This prevents errors when working on projects that do not have those files yet.

311c427fce7296d68921d2f47107ec1855e122ff.text: The help menu was cleaned up to be easier to read. The welcome message is now simpler and less cluttered.

a889ebf02c82ddb0a0ad88839b56503c9d048196.text: The assistant can now read your basic computer settings. This helps it give advice that fits your specific setup.

c1a6afbe729a1dc133b8979f2f995775ff79241a.text: The system now saves generated responses on the server. This helps keep a record of what the assistant said.

c409707321172e20165a3a6116c0b53ad8c1beec.text: The system now tracks usage and calculates costs. This enables accurate billing and quota management for users.

a61a6eb25a2dd6f238acb75f5d729ef61eb4efc9.text: The assistant now requires your explicit permission before saving or rewriting project history. This prevents it from making permanent changes to your files without asking first.

02bdf194609c3974a27ea19a265700bece9163e2.text: The assistant now ignores short inputs like 'add' or 'hey' that it previously mistook for system instructions. This prevents errors when you type these common words during normal conversation.

c5c62f922dad7f963ecad0de4fab769c1f3bbd58.text: We fixed a small internal issue that stopped us from publishing a tool to the public marketplace. This change helps us release updates more smoothly.

9e9123c9c35a23cdcbc35cebfcad617df69a9d00.title: Filter large low-priority files in prompt context
9e9123c9c35a23cdcbc35cebfcad617df69a9d00.summary: updateFileContext in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now filters loaded files before building prompt context. Files ranked beyond the top 5 are excluded if countTokens exceeds 5,000. This prevents oversized, low-priority files from consuming the context window.

750792c767609146a22c1f40c9ce6f33a61213ea.title: Remove manicode intro console logs
750792c767609146a22c1f40c9ce6f33a61213ea.summary: Deleted three `console.log` statements from `npm-app/src/index.ts`. Removes verbose initialization output before `cli.printInitialPrompt()`.

e02cb2c8cdf9734275e22935905d8396afe0a2b6.title: Unify project root and working directory in CLI
e02cb2c8cdf9734275e22935905d8396afe0a2b6.summary: Project root is now the current directory. `setProjectRoot` replaces `initProjectRoot` and prints a green message when the directory changes. `getCurrentWorkingDirectory` and `setCurrentWorkingDirectory` are removed in favor of `getProjectRoot`. Terminal commands and file contexts use `getProjectRoot` directly.

d213792a89fde8df257d192a0c03dcd4afd7ce83.title: Truncate git changes, bump file tree budget to 80k
d213792a89fde8df257d192a0c03dcd4afd7ce83.summary: Adds `truncateString` and `countTokensJson` to prevent oversized prompts. `getGitChangesPrompt` now truncates diffs and status to 30k chars (10% for status/commits). `getProjectFileTreePrompt` budget increases from 60k to 80k tokens. Token counting shifts to JSON-stringified length for accuracy.

ae02ee8ff41b5f74cf4bb7fbb6375c0fd6a899a7.title: Move file changes status message to backend main-prompt
ae02ee8ff41b5f74cf4bb7fbb6375c0fd6a899a7.summary: Moved 'Applying file changes. Please wait...' from client.ts to backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Backend emits via onResponseChunk when fileProcessingPromises.length > 0. Client.ts removes STOP_MARKER and '- Editing file: ' string-matching hack. CLI prints 'Complete!' after file list, and index.ts adds three init console.logs.

52011e941a82a3c3cfe0b0b5709b6c0e48276b3e.title: Add index file patch test case
52011e941a82a3c3cfe0b0b5709b6c0e48276b3e.summary: Added test case 'should handle index file with placeholder at end' to `test/__src__/generate-patch.test.ts`. Includes mock data files (`expected.ts`, `new.ts`, `old.ts`) in `test/__mock-data__/index/` covering CLI entrypoint structure with `require.main` guard and `--help` handling. Test marked with `it.only` for focused execution.

3d17d0bf8290054e72b266dbd5fc684f8ab67e3b.title: /run prefix added to CLI terminal command detection
3d17d0bf8290054e72b266dbd5fc684f8ab67e3b.summary: CLI now recognizes `/run <command>` prefix for terminal execution. Detection logic allows up to 5 tokens (previously <4) without prefix. Menu help text updated to document `/run` usage. Internal change in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/menu.ts`.

3d1a187e92fa77daf5b14912902ad5fd5c951ff0.title: Rename file XML tags to editfile across prompts and parser
3d1a187e92fa77daf5b14912902ad5fd5c951ff0.summary: The agent's file-editing XML tag changed from `<file>` to `<edit_file>` in all system prompts, diff-generation instructions, and the shared parser. This disambiguates edit blocks from other file references and aligns the CLI client's completion detection with the new tag. Updates span `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`, `main-prompt.ts`, `generate-diffs-prompt.ts`, `generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts`, `generate-knowledge-files.ts`, `common/src/util/file.ts`, and `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The regex patterns `fileRegex` and `fileWithNoPathRegex` now match `<edit_file ...>` instead of `<file ...>`, and the CLI waits for `- Editing file:` before announcing change application.

d423ddda29da8d609f43bfa616b9c3677ab9069d.title: Web: replace email signup with Manicode npm link
d423ddda29da8d609f43bfa616b9c3677ab9069d.summary: Home page email input and submit button removed from `web/src/app/page.tsx`, replaced by direct link to `manicode` npm package. Footer gains Airtable form link in `web/src/components/footer.tsx`. Navbar Features/Pricing/Docs anchors commented out in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`.

7882259039863d3e678a72bf45a534f421b2d9ae.title: Terminal command detection threshold lowered to 3 words
7882259039863d3e678a72bf45a534f421b2d9ae.summary: Reduced word count limit for automatic terminal command detection from 5 to 3 in npm-app/src/cli.ts. This change aims to reduce false positives where natural language inputs are incorrectly parsed as commands. The logic still respects SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS and the 'run' prefix.

d213792a89fde8df257d192a0c03dcd4afd7ce83.text: The system now limits how much code history it reads to keep requests manageable. It also allows a slightly larger view of your project's file structure. These adjustments help the assistant process your work more efficiently.

d423ddda29da8d609f43bfa616b9c3677ab9069d.text: The website no longer collects emails for signups. Instead, it directs users to a new installation link, and some navigation menu items were hidden.

9e9123c9c35a23cdcbc35cebfcad617df69a9d00.text: The assistant now skips large, less important files when preparing its response. This keeps conversations focused and prevents the system from getting overwhelmed by unnecessary information.

e02cb2c8cdf9734275e22935905d8396afe0a2b6.text: The assistant now treats the current folder as the single source for all files. This simplifies how it finds your work.

3d17d0bf8290054e72b266dbd5fc684f8ab67e3b.text: The app now recognizes a new command to open a terminal window. This is a small internal update that does not change how you use the main features.

750792c767609146a22c1f40c9ce6f33a61213ea.text: The tool stopped printing extra setup messages when it starts. This keeps the screen cleaner.

7882259039863d3e678a72bf45a534f421b2d9ae.text: The assistant now needs at least three words to recognize a command. Shorter phrases are treated as normal conversation to avoid mistakes.

ae02ee8ff41b5f74cf4bb7fbb6375c0fd6a899a7.text: The assistant now sends a 'Please wait' message directly to the user interface when it is editing files. This removes a workaround that previously caused confusing text to appear on the screen.

52011e941a82a3c3cfe0b0b5709b6c0e48276b3e.text: A small internal update adds a check to ensure the software correctly handles a specific file structure. This change does not affect how you use the product.

062d3bbb0093d619576b2a8444c91454e8b4999b.title: Update feedback email address in README
062d3bbb0093d619576b2a8444c91454e8b4999b.summary: Corrects the feedback email address in `npm-app/README.md` from `james@manifold.markets` to `james@manicode.ai`. This change aligns the documentation with the current Manicode domain. Scope is limited to the npm-app package README.

af42ba6fddd1964b1355b73d830828792fdd6c07.title: Fix null handling in main-prompt test
af42ba6fddd1964b1355b73d830828792fdd6c07.summary: Updated `processFileBlock` test to explicitly check for null results before destructuring. Prevents TypeScript errors and clarifies test intent. Scope limited to `test/__src__/main-prompt.test.ts`.

7015281c3cd27267275e3ad8c3ba9f8619e93a3d.title: Suppress websocket connection logs
7015281c3cd27267275e3ad8c3ba9f8619e93a3d.summary: Comments out console.log statements for WS client connected and disconnected events in backend/src/websockets/server.ts. Reduces noise in server logs during frequent connection cycles. No change to connection handling logic or SWITCHBOARD integration.

487692dc90b49b2eaa365b8d35a77f81252825df.title: generateKnowledgeFiles reuses search system prompt for caching
487692dc90b49b2eaa365b8d35a77f81252825df.summary: generateKnowledgeFiles now calls getSearchSystemPrompt(fileContext) instead of manually composing getProjectFileTreePrompt and getRelevantFilesPrompt. The returned array is spread into the systemPrompt before appending the knowledgeFilesPrompt text block, aligning the prompt structure with the search agent. This change in backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts enables upstream prompt caching by matching the prefix used elsewhere. The fileContext data is injected via the shared search prompt builder rather than inline string interpolation.

8e247ecaa0a0d587f313eab5cc6ab53be3a18dec.title: updateManicode skips local dev
8e247ecaa0a0d587f313eab5cc6ab53be3a18dec.summary: updateManicode now early-returns when `isProduction` is false. Prevents npm version checks and updates in local dev. Internal change in `npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts`.

1dd3fa95a71f8fa2156f1e8cc507049acfdbec35.title: Ignore minified files in project file tree
1dd3fa95a71f8fa2156f1e8cc507049acfdbec35.summary: Adds `*.min.*` to default ignore list in `getProjectFileTree` within `common/src/project-file-tree.ts`. Reduces noise by excluding minified assets from file tree traversal and indexing. Refactors `getLastReadFilePaths` signature for multi-line parameter formatting.

1e75915c45f7a0704bef650b2697ec3a206e4467.title: Inject recently read files into system prompt
1e75915c45f7a0704bef650b2697ec3a206e4467.summary: System prompt now includes top 20 recently read file paths based on OS atime. FileTreeNode schema extended with filePath and lastReadTime. getProjectFileTree in common/src/project-file-tree.ts captures atimeMs during traversal. Backend system-prompt.ts renders these paths in a new <recently_read_file_paths_most_recent_first> block to provide context.

603b1250745ae26f6cdf68e8fb64d1d93e4cb220.title: Add placeholder comments to incomplete sketches in generate-patch
603b1250745ae26f6cdf68e8fb64d1d93e4cb220.summary: generatePatch now wraps incomplete sketches with `... existing code ...` placeholders when `shouldAddPlaceholderComments` is true. This prevents unintended deletions when Claude omits surrounding context in single-function edits. Changes affect `backend/src/generate-patch.ts` logic and `isSketchCompletePrompt` return structure.

af4c1ae2a9c6c51b83636a9a8cdb2c647f2061a6.title: Exclude tool results from last user message index
af4c1ae2a9c6c51b83636a9a8cdb2c647f2061a6.summary: Fixes `lastUserMessageIndex` calculation in `main-prompt.ts` by filtering out messages containing `TOOL_RESULT_MARKER`. Previously, tool result messages (which have role 'user') were incorrectly identified as the last real user input, skewing `numAssistantMessages` counts and potentially affecting terminal call limits. This ensures the index points to the actual human prompt, not the agent's tool feedback loop.

cb6b625beb5195bce2988325c81047a4223bbf27.title: Expand system prompt with tool call guidance and use cases
cb6b625beb5195bce2988325c81047a4223bbf27.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated to include explicit tool call syntax, purposes, and use cases for find_files and run_terminal_command. New manifold submodule added. This clarifies agent behavior for file discovery and terminal execution.

7015281c3cd27267275e3ad8c3ba9f8619e93a3d.text: The system now hides routine messages about connections starting and stopping in the background logs. This reduces clutter for support teams but changes nothing for users.

062d3bbb0093d619576b2a8444c91454e8b4999b.text: The support email address shown in the app's help guide was updated to the correct new address. This small fix ensures users can reach the right team for feedback.

af42ba6fddd1964b1355b73d830828792fdd6c07.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system checks for missing data in one test.

603b1250745ae26f6cdf68e8fb64d1d93e4cb220.text: The system now adds a visual marker to show which parts of the code were not changed. This prevents the tool from accidentally removing existing work when it only updates a small section.

cb6b625beb5195bce2988325c81047a4223bbf27.text: The assistant learned better rules for finding files and running commands. This helps it understand tasks more accurately. No visible changes to the product.

487692dc90b49b2eaa365b8d35a77f81252825df.text: The system now reuses a standard text template to prepare information. This small internal update helps the computer remember previous work, making responses faster.

8e247ecaa0a0d587f313eab5cc6ab53be3a18dec.text: A small internal update stops the system from checking for new versions while developers work locally. This change has no impact on how you use the product.

1dd3fa95a71f8fa2156f1e8cc507049acfdbec35.text: The list of files shown to the assistant now skips small, unreadable code files. This helps the assistant focus on your actual project files.

1e75915c45f7a0704bef650b2697ec3a206e4467.text: The assistant now sees a list of files you recently opened. This helps it understand your current work context without you having to explain it.

f3a40a02a39f2b5b86ded617043916b38cc645be.title: Refine knowledge generation prompt and tests
f3a40a02a39f2b5b86ded617043916b38cc645be.summary: Adjusted knowledge generation prompt in backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts to prioritize user expectation mismatches over code clarity, and added instructions for preserving existing file content during updates. Updated test mock data in test/__mock-data__/knowledge-files to reflect new tool call formats and expected file changes. Renamed test script in test/package.json from test-generate-knowledge to test-knowledge.

b8948ba46d8e1b1a846112cfff0bf2f3eaf54b14.title: Add npm view fallback for manicode version check
b8948ba46d8e1b1a846112cfff0bf2f3eaf54b14.summary: The `getManicodeNpmVersion` function in `npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts` now attempts to fetch the latest version via `npm view manicode version` before falling back to web scraping. This change improves reliability by using the native npm CLI, which is faster and less prone to scraping failures than parsing the npmjs.com HTML. The implementation includes a regex match for semantic versioning and silently catches errors to trigger the existing `scrapeWebPage` fallback if the command fails.

30c758cd8e1ae29522bd0c069ed428fa54c42586.title: Add start-dir script and refine CLI welcome message
30c758cd8e1ae29522bd0c069ed428fa54c42586.summary: Added `start-dir` npm script in `npm-app/package.json` to run `ts-node src/index.ts` with environment variables. Updated `printInitialPrompt` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to conditionally display a personalized welcome message with an emoji and prompt, or a generic prompt if no user is detected. This improves local development startup options and refines the CLI's initial interaction flow.

44db2b765f106bae76c677ff4d6b2ee2335b01dd.title: Update menu tips and feedback email
44db2b765f106bae76c677ff4d6b2ee2335b01dd.summary: Updated CLI menu tips in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to include new usage patterns like refactoring and test fixing. Reordered help commands for better visibility. Changed feedback email address to `james@manicode.ai`.

a23ac9df33c00f92cf5bc50b4212fa160ccc5ed6.title: Add env var validation to npm-app build
a23ac9df33c00f92cf5bc50b4212fa160ccc5ed6.summary: Added missing environment variable checks in `npm-app/loadEnv.js` before build completion. Validation ensures `APP_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` are present and non-empty. Scope limited to npm-app build tooling.

7c6ef69a37cbf607682679ed7c19ce0ff33997cd.title: Refactor stream handling in backend/src/main-prompt.ts
7c6ef69a37cbf607682679ed7c19ce0ff33997cd.summary: Refactors streaming logic in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to separate raw accumulation from display processing. Introduces `printedChunk` to handle `<file>` tag stripping and formatting before user display, while `fullResponse` retains raw content. Updates `onTagStart` and `onTagEnd` handlers to emit and close `<file>` tags correctly. This internal change ensures file editing status messages display cleanly without leaking raw XML tags to the UI.

1919ba5957042d59a9b187b293fa11be882fee94.title: debugLog adds DEBUG prefix to console output
1919ba5957042d59a9b187b293fa11be882fee94.summary: backend/src/util/debug.ts debugLog now calls console.log('[DEBUG]', ...args) before writing to debug.log. File logging behavior unchanged: ISO timestamp prefix, JSON.stringify for objects, appendFileSync. No user-facing change; internal debug tooling only.

1033372807349c8e71c8a5fea54d12a2e7760580.title: Fix tool call parsing and stream termination
1033372807349c8e71c8a5fea54d12a2e7760580.summary: Corrected tool call parsing in `main-prompt.ts` by wrapping content in `<tool_call>` tags and deferring `isComplete` flag assignment. Updated `process-stream.ts` to return an object with `isComplete` status, allowing the stream generator to terminate early upon detecting a complete tag. Adjusted `tool-handlers.ts` console output for terminal commands to include a newline.

e7bf5dedf3b0ded8a502e30b5b8cb18be6d7776e.title: Fix DOTENVPATH logic in common/src/db/env.mjs
e7bf5dedf3b0ded8a502e30b5b8cb18be6d7776e.summary: Inverted ternary operator logic in common/src/db/env.mjs corrected to ensure DOTENV_PATH resolves to '/etc/secrets' when RENDER environment variable is true, defaulting to '..' otherwise. This fixes path resolution for environment configuration files on Render deployments. Change scoped to core database environment loading.

2f64ead5948cd33b095aaf39edff7eb9de28698e.title: Fix applyPatch context match and backslash filter
2f64ead5948cd33b095aaf39edff7eb9de28698e.summary: applyPatch in common/src/util/patch.ts now filters lines starting with backslash and uses inclusive loop bounds in findContextMatch and findContextMatchTrimmed. This prevents patch application failures when context lines appear at the end of files or contain backslash escapes. Tests added in test/__src__/patch.test.ts with mock data in test/__mock-data__/inbox-screen/.

2f64ead5948cd33b095aaf39edff7eb9de28698e.text: Fixed a bug where updates failed if text lines started with a slash or were at the end of a file. This makes applying changes more reliable for users.

30c758cd8e1ae29522bd0c069ed428fa54c42586.text: The tool now shows a friendly greeting with your name when it starts. If your name is missing, it shows a simple message instead.

7c6ef69a37cbf607682679ed7c19ce0ff33997cd.text: The system now hides technical file-editing markers from the screen. Users see clean status messages instead of confusing code symbols.

1919ba5957042d59a9b187b293fa11be882fee94.text: A small internal update makes debugging messages easier to read for the team. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

a23ac9df33c00f92cf5bc50b4212fa160ccc5ed6.text: A small internal update checks that required settings are correct before the app builds. This prevents the app from starting with missing information, ensuring it runs properly for users.

44db2b765f106bae76c677ff4d6b2ee2335b01dd.text: The menu now shows clearer tips for common tasks like fixing tests and reorganizing code. Help options were reordered to make them easier to find, and the support email address was updated.

e7bf5dedf3b0ded8a502e30b5b8cb18be6d7776e.text: Fixed a mistake that stopped the app from finding its secret settings on certain servers. This change is small and internal, so you will not see any new features.

4cf5b36e27ee4e7b13e94506e4fa7df37439e244.title: Bump manicode to 1.0.70
4cf5b36e27ee4e7b13e94506e4fa7df37439e244.summary: Version bump in npm-app/package.json from 1.0.69 to 1.0.70. No functional changes. Internal package metadata update.

edebdcd2b2a8209e47de4d799d1dc895039d99a8.title: env loader switches path resolution from ENVIRONMENT to RENDER
edebdcd2b2a8209e47de4d799d1dc895039d99a8.summary: backend, common, and web env loaders now resolve DOTENV_PATH using process.env.RENDER === 'true' instead of checking ENVIRONMENT === 'local'. This decouples file location logic from the environment name, allowing local-style relative paths on Render regardless of the ENVIRONMENT value. Affects backend/src/env.mjs, common/src/db/env.mjs, and web/src/env.mjs. Non-Render deployments continue reading secrets from /etc/secrets.

bf5126fbe07a44ac5e3c2e36f15d750fee80ef7c.title: Flip DOTENVPATH ternary for RENDER check
bf5126fbe07a44ac5e3c2e36f15d750fee80ef7c.summary: Inverted the ternary logic for `DOTENV_PATH` in `backend/src/env.mjs` and `web/src/env.mjs`. When `process.env.RENDER === 'true'`, the path now resolves to `/etc/secrets` instead of `..`. This ensures secrets are loaded from the correct absolute path on Render deployments.

0741ec583056162f9a64d7ff0393fe58058b21ab.title: Fix process-stream regex state
0741ec583056162f9a64d7ff0393fe58058b21ab.summary: Removed global flag from openTagRegex and closeTagRegex in backend/src/process-stream.ts. Switched from regex.exec to string.match to prevent lastIndex state corruption during tag parsing. Added guard for undefined match.index. Internal refactor, no user-facing behavior change.

0fbcd881c6a38f09658a71033ea07c5f1c2748a6.title: Buffered streaming and typed tag callbacks
0fbcd881c6a38f09658a71033ea07c5f1c2748a6.summary: Refactored `processStreamWithTags` to use a fixed 250-byte buffer, yielding content only when the buffer exceeds this threshold or at stream end. Updated `onTagStart` callbacks in `main-prompt.ts` to return strings instead of `void`, allowing direct yield of status messages like 'Editing file: {path}'. Removed side-effectful `onResponseChunk` calls from tag processing, consolidating response accumulation into `fullResponse`. Deleted unused `tmp-graph.ts` mock data file.

ebd94d1f47e0f60716c7870b127c7553b465281d.title: Improve installer detection and exit after update
ebd94d1f47e0f60716c7870b127c7553b465281d.summary: update-manicode.ts now exits process after successful update. detectInstaller() refined to check specific paths (.yarn, .pnpm, .bun, node_modules) and returns undefined if unknown, triggering manual update prompt. index.ts awaits readyPromise before CLI init, parallelizing file context.

8a1b30b651eb64c1d661a51db93cd339e895f109.title: Add CLI login flow
8a1b30b651eb64c1d661a51db93cd339e895f109.summary: Introduced WebSocket-based authentication for CLI using one-time auth codes linked via `fingerprintId`. Backend generates hashed tokens with 5-minute expiry; `session` table now stores `fingerprintId` and `fingerprintHash`. New `login-code-request` and `login-status-request` actions handle credential exchange. Requires `APP_URL` and `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` env vars.

16e9952360cc28c2219d8a130db5581b6c2d076d.title: CLI Login Auth Code Flow
16e9952360cc28c2219d8a130db5581b6c2d076d.summary: Implements one-time auth code generation and validation for CLI login via `login-code-request` and `login-status-request` WebSocket actions. Backend verifies hash using `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` and links `fingerprintId` to user sessions. Adds `fingerprintId` and `fingerprintHash` columns to `session` table with new migration. Scope includes `common/src/actions.ts`, `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`, and `common/src/db/migrations`.

bbe93e4bd866ffdd12913862a5445943d85e2a74.title: Add generate patch test for process-stream
bbe93e4bd866ffdd12913862a5445943d85e2a74.summary: Added a test case for `generatePatch` using `process-stream` mock data. The test validates patch generation by comparing `old.ts` and `new.ts` against `expected.ts`. Mock data files include specific `processStreamWithTags` implementations to exercise the patching logic.

92334a746484a4e10f1626df1a0b36e664295bb6.title: Revert CLI login auth flow
92334a746484a4e10f1626df1a0b36e664295bb6.summary: Reverts the CLI login feature, removing WebSocket `login-code-request`, `login-status-request`, and `clear-auth-token` handlers from `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`. Deletes associated auth logic, `fingerprintId`/`fingerprintHash` session columns, and migration `0001_fuzzy_typhoid_mary.sql`. Updates `common/src/actions.ts` to exclude login-related client/server actions and removes `APP_URL`/`NEXTAUTH_SECRET` from backend env validation.

4cf5b36e27ee4e7b13e94506e4fa7df37439e244.text: We updated internal system labels to keep everything organized. You will not notice any difference.

bf5126fbe07a44ac5e3c2e36f15d750fee80ef7c.text: A small internal update fixed how the system finds its secret passwords when running on Render. This ensures the service loads the correct credentials from the right place.

0741ec583056162f9a64d7ff0393fe58058b21ab.text: The program now finds hidden markers in text more reliably. Nothing changes for you.

16e9952360cc28c2219d8a130db5581b6c2d076d.text: You can now log in to command-line tools by entering a short, one-time code displayed on your screen. This method links your login session to your specific device for better security.

ebd94d1f47e0f60716c7870b127c7553b465281d.text: The software now detects your setup better to avoid errors, and closes automatically after updates finish. This small internal change makes the tool more reliable and less confusing.

bbe93e4bd866ffdd12913862a5445943d85e2a74.text: The team added an internal check to ensure a new data processing feature works correctly. This update does not change how the product looks or feels for users.

8a1b30b651eb64c1d661a51db93cd339e895f109.text: You can now sign in to the command-line tool by opening a link in your browser. This keeps your account secure because the login code expires quickly.

8463c9b1b24463cf01d4f77e78bce6b593ed850d.title: Suppress deadConnectionCleaner errors
8463c9b1b24463cf01d4f77e78bce6b593ed850d.summary: Commented out `console.error` in `deadConnectionCleaner` catch block in `backend/src/websockets/server.ts`. Prevents noisy logs during client termination errors. Refactored `SWITCHBOARD.getClient(ws)` into a local `client` variable for readability.

2c6f16d0f484eee151bbfed00d77dd3be3f4d9fc.title: update-manicode error log drops stack trace
2c6f16d0f484eee151bbfed00d77dd3be3f4d9fc.summary: updateManicode error handler in npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts now logs static string 'Failed to update Manicode.' instead of concatenating error object. Removes stack trace and error message details from console output. Scope limited to single catch block in update flow.

b0034f122ec20d275ca0207ffca811bacedca698.title: detectInstaller uses which manicode
b0034f122ec20d275ca0207ffca811bacedca698.summary: detectInstaller in npm-app/src/update-manicode.ts now resolves the binary path via `which manicode` instead of inspecting `process.execPath`. This ensures the installer detection logic checks the actual executable location rather than the Node.js runtime path. The change affects the update mechanism within the npm-app package.

1574228876c81d067cf4e025f5fd02b99625a2cb.title: Bump version to 1.0.65
1574228876c81d067cf4e025f5fd02b99625a2cb.summary: Version bumped to 1.0.65 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Routine release increment.

c78cc674b21fda605af3dbd890e00063ceb539dd.title: Log npm version check result in websocket-action.ts
c78cc674b21fda605af3dbd890e00063ceb539dd.summary: Added `console.log` in `onCheckNpmVersion` to log `clientVersion` and `latestVersion` alongside `isUpToDate` status. Provides visibility into version mismatch detection during websocket checks. Scope limited to `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`.

1957662225e21cadeedeb264f448951360602776.title: Auto-update Manicode via npm registry check
1957662225e21cadeedeb264f448951360602776.summary: Replaced backend WebSocket version check with client-side auto-update in `update-manicode.ts`. Scrape npm registry for latest version, compare semver, and run global install via detected package manager (npm/yarn/pnpm/bun). Removed `check-npm-version` and `npm-version-status` actions from `common/src/actions.ts` and `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`. `scripts/bump-version.ts` now only increments `npm-app` version.

405898a1bd09a0c4bb0e07e5e63c378a4060fdaa.title: Add colon to Manicode prompt in CLI
405898a1bd09a0c4bb0e07e5e63c378a4060fdaa.summary: The `Manicode` prompt in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now includes a trailing colon (`Manicode:`). This change affects the CLI's visual output when waiting for user input. No functional logic or user-facing behavior changes occur beyond this formatting adjustment.

f19d717189cacb8acc4eebf229fff8d919acb5e2.title: Limit file tree scan to 10k files
f19d717189cacb8acc4eebf229fff8d919acb5e2.summary: getProjectFileTree now uses breadth-first search with a maxFiles limit (default 10,000) to prevent excessive scanning. Special handling added for home directory scans (max 1000 files, ignores dotfiles). New DirectoryNode type introduced in util/file.ts for tree construction.

950bb55122c3a51a3df5b29e2d21a3e20c051552.title: Extract code-map into standalone package
950bb55122c3a51a3df5b29e2d21a3e20c051552.summary: The `common` package's `codemap` subsystem is extracted into a new `packages/code-map` package. This isolates tree-sitter dependencies and query files, removing them from `common`'s build and dependency list. The npm-app and test packages are updated to reference the new package via tsconfig paths and build scripts.

ec0d7df5d6f1192b300c268f77b768b62ab00e0e.title: Suppress END marker in stream, fix CLI spacing
ec0d7df5d6f1192b300c268f77b768b62ab00e0e.summary: Stream handler buffers chunks to strip trailing `\n[END]` before UI render, retaining marker in full response. CLI spacing cleaned: prompt gets trailing newline, exit removes `clearLine`, file change logs adjust blank lines, `Manicode:` label formatting fixed.

405898a1bd09a0c4bb0e07e5e63c378a4060fdaa.text: The text shown when waiting for input now includes a colon. This small visual change makes the prompt clearer. It does not affect how the product works.

ec0d7df5d6f1192b300c268f77b768b62ab00e0e.text: The assistant now hides a confusing end marker from your screen. Text spacing in the command-line view is also cleaner.

1957662225e21cadeedeb264f448951360602776.text: The app now checks for new versions directly and updates itself automatically.

8463c9b1b24463cf01d4f77e78bce6b593ed850d.text: We fixed a small internal issue to stop the system from recording unnecessary error messages when connections close unexpectedly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2c6f16d0f484eee151bbfed00d77dd3be3f4d9fc.text: The system now hides detailed technical error messages when a specific update fails. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

b0034f122ec20d275ca0207ffca811bacedca698.text: The app now finds the correct update tool by checking where it is actually installed on your computer, rather than guessing based on the program running it. This small internal fix helps ensure updates work more reliably.

950bb55122c3a51a3df5b29e2d21a3e20c051552.text: The software's internal organization was cleaned up to separate specific tools. This is a small technical change that does not affect how you use the product.

c78cc674b21fda605af3dbd890e00063ceb539dd.text: The system now records more detail when it checks if its tools are up to date. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

1574228876c81d067cf4e025f5fd02b99625a2cb.text: The team updated the internal software version. This is a routine housekeeping task that does not change how the product works.

f19d717189cacb8acc4eebf229fff8d919acb5e2.text: The file viewer now limits how many files it loads to prevent freezing on huge folders. This keeps the app responsive when you open directories with thousands of items.

b501a194b9dae0624a74d492bb41b8b0c6bcfba0.title: Prefer editing existing knowledge files
b501a194b9dae0624a74d492bb41b8b0c6bcfba0.summary: Updated prompt in `backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts` to instruct the model to update existing knowledge files rather than creating new ones for meaningful changes. This reduces redundancy and fragmentation in the knowledge base. The change applies to the backend knowledge generation logic.

75faaa098288028603dd2a95f6fb936723b23408.title: Rename agent Manny to Mani
75faaa098288028603dd2a95f6fb936723b23408.summary: Agent name updated from Manny to Mani across system prompt, docs, and UI. Files touched: backend/src/system-prompt.ts, knowledge.md, npm-app/knowledge.md, web/src/app/page.tsx, web/src/lib/constant.ts. Minor formatting tweaks in constant.ts and knowledge.md. Internal branding change only.

e74bee41117c1e9d96b2e3a5959b4a8165daa902.title: Update checkNewFilesNecessary prompt logic
e74bee41117c1e9d96b2e3a5959b4a8165daa902.summary: Refined `checkNewFilesNecessary` prompt in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`. Explicitly instructs model to identify files for modification or reading. Added fallback to display 'None' when `previousFiles` is empty.

99d56e0dda49a39054bff4fede7488f097bad9cb.title: Replace NodeJS.Timer with any in websocket-client.ts
99d56e0dda49a39054bff4fede7488f097bad9cb.summary: Type error in `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts` resolved by casting `OutstandingTxn.timeout`, `APIRealtimeClient.connectTimeout`, and `APIRealtimeClient.heartbeat` from `NodeJS.Timer` to `any`. The `NodeJS.Timer` type was causing compilation failures in the shared core package. Scope limited to `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`.

3ad9add1f9e9f4f48f69b4840e3f2c7300195b7d.title: Skip file context update when client used tool
3ad9add1f9e9f4f48f69b4840e3f2c7300195b7d.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts now wraps the file context update and prompt cache warming in a `!didClientUseTool(lastMessage)` check. This prevents redundant file selection steps when the last message indicates tool usage. Scope limited to backend main prompt logic. Refactors existing flow to align with tool usage state.

05dfcc10dc24307b66ac25a68583104de975a91b.title: Fix NodeJS.Timeout type error in websocket client
05dfcc10dc24307b66ac25a68583104de975a91b.summary: Reverted `NodeJS.Timeout` to `NodeJS.Timer` in `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`. Addresses type error in `OutstandingTxn`, `connectTimeout`, and `heartbeat` fields. Internal type fix for shared websocket client.

bb8fa45142b5f64ec57ffbe039e7c3ba8733b37b.title: Fix drizzle config paths and remove unused import
bb8fa45142b5f64ec57ffbe039e7c3ba8733b37b.summary: Drizzle config paths switched to relative strings. Removes `__dirname` usage in `common/src/db/drizzle.config.ts`. Fixes local error. `web/src/app/layout.tsx` drops unused `ThemeSwitcher` import.

2a27f72e60fa1fb141926d64667971fd2041eb54.title: Include project file tree in knowledge file generation prompt
2a27f72e60fa1fb141926d64667971fd2041eb54.summary: The `generateKnowledgeFiles` system prompt now injects the project file tree via `getProjectFileTreePrompt`. The previously private helper in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` was exported to allow this usage. This ensures the AI model considers the full directory structure when determining if a code change warrants a new knowledge file.

175ac5e4ea10ed0acf5e2d68099168da37f7528c.title: System prompt cleanup: punctuation and knowledge file simplification
175ac5e4ea10ed0acf5e2d68099168da37f7528c.summary: Added trailing periods to list items in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` for grammatical consistency. Simplified `knowledgeFilesPrompt` by removing the distinction between directory-level and file-specific knowledge files, replacing it with a unified definition. Scope limited to backend system prompt configuration. The change reduces prompt verbosity and potential ambiguity regarding knowledge file types.

169a24a087447e04cc889302f8535c7e730a9598.title: Remove native tool use, switch to tag-based streaming
169a24a087447e04cc889302f8535c7e730a9598.summary: Native Anthropic tool use removed from backend. promptClaudeStream now yields strings only; tool call yields commented out. processStreamWithFiles replaced by generic processStreamWithTags parsing XML-like tags with attributes. DEFAULT_TOOLS imports and tools parameters stripped from request-files-prompt, generate-knowledge-files, and main-prompt. stop_sequences: [] added to claude.ts API call.

b501a194b9dae0624a74d492bb41b8b0c6bcfba0.text: The assistant now updates existing information files instead of creating new ones. This keeps the knowledge base organized and reduces duplicate entries.

75faaa098288028603dd2a95f6fb936723b23408.text: The assistant changed its name from Manny to Mani. This update affects how the assistant introduces itself in the app and help guides.

05dfcc10dc24307b66ac25a68583104de975a91b.text: Fixed an internal error in the system's communication tool. This small update helps the app stay connected reliably.

99d56e0dda49a39054bff4fede7488f097bad9cb.text: Fixed a hidden coding error in the part of the software that keeps your connection live. This update ensures the system builds correctly, with no visible changes to how the product works for you.

2a27f72e60fa1fb141926d64667971fd2041eb54.text: The assistant can now see the full project structure to better decide if a new knowledge file is needed.

bb8fa45142b5f64ec57ffbe039e7c3ba8733b37b.text: Fixed a small internal setup error that stopped the database tool from working locally. Removed an unused feature button from the web page.

e74bee41117c1e9d96b2e3a5959b4a8165daa902.text: The assistant now better understands which files to read or change. If no files are available, it shows 'None' instead of being confusing.

3ad9add1f9e9f4f48f69b4840e3f2c7300195b7d.text: The system now stops checking for file updates when you use a tool. This saves time by avoiding unnecessary steps.

175ac5e4ea10ed0acf5e2d68099168da37f7528c.text: Small internal update. The assistant's instructions were simplified. This reduces confusion about how it uses information.

36c00fe204598485ad7c19f632fdc30de44fea55.title: Guard null relevantFiles to skip empty file-info chunks
36c00fe204598485ad7c19f632fdc30de44fea55.summary: requestRelevantFiles now returns null when no new files are necessary, replacing the previous string[] return. main-prompt.ts guards on relevantFiles !== null && length > 0 before emitting the getRelevantFileInfoMessage chunk, and updateFileContext checks relevantFiles === null alongside the length test. Covers backend prompt pipeline in main-prompt.ts and request-files-prompt.ts. Eliminates a stray newline plus empty-file-info chunk that previously reached the response stream when the file set was unchanged.

ed65d7975f641fe3555db03b8c6daa517876a5b0.title: Navbar and layout fixes in web app
ed65d7975f641fe3555db03b8c6daa517876a5b0.summary: Fixed navbar rendering and layout issues in web/src/app/layout.tsx, web/src/app/page.tsx, and web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx. Removed redundant div wrapper in navbar Link component. Added bg-black text-white to body className in layout.tsx. Removed duplicate bg-black text-white from page.tsx div. Semicolon removal in imports.

ea56afa4c417a71e869102be3a06de00ec4a9e9c.title: Skip no-op file writes in knowledge generation
ea56afa4c417a71e869102be3a06de00ec4a9e9c.summary: Added early return in `processFileBlock` when `newContent` matches `oldContent`, preventing unnecessary patch generation and file updates. Updated return types from `FileChange` to `FileChange | null` in `generate-knowledge-files.ts` and `main-prompt.ts` to reflect skipped operations. Added production logging for `generateKnowledgeFiles` inputs and default empty string handling in `generate-patch.ts`.

01b7a9284017f06caf57bcd391bc11722ec36e40.title: Reduce request-files-prompt file request counts
01b7a9284017f06caf57bcd391bc11722ec36e40.summary: Adjusts `countPerRequest` from 4 to 5 and `numNonObviousPrompts` from 3 to 1 in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` for non-assistant flows. `numKeyPrompts` also decreases from 3 to 2. These changes limit the number of file context requests generated per turn, reducing total read file calls.

a05cfb6fe95189eae4071effa32404356c159d61.title: Fix light mode styling and move theme switcher
a05cfb6fe95189eae4071effa32404356c159d61.summary: Light mode support added to web app. `layout.tsx` body class now uses `bg-white text-black` with `dark:` variants. `ThemeSwitcher` moved from absolute footer position to `navbar.tsx` flex container. Feature cards in `page.tsx` updated with explicit `text-white` headings and `text-gray-500` paragraphs for light mode contrast.

fa0f1455114d1b0b8fc4733c036b40504403125e.title: Drop cloud-sql-proxy script and docs from backend
fa0f1455114d1b0b8fc4733c036b40504403125e.summary: Removed cloud-sql-proxy setup instructions from backend/README.md and deleted the start-cloud-sql-proxy script and its dependency in the start script within backend/package.json. This simplifies local development by removing the explicit Cloud SQL Auth Proxy requirement for starting the backend. The change affects the backend package and its documentation.

135d30ff7623de37a897108855894a232e7e4dad.title: Fix applyPatch context parsing
135d30ff7623de37a897108855894a232e7e4dad.summary: Rewrote parseHunk in common/src/util/patch.ts to correctly collect context lines. Removed flawed initialContextCount logic that mishandled leading deletions. Added regression tests using delete-comment2 mock data covering import reordering and comment deletion.

3c7bb3d4dff0d30b995ac492f75842a618bedc16.title: Add Manicode label to CLI assistant responses
3c7bb3d4dff0d30b995ac492f75842a618bedc16.summary: CLI assistant responses now prefix with an underlined green 'Manicode' label. Replaced empty console.log() with process.stdout.write() using picocolors underline and green functions. Affects npm-app/src/cli.ts. Requires updated picocolors import to include underline.

0f585dfefd153fba545d3b0715fbf722d95a998c.title: Fix npm version check path and warning color
0f585dfefd153fba545d3b0715fbf722d95a998c.summary: Removed environment check in onCheckNpmVersion, forcing package.json read from ../../. Updated backend path to ../../ and client warning color to yellow. Affects backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts and npm-app/src/client.ts. Version check now always reads backend package.json regardless of environment.

5c3735a2c5cc07a9968b5d85e591a9234dc30258.title: Refine system prompt editing instructions
5c3735a2c5cc07a9968b5d85e591a9234dc30258.summary: Updated `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to clarify file modification guidelines. Replaced verbose constraints with a bulleted list emphasizing concise context, placeholder comments for imports, and avoiding unnecessary code reproduction. Added logic to recognize when requested changes already exist in fetched files.

36c00fe204598485ad7c19f632fdc30de44fea55.text: This small internal fix stops the assistant from sending blank messages when there are no new files to process. Users will see cleaner responses without extra empty lines.

ea56afa4c417a71e869102be3a06de00ec4a9e9c.text: The system now skips saving files if the content is unchanged. This reduces unnecessary processing steps.

ed65d7975f641fe3555db03b8c6daa517876a5b0.text: The top menu bar now displays correctly without extra blank spaces. The dark background color is applied consistently across the entire page.

3c7bb3d4dff0d30b995ac492f75842a618bedc16.text: The assistant now shows a green 'Manicode' label at the start of its replies. This small visual change helps you tell its answers apart from other text on the screen.

0f585dfefd153fba545d3b0715fbf722d95a998c.text: The system now always checks the correct location for its update information, regardless of how it is running. A warning message about this check also changed color to yellow. This is a small internal fix that should not change how the product works for you.

01b7a9284017f06caf57bcd391bc11722ec36e40.text: The assistant now asks for fewer files to read during each conversation turn. This small internal adjustment reduces how often it needs to access your data.

5c3735a2c5cc07a9968b5d85e591a9234dc30258.text: The assistant's internal guidelines were refined to better recognize when requested changes already exist and to avoid unnecessary repetition. This small, internal update improves the clarity and efficiency of how the assistant handles file modifications.

135d30ff7623de37a897108855894a232e7e4dad.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant could misread changes to files with deleted lines at the start. This ensures edits apply correctly, preventing accidental file corruption.

fa0f1455114d1b0b8fc4733c036b40504403125e.text: The system now starts without needing a special helper program. This makes setup easier for the team.

6d92b457cfff31df35ca996775618d0d88248015.title: Unify web navbar styling and layout
6d92b457cfff31df35ca996775618d0d88248015.summary: Moved inline header from `web/src/app/page.tsx` into `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. Applied `container mx-auto px-4 py-6` classes to match previous homepage header. Updated `web/.eslintrc.js` to disable `prettier/prettier` rule.

d98196190301f2ed83ec0c225b91cae0f4b83acd.title: Add mock data for knowledge file generation tests
d98196190301f2ed83ec0c225b91cae0f4b83acd.summary: Added `test/__mock-data__/knowledge-files/delete-comment.ts` containing a massive `ProjectFileContext` fixture. This mock data simulates a complex project directory structure to validate knowledge file generation logic. Covers internal testing infrastructure for the `common` module.

3d2c0dd251f5323cae50c6a0e65403169de218dc.title: Add error handling to checkNewFilesNecessary in request-files-prompt
3d2c0dd251f5323cae50c6a0e65403169de218dc.summary: Added a .catch() block to the checkNewFilesNecessary function in backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts to prevent server crashes when the underlying LLM call fails. The error is logged via console.error, and the function defaults to returning 'YES'. This ensures the request processing pipeline continues gracefully if the file necessity check encounters an exception.

504c3ce42b4001e0060d854c3d6807b75171f06f.title: web/eslint prettier rule ignore
504c3ce42b4001e0060d854c3d6807b75171f06f.summary: Changed prettier/prettier rule from error to ignore in web/.eslintrc.js. Prettier formatting checks no longer block ESLint. Scope limited to web package.

76934587f33ced5b3f877ca425a59f75ff54116b.title: Stricter knowledge file creation criteria
76934587f33ced5b3f877ca425a59f75ff54116b.summary: Updated `generate-knowledge-files.ts` and `system-prompt.ts` to raise the bar for creating knowledge files. The generation logic now requires a strong 'yes' on specific context-missing or non-obviousness questions before outputting, and the system prompt explicitly prefers directory-level files while discouraging file-specific ones. This reduces noise by ensuring only high-value, non-obvious project context is captured.

a2e91c18f510cd091d55929f54451a7f9871800f.title: Web landing page switched to Manicode template
a2e91c18f510cd091d55929f54451a7f9871800f.summary: Replaced `web/src/app/page.tsx` with a new 'Manicode' landing page featuring a 3D globe (`cobe`, `three`) and animated beams (`framer-motion`). Added dependencies `@react-three/drei`, `@react-three/fiber`, `aceternity-ui`, `cobe`, `framer-motion`, `react-spring`, `three`, and `three-globe`. Disabled `plugin:tailwindcss/recommended` in `web/.eslintrc.js` and set `semi: false` in `web/.prettierrc.js` to match new code style. Scope limited to `web/` package; no CLI or core logic changes.

461c31d4eb7e7e0cfde1fa5c3d6b5bb6f263c854.title: Disable no-explicit-any ESLint rule and remove unused Button import
461c31d4eb7e7e0cfde1fa5c3d6b5bb6f263c854.summary: Disables `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` in `web/.eslintrc.js` to suppress TypeScript issues. Removes unused `Button` import from `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. Affects web linting configuration and navbar component.

2d267eda1e830442ec31c63f2c1ecafd89bc7669.title: Remove unused drizzle.config.ts
2d267eda1e830442ec31c63f2c1ecafd89bc7669.summary: Deleted `backend/drizzle.config.ts` as it was unused. This removes the local Drizzle Kit configuration for PostgreSQL migrations. Scope limited to backend repo files. No functional impact on runtime.

7ec5babbc99e1493543bca1f189c7b34ebc94eb9.title: Warm search cache after file addition
7ec5babbc99e1493543bca1f189c7b34ebc94eb9.summary: Backend now warms search cache immediately after adding files in `main-prompt.ts`, moving logic from post-response to mid-process. `updateFileContext` returns `null` instead of empty string for no relevant files, triggering conditional cache warm-up. `system-prompt.ts` splits prompt parts across two text blocks with `cache_control: ephemeral` on second block. `request-files-prompt.ts` adds explicit tool-call prohibition instruction.

9eef70a6a490319f0a7d38ad9d4a9aefdc1c1d86.title: Consolidate DB tooling to common/src/db
9eef70a6a490319f0a7d38ad9d4a9aefdc1c1d86.summary: Database configuration, migrations, and client logic moved from `backend` and `web` to `common/src/db`. New scripts (`db:start`, `db:migrate`) and a Docker Compose setup automate local Postgres deployment and Drizzle migrations. Removed legacy `backend/src/db` files and updated dependencies in `common/package.json`.

a2e91c18f510cd091d55929f54451a7f9871800f.text: The website's main page now displays a new design with a spinning globe. This is an internal visual update that does not change how the software works.

9eef70a6a490319f0a7d38ad9d4a9aefdc1c1d86.text: The team cleaned up how the app handles data storage behind the scenes. This internal update makes the system easier to manage without changing how you use the product.

3d2c0dd251f5323cae50c6a0e65403169de218dc.text: The system now handles errors during file checks without crashing. If a problem occurs, it assumes files are needed and continues working.

2d267eda1e830442ec31c63f2c1ecafd89bc7669.text: The team removed an unused setup file from the internal system. This change has no effect on how the product works for you.

504c3ce42b4001e0060d854c3d6807b75171f06f.text: A small internal change stopped the system from blocking code submissions over minor formatting errors. This does not change how the product works for you.

461c31d4eb7e7e0cfde1fa5c3d6b5bb6f263c854.text: The website's code checker now allows some technical shortcuts, and an unused button was removed from the menu. This is a small internal update that does not change how the site looks or works for you.

76934587f33ced5b3f877ca425a59f75ff54116b.text: The assistant now creates memory notes only for important, non-obvious details to avoid clutter.

d98196190301f2ed83ec0c225b91cae0f4b83acd.text: A small internal update adds sample data to help test how the system builds knowledge files. This change does not affect what you see or do in the product.

7ec5babbc99e1493543bca1f189c7b34ebc94eb9.text: The assistant now prepares search results as soon as you add files. This helps it find information faster in the next response.

6d92b457cfff31df35ca996775618d0d88248015.text: The website's top navigation bar was moved to a shared location and styled to match the homepage. This is an internal cleanup that ensures consistent appearance across pages.

2600b6a51d8c45da537f42241e0978bf0bf4260e.title: Implement prompt caching for file context and tools
2600b6a51d8c45da537f42241e0978bf0bf4260e.summary: Added `warmCacheForRequestRelevantFiles` to pre-warm the Anthropic prompt cache using a minimal 'hi' message with `maxTokens: 1`. Updated `getSearchSystemPrompt` to split the system prompt into two distinct blocks, both marked with `cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' }`, and applied similar caching controls to `tool_use` and `tool_result` message schemas in `common/src/actions.ts`. Refactored `mainPrompt` to always execute file context updates first, removing the conditional check for empty file contexts. This change reduces latency and cost by leveraging prompt caching for stable system prompts and file trees across multiple turns.

86f82192302d02d8b750c27b59f4c576f1c7304c.title: clean-package.js switches NODEENV to ENVIRONMENT
86f82192302d02d8b750c27b59f4c576f1c7304c.summary: npm-app/clean-package.js injects process.env.ENVIRONMENT = 'production' into dist/index.js instead of process.env.NODE_ENV. This change aligns the build-time environment variable with the application's specific configuration expectations, avoiding potential conflicts with standard Node.js environment handling. The script continues to insert the assignment after the shebang line if it is not already present. Log messages updated to reflect ENVIRONMENT setting status.

25b24d859173d122b99bb79c09982f9463f40d90.title: Add checkNewFilesNecessary gate to requestRelevantFiles
25b24d859173d122b99bb79c09982f9463f40d90.summary: New `checkNewFilesNecessary` function in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` gates file retrieval via LLM YES/NO check. Skips `generateFileRequests` when current files suffice. Refactors `requestRelevantFiles` to run both checks concurrently, returning `previousFiles` early if unnecessary. Uses `models.sonnet` for the gating prompt.

8ef404f7828bc7ce6d1e927f3953bd5cf490fd11.title: Refactor patch apply util
8ef404f7828bc7ce6d1e927f3953bd5cf490fd11.summary: Refactors `applyPatch` in `common/src/util/patch.ts`. Extracts complex hunk matching logic into `getMatchIndex` and introduces `REMOVED_LINE` sentinel for deferred filtering. Search functions now return `undefined` instead of `-1`. Internal refactor only.

7d1470ef751884910c4d1a8c32d40577343b3955.title: Skip LLM patch generation for complete sketches
7d1470ef751884910c4d1a8c32d40577343b3955.summary: Added `isSketchCompletePrompt` to `backend/src/generate-patch.ts`. If the sketch contains no placeholder comments, `createPatch` from `diff` generates the patch directly, bypassing `generatePatchPrompt`. This reduces latency and cost for fully specified edits. Falls back to LLM generation if placeholders are detected.

c587aae615c068ba13fe9290e69628519c378849.title: Backend env validation via t3-env, healthz endpoint, deploy script
c587aae615c068ba13fe9290e69628519c378849.summary: Backend replaces raw `process.env` access with `@t3-oss/env-core` in `backend/src/env.mjs`, enforcing Zod schemas for API keys and `PORT`. A `/healthz` endpoint is added to `backend/src/index.ts` for readiness checks. Legacy Docker/GCP deployment scripts (`deploy.sh`, `Dockerfile`) are deleted from `backend/`, and `.gitignore` now excludes all `.env.*` files except `.env.example`.

596552d28cd8b1286c64955972d5ba6cefa1467c.title: System prompt file tree truncation fallback
596552d28cd8b1286c64955972d5ba6cefa1467c.summary: Added `else` branch in `truncateFileTreeBasedOnTokenBudget` (`backend/src/system-prompt.ts`) to return root-only directory tree when token budget exhaustion prevents standard truncation. Renamed `line` to `patchLine` in `applyPatch` (`common/src/util/patch.ts`) to resolve shadowing conflicts with `parseHunk` context variables. Scope limited to core prompt assembly and patch utility internals. No user-facing behavior change; ensures valid tree structure persists under strict token limits.

3cbefde8c7b78bb988f91f34a80100034bf2d3dc.title: Fix applyPatch hunk boundary logic
3cbefde8c7b78bb988f91f34a80100034bf2d3dc.summary: Corrected `applyPatch` in `common/src/util/patch.ts` to properly calculate `nextHunkIndex` by deriving distance from `findIndex` and handling the `-1` return value. Previous logic incorrectly sliced patch lines when the next hunk was absent or at the end, causing context line skipping errors. Added comprehensive test mocks in `test/__mock-data__/graph/patch.ts` and `test/__mock-data__/tmp-graph.ts` to validate patch application on complex D3 graph updates.

a9461c25625621ba785fe8d226cef84808e7c1a8.title: Add Drizzle ORM PostgreSQL backend
a9461c25625621ba785fe8d226cef84808e7c1a8.summary: Integrated Drizzle ORM 0.33.0 and postgres.js 3.4.4 for backend database management. New schema defines a users table with serial id, unique varchar email, and timestamp created_at. Migrations generated in backend/src/db/drizzle; setup requires Cloud SQL proxy via mac-cloud-sql-proxy binary and DATABASE_URL env var.

9f62f7976a0b44e340a50ec5458112cb4d199167.title: Add regression test for patch function rearrangement
9f62f7976a0b44e340a50ec5458112cb4d199167.summary: New test case in `patch.test.ts` verifies `applyPatch` correctly handles patches that move code blocks, specifically rearranging the `setupSubscriptions` function within `Client`. Mock data files (`old.ts`, `patch.ts`, `expected.ts`) added to `test/__mock-data__/patch/` to support this scenario. Ensures patch application logic remains robust against structural changes like function reordering.

86f82192302d02d8b750c27b59f4c576f1c7304c.text: A small internal update changes how the product identifies its environment. Users will not notice any difference.

9f62f7976a0b44e340a50ec5458112cb4d199167.text: Added a small internal check to ensure the system correctly handles rearranged code blocks during updates.

2600b6a51d8c45da537f42241e0978bf0bf4260e.text: The assistant now remembers the files and tools it needs for your requests, instead of re-reading them every time. This makes responses faster and cheaper to produce.

3cbefde8c7b78bb988f91f34a80100034bf2d3dc.text: Fixed a bug that caused errors when updating data graphs. This change is internal.

25b24d859173d122b99bb79c09982f9463f40d90.text: The system now checks if it already has enough information before searching for more files. This saves time and reduces unnecessary work behind the scenes.

8ef404f7828bc7ce6d1e927f3953bd5cf490fd11.text: The software's internal instructions for fixing files were reorganized to be clearer and more reliable. This is a behind-the-scenes update that helps the system work better, but you won't notice any changes in how the product looks or behaves.

c587aae615c068ba13fe9290e69628519c378849.text: The system now checks its own settings automatically to catch errors early. A simple status check was added to help the service stay online. These are small internal changes to make the product more stable.

596552d28cd8b1286c64955972d5ba6cefa1467c.text: The system now shows a simplified folder list if the full one is too long to fit. This is a small internal fix that ensures the assistant keeps working correctly without changing how you see the results.

a9461c25625621ba785fe8d226cef84808e7c1a8.text: The system now uses a new, more reliable way to store user accounts and details. This change is internal and improves how data is saved, but you will not see any difference in the app.

1a7ece065b2da90198d92d34b291f8249a4ac162.title: Add CODEOWNERS and ts-pattern dependency
1a7ece065b2da90198d92d34b291f8249a4ac162.summary: Introduced .github/CODEOWNERS to assign default reviewers (@brandonkachen, @jahooma) and added ts-pattern@5.3.1 to backend/package.json. This enables automated PR routing and resolves a missing dependency for pattern matching in backend code. The change affects repository governance and backend dependency manifest.

7892ae54c08423ec2c4c1c0e19f7056138d0459d.title: Patch apply guards against out-of-bounds line index
7892ae54c08423ec2c4c1c0e19f7056138d0459d.summary: applyPatch in common/src/util/patch.ts adds bounds checks before comparing oldIndex against lines.length. Prevents crash when a '-' line references a position past the file end. Fuzzy match loop also breaks early if oldIndex + j exceeds array length. Covers core patch utility used by all surfaces.

79334019ff6a5000395bbdb1a5f5596dac98ce20.title: Swap generate-patch to new fine-tuned model
79334019ff6a5000395bbdb1a5f5596dac98ce20.summary: generate-patch.ts now calls ft:gpt-4o-2024-08-06:manifold-markets::A7wELpag instead of ft:gpt-4o-2024-08-06:manifold-markets:run-1:A4VfZwvz. Old model ID is commented out. Scope limited to backend patch generation.

76dfa7f9bf87f34de548b671ec1be25be897ce64.title: Fix src import path in common/util/tools
76dfa7f9bf87f34de548b671ec1be25be897ce64.summary: Corrected import paths for `common/util/tools` from `common/src/util/tools` in backend source files. Updated `generate-knowledge-files.ts`, `main-prompt.ts`, and `websocket-action.ts` to use the resolved path. Adjusted `exported-tokens.json` and test mock data to reflect the new path key. Added `backend/README.md` with GCP deployment instructions.

c6622fefa7dabd0a797510e1c1fb6654b21cd60b.title: Auto-generate knowledge files from codebase changes
c6622fefa7dabd0a797510e1c1fb6654b21cd60b.summary: New `generateKnowledgeFiles` function automatically creates or updates `.knowledge.md` files based on meaningful codebase changes and user corrections. Triggered in `mainPrompt` when chat history exists and no tools were used, utilizing an LLM to filter for non-obvious context. Refactored `tools.ts` to `common/src/util/tools.ts` to share `DEFAULT_TOOLS` and add `didClientUseTool` helper. Scope covers backend logic, system prompts, and shared utilities.

7615438e2c03a608ae43b0f591a801fcce0c6c06.title: Improve patch context matching in applyPatch
7615438e2c03a608ae43b0f591a801fcce0c6c06.summary: Refactored `applyPatch` in `common/src/util/patch.ts` to use a multi-stage context matching strategy involving hunk headers and trimmed whitespace comparison. Replaced inline parsing with extracted helper logic to handle cases where strict line numbers fail, falling back to headline indices or trimmed matches. This increases resilience against minor file drift or formatting differences during patch application. Added `test:patch` script to `package.json` for targeted verification.

8152a30a735673952b411fb9951bd727a4b90599.title: Append assistant edits to response and truncate large user diffs
8152a30a735673952b411fb9951bd727a4b90599.summary: Backend appends assistant-made changes to the response message within `<edits_made_by_assistant>` tags. CLI truncates user edit diffs exceeding 40k chars to `[LARGE_FILE_CHANGE_TOO_LONG_TO_REPRODUCE]` before formatting. Updates `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `npm-app/src/cli.ts`.

01a6efbf4a81d533df15129e27e54d3e6991cfa8.title: Tweak fine-tuning script params
01a6efbf4a81d533df15129e27e54d3e6991cfa8.summary: Adjusts `scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts` to optimize dataset generation. Increases `NUMBER_OF_COMMITS` to 5000, decreases `PARALLEL_PROCESSES` to 5, and adds a 50k token limit per file using `countTokens`. Updates `BLACK_LIST_STRINGS` to exclude more autogenerated files and shifts train/validation split to 90/10.

cf93047761b47fe5053f4ca63ec8522ddc15eb01.title: Add checkpointing to fine-tuning dataset generation script
cf93047761b47fe5053f4ca63ec8522ddc15eb01.summary: scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts now saves intermediate progress to dataset_progress.json and resumes from existing entries. Switched from manual batching to mapAsync for concurrency. Added pytorch, linux, nushell, and vscode to PROJECTS_LIST. Increased NUMBER_OF_COMMITS to 3000 and FILES_TO_PROCESS to 1000. Removed ANTHROPIC_API_KEY check from createDataset.

c6622fefa7dabd0a797510e1c1fb6654b21cd60b.text: The assistant now automatically updates its internal notes when you correct it or when the software changes significantly. This helps it remember important context for future conversations without you needing to do anything.

76dfa7f9bf87f34de548b671ec1be25be897ce64.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system finds its tools. This change helps the app run more reliably for you.

7892ae54c08423ec2c4c1c0e19f7056138d0459d.text: The software now checks if a requested change points to a line that does not exist. This prevents crashes when editing text, making the experience more stable.

7615438e2c03a608ae43b0f591a801fcce0c6c06.text: The software now checks file changes more flexibly. This helps updates apply correctly even if the file looks slightly different.

1a7ece065b2da90198d92d34b291f8249a4ac162.text: Small internal update. Changes how requests are reviewed and fixed a background issue.

79334019ff6a5000395bbdb1a5f5596dac98ce20.text: The tool that creates updates now uses a newer, more accurate version of its underlying technology. This internal change helps it write better code but does not add new features or change how you use the product.

8152a30a735673952b411fb9951bd727a4b90599.text: The assistant now lists its own changes in responses. Large user edits are shortened to prevent overload.

cf93047761b47fe5053f4ca63ec8522ddc15eb01.text: The system now saves progress during data creation, allowing it to resume from where it left off if interrupted. This change is internal and does not affect the product's visible features.

169a24a087447e04cc889302f8535c7e730a9598.text: The assistant switched how it understands your requests. This change is internal, so you likely won't notice a difference in how you use the product.

01a6efbf4a81d533df15129e27e54d3e6991cfa8.text: The system now uses more data to train the assistant, but splits it differently to improve learning. This change may make the assistant slightly smarter or more accurate.

4277bb6ba248b95a4afb0bcbdf0ddcbd3904af0b.title: Patch context matching now allows blank lines
4277bb6ba248b95a4afb0bcbdf0ddcbd3904af0b.summary: The `findContextMatchTrimmed` function in `common/src/util/patch.ts` was updated to treat blank lines in context as wildcards. Previously, exact whitespace matching was required for all context lines, causing patch failures when surrounding lines differed in indentation or blank status. This change ensures patches apply correctly when context lines are empty, regardless of the target file's whitespace.

6983ecf60e43e3716f196e278067b77de84b2caa.title: Add recursive directory creation to applyChanges
6983ecf60e43e3716f196e278067b77de84b2caa.summary: The `applyChanges` function in `common/src/util/changes.ts` now creates parent directories recursively before writing files. This prevents errors when saving changes to paths that do not yet exist. Scope limited to core file writing logic.

3a539e522a7f148413c00a624c98d92beae57632.title: Add git commit to bump-version script
3a539e522a7f148413c00a624c98d92beae57632.summary: The `scripts/bump-version.ts` file now automatically executes `git add` and `git commit` after incrementing the version in `npmAppPath` and `backendPath`. This change ensures version bumps are immediately tracked in the repository history. The commit message dynamically uses the new version from the updated `package.json`. This affects the internal tooling used for release preparation.

a9a2b7dbdc9a560ce4e4e4d6ea432ca32fd72dca.title: Version 1.0.61
a9a2b7dbdc9a560ce4e4e4d6ea432ca32fd72dca.summary: Patch version bumped to 1.0.61. Updates `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json`. No functional changes.

d9881d19056719643cd0b0466eeb4f153f175028.title: Add mapAsync util
d9881d19056719643cd0b0466eeb4f153f175028.summary: Adds `mapAsync` in `common/src/util/promise.ts`. Limits concurrency to `maxConcurrentRequests` (default 20). Resolves with results array.

c3a6bfd24c93e02fcda7828c282b8a4ece8c9c49.title: Cancel tool-call apply on stale input
c3a6bfd24c93e02fcda7828c282b8a4ece8c9c49.summary: Client.ts adds currentUserInputId tracking to guard tool-call subscriptions. Stale responses matching cancelled inputs skip file-change application. Scope limited to npm-app/src/client.ts WebSocket handling.

15db2d570cc59ac20c67b0e74bb6b6b13406752b.title: Move user edit tracking from system prompt to CLI message content
15db2d570cc59ac20c67b0e74bb6b6b13406752b.summary: Removed the `<user_edits_since_last_chat>` block from `gitChangesPrompt` in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The CLI (`npm-app/src/cli.ts`) now calculates changes since the last file version using `getChangesSinceLastFileVersion` and prepends the block directly to the user message content. `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` exports `getChangesSinceLastFileVersion` and refactors the internal logic to support this shift.

f15370c008abddafff867814d4b18b9c774dd3aa.title: Pause mainPrompt after 3 consecutive assistant tool calls
f15370c008abddafff867814d4b18b9c774dd3aa.summary: Added a guard in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to force a pause after 3 consecutive assistant messages. The change calculates `numAssistantMessages` since the last user message and returns early with a pause response if the count is 3 or more. This prevents the agent from looping indefinitely without user input.

87740f70af36f31019f86a277552379e39b05bad.title: Split Search vs Agent system prompts
87740f70af36f31019f86a277552379e39b05bad.summary: Refactored system prompt generation into getSearchSystemPrompt and getAgentSystemPrompt. Search prompt now contains only file tree and relevant files prompt part 1. Agent prompt includes file tree conditionally based on size (<40k chars) to save context. Updated main-prompt.ts and websocket-action.ts to use new functions.

b95f7a01b4b08be2401cc2442d4e5746c197ebb8.title: Preserve manual edits across chat turns
b95f7a01b4b08be2401cc2442d4e5746c197ebb8.summary: System prompt injects `changesSinceLastChat` via `gitChangesPrompt` in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. `ProjectFileContextSchema` adds `changesSinceLastChat` record in `common/src/util/file.ts`. `npm-app` computes diffs against `lastFileVersion` using `diff.createPatch` in `project-files.ts`, passed from `client.ts` `sendUserInput`. Scope: Backend prompts, Common schema, NPM app CLI/Client. Detail: `getChangesSinceLastFileVersion` filters null diffs and reads disk content per file path.

3a539e522a7f148413c00a624c98d92beae57632.text: The tool that prepares software releases now automatically records version updates in its history log. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

a9a2b7dbdc9a560ce4e4e4d6ea432ca32fd72dca.text: The system's internal label changed. Nothing new or different happens for you.

f15370c008abddafff867814d4b18b9c774dd3aa.text: The assistant now stops after three steps to ask for your input. This prevents it from getting stuck in a loop.

c3a6bfd24c93e02fcda7828c282b8a4ece8c9c49.text: A small internal update prevents the app from applying old changes after you cancel a request. This stops the assistant from editing files based on input you already stopped.

d9881d19056719643cd0b0466eeb4f153f175028.text: The app now handles multiple requests at once, but keeps the number running at the same time under a limit to prevent overload. This makes the experience smoother and more stable.

15db2d570cc59ac20c67b0e74bb6b6b13406752b.text: The assistant now sees recent file edits directly in the conversation instead of through a hidden background note. This is an internal cleanup that does not change how the product looks or works for you.

b95f7a01b4b08be2401cc2442d4e5746c197ebb8.text: The assistant now sees your manual edits before replying. This ensures it accounts for changes you made outside the chat.

6983ecf60e43e3716f196e278067b77de84b2caa.text: The app now automatically creates missing folders before saving files. This prevents errors when you try to save changes to a new location.

4277bb6ba248b95a4afb0bcbdf0ddcbd3904af0b.text: The software now updates files more reliably, even when they have extra blank spaces. This means fewer errors when you save changes.

87740f70af36f31019f86a277552379e39b05bad.text: The assistant now uses different instructions for searching files versus completing tasks. This helps it save memory and work more efficiently.

337f5d8c049f383cc9a52013789e0ba5712f3656.title: Swap chalk for picocolors in terminal tool handlers
337f5d8c049f383cc9a52013789e0ba5712f3656.summary: npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts replaces `chalk` with `picocolors` for command output formatting. `chalk.blue` calls are swapped for `green` from `picocolors` in `handleRunTerminalCommand`. test/package.json adds `common` dependency; test/tsconfig.json removes `moduleResolution` and `skipLibCheck`.

d8e2e520d17be9d59672da347039667622e06c90.title: Add troubleshooting section to README
d8e2e520d17be9d59672da347039667622e06c90.summary: Added a Troubleshooting section to npm-app/README.md addressing global installation permission errors. Recommends using version managers like nvm for OSX/Unix and nvm-windows for Windows, including installation commands and links.

2b6ba0522ae4bd01b8578d8f1938450d8af0a043.title: Update npm-app README troubleshooting section
2b6ba0522ae4bd01b8578d8f1938450d8af0a043.summary: Refined Troubleshooting section in `npm-app/README.md`. Converted inline advice into hyperlinks for node version managers and adjusted heading levels from H3 to H4. Minor copy edits improved readability.
