6847f8e06b1c1a43b06d9fbaff652e64fcfc9ab4.title: Copy tree-sitter queries in common build
6847f8e06b1c1a43b06d9fbaff652e64fcfc9ab4.summary: Updated `common` package build script to copy `src/codemap/tree-sitter-queries` into `dist/codemap/` after TypeScript compilation. This ensures tree-sitter queries are available in the distributed build output. Version bumped to 1.0.60 for `backend` and `npm-app`.

94d47b15dbe328f9fbc8d5a9cc615f38a5387fcc.title: Add Manicode README and local dev startup scripts
94d47b15dbe328f9fbc8d5a9cc615f38a5387fcc.summary: Added comprehensive README.md for Manicode, detailing features, usage, and local setup instructions. Created backend/.env.example with placeholder keys for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Helicone. Updated package.json scripts to separate client and server startup commands (start-client, start-server) and added ts-node dependency. Introduced start-dev.sh to orchestrate local development by launching server and client in separate terminal windows.

526541c50b1103ad92b33ca991a1b827d18956ec.title: Version bump to 1.0.59
526541c50b1103ad92b33ca991a1b827d18956ec.summary: Version bumped to 1.0.59 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Unused `createPatch` import removed from backend/src/main-prompt.ts. No user-facing changes.

5965ee9b8ce9d5e259dfcaac8811d44b2b97a9ea.title: Dynamic tree-sitter language loading
5965ee9b8ce9d5e259dfcaac8811d44b2b97a9ea.summary: Refactors `common/src/codemap/languages.ts` to dynamically import `tree-sitter` language modules via `packageName` strings instead of static imports. Updates `parse.ts` and `project-files.ts` to handle async language config retrieval and token parsing. Improves startup performance by deferring native module loading.

c11faad368a762482fa6cd50bb9d1658ab05786f.title: Add start-dev.sh for local development setup
c11faad368a762482fa6cd50bb9d1658ab05786f.summary: New `start-dev.sh` script automates starting server and client in separate macOS Terminal windows. It waits for server readiness on port 4242 before launching client. `package.json` scripts renamed `dev:start-server`/`dev:start-client` to `start-server`/`start-client`. README updated with usage instructions and macOS limitation note.

34de88ced7e058b1b2b9c7869a6a649994be1525.title: Add README, .env.example, dev scripts
34de88ced7e058b1b2b9c7869a6a649994be1525.summary: Added root README.md documenting Manicode features, usage, and local setup. Created backend/.env.example with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPEN_AI_KEY, HELICONE_API_KEY placeholders. Updated package.json with dev:start-client and dev:start-server scripts, added ts-node dependency, and specified bun@1.1.27 packageManager.

40c4900cd1ef6078e2c6d4740ff31ad0a7a644f3.title: Remove bold formatting from CLI stdout output
40c4900cd1ef6078e2c6d4740ff31ad0a7a644f3.summary: In `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, the `process.stdout.write` call inside `subscribeToResponse` now writes the raw `chunk` instead of `bold(chunk)`. This change removes the bold styling applied to streaming responses in the CLI. The modification is internal to the CLI package and affects how text is rendered to the standard output.

94d47b15dbe328f9fbc8d5a9cc615f38a5387fcc.text: Internal setup for developers was improved to make starting the tool easier.

526541c50b1103ad92b33ca991a1b827d18956ec.text: The team made small internal updates to the system's code. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

337f5d8c049f383cc9a52013789e0ba5712f3656.text: The program now uses a simpler tool to color text in the command window. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works or looks.

c11faad368a762482fa6cd50bb9d1658ab05786f.text: A new helper button lets staff launch the app’s parts in one click. It waits for the main part to be ready before starting the other. This saves time and avoids errors when setting up the app on a Mac.

40c4900cd1ef6078e2c6d4740ff31ad0a7a644f3.text: The command line tool now shows responses in plain text instead of bold. This small internal change only affects how the text looks.

6847f8e06b1c1a43b06d9fbaff652e64fcfc9ab4.text: The app now includes extra setup files needed for its code analysis feature to work correctly after installation. This is a small internal fix that helps the product run smoothly.

2b6ba0522ae4bd01b8578d8f1938450d8af0a043.text: Help guide wording improved. Links added for setup steps.

5965ee9b8ce9d5e259dfcaac8811d44b2b97a9ea.text: The app now loads some background tools only when needed, rather than at start-up. This makes the program start faster.

d8e2e520d17be9d59672da347039667622e06c90.text: The help guide now includes instructions for fixing common setup errors. This helps users resolve installation problems on their own without needing technical support.

34de88ced7e058b1b2b9c7869a6a649994be1525.text: The team added setup guides and tools to help the software start correctly.

92e3be3aa98dc53a4d94f787f1e2cda59cb899d9.title: Replace chalk with picocolors
92e3be3aa98dc53a4d94f787f1e2cda59cb899d9.summary: Swaps `chalk` for `picocolors` in CLI and WebSocket client. Updates imports in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, `client.ts`, `index.ts`, `menu.ts`, and `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`. Removes `chalk` dependency from `npm-app/package.json`, adds `picocolors`. Adjusts color function calls to use named exports (`green`, `yellow`, `bold`).

6b7ee257fb17dc1a6f92be8bfd7c2d2408dd71d3.title: Rust language support added to codemap parser
6b7ee257fb17dc1a6f92be8bfd7c2d2408dd71d3.summary: Rust language parsing enabled in codemap via tree-sitter-rust. The `tree-sitter-rust-tags.scm` query was rewritten to simplify identifier extraction, replacing complex definition/reference tags with flat `@identifier` and `@call.identifier` captures. A `DEBUG_PARSING` flag gates verbose logging and token export logic in `parse.ts`. New `start-nushell` npm scripts added for local testing.

18f0083112519bee19f3dced0a13adc4f5416a19.title: Update npm-app README wording and steps
18f0083112519bee19f3dced0a13adc4f5416a19.summary: npm-app/README.md intro and usage steps revised. Manicode description shifts to generating better code. Steps clarify running from project directory and simplify file I/O wording. Scope limited to npm-app documentation.

d6f12897fdfa5c4182151bd2afa38b0731ba6480.title: Ignore mock projects in gitignore
d6f12897fdfa5c4182151bd2afa38b0731ba6480.summary: `.gitignore` now excludes `__mock-projects__`. This prevents mock project directories from being tracked in the repo. Scope is the root `.gitignore` only; no model, CLI, Web, Desktop, or docs changes. Entry is appended after `.manicode`, and the file remains without a trailing newline.

46332752838fdbc146595ff39c1d1354332a9645.title: Rust tree-sitter queries index implitem tags
46332752838fdbc146595ff39c1d1354332a9645.summary: Added `impl_item` query patterns to `tree-sitter-rust-tags.scm` to capture trait and type implementations. This enables the codemap to index Rust `impl` blocks as callable tags. The change applies to the shared core `common/src/codemap` subsystem. Specific patterns match `trait` and `type` identifiers, with `!trait` ensuring type-only implementations are also captured.

f9ddb198eedc1aa7dc9c30142de4a887285bfaa7.title: CLI uses green and bold text for status and responses
f9ddb198eedc1aa7dc9c30142de4a887285bfaa7.summary: The CLI `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now uses `chalk.green` for status messages like Undo/Redo and 'Thinking...', and `chalk.bold` for assistant response chunks. This replaces previous `blue` and `magenta` colors to standardize visual cues. The change affects the CLI's display logic for navigation history, exit messages, loading spinners, and streamed output.

0b3b4355e24223ca2766f2a0ae5a717f3e8b4ea1.title: Reduce file request counts when assistant is asking
0b3b4355e24223ca2766f2a0ae5a717f3e8b4ea1.summary: Adjusts `countPerRequest`, `numNonObviousPrompts`, and `numKeyPrompts` in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` to lower values when `assistantPrompt` is active. This change prevents excessive file requests during assistant-initiated queries. The modification is internal to the backend logic.

4414f83055f0970cabdace6ef093de9587aef6ca.title: Java codemap support enabled
4414f83055f0970cabdace6ef093de9587aef6ca.summary: Java parsing enabled in `common/src/codemap/languages.ts` by uncommenting `JavaLanguage` import and config. `tree-sitter-java-tags.scm` updated to standardize capture names (`@identifier`, `@call.identifier`) and fix tag definitions for classes, interfaces, methods, and references. Scope limited to `common/src/codemap` subsystem.

e6703e5c5f03cc8ec462f24435f6a556d052612f.title: Codemap adds C, C++, C, Java, Rust language support
e6703e5c5f03cc8ec462f24435f6a556d052612f.summary: Uncommented and registered tree-sitter parsers for C, C++, C#, Java, and Rust in common/src/codemap/languages.ts. Updated tree-sitter query files (.scm) to use unified @identifier captures instead of granular @name.definition.* patterns. Added tree-sitter-c to package.json dependencies alongside existing language grammars.

ee96fe281beb7224909fb3ab0b3a87cd0cb7c7fd.title: Codemap adds Ruby, Go, PHP support and drops Elisp, Elixir, Elm, OCaml
ee96fe281beb7224909fb3ab0b3a87cd0cb7c7fd.summary: Codemap now parses Ruby, Go, and PHP by uncommenting their tree-sitter configs and queries in languages.ts, while removing support for Elisp, Elixir, Elm, and OCaml. C files now use the dedicated tree-sitter-c-tags.scm query instead of the C++ one. Go and PHP queries were simplified to use generic @identifier captures, dropping complex doc-string stripping and specific definition/reference types.

f9ddb198eedc1aa7dc9c30142de4a887285bfaa7.text: The text in the command line tool now uses green and bold styles for status updates and responses. This change standardizes visual cues for better readability.

4414f83055f0970cabdace6ef093de9587aef6ca.text: The tool now understands Java code. You can map and navigate Java projects.

d6f12897fdfa5c4182151bd2afa38b0731ba6480.text: The system now automatically ignores temporary test files. This keeps your main workspace clean and organized.

0b3b4355e24223ca2766f2a0ae5a717f3e8b4ea1.text: The assistant now asks for fewer files when it starts a conversation. This internal update helps prevent unnecessary requests, making interactions smoother.

e6703e5c5f03cc8ec462f24435f6a556d052612f.text: The tool can now recognize and map C, C++, C#, Java, and Rust code. This means it can better understand and organize projects written in these languages.

6b7ee257fb17dc1a6f92be8bfd7c2d2408dd71d3.text: The tool now understands Rust code. This helps the assistant read and explain projects written in that language.

18f0083112519bee19f3dced0a13adc4f5416a19.text: The instructions for using the assistant were updated to be clearer. This small internal change helps you understand how to start it and what it does, but it does not affect how the product works.

92e3be3aa98dc53a4d94f787f1e2cda59cb899d9.text: The software switched to a lighter tool for showing colored text. This small update makes the program run slightly faster with no visible changes for users.

46332752838fdbc146595ff39c1d1354332a9645.text: The tool now recognizes and lists specific parts of Rust code, such as trait and type implementations, in its index. This means users can more easily navigate and find these code sections without manually searching.

ee96fe281beb7224909fb3ab0b3a87cd0cb7c7fd.text: The tool now reads Ruby, Go, and PHP files to show their structure, but it stopped reading Elisp, Elixir, Elm, and OCaml files.

d859e4810be56d2c57db8d549304a249d60f160d.title: System prompt enforces file blocks for code and knowledge edits
d859e4810be56d2c57db8d549304a249d60f160d.summary: System prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts mandates use of <file> blocks for all code writing and knowledge file edits. Adds explicit instructions to prevent raw code output outside file blocks. This ensures consistent parsing and editing behavior across the agent's internal logic.

19d4290319603d8cb4608d224b243907637423dc.title: Skip lib checks in common tsconfig
19d4290319603d8cb4608d224b243907637423dc.summary: Added skipLibCheck: true to common/tsconfig.json to bypass type-checking of external declaration files. Pinned typescript to 5.5.4 in npm-app/package.json, removing caret range. Affects shared core compilation and npm-app dependency resolution. Reduces build time and prevents errors from upstream type definition mismatches.

2291f88b15dbeef9fc45726e84326295790f669c.title: Expand terminal command skip list and add word count limit
2291f88b15dbeef9fc45726e84326295790f669c.summary: Added help, find, and kill to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts. Updated npm-app/src/cli.ts to reject user inputs with 4 or more words before execution. This prevents benign text or complex sentences from triggering terminal commands.

d802a8ae32441e522f6c35f2d9c292c92a28d5b1.title: Add bump-version script and litestar start command
d802a8ae32441e522f6c35f2d9c292c92a28d5b1.summary: Replaced `scripts/build-version-info.js` with `scripts/bump-version.ts` to increment patch versions in `npm-app/package.json` and `backend/package.json`, exposed via new `bump` script in root `package.json`. Added `start-litestar` command to `npm-app/package.json` and root `package.json` for testing against a mock Litestar project. Updated `todo.knowledge.md` to mark two tasks as complete and add a new note regarding file overwriting.

915f42f128f863efc7d80675193e0ed20ffdc966.title: Codemap parser caching and export statement support
915f42f128f863efc7d80675193e0ed20ffdc966.summary: The `getLanguageConfig` function now lazily initializes and caches tree-sitter `Parser` and `Query` instances within the language configuration object, preventing redundant instantiation during file parsing. The TypeScript tags query file (`tree-sitter-typescript-tags.scm`) was updated to capture identifiers from `export_statement` declarations for both `lexical_declaration` and `variable_declaration`. This change removes the global parser instance from `parse.ts` and deletes the unused `typescript-query.scm` file. Scope is limited to the `common/src/codemap` subsystem.

77f61ef3bb526e99c4f5427f0a830a4a24d7a8fa.title: Reduce file tree token budgets and switch indentation to spaces
77f61ef3bb526e99c4f5427f0a830a4a24d7a8fa.summary: System prompt token budgets for truncated files and project file trees were reduced from 100k/75k to 80k/60k. File tree rendering in `common/src/util/file.ts` switched from tab to space indentation to minimize token consumption. Debug logging for token counts was added to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, while verbose parsing logs and exported token file writes were removed or commented out in `common/src/codemap/parse.ts` and `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. These changes optimize context window usage and reduce noise in CLI output.

ca0767a691bcd246be6d06fee0a7a7c5ed22e061.title: Tree-sitter fixes: Add Javascript & Python
ca0767a691bcd246be6d06fee0a7a7c5ed22e061.summary: Tree-sitter codemap parsing fixed for Javascript and Python. `common/src/codemap/languages.ts` splits TypeScript/TSX configs. `common/src/codemap/parse.ts` adds `IGNORE_TOKENS` and increases parser `bufferSize`. `common/src/codemap/tree-sitter-queries/` replaces complex doc-extraction queries with simplified identifier captures for JS and Python.

de7f68d523d5b79acadd2e592f2e95d3b4f6c12d.title: Tree-sitter integration for code parsing
de7f68d523d5b79acadd2e592f2e95d3b4f6c12d.summary: Added tree-sitter library and language bindings to common package. New codemap module parses source files using tree-sitter queries for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, C#, C++, PHP, Rust. Includes .scm query files defining tag extraction rules for classes, functions, types. Backend main-prompt.ts updated with debug logging for patch generation.

1d5ff54ec05689765212bf379e7258f8a51b9fc9.title: getFileTokenScores replaces getExportedTokens with weighted scoring
1d5ff54ec05689765212bf379e7258f8a51b9fc9.summary: Refactored `getExportedTokens` to `getFileTokenScores` in `common/src/codemap/parse.ts`. The new implementation calculates weighted scores based on file depth, line count, and external call frequency using tree-sitter queries. Updated TypeScript tree-sitter queries in `common/src/codemap/tree-sitter-queries/tree-sitter-typescript-tags.scm` to capture identifiers and call expressions for scoring. `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` updated to reflect the new function signature.

204541c94317189c62b94080e75d188ba1840262.title: Include exported tokens up to context limit
204541c94317189c62b94080e75d188ba1840262.summary: System prompt file tree generation now includes exported tokens up to a 75k budget. `ProjectFileContext` schema updated from `exportedTokens` to `fileTokenScores` with recursive token-based truncation logic. Tree-sitter language configs for Ruby, Go, Java, C#, C++, PHP, and Rust commented out in `common/src/codemap/languages.ts`. `printFileTreeWithTokens` added to `common/src/util/file.ts` for token-aware tree rendering.

77f61ef3bb526e99c4f5427f0a830a4a24d7a8fa.text: The assistant now uses less memory to track project files, making responses faster and more focused. This small update reduces clutter in the background so the tool works more efficiently.

2291f88b15dbeef9fc45726e84326295790f669c.text: The assistant now ignores certain commands and refuses to act on inputs containing four or more words. This stops accidental or overly complex text from triggering actions.

d802a8ae32441e522f6c35f2d9c292c92a28d5b1.text: The team improved internal tools that help update the software version and test new features. This change does not affect how you use the product.

915f42f128f863efc7d80675193e0ed20ffdc966.text: The tool now reuses parts of itself to work faster, avoiding repeated setup steps. It also recognizes more types of code exports, making its analysis more complete.

d859e4810be56d2c57db8d549304a249d60f160d.text: The assistant now puts code and knowledge edits in clear, labeled sections so the system can read them correctly. This internal fix makes editing more reliable for you.

19d4290319603d8cb4608d224b243907637423dc.text: A small internal update skips some checks of outside instructions while preparing the product and locks the preparation tool to a fixed version. It makes preparation faster and avoids errors from mismatched outside instructions.

1d5ff54ec05689765212bf379e7258f8a51b9fc9.text: The assistant now scores files based on their size, location, and usage to better understand your project. This helps it find the most relevant information when you ask questions.

204541c94317189c62b94080e75d188ba1840262.text: The assistant now includes more file details when analyzing your project, fitting them within a set limit. This helps it understand your code better without losing important context.

ca0767a691bcd246be6d06fee0a7a7c5ed22e061.text: The tool now accurately reads JavaScript and Python code to build a map of the project. This means the assistant can better understand and navigate these types of files when you ask it questions.

98218308adbf621288c469b1d1c369c2eeb3d851.title: Version bump to 1.0.56
98218308adbf621288c469b1d1c369c2eeb3d851.summary: Incremented version to 1.0.56 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Routine release preparation.

bbf6819d104cc6b0a9d35f4b7b934df6402ef550.title: Bump backend and npm-app to 1.0.55
bbf6819d104cc6b0a9d35f4b7b934df6402ef550.summary: Version increment in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. New mock project submodules added under test/__mock-projects__/ for jpcsp and litestar. No functional code changes.

366778fb4c6efd6bbdcdcb07fde79f1fb46698f4.title: Patch util finds first hunk dynamically
366778fb4c6efd6bbdcdcb07fde79f1fb46698f4.summary: common/src/util/patch.ts now locates the first @@ hunk via findIndex instead of slicing a fixed 4-line header. This handles patches with variable header lengths. Internal utility change in Shared/Core.

3d2509aa497840cfdcc79f1e41e927cc0d2da8c0.title: Patch apply fallback to parsed line number
3d2509aa497840cfdcc79f1e41e927cc0d2da8c0.summary: applyPatch falls back to `startLineToTry` when context matching fails. Prevents patch rejection on ambiguous or missing context lines. Scope: `common/src/util/patch.ts`, backend/npm-app version bump to 1.0.57.

0ccf19a06d0003bc841730dcaee2ad1d8f752200.title: Patch application uses hunk header line numbers
0ccf19a06d0003bc841730dcaee2ad1d8f752200.summary: applyPatch parses @@ headers to seed context matching at startLineToTry before falling back to sequential oldIndex or trimmed matching. Covers common/src/util/patch.ts. Adds regex extraction for hunk start lines with 0-based index adjustment.

633f39f939a33ae126addd07689ff1b8ad104903.title: Normalize line endings in fine-tuning dataset generation
633f39f939a33ae126addd07689ff1b8ad104903.summary: Added `.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')` to `oldContent`, `newContent`, and `patch` in `scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts`. This ensures consistent Unix-style line endings in the generated dataset, preventing potential parsing or model training issues caused by Windows-style CRLF sequences.

81121b36247a0b2fac42ab769815e13acb871f9d.title: generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts drops continuation and adds
81121b36247a0b2fac42ab769815e13acb871f9d.summary: Switches scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts from promptClaudeWithContinuation to promptClaude. Adds early return when Claude sketch is empty. Raises FILES_TO_PROCESS from 20 to 200. Replaces libgdx with jpcsp in PROJECTS_LIST.

f67ca0d994dd62b87cca3ef6ed484b626d348dfe.title: Add ignoreHelicone flag to promptClaude
f67ca0d994dd62b87cca3ef6ed484b626d348dfe.summary: Added ignoreHelicone boolean to promptClaude, promptClaudeStream, and promptClaudeWithContinuation options in backend/src/claude.ts. When true, skips Helicone baseURL and auth headers, routing directly to Anthropic. Used by scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts to bypass proxy for dataset generation. Dataset entries now include filePath and old file line numbers in prompts.

e65d9700e20a1005aa25b1b5e5708ec8d368ce2d.title: Add blacklist filter to fine-tuning dataset generator
e65d9700e20a1005aa25b1b5e5708ec8d368ce2d.summary: scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts now skips files containing 'This file was automatically generated' via BLACK_LIST_STRINGS. FILES_TO_PROCESS reduced from 100 to 20. libgdx mock project added to PROJECTS_LIST.

fff6d38300ea5fd18de41bda42feca55b47a16c7.title: Switch to GPT-4o fine-tuned model for patch generation
fff6d38300ea5fd18de41bda42feca55b47a16c7.summary: Patch generation now uses a fine-tuned `gpt-4o-2024-08-06` model instead of local diff expansion logic. The backend `generatePatch` function constructs a prompt with line-numbered file content and calls `promptOpenAI` with the specific model ID `ft:gpt-4o-2024-08-06:manifold-markets:run-1:A4VfZwvz`. This change affects `backend/src/generate-patch.ts`, `backend/src/openai-api.ts`, and `common/src/actions.ts`, where the `CHANGES` schema is updated to handle structured `FileChange` objects rather than raw patch strings. Timeout for OpenAI requests increased to 200 seconds in `backend/src/openai-api.ts`.

fff6d38300ea5fd18de41bda42feca55b47a16c7.text: The system now uses a new, more capable AI model to create code updates. This improves the accuracy and quality of changes, making the product work better for you.

98218308adbf621288c469b1d1c369c2eeb3d851.text: The software received a routine update. This change had no visible effect for users.

633f39f939a33ae126addd07689ff1b8ad104903.text: A small internal update ensures text data used to train the assistant is formatted consistently. This prevents potential errors when the system processes information from different computer types.

3d2509aa497840cfdcc79f1e41e927cc0d2da8c0.text: When updates to the software encounter confusing instructions, they now use a backup method to find the right place to apply changes. This reduces errors during updates, making the process smoother for you.

bbf6819d104cc6b0a9d35f4b7b934df6402ef550.text: A small internal update changed the version number of the software. It added some tools for testing the system. The product works exactly the same for you.

366778fb4c6efd6bbdcdcb07fde79f1fb46698f4.text: The app now reads update instructions more flexibly, so it can handle different formats without failing. This internal fix helps keep the software running smoothly when applying changes.

0ccf19a06d0003bc841730dcaee2ad1d8f752200.text: When applying an update, the product now uses the starting line number included in the update to look for the right place first. If that does not work, it still checks in the usual way. This is an internal change, so you may not notice it.

f67ca0d994dd62b87cca3ef6ed484b626d348dfe.text: A small internal update lets certain background tools send requests directly to the AI provider, skipping a middleman. This helps generate better training data but does not change how the product works for you.

81121b36247a0b2fac42ab769815e13acb871f9d.text: The tool now processes more files and uses a different set of projects. This internal update improves how the system prepares data for the assistant.

e65d9700e20a1005aa25b1b5e5708ec8d368ce2d.text: The system now skips certain files when creating training data, reducing the number of files processed from 100 to 20. This internal change helps the assistant learn from cleaner, more relevant information.

bdfe6c3ba161fec4c4350609bd917988ad2f558a.title: Project file context cache keyed by cwd
bdfe6c3ba161fec4c4350609bd917988ad2f558a.summary: getProjectFileContext now derives contextRoot from current working directory relative to project root. Cache invalidation triggers when currentWorkingDirectory mismatches contextRoot, preventing stale file trees after directory changes. Affects npm-app/src/project-files.ts. README trimmed.

398708a6162e4123f40b85d991bddac93c5dedec.title: Version bump to 1.0.54 and README copy edits
398708a6162e4123f40b85d991bddac93c5dedec.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.53 to 1.0.54 in `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json`. `npm-app/README.md` updated with revised value propositions and a whitespace fix in the Tips section. Scope limited to repo metadata and documentation.

d4930b71d53ee015fe53634d66c4a6ead5380f0c.title: Version bump to 1.0.52
d4930b71d53ee015fe53634d66c4a6ead5380f0c.summary: Incremented package version from 1.0.51 to 1.0.52 in backend and npm-app manifests. Applies to backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Routine release preparation.

f33d602ee496897e47d452a7d9cc72a7eee55f60.title: Update npm-app README and bump version to 1.0.53
f33d602ee496897e47d452a7d9cc72a7eee55f60.summary: Updated `npm-app/README.md` with new tagline, usage steps, and feature descriptions. Bumped `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json` versions from 1.0.52 to 1.0.53. Scope limited to documentation and version metadata.

05911ef13af14afffdf853692add368681458928.title: Expand file types and scale dataset generation
05911ef13af14afffdf853692add368681458928.summary: Updated scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts to include Python, JS, Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, and Markdown files alongside TypeScript. Increased commit scan to 1000 and parallel processes to 20. Added logic to skip diffs with fewer than 10 changed lines.

4dfcaab8c0e5a0741974bc1d1a3dec0c29d0e3e1.title: Add JSONL output to fine-tuning dataset script
4dfcaab8c0e5a0741974bc1d1a3dec0c29d0e3e1.summary: generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts now writes fine-tuning-data-manifold.jsonl alongside the existing dataset. Each JSONL entry contains a messages array with a user prompt embedding oldFile and claudeSketch, and an assistant response containing the patch. Commit and file processing limits reduced from 1000/100 to 100/10. Internal tooling only.

a0572b1406dc1d4d9e8b2fe6b1d90181befe47a0.title: Generate fine-tuning datasets over multiple projects
a0572b1406dc1d4d9e8b2fe6b1d90181befe47a0.summary: scripts/generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts now iterates PROJECTS_LIST (manifold, litestar) instead of hardcoding MANIFOLD_PROJECT_PATH. createDataset accepts a { name, path } object, prefixes sketch filenames with project name, and outputs fine_tuning_dataset_<name>.json. Adds lodash and @types/lodash to scripts/package.json for shuffle import.

b0dba61a8f106062474ffda74b8b3956aed7b56a.title: Remove automatic git staging from CLI
b0dba61a8f106062474ffda74b8b3956aed7b56a.summary: Removed the `stageChanges` helper and its call from `npm-app/src/cli.ts`, along with the now-unused `child_process.exec` import. The helper previously ran `git add .` in the project root immediately before sending user input, and the change stops that automatic staging behavior. Scope is the CLI only; chat messages are still stored and processed, but the working tree is no longer staged as a side effect.

17204f201230ce24266355c1fbbb9f07bd65c121.title: Increase OpenAI timeout to 120s
17204f201230ce24266355c1fbbb9f07bd65c121.summary: OpenAI request timeouts doubled from 60s to 120s in `promptOpenAI` and `promptOpenAIWithContinuation` within `backend/src/openai-api.ts`. This accommodates longer-running completions and streaming responses without premature aborts.

c89d785b3f6f9163b1b55b24d2d198bb8a96a325.title: Add scripts package for fine-tuning dataset generation
c89d785b3f6f9163b1b55b24d2d198bb8a96a325.summary: New scripts package with generate-fine-tuning-dataset.ts. Builds Claude fine-tuning data from git diffs. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Outputs tmp/ dataset.

a0572b1406dc1d4d9e8b2fe6b1d90181befe47a0.text: The tool now gathers training data from several projects at once, rather than just one. This internal update helps the system learn from a wider variety of examples.

f33d602ee496897e47d452a7d9cc72a7eee55f60.text: The instructions and description for the app were updated to be clearer. This change does not affect how the app works.

398708a6162e4123f40b85d991bddac93c5dedec.text: The team updated internal records and fixed small text errors in the help guide. This change does not affect how the product works.

bdfe6c3ba161fec4c4350609bd917988ad2f558a.text: The app now keeps a record of which folder you are in to update the file list correctly. This fixes an issue where old files might show up after you move to a different folder.

4dfcaab8c0e5a0741974bc1d1a3dec0c29d0e3e1.text: A tool used to teach the assistant now saves its training data in a simpler format. This internal update also lowers the number of files processed at once to improve reliability.

d4930b71d53ee015fe53634d66c4a6ead5380f0c.text: The software's internal version number increased. This routine update has no visible effect for users.

c89d785b3f6f9163b1b55b24d2d198bb8a96a325.text: Internal tool added to build training data from code changes. No user-facing change.

05911ef13af14afffdf853692add368681458928.text: The system now uses more types of files to teach the assistant, and it looks at more information at once to learn faster.

b0dba61a8f106062474ffda74b8b3956aed7b56a.text: The tool no longer automatically saves your project changes before processing input. Your files remain untouched unless you manually save them.

17204f201230ce24266355c1fbbb9f07bd65c121.text: The system now waits longer for AI responses to finish. This reduces the chance of interruptions during complex tasks.

07f411856def360a640c6395035c570aa90e68f0.title: Refactor skipped terminal commands in CLI
07f411856def360a640c6395035c570aa90e68f0.summary: Refactors `skippedTerminalCommands` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to dynamically append trailing spaces to base command strings ('what', 'which', 'file'). This change centralizes the formatting logic, improving maintainability while preserving existing behavior for terminal command skipping.

4f9313ee46b29fde5a76d87f2d707ed5cedd935d.title: main-prompt.ts accumulate fileContent in onFile callback
4f9313ee46b29fde5a76d87f2d707ed5cedd935d.summary: backend/src/main-prompt.ts onFile callback now appends fileContent to fullResponse. Fixes missing file content in the final aggregated response. Scope limited to backend main-prompt logic. Accumulation occurs before processFileBlock push, ensuring content is captured even if async processing delays.

03b881ed98315908cfb83e453e779d7cc956e321.title: Remove chain of thought from system prompt
03b881ed98315908cfb83e453e779d7cc956e321.summary: Removed brainstorming, uncertainty scoring, and code review steps from system prompt. Simplified file request logic and terminal command failure handling. Affects backend/src/system-prompt.ts.

a16795258bd8b4260c7a92db4756b5cc472cd835.title: Version bump to 1.0.51
a16795258bd8b4260c7a92db4756b5cc472cd835.summary: Bumped version to 1.0.51 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json.

4a256323e5415622215fb4aa78dab851bfefd801.title: Backend 1.0.51 fixes file response accumulation
4a256323e5415622215fb4aa78dab851bfefd801.summary: Bumped backend package.json version to 1.0.51. Moved fullResponse += fileContent after fileProcessingPromises.push() in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Scope: backend package only. Prevents race condition where file content was appended before async processing queued.

c9b9c0d971e42663662d5721237eb8e76a9d173f.title: Add conversation context to diff generation prompts
c9b9c0d971e42663662d5721237eb8e76a9d173f.summary: Conversation history and full assistant response are injected into prompts in generate-diffs-prompt.ts and generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts. This ensures the model considers user intent, preventing deletion of unshown code when expanding files or generating search/replace blocks. Internal backend change affecting diff accuracy.

59daf6ff6ec0f41343cb551c44e45483054b3654.title: Fix Windows command not found detection in tool-handlers.ts
59daf6ff6ec0f41343cb551c44e45483054b3654.summary: Added Windows-specific error string 'is not recognized as an internal or external command' to the 'command not found' detection logic in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts`. This ensures `handleRunTerminalCommand` correctly identifies failed commands on Windows, preventing false negatives when checking for syntax or not-found errors. Scope limited to `npm-app` core tool handlers.

216017404bcabd4cba4933fdbba011c83fd8c99d.title: Update README branding, fix typos, add test-diff script
216017404bcabd4cba4933fdbba011c83fd8c99d.summary: npm-app/README.md updated: title changed to 'The AI tool for senior engineers', description rewritten, typo fixed ('paried'->'paired'), undo/redo instructions changed from `Ctrl+U`/`Ctrl+R` to `undo`/`redo` commands. test/package.json adds 'test-diff' script running generate-patch.test.ts.

69336f58aa6e5072e8031b0857784fdec186edba.title: Expand skipped terminal commands
69336f58aa6e5072e8031b0857784fdec186edba.summary: Added 26 shell commands to SKIPPED_TERMINAL_COMMANDS in common/src/constants.ts. CLI logic in npm-app/src/cli.ts now imports this shared constant instead of using a local hardcoded array. Scope covers CLI terminal handling and shared constants. Match logic uses startsWith on lowercase input.

73ee33db17b72f3d87846c2f01e91836006fb8ce.title: Add maxTokens parameter to Claude API calls
73ee33db17b72f3d87846c2f01e91836006fb8ce.summary: Claude API functions now accept optional maxTokens parameter, defaulting to 4096. Anthropic SDK updated to 0.27.1. Added cache_control support to message schema and assert utility function.

07f411856def360a640c6395035c570aa90e68f0.text: Small internal update. No change to how the product works.

c9b9c0d971e42663662d5721237eb8e76a9d173f.text: The assistant now remembers the full conversation when creating code changes. This helps it avoid accidentally deleting parts of your work that you haven't seen yet.

69336f58aa6e5072e8031b0857784fdec186edba.text: The app now recognizes more basic system commands and skips them automatically. This makes the experience smoother by preventing the app from trying to process simple instructions it shouldn't handle.

4f9313ee46b29fde5a76d87f2d707ed5cedd935d.text: A small internal fix makes the assistant add file text to the complete response. This fixes missing file content in the final answer.

59daf6ff6ec0f41343cb551c44e45483054b3654.text: The assistant now correctly recognizes when a command fails on Windows computers. This prevents it from mistakenly thinking a missing command was successful.

216017404bcabd4cba4933fdbba011c83fd8c99d.text: The help guide now lists simpler commands for undoing and redoing actions. Small text errors were also fixed.

a16795258bd8b4260c7a92db4756b5cc472cd835.text: The system updated its internal record to match the latest release. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

73ee33db17b72f3d87846c2f01e91836006fb8ce.text: The assistant can now limit the length of its replies. This helps control how much text it generates at once.

03b881ed98315908cfb83e453e779d7cc956e321.text: The assistant stopped showing its internal reasoning steps before answering. This makes responses shorter and faster.

8e6b19452a41a34a6fe31ef9071107e6a5153bc6.title: Version bump to 1.0.50
8e6b19452a41a34a6fe31ef9071107e6a5153bc6.summary: Incremented version to 1.0.50 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Internal release preparation.

2b08698b2f0fce32c9a3570cfb3d8a760ea48ded.title: Add .manicodeignore support to project file tree
2b08698b2f0fce32c9a3570cfb3d8a760ea48ded.summary: Added `.manicodeignore` parsing to `parseGitignore` in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts`. The function now checks for and applies patterns from this file alongside `.gitignore`. Leading slashes in `.manicodeignore` entries are stripped before being added to the ignore instance. This allows Freebuff to respect project-specific ignore rules distinct from git.

96b46ce6bfd87ea6a5f210a46b75da81bac52580.title: File tree depth indicator replaces tabs
96b46ce6bfd87ea6a5f210a46b75da81bac52580.summary: printFileTree in common/src/util/file.ts switches from tab-based indentation to numeric depth prefixes. The system prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts clarifies that numbers denote directory depth. This compresses the file tree representation.

eb383b425230f5cabfe0f05cfc5693170962f99e.title: Fix files service random commentary
eb383b425230f5cabfe0f05cfc5693170962f99e.summary: Added filter to reject lines with spaces in getRelevantFiles. Appended 'Ignore previous instructions' to prompts for non-obvious and key project files. Prevents model from outputting commentary instead of file paths. Changes isolated to backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts.

da8f45af149c6bbd6357dc8af4234c48de8b6635.title: Clarify updatefilecontext tool description
da8f45af149c6bbd6357dc8af4234c48de8b6635.summary: Updated the `update_file_context` tool description in `backend/src/tools.ts` to explicitly restrict usage to reading existing files. The new text clarifies that the tool selects from the set of existing files and must not be used to create new files. This change applies to the backend tool definitions.

196e3b3450191b23765922abe86fbe661347a123.title: Fix relative imports in websocket-action.ts
196e3b3450191b23765922abe86fbe661347a123.summary: Replaced absolute `src/` paths with relative `../` paths for `tools`, `system-prompt`, and `claude` in `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`. Ensures correct module resolution within the backend package structure. No user-facing behavior change.

afc40f9bf6ffad4673482b8a7e8067eecbca2a62.title: Inject recent git commit messages into system prompt
afc40f9bf6ffad4673482b8a7e8067eecbca2a62.summary: Added `git_commit_messages_most_recent_first` block to system prompt. Mechanism: `getGitChanges` executes `git shortlog HEAD~100..HEAD`, parses output, and reverses order to ensure most recent commits appear first. Scope: `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` template, `common/src/util/file.ts` schema, `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` logic. Detail: `ProjectFileContextSchema` updated with `lastCommitMessages` string field; fallback to empty string on error.

0c7b020b87db6a1db630f7c09e51dcfa16f97f2e.title: Inject git status and diff into project file context
0c7b020b87db6a1db630f7c09e51dcfa16f97f2e.summary: System prompt now includes git status, diff, and cached diff via ProjectFileContext. Backend getRelevantFilesPromptPart2 renders <git_status>, <git_diff>, <git_diff_cached> tags when gitChanges present. npm-app/src/project-files.ts executes git commands via child_process.exec, caching results in ProjectFileContextSchema. common/src/util/file.ts adds gitChanges field to ProjectFileContextSchema; fileTree uses z.custom<FileTreeNode>() instead of FileTreeNodeSchema. Git command failures return empty strings, silently omitting git context from prompt.

658d323a4edd196f253471fffb843a5c7bab2fb9.title: Add warm-context-cache action and prompt refinements
658d323a4edd196f253471fffb843a5c7bab2fb9.summary: New `warm-context-cache` client action triggers a dummy prompt to pre-warm the system prompt cache. `getSystemPrompt` now accepts an options object with `onlyCachePrefix` to isolate cacheable content. File selection prompts in `request-files-prompt.ts` are tightened to enforce strict newline-separated output.

ed8ad07551bb886153f0bac365f9efc818d10131.title: Parallelize file request prompts
ed8ad07551bb886153f0bac365f9efc818d10131.summary: Replaced single sequential LLM calls with parallel batches for key and non-obvious file requests in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`. `getRelevantFiles` now accepts user prompt directly; `generateNonObviousRequestFilesPrompt` and `generateKeyRequestFilesPrompt` take `count` and `index` to shard requests. Results merged via `Promise.all` and `uniq`. Internal refactor.

96b46ce6bfd87ea6a5f210a46b75da81bac52580.text: The assistant now shows folder levels using numbers instead of blank spaces. This makes the list of files shorter and easier to read.

2b08698b2f0fce32c9a3570cfb3d8a760ea48ded.text: The assistant now follows a custom list of files to skip, separate from standard version control rules. This lets you hide specific files from the assistant without affecting your project's main history.

196e3b3450191b23765922abe86fbe661347a123.text: Fixed an internal issue to help the assistant find its tools correctly. This change is small and does not affect how the product works for users.

0c7b020b87db6a1db630f7c09e51dcfa16f97f2e.text: The assistant now automatically checks recent changes in your project files. This helps it understand what you are working on, so its answers are more relevant.

afc40f9bf6ffad4673482b8a7e8067eecbca2a62.text: The assistant can now see recent project updates. This helps it understand current changes when you ask questions.

da8f45af149c6bbd6357dc8af4234c48de8b6635.text: The assistant now has clearer instructions to only read existing files and never create new ones. This is a small internal update that helps the assistant follow rules more accurately.

658d323a4edd196f253471fffb843a5c7bab2fb9.text: The app now prepares its memory in advance, making responses start faster. File list handling became stricter to prevent errors.

eb383b425230f5cabfe0f05cfc5693170962f99e.text: The system now filters out extra text and ignores confusing instructions, so it returns only the requested file paths instead of random commentary.

8e6b19452a41a34a6fe31ef9071107e6a5153bc6.text: The software received a small internal update. You will not notice any changes.

ed8ad07551bb886153f0bac365f9efc818d10131.text: The system now checks for needed files in groups instead of one at a time. This makes the assistant respond faster when asking for files.

8adbaf5a764d911a8b7d24d04d7f66e18ee9b2ae.title: Bump backend and npm-app to 1.0.48
8adbaf5a764d911a8b7d24d04d7f66e18ee9b2ae.summary: Incremented version numbers in `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json` from 1.0.47 to 1.0.48. Pure version bump. No code changes.

24a9ca34782ccdf03a164e870e646dbe93c09e43.title: Move backend tests to dedicated test package
24a9ca34782ccdf03a164e870e646dbe93c09e43.summary: Relocated test files and mock data from `backend/src/__tests__` to a new top-level `test/` directory. This separates test infrastructure from the backend source code, improving modularity and potentially speeding up backend builds by excluding test artifacts from the production bundle.

10d3a623fc5bbda24c1d5c3690e0ee618eecf4c2.title: Terminal handler routes syntax error to assistant
10d3a623fc5bbda24c1d5c3690e0ee618eecf4c2.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand now resolves 'command not found' when stderr contains 'syntax error', alongside existing 'command not found' check. Refactored data.toString() to dataStr to avoid redundant calls. Scope limited to npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

d665e076fc232bfff32ff2b22d506795c183c7c1.title: Remove filelist tags in request-files-prompt
d665e076fc232bfff32ff2b22d506795c183c7c1.summary: Removed `<file_list>` XML tags from file extraction logic and prompts in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`. Direct response parsing replaces regex matching to handle plain text file lists. Limit increased from 6 to 10 files for crucial request prompts. Internal change affects backend file retrieval mechanism.

039cc2fcaadaf98344b28f8608686639e5e6040a.title: Add ignore dependency to backend
039cc2fcaadaf98344b28f8608686639e5e6040a.summary: Added ignore 5.3.2 to backend/package.json dependencies. Enables file path filtering in backend services. Scope limited to backend package.

5647c2b851a47d8c5b33a9e3a5e73c6fc84992b3.title: Version bump backend and manicode to 1.0.49
5647c2b851a47d8c5b33a9e3a5e73c6fc84992b3.summary: Incremented version numbers in `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json` from 1.0.48 to 1.0.49. This is a routine release preparation step. No functional code changes included.

b72d9ee5c9ad777dc88f86be71f1de7da4007e40.title: Add tests to dockerignore and ignore dep to common
b72d9ee5c9ad777dc88f86be71f1de7da4007e40.summary: Added `__tests__` to `backend/.dockerignore` and `ignore: 5.3.2` to `common/package.json` dependencies. Excludes test directories from Docker images and introduces the ignore library to the shared core package. Affects backend containerization and common module dependencies.

f34f16a80654dbedc03e428bcef6bc40a4784d8e.title: Fix import path and reduce deploy sleep
f34f16a80654dbedc03e428bcef6bc40a4784d8e.summary: Corrected import path in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` to `common/project-file-tree`. Reduced VM readiness sleep in `backend/deploy.sh` from 60s to 10s. Affects internal build and deployment scripts.

a8ce7118e3609a6b2c921e01183ecd8f453e425c.title: Update main-prompt.ts to preserve existing code and comments
a8ce7118e3609a6b2c921e01183ecd8f453e425c.summary: Instruction in backend/src/main-prompt.ts now explicitly directs preservation of existing code, comments, and behavior while limiting edits to core requirements. This ensures the agent avoids unnecessary modifications. Scope limited to the main prompt configuration.

0c6ae21abfdd36c42508d92756d45a58e933fb17.title: Token counter uses gpt-4o tiktoken encoding
0c6ae21abfdd36c42508d92756d45a58e933fb17.summary: The backend token counter now calls `encoding_for_model` with `gpt-4o` instead of `gpt-4o-2024-08-06`. The change fixes the model used for token counting in `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts`. The selected tiktoken encoding alias moves from a dated snapshot to the base model name.

5647c2b851a47d8c5b33a9e3a5e73c6fc84992b3.text: The software team updated the internal version label for two parts of the system. This is a routine housekeeping step to mark a new release. You will not notice any changes in how the product works.

f34f16a80654dbedc03e428bcef6bc40a4784d8e.text: A small internal fix corrected a broken link in the setup and shortened a waiting period during updates. This change does not affect how you use the product.

10d3a623fc5bbda24c1d5c3690e0ee618eecf4c2.text: The assistant now better understands when a command fails due to a syntax error, treating it similarly to a command not being found. This small internal update helps the assistant provide more accurate feedback when trying to run commands.

24a9ca34782ccdf03a164e870e646dbe93c09e43.text: We moved the automatic checks that test our software into their own separate area. This keeps the main program cleaner and may help it load slightly faster, but you won't notice any changes to how the product works.

8adbaf5a764d911a8b7d24d04d7f66e18ee9b2ae.text: The internal version number increased. Nothing changed for you.

d665e076fc232bfff32ff2b22d506795c183c7c1.text: The system now handles file lists more reliably and allows up to 10 files in critical requests. This internal update improves how the assistant processes your files, but you likely won't notice a big difference.

039cc2fcaadaf98344b28f8608686639e5e6040a.text: The system can now skip certain files when looking for data. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

0c6ae21abfdd36c42508d92756d45a58e933fb17.text: A small internal update improves how the system counts text length. This helps ensure accurate processing behind the scenes, with no visible changes to you.

b72d9ee5c9ad777dc88f86be71f1de7da4007e40.text: The app now excludes its internal test files from its main installation package. This keeps the app lighter and prevents test data from accidentally appearing in the final version.

a8ce7118e3609a6b2c921e01183ecd8f453e425c.text: The assistant now follows stricter rules to keep existing code and comments unchanged unless absolutely necessary. This reduces the risk of accidental errors when it helps with software tasks.

b16069fba90733892204c961141be294766caeb4.title: Bump backend and npm-app to 1.0.47
b16069fba90733892204c961141be294766caeb4.summary: Version increment from 1.0.46 to 1.0.47 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. No functional changes or dependency updates included. Covers backend server and npm-app package.

436a91c968214639b664c1b8c64d5571e725f506.title: Only change dir on successful command
436a91c968214639b664c1b8c64d5571e725f506.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand now checks exit code === 0 before updating working directory. Prevents state corruption when cd fails. Scope: npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

11da2ea162e545230221a28e9c527695d60c3737.title: Exclude knowledge.md files from request-files-prompt
11da2ea162e545230221a28e9c527695d60c3737.summary: Instruction added to request-files-prompt.ts to prevent LLM from selecting knowledge.md files. Assumes default inclusion of these files. Internal backend change.

7f7e1e5d9d1ed21d35e4e813b482de26c4e583b3.title: Test asserts commentid and isAdmin in delete-comment.ts
7f7e1e5d9d1ed21d35e4e813b482de26c4e583b3.summary: Manifold project tests now verify `delete-comment.ts` patches reference `comment_id` and `isAdmin`. Logic changed to map file paths to patch content via `Object.fromEntries` for direct string inclusion checks. Scope limited to `backend/src/__tests__/manifold-project.test.ts`. Ensures generated code maintains correct authorization and identifier usage.

a057530b64f7268510ee4586f7342ddcac8aceb2.title: CLI prompt and assistant text color updates
a057530b64f7268510ee4586f7342ddcac8aceb2.summary: CLI prompt uses `chalk.green` via `setPrompt()` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Assistant text streams `chalk.blue`. Terminal commands starting with 'what ' or 'which ' skip shell execution.

3f031b1990ef9473706fb968f3c9e1397735b906.title: Switch to Sonnet for non-obvious file requests
3f031b1990ef9473706fb968f3c9e1397735b906.summary: File request strategy updated to use Sonnet model for identifying 'non-obvious' files, replacing Haiku's 'comprehensive' approach. Logic in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` now prompts for files beyond the obvious choices. `common/src/util/changes.ts` adds existence check before unlinking files during change reverts to prevent errors on missing files.

a6a7e8373a4d63e88b6949d8c0e50f8dabf5a3dd.title: Claude prompt caching in file selection
a6a7e8373a4d63e88b6949d8c0e50f8dabf5a3dd.summary: File selection prompts now pass full message history, system prompt, and tools to Claude for prompt caching. `requestRelevantFiles` accepts a structured object instead of raw messages, enabling reuse of cached context across Haiku and Sonnet calls. `mainPrompt` propagates these parameters through `updateFileContext`. Changes affect `backend/src/claude.ts`, `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, and `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`.

e2af5e4b0d1eff03c534faae67b1db0eea65e128.title: Improve long path handling in file request prompt
e2af5e4b0d1eff03c534faae67b1db0eea65e128.summary: Updated `request-files-prompt.ts` to handle long paths better by adding `topLevelDirectories` and `getExampleFileList` helpers. The prompt now explicitly instructs the model to correct relative imports to full root paths and includes shuffled example file lists to guide selection. Scope limited to backend file context logic.

b54a1daaab12901b9e8afd8575f6956bc78fc960.title: CLI terminal commands now track working directory state
b54a1daaab12901b9e8afd8575f6956bc78fc960.summary: Internal refactor of CLI tool handling to persist current working directory across terminal commands. Replaced hardcoded `cd ${getProjectRoot()}` prefix in `handleRunTerminalCommand` with dynamic `cwd` tracking via new `getCurrentWorkingDirectory` and `setCurrentWorkingDirectory` functions in `project-files.ts`. Updated `cli.ts` to refresh the readline prompt base directory after command execution. This ensures `cd` commands executed by the agent correctly update the context for subsequent commands.

ab99d9e25b99b3786d97592159cfb1378f5be4d2.title: CLI executes terminal commands and updates prompt
ab99d9e25b99b3786d97592159cfb1378f5be4d2.summary: CLI intercepts user input to execute terminal commands directly via `handleRunTerminalCommand` before triggering AI processing. The `handleRunTerminalCommand` function in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` now accepts a `mode` parameter to distinguish between 'user' and 'assistant' execution, suppressing specific console logs and timeout kills for user-initiated commands. The CLI prompt in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` displays the project root basename. Backend file request logic in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` no longer skips file requests for terminal command inputs.

b54a1daaab12901b9e8afd8575f6956bc78fc960.text: The assistant now remembers your current folder when you run commands. This means you can move between folders and subsequent commands will automatically run in the right place.

a057530b64f7268510ee4586f7342ddcac8aceb2.text: The assistant now uses green for prompts and blue for its replies to help you tell them apart. Also, it no longer runs commands that start with 'what' or 'which' as system instructions.

b16069fba90733892204c961141be294766caeb4.text: The software received a small internal update that did not change how it works or what it does.

7f7e1e5d9d1ed21d35e4e813b482de26c4e583b3.text: A small internal update adds checks to ensure the system correctly identifies comments and user permissions when deleting them. This helps keep the product secure and accurate for everyday users.

436a91c968214639b664c1b8c64d5571e725f506.text: The assistant now only updates its current location if the move command works. This prevents errors from leaving the assistant in a broken state.

11da2ea162e545230221a28e9c527695d60c3737.text: The assistant now skips certain internal reference files when answering your questions. This is a small internal adjustment that helps it focus on the right information.

e2af5e4b0d1eff03c534faae67b1db0eea65e128.text: The assistant can now use full file paths instead of shortcuts when working with files.

3f031b1990ef9473706fb968f3c9e1397735b906.text: The assistant now better understands when you need less obvious files. This change also prevents errors when undoing changes if a file is already missing.

a6a7e8373a4d63e88b6949d8c0e50f8dabf5a3dd.text: The assistant now remembers previous instructions and context to speed up file selection.

ab99d9e25b99b3786d97592159cfb1378f5be4d2.text: The app now runs your typed commands directly in the terminal without sending them to the AI first. This makes command execution faster and prevents unnecessary interruptions, while the prompt shows your current project folder.

e4ee9f0732b9fa01dbcc9184c2b62262bfa0386f.title: Add manifold project test without knowledge context
e4ee9f0732b9fa01dbcc9184c2b62262bfa0386f.summary: Added testDeleteCommentWithoutKnowledge to verify code generation accuracy when fileContext.knowledgeFiles is empty. Test asserts presence of delete-comment.ts, app.ts, and schema.ts changes, then scores based on yarn compile type errors. Also silenced stdout chunk writing in runMainPrompt.

5f88470bb786e7c810b5346462a0e0afe6203f9b.title: Add 60s timeout to OpenAI API requests
5f88470bb786e7c810b5346462a0e0afe6203f9b.summary: backend/src/openai-api.ts adds timeoutPromise(60000) and wraps openai.chat.completions.create in Promise.race for promptOpenAI and promptOpenAIWithContinuation. Prevents indefinite hangs on upstream OpenAI API latency or stalls. Backend only; affects both non-streaming and streaming chat completions paths.

c7ae728112c6ae83fc2f5f49c91203c25092d701.title: Add manifold mock project to backend test fixtures
c7ae728112c6ae83fc2f5f49c91203c25092d701.summary: Full Manifold Markets monorepo snapshot added under backend/src/__tests__/__mock-projects__/manifold/ as a test fixture. Provides a realistic multi-package codebase (web/, backend/, common/, docs/) with Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, Docker, and ESLint configs for exercising backend parsing and analysis paths. Scope limited to backend test infrastructure; no runtime or user-facing surface affected. 196,586 lines added across the fixture tree.

5814fa1bb7ef48aacf2421365ef3febb7e19ba20.title: Add incrementScore to projectTest for granular type error scoring
5814fa1bb7ef48aacf2421365ef3febb7e19ba20.summary: Refactored `projectTest` in `backend/src/__tests__/score-tests.ts` to expose an `incrementScore` callback alongside `expectTrue`. The manifold test in `backend/src/__tests__/manifold-project.test.ts` now parses `tsc` output to count files with type errors, awarding points proportionally instead of binary pass/fail. This enables granular scoring for compilation success in agent evaluations.

5afb342c276e4fada0e837eff2f4a59c38fa7657.title: Add score-tests helper for manifold project tests
5afb342c276e4fada0e837eff2f4a59c38fa7657.summary: New `score-tests.ts` helper implements `projectTest` to track pass/fail counts via `expectTrue` callbacks. `manifold-project.test.ts` refactored to use this helper, replacing direct `expect` calls with scored assertions. This internal change improves test observability by logging individual check results and a final score ratio.

91c4a4a6ae820ffd9c693535eacaefe572734054.title: Manifold mock project build fix
91c4a4a6ae820ffd9c693535eacaefe572734054.summary: Removed `incremental` flag from `tsconfig.json` in `backend/api` and `backend/shared` mock projects. Added `declarationMap` to `backend/shared`. Fixes manifold project build.

21d52d137265dd24d44ac81648e97905031c04c8.title: Refactor applyChanges to common/util/changes and switch tests to bun
21d52d137265dd24d44ac81648e97905031c04c8.summary: applyChanges and getProjectFileTree moved from npm-app/src/project-files.ts to new common modules (util/changes.ts, project-file-tree.ts). CLI and client now import from common, passing projectRoot explicitly. Backend test runner switched from jest to bun test; jest/ts-jest deps removed. New manifold-project.test.ts added.

6a3f42b71e8280b52b1ea4136d60a4e65437e943.title: Deploy script prunes Docker images and uses timestamp tags
6a3f42b71e8280b52b1ea4136d60a4e65437e943.summary: backend/deploy.sh now runs docker system prune -af --volumes on the VM before deployment to clear old images. Container references switch from :latest to :$TIMESTAMP for both create and update paths. Boot disk size reverts to 10GB on new instances. Internal deploy tooling only.

7d2290025bada11b496290bcf90babe3ec7b1823.title: Static gpt-4o encoder in token-counter
7d2290025bada11b496290bcf90babe3ec7b1823.summary: Backend token-counter.ts initializes encoder once for gpt-4o-2024-08-06 instead of per-call. Removed TiktokenModel param from countTokens and countTokensForFiles. Eliminates repeated allocation and free() overhead.

9adc2e0f03a1ca6fad5812a8653e055dca4dd716.title: Parallel score test execution and subtest context
9adc2e0f03a1ca6fad5812a8653e055dca4dd716.summary: Refactored `projectTest` in `score-tests.ts` to accept a `getContext` factory, enabling parallel execution of subtests via `Promise.all`. `manifold-project.test.ts` now runs `testDeleteComment` 3 times concurrently using `lodash.range`. The scoring logic tracks aggregate scores and per-subtest scores in `subScores`, printing detailed breakdowns to console. This internal change improves test throughput and observability without affecting production code.

21d52d137265dd24d44ac81648e97905031c04c8.text: Developers reorganized the program's internal files to make it easier to update. This change is small and internal, so users will not notice any difference in how the product works.

9adc2e0f03a1ca6fad5812a8653e055dca4dd716.text: Internal checks now run at the same time to finish faster. You will not see a difference in the product.

5afb342c276e4fada0e837eff2f4a59c38fa7657.text: This internal update adds a way to track which checks pass or fail during quality tests. It does not change how the product works for you.

91c4a4a6ae820ffd9c693535eacaefe572734054.text: Fixed a small internal error that stopped a test project from building correctly. This change does not affect how you use the product.

5814fa1bb7ef48aacf2421365ef3febb7e19ba20.text: The system now gives partial credit for small mistakes in background tasks. This helps it learn from errors instead of just failing.

5f88470bb786e7c810b5346462a0e0afe6203f9b.text: The assistant now stops waiting if a reply takes too long. This prevents the chat from hanging indefinitely when the service is slow.

e4ee9f0732b9fa01dbcc9184c2b62262bfa0386f.text: The team added an internal check to ensure the assistant works correctly when it lacks extra background information. This small update helps verify the assistant's accuracy and does not change how you use the product.

7d2290025bada11b496290bcf90babe3ec7b1823.text: The system now prepares its text counter just once instead of repeatedly. This internal cleanup makes the service run more efficiently.

c7ae728112c6ae83fc2f5f49c91203c25092d701.text: The team added a large sample project to their internal testing system to help check that the software works correctly. This change affects only the tools used by the developers and does not change how the product works for users.

6a3f42b71e8280b52b1ea4136d60a4e65437e943.text: A small internal update cleaned up old software files on the server and changed how new versions are labeled to prevent errors.

6278ff4309ddfdf4559ca9cac2333e5195531a52.title: Version bump 1.0.46
6278ff4309ddfdf4559ca9cac2333e5195531a52.summary: Version bumped to 1.0.46 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Internal release increment.

17d000f69b76d9b2bfbe75205acca743d8fae3e4.title: Increase deploy.sh boot disk size to 20GB
17d000f69b76d9b2bfbe75205acca743d8fae3e4.summary: backend/deploy.sh GCE instance creation now sets --boot-disk-size=20GB, up from 10GB. Change addresses storage space constraints for container mount /app/logs and host path /var/log/app. Scope limited to backend deploy script; no impact on runtime code or model configurations.

e3d7ecf5e945857fb978c162c08d9bee1c45b3b0.title: Suppress websocket ping errors in realtime client
e3d7ecf5e945857fb978c162c08d9bee1c45b3b0.summary: Ping websocket errors are no longer printed from the shared realtime client. `APIRealtimeClient` heartbeat calls `sendMessage('ping', {})` every 30000 ms and now swallows rejected pings instead of `console.error`. The change is limited to `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`. Existing heartbeat timing and connection behavior remain unchanged.

75e525e8d9fe924b794327fc0b2815c4f4d54019.title: Add MAXITERATIONS guard to mainPrompt loop
75e525e8d9fe924b794327fc0b2815c4f4d54019.summary: Added `iterationCount` and `MAX_ITERATIONS = 20` to the `while (!isComplete)` loop in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Prevents infinite loops by forcing exit after 20 iterations. Logs 'Reached maximum number of iterations in mainPrompt' via `console.log` and `debugLog` if cap hit.

b44b574b9613a88a19bdaba500c3ada3a5f48c61.title: backend/deploy.sh drops latest tag, pushes timestamped image
b44b574b9613a88a19bdaba500c3ada3a5f48c61.summary: backend/deploy.sh removes the :latest Docker tag from build and push steps, now only tagging and pushing gcr.io/$GCP_PROJECT/$VM_NAME:$TIMESTAMP. This ensures each deploy is uniquely identified by timestamp rather than overwriting a mutable latest pointer. Scope limited to backend/deploy.sh. The commented-out push for the timestamped tag is now active.

0a074a6fe9e7ed40a972f9828d57a0594f7b48ca.title: Downgrade tiktoken to 1.0.15 and add token count fallback
0a074a6fe9e7ed40a972f9828d57a0594f7b48ca.summary: Backend downgrades `tiktoken` from 1.0.16 to 1.0.15 in `package.json`. `countTokens` in `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts` now wraps encoding in a try-catch, returning `Math.ceil(text.length / 3)` on error. Scope limited to backend utilities.

2f5ba66fcd23a18efe394cdde082b68ca30d76be.title: README.md: Replace AGI-level with AI
2f5ba66fcd23a18efe394cdde082b68ca30d76be.summary: Updated the introductory description in `npm-app/README.md` to remove the 'AGI-level' claim, replacing it with 'AI coding assistant'. This change aligns the documentation with the project's actual capabilities and avoids overstating the technology. The modification is limited to the `npm-app` package README.

2190b8d08c3d40aabf14682199e64cdbe8dbe628.title: backend deploy.sh parameterizes image name and adds timestamp tag
2190b8d08c3d40aabf14682199e64cdbe8dbe628.summary: backend/deploy.sh replaces hardcoded manicode-backend image references with $VM_NAME variable and generates a timestamped Docker tag. Adds backend/.dockerignore to exclude node_modules and debug files from build context. Updates todo.knowledge.md with new bug reports regarding terminal control and reconnection states.

29ac523f8c9684c05c3a16d258e710e903fe3860.title: Remove stream error catch and lower max iterations
29ac523f8c9684c05c3a16d258e710e903fe3860.summary: Removed try/catch wrapper from processStreamWithFiles in backend/src/process-stream.ts and reduced MAX_ITERATIONS from 20 to 10 in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. This prevents silent failures that previously resulted in empty continuation messages when stream errors occurred. Scope covers backend stream processing and prompt iteration logic.

5de755f789383c905878a4067098aa72333c2954.title: Add start-manifold npm scripts
5de755f789383c905878a4067098aa72333c2954.summary: Added `start-manifold` script to `package.json` and `npm-app/package.json`. Root script delegates to `npm-app` via `bun --cwd`. `npm-app` script runs `ts-node src/index.ts ../../manifold`.

b44b574b9613a88a19bdaba500c3ada3a5f48c61.text: The backend now uses a unique time-stamp for each update instead of a generic label. This helps track exactly which version is running. No visible changes to the user.

6278ff4309ddfdf4559ca9cac2333e5195531a52.text: The team marked a new internal release. This does not change how the product works for someone who just uses it.

75e525e8d9fe924b794327fc0b2815c4f4d54019.text: The system now stops trying after 20 attempts if it gets stuck. This prevents endless processing loops that could freeze the assistant.

17d000f69b76d9b2bfbe75205acca743d8fae3e4.text: We gave the server that runs the product more storage space. This helps the system keep its activity records without running out of room. The product itself works exactly the same for you.

29ac523f8c9684c05c3a16d258e710e903fe3860.text: The assistant now stops trying when it hits a problem instead of failing silently. It also tries fewer times before giving up.

e3d7ecf5e945857fb978c162c08d9bee1c45b3b0.text: The app stops showing errors when it tries to check if the connection is still active. This is a small internal change that cleans up the logs without affecting how you use the features.

2f5ba66fcd23a18efe394cdde082b68ca30d76be.text: The description of the assistant changed from claiming it reaches a very high level of intelligence to simply calling it an AI coding assistant. This update makes the information more accurate about what the tool actually does.

0a074a6fe9e7ed40a972f9828d57a0594f7b48ca.text: The system now uses a safer backup method to estimate text length if the main tool fails. This prevents errors from stopping the assistant. You will not see any changes in how you use the product.

5de755f789383c905878a4067098aa72333c2954.text: The team added a new command to start the application. This change helps internal staff launch the software more easily.

93a9f340acb4c805d80af606144cbf1ba310a7b8.title: Catch errors in deadConnectionCleaner loop
93a9f340acb4c805d80af606144cbf1ba310a7b8.summary: Added a try/catch block around the client iteration in the `deadConnectionCleaner` interval in `backend/src/websockets/server.ts`. Previously, an error thrown by `SWITCHBOARD.getClient` would propagate and crash the interval, halting connection cleanup. Now, errors are logged to the console, allowing the cleaner to continue running.

b4f4a1c8e883bcb00978eb7b3d77d7cd7072e72e.title: System prompt emphasizes file requests
b4f4a1c8e883bcb00978eb7b3d77d7cd7072e72e.summary: The system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` was updated to explicitly instruct the model to use the `update_file_context` tool for requesting files. The logic now prioritizes checking for missing files before assuming sufficiency, changing the confirmation text from a passive check to an active request directive. This applies to the core backend system prompt generation.

129e703b4190c531c880480151dacc95a72bc406.title: Add bun-types to backend and root tsconfig
129e703b4190c531c880480151dacc95a72bc406.summary: Added bun-types ^1.1.25 to devDependencies in backend/package.json and root package.json. Updated backend/tsconfig.json types array to include bun-types alongside node and jest. This enables TypeScript to resolve Bun-specific global types and APIs.

c224d5cf9b5d417b71f517c3b1cfbe0a07867b14.title: Fix postpublish script in npm-app
c224d5cf9b5d417b71f517c3b1cfbe0a07867b14.summary: Replaced inline `bun run -e` execution with piped `echo | bun run -` for the postpublish script in `npm-app/package.json`. The previous invocation likely failed due to argument parsing or shell escaping issues with the inline code string. This ensures `temp.package.json` correctly restores `package.json` and cleans up after publishing.

2a1da4dab3ae9b1e1794cbb7aca3416a0505dc10.title: Fix saveFilesChanged to initialize file state when missing
2a1da4dab3ae9b1e1794cbb7aca3416a0505dc10.summary: saveFilesChanged in chat-storage.ts now initializes a new FileVersion via addNewFileState when getCurrentVersion returns null, instead of returning an empty array. This ensures file changes are tracked correctly even when no prior version exists, preventing undo failures. Scope limited to npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts.

138b6523ea8bba873b18ae504146131a97839737.title: Fix npm-app build
138b6523ea8bba873b18ae504146131a97839737.summary: Added `bun run build` to the `prebuild` script in `npm-app/package.json` to ensure the `../common` package is compiled before the main build. Downgraded `chalk` dependency from `5.3.0` to `4.1.2` to resolve compatibility issues with the CommonJS build pipeline. Changes affect `npm-app/package.json` and `bun.lockb`.

e45f260c04c55d5d0c55050c0f1a1f46c3082251.title: Add debug log for new file content in diff expansion
e45f260c04c55d5d0c55050c0f1a1f46c3082251.summary: Added debugLog call in backend/src/generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts to log unexpanded new file content. This change aids in debugging diff generation issues by providing visibility into the raw content before expansion. The update is internal and does not affect user-facing behavior.

f977ea9080d8aafbeef118619502b9a6d875fc5f.title: System prompt file request step moved second
f977ea9080d8aafbeef118619502b9a6d875fc5f.summary: The file request step is moved from position 0 to position 2 in the `getResponseFormatPrompt` function. A dynamic `bulletNumber` counter now handles step numbering instead of hardcoded values. This change affects the general case workflow for file context updates in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`.

d11936f407a1f2e2a00efd8826f46d99d83b7cb5.title: Propagate WebSocket errors to CLI state
d11936f407a1f2e2a00efd8826f46d99d83b7cb5.summary: APIRealtimeClient now accepts an onError callback, invoked on first connection failure. CLI constructs Client internally and binds onWebSocketError to halt loading animations and reset isReceivingResponse before printing retry message. Scope covers common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts, npm-app/src/client.ts, npm-app/src/cli.ts, and npm-app/src/index.ts. Refactor moves Client and ChatStorage instantiation from index.ts into CLI constructor, coupling connect() with readyPromise.

a38a3180d7a9e25f1a83f4c3365fddcd90bdd4e6.title: Add custom stream parser to suppress file content emission
a38a3180d7a9e25f1a83f4c3365fddcd90bdd4e6.summary: Implemented `processStreamWithFiles` in `backend/src/process-stream.ts` to intercept and buffer file blocks during streaming, preventing raw file contents from being emitted to the client. Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to use this new generator, replacing the previous logic that accumulated and parsed file blocks manually. The parser yields only the opening/closing tags and non-file text, calling `onFileStart` and `onFile` callbacks to handle file processing internally.

c224d5cf9b5d417b71f517c3b1cfbe0a07867b14.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system prepares its files for release. This ensures the product remains stable and available for you to use.

129e703b4190c531c880480151dacc95a72bc406.text: A small internal update helps the computer understand the app's tools better. This change does not affect how the app works for you.

e45f260c04c55d5d0c55050c0f1a1f46c3082251.text: The team added a small internal record that captures the file text before the system prepares change details. This helps them investigate problems with how file changes are shown. It does not change anything for people using the product.

f977ea9080d8aafbeef118619502b9a6d875fc5f.text: The order of steps for updating file context has changed. This internal adjustment does not affect how you use the product.

d11936f407a1f2e2a00efd8826f46d99d83b7cb5.text: When the connection to the server fails, the app now stops showing loading animations and displays a retry message instead of freezing.

93a9f340acb4c805d80af606144cbf1ba310a7b8.text: A small internal change helps a background cleanup process keep running when it hits an error. It records the problem and continues checking for inactive connections, so cleanup can continue.

2a1da4dab3ae9b1e1794cbb7aca3416a0505dc10.text: This small internal fix ensures that the system correctly recognizes file changes even when no previous version exists. As a result, undo features will work more reliably.

138b6523ea8bba873b18ae504146131a97839737.text: Fixed a problem that stopped the software from building correctly. Users will see no changes, but the product now builds reliably.

a38a3180d7a9e25f1a83f4c3365fddcd90bdd4e6.text: A new internal tool now hides raw file contents while they load, showing only the file's name and status. This keeps the chat window clean and prevents confusing text from appearing on your screen.

b4f4a1c8e883bcb00978eb7b3d77d7cd7072e72e.text: The assistant now checks for missing files before acting. This internal update helps it request files more actively instead of assuming they are present.

c86b10d05f2666442089a002166eade9ad99c578.title: Bump version to 1.0.45
c86b10d05f2666442089a002166eade9ad99c578.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.44 to 1.0.45. Applies to backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Internal release increment.

4eceb0e0dce596c3a3f0e89263a724ba5589d3a8.title: Backend exits on SIGINT
4eceb0e0dce596c3a3f0e89263a724ba5589d3a8.summary: Added a SIGINT handler in `backend/src/index.ts` to force process termination. Ensures clean shutdown when the backend receives an interrupt signal. Internal change, no user-facing impact.

538005e79df18e371aaf34755dfe2be9704083fd.title: Pin dependency versions to exact releases
538005e79df18e371aaf34755dfe2be9704083fd.summary: Dependency ranges converted from caret (^) to exact versions across backend, npm-app, and root package.json files. Includes major upgrades for @anthropic-ai/sdk (0.24.3 to 0.26.1), axios (0.24.0 to 1.7.4), and typescript (5.3.2 to 5.5.4), alongside minor/patch bumps for express, zod, ws, and others. Ensures reproducible builds by eliminating floating version resolution.

6421d5838fa8fd42595093a1a083ede9e6874add.title: File request prompts enforce project root paths
6421d5838fa8fd42595093a1a083ede9e6874add.summary: System and file-request prompts now explicitly require full paths from the project root, correcting relative import ambiguity. This change targets `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to ensure consistent file resolution. The updated instructions direct the agent to normalize relative subdirectory imports into absolute root-relative paths during request generation.

0fa2bf1bc2ec6a37c2fcd6db54d64bfdeaa4799b.title: Switch package manager from Yarn to Bun
0fa2bf1bc2ec6a37c2fcd6db54d64bfdeaa4799b.summary: Repository scripts and documentation updated to use Bun instead of Yarn for dependency management and execution. Backend and npm-app package.json scripts now invoke `bun run` or `bun` directly, removing `ts-node` dependencies where possible. Knowledge base files reflect the new standard, instructing users to use `bun add`, `bun install`, and `bun run build`.

fa4da0ab3aad385caa2d0eb0be36422cfc82e4b3.title: Fix undo boundary check in chat storage
fa4da0ab3aad385caa2d0eb0be36422cfc82e4b3.summary: Corrected `navigateVersion` undo logic in `npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts` to allow reverting from index 0. Changed condition from `> 0` to `>= 0`. Removed unused `messageIndex` from `FileVersion` interface and state creation.

9972f7a121ed80148afe4ee4b1f62b38a4c0309c.title: Dockerfile env copy and npm version check fix
9972f7a121ed80148afe4ee4b1f62b38a4c0309c.summary: Dockerfile release stage copies .env. WebSocket checkNpmVersion reads package.json only in production, preventing path errors in dev. CLI key handler adds detectPasting call. Affects backend/Dockerfile, backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts, npm-app/src/cli.ts.

74bd3f565bffd3e804fb7ee04373547b4aa6f25a.title: Raise paste detection threshold to 10ms
74bd3f565bffd3e804fb7ee04373547b4aa6f25a.summary: Paste detection threshold in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` increased from 5ms to 10ms. This accommodates slower input timing to reduce false negatives in fast consecutive input detection. Affects CLI input processing only.

077c204682065b3c083ef7fcbc9ccffff05b7b79.title: Disable Helicone LLM security for OpenAI prompts
077c204682065b3c083ef7fcbc9ccffff05b7b79.summary: The Helicone-LLM-Security-Enabled header is commented out in backend/src/openai-api.ts, disabling Helicone's LLM security layer for OpenAI prompt requests.
