This change alters how prompt safety checks are handled for OpenAI API calls routed through Helicone. The modification is scoped to the OpenAI API client configuration.

0cbe3ff3d039b022031b83c7d9d3e2612f1f2697.title: Backend Dockerfile switches to Bun runtime
0cbe3ff3d039b022031b83c7d9d3e2612f1f2697.summary: backend/Dockerfile uses oven/bun:1 with multi-stage build. deploy.sh copies common/src to backend/src/common before docker build. tsconfig.json paths updated to resolve common/* from ./src/common/*.

0cbe3ff3d039b022031b83c7d9d3e2612f1f2697.text: The internal systems that run the product now use a faster tool for processing tasks. This change is small and happens behind the scenes, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

c86b10d05f2666442089a002166eade9ad99c578.text: The team updated the internal version number for the service.

4eceb0e0dce596c3a3f0e89263a724ba5589d3a8.text: The system now shuts down cleanly when stopped. This internal change has no effect on users.

fa4da0ab3aad385caa2d0eb0be36422cfc82e4b3.text: A small internal fix ensures the undo feature works correctly when reverting to the very first step.

077c204682065b3c083ef7fcbc9ccffff05b7b79.text: A background safety check for the assistant's responses was turned off. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

0fa2bf1bc2ec6a37c2fcd6db54d64bfdeaa4799b.text: The team changed how the software builds itself. This background update has no visible effect for users.

74bd3f565bffd3e804fb7ee04373547b4aa6f25a.text: The tool now waits a tiny bit longer to recognize pasted text. This helps it catch pastes that arrive slowly.

9972f7a121ed80148afe4ee4b1f62b38a4c0309c.text: The app now loads settings more reliably during startup. This small fix prevents occasional errors for users.

beaa17a54105cca01fc8ed4e2fc727b0be689d25.title: Fix system prompt types for Anthropic SDK
beaa17a54105cca01fc8ed4e2fc727b0be689d25.summary: Updated `system` parameter type in `claude.ts` and `main-prompt.ts` to accept `string | Array<TextBlockParam>`. Imported `TextBlockParam` from `@anthropic-ai/sdk/resources` to align with SDK expectations. Applied `as const` assertions to `type` and `cache_control` fields in `system-prompt.ts` to satisfy strict literal type checks. Scope limited to backend Claude integration files.

88a37c539f708e91b08c99a7d39f7d2503ee6cbb.title: Cache project file context
88a37c539f708e91b08c99a7d39f7d2503ee6cbb.summary: Added caching for `getProjectFileContext` in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. File tree and knowledge files are computed once per session and reused, while only `files` are refreshed. `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` notes this caching behavior.

53c28f871e6643f80f80f86c923f11708a9bb11c.title: Anthropic prompt caching for system prompt prefix
53c28f871e6643f80f80f86c923f11708a9bb11c.summary: Added `anthropic-beta: prompt-caching-2024-07-31` header and `cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' }` to the first system prompt block in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. The prompt is now an array of two text blocks: the first contains static instructions, file tree, and knowledge files; the second contains dynamic relevant files and response format. This split allows the stable prefix to be cached across requests, reducing latency and token usage for the knowledge files and file tree sections.

af6e99710b317e7db155e12408286afde3766f63.title: Defer CLI setup to first message
af6e99710b317e7db155e12408286afde3766f63.summary: CLI startup no longer blocks on `initFingerprint`, `getProjectFileContext`, or `client.connect`. `index.ts` aggregates these into a `readyPromise` passed to the `CLI` constructor. `cli.ts` awaits this promise only when submitting a user message, allowing the terminal prompt to appear instantly. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

e4b3d766dde242dbd34af5e40a801ab729f36d22.title: System prompt: file context, uncertainty pause, two-fail stop
e4b3d766dde242dbd34af5e40a801ab729f36d22.summary: getSystemPrompt injects <files> list from truncatedFiles keys and requires explicit 'I have all the files I need' confirmation before proceeding. High uncertainty (>5) now mandates pausing without file modification. Step 4 adds a hard stop after two consecutive command/task failures, requiring user guidance. Knowledge file rules expanded with concrete examples (package managers, function choices, style, tests).

a0c552072f3588c4501e4bb04da2220e50c5c9c6.title: Refactor system prompt into modular pieces
a0c552072f3588c4501e4bb04da2220e50c5c9c6.summary: Refactored `getSystemPrompt` in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to compose the prompt from distinct constants and helper functions (`introPrompt`, `getProjectFilesPrompt`, `editingFilesPrompt`, `getKnowledgeFilesPrompt`, `getToolsPrompt`, `getResponseFormatPrompt`). This improves readability and maintainability of the core prompt logic. No user-visible behavior changes.

28f5b49ec01651f15db22fa86dd52daa97dab378.title: Improve websocket error handling and startup logs
28f5b49ec01651f15db22fa86dd52daa97dab378.summary: WebSocket client now suppresses repeated error logs during reconnect attempts, printing 'Could not connect. Retrying...' once and 'Reconnected!' on success. CLI startup logs and git directory checks moved to occur after client initialization completes. Affects `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts` and `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

55e6b53c51e231dca63340cf3be5dc31b9364fd3.title: Restructure backend system prompt
55e6b53c51e231dca63340cf3be5dc31b9364fd3.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts reorders and splits prompt sections. getProjectFilesPrompt replaced by getProjectFileTreePrompt and getRelevantFilesPrompt. Knowledge files moved to relevant files block. Tools section reorders run_terminal_command before web_scrape. Intro prompt consolidates project access details.

f7806cf07b5919933ec7d4f4f7407473438e1ad8.title: Bump manicode to 1.0.43
f7806cf07b5919933ec7d4f4f7407473438e1ad8.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.42 to 1.0.43 in `backend/package.json` and `npm-app/package.json`. CLI undo/redo output messages updated in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to use present tense. Added known issues and testing notes to `todo.knowledge.md`.

e735ec85762098d81964e4a5071854052bd8f702.title: Bump backend and npm-app to 1.0.44
e735ec85762098d81964e4a5071854052bd8f702.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.43 to 1.0.44 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Internal release increment.

28f5b49ec01651f15db22fa86dd52daa97dab378.text: The app now shows one clear message when it cannot connect and tries again, then says when it reconnects. It also waits to finish starting up before showing some setup messages. This is a small internal change that makes the messages easier to follow.

e735ec85762098d81964e4a5071854052bd8f702.text: The software team made a small internal update to keep the system running smoothly. You will not notice any changes.

af6e99710b317e7db155e12408286afde3766f63.text: The program now shows the command prompt instantly instead of waiting for background tasks to finish. These tasks only happen when you send your first message.

beaa17a54105cca01fc8ed4e2fc727b0be689d25.text: A small internal fix improves how the assistant handles its core instructions. This helps prevent errors and keeps responses consistent.

88a37c539f708e91b08c99a7d39f7d2503ee6cbb.text: The app now remembers project details it already looked up, so it does not need to re-read them every time. This makes opening projects faster.

55e6b53c51e231dca63340cf3be5dc31b9364fd3.text: The assistant's internal instructions were reorganized to help it find project files more efficiently. Users may notice slightly faster or more accurate responses when working with specific files.

e4b3d766dde242dbd34af5e40a801ab729f36d22.text: The assistant now confirms it has all necessary files before starting work. It pauses if unsure to avoid mistakes and asks for help after two failed attempts.

53c28f871e6643f80f80f86c923f11708a9bb11c.text: The assistant now remembers the fixed instructions and background information between requests, so it does not have to re-read them every time. This makes responses faster and saves some data usage.

f7806cf07b5919933ec7d4f4f7407473438e1ad8.text: A small internal update improved how the tool explains its actions when you undo or redo changes.

a0c552072f3588c4501e4bb04da2220e50c5c9c6.text: The instructions that guide the assistant were reorganized to make them easier to update. This is a small internal change and will not affect how the product works.

8164ee2ad970632ed612f141d883459eccc435eb.title: Stronger updatefilecontext prompt
8164ee2ad970632ed612f141d883459eccc435eb.summary: The system prompt now explicitly directs the agent to verify completeness of the <relevant_files> block before proceeding. This change strengthens the instruction to use update_file_context when needed files are missing, while retaining the constraint against requesting files absent from <project_file_tree>. The modification is isolated to backend/src/system-prompt.ts.

4ebc99deffebb8dca59db124002dba9b291b192d.title: Improve error handling in diff generation and CLI
4ebc99deffebb8dca59db124002dba9b291b192d.summary: Refactored `generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts` to log errors and return `oldContent` instead of throwing on extraction failures. Updated `main-prompt.ts` to catch `processFileBlock` errors, log them, and filter empty results from the final changes array. Tweaked `cli.ts` to print a newline after stopping the loading animation and adjusted `menu.ts` prompt instructions.

2348663a7319595360bf355b7ba77d8229560f7c.title: Add minimal change instruction to main prompt
2348663a7319595360bf355b7ba77d8229560f7c.summary: Injected <additional_instruction> block into mainPrompt to enforce minimal code changes. Backend/src/main-prompt.ts modified. Directs agent to complete core request and pause for instructions.

f7124b68c843c913e947df945560e0d71f5d03f2.title: Bump version to 1.0.42
f7124b68c843c913e947df945560e0d71f5d03f2.summary: Incremented version field to 1.0.42 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Internal release bump.

b17a5633b4ca701fb88f08aa3e5161f465118fd2.title: Suppress meta-comments in diff generation
b17a5633b4ca701fb88f08aa3e5161f465118fd2.summary: Added instruction to `generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts` to omit meta-comments like "Add this import" from output. Updated examples to include such comments, demonstrating the exclusion rule. Ensures cleaner diffs by removing noise.

708bb5499554d3681ca34b5060d86e135548783d.title: CLI auto-stages changes via git add .
708bb5499554d3681ca34b5060d86e135548783d.summary: CLI `stageChanges` helper executes `git add .` via `child_process.exec` before `sendUserInputAndAwaitResponse`. Ensures working tree state is captured prior to agent processing. Scope limited to `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Error handling silently swallows `exec` failures.

f5e02504a5ae732101c476b65df9296a621b3a75.title: stageChanges cd project root
f5e02504a5ae732101c476b65df9296a621b3a75.summary: stageChanges in npm-app/src/cli.ts now prefixes git add . with cd ${getProjectRoot()}. Import of getProjectRoot added from project-files. Ensures staging runs against correct directory regardless of current working directory.

7f031f9931b38b8a8ed67b0739ce455014a82dc9.title: Add hallucinated patch test case
7f031f9931b38b8a8ed67b0739ce455014a82dc9.summary: Adds `hallucinated` mock data and test case for `generatePatch`. Verifies streaming response handling and file block processing logic. Covers backend test suite only.

58e20dff5dd4e25b668878cf8f85f86f69c5147e.title: Fix CLI undo/redo status messages
58e20dff5dd4e25b668878cf8f85f86f69c5147e.summary: Moved undo/redo console logs in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to execute only after successful version navigation, adding explicit 'No more undo/redo' feedback on failure. Updated `npm-app/src/menu.ts` help text to standardize bullet formatting for the 'Don't change any files' tip. Scope limited to CLI interaction surfaces.

fc1d61f2fe380d69c7f58013b793a9d1f15ccc7a.title: CLI menu layout and tips updated
fc1d61f2fe380d69c7f58013b793a9d1f15ccc7a.summary: CLI menu groups commands under COMMANDS header with bullet prefixes. Tips section replaces static knowledge.md guidance with prompts to generate knowledge files and handle corrections. lastInputWasMenu state removed from CLI class. Changes confined to npm-app/src/cli.ts and npm-app/src/menu.ts.

b17a5633b4ca701fb88f08aa3e5161f465118fd2.text: The assistant now hides its own notes about how to make changes, showing only the final updates. This makes the list of changes easier to read.

2348663a7319595360bf355b7ba77d8229560f7c.text: The assistant now makes only the smallest necessary changes to your requests, pausing for your instructions instead of doing extra work on its own.

4ebc99deffebb8dca59db124002dba9b291b192d.text: The system now handles certain internal errors more gracefully, preventing crashes and ensuring stable operation. This change is small and internal, so users may not notice any immediate difference in the product's behavior.

8164ee2ad970632ed612f141d883459eccc435eb.text: The assistant now double-checks that it has all the necessary files before starting a task. This helps it work more accurately by ensuring it doesn't miss important information.

f7124b68c843c913e947df945560e0d71f5d03f2.text: The team updated the internal version number. This small change does not affect how you use the product.

58e20dff5dd4e25b668878cf8f85f86f69c5147e.text: The app now shows clearer messages when you undo or redo changes, including a specific note if there are no more steps to go back or forward. This small update improves how the tool communicates with you during these actions.

f5e02504a5ae732101c476b65df9296a621b3a75.text: A small internal fix ensures that saving changes happens in the correct project folder, even if the tool is opened from a different location.

7f031f9931b38b8a8ed67b0739ce455014a82dc9.text: A small internal update added a test to check how the system handles unexpected data. This helps ensure the product stays stable, but users will not notice any changes.

708bb5499554d3681ca34b5060d86e135548783d.text: The tool now automatically saves your current work state before processing. If this saving step fails, it happens silently without warning you.

432ee9ff077425f6d079b8c56f8e22710c413c72.title: Added authentication and billing knowledge plan
432ee9ff077425f6d079b8c56f8e22710c413c72.summary: Added authentication_and_billing.knowledge.md detailing planned auth, PostgreSQL, OAuth, Stripe, and usage limits for Manicode. Updated todo.knowledge.md to mark completed items (Dawson case, marker token, out-of-date message) and add new notes on file diff context and update_file_context behavior.

b6b56b35a163ec66ca4687a7be5773f7ed0f95ee.title: system-prompt.ts add terminal command file edit restriction
b6b56b35a163ec66ca4687a7be5773f7ed0f95ee.summary: Added explicit instruction to system-prompt.ts prohibiting use of run_terminal_command for creating or editing files. Directs agent to use <file> blocks per editing_instructions instead. Affects backend prompt logic only.

63532e78aaf889034e87f463a4861813b6f9265d.title: Bump backend and manicode to 1.0.41
63532e78aaf889034e87f463a4861813b6f9265d.summary: Version bumped 1.0.40 to 1.0.41. Applies to backend and npm-app (manicode) package.json files. No functional changes.

4b216929255223d16c52bb9a09c5de3abde4f172.title: Refine editing instructions in system prompt
4b216929255223d16c52bb9a09c5de3abde4f172.summary: Updated `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to clarify that edits are applied by a separate assistant, requiring explicit context and shorter excerpts. Added guidance to preserve user edits and avoid reproducing unchanged code sections. Updated `todo.knowledge.md` with a new item regarding tree-sitter integration.

e660eed1ee376323f25735b4fc80471cbbadd5bb.title: Pass fullResponse to diff expansion to prevent line deletion
e660eed1ee376323f25735b4fc80471cbbadd5bb.summary: Propagates fullResponse through processFileBlock, generatePatch, and expandNewContent to inject assistant message context into the expansion prompt. This mechanism aims to prevent Claude from deleting intermediate lines when expanding shortened file diffs. System prompt updated with explicit instructions to use '// ... existing code ...' placeholders. Scope limited to backend diff generation logic in generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts, generate-patch.ts, and main-prompt.ts.

a75a11152a6ca1105754c8bbe3c4ecd2f7550f95.title: Simplify upgrade message in npm-app client
a75a11152a6ca1105754c8bbe3c4ecd2f7550f95.summary: The console warning for outdated versions in `npm-app/src/client.ts` no longer interpolates `packageJson.version`. The message now states 'There's a new version of Manicode!' without the specific installed version number. This change is internal to the CLI client's update notification logic.

00d7919b9aa249263d7d19d38dd97a66e8306784.title: Disable ensureDirectoryExists in ChatStorage constructor
00d7919b9aa249263d7d19d38dd97a66e8306784.summary: The `ensureDirectoryExists` call is commented out in the `ChatStorage` constructor within `npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts`. This change prevents the automatic creation of empty chat directories during initialization. The modification is internal to the storage logic and does not affect user-facing features or model availability.

f654b710fc71f37dee91fa334b1b9f4825cc10c5.title: Restore ESC to cancel generation in CLI
f654b710fc71f37dee91fa334b1b9f4825cc10c5.summary: Added keypress listener in npm-app/src/cli.ts to handle 'escape' key, invoking handleEscKey() to stop response generation. Removed fallback menu display logic from handleEscKey(), ensuring ESC strictly cancels active generation without side effects.

fa63a68f0819a8de5fd4f034b958334306b4cffe.title: Apply file changes immediately per tool call
fa63a68f0819a8de5fd4f034b958334306b4cffe.summary: System prompt no longer defers file edits until response end; changes apply immediately per tool call. `ChatStorage.saveFilesChanged` merges new file states into current version before `applyChanges` runs in `client.ts` and `cli.ts`. Covers npm-app client, CLI, and chat storage. Ensures context reflects latest disk state during multi-step tool sequences.

24ca807698520e29f4e6d0d7144f61d044355942.title: CLI undo/redo switch to typed commands
24ca807698520e29f4e6d0d7144f61d044355942.summary: Removed `keypress` listener in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` handling `Ctrl+U`/`Ctrl+R`/`ESC`. Replaced with text input parsing for `undo`/`u`, `redo`/`r`, and `help`/`h`. Updated startup prompt in `npm-app/src/index.ts` and menu text in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to reflect typed commands.

f654b710fc71f37dee91fa334b1b9f4825cc10c5.text: Pressing the Escape key now stops the text generation. It no longer opens a menu by accident.

432ee9ff077425f6d079b8c56f8e22710c413c72.text: The team recorded plans for future account security and payment features. They also updated internal notes to track completed work and new ideas. This change does not affect how you use the product right now.

b6b56b35a163ec66ca4687a7be5773f7ed0f95ee.text: The assistant now uses a safer method to change files instead of running background commands. This small internal update helps prevent errors when editing your documents.

e660eed1ee376323f25735b4fc80471cbbadd5bb.text: The assistant now sees more context when updating files, helping it avoid accidentally removing lines it shouldn't. This small internal fix makes file edits more reliable.

63532e78aaf889034e87f463a4861813b6f9265d.text: The team updated internal software components to a newer version. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

fa63a68f0819a8de5fd4f034b958334306b4cffe.text: File changes now take effect instantly during a task, rather than waiting until the end. This ensures the assistant sees the most current version of your files as it works.

00d7919b9aa249263d7d19d38dd97a66e8306784.text: The system stopped automatically creating empty folders for chat history. This internal change does not affect how the product works.

4b216929255223d16c52bb9a09c5de3abde4f172.text: The assistant now follows clearer rules when making edits, requiring specific context and shorter excerpts to preserve user changes and avoid rewriting unchanged code.

a75a11152a6ca1105754c8bbe3c4ecd2f7550f95.text: The app now shows a simple message when a new version is available, without listing the current version number. This change only affects the text of the update alert.

24ca807698520e29f4e6d0d7144f61d044355942.text: The undo and redo functions now work by typing commands instead of pressing special keys.

71bfc86adbea6aece98931154253b4d8d9ae72cd.title: Bump backend and npm-app to 1.0.40
71bfc86adbea6aece98931154253b4d8d9ae72cd.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.39 to 1.0.40 in backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. Patch release. No functional changes.

729dd03a1d1948e6c16c90919d7c6101c4a710d0.title: Preserve previous files in requestRelevantFiles result
729dd03a1d1948e6c16c90919d7c6101c4a710d0.summary: requestRelevantFiles in backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts now captures Object.keys(fileContext.files) as previousFiles and returns uniq([...comprehensiveResult.files, ...previousFiles]). Prevents loss of previously identified relevant files when the comprehensive result omits them. Change is internal to backend request-file logic. Uses uniq to deduplicate the merged file list.

63f191756da1bbfed0c21c5546ff80c16f206b7e.title: Pin temperature to 0 in OpenAI API calls
63f191756da1bbfed0c21c5546ff80c16f206b7e.summary: Added explicit `temperature: 0` to `promptOpenAI` and `promptOpenAIWithContinuation` in `backend/src/openai-api.ts`. This ensures deterministic outputs for OpenAI models, matching the implicit default and existing behavior for Claude. Update logged in `todo.knowledge.md`.

91edc1f008ecfcbe1061646034c880943a6c4d8f.title: Add missing-line-actions patch test fixture
91edc1f008ecfcbe1061646034c880943a6c4d8f.summary: Added `missing-line-actions` test fixture to `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/`. This fixture tests `generatePatch` handling of `checkNpmVersion` client action and `npmVersionStatus` server action additions. Test case added to `backend/src/__tests__/generate-patch.test.ts`.

3f8b579382b457dc4522d73da9a3062b3ae2b57e.title: Preserve user edits
3f8b579382b457dc4522d73da9a3062b3ae2b57e.summary: Added instruction to system prompt to preserve user edits. Updates todo.knowledge.md to mark task complete. Covers backend/src/system-prompt.ts and todo.knowledge.md. Addresses risk of overwriting concurrent user changes.

66ed712e83dd5455a0196c11ef8b78ee1c8e04f9.title: python-app skeleton added to repo
66ed712e83dd5455a0196c11ef8b78ee1c8e04f9.summary: New python-app directory contains pre-alpha Manicode Python package skeleton. Includes pyproject.toml (v0.1.1, setuptools), src/manicode/__init__.py (placeholder main), README.md, LICENSE, and egg-info. Current functionality only prints 'coming soon' message directing users to npm install. No actual AI coding features implemented.

167fc49d8e6fe45e8e551b8b950f29b33df949c8.title: Expansion edits use gpt-4o
167fc49d8e6fe45e8e551b8b950f29b33df949c8.summary: generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts swaps gpt-4o-mini for gpt-4o-2024-08-06 in the expansion edit pipeline. gpt-4o matches mini's speed while delivering higher quality edits. Change scoped to backend diff generation logic.

ea9015aa9c22aaa0cbeda2c446d77b0e602ab871.title: gpt-4o-2024-08-06 replaces gpt-4o-mini for file requests
ea9015aa9c22aaa0cbeda2c446d77b0e602ab871.summary: backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts switches the comprehensive file request model from 'gpt-4o-mini' to 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06'. The 'Key' model request path using models.sonnet is commented out, leaving only the comprehensive path active. getRelevantFiles routing logic updated to check model.startsWith('gpt') instead of strict equality. Scope limited to backend request files prompt logic.

3ede4b9ef73b2c63626b319a74a88d03ada958a7.title: Switch diff generation to gpt-4o
3ede4b9ef73b2c63626b319a74a88d03ada958a7.summary: Backend diff generation now uses `promptOpenAIWithContinuation` with `gpt-4o-2024-08-06` instead of `promptClaudeWithContinuation`. Added `promptOpenAIWithContinuation` in `backend/src/openai-api.ts` to handle streaming, stop markers, and automatic continuation logic. Updated `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` to import the new helper and adjust prompt instructions for unique block matching.

2e6270d27fa41c8624131a57ae90f25a9c51c50f.title: Add npm version check and update warning
2e6270d27fa41c8624131a57ae90f25a9c51c50f.summary: Implemented client-server version checking via new 'check-npm-version' and 'npm-version-status' WebSocket actions. Client sends local version on connect; backend compares against build-synced package.json and returns status. Outdated clients receive yellow chalk warning with update command. Build script syncs npm-app version to backend package.json.

3f8b579382b457dc4522d73da9a3062b3ae2b57e.text: The assistant now keeps any edits you make to a task, preventing them from being accidentally overwritten by other changes.

729dd03a1d1948e6c16c90919d7c6101c4a710d0.text: The assistant now remembers files it previously found important, even if it doesn't list them again. This prevents it from losing track of your documents.

71bfc86adbea6aece98931154253b4d8d9ae72cd.text: The team updated internal software labels. Nothing about the product's features or behavior changed.

3ede4b9ef73b2c63626b319a74a88d03ada958a7.text: The system switched to a new AI model for generating text differences. This change is internal and may improve the accuracy of the suggestions you see.

66ed712e83dd5455a0196c11ef8b78ee1c8e04f9.text: The team added a basic framework for a new Python tool to the project files. This tool currently does nothing but show a message directing users to the existing version; no new features are available yet.

167fc49d8e6fe45e8e551b8b950f29b33df949c8.text: The system now uses a more capable tool to create text edits. This change happens behind the scenes and aims to improve the quality of the results you see.

91edc1f008ecfcbe1061646034c880943a6c4d8f.text: Added a test case to verify the software correctly handles specific actions related to checking for updates. This is an internal change to improve software reliability and does not affect the user experience.

ea9015aa9c22aaa0cbeda2c446d77b0e602ab871.text: The system now uses a more capable AI model to process file requests, improving the quality of answers. This is an internal update, so users may notice slightly better results when asking questions about files.

63f191756da1bbfed0c21c5546ff80c16f206b7e.text: The assistant now gives the same answer every time for the same request. This small internal update makes its responses more predictable and consistent.

cab368ef9a62857a642b1b7e766f74add8537ea2.title: manicode 1.0.39
cab368ef9a62857a642b1b7e766f74add8537ea2.summary: Bumped version in npm-app/package.json. Routine release increment. No functional changes.

d9775dd20e37da9c948ceea5c1f21ae9fc8bd60d.title: Pass userId to patch generation pipeline
d9775dd20e37da9c948ceea5c1f21ae9fc8bd60d.summary: Backend patch generation functions now accept and propagate a userId parameter. This threads the user identifier through generatePatch, processFileBlock, and downstream prompt generators like generateDiffBlocks and expandNewContent. The change ensures internal API calls for diff and patch generation are attributed to the correct user context. No breaking changes to external interfaces; internal refactoring only.

efc5cb41ea406771cacb3a3acdb5cae91fe7f81e.title: Add Helicone rate limit policy to Claude and OpenAI API calls
efc5cb41ea406771cacb3a3acdb5cae91fe7f81e.summary: Added `Helicone-RateLimit-Policy` header to `promptClaudeStream`, `promptClaude`, and `getOpenAI` default headers. Policy string `2000;w=86400;u=cents;s=user` defined in new `backend/src/constants.ts`. Scope limited to backend API clients.

583aa0626abe520f57608b3665c0bda83a710d9a.title: Add delete-comment mock data and patch test
583aa0626abe520f57608b3665c0bda83a710d9a.summary: Added `delete-comment` mock files (`expected.ts`, `new.ts`, `old.ts`) under `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/`. Registered a new test case 'should remove try catch in delete comment' in `generate-patch.test.ts`. The mocks demonstrate the transition from error-wrapped deletion logic to direct execution.

6a7aa5141c1e2529077307bb6937ca11a345c1e7.title: manicode 1.0.38
6a7aa5141c1e2529077307bb6937ca11a345c1e7.summary: Version bump to 1.0.38 in npm-app/package.json. No functional changes.

f54acb1c23a14bd21fc87404c2a276b38b165207.title: Add userId argument to generateExpandedFileWithDiffBlocks in tests
f54acb1c23a14bd21fc87404c2a276b38b165207.summary: Added missing 'userId' argument to generateExpandedFileWithDiffBlocks call in diff-prompt.test.ts. Fixes type error.

25f3fe76ee7af4776c620e81e0ad087162b02d68.title: Enable Helicone LLM Security on Claude and OpenAI clients
25f3fe76ee7af4776c620e81e0ad087162b02d68.summary: Added 'Helicone-LLM-Security-Enabled': 'true' header to Helicone proxy requests in backend/src/claude.ts and backend/src/openai-api.ts. This activates Helicone's LLM security layer for both Claude and OpenAI API streams. Scope covers backend service clients only; no frontend or config changes.

7722459eb1ed718ae76ec7d2d2484459a13eedf0.title: Skip redundant file check instructions in system prompt after initial
7722459eb1ed718ae76ec7d2d2484459a13eedf0.summary: System prompt generation now accepts a checkFiles boolean to conditionally exclude the instruction to request missing files. This prevents the agent from re-evaluating file context immediately after updateFileContext has already populated it during the initial prompt setup. Logic resides in backend/src/main-prompt.ts and backend/src/system-prompt.ts, adjusting the general case instructions based on the shouldCheckFiles flag.

716ba48f0206c4bdc92ec1351fa15908f31e71b6.title: Propagate fingerprint ID to Helicone user ID for backend requests
716ba48f0206c4bdc92ec1351fa15908f31e71b6.summary: Backend LLM calls now include a Helicone-User-Id header derived from the client's fingerprint ID. The fingerprint ID is threaded through WebSocket actions, main prompt handlers, and API clients in claude.ts and openai-api.ts. This change affects shared types in common/src/actions.ts and the npm client in npm-app/src/client.ts. A minor system prompt update clarifies comment generation rules.

10c9d37b5107b50b193dafc8841732a7f80b95bc.title: Scrape URLs from user input
10c9d37b5107b50b193dafc8841732a7f80b95bc.summary: Client.ts now parses URLs from the last user message and appends scraped content blocks, mirroring existing knowledge.md handling. Logic extracted to web-scraper.ts getScrapedContentBlocks. System prompt reordered to prioritize file context requests over code review.

583aa0626abe520f57608b3665c0bda83a710d9a.text: The system's internal safety checks for removing comments were simplified. This small, behind-the-scenes update makes the process more direct, but you will not see any changes in how the product works.

10c9d37b5107b50b193dafc8841732a7f80b95bc.text: The assistant now reads links in your last message and uses their content to help answer. This also changes how it prioritizes requests for file context versus code reviews.

6a7aa5141c1e2529077307bb6937ca11a345c1e7.text: The internal version label updated. Nothing changed in how the product works or looks.

cab368ef9a62857a642b1b7e766f74add8537ea2.text: The developers updated the software's internal label. This routine step does not change how the product works or looks for users.

25f3fe76ee7af4776c620e81e0ad087162b02d68.text: A security filter was added to the AI service. This protects the system from harmful inputs. No visible changes for users.

efc5cb41ea406771cacb3a3acdb5cae91fe7f81e.text: A small internal update adds a usage limit to the assistant's connections with two external services. This helps prevent the system from becoming overloaded, keeping the service stable for everyone.

d9775dd20e37da9c948ceea5c1f21ae9fc8bd60d.text: The system now links internal updates to the right user account. This keeps background tasks accurate. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

716ba48f0206c4bdc92ec1351fa15908f31e71b6.text: The system now sends a private, anonymous identifier with your requests to help manage usage limits. This background update improves service stability without changing how you interact with the assistant.

5cb4611c2d42ad79e951a9d5d1193db5b3984176.title: manicode 1.0.36
5cb4611c2d42ad79e951a9d5d1193db5b3984176.summary: Version bump in npm-app/package.json. No functional changes.

a291dca7a8c9eccdccdda944f6439faa76daf28f.title: Upgrade OpenAI SDK to v4
a291dca7a8c9eccdccdda944f6439faa76daf28f.summary: Backend OpenAI SDK upgraded from v3.2.1 to v4.55.4. Configuration class replaced by direct OpenAI constructor instantiation, and chat completion logic updated to use `openai.chat.completions.create` instead of `createChatCompletion`. Helicone proxy base URL and auth headers migrated to `baseURL` and `defaultHeaders` parameters. Scope limited to `backend/package.json` and `backend/src/openai-api.ts`.

646e41095783f6ce01346f6487f71bb383e4eb54.title: System prompt tweaks
646e41095783f6ce01346f6487f71bb383e4eb54.summary: System prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` reorders brainstorming steps and adds explicit instruction to minimize edits. Uncertainty scoring moved before plan selection, and a new `<important_instruction>` block mandates preserving existing behavior. Unused `countTokens` import removed.

2ace24ce4c4783985274f508bf22919ad944b92b.title: Apply file changes with directory creation
2ace24ce4c4783985274f508bf22919ad944b92b.summary: Added recursive directory creation before file writes in `applyChanges` within `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. Prevents errors when applying patches to files in non-existent directories.

85f06cb54f1c0a96577a7a9e373232de627c9e35.title: Enforce knowledge file edits and fix CLI paste detection
85f06cb54f1c0a96577a7a9e373232de627c9e35.summary: System prompt updated to mandate knowledge file edits upon user correction and allow necessary changes to these files. CLI version bumped to 1.0.37. `handleInput` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now calls `detectPasting()` before processing input to ensure paste mode activates correctly.

3b4ed03fcecaa75b207956fa60fdcf07a1080b53.title: CLI paste detection buffers newlines
3b4ed03fcecaa75b207956fa60fdcf07a1080b53.summary: Refactor CLI input handling in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to buffer pasted content across newlines. Replaced immediate line processing with `handleInput` that accumulates lines when `isPasting` is true. Prevents multi-line pastes from triggering separate responses.

961453dae185cb06f8ea4b20d52122f7d30cbe8b.title: Implement 100k token budget for file context
961453dae185cb06f8ea4b20d52122f7d30cbe8b.summary: Added `getTruncatedFilesBasedOnTokenBudget` in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to limit file context to 100,000 tokens using new `tiktoken` dependency. Files exceeding the budget are replaced with `[TRUNCATED TO FIT TOKEN BUDGET]` marker. Includes new `backend/src/util/token-counter.ts` for token counting logic and moves `debug.ts` to `backend/src/util/debug.ts`.

e31b5f853ccb43e43a5ae3e97d329f6d50a16d2c.title: Lazy-load project files on demand
e31b5f853ccb43e43a5ae3e97d329f6d50a16d2c.summary: Project files are now loaded lazily via requestFiles instead of eagerly in updateFileContext. The ProjectFileContextSchema allows null values for missing files, and the system prompt instructs the agent to explicitly request files not in the context before modification. Token counting logic handles null content by returning 0.

ce4c9e3658175fcf90ceaddf43aad3bf7d353b43.title: CLI paste detection via input timing
ce4c9e3658175fcf90ceaddf43aad3bf7d353b43.summary: Added `detectPasting` and `isPasting` to `CLI` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to suppress `handleUserInput` during rapid input bursts. Mechanism tracks `lastInputTime` and `consecutiveFastInputs` on `line` and `keypress` events, treating inputs <5ms apart as paste. Scope limited to CLI core; `todo.knowledge.md` marks the feature complete. Threshold requires 2+ fast inputs to trigger paste state.

92b54a227398657bed70dec701400db26f76f0f5.title: Split todo.knowledge.md from musings.knowledge.md
92b54a227398657bed70dec701400db26f76f0f5.summary: New todo.knowledge.md file created to hold task lists and problem tracking, extracted from musings.knowledge.md. Musings.knowledge.md retains high-level ideas and wish lists. This separates actionable items from conceptual notes.

92b54a227398657bed70dec701400db26f76f0f5.text: A small internal change separates task lists and problem tracking from high-level ideas and wish lists. This keeps action items apart from general notes.

3b4ed03fcecaa75b207956fa60fdcf07a1080b53.text: The assistant now waits for a whole message to finish before answering. This stops it from replying to each line of a long pasted text.

a291dca7a8c9eccdccdda944f6439faa76daf28f.text: The system's connection to the AI service was updated to match current standards. This internal maintenance work ensures the assistant continues to function correctly without affecting how you use the product.

5cb4611c2d42ad79e951a9d5d1193db5b3984176.text: The team updated the internal version label for the app. This change does not affect how you use the product.

e31b5f853ccb43e43a5ae3e97d329f6d50a16d2c.text: The assistant now only opens the specific files it needs for a task, rather than loading all project files at once. This makes the tool faster and more efficient for you.

85f06cb54f1c0a96577a7a9e373232de627c9e35.text: The assistant now updates its reference notes when you correct it. Typing or pasting text into the command tool works more reliably.

ce4c9e3658175fcf90ceaddf43aad3bf7d353b43.text: The app now ignores fast, repeated typing bursts to prevent accidental errors when you paste text. This small update makes the experience smoother when copying and pasting.

2ace24ce4c4783985274f508bf22919ad944b92b.text: The system now creates missing folders automatically when saving files. This prevents errors when updates involve new folders.

646e41095783f6ce01346f6487f71bb383e4eb54.text: The assistant's internal planning steps changed to make it edit existing things less and keep current behavior working. Small internal tweak.

961453dae185cb06f8ea4b20d52122f7d30cbe8b.text: The assistant now limits the amount of file content it reads to prevent overload. If a file is too long, it stops reading partway through to keep things running smoothly.

0c9caf592f2d2af87ebbe17a8e991727243d4540.title: Helicone OpenAI proxy URL updated
0c9caf592f2d2af87ebbe17a8e991727243d4540.summary: OpenAI API base URL updated from oai.hconeai.com to oai.helicone.ai in backend/src/openai-api.ts. Reflects Helicone's domain rebrand. Internal backend routing only.

94adf5fb064359dfcd5360ef9831e90ae8f72e43.title: Bump manicode npm package version to 1.0.35
94adf5fb064359dfcd5360ef9831e90ae8f72e43.summary: Version field in `npm-app/package.json` incremented from `1.0.34` to `1.0.35`. Internal release metadata update. No functional changes or new features.

108cb92c1d9876cba6293e6b671d5bd479b94d4a.title: Switch to uncertainty score
108cb92c1d9876cba6293e6b671d5bd479b94d4a.summary: System prompt logic in backend/src/system-prompt.ts replaces confidence scoring with an uncertainty metric. Thresholds invert: proceed if uncertainty ≤ 10, halt for clarification if > 10. musings.knowledge.md marks related context and IP config tasks as resolved.

834fd560811b8e2954481970a12f0942eb16bf05.title: Lower system prompt uncertainty threshold to 5
834fd560811b8e2954481970a12f0942eb16bf05.summary: The system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` now triggers clarification requests when the uncertainty score exceeds 5, down from 10. This change tightens the threshold for proceeding without user confirmation, aiming to reduce ambiguity in plan selection. The update affects the core brainstorming logic for all agent sessions.

fe97f7321e301d188dc28144a30295ea016a2de6.title: Add hardware fingerprint ID to npm-app client init
fe97f7321e301d188dc28144a30295ea016a2de6.summary: New `fingerprint.ts` derives a SHA-256 base64url ID from `systeminformation` (BIOS, baseboard, CPU, OS). `config.ts` exposes `initFingerprint` to populate `fingerprintId`; `index.ts` awaits this during `manicode` startup before `Client` instantiation. Scope limited to `npm-app` CLI; adds `systeminformation` and `@types/systeminformation` deps. Fingerprint computed asynchronously in parallel with project root init to mask latency.

726f29a193eb5ca6df7007d3d517fc72d74284c8.title: Improve terminal command timeout handling and status reporting
726f29a193eb5ca6df7007d3d517fc72d74284c8.summary: Refactored `handleRunTerminalCommand` to use dynamic timeout messaging and explicit status strings instead of boolean flags. `formatResult` now accepts an optional `status` parameter, allowing accurate reporting for both timeouts (`Command timed out after X seconds. Partial results shown.`) and normal completions (`Command completed`). This change affects `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` and updates internal tracking in `musings.knowledge.md`.

ad123adb0ab8edb8d9f7689aa03b113e39c2b702.title: CLI menu becomes one-time print with colorized ASCII
ad123adb0ab8edb8d9f7689aa03b113e39c2b702.summary: Refactored `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to remove persistent menu state (`isInMenu`) in favor of a one-time print flag (`lastInputWasMenu`). `npm-app/src/menu.ts` updated to use `chalk` for random-colored block-character ASCII art and removed `console.clear()` calls in favor of `process.stdout.clearLine(0)`. Menu display now triggers once per ESC press without blocking subsequent input handling.

1e55853080386c44abb26ef55ae1b910b8964ae2.title: System prompt step 4 adds file context loop
1e55853080386c44abb26ef55ae1b910b8964ae2.summary: Step 4 in backend/src/system-prompt.ts now instructs the agent to use update_file_context and return to step 1 when more files are needed. Blank line between 3a and 3b removed. Internal prompt logic only.

18e7005f8467e2e9652f0edac600762e3256d6be.title: Update system prompt structure and menu art
18e7005f8467e2e9652f0edac600762e3256d6be.summary: System prompt step 3 formatting flattened from sub-items 3a/3b to direct conditionals. CLI menu art replaced ASCII block letters with geometric shapes and added AI/CODE tags. Color randomization logic updated to select three distinct colors from a wider palette for menu rendering.

cf59adfa96aba3cd3c0ae2571ccbc79343836bfc.title: Fix project directory resolution and terminal cwd reset
cf59adfa96aba3cd3c0ae2571ccbc79343836bfc.summary: Refactored `projectRoot` from a static `config.ts` export to a dynamic `getProjectRoot()` function in `project-files.ts` to correctly resolve the working directory. Updated `chat-storage.ts`, `menu.ts`, and `tool-handlers.ts` to consume this new accessor, ensuring file operations and terminal commands target the initialized project root. The system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` now explicitly states that the working directory resets to the project root for each command, aligning backend instructions with the frontend's `cd ${getProjectRoot()}` execution logic.

726f29a193eb5ca6df7007d3d517fc72d74284c8.text: The assistant now clearly states if a command finished or ran out of time. This helps you understand what happened without guessing.

94adf5fb064359dfcd5360ef9831e90ae8f72e43.text: The team updated the software's internal record to keep track of the latest release. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for you.

18e7005f8467e2e9652f0edac600762e3256d6be.text: The menu now shows cleaner text and colorful geometric shapes instead of block letters. These small visual updates make the screen easier to read.

ad123adb0ab8edb8d9f7689aa03b113e39c2b702.text: The menu now appears only once when you press the escape key, with colorful text art. This change removes the previous persistent menu and screen clearing behavior, making the interface less disruptive while you type.

0c9caf592f2d2af87ebbe17a8e991727243d4540.text: We changed the web address the product uses to talk to its AI service to match a company rebrand. This is an internal update. You will not notice any difference.

cf59adfa96aba3cd3c0ae2571ccbc79343836bfc.text: Fixed how the app finds its main folder. Commands now run in the correct place.

108cb92c1d9876cba6293e6b671d5bd479b94d4a.text: The assistant now asks for clarification when unsure, instead of guessing.

1e55853080386c44abb26ef55ae1b910b8964ae2.text: The assistant now checks for extra files when it needs more context to answer your question. This internal update helps it find the right information more often.

834fd560811b8e2954481970a12f0942eb16bf05.text: The assistant now asks for confirmation more often when it is unsure about what to do. This small internal change helps avoid mistakes by checking with you sooner.

fe97f7321e301d188dc28144a30295ea016a2de6.text: The app now quietly creates a unique label for your computer to help it recognize your device. This is a small internal update that does not change how you use the product.

f347eed4ada633148087b31daf567c613ea90470.title: Improve OpenAI error handling and terminal command prompt
f347eed4ada633148087b31daf567c613ea90470.summary: Backend error logging refined in openai-api.ts to extract specific error messages. request-files-prompt.ts now catches errors and returns empty results to prevent crashes. system-prompt.ts updated to clarify terminal command execution behavior.

53789205f380cc3dd994ee70c5e6a9a3e06add65.title: Add confidence scoring to system prompt brainstorming
53789205f380cc3dd994ee70c5e6a9a3e06add65.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated to require explicit confidence scoring (0-100) within the <brainstorm> block. Logic gates file editing: scores <90 force user clarification, while >=90 permit plan selection and execution. This change restricts autonomous action on ambiguous requests.

ab6adec5f86225152d1b5c80c92de8006cd37c86.title: Run terminal commands from project root
ab6adec5f86225152d1b5c80c92de8006cd37c86.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand now prefixes commands with cd ${projectRoot} before execution. This ensures consistent working directory context for spawned processes. Import projectRoot from ./config in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

182fa2dff468b2b9d55179d1e254387aa48e372d.title: Bump npm-app version to 1.0.32
182fa2dff468b2b9d55179d1e254387aa48e372d.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.31 to 1.0.32 in npm-app/package.json. Incremental release. Affects npm-app package.

adea156802b0c3e9e498ccf2b0c35974de9ded72.title: Bump manicode package version to 1.0.33
adea156802b0c3e9e498ccf2b0c35974de9ded72.summary: Version in `npm-app/package.json` incremented from 1.0.32 to 1.0.33. This is a standard release version bump for the `manicode` package. Scope limited to the npm app package metadata.

380ebf372cdeac37b0fc2365c8de5a18a92e063b.title: License field standardized to UNLICENSED across packages
380ebf372cdeac37b0fc2365c8de5a18a92e063b.summary: Root, backend, and common package.json files updated to use "UNLICENSED" instead of "proprietary" or missing values. Aligns licensing metadata with npm conventions for private/unlicensed code. Affects backend/package.json, common/package.json, and package.json. Standardizes the string across the workspace.

3463b5ab00159dde8d12775cc64a2356893561d8.title: clean-package.js appends newline to temp package.json
3463b5ab00159dde8d12775cc64a2356893561d8.summary: npm-app/clean-package.js now writes a trailing newline to temp.package.json after JSON.stringify. Semistandard compliance fix for temp file output. Internal build script change.

5d6d472a7e58d375b97a722abf7f384cd8c7d9fa.title: CLI spinner and stream-start callback
5d6d472a7e58d375b97a722abf7f384cd8c7d9fa.summary: npm-app/src/cli.ts replaces the static '...' output with a 100ms spinner and clears it when the response ends or the first streamed chunk arrives. npm-app/src/client.ts adds an onStreamStart callback to subscribeToResponse, fired once for the matching userInputId when the first response-chunk is received. npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts logs the exit code after run_terminal_command closes. The change is scoped to the npm CLI client and tool handler files shown in the diff.

083a060ca9f4544cdcfedf34350a93bb157adff4.title: Skip file requests for terminal commands and empty results
083a060ca9f4544cdcfedf34350a93bb157adff4.summary: Added guards in `main-prompt.ts` to return empty strings when `filePaths` or `relevantFiles` are empty, preventing unnecessary context updates. Modified `request-files-prompt.ts` to skip fetching comprehensive file lists if the key file list is empty, and updated the comprehensive model selection to `gpt-4o-mini` via `promptOpenAI`. Prompt instructions now explicitly direct the model to return no files if the user's last message is a terminal command.

adea156802b0c3e9e498ccf2b0c35974de9ded72.text: A small internal update was made to the code that powers the product. Users will not notice any changes.

f347eed4ada633148087b31daf567c613ea90470.text: The system now handles connection issues more smoothly, preventing sudden crashes. Clearer instructions were added to how it runs commands.

083a060ca9f4544cdcfedf34350a93bb157adff4.text: The assistant now skips searching for files when you type a command or when there is nothing to find. This keeps responses faster and avoids showing empty or irrelevant results.

5d6d472a7e58d375b97a722abf7f384cd8c7d9fa.text: The loading indicator now spins to show activity and disappears as soon as the first piece of the response arrives. This makes the wait feel shorter and confirms the system is working.

2e6270d27fa41c8624131a57ae90f25a9c51c50f.text: The app can now check whether it is up to date. If it is not, it shows a warning and tells you how to update. This means you may see a reminder to get the newer app.

3463b5ab00159dde8d12775cc64a2356893561d8.text: A small internal update fixed how the system saves a temporary file. This change has no effect on how the product works for users.

53789205f380cc3dd994ee70c5e6a9a3e06add65.text: The assistant now rates its certainty when brainstorming ideas. If the rating is low, it asks you for more details before acting; if high, it proceeds with the plan.

182fa2dff468b2b9d55179d1e254387aa48e372d.text: The app received a small internal update. This change does not affect how you use the product.

380ebf372cdeac37b0fc2365c8de5a18a92e063b.text: The team updated internal license tags to follow standard rules. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ab6adec5f86225152d1b5c80c92de8006cd37c86.text: A small internal update ensures the assistant always starts tasks from the project's main folder. This makes tool execution more consistent.

a8aa186e55a1cbadd10fbfcea5f1166157a4d2ec.title: Route Claude and OpenAI through Helicone
a8aa186e55a1cbadd10fbfcea5f1166157a4d2ec.summary: Backend LLM clients now proxy requests through Helicone. `claude.ts` sets `baseURL` to `anthropic.helicone.ai` and injects `Helicone-Auth`. `openai-api.ts` updates `baseOptions.url` to `oai.hconeai.com/v1` with matching auth headers. Requires `HELICONE_API_KEY` environment variable.

5815032be151d6d273eed2303699edcf0fd323e0.title: Strip leading newline in parseFileBlocks
5815032be151d6d273eed2303699edcf0fd323e0.summary: parseFileBlocks and parseFileBlocksWithoutPath in common/src/util/file.ts now strip leading newlines from parsed file content. Removed verbose prompt logging in backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts. Prevents malformed file content from starting with unnecessary whitespace.

4a4d25764b97290ec02cb877105331a7cc4cbd51.title: Add .git directory check warning to CLI startup
4a4d25764b97290ec02cb877105331a7cc4cbd51.summary: Added fs.existsSync check for .git directory in npm-app/src/index.ts. Warns if missing to prevent wrong root execution. Also added process.stdout.clearLine(0) in npm-app/src/cli.ts handleExit to clean terminal output.

26a6f8d6373c4c7e9816805ba5b400239dee5058.title: system-prompt adds minimal-change guard for code edits
26a6f8d6373c4c7e9816805ba5b400239dee5058.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts gains an instruction telling the agent to assume every line has a purpose and to make only the most minimal change when modifying existing code. The change addresses observed behavior where the agent removed if guards, dropped log/error statements, or added <form> elements beyond the request. musings.knowledge.md records the motivating failure cases alongside the new rule.

8e4bcab16c46c3b4cd9c7ae98149ec5b246c79e7.title: System prompt clarification on user corrections
8e4bcab16c46c3b4cd9c7ae98149ec5b246c79e7.summary: System prompt instructions in backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated to clarify knowledge file update triggers. Changed 'did something wrong' to 'corrects you or contradicts you or gives broad advice'. Reordered plan steps to place file editing before final knowledge note.

dfb7ed8fcc5250ebfd7887b6b4a58cfe0590dfd6.title: Refine diff parsing to strip leading/trailing newlines
dfb7ed8fcc5250ebfd7887b6b4a58cfe0590dfd6.summary: Replaced `trim()` with `removeNewlinesFromStartAndEnd()` in `parseAndGetDiffBlocks` within `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts`. This change preserves internal whitespace and indentation while strictly removing only leading and trailing newlines from search and replace content blocks. Documentation in `backend/knowledge.md` was updated to reflect the two main diff generation strategies. The new helper function uses regex `/^\n+|\n+$/g` to ensure precise content matching for file diffs.

fdad7a3cea8e9baeee33c821eff94d189828fd19.title: Terminal command handler adds 10s timeout and live output
fdad7a3cea8e9baeee33c821eff94d189828fd19.summary: handleRunTerminalCommand replaces promisify(exec) with spawn to enforce a 10-second MAX_EXECUTION_TIME. Output streams live to process.stdout/stderr via chalk, while a formatResult helper aggregates captured data. Timed-out commands return partial results with a status tag; completed commands include exit_code. The timeout message incorrectly states 2 seconds despite the 10_000ms constant. Scope limited to npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

b95c04e5e2171588c98c8f3fb8f5d14251d0aead.title: Lazy init openai client
b95c04e5e2171588c98c8f3fb8f5d14251d0aead.summary: OpenAI client initialization moved from module load to `getOpenAI` helper in `backend/src/openai-api.ts`. Defers `Configuration` and `OpenAIApi` construction until `promptOpenAI` executes, preventing startup errors if `OPEN_AI_KEY` is unset. Internal backend refactor only.

7f1629543df85669e89ad87d7d0d978f06bbe5fb.title: Drop request summary step from system prompt
7f1629543df85669e89ad87d7d0d978f06bbe5fb.summary: General case instruction in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` drops step 1 "Summarize the user's request", renumbering remaining steps 2-5 to 1-4. `code_review` block now leads the flow, followed by `brainstorm`, step-by-step reasoning, and knowledge-file edit. Scope: backend system prompt only; six mock-data files under `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/` plus `expansion-diff-prompt.test.ts` added to cover the change.

c4091bc7c28991d8a7f85c28f5a5998885e26ad1.title: Add generate-patch.ts with line ending normalization
c4091bc7c28991d8a7f85c28f5a5998885e26ad1.summary: New backend/src/generate-patch.ts replaces expansion-only logic with hybrid strategy using LARGE_FILE_CHARACTERS threshold. Normalizes CRLF to LF before processing, restores original line endings in final patch. generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts loses generatePatch export; main-prompt.ts imports from new module. generateExpandedFileWithDiffBlocks added to generate-diffs-prompt.ts for diff-block application.

5815032be151d6d273eed2303699edcf0fd323e0.text: The system now ignores extra blank lines at the start of files. This keeps text tidy for the assistant to read.

dfb7ed8fcc5250ebfd7887b6b4a58cfe0590dfd6.text: The system now ignores extra blank lines at the very beginning or end of text blocks. This helps it match content more accurately when updating files.

8e4bcab16c46c3b4cd9c7ae98149ec5b246c79e7.text: The assistant's instructions were updated to better recognize when to update its memory files based on user corrections. This small internal change helps the assistant learn from feedback more accurately.

4a4d25764b97290ec02cb877105331a7cc4cbd51.text: The tool now warns you if you run it in the wrong folder. This helps prevent mistakes when starting the program.

c4091bc7c28991d8a7f85c28f5a5998885e26ad1.text: The system now cleans up hidden line-ending differences before preparing an update, then restores the file’s original line style in the finished update. For someone who just uses the product, this is a small behind-the-scenes fix that may make updates look less messy.

a8aa186e55a1cbadd10fbfcea5f1166157a4d2ec.text: The system now uses a middleman to handle requests to AI services. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

26a6f8d6373c4c7e9816805ba5b400239dee5058.text: The assistant now changes only what it must when editing code, avoiding accidental removal of safety checks or extra elements. This is a small internal update to make its responses more precise and reliable.

fdad7a3cea8e9baeee33c821eff94d189828fd19.text: Commands that run too long now stop after 10 seconds instead of waiting forever. You can see results as they happen, and if a command times out, you get the partial output.

7f1629543df85669e89ad87d7d0d978f06bbe5fb.text: The assistant now skips the step of repeating your request back to you. This makes responses slightly shorter and more direct.

26a934456ed7a4b4a5223013cf7e69eccbad0ac6.title: Fix patch file path extraction in applyChanges
26a934456ed7a4b4a5223013cf7e69eccbad0ac6.summary: getFilePathFromPatch now parses 'Index: <path>' headers instead of 'diff --git' lines. applyChanges uses this helper to resolve file paths and passes the full patch string to applyPatch, replacing manual line splitting. Covers common/src/util/file.ts and npm-app/src/project-files.ts. Ensures compatibility with patch formats using standard Index headers.

8e18438d05f682b2793fbae585d9a7ba65741d36.title: Factor out inner prompt for request files
8e18438d05f682b2793fbae585d9a7ba65741d36.summary: Refactored `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` to extract `innerPromptContent` from `generateComprehensiveRequestFilesPrompt`. This isolates message history and file context string generation, applying `STOP_MARKER` stripping via `common/constants`. Internal backend refactor; no user-facing behavior change.

d5a852d0725232b4806fb5088796160a67fee30f.title: manicode 1.0.31
d5a852d0725232b4806fb5088796160a67fee30f.summary: Version bump in `npm-app/package.json`. No functional changes. Internal release marker.

82beff8938c9dbed81038959bd7de58482a08bb6.title: JSON stringify message history in request files prompt
82beff8938c9dbed81038959bd7de58482a08bb6.summary: Message content in request files prompt is now JSON stringified. This ensures proper escaping and serialization of user and assistant messages within XML tags. Added console logs for file creation and patch generation in main-prompt. Internal change affecting backend prompt construction logic.

48ae6aaad30fc89846802d1377472e6c8563fe89.title: Switch diff expansion to gpt-4o-mini
48ae6aaad30fc89846802d1377472e6c8563fe89.summary: Backend diff generation now uses gpt-4o-mini via promptOpenAI instead of Claude Haiku. openai-api.ts exposes promptOpenAI accepting dynamic model strings. Scope limited to backend/src/generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts and backend/src/openai-api.ts. sendChatMessage replaced by promptOpenAI to support model parameterization.

83aabe570d1c4e1401398e6d96b6f4c91c14c20d.title: Add action schema diff regression tests
83aabe570d1c4e1401398e6d96b6f4c91c14c20d.summary: New diff regression tests for `generateDiffs` and `generatePatch` cover `CLIENT_ACTIONS`/`SERVER_ACTIONS` zod schemas in `src/action.ts`. Mock fixtures (`expected.ts`, `new.ts`, `old.ts`) under `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/actions` validate expansion of 3 comment markers. Scope limited to backend test suite; no runtime or model changes.

afba5af63c25c8835945eda70a9117ef9951d24d.title: System prompt: stop re-reading files already in context
afba5af63c25c8835945eda70a9117ef9951d24d.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts instructs the agent not to call update_file_context for files already included in the <relevant_files> block. Redundant read loops caused the agent to request files it already had, wasting tokens and blocking edits. musings.knowledge.md logs the observed loop where the agent greps for changes that never landed because it kept re-fetching the same file.

2ee70575b64e03eb88061d1ef403c7cbf994a3e4.title: Thread userInputId through WebSocket actions
2ee70575b64e03eb88061d1ef403c7cbf994a3e4.summary: A required userInputId string is threaded through user-input, response-chunk, response-complete, tool-call, and terminal-command-result actions. The backend forwards it on every sendAction, while the client reuses it for tool-call follow-ups and ignores mismatched response chunks or completion events. The change spans common/src/actions.ts, backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts, npm-app/src/client.ts, npm-app/src/cli.ts, npm-app/package.json, and npm-app/knowledge.md. CLI inputs generate an ID with Math.random().toString(36), and the package adds nanoid plus docs for the client-side correlation system.

d2809905e36a4015a9511174f278231dd93fccc4.title: Refactor expansion prompt for diffs
d2809905e36a4015a9511174f278231dd93fccc4.summary: Restructured `expandNewContent` prompt in `backend/src/generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts` to enforce explicit section identification. Added `<sections-to-expand>` block and `[ALREADY_EXPANDED]` sentinel to handle no-op cases. Updated test fixtures in `backend/src/__tests__/expansion-diff-prompt.test.ts` and `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/graph/expected.ts` to match new output format. This reduces hallucination by separating discussion, expansion planning, and code generation.

99e137ae93ee9ece6a9a7c1ebf0838d8bfd2990a.title: Switch to expansion diff strategy for file changes
99e137ae93ee9ece6a9a7c1ebf0838d8bfd2990a.summary: Backend now generates unified patches via `generatePatch` instead of search/replace blocks, updating `FileChanges` type to string array in `common/src/actions.ts`. `npm-app` applies these using `diff` library's `applyPatch` in `project-files.ts`, replacing manual string replacement logic. `system-prompt.ts` instructs model to use terminal commands for file deletion/renaming, removing `[DELETE]` token support. `knowledge.md` documents the new strategy and client-side application flow.

d5a852d0725232b4806fb5088796160a67fee30f.text: The team updated internal records to mark a new version. Nothing changed in how the product works.

48ae6aaad30fc89846802d1377472e6c8563fe89.text: The system now uses a different AI model to create summaries of changes. This internal update aims to keep the feature running smoothly without changing how you experience the product.

afba5af63c25c8835945eda70a9117ef9951d24d.text: The assistant stopped re-reading files it already had. This saves time and lets it make edits faster.

2ee70575b64e03eb88061d1ef403c7cbf994a3e4.text: The system now tags each request with a unique ID to track responses. This helps the app match replies to your specific actions, reducing errors from mixed-up results.

83aabe570d1c4e1401398e6d96b6f4c91c14c20d.text: The team added automatic safety checks to a small part of the system. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

8e18438d05f682b2793fbae585d9a7ba65741d36.text: Developers cleaned up how the system prepares background information for requests. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

82beff8938c9dbed81038959bd7de58482a08bb6.text: A small internal update fixes how text is formatted in the background. This helps prevent errors when the system reads conversation history.

d2809905e36a4015a9511174f278231dd93fccc4.text: We improved how the assistant breaks down long tasks. This helps it stay focused and reduces mistakes when writing code.

26a934456ed7a4b4a5223013cf7e69eccbad0ac6.text: The tool now identifies files to update using standard headers instead of specific diff lines. This ensures patches apply correctly across different formats.

99e137ae93ee9ece6a9a7c1ebf0838d8bfd2990a.text: The app now uses a more reliable method to update your files. This makes edits safer and prevents accidental mistakes when the assistant changes your work.

a685d7755e69a75bfdd4a411b9acf3e65619e22b.title: Bump manicode package version to 1.0.30
a685d7755e69a75bfdd4a411b9acf3e65619e22b.summary: Version in `npm-app/package.json` bumped from `1.0.29` to `1.0.30`. Internal release increment. Scope limited to `npm-app`.

37ae6a49f281f6033ddfef12c54fb2ef5a859b7c.title: Version bump to 1.0.29
37ae6a49f281f6033ddfef12c54fb2ef5a859b7c.summary: Manicode package version incremented to 1.0.29. musings.knowledge.md updated with new prompt engineering notes regarding local edits and user confirmation. Scope limited to internal repo metadata and documentation.

9a9c514a858218e6e04ff162318bc213d57b4fae.title: Refactor system prompt for updatefilecontext usage
9a9c514a858218e6e04ff162318bc213d57b4fae.summary: System prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts replaces read_files instructions with update_file_context workflow. Relevant files now injected directly into prompt context, removing need for explicit read calls before edits. Debug logging in main-prompt.ts removed. Typos fixed in request-files-prompt.ts. Scope limited to backend prompt logic; no user-facing CLI/Web changes.

64a25d71569463067303f06c0c93c72572fbd965.title: Prompt ordering instructions added
64a25d71569463067303f06c0c93c72572fbd965.summary: Added explicit ordering instructions to prompt templates in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`. Changes instruct the model to order relevant files by importance, first. Internal prompt engineering adjustment.

be899b33d927028a64cef09a21a1ba9e30cb5252.title: CLI output colorized with chalk
be899b33d927028a64cef09a21a1ba9e30cb5252.summary: CLI status messages now use chalk for colorized output. File version navigation, response stopping, exit, and file change logs display in blue, yellow, magenta, gray, red, green, and cyan. Backend file reading prompt whitespace adjusted. Chalk dependency added to npm-app.

5c4b02d9a49aba52f1c0e129ea77b3889d493ffb.title: CLI loaded files color changed to green
5c4b02d9a49aba52f1c0e129ea77b3889d493ffb.summary: Loaded files output in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` changes from `chalk.cyan` to `chalk.green`. Complete message drops `chalk.green` styling. Adjusts terminal color consistency.

f3243f024b2d10f2a8bc9dd6f95f3796f2ab9a8d.title: Refine relevant file logging and dedup
f3243f024b2d10f2a8bc9dd6f95f3796f2ab9a8d.summary: Removed verbose timing logs from `requestRelevantFiles`. Switched dedup to `uniq`. Added dynamic timing/response logs in `getRelevantFiles`. Prompt updated to mention `read_files` tool.

105b6250c6a7b540cf610c381240e86f015a16db.title: Stream file reads, flatten tree schema
105b6250c6a7b540cf610c381240e86f015a16db.summary: Backend streams file read notifications via onResponseChunk in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. b87028262f6a5d870126ea483302cb85d5b93c02.title: Update backend knowledge doc
b87028262f6a5d870126ea483302cb85d5b93c02.summary: backend/knowledge.md restructured to reflect current Manicode architecture. Project Structure section replaced by Architecture Overview. New sections added: Tool Handling, Error Handling and Debugging, Build and Deployment, Security Considerations. TODO list updated with diff generation optimization item.

1b712e5f1c642eb5fa98d1df6cb3b10f16f2915d.title: Replace readfiles tool with updatefilecontext
1b712e5f1c642eb5fa98d1df6cb3b10f16f2915d.summary: The `read_files` tool is replaced by `update_file_context`, which accepts a natural language prompt to select relevant files. This change moves file context management from explicit path listing to an AI-driven selection process using `requestRelevantFiles` with the new prompt. The system prompt now dynamically injects selected file contents via `getSystemPrompt`, removing the need for a separate `<relevant_files>` block in the user message. be899b33d927028a64cef09a21a1ba9e30cb5252.text: Status messages in the command-line tool now appear in different colors to help distinguish between actions like stopping, exiting, or file changes. This is a small internal visual update that does not change how the product functions.

105b6250c6a7b540cf610c381240e86f015a16db.text: The system now reads files in smaller pieces and shows multiple top-level folders instead of just one. This makes the file list more flexible and responsive.

1b712e5f1c642eb5fa98d1df6cb3b10f16f2915d.text: The assistant now finds the right information for you automatically, instead of needing you to pick specific files. It also stopped searching certain market data.

5c4b02d9a49aba52f1c0e129ea77b3889d493ffb.text: The text showing loaded files now appears green instead of blue. This is a small internal change to keep colors consistent. Users will notice no functional difference.

9a9c514a858218e6e04ff162318bc213d57b4fae.text: The assistant now automatically sees relevant files, so it does not need to ask permission to read them before making changes. This internal update makes the editing process smoother and faster.

c8ca3f1b922450a98f239013efb57c43fd3f53da.summary: Relocates the printFileTree function from backend/src/system-prompt.ts to common/src/util/file.ts. This centralizes file tree formatting logic within the shared utility module, removing the local implementation from the backend system prompt generator. The change affects only internal code structure without altering runtime behavior or user-facing features.

c91e9d666a74a8101af3ff71ad67d7a82e626684.summary: Corrected import path for `ProjectFileContext`, `printFileTree`, and `createFileBlock` in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`. Changed source from `common/src/util/file` to `common/util/file`. This resolves module resolution errors in the backend build. Scope limited to backend request handling.

d286f873e19f46d4629469c6e6fffb4323631881.title: Move prompt instructions to system prompt
d286f873e19f46d4629469c6e6fffb4323631881.summary: Relocates `scrape_web_page` and knowledge file editing instructions from `main-prompt.ts` to `system-prompt.ts`. `main-prompt.ts` now only appends the `STOP_MARKER` to user messages. `system-prompt.ts` integrates these rules into the numbered workflow list, shifting existing steps down. This centralizes behavioral guidance in the system context.

d07c29de932ab6022db9d3d52dd58dc0d9a36796.title: manicode version bump 1.0.25 to 1.0.26
d07c29de932ab6022db9d3d52dd58dc0d9a36796.summary: Version field in `npm-app/package.json` incremented from `1.0.25` to `1.0.26`. Release metadata update for the `manicode` package. No functional code changes included in this diff.

a3ff180f323ba45d7623c73bfac233a3f600785f.title: System prompt adds export grep rule and scope limits
a3ff180f323ba45d7623c73bfac233a3f600785f.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts instructs agent to grep references before renaming exported symbols and restricts file access to current working directory. Response format tightened to strictly execute user requests without extrapolation. knowledge.md adds Project Goals section prioritizing developer productivity and power user focus. Internal prompt engineering change affecting agent behavior across all surfaces.

63d4625c2cbd17c41a4301659b7ce819b304bc76.title: Parallel key and comprehensive file requests
63d4625c2cbd17c41a4301659b7ce819b304bc76.summary: requestRelevantFiles now executes parallel Claude calls using models.sonnet for a focused key-file prompt and models.haiku for a comprehensive prompt. Results merge via Set deduplication to balance precision and recall. Internal backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts only. Key prompt hard-caps selection at approximately 6 files.

b5c0bfe715e5039f527623630959910a2157dbe2.title: Update knowledge.md with backend prompts, WebSocket flow, and tool
b5c0bfe715e5039f527623630959910a2157dbe2.summary: Documentation expanded across `backend/knowledge.md`, `knowledge.md`, and `npm-app/knowledge.md`. Added sections detailing the Request Files Prompt (`src/request-files-prompt.ts`), WebSocket communication flow, file versioning (`CTRL+U`/`CTRL+R`), and CLI key handling. Tool handlers (`read_files`, `scrape_web_page`, `search_manifold_markets`, `run_terminal_command`) and security considerations documented.

f5b545f4051816951d89c3d7deedda256de3ad04.title: Fix gitignore leading slash handling in project-files.ts
f5b545f4051816951d89c3d7deedda256de3ad04.summary: parseGitignore in npm-app/src/project-files.ts strips leading slashes from gitignore lines before adding to ignore instance. loadAllProjectFiles removed as redundant. getProjectFileTree uses defaultIgnore instead of rootIgnore. Version bumped to 1.0.28 in npm-app/package.json.

df3047298098a06e9306328fa09300d35bc4eb6c.title: Manicode 1.0.27 README restructure
df3047298098a06e9306328fa09300d35bc4eb6c.summary: npm-app/README.md reorganized with explicit Features, Knowledge Files, Tips, and Feedback sections. CLI usage updated to `manicode [project-directory]` with default current-directory fallback. Keyboard shortcuts `Ctrl+U`/`Ctrl+R` added for file change undo/redo. Package version bumped to 1.0.27 in npm-app/package.json.

8d613fb0a458e56d1fb49cb6068b27c77b9e11c4.title: Pre-fetch relevant files via Haiku before main prompt
8d613fb0a458e56d1fb49cb6068b27c77b9e11c4.summary: New `requestRelevantFiles` function uses Haiku to identify files from the project tree and message history. These files are pre-fetched and injected into the last user message under `<relevant_files>`, replacing the previous instruction for Claude to manually list and read directories. The system prompt is updated to remove the file-reading steps, assuming context is already provided. This change affects `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`, `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts`, and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`.

c8ca3f1b922450a98f239013efb57c43fd3f53da.text: The code that formats file lists was moved to a shared location. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the product works for you.

b5c0bfe715e5039f527623630959910a2157dbe2.text: Internal notes about how the assistant finds files and uses tools were updated. This helps the team keep the assistant working correctly, but you will not see any changes.

d286f873e19f46d4629469c6e6fffb4323631881.text: The assistant now receives its core rules about reading web pages and editing files in a more reliable way. This is a small internal cleanup that helps the assistant follow instructions more consistently.

8d613fb0a458e56d1fb49cb6068b27c77b9e11c4.text: The assistant now finds helpful files automatically before answering. This saves time and improves accuracy.

c91e9d666a74a8101af3ff71ad67d7a82e626684.text: Fixed a small internal connection issue so the system can correctly find file information. This prevents errors when the assistant processes requests involving files.

939542dbe591e65ea5849cf29d7a1a30d3e45e28.summary: Menu text updated to be more informative. Root directory display added via `projectRoot` import. Tips and descriptions revised for clarity.

182f4530e763cd4d5ea1b868f7c8ff55ec28cc0b.summary: Version bump to 1.0.25 in npm-app/package.json. Internal package version increment.
