f47b3f976467d6e7a7d74d2d194227a5b7dcae38.summary: Bumped manicode version 1.0.23 to 1.0.24 in npm-app/package.json. Internal release increment.

579eaa90e04ca60a8be12a4077e20cd7cff902f8.title: Remove dirname fallback in getCurrentDirectory
579eaa90e04ca60a8be12a4077e20cd7cff902f8.summary: Removes the `__dirname` fallback in `getCurrentDirectory` within `npm-app/src/config.ts`. Previously, the function caught `process.cwd()` errors and used `__dirname` as a fallback before throwing. Now, any failure to get the current working directory immediately throws an Error with the original cause, simplifying the error handling flow.

4933c6335fc244e12e3dd1413c24c827fd711a79.title: System prompt: Execute terminal commands without commentary
4933c6335fc244e12e3dd1413c24c827fd711a79.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated to instruct the agent to execute user-provided terminal commands and print results directly, suppressing extra commentary unless analysis is expected. This refines the response format guidelines for internal system behavior. The change applies to the backend system prompt configuration.

9bc2e51edb889c1c9a57b7707167e70258caedf3.title: Fix terminal tool to always pass stdout and stderr
9bc2e51edb889c1c9a57b7707167e70258caedf3.summary: Updated `handleRunTerminalCommand` in `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` to return a combined `<terminal_command_result>` containing both `<stdout>` and `<stderr>`, removing the previous logic that short-circuited and returned `<terminal_command_error>` if `stderr` was present. This ensures the model receives standard output even when commands write to standard error. The change applies to the terminal tool handler.

a65dcd02b1a8753aeb1cf44d6e1b59c2a34a1360.title: Suppress file and directory read errors in project tree
a65dcd02b1a8753aeb1cf44d6e1b59c2a34a1360.summary: Commented out `console.error` calls for file processing and directory reading in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts`. Errors are ignored to prevent noise from permission issues during tree generation. Import statements for `common/util/file` were also reformatted.

6f6bf64e518a6b2c1b7919035e1d0fa48c3101b4.title: Add fallback for cwd failure in config
6f6bf64e518a6b2c1b7919035e1d0fa48c3101b4.summary: Wrap process.cwd() in try/catch within npm-app/src/config.ts to handle deleted working directories. Fallback uses __dirname with warning, or throws if unavailable. Bump manicode version to 1.0.23 in npm-app/package.json.

fb58235d16d47825439bb7840573652c19a00dd7.title: system-prompt.ts adds read more files guidance
fb58235d16d47825439bb7840573652c19a00dd7.summary: The system prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts was updated to instruct the agent to read a broad range of files for context before acting. It specifies reading 10 more files than deemed most useful and considering all files in the target directory. The <code_review> block requirement now applies after reading files rather than just code files.

96b27cb268419a95ff3074414bce203ebb798f69.title: Add --help flag and clarify project directory in CLI
96b27cb268419a95ff3074414bce203ebb798f69.summary: Added --help and -h flags to the CLI entry point in index.ts, printing usage instructions and exiting cleanly. The startup message now explicitly states the resolved project directory where files will be read and written, replacing the generic prompt in cli.ts. initProjectRoot in project-files.ts was updated to return the resolved path to support this logging. Input handling in cli.ts was also patched to prevent processing user lines while the menu is active.

182f4530e763cd4d5ea1b868f7c8ff55ec28cc0b.text: A small internal update improved how the software keeps track of its own version. Users will not see any new features or changes.

f47b3f976467d6e7a7d74d2d194227a5b7dcae38.text: This was a small, internal update that did not change how the product works for you. You can keep using it exactly as before.

939542dbe591e65ea5849cf29d7a1a30d3e45e28.text: The menu text was updated to be clearer and more helpful. This small internal change makes it easier to understand the available options.

9bc2e51edb889c1c9a57b7707167e70258caedf3.text: The assistant now sees all text produced by commands, including error messages. This prevents it from missing important information when a command fails.

a65dcd02b1a8753aeb1cf44d6e1b59c2a34a1360.text: The app now hides minor errors that appear when it cannot read certain files. This keeps the file list clean and prevents confusing messages from showing up.

96b27cb268419a95ff3074414bce203ebb798f69.text: The tool now shows a help menu when asked and clearly states which folder it uses for files. It also ignores input while a menu is open to prevent mistakes.

4933c6335fc244e12e3dd1413c24c827fd711a79.text: The assistant now runs commands without extra talk. You get just the result unless you ask for more.

6f6bf64e518a6b2c1b7919035e1d0fa48c3101b4.text: The app now automatically recovers if its starting location is missing, preventing a crash. This small internal fix ensures the tool keeps running smoothly even if the folder it was launched from gets deleted.

fb58235d16d47825439bb7840573652c19a00dd7.text: The assistant now reviews more files before acting. This helps it understand context better. The change is internal.

d4581ed59329811065c9d3431dc6ef61fa4ea739.title: Fix extra space in graph.js test
d4581ed59329811065c9d3431dc6ef61fa4ea739.summary: Removed extra space in `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/graph/expected.ts` and `old.ts`. Updated `CLAUDE_CALL_TIMEOUT` to 200s in `diff-prompt.test.ts`. Changed `it.only` to `it` for graph test.

d0954571c6b2760060e03f1fee816a23fff1b208.title: Update .gitignore entries
d0954571c6b2760060e03f1fee816a23fff1b208.summary: Removed debug.log and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo from root .gitignore; added prompt.debug.json and debug.log to backend/.gitignore. Refines ignored file patterns for backend debugging artifacts.

77474bb4fffbbca12872f98aa61781910f0a3f9e.summary: Version increment in npm-app/package.json from 1.0.19 to 1.0.20. Standard release housekeeping for the CLI package. No functional code changes.

31f7de7cac01d96dead9146ddd61f9d54ac0916f.title: backend/deploy.sh: update-container replaces delete-recreate
31f7de7cac01d96dead9146ddd61f9d54ac0916f.summary: backend/deploy.sh now calls gcloud compute instances update-container when the VM exists, instead of deleting and recreating it. This preserves instance state and avoids full provisioning on every deploy. New VMs still use create-with-container with identical flags. Scope limited to backend deploy script.

aff53c7551c70dcad00d744b35a9902b95c069d2.title: Improve prompt debug log
aff53c7551c70dcad00d744b35a9902b95c069d2.summary: Refactors prompt debugging in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to append structured JSON arrays to `prompt.debug.json` instead of appending raw objects. Introduces `savePromptLengthInfo` to capture message content, system/tools lengths, and timestamps. Updates `npm-app/package.json` formatting.

967d8a04f1cf376de26634a4683dc4d413818672.title: npm package version bump to 1.0.21
967d8a04f1cf376de26634a4683dc4d413818672.summary: Incremented `manicode` package version from 1.0.20 to 1.0.21 in `npm-app/package.json`. This change reflects a standard internal release process. No functional code changes or user-facing features are included in this specific diff.

cd5349e25eadd27f76346cd021b6d2160cae5f04.title: Improve expand-based diff prompt
cd5349e25eadd27f76346cd021b6d2160cae5f04.summary: Refactored `expandNewContent` in `generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts` to use `createFileBlock` for consistent file formatting and added few-shot examples to the prompt. The extraction logic now trims whitespace and appends a newline instead of blindly slicing the first character. Updates cover backend diff generation and associated tests.

b72978018a8365e59b50ed7910ee47f07c35c29c.title: CLI accepts project directory as first argument
b72978018a8365e59b50ed7910ee47f07c35c29c.summary: The CLI now takes the project directory as its first argument instead of a user prompt. `initProjectRoot` resolves the provided path or defaults to `process.cwd()`, setting the internal `projectRoot` before context loading. This removes the initial prompt handling from `manicode`, requiring users to specify the working directory explicitly when launching via `npm start` or `ts-node`.

1d31f52b488c5509c6ec43b6ae891313cfc8080d.title: Fix CLI prompt duplication and input queueing
1d31f52b488c5509c6ec43b6ae891313cfc8080d.summary: CLI prompt logic moved from constructor to `printInitialPrompt` and called after `handleUserInput` completes. Input lines are now ignored if `isReceivingResponse` is true, preventing race conditions. `index.ts` calls `printInitialPrompt` only when no user prompt is provided, removing duplicate initial output. `musings.knowledge.md` marks bash execution notes as complete.

b0747decef0e9c53413e9cf4b09190456b996f87.title: Replace flat file list with recursive tree structure in system prompt
b0747decef0e9c53413e9cf4b09190456b996f87.summary: Project context generation now builds a recursive `FileTreeNode` structure instead of a flat array of file paths. The system prompt renders this tree using tab-indented hierarchy, improving spatial understanding of the codebase. `common/src/util/file.ts` defines the new schema, while `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` implements the directory traversal and gitignore filtering (including `.git`). `knowledge.md` adds constraints regarding `src` path inclusion and token limits.

d4581ed59329811065c9d3431dc6ef61fa4ea739.text: A small internal update fixed a formatting error in test data and adjusted a timeout setting. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

cd5349e25eadd27f76346cd021b6d2160cae5f04.text: The system now formats file comparisons more consistently and uses clearer examples to understand changes. This helps the assistant present updates in a cleaner, easier-to-read way.

967d8a04f1cf376de26634a4683dc4d413818672.text: The team updated the software's internal version number. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

b0747decef0e9c53413e9cf4b09190456b996f87.text: The assistant now sees the project's files organized in folders, like a tree, instead of one long list. This helps it understand how files relate to each other and navigate the codebase more effectively.

b72978018a8365e59b50ed7910ee47f07c35c29c.text: The tool now expects the folder path to be typed directly when starting it, rather than asking for it later. This means users must tell the tool which project folder to open right away.

d0954571c6b2760060e03f1fee816a23fff1b208.text: The system updated how it handles internal files, ensuring it ignores specific debugging data.

31f7de7cac01d96dead9146ddd61f9d54ac0916f.text: The system now updates the server directly instead of deleting and rebuilding it. This keeps the server running without interruptions during maintenance.

aff53c7551c70dcad00d744b35a9902b95c069d2.text: This small internal update improves how the system records its thinking process for support staff. You will not see any changes.

77474bb4fffbbca12872f98aa61781910f0a3f9e.text: We updated the internal tooling for this product. This routine maintenance does not change how the product works or what you see.

1d31f52b488c5509c6ec43b6ae891313cfc8080d.text: The tool no longer shows duplicate prompts or accepts input while it is still answering. This keeps the conversation clear and prevents commands from being processed out of order.

33ffa777d15bae95e4aaeabfdeb2533708cdab88.summary: Added fs and path imports to backend/src/main-prompt.ts. f958197f5e506f58dd43054cfe8668f691e89cdc.summary: npm-app/clean-package.js appends a trailing newline to index.js after injecting NODE_ENV. Prevents missing final newline warnings in downstream tooling. Internal build script change.

5c80a84f990f119a51db1f172827e751735f635c.summary: Added instruction to `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` specifying that file changes only occur after the `${STOP_MARKER}` token. This clarifies the execution model for the agent's editing capabilities. Scope limited to internal system prompt.

a72118747f09a2e07a0ad93c289360752fb8b968.summary: Version bump in npm-app/package.json. Inc npm version. Scope: manicode package.

1f86dbbdd6e16a41222551540eb99bf60e5382b1.summary: System prompt now injects `currentWorkingDirectory` into `ProjectFileContext`. `common/src/util/file.ts` updates the Zod schema to require this string. `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` populates it from `projectRoot`. 46be127346fb972fea119f4fe244051d423b585e.title: Production websocket URL uses api.manicode.ai

5a1168bae1ff1b897b96323f72fe2cb1cd1cae9d.title: Remove redundant prompt call in CLI stopResponse
5a1168bae1ff1b897b96323f72fe2cb1cd1cae9d.summary: Removed `this.rl.prompt()` from `stopResponse` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. This eliminates a duplicate prompt trigger during cleanup.

508d5810e2018a14c94d1c386da2c55429c5bb8e.title: CLI initial prompt handling and startup sequence tweaks
508d5810e2018a14c94d1c386da2c55429c5bb8e.summary: Refactors CLI initialization to consolidate `start()` logic into the constructor and introduces `printInitialPrompt()` for consistent messaging when exiting the menu. Updates `index.ts` to await `client.connect()` before instantiating `CLI`, ensuring the websocket is ready before prompt display. Removes debug logging from `getProjectFileContext` in `project-files.ts`. Standardizes prompt text to "What would you like to do? Press ESC for menu."

b50f3e0787f1faf744fc8a879bd0dd9470643d50.title: Version bump to 1.0.17
b50f3e0787f1faf744fc8a879bd0dd9470643d50.summary: npm-app/package.json version incremented from 1.0.16 to 1.0.17. Routine release metadata update.

cf60580e175b2db88db0bc2818b8ea16fbdba792.title: Replace hardcoded dir excludes with gitignore-aware file traversal
cf60580e175b2db88db0bc2818b8ea16fbdba792.summary: project-files.ts now walks the tree using the `ignore` package instead of a static `excludedDirs` list. `parseGitignore` reads each `.gitignore`, and traversal merges parent and current ignore rules to skip files via `mergedIgnore.ignores(relativeFilePath)`. Scope limited to `npm-app` (`project-files.ts`, `package.json`, `knowledge.md`). Follow-up: `getProjectFileContext` retains a debug `console.log('got file paths', filePaths)` line.

e68c4539c90295fa30bbd970b4c3b662be9bd7e1.title: Remove trailing newline from diff prompt
e68c4539c90295fa30bbd970b4c3b662be9bd7e1.summary: Trailing newline stripped from the diff prompt template in `generate-diffs-prompt.ts`. This aligns the prompt structure with expected model output formatting. Scope limited to backend diff generation logic. No user-facing behavior change.

4ae09f01e7101d41e80049d3a3124268d40df2cc.title: Disable chat persistence to filesystem
4ae09f01e7101d41e80049d3a3124268d40df2cc.summary: Chat persistence to the local filesystem is disabled in `npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts`. The `fs.writeFileSync` call within `saveChat` is commented out, preventing chat data from being serialized to disk. This change affects the internal storage mechanism for the npm-app package.

b315e16373a3a4de337c60dd025dd6c3dae6c9f4.title: Version bump to 1.0.16
b315e16373a3a4de337c60dd025dd6c3dae6c9f4.summary: Incremented `manicode` package version from 1.0.15 to 1.0.16 in `npm-app/package.json`. Marked Windows-specific input and edit failures as resolved in `musings.knowledge.md`.

e788290a856521ec286135becbe706f8ae01dedd.title: System prompt: planning block becomes brainstorm block
e788290a856521ec286135becbe706f8ae01dedd.summary: Renamed the <planning> block to <brainstorm> in backend/src/system-prompt.ts. The instruction now asks the agent to consider possible plans, check for a better alternative to the first idea, and choose the best one before proceeding. Internal prompt-only change; no user-facing commands or model behavior contracts altered.

7ec8dddba2b6139649c21b314ea6c24c062cb47e.title: Update menu instructions
7ec8dddba2b6139649c21b314ea6c24c062cb47e.summary: Updated `npm-app/src/menu.ts` to clarify keyboard shortcuts and tip formatting. Changed exit instructions to specify ESC for closing and CTRL-C for exiting. Updated undo/redo tips to reference CTRL-U and CTRL-R instead of arrow keys.

112c961f63b83290118b293bbb8a05e0fb1316c0.title: CLI undo redo commands
112c961f63b83290118b293bbb8a05e0fb1316c0.summary: CLI keybindings for file version control switched from Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y to Ctrl+U/Ctrl+R. Internal handler methods renamed to handleUndo/handleRedo to match new semantics. Text commands `undo`, `redo`, `quit`, `exit`, and `q` added to input parser. Covers npm-app/src/cli.ts and npm-app/knowledge.md.

3b6a059bf1d4801d75acc2b67da774d0f5763273.title: Bump version to 1.0.15
3b6a059bf1d4801d75acc2b67da774d0f5763273.summary: Incremented `manicode` package version from 1.0.14 to 1.0.15 in `npm-app/package.json`. This change updates the internal version identifier for the CLI application. No functional code or dependencies were modified.

cb03845c5a62f71adae09578084e6b47779e67f6.title: CLI uses readline module
cb03845c5a62f71adae09578084e6b47779e67f6.summary: The CLI now utilizes the Node.js `readline` module for input handling, replacing custom raw-mode key processing. This update enables standard terminal features such as command history navigation via Up/Down arrows and cursor movement via Left/Right arrows. The `ChatStorage.navigateVersion` method signature changed from accepting 'left'/'right' to 'undo'/'redo', aligning with new `Ctrl+Z`/`Ctrl+Y` bindings for file version control. Changes affect `npm-app/src/cli.ts` and `npm-app/src/chat-storage.ts`.

1116bc4969e0bcba8b5edcc28030d74e43e4b951.title: Print generating files message earlier in CLI
1116bc4969e0bcba8b5edcc28030d74e43e4b951.summary: Moved the 'Generating file changes' console log from `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to `npm-app/src/client.ts`. The message now prints immediately when the response stream ends and contains the `STOP_MARKER` plus `</file>`, rather than waiting for the full response to be awaited. This provides faster feedback to the user during file generation.

1dbb42756316f806d1067fb14b43b3ecd57dccab.title: Simplify CLI response handling and fix client race
1dbb42756316f806d1067fb14b43b3ecd57dccab.summary: Refactored `sendUserInputAndAwaitResponse` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to remove the `onStreamEnd` callback, checking for `<file>` tags post-stream instead. Updated `npm-app/src/client.ts` to skip assistant message creation if the last message is already from the assistant, preventing duplicate logs on cancelled streams. Fixed WebSocket unsubscription logic to use a single `unsubscribe()` call.

6a6106b5d8222a89222b03928351581facdc31ff.title: Fix CLI escape to stop generating
6a6106b5d8222a89222b03928351581facdc31ff.summary: Refactored `subscribeToResponse` in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to return a `stopResponse` closure and `responsePromise` instead of an `unsubscribe` wrapper and raw result promise. Updated `npm-app/src/cli.ts` to invoke this closure on Esc key press, replacing the manual `stopResponseRequested` flag and `responseBuffer` logic with a `wasStoppedByUser` state returned by the client. This ensures file generation stops cleanly and the CLI correctly suppresses post-processing when the user interrupts the stream.

baf505b980bb3e0e3c5d316a82b97e0bb170f8f2.title: npm version 1.0.14
baf505b980bb3e0e3c5d316a82b97e0bb170f8f2.summary: Incremented npm package version from 1.0.13 to 1.0.14 in `npm-app/package.json`.

554f7982b3450290329a9a3826bcf8ab5ca1c872.title: Add explicit license fields to package.json files
554f7982b3450290329a9a3826bcf8ab5ca1c872.summary: Added `license: "MIT"` to `npm-app/package.json` and `license: "proprietary"` to root `package.json`. Created `README.md` clarifying that only the npm package is MIT licensed while server-side and non-public client code remains proprietary. This ensures correct license metadata is exposed for the public package.

2f3f472c6863b430222380e62ef807d6f8d142f4.title: Rename ChatClient to Client in npm-app
2f3f472c6863b430222380e62ef807d6f8d142f4.summary: Renamed `ChatClient` class to `Client` and `chat-client.ts` to `client.ts` within `npm-app`. Updated imports and constructor arguments in `src/cli.ts` and `src/index.ts` to reflect the new name and parameter order. Internal WebSocket property renamed from `ws` to `webSocket` for clarity. No functional changes to user-facing behavior.

782cd8f5cbfbede2b91bc633d0cc367b4c794c2b.title: Add root start script
782cd8f5cbfbede2b91bc633d0cc367b4c794c2b.summary: Added `start` script to root `package.json`. Delegates to `npm-app` workspace. Internal tooling only.

c12ece9730cc02fb05a607840526fa595b0433c3.title: Fix search replace line ending handling
c12ece9730cc02fb05a607840526fa595b0433c3.summary: Added line ending normalization and restoration to `processFileBlock` in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. CRLF files are normalized to LF before diff generation, and original line endings are restored in the returned changes. Prevents search/replace failures on Windows files.

8e31d5f27feb75694e2cb28ae6031dac8c82da56.title: Fix Windows line endings in main-prompt
8e31d5f27feb75694e2cb28ae6031dac8c82da56.summary: Normalize line endings for new file content before diff generation in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Export `processFileBlock` to enable unit testing. Add `backend/src/__tests__/main-prompt.test.ts` to verify normalization logic. Internal refactor affecting backend prompt processing.

8f965d94fe3cc86e60ec0305657274091e8ef9fb.title: 1.0.13 fixes path normalization and clean script
8f965d94fe3cc86e60ec0305657274091e8ef9fb.summary: Project file paths now normalize via `path.relative` instead of manual string replacement. Build `clean` script tolerates missing `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`. Adds `ssh` script for backend. Covers `npm-app` package.

efd99c7795a40dc705ea225946d8e2efd1e9fd92.title: Add Janna Stephen Windows test notes to musings.knowledge.md
efd99c7795a40dc705ea225946d8e2efd1e9fd92.summary: Added Janna & Stephen test findings to musings.knowledge.md. Notes detail Windows-specific input and edit failures: backspace cursor movement, left arrow unresponsiveness, edit application errors, and CTRL-C non-functionality. Scope limited to internal documentation.

76004ab06fdd148150bf243ed8ef3162e0cc9b28.title: Rename manicode workspace to npm-app
76004ab06fdd148150bf243ed8ef3162e0cc9b28.summary: Renamed the `manicode` directory to `npm-app`. Updated root `package.json` workspaces and `tsconfig.json` references to point to the new path. Internal refactor; no functional changes to the CLI or API.

472cf449d13ecbad427d002d24d5fcb71b9c270c.title: Disable exported tokens in project file context
472cf449d13ecbad427d002d24d5fcb71b9c270c.summary: Commented out `getExportedTokensForFiles` call in `getProjectFileContext` and wrapped function definitions in `npm-app/src/project-files.ts` with block comments. Removed unused `typescript` import. Exported tokens are now hardcoded to an empty object `{}`.

cb03845c5a62f71adae09578084e6b47779e67f6.text: The app now uses standard keyboard shortcuts, so you can use the arrow keys to move the cursor and see past commands. This replaces older custom settings with familiar behavior.

b315e16373a3a4de337c60dd025dd6c3dae6c9f4.text: A small update was made. It notes that some typing and editing problems on Windows are now marked fixed. For a Windows user, those problems are no longer listed as current issues.

3b6a059bf1d4801d75acc2b67da774d0f5763273.text: The internal version label changed. Nothing new for you to use.

782cd8f5cbfbede2b91bc633d0cc367b4c794c2b.text: The team made a small, behind-the-scenes update to how the software starts up. This change does not affect how you use the product.

8e31d5f27feb75694e2cb28ae6031dac8c82da56.text: This is a small internal update that fixes how text is handled in the background. You will not notice any changes.

baf505b980bb3e0e3c5d316a82b97e0bb170f8f2.text: Internal maintenance update to package version. No visible changes for users.

6a6106b5d8222a89222b03928351581facdc31ff.text: Pressing the escape key now stops the assistant's response generation cleanly. This prevents the system from processing incomplete or unwanted text after you interrupt it.

554f7982b3450290329a9a3826bcf8ab5ca1c872.text: The product now clearly shows its rules for sharing. Some parts are open for everyone to use, while others stay private.

2f3f472c6863b430222380e62ef807d6f8d142f4.text: The software team renamed some internal parts to make them easier to understand. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

112c961f63b83290118b293bbb8a05e0fb1316c0.text: Undo and redo now use different keyboard shortcuts, and you can also type commands to undo, redo, or quit.

c12ece9730cc02fb05a607840526fa595b0433c3.text: Search and replace now works correctly on files created on Windows. This fixes a small internal issue that previously caused errors when editing text in these files.

5e81bc14db8a67c436efd3daf760b76f7fb31b37.title: Remove spurious common dependency from manicode
5e81bc14db8a67c436efd3daf760b76f7fb31b37.summary: Removed invalid `common` dependency from `manicode/package.json`. Added `start-prod` script with `NODE_ENV=production`. Bumped package version to 1.0.2. Internal repo cleanup.

48a6d3eac7865d80599ceb88bdbeebace9293376.title: manicode 1.0.7
48a6d3eac7865d80599ceb88bdbeebace9293376.summary: manicode 1.0.7 fixes bin entry. dist/manicode.js removed. dist/index.js used. prebuild/postbuild scripts add tsc-alias. zod 3.21.4 added. Covers manicode/package.json. Build pipeline refactored for alias resolution.

b0511da7882199f5cacbbd0b37380c3fe33dde85.title: Use process.cwd() as project root
b0511da7882199f5cacbbd0b37380c3fe33dde85.summary: The `manicode` package updated its version to 1.0.11 and switched the `projectRoot` definition in `src/config.ts` from a static path resolution (`path.resolve(__dirname, '..')`) to dynamic execution via `process.cwd()`. This change ensures that file operations and chat storage correctly target the directory where the CLI is invoked, rather than the installation directory. `ChatStorage` and `project-files.ts` were refactored to consume the centralized `projectRoot` export, removing redundant local path calculations and constructor parameters.

9b3b7939d6ea8127e8c082965f390ce17a0843de.title: Add musings to knowledge file
9b3b7939d6ea8127e8c082965f390ce17a0843de.summary: Added three new todo items to musings.knowledge.md regarding file path context usage, server error printing visibility, and IP address configuration. These entries serve as internal tracking for potential future improvements or debugging tasks.

4d25562637e4f7a3ab075a45705211bb33a7e90c.title: Dockerfile sets NODEENV and copies .env
4d25562637e4f7a3ab075a45705211bb33a7e90c.summary: backend/Dockerfile sets NODE_ENV=production and copies .env alongside package.json. manicode/src/config.ts enables production check via process.env.NODE_ENV, switching websocketUrl to ws:// for production. Scope covers backend container config and manicode client settings. Note: insecure websockets (ws://) used temporarily in production.

11ccbdb184aab6cb277ee80ccf773aea3f0cc099.title: Add clean-package.js and publish hooks for manicode 1.0.9
11ccbdb184aab6cb277ee80ccf773aea3f0cc099.summary: Introduces clean-package.js and prepublishOnly/postpublish scripts in package.json to strip devDependencies and peerDependencies from the published tarball while preserving the local environment. The script also injects process.env.NODE_ENV = 'production' into dist/index.js to enforce production behavior. Concurrently, src/config.ts removes the custom loadEnvironmentVariables function and associated fs imports, relying instead on standard environment handling or the injected NODE_ENV. This internal cleanup reduces published package size and ensures consistent runtime configuration for the manicode CLI.

b0511da7882199f5cacbbd0b37380c3fe33dde85.text: The tool now works directly inside the folder you open. This fixes problems where files were saved in the wrong place.

76004ab06fdd148150bf243ed8ef3162e0cc9b28.text: Renamed internal project folder. No effect on features or usage.

efd99c7795a40dc705ea225946d8e2efd1e9fd92.text: The team recorded notes about problems with typing and copying on Windows computers. This update only adds internal records and does not change how the product works for users.

9b3b7939d6ea8127e8c082965f390ce17a0843de.text: The team added three notes to their internal list about future improvements. This small, behind-the-scenes update does not change how the product works for users.

48a6d3eac7865d80599ceb88bdbeebace9293376.text: The application now starts correctly when installed. This small internal update fixes a launch problem.

11ccbdb184aab6cb277ee80ccf773aea3f0cc099.text: A small internal cleanup makes the tool load faster and behave the same way for everyone. It removes extra files that were never used after installation.

472cf449d13ecbad427d002d24d5fcb71b9c270c.text: A small internal update stops the system from looking up extra details about your files. This change does not affect how you use the product.

4d25562637e4f7a3ab075a45705211bb33a7e90c.text: The system now automatically switches to a secure connection mode for live updates when running in production. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

5e81bc14db8a67c436efd3daf760b76f7fb31b37.text: A small internal cleanup removed an unnecessary connection that was causing errors. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

1f86dbbdd6e16a41222551540eb99bf60e5382b1.text: The assistant now knows which folder to use when running tasks. This keeps commands in the right place, so it works on the correct files.

682e9fe5268e2eb2892d214c6cf4dfe22235f1e3.text: The team updated the app's internal version number. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

5c80a84f990f119a51db1f172827e751735f635c.text: The assistant now follows a clearer rule for when to update files. This small internal change helps it avoid saving changes too early.

a72118747f09a2e07a0ad93c289360752fb8b968.text: The app’s internal packaging data was updated. This is a small maintenance change with no visible effect on users.

46be127346fb972fea119f4fe244051d423b585e.text: The service now connects to a separate address for background tasks. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

24667acf4343433cba3279e8a8235efd0df83c7b.text: The assistant can now run system commands on your computer. This lets it perform tasks directly, like checking files or running programs.

59ae997b11f54f1c34c578778feed1b4c7ac01a2.text: The assistant's internal instructions were updated to help it find relevant files more accurately when making changes. This is a small, behind-the-scenes adjustment that improves how the tool locates information.

f958197f5e506f58dd43054cfe8668f691e89cdc.text: A small internal change fixed a minor formatting issue in a background file. This has no impact on how the product works or what you see.

5a1168bae1ff1b897b96323f72fe2cb1cd1cae9d.text: Fixed a minor internal bug that caused duplicate prompts during cleanup.

33ffa777d15bae95e4aaeabfdeb2533708cdab88.text: The computer quietly records details about how it processes requests for its own troubleshooting. You will not see any changes to how the product works.

d37dfa943b0da5dda6fe0f9b33eb8e6f0993ec64.title: Backend Docker deployment, build scripts, and system prompt update
d37dfa943b0da5dda6fe0f9b33eb8e6f0993ec64.summary: Added backend/Dockerfile and backend/deploy.sh to containerize and push the backend service to gcr.io/manicode-430317/manicode-backend. Updated backend/package.json and common/package.json with composite TypeScript build scripts (prebuild, postbuild, clean) and renamed backend/src/openai.ts to backend/src/openai-api.ts. Modified backend/src/system-prompt.ts to instruct the agent to skip editing files if contents are already correct, preventing redundant writes.

02565d598fcc0b55c1ac1769c8807d9fdc7d6c20.title: Add GCP VM deploy script, update main prompt with scrapewebpage tool
02565d598fcc0b55c1ac1769c8807d9fdc7d6c20.summary: backend/deploy.sh expanded from bare `yarn build` and `docker build` into full GCP deployment pipeline: Docker image build, GCR push, firewall rule creation, and `gcloud compute instances create-with-container` on e2-micro VM in us-east4-a. backend/src/main-prompt.ts adds instruction to invoke `scrape_web_page` tool when user provides URL, before `read_files` request. Scope internal, repo-level only.

ca5f91dc4d362b9e1936d21121f9711545343daf.title: Fix backend Docker build and deploy config
ca5f91dc4d362b9e1936d21121f9711545343daf.summary: Backend Docker build now uses `tsc-alias` to resolve path aliases into relative imports in `dist`, preventing "Cannot find module" errors at runtime. Entry point renamed from `src/server.ts` to `src/index.ts` across `package.json` scripts and Dockerfile. `deploy.sh` updated to force `linux/amd64` platform, switch VM machine type to `n2-standard-2`, and pin COS image family to `cos-109-lts`. `manicode/src/config.ts` adds `isProduction` flag to toggle WebSocket URL between localhost and wss://manicode.ai.

f2dbd7a08cd0a43be5d10aa3a45ec34f8504400a.title: Default port 4242, lodash peerDeps, build cleanup
f2dbd7a08cd0a43be5d10aa3a45ec34f8504400a.summary: Default backend port changed from 3000 to 4242 in `backend/src/server.ts` and `manicode/src/config.ts`. `lodash` moved to `peerDependencies` or wildcard versions across `backend`, `common`, and `manicode` `package.json` files. `manicode` build script simplified to remove redundant `copy-files` step and clean `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`. Root `package.json` adds `lodash` and types to `devDependencies`.

b50f3e0787f1faf744fc8a879bd0dd9470643d50.text: The software received a routine update that tracks its release history. This change does not affect how you use the product.

e788290a856521ec286135becbe706f8ae01dedd.text: The assistant now checks for better ideas before choosing a plan. This small internal update helps it make smarter decisions.

cf60580e175b2db88db0bc2818b8ea16fbdba792.text: The tool now follows project ignore rules automatically, so it skips the right files when searching. This internal update has no visible change for you.

02565d598fcc0b55c1ac1769c8807d9fdc7d6c20.text: A small internal update changed how the product is made available online and how it handles web links. When you give it a link, it can now read that page before looking at your files.

4ae09f01e7101d41e80049d3a3124268d40df2cc.text: The app stopped saving chat data to your device. For normal use, chat data is no longer kept there.

7ec8dddba2b6139649c21b314ea6c24c062cb47e.text: The help menu now shows clearer instructions for keyboard shortcuts. You can close menus with the Escape key and quit the program with Control-C. Undo and redo now use Control-U and Control-R instead of the arrow keys.

f2dbd7a08cd0a43be5d10aa3a45ec34f8504400a.text: The assistant now uses a different default connection point, which may help avoid conflicts with other programs. Some internal setup tasks were simplified to keep the system running smoothly.

d37dfa943b0da5dda6fe0f9b33eb8e6f0993ec64.text: The service runs more reliably and uses less data because the assistant now skips rewriting files that are already correct.

1116bc4969e0bcba8b5edcc28030d74e43e4b951.text: The app now shows a progress message earlier while creating files. This gives you quicker feedback that work is happening.

5b3e9d0875c0b9501bb7a38993cb70c999308f3c.title: Remove auto-scrape from knowledge files
5b3e9d0875c0b9501bb7a38993cb70c999308f3c.summary: Removed automatic web scraping of URLs found in `knowledge.md` files during project context loading. `getProjectFileContext` now calls `getExistingFiles` instead of `getExistingFilesWithScrapedContent`, and the latter's scraping logic was deleted. The system prompt was updated to explicitly instruct the agent to use the `web_scrape` tool for URLs found in knowledge files or provided by the user, rather than relying on pre-loaded scraped content.

72591c6b937cf3872d2e2162a041fedadb2e3965.title: CLI conditional file changes message
72591c6b937cf3872d2e2162a041fedadb2e3965.summary: Updated `onStreamEnd` callback in `manicode/src/cli.ts` to accept the full response string. The 'Generating file changes' log now only prints if the response contains the `</file>` tag. This prevents misleading status updates when no file changes are generated.

12e25be8a163cb29d77631abc7a6a4ab76ee970f.title: Add many-updates diff generation test case
12e25be8a163cb29d77631abc7a6a4ab76ee970f.summary: New mock fixture `many-updates` added to backend tests to exercise `generateDiffs` on a complex `ChatClient` file. The fixture provides `old.ts` and `new.ts` versions with distinct tool handler implementations and subscription logic. A corresponding test case in `prompts.test.ts` runs the diff generation against this fixture, ensuring the model correctly handles multiple structural changes in a single file update.

d8e0e8bda4483fb8973248c4589cc7f3ab2d63f2.title: Restore automatic URL scraping for knowledge files
d8e0e8bda4483fb8973248c4589cc7f3ab2d63f2.summary: Re-enabled automatic scraping of URLs found in `knowledge.md` files. `getExistingFilesWithScrapedContent` now parses URLs and appends scraped web content within `<web_scraped_content>` tags. System prompt updated to reflect this behavior. Affects `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`, `manicode/src/index.ts`, and `manicode/src/project-files.ts`.

ffe0b0d53c8dd60bf7542c81ed485e9298b523e2.title: Send error message as response-chunk in WebSocket
ffe0b0d53c8dd60bf7542c81ed485e9298b523e2.summary: WebSocket handler wraps mainPrompt in try/catch. Extracts e.message, sends via response-chunk, then response-complete after 100ms. CLI suppresses 'Complete!' log if changesSuceeded is empty. Covers backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts and manicode/src/cli.ts.

c0839d542c602e23c2260a2e68fb6b4732c9630e.title: Add web scraping to knowledge files
c0839d542c602e23c2260a2e68fb6b4732c9630e.summary: System prompt now instructs agent to save helpful URLs in knowledge files. New `web-scraper.ts` in `manicode` uses `axios` and `cheerio` to fetch page content. `getProjectFileContext` in `project-files.ts` awaits scraping and appends content to knowledge files before sending context. This automates the ingestion of external documentation.

35b93639aaa0860381c7b3f2c3ba39bee6170b8d.title: Remove message history from diffs prompt
35b93639aaa0860381c7b3f2c3ba39bee6170b8d.summary: Removed message history injection from the diffs generation prompt in backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts. The <message_history> block is stripped, leaving only the old file content and prompt instructions for diff calculation.

33d729465cbb73556b089f0c5501ec4357605772.title: Add scrapewebpage tool with handler registry refactor
33d729465cbb73556b089f0c5501ec4357605772.summary: New `scrape_web_page` tool added to backend via `getTools` in `backend/src/tools.ts`, accepting a `url` string. `manicode/src/chat-client.ts` refactored to use a dynamic `toolHandlers` registry from new `manicode/src/tool-handlers.ts` instead of hardcoded `read_files` logic, enabling async execution. `handleScrapeWebPage` wraps output in `<web_scraped_content>` tags or returns `<web_scraping_error>` on failure. `backend/knowledge.md` updated with Web Scraping section.

805c04d86eba0256b6b293ce3b8555a97d3ec960.title: Add DELETE token for file removal in CLI
805c04d86eba0256b6b293ce3b8555a97d3ec960.summary: Agent can delete files via [DELETE] token in file block body. applyChanges detects token, calls fs.unlinkSync. CLI logs Deleted instead of Created/Updated. Covers backend system-prompt, manicode project-files, cli.ts.

d8e0e8bda4483fb8973248c4589cc7f3ab2d63f2.text: The assistant now automatically reads web links found in your knowledge files. This means it can use information from those linked pages to answer your questions.

5b3e9d0875c0b9501bb7a38993cb70c999308f3c.text: The system no longer automatically reads web links stored in project files. It now waits for you to ask before fetching online content.

12e25be8a163cb29d77631abc7a6a4ab76ee970f.text: The team added a test to check how the assistant handles files with many changes at once. This is an internal update that helps ensure the assistant works correctly for you.

72591c6b937cf3872d2e2162a041fedadb2e3965.text: The tool now hides a 'generating changes' message when it does not actually create new files. This stops the screen from showing a misleading status update.

805c04d86eba0256b6b293ce3b8555a97d3ec960.text: The assistant can now remove files when asked. This lets it clean up old or unwanted items directly.

c0839d542c602e23c2260a2e68fb6b4732c9630e.text: The assistant now automatically reads and saves helpful web pages to its memory. This means it can use online instructions without you having to copy them manually.

33d729465cbb73556b089f0c5501ec4357605772.text: The assistant can now read website content when asked. This change also improved how the system handles these new reading tasks behind the scenes.

f1744c6fb4c1c5e1c281acd92756d59a40c9453e.text: The assistant can now look up predictions about future events.

ffe0b0d53c8dd60bf7542c81ed485e9298b523e2.text: The system now displays error messages directly to users during connection issues instead of failing silently. This small internal update ensures you see clearer feedback when something goes wrong.

35b93639aaa0860381c7b3f2c3ba39bee6170b8d.text: The assistant now creates file changes using only the current file content and instructions. It no longer uses the chat history to decide what to change.

da30a4f348314aaee13d0fb84c2e8924d7c02e97.title: Prompt tweaks for diff generation
da30a4f348314aaee13d0fb84c2e8924d7c02e97.summary: Updated prompts in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to clarify handling of placeholder comments like `// ... existing code ...`. The diff generation prompt now explicitly expects placeholders in new file content, while the system prompt emphasizes the risk of deleting file content if placeholders are omitted. Internal prompt engineering only.

00954e950de26748808545ae0f70a4dbac3c3496.title: Update CLI prompts and menu tips
00954e950de26748808545ae0f70a4dbac3c3496.summary: src/index.ts prompt adds ESC hint. src/menu.ts changes SPACE action to chat and replaces Tips with TODO. Knowledge.md instruction simplified.

f4d70bdcc4276869ebffbfe0dd36d4839a93305b.title: CLI direct write smooths input typing
f4d70bdcc4276869ebffbfe0dd36d4839a93305b.summary: CLI input handler writes keystrokes directly to stdout instead of full line refresh. `process.stdout.write(key)` replaces `this.refreshLine()` in the character append path. `getInputLineCount` extracted from `refreshLine` to track line height after direct writes. Scope limited to `manicode/src/cli.ts`.

6efe8eaafa786edb594157b9bb413f90093b2426.title: CLI history navigation preserves unsent input
6efe8eaafa786edb594157b9bb413f90093b2426.summary: CLI history navigation now preserves the current `inputBuffer` when moving through previous commands. The `savedInput` property stores the active buffer before history traversal begins and restores it when the index returns to -1. This prevents the loss of unsent text when navigating up and down in `manicode/src/cli.ts`. The fix ensures that returning to the end of the history stack displays the original input rather than an empty string.

bf2c0599c4ad19c2859bca142536c5b8f8187e71.title: Update manicode build process and tsconfig
bf2c0599c4ad19c2859bca142536c5b8f8187e71.summary: Refactored `manicode/package.json` to chain `yarn build:common`, `yarn build:manicode`, and `yarn dist:copy` for the build script, replacing direct `tsc` invocation. Updated `manicode/tsconfig.json` to set `rootDir` to `./src` alongside `outDir`. This ensures proper compilation structure and artifact copying for the manicode package.

80b9a1ddfa78dd182116dabcfbf1c851628d97c1.title: Restructure manicode as npm package
80b9a1ddfa78dd182116dabcfbf1c851628d97c1.summary: Reorganizes the monorepo to make the `manicode` CLI an installable npm package. Moves client source files into a new `manicode` workspace, adds `manicode/package.json` and `tsconfig.json`, and updates root `package.json` workspaces. Refactors `backend` and `common` tsconfigs to support composite builds without inheriting from root. Adds `STOP_MARKER` to `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts`.

0c7c30edebde240f56733da60cdae23a4f9a6ff1.title: Manicode README and package files export
0c7c30edebde240f56733da60cdae23a4f9a6ff1.summary: Added manicode/README.md documenting CLI usage, knowledge.md context strategy, and installation. Updated manicode/package.json files field to export dist and README.md. This ensures the package contains necessary documentation and build artifacts when published.

a68ca54ce698b982ea9fc51d829501e1ed954c10.title: CLI chat response handling and storage fix
a68ca54ce698b982ea9fc51d829501e1ed954c10.summary: Fixed non-alternating chat bug by ensuring assistant messages are always persisted to ChatStorage, regardless of user stop requests. Refactored sendUserInputAndAwaitResponse to return a Promise resolving with response and file changes, replacing previous branching logic. Updated variable names (chartClient to chatClient, wsClient to client) in manicode/src/cli.ts and manicode/src/index.ts for consistency.

033bd3caba7038d2fde5ba62b7a1e3554c5dccac.title: CLI menu replaced with static ascii art and tips
033bd3caba7038d2fde5ba62b7a1e3554c5dccac.summary: The interactive chat history menu in `src/menu.ts` and `src/cli.ts` was replaced with a static ASCII art display and usage tips. The `displayMenu` function no longer accepts `ChatStorage` or manages navigation state, simplifying the CLI startup flow. Users now press SPACE to bypass the menu and enter the prompt directly, removing the ability to select or create chats via arrow-key navigation at this stage.

3383120ca5be7ec0dcab06028a1a41a518b54b68.title: Add Manicode project structure knowledge base
3383120ca5be7ec0dcab06028a1a41a518b54b68.summary: New file `manicode/knowledge.md` documents the Manicode project structure, covering root configuration, source layout (`src/`), build process, and key components like `ChatClient` and `CLI`. This internal documentation establishes context for the AI agent's knowledge management system, detailing how `knowledge.md` files are used to store project-specific guidance. The file explicitly notes that Manicode is designed to update these knowledge files dynamically as it works.

f4d70bdcc4276869ebffbfe0dd36d4839a93305b.text: Typing into the command line feels smoother now because each key appears instantly instead of redrawing the whole line. This small internal fix makes text entry more responsive.

80b9a1ddfa78dd182116dabcfbf1c851628d97c1.text: The tool was reorganized so it can be installed on its own more easily. It also gained a clearer signal for when generated text should stop. This is mostly an internal change, so everyday use should look the same.

6efe8eaafa786edb594157b9bb413f90093b2426.text: You can now press the up and down arrow keys to look through past commands without losing whatever you have already typed but not yet sent.

bf2c0599c4ad19c2859bca142536c5b8f8187e71.text: The internal tools that create the product were improved to ensure everything is packaged correctly. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

0c7c30edebde240f56733da60cdae23a4f9a6ff1.text: The tool now includes helpful instructions and guides for users. This makes it easier to understand how to use the assistant.

a68ca54ce698b982ea9fc51d829501e1ed954c10.text: Fixed a bug so chat history stays accurate even if you stop a response. This is an internal cleanup.

3383120ca5be7ec0dcab06028a1a41a518b54b68.text: The assistant now keeps a plain-language guide about how its own tools fit together. It updates that guide as it works. This is an internal change; you will not notice anything different.

033bd3caba7038d2fde5ba62b7a1e3554c5dccac.text: The startup menu changed to a static screen with tips. Press SPACE to skip it and start chatting.

00954e950de26748808545ae0f70a4dbac3c3496.text: The menu now shows how to cancel actions and uses the space bar to start a chat. The help tips were replaced with a to-do list, and the assistant's instructions were simplified.

da30a4f348314aaee13d0fb84c2e8924d7c02e97.text: The assistant was updated to better understand instructions about keeping existing code when suggesting changes. This small internal improvement helps prevent accidental deletion of content.

9081ea5fd0ccd2abe261611943629cb2ca571de4.title: Rename WebSocketClient to ChatClient
9081ea5fd0ccd2abe261611943629cb2ca571de4.summary: Renamed `WebSocketClient` class and `websocket-client.ts` file to `ChatClient` and `chat-client.ts`. Updated references in `src/cli.ts` and `src/index.ts` to use the new name. Internal refactor for clarity; no functional changes.

446a332cd560740bb94873ad815982f692a39afa.title: CLI left/right arrow file version navigation
446a332cd560740bb94873ad815982f692a39afa.summary: Left/right arrow keys navigate file versions in CLI chat sessions. `ChatStorage` tracks `FileVersion` snapshots per message; `project-files.ts` adds `getExistingFiles` and `setFiles` for disk sync. Scope limited to `src/chat-storage.ts`, `src/cli.ts`, `src/project-files.ts`.

3521ae1731ba655d9dcb718a8d408ea74f84cb9d.title: Add file-specific knowledge files to system prompt
3521ae1731ba655d9dcb718a8d408ea74f84cb9d.summary: System prompt updated to support file-specific knowledge files alongside directory-level ones. Agents now create `<filename>.knowledge.md` for granular context, while `knowledge.md` remains for directory scopes. This change resides in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Exclusion rule for single-file documentation explicitly directs users to the new file-specific format.

fc982c8568ae25d4a81d20d465653d8b72cc2069.title: Refactor diff generation to patch-based expansion
fc982c8568ae25d4a81d20d465653d8b72cc2069.summary: Replaced `generate-diffs-haiku.ts` with `generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts`, introducing `generatePatch` that uses `diff.createPatch` after LLM expansion. Added `openai.ts` wrapper for `gpt-4o` chat completions. Updated `backend/package.json` with `openai`, `diff`, and `@types/diff` dependencies. Expansion prompt now enforces exact line copying and handles trailing brackets.

48ad7f372029c76ef633a3fcb148a1601d110352.title: knowledge.md adds Knowledge Management section and TODO
48ad7f372029c76ef633a3fcb148a1601d110352.summary: knowledge.md gains a Knowledge Management subsystem description and file reference. Guidelines shift to plural 'knowledge files' with new comment/documentation rule. TODO replaces error-handling item with 'Try a better diffing strategy?'.

f8e7677a226835196471a95b36e1b5501fa393de.title: Exclude mock-data from backend tsconfig
f8e7677a226835196471a95b36e1b5501fa393de.summary: Added `exclude` rule to `backend/tsconfig.json` to ignore `src/**/__mock-data__/**/*`. Prevents TypeScript compiler errors from test mock files. Internal build configuration update.

1a0cb9c328cdeba83a093af35e3751910662ac21.title: Add Haiku-based diff expansion and sliding window algorithm
1a0cb9c328cdeba83a093af35e3751910662ac21.summary: New backend module `generate-diffs-haiku.ts` implements `expandNewContent` using Claude Haiku to resolve placeholder comments in shortened diffs, alongside `generateDiffBlocks` using a sliding window match strategy. Knowledge base updated to document `windowSize` trade-offs: larger windows handle scattered changes but degrade performance (O(windowSize^2)) and accuracy. Scope limited to backend diff generation subsystem.

b00d1c37492084dec807ea468716e4c9c55c361f.title: Split prompts.ts into main-prompt and generate-diffs-prompt
b00d1c37492084dec807ea468716e4c9c55c361f.summary: Refactored backend/src/prompts.ts into two files: backend/src/main-prompt.ts and backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts. mainPrompt now handles the core streaming loop and tool calls, while diff generation logic is isolated. Updated imports in backend/src/server.ts and backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts to reference the new module structure.

f23277e9a0fdc0988a4d8b4559acb3bb131972ce.title: Defer file changes to response completion in CLI
f23277e9a0fdc0988a4d8b4559acb3bb131972ce.summary: File changes are now batched and applied only after the assistant response finishes streaming, replacing the immediate `change-files` WebSocket action with `response-complete`. The `user-input` client action requires a `previousChanges` payload to carry over pending edits across tool-call loops. This affects `backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`, `common/src/actions.ts`, `src/chat-client.ts`, and `src/cli.ts`. The CLI now prints 'Generating file changes...' on stream end and deduplicates applied changes using `uniqBy` before writing to disk.

4ae0090ae9f7110e93090689876343fb1f83ee1b.title: STOPMARKER shortened to END, claude.ts removed
4ae0090ae9f7110e93090689876343fb1f83ee1b.summary: STOP_MARKER constant in common/src/constants.ts changed from '[END_OF_RESPONSE]' to '[END]'. System prompt and continuation logic updated to encourage explicit marker usage for user guidance. Deleted unused src/claude.ts Anthropic wrapper. Removed redundant cli.promptUser() call in src/index.ts.

9081ea5fd0ccd2abe261611943629cb2ca571de4.text: Developers renamed an internal tool to make its purpose clearer. The product works exactly the same.

f8e7677a226835196471a95b36e1b5501fa393de.text: The system now ignores test data during setup. This fixes internal errors. You will see no change.

3521ae1731ba655d9dcb718a8d408ea74f84cb9d.text: The assistant can now use separate memory notes for each file, not just folders. This helps it remember details about specific documents you are working on.

fc982c8568ae25d4a81d20d465653d8b72cc2069.text: The system now checks changes more carefully by copying exact lines. This makes the results more accurate for you.

446a332cd560740bb94873ad815982f692a39afa.text: Users can now use their keyboard's left and right arrow keys to look at previous and next versions of files while chatting with the assistant. This small update makes reviewing past changes easier without needing to click through menus.

b00d1c37492084dec807ea468716e4c9c55c361f.text: The team reorganized the internal instructions that guide the assistant's responses, separating general behavior from specific tasks like creating updates. This change is small and internal, meaning it improves how the system is managed without altering the features or experience for users.

4ae0090ae9f7110e93090689876343fb1f83ee1b.text: The assistant uses a shorter signal to know when it has finished answering. You might see clearer pauses and endings in conversations.

b68ba06952382ea3483c96037b8d91d27ad2ee94.title: Add chat history menu to manicode mock data
b68ba06952382ea3483c96037b8d91d27ad2ee94.summary: Added interactive chat history menu to `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/existing-comments` scripts. Implemented `displayMenu` and `initializeMenu` functions for navigating chat sessions with arrow keys. Constants `CHATS_PER_PAGE` and `NEW_CHAT_OPTION` moved into function scope. Scope limited to test mock data files; no production code affected.

c71bcaf718b7cad73c63bd83f4f64b41a3decb7e.title: System prompt adds step-by-step plan reasoning
c71bcaf718b7cad73c63bd83f4f64b41a3decb7e.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts injects an instruction for Manny to explain plan reasoning step-by-step for complex tasks and re-explain after error corrections. The change also adds a 'You are concise' directive to the persona block. Scope is limited to the backend system prompt generation logic.

97c2699071e9133449a76c8d29d785664c74b360.title: Standardize prompt shorthand to // ... existing code ...
97c2699071e9133449a76c8d29d785664c74b360.summary: Backend prompts in `backend/src/prompts.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` now strictly enforce `// ... existing code ...` as the sole shorthand for unchanged code, removing support for `... rest of the file` and similar variations. This standardization ensures consistent parsing of search/replace blocks by eliminating ambiguous placeholder formats. The change affects the core editing instructions sent to the model, requiring all file modification examples to use the single approved comment string.

2d4fe63dadde995c5238e2eed91f090fcd48eb72.title: Chat history menu in CLI
2d4fe63dadde995c5238e2eed91f090fcd48eb72.summary: Added interactive chat history navigation menu to CLI input handling in `src/index.ts`. Pressing ESC now toggles a paginated list of previous chats and a 'New chat' option, selectable via arrow keys and SPACE/ENTER. This replaces the previous behavior where ESC immediately exited the application when not receiving a response. The menu logic manages state via `isInMenu`, `menuSelectedIndex`, and `menuOffset`, integrating with `chatStorage.listChats()`.

cabb0ebd15ee2b4ec5e01b4af15e1c2be2f3dde2.title: Robust backspace handling for multi-line input
cabb0ebd15ee2b4ec5e01b4af15e1c2be2f3dde2.summary: Implemented dynamic line tracking and clearing logic in refreshLine to support multi-line input rendering. Replaced simple clearLine with cursor movement loops based on terminal width and buffer length. Updated src/index.ts to handle input buffer changes and resets correctly.

0b87d658bd2a85d375d86079b79ec0eaf359c041.title: Add unsure and scope guardrails to system prompt
0b87d658bd2a85d375d86079b79ec0eaf359c041.summary: Added explicit instructions to `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` requiring the agent to state uncertainty and defer on large scopes. The prompt now mandates the phrase "I don't have enough information to confidently answer your question" when unsure. It also instructs the agent to identify requests exceeding 750 lines of code as too large and ask the user to select a sub-problem. This internal change applies to the backend system prompt generation.

391963d260dc0351a28eb3fd24cca2c9968ef85e.title: Fix diff application bug and improve prompts
391963d260dc0351a28eb3fd24cca2c9968ef85e.summary: Corrects `processFileBlock` to record actual `searchContent`/`replaceContent` instead of original `oldContent`/`newContent`. Refines file-editing prompts to enforce exact context matching, remove invalid placeholder comments from search blocks, and simplify indentation instructions. Adds temporary `fs.writeFileSync` debug hook in `backend/src/prompts.ts`.

29d41099d146c6cf01e4c86de2f6f7a08e259dc8.title: Add existing-comments test fixtures and reorganize mock data
29d41099d146c6cf01e4c86de2f6f7a08e259dc8.summary: New test fixtures under `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/existing-comments/` validate diff generation when preserving existing comments. Previous indentation-specific mock files moved to `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__/indentation/` for clearer categorization. `prompts.test.ts` updated to reference new paths and includes a test case for handling lots of comments.

e7f52632973782fea2bf03ea76964af888d84850.title: Refactor CLI into modular components
e7f52632973782fea2bf03ea76964af888d84850.summary: Split monolithic index.ts into discrete modules: cli.ts, config.ts, menu.ts, and websocket-client.ts. ChatStorage now manages currentChat state with getCurrentChat/setCurrentChat methods. Backend prompts.ts fixes debug log variable scope in processFileBlock. This structure separates concerns for easier maintenance and testing.

f50c11cd424aa5fa7d072d06cbcb7380dfac2d84.title: prompts.ts: lettered edit groups + indentation retry fallback
f50c11cd424aa5fa7d072d06cbcb7380dfac2d84.summary: Prompt steps 2/3/5 now require lettered edit groups (A, B...) with per-edit context and indentation levels, and example search/replace blocks are prefixed with those letters. parseAndGetDiffBlocks gains a tryToDoStringReplacementWithExtraIndentation fallback: when a search block misses, it retries by prefixing every line with 1-12 spaces then 1-6 tabs to recover from model indentation drift. Covers backend prompts.ts plus updated prompts.test.ts and index-new-goal.ts mock data. Fallback returns the indented search/replace pair only on exact match, otherwise the block still falls through to diffBlocksThatDidntMatch.

2d4fe63dadde995c5238e2eed91f090fcd48eb72.text: Pressing the Escape key now opens a menu to browse past chats or start a new one, instead of closing the program.

c71bcaf718b7cad73c63bd83f4f64b41a3decb7e.text: The assistant now shows its thinking steps when solving hard problems and after fixing errors. It also keeps answers shorter and to the point.

b68ba06952382ea3483c96037b8d91d27ad2ee94.text: A small internal tool for testing chat features was updated. Users will not notice any change.

0b87d658bd2a85d375d86079b79ec0eaf359c041.text: The assistant now admits when it lacks enough information to answer confidently. It also asks users to narrow down very large requests instead of trying to handle them all at once.

391963d260dc0351a28eb3fd24cca2c9968ef85e.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant failed to find the correct spot to make edits. Improved instructions to help it match text exactly and format changes properly.

e7f52632973782fea2bf03ea76964af888d84850.text: The program's internal structure was reorganized to separate different functions. This change is invisible to users but makes the software easier to maintain and test.

cabb0ebd15ee2b4ec5e01b4af15e1c2be2f3dde2.text: The app now correctly removes text when you press backspace on multi-line inputs. This small internal fix ensures your typing appears as expected.

29d41099d146c6cf01e4c86de2f6f7a08e259dc8.text: The system's ability to accurately process documents with many existing comments was improved. This internal change ensures the tool works more reliably when handling complex files.

97c2699071e9133449a76c8d29d785664c74b360.text: The assistant now uses one fixed phrase to mark unchanged code, removing ambiguous alternatives. This internal adjustment helps it edit files more consistently. No visible changes for users.

93763411363636e4194f79caaf5bf7b264e8e1d1.title: Clarify codereview and planning trigger conditions
93763411363636e4194f79caaf5bf7b264e8e1d1.summary: System prompt instructions for <code_review> and <planning> blocks tightened. <code_review> now mandates post-file-read context; <planning> requires understanding both request and code. Scope: backend/src/system-prompt.ts, backend/src/claude.ts (added continuation debug logs), musings.knowledge.md (tracked issues).

e7b486a15b295697e22197dd56f26405c827fd92.title: Add tricky diff blocks test
e7b486a15b295697e22197dd56f26405c827fd92.summary: Added a test case to `prompts.test.ts` to verify `generateDiffBlocks` handles complex indentation changes. Introduced mock data files `index-old.ts` and `index-new.ts` in `backend/src/__tests__/__mock-data__` to serve as the test fixtures.

c95b1082150052edc624700ad56aec903b9a244a.title: Rename old/new diff tags to search/replace
c95b1082150052edc624700ad56aec903b9a244a.summary: backend/src/prompts.ts renames <old>/<new> XML tags to <search>/<replace> in Claude prompts and diff parsing. Internal variable names (oldContent, newContent) updated to searchContent, replaceContent to match the new schema. The string replacement logic in processFileBlock and generateDiffBlocks now expects the new tag names for exact matches. No external API changes; purely internal prompt engineering and code consistency.

22e6a77871e47c875a8dffe35d9d097b3fafd103.title: Fix deprecated ts-jest globals warning
22e6a77871e47c875a8dffe35d9d097b3fafd103.summary: Removed deprecated `globals` config for `ts-jest` in `backend/jest.config.js`, migrating `tsconfig` path to the `transform` array syntax. Updated `testMatch` patterns to strictly target `.test.ts` files. Added `test:coverage` script to `backend/package.json`.

6a2e93e1a002a3682492aebb7bc43743771cd483.title: Add STOPMARKER instruction to Claude prompt loop
6a2e93e1a002a3682492aebb7bc43743771cd483.summary: Added explicit instruction to end responses with STOP_MARKER in promptClaudeAndGetFileChanges. Updated knowledge file instruction to allow editing existing files rather than just adding notes. Added duplicate debug logging for message count.

0de6e418c011cc99c7874b6ecf22f7146f531b68.title: Add retry logic for diff block generation
0de6e418c011cc99c7874b6ecf22f7146f531b68.summary: Added a retry mechanism in `backend/src/prompts.ts` for diff block generation. If `parseAndGetDiffBlocks` detects `<old>` content that fails to match the file via strict string inclusion, the system constructs a corrective prompt containing the failed blocks and requests a new strategy from Claude. This handles cases where the model generates valid but non-applicable diff blocks.

c31d5345d35de6c10f958e66c88b60f02f393925.title: Add instant Escape interrupt and partial response handling
c31d5345d35de6c10f958e66c88b60f02f393925.summary: Implemented immediate response termination on ESC key press, clearing terminal line and resetting state to prompt user. Added `responseBuffer` to capture streamed content, saving partial responses with `[RESPONSE_STOPPED_BY_USER]` marker if interrupted. Refactored input loop into `promptUser` function for recursive handling after stop. Updated `musings.knowledge.md` with note on indicating diff generation status.

cf327e0af8eaf63719c81ded536b24ba3ed34893.title: Replace readline with raw stdin for arrow key history
cf327e0af8eaf63719c81ded536b24ba3ed34893.summary: src/index.ts drops `readline.createInterface` for manual `process.stdin` raw mode handling. Implements `history` array and `historyIndex` to support Up/Down arrow cycling through previous inputs. `promptUser` now writes `> ` directly via `process.stdout.write`.

34b75c9ce074d652cff41d90d46ea6cb661feddc.title: Simplify CLI console output and file exclusion logic
34b75c9ce074d652cff41d90d46ea6cb661feddc.summary: Reduced verbose console messages in `src/index.ts`, replacing multi-line file change reports with single-line status updates. Exit handling simplified by removing explicit keyword checks for 'exit'/'quit' in favor of standard readline closure. `src/project-files.ts` refactored to pass `excludedDirs` directly to `loadAllProjectFiles`, eliminating post-filtering of `node_modules`, `dist`, and `.git`.

a528a49ef6a21a7bd4e5990ebb4fb03a5fcda199.title: Remove common barrel export
a528a49ef6a21a7bd4e5990ebb4fb03a5fcda199.summary: Deleted `common/src/index.ts` barrel file. `src/claude.ts` and `src/project-files.ts` now import `removeUndefinedProps` and `filterObject` directly from `common/util/object`. Removed `console.log` for file updates in `applyChanges`. Forces explicit module paths for shared utilities.

cf327e0af8eaf63719c81ded536b24ba3ed34893.text: The keyboard input system was updated to better recognize arrow key presses. This allows you to use the up and down arrows to easily review and reuse your previous questions.

0de6e418c011cc99c7874b6ecf22f7146f531b68.text: The assistant now tries again if its first attempt to update a file fails. This helps it fix mistakes automatically without you needing to ask.

22e6a77871e47c875a8dffe35d9d097b3fafd103.text: A small internal update cleaned up old settings in the testing system. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

c95b1082150052edc624700ad56aec903b9a244a.text: The assistant now uses clearer labels for the parts of a text it finds and the parts it changes. This internal update improves accuracy but does not change how you use the product.

93763411363636e4194f79caaf5bf7b264e8e1d1.text: The assistant now checks file context before reviewing code and understands both the request and code before planning. This internal change improves accuracy without altering user-facing features.

c31d5345d35de6c10f958e66c88b60f02f393925.text: Pressing the Escape key now immediately stops the assistant's response. Any partial text received before stopping is saved, so you can see what was generated up to that point.

34b75c9ce074d652cff41d90d46ea6cb661feddc.text: The program now shows shorter, simpler messages when it runs. It also skips unnecessary folders more efficiently.

e7b486a15b295697e22197dd56f26405c827fd92.text: The team added internal checks to ensure the system correctly displays changes in text formatting. This helps maintain accuracy when the assistant shows how content differs, but users will not see a visible change.

a528a49ef6a21a7bd4e5990ebb4fb03a5fcda199.text: The software's internal structure was simplified to make it easier to manage. This change is technical and does not affect how the product works for you.

73721cfa69e464044026cd9b488f58ff40cbefa6.title: Update ts-node script and tsconfig include path
73721cfa69e464044026cd9b488f58ff40cbefa6.summary: The `code` script in `package.json` now points to `src/index.ts` instead of `index.ts`. The `include` array in `tsconfig.json` was updated to remove the root `index.ts` file, retaining only `src/**/*`. This aligns the build and execution entry points with the current source directory structure.

25bcef46b6bd63e4a8bba123cef51c2711085b03.title: Rename scoped @manicode/common package to plain common
25bcef46b6bd63e4a8bba123cef51c2711085b03.summary: Renamed package `@manicode/common` to `common` in `package.json` files. Updated import paths across `backend`, `src`, and `common` to use the shorter name (e.g., `common/util/file` instead of `@manicode/common/src/util/file`). Adjusted `tsconfig.json` path mappings and `jest.config.js` module resolution to support the new alias. This simplifies internal dependency references and reduces import verbosity.

d4aadcfe8acc326d01b637c10709f22aa27873fc.title: Fix createFileBlock arg order in prompts.ts
d4aadcfe8acc326d01b637c10709f22aa27873fc.summary: Corrected argument order for `createFileBlock` in `backend/src/prompts.ts` by moving `filePath` to the first position in three example generation calls. Added debug logging for message counts and empty diff block warnings to aid troubleshooting. Internal fix affecting prompt generation logic only.

85226e1dcc6dfb6ca9997e598005b1566f6bdb7d.title: Multi-message continuation handling in promptClaudeAndGetFileChanges
85226e1dcc6dfb6ca9997e598005b1566f6bdb7d.summary: Refactored `continuedMessage` to `continuedMessages` array in `backend/src/prompts.ts` to support multi-turn continuation. Added explicit user prompt 'Please continue from the very next character' when generation pauses without stop marker or tool call. Removed premature `isComplete` flag setting on tool chunk receipt to ensure proper state transition. Also removed debug `console.log` for `currentChat` in `src/index.ts`.

be19b40c22d27853ff48643096530f0cfeea490f.title: Add Jest testing infrastructure to backend
be19b40c22d27853ff48643096530f0cfeea490f.summary: Introduced Jest, ts-jest, and @types/jest to backend/package.json devDependencies. Added 'test' and 'test:watch' scripts to enable unit testing. This establishes the testing framework for the backend service.

ff4327c421e108ec46b990fbb6bf9e171db8c22a.title: Remove unused addUserMessage logic
ff4327c421e108ec46b990fbb6bf9e171db8c22a.summary: Deleted `addUserMessage` from `src/index.ts` and removed the unused `promptClaude` import in `backend/src/prompts.ts`. Direct `chatStorage.addMessage` calls replace the helper in `handleUserInput`. Scope limited to internal cleanup; no user-facing behavior change.

918a7aa4253a876c3a47f6c56395745454283c0c.title: Add Jest setup file for backend environment variables
918a7aa4253a876c3a47f6c56395745454283c0c.summary: New `backend/jest.setup.js` loads `.env` via `dotenv` for Jest runs. `backend/jest.config.js` registers it in `setupFilesAfterEnv`. Ensures backend tests have access to environment variables.

c7e41a056c9867e18e50b95bf84ddbf69e03d9d1.title: Fix chat storage bug
c7e41a056c9867e18e50b95bf84ddbf69e03d9d1.summary: ChatStorage.addMessage signature changed from (chatId, message) to (chat, message) in src/chat-storage.ts. Callers in src/index.ts updated to pass currentChat object directly instead of currentChat.id. This ensures the in-memory chat object reference is mutated and saved correctly.

e350c7f460b34059eb4cdd72a9683eb4e6695258.title: Add Jest config and refactor Claude continuation logic
e350c7f460b34059eb4cdd72a9683eb4e6695258.summary: Introduced `backend/jest.config.js` and updated `backend/tsconfig.json` to enable unit testing. Moved `promptClaudeWithContinuation` from `backend/src/prompts.ts` to `backend/src/claude.ts`, simplifying it by removing tool call handling from the loop. Exported `generateDiffBlocks` for testing and added instruction 7 to diff generation prompts to strip meta-comments.

ac5ba3f50a891a392ae6fab938ff1a58a50fee11.title: Improve generation continuation and add code review/planning prompts
ac5ba3f50a891a392ae6fab938ff1a58a50fee11.summary: The generation continuation logic in `backend/src/prompts.ts` was refined to strip the last line of the partial response before resuming, preventing repetition. The system prompt in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` now instructs the model to use `<code_review>` and `<planning>` blocks for complex tasks. `STOP_MARKER` was moved from `common/src/prompts.ts` to `common/src/constants.ts` to better reflect its nature.

d4aadcfe8acc326d01b637c10709f22aa27873fc.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant sometimes confused file locations in its responses. This change is internal and may slightly improve accuracy when the assistant references specific files.

85226e1dcc6dfb6ca9997e598005b1566f6bdb7d.text: The assistant now handles interruptions better, ensuring it picks up exactly where it left off to provide complete answers. This internal fix improves reliability when responses are cut short.

918a7aa4253a876c3a47f6c56395745454283c0c.text: The team made a small internal change so that tests can find the settings they need. This helps catch problems before updates reach you.

c7e41a056c9867e18e50b95bf84ddbf69e03d9d1.text: Fixed an issue where messages might not save correctly. Your chat history now stays up to date.

e350c7f460b34059eb4cdd72a9683eb4e6695258.text: The team improved the internal tools that help the assistant understand and change text. You might see fewer confusing notes in the results.

ff4327c421e108ec46b990fbb6bf9e171db8c22a.text: Developers removed unused code from the chat system. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the product works for you.

73721cfa69e464044026cd9b488f58ff40cbefa6.text: The software now begins from the right place in its current files, and its file checks use that same place. This is a small internal update, not a new feature.

25bcef46b6bd63e4a8bba123cef51c2711085b03.text: The app's internal labels were made shorter. This change does not affect how you use the product.

be19b40c22d27853ff48643096530f0cfeea490f.text: The team set up a system to automatically check the service for errors. This internal change helps the team catch problems before they reach you, but you won't see any new features.

61b9683c28dea64cc30c796fae17563fef072e58.title: Refine diff generation prompt and system instructions
61b9683c28dea64cc30c796fae17563fef072e58.summary: Updated `backend/src/prompts.ts` to include explicit `<old>`/`<new>` block examples and simplified indentation analysis instructions. Modified `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to clarify that file edits are applied automatically without user intervention. Changes affect internal prompt logic for diff generation and system context.

9b4c3d5ac8f9c3c713c8f1ec132fd1010b14a866.title: Remove getInitialPrompt from backend/src/prompts.ts
9b4c3d5ac8f9c3c713c8f1ec132fd1010b14a866.summary: Deleted getInitialPrompt function from backend/src/prompts.ts, removing ~95 lines of inline prompt instructions and examples. Updated musings.knowledge.md to mark 'prompt engineer for knowledge changes' and 'context loading' problems as resolved, and added a new issue for indentation failures during multi-level edits. Scope limited to backend prompt logic and internal knowledge base.

6aaacb83f0deaf00e1d48a0a9439d7db0b96a5e2.title: Remove applyReplacement helper
6aaacb83f0deaf00e1d48a0a9439d7db0b96a5e2.summary: Deleted applyReplacement from backend/src/prompts.ts. processFileBlock now uses direct String.includes and replace with trimmed content. Removed flexible whitespace and indentation matching logic.

e70163a8da801e05f0e15515be27fc7ec7fa81b6.title: Enforce file path in diff generation and system prompt
e70163a8da801e05f0e15515be27fc7ec7fa81b6.summary: generateDiffBlocks now requires filePath to tag logs and enforce path in file blocks via createFileBlock. System prompt upgrades read_files recommendations to strict important_instructions to prevent stale edits. Covers backend prompts.ts and system-prompt.ts. Diff blocks now explicitly include paths, replacing createFileBlockWithoutPath usage in examples.

5fceb4b0ecc20b0427785ac56bc33a937cb7b0dc.title: Await websocket callbacks in onWebsocketAction
5fceb4b0ecc20b0427785ac56bc33a937cb7b0dc.summary: onWebsocketAction now awaits callbacks via Promise.all instead of firing them without await. This ensures errors thrown by callbacks are caught and logged synchronously. Scope limited to backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. Error logging now includes the full msg object alongside the message.

8fad941fdb5fb5178e1941254fd0f004758db45a.title: Add file reading and knowledge update instructions to prompt
8fad941fdb5fb5178e1941254fd0f004758db45a.summary: Appends `<additional_instruction>` tags to the last user message in `promptClaudeAndGetFileChanges` (`backend/src/prompts.ts`). Directs the agent to request files via `read_files` and update knowledge files when learning from feedback. Removes debug logging in `requestFiles` (`backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts`).

73828a089d30eb253a342e6962ea65ab33ecf8c4.title: Save partial assistant responses on stop
73828a089d30eb253a342e6962ea65ab33ecf8c4.summary: src/index.ts persists assistant messages regardless of stopResponseRequested flag. Previously, stopping generation discarded the partial response. Now logs '[Response stopped by user. Partial response saved.]' after saving. Also refactors ESC key handling to constant and applies prettier formatting to chatStorage calls.

87039279e416c3fb0aaf2508c93640520f190f84.title: Add message history to diff prompt context
87039279e416c3fb0aaf2508c93640520f190f84.summary: Message history injected into diff generation prompt via `processFileBlock` and `generateDiffBlocks` in `backend/src/prompts.ts`. Provides conversational context to Claude for more accurate code changes. Scope: backend prompt engineering. Detail: `Message[]` passed through call chain, formatted as `<message_history>` block before old/new content.

577e1c040c68dcbce71dc95d22c9bb6d5b3d014a.title: Server-initiated file read via WebSocket actions
577e1c040c68dcbce71dc95d22c9bb6d5b3d014a.summary: Added `read-files` and `read-files-response` actions to WebSocket schema. Server requests file contents from client, replacing static `fileContext`. `getFiles` now returns `null` for missing paths instead of throwing. `filterObject` added to `common/src/util/object.ts` to strip nulls in `getKnowledgeFiles`.

55fd3e69d089025ea4159569c578bdbd1f313eb0.title: Fix prompt diff trimming bug
