ab3dcc9148c27cfd7df5d49e5f84bc3bc443d3ac.text: When the tool's status screen reports that a needed setup file is missing, it now adds a short hint telling the person to run the setup command to fix it, instead of just flagging the problem. This affects anyone who opens the status menu before finishing initial configuration. The change is small and internal: three lines of display text updated in one file.

c8ec2d2f3d1728c09acd2fce0168574dcf39f46b.text: A small internal fix corrected the spacing between column headers in a command list, so the 'COMMANDS' and 'DESCRIPTION' headings now line up with their entries. This affects only the visual alignment in the text-based menu. If someone looks at that menu, they will see the headings sit properly above the list items instead of being shifted to the side.

9bebbe47146fc889fc5ce904e2f49bb20b2908fa.text: The startup menu now picks three colors at random from a set of seven, then applies them to the text. This makes the menu look slightly different each time it appears, but the overall style stays consistent.

31bc4b20f88ab7d7f3d8449bad2af285d3709e4f.text: The assistant now follows stricter rules for managing background tasks. It ensures all related parts of a task are stopped together to prevent leftover processes, and restarts tasks correctly in the background. This change is live today. Users will notice fewer stuck or zombie processes when stopping or restarting background operations.

ec646edcd1946220593edd58e168251a8ad8d8d2.text: The Discord invitation message in the app menu now shows the correct keyboard key for the computer being used: Command on Apple computers and Control on other computers. The hint is gray instead of yellow. This is a small interface fix, live when the menu appears.

294e036ab38dd55fab20a9eb7e802cdadd1ebcad.text: The command-line tool now ignores the 'press twice to quit' rule if you are currently typing text. This prevents accidental shutdowns that would discard your unsent input. You will notice the program stays open when you hit the stop key twice while writing a message.

7d8a37e5712e70dc92247fe0583799185607f4ee.text: The startup help screen was cleaned up to remove repetitive words and combine instructions into a single line. This small internal change affects only the text displayed on the screen when the program starts. A person looking at the help menu would see a simpler list of commands with clearer, less cluttered instructions.

381a44f5fa93bbaa73bb7a7b8a270dcf631fda06.text: The welcome screen's help menu now greets you with 'Thanks for using Codebuff!' before listing contact options. The bottom prompt changed to '↓ Enter your prompt or command below ↓'. This is a small text update affecting only the initial menu display.

7dfb438d63d2e4a896793d9b89c7b9d27b3c9242.text: The coding assistant now stops running if it is opened in the system's main folder or your personal home folder. This prevents it from accidentally changing important files outside of a specific project. You will see a warning message and the assistant will quit if you start it in those locations.

9c9cf198ab9cbe7bc6cb3b9e7d049eb5978a596b.text: The assistant was told to stop re-reading files it has already seen. This saves time and prevents confusion by relying on automatic updates instead. The change is live now for the internal tooling.

7b56b6e50da704593571588f3307d29786f5c05f.text: The assistant now wraps user inputs in specific tags to distinguish them from system instructions. This internal change helps the AI better understand which parts of the message are from you and which are from the system. You will not notice any immediate difference in how the assistant responds.

6b6a807ecd8f66cb97f4ed8685ac621595969b61.text: The label 'Diagnostics Check' was renamed to 'Project Setup' in the command-line menu. This is a small internal text change that affects only the menu header. Users will see the new label 'Project Setup' instead of 'Diagnostics Check'.

c34293dc8e061fe1acf1dfff5df2c40f825967f4.text: We added a silent tracker that records exactly why the automatic software update fails. This change is internal and affects only the engineering team, not you. You will notice nothing different when using the program.

e3fcf0ce0086870be8327e51980a59b4537bf45b.text: The assistant now clearly separates its own file location from yours, preventing it from saving edits to the wrong folder. This fix applies to most AI models but not all. You would notice fewer errors when asking the assistant to open or save files while working in a specific subfolder.

ce68a5d652d8868ced1456d9397be3b6c2022f47.text: The command-line tool now wipes out leftover clipboard text whenever you start a new prompt. This fixes a bug where old pasted data might accidentally leak into fresh questions. You would only notice this if you previously saw strange text from an earlier paste appear in a new prompt.

7c9715349c229bdd55c23d8cca8acf36eb4f4cb7.text: The system now records how long it takes to process your request and how many steps it needed. This data goes to the company's internal reports to help them measure performance. You will not see any difference in the application.

df9797be99058335dfd30ddd48064aba1def883c.text: Typing a slash now shows a menu of quick commands. Pressing tab completes the word. This change affects the internal command-line tool today.

e7c367498103d349dd730800557510f6fa6a72bd.text: The assistant now receives the exact folder path it is working in, rather than a vague description. This helps it find and edit files more accurately. The change is small and internal, so people will not see a new button or menu, but file operations should work more reliably.

2c86dc19181a88a3170e4c0aeb4ce109817ecb06.text: The text-based assistant's startup screen now shows a fixed list of sample tasks and explicitly warns that it ignores standard exclusion files. The colorful logo text changed from random hues to a stable set of colors. These updates are live for anyone running the tool in a command-line window.

70222b07c3b77d9495c55301c383a2710ff988e1.text: The system now explains its actions more clearly when it stops reading a response early. If it ends a specific detail, it tells you it added the closing mark; if it ends a tool command, it notes that the stopping signal might have been missing, treating this as a minor update rather than a warning. This change is internal and does not affect what you see or how the system works today.

c976d02582ecb8bdf44ae5697dc6689cd1e62a5c.text: A small internal fix stops the terminal from freezing on Windows when the assistant runs commands. The tool now counts and clears output lines one by one instead of all at once, and adds a missing 'enter' press when changing folders. You will notice fewer stuck commands while using the assistant on Windows.

f3f39477859b4ad8704ebc09f2dfedcbc3589537.text: The assistant now recognizes both 'init' and '/init' to start the setup process. Users typing either command in the chat interface will trigger the same initialization flow. This small internal update ensures the feature works regardless of whether the slash is included.

427373457cac725710f8217af5f978c0278d4e72.text: The tool's startup screen now shows a short product description instead of a long list of command instructions. Two specific settings for speed and quality are now visible on this screen. This change affects internal tooling and is live today.

80e1ce908ea59f72ff6783f02be713ad559ae9ac.text: The tool now checks if it is running from your main user folder. If so, it shows a welcome message with setup steps and closes immediately. This prevents the tool from getting stuck without a specific project folder to edit. The change is live today.

433ca68facb6408edf0e664d8d88e0f33bb2e368.text: This small internal fix corrects how the command-line tool prepares line breaks before showing text. It affects people using that tool, especially when output contains several line breaks in a row. They would see cleaner terminal text, with fewer broken or doubled blank lines. The change is already in the tool.

f525deb12fe7dfa8789ff1c3cd23c87127d36f65.text: The system now records fewer warning messages when a specific tool fails to close correctly, noting instead that the response was automatically completed. This internal logging adjustment affects only the engineering team monitoring system health, so customers will notice no changes in performance or output.

b68d5d6c55772e309c312be7dae564059b2af999.text: The AI assistant now receives clearer instructions to minimize the amount of text it generates when editing files, specifically by using a more efficient method for small changes. This internal update aims to reduce processing time and costs, meaning users might experience slightly faster responses during file edits without any visible change to the final output.

41da8383dae1315b5c26aab2ad4086ca0e044229.text: A small internal update ensures text data is always read using standard English characters. This prevents rare glitches where messages might appear as strange symbols. Most people will notice no change, but the system is now more reliable when handling special characters.

228d3ec90e1dd272b4923a68b01c40ea330de42e.text: The team added a safety check to ensure the assistant's core instructions stay consistent. They also wrote down a rule for how to run these checks correctly. This change is for internal staff only, so regular users will not notice any difference.

ffd1f70fa537dcaec685a9f7b492f3ec5f955bc7.text: The program now always reads text data as UTF-8, ignoring previous settings that might have used a different format. This ensures consistent handling of special characters and emojis. Users will see fewer errors when processing complex text. This change is active immediately.

9ce53baf5b6f43953bd228c7bc15d9b1c066ec2b.text: The system now removes special memory-saving instructions from all text when trimming messages. This internal cleanup affects how data is prepared for processing, though no visible changes appear for non-programmers.

7b74fe111b380968a6bed2b17bdf56707af6ff96.text: When the system cuts off long text, it now adds a clearer note saying 'TRUNCATED DUE TO LENGTH'. The dots appear in the right place depending on whether the start or end of the message was removed. This small fix improves how those cutoff notices look to anyone reading the message.

e324baabef67b6c2c69f986f2de610fcd73e53ce.text: The system now safely handles errors when sending usage data. If a transmission fails, it quietly records the problem instead of crashing. This internal fix improves stability without changing what you see or do.

f80621692ac4f8d57c0e56f9154f8580302d3fa4.text: The command-line tool now uses a single shared connection to the server instead of letting parts of the program create separate ones. This prevents accidental duplicate connections within the same tool session. Internal change; users will not see any difference.

5889be9e74ca30f741e348af1fc0f5be33d08ed6.text: A small internal fix corrects how the app cuts off the start of long text when adding a warning label. It ensures the visible message keeps the right amount of content without losing extra characters. This affects anyone seeing truncated text with a start-removal label, though the change itself is invisible to most users.

8224f3e35031420a86afcea90e18661d799c0e68.text: The assistant now checks its own previous replies for mistakes before continuing. This happens automatically whenever past messages exist. You might see it correct itself or steer the conversation back on track without you asking.

b7121965147db2a996aff635acb87136e6c5bf84.text: The command-line assistant now checks your project folder for missing setup files and shows a simple list of commands if your screen is narrow. This helps people starting new projects see exactly what needs fixing before they begin. The change is live for anyone using the tool today.

010ea8f4bd613db0d2ed1a6af993cfc80a15b6bc.text: The tool's help menu now lists speed and quality settings at the bottom instead of the top. This change affects anyone using the command line interface. Users will see a cleaner list of options, with advanced settings moved to the end.

820d62950d6e8bf1614e3ae2fc6e8fd76ef78a8a.text: The billing system stopped automatically creating refund documents for new draft invoices. This change affects internal billing processing, but customers will notice no difference in their invoices or charges because all invoices are now set to zero dollars.

3f376ed78983a5da746167091d1219a5f271f829.text: A new tool was added to the shared foundation of the app to help it create random numbers reliably. This is a small internal setup step that does nothing yet. No one will notice any change in how the app works today.

853a380f27f813b0d781a9141b848d43db637091.text: The AI assistant now has a specific way to signal it is completely finished with a task and needs to wait for the user's next input. This stops the assistant from endlessly waiting for or processing background results after it has already answered. Users will notice the assistant responds faster and stops talking immediately once it has provided the final answer.

c020f22baec530cd6e2ab4cc269739ff3e976fa2.text: The internal test checks for file reading were updated to match a recent change in how the system reports which other files link to a document. This is maintenance work for the development team and does not affect any features or customer experience.

99624c1b1904df84d981b3705a276a36ab04540d.text: The system now reads file content more flexibly, ignoring extra blank lines or spacing between sections. This fixes a rare glitch where text could be cut off if the formatting was slightly uneven. You might notice this if you previously saw incomplete file contents in responses. This small fix is live today.

3482e499819aa717e968af06c910ebc76ae57032.text: The AI now clearly distinguishes between the user's directory and its own project directory when receiving commands. This internal clarification helps the AI avoid confusion about where to run specific tasks. Users will not see any visual changes, as this update only improves the AI's underlying understanding of file locations.

4db812729e2535d45d6b9ff03624a6613cbb3190.text: The system now converts past AI responses into user messages so the AI can distinguish its own history from actual user input. This internal adjustment is currently inactive for live conversations because a specific feature flag remains disabled.

19f0de4ec1cc8d784649ba5350b2b3e9fb88f3b1.text: Internal testing tools now give each automated run its own unique tracking number. This helps developers tell separate tests apart and use standard settings instead of experimental ones. Regular users will not notice any difference.

747efae72b2958aa8ed5232f073f8ee2ba574cea.text: A small internal fix corrects how the system handles conversation history. Previously, a mistake in the code caused all past messages to be ignored or deleted during processing. Now, the system correctly keeps the relevant history and only filters out specific internal instructions. This ensures the assistant maintains proper context during conversations.

80d76b1b657c557ef687345f9d2a0b24fd3ec932.text: The automated testing system now specifically searches for and runs only files named with '.test.ts'. A debugging tool that previously opened a remote shell when tests failed has been disabled. This internal change affects how the system identifies tests and handles failures, but requires no action from users.

cb416767e33be5297ed874d1707fb32f8266866f.text: The AI assistant now strictly follows a specific signal to pause or finish its turn. This prevents the assistant from stopping early while it is still working on a task. The change is live and affects all internal agent modes, ensuring more reliable responses.

b7347271d4fb7c1c1f35817ebcc9f256072d8f9e.text: The automated testing system no longer treats its own runs differently than regular operations. If a test fails, engineers can now open a temporary remote session to inspect the environment directly. This change is live and affects only the internal team maintaining the software.

d34e4c9f4cb01934f1dd09daf7ad12da86996238.text: The automatic testing system previously struggled to locate specific test files, causing checks to fail. The system now searches for these files dynamically during execution, ensuring tests run correctly. This internal fix improves reliability for the engineering team without changing how the software functions for end users.

11791918a9d333661d7935e82010a49d156f8423.text: Automated checks no longer open a temporary live session for developers when tests fail. This internal change affects only the engineering team's debugging process. People using the product will notice no difference.

15ead13bb5b33d807eb1cc0b6688048514b7e843.text: The AI assistant now stops writing immediately after completing a task, rather than continuing to make unnecessary changes. This update applies to internal tools and ensures responses are concise and finished once the main request is met. Users of the internal system will notice shorter, more direct answers without extra, unrequested edits.

a9c79fcb6da92a14d0618856be825eb170505b38.text: The system now uses a newer, official version of its underlying engine for automated checks. This change affects only the internal testing environment where code is automatically verified before being accepted. You would notice no difference in the final product, as this is a minor internal maintenance update to keep our tools current.

bd7eb3703f43cb776b5ad882d93b4c772d4aa077.text: The internal checks for how the system reads special document formats were updated to match its current behavior. This is an invisible maintenance change for the developers; customers will not notice any difference in the application's performance or features.

a704af7d2a2c7a779b248f5af832fd1d18980c73.text: The system now correctly lists all original credit amounts for active grants, even if the current balance is zero or negative. Previously, it only showed these amounts when the balance was positive, hiding data for exhausted or overdrawn accounts. This internal fix ensures accurate accounting records for billing audits.

e652a54b667329c212f78e0f2b1897f92f4e0a23.text: The automated system that checks code quality previously failed to find certain test files because of a formatting error in its search instructions. This fix ensures the system correctly locates and runs all necessary checks for the application's internal components. Developers will notice that continuous integration jobs now pass reliably without manual intervention.

6d236f12588b7efa915cb11930de14511c097407.text: The automatic testing system now opens its live inspection window only after the checks finish. This change affects the internal team who watches the tests run. Instead of pausing the process early, the team can now inspect the results exactly as they appear at the end of the run.

a99219be402d35bf8f6f2ac32cc3fd5e74b711ec.text: A small internal cleanup removes automated file listings and moves a temporary access tool to run after tests instead of before them. This change affects only the internal testing process and does not alter how the software behaves for anyone else. You would notice nothing, as this only organizes how the system checks its own work behind the scenes.

c2c315d89b86a09d3bd789624ce6f64e65daec3d.text: The automated system's emergency remote access feature now requires specific manual activation or a task failure to start, preventing unauthorized connections. It restricts access solely to the person who started the task and ends automatically after thirty minutes. Internal engineers will notice stricter security checks when attempting to troubleshoot failed automated tasks.

dbceefdb35381bbce7542c064a02547c5589fdad.text: The automated system that checks for errors in new code updates now tries five times instead of just once. This helps ensure that temporary glitches do not falsely report problems. Developers will see fewer unnecessary error alerts.

ce97fdc5f4c9e6a8b12c31772767065f75957d66.text: The automatic check that tests the software now only opens a special remote access window if a test fails, instead of opening it every time. This change affects the internal team who maintains the software and prevents unnecessary delays when everything works correctly. It is active today and makes successful tests finish faster.

c730cd91e5ffff204b7d6d2202eeb6cdad167e37.text: The automated testing process was reordered to allow engineers to inspect the environment before tests run. This internal change helps diagnose why some checks fail, specifically by verifying if a necessary text-analysis component is present. Regular users will not notice any difference, as this only affects the team's ability to fix software issues.

18f061e4a9e0c1f599b7c3ec16865da3c4ebb8a8.text: Temporary diagnostic messages were removed from the internal software build process. This change affects only the engineering team's automated testing tools. No external users or customer-facing features are impacted.

5b73c255ca0ca51296b778266e0897e4f4ff6678.text: The automated testing system now stops after the first failure instead of trying five times, and it allows engineers to connect to the test machine for live inspection if a run fails or debugging is enabled. This change affects only the internal development team's workflow and is live today.

5fa94bb045a318747504d730f80800745869a6b1.text: The automated system that checks software updates now prints the computer's basic setup details before starting other tasks. This helps the engineering team see exactly what kind of machine ran the check if something goes wrong. Regular users will not notice any difference, as this only changes the internal logs for the development team.

fb3956d9e5d5713212f6c4d8e1f1f19a1845d8d3.text: A stray character in an internal checklist caused the automated review process to fail. This fix removes that character, allowing the checks to run correctly. The change affects only the internal tools used to verify code, not the features seen by end users.

b9efc1ab9dbc218f1b124e41cf507e22a3b9547a.text: The automatic checks that report on the computer setup and file locations were moved to happen after the main building step finishes. This affects only the internal team who watches these automated reports. They will now see this technical information appear later in the process, rather than at the very beginning.

1aa4258755220e2ea8b26d1e8532a1b877ff09cf.text: The system now always shows four specific credit categories on your usage page, even if you have zero balance in one. Previously, empty categories might have been hidden or displayed inconsistently. This update is live and ensures a uniform view of your account's credit breakdown.

0a8e4878aaa1ea8ea7bb4f26bf998944d6901f55.text: The automated testing system now uses a newer version of its underlying software engine and includes extra diagnostic steps to inspect specific files. This change is internal and only affects how the system checks its own health during builds, so regular users will notice no difference.

34bc250bdf3848131c7591f27f8e1e67de6e4962.text: Developers added a temporary debug step to their internal testing tools. This change does not affect the software or its users. Only the development team sees these hidden test logs.

35793599e381348e48a05280e7807a8ca45351ff.text: A small internal fix corrected a mismatch in the program's description of how it reports output errors. This only affects the automated checks that run when developers submit code, not the people using the app. If those checks were failing, they now pass, but nothing visible changes for regular users.

fd6d7e4d334afd0b614f3eb26607cf27c971ffb4.text: The system now reads broken text pieces in the right order. This fixes rare cases where messages appeared scrambled. You will see correct text display when data arrives in uneven chunks.

88a060c0cadcade2b07bed7289af204abfdf7327.text: The assistant now clearly shows which folder belongs to you and which folder it uses for its own work. This prevents confusion when you ask it to find or edit files. You will see this clarification in the chat and the terminal window.

0f33e633e79bd9e75060f9722bcf681c1aef3ede.text: When a request is handled in the cheaper mode, the assistant is no longer told to run automatic checks or insist on completing every step before stopping. This affects only requests sent through that cheaper mode, not normal requests. A person using it may notice faster, lower-cost replies, but the assistant may be less careful and may stop sooner.

53d49574e52d85570574f60b96a8c9b8b022a82e.text: A small internal update limits how much text the system logs at once to match stricter environment rules. This affects only the backend logging tool, not any visible feature. Users will notice nothing, as this is a safety tweak to prevent log errors.

0808a5f1a76b110f3de330438108b405ce3ae412.text: The system now provides clearer warnings when it encounters malformed instructions, specifically when parts of a message are left open or contain unexpected tags. This affects the backend processing of these messages, helping developers quickly identify and fix formatting errors in their code. Users will not notice any immediate changes, as this is an internal improvement for debugging.

a9aa4fb1dc1d8fb527ac1021f2daef85a04286c8.text: When the assistant fails to save a file, the error message now includes the specific file path. Support staff can see exactly which file caused the problem without guessing. This internal logging improvement is live but invisible to end users.

2c1b68ff9199828cc34d7764716bd59b52834cd1.text: The system now adds a unique marker to each step of the assistant's thought process. This helps support staff trace exactly what happened during a specific request if something goes wrong. Users will not see any visible changes, but it makes internal troubleshooting faster and more accurate.

984f285ad3bdb5661cf12436fc43830a7fe510d3.text: The system now records what you type only after confirming your account is valid. This ensures that if you are not logged in, your text is not saved to the usage logs. You will not see any changes in the app, but the internal data is now more accurate.

c78cd87e2e12887d0dea7d90d12115abf94c1c09.text: A small internal change is live today in the text-based assistant tool's remembered-request list. If someone types a request they used before, that request moves to the newest position instead of being left behind or dropped. People using the internal tool will see repeated requests appear in their most recent order.

6e9750b7e926445391766db5345bec8c3b0fdc1c.text: The AI assistant no longer requires you to manually signal when it is finished or when it is waiting for results. The system now automatically detects these moments and continues the conversation without extra steps. You will notice smoother interactions with fewer interruptions or manual prompts.

bc3991444e4d37d090b2fc20447feeefd6cc1462.text: The assistant now labels the output from its built-in actions as system information, not as a reply from the person using it. This stops it from treating that output as agreement to continue after asking a question. The change is internal and minor, and is live now; people would only notice fewer mistaken continuations.

9e4c5dafa6e4c719aebb90782ec6746cb032ffbd.text: We added new checks to our internal safety tests to ensure the system correctly ignores broken or extra closing tags in data streams. This change only affects the testing tools used by our internal team to verify code reliability. It does not change how the application behaves for anyone, and no features are added or removed for end users.

adda69659cde44f32ae0e52c5e1468d098862536.text: The app now handles XML files more reliably. It prevents a specific crash that could happen when the app started reading a file without a clear instruction on how to interpret the text. If that rare issue occurred, the app would now fall back to a standard method instead of stopping.

e67405a81a75832c42aa2204aa8ba826c429b2f8.text: The system now recognizes when a request is used for internal file searching training. It stops charging users for these specific background tasks. The change is active and prevents unexpected fees for internal operations.

04c9f7d9ec3356a07b8caa218b3c085f4e8af14b.text: A small internal update added specific instructions for a particular AI model to ensure it finishes all parts of a request before stopping. This change is active and applies only when that specific model is used. Users might notice fewer incomplete responses during complex, multi-step tasks, but the underlying behavior for other models remains unchanged.

ffd805fa006107cb6992598ef83c6075afac485e.text: The assistant now reports specific reasons when file edits fail, such as missing text or unchanged files, instead of silently skipping them. This helps users understand why a requested change didn't happen and how to fix it. The update is live and affects all users interacting with the assistant's file editing tools.

b676962260dc5be0e3fb88b2f877d92bd55795ac.text: Internal system logs for credit calculations are now hidden by default. This change only affects the technical team monitoring the system, not regular users. Engineers will see a cleaner log feed unless they manually enable detailed tracking.

b2b3604e8d5b0451c6a3fdf85e83fbafef81984f.text: Previously, if the assistant sent a command in a slightly wrong format, the system silently ignored it, causing the action to fail without explanation. Now, the system recognizes these malformed commands and treats them as regular text, ensuring the assistant's output is never lost. This update is live and prevents confusing gaps in responses when the assistant makes formatting mistakes.

b450741963e3975f3e7b1f0c311fe4ba544c0711.text: The AI assistant can now run commands in specific folders instead of always starting from the main project folder. This helps the assistant work more accurately when you ask it to do things in different parts of your code. You might notice the assistant is better at finding files or running tools when you mention a specific location.

95ac3778eafb2c777796932b8ca4364e4d32e813.text: A small internal fix ensures the computer always looks inside the correct project folder before running a task. Previously, a timing glitch could cause it to search the wrong place, leading to failed actions. You will not notice a visual change, but the system will now reliably find your files when asked to do something.

b2dc44b04f4ea6253d8134354d0592cfe1df644d.text: In the highest-cost mode, the system stopped running a separate search for unexpected files. It now uses only the main search results. This makes file selection simpler and less resource-intensive. The change is live.

35442b388778a0d30072903b5c83bc1f9b878603.text: The system stopped writing temporary internal notes to its hidden activity log while reading incoming data. This change only affects the engineering team reviewing backend records. Users will notice no difference in the application's behavior.

e61897f728a707e32b576074bdad43518e591643.text: The text display logic now standardizes line breaks to Windows format before checking for empty space. This ensures that consecutive blank lines are correctly collapsed into a single blank line, preventing visual gaps from appearing in the output.

27a519e7246d53445c3419316dc7f857bb6ff01d.text: A small internal cleanup removed leftover conflict notes from the assistant's instructions. This ensures the system runs without errors when the assistant has nothing to say. No visible changes for users.

4c1c17e0d64b9ae61618d73f19e8400ca77964d9.text: The system now skips saving certain background information for improvement purposes when no specific documents were asked for. This is an internal data collection adjustment. Users will notice no changes to the assistant's responses or features.

0ffa2f40e062e71a778d4b75fa85ab93b07d9a14.text: A small internal update lowered the limit on how many times the assistant can send messages back-to-back during a single interaction. This change applies to the core system and is live today. Regular users will not notice any difference, as this adjustment primarily affects how the software manages conversation flow behind the scenes.

95e59b8a0f3924722637e1f68727c6442ab5f045.text: The AI assistant now runs commands only from the main project folder, ignoring any folder changes it might have made earlier. This keeps the assistant's actions predictable and prevents it from getting lost in subdirectories. You would see the assistant report that it ran a command from the project root.

ed2a4dd91662583f650d330ff65eaba4555c53db.text: A small internal fix helps the software's self-checks run more reliably. It stops the tests from failing when they try to find a specific folder path. This change only affects the team's quality checks and does nothing for the product you use.

fcb0f94dbaf29323c5587a64ba230d0f2d6e2f31.text: The test environment now resets its file-checking rules before and after every test run. This prevents leftover settings from one test affecting another. Only internal quality checks are affected; customers see no change.

879b743cd517244d755ac1ddbed251827ae8dbce.text: When the assistant receives a broken reply from the server, it now records the error instead of ignoring it. This helps support teams spot and fix these glitches. Users might see a new error message in their console, but the app's behavior remains the same.

7198e0392cee09135528380c425b5ece18f377d4.text: The assistant now ignores blank spaces between commands. This stops random line breaks from appearing in the chat history. The fix is active.

9536965727e3f62969b74bed4c605db2ab709bf7.text: This is a small internal cleanup to how the system records errors when a documentation request fails. The error message and the details about the failure are now written on separate lines in the logs. Staff looking at these logs will see the same information, just formatted more clearly.

26d197b40bdace61de389775a4630bb1e497e93c.text: The system now checks two separate lists of files to help the AI learn, instead of just one. It combines these lists, removes duplicates, and keeps only the most important ones up to a set limit. This change is internal and affects how the AI selects context for training; users will not see any direct difference in the interface.

df0edf50f63f0c546cfca4e0c8d3f3193d114c98.text: Programmers cleaned up leftover notes in a shared tool that reads data. The tool now ignores empty spaces in text, matching earlier behavior. This internal fix has no visible effect on your experience.

3a5e593d512005acfb865c3727621b2b118f3c8b.text: The system stopped limiting credit purchases to bank cards only. This allows other supported payment options to work. The change is live now.

7d6815e377d4c37e67b5b94f0a47d6c828a2a407.text: The assistant's internal formatting rules for saving files were tightened to remove extra blank lines. This ensures the saved text matches the source exactly without added spacing. The change is live and affects how the system prepares file content for storage.

1ec706f75036a05e22c86f1e92f74751ff1ec763.text: The system now quietly records a much larger snapshot of the project files being discussed. This data feeds into the assistant's future learning. Regular users will not notice any change in how the tool behaves today.

b1bac2c744a2e3cc53f64c5ca305ca90596dcb00.text: The assistant now uses a newer version of its underlying reasoning engine. This update is live and applies to all conversations. Users may notice slightly different responses, but no new features or interface changes are visible.

4d582780490739dbec7967cafae57135e1c07ae1.text: The internal system stopped collecting extra file data for training purposes. This change affects only the background processes used to improve the software's ability to find relevant code. Developers or users will not notice any difference in how the tool works.

2763eef3cc93f9f915924bb6c11157d78a56b663.text: A small internal fix stops the system from crashing when it receives a timeout value in the wrong format. This affects the tool that runs terminal commands. Users might see a clearer error message instead of a system crash if they enter an invalid wait time.

463ef5a59773b55dbeab4231c5733c9fac3937ac.text: The system now uses cheaper, faster artificial intelligences for background tasks in 'lite' mode, making it less expensive to run. This change is live and affects anyone using the lite setting, though they might not notice any difference in performance.

67cf38db9c420ea7e875f42d6765e9764f75fa88.text: Buying credits now uses the card or payment option you marked as default, rather than guessing which one to use. It also lets you pay with Link, a faster checkout method. If your default card is expired, it skips it and shows the normal checkout page instead. This change is live today.

77b6e4345669c3e1d9d0cb8325d3603cfb28c7d5.text: The system now quietly collects a wider set of project files to help teach the coding assistant. This happens in the background and does not change how the assistant answers your questions today. You will not notice any difference in the app's speed or results.

d352882a73d99ef69fab07fa409a337b04b0b0ab.text: The AI now limits its extra reasoning step to the highest-cost setting. Most users will notice faster responses and lower charges because the AI skips this deep thinking for standard requests. This change is live today.

69a66e1d04cd22cff6c75aeffc766df5b0720ce9.text: The assistant now strictly requires full folder paths when saving or opening files. This applies only to specific AI models. If a user sees the assistant fail to find a file, it is because the assistant was guessing incomplete paths.

ce0ef767dfe4065c39e1455238060a1a518a612c.text: The assistant now stops asking for updates while it is already checking your work with a command. This change is live for the internal tooling. You will see fewer pauses when the assistant waits for results, because it only pauses when no specific check command is available.

7f35f640dfcc9996c7380345504d90df78ee49c4.text: The assistant's internal reasoning instructions were tweaked to ask for short code snippets instead of full rewrites. This is a minor internal change affecting how the system drafts its thoughts. Users will not notice any difference in the final output.

c7a934eca71ec50ec2d246da6cd0f143dbe8e216.text: The AI assistant now always checks its work before stopping. It verifies files saved correctly and tests pass. This applies to all users regardless of their plan.

1fb6f18190af2630f4f863773b65c7dd6bd22ebb.text: The coding assistant now has a new habit of pausing after every few steps to check its own work. It will look at the results of its recent actions to make sure files saved correctly or tests passed before moving on. You might notice it taking short breaks to verify progress instead of rushing to finish.

7638e472c2a1a71d4d836450777c85bed12c7202.text: Fixed how the file list ignores nested folders. Previously, ignore rules in subfolders applied incorrectly to the whole project. Now, rules only affect the folder they are in. This ensures hidden files stay hidden in their specific locations.

8c048dd8dc038298a44d6021900f779be3e16736.text: The AI assistant now stops its internal reasoning process when using standard or maximum cost settings. This change reduces response time and lowers operational costs for these specific modes. Users selecting these settings will see faster answers without the delay of the assistant's hidden thinking steps.

511918a26dbbd2a41687ea2164b57b94871f4b76.text: A small internal change made the waiting rule for documentation lookups and the answer request that follows them consistent. If either request takes longer than ten seconds, it now stops waiting in the same way, instead of using separate rules. People using the documentation lookup should not notice a change during normal use, except that slow requests may end more predictably.

2b180da3ec412191f7cbbcbb5896d65504f01437.text: The system now turns off the 'deep thinking' mode for experimental cost settings. This ensures the assistant stops analyzing a question before answering, just like it does for standard modes. Since this is an internal tweak, regular users will not notice any change.

00ca17f4249d7e5010c6ad7e18b10ae52267309c.text: The AI assistant now only receives specific custom instructions when a full conversation context is provided. Without this context, it falls back to basic tool settings. This internal change ensures the assistant behaves consistently regardless of how it is called.

a8c76bd5c1e37469b4550db7ca1b60c97421ea0d.text: The tool that reads structured data now labels its temporary storage more clearly and processes text chunks faster. This is an internal cleanup that makes the software easier for programmers to maintain. Regular people will not notice any change in how the application looks or works.

1e229c2414d21296fbe1b3df534d7e99015948d9.text: A small internal fix tells the assistant to write symbols like less-than and greater-than directly, instead of using code words for them. This stops the assistant from making mistakes when it tries to use tools. The change is live now, but only affects how the assistant formats its own instructions behind the scenes.

dd23114f5046383bc4931fb2fe9f93c6da3285ff.text: The assistant now checks its work by running code validators before finishing a task, rather than just pausing. It also switched to a different AI model for standard tasks and disabled deep thinking mode to save resources. Users will see the assistant spend less time 'thinking' and more time verifying that its changes actually work before responding.

03fef962e1215a65f51c2fa7cfe47377d6d0ffbe.text: The assistant's internal guidebook was updated to stop it from explicitly telling itself to act like a specific character. This change affects how the system generates responses behind the scenes, ensuring it focuses on the task rather than the roleplay instructions. Users might notice slightly more direct and professional answers, without the character's name appearing in the output.

13ab3a4de64c48ecaecb37d5e6ae3ff7df130199.text: The system now uses a stricter form-checking tool when looking up documentation. Instead of guessing how sure it is about a match, it simply marks whether the information is relevant. This internal change makes results more reliable for anyone using the assistant, though you won't see a difference in the interface.

d074f6512ecdbad28235f9261a2af022b72f81fb.text: The AI assistant now uses a different thinking engine when you turn on its experimental setting, and it reads files more carefully in that mode. This change is not active for regular use; you must manually start the experimental version to see it. If you do, the assistant might answer slightly differently or take a bit longer because it is using a more powerful but untested brain.

f70d699d484f2c1cfb224d437b7ad445e1981570.text: Programmers using a specific editor no longer get automatic code cleanup when saving files. They must now fix errors manually or run a separate command. This change only affects developers working on this project's internal setup.

9bb6fe282e5948105a77e5edf3344643c9180f05.text: The system now stops sending extra background instructions to the AI unless a specific experimental setting is turned on. This saves processing power for standard users, who will notice the AI following core commands slightly more strictly without the extra guidance.

8c7a04be0da6d90dfdebefe4ec0639a886e65210.text: The system now waits for complete text before displaying it, fixing glitches where special characters broke across data packets. Readers see accurate text without missing symbols or random ampersands.

893d2dddf1083a28c926885e6361bf7c2ecdb897.text: The AI assistant now drafts its code changes and planning documents in its internal reasoning before taking action. This affects internal backend operations. Users will not see any immediate difference, as this is an internal logic adjustment.

fc55d0bf3ed1f877431508b320c5df505553dd61.text: A small internal fix prevents the loading animation from adding extra blank lines to the terminal display. The tool now remembers the screen state before the animation starts and restores it correctly when finished. Users will see cleaner output with no unwanted gaps during loading processes.

8e0ae7d1a89fabf5cffb612178166e178f78221e.text: The system now recognizes specific AI models from Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic, allowing it to connect to them correctly. Previously, it only worked with one type of model and failed with others. This change is active immediately, enabling broader model support without errors.

1e992adce74376778376328e6598ac4e9fc24551.text: A minor internal fix corrected how a loading animation finds its data. Developers and automated systems will see no visible change, but the software now builds correctly.

de18ec1fd18f7a6f0ec69ada2d2ff7e091eeae40.text: The tool now shows the correct folder path after running a command. This fixes a display glitch where the path might be wrong or missing after the tool automatically moves out of the project folder. This is a small internal fix for people using the command-line tool.

3a298a3063af38830e48d23205adc3099a50da4d.text: Two internal helpers that guide the AI were adjusted for better clarity. The command checker now reads requests more distinctly, reducing mistakes in identifying runnable instructions. The documentation finder uses a confidence score instead of a simple yes/no, only fetching help if the match is strong. These changes are live and affect how accurately the AI responds to internal prompts.

c833fbf296103e4c38becfdafda2bd1f4e2dc713.text: The assistant's command runner now allows a negative timeout value to mean 'no limit,' letting long-running tasks finish without being stopped. This affects internal tooling and requires no action from end users.

47370537e59039a7686938e309adba029663853b.text: The assistant now explicitly checks its current location before running commands, preventing errors from files being in unexpected places. It also always displays the final location after a command finishes, even if it did not change. This small internal update helps the assistant navigate projects more reliably.

8944e4d9adb65742406b8730169d73d996194f1a.text: The command-line tool now strictly limits itself to one active instance. It prevents starting multiple copies, stopping them, or using it before it is ready. This protects against internal errors but does not change how you type commands or see results.

cdd32b801a6e2f5cd1a82451c79da66397a464c2.text: The internal map tool now ignores generic labels like 'toString' and 'hasOwnProperty' to prevent false matches. This small, invisible fix ensures the tool only highlights meaningful connections for internal staff.

94fca2c5be2787bd76a6a5fa20769875c89818d0.text: The internal system now supports a new set of artificial intelligence tools. This is a small technical update for the development team. Regular users will not see any changes or notice any difference in how the service works.

dab97535beb980aae0543ec87f2188ebe2172859.text: The AI assistant was instructed to stop using special symbols when naming its internal tools. This prevents the system from misreading the assistant's thoughts as commands. The change applies to the assistant's internal reasoning process. Users will not notice any difference.

f324f147c3d61a106de183afb3d912cb8e8826c6.text: The assistant's internal instructions were corrected to reflect that it stays in the same folder between steps. Previously, the guidance wrongly told the assistant to restart in the main folder for every command. This fix applies to the assistant's behavior when running tasks, though the change is small and internal.

8d1a2a56e6e78f7cdc5bbe3fe97c07056c15c2ad.text: The program now removes extra blank lines from its text output using a simpler method. This fixes a bug where hidden formatting codes caused the blank-line removal to fail, resulting in messy spacing on the screen. This change affects internal tooling and improves how the text appears when printed.

674a6f9c70795af989774417b48b98a279094a33.text: The assistant now behaves the same way in 'normal' mode as it does in 'max' mode. This means it will ask for more files at once and use a smarter, more careful thinking process when answering your questions. You will notice this immediately when using the standard settings, as the assistant will be more thorough and less likely to miss context.

b0f62ac0188835ffadd0560cd6184496fb6b40ef.text: The team cleaned up old internal notes about how the AI assistant works. This does not change how the software behaves for anyone outside the team.

0cd0f9fe6d1cc8c33de368e6e457f03b0d27a735.text: The command-line tool now remembers past questions you have typed. Next time you open it, you can press the up arrow to find and reuse an old question without retyping it. This feature is active immediately for anyone using the tool.

4b66e341afcb345b917abe363245a38b957f9f7e.text: The automated system that checks code before publishing now has permission to download a specific background tool. This change fixes a potential error during these checks. Only the internal team managing the software build will see this fix, as it ensures the checking process completes successfully.

9c136ff8f533e1e6c864ac9c92f2518d4a096941.text: Fixed a bug where colored text caused the program to miscount blank lines, leading to messy spacing on the screen. The software now correctly ignores invisible formatting codes to keep the layout tidy. This affects internal tools and is active immediately.

de5954b7c69cde46098b4cfcbab1c156dff38fd6.text: A small internal fix removes extra blank lines that sometimes appeared at the top of tool output. This affects only the text display within the application's console. Users will see cleaner, tighter formatting when these tools run.

4000dfed01964035908b4341aa76e46879891d48.text: The program now remembers how many blank lines it just printed, even when text arrives in small pieces. This stops it from accidentally deleting extra empty lines between sentences. The change affects how text looks on the screen and is live.

06514e514e06b6ce5520ad56fe10b2a3db260f85.text: The AI assistant stopped wasting time re-reading files it already saw before making edits. It also simplified how it signals complex thinking steps to the user. This internal tweak makes the assistant faster and cleaner for everyone using the tool.

e3295f45892d7484ea2ff0ad073deb8468153901.text: The system now resets its count of repeated assistant messages after logging a duration. This prevents the chat from stopping too early when it thinks it is stuck in a loop. The fix is live for internal backend processes. Non-programmers will not see any visual change, but chats will avoid premature force-stops.

fc8f626a0c035c73a506dfbc7de9d5c6182d8275.text: A small internal tool that prints recent activity logs failed when started because it lacked a required connection setup. A missing link was added to the tool's dependency list and a connection step was inserted before the log fetch. This fix applies only to that specific internal script, so external customers see no change.

4c2b80e180defef9d56598e69ed306d1176b0458.text: A new button was added to the setup menu for internal staff. It lets them test the app with maximum settings turned on. This is only for local testing and does nothing for regular users.

d222ee962475d19480a2ad8891e38e55f732da54.text: The assistant now marks files that are set to be ignored by the project's version control system with a strikethrough and a '(blocked)' label when it lists them or uses them as arguments. This helps prevent the assistant from accidentally trying to edit or read files that are meant to be hidden from the project's main history.

d6e5880d45e9f27190d0ae0cdf9bb2bee34567b8.text: The assistant now formats file-writing instructions with proper spacing, preventing accidental extra blank lines in the output. The system was also updated to ignore these stray spaces when reading back its own instructions, ensuring the final text appears clean. This change is live and affects how the assistant displays file creation tasks.

49aa0811060929487e0178db5d616ee75633f3bb.text: The command-line tool now displays a hint telling you to type 'usage' to check your remaining credits. This affects anyone using that tool. You will see this new instruction listed among the startup tips.

90d0399f625b6889db9b98bafcc916c02fdba650.text: The system now hides its internal notes about how it trims file lists to fit a limit. This change is for internal staff and affects only their diagnostic logs. They will see fewer cluttered messages in the system's record.

21cf6b6df5af6f30dafd44249d6a9db7de4163e0.text: The system now allows the AI to set a custom time limit for running commands, rather than always using a fixed default. This helps when a task needs more or less time to finish, preventing unnecessary waits or premature stops. Users might notice the AI handling long-running tasks more smoothly.

ec880a1dd15d0aa6615586739a91de5af05e6207.text: The assistant's internal instructions previously appeared as unreadable text when given as a list of items. This small backend fix ensures those instructions are formatted correctly before processing. The change affects how the system reads its own setup data, preventing confusing errors during file checks.

7ebc9b32008b647f95b706a8da52f2c6e4d57966.text: The system now allows messages that cost zero credits to be recorded accurately, instead of forcing a minimum charge of one. It also reorganized how the assistant retrieves background information, ensuring it checks for recent messages before deciding whether to stop. This internal fix prevents minor billing errors and keeps conversation state consistent for all active sessions.

15c17cc63623f76987ecc136b573e959afde121c.text: The system now shows a loading indicator when it is waiting for a response after receiving information. This change affects people using the chat interface. They will see a spinning symbol appear while the assistant is thinking, rather than a blank screen.

f80dfe5fdc45c2c5b443dff468de82ce09fac001.text: The system now packs text details together without extra blank lines. This fixes minor visual gaps when the assistant shows its work. You will see slightly tighter text in the chat window.

54f4d6eee4331aafc0f7a5b5f02c850d16a40be7.text: The automated testing setup now uses a single, reusable template to check three different parts of the software, replacing three separate, nearly identical instructions. This change affects only the internal team maintaining the tests, not the end users. If you looked at the test results, you would see the same checks running, but the underlying instructions are shorter and easier to update.

4961c59eb6ae1438ee4310cae487d456f453145f.text: The tool now quietly skips sending usage data if the network fails, instead of stopping or showing an error. This helps internal developers avoid interruptions from analytics glitches. Regular users see no change.

ac1f748be3c8bca327512edca6b8791fb8638c72.text: The server now shuts down instantly when running in a local testing environment, skipping the usual wait for background tasks to finish. This change is internal and does not affect live production systems. Developers working on their own machines will see the application close faster without waiting for data processing to complete.

24721efbb728525787f1ed097df4adcf4d24bc4f.text: The assistant now knows it must pause and wait for your reply before asking a question. Previously, it might have asked something while still working, leaving you unable to answer. This small update ensures that when the assistant asks for more information, it stops its current action so you can type your response.

32a90df39432c0ac15c70c37cf22a74ebd085a07.text: The automated check for server errors now runs up to five times if a test fails unexpectedly. This change helps prevent temporary network hiccups from falsely reporting that the software is broken. Developers will see fewer false alarms in the daily reports.

60b3ddd094e4903304071d77d15a860b267ec06a.text: The assistant now separates the folder where you are working from the main folder of your project. This prevents the tool from accidentally changing your working folder when it looks for project files. You will notice the assistant keeps your current location stable while correctly identifying the project root.

f5c4a776def8898e1d09bdab34224f3cad7f64af.text: The automated system that checks the software's health stopped trying to run failed checks multiple times. This change only affects the internal team who monitors these reports. They will see check failures appear immediately instead of waiting for repeated attempts.

a736dbec1672746654befe1978c11a7326cafe97.text: The team updated their internal testing system to handle setup tasks in one place instead of repeating them. This change only affects how developers run automated checks and does not change how the product works for customers. You would not notice any difference, as the software behaves exactly the same as before.

42df18ba747a8bf69aba435b48491419fb09caf0.text: A small internal setting was added to the automatic testing system. It tells the test environment to act like a local computer. This change only affects how tests run behind the scenes. No customers will notice any difference.

fbfe090ca925a0dacab799349a472db560fe59b3.text: Internal team change. Small automation update ensures testing tools find necessary settings before checking server code. No visible impact for regular users.

0a74a72d65db99021f323434d27f2d98fd9dcdbe.text: The internal terminal tool now loads all standard user configuration files instead of just one. This change affects only the hidden background process that powers the app's terminal features. Regular users will not see any visible difference or new buttons.

c0621152f01d986b25f56824f86778c9d2b79c0a.text: A small internal update ensures the automated setup process uses a specific command language to create configuration files. This change only affects the background systems that prepare the environment for testing. Developers will not see any visible changes in the final product.

c1ddb9e96e2cf110a689417c2c000033b5c651ab.text: Developers updated the internal safety checks that run when they test the system. These checks now prevent the testing process from accidentally recording fake activity logs. Regular users will not notice any changes, as this only helps the team keep their testing environment clean and reliable.

b5a6ece7615b0d1b6aaeddb4be7b840001c90ada.text: The internal assistant now checks if its work is complete and error-free before stopping. This applies only to specific high-cost modes. Staff using these modes will see the assistant pause to verify results, preventing it from ending a task too early.

ffba3745c455d1c6e092dc93145924b795b379c8.text: The system now stops recording extremely long internal messages earlier than before, leaving extra room in the storage limit. This change helps prevent data loss when the logging system gets full. It affects only the backend operations team, who will see fewer truncated error reports.

cffb9ee7952e9cc0c63a9e90d04f215a63b1223f.text: The software now finds the test files correctly when checking the code automatically. This affects only the internal system that reviews changes, not the people using the app. You would not notice any difference in the application itself.

7af6b743dc0413f95603a1623f6d7d5d094494e4.text: The assistant can now create a new file by replacing empty text with content. Before, it only edited existing files. This is a small internal change for the assistant's file tools.

21b1f3f3c8f37be29c6c1ec926724e8d991e9bed.text: The team fixed a small internal check to ensure their safety tests run correctly. This change is for the developers only and is live today. Regular users will not notice any difference in the application's behavior.

2f406034d08e329db06b09ad5c5d4de19000b3ed.text: The automated system that checks new code changes had trouble finding the secret keys needed to run its tests. We adjusted the timing so these keys are provided right before the checks start. This fixes the false failures that were stopping valid updates from being approved. You would only notice this if you were watching the internal approval dashboard.

3af25d94ece663073806355bac686c5a39a09884.text: Internal cleanup only. Fixed broken internal test tooling so the quality-check system runs correctly. No customer-facing changes.

a740c492bd42ed0f0c5c904d6fb31e2abd489c2e.text: Developers disabled a test setting that hid system log messages during automated checks. This internal adjustment fixes a glitch that stopped the automatic review process from passing. Regular users will not notice any change in how the application works.

bf47284e69a75ff225e82928b4f696aa72733def.text: A small internal cleanup removed a broken logging shortcut from the automated test suite. This change only affects developers running tests in the background and fixes a glitch that was making the test results show false errors. Regular users will not notice any change in how the application behaves.

9480b4e871f6de484ae769fdf0de4b96e09416fd.text: A redundant instruction was removed from an internal system that prepares work environments. This change affects only the automated setup process, not the final software features. No customers or developers will notice any difference in behavior or performance.

d249ca98604f51f4d5cfe95895e53e75d0bb62f2.text: The automated testing system now places a secure key and a special marker into a hidden configuration file before checking the software. This step happens only inside the testing environment, so it affects the internal team running the checks. Customers will not see any change, as this only helps the testing system recognize it is running automatically.

fbc8a096753bad54325f1cc4bc9006f076258f31.text: The system now automatically saves its settings before running checks. This helps the checks find the right keys to work with. It happens quietly in the background, so you will not see any change in how the app looks or behaves.

e1ccedddf7f8bbbd959245bec86e42ee1ef25f5c.text: The troubleshooting guide moved to the advanced section and now appears first. The list of supported models updated to include a new option for complex reasoning. Help pages now link directly to the troubleshooting guide, and installation instructions were simplified for easier reading.

d3bb6937fb786aa62d6009359c8dc9c9728babbc.text: A small internal update moved where secret credentials are loaded during automated testing. This change does not affect how the application looks or behaves for users. It only ensures the test environment has the right access permissions earlier in the process.

8e53414e75adaf46bb04070793ae4974de2fb498.text: A small internal adjustment now hides the technical build progress messages when starting the local development environment. This change only affects developers working on the project's internal tools. They will see a cleaner, less cluttered screen with fewer distracting lines of text.

df0ae778a478ea90641aa1c5f052b497d33f98d2.text: The system now pulls secure login details from the correct internal storage location, fixing a previous error where it looked in the wrong place. This change is internal and affects only the automated testing process. A non-programmer would notice nothing, as this ensures the automated checks run correctly behind the scenes.

5bf55e6e6fba17ba173b5625dfa23b83cdf48a3c.text: A small internal update fixes how the system checks code ownership during automated tests. Previously, tests failed because the system rejected files owned by a different user. Now, the system accepts any ownership, allowing these checks to pass. This affects only the internal testing process and is live today.

ad02e74d4a437864ede0e2836d18c669cfd73084.text: The system now automatically downloads project files before running checks. This ensures internal testing tools work correctly. It is a small background fix for developers, so regular users will not notice any changes.

b2e20ade92dc4f9ee8c1427544e14cc7621b06e4.text: The assistant now recognizes questions about itself (like 'what model are you?' or 'how many credits do I have?') and skips searching project files for answers. This makes responses to these specific queries faster and cheaper. The change is live and affects all users asking meta-questions.

6122b0d3f0fcd0f62eaf454101c219d425c15784.text: The system stopped overwriting local settings with cloud credentials during automated checks. Internal tools now only add a specific 'test mode' flag, leaving other settings alone. Developers running tests locally will see their custom configurations remain intact instead of being erased.

c77920a8ef1c614a1477afded0dfd56d546d8d56.text: When the assistant clears its memory to handle a new request, it now automatically removes hidden internal instructions from the conversation history. This prevents those invisible rules from taking up space or confusing the assistant when it tries to remember the chat. The change is live and works in the background.

cd0044041909ca7fd4d4f1d638075c808f6fd596.text: New help instructions were added for people whose software keeps trying to update itself endlessly. This happens when two different ways of installing the underlying tools clash on your computer. If you face this loop, you can now follow the guide to fix it, though the software itself did not change.

fe425a050b39b2148db349d6c9a44f8586156323.text: The terminal now tracks your current folder by checking where you ended up after running a command, instead of guessing based on what you typed. This fixes issues where moving between nested folders or using shortcuts didn't update the location correctly. If you use the terminal, you will see the correct folder path displayed after commands, ensuring tools run in the right place.

c073c689582f8fe527a1ce5850b380b1668ef96b.text: Before building the software, the system now clears its temporary memory. This prevents old, incorrect data from causing errors during the process. The change is live and ensures builds are more reliable, though users will see no visual difference.

7b8675edfd9e045a743b0344f3f62693951ad05d.text: The system now checks if test results are ready without blocking the screen, so progress appears instantly. It also stops showing error messages for missing tracking data during development tasks. This internal cleanup helps developers see real-time feedback and reduces confusing startup errors.

4952f808ccd1f6d5e854a8ad61b360d87789bfe3.text: The tool now correctly understands folder locations when you start it from a different directory. If you type a relative path like '../my-project' or a path with dots, the system converts it to the full, correct address automatically. This prevents errors where the assistant looks in the wrong place for your files. The fix is active in the current internal build.

73efb470e4f93593e2f9bd8f400ebe86c8fa9a3b.text: The team updated the internal system that automatically shares configuration files between different stages of the software testing process. This change ensures the testing pipeline continues to work correctly as the underlying platform evolves. Developers will not notice any difference in their daily work, but the automated checks will remain stable and reliable.

2d5479433a2d69e406b95892c7fff42cf1189e0f.text: The command-line tool now automatically finds your project's main folder by looking for hidden setup files, even if you start it from a subfolder. This helps the AI assistant understand exactly where it is working. You will notice the assistant gives more accurate answers about your project structure.

bd33bb2817591471616d0c0bb0c238f406e15a4e.text: The update message now starts on a new line. This separates the success notice from previous text, making it easier to read. Only people running the update command see this change.

c73ba9c9cecfba6ff7d2a41fcc55cae75a6c1336.text: A small internal update clarifies how the AI assistant finds files when saving or reading them. If a user changes their folder location in the terminal, the assistant still looks for files relative to the main project folder, not the new location. This prevents errors where the assistant tries to save a file in the wrong place.

9340aa8ca68b73cba1adfd8185376f246244084c.text: The automatic checks that run when code is submitted now split into separate, parallel tasks instead of one long sequence. This speeds up the process for the internal team by letting different parts of the system be tested at the same time. You would notice this as faster feedback on whether a recent update passed or failed.

c8793b49aaf6a5465f7e786c731bfd2a94562143.text: A small internal fix ensures that secret login details are correctly passed to each step of the automated testing process. This prevents the system from failing due to missing credentials when different tests run simultaneously. Developers will notice fewer random failures in the automated checks.

524ae7ef970e488defdd7e6bad732a5dc25c608e.text: The automated checks now create their own secure settings file in each step, instead of passing it between steps. This change affects only the internal testing process and has no visible impact on users.

9abb38de789ded530507b492056b3e4c8458bd21.text: The automated system that checks code for errors was told to look in the wrong folders. This fix makes it search the correct locations for the test files. Developers will notice the automated checks pass reliably instead of failing or skipping tests.

f297bd6a2682c32ecff3d3aa42a50dc059cb4b62.text: The automated system now checks the correct files for each project part. Before, it might have looked in the wrong folders, causing false errors or missing checks. This small fix ensures tests run accurately for the internal team.

07a1aa95a598677aba7e137356cab540c9d132c4.text: The AI assistant now sees exactly which folder it is in after running any command. This prevents it from getting lost when you ask it to do things in different places. You will notice the AI makes fewer mistakes about where files are located.

5f86cc0b645d0b2dc351bbcfb8ee562ecb4ea6f6.text: A small internal fix restores the missing step that prepares the website for release. This ensures the site can be successfully built and deployed again. Regular visitors will not notice any change, as this only affects how the website is created behind the scenes.

0af01373a44540d96bb63ceab1b83c9773e2cc87.text: Internal testing and display spacing adjustments were made. The automated checks now find all test files, and a small list in the interface ends with extra blank space. These changes are invisible to regular users.

d15034b6da24db2a43c0ad58dc9a054170a033f2.text: A small internal update to the automated testing system ensures it looks in the right folder for each part of the software before running checks. This prevents errors where the system might accidentally test the wrong component. Only the internal team building the software sees this change; customers will not notice any difference in how the product works.

c24115a5744c31d4969c262edd5a5dc8f43cf8c8.text: The automated process that checks and prepares the software for release now uses a single, simpler instruction instead of running two separate steps one after the other. This internal adjustment fixes previous failures in the release pipeline. Developers and internal teams will notice smoother, more reliable automated checks when preparing new versions.

4efb075c97ce569b18a09b1c41b89b9e159a5967.text: The team added written instructions for fixing a common computer error that stops project builds. This helps internal developers who see a 'corrupted database' message when their build tool crashes. They now know to reset the tool's memory, which fixes the problem but makes the next build slower.

ff0f818a5f7b36c0245dd26b4fcb21de9a2b09ed.text: A small internal fix is live now and improves how the app handles Windows command output. When a command is run on Windows, it now treats the repeated command text as one line and checks for the usual end-of-command sign. Windows users may see commands finish and return to the app more cleanly, without extra waiting or stuck output.

9c812f0cccc43a90ac980d4fb8b1be4f5aa8e1e1.text: A new cleanup command was added to the internal development tools. This change only affects the team building the software, not the people who use it. There is no visible change for end users.

646d88b3d86089feb284cd8d487ee97d421fbd28.text: The command line tool now hides the repetitive 'Command completed.' message to keep the screen clean. It also fixes a glitch where the input prompt appeared stuck to the previous line. This small update is live for everyone using the tool.

5d40a19f727f05e4662556e5ed26e12b0f0cb7e8.text: The tool now records when you change folders while working. It saves where you started and where you went. You will see no difference on screen, but the company can now understand how people move through files.

8f0084437aec929871d33aad9ebf12f2c43f7a2a.text: The build process for the database and billing components was updated to generate type definition files. This fixes a deployment issue for the database component. The change is internal and affects how these components are packaged for use by other parts of the system.

f3d9be4ab2418808f32e3b86cfdc3e142aff4fe2.text: The tool now stops you from moving into a folder that doesn't exist or is outside the current project, preventing errors. If you try to go outside the project, it gives you clear steps to restart in the right place instead of just failing.

82e9c61af8ea9be36de12bd77b0a472ba3d9ea7a.text: The command-line tool now remembers two separate locations: the project's main folder and the current folder you are viewing. If you navigate into a subfolder, file suggestions and prompts show paths relative to that subfolder, but the AI assistant still reads and writes files based on the main project root. This prevents path confusion when working in deep directory structures.

fafd076e9abca255e998845610be0f65bc754f61.text: A small internal fix stops the 'clean' command from failing when a specific temporary file is missing. This affects only the shared code library used by developers, not end-users. No customer-facing features or visual changes will be noticed.

00b91827ce90f96005fec1b18ed3e9b830771e9c.text: The list of shared login details for the internal Windows testing machine is now formatted with bullet points. This is a visual tidy-up for staff who need to set up their environment. The passwords and accounts themselves are unchanged.

df35f81c8ea876490887ad8cd0dee06cf11e06fd.text: The program now secretly records details about every command you type into its terminal, including whether it succeeded or failed. This change is live and affects all users of the desktop application. You will not notice any visible difference in the app's behavior, as this data is sent silently to help the developers fix bugs.

cf280d60a28f24211787a914698c7c162cab40a3.text: The internal tool that displays search results now adds extra blank lines before and after its output. This small formatting adjustment makes the text easier to read by separating the results from surrounding messages. It is live for internal users.

a61690c3d804051199037acf5a247a855d6d50fd.text: The system now records every time the AI uses a tool, including the specific details of that action. These records are sent to the analytics service immediately instead of waiting for a timer. This helps the team see exactly what the AI is doing in real time, but users will not see any change in the interface.

65e29cfe78347b1529738181d73c69f3bd02ff6b.text: The help guide now explains how to make the assistant read specific files that were previously hidden. Users who need the assistant to see a file listed in their ignore settings can follow the new examples to change this. The update is live and appears in the online FAQ.

098e5c2b9d037a2a9f83095b257cb4dcf88302f3.text: A small internal fix ensures the system correctly identifies which model to use when processing requests. This change affects only the backend logic and is live today. Users will not notice any visible difference, as the system now handles this step more reliably behind the scenes.

71f7c64f238a415c47a0fc9e6e47edcd80da98e7.text: The program now quietly records extra details about how you use it, such as which computer system you have and which specific commands you run. This information goes to the company's internal statistics team to help them understand usage patterns. You will notice absolutely no change in the app's speed, appearance, or behavior.

e50c0ec9be8ab8cef45679d5dc8821599b76d417.text: The system now quietly records a note every time it charges you for using the AI. This helps the team understand how much people spend, but you will not see any change in how the software works or looks.

2647d6cedd87720f23fb06728f0c4b5fc777d77d.text: The assistant now handles a specific fast model by sending it to a different service route. It also received stricter instructions to always show the full folder path when mentioning files. This small internal adjustment helps the assistant plan edits more accurately.

409d2537e88bd96037413785d1352cc1e3cf63d4.text: The tool now waits for the terminal to fully finish typing before saving the results. This prevents the text from getting cut off or mixed with the command itself. Internal staff running commands will see complete, clean output logs.

f39688c2cf06e27c95df5a2dd4961d44ffd21e24.text: A small internal fix adjusts how the system displays terminal commands. Previously, it tried to hide every line of a typed command, which broke when commands had multiple lines or output arrived unevenly. Now it only hides the very first line, assuming that is the command being echoed back. This change is live and affects the text shown in the terminal view.

dcddb72525a27954dfc3e28fc6e96a5196090eb7.text: A small internal update ensures old temporary files are removed before building the main application package. This prevents a rare issue where the app failed to start due to missing components. No visible changes for end-users; affects only the automated build process.

1d36564a1a9f39c10446a360ad2fb79382241380.text: Fixed a bug where typing a multi-line command into the terminal would cause the first line of actual results to disappear. This affects internal tools that run commands in the terminal. Users will now see the complete output for multi-line commands, with the typed command itself still correctly hidden.

e00056bad736316e030a36c0e5351f1c0d896d09.text: A developer removed a temporary error message that was printing random text while the system handled commands. This only affects the internal team building the software. They will no longer see that cluttered text appear in their logs.
